papers.title: From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract_en: Real-world robot deployment rarely maintains the training-stage camera setup, where cameras often experience repositioning or remounting depending on actual scenarios. Existing view-robust Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies tolerate such camera variations only when the camera extrinsics are explicitly provided, making them fragile and hard to use especially when view robustness is critical. We argue that the policy should not be told where the camera is, but rather figure it out by itself. To this end, we introduce Camera-Centric VLA (CamVLA), a new VLA model that decouples manipulation controls from camera geometry by predicting (i) a camera-centric end-effector action expressed in the local camera frame, and (ii) a 6-DoF hand-eye matrix relating cameras to the robot base. A deterministic geometric transformation composes the two predictions into a robot base-frame action. This disentangles how I should move in pose-independent camera-centric action generation from where I am looking from in camera-perspective geometric grounding. The resulting policy is calibration-free, depth-free, and single-view, requiring only a single monocular RGB image as the visual observation and task instruction at deployment. Evaluations in both simulation and real-world robot data show that CamVLA consistently improves success rates across diverse unseen viewpoints. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/CamVLA/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Camera-Centric VLA (CamVLA)，一种无需标定、深度和视角鲁棒的视觉-语言-动作模型。通过预测相机视角下的末端执行器动作和6-DoF手眼矩阵，并利用确定性几何变换得到机器人基座动作，实现从固定相机到自由相机的泛化。在仿真和真实机器人实验中，CamVLA 在多种未见过的相机视角下显著提升了任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有视角鲁棒的VLA策略要求显式提供相机外参才能应对实际部署中的相机位置变化，这限制了其鲁棒性和易用性。论文认为策略应自行推断相机位置而非被告知。
Method: CamVLA 解耦了动作生成与相机几何：预测相机坐标系下的末端执行器动作（相机中心动作）以及相机到机器人基座的6-DoF手眼矩阵，再通过确定性几何变换将两者组合为基座坐标系动作。
Result: 在仿真和真实机器人数据上，CamVLA 在多种未见过的相机视角下一致提高了任务成功率。
Conclusion: CamVLA 实现了免标定、免深度、单目RGB图像输入的视角鲁棒VLA策略，降低了实际部署中对相机配置的依赖性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Direct On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a powerful recipe for improving language-model reasoning, but it is expensive to repeat on every new strong model because the target model must generate many rollouts during training. As models scale, post-training itself becomes a bottleneck. We study a weak-to-strong alternative: run RL on a smaller model where rollouts are cheaper, then reuse what that RL run learned to improve a stronger target model. Directly distilling the post-RL weak teacher is not enough, because the teacher's final policy mixes useful RL gains with the limitations of the smaller model. We propose Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD), which transfers the teacher's RL-induced policy shift instead. Direct-OPD compares the post-RL teacher with its own pre-RL reference and treats their log-ratio as a dense implicit reward for the student. In plain terms, the checkpoint pair tells us which actions RL made the weak model more or less likely to take, and Direct-OPD applies that signal on the stronger student's own on-policy states. This directly reuses the weak model's RL supervision signal without training an explicit reward model or running sparse-reward RL on the target model. Empirically, Direct-OPD consistently leverages weaker teachers to improve stronger target models; notably, it boosts Qwen3-1.7B from 48.3% to 62.4% on AIME 2024 in just 4 hours on 8 A100 GPUs. It outperforms step-matched direct RL and enables the sequential composition of multiple policy shifts. Our results show that RL outcomes can be reused across model scales as implicit reward signals, not merely as final models to imitate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出直接在线策略蒸馏（Direct-OPD），通过将弱模型在强化学习（RL）后产生的策略偏移（log-ratio）作为隐式奖励信号，直接用于改进更强的目标模型，无需显式奖励模型或对目标模型进行稀疏奖励RL。实验表明，该方法可有效从较弱教师模型迁移RL收益，在AIME 2024上使用Qwen3-1.7B仅用4小时在8块A100上即从48.3%提升至62.4%，并支持多策略偏移的序列组合。
Motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）能有效提升语言模型推理能力，但每次对新强模型重复训练代价高昂，因为目标模型需在训练中生成大量rollout。后训练本身成为模型扩展的瓶颈。
Method: Direct-OPD：将经过RL的学生模型与其RL前的参考模型比较，将其log-ratio作为稠密隐式奖励，应用于更强目标模型自身的在线（on-policy）状态上，从而复用弱模型的RL监督信号，无需显式奖励模型或对目标模型进行稀疏奖励RL。
Result: 在AIME 2024上，Direct-OPD将Qwen3-1.7B从48.3%提升至62.4%，仅需4小时在8块A100 GPU上。性能优于步级匹配的直接RL，并支持多策略偏移的序列组合。
Conclusion: RL的结果可以作为隐式奖励信号在不同规模模型间复用，而不仅仅是作为最终模型进行模仿。Direct-OPD展示了这种跨模型尺度的RL收益迁移的有效性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Interpretable Human-Label-Free Deep Learning for Real-Bogus Classification with Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Time-domain surveys generate many transient candidates, making Real-Bogus classification a critical step in automated discovery pipelines. Reliable labels are costly, while community labels can be noisy and survey-dependent. We aim to develop a Real-Bogus classification framework that can be trained without human-labeled data using injected transients and bogus-dominated survey data, remains robust under strong class contamination, and provides calibrated uncertainty quantification. We combine simulated transient injections with a contaminated survey class and train a dual-network model using asymmetric co-teaching for classes with different label-noise levels. We evaluate performance on a benchmark subset and analyze the learned representation with latent-space visualization tools. For uncertainty quantification (UQ), we compare MC dropout and deep ensembles and propose a low-cost hybrid strategy that exploits the dual-network setting to improve calibration. We extend the evaluation to the light-curve domain to assess recovery of light-curve classes. The method achieves strong Real-Bogus performance on the labeled subset and remains stable under severe class contamination. It recovers transient light-curve classes with high fidelity, while single-source identification is limited by ambiguity in light-curve-derived labels. Our hybrid UQ approach achieves competitive calibration relative to more expensive ensemble baselines. Latent-space analyses indicate that uncertainty aligns with the decision boundary and reveal subclasses within the bogus population. Our results show that injection-driven, weakly supervised training can enable scalable and consistent Real-Bogus classification without human-labeled training data while providing calibrated uncertainties. The method is suited for transfer to forthcoming surveys by re-running the injection-based training pipeline.
papers.comment: Submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics, revised after first referee report
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需人工标注标签的深度学习框架，用于天文时域调查中的真实-虚假（Real-Bogus）分类。通过注入模拟瞬变信号并利用受污染的真实观测数据，结合非对称协同训练（asymmetric co-teaching）处理不同噪声水平，实现鲁棒分类。该方法在基准子集上表现优异，同时提供了校准的不确定性量化（MC dropout、深度集成及混合策略）。潜在空间可视化揭示虚假样本的子类结构，且方法对严重类别污染保持稳定。
Motivation: 时域调查产生大量候选瞬变源，Real-Bogus分类是自动发现流程的关键步骤。人工标注成本高且社区标签存在噪声和调查依赖性。现有方法缺乏无需人工标签且能处理严重类别污染的鲁棒框架，同时需要校准的不确定性估计。
Method: 结合模拟瞬变注入与受污染的观测数据，构建双网络模型，采用非对称协同训练（asymmetric co-teaching）处理不同标签噪声水平。对于不确定性量化（UQ），比较MC dropout和深度集成，并利用双网络设置提出低成本的混合策略以改进校准。评估扩展到光变曲线域以检验光变曲线类别的恢复能力。
Result: 在标注子集上取得强Real-Bogus性能，并在严重类别污染下保持稳定。高保真地恢复瞬变光变曲线类别，但单一源识别受光变曲线标签歧义限制。混合UQ方法在校准上达到与更昂贵的集成基线相当的效果。潜在空间分析表明不确定性对应决策边界，并揭示虚假样本内的子类。
Conclusion: 该方法表明，基于注入的弱监督训练可以在无需人工标签的情况下实现可扩展且一致的Real-Bogus分类，并提供校准的不确定性。该框架适用于未来巡天项目的转移学习。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SynCity 3000: Bootstrapping Scene-Scale 3D Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We present SynCity 3000, a framework for generating 3D scenes that are globally coherent while enabling fine-grained layout control. Building on the ability of current image-to-3D generators to produce complex 3D assets from a single image, we extend this capability to the scale of entire scenes by adapting the generator to be applicable as a convolutional operator. We achieve this by fine-tuning the model on scene-like data generated by a new synthetic data engine, which we propose to address the scarcity of 3D scene data for training. The convolutional generator is then applied to a dimetric image of the entire scene, generated from the user prompt, resulting in 3D scenes of arbitrary size and complexity. Across diverse prompts and layouts, SynCity 3000 produces large, coherent, and detailed scenes, addressing the shortcomings of prior approaches to 3D scene generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SynCity 3000 提出了一种通过微调图像到3D生成器作为卷积算子来生成大规模、全局连贯三维场景的框架。该方法利用新的合成数据引擎解决3D场景数据稀缺问题，并从用户提示生成的二轴测图（dimetric image）中产出任意大小和复杂度的3D场景。
Motivation: 现有图像到3D生成器擅长生成单个复杂3D资产，但难以扩展到整个场景，且缺乏用于训练的3D场景数据。
Method: 将图像到3D生成器微调为卷积算子，使其能应用于用户提示生成的整个场景的二轴测图，从而生成任意尺寸的3D场景。通过新的合成数据引擎生成场景级训练数据以解决数据稀缺问题。
Result: SynCity 3000 在多样化提示和布局下生成了大规模、连贯且细节丰富的3D场景，克服了先前3D场景生成方法的缺点。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了通过卷积算子扩展图像到3D生成器到场景级生成的可行性，并强调了合成数据在解决训练数据稀缺问题中的作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
papers.abstract_en: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness, we introduce LLM-as-a-Verifier, a general-purpose verification framework that provides fine-grained feedback for agentic tasks without requiring additional training. Unlike standard LM judges that prompt LLMs to produce discrete scores for candidate solutions, LLM-as-a-Verifier computes the expectation over the distribution of scoring token logits to generate continuous scores. This probabilistic formulation enables verification to scale along multiple dimensions: (1) score granularity, (2) repeated evaluation, and (3) criteria decomposition. In particular, we show that scaling the scoring granularity leads to better separation between positive and negative solutions, resulting in more calibrated comparisons. Moreover, scaling repeated evaluation and criteria decomposition consistently lead to additional gains in verification accuracy through variance and complexity reduction. We further introduce a cost-efficient ranking algorithm for selecting the best solution among candidates using the verifier's continuous scores. LLM-as-a-Verifier achieves state-of-the-art performance on Terminal-Bench V2 (86.5%), SWE-Bench Verified (78.2%), RoboRewardBench (87.4%), and MedAgentBench (73.3%). Beyond verification, the fine-grained signals from LLM-as-a-Verifier can also serve as a proxy for estimating task progress. We build an extension for Claude Code, enabling developers to monitor and improve their own agentic systems. Finally, we show that LLM-as-a-Verifier can provide dense feedback for RL, improving the sample efficiency of SAC and GRPO on robotics and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM-as-a-Verifier，一个无需额外训练的通用验证框架，通过计算评分token logits分布的期望产生连续分数，实现细粒度反馈。该框架在多个agentic任务基准上取得最先进性能，并能作为RL的密集奖励信号。
Motivation: 现有验证方法通常依赖离散评分，缺乏细粒度和可扩展性，限制了LLM在agentic任务中的验证能力。
Method: 引入连续评分机制，通过计算评分token logits的期望生成连续分数，并支持评分粒度、重复评估和标准分解三个维度的缩放。
Result: 在Terminal-Bench V2（86.5%）、SWE-Bench Verified（78.2%）、RoboRewardBench（87.4%）和MedAgentBench（73.3%）上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 验证可作为新的计算缩放轴，连续分数为agentic系统提供更精细的监控和RL训练信号。

papers.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
papers.abstract_en: Predicting object dynamics (i.e., world modeling) is a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation, and modeling deformable objects presents a particularly difficult case due to their high-dimensional state spaces and complex material properties. While current world models approach this through two distinct paradigms: learning the dynamics over the 2D pixel space or more explicit 3D geometric space. A systematic understanding of their relative strengths and limitations remains elusive due to the lack of diverse, large-scale real-world data. To address this, we present Deform360, a large-scale visuotactile dataset featuring 198 daily-life objects, 1,980 interaction sequences, and over 215 hours of observations from 41 surround-view cameras and bimanual tactile grippers to capture both global motion and contact-induced local deformations. Leveraging a novel markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline to extract dense geometry and motion, we systematically evaluate current state-of-the-art world models, comparing 2D video models against 3D particle models. Finally, we provide a preliminary demonstration indicating the real-world applicability of our dataset by performing robot planning tasks on deformable objects. Our analysis reveals key insights into the trade-offs between structural priors and scalability, providing a solid benchmark for future research in generalizable deformable object-centric world modeling. Project website: https://deform360.lhy.xyz

TL;DR: Deform360 是一个大规模多视角视觉触觉数据集，包含 198 个日常物体、1980 个交互序列和超过 215 小时的观测数据，用于建模可变形物体的动力学。数据集通过 41 个环绕摄像头和双手触觉夹爪捕捉全局运动和接触诱导的局部变形，并利用无标记视觉触觉 3D 跟踪流水线提取密集几何与运动。基于该数据集，论文系统评估了 2D 视频世界模型和 3D 粒子世界模型的性能，揭示了结构先验与可扩展性之间的权衡，并通过机器人规划任务展示了其实际应用性。
Motivation: 可变形物体的动态预测（世界建模）是机器人操作的基础挑战，但由于缺乏大规模、多样化的真实世界数据，当前 2D 像素空间和 3D 几何空间两种范式的相对优劣势难以系统理解。
Method: 构建 Deform360 数据集，涵盖 198 个日常物体、1980 个交互序列，由 41 个环绕摄像头和双手触觉夹爪采集，总计 215 小时观测。采用无标记视觉触觉 3D 跟踪流水线（markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline）提取密集几何和运动信息，并基于该数据集比较了 2D 视频模型与 3D 粒子模型。
Result: 系统评估表明，2D 视频模型和 3D 粒子模型在变形物体动态预测上各有优劣，存在结构先验与可扩展性之间的权衡；初步机器人规划任务验证了数据集的实际可用性。
Conclusion: Deform360 为可泛化的变形物体世界建模提供了坚实基准，并指出了不同建模范式在真实世界应用中的关键折中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InFlux++: Real and Synthetic Data for Estimating Dynamic Camera Intrinsics
papers.abstract_en: Camera intrinsics are vital for recovering 3D structure from 2D video. However, most 3D algorithms assume fixed intrinsics throughout a video, an assumption that often fails for real-world in-the-wild videos. Consequently, estimating per-frame intrinsics from RGB images is critical for making 3D methods robust to videos with dynamic intrinsics. InFlux previously advanced this research direction by establishing the first real-world benchmark with per-frame ground truth intrinsics for dynamic intrinsics videos. Nevertheless, existing methods remain inaccurate due to two obstacles: (i) training data is scarce and lacks intrinsics diversity; and (ii) benchmarks, including InFlux, have limited scene and camera motion diversity, making it difficult to properly evaluate methods. To address both gaps, we present InFlux++, consisting of two components. InFlux++ Synth is a large-scale procedurally generated synthetic video dataset with 441K+ annotated frames from 1841 high-resolution videos, providing accurate per-frame ground truth intrinsics for training dynamic intrinsics prediction models; a subset also includes per-frame pose, depth, and normals. The videos feature rich intrinsics diversity through changes in camera zoom and focus, as well as dynamic objects and realistic rendering effects such as lens distortion and defocus blur. InFlux++ Real is a large-scale real-world benchmark that extends InFlux with 514K+ newly captured frames across 334 high-resolution videos, spanning a wider range of scenes and camera motions. Finetuning existing intrinsics prediction methods on InFlux++ Synth consistently improves focal length estimation across both InFlux++ Real and InFlux, suggesting that synthetic supervision is promising for RGB-based intrinsics prediction. For the dataset, benchmark, code, videos, submission instructions, and live leaderboard, please visit https://influx.cs.princeton.edu/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InFlux++，包含大规模合成视频数据集 InFlux++ Synth（441K+ 标注帧，1841 个高分辨率视频）和扩展的真实世界基准 InFlux++ Real（514K+ 新帧，334 个视频），用于动态相机内参估计。合成数据提供每帧真实内参、姿态、深度和法线，并包含变焦、对焦、镜头畸变等动态效果。在合成数据上微调现有方法可一致提升焦距估计性能，表明合成监督对基于 RGB 的内参预测有前景。
Motivation: 现有方法在动态相机内参估计上精度不足，主要因为训练数据稀缺、内参多样性不足，以及基准（包括 InFlux）场景和相机运动多样性有限，难以有效评估方法。
Method: 构建 InFlux++ Synth 大规模程序化生成合成视频数据集（441K+ 帧）和 InFlux++ Real 扩展真实基准（514K+ 帧），前者提供准确的每帧内参、姿态、深度和法线，并包含变焦、对焦、动态物体及镜头畸变、散焦模糊等真实渲染效果。
Result: 在 InFlux++ Synth 上微调现有内参预测方法，在 InFlux++ Real 和 InFlux 基准上均一致提升了焦距估计的准确性。
Conclusion: 合成数据监督对基于 RGB 的动态相机内参预测有前景，InFlux++ 为相关研究提供了更丰富的数据和评估平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Search Beyond What Can Be Taught: Evolving the Knowledge Boundary in Agentic Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Visual generators excel at rendering, but they confidently fabricate what they do not know. User requests are unbounded, evolving, and deeply long-tailed: new characters, trending entities, post-cutoff events, and more. This world-knowledge bottleneck is structural: generators are trained on fixed corpora, but the visual world is open-ended. We construct SearchGen-20K and SearchGen-Bench, with 20,839 prompts spanning twelve failure categories and twenty-two domains, paired with a pre-executed multimodal SearchGen-Corpus-1M to support offline, reproducible research. On SearchGen-Bench, frontier open generators score only 21 to 28 out of 100, a 40-point collapse invisible to existing benchmarks. The natural remedy is to employ search tools, enabling agentic visual generation. However, we find that naive search fails: it retrieves indiscriminately, injecting noise into prompts the generator already handles. We trace the root cause to a generator-specific, evolving knowledge boundary: the divide between what a generator can internalize through training and what must remain in external context. Although this boundary is hard to specify in advance, we show that it is discoverable through a teach-then-search co-training framework. Even a minimal version of this co-training recipe produces monotonic improvement, laying the foundation for recursive self-improvement in visual generation that can meet world-knowledge-grounded requests. We release the full dataset, co-training corpus, and search corpus as a replayable harness for tool-augmented, world-knowledge-grounded visual generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出视觉生成模型在遇到超出其训练知识范围（如新角色、后截止日期事件等）时会自信地捏造内容，构成结构性瓶颈。作者构建了涵盖12个失败类别、22个领域、20,839条提示的SearchGen-20K基准和SearchGen-Corpus-1M语料库，发现前沿开源生成模型在该基准上得分仅为21-28/100，相比现有基准崩塌40分。通过分析发现，简单引入搜索工具无效，因为会无差别检索并注入噪声；根源在于生成器存在一个不断演化的知识边界。论文提出“教而后搜”（teach-then-search）的协同训练框架，即使最简版本也能带来单调改进，为视觉生成实现递归自我改进奠定基础。
Motivation: 视觉生成模型在处理用户提出的开放式、长尾请求（如新角色、流行实体、截止后事件）时存在结构性知识瓶颈，而现有基准无法暴露这一缺陷。
Method: 构建大规模基准SearchGen-20K（20,839条提示）和SearchGen-Bench，以及预执行的多模态搜索语料库SearchGen-Corpus-1M，并提出一个生成器特定的“教而后搜”协同训练框架，逐步发现并扩展生成器的知识边界。
Result: 在SearchGen-Bench上，前沿开源生成模型得分仅为21-28/100，较常见基准崩塌约40分；简单的搜索增强无效，而所提协同训练框架即使最简版本也能带来单调提升。
Conclusion: 生成器的知识边界虽难以预先指定，但可通过协同训练发现并扩展，为工具增强、基于世界知识的视觉生成提供可复现的研究框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Does a Discrete Diffusion Model Learn?
papers.abstract_en: What does a discrete diffusion model learn: a denoiser, a score ratio, or a bridge plug-in predictor? At the level of jump rates, these are one object in different coordinates, and reading a neural network in the wrong coordinate changes the process being trained and sampled. Starting with a rigorous derivation of the continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) ELBO for any noising process, boundary terms included, we prove the \emph{Oracle Distance} theorem: the negative ELBO is exactly equal to the data entropy plus the path KL from the oracle reverse process to the learned one, not merely a bound. Its unique optimizer is therefore the conditional expectation of the true reverse jump rate given the current noisy state, and its irreducible cost is the rate at which the forward process $Z_t$ destroys information about the clean data $Z_0$, $-\tfrac{d}{dt}I(Z_0; Z_t)$, so every noising process shares the same best achievable negative ELBO: the data entropy. For sequences with token-factorizing noise, the oracle projection yields three exact coordinates for the optimizer: denoiser, cavity (bridge plug-in), and score, with closed-form conversions among them. This framework identifies which law each loss in the literature actually optimizes, recovering MDM, UDM, SEDD, and GIDD as special cases; explains why denoiser and cavity coincide for masked diffusion but not for uniform diffusion; proves that a denoiser parameterization makes the uniform ELBO diverge at initialization while the bridge plug-in stays finite; and calibrates ELBO implementations exactly at initialization. Every identity is verified numerically, without approximation, on an exactly solvable model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上严格推导了离散扩散模型的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）ELBO，证明其负ELBO等于数据熵加上路径KL散度，最优解是真实反向跳转率在给定噪声状态下的条件期望，并且所有加噪过程的最佳负ELBO相同（数据熵）。对于序列的token分解噪声，优化器有三种等价坐标形式（去噪器、空穴预测器、分数），并给出了它们之间的显式转换。该框架统一了MDM、UDM、SEDD、GIDD等现有模型，解释了掩码扩散与均匀扩散的差异，并证明均匀扩散的去噪器参数化在初始化时ELBO发散而空穴预测器保持有限。所有结论在精确可解模型上进行了数值验证。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散模型的损失函数形式多样，但缺乏统一的理论理解——不同参数化（去噪器、分数比、桥接预测器）实际上对应同一对象的不同坐标，错误选择坐标会导致训练和采样的流程出错。本文旨在澄清这些关系，并推导离散扩散模型学习的本质。
Method: 从连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）ELBO的严格推导出发，包含边界项；证明Oracle Distance定理：负ELBO精确等于数据熵加路径KL散度，其唯一优化器是真实反向跳转率关于当前噪声状态的条件期望。对于token因子化噪声，给出优化器的三种精确坐标（去噪器、空穴预测器、分数）及其闭式转换。
Result: 证明所有加噪过程的最佳负ELBO相等（数据熵）；标识出现有损失函数各自优化的真实律（MDM、UDM、SEDD、GIDD为特例）；解释为什么去噪器和空穴预测器在掩码扩散中相同但在均匀扩散中不同；证明均匀扩散中去噪器参数化导致ELBO在初始化时发散而空穴预测器有限；在精确可解模型上数值验证所有恒等式无近似。
Conclusion: 离散扩散模型学习的是条件期望形式的反向跳转率，不同参数化在理论上是等价的但实践行为不同；理论框架可指导选择参数化和校准ELBO实现，并揭示信息论下界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TabPack: Efficient Hyperparameter Ensembles for Tabular Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: In deep learning for tabular data, efficient ensembles of multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) have recently emerged as effective and practical architectures. Existing methods of this kind use the same hyperparameters for all underlying MLPs, which requires hyperparameter tuning for achieving the best performance. In this work, we introduce TabPack, an efficient MLP ensemble with strong out-of-the-box performance and reduced reliance on traditional tuning. In a single run, TabPack samples and trains many MLPs with different hyperparameters efficiently in parallel and selects ensemble members on the fly during training. Thus, TabPack only requires specifying ranges from which to sample MLP hyperparameter rather than exact hyperparameter values, which naturally demands less precision for good performance. In experiments on medium-to-large public datasets, TabPack with default settings performs on par with extensively tuned prior methods, thus substantially reducing effort and compute resources needed to achieve competitive results on tabular tasks. Notably, running the default TabPack configuration on a modern MacBook took less time than tuning some baselines on an industry-grade GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TabPack，一种用于表格数据的高效多层感知机集成方法。它在单次运行中并行采样并训练多个具有不同超参数的 MLP，并在训练过程中动态选择集成成员，从而大幅减少超参数调优需求。实验表明，TabPack 的默认配置在中等规模到大规模公共数据集上性能与经过大量调优的先前方法相当，且计算资源消耗更低。
Motivation: 现有高效 MLP 集成为所有底层网络使用相同的超参数，需额外调优才能达到最优性能。TabPack 旨在降低调优负担，提供即开即用的强性能。
Method: TabPack 在单次运行中并行采样并训练大量超参数各异的 MLP，并在训练过程中动态选择集成成员。用户仅需指定超参数采样范围，而非精确值。
Result: 在中等至大规模公共数据集上，TabPack 默认配置与经过广泛调优的先前方法性能相当；默认配置在 MacBook 上的运行时间少于部分基线方法在专业 GPU 上的调优时间。
Conclusion: TabPack 显著减少了在表格任务上取得竞争性结果所需的努力和计算资源，特别适合非专家用户。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 TabPack，一种用于表格数据的高效多层感知机集成方法。它在单次运行中并行采样并训练多个具有不同超参数的 MLP，并在训练过程中动态选择集成成员，从而大幅减少超参数调优需求。实验表明，TabPack 的默认配置在中等规模到大规模公共数据集上性能与经过大量调优的先前方法相当，且计算资源消耗更低。

summary_sections.method: TabPack 在单次运行中并行采样并训练大量超参数各异的 MLP，并在训练过程中动态选择集成成员。用户仅需指定超参数采样范围，而非精确值。

papers.title: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agentic LLMs are increasingly limited by finite context windows, as extended interaction trajectories can exceed the maximum context length before a task is completed. Context compaction offers a natural solution by summarizing previous interaction states and continuing the rollout under a compressed context, but incorporating compaction into reinforcement learning remains underexplored. We propose CompactionRL, a reinforcement learning strategy to train long-horizon agentic LLMs with context compaction. Our approach jointly optimizes task execution and summary generation with token-level loss normalization and cross-trajectory generalized advantage estimation. This design enables the LLM agents to learn from compacted long-horizon trajectories. We train CompactionRL on top of open models and observe consistent performance gains on agentic coding tasks. CompactionRL enables the open GLM-4.5-Air model (106B-A30B) to achieve Pass@1 scores of 66.8% on SWE-bench Verified and 24.5% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, with absolute gains of 7.0 and 3.1 points, respectively. Built upon GLM-4.7-Flash (30B-A3B), CompactionRL improves Pass@1 by 5.5 and 6.8 points, reaching 56.0% on SWE-bench Verified and 20.2% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, respectively. CompactionRL is thus deployed in the RL pipeline for training the open GLM-5.2 model (750B-A40B).

papers.title: Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: While recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise toward generalist manipulation policies, they struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their Markovian nature-relying solely on current observations. Hierarchical dual-system methods address this but suffer from a gap between high-level planning semantics and low-level execution kinematics. We introduce Cortex, a bidirectionally aligned embodied agent framework with a customized planning interface that conveys executable and tractable subtask plans from high-level VLM to low-level VLA. Specifically, we standardize manipulation subtasks into 32 canonical skill primitives and inject tractability principles, such as representative object attributes and improved trajectory reachability, into the data generation pipeline. This enables automatic annotation of over 4k hours of open-source video data and generation of 30 hours of simulation data. We further devise an event-balanced sampling strategy to construct training data for fine-tuning the framework to better handle planning ambiguity during subtask transitions, enhanced by carefully designed harness engineering from task contexts to skill constraints during inference. Both open-loop VLM and closed-loop system evaluations demonstrate Cortex's efficacy, e.g., it outperforms monolithic baselines by 3.1% on Libero-long and 4.1% on RoboTwin. Notably, Cortex's generalist VLM enables zero-shot completion of unseen real-world long-horizon tasks, such as multi-stage chemistry experiments, by simply combining with a fine-tuned VLA-a capability infeasible through VLA fine-tuning alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cortex，一个双向对齐的具身智能体框架，通过标准化32种技能原语和可执行性注入，弥合高层次规划与低层执行之间的鸿沟，使VLM能处理长时域操作任务。在Libero-long和RoboTwin上分别提升3.1%和4.1%，并支持零样本完成未见过的真实世界长时域任务。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型因马尔可夫性难以完成长时域任务；层次化双系统方法存在高层规划语义与低层执行运动学之间的鸿沟。
Method: 提出Cortex框架，包括标准化32种规范技能原语（skill primitives），注入可执行性原则（代表性物体属性、改善轨迹可达性）到数据生成流程，自动标注4k小时开源视频和30小时模拟数据，采用事件平衡采样策略训练，以及推理时从任务上下文到技能约束的工程引导。
Result: 在Libero-long上超过单体基线3.1%，在RoboTwin上提升4.1%；通用VLM结合微调VLA可实现零样本多阶段化学实验等真实世界任务。
Conclusion: 通过双向对齐和定制规划接口，有效弥合高层规划与低层执行之间的差距，使长时域操作任务得以实现，且通用VLM可零样本适应新任务。

papers.title: MV-Forcing: Long Multi-View Video Generation via 4D-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Self-Forcing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled either long single-view generation through temporal autoregression, or short multi-view synthesis through bidirectional attention. However, generating long, multi-view consistent videos of dynamic scenes remains unsolved. In this work, we present MV-Forcing, a framework that composes temporal and view-wise autoregression within a single diffusion model by introducing a 4D geometric bridge between sequentially generated views. Our key insight is that an autoregressive 3D reconstruction model naturally interfaces between autoregressively generated views. Given a completed source view, we reconstruct its 3D structure and render a geometric prior of the next target viewpoint, which the diffusion model refines into a high-quality video. To extend generation beyond the teacher's fixed temporal window, we introduce a joint denoising regime where both view slots are initialized from noise during training, enabling temporally unbounded generation. We distill the model via Distribution Matching Distillation with Spatio-Temporal Self-Forcing, closing the train-inference exposure bias gap for both temporal and view-sequential autoregression. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that MV-Forcing produces geometrically consistent multi-view videos of dynamic scenes at arbitrary lengths and viewpoint counts using a single few-step student model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MV-Forcing 框架，通过 4D 几何桥梁连接时间自回归和视图自回归，实现单扩散模型生成长序列多视角一致动态视频。关键思想是使用自回归 3D 重建模型生成几何先验，再由扩散模型细化；通过联合去噪训练和分布匹配蒸馏实现无界时空生成。实验表明该方法能在少量推理步骤下生成任意长度和视角数的几何一致多视角视频。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型要么能生成长单视角视频（时间自回归），要么能生成短多视角视频（双向注意力），但无法同时生成长序列且多视角一致、动态场景的视频。
Method: 提出 4D 几何桥接：利用自回归 3D 重建模型从已生成源视图恢复 3D 结构，渲染目标视角的几何先验，由扩散模型精化为高质量视频。训练时采用联合去噪（两个视图槽均从噪声初始化）实现时间无界生成，并通过时空自强迫分布匹配蒸馏（Spatio-Temporal Self-Forcing）缩小训练-推理暴露偏差。最终模型为少步学生模型。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上实验表明，MV-Forcing 能生成任意长度和任意视角数的几何一致多视角动态视频，且仅需单次少步推理。
Conclusion: 该方法通过自回归 3D 重建模型桥接多视角与时间维度的自回归生成，结合分布匹配蒸馏，有效解决了长序列多视角一致视频生成的难题。

papers.title: Fitted Occupancy-Ratio Evaluation without Bellman Completeness
papers.abstract_en: Occupancy ratios correct distribution shift in offline reinforcement learning and are central to off-policy evaluation. Existing primal-dual and minimax methods typically estimate these ratios by enforcing occupancy-balance moments over a critic class. We propose fitted occupancy-ratio evaluation (FORE), a fitted fixed-point method that characterizes the discounted occupancy ratio through an adjoint Bellman recursion. At each iteration, FORE solves a single-level density-ratio objective on one-step-transition data, thereby projecting the adjoint Bellman image onto a log-ratio class in Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence. Unlike analyses of fitted Q-evaluation, which typically require value-function realizability together with Bellman completeness or projected-operator stability, our central approximation condition is just realizability of the discounted occupancy ratio itself. Under this condition, the population KL-projected recursion contracts in relative entropy toward the true ratio by virtue of the adjoint Bellman operator being a KL-contraction. For the empirical recursion, we establish finite-sample regret bounds that yield convergence in KL up to log-ratio approximation error and a statistical error governed by the complexity of the ratio hypothesis class. The fitted ratio supports direct value estimation by reward reweighting, occupancy-weighted fitted Q-evaluation, and doubly robust estimation that combines the fitted ratio with a fitted Q-function. Together, these results identify discounted occupancy-ratio realizability as a sufficient condition for offline policy evaluation without any completeness assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出拟合占用率评估（FORE），一种不需要Bellman完备性假设的离线策略评估方法。FORE通过对偶Bellman递归和KL散度投影，仅需折扣占用率本身的可实现性，即可保证种群级相对熵收缩和有限样本遗憾界。该方法支持直接价值估计、占用率加权拟合Q评估和双重稳健估计。
Motivation: 现有off-policy评估方法（如primal-dual和minimax方法）通常需要Bellman完备性假设，这在实际中难以满足。本文旨在寻找更弱的充分条件，即仅依赖折扣占用率的可实现性。
Method: 提出拟合占用率评估（FORE），一种拟合不动点方法。通过将对偶Bellman算子应用于占用率，并在每次迭代中将邻接Bellman图像投影到对数比率类上（最小化KL散度），从而形成单层密度比目标。该方法不需要值函数可实现性或Bellman完备性，仅需占用率本身的可实现性。
Result: 在种群级别，KL投影递归在相对熵下收缩到真实占用率；在经验级别，建立了有限样本遗憾界，收敛速度取决于对数比率近似误差和假设类的复杂度。实验暂未提及。
Conclusion: 折扣占用率的可实现性是离线策略评估的充分条件，无需任何完备性假设。FORE的拟合比值可直接用于奖励加权、占用率加权FQE和双重稳健估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PixWorld: Unifying 3D Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Pixel Space
papers.abstract_en: 3D reconstruction and generation are commonly tackled by separate paradigms: pixel-based regression for reconstruction, and latent diffusion for generation. Recent works attempt to unify them in latent space, but with notable drawbacks: the diffusion objective is defined on latent features rather than the underlying 3D representation, and both branches suffer from information loss introduced by latent encoding, while requiring a pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) or Representation Autoencoder (RAE). In this paper, we reformulate these two tasks under a unified pixel-space diffusion paradigm and introduce PixWorld, a single model that jointly addresses 3D reconstruction and generation. By supervising diffusion directly on rendered images, PixWorld removes the above limitations and aligns optimization with 3D scene fidelity. Beyond photometric and perceptual supervision that operates at the 2D image level and lacks 3D geometric awareness, we further introduce a geometry perception loss that aligns rendered views with their ground truth in the geometry-aware feature space of a pretrained 3D foundation model, providing 3D structural supervision. PixWorld consistently outperforms prior latent-space generation methods and matches state-of-the-art reconstruction methods, demonstrating the superiority of a unified pixel-space approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PixWorld，一个在像素空间统一处理 3D 场景生成与重建的扩散模型。通过对渲染图像直接进行扩散监督，避免潜在空间方法的信息损失和预训练 VAE/RAE 依赖，并引入几何感知损失以提升三维结构一致性。该方法在生成任务上优于潜在空间方法，在重建任务上与最先进方法持平。
Motivation: 现有 3D 重建和生成通常分别采用像素回归和潜在扩散，统一方法在潜在空间中存在扩散目标与 3D 表示脱节、信息损失及依赖预训练自编码器的问题。
Method: 将两个任务统一为像素空间扩散范式，扩散目标直接定义在渲染图像上；额外设计几何感知损失，利用预训练 3D 基础模型的几何感知特征对齐渲染视图与真实视图。
Result: 在生成任务上持续优于先前潜在空间方法，在重建任务上达到与最先进方法相当的性能。
Conclusion: 像素空间统一方法能克服潜在空间的局限性，提升 3D 场景的保真度和几何一致性。

summary_sections.result: 在生成任务上持续优于先前潜在空间方法，在重建任务上达到与最先进方法相当的性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 像素空间统一方法能克服潜在空间的局限性，提升 3D 场景的保真度和几何一致性。

papers.title: GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks
papers.abstract_en: For robots to work reliably in commercial and industrial applications, can recent advances in agentic coding systems combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model-free policies? We focus on "Variational Automation" (VA), a class of tasks that have larger variations in object geometry and pose than fixed automation. Model-free policies often struggle to close the reliability gap for VA tasks, which must be executed persistently and reliably in commercial and industrial applications. Motivated by prior work on Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) and the Robot Operating System (ROS), we introduce Graph-as-Policy (GaP), a multi-agent coding harness that generates directed computation graphs with perception, planning, and control nodes from a Modular Open Robot Skill Library (MORSL). GaP then generates an internal simulation environment to rehearse task instances with different graphs in parallel to iteratively refine the graph structure and parameters to improve success rates and throughput. Evaluation with 8 new open VA task benchmarks, 4 in-simulation and 4 in real-world, suggests that GaP can achieve success rates that significantly outperform baselines. Details, code, and data can be found online: https://graph-robots.github.io/gap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对变分自动化（VA）任务（物体几何和位姿变化较大的工业任务），提出Graph-as-Policy (GaP)多智能体编码框架。GaP从模块化开放机器人技能库（MORSL）生成有向计算图，包含感知、规划和控制节点，并通过内部模拟环境并行排练不同图实例，迭代优化图结构和参数以提高成功率和吞吐量。在8个新的VA任务基准（4个仿真+4个真实）上，GaP显著优于基线方法。
Motivation: 模型无关策略在商业和工业应用中难以弥合VA任务的可靠性差距，而固定自动化无法适应开放世界变化。现有方法如任务与运动规划（TAMP）和ROS虽可解释但缺乏自适应性。需要一种结合可解释编程和模型无关策略开放世界适应性的方法。
Method: 提出Graph-as-Policy (GaP)框架，包含：(1) 从模块化开放机器人技能库（MORSL）生成有向计算图，节点为感知、规划和控制模块；(2) 内部模拟环境，并行排练不同图实例；(3) 迭代优化图结构和参数（通过模拟结果反馈），以提升成功率和吞吐量。
Result: 在8个新开放的VA任务基准（4个仿真、4个真实环境）上，GaP实现了显著优于基线的成功率。
Conclusion: GaP通过将机器人编程表示为可优化的计算图，结合模拟排练，为VA任务提供了一种可解释且自适应的解决方案。论文开源了代码和数据。

papers.title: SPEARBench: A Benchmark for Naturalness Evaluation in Streaming Speech-to-Speech Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Streaming speech-to-speech language models aim to answer spoken queries directly with synthetic speech. However, standard speech and text benchmarks do not capture whether these systems behave naturally in conversations, where timing, turn-taking, prosody, interpersonal stance, language and dialect consistency, and relationship-aware appropriateness jointly shape perceived quality. We introduce SPEARBench, a benchmark for evaluating naturalness in speech-to-speech language models from question-answer interactions. SPEARBench constructs controlled dialogue prompts from the Seamless Interaction corpus, runs inference across multiple models, and evaluates generated answers using a multidimensional protocol that covers response latency, interruptions, speech quality, ASR robustness, language and dialect consistency, emotional naturalness, interpersonal stance, and explainable distributional baselines. The benchmark includes original human answers as a reference condition and reports results for several contemporary models. Results show that current models can achieve high signal-level quality and low ASR error while still differing from human conversational behavior in latency, overlap, dialect preservation, emotional adaptation, and interpersonal stance dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPEARBench是一个评估流式语音到语音语言模型在对话中自然度的基准。它从Seamless Interaction语料库构建受控对话提示，对多个模型进行推理，并使用多维协议评估生成回答，涵盖响应延迟、中断、语音质量、ASR鲁棒性、语言和方言一致性、情感自然度、人际立场和可解释的分布基线。结果显示当前模型在信号级质量和ASR错误率上表现良好，但在延迟、重叠、方言保留、情感适应和人际立场动态方面与人类对话行为存在差异。
Motivation: 现有的语音和文本基准无法捕捉语音到语音系统在对话中是否表现自然，而自然度由时机、话轮转换、韵律、人际立场、语言和方言一致性以及与关系相关的恰当性共同决定。
Method: SPEARBench从Seamless Interaction语料库构建受控对话提示，对多个模型进行推理，并使用多维协议评估生成回答，包括响应延迟、中断、语音质量、ASR鲁棒性、语言和方言一致性、情感自然度、人际立场和可解释的分布基线，并将原始人类回答作为参考条件。
Result: 当前模型能够实现高信号级质量和低ASR错误，但在延迟、重叠、方言保留、情感适应和人际立场动态方面与人类对话行为存在差异。
Conclusion: SPEARBench揭示了现有流式语音到语音模型在自然度方面的不足，特别是在对话动态方面的差距。

papers.title: REDDIT: Correcting Model-Generated Timestamp Drift in ASR without Forgetting via Replay-Based Distribution Editing
papers.abstract_en: Modern autoregressive ASR systems can emit timestamps as decoded tokens, enabling timestamped transcription without frame-level aligners or inference-time post-processing. We show that these generated timestamps can drift across long non-speech spans: the transcript may remain plausible, but the decoded time axis drifts away from the audio. We study this non-speech-induced timestamp drift with self-built gap and long-gap benchmarks across 15 evaluated timestamp-producing ASR and audio-language systems. Naive timestamp-corrected fine-tuning improves alignment but can severely degrade non-target ASR behavior, exposing a forgetting problem. We propose REDDIT(REplay-based Distribution eDITing), a lightweight two-stage post-training framework that corrects timestamps while avoiding this catastrophic forgetting: it first edits timestamp targets under the model's own replayed decoder context while matching the frozen base distribution on non-timestamp tokens, then applies a short edited-prefix refinement stage. In this framework, we construct correction supervision without human transcripts or human timestamp annotations by combining VAD-trimmed speech spans with inserted non-speech gaps and known concatenation offsets. On Whisper-tiny, 34.9 hours of targeted correction audio used and only 1.6% of model parameters updated, raising long-gap mIoU from 38.7% to 95.0% and reducing mixed-gap out-of-domain AAS from 2752 ms to 223 ms while preserving CV-en MER at 41.3% (versus 524.2% for ordinary SFT decoder tuning).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现自回归ASR系统生成的解码时间戳在长非语音段存在漂移，提出REDDIT（基于重放的分布编辑）轻量级两阶段后训练框架，通过模型自身解码上下文编辑时间戳目标，避免灾难性遗忘。在Whisper-tiny上仅用34.9小时音频、更新1.6%参数，将长间隔mIoU从38.7%提升至95.0%，混合间隔域外AAS从2752ms降至223ms，同时保持CV-en MER为41.3%。
Motivation: 现有ASR时间戳生成在长非语音段漂移，而简单时间戳修正微调会严重破坏非目标ASR行为，导致遗忘问题。
Method: 提出REDDIT框架，包含两阶段：第一阶段在模型自身重放解码器上下文下编辑时间戳目标，同时匹配冻结基分布的非时间戳令牌输出；第二阶段进行简短编辑前缀微调。通过VAD裁剪语音段、插入非语音间隙和已知连接偏移构造修正监督，无需人工标注。
Result: 在Whisper-tiny上，使用34.9小时目标修正音频，仅更新1.6%参数，长间隔mIoU从38.7%升至95.0%，混合间隔域外AAS从2752ms降至223ms，CV-en MER保持41.3%（普通SFT解码器调优为524.2%）。
Conclusion: REDDIT能有效修正ASR时间戳漂移且避免灾难性遗忘，所需数据量和参数更新极少。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SovereignPA-Bench: Evaluating User-Owned Personal Agents under Evolving Intent, Platform Mediation, and Consent Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents are becoming persistent user-owned intermediaries: they remember preferences, filter platform-mediated information, use tools, and negotiate with services. Existing benchmarks evaluate tool use, web navigation, desktop control, personalization, recommendation, and evolving context, but rarely ask whether an agent preserves user sovereignty: advancing the user's current interests while respecting privacy, consent, evidence, user burden, and resistance to manipulative incentives. We introduce SovereignPA-Bench, an executable benchmark for evaluating user-owned personal agents under evolving intent, platform mediation, privacy boundaries, consent constraints, evidence requirements, and burden tradeoffs. The benchmark separates agent-visible ObservableState from evaluator-only HiddenLabels, reports component metrics for task success, alignment, privacy, consent, evidence, manipulation, burden, and auditability, and preserves paired scenario ordering for model and policy comparisons. We evaluate 120 sovereignty stress scenarios across 4 model families and 8 policy baselines, yielding 3,840 frozen-prompt trajectories with raw prompts, outputs, provider-form responses, parsed actions, recomputable metrics, hard-set analyses, qualitative cases, and a blinded 3-annotator audit over 240 items. Full-sovereign scaffolding improves sovereignty score over direct, memory-only, consent-only, evidence-only, ReAct/tool-use, safety-prompt, and judge-guard baselines while reducing privacy leakage, consent violation, over-concession, and manipulation capture. Human audit shows high agreement on privacy and consent and lower agreement on manipulation, identifying the subjective frontier of platform-persuasion judgments. These results show that personal-agent evaluation must move beyond task completion toward representative, consent-aware, evidence-grounded action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SovereignPA-Bench，一个可执行的基准测试，用于评估用户拥有的个人代理在演变意图、平台中介、隐私边界、同意约束、证据要求和负担权衡下的表现。基准分离可观察状态和隐藏标签，报告多组件指标，并在4个模型家族和8个策略基线上评估120个压力场景，生成3840条轨迹。实验表明，完全主权脚手架在主权的各方面优于多种基线，人工审计显示隐私和同意一致性高，操纵一致性低。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估工具使用、网页导航、桌面控制、个性化等，但忽略了用户主权（隐私、同意、证据、负担、抗操纵）这一关键维度，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出 SovereignPA-Bench，包含120个压力场景，每个场景分离可观察状态和隐藏标签；评估4个模型家族和8个策略基线（包括直接、仅记忆、仅同意、仅证据、ReAct/工具使用、安全提示、裁判防护及完全主权脚手架），产生3840条冻结提示轨迹，并配有原始提示、输出、解析动作、可重计算指标及240个项目的三人盲审审计。
Result: 完全主权脚手架在主权的综合得分上显著优于所有基线，降低了隐私泄露、同意违规、过度让步和操纵捕获；人工审计显示隐私和同意的一致性高（同意一致性较低），表明操纵判断存在主观前沿。
Conclusion: 个人代理的评估必须超越简单的任务完成，转向代表性、同意感知、基于证据的行动，以保障用户主权。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Sparse Sampling: Breaking the Curse of the Horizon in Continuous MDP Planning
papers.abstract_en: Planning under uncertainty in continuous domains is essential for autonomous systems, yet computationally demanding. Tree-based search methods such as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) remain popular, but their branching structure can require sampling budgets that grow exponentially with lookahead depth in the worst case. From a tree perspective, continuous state or action spaces become especially challenging, since the planner must decide where to search in an infinite branching hierarchy. We propose Graph Sparse Sampling (GSS), an online planning algorithm that shares sampled futures across many candidate decisions, rather than sampling separate successors for each candidate action. This branch-free graph exposes large GPU-friendly batches, while using heuristics to focus computation. We prove finite-sample performance guarantees for GSS covering full-rank or low-rank generative simulators via smoothed backups, and discrete or sampled continuous action spaces. Under suitable overlap, regularity, and action-coverage conditions, these bounds have polynomial dependence on the planning horizon, formalizing when shared futures can avoid the exponential horizon dependence of tree-shaped sparse sampling. We demonstrate continuous-control simulations where GSS substantially outperforms tree-based planners on long horizons or achieves near-optimal performance, supporting no-branching graph planning as a complementary design principle for online control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Graph Sparse Sampling (GSS)算法，用于连续状态/动作空间的在线规划。GSS通过跨候选决策共享采样路径，避免树形搜索的指数分支增长，并利用启发式聚焦计算资源。理论证明了有限样本性能保证，并在连续控制仿真中展示了在长时域上优于基于树的规划器。
Motivation: 连续空间中的规划面临树形搜索采样预算随搜索深度指数增长的挑战，现有的MCTS等方法在长时域下计算昂贵。
Method: 提出GSS算法，采用无分支的图结构，共享采样未来路径，利用GPU批量处理，并引入启发式聚焦计算。理论上证明了在合适的覆盖、正则性和动作覆盖条件下，采样复杂度关于规划时域呈多项式依赖。
Result: 在连续控制仿真中，GSS在长时域上显著优于基于树的规划器，或达到接近最优性能。
Conclusion: 无分支图规划可以作为在线控制的一种互补设计原则，打破了树形稀疏采样中时域指数的诅咒。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出GSS算法，采用无分支的图结构，共享采样未来路径，利用GPU批量处理，并引入启发式聚焦计算。理论上证明了在合适的覆盖、正则性和动作覆盖条件下，采样复杂度关于规划时域呈多项式依赖。
summary_sections.result: 在连续控制仿真中，GSS在长时域上显著优于基于树的规划器，或达到接近最优性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 无分支图规划可以作为在线控制的一种互补设计原则，打破了树形稀疏采样中时域指数的诅咒。

papers.title: ReCal3R: Reliability-Calibrated Learning Rates for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Streaming 3D reconstruction relies on a compact recurrent scene state to process long image streams in linear time and bounded memory. However, repeated updates can gradually corrupt this state, causing reliable historical information to be overwritten by noisy or ambiguous observations. We introduce ReCal3R, a reliability-calibrated learning rate method for recurrent 3D reconstruction. Instead of directly applying a candidate learning rate, our method estimates state token reliability from the maintained scene state and uses it to calibrate a candidate learning rate derived from token alignment, state reconstruction residual, and recent update pressure. The resulting token-wise learning rate interpolates between a conservative base rate and the candidate rate, suppressing aggressive updates on unreliable tokens while preserving adaptation to informative frames. Applied to CUT3R as a training-free calibration rule, ReCal3R reaches strong performance on long sequences in pose, depth, and reconstruction quality, including a 3.7$\times$ reduction in ATE, with comparable runtime and memory. Code is available at: https://github.com/Powertony102/ReCal3R.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReCal3R，一种针对流式3D重建的可靠性校准学习率方法。通过从场景状态估计token可靠性，校准候选学习率，从而抑制不可靠token的激进更新，保留对信息帧的适应能力。在CUT3R上应用后，长序列的姿态、深度和重建质量均提升，ATE降低3.7倍。
Motivation: 流式3D重建中，重复更新会逐渐腐蚀紧凑循环场景状态，导致可靠历史信息被噪声或模糊观测覆盖。
Method: 提出可靠性校准学习率方法ReCal3R：从维护的场景状态估计token可靠性，用于校准由token对齐、状态重建残差和近期更新压力导出的候选学习率；最终生成token-wise学习率，在保守基率和候选率之间插值。
Result: 在CUT3R上作为免训练校准规则，长序列姿态、深度和重建质量显著提升，ATE降低3.7倍，运行时间和内存相当。
Conclusion: ReCal3R通过校准学习率有效防止历史信息被覆盖，且作为训练无关插件易于集成，但方法仅在CUT3R上验证，泛化性待探索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Faithfulness to Refusal: A Causal Audit of Neuron Selectors
papers.abstract_en: Attribution scores increasingly identify which neuron rows of a language model matter for applications such as pruning, interpretability, and editing for safety, yet whether they identify causally important rows is rarely tested directly. We address this with two paired audits built on one-shot neuron-row zeroing. We first audit selectors at the language-modeling level: attribution methods substantially outperform activation and magnitude-based baselines at identifying dispensable rows across five LLMs. We then adapt the same intervention into a behavior test by driving it with a contrastive harmful-versus-benign signal; the attributed rows are sufficient to install refusal on hate and crime while keeping benign over-refusal low and preserving language model fluency, and specific in that layer-matched random controls at the same depths fail. Highly rank-stable selectors can be among the least causally valid. Refusal moreover lives in a redundant subspace, where different attribution methods install it through largely disjoint row sets, so the recovered edit is one realization of a sufficient set rather than a unique mechanism. Together, these findings show that rank-stability proxies miss the kinds of selector failures a direct causal audit can surface.%
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过单次神经元行归零审计，检验语言模型中归因分数是否能识别出因果重要的神经元行。在五个LLM上，归因方法在识别可丢弃行方面优于激活和幅度基线；进一步将同一干预改编为行为测试，发现归因行足以安装拒绝机制（对仇恨和犯罪内容），同时保持低良性过度拒绝和语言模型流畅性，且具有层匹配特异性。高排名稳定的选择器因果效度低，且拒绝行为存在于冗余子空间，不同归因方法通过不相交的行集实现。
Motivation: 归因分数广泛用于识别语言模型中重要神经元行（如剪枝、可解释性、安全编辑），但其因果重要性很少被直接测试。
Method: 提出两个配套审计，均基于单次神经元行归零：语言建模层面审计（比较归因方法与激活、幅度基线识别可丢弃行的能力）和行为测试层面审计（通过对比有害-良性信号驱动干预，检验归因行是否足以安装拒绝行为）。
Result: 归因方法在五个LLM上识别可丢弃行时显著优于基线；归因行足以安装对仇恨和犯罪的拒绝，同时保持低良性过度拒绝和语言模型流畅性，且层匹配随机对照失败；高排名稳定性的选择器因果效度可能较低；拒绝行为存在于冗余子空间，不同归因方法使用大部分不相交的行集。
Conclusion: 排名稳定性代理（如rank-stability）无法捕获直接因果审计所能揭示的选择器失败，直接因果审计对于评估归因分数有效性至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Reciprocity: Unlocking Self-Supervision for Stereoscopic Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Monocular-to-stereo conversion synthesizes stereoscopic content from 2D videos for immersive 3D experiences. In modern Depth-Image-Based Rendering (DIBR) approaches, stereo inpainting of disocclusions is the critical bottleneck. Training-based methods achieve superior quality but rely on scarce stereo pairs or synthetic data with domain gaps. We address this through the first self-supervised framework learning from monocular videos via cycle consistency. Our key contribution is the Geometric Reciprocity Theorem (GRT): under the nearest-neighbor DIBR formulation, the disocclusion mask when synthesizing a target view equals the mask of pixels lost when warping back from target to source, enabling analytical computation of test-time disocclusion masks directly from monocular images. This yields train-test consistency for the stated warping formulation, supporting self-supervised learning from unlimited monocular videos and substantial improvements over training-free and supervised state-of-the-art methods. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/grt/
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/grt/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个从单目视频自监督学习立体视频生成的方法，核心贡献是几何互易定理(GRT)。该定理在最近邻深度图像渲染(DIBR)框架下，使得测试时遮挡掩码可以从单目图像解析计算，从而支持自监督学习，实现训练-测试一致性。在立体视频生成上超越了无训练和监督方法。
Motivation: 现有基于训练的立体视频生成方法依赖稀缺的立体对或合成数据，存在域差距；无训练方法质量有限。本文旨在利用无限的单目视频进行自监督学习，解决训练数据瓶颈。
Method: 提出几何互易定理(GRT)，在最近邻DIBR公式下，推导出目标视图合成时的遮挡掩码等于从目标视图反向投影到源视图时丢失像素的掩码，从而可直接从单目图像解析计算测试时遮挡掩码，实现训练-测试一致性。
Result: 在立体视频生成任务上，该方法超越了无训练和监督方法。
Conclusion: GRT使得自监督学习成为可能，利用无限单目视频显著改进立体视频生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Selective Disclosure Watermarking for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking methods embed imperceptible and verifiable signals into text generated by large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches include zero-bit schemes for distinguishing synthetic text from human writing and multi-bit schemes for embedding metadata. However, current multi-bit watermarking methods do not allow selective disclosure: verifying any part of the watermark requires revealing the entire embedded message. This lack of control leads to unnecessary information exposure and raises privacy concerns. We propose Hierarchical Vocabulary Routing (HeRo), a watermarking framework that enables selective disclosure of embedded metadata. The method recursively partitions the vocabulary and distributes watermark information across hierarchical layers, so that different verifiers can decode only the portions of the payload corresponding to their access level. We show that the proposed scheme preserves the unbiasedness of the underlying sampling process and thus maintains text quality. Experiments demonstrate that our framework supports fine-grained access control while achieving high detection accuracy and low latency. Code is available at https://github.com/xuyangc03/hero-watermark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层词汇路由（HeRo）水印框架，通过递归划分词汇表并在分层中分布水印信息，实现选择性披露：不同验证者只能解码其访问级别对应的部分。该方法保持基础采样的无偏性，从而维持文本质量，实验表明支持细粒度访问控制，检测精度高且延迟低。
Motivation: 现有多比特水印方法不支持选择性披露，验证任何部分都需要揭示整个嵌入信息，导致不必要的信息暴露和隐私问题。
Method: 提出Hierarchical Vocabulary Routing (HeRo)，递归划分词汇表，将水印信息分布到分层结构中，不同验证者根据访问级别解码对应部分。
Result: 保持采样无偏性，维持文本质量；实验表明实现细粒度访问控制，检测精度高、延迟低。
Conclusion: HeRo框架解决了多比特水印的隐私和访问控制问题，实现了选择性披露。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments governed by complex physical interactions. Whereas single-player world models treat the other agents as part of the environment, ours conditions on the action streams of multiple agents, learning to attribute changes in the scene to the correct player and to stay coherent under arbitrary combinations of their actions. We study this problem in the game of Rocket League, where players compete and cooperate under fast, tightly coupled dynamics. Trained on 10,000 hours of gameplay collected with publicly available bots, our 5-billion-parameter latent diffusion model generates four-player matches in real time, producing 20 frames per second on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. Although trained only on short clips, its rollouts stay stable far beyond the training horizon: distributional quality holds steady out to five minutes, the longest horizon we measure, and in practice we observe rollouts continuing for hours with no sign of collapse. We systematically investigate the central design choices: the video codec, the generative objective, and the multiplayer conditioning scheme. In addition, we characterize how behavior changes with model and data scale, including the capabilities that emerge and the failure modes that persist. We further develop targeted evaluations that probe the model's physical understanding rather than visual appearance alone. To support continued research on multiplayer world models, we release our dataset, our full training and inference codebase, and a live demo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了首个支持高度动态、复杂物理交互环境的多玩家世界模型，在Rocket League游戏中，基于10000小时公开bot gameplay数据训练了一个50亿参数的潜在扩散模型，能够在单张Nvidia B200 GPU上以20fps实时生成四玩家匹配，且rollout稳定性远超训练长度（至少5分钟）。系统研究了视频编解码器、生成目标和多玩家条件机制的设计选择，并分析了行为随模型和数据规模的变化。
Motivation: 现有世界模型大多为单玩家设计，将其他智能体视为环境的一部分，无法处理多个玩家动态交互的场景。需要一种能够同时处理多个动作流、正确归因场景变化并保持一致性的多玩家世界模型。
Method: 使用潜在扩散模型，以多个玩家的动作流为条件，学习将场景变化归因到正确玩家。训练数据为10000小时Rocket League bot gameplay，模型参数50亿，采用视频编解码器、生成目标和多玩家条件机制的系统设计研究。
Result: 模型在单张B200 GPU上实时生成20fps的四玩家匹配，rollout稳定性至少保持5分钟（最长测量长度），并观察到数小时不崩坏的rollout。
Conclusion: 本文展示了第一个可用于复杂动态环境的多玩家世界模型，并开源了数据集、代码和demo，为后续研究提供基础。

papers.title: Beyond Isolated Objects: Relationship-aware Open Vocabulary Scene Understanding via 3D Scene Graph Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding aims to segment 3D scenes beyond predefined categories by transferring semantic knowledge from vision-language models. Existing methods have advanced this task by lifting language-aligned 2D features into 3D, yet they often rely on context-independent semantic representations, leaving object relationships underexplored for contextual refinement. We propose RelGraphOV, a relationship-aware framework that uses 3D scene graphs to enhance open-vocabulary 3D understanding. Our method constructs relational scene graphs from multi-view observations by leveraging vision-language reasoning to infer object relationships and prune geometrically implausible connections, without manual relationship annotations. To aggregate relational context while avoiding feature interference, we introduce an Adaptive Gated Dual-Stream Contextual GAT that separates dense geometric features and semantic CLIP embeddings, performs edge-guided message passing, and adaptively fuses complementary semantics. A hierarchical contrastive objective further promotes instance-level consistency and category-level discrimination. Experiments on ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, ScanNet$++$, and Replica demonstrate strong performance and generalization ability. Project Page: https://cxavireh.github.io/relgraphov-projectpage
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RelGraphOV，一种利用 3D 场景图关系增强开放词汇 3D 场景理解的框架。通过视觉-语言推理构建关系场景图，并引入自适应门控双流上下文 GAT 聚合关系上下文，避免特征干扰。在多个基准上展示了强性能与泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇 3D 场景理解方法依赖上下文无关的语义表示，忽视了物体间关系对语义精炼的潜力。
Method: 构建基于多视角观测的关系场景图，利用视觉-语言推理推断物体关系并修剪几何不可靠连接；提出 Adaptive Gated Dual-Stream Contextual GAT，分离稠密几何特征与 CLIP 语义嵌入，进行边引导消息传递与自适应融合；使用层次对比学习促进实例一致性与类别判别性。
Result: 在 ScanNetV2、ScanNet200、ScanNet++ 和 Replica 数据集上表现优异并展现泛化能力。
Conclusion: 通过关系感知的场景图分析，可以有效提升开放词汇 3D 场景理解，无需人工关系标注。

papers.title: WildSplat: Feedforward Gaussian Splatting from Unposed In-the-Wild Images
papers.abstract_en: While feedforward 3D reconstruction excels at efficient novel view synthesis, it typically falters when faced with scenes under varying illumination. To this end, we introduce WildSplat, the first feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework capable of appearance-conditioned novel-view synthesis for unposed in-the-wild images. To handle inconsistent photometric conditions, we propose a dual-branch architecture that explicitly decouples geometry from appearance. The geometry branch extracts an appearance-invariant 3D structure and jointly predicts camera poses. To govern the rendering appearance, the appearance branch injects target appearance cues into the content features via a globally pre-modulated cross-attention mechanism. To further prevent feature entanglement, we introduce a joint multi-reference training strategy that stabilizes the training process. Extensive experiments show that WildSplat surpasses existing optimization-based and feedforward methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in in-the-wild novel view synthesis and appearance editing from sparse inputs in a single forward pass.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 9 figures; Accepted by ECCV 2026. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/wildsplat/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WildSplat 是首个适用于无位姿野外图像的前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，通过双分支架构解耦几何与外观，实现外观条件化的新视角合成。其几何分支提取光照不变的 3D 结构并联合预测相机位姿，外观分支通过全局预调制交叉注意力注入目标外观线索。多参考训练策略进一步防止特征纠缠。在多个野外场景上，WildSplat 以单次前向推理优于现有优化与基于前馈的方法。
Motivation: 现有前馈 3D 重建方法在光照变化剧烈的野外场景下性能显著下降，无法处理不一致的光照条件。
Method: 提出双分支架构：几何分支提取外观不变的结构并预测相机位姿；外观分支通过全局预调制交叉注意力将目标外观注入内容特征，并采用联合多参考训练策略稳定训练。
Result: 在野外新视角合成和外观编辑任务上，WildSplat 超越现有基于优化和前馈的方法，实现最先进性能。
Conclusion: WildSplat 首次实现无位姿野外图像的前馈外观条件化新视角合成，验证了解耦几何与外观的有效性。

papers.title: OptiAgent: End-to-End Optimization Modeling via Multi-Agent Iterative Refinement
papers.abstract_en: We propose OptiAgent, a multi-agent framework that, given a natural language description of an Operations Research problem, is able to output a solver-ready mathematical formulation as well as executable code. Our architecture prioritizes the mathematical modeling step, where dedicated agents extract structures, such as decision variables and constraints, enabling iterative self-correction. We introduce a novel multi-loop validation architecture with four specialized feedback mechanisms, each targeting a distinct failure mode such as misinterpretation, structural defects, mathematical inconsistencies, validation failures, and code errors. Alongside accuracy, our modular design improves the process of solving optimization problems by improving transparency, as each agent exposes its reasoning and feedback, making the full modeling process auditable. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on 3 out of 4 benchmarks across LP, MILP, and Nonlinear Programming tasks, while remaining highly competitive on the remaining dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OptiAgent，一个多智能体框架，能够将运筹学问题的自然语言描述自动转化为可求解的数学公式和可执行代码。架构强调数学建模步骤，通过专用智能体提取决策变量和约束结构，并引入多循环验证架构和四种专用反馈机制来纠正误解、结构缺陷、数学不一致、验证失败和代码错误。在 LP、MILP 和非线性规划任务的四个基准测试中，该方法在三个上达到最先进性能，在剩余一个上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 将自然语言描述的运筹学问题自动转化为精确的数学模型是复杂且易出错的任务，现有方法缺乏系统性的错误检测与校正机制。
Method: 采用多智能体多循环验证架构，包含四个专用反馈机制分别针对不同失败模式（如误解、结构缺陷、数学不一致等），并通过智能体暴露推理和反馈过程提高透明度和可审计性。
Result: 在 LP、MILP 和非线性规划任务的四个基准测试中，OptiAgent 在三个上达到最先进性能，在剩余一个上保持高度竞争力。
Conclusion: 模块化设计不仅提升了求解优化问题的准确性，还通过每个智能体暴露推理和反馈使完整建模过程可审计，提高了透明度。

papers.title: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is effective when the current policy already samples useful reasoning trajectories, but it stalls on hard prompts whose correct solution modes lie outside the student's on-policy support. We propose TREK (Teacher-Routed Exploration via Forward KL), a simple staged procedure that uses distillation not for imitation but for exploration support expansion. A key advantage of TREK is its generality: because it only consumes verified output trajectories, it can use an external black-box teacher, a white-box teacher, or the same model given additional inference-time context, and it can efficiently identify which hard-prompt samples are most worth consolidating even when teacher internals are unavailable. TREK first identifies prompts where the unaided student has very low pass rate, queries a proposal source to produce verified candidate solutions, keeps the top-$r$ proposals ranked by current student likelihood, applies a short forward-KL phase to pull those verified modes into the student's support, and then returns to standard on-policy GRPO refinement. On mathematical reasoning, TREK with DeepSeek-V4 proposals improves Qwen3 models across all tested scales on AIME 2024 and AIME 2025; for Qwen3-8B, it improves AIME 2025 from 36.9 to 40.3 and AIME 2024 from 47.9 to 51.1 (avg@16), while the self-context variant reaches 38.5 and 49.6 without an external teacher. On agentic tasks, TREK raises ALFWorld success rate from 75.8 to 82.8 and ScienceWorld success rate from 12.5 to 26.7; notably, on the hardest task types, TREK achieves high success rates early in training while unaided GRPO requires substantially more optimization steps to reach comparable levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TREK（Teacher-Routed Exploration via Forward KL），一种两阶段蒸馏-强化学习框架，用于解决GRPO在困难提示样本上的失效问题。TREK首先识别学生模型通过率极低的提示，利用外部教师或自上下文生成验证过的候选解，通过正向KL散度阶段将这些解模式拉入学生支持域，再切换回在线策略GRPO精炼。在数学推理（AIME 2024/2025）和智能体任务（ALFWorld, ScienceWorld）上的实验表明，TREK显著提升性能，且无需教师模型内部信息。
Motivation: GRPO在困难提示上失效，因为正确解模式不在学生当前策略的支持域内，导致探索停滞。现有方法依赖模仿或教师内部信息，缺乏通用性。
Method: TREK包含三个阶段：困难提示识别（基于低通过率）、候选解生成与筛选（利用教师或自上下文生成，按学生似然保留top-r）、正向KL蒸馏阶段（将验证过的解模式拉入学生支持域），然后返回GRPO精炼。
Result: 在AIME 2025上，Qwen3-8B从36.9提升至40.3；AIME 2024从47.9提升至51.1（avg@16）。ALFWorld成功率从75.8升至82.8，ScienceWorld从12.5升至26.7。在困难任务上，TREK早期即达到高成功率，而GRPO需要更多优化步骤。
Conclusion: TREK通过通用、轻量的蒸馏阶段扩展策略支持域，显著提升GRPO在困难样本上的性能，且可适配多种教师源和无教师场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How Far is Too Far? Defining the Distance Threshold for Verification Siamese Networks
papers.abstract_en: Siamese verification networks are widely used to compare items such as faces, cars, or signatures. In these scenarios, the network is trained to learn an embedding space in which similar objects are mapped closer together, while dissimilar objects are mapped further apart. Two objects are considered to belong to the same class (e.g., the same person in two different images) when the distance between their embeddings falls below a predefined threshold. Defining this threshold, however, is a non-trivial task and typically requires labeled data. In this work, we assume that the distribution of distances produced by a siamese verification network can be approximated by a bimodal function. Based on this assumption, we propose an unsupervised method to determine the verification threshold by identifying the minimum point between the two modes. The proposed approach does not require annotated samples, enabling the verification threshold to be updated directly in the deployment environment without the cost of manual labeling. We evaluate our method on four datasets: MNIST, CIFAR-10, LFW, and PKLot. The results indicate that the proposed approach achieves an average verification accuracy of 94%, comparable to the Equal Error Rate method, while eliminating the need for labeled data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督方法来确定孪生验证网络（Siamese verification network）的阈值，假设嵌入距离分布为双峰函数，通过寻找两峰之间的最低点来设定阈值。在MNIST、CIFAR-10、LFW和PKLot四个数据集上，平均验证准确率达到94%，与等错误率（Equal Error Rate）方法相当，但无需标注数据。
Motivation: 孪生验证网络中，阈值设定通常需要标注数据，这限制了模型在部署环境中的自适应更新。本文旨在消除对标注数据的依赖，实现无监督的阈值确定。
Method: 假设孪生网络输出的距离分布近似为双峰函数，通过识别双峰之间的极小点（即两模式间的最低点）作为验证阈值，无需使用任何标签。
Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、LFW和PKLot四个数据集上，该方法平均验证准确率为94%，与需要标签的等错误率方法性能相当。
Conclusion: 所提出的无监督阈值方法可以替代有监督的等错误率方法，降低了部署成本，且能够在部署环境中直接更新阈值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CenSynCMB: Centre Maps and Physics-Guided Synthesis for Microbleed Detection
papers.abstract_en: Cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) are MRI markers of small vessel disease and the microbleed component of amyloid related imaging abnormalities (ARIA-H), but their small size, sparsity, and similarity to vessels, calcification-like foci, and artefacts make automated detection difficult. We propose CenSynCMB, a centre-guided and mimic-aware framework combining a 3D Attention U-Net, auxiliary centre-map supervision, false-negative-driven reweighting, and fold-wise physics-guided synthesis of positive CMBs and labelled hard negatives. Synthetic data expose the detector to compact lesions and common mimics without validation or test leakage. On VALDO Task 2, CenSynCMB achieved the best local-comparison lesion-level F1 (74.3%, p = 0.020); on external AIBL SWI, it achieved the highest local-comparison recall (88.5%, p = 0.0058) and F1 (65.0%, p = 0.0016). Together, these results support scalable CMB candidate extraction in large, unlabelled MRI cohorts, while highlighting cohort-specific calibration as the next step toward reliable burden estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CenSynCMB，一种基于中心点引导和物理引导合成的微出血检测框架，结合3D Attention U-Net、辅助中心点监督、假阴性驱动重加权和折叠式物理引导合成。在VALDO Task 2上取得最佳病变级F1（74.3%），在外部AIBL SWI上取得最高召回率（88.5%）和F1（65.0%）。
Motivation: 脑微出血（CMBs）体积小、稀疏且易与血管、钙化灶等混淆，自动检测困难。现有方法缺乏对中心点的显式监督和针对硬负样本的合成策略。
Method: 提出CenSynCMB框架，包含3D Attention U-Net作为检测骨干，加入中心点图辅助监督，采用假阴性驱动重加权，并通过折叠式物理引导合成生成阳性CMB和标注的硬负样本，用于训练而不污染验证/测试集。
Result: 在VALDO Task 2上，CenSynCMB达到最佳局部对比病变级F1=74.3%（p=0.020）；在外部AIBL SWI数据集上，获得最高局部对比召回率88.5%（p=0.0058）和F1=65.0%（p=0.0016）。
Conclusion: 该方法支持在大规模未标注MRI队列中可扩展地提取CMB候选，但需要针对具体队列校准以可靠估计负担。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法支持在大规模未标注MRI队列中可扩展地提取CMB候选，但需要针对具体队列校准以可靠估计负担。

papers.title: Steering Optimisation Trajectories in Diffusion Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study why diffusion autoencoders can achieve similar image quality while learning substantially different latent structures. We trace this behaviour to optimisation dynamics; we analyse curves of image reconstruction against latent representation quality, revealing trajectories that organise around two distinct regimes early in training. Models in the reconstruction regime prioritise image fidelity early, whereas those in the disentanglement regime improve reconstruction and disentanglement more gradually. We hypothesise that this behaviour can be influenced by targeting shortcut pathways in the diffusion U-Net and controlling early noise-level exposure, thereby shaping the reconstruction-disentanglement trade-off during training. To steer optimisation toward stronger representations, we introduce SteeringDRL, combining gated residual U-Nets with a simple noise-level exposure curriculum for training. Across disentanglement benchmarks, SteeringDRL improves representation quality and reduces seed sensitivity. Our method further extends to spatial disentanglement in object-centric learning, improving segmentation quality on synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散自编码器训练中的优化动力学，发现模型早期会进入重建优先或解缠优先两种轨迹。提出SteeringDRL方法，通过门控残差U-Net和噪声级暴露课程学习引导优化，在解缠基准上提升表示质量并降低种子敏感性，并有效扩展到对象中心学习的空间解缠。
Motivation: 扩散自编码器在不同训练条件下会学到显著不同的潜在结构，但图像质量相似，作者希望理解并控制这一行为以引导优化走向更强的表示。
Method: 分析训练中重建损失与潜在表示质量的曲线，识别出两个不同阶段；提出SteeringDRL，结合门控残差U-Net和噪声级暴露课程学习，通过控制早期噪声暴露和U-Net捷径路径来塑造重建-解缠权衡。
Result: 在解缠基准上，SteeringDRL改进了表示质量并减少了种子敏感性；在对象中心学习中，进一步提高了合成和真实数据集上的分割质量。
Conclusion: 通过控制扩散模型早期噪声暴露和捷径路径可以有效引导优化轨迹，改善表示解缠能力，方法可推广到空间解缠任务。

papers.title: Topological Shape Representation for Aneurysm -- Bifurcation Detection
authors: Mansi Dhamne (1) ((1) Sardar Patel Institute of Technology
papers.abstract_en: Automated detection of intracranial aneurysms (IAs) from CT angiography (CTA) is severely hindered by high false-positive rates. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) rely on local pixel intensities, causing systematic confusion between saccular aneurysms and vascular bifurcations -- a problem especially acute for small lesions (<3 mm), where detection sensitivity falls below 60%. We propose a plug-and-play, topology-aware false-positive reduction framework evaluating the Smooth Euler Characteristic Transform (SECT) -- a directional representation encoding global 3D vascular geometry independently of intensity -- against persistence-based summaries (Persistence Images and Landscapes), tested on a stratified subset of the RSNA 2025 dataset. SECT achieves an AUC of 0.943, substantially outperforming direction-agnostic methods (AUC ~0.68), and exhibits a clinical performance inversion: it excels on the sub-3 mm cohort, maintaining 0.943 AUC and 78.5% sensitivity at 95% specificity. The representation is also scanner-agnostic, achieving 0.927 mean AUC under leave-one-scanner-out (LOGO) validation across four manufacturers. By capturing asymmetric geometric invariants rather than intensity profiles, SECT reliably resolves the primary structural confounder in IA detection, positioning it as a robust downstream filter for hybrid deep-learning diagnostic pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CT血管造影中颅内动脉瘤检测的高假阳性率问题，提出了一种拓扑感知的假阳性减少框架，使用平滑欧拉特征变换（SECT）表示全局3D血管几何。在RSNA 2025数据集子集上，SECT达到0.943 AUC，尤其在小于3mm的动脉瘤上表现优异（0.943 AUC, 78.5%敏感性），并且跨扫描仪泛化能力强。
Motivation: 现有CNN依赖局部像素强度，导致囊状动脉瘤和血管分叉混淆，尤其是小病灶（<3mm）灵敏度低于60%。
Method: 提出即插即用的拓扑感知假阳性减少框架，评估平滑欧拉特征变换（SECT）与持久性摘要（持久性图像和景观）的比较。
Result: SECT AUC 0.943，优于方向无关方法（AUC~0.68）；在<3mm队列上保持0.943 AUC，95%特异性下敏感性78.5%；留一扫描仪验证平均AUC 0.927。
Conclusion: SECT通过捕获非对称几何不变量而非强度分布，可靠地解决了IA检测中的主要结构混淆因素，可作为混合深度学习诊断流水线的鲁棒下游滤波器。

papers.title: How Much is Left? LLMs Linearly Encode Their Remaining Output Length
papers.abstract_en: Large language models generate one token at a time, yet their responses show remarkably consistent length structure: step-by-step solutions converge in predictable token counts, retrievals stop after a few sentences, retractions extend responses by measurable amounts. We ask whether the model carries an internal estimate of how much response remains. Training minimal-capacity linear probes on frozen hidden states of three open-weight 7-8B models across seven completion-style datasets, we find three converging pieces of evidence. First, total response length is linearly decodable from the prompt's last hidden state alone, before any output is emitted. Second, probe directions trained on natural-language datasets transfer broadly, including to controlled synthetic completions never seen in training, outperforming a statistical baseline; the converse direction generally fails, and this asymmetry is itself informative. Third, on curated high-loss completions, the probe's per-position estimate shifts upward at the moment the model retracts and restarts a partial solution, a directional behavior no position-only predictor can reproduce (qualitative, not aggregate). We frame this as approximate estimation of remaining generation length, distinct from exact-counting impossibility results for transformers, and interpret it as evidence that LLMs maintain a plan-like internal representation of output length (decodable, not necessarily used causally).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在其隐藏状态中是否线性编码了剩余输出长度。通过在三个7-8B开源模型上训练轻量线性探针，作者发现总响应长度可以从提示的最后一个隐藏状态解码，探针方向可跨数据集迁移，并在模型回溯重试时表现出估计偏移。这些证据表明LLM内部维持一种近似计划式的输出长度表示。
Motivation: 现有理论认为Transformer无法精确计数输出长度，但实际LLM生成表现出长度结构（如步骤解答有固定令牌数），因此需要探究模型内部是否隐含地估计了剩余生成长度。
Method: 在七个补全风格数据集上，对冻结的隐藏状态训练最小容量线性探针，解码总响应长度；并测试探针方向在自然语言与合成补全之间的转移，以及在高损失补全中探针估计随时间的变化。
Result: 总响应长度可从提示最后一个隐藏状态线性解码；探针方向可迁移到未见过的合成补全，优于统计基线，但反向迁移失败；在高损失补全中，模型回溯重试时探针估计向上偏移。
Conclusion: LLM维护一种近似计划式的内部表示来估计剩余生成长度，这种表示可解码但未必用于因果生成。

papers.title: Locally Private Online Quantile Regression: Estimation and Inference
papers.abstract_en: We study estimation and inference for online quantile regression under a one-report user-level $\eps$-locally differentially private ($\eps$-LDP) protocol. The main difficulty is that the standard quantile-regression estimating-equation contribution couples covariates with a residual comparison, so a server that receives only privatized reports cannot form the usual online update. We address this by developing a finite-alphabet channel in which each user computes the contribution locally, applies support-aware stochastic quantization and randomized response to one selected-block category, and sends one report. A public decoder corrects the randomized-response distortion and reconstructs a server-side estimating-equation input with the correct conditional mean. These decoded inputs are then used in projected Polyak-Ruppert averaging. For fixed finite channel designs, we establish local privacy, decoder unbiasedness, consistency, asymptotic normality, and Hessian-free self-normalized inference for prespecified scalar contrasts. Simulations and a New York City taxi-trip illustration show that the private trajectory approaches the nonprivate online reference as the privacy budget grows and outperforms direct Laplace and face-exponential geometric releases in the reported regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在单报告用户级ε-本地差分隐私协议下的在线分位数回归问题。作者提出有限字母表信道机制：用户本地计算贡献，经支持感知随机量化和随机响应后发送一个报告；服务器使用公共解码器纠正扭曲，重建无偏估计方程输入，并采用投影Polyak-Ruppert平均进行在线更新。方法在固定信道设计下建立了局部隐私、一致性、渐近正态性和无Hessian的自标准化推断。仿真与纽约出租车数据表明，随隐私预算增加，私有轨迹接近非私有基准，且优于直接拉普拉斯和面指数几何注入。
Motivation: 标准在线分位数回归的估计方程涉及协变量与残差比较的耦合，在本地差分隐私下服务器仅能接收隐私化报告，无法直接形成传统在线更新，需要新的协议设计。
Method: 开发有限字母表信道：每个用户本地计算估计方程贡献，对所选块类别应用支持感知随机量化和随机响应生成一个报告；服务器端公共解码器纠正随机响应失真，恢复具有正确条件均值的服务器端估计方程输入，随后使用投影Polyak-Ruppert平均进行在线更新。
Result: 在固定有限信道设计下，理论证明了局部隐私、解码器无偏性、一致性、渐近正态性以及无需Hessian的自标准化推断。仿真和纽约出租车数据案例表明，私有轨迹随隐私预算增加趋近非私有在线参考，且在报告设定下优于直接拉普拉斯和面指数几何机制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提方法在本地差分隐私约束下实现了有效的在线分位数回归估计与推断，兼具理论保证和实际竞争力。

papers.title: Deep Learning for Semen Analysis in Male Infertility: Computer Vision, Multimodal Fusion, and Clinical Translation
papers.abstract_en: Male infertility contributes substantially to the global infertility burden, and sperm analysis remains central to diagnosis, treatment planning, and assisted reproductive technology. Conventional semen evaluation, however, is labor-intensive, operator-dependent, and limited by inter- and intra-observer variability, motivating the development of objective and reproducible computational approaches. This review provides a comprehensive and perspective-oriented synthesis of artificial intelligence-driven sperm analysis, with a focus on computer vision, deep learning, multimodal fusion, robustness, and clinical translation. We first review task-specific methods for sperm detection and counting, tracking-based motility assessment, semantic and instance segmentation, morphology and defect classification, functional assessment, and genetic integrity evaluation. We then summarize public datasets, benchmarks, evaluation metrics, and emerging multimodal strategies that integrate microscopic images, time-lapse videos, CASA-derived parameters, DNA integrity assays, and clinical metadata. Beyond algorithmic performance, we discuss key barriers to real-world deployment, including data scarcity, cross-center domain shift, annotation inconsistency, interpretability, uncertainty calibration, privacy-preserving learning, and workflow integration. Finally, we outline a staged clinical translation roadmap spanning technical standardization, multicenter retrospective validation, silent prospective evaluation, human-in-the-loop clinical testing, ART outcome validation, regulatory approval, and post-market monitoring. By organizing the field from task-specific visual recognition to trustworthy multimodal reproductive intelligence, this review highlights both the progress and the unresolved challenges required to translate AI-driven sperm analysis into clinically meaningful decision support.

TL;DR: 本文全面综述了基于深度学习的精子分析技术，涵盖计算机视觉、多模态融合、鲁棒性和临床转化，讨论了数据稀缺、域偏移、可解释性等实际部署障碍，并提出分阶段临床转化路线图。
Motivation: 常规精液分析依赖人工、主观性强且可重复性差，需要客观、可复现的计算方法辅助诊断。
Method: 系统回顾了任务特定方法（检测、跟踪、分割、分类、功能评估等），总结了公共数据集、基准和评估指标，以及集成多模态数据（显微镜图像、视频、CASA参数、DNA完整性等）的策略，并讨论了关键障碍和临床转化步骤。
Result: 本文系统梳理了现有方法、数据集和评估指标，归纳了实际部署的关键挑战，并提出了分阶段临床转化路线图。
Conclusion: 强调将AI驱动精子分析转化为临床决策支持所需的进展和未解决挑战。

papers.title: Evaluating and Understanding Model Editing for Medical Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Model editing promises a fast, targeted way to correct post-deployment mistakes in medical vision-language models (VLMs) without costly retraining. However, existing multimodal model editing benchmarks focus on general-purpose tasks and do not reflect realistic clinical domain requirements and variability. To address this, we introduce M3Bench, a clinically grounded benchmark for multimodal model editing that evaluates whether an edit remains reliable, precise, and generalizable under the challenges of image and text variation, modality and protocol shifts, clinical knowledge composition, and temporal progression. M3Bench contains 16,276 questions spanning diverse anatomy, modalities, and specialties, and supports both single and sequential edits. By evaluating 4 representative editors across 6 medical and general VLMs, we find that no method excels across all criteria. Gradient-based editors achieve strong transfer but suffer from catastrophic locality violations, whereas memory-based methods preserve locality but lack compositional generality and exhibit high backbone-dependent hyperparameter sensitivity. We further attribute these failures to the latent space geometry of VLMs and how different editing methods shift its landscape. Overall, M3Bench establishes a rigorous clinical stress test for multimodal model editing and offers actionable guidance for safer post-deployment adaptation. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/BioMed-AI-Lab-U-Michgan/M3Bench .
papers.comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/BioMed-AI-Lab-U-Michgan/M3Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出M3Bench，一个针对医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的模型编辑基准，包含16,276个问题，涵盖多种解剖结构、模态和专业领域，支持单次和顺序编辑。评估4种编辑器和6种VLM后发现，梯度编辑器迁移性强但破坏局部性，记忆方法保持局部性但缺乏组合泛化且对超参数敏感。这些失败归因于VLM潜在空间几何特性及编辑方法的改变。
Motivation: 现有模型编辑基准聚焦通用任务，无法反映临床领域对可靠性、精确性和泛化性的特殊需求及多变性。
Method: 引入M3Bench基准，包含16,276个问题，覆盖多解剖、多模态、多专业，并设计图像/文本变化、模态/协议迁移、临床知识组合及时间演进等挑战；评估4种代表编辑器和6种医学及通用VLM。
Result: 梯度编辑器在编辑转移上表现强但严重违反局部性；记忆方法保持局部性但缺乏组合泛化，且对骨干网络依赖的超参数高度敏感。
Conclusion: M3Bench为多模态模型编辑提供严格的临床压力测试，并给出安全后部署适应的可行指导。
Relevance: 0
