papers.title: EvoAgentBench: Benchmarking Agent Self-Evolution via Ability Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Agent self-evolution in long-horizon LLM systems is largely procedural: useful experience is not merely stored information, but reusable procedures for searching, debugging, and verification. Yet current evaluations do not isolate this form of transfer. Agent benchmarks test single-episode task solving; memory benchmarks target information retention rather than procedural reuse. We introduce EvoAgentBench, a benchmark for agent self-evolution via Ability-guided transfer across four agentic domains: web research, algorithmic reasoning, software engineering, and knowledge work. EvoAgentBench extracts trace-grounded Abilities from agent executions, canonicalizes them into operational units, and builds domain-specific Ability Graphs linking tasks that share procedural overlap. By design, every test task is backed by verified training-side Ability support. Across a 528/267 train/test split, two scaffolds, and three backbones, curated Ability content transfers reliably across model families, but no current automatic method sustains positive gain in all settings. EvoAgentBench shifts self-evolution evaluation from aggregate accuracy comparison to fine-grained diagnosis of experience encoding, routing, and uptake. The benchmark is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/EverMind-AI/EvoAgentBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoAgentBench是一个面向智能体自我进化（agent self-evolution）的基准测试，通过能力迁移（ability transfer）评估智能体在四个领域（网页研究、算法推理、软件工程、知识工作）中跨任务复用执行经验的能力。该基准从智能体轨迹中提取并规范化能力，构建领域能力图谱（Ability Graphs），并设置528/267的训练/测试划分。实验显示，精心设计的能力内容可在不同模型间可靠迁移，但现有自动方法难以在所有设置下保持正向收益。
Motivation: 现有评估多聚焦于单回合任务求解或信息记忆，忽略了智能体在长期交互中将经验转化为可复用程序性知识（过程迁移）的能力，缺乏对这一关键维度的孤立评测。
Method: 构建EvoAgentBench基准，从智能体执行轨迹中提取基于轨迹的能力（trace-grounded Abilities），将其标准化为可操作单元，并为每个领域构建能力图谱，利用程序重叠连接任务。所有测试任务均预设了经过验证的训练阶段能力支持。
Result: 在528/267的训练/测试划分、两种框架、三种基座模型上，精心挑选的能力内容可跨模型族可靠迁移，但当前无自动方法能在所有场景下持续取得正向收益。
Conclusion: EvoAgentBench将自我进化评估从聚合精度比较转向细粒度的经验编码、路由和吸收诊断。基准已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlatManifold: Robust Continual Learning under Severe Label Noise and Domain Shifts via Intrinsic Manifold Flattening
papers.abstract_en: In non-stationary streaming environments, simultaneously adapting to complex, non-linear domain shifts via continual learning while mitigating the catastrophic effects of severe, uncalibrated label noise poses a fundamental mathematical challenge. In this paper, we propose \FlatManifold{}, a novel, streamlined robust continual learning framework that utilizes a Nyström manifold flattening map based on the kernel trick and projection onto an orthogonalized Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). Unlike traditional methods that rely on complex, error-prone sample-filtering pipelines, the proposed approach exploits the intrinsic mathematical robustness of the flattened space itself. By mapping feature distributions onto a fixed orthogonal target topology with a ridge regularizer, the framework naturally smoothes and counteracts the influence of extreme label noise during the optimization process. Concurrently, catastrophic forgetting is prevented via a continual topology brake term that leverages the covariance matrix of past experiences. Extensive evaluation on real-world multi-session robotics datasets demonstrates that even under severe conditions featuring 40\% symmetric label noise, \FlatManifold{} successfully mitigates gradient corruption. Under extreme cross-session domain shifts spanning various seasons and lighting conditions, the proposed framework establishes high generalization capabilities, significantly outperforming standard sequential optimization baselines and proving that structural linearization itself serves as a powerful mathematical barrier against distributed label corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlatManifold，一种基于Nyström流形展平映射的稳健持续学习框架，通过将特征分布映射到正交化RKHS中的固定拓扑，利用流形展平本身的内在数学稳健性来同时应对严重标签噪声和域偏移。实验表明，在40%对称标签噪声和跨季节/光照的极端域偏移下，该方法能有效抑制梯度污染并保持高泛化能力。
Motivation: 非平稳流式环境中，持续学习需同时适应复杂非线性域偏移和缓解严重标签噪声，现有依赖样本过滤的方法复杂且易出错，缺乏数学上的鲁棒性保证。
Method: 采用Nyström流形展平映射，基于核技巧和正交化RKHS投影，结合岭正则化将特征分布对齐到固定正交目标拓扑；通过利用历史经验协方差矩阵的持续性拓扑刹车项防止灾难性遗忘。
Result: 在真实多会话机器人数据集上，即使40%对称标签噪声下，该方法成功缓解梯度污染；在跨季节/光照的极端域偏移下，显著优于标准序贯优化基线。
Conclusion: 结构线性化本身可作为对抗分布式标签污染的有力数学屏障，无需复杂样本过滤。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reason, Reward, Refine: Step-Level Errors Corrections with Structured Feedback for Physics Reasoning in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Physics reasoning fails structurally in small language models: an error at any step propagates forward, corrupting every inference that follows. Limited domain knowledge, hallucination under multi-step derivation, and distributional sensitivity compound this failure. We propose a step-level reward framework that identifies the first reasoning error, generates targeted structured feedback, and trains the model to revise its solution via policy gradient with KL regularization, without exposing it to ground truth solutions as generation targets. Unlike annotation-dependent step-level methods, no preference data construction is required and the external verifier operates exclusively at training time. Across five physics benchmarks, our framework delivers accuracy gains of 17-20% over CoT prompting and 10-16% over the strongest baseline, reduces calculation errors from 56.9% to 23.5%, and reduces miscomprehension errors from 22.3% to 12.0% in the best observed cases. Conceptual errors reduce from 89.7% to 68.7%, yet persist as the hardest failure mode across all conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种步骤级奖励框架，用于纠正小型语言模型在物理推理中的结构性错误。该框架识别首个推理错误，生成结构化反馈，并通过带KL正则化的策略梯度训练模型修正答案，无需人工标注偏好数据或使用真实答案作为生成目标。在五个物理基准上，准确率相较于CoT提示提升17-20%，相较于最强基线提升10-16%，计算错误从56.9%降至23.5%，理解错误从22.3%降至12.0%，但概念错误仍是最难解决的失败模式。
Motivation: 小型语言模型在物理推理中存在结构性失败：任何步骤的错误都会传播并污染后续推理。领域知识有限、多步推导下的幻觉以及分布敏感性加剧了这一问题。
Method: 提出步骤级奖励框架：首先定位第一个推理错误，生成针对性结构化反馈，然后通过带KL正则化的策略梯度训练模型修正解决方案，无需暴露真实答案作为生成目标，也无需构建偏好数据，外部验证器仅在训练时使用。
Result: 在五个物理基准上，准确率提升17-20%（相对于CoT提示）和10-16%（相对于最强基线）；计算错误从56.9%降至23.5%，理解错误从22.3%降至12.0%，概念错误从89.7%降至68.7%。
Conclusion: 该框架有效减少了小型语言模型在物理推理中的步骤级错误，但概念错误仍然是最具挑战性的失败模式。

papers.title: Noisy-Channel Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding yields more robust and higher-quality text generation than maximum a posteriori (MAP) decoding by selecting hypotheses that maximize expected utility over sampled pseudo-references. However, there exists a discrepancy in the design: hypothesis selection calculates expected utility scores conditioned on given pseudo-references, while commonly used evaluation metrics, e.g., BLEU and COMET, are asymmetric. Therefore, it is important to consider both hypothesis-to-reference and reference-to-hypothesis directional effects. In this study, we introduce a noisy channel decomposition of MBR decoding that naturally incorporates bidirectional effects to account for these asymmetries. We decompose MBR decoding into four interacting components: hypothesis-to-reference likelihood, reference-to-hypothesis likelihood, hypothesis prior, and reference prior. This decomposition provides a unified interpretation of existing MBR variants and enables metric- and task-specific interpretability by isolating the contribution of each channel. Our comprehensive analysis reveals that channel-wise contributions exhibit distinct characteristics across metrics while remaining consistent across tasks, and suggests that appropriate channel weighting may lead to improvements over original MBR decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对最小贝叶斯风险解码中假设选择与评估指标不对称的问题，提出了一种噪声信道分解方法，将MBR解码分解为假设到参考似然、参考到假设似然、假设先验和参考先验四个交互组件，实现了对现有MBR变体的统一解释和度量/任务特定的可解释性。
Motivation: 现有MBR解码在假设选择时仅计算给定伪参考下的期望效用，但常用评估指标（如BLEU、COMET）不对称，忽略了双向方向效应，导致设计不一致。
Method: 引入噪声信道分解，将MBR解码分解为四个组件：假设到参考似然、参考到假设似然、假设先验、参考先验，以自然融入双向效应。
Result: 分析表明，各通道的贡献在不同度量上表现出不同特征，而在不同任务上保持一致，并暗示适当的通道加权可能优于原始MBR解码。
Conclusion: 噪声信道分解为MBR解码提供了统一视角和可解释性，通道加权可能带来性能提升，但摘要未给出具体实验数值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unified Audio Intelligence Without Regressing on Text Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Audio intelligence involves understanding, reasoning about, and generating both audio and speech. In this work, we introduce Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B (Audex), a unified audio-text LLM built on Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B, a strong text-only MoE LLM. Audex adopts a simple unified design with a single Transformer decoder: audio inputs are encoded and projected into the text embedding space, while text tokens and quantized audio output tokens are treated uniformly during generation. This architecture enables strong audio-text fusion, seamless multimodal generation, and compatibility with standard LLM training and inference infrastructure. For training, we meticulously curate audio-text datasets comprising 157.4B audio tokens and 320.5B text tokens. We apply multi-stage supervised training on these datasets, followed by text-only Cascade RL and multi-domain on-policy distillation. Audex delivers state-of-the-art audio understanding, speech recognition and translation, text-to-speech, audio generation, and speech-to-speech generation, while preserving very compelling reasoning, alignment, knowledge, long-context, and agentic capabilities of its text-only LLM backbone with marginal or no regression. We release the model checkpoints to facilitate open research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B (Audex)，一个基于 Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B 文本 MoE LLM 构建的统一音频-文本大语言模型。Audex 采用单一 Transformer 解码器，将音频输入编码并投影到文本嵌入空间，在生成时统一处理文本 token 和量化音频输出 token。通过多阶段监督训练和文本 Cascade RL 及多域 on-policy 蒸馏，Audex 在音频理解、语音识别与翻译、文本转语音、音频生成和语音转语音生成上达到最先进水平，同时保留了文本 LLM 后端的推理、对齐、知识、长上下文和智能体能力，几乎没有或完全没有回归。
Motivation: 现有音频智能模型往往在提升音频能力时牺牲文本智能（如推理、对齐等），需要一种统一架构在增强音频处理的同时保持文本 LLM 的强能力。
Method: 基于预训练的文本 MoE LLM (Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B)，添加音频编码器和投影层，将音频 token 与文本 token 统一在单一 Transformer 解码器中处理。训练使用精心筛选的 157.4B 音频 token 和 320.5B 文本 token 数据集，进行多阶段监督训练，随后进行文本 Cascade RL 和多域 on-policy 蒸馏。
Result: Audex 在音频理解、语音识别与翻译、文本转语音、音频生成、语音转语音生成等任务上达到 SOTA，同时在推理、对齐、知识、长上下文和智能体基准上保持与文本 LLM 相当的性能，无显著退化。
Conclusion: 统一音频-文本 LLM 设计可以同时实现强大的音频智能和保持文本智能，无需在两者之间权衡；模型检查点已发布以促进开放研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Claws Remember but Do Not Tell: Stealthy Memory Injection in Persistent Personal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent personal agents combine long-term memory with access to users' external environments, enabling personalized foreground assistance and proactive background execution. This integration also creates a new path to compromise: untrusted external content can be silently written into persistent memory and later reused as trusted state. We study this threat as stealth memory injection, in which a remote black-box adversary delivers a single email payload that must induce the agent to write poisoned memory, stay hidden in the agent's response to the user, and affect future behavior. We introduce WhisperBench, a 108-case benchmark spanning five risk categories and both fact and preference poisoning. Built on a real IMAP/SMTP workflow and an authentic email agent skill, it enables full-cycle evaluation of stealth memory injection attacks. To enable this black-box attack under single-email delivery and without runtime feedback, we propose MemGhost, a one-shot payload generation framework. MemGhost uses an environment proxy to emulate persistent-agent execution and an objective proxy to convert memory adoption and conversational stealth into dense rubric-based rewards, then trains the attacker policy with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Across 56 held-out test cases, MemGhost achieves 87.5% end-to-end success on OpenClaw with GPT-5.4 and 71.4% on Claude Code SDK with Sonnet 4.6. It also transfers across personal-agent architectures (NanoClaw and Hermes Agent) and memory backends (filesystem and vector-based Mem0), and remains effective against input-level, model-level, and system-level defenses. These results suggest that persistent memory can turn ordinary external processing into a practical pathway for long-term agent compromise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对持久性个人代理（persistent personal agents）的隐秘内存注入攻击，攻击者通过单封电子邮件将恶意内容写入代理的持久内存，并在后续交互中操控其行为。作者构建了包含108个测试用例的基准WhisperBench，并提出了单次攻击框架MemGhost，其通过环境代理和目标代理进行策略训练。实验结果显示，在GPT-5.4驱动的OpenClaw上达到87.5%的成功率，在Claude Code SDK上达到71.4%，且能跨架构和内存后端迁移，绕过多种防御。
Motivation: 持久性个人代理将长期记忆与外部环境整合，但也会使不可信的外部内容被写入内存并作为可信状态重用，形成新的攻击面。现有工作未充分研究这种隐秘内存注入的威胁。
Method: 提出MemGhost框架，利用环境代理模拟代理执行，并用目标代理将内存采纳和对话隐蔽性转化为基于rubric的密集奖励，通过监督微调和强化学习训练攻击者策略，实现单次邮件投递的黑盒攻击。
Result: 在56个保留测试用例上，MemGhost在OpenClaw（GPT-5.4）上达到87.5%端到端成功率，在Claude Code SDK（Sonnet 4.6）上达到71.4%，且在不同代理架构和内存后端间具有可迁移性，有效应对输入级、模型级和系统级防御。
Conclusion: 论文表明持久内存可将普通外部处理转化为长期代理妥协的实用途径，强调了该威胁的严重性和现有防御的不足。

papers.title: Latent Programming Horizons in Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: A coding agent solving a software-engineering task spends dozens of steps reasoning, editing code, and running tests, yet little is known about what the underlying language model internally represents about the program it is working on. We show that the residual streams of language models under coding agents linearly encode properties of the evolving program: a logistic-regression probe on hidden states is able to decode whether the current code parses, passes its test suite, reduces the number of failing tests, and introduces regressions, reaching AUC up to 0.83 for correctness across two models and two benchmarks. Our second finding is more surprising: these representations run ahead of the agent's own edits. Probes trained to predict the outcome of future edits (before they are materialized and written on disk) achieve performance above chance up to roughly 25 steps in advance. We call this the agent's latent programming horizon. As a proof of external validity, we show that the probes transfer across benchmarks without retraining. Our positive results open calls for more research in mechanistic interpretability of coding agents.

TL;DR: 本文研究编码代理中语言模型的残差流如何线性编码程序演化属性，并发现这些表示可以预测未来编辑结果，提出“潜编程视野”概念。
Motivation: 编码代理在软件工程任务中执行多步推理、编辑和测试，但语言模型内部对程序的知识表示尚不明确。
Method: 通过逻辑回归探针在隐藏状态上解码当前代码是否解析、通过测试、减少失败测试数、引入回归等，并训练探针预测未来编辑结果。
Result: 在两种模型和两种基准上，对正确性的AUC达到0.83；探针可以提前约25步预测未来编辑结果，且跨基准迁移。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了编码代理中语言模型具有潜编程视野，呼吁更多对编码代理的机制可解释性研究。

papers.title: SMART: A Machine Learning and Monte Carlo Framework for Rapid Analysis of Stochastic Transistor Aging and Process Variation in Digital Circuits
papers.abstract_en: As CMOS technology scales into the deep nanometer regime, digital circuit reliability is increasingly threatened by the combined stochastic effects of Bias Temperature Instability (BTI) and Process Variation (PV). Traditional reliability analysis methods, which rely on computationally intensive simulations or extensive lookup tables, fail to scale efficiently for large designs, creating a critical bottleneck in design space exploration. To address this, we propose SMART, a novel framework that integrates Machine Learning (ML) with Monte Carlo simulation to enable rapid, high-fidelity reliability analysis. SMART employs Random Forest regression to predict gate delay distributions directly, bypassing time-consuming atomic model parameter extractions. Crucially, the model utilizes Bayesian Optimization for automated hyperparameter tuning, ensuring maximum predictive robustness across diverse libraries. Experimental validation on ISCAS85 benchmark circuits demonstrates that SMART achieves a 94.54% reduction in analysis time compared to state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining a remarkable average accuracy error of just 1.63%. By shifting computational complexity to an offline training phase, the proposed framework offers a scalable, accurate solution for designing resilient, reliability-aware digital systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出SMART框架，结合机器学习（随机森林回归）与蒙特卡洛仿真，用于快速分析数字电路中晶体管的随机老化（BTI）和工艺变化（PV）。在ISCAS85基准电路上，相比现有方法分析时间减少94.54%，平均精度误差仅1.63%。
Motivation: 随着CMOS技术进入深纳米尺度，BTI和PV的随机效应严重威胁数字电路可靠性，传统仿真方法计算开销大，无法高效处理大规模设计，成为设计空间探索的瓶颈。
Method: 采用随机森林回归直接预测门延迟分布，避免耗时的原子模型参数提取；利用贝叶斯优化自动调整超参数，确保跨不同库的预测鲁棒性，并将计算复杂度转移到离线训练阶段。
Result: 在ISCAS85基准电路上，SMART实现分析时间减少94.54%，平均精度误差仅1.63%。
Conclusion: SMART框架通过离线训练将计算复杂度转移，为设计抗老化、可靠性感知的数字系统提供了可扩展且准确的解决方案。

papers.title: ClassicLogic: A Knowledge-Driven Benchmark of Classic Puzzle Games for Evaluating Compositional Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Compositional generalization, the ability to understand and produce novel combinations of known components, remains a fundamental challenge for modern artificial intelligence. While few benchmarks exist, many focus on linguistic tasks and lack complex, explicit compositional structures. We introduce ClassicLogic, a new benchmark suite designed to evaluate an agent's ability to learn and compose problem-solving strategies. The benchmark consists of four classic logic puzzles: Sudoku, KenKen, Kakuro, and Futoshiki. Its core innovation is a hierarchical, explicit knowledge base for each game, where complex solving strategies are formally defined as compositions of simpler, foundational strategies. This structure allows for fine-grained evaluation of an agent's reasoning capabilities, from learning basic rules to applying multi-step compositional strategies to solve puzzles of increasing, mathematically validated difficulty. The open-source benchmark provides a challenging new testbed for advancing neuro-symbolic and other advanced AI reasoning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了ClassicLogic基准，用于评估AI的组合泛化能力，包含四个经典逻辑谜题（数独、KenKen、数谜、不等式谜题）。基准的核心是为每个游戏构建层次化的显式知识库，将复杂策略定义为简单策略的组合，从而支持对推理能力（从基本规则学习到多步组合策略）的细粒度评估。该基准旨在推动神经符号等高级AI推理系统的发展。
Motivation: 现有组合泛化基准多聚焦于语言任务，缺乏复杂且显式的组合结构，无法充分评估智能体在逻辑推理中的组合泛化能力。
Method: 构建包含四个逻辑谜题的基准套件，每个谜题配备一个层次化显式知识库，其中复杂求解策略被形式化定义为更简单基础策略的组合。
Result: 基准支持从基本规则学习到多步组合策略的细粒度评估，并通过数学验证的难度递增来测试智能体。
Conclusion: ClassicLogic为神经符号及其他高级AI推理系统提供了具有挑战性的新测试平台。

papers.title: Rethinking On-Policy Self-Distillation for Thinking Models
papers.abstract_en: Self-distillation is a promising recipe for self-improvement in language models. In this setting, a model can serve as its own teacher when given privileged information, such as a solution to a math problem. This seems especially appealing for thinking models, which can use test-time reasoning to absorb the privileged information. Surprisingly, we show that privileged self-distillation degrades thinking models on long reasoning traces: across five Qwen3 and OLMo thinking models evaluated on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, privileged-context distillation causes a relative drop of up to 17% in avg@16 accuracy. The degradation scales with the amount of privileged context withheld from the student and is most pronounced at long rollout budgets, where thinking models otherwise obtain their largest gains. This failure mode is not specific to self-distillation: on-policy distillation (OPD) improves thinking models, but privileged OPD reverses these gains. Our diagnostics link this failure mode to how privileged teacher context reshapes learning at high-entropy forking positions, where multiple continuations remain plausible and may lead to different reasoning paths. Privileged context lowers fork rates in thinking-model rollouts but not in instruction-model rollouts. This leads to an interesting dichotomy, where privileged context can help instruction-tuned models but hurts stronger thinking models. The effect is visible when the student begins a self-correction branch, where privileged OPD penalizes sampled reconsideration tokens that vanilla OPD supports. Thinking models trained with a privileged teacher produce fewer verification, backtracking, and hedging markers, even after length normalization. These findings indicate that self-distillation for strong thinking models requires attention to token-level signal, especially around correction and reasoning steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了思维模型（thinking models）的on-policy自蒸馏方法，发现基于特权上下文（privileged context）的蒸馏会在长推理轨迹上显著降低模型性能。在Qwen3和OLMo系列思维模型上，AIME24、AIME25和HMMT25基准中的avg@16准确率相对下降最高达17%，且退化程度随特权上下文量增大而加剧。诊断表明，特权上下文在高熵分支位置抑制了分支率，并惩罚了模型自然产生的验证、回溯和对冲标记，导致推理路径单一化。
Motivation: 自蒸馏被视为语言模型自我改进的有效手段，但特权上下文蒸馏对思维模型的具体影响尚不明确。本文旨在揭示其在长推理场景中的潜在退化模式及原因。
Method: 通过对比特权上下文蒸馏（privileged self-distillation）与标准on-policy蒸馏在思维模型上的效果，分析分支率变化、token级信号差异以及自纠正分支中的行为模式。
Result: 在AIME24、AIME25和HMMT25上，特权自蒸馏导致avg@16准确率相对下降高达17%，退化与特权上下文量正相关，且在长rollout预算时最显著。特权OPD（on-policy distillation）逆转了普通OPD带来的收益，并降低模型的分支率及验证、回溯、对冲标记的出现频率。
Conclusion: 强化思维模型的自蒸馏需关注token级信号，尤其是推理步骤中的纠正与重新考虑行为；特权上下文在不同模型族中效果存在二分性（对指令模型有益但对思维模型有害）。

papers.title: VLM-CASE: Vision-Language Model Enabled Context-Adaptive Safety Envelopes for Anticipatory Safe Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Adverse driving conditions, such as bad weather, remain a principal barrier to autonomous driving because they degrade two things at once: what the vehicle can perceive and what it can physically do. Human drivers cope by anticipation, reasoning about the scene and re-budgeting speed, following distance, and steering before grip or sight is lost, whereas current autonomous driving systems at best react after the fact. This paper proposes VLM-CASE, a framework that gives an autonomous vehicle this anticipatory capacity while keeping its motion bounded by a formal safety model at all times. A vision-language model (VLM), fine-tuned with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), reasons about the scene from the front-camera image and reports the road surface and visibility conditions. This output parametrizes a context-adaptive safety envelope (CASE), derived from physical limits and the guarantees of responsibility-sensitive safety, that couples braking and steering through a shared friction budget. A model predictive controller then drives freely within the envelope, while the VLM runs asynchronously so it never blocks the real-time control loop. We validate the framework in closed-loop CARLA simulation on tasks that demand both lateral and longitudinal control, across a range of weather, road-surface, and lighting conditions. The resulting controller, VLM-CASE-MPC, completes all trials, outperforming a conventional MPC baseline and a state-of-the-art VLM-integrated controller. Ablations confirm that the gains come from context adaptation, with the friction and visibility adaptations proving complementary. Furthermore, the framework is controller-agnostic and pairs with almost any low-level controller, offering a promising direction for safe autonomous driving. The dataset and supplementary materials for VLM-CASE are available at https://github.com/ytj254/VLM-CASE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VLM-CASE框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）感知道路表面和能见度条件，自适应调整安全包络（CASE），并通过模型预测控制（MPC）实现预期安全自动驾驶。在CARLA仿真中，该方法在不同天气和光照条件下完成所有测试任务，优于传统MPC和现有VLM集成控制器。
Motivation: 恶劣驾驶条件同时降低感知和车辆物理能力，当前自动驾驶系统缺乏人类驾驶员的预期能力，无法在抓地力或视野丧失前调整速度和转向。
Method: 使用低秩适应（LoRA）微调的VLM从前摄像头图像推理道路表面和能见度条件，参数化上下文自适应安全包络（CASE），结合物理限制和责任敏感安全保证，通过共享摩擦预算耦合制动和转向，MPC在包络内自由控制，VLM异步运行不阻塞实时控制。
Result: 在CARLA仿真中，VLM-CASE-MPC完成所有测试任务，优于传统MPC基线和最新VLM集成控制器。消融实验证实性能提升来自上下文自适应，摩擦和能见度适应互补。
Conclusion: VLM-CASE框架结合VLM场景理解与形式化安全包络，实现预期安全自动驾驶，且与低层控制器无关，为安全自动驾驶提供有前景的方向。

summary_sections.method: 使用低秩适应（LoRA）微调的VLM从前摄像头图像推理道路表面和能见度条件，参数化上下文自适应安全包络（CASE），结合物理限制和责任敏感安全保证，通过共享摩擦预算耦合制动和转向，MPC在包络内自由控制，VLM异步运行不阻塞实时控制。
summary_sections.result: 在CARLA仿真中，VLM-CASE-MPC完成所有测试任务，优于传统MPC基线和最新VLM集成控制器。消融实验证实性能提升来自上下文自适应，摩擦和能见度适应互补。
summary_sections.conclusion: VLM-CASE框架结合VLM场景理解与形式化安全包络，实现预期安全自动驾驶，且与低层控制器无关，为安全自动驾驶提供有前景的方向。

papers.title: Relational Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Pricing in High-Speed Railway Markets
papers.abstract_en: In liberalised railway systems, operators must set prices dynamically in an environment with partial observability, as they retain private information about their objectives and performance, where regulatory constraints prohibit communication or direct information exchange between competitors to prevent explicit collusion. Consequently, agents must learn to infer strategic interactions only from observable market data which presents a significant challenge for multi-agent reinforcement learning, where standard approaches typically treat observations as unstructured vectors, ignoring the underlying market topology that governs strategic interactions. To address this, an entity graph modelling approach is proposed, which represents the environment as a graph of operational units, rather than decision-making agents or static infrastructure, encoding competition, coordination, and connectivity relations between entities. Then, an extension of the multi-agent twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm with graph-based representation learning processes the features of the entities through a multi-layer relational graph convolutional network and aggregates them via a learnt attention mechanism. Experimental results in a rail pricing reinforcement learning environment show that this novel framework achieves higher revenue and stability in two different settings of increasing market complexity compared to a representative selection of relational and non-relational baselines. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/Kinrre/RelationalRailPricing-RL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高速铁路市场中运营商动态定价问题，提出一种基于实体图的多智能体强化学习框架。该方法将环境建模为运营单元（而非智能体或基础设施）构成的图，捕捉竞争、协调与连通关系，并扩展了MATD3算法，通过多层关系图卷积网络处理实体特征，利用注意力机制聚合。实验在两种复杂度递增的铁路定价模拟环境中显示，该框架相比关系与非关系基线获得了更高的收益和稳定性。
Motivation: 现有标准多智能体强化学习方法将观测视为非结构化向量，忽略了影响战略互动的市场拓扑结构；而在自由化铁路系统中，监管禁止竞争者间直接通信，智能体必须仅从可观测数据推断互动，这对现有方法构成挑战。
Method: 提出实体图建模方法，将环境表示为运营单元的图，编码竞争、协调与连通关系；基于此扩展MATD3算法，使用多层关系图卷积网络（R-GCN）处理实体特征，并通过学习注意力机制聚合特征。
Result: 在两个不同复杂度的铁路定价强化学习环境中，该框架相比一组关系与非关系基线实现了更高的收入和稳定性。
Conclusion: 摘要指出实体图建模与关系图卷积网络能够有效捕捉市场拓扑信息，提升多智能体动态定价策略的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CP-WSP: A Declarative CP-SAT Framework for Configurable Multi-Constraint Workforce Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Workforce scheduling is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and operational objectives. Existing CP formulations typically model simplified instances with 6-12 constraints at shift-level granularity and critically lack explicit support for: mandatory break scheduling with midpoint placement control; acuity weighted workload equity; sub-shift temporal granularity enabling demand-driven staffing; inter-week schedule stability; and cross-midnight shift patterns common in 24-hour operations. This paper presents CP-WSP: a declarative CP-SAT framework enforcing 14 hard constraints as mathematically inviolable requirements (zero regulatory violations by construction) while optimizing 15 soft objectives through a unified weighted penalty function -- all configurable via a JSON specification with no code changes required. Key contributions include: a shift-window variable decomposition enabling mandatory break scheduling with centrality control; acuity-weighted workload equity; multi-granularity temporal resolution from 30 minutes to 2 hours; inter-week schedule stability; a grid-offset preprocessing technique for cross-midnight shifts; and a reproducible 36-configuration benchmark suite for community comparison. Evaluated on INRC-II benchmarks at both hourly and shift-level granularity and on 36 synthetic configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CP-WSP，一个声明式CP-SAT框架，用于可配置的多约束劳动力调度问题。该框架强制执行14个硬约束并优化15个软目标，所有配置通过JSON规范完成，无需修改代码。关键贡献包括：班次窗口变量分解、强制休息调度、敏锐度加权工作量公平性、多粒度时间分辨率、跨周调度稳定性、跨午夜班次处理以及一个可复现的36配置基准套件。在INRC-II基准和36个合成配置上进行了评估。
Motivation: 现有CP公式通常建模简化实例，以班次粒度处理6-12个约束，缺乏对强制休息调度、敏锐度加权工作量公平性、子班次时间粒度、跨周调度稳定性和跨午夜班次模式的显式支持。
Method: 提出CP-WSF框架，使用声明式CP-SAT建模，通过统一加权惩罚函数优化15个软目标，并采用Shifts-window变量分解、敏锐度加权工作量公平性、多粒度时间分辨率、跨周调度稳定性和网格偏移预处理技术。
Result: 在INRC-II基准（小时和班次粒度）以及36个合成配置上进行了评估。
Conclusion: CP-WSF提供了一个可配置、可扩展的劳动力调度框架，能够处理实际应用中的复杂约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FSDC-DETR: A Frequency-Spatial Domain Collaborative DETR for Small Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Small object detection (SOD) remains a challenging task in real-world applications. Despite recent advances, existing detectors remain limited by rigid processing that entangle spatial aggregation with implicit frequency aliasing and truncation, leading to inadequate preservation of high-frequency components for SOD. To tackle these limitations, we propose a Frequency-Spatial Domain Collaborative Detection Transformer (FSDC-DETR), a novel collaborative framework that explicitly models complementary spatial and frequency representations. Specifically, we first introduce Dual-Branch Frequency-Spatial Adaptive Fusion (DBFSAF) to enhance frequency diversity and adaptively capture frequency-spatial domain discriminative representations. Building on these representations, a frequency-spatial interaction scheme is further explored within the hybrid encoder to enable progressive feature propagation to the decoder. In particular, structure-aware frequency-spatial aggregation is achieved through Shunt Frequency-Spatial Feature Fusion (SFS-FF), establishing bidirectional interaction and progressive cross-scale propagation between frequency and spatial representations for coherent discriminative modeling. Meanwhile, informative high-frequency responses are preserved during scale transitions through Frequency-Spatial Dynamic Downsampling (FSD-Down), thereby minimizing frequency degradation throughout multi-scale fusion for the precise SOD. Experimental results demonstrate that FSDC-DETR achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving AP by 6.4 on VisDrone-DET2019 and 6.6 on AITODv2, with gains of 6.8 and 6.9 AP for small objects. The code is available at github.com/nevereverinsomnia/FSDC-DETR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FSDC-DETR，一种频率-空间域协作的DETR模型，用于小目标检测。通过双分支频率-空间自适应融合(DBFSAF)和分流频率-空间特征融合(SFS-FF)等模块，显式建模互补的频率和空间表示，保留高频信息。在VisDrone-DET2019和AITODv2上分别提升AP 6.4和6.6，小目标AP提升6.8和6.9。
Motivation: 现有检测器在处理小目标时受限于刚性处理，将空间聚合与隐式频率混叠和截断纠缠在一起，导致高频分量保存不足，影响小目标检测性能。
Method: 提出频率-空间域协作框架，包括双分支频率-空间自适应融合(DBFSAF)增强频率多样性，分流频率-空间特征融合(SFS-FF)实现双向交互与渐进跨尺度传播，以及频率-空间动态下采样(FSD-Down)减少频率退化。
Result: 在VisDrone-DET2019上AP提升6.4，小目标AP提升6.8；在AITODv2上AP提升6.6，小目标AP提升6.9。
Conclusion: FSDC-DETR通过显式协同频率与空间表示，有效提升小目标检测精度，代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Platonic Projection Structures: Operator-Induced Observability in Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We characterize observability in representation learning through Platonic Projection Structures (PPS), an operator-theoretic framework for analyzing representation accessibility under partial observation. Rather than treating observable outputs as direct reflections of latent representations, PPS models observation through a self-adjoint positive semidefinite operator acting on a latent representation space. A system is represented as a triple $(H, Π, O)$, where $H$ is a latent representation space, $Π\succeq 0$ is an observation operator, and $O(v)=\langle v,Πv\rangle$ defines an induced scalar observable. Observability is characterized by the quotient geometry $H/\ker(Π)$, representing equivalence classes of latent states indistinguishable under observation. We show that quantum measurement and representation inference under linear observation models share this operator-theoretic structure while differing in the algebraic properties of their observation operators; the correspondence is structural rather than physical. Representation transfer and knowledge distillation can likewise be interpreted as approximate preservation of observable geometry through $ΦΠ_T \approx Π_S Φ$. PPS also reveals a structural limitation of output-based interpretability: latent components in $\ker(Π)$ are inaccessible from induced observables, imposing intrinsic constraints on attribution and explanation methods. Controlled empirical validations demonstrate kernel-invariant observability, projection-induced attribution gaps, and rank-controlled observable geometry in latent representation spaces. PPS thus provides an explicit characterization of observability through operator-induced quotient geometry and a unified perspective on representation accessibility, interpretability, and projection-mediated inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Platonic Projection Structures (PPS)，一个算子理论框架，用于在表示学习中刻画部分观测下的可观测性。系统表示为三元组(H, Π, O)，其中Π是自伴正半定观测算子，可观测性由商几何H/ker(Π)决定。作者证明量子测量和线性观测模型下的表示推断共享此结构，且知识蒸馏可视为保持可观测几何的近似。实验验证了核不变可观测性、投影引起的归因差距和秩控制的可观测几何。
Motivation: 现有表示学习缺乏对部分观测下表示可访问性的形式化刻画，导致对可解释性和推理的限制理解不足。
Method: 定义了PPS框架，通过算子诱导的商几何H/ker(Π)表征观测等价类，并分析了与量子测量、知识蒸馏的结构对应关系。
Result: 理论结果表明核(Π)中的潜在成分不可观测，限制了输出可解释性；知识蒸馏中ΦΠ_T ≈ Π_S Φ的近似保持可观测几何。实验在潜空间中验证了核不变可观测性和归因差距。
Conclusion: PPS提供了表示学习可观测性的统一视角，揭示了基于输出的可解释性的固有局限性，并连接了投影介导推理。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: AgentGym2: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in De-Idealized Real-World Environments
papers.abstract_en: Language agents, i.e., LLM agents, progress rapidly and are increasingly deployed in production environments. This trend underscores the urgent need for rigorous and realistic evaluations. However, most existing benchmarks evaluate agents in simplified, idealized settings. They typically rely on pre-packaged tool interfaces, overlook critical steps, and assume inputs are clean and fully specified. Consequently, they understate the difficulty of real deployments, where uncertainty and noise are ubiquitous and agents must proactively explore the environment to uncover new tools. To bridge this gap, we present AgentGym2, a new evaluation framework with task instances grounded in real-world end-to-end working demands. Beyond reasoning and planning, it measures agents' ability to execute end-to-end procedures, discover tools via exploration, compose tools for unseen tasks, and remain robust to noisy and underspecified information. Experiments on 15 proprietary and open-source models show that even SOTA systems like Gemini and GPT-5 struggle on AgentGym2, revealing a substantial gap between the capability of current agents and the demands of real-world applications.
papers.comment: Accepted as a main conference paper at ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentGym2，一个针对大语言模型代理在非理想化真实环境中的评估框架。该框架通过端到端任务实例，测试代理在嘈杂、不完整信息下的工具发现、组合和鲁棒执行能力。实验显示，即使是GPT-5和Gemini等最先进模型在该基准上也表现挣扎，揭示了当前代理能力与真实应用需求之间的显著差距。
Motivation: 现有基准多在简化、理想化环境中评估代理，通常依赖预打包工具接口，忽略关键步骤，且假设输入干净完备，低估了真实部署中不确定性、噪声和需要主动探索的难度。
Method: 构建基于真实世界端到端工作需求的任务实例，衡量代理执行完整流程、通过探索发现工具、组合工具处理未见任务、以及对噪声和不明确信息的鲁棒性。
Result: 在15个商业和开源模型上的实验表明，包括GPT-5和Gemini在内的SOTA系统在AgentGym2上表现不佳，凸显当前代理能力与真实应用需求间的巨大差距。
Conclusion: 代理在去理想化真实环境中的评估至关重要，现有模型仍有显著提升空间。

papers.title: The Changing Role of Symbolic Methods in Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Why do intelligent systems need to perform explicit symbolic reasoning? Computer science has traditionally regarded symbolic reasoning as a defining component of intelligence. Yet the remarkable success of modern foundation models raises a fundamental question: if increasingly capable AI systems can operate with little explicit symbolic reasoning, what role do symbolic methods actually play? This article argues that explicit symbolic reasoning is not a fundamental property of intelligence, but a computational consequence of operating on simplified models of reality. We propose the Compression Principle: every computational model is a simplified representation of reality, and explicit symbolic reasoning compensates for information omitted during model construction. From this principle, we derive the Modeling--Reasoning Trade-off: as computational models preserve richer representations of the world, the need for explicit symbolic reasoning correspondingly decreases. This perspective provides a unified explanation for both the historical success of symbolic methods and the remarkable effectiveness of modern foundation models. Paradoxically, the same development makes symbolic methods increasingly important for humans. As intelligent systems become more capable and more opaque, symbolic representations increasingly serve as interfaces through which humans specify requirements, verify behavior, regulate autonomous systems, and establish trust. We therefore argue that the future of symbolic methods lies not primarily as the computational engine of intelligent systems, but as the symbolic interface between increasingly capable AI systems and the humans who build, govern, and depend upon them.

papers.title: MeGA-MP: Metric Graph Advection Message Passing -- A Physics-Informed Message Passing Operator for Advection-Dominated Metric Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world systems are organized as networks where spatio-temporal dynamics unfold along connections and not discretely between nodes. Examples include utility networks such as water distribution systems or gas networks, electrical grids, and traffic flow networks. Such systems are naturally modeled as metric graphs, where edges correspond to one-dimensional Euclidean subspaces connected at vertices. Metric graphs are independent of an underlying global Euclidean space, limiting direct application of typical PINNs and operator-learning methods. Especially transport dynamics like advection require a methodology able to capture antisymmetric and long-range dependencies on graphs, which is itself a challenge. We propose a novel physics-informed message passing operator that encodes linear advection on metric graphs as an inductive bias. In the purely advective setting, the operator provably recovers the exact dynamics up to a theoretically derived discretization error without any training. Combined with trainable components like MLPs, our message passing operator extends to realistic advection-reaction dynamics in water distribution systems, where we achieve superior performance compared to baselines and zero-shot generalization across different graph topologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息消息传递算子MeGA-MP，将度量图上的线性对流编码为归纳偏置。在纯对流情况下，该算子无需训练即可精确恢复动力学，并具有理论可证离散误差。结合可训练组件后，能扩展到供水系统中的对流-反应动力学，超越基线并实现零样本泛化。
Motivation: 许多真实系统（如供水网、电网）可建模为度量图，但现有物理信息神经网络（PINNs）和算子学习方法难以直接应用，尤其对流动力学需要捕获图中的反对称和长程依赖，现有方法缺乏针对性。
Method: 提出一种物理信息消息传递算子，将线性对流方程作为归纳偏置嵌入消息传递过程，在纯对流设置下证明可精确恢复动力学，并融入可训练的MLP等组件以处理对流-反应等复杂动力学。
Result: 在供水系统对流-反应动力学任务上，该方法优于基线，并能零样本泛化到不同图拓扑结构。
Conclusion: 该算子为度量图上的对流主导问题提供了有效的物理信息消息传递框架，兼具理论保证和实际泛化能力。

papers.title: Physiological Noise Augmentation Improves Non-Invasive Brain-to-Speech
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive brain-to-speech decoding aims to restore communication to patients suffering from neurodegenerative disease, without the risks of neurosurgery. Existing MEG- and EEG-based methods, while scalable, continue to suffer from high word error rates driven by relatively low signal-to-noise ratios compared to invasive recordings. We propose physiological noise augmentation (PNA), a data augmentation method that explicitly trains decoders to become invariant to task-agnostic artifacts (e.g. ocular and cardiac activity). PNA draws inspiration from automatic speech recognition systems, where environmental noise (e.g. dogs barking, city traffic) is added to clean speech to improve robustness. Analogously, we decompose brain recordings into clean data and noise artifacts using independent component analysis (ICA), before scaling and remixing to generate biophysically realistic, label-preserving training examples. We show that PNA approximates anisotropic regularization, penalizing decoder sensitivity along artifact-dominated directions. On MegNIST, a 12k-trial imagined-digit MEG dataset, PNA with 10-trial averaging improves EEGNet decoding accuracy by 4.7 percentage points (absolute) over training on real data alone. Our results suggest that artifact-aware augmentation and trial averaging are complementary tools for improving robustness in non-invasive speech BCIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生理噪声增强（PNA）方法，通过独立成分分析分解脑磁图/脑电图记录，将眼动、心电等非任务伪影作为噪声重新混合以生成训练样本，从而提高非侵入式脑到语音解码的鲁棒性。在MegNIST数据集上，PNA结合10次试验平均可将EEGNet解码准确率绝对提升4.7个百分点。
Motivation: 现有非侵入式脑到语音方法（如MEG/EEG）信噪比低，导致高词错误率。需要一种方法使解码器对任务无关的生理伪影具有不变性。
Method: 提出PNA：利用独立成分分析分离干净信号与噪声伪迹，缩放后重新混合生成保留标签的训练样本，等效于各向异性正则化，惩罚沿伪影主导方向的解码器敏感性。
Result: 在MegNIST的12k次想象数字MEG数据集上，结合10次试验平均，EEGNet解码准确率绝对提升4.7个百分点（相比仅使用真实数据训练）。
Conclusion: 伪影感知的数据增强与试验平均是非侵入式语音BCI中互补的鲁棒性提升工具。

papers.title: Open Problems in AI Incident Governance
papers.abstract_en: AI systems may produce failures after deployment that pre-deployment safety assessments do not anticipate. Managing these failures requires what we refer to as adequate \textit{AI incident governance}, where having good definitions, taxonomies, monitoring practices, reporting mechanisms, and incident analysis is essential. We examine existing frameworks related to AI incident governance by regulatory bodies and independent efforts, and find that while there are frameworks that describe how individual functions can be performed, there is a lack of consistency within the aspects of definitions, classification, monitoring, and reporting. These inconsistencies apply to the types of incident data that is collected and reported, the ways in which they are categorised, and as a result, the depth, representativeness, and accuracy of analysis that can be performed.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML Technical AI Governance Research workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了人工智能（AI）事故治理（incident governance）领域的现有框架，包括监管机构及独立研究提出的定义、分类法、监控实践、报告机制及事故分析流程。研究发现，尽管存在描述各环节功能的框架，但在定义、分类、监控和报告方面存在显著不一致性，导致所收集的事故数据类型、分类方式以及后续分析的深度、代表性和准确性均受到限制。
Motivation: AI系统在部署后可能产生部署前安全评估未能预见的故障，需要有效的事故治理。然而，现有框架在关键方面缺乏一致性，阻碍了跨机构、跨领域的事故数据整合与分析，因此亟需厘清开放问题。
Method: 对监管机构及独立研究提出的AI事故治理框架进行文献审查，重点比较其在定义、分类法、监控实践、报告机制和事故分析五个维度的异同。
Result: 研究发现现有框架虽覆盖各功能环节，但在定义、分类、监控和报告上缺乏一致性，且这种不一致性直接影响了所收集事故数据的类型、分类方式以及后续分析的深度、代表性和准确性。
Conclusion: 本文指出AI事故治理领域存在开放问题，特别是在定义、分类、监控和报告的标准化方面，未来需要建立更一致的框架以支持有效的事故分析和治理。

papers.title: EdgeBench: Unveiling Scaling Laws of Learning from Real-World Environments
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining scaling laws reveal that model capability improves predictably with data and compute. But learning from real world environments after deployment remains far less understood. Analyzing roughly 38,000 hours of agent interaction with the environment across 134 real world tasks, we find, to the best of our knowledge, the first evidence that overall performance during environment learning follows a log-sigmoid scaling law with remarkably high precision, reaching R^2 = 0.998. Across model generations, we also find that agent learning speed roughly doubles every three months. This discovery stems from EdgeBench, a suite of 134 real world tasks with ultra-long horizons, spanning scientific discovery, software engineering, combinatorial optimization, professional knowledge work, formal mathematics, and interactive games. Each task sustains at least 12 hours of continuous agent operation under rich, multilevel feedback, and is built through substantial expert effort. We publicly release 51 tasks and our full evaluation framework to accelerate the study of how agents learn from real world experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过分析约38000小时的智能体与真实环境交互，首次发现环境学习中的整体性能遵循对数S形缩放定律（log-sigmoid scaling law），拟合精度高达R²=0.998，并观察到智能体学习速度约每三个月翻倍。为此发布了EdgeBench基准，包含134个超长周期真实世界任务，涵盖科学发现、软件工程、组合优化、专业知识工作、形式数学和交互式游戏等。
Motivation: 部署后的智能体在真实环境中的学习行为尚不清晰，缺乏大规模系统的实证研究。
Method: 构建EdgeBench基准套件，包含134个精心设计的超长周期任务（每个任务至少支持12小时连续交互），通过大规模智能体与环境交互实验，拟合性能随训练数据变化的缩放律。
Result: 发现整体性能服从对数S形缩放律，R²=0.998；智能体学习速度约每三个月翻倍。
Conclusion: 释放51个任务及完整评估框架，以促进对智能体从真实经验中学习机制的进一步研究。

papers.title: Geometric Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: Scientists often seek to draw causal inferences from structured data that is not independently and identically distributed, such as spatial data, network data, or molecular data. We develop geometric causal models (GCMs), a framework for causal inference from dependent data that exploits underlying symmetries of the data generating process. For example, in spatial data, we consider processes that are symmetric under translations, or in graph data, symmetric under permutations of the nodes. We show how symmetries, formalized with group theory, can enable causal identification and estimation. We deploy ergodic theory for amenable groups to establish identification, and combine geometric deep learning with scalable Bayesian inference for estimation. We recover i.i.d. causal models and do-calculus when the data is a sequence and the symmetry is permutation equivariance, and find novel types of causal models when we use alternate structures and symmetries. As an example, we construct a causal model that satisfies the symmetries of DNA. This GCM enables new estimators for the effects of genetic variation, combining deep functional genomics models to describe outcomes and DNA language models to describe propensities. We illustrate on semisynthetic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何因果模型（GCMs），利用数据生成过程中的对称性（如空间平移对称、图节点置换对称）进行因果推断。通过群论形式化对称性，结合遍历理论建立可识别性，并融合几何深度学习与可扩展贝叶斯推断进行估计。该框架在DNA序列等结构数据上展示了新类型的因果模型，可用于基因变异效应估计。
Motivation: 现有因果推断方法大多假设独立同分布数据，但实际中如空间数据、网络数据、分子数据等存在依赖结构，传统方法难以直接应用。
Method: 利用群论将对称性形式化，通过可解群的遍历理论建立因果识别，结合几何深度学习和可扩展贝叶斯推断进行参数估计。在序列数据且对称性为置换等变时，可恢复独立同分布因果模型和do-calculus。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在DNA序列等结构数据上构建了满足对称性的因果模型，并实现了基因变异效应的新估计量，在半合成数据上进行了验证。
Conclusion: GCM框架为依赖结构数据提供了一种利用对称性进行因果推断的通用方法，但实际应用中需定义合适的对称性群，且计算成本可能较高。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Claim-Level Rubric Rewards for Video Caption Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Claim-Level Rubric Rewards (CuRe), a structured reward framework designed to address the reward-design bottleneck in reinforcement learning for dense video captioning. Existing reward designs generally fall into two categories: holistic response-level judgment across heterogeneous criteria, or alignment-based evaluation against reference captions. However, both paradigms suffer from fundamental limitations. Holistic rewards struggle to ensure factual accuracy and are prone to stylistic reward hacking, while reference-based rewards overly rely on rigid textual alignment, failing to preserve the completeness and diversity inherent to open-ended generation tasks. To address these challenges, CuRe reformulates reward modeling as fine-grained claim-level verification. Specifically, CuRe decomposes captions into category-aware atomic claims through a structured rubric, converting holistic evaluation into simpler and more reliable claim-level verification.

papers.title: Fully Rotation-Equivariant Spectral-Spatial Learning for Multispectral Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing multispectral detectors are limited by discrete spectral processing, a scale-dependent shift in the relative reliability of spectral and spatial cues across pyramid levels, and the lack of explicit rotation-equivariant geometric priors for arbitrarily oriented objects. To tackle these limitations, we propose FressDet, a fully rotation-equivariant spectral-spatial learning framework for multispectral object detection, capable of capturing the continuous, ordered nature of spectral structure and enabling reliable spectral-spatial fusion across pyramid levels under arbitrary in-plane rotations. FressDet integrates three complementary components. Spectral Implicit Warp (SpeIW) enables query-based spectral resampling via a coordinate-conditioned implicit field, yielding a monotone, order-preserving warp. Rotation-Equivariant Consistency Weighting (ReCoW) adaptively fuses spectral and spatial branches based on branch reliability, reinforcing informative cues while suppressing noise across pyramid levels. The oriented-aware head exploits group-indexed features to stably predict oriented objects without parameter replication. Taken together, FressDet learns more discriminative and robust spectral-spatial representations even under rotational perturbations. By achieving state-of-the-art performance with 93% fewer parameters on three public benchmarks, FressDet demonstrates its effectiveness and generalizability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出FressDet，一个全旋转等变光谱-空间学习框架，用于多光谱目标检测。包含三个组件：光谱隐式扭曲（SpeIW）、旋转等变一致性加权（ReCoW）和朝向感知头。在三个公共基准上达到当前最优性能，参数减少93%。
Motivation: 现有多光谱探测器受限于离散光谱处理、跨金字塔层级光谱和空间线索的相对可靠性变化，以及缺乏对任意朝向目标的显式旋转等变几何先验。
Method: 集成三个组件：SpeIW通过坐标条件隐式场进行查询式光谱重采样，实现单调保序扭曲；ReCoW基于分支可靠性自适应融合光谱和空间分支；朝向感知头利用组索引特征稳定预测朝向目标。
Result: 在三个公共基准上达到当前最优性能，参数减少93%。
Conclusion: FressDet在旋转扰动下学习到更判别且鲁棒的光谱-空间表示，验证了有效性和泛化性。

papers.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling draft generation from target verification. While recent parallel drafters efficiently propose long token sequences in a single forward pass, they suffer from rapid acceptance decay due to a lack of inter-token dependencies. Furthermore, indiscriminately verifying these extended blocks wastes critical batch capacity on tokens with high rejection risks, severely degrading throughput in high-concurrency serving systems. We introduce DSpark, a speculative decoding framework that unifies high-throughput parallel generation with adaptive, load-aware verification. To maintain draft quality, DSpark utilizes a semi-autoregressive architecture, coupling a parallel backbone with a lightweight sequential module, to introduce intra-block dependency modeling and mitigate suffix decay. To optimize system efficiency, DSpark employs confidence-scheduled verification, dynamically tailoring the verification length for each request based on estimated prefix survival probabilities and engine-specific throughput profiles. On offline benchmarks across diverse domains, DSpark substantially improves the accepted length over state-of-the-art autoregressive and parallel drafters. When deployed within the DeepSeek-V4 serving system under live user traffic, DSpark successfully mitigates verification waste. Compared to the established production baseline (MTP-1), DSpark accelerates per-user generation speeds by 60 to 85 percent at matched throughput levels. More importantly, by preventing severe throughput degradation under strict interactivity constraints, it enables performance tiers that were previously unattainable, shifting the Pareto frontier of our serving system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSpark是一种投机解码（speculative decoding）框架，结合半自回归（semi-autoregressive）生成与置信度调度验证，用于加速大语言模型推理。它通过并行骨干网络和轻量级顺序模块缓解长序列生成中的接受率衰减，并根据每个请求的估计存活概率动态调整验证长度。在DeepSeek-V4生产系统中，DSpark在匹配吞吐量下将用户生成速度提升60-85%，并改进了Pareto前沿。
Motivation: 现有并行投机解码方法因缺乏令牌间依赖导致接受率快速衰减，且盲目验证长块浪费批处理容量，降低高并发服务系统的吞吐量。
Method: 提出半自回归架构（并行骨干+轻量顺序模块）建模块内依赖以维持草稿质量，并采用置信度调度验证，基于前缀存活概率和引擎吞吐量轮廓动态调整每个请求的验证长度。
Result: 在离线基准上显著提升接受长度；在DeepSeek-V4生产系统中，相比MTP-1基线，用户生成速度提升60-85%，且避免了严格交互约束下的吞吐量下降，实现了之前无法达到的性能层级。
Conclusion: DSpark通过统一高吞吐并行生成与自适应负载感知验证，有效减少验证浪费，推动服务系统的Pareto前沿。

papers.title: PDEFlow: Autonomous Agentic PDE Pipelines for Neural Operator Learning and Solver-Free Inference
papers.abstract_en: We present PDEFlow, an autonomous agentic framework that turns user-level ODE and PDE descriptions into solver-backed neural-operator pipelines. The workflow links problem specification, data generation, operator training, and checkpoint-based inference. A stateful input graph converts multi-turn natural-language input and user edits into validated problem specifications. The data-generation module then samples parameters, solves the configured governing-equation with FEniCSx finite-element backend, and stores the solutions as operator-ready tensors. The training and inference stages use a registry-based interface, allowing different neural operators to be trained and deployed without changing the surrounding pipeline. In the current implementation, we instantiate this interface with a multi-branch Bayesian DeepONet. Experiments on benchmark ODE and PDE tasks show that PDEFlow can construct valid specifications, generate solver-backed datasets, train neural operators across steady and transient problem classes, and provide solver-free predictions from saved checkpoints. The framework is designed for repeatable scientific and engineering workflows where many related physics configurations must be specified, simulated, learned, and queried with minimal manual intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PDEFlow，一个自主代理框架，将用户层面的 ODE/PDE 描述转化为基于求解器的神经算子流水线，涵盖问题规格说明、数据生成、算子训练和基于检查点的推理。当前实现使用多分支贝叶斯 DeepONet，在标准 ODE/PDE 基准任务上验证了框架的有效性。
Motivation: 在科学和工程中，许多物理配置需要重复进行规格说明、模拟、学习和查询，手动干预繁琐且易出错。现有神经算子方法缺乏端到端自动化流水线。
Method: 构建状态输入图将多轮自然语言输入转换为验证后的问题规格，使用 FEniCSx 有限元后端进行数据生成，通过注册表接口支持不同神经算子（如多分支贝叶斯 DeepONet）的训练和部署。
Result: 在 ODE/PDE 基准任务上，PDEFlow 能生成有效规格、基于求解器的数据集，训练稳态和瞬态问题的神经算子，并从保存的检查点提供无求解器预测。
Conclusion: PDEFlow 为可重复的科学工作流提供自动化，减少手动干预，但当前实现未涉及大规模或特定应用领域。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: UNIVERSE: Unified Video Action Models for Autonomous Driving with Flexible Mask-Modulated Modality Generation
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for improving action generalization in autonomous driving by using future video prediction as dense supervision for scene dynamics and temporal causality. However, it remains unclear which architecture better transfers video-modeling benefits to trajectory generation. Existing cascaded or dual-DiT designs separate video imagination from action prediction, weakening the transfer of video-learned world dynamics to the trajectory branch: the action model may still overfit dataset-specific driving priors, while the video model only indirectly regularizes planning. We propose UNIVERSE, a unified video-action model built upon a single mask-modulated Diffusion Transformer. By co-training future video latents and ego-trajectory tokens within shared generative parameters, UNIVERSE allows dense video supervision to directly shape trajectory denoising, leading to stronger cross-domain action generalization. To ensure causal validity and efficient deployment, we introduce a Modality-Decoupling Visibility Mask, which shares historical context across modalities while blocking mutual attention between future video and trajectory tokens. This prevents future-target leakage and enables trajectory-only inference by removing future-video denoising at test time, achieving a $4.3\times$ speedup over joint video-action rollout while maintaining comparable planning accuracy. The same model also supports video-only and joint video-action rollouts. Experiments show that UNIVERSE achieves 91.0 PDMS on NAVSIM (vs. 89.6 for the Two-DiT variant), and demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer to nuScenes and Bench2Drive without fine-tuning, while ablations confirm the importance of single-DiT unification, video co-training, and mask-based modality decoupling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UNIVERSE，一个基于单掩码调制 Diffusion Transformer 的统一视频-动作模型，用于自动驾驶。通过联合训练未来视频潜变量和自车轨迹令牌，使密集视频监督直接塑造轨迹去噪，增强了跨域动作泛化。引入模态解耦可见性掩码，保证因果性并实现高效推理，在 NAVSIM 上达到 91.0 PDMS，且无需微调即可零样本迁移到 nuScenes 和 Bench2Drive。
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models (WAMs) 采用级联或双 DiT 设计，将视频预测与轨迹预测分离，削弱了视频学到的世界动态对轨迹分支的约束，导致动作模型可能过拟合驾驶先验，视频模型仅间接正则化规划。
Method: 基于单个掩码调制 Diffusion Transformer (DiT)，联合训练未来视频和自车轨迹令牌；提出 Modality-Decoupling Visibility Mask，共享历史上下文但阻止未来视频与轨迹令牌间的互注意，保证因果性，并支持测试时仅用轨迹推理（4.3倍加速）。
Result: UNIVERSE 在 NAVSIM 上达到 91.0 PDMS（优于双 DiT 变体的 89.6），零样本迁移到 nuScenes 和 Bench2Drive 表现强，消融实验验证了单 DiT 统一、视频联合训练和掩码解耦的重要性。
Conclusion: 统一的单模型设计和掩码模态解耦能有效将视频建模收益转移到轨迹生成。

papers.title: TacReasoner: A Dynamic Tactile-Language Framework for Interactive Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Among the five primary human senses, tactile is arguably the most fundamental to survival, as it enables the perception of physical contact and interaction in real-world environments. In this paper, we explore two key challenges of integrating tactile sensing into intelligent systems for multimodal reasoning: (i) insufficient modeling of dynamic tactile signals, which restricts reasoning over temporally evolving properties, and (ii) hallucination in tactile foundation models caused by the absence of explicit reasoning mechanisms, leading to unstable real-world inference. To address these challenges, we propose TacReasoner, a dynamic tactile-language framework for interactive reasoning in real-world scenarios. First, TacReasoner incorporates a Dynamic-aware Tactile Encoder to enhance the perception and representation of dynamic tactile signals. More importantly, we introduce TouchCoT-10k, the first tactile chain-of-thought dataset for structured reasoning over tactile inputs. Upon it, we establish DynTac-Bench to systematically evaluate dynamic tactile perception and real-world commonsense reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that TacReasoner achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art models across multiple datasets. Notably, despite using only 7B parameters, TacReasoner outperforms the 14B VTV-LLM model on most subtasks, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency in tactile commonsense reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TacReasoner，一个动态触觉-语言框架，用于现实场景中的交互式推理。它包含动态感知触觉编码器，并构建了首个触觉链式思维数据集TouchCoT-10k和评估基准DynTac-Bench。实验表明，TacReasoner仅用7B参数即在多数子任务上超越14B的VTV-LLM模型。
Motivation: 触觉感知在智能系统中存在两个关键挑战：动态触觉信号建模不足导致无法推理时间演化的属性，以及触觉基础模型因缺乏显式推理机制而产生幻觉，影响现实世界推理的稳定性。
Method: 提出TacReasoner框架，包含动态感知触觉编码器增强动态触觉信号感知与表示；构建首个触觉链式思维数据集TouchCoT-10k用于结构化推理；建立DynTac-Bench评估基准。
Result: 在多个数据集上达到竞争性能，仅用7B参数即在多数子任务上超越14B的VTV-LLM模型，证明了触觉常识推理的有效性和效率。
Conclusion: TacReasoner通过动态触觉编码和链式思维推理有效缓解了动态触觉建模不足和触觉基础模型幻觉问题，在触觉常识推理任务上表现出色。

papers.title: Physically-Relevant Information Learning in High-Dimensional Time-Derivatives Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the physics of many-body complex dynamical systems is typically non-trivial. High-dimensional analysis approaches are often deemed necessary to prevent losing important information. Typically, these use order parameters or descriptors capturing information related to, e.g., relative positions, symmetries, etc., of the units in the studied system. However, in many cases, gaining information related to the relative positions (or velocities) of the constitutive units alone may be insufficient, and to reach a more complete physical knowledge, one should ideally learn and correlate with each other both structure and dynamics. Here we demonstrate how to efficiently achieve such a goal by building and navigating high-dimensional Time-Derivatives (TiDe) space. A TiDe space can be easily generated for virtually any type of system/phenomenon under study from the time-series data collected along its observation over time. Each TiDe's dimension corresponds to a growing-order time-derivative of the extracted data, thus containing information related to different types of physical phenomena/events that can be easily extracted via unsupervised approaches. We demonstrate how, by definition, TiDes can be directly analyzed without a need for prior dimensionality reduction, providing results that are intrinsically intuitive to interpret. We show the potential of the method by analyzing two prototypical example datasets extracted from molecular dynamics simulations or experimental tracking of different complex dynamical systems. Our results demonstrate how efficiently one can navigate and learn in such information-rich TiDe spaces, which provide robust general frameworks for data analysis and for studying complex dynamical systems from the data collected along their observation over time.

Conclusion: TiDe空间提供了一种鲁棒的通用框架，用于从观测时间序列数据中分析复杂动力学系统。

papers.title: Three-Phase Evaluation of AI-Assisted Software Development Life Cycle
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an exploratory evaluation of how increasing levels of AI autonomy affect software development productivity, requirement adherence, and developer cognitive workload. A team of four developers reimplemented the same full-stack web application across three sequential phases: partial AI-assisted development using GitHub Copilot, an AI-exclusive workflow using GitHub Copilot, and an AI-exclusive workflow using AWS Kiro. Evaluation metrics included development effort (hours), requirement adherence (RITM score), AI-interaction efficiency, and NASA-TLX workload measures. Across phases, higher levels of AI autonomy were associated with reduced development effort, improved requirement adherence, and lower self-reported mental workload, while developer frustration increased modestly. The AWS Kiro phase achieved the strongest overall performance on most measured dimensions, suggesting that tooling architecture may influence outcomes independently of AI autonomy level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过三个阶段的实验，评估了不同AI自主性水平（部分AI辅助、AI独占使用GitHub Copilot、AI独占使用AWS Kiro）对软件开发生产率、需求符合度和开发者认知工作负荷的影响。结果显示，更高的AI自主性减少了开发时间，提高了需求符合度，降低了心理工作负荷，但开发者受挫感略有增加。AWS Kiro阶段在大多数指标上表现最佳。
Motivation: 当前缺乏对不同AI自主性水平在完整软件开发周期中影响的系统性比较研究，尤其是对开发者工作负荷和需求符合度的量化评估。
Method: 设计三阶段实验：阶段一为部分AI辅助（GitHub Copilot），阶段二为AI独占工作流（GitHub Copilot），阶段三为AI独占工作流（AWS Kiro）。同一团队四名开发者重新实现相同全栈Web应用，记录开发工时、需求符合度（RITM分数）、AI交互效率及NASA-TLX工作负荷。
Result: 更高AI自主性阶段降低了开发工时，提高了RITM需求符合度，降低了NASA-TLX自报心理工作负荷；但开发者受挫感略有上升。AWS Kiro阶段在多数测量维度上表现最强。
Conclusion: AI辅助工具可显著提升软件开发效率并减轻开发者认知负担，但工具架构本身（如Kiro vs Copilot）可能独立于自主性水平影响结果，需进一步研究。

papers.title: ASSEMCAD: Production-Ready CAD Assembly Generation from Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models and programmatic CAD have significantly improved Text-to-CAD generation for individual parts. However, production-ready mechanical assembly generation remains largely unsolved. Unlike single-part modeling, assemblies require coordinated reasoning over multiple components, functional interfaces, assembly relations, engineering principles, and physical consistency. Consequently, directly generating executable CAD code is insufficient for constructing mechanically valid and reusable assemblies. We present AssemCAD, an axiom-grounded framework for production-ready CAD assembly generation from natural language. Instead of representing an assembly as monolithic CAD code, AssemCAD first constructs an axiomatic Assembly Specification consisting of typed parts, geometry-backed ports, executable mates, and engineering axioms. Each assembly relation is explicitly grounded in one or more engineering principles, making the resulting specification interpretable, reusable, and verifiable. To realize this specification, AssemCAD introduces a port- and mate-based CAD assembly library that executes symbolic assembly relations through deterministic mate transformations and validates declared interfaces using concrete B-Rep geometric evidence. Built on this representation and library, AssemCAD further supports on-demand synthesis of reusable parametric component factories for both standard and open-world geometries. Experiments on AssemBench show that AssemCAD substantially improves assembly preservation and physical validity over code-centric CAD generation baselines, while generalizing across different foundation-model backbones. By combining axiom-grounded assembly reasoning with deterministic geometric execution, AssemCAD extends Text-to-CAD from isolated part generation toward production-ready mechanical assembly design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AssemCAD，一个从自然语言生成生产就绪 CAD 装配的公理化框架。它通过构建包含类型化部件、几何端口、可执行配合和工程公理的装配规范，并配合基于端口和配合的 CAD 装配库实现，支持按需合成可重用参数化组件工厂。在 AssemBench 基准上，AssemCAD 相比代码中心的基线显著提升了装配保持率和物理有效性，并能在不同基础模型上泛化。
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型和程序化 CAD 已提升单个零件的文本生成能力，但生产就绪的机械装配生成仍未解决，因为装配需要多组件协调推理、功能接口、装配关系、工程原理和物理一致性，直接生成 CAD 代码不足以保证机械有效性和可重用性。
Method: 提出 AssemCAD 框架，先构建公理化装配规范（含类型化部件、几何端口、可执行配合和工程公理），再引入基于端口和配合的 CAD 装配库，通过确定性配合变换和 B-Rep 几何验证执行装配关系，并支持按需合成可重用参数化组件工厂。
Result: 在 AssemBench 基准上，AssemCAD 在装配保持率和物理有效性上显著优于代码中心的 CAD 生成基线，且在不同基础模型骨干上表现一致。
Conclusion: 通过公理化装配推理与确定性几何执行的结合，AssemCAD 将 Text-to-CAD 从孤立零件生成扩展至生产就绪的机械装配设计。

papers.title: Green for Go, Red for No: Visual Grounding via Semantic Segmentation for VLA Navigation Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robot navigation from natural language and visual goals, but remain susceptible to perceptual distractions and ambiguous scene interpretations. This paper presents the first empirical evaluation of visual grounding for VLA navigation policies. We propose a real-time segmentation-based grounding method that highlights traversable areas in green and non-traversable areas in red using SegFormer. Two variants are evaluated: observation-only segmentation and joint observation-goal augmentation. Using OmniVLA on the Grand Tour dataset, we show that visual grounding reduces the mean waypoint error by 27-44% at the farthest waypoint, depending on the instruction length. The benefits are greater for long instructions than for short instructions, and grounding provides little improvement for image goals. Normalized error analysis indicates that grounding primarily acts as a trajectory length regularizer, reducing the predicted path length by 30% without improving per-unit-distance reasoning. Our results indicate that visual grounding offers a simple, computationally inexpensive method to improve VLA navigation without model retraining, although it cannot compensate for missing training signals in out-of-distribution instructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对视觉接地 (visual grounding) 在视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 导航策略中的效果进行实证评估。提出一种基于 SegFormer 的实时分割接地方法，将可穿越区域标记为绿色、不可穿越区域标记为红色，并评估了两种变体。在 Grand Tour 数据集上使用 OmniVLA 模型，结果表明视觉接地将最远航路点的平均误差降低 27-44%，并作为轨迹长度正则化器将路径长度减少 30%。
Motivation: VLA 模型在机器人导航中易受感知干扰和场景歧义影响，现有工作缺乏对视觉接地在 VLA 导航中作用的系统评估。
Method: 提出实时分割接地方法，使用 SegFormer 对观测进行语义分割，将可穿越区域着色为绿色、非可穿越区域为红色。评估两种变体：仅对观测进行分割，以及同时对观测和目标进行分割增强。
Result: 在 Grand Tour 数据集上，视觉接地将最远航路点平均误差降低 27-44%（取决于指令长度），对长指令收益更大，对图像目标改善有限。归一化误差分析表明接地主要作为轨迹长度正则化器，将预测路径长度减少 30% 而不提升每单位距离推理。
Conclusion: 视觉接地提供了一种简单、计算开销低的方法来改进 VLA 导航，无需重新训练模型，但无法补偿分布外指令中缺失的训练信号。

papers.title: Agent Data Injection Attacks are Realistic Threats to AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents act on behalf of user prompts, consuming external data and taking actions based on the agent context. Prior research on AI agent security has primarily focused on indirect prompt injection (IPI). Its most well-studied category is instruction injection, where attacker-controlled untrusted data is interpreted as an instruction. In response, many mitigations have been proposed to prevent instruction injection attacks. In this paper, we introduce a new category of IPI, agent data injection attacks (ADI). ADI injects malicious data disguised as trusted data, such as security-critical metadata (e.g., resource identifiers or data origins) or agent context data (e.g., tool call and response formats). As a result, agents unknowingly execute unintended actions based on attacker-controlled data. ADI has similar attack impacts as instruction injection attacks, because it causes agents to misbehave and execute unintended actions. Despite the similar impact, ADI remains underexplored and easily bypasses existing IPI defenses. We found several critical vulnerabilities in real-world agents that allow an attacker to launch various attacks: arbitrary click attacks on web agents (Claude in Chrome, Antigravity, and Nanobrowser), and remote code execution and supply-chain attacks on coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI). We evaluate ADI vulnerabilities across off-the-shelf models and AI agents, and find that ADI is effective in both standalone LLMs and AI agent settings. ADI exposes a critical gap in agent security, signifying that current AI agents do not employ a fundamental security principle: current agents do not isolate trusted data from untrusted data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的间接提示注入类别——代理数据注入攻击（ADI），攻击者将恶意数据伪装成可信数据（如资源标识符或工具调用格式），使AI代理执行非预期动作。研究表明ADI在真实世界代理（如Claude in Chrome、Claude Code等）中有效，可实现任意点击、远程代码执行等攻击，且能绕过现有防御。
Motivation: 现有AI代理安全研究主要关注指令注入攻击，而数据注入攻击（ADI）尚未被充分探索，且容易绕过现有防御，造成严重威胁。
Method: 提出并分析了代理数据注入攻击（ADI），通过注入伪装成可信数据的恶意数据来操控代理行为。
Result: 在多个真实世界代理（如Claude in Chrome、Antigravity、Nanobrowser、Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI）中发现漏洞，可实现任意点击攻击、远程代码执行和供应链攻击。
Conclusion: 当前AI代理缺乏将可信数据与不可信数据隔离的基本原则，ADI揭示了代理安全的重要缺口。

papers.title: Localized LoRA-MoE: Block-wise Low-Rank Experts With Adaptive Routing
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) and high-dimensional perception networks increasingly rely on parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) to adapt to diverse operational contexts. However, standard methods like LoRA are structurally limited by a monolithic bottleneck, making them highly susceptible to gradient warfare. Interleaved multi-task streams may trigger destructive optimization feedback, collapsing adapter weights into unspecialized averages. While recent spatial partitioning methods have introduced block-wise isolation, they remain trapped in static topologies, unable to adapt to dynamic task-switching or environmental sensor failure. In this work, we introduce Localized LoRA-MoE, a unified framework that fuses localized spatial blocking with dynamic, context-conditioned routing. We propose and evaluate two novel architectural paradigms: Block-Wise LoRA-MoE (Centralized Macro-Routing), which modulates the entire structural grid via a monolithic context signal, and Cell-Wise LoRA-MoE (Decentralized Micro-Routing), which empowers every coordinate cell in the matrix grid with autonomous, localized expert gating. Through a comprehensive suite of benchmarks, ranging from high-dimensional SVD matrix simulations and real-world tabular transformations to spatial vision perception under sensor degradation, we demonstrate that both architectures resolve optimization deadlocks inherent in static baselines. Our empirical results establish that decentralized cell-level gating achieves complete statistical parity with an omniscient global coordinator, providing a robust "gradient firewall" that protects surviving pathways from fault-propagated corruption. Our proposals consistently outperform static baselines, offering a scalable and parameter-efficient solution for dynamic model adaptation across granular coordinate fields and shifting operational regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LoRA在多任务微调中梯度冲突和静态分区的问题，提出Localized LoRA-MoE框架，融合局部空间分块与动态上下文路由，包括集中式宏路由（Block-Wise）和去中心化微路由（Cell-Wise）两种架构。在矩阵模拟、表格变换和空间视觉感知任务上的实验表明，该框架解决了优化死锁，去中心化门控可达到与全局协调器相同的统计性能，并提供梯度防火墙保护未受损路径。
Motivation: 标准LoRA受限于瓶颈结构，多任务流容易引发梯度冲突和优化反馈破坏；现有空间分区方法采用静态拓扑，无法适应动态任务切换或传感器故障。
Method: 提出两种架构：Block-Wise LoRA-MoE通过全局上下文信号调制整个结构网格；Cell-Wise LoRA-MoE赋予每个坐标单元独立的专家门控，实现去中心化路由。
Result: 在高维SVD矩阵模拟、现实表格变换和传感器退化下的空间视觉感知基准上，两种架构均优于静态基线，去中心化门控实现与全局协调器完全统计等价，且作为梯度防火墙阻断了故障传播。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了可扩展、参数高效的动态模型适配方案，适用于细粒度坐标域和动态操作场景，有效解决了优化死锁问题。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对LoRA在多任务微调中梯度冲突和静态分区的问题，提出Localized LoRA-MoE框架，融合局部空间分块与动态上下文路由，包括集中式宏路由（Block-Wise）和去中心化微路由（Cell-Wise）两种架构。在矩阵模拟、表格变换和空间视觉感知任务上的实验表明，该框架解决了优化死锁，去中心化门控可达到与全局协调器相同的统计性能，并提供梯度防火墙保护未受损路径。
summary_sections.motivation: 标准LoRA受限于瓶颈结构，多任务流容易引发梯度冲突和优化反馈破坏；现有空间分区方法采用静态拓扑，无法适应动态任务切换或传感器故障。
summary_sections.method: 提出两种架构：Block-Wise LoRA-MoE通过全局上下文信号调制整个结构网格；Cell-Wise LoRA-MoE赋予每个坐标单元独立的专家门控，实现去中心化路由。
summary_sections.result: 在高维SVD矩阵模拟、现实表格变换和传感器退化下的空间视觉感知基准上，两种架构均优于静态基线，去中心化门控实现与全局协调器完全统计等价，且作为梯度防火墙阻断了故障传播。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架提供了可扩展、参数高效的动态模型适配方案，适用于细粒度坐标域和动态操作场景，有效解决了优化死锁问题。

papers.title: Grokking Is Conditional and Fragile: A Fully-Tractable, Multi-Seed Study at 12K Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Grokking -- the delayed onset of generalization long after a network has fit its training set - -is usually studied in models too large to read completely and reported from single training runs. We instead study a publicly released ~11,856-parameter Llama-style transformer (Glimmer-1-Base) on modular arithmetic, small enough to enumerate its weights, attention, and full input-output map, and we measure grokking as a multi-seed rate rather than a single outcome. In this fully-tractable regime grokking is a conditional, fragile phase transition. It is gated by training-set coverage, whose threshold tracks output cardinality (the modulus) more than task structure, an ordering that holds above the transition and across a ten-fold change in domain size. Weight decay reproduces the Omnigrok inverted-U at 12K parameters, a positive control on the rate measurement. Grokking also sits on a numerical knife-edge: two perturbations of the floating-point environment -- CPU thread count (reduction order) and CPU-versus-GPU execution -- each flip a minority of same-seed outcomes without a detectable shift in the aggregate rate. Decomposition into sub-task specialists helps chiefly by making coverage cheap rather than by adding supervision. Methodologically, multi-seed control under a fixed numerical environment overturns three dramatic single-run narratives in our own data, each a seed confound. The unit of evidence for grokking must therefore be a multi-seed rate under a pinned numerical environment, checked where possible against a direct reading of the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在约12,000参数的小型可完全枚举Transformer（Glimmer-1-Base）上研究grokking现象，发现其具有条件性和脆弱性。摘要报告grokking是条件性相变，受训练集覆盖阈值控制，阈值由输出基数（模数）决定；权重衰减复现Omnigrok倒U型曲线；浮点环境扰动（CPU线程数、CPU vs GPU）会翻转部分种子结果但不改变聚合速率。多种子实验表明单次运行结论不可靠。
Motivation: 现有研究通常在过大的模型上观察grokking且仅报告单次训练结果，缺乏统计可靠性和可解释性。本文通过完全可枚举的小模型和多种子实验来揭示grokking的真实性质。
Method: 使用公开的约12,000参数Llama风格Transformer（Glimmer-1-Base）执行模算术任务，枚举所有权重、注意力和完整输入输出映射，并以多种子速率而非单次结果衡量grokking。
Result: 摘要显示：grokking的条件性由训练集覆盖率决定，阈值与输出基数（模数）相关，并在十倍域大小变化下保持；权重衰减在12K参数上再现Omnigrok倒U型；浮点环境扰动（CPU线程数、CPU vs GPU）使少量种子结果翻转但不影响聚合速率；分解为子任务专家主要降低覆盖成本而非增加监督。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，grokking的证据单位应为固定数值环境下的多种子速率，并尽可能通过直接读取模型验证；单次运行结果可能由于种子和数值环境而误导。

papers.title: Choosing a parallel heterogeneous ensemble method for tabular classification
papers.abstract_en: Parallel ensemble methods were compared on $56$ small-to-medium tabular classification tasks drawn from OpenML CC18. A set of ``best practice'' recommendations on the use of ensemble methods was derived from these observations. It was later validated on 28 additional tasks using TabArena's precomputed data, where the recommendation set significantly outperformed Single Best and matched or exceeded individual ensemble methods. Two key observations were made. First, Blending and Stacking are inconsistent, but their inconsistencies are independent and happen on different tasks. Second, while Hard Voting's probabilistic classification is rather weak, a consequence of using vote proportions as posterior estimates, Robust Soft Voting's probabilistic classification is particularly successful, especially in the multiclass case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在OpenML CC18的56个中小型表格分类任务上系统比较了多种并行集成方法（Blending、Stacking、Hard Voting、Robust Soft Voting），并基于观察得出一组“最佳实践”推荐。该推荐集在TabArena的28个额外任务上验证，表现优于单一最佳模型，且与单个集成方法相当或更优。关键发现包括：Blending和Stacking的不一致性相互独立且发生在不同任务上；Hard Voting的概率分类较弱，而Robust Soft Voting在多元分类中表现突出。
Motivation: 现有并行集成方法的选择缺乏系统性比较和实用指南，尤其是在表格分类任务中，不同方法的表现和一致性尚未被充分理解。
Method: 在56个OpenML CC18任务上对比Blending、Stacking、Hard Voting和Robust Soft Voting等并行集成方法，提炼出“最佳实践”推荐，并在28个TabArena任务上验证其有效性。
Result: 推荐集显著优于Single Best，并匹配或超越单个集成方法；Blending和Stacking不一致但独立；Hard Voting概率估计差，Robust Soft Voting在多元分类上表现优异。
Conclusion: 所提出的“最佳实践”推荐可指导表格分类中的并行集成方法选择，但结论可能受限于中小型数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Counterfactual Methods for Detecting Unfairness in Anti-Money Laundering Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: The application of machine learning-based predictive algorithms to Anti-Money Laundering (AML) has grown rapidly, driven by the vast volume of financial transaction data available to banks. These algorithms are typically trained not only on transactional data but also on sensitive client information, which may raise fairness concerns. Despite this, AML detection systems remain largely underexplored from a fairness perspective, even though deeper analytical methods based on counterfactuals are now available. Such techniques enable the decomposition of the direct and indirect effects of potentially sensitive features on model predictions, thereby supporting the evaluation of whether their influence is acceptable from a fairness perspective. Closing this gap, we consider the synthetic IBM AMLSim transaction dataset and construct additional features of the country of an account and its average behaviour. This improves the predictive performance of diverse machine learning models, ranging from baseline decision trees to state-of-the-art graph neural networks. We assess the potential unfairness associated with these features through a counterfactual, path-specific effect analysis. This reveals that fairness violations tend to be more pronounced for models whose predictive performance benefits the most from the extended features. Such a finding highlights a concrete instance of the trade-off between predictive accuracy and fairness in AML applications, thus underscoring the urgency of a systematic fairness analysis in such critical domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究反洗钱（AML）机器学习算法中的公平性问题，使用反事实路径特定效应分析来检测潜在的不公平。作者在合成IBM AMLSim数据集上扩展了账户国家和平均行为特征，提升了模型预测性能，但发现性能提升越大的模型，公平性违规越严重，揭示了准确性与公平性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 反洗钱算法通常使用敏感客户信息，但公平性未得到充分研究。现有反事实分析方法可用于分解敏感特征的直接和间接影响，从而评估公平性。
Method: 使用合成IBM AMLSim数据集，构建账户国家和平均行为等附加特征，训练从决策树到图神经网络等多种模型，并通过反事实路径特定效应分析来评估不公平性。
Result: 扩展特征提高了预测性能，但反事实分析显示，预测性能提升越大的模型，不公平性越显著，表明准确性与公平性之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: 论文强调了在反洗钱等关键领域进行系统性公平性分析的必要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AIFS-SUBS: Extending Data-Driven Forecasting to Sub-Seasonal Timescales
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven models now rival numerical weather prediction in the medium range, but extending them to sub-seasonal lead times raises challenges absent at shorter horizons. Errors accumulate over long autoregressive rollouts, systematic biases grow with lead time, and several years of data must be held out for independent verification, even though machine-learning models otherwise benefit from longer training records. To address these challenges, we adapt ECMWF's AIFS-CRPS medium-range model. AIFS-SUBS adopts a 24h autoregressive time step to reduce error accumulation, adds stratospheric levels and top-of-atmosphere thermal radiation as predictors, and reserves 2007--2011 as an independent verification window. We evaluate two config-durations: AIFS-SUBS, fine-tuned on operational analyses, and AIFS-SUBS-ERA5, trained on ERA5 alone. Across weeks 2--6, AIFS-SUBS matches the operational Integrated Forecasting System (IFS) in probabilistic skill while reducing systematic biases. For the convective (OLR) component of the Madden--Julian Oscillation (MJO), AIFS-SUBS extends skilful forecasts (correlation > 0.5) by eight days relative to the IFS, while matching or exceeding the IFS for the full multivariate RMM index. AIFS-SUBS also reproduces the observed MJO modulation of tropical cyclone activity comparably. Stratospheric skill is particularly strong with AIFS-SUBS reproducing sudden stratospheric warming (SSW) frequency and surface impact. In the AI Weather Quest, AIFS-SUBS-ERA5 attains a variable-averaged ranked probability skill score slightly ahead of the IFS at weeks 3 and 4. At inference, AIFS-SUBS uses about 200 times less energy than the IFS, opening the door to much larger real-time ensembles. AIFS-SUBS is ECMWF's first machine-learning model targeted at sub-seasonal time-scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍AIFS-SUBS，一种将数据驱动预报扩展到次季节时间尺度的模型。该模型采用24小时自回归步长减少误差累积，加入平流层和大气顶热辐射作为预测因子，并使用2007-2011年作为独立验证窗口。结果表明，在第2-6周，AIFS-SUBS在概率技能上匹配操作IFS，减少系统性偏差，在MJO预报中比IFS提前8天达到相关性>0.5，且能耗降低约200倍。
Motivation: 数据驱动模型在中程预报中已媲美数值预报，但扩展到次季节时间尺度面临误差累积、系统性偏差增长和独立验证数据不足等挑战。
Method: 基于ECMWF的AIFS-CRPS中程模型，采用24小时自回归时间步长，增加平流层和大气顶热辐射作为预测因子，并保留2007-2011年作为独立验证窗口。包含两个配置：AIFS-SUBS（基于操作分析微调）和AIFS-SUBS-ERA5（仅基于ERA5训练）。
Result: 在第2-6周，AIFS-SUBS在概率技能上匹配IFS并减少系统性偏差；MJO预报中对流OLR成分比IFS提前8天达到相关性>0.5；对热带气旋活动的MJO调制再现能力相当；平流层技能强劲，能再现平流层突然增温频率和地表影响；AIFS-SUBS-ERA5在第3-4周的综合概率技能评分略优于IFS；推理能耗约为IFS的1/200。
Conclusion: AIFS-SUBS是ECMWF首个面向次季节时间尺度的机器学习模型，在减少能耗的同时实现了与IFS相当或更优的预报技能，特别在MJO和平流层预报方面表现突出。
Relevance: 70
