papers.title: Functional Bilevel Optimization for Predictive Fairness
papers.abstract_en: When sensitive attributes are continuous and high-dimensional $-$ demographic score vectors, posteriors over attributes, age or income profiles $-$ enforcing full statistical independence is often too restrictive, and existing relaxations rely on indirect dependence penalties or adversarial schemes that do not directly target the fairness-accuracy trade-off. We instead consider mean demographic parity through DPVar, the variance of the conditional-mean prediction given the sensitive attribute, and show that optimizing it yields a functional bilevel problem. We propose two algorithms for this problem: FBO, which uses a closed-form adjoint we derive for the squared-loss case to obtain an exact hypergradient, and ITD, which differentiates through unrolled inner steps and extends beyond squared loss. On synthetic data and a new semi-synthetic benchmark built from 60 tabular regression datasets, both methods achieve the lowest or near-lowest aggregate fairness-accuracy regret, and consistently match or outperform strong HSIC, adversarial, linear-dependence, and generalized-DP baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对预测公平性的功能双层优化方法，旨在处理连续高维敏感属性时的公平性-准确性权衡。作者提出了两种算法（FBO和ITD），在合成数据和基于60个表格回归数据集构建的半合成基准上，达到了最低或接近最低的公平性-准确性遗憾值，并优于多种基线方法。
Motivation: 当敏感属性是连续且高维时（如人口统计评分向量、属性后验、年龄或收入剖面），强制完全统计独立性往往过于严格，而现有的松弛方法依赖间接的依赖性惩罚或对抗性方案，不能直接优化公平性-准确性权衡。
Method: 通过DPVar（给定敏感属性条件下的条件均值预测的方差）来定义均值人口平等，并证明优化该问题会产生一个功能双层优化问题。提出了两种算法：FBO利用平方损失下的闭形式伴随矩阵精确计算超梯度；ITD通过对展开的内循环步骤进行微分，可扩展到非平方损失。
Result: 在合成数据和包含60个表格回归数据集的新半合成基准上，两种方法均达到最低或接近最低的公平性-准确性遗憾值，并一致地匹配或优于HSIC、对抗性、线性依赖和广义DP等强基线方法。
Conclusion: 本文证明，通过功能双层优化直接优化DPVar可以在连续高维敏感属性条件下有效平衡公平性和准确性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 当敏感属性是连续且高维时（如人口统计评分向量、属性后验、年龄或收入剖面），强制完全统计独立性往往过于严格，而现有的松弛方法依赖间接的依赖性惩罚或对抗性方案，不能直接优化公平性-准确性权衡。
summary_sections.method: 通过DPVar（给定敏感属性条件下的条件均值预测的方差）来定义均值人口平等，并证明优化该问题会产生一个功能双层优化问题。提出了两种算法：FBO利用平方损失下的闭形式伴随矩阵精确计算超梯度；ITD通过对展开的内循环步骤进行微分，可扩展到非平方损失。
summary_sections.result: 在合成数据和包含60个表格回归数据集的新半合成基准上，两种方法均达到最低或接近最低的公平性-准确性遗憾值，并一致地匹配或优于HSIC、对抗性、线性依赖和广义DP等强基线方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文证明，通过功能双层优化直接优化DPVar可以在连续高维敏感属性条件下有效平衡公平性和准确性。

papers.title: FAST: A Holistic Framework for Optimizing Memory-I/O, Computation, and Sampling in Temporal GNN Training
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) are widely used for learning from dynamic graphs in applications such as recommendation, social network analysis, and traffic forecasting. However, scaling TGNN training to large dynamic graphs remains challenging due to three intertwined bottlenecks: memory I/O, irregular computation, and temporal neighbor sampling. Existing systems often optimize these stages in isolation, leaving substantial performance headroom on the table. We present FAST, a holistic framework that accelerates end-to-end TGNN training by jointly optimizing sampling, memory I/O, and computation. FAST introduces SlimCache, which exploits within-batch compression and cross-batch caching to reduce host-device data movement under limited GPU memory budgets. It further designs thread-efficient graph operators tailored to sparse temporal subgraphs, improving GPU cache locality and reducing the latency of aggregation and edge softmax. In addition, FAST employs a topology-aware sampling strategy that improves CPU cache locality and accelerates temporal neighbor sampling. Extensive experiments on real-world large dynamic graphs show that FAST achieves an average of 2.1x (up to 4.7x) speedup over state-of-the-art systems without sacrificing model accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出FAST框架，联合优化时间图神经网络训练中的采样、内存I/O和计算，通过SlimCache压缩、线程高效图算子和拓扑感知采样实现端到端加速，在真实动态图上平均获得2.1倍速度提升。
Motivation: 现有TGNN训练系统孤立优化三个瓶颈（内存I/O、不规则计算、时序邻居采样），导致性能提升有限。
Method: FAST包含三个组件：SlimCache（批内压缩与跨批缓存）、针对稀疏时序子图的线程高效图算子、以及拓扑感知采样策略。
Result: 在真实大规模动态图上，FAST相比现有系统实现平均2.1倍（最高4.7倍）加速，且不损失模型精度。
Conclusion: 联合优化采样、内存I/O和计算是TGNN训练加速的关键，FAST证明了该思路的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Semantic Video Communication via Multi-Scale Convolution and Dynamic Routing for Next-Generation Networks
papers.abstract_en: The exponential growth of video traffic demands novel semantic communication paradigms that transmit meaning rather than raw bits. We present a generative AI-enabled framework for semantic video communication addressing two critical challenges: efficient hierarchical temporal modeling for bandwidth-constrained transmission and robust semantic alignment between video content and natural language queries at network edge devices. Our approach introduces a multi-scale temporal convolutional encoder that captures motion patterns across different temporal granularities with O(T) complexity suitable for resource-constrained IoT deployments. We further propose a capsule-based dynamic routing mechanism that iteratively refines segment-query associations, enabling flexible modeling of non-monotonic semantic alignments essential for goal-oriented communication. These components are unified through a multi-task learning objective optimizing temporal boundary regression, cross-modal alignment, and capsule diversity. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions demonstrate significant improvements, achieving 42.9% Recall@0.5 and 41.1% mean IoU while maintaining computational efficiency critical for edge deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted at the AAAI 2026 Workshop on AI for Time Series (AI4TS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对下一代网络中视频流量激增的问题，提出了一种基于生成式AI的语义视频通信框架。该框架通过多尺度时序卷积编码器（复杂度O(T)）捕获不同粒度的运动模式，并引入基于胶囊的动态路由机制迭代优化片段-查询关联，最终在多任务学习目标下统一训练。在ActivityNet Captions数据集上，方法在Recall@0.5和平均IoU上分别达到42.9%和41.1%，同时保持了边缘部署所需的计算效率。
Motivation: 现有语义通信方法在带宽受限传输中缺乏高效的分层时序建模能力，且无法在边缘设备上实现视频内容与自然语言查询的鲁棒语义对齐。
Method: 提出多尺度时序卷积编码器（Multi-Scale Temporal Convolutional Encoder）以O(T)复杂度捕获不同时间粒度的运动模式；设计基于胶囊的动态路由机制（Capsule-based Dynamic Routing）迭代优化片段-查询的非单调语义对齐；通过多任务学习目标联合优化时序边界回归、跨模态对齐和胶囊多样性。
Result: 在ActivityNet Captions基准上，Recall@0.5达到42.9%，平均IoU达到41.1%，且计算效率满足边缘部署要求。
Conclusion: 本文验证了多尺度卷积与胶囊动态路由在语义视频通信中的有效性，为资源受限场景下的生成式AI通信框架提供了新思路。

papers.title: Be Indiscrete: The Benefits of Learning Continuous Spine Degeneration Severity Scores
papers.abstract_en: Lumbar spine degeneration is a major contributor to chronic low back pain and is routinely assessed on MRI using ordinal grading systems, e.g. normal, mild, moderate, severe. Consequently, most approaches to train models to grade these MRIs formulate grading as a multi-class classification problem, treating ordinal grades as categorical, ignoring differences in misclassification severity, and imposing hard decision boundaries on a continuous disease process. This work explores modeling spinal degeneration as a continuous severity ranking problem. We introduce SpineRankNet, a framework that learns scalar severity scores from lumbar spinal MRI, and compare it against multi-class classification and ordinal regression. Using multiple degeneration measures from the Genodisc dataset, we show that a model trained using a ranking loss to produce a continuous score enables fine-grained ordering of MRI scans. Furthermore, the ordinal grading classes can be recovered from the score with comparable accuracy to those from a model trained directly for classification. The score learned by ranking even improves discrimination between more distant classes. Source code is available at https://github.com/spinetools/spineranknet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨将腰椎退变严重性建模为连续评分问题，提出 SpineRankNet 框架，从腰椎 MRI 学习标量严重性分数，并与多类分类和序数回归比较。在 Genodisc 数据集上，使用排序损失训练的连续评分模型能实现 MRI 扫描的细粒度排序，且可从分数中恢复序数等级，准确率与直接分类模型相当。
Motivation: 现有腰椎退变分级通常采用序数分级系统（如正常、轻度、中度、重度），但多类分类方法忽略误分类严重性差异，对连续疾病过程施加硬决策边界。
Method: 提出 SpineRankNet，使用排序损失（ranking loss）从腰椎 MRI 学习连续的标量严重性分数，并与多类分类和序数回归方法进行对比。
Result: 在 Genodisc 数据集的多个退变测量上，连续评分模型实现了 MRI 扫描的细粒度排序；序数等级可从分数中恢复，准确率与直接分类模型相当，且排序学习的分数能更好地区分距离较远的类别。
Conclusion: 连续严重性评分建模能够提供更细粒度的排序，同时保持分级准确性，有望替代传统分类方法。

papers.title: TimeThink: Reasoning with Time for Video LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Video reasoning requires models to identify and verify temporally localized evidence within long video sequences. Recent Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have shown promising reasoning abilities when aligned with reinforcement learning, yet existing approaches typically rely on outcome-based rewards that supervise only the final prediction. Such supervision provides limited guidance on how models should discover the relevant temporal evidence during intermediate reasoning. In this work, we propose TimeThink, a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly guides temporal evidence discovery in Video-LLMs. Our key idea is to treat temporal clue steps as the fundamental optimization primitive of video reasoning, where each reasoning step references a candidate time interval in the video. We introduce a step-wise temporal process reward that provides localized credit assignment for these clues and a joint process--outcome optimization objective that balances reasoning fidelity with task correctness. To enable scalable training, we construct TimeThink-RFT-20K, a dataset with automatically derived temporal evidence segments. Extensive experiments across video reasoning, temporal grounding, and general video understanding benchmarks show that TimeThink consistently improves both temporal localization and reasoning performance, achieving state-of-the-art results among open-source video RL models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TimeThink，一种面向视频大语言模型 (Video-LLM) 的强化学习框架，通过显式引导时间线索发现来提升视频推理能力。核心是将时间线索步骤作为优化基本单元，引入逐步骤的时间过程奖励和联合过程-结果优化目标。构建了 TimeThink-RFT-20K 数据集用于训练，在视频推理、时间定位和通用视频理解基准上取得开源视频 RL 模型的最高性能。
Motivation: 现有视频 LLM 在推理时通常仅依赖最终预测的结果奖励，缺乏对中间推理过程中如何发现相关时间证据的指导，导致时间证据定位不足。
Method: 将每个推理步骤对应视频中的候选时间区间，设计逐步骤的时间过程奖励 (step-wise temporal process reward) 实现局部信用分配，并联合过程-结果优化目标以平衡推理保真度与任务正确性。同时构建包含自动生成时间证据片段的数据集 TimeThink-RFT-20K。
Result: 在多个视频推理、时间定位和通用理解基准上，TimeThink 一致提升了时间定位与推理性能，达到开源视频 RL 模型的最佳结果。
Conclusion: 时间过程奖励能有效引导视频 LLM 发现相关时间证据，提升推理能力；未来可扩展至更复杂的视频推理场景。

papers.title: RADIANCE: Relative Adaptive Denoising with IP-Adapter for Novel Concept Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved striking progress but still struggle to synthesize rare concepts involving unusual attribute-object pairings, often resulting in concept omission or semantic drift where a dominant entity overwhelms the generation. Tracing these failures to a lack of compositional balance during the denoising trajectory, we propose RADIANCE, a training-free framework that treats inference as a closed-loop feedback process. RADIANCE augments pretrained backbones with three modular components: (1) a Compositional Similarity Monitor (CSM) that tracks the emergence of objects and attributes in intermediate latents via CLIP-based feedback; (2) a Bidirectional Scale Controller (BSC) that applies a reactive "restoring force" using positive and negative IP-Adapter scales to rebalance biased trajectories; and (3) a Feedback Guidance Scheduler (FGS) that coordinates these updates across timesteps without additional training. We further extend the framework to multi-object prompts via Delayed Adapter Activation (DAA) and Layer-wise Alternating Guidance (LAG) to prevent premature concept fusion. By overlapping monitoring and denoising through pipelined execution, RADIANCE maintains competitive latency while significantly enhancing the per-sample success rate and effective throughput. Experiments on RareBench and T2I-CompBench demonstrate that RADIANCE consistently enhances compositional alignment and perceptual quality over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RADIANCE，一种无需训练的框架，通过闭环反馈在推理时增强文生图扩散模型对罕见概念（不常见的属性-对象组合）的合成能力。由三个模块组成：组合相似度监视器（CSM）、双向尺度控制器（BSC）和反馈引导调度器（FGS），并通过延迟适配器激活（DAA）和逐层交替引导（LAG）扩展到多物体提示。实验在RareBench和T2I-CompBench上提升了组合对齐和感知质量。
Motivation: 现有文生图模型在合成罕见概念时容易出现概念遗漏或语义漂移，即主导实体压倒生成。作者将失败归因于去噪轨迹中缺乏组合平衡。
Method: 将推理视为闭环反馈过程，通过CSM监控中间潜变量中的物体和属性（基于CLIP反馈），BSC使用正负IP-Adapter尺度施加类似“恢复力”的干预来重新平衡偏斜轨迹，FGS跨时间步协调更新。额外引入DAA和LAG处理多物体提示。
Result: 在RareBench和T2I-CompBench上，RADIANCE一致优于现有基线，提升了组合对齐和感知质量，同时通过流水线执行保持竞争性延迟，提高了单样本成功率和有效吞吐量。
Conclusion: RADIANCE是一个即插即用的训练免费框架，能有效提升扩散模型对罕见概念合成的组合能力。

papers.title: Computing Monetary Risk Measures in Linear Time
papers.abstract_en: Monetary risk measures have gained popularity for expressing decision-makers' risk aversion. Value-at-Risk (VaR) and Conditional-Value-at-Risk (CVaR), in particular, are used commonly for this purpose. This paper proposes new efficient algorithms to compute these risk measures for a discrete random variable in expected linear time with respect to the size of its domain. First, we propose a QuickVaR algorithm that computes the VaR of a discrete random variable. Then, we leverage QuickVaR to propose QuickDivergence, an algorithm for computing a class of $\varphi$-divergence risk measures, including the popular CVaR risk measure. The QuickVaR algorithm adapts the well-known Quickselect algorithm, while QuickDivergence builds on polymatroid optimization algorithms. Numerical results show that our new algorithms offer an order-of-magnitude speedup for large domains, and a library implementation of the algorithms is available at https://github.com/RiskAverseRL/RiskMeasures.jl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离散随机变量，提出两种线性时间期望复杂度的算法：QuickVaR计算Value-at-Risk，QuickDivergence计算φ-散度风险测度（含CVaR）。数值实验表明，在大规模域上算法实现数量级加速。
Motivation: 现有VaR和CVaR计算方法在大规模离散分布场景下效率不足，亟需线性时间算法。
Method: QuickVaR基于Quickselect选择算法；QuickDivergence结合多拟阵优化理论，通过QuickVaR实现风险测度计算。
Result: 新算法在大规模域上实现数量级加速，开源库RiskMeasures.jl提供实现。
Conclusion: 所提算法为离散分布的风险测度计算提供了理论保证和实用加速。

papers.title: LangLoc: "Tell Me What You See"
papers.abstract_en: We tackle fine-grained indoor localization from natural language: given a free-form description of one's surroundings, estimate the observer's 2D position and heading within a known 3D environment. Language queries are lightweight, privacy-preserving, and need no camera - yet prior work stops at coarse scene retrieval and cannot resolve an intra-scene pose. We close this gap with LangLoc, a three-stage pipeline that (i) retrieves the correct scene via a dual-branch GATv2 encoder with CLIP semantic features, surpassing the previous best by 8 percentage points in Top-1 recall; (ii) estimates position and heading by scoring a dense floor grid through ray-cast object visibility, reaching a median error of 0.95 m; and (iii) resolves residual ambiguity through a Bayesian dialog module that asks targeted yes/no questions and updates a pose posterior until the location is pinpointed. To support this task we contribute a benchmark of $13{,}000{+}$ pose-indexed natural-language descriptions over $1{,}300{+}$ indoor 3D scans.
papers.comment: Accepted at the European Conference of Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LangLoc，一种从自然语言描述进行细粒度室内定位的方法。该方法通过三阶段流水线：场景检索（双分支GATv2编码器+CLIP特征）、位置估计（射线投射物体可见性评分）、贝叶斯对话模块消除歧义，在包含13000+条描述和1300+个3D扫描的基准上实现Top-1召回率提升8个百分点，中位误差0.95米。
Motivation: 现有室内定位工作仅能进行粗粒度场景检索，无法从语言描述解析出场景内的精确姿态。
Method: LangLoc包含三阶段：1）使用双分支GATv2编码器与CLIP语义特征检索正确场景；2）通过射线投射物体可见性对密集地板网格评分估计位置和朝向；3）贝叶斯对话模块主动提问yes/no问题更新姿态后验直至定位确定。
Result: 摘要报告场景检索Top-1召回率超过先前最佳8个百分点，位置估计中位误差0.95米，并贡献了包含13000+条姿态标注自然语言描述和1300+个室内3D扫描的基准。
Conclusion: 摘要表明LangLoc填补了从自然语言描述到精确室内定位的空白，验证了结合场景检索、几何推理和交互式对话的有效性。

papers.title: Diffusion-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Delayed Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning in real world environments often suffers from severe performance degradation due to delayed feedback. Existing approaches typically mitigate performance degradation caused by observation delays by constructing augmented states or predicting the true states. However, these methods often overlook the inherent discrepancy between delayed state and true states induced by stochastic MDP. We theoretically prove the existence of such a discrepancy and show that it leads to the degradation of the optimal policy. To address this challenge, we propose Diffusion Guided Uncertainty Aware Delayed Policy Optimization (DUPO). Our method explicitly models the relationship between delayed state message and the current state using a diffusion model, and leverages the resulting discrepancy estimates to weight delayed policies. Extensive experiments on continuous robotic control tasks with multiple stochastic delays demonstrate that DUPO consistently outperforms existing methods and remains effective even under long and random delay scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中延迟反馈导致的性能下降问题，提出扩散引导的不确定性感知延迟策略优化（DUPO）方法。该方法利用扩散模型显式建模延迟状态与当前状态的关系，并利用差异估计对延迟策略进行加权，在连续机器人控制任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法通过构建增广状态或预测真实状态来缓解延迟观测带来的性能下降，但忽略了随机MDP下延迟状态与真实状态之间的固有差异。论文理论证明了该差异的存在及其导致最优策略退化的机制。
Method: 提出DUPO方法，使用扩散模型建模延迟状态信息与当前状态之间的映射关系，并基于该映射产生的差异估计对延迟策略进行加权，从而减少延迟带来的偏差。
Result: 在具有多种随机延迟的连续机器人控制任务中，DUPO在性能和鲁棒性上一致优于现有方法，即使在长延迟和随机延迟场景下也保持有效。
Conclusion: 论文从理论上证明了延迟状态与真实状态差异的存在及其对策略的负面影响，并验证了所提扩散引导加权方法的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: KVpop -- Key-Value Cache Compression with Predictive Online Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Key-value (KV) cache growth is a major bottleneck in autoregressive decoding, as memory and bandwidth scale linearly with context length. Existing KV eviction methods often rely on static heuristics or proxy scores, which poorly track future token utility and cause brittle eviction as relevance shifts. To address this, we introduce KVpop, which learns a fixed-budget KV eviction policy by directly supervising the keep-or-drop decision. The scorer is trained against a novel future-attention target, computed efficiently without materializing dense attention maps. We further introduce a delayed memory-based scorer that, uniquely among learned eviction methods, defers scoring for a fixed number of steps to exploit near-future context. On AIME and HMMT mathematical reasoning, KVpop retains 98% of full-attention performance on Qwen3-4B at 75% KV cache compression and 97% at 88% compression, consistently outperforming established eviction baselines. Qwen3-8B shows even stronger results, reaching near-full teacher performance. These results show that supervising eviction with future-attention signals cuts memory costs while maintaining quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KVpop，一种学习型KV缓存压缩方法，通过直接监督保留/丢弃决策并引入基于未来注意力的训练目标，在数学推理任务上实现75%压缩时保留98%的全注意力性能。
Motivation: KV缓存增长是自回归解码的主要瓶颈，现有驱逐方法依赖静态启发式或代理分数，无法准确跟踪未来token效用，导致驱逐不稳定。
Method: KVpop学习固定预算的KV驱逐策略，使用新型未来注意力目标训练评分器，并引入延迟内存评分器，在固定步数后利用近未来上下文进行评分。
Result: 在AIME和HMMT数学推理任务上，Qwen3-4B在75%压缩时保留98%性能，88%压缩时保留97%；Qwen3-8B结果更强，接近全注意力教师性能。
Conclusion: 用未来注意力信号监督驱逐可有效降低内存成本同时保持质量。

papers.title: Consistent and Editable: A Balanced Framework for Text-Guided Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recently, diffusion models have achieved considerable success in the text-guided video editing domain. However, existing works often struggle to balance the trade-off between temporal consistency and editability in video editing, with consistency and editability typically being inversely related. To address this, we propose a high-quality video editing framework enhanced for consistency and editability, named EquiEdit, which improves coordinatively the temporal consistency and editability of the edited videos while achieving a balance between the two. In terms of temporal consistency, the proposed temporal Mamba module with a tailored temporal-aware scanning scans fused video sequences following four designed directions, effectively enhancing the inter-frame consistency of edited videos. For editability, we design a noise injection strategy based on the spectral transformation to increase editing flexibility, where the Fourier transform is used to preserve the hidden structure in the initial latent noise used for editing, ensuring inter-frame consistency of the edited video and fidelity to the input video. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in terms of temporal consistency and editability, as well as its great fidelity to the input video itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 EquiEdit 的文本引导视频编辑框架，旨在平衡时序一致性和可编辑性之间的矛盾。通过时序 Mamba 模块增强帧间一致性，并利用基于频谱变换的噪声注入策略提高编辑灵活性。实验表明该方法在一致性和可编辑性上均有效，并保持对输入视频的高保真度。
Motivation: 现有文本引导视频编辑方法难以同时兼顾时序一致性和可编辑性，两者通常呈反比关系。
Method: 提出 EquiEdit 框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 时序 Mamba 模块，通过四种方向的时序扫描增强帧间一致性；(2) 基于傅里叶变换的噪声注入策略，保留初始潜噪声中的隐藏结构以提升编辑灵活性并保证帧间一致性。
Result: 大量定性与定量实验表明，EquiEdit 在时序一致性和可编辑性方面均优于现有方法，且对输入视频保真度高。
Conclusion: EquiEdit 通过协调一致性和可编辑性实现了高质量的视频编辑，在保持输入视频结构的同时提供灵活的编辑能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Toward Trustworthy Large Language Model Agents in Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare appointment scheduling remains a persistent operational bottleneck, driven by manual coordination, fragmented legacy systems, and high administrative overhead. These inefficiencies constrain provider availability and degrade patient access to care. This paper presents CareConnect, a safety-first conversational agent for healthcare logistics automation that leverages large language model (LLM) function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and layered deterministic safety guardrails. The system orchestrates eight domain-specific tools to support appointment booking, modification, cancellation, and facility information retrieval, while enforcing strict scope constraints that prohibit medical advice or diagnosis. Safety-critical situations are handled through deterministic short-circuit mechanisms for emergency detection and medical intent refusal. We evaluate CareConnect on a comprehensive benchmark of 680 task-oriented scenarios spanning end-to-end workflows, multi-turn interactions, and edge cases. Experimental results demonstrate a 91.8% task completion rate with a median per-request latency of 2.2 seconds, 96.0% safety compliance on the dedicated safety-critical evaluation subset, and an average operational cost of $0.0324 per appointment, yielding a significant cost reduction compared to manual human scheduling. These findings show that carefully scoped and rigorously safeguarded LLM-based agents can reliably automate complex healthcare operational workflows while maintaining safety guarantees and achieving substantial cost efficiency. The source code and system implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/Hadi-Hsn/CareConnect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CareConnect，一个用于医疗保健物流自动化的安全优先对话代理，利用LLM函数调用、RAG和分层确定性安全护栏，支持预约、修改、取消和设施信息检索。在680个任务场景的基准测试中，任务完成率达91.8%，中位延迟2.2秒，安全合规性96.0%，每次预约平均成本0.0324美元。

Conclusion: 精心划定范围并严格保障安全的LLM代理能够可靠地自动化复杂医疗操作流程，同时保持安全保证和成本效益。

papers.title: Beyond Independent Labels: Schwartz-Geometry Decoding for Human Value Detection
papers.abstract_en: Human value detection is commonly formulated as sentence-level multi-label classification over the 19 refined Schwartz values, typically predicted as independent labels. Schwartz theory, however, describes them as a circular motivational continuum, in which adjacent values are compatible and opposing values are in tension. We ask whether this structure can be operationalized as an explicit output-space geometry and used as a soft bias rather than a hard constraint. On a DeBERTa-v3-base classifier, we compare two ways of injecting it: training-time geometry-aware objectives and a post-hoc Schwartz-aware energy decoder that scores whole label sets jointly. Across five seeds, training-time geometry gives only limited gains-no larger for the true continuum than for a random ordering-whereas the decoder makes label sets more coherent with the continuum-on theory-aware coherence metrics we introduce-at no cost to Macro-F1 or Micro-F1 (held fixed by its selection rule). The gain is specific to the true Schwartz ordering: it does not appear for a random permutation or an empirical co-occurrence graph through the identical decoder. A bounded Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct diagnostic shows that supplying the continuum at inference shifts behavior but does not match supervised structured prediction. Theory-aware decoding thus offers a lightweight, controllable way to make value detection faithful to its label space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人类价值检测中是否可以利用Schwartz理论描述的圆形动机连续体作为输出空间的软偏置。作者在DeBERTa-v3-base分类器上比较了训练时几何感知目标和事后解码器两种注入方式，发现解码器能提高标签集与连续体的一致性，且不影响Macro-F1或Micro-F1。这种理论感知解码提供了一种轻量级、可控的方法来使价值检测忠实于其标签空间。
Motivation: 现有的人类价值检测通常将19种Schwartz价值观视为独立标签进行分类，但Schwartz理论描述它们为圆形动机连续体，相邻价值兼容，对立价值冲突。作者希望探究能否将这种结构显式作为输出空间几何并用作软偏置。
Method: 在DeBERTa-v3-base分类器上，比较两种注入Schwartz结构的方式：训练时几何感知目标和事后Schwartz感知能量解码器（对整组标签集进行评分）。解码器通过选择规则固定Macro-F1/Micro-F1，同时提升理论感知的一致性指标。
Result: 训练时几何目标仅带来有限提升，且真实连续体与随机排序无显著差异；而解码器使标签集与连续体更一致，且不损害F1分数。收益对真实Schwartz排序特异，对随机排列或经验共现图不出现。

papers.title: A Real-Time Remote-Sensing-Guided Decision-Support Framework for Cloud-Seeding Operations: A Field Demonstration Using Himawari-9 and C-band Phased Array Weather Radar
papers.abstract_en: This study proposes a real-time remote-sensing-guided decision-support framework for cloud-seeding operations using high frequency geostationary satellite and ground weather radar observations. The framework integrates cloud assessment, human-in-the-loop decision support, and aircraft operation to translate high-frequency remote-sensing information into actionable guidance for seeding aircraft. We demonstrate the framework using 2.5-min Himawari-9 geostationary satellite observations and 60-s C-band phased-array weather radar (C-PAWR) observations during the preliminary dry-ice cloud-seeding field campaign conducted over Toyama Bay, Japan, in January 2026. In the 13 January case, the framework enabled the ground team to identify a developing cumulus cloud with a lifetime of approximately 20 min, communicate guidance to the aircraft, and conduct seeding immediately before the cloud began to dissipate naturally. Candidate seedable clouds were identified from Himawari-9 infrared indices, and their selection was supported by near-real-time C-PAWR observations of precipitation echoes. Because the released dry-ice amount was limited to 30 kg, this study does not attempt to attribute subsequent cloud evolution to seeding effects. Instead, the results demonstrate that rapid-scan satellite and ground radar observations can support real-time target selection and aircraft guidance for responsible, operationally feasible weather-intervention field experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于高频静止卫星和地基天气雷达的实时遥感引导决策支持框架，用于云播撒操作。该框架集成云评估、人在回路决策支持和飞机操作，将高频遥感信息转化为可操作的播撒指引。研究利用2.5分钟Himawari-9卫星观测和60秒C波段相控阵天气雷达（C-PAWR）观测，在日本富山湾的干冰云播撒实地试验中演示。2026年1月13日的案例中，地面团队识别出生命周期约20分钟的积云，在云自然消散前及时引导飞机播撒。
Motivation: 云播撒操作需要实时、准确的目标选择和飞机引导，但现有方法缺乏高效整合多源遥感数据并转化为可操作决策的框架。
Method: 提出一个实时决策支持框架，包括云识别（基于Himawari-9红外指数）、候选云验证（利用C-PAWR近实时降水回波观测）、人在回路决策支持以及飞机通信。框架使用2.5分钟Himawari-9和60秒C-PAWR数据，实现高频遥感信息到播撒操作的快速转换。
Result: 在2026年1月13日案例中，框架成功识别出生命周期约20分钟的积云，并在云自然消散前指导飞机进行干冰播撒（使用30 kg干冰）。
Conclusion: 快速扫描的静止卫星和地基雷达观测能够支持实时目标选择和飞机引导，为负责任且可操作的人工影响天气实地实验提供可行方案。本研究未将后续云演化归因于播撒效果，而是证明框架的实时决策支持能力。

papers.title: CollabEval: Statistically Efficient Collaborative Model Evaluation via Matrix Completion
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating generative AI models is a routine, but resource-intensive, process that is conducted over and over again during the course of model development. In this work, we propose Collaborative Evaluation (CollabEval), a simple, effective, and principled method for exploiting dependencies between historical runs of different models on the same tasks to improve statistical efficiency. Specifically, our approach treats model evaluation as a matrix completion problem over an $M \times N$ matrix of evaluation scores, where $M$ is the total number of models and $N$ is the total number of evaluation prompts. We assume that a subset of these $M$ models are targeted for evaluation. For these target models only a small fraction, $p$, of prompts has been annotated with evaluation scores. Leveraging recent results in prediction-powered inference, we build a low-rank approximation of the score matrix, and use the reconstructed values as control variates in a manner that guarantees unbiased estimates of the true evaluation metric mean, in addition to statistically valid confidence intervals. Empirically, across a wide range of datasets, models, and sparsity levels $p$, we find that CollabEval substantially reduces the mean confidence interval size, and the mean squared error of the point estimate, compared to baseline methods at the same annotation budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CollabEval，一种利用历史模型评估结果之间的依赖关系来提高统计效率的方法。该方法将模型评估视为矩阵补全问题，通过低秩近似重建评分矩阵，并使用控制变量法获得无偏估计和有效置信区间。实验表明，在多种数据集、模型和稀疏度水平下，CollabEval显著减小了置信区间宽度和点估计均方误差。
Motivation: 生成式AI模型评估是资源密集型过程，需要多次重复进行。现有方法未充分利用不同模型在同一任务上的历史评估结果之间的依赖关系，导致统计效率低下。
Method: 将模型评估建模为M×N评分矩阵的补全问题，其中M为模型总数，N为评估提示数。对目标模型仅注释p比例的提示，利用预测驱动推断构建低秩近似矩阵，并将重构值作为控制变量，保证无偏估计和统计有效的置信区间。
Result: 在多个数据集、模型和稀疏度p下，与基线方法相比，CollabEval在相同标注预算下显著降低了平均置信区间大小和点估计均方误差。
Conclusion: CollabEval提供了一种简单、有效且原则性的方法来提升模型评估的统计效率，适用于生成式AI模型的开发过程。

papers.title: On the Genealogy of Machine Learning Weather Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine-learning weather prediction (MLWP) has largely inherited the initial-value-problem (IVP) framing of numerical weather prediction (NWP). This inheritance leads to a dominant paradigm of learned autoregressive time-stepping and constrains how the learning problem is defined and architectures are favored. In this study we make the inheritance explicit, contrast two philosophical traditions: "scientific surrogate modeling," where machine learning (ML) is embedded within a physical system and must respect its structural constraints, and "free-form data-driven modeling," where atmospheric fields are treated as spatiotemporal sequences and models learn latent dynamics without explicit physical constraints. By reviewing the governing primitive equations, surveying recent literature, and analyzing concrete physical examples, we map each modeling paradigm to either a state-conditioned or evolution operator formulation. We conclude that principled model selection requires explicitly aligning architecture and training objectives with either the physical system structure or the statistical structure of the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文明确指出现代机器学习天气预报（MLWP）继承自数值天气预报（NWP）的初值问题（IVP）框架，导致主导范式为学习自回归时间步进。文章对比了两种哲学传统：“科学替代建模”（ML嵌入物理系统并尊重其结构约束）与“自由形式数据驱动建模”（将大气场视为时空序列，学习潜在动力学而无显式物理约束）。通过回顾原始方程、调查近期文献和分析物理实例，文章将每种建模范式映射到状态条件或演化算子形式，并得出结论：原则性模型选择需要明确地将架构和训练目标与物理系统结构或数据统计结构对齐。
Motivation: 当前MLWP范式继承自NWP的IVP框架，限制了学习问题的定义和架构偏好，但该继承未被明确认识。文章旨在澄清这一继承，并对比两种建模哲学，为模型选择提供指导。
Method: 通过回顾控制原始方程、调查近期文献、分析具体物理实例，将建模范式映射到状态条件（state-conditioned）或演化算子（evolution operator）形式，并讨论各自的设计原则。
Result: 文章未提供具体实验结果，而是通过理论分析得出：原则性模型选择需要明确对齐架构和训练目标与物理系统结构或数据统计结构。
Conclusion: 文章强调，MLWP的模型选择应基于对物理系统结构或数据统计结构的明确对齐，而非默认采用IVP框架。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: RUFNet: Query-Guided Support Mask Refinement and Uncertainty Fusion based on Hybrid Mamba for Few-Shot Brain Tumor Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot brain tumor segmentation remains challenging due to noisy support masks, inter-patient variations between support and query images, and the lack of pixel-wise confidence estimation. This study proposes RUFNet, a Hybrid Mamba-based few-shot framework that combines support mask refinement with uncertainty-aware posterior fusion. To preserve support-query dependencies with manageable cost, RUFNet adopts a Hybrid Mamba interaction backbone with linear complexity. To reduce support-mask noise, an Attention-Guided Mask Refinement module (AGMR) uses query features to recalibrate support masks and improve prototype consistency. To handle ambiguous predictions, an Uncertainty-Aware Posterior Fusion module (UAPF) estimates pixel-wise variance and adaptively balances few-shot predictions with query-aligned priors. On the Brain Tumor Segmentation Challenge (BraTS) 2020 dataset, RUFNet achieves Dice coefficients of 84.3% and 86.1% in the 1-way 1-shot and 1-way 5-shot settings, respectively, outperforming the compared state-of-the-art methods. These results suggest that Hybrid Mamba interaction, mask refinement and uncertainty modelling can improve the robustness of few-shot medical image segmentation. The official implementation code is available at https://github.com/hdy6438/RUFNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RUFNet，一种基于Hybrid Mamba的小样本脑肿瘤分割框架，结合支持掩码细化与不确定性感知后验融合。在BraTS 2020数据集上，1-way 1-shot和1-way 5-shot设置下Dice系数分别达到84.3%和86.1%，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 小样本脑肿瘤分割面临支持掩码噪声、支持与查询图像间的患者间差异以及缺乏逐像素置信度估计等问题，现有方法鲁棒性不足。
Method: 采用线性复杂度的Hybrid Mamba交互骨干网络；提出注意力引导的掩码细化模块（AGMR），利用查询特征重校准支持掩码以改进原型一致性；提出不确定性感知后验融合模块（UAPF），估计逐像素方差并自适应平衡小样本预测与查询对齐先验。
Result: 在BraTS 2020上，1-way 1-shot和1-way 5-shot的Dice系数分别为84.3%和86.1%，超越比较的最先进方法。
Conclusion: Hybrid Mamba交互、掩码细化和不确定性建模可提升小样本医学图像分割的鲁棒性。代码已开源。

papers.title: LLM-Based Test Oracles: Source-of-Authority Taxonomy -- A Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to produce test oracles, the part of a test that decides whether observed behavior is correct. Yet a clear account of where these oracles draw their authority is missing. Prior secondary studies organize the area by oracle form or by LLM technique. None organizes it by the source of the verdict's authority, the property that governs how far a verdict can be trusted. This article presents a systematic literature review, conducted and reported under the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. From 2,436 records, an LLM pre-filter followed by independent dual human screening (reviewer agreement, a Cohen's kappa of 0.79) and full-text assessment yielded 54 included studies. We analyze these along three axes: the source of an oracle's authority, the form it takes, and the mechanism that adjudicates it. We characterize the landscape of domains, languages, models, and adaptation strategies. Specification-derived authority, though the most common single source, covers about half of the studies (28 of 54). The remaining 26 reach a verdict with no specification at all. The source of authority and the adjudication mechanism cross-cut: the same source is checked by several mechanisms and one mechanism serves several sources, so a label such as LLM-as-a-judge names a mechanism rather than a basis for trust. We further report how these oracles are evaluated and how they fail, and read the sparse and empty regions of the taxonomy as a research agenda. The protocol, search query, and per-study coding sheet are released as supplementary material.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Systematic literature review. Submitted to IEEE Access
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统文献综述，对基于LLM的测试预言（test oracle）进行了分类，重点分析了其权威来源。从2436篇文献中筛选出54篇，发现约一半（28篇）的测试预言基于规范推导的权威（specification-derived authority），其余26篇则没有任何规范。研究还揭示了权威来源与裁决机制之间的交叉关系，并提出了一个研究议程。
Motivation: 现有研究主要按预言形式或LLM技术组织，缺乏对测试预言权威来源的系统分类，而这种分类决定了预言结果的可信度。
Method: 遵循PRISMA 2020指南，从2436条记录开始，经过LLM预筛选和独立双人人工筛查（Cohen's kappa=0.79），最终纳入54篇研究，并从权威来源、形式、裁决机制三个维度进行分析。
Result: 规范推导的权威是最常见的单一来源，覆盖约一半研究（28/54）；其余26篇完全没有规范。权威来源与裁决机制相互交叉，例如LLM-as-a-judge只是一种机制而非信任基础。

papers.title: A Mutual Information-Based Ensemble Kalman Filter
papers.abstract_en: Ensemble Kalman filters (EnKFs) are widely used for data assimilation in geophysical systems. Among various implementations, the local ensemble transform Kalman filter (LETKF) has gained popularity because of its computational efficiency. However, the deterministic EnKF such as the LETKF is known to be less robust than the stochastic EnKF in strongly nonlinear regimes. We generalize the LETKF such that it contains a stochastic term and includes the stochastic EnKF within it. We adaptively optimize the parameter that determines the weight of the stochastic term based on an identity of mutual information, which is satisfied by the Kalman filter in linear Gaussian systems. As the analysis perturbation equations of EnKFs are decomposed into a system of equations for modes that are uncorrelated with each other, the application of mutual information is easily achieved. The generalized LETKF thus optimized is named the mutual information-based ensemble Kalman filter (MI-EnKF). The MI-EnKF indirectly uses the third- and fourth-order moments of the forecast ensemble through entropy. To speed up calculations of entropy, we create a lookup table based on maximum entropy distributions. We conduct data assimilation experiments using the Lorenz-96 model to confirm the validity of the optimization method of MI-EnKF. When the observation operator is linear, the ML-EnKF shows the same analysis accuracy as the LETKF. When the observation operator is strongly nonlinear, the MI-EnKF is more accurate than both LETKF and stochastic EnKF regardless of ensemble size. Optimizing just the first mode can lead to significant improvements, but positive impacts of increasing the number of optimized modes are not observed unless the ensemble size is large. The optimized parameter values indicate that the optimal EnKF lies between the deterministic EnKF and the stochastic EnKF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对确定性集合卡尔曼滤波（如LETKF）在强非线性场景下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出了一种基于互信息（mutual information）的自适应随机化推广——MI-EnKF。该方法通过最大化互信息来优化随机项的权重，间接利用预报集合的三阶和四阶矩计算熵，并借助最大熵分布查表加速计算。在Lorenz-96模型上的实验表明，在线性观测算子下MI-EnKF精度与LETKF相当，在强非线性观测算子下优于LETKF和随机EnKF。
Motivation: 确定性EnKF（如LETKF）在强非线性场景下不如随机EnKF鲁棒，而传统随机EnKF无法自适应调节随机化程度，需要一种能自动平衡确定性与随机性成分的滤波方法。
Method: 在LETKF框架中引入可调随机项，利用卡尔曼滤波在线性高斯系统中满足的互信息恒等式，自适应优化随机项权重；通过分析扰动方程解耦为不相关模态，利用预报集合熵（间接使用三、四阶矩）计算互信息；为加速熵计算，基于最大熵分布构建查找表。
Result: 在线性观测算子下，MI-EnKF与LETKF精度相同；在强非线性观测算子下，MI-EnKF均优于LETKF和随机EnKF，且该优势与集合大小无关。仅优化第一个模态即可显著提升，但增加优化模态数仅在集合较大时有效。优化后的参数表明最优EnKF介于确定性与随机EnKF之间。
Conclusion: MI-EnKF通过互信息自适应调节随机化强度，在强非线性场景下提升同化精度，且计算开销可通过查表控制。后续可扩展至实际地理系统。
Relevance: 70

papers.title: Your Agent's Memories Are Not Its Own: Forged Reasoning Attacks on LLM Agent Memory and Defenses
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory has enabled large language model (LLM) agents to store factual knowledge, prior decisions, reasoning histories, tool usage information, and context. While this has improved the agent's functionality and continuity across tasks, it has also introduced a new attack surface: the agent's own reasoning history. In this paper, we introduce the Forged Amplifying Rationale Memory Attack (FARMA), which poisons an agent's remembered reasoning rather than its factual knowledge. It inserts forged reasoning traces using evasive language that bypasses keyword-based defenses, then amplifies them through self-referential reinforcement that defeats consensus-based defenses. To address FARMA, we introduce SENTINEL, a layered defense pipeline to detect forged reasoning entries. Its central component is the Reasoning Guard that structurally analyzes candidate entries for forgery using five weighted signals. We evaluate FARMA and SENTINEL across multiple agents and different LLM models with 50 trials and show that FARMA achieves an attack success rate of up to 100% under baseline conditions and is capable of defeating defense mechanisms like keyword filter and A-MemGuard. Our evaluation also shows that SENTINEL reduces FARMA's attack success rate to as low as 0% with no false positives observed across 326 benign agent traces. Our work demonstrates the need to protect not only an agent's retrieved content but also the integrity of its reasoning history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FARMA攻击，通过向LLM agent的记忆中注入伪造的推理痕迹并利用自我引用强化来绕过关键词和共识防御，同时提出SENTINEL防御框架，其核心组件Reasoning Guard使用五种加权信号检测伪造条目。实验表明FARMA在基线条件下攻击成功率达100%，而SENTINEL将其降至0%且无假阳性。
Motivation: LLM agent的持久记忆存储推理历史，但现有防御主要针对事实知识毒化，忽略了推理历史被篡改的风险，导致新的攻击面。
Method: 提出FARMA攻击，使用规避性语言插入伪造推理痕迹并通过自我引用强化绕过防御；提出SENTINEL分层防御管道，其Reasoning Guard通过五个加权信号对候选条目进行结构化分析。
Result: 在多种agent和LLM模型上，FARMA基线攻击成功率100%，能击败关键词过滤和A-MemGuard；SENTINEL将攻击成功率降至0%，在326条良性痕迹中无假阳性。
Conclusion: 研究表明需要保护agent推理历史的完整性，而不仅仅是检索内容的真实性。

papers.title: Uncertainty-aware damage identification in short-span bridges via physics-informed variational autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: Vibration-based damage identification in civil infrastructure is a challenging, ill-posed inverse problem due to measurement noise, sparse sensor arrays, and environmental variability. While deep learning is powerful for system identification, deterministic approaches lack reliable uncertainty quantification and can yield physically inconsistent results. This work proposes a robust probabilistic Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) framework: a physics-informed Gaussian copula variational autoencoder (PI-GCVAE) for structural health monitoring (SHM). First, we eliminate the need for data-driven surrogates by embedding a differentiable numerical eigenvalue solver directly into the VAE architecture. This ensures that latent space samples satisfy the governing equations of structural dynamics, reducing the trainable parameter space and improving generalization. Second, we replace the conventional independence assumption of latent variables with a Gaussian copula. This model captures complex, physics-dependent spatial cross-correlations between adjacent structural elements, defining feasible solutions while accounting for inherent system variability and measurement errors. Third, compared with alternatives such as Gaussian mixtures, our copula-based VAE provides an efficient distributional model for high-dimensional, strongly correlated latent spaces. We validate the approach using a synthetic dataset of a simply supported bridge subjected to various damage scenarios and corrupted with stochastic Gaussian noise. Synthetic data enables exhaustive validation against ground-truth stiffness values unavailable in practice. Results demonstrate that the PI-GCVAE accurately recovers the true posterior distribution, achieving 77.2% coverage. The proposed framework provides a reliable, scalable tool for early-stage damage diagnosis in operating bridges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息的高斯copula变分自编码器（PI-GCVAE）框架，用于短跨桥梁的振动损伤识别。通过将可微数值特征值求解器嵌入VAE架构，确保潜在空间样本满足结构动力学方程，并利用高斯copula建模相邻结构单元之间的空间交叉相关性。在简支桥梁合成数据集上，该方法准确恢复了真实后验分布，达到77.2%覆盖率。
Motivation: 基于振动的损伤识别是一个不适定逆问题，受测量噪声、稀疏传感器和环境变化影响。确定性深度学习方法缺乏可靠的不确定性量化，且可能产生物理不一致的结果。
Method: 提出PI-GCVAE框架：将可微数值特征值求解器直接嵌入VAE架构，消除对数据驱动代理的依赖；用高斯copula替代潜在变量的独立假设，捕捉物理相关的空间交叉相关性。
Result: 在简支桥梁合成数据集上，PI-GCVAE准确恢复了真实后验分布，达到77.2%覆盖率。
Conclusion: 该框架为运营桥梁的早期损伤诊断提供了可靠、可扩展的工具，能够处理系统变异性和测量误差。

papers.title: Beyond Modality Fusion: Deep Ensembles for Multimodal Classification
papers.abstract_en: In multimodal classification, late-fusion approaches classify concatenated modality-specific features extracted by unimodal neural networks. When modality imbalance is pronounced, various regularization techniques have been proposed to balance the learning process and overcome the inferior performance of late-fusion networks. In contrast, this work demonstrates that multimodal data can be effectively classified without any explicit modality fusion, using deep ensembles of unimodal networks. We systematically compare deep ensembles to late-fusion networks at equal parameter count and show that ensembles consistently outperform state-of-the-art late-fusion methods designed to address modality imbalance. This advantage also holds over intermediate-fusion techniques we evaluated and over hybrid methods that combine unimodal and multimodal predictions. We propose and empirically validate a method for selecting the number of models per modality in an ensemble, avoiding computationally expensive exhaustive search. Under extreme modality imbalance and small ensemble sizes, the heuristic indicates that ensembles of unimodal models trained solely on the stronger modality are preferable; as the ensemble scales up, incorporating models from the weaker modality becomes beneficial. Both predictions align with our empirical findings. To systematically explore the challenges of optimizing multimodal models, we propose a synthetic multimodal framework that allows control over both the number of modalities and their predictive strength; our findings are consistent across synthetic and real-world datasets. Finally, by fitting scaling laws to bimodal datasets, we estimate the asymptotic performance of ensembles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明无需显式模态融合，使用深度集成（deep ensembles）的单模态网络即可有效进行多模态分类。在参数数量相同情况下，集成方法持续优于为应对模态不平衡而设计的最新晚期融合方法，也优于中间融合和混合方法。作者还提出了一个启发式方法，用于选择集成中每个模态的模型数量，并拟合缩放定律估计集成的渐近性能。
Motivation: 现有的多模态分类中，晚期融合（late-fusion）在模态不平衡时性能较差，需要各种正则化技术。本文探索是否可以不进行任何显式融合，仅通过深度集成单模态网络来有效分类。
Method: 系统比较深度集成（deep ensembles）与晚期融合网络（参数数量相同）；提出一个启发式方法选择每个模态的模型数量，避免穷举搜索；构建一个可控多模态合成框架以系统性研究优化挑战；拟合双模态数据集的缩放定律。
Result: 在参数数量相等时，深度集成持续优于最先进的晚期融合方法，以及中间融合和混合方法。在极端模态不平衡和小集成规模下，仅使用强模态的模型更优；集成规模增大时，纳入弱模态的模型变得有益。这些发现与合成及真实数据集一致。
Conclusion: 多模态分类不一定需要显式模态融合，深度集成是一种简单而有效的方法。启发式方法和缩放定律可为实际中集成大小的选择提供指导。

papers.title: Hyperparameter Transfer in Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The performance of deep learning models crucially depends on the settings of hyperparameters like learning rate, initialization scale, and weight decay. Hyperparameter transfer aims to make near-optimal hyperparameter settings consistent across model scale, so that large models can be optimized by proxy tuning their smaller, cheaper-to-optimize counterparts. While transfer principles are well-studied in the context of dense neural networks in language and vision tasks, they remain comparatively under-explored for graph neural networks (GNNs). We develop and validate a transfer parameterization for GNNs trained with SGD, Adam, and AdamW. Through theoretical scaling analyses and controlled experiments, we show that the proposed parameterization yields stable feature updates, learning rate transfer, and improved performance as width and depth increase. For SGD, we identify graph-dependent first-layer correction factors and show that their use can accelerate early training in graphs with sparse bag-of-words inputs. For Adam, we explore how different message passing normalizations affect early- and late-training transfer behavior, illustrating the importance of message passing normalization and advocating for an associated hyperparameter. For AdamW, we adapt a parameterization that allows for the joint transfer of weight decay and learning rate. Together, these results provide a practical recipe for scaling GNNs across a variety of learning tasks and training scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究图神经网络（GNN）中的超参数迁移问题，提出适用于SGD、Adam和AdamW优化器的迁移参数化方案，通过理论分析和实验验证了该方案在宽度和深度增加时能保持稳定的特征更新、学习率迁移及性能提升。
Motivation: 超参数迁移在密集神经网络中已有充分研究，但在GNN中尚不充分，而GNN的独特结构（如消息传递）可能影响迁移效果。
Method: 通过理论缩放分析和控制实验，为GNN设计迁移参数化方案，针对SGD引入图依赖的第一层校正因子，针对Adam探索不同消息传递归一化对迁移行为的影响，针对AdamW提出联合迁移权重衰减和学习率的参数化。
Result: 实验表明所提参数化在宽和深的GNN中实现稳定特征更新、学习率迁移和性能提升；SGD校正因子加速稀疏词袋输入图上的早期训练；Adam中消息传递归一化对迁移行为关键。
Conclusion: 提供了缩放GNN的实用方案，适用于多种学习任务和训练场景。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统研究图神经网络（GNN）中的超参数迁移问题，提出适用于SGD、Adam和AdamW优化器的迁移参数化方案，通过理论分析和实验验证了该方案在宽度和深度增加时能保持稳定的特征更新、学习率迁移及性能提升。
summary_sections.motivation: 超参数迁移在密集神经网络中已有充分研究，但在GNN中尚不充分，而GNN的独特结构（如消息传递）可能影响迁移效果。
summary_sections.method: 通过理论缩放分析和控制实验，为GNN设计迁移参数化方案，针对SGD引入图依赖的第一层校正因子，针对Adam探索不同消息传递归一化对迁移行为的影响，针对AdamW提出联合迁移权重衰减和学习率的参数化。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明所提参数化在宽和深的GNN中实现稳定特征更新、学习率迁移和性能提升；SGD校正因子加速稀疏词袋输入图上的早期训练；Adam中消息传递归一化对迁移行为关键。
summary_sections.conclusion: 提供了缩放GNN的实用方案，适用于多种学习任务和训练场景。

papers.title: Knowledge Knows, Verbalization Tells: Disentangling Latent Directions for Mathematical Solvability in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although LLMs have made significant progress in mathematical reasoning, determining whether a mathematical problem is solvable remains a fundamental yet challenging capability. While recent studies have probed internal representations of model solvability beliefs, verbalization has primarily been studied behaviorally rather than as an internal representation, limiting its analysis and manipulation. We address this gap by separately probing representations of solvability knowledge and verbalization, allowing us to disentangle the two within model hidden states. Across multiple LLMs, we show that knowledge and verbalization are encoded as distinct, linearly decodable representations and that fabrication is primarily associated with changes in verbalization rather than the underlying knowledge. Prompting with unsolvability cues reduces fabrication primarily by shifting verbalization, while activation steering demonstrates that these representations can be echanistically manipulated to improve model abstention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在数学问题可解性判断中的内部表示，区分了“可解性知识”与“口头表达”（verbalization）。通过线性探针实验，发现两者在隐藏状态中编码为不同的可线性解码表示，且模型编造（fabrication）主要与口头表达变化相关，而非底层知识。提示不可解线索或激活操控可改善模型弃权行为。
Motivation: 现有研究关注LLM对人类可解性信念的内部表示探针，但口头表达主要被行为研究而非内部表示分析，限制了对其的操控和理解。本文旨在分离可解性知识与口头表达的神经表示。
Method: 对多个LLM的隐藏状态进行线性探针，分别解码可解性知识和口头表达；并通过提示不可解线索和激活操控（activation steering）来验证表示的可操纵性。
Result: 知识与口头编码为不同的线性可解码表示；编造主要源于口头表达的变化；提示不可解线索主要通过改变口头表达减少编造；激活操控可直接改善模型弃权。
Conclusion: LLM的数学可解性判断中，知识表示与口头表达是可分离的，且口头表达是编造行为的核心因素，为干预模型信心表达提供了机械性路径。

papers.title: ImputeECG: Deep Learning Reconstruction of Complete 12-Lead Electrocardiograms from Incomplete Recordings for Cardiac Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Complete digital 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) are essential for AI-enabled cardiovascular assessment, yet many clinical ECG records, particularly those digitized from ECG images, remain incomplete because of short display formats, incomplete waveform digitization, lead loss, or signal corruption. We developed ImputeECG, a mask-conditioned one-dimensional Transformer autoencoder that completes 12-lead, 10-s ECGs while retaining all observed samples. The model was trained on PTB-XL and evaluated on PTB-XL and CPSC2018 under simulated incomplete settings, with additional real-world validation in a 43,633-record Kailuan clinical cohort after ECG image digitization. Metrics were computed over originally missing regions, with analyses of morphology and downstream diagnostic utility. On PTB-XL, ImputeECG reduced missing-region MAE by 41.7-51.0% and MSE by 54.0-63.7% versus the strongest baseline, with lower errors in R-peak timing, RR interval, QRS duration, QT interval, and P-wave, QRS-complex, and T-wave reconstruction. On CPSC2018, ImputeECG reduced MAE by 49.7-51.9%, supporting external generalization. In downstream multi-label classification, ImputeECG restored performance to 92.28% AUROC and 33.88% AUPRC in the most incomplete PTB-XL setting, approaching complete-ECG performance. On CPSC2018, completed ECGs achieved 94.75-95.89% AUROC and 78.83-81.86% AUPRC across settings. In Kailuan, ECG completion improved zero-shot sex prediction AUROC from 82.6% to 85.8% and reduced age prediction MAE from 10.72 to 9.87 years after image-based ECG digitization. These findings support ECG completion as a practical strategy for converting incomplete ECG records into AI-ready 12-lead, 10-s digital signals and extending the usable scope of ECG archives for digital cardiac assessment.

TL;DR: 本文提出ImputeECG，一种掩码条件的一维Transformer自编码器，用于从不完整的心电图记录中重建完整的12导联10秒心电图。在PTB-XL和CPSC2018数据集上模拟不完整设置下训练和评估，并在43,633条记录的Kailuan临床队列中进行了真实世界验证。结果表明，ImputeECG在缺失区域MAE和MSE上分别降低41.7-51.0%和54.0-63.7%（相对于最强基线），下游分类性能接近完整ECG水平。结论支持ECG补全作为将不完整ECG记录转化为AI就绪数字信号的实际策略。
Motivation: 许多临床ECG记录因显示格式短、波形数字化不完整、导联丢失或信号损坏而不完整，限制了AI心血管评估。
Method: 提出ImputeECG，一种掩码条件的一维Transformer自编码器，在保留所有观测样本的同时补全12导联10秒ECG。
Result: 在PTB-XL上，缺失区域MAE降低41.7-51.0%，MSE降低54.0-63.7%；在CPSC2018上MAE降低49.7-51.9%。下游分类在PTB-XL最不完整设置下AUROC达92.28%，AUPRC达33.88%，接近完整ECG。在Kailuan队列中，ECG补全将零样本性别预测AUROC从82.6%提升至85.8%，年龄预测MAE从10.72降至9.87年。

papers.title: Comparison of Loss Functions for Robust Deep Learning-based Echocardiography Segmentation when Learning with Partially Labelled Data from Multiple Domains
papers.abstract_en: Echocardiography is the first imaging modality used for assessing cardiac function, and accurate segmentation of cardiac structures is essential for deriving biomarkers. However, the development of effective automated segmentation models for multiple cardiac structures is challenged by the difficulty of training on datasets from different sources that are often partially-labelled. This study aims to address this challenge by evaluating the performance of three loss functions - adaptive categorical cross entropy (aCCE) loss, marginal loss, and the adaptive binary cross entropy (aBCE) loss - in handling partially-labelled data. We conduct a comprehensive comparison of these loss functions across multiple scenarios and network architectures: intra-domain and inter-domain tasks, with both single and multiple partial-labels, and varying proportions of fully-labelled to partially-labelled data. Our experiments reveal that all three loss functions exhibit strong performance in intra-domain segmentation tasks, effectively handling label variations within the same domain. For inter-domain tasks, where models are trained on datasets with a domain shift, the aBCE and marginal losses show superior performance when dealing with the case of one label being missing from some training examples. In scenarios involving more than one label being missing, marginal loss outperforms the other methods, demonstrating its robustness in such complex conditions. These results highlight the strengths of each loss function depending on the labelling scenario, emphasizing the importance of selecting the appropriate loss function to optimize model performance. This study represents the first investigation of techniques for handling partially-labelled data from multiple different domains in echocardiography segmentation and provides a comprehensive comparison of loss-based solutions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对心脏超声（echocardiography）分割中多域部分标注数据训练难题，系统比较了三种损失函数：自适应分类交叉熵（aCCE）、边际损失（marginal loss）和自适应二元交叉熵（aBCE）。实验涵盖域内和跨域任务、单个和多个部分标签以及不同全标注与部分标注数据比例。结果表明，域内任务三种损失函数表现均强；跨域任务中，当单标签缺失时aBCE和边际损失更优，多标签缺失时边际损失最为鲁棒。这是首个在心脏超声分割中研究多域部分标注数据损失函数的工作。
Motivation: 心脏超声是评估心脏功能的首选影像模态，但来自不同来源的数据集往往只有部分标注，阻碍了多结构自动分割模型的开发。
Method: 在部分标注数据场景下，比较自适应分类交叉熵（aCCE）损失、边际损失（marginal loss）和自适应二元交叉熵（aBCE）损失，并在多种网络架构、域内/跨域任务、单/多标签缺失及不同全/部分标注比例下进行评估。
Result: 域内任务中三种损失函数均表现良好；跨域任务且单标签缺失时aBCE和边际损失更优；多标签缺失时边际损失优于其他方法，展现出最强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 不同标注场景下各损失函数各有优势，应根据标签缺失情况选择合适损失函数以优化模型性能。该研究首次在心脏超声分割中系统探索多域部分标注数据的损失函数解决方案。

papers.title: Quantum-Inspired Harmonic Decision Models: A Computational Framework for Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a quantum-inspired computational framework for harmonic decision-making in music. The proposed approach formulates harmonization as an optimization problem within a structured combinatorial space, where multiple candidate chord sequences are evaluated under interacting musical constraints. The model combines an interference-based harmonization stage with a classical optimization procedure grounded in tonal harmony. The quantum-inspired component enables the parallel consideration of multiple harmonic alternatives, while the classical stage refines the resulting sequences to ensure structural coherence and stylistic plausibility. The framework is evaluated on selected musical examples, including Autumn Leaves and It's a Long Way to Tipperary. Quantitative analysis shows that the optimization stage significantly reduces chord density, increases harmonic stability, and improves functional organization. At the same time, expert evaluation highlights the importance of stylistic context, demonstrating that increased harmonic complexity is not always perceived as more natural. The results suggest that harmonic generation can be interpreted as a structured decision-making process in a constrained search space. The proposed approach provides a computational model that integrates domain-specific knowledge with an interference-based search mechanism. Although preliminary, this work indicates that quantum-inspired methods may offer a useful framework for modeling complex decision processes in creative domains such as music. The proposed framework contributes to ongoing research on quantum-inspired models of cognition and decision-making in complex biological and creative systems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种量子启发式计算框架用于音乐中的和声决策，将和声配问题建模为带约束的组合优化，结合量子干涉启发阶段与经典优化阶段。在Autumn Leaves等乐曲上评估，量化分析表明优化降低了和弦密度、提高了和声稳定性与功能组织，但专家评估显示更高和声复杂性并非总是更自然。
Motivation: 现有和声生成方法缺乏结构化决策过程，未能同时考虑多个和声候选及其交互约束。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：首先利用量子启发干涉机制并行评估多个和弦序列，然后通过经典优化强化结构一致性与风格合理性。
Result: 在示例乐曲上，优化阶段显著降低和弦密度、增加和声稳定性、改善功能组织；专家评估指出风格语境很重要，高复杂性不一定更自然。
Conclusion: 和声生成可解释为受限搜索空间中的结构化决策过程，量子启发方法为创造性领域（如音乐）的复杂决策建模提供了有用框架。

papers.title: Unsupervised Pixel-Level Semantic Left-Right Understanding of In-the-Wild Images
papers.abstract_en: While various works address reflective symmetry understanding in 3D data and images, pixel-level semantic left-right prediction of in-the-wild images remains challenging, due to certain difficulties including the lack of 3D information, occlusion, object pose variation, partiality, etc. In this work, we propose an unsupervised learning framework to tackle this challenge. Leveraging recent advances in vertex-wise semantic left-right understanding of 3D data, our unsupervised learning method jointly utilises 3D shape and image datasets to infer pixel-wise semantic left-right predictions in single-view images. In particular, we show that a medium-scale 3D shape dataset comprising mainly of human- and quadruped animal-like shapes, combined with diverse in-the-wild image data, are sufficient to achieve high-quality semantic left-right prediction in images, even for entirely unseen 3D object categories, such as cars or trains. Overall, our approach achieves superior performance in dense pixel-wise semantic left-right predictions on both rendered and in-the-wild image datasets when compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督学习框架，利用顶点级3D语义左右理解的最新进展，联合使用中等规模3D形状数据集（主要包含人类和四足动物）和多样化野外图像，实现单视图图像的像素级语义左右预测。该方法在渲染和野外图像数据集上均优于现有最先进方法，并能泛化到未见过的物体类别（如汽车、火车）。
Motivation: 像素级语义左右预测在野外图像中因缺乏3D信息、遮挡、姿态变化等挑战而困难，现有工作多聚焦于三维数据或整体对称性，缺乏无监督的像素级预测方法。
Method: 利用3D形状数据集的顶点级左右标注，通过无监督学习将3D知识迁移到2D图像，结合图像数据训练网络输出像素级左右语义。
Result: 在渲染和野外图像数据集上，密集像素级左右预测性能超越现有方法，且对未见过的类别（如汽车、火车）具备泛化能力。
Conclusion: 中等规模的人形和四足动物3D形状数据结合多样化图像，足以实现高质量语义左右预测，并可泛化至新类别。

summary_sections.method: 利用3D形状数据集的顶点级左右标注，通过无监督学习将3D知识迁移到2D图像，结合图像数据训练网络输出像素级左右语义。
summary_sections.result: 在渲染和野外图像数据集上，密集像素级左右预测性能超越现有方法，且对未见过的类别（如汽车、火车）具备泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 中等规模的人形和四足动物3D形状数据结合多样化图像，足以实现高质量语义左右预测，并可泛化至新类别。

papers.title: Geometry-aware Depth-guided Representation Learning for Structure-preserving Low-light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Low-light degradation reduces image visibility and weakens structural cues that are important for visual representation and scene understanding. Existing low-light image enhancement methods mainly focus on appearance restoration, while insufficiently exploiting scene geometry to preserve structural consistency. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a Depth-guided Multi-scale Attention Network (DMSA-Net) for geometry-aware low-light image enhancement. DMSA-Net introduces depth-related structural priors into low-light representation learning through reflectance-geometry interaction. A Retinex-based decomposition module is first used to obtain illumination-invariant reflectance representations, from which depth cues are inferred to characterize scene structure under degraded illumination. A multi-scale depth-guided fusion strategy is then embedded into a hierarchical encoder-decoder architecture, where depth-aware attention adaptively integrates geometric and appearance features. Experiments on several benchmark datasets show that DMSA-Net achieves effective low-light restoration while improving structural preservation. Moreover, we construct LOL-D, a depth-augmented low-light dataset, to facilitate research on geometry-aware low-light vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出深度引导多尺度注意力网络 (DMSA-Net) 用于低光图像增强，通过 Retinex 分解获得反射率表示并推断深度先验，利用多尺度深度引导融合策略在编码器-解码器架构中整合几何与外观特征，在多个基准数据集上实现有效的低光恢复并改善结构保持。同时构建了深度增强的低光数据集 LOL-D。
Motivation: 现有低光图像增强方法主要关注外观恢复，未充分利用场景几何信息来保持结构一致性。
Method: 提出 DMSA-Net，包含 Retinex 分解模块获得光照不变反射率表示，从中推断深度线索表征场景结构；然后采用多尺度深度引导融合策略，在层次化编码器-解码器中通过深度感知注意力自适应整合几何与外观特征。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上实验表明，DMSA-Net 实现有效低光恢复并改善结构保持。
Conclusion: 通过引入深度相关的结构先验可以提升低光图像增强中的结构一致性，并发布 LOL-D 数据集以促进几何感知低光视觉研究。

papers.title: TACTIC-KG: Toward Small Agent Teams for Cyber Threat Intelligence Knowledge Graph Construction
papers.abstract_en: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) reports are predominantly unstructured, heterogeneous, and noisy, which limits their direct usability for automated analysis and reasoning. Cybersecurity Knowledge Graphs (CSKGs) provide a structured representation of adversarial entities, actions, and relations, but constructing such graphs from free-text CTI remains a challenge. Recent approaches rely on monolithic Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform end-to-end extraction and completion, leading to high cost, limited controllability, and unstable performance. This paper introduces TACTIC-KG, an agentic framework for CSKG construction that decomposes the task into modular, specialized LLM agents responsible for extraction, typing, verification, and curation. Using lightweight models (3B--8B), TACTIC-KG improves stability, recall, and graph consistency while reducing deployment cost. We implement and evaluate TACTIC-KG against recent state-of-the-art systems. Experiments on human-annotated CTI reports show that agent specialization consistently outperforms larger monolithic in-context-learning (ICL) baselines in extraction F1-score, typing accuracy, and structural graph similarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TACTIC-KG，一个基于智能体（agent）的网络威胁情报知识图谱构建框架，将任务分解为多个模块化的轻量级LLM智能体（3B-8B参数），分别负责实体提取、类型标注、验证和整理。实验表明，在人工标注的CTI报告上，该方法在提取F1分数、类型准确性和图结构相似性方面优于使用大型单模型上下文学习（ICL）的基线方法。
Motivation: 现有从非结构化的网络威胁情报（CTI）报告构建知识图谱的方法通常依赖单一大型语言模型进行端到端提取，存在成本高、可控性差和性能不稳定的问题。
Method: 将知识图谱构建任务分解为提取、类型标注、验证和整理四个子任务，每个子任务由专门的轻量级LLM智能体（3B-8B参数）负责，以提高模块化、稳定性和可控制性。
Result: 在人工标注的CTI报告上，TACTIC-KG在提取F1分数、类型准确性和图结构相似性方面均优于大型单模型ICL基线。
Conclusion: 智能体专业化（agent specialization）在构建网络安全知识图谱中比单一大型模型更有效，同时降低了部署成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Canonical quantization of neurons
papers.abstract_en: Canonical quantization provides a systematic procedure for constructing quantum models from classical Hamiltonians. Here, we apply this principle to a fundamental computational primitive of machine learning: the neuron. Specifically, by viewing a neuron as a composition of an energy function and an activation function, we quantize this model by replacing the energy function with a quantum Hamiltonian and applying the activation function to it through matrix functional calculus. This results in an activation observable that can be measured on an input quantum state. We investigate the use of these quantized neurons for function approximation, where the objective is to learn an unknown observable from labeled quantum data. For this purpose, we develop hybrid quantum-classical algorithms for training and evaluation, including procedures for measuring the activation observable and estimating gradients of the squared loss error. Our algorithms for gradient estimation rely on basic primitives like classical random sampling, the Hadamard test, and Hamiltonian simulation, and those for measuring an activation observable rely on quantum algorithms known as the power of one qumode and Schroedingerization. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our quantized neurons exhibit enhanced expressive capabilities relative to corresponding classical neurons on representative learning tasks. Our work establishes canonical quantization as a principled framework for constructing quantum machine learning primitives and provides a foundation for developing neural architectures tailored to quantum data.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, companion paper available at arXiv:2605.24386
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将规范量化（canonical quantization）应用于神经元，通过用量子哈密顿量替换能量函数并利用矩阵函数演算得到激活可观测量，从而构建量化神经元。针对函数逼近任务，开发了混合量子-经典算法，包括激活可观测量测量和梯度估计。数值实验表明量化神经元在代表性学习任务中比经典神经元具有更强的表达能力。
Motivation: 经典量化为构建量子模型提供系统方法，但尚未应用于机器学习的神经元，缺乏从经典神经元到量子神经元的系统量化框架。
Method: 将神经元视为能量函数与激活函数的组合，用量子哈密顿量替换能量函数，通过矩阵函数演算得到激活可观测量；利用经典随机采样、Hadamard测试和哈密顿模拟估计梯度，使用power of one qumode和Schroedingerization测量激活可观测量。
Result: 数值实验表明量化神经元在代表性学习任务中比经典神经元具有更强的表达能力。
Conclusion: 该工作将规范量化确立为构建量子机器学习基元的原则性框架，并为开发针对量子数据的神经架构提供基础。

papers.title: The Map Behind the Flow: Finite-Step Gradient Descent as a Dynamical System
papers.abstract_en: Many phenomena of deep learning are dynamical: they concern not only which minima exist, but how gradient descent reaches, avoids, or selects among them. Edge-of-stability behavior, sharpness oscillations, catapult phases, balancing, and movement toward flatter representations are effects of the training map itself, and are poorly captured by the small-step gradient-flow limit. This paper studies fixed-step gradient descent as a discrete dynamical system in a hierarchy of exactly solvable models retaining basic structures of deep learning: depth, factorization, width, data coupling, activation, and stochasticity. The starting point is the balanced scalar reduction of a deep linear chain, giving a quartic loss and a cubic gradient map whose post-edge behavior is explicit. Under the natural large-depth scaling, this dynamics converges to a universal Ricker-type map. The edge of stability is therefore not a breakdown of optimization, but the first bifurcation of the training map. Embedding the scalar dynamics back into factored models turns these regimes into learning phenomena. Finite steps break conservation laws of gradient flow and contract factorization imbalance; residual oscillations move parameters toward flatter, more balanced representations. Wider linear networks produce a ladder of spectral edges, so the optimal learning rate can lie beyond the first edge. Data coupling, nonlinear activations, and stochastic targets preserve the same organizing principle: finite-step oscillations drive alignment, balancing, and representation selection. Thus the learning rate is not merely a numerical stability parameter. It is a structural parameter of the training dynamics, determining its attractors and shaping the representations gradient descent selects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究固定步长梯度下降作为离散动力系统的行为，通过一系列可精确求解的简化模型（如深度线性链的标量约化）揭示边缘稳定性、振荡、平衡化等现象，指出学习率是结构参数而非仅数值稳定参数，决定吸引子并塑造表示选择。
Motivation: 深度学习中的许多现象（如边缘稳定性、尖刺振荡、弹射相、平衡化等）是动力学的，但传统的梯度流极限无法很好捕捉这些效应。
Method: 将固定步长梯度下降视为离散动力系统，建立从深度线性链的标量约化到更复杂模型（含因子化、宽度、数据耦合、激活函数、随机性）的分层可解模型，并分析其映射性质。
Result: 在深度线性链的标量模型下，梯度下降映射在自然大深度缩放下收敛到通用的Ricker型映射，边缘稳定性对应映射的第一个分岔；在更宽网络中，优化学习率可位于第一个谱边缘之后；有限步振荡驱动对齐、平衡化和表示选择。
Conclusion: 学习率不仅是数值稳定参数，更是训练动力学的结构参数，决定了吸引子并影响梯度下降选择的表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-Convex Sparse Reinforcement Learning via Non-Monotone Inclusions
papers.abstract_en: This work delivers two key contributions: one to efficient feature selection in reinforcement learning (RL), the other to the theory of non-monotone inclusions. On the RL side, the estimation bias inherent in conventional regularization schemes is addressed by augmenting classical least-squares temporal-difference (LSTD) policy evaluation with the sparsity-inducing, non-convex projected minimax concave (PMC) penalty. Because the PMC penalty is weakly convex, the resulting fixed-point problem is no longer monotone; instead, it falls under a broader class of non-monotone inclusions involving the sum of a monotone Lipschitz operator and a hypomonotone operator. On the theory side, novel convergence conditions are developed for the forward-reflected-backward splitting (FRBS) method applied to this broader class of non-monotone inclusion problems. Under mild conditions, Lyapunov stability and the existence of a limit point of the sequence of FRBS iterates are established; alternatively, under the weak Minty variational inequality assumption, exact convergence is guaranteed. Numerical tests on benchmark datasets show that the proposed FRBS iterates, applied to the non-convexly regularized LSTD problem, substantially outperform state-of-the-art feature-selection methods, especially when many noisy features are present.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了非凸正则化最小二乘时序差分（LSTD）策略评估方法，采用投影极小极大凹（PMC）惩罚来实现特征选择。由于PMC惩罚弱凸，导致固定点问题非单调，属于更广泛的非单调包含问题。文章发展了前向-反射-后向分裂（FRBS）方法在该类问题上的新收敛条件，并在基准数据集上展示了优于现有特征选择方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有强化学习中的正则化方法存在估计偏差问题，尤其在高维噪声特征下，需要更有效的特征选择方法。
Method: 将非凸PMC惩罚引入LSTD，形成非单调包含问题，并应用FRBS方法求解，同时扩展了FRBS的收敛理论。
Result: 数值实验表明，所提方法在基准数据集上显著优于现有特征选择方法，尤其在包含大量噪声特征时。
Conclusion: 论文为强化学习中非凸稀疏正则化提供了理论基础，并展示了实际效果，但实验规模有限，未来需扩展到更大规模任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Data-Driven Soft Labeling Scales DNA Read Classification to Whole-Body Cell-Type Deconvolution
papers.abstract_en: Cell-type deconvolution, the task of estimating the proportions of constituent cell types in a heterogeneous biological sample, is a core problem in computational biology. Methods that rely on epigenetic marks such as DNA methylation typically operate on aggregated methylation estimates, discarding the pattern-level information carried by individual DNA reads. Existing read-level approaches that exploit this information are scarce, and all remain restricted to few-class settings; scaling them further is an open problem because, at scale, non-discriminative reads dominate and hard labels conflict with the many-to-many mapping between methylation patterns and cell types, preventing classifier convergence. To overcome this, we propose data-driven soft labels that estimate the conditional cell-type distribution for each read, and integrate this scheme into Syto, a new modular framework for read-level classification-based deconvolution. On a whole-body atlas of 39 human cell types, Syto reduces MSE by 2.56$\times$ over SoTA, with gains transferring to an out-of-distribution dataset spanning 16 tissues. Syto lays the foundation for modeling increasingly large cell-type panels, with improved applications in biology and healthcare. The proposed soft-labeling scheme is further translatable to any setting with a many-to-many signal-to-label mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对DNA读段级别的细胞类型解卷积问题，提出数据驱动的软标签（soft labels）方法，解决传统硬标签在多类设置下分类器不收敛的问题。将该方案集成到Syto框架中，在39种人类细胞类型的全身体图谱上，均方误差降低2.56倍，并泛化到16种组织的分布外数据集。软标签方案可推广到任何多对多信号-标签映射场景。
Motivation: 现有基于DNA甲基化的细胞类型解卷积方法多依赖聚合甲基化估计，丢失单个读段的模式信息；而现有的读段级方法仅限于少类设置，因为非区分性读段占主导且硬标签与甲基化模式和细胞类型之间的多对多映射冲突，阻碍分类器收敛。
Method: 提出数据驱动的软标签（data-driven soft labels），估计每个读段的条件细胞类型分布，并将其集成到Syto模块化框架中，用于读段级别的分类解卷积。
Result: 在39种人类细胞类型的全身体图谱上，Syto将均方误差降低2.56倍（相比最先进方法），且增益转移到覆盖16种组织的分布外数据集。
Conclusion: Syto为建模越来越大的细胞类型面板奠定了基础，改进了生物学和医疗应用；所提出的软标签方案可推广到任何多对多信号-标签映射场景。

papers.title: Virtual Category-Guided Continual Generalized Category Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Continual Generalized Category Discovery (C-GCD) aims to incrementally identify novel categories from sequential unlabeled data while preserving recognition of known classes, which is an essential capability for open-world visual learning. A major bottleneck lies in ambiguous unlabeled samples that cannot be confidently assigned to known classes nor reliably grouped as novel ones, making pseudo-labeling brittle and often biasing learning toward familiar categories. In this work, we introduce Virtual Category-Guided Continual Generalized Category Discovery by adapting Virtual Category Learning (VCL) to the continual setting. Our method identifies uncertain samples and assigns them to temporary virtual categories, enabling safe and informative learning from unlabeled streams without injecting noisy labels, while improving unlabeled data utilization and mitigating prediction bias. To further stabilize discovery across sessions and enhance class separation, we augment VCL with Expanded Neighborhood Contrastive Learning (ENCL), which exploits extended neighborhood relations and an adaptive margin to learn more discriminative and well-separated representations for both old and emerging classes. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, Tiny ImageNet, and ImageNet-100 demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, establishing a scalable and effective solution for C-GCD.

TL;DR: 本文针对持续广义类别发现（C-GCD）中未标注样本模糊性问题，提出虚拟类别引导方法，通过虚拟类别学习（VCL）处理不确定样本，并结合扩展邻域对比学习（ENCL）提升表示判别性。在CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet和ImageNet-100上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有C-GCD方法难以处理无法置信归属的模糊未标注样本，导致伪标签脆弱且偏向已知类别。
Method: 将虚拟类别学习（VCL）适应到持续学习设定，为不确定样本分配临时虚拟类别；同时提出扩展邻域对比学习（ENCL）利用扩展邻域关系和自适应边距学习判别性表示。
Result: 在CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet和ImageNet-100上持续超越现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 本文方法为C-GCD提供可扩展的有效解决方案。

papers.title: LLM for the development of FCM
papers.abstract_en: This article is about the development of a fuzzy cognitive map using a local large language model. In the light of recent advances it is evident that large language models, and even local large language models are capable of extracting quantities from textual data. In other words, a local LLM like Qwen2.5-32B, or probably larger, can accept entities as prompt input and determine relevant quantitative data as the model output. In turn, this output can be utilized for the construction of a data driven fuzzy cognitive map. Hence, this implementation is achieved and then the model is thoroughly tested; Qwen2.5-32B is used and the data is extracted from hotel reviews from TripAdvisor. Furthermore, the extracted documents pass through the model unfiltered and then a fuzzy cognitive map is trained and evaluated. A case is made about Greek reviews where a star topology FCM is formed that indicates the preferences of the reviewers. Finally, external validation is performed to establish whether the fuzzy cognitive map can correlate the star rating of the review -an outcome outside the model's inference scope -with its predicted satisfaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨利用本地大语言模型（如Qwen2.5-32B）从文本数据中提取定量信息，并用于构建数据驱动的模糊认知图（FCM）。以TripAdvisor酒店评论为例，模型接收实体作为提示输入，输出相关量化数据，进而训练并评估FCM。针对希腊语评论形成星型拓扑FCM，展示评论者偏好，并通过外部验证检查FCM能否将评论星级（模型推理范围外的结果）与预测满意度相关联。
Motivation: 大语言模型能够从文本中提取定量数据，但将其用于构建模糊认知图的实现尚需探索，特别是利用本地模型处理未过滤文本以构建数据驱动的FCM。
Method: 使用本地大语言模型Qwen2.5-32B，以实体作为提示输入，获取相关量化输出，并利用这些数据构建和训练模糊认知图。实验使用TripAdvisor酒店评论数据，评论未经过滤直接输入模型。
Result: 成功构建了基于希腊语评论的星型拓扑FCM，该图能够反映评论者偏好；外部验证表明FCM能够将评论星级（模型推理范围外的结果）与预测满意度关联起来。
Conclusion: 本地大语言模型可用于从文本中提取定量数据以构建模糊认知图，且该图能够捕捉与外部指标（如星级）的相关性，展示了LLM在知识图谱构建中的潜力。

papers.title: Joint Velocity Slope Diffusion Prior for Structurally Constrained Velocity Model Building
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution velocity models are crucial for reservoir characterization and subsurface delineation. However, the band limited nature of our surface recorded data limits resolution. Utilizing well measurements to enhance the resolution of our subsurface models is an important objective. To this end, we present a diffusion-guided framework for structurally preconditioned velocity-model reconstruction from sparse well-log information. The proposed approach combines plane-wave PDE regularization, structurally preconditioned inversion, and measurement-guided diffusion posterior sampling within a unified formulation. Local structural slopes estimated through plane-wave destruction are used both to propagate well information along geological dip directions and to guide the diffusion sampling process through a joint velocity--slope generative prior. Numerical experiments on the Volve synthetic model and the Viking Graben field dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework improves structural continuity, lateral consistency, and geological realism compared with conventional structurally preconditioned inversion approaches while maintaining computationally practical inference through DDIM sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种扩散引导框架，用于从稀疏测井信息中重建结构预条件的速度模型。该方法结合平面波PDE正则化、结构预条件反演和测量引导的扩散后验采样，利用平面波破坏估计的局部结构斜率沿地质倾角方向传播测井信息，并指导扩散采样过程。在Volve合成模型和Viking Graben现场数据集上的实验表明，与常规结构预条件反演方法相比，所提框架改进了结构连续性、横向一致性和地质真实性，同时通过DDIM采样保持了计算可行性。
Motivation: 传统速度模型受限于地表记录数据的带宽，分辨率不足。利用测井测量提高分辨率是重要目标，但现有方法缺乏结构性先验约束。
Method: 提出统一框架，结合平面波PDE正则化、结构预条件反演和测量引导的扩散后验采样。通过平面波破坏估计局部结构斜率，用于沿地质倾角传播测井信息并引导扩散采样过程。
Result: 在Volve合成模型和Viking Graben现场数据集上，该方法在结构连续性、横向一致性和地质真实性上优于常规结构预条件反演方法，且通过DDIM采样保持计算效率。
Conclusion: 该框架有效结合扩散先验和结构约束，改进了速度模型重建的几何真实性和计算可行性。

papers.title: Qantara: Bridge-Flow Training for Multi-Paradigm JEPA Control
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) underpin a growing family of latent world models for control from raw pixels, but every existing JEPA world model commits at training time to a single inference paradigm: either trajectory optimisation in a learned dynamics model, or direct behaviour cloning. A single checkpoint that serves both would defer this choice to inference, when deployment constraints (rollout cost, observation accessibility) determine which path wins. We present Qantara, an end-to-end JEPA whose joint training objective pairs a Brownian-bridge interpolant between consecutive clean latents on the state axis with noise-to-data flow matching on the action axis. The same checkpoint serves three inference paradigms without retraining: latent planning, behaviour-cloning action sampling, and inverse dynamics, which we query through a video-inverse composition that first predicts the next latent without action conditioning, then extracts the action. Training concentrates mass on the edges of the (action-time, state-time) noise square, where inference queries the predictor: replacing it with uniform interior sampling drops Push-T planning from 90.1 to 53.3 SR at matched compute. On the LeWM control suite, Qantara reaches a 91.2 SR three-train-seed average and sets new SOTA on OGBench-Cube (+7.7 SR over DINO-WM, +19.7 over LeWM). From the same weights, the behaviour-cloning and video-inverse paths reach 82-83 SR on Push-T and 71-73 SR on Cube. These results move JEPA world models from single-paradigm planners to multi-paradigm controllers.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://corl-team.github.io/qantara
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Qantara，一种端到端的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），通过桥接流训练统一了多种推理范式（轨迹优化、行为克隆、逆动力学），使得单个检查点即可在推理时根据部署条件选择不同范式，无需重新训练。在LeWM控制套件和Push-T任务上取得了新的最优结果。
Motivation: 现有的JEPA世界模型在训练时只能选择单一的推理范式（轨迹优化或行为克隆），无法在部署时根据计算成本或观测条件灵活切换。需要一种统一方法让同一模型支持多种推理范式。
Method: 提出Qantara，其联合训练目标结合了状态轴上的布朗桥插值（Brownian-bridge interpolant）和动作轴上的噪声到数据流匹配（flow matching）。训练时在噪声正方形的边（action-time, state-time）上集中质量，并在推理时支持潜在规划、行为克隆动作采样和逆动力学三种范式。
Result: 在LeWM控制套件上，Qantara达到91.2 SR的平均成功率（三训练种子），在OGBench-Cube上比DINO-WM提升了7.7 SR，比LeWM提升了19.7 SR。行为克隆和逆动力学路径在Push-T和Cube任务上分别达到82-83 SR和71-73 SR。
Conclusion: Qantara将JEPA世界模型从单一范式的规划器转变为多范式控制器，使得推理时可以根据部署约束（如预算成本、观测可用性）选择最优推理路径。
