papers.title: Compressed Computation under $L^4$ Loss is likely Computation in Superposition
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are thought to represent concepts as directions in their activation space, and superposition lets them encode more concepts than they have dimensions. It is natural to ask whether they can also compute more functions than they have neurons, i.e., perform computation in superposition. In this regime many functions of sparse inputs are evaluated by a layer with fewer neurons than there are functions to compute. Representation in superposition is by now fairly well understood, but computation in superposition is not, and there are few toy models of it arising through training rather than being hand designed. As a toy model of computation in superposition we study the compressed-computation setup: a single-hidden-layer ReLU network with 50 neurons that must compute the ReLU of each of 100 sparse input features. We show that training it under an $L^4$ loss (the mean fourth power of the error), rather than the usual $L^2$, elicits a solution that appears to compute all features in superposition. We then reverse-engineer this solution. We find that the network assigns each feature a sparse binary codeword over neurons and decodes it with a pseudoinverse of the encoder. Given these codewords, a description with only three scalars recovers most of the network's performance, and we validate it by building equivalent networks from hand-designed codes.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, 1 table + 2 pages, 5 figures, 1 table appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络中的计算叠加现象。通过一个单隐藏层ReLU网络（50神经元）需计算100个稀疏输入特征的ReLU，发现使用L4损失训练可以诱导出计算叠加的解。作者反向工程了这个解，发现网络为每个特征分配一个稀疏二进制码字，并用伪逆解码。仅用三个标量描述即能恢复大部分性能，并通过手工编码验证。
Motivation: 表示叠加已被较好理解，但计算叠加尚未被很好理解，且缺乏通过训练自然出现的玩具模型。
Method: 采用压缩计算设置：单隐藏层ReLU网络，50神经元，需计算100个稀疏输入特征的ReLU，使用L4损失训练。
Result: 训练后网络似乎以叠加方式计算所有特征。反向工程发现特征被分配稀疏二进制码字，解码使用编码器的伪逆。仅用三个标量描述即可恢复大部分性能，并通过手工编码构建等价网络验证。
Conclusion: 论文展示了计算叠加可以通过训练自然出现，并提供了一个可解释的玩具模型。

papers.title: An Exploration of Agentic Information Fusion for Test Maintenance Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Test maintenance is a critical, yet costly, activity - particularly as codebases rapidly evolve. To assist, we present MAST, a multi-agent framework that predicts which test cases require maintenance following changes to the production code. This identification task is necessary as a precondition to any subsequent maintenance activities, but remains challenging due to the complex relationships between production and test code. MAST advances the state-of-the-art by integrating multiple analyses -- including static, lexical, and semantic analyses - through an intelligent fusion and post-check procedure and by focusing on a realistic use and evaluation setting - i.e., standardized input formats, repository-level analyses, and the ability to infer relations between test and production artifacts rather than assuming a pre-existing mapping. We evaluated MAST on 21 industrial Java repositories from Ericsson AB, considering situations where test maintenance both was and was not required in the ground truth. MAST yielded superior precision to a state-of-the-art baseline - resulting in a higher accuracy, F1, and F2 score - with only some loss in recall. Our ablation study demonstrates the value of each analysis in producing the final recommendations. MAST illustrates the potential of multi-agent systems that can fuse multiple information sources when performing software testing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出MAST框架，通过多智能体融合静态、词法和语义分析，预测生产代码变更后哪些测试用例需要维护。在21个Ericsson工业Java仓库上评估，相比基线提升了精确率、准确率、F1和F2分数，但召回率略有下降。消融实验证实各分析模块的贡献。
Motivation: 测试维护成本高昂，且由于生产代码与测试代码间复杂关系，预测哪些测试需要维护具有挑战性。现有方法常假设预定义的映射关系，不适用于实际工业场景。
Method: MAST是一个多智能体框架，整合静态分析、词法分析和语义分析，通过智能融合和后检查流程，在仓库级别推断测试与生产代码间的关联，无需预设映射。
Result: 在21个工业Java仓库上，MAST相比基线取得更高的精确率、准确率、F1和F2分数，仅召回率略有下降。
Conclusion: MAST展示了多智能体系统融合多种信息源在软件测试任务中的潜力，尤其适用于需要预测测试维护的现实工业环境。

papers.title: Predicting Drafted Deck Strength for "Magic: the Gathering"
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world games do not admit a fixed, compact rule set: instead, their dynamics are defined by interactions among a large and often evolving collection of game pieces, making general-purpose policy learning impractical. Magic: the Gathering (MTG) exemplifies this setting, where the cards themselves define and alter gameplay rules, strategic constraints, and long-term outcomes, while the pool of available cards is ever-changing. We study Draft, a constrained deck-building format of MTG in which eight players make 39-45 sequential selections from semi-random packs to construct a 40-card deck under partial information. By isolating the card selection process from gameplay, Draft provides a tractable yet non-trivial setting for studying decision-making driven by combinatorial card synergies. We propose an encoder-based model that produces set-contextualized card embeddings to encode the draft decision sequence, with a consistent improvement over linear baselines on large-scale real-world data, establishing a first learned benchmark for outcome prediction in MTG Draft. Our code is available at github.com/akulen/MtGDraftEncoder.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Conference on Games (CoG) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究《万智牌》（Magic: the Gathering）Draft模式中的牌组强度预测问题。Draft是一种受限的组牌模式，八名玩家从半随机补充包中顺序选牌，构建40张牌的牌组。作者提出一个基于编码器的模型，生成套牌上下文化的卡牌嵌入（set-contextualized card embeddings），编码选牌决策序列。在大规模真实数据上，该模型一致优于线性基线，建立了Draft结果预测的第一个学习基准。
Motivation: 许多现实游戏规则复杂且牌池不断变化，传统策略学习方法难以直接应用。《万智牌》Draft模式提供了一个可控但非平凡的环境，研究组合性卡牌协同效应驱动的决策过程。
Method: 提出编码器模型，利用套牌上下文化的卡牌嵌入表示每个选牌决策，并通过序列编码整合整个草案过程，预测最终牌组强度。
Result: 在真实大规模《万智牌》Draft数据上，模型一致优于线性基线，建立了首个针对该任务的学习基准。
Conclusion: 该编码器模型能有效捕捉卡牌间的组合协同效应，为预测复杂游戏中的牌组强度提供了新的基准方法，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-Asymptotic Error Bounds for SMC with Biased Proposals: Application to Conditional Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods are a natural tool for post-hoc conditioning of pretrained generative models, but in many applications the mutation kernels used by the particle system are biased approximations of an ideal Feynman--Kac flow. This paper develops a non-asymptotic error analysis for such SMC samplers. Under forward-smoothing forgetting conditions, we decompose the total error into a kernel bias, measuring the effect of replacing the ideal transition kernels by approximate ones, and a finite-particle Monte Carlo error. Our approach relies on extending local Doeblin-type conditions and Lyapunov drift arguments for Markov kernels to conditional distributions, thereby enabling a principled control of the bias. We then instantiate this general framework for conditional sampling with score-based diffusion models, and derive the first non-asymptotic error bound that jointly controls initialization error, time discretization, and score approximation in the reverse diffusion dynamics as well as finite-particle Monte Carlo error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法在使用有偏建议核时的非渐近误差分析，将总误差分解为核偏差和有限粒子蒙特卡洛误差，并在前向平滑遗忘条件下建立了理论界。该方法被实例化为基于分数扩散模型的条件采样，首次联合控制了反向扩散动力学中的初始化误差、时间离散化、分数近似以及有限粒子蒙特卡洛误差。
Motivation: 在许多应用中，SMC方法使用的突变核是理想Feynman-Kac流的近似，但缺乏非渐近误差界，尤其是当核有偏时。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 扩展了马尔可夫核的局部Doeblin型条件和Lyapunov漂移参数到条件分布，从而将总误差分解为核偏差和有限粒子蒙特卡洛误差，并推导出非渐近界。
Result: 论文为基于分数的扩散模型条件采样提供了首个非渐近误差界，同时控制了初始化误差、时间离散化、分数近似和有限粒子蒙特卡洛误差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架可用于条件采样等任务，但未讨论局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DGSeg: Dynamic Gating of Semantic-Spatial Guided Predictions for Reasoning Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning segmentation aims to predict pixel-wise masks for targets given complex language queries. Existing approaches leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for vision-language reasoning and generate intermediate target cues (e.g., points or boxes) to guide a segmentation model. However, compressing rich reasoning into sparse cues often introduces ambiguity and noise, preventing these cues from accurately preserving the reasoning intent. While multiple complementary cues can enrich target information, existing methods typically feed them jointly into a single segmentation process, allowing ambiguous or erroneous cues to affect the entire prediction. Therefore, we propose DGSeg, a reasoning segmentation framework that learns to fuse predictions guided by semantic and spatial cues. Specifically, the MLLM jointly reasons about both target identity and spatial location, producing complementary semantic and spatial cues that are fed into separate segmentation branches. Their predictions are adaptively integrated by a lightweight dynamic gating module trained with relative branch-quality supervision to suppress noisy or conflicting regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DGSeg consistently outperforms strong baselines on multiple benchmarks and achieves 69.6% and 67.3% gIoU on the challenging ReasonSeg validation and test splits. Code is available at https://github.com/RZZeng/DGSeg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DGSeg，一种通过动态门控融合语义和空间线索的推理分割框架。利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理目标身份和空间位置，生成互补的语义和空间线索，分别输入独立的分割分支，再通过轻量级动态门控模块自适应整合预测，以抑制噪声或冲突区域。
Motivation: 现有方法将推理压缩为稀疏线索（如点或框）来指导分割，但容易引入歧义和噪声，且多线索联合输入单个分割过程时，错误线索会影响整体预测。
Method: MLLM同时推理目标身份和空间位置，输出语义和空间线索；两个独立分割分支分别处理这两类线索；轻量级动态门控模块根据分支质量相对监督学习融合预测。
Result: 在多个基准上优于强基线，在ReasonSeg验证集和测试集上分别达到69.6%和67.3% gIoU。
Conclusion: DGSeg通过动态门控融合多线索预测有效提升了推理分割的鲁棒性和准确性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Personalized Differentially Private Learning for Decentralized Local Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph-structured data is increasingly generated and stored in decentralized environments, such as social platforms, mobile applications, and edge networks, where users maintain control over their local graph data. However, collecting and analyzing such decentralized graph data for downstream learning tasks raises significant privacy concerns, as nodes and their attributes often contain sensitive personal information. Local Differential Privacy (LDP) has emerged as a promising solution for privacy-preserving data collection without relying on trusted servers. Nevertheless, existing LDP-based graph learning methods typically assume uniform privacy requirements across users, ignoring the heterogeneous and personalized privacy preferences commonly observed in real-world systems. This uniform treatment leads to inflexible noise injection at the data collection stage, resulting in substantial distortion of graph data and degraded utility in subsequent analysis. To address this limitation, we propose PPGNN, a personalized differentially private framework for decentralized graph data. PPGNN enables user-specific privacy budgets during local perturbation while preserving analytical utility. To handle heterogeneous privacy levels and noise distortion, we design a two-stage solution consisting of a Personalized Perturbation Mechanism (PPM) and a weighted calibration strategy, FlexProp. Extensive experiments on six real-world graph datasets demonstrate that PPGNN effectively balances personalized privacy protection and data utility in decentralized graph learning scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PPGNN框架，用于解决去中心化图数据中用户隐私预算异质性问题。现有基于局部差分隐私（LDP）的图学习方法假设统一隐私需求，导致噪声注入不均和效用下降。PPGNN允许用户自定义隐私预算，并通过个性化扰动机制（PPM）和加权校准策略FlexProp来平衡隐私与效用。在六个真实图数据集上的实验表明该方法有效。
Motivation: 去中心化图数据中用户隐私需求通常异构，现有LDP图学习方法采用统一隐私预算，导致数据扰动过大或不足，影响下游任务效用。
Method: 提出PPGNN框架，包括两阶段：1) 个性化扰动机制（PPM），允许每个用户根据自身隐私预算对局部图数据进行扰动；2) FlexProp加权校准策略，在聚合时根据噪声水平分配权重，减少扰动带来的偏差。
Result: 在六个真实图数据集上的实验表明，PPGNN在个性化隐私保护下有效维持了数据效用，优于统一隐私预算的方法。
Conclusion: PPGNN能够灵活处理去中心化图数据中异构的隐私需求，为个性化差分隐私图学习提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Non-asymptotic Convergence of Stochastic Gradient Descent in Score-based Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Score-based Generative Models (SGMs) have achieved impressive performance in data generation across a wide range of applications. While the statistical properties of their sampling procedures are increasingly well understood, the optimization dynamics underlying their training remain less explored. SGMs are typically trained by minimizing a weighted denoising scorematching objective, yet optimization guarantees with stochastic gradients remain limited. In this work, we study Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) for SGMs, contributing results in two complementary regimes. First, for general score parameterizations, we establish a non-convex convergence rate for SGD on the weighted denoising score-matching objective, with explicit dependence on the schedule-dependent weighting factors. Second, for overparameterized two-layer ReLU networks, we develop a Neural Tangent Kernel analysis tailored to diffusion training with stochastic gradients, yielding score-approximation error bounds along the SGD trajectory. Finally, our analysis quantifies the role of the reweighting factor in the score approximation error, providing theoretical guidance for weighting choices used in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于得分的生成模型（SGMs）中随机梯度下降（SGD）的优化动力学，针对加权去噪得分匹配目标建立了非凸收敛率，并针对过参数化两层ReLU网络给出了神经正切核分析，揭示了重加权因子在得分近似误差中的作用。
Motivation: SGMs在数据生成中表现优异，但其训练过程的优化动力学理解不足，特别是随机梯度下的收敛保证有限。
Method: 通过非凸优化分析SGMs的加权去噪得分匹配目标的SGD收敛率，并利用神经正切核分析过参数化两层ReLU网络的得分近似误差。
Result: 建立了SGD在非凸目标上的收敛率，显式依赖于权重因子；在NTK框架下给出了得分近似误差界；量化了重加权因子对误差的影响。
Conclusion: 为SGMs的SGD训练提供了理论保证，指导实际中的权重选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MARLIN: De Novo Molecular Structure Elucidation from Tandem Mass Spectra without a Ground-Truth Formula
papers.abstract_en: Untargeted tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) detects thousands of small molecules per biological sample, yet most go unidentified because they are absent from spectral libraries. These uncharacterized metabolites and natural products are precisely the compounds that matter for drug discovery, biomarker research, and exposomics. Computational de novo structure elucidation could close this gap, but almost all state-of-the-art methods assume the ground-truth molecular formula is known, an oracle that does not exist for genuinely novel compounds and is itself predicted with substantial error. We present MARLIN, a de novo method that elucidates structures directly from a spectrum with no molecular formula at any stage. A self-supervised encoder predicts a molecular fingerprint from the raw peaks, and a block-diffusion language model generates candidate structures conditioned only on the fingerprint and the instrument-measured precursor mass. A provably safe mass-shell constraint keeps every candidate consistent with the measured mass without fixing the atom inventory, and candidates are accepted by exact parts-per-million mass agreement. A symmetric noise objective absorbs encoder error, and a candidate-diversity mechanism keeps the candidates from collapsing to a single structure. On the NPLIB1 benchmark, MARLIN is the strongest method evaluated without a ground-truth formula across exact-match accuracy, structural distance, and fingerprint similarity, and it recovers the correct molecular formula as a byproduct about as often as a dedicated predictor without ever using one. MARLIN enables reliable de novo structure elucidation in the realistic discovery regime where the molecular formula is unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MARLIN，一种无需ground-truth分子式的从头结构解析方法，直接从串联质谱（MS/MS）中鉴定未知小分子。该方法利用自监督编码器从原始峰预测分子指纹，并通过块扩散语言模型（block-diffusion language model）在指纹和前体质量条件下生成候选结构，同时采用质量壳约束、对称噪声目标和候选多样性机制。在NPLIB1基准上，MARLIN在不提供真实分子式的所有评估指标（精确匹配准确率、结构距离和指纹相似度）上均达到最优，且其副产品分子式预测能力与专用预测器相当。
Motivation: 现有从头结构解析方法通常假设已知真实分子式，但对真正未知化合物此假设不成立，且分子式预测本身误差较大。本文旨在填补无需分子式的从头解析空白，以支持药物发现、生物标志物研究和暴露组学中未表征代谢物和天然产物的鉴定。
Method: MARLIN采用两阶段流程：第一，自监督编码器从原始质谱峰预测分子指纹；第二，基于块扩散的语言模型以预测的指纹和仪器测量的前体质量为条件，生成候选结构。通过可证明安全的质量壳约束确保每个候选结构与测量质量一致，无需固定原子组成；对称噪声目标吸收编码器误差；候选多样性机制防止结构坍塌。最后通过精确百万分比质量一致性接受候选。
Result: 在NPLIB1基准上，MARLIN在无需真实分子式的条件下，在精确匹配准确率、结构距离和指纹相似度上均优于所有对比方法，并且其分子式恢复准确率与专用预测器相当。
Conclusion: MARLIN实现了在分子式不可用的现实发现场景中可靠的从头结构解析，为未知化合物鉴定提供了实用工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SLAM: Structured and Localized Analytic Manifold Adaptation for Lifelong VPR
papers.abstract_en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) in lifelong deployment requires continuous adaptation to new environments without catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose SLAM, a Structured and Localized Analytic Manifold adaptation framework. Our framework elegantly unifies uncertainty-aware smoothing via Unscented transformation, topological space partitioning through a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), and $H_\infty$ robust bound optimization into a singular, unified closed-form analytical recursion. Exhaustive ablation studies demonstrate that while the synergistic combination of uncertainty smoothing and localized mapping (U+G configuration) achieves the state-of-the-art nominal accuracy of 27.5%, the full deployment of the $H_\infty$ bound does not require an architectural split; rather, it introduces a mathematically guaranteed minimax robust bound. This formulation enables the system to seamlessly modulate the intrinsic trade-off between nominal placement precision and worst-case disturbance attenuation through a single regularization parameter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SLAM框架，用于视觉地点识别（VPR）的终身部署中的自适应，通过无迹变换实现不确定性感知平滑、高斯混合模型进行拓扑空间划分，并结合H_∞鲁棒优化，形成统一的闭式解析递归。消融实验表明，不确定性平滑与局部映射的组合（U+G）达到了27.5%的最优名义精度，而完整H_∞边界无需架构拆分，仅通过单一正则化参数即可调节名义精度与最坏情况干扰衰减之间的权衡。
Motivation: 视觉地点识别在终身部署中需要持续适应新环境，同时避免灾难性遗忘，现有方法缺乏统一的理论框架来同时处理不确定性、拓扑结构和鲁棒性。
Method: 提出结构化局部解析流形自适应框架（SLAM），融合无迹变换（不确定性感知平滑）、高斯混合模型（拓扑空间划分）和H_∞鲁棒边界优化，得到单一闭式解析递归更新。
Result: 消融实验显示，不确定性平滑与局部映射组合（U+G）在名义精度上达到27.5%的当前最优；完整H_∞边界通过一个正则化参数即可调节精度与鲁棒性权衡，无需架构拆分。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了多种技术，并通过理论保证的鲁棒边界和可调参数，为终身VPR提供了高效且可解释的解决方案。

papers.title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay
papers.abstract_en: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) for agentic tasks, where an LLM agent interacts with an environment over multiple turns and a student imitates a teacher over these multi-turn interaction histories. Fully online OPD is costly because each update requires fresh student rollouts through the environment and teacher queries at visited histories. We propose Replayed-Prefix On-Policy Distillation (ReOPD), an off-environment alternative that reuses pre-collected teacher trajectories as replayed prefixes: the student acts at selected steps, while the teacher provides dense per-step supervision without executing new environment interactions. We show that multi-turn OPD introduces a prefix trap: making histories more student-on-policy improves relevance to the student, but can query the teacher on histories where its target is unreliable. This creates a two-sided distribution shift between student occupancy and teacher reliability. ReOPD addresses this by treating multi-turn OPD as a reliability-aware prefix distribution design and implements it with a simple step-decaying sampling schedule that emphasizes early, lower-shift prefixes. Across mathematical reasoning with Python and search environments over multiple teacher and student model scales, ReOPD preserves or improves OPD-level accuracy, uses zero tool calls during student training, and is at least 4$\times$ faster per training step than OPD. ReOPD therefore turns expensive agent-environment interaction into a reusable offline resource, enabling scalable distillation across tools, tasks, and environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多轮在线蒸馏 (OPD) 在代理任务中的应用，提出 Replayed-Prefix On-Policy Distillation (ReOPD) 方法，通过重用预收集的教师轨迹作为重放前缀，避免学生与环境实时交互。该方法解决了多轮 OPD 中的“前缀陷阱”问题，并采用逐步衰减采样策略平衡学生状态分布与教师可靠性。实验表明，ReOPD 在数学推理和搜索环境中保持或提升 OPD 准确率，零工具调用，训练速度至少提升 4 倍。
Motivation: 全在线 OPD 在代理任务中代价高昂，每次更新需要新鲜的学生轨迹和教师查询。现有方法存在“前缀陷阱”：学生在线程度提高相关性但降低教师目标的可靠性，导致双重分布偏移。
Method: 提出 ReOPD，将多轮 OPD 视为可靠性感知的前缀分布设计，使用预收集的教师轨迹作为重放前缀，学生仅在选定步骤行动，教师提供密集逐步骤监督，无需新环境交互。实现一个简单逐步衰减采样策略，强调早期低偏移前缀。
Result: 在数学推理（Python）和搜索环境中，跨多种教师和学生模型规模，ReOPD 保持或提升 OPD 级别准确率，学生训练中零工具调用，每训练步骤速度至少比 OPD 快 4 倍。
Conclusion: ReOPD 将昂贵的代理-环境交互转化为可重用离线资源，使蒸馏在工具、任务和环境上可扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeGenseGS: Geometrically and Semantically Decoupled Surgical Scene Understanding in 4D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Real-time, text-promptable 4D reconstruction is indispensable for autonomous surgical interaction. Severe misalignment between semantic meaning and physical anatomy still persists, largely because existing solutions integrate Vision-Language Models into deformable fields via a rigid coupling scheme that tightly binds semantic features to geometric warping. In this paper, we propose DeGenseGS, Geometrically and Semantically Decoupled Surgical Scene Understanding in 4D Gaussian Splatting, a novel framework that independently models semantic evolution and geometric deformation. Specifically, we propose a HexPlane-based spatiotemporal entanglement module that uses shared kinematic latents to synchronize semantic mutations with scene dynamics, while explicitly disentangling semantic updates from geometric deformation. To further ensure robustness against reconstruction artifacts, we devise a Rasterization-Native Semantic Extraction mechanism that infers semantics from topologically continuous feature maps. Additionally, we incorporate an angular-aligned optimization strategy that conforms to the native hyperspherical latent space, thereby preventing semantic distortion. Extensive evaluations on the CholecSeg8k and EndoVis18 datasets demonstrate that DeGenseGS achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our framework yields enhanced geometric completeness and robust semantic-anatomic alignment, enabling spatially continuous segmentation despite drastic tissue deformation and topological transitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeGenseGS，一种在4D高斯泼溅中实现几何和语义解耦的手术场景理解框架。它使用HexPlane时空纠缠模块独立建模语义演化和几何形变，并引入光栅化原生语义提取和角度对齐优化策略。在CholecSeg8k和EndoVis18数据集上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有方法将视觉语言模型集成到形变场中时采用刚性耦合，导致语义与物理解剖严重错位。
Method: 提出HexPlane时空纠缠模块，用共享运动学潜变量同步语义突变与场景动态，同时显式解耦语义更新与几何形变。设计光栅化原生语义提取机制从拓扑连续特征图推断语义，并引入角度对齐优化策略。
Result: 在CholecSeg8k和EndoVis18数据集上达到SOTA，实现了增强的几何完整性和鲁棒的语义-解剖对齐，即使在剧烈组织形变和拓扑转换下也能实现空间连续分割。
Conclusion: 所提框架实现了几何与语义的解耦，提升了手术场景理解的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgenticPD: A Stage-Aware Agentic Framework for Physical Design QoR Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Physical design quality-of-results~(QoR) optimization is hard and expensive. Choices made at one stage can help or hurt later stages. Each evaluation requires a costly EDA run through the full flow. While existing methods still treat optimization as flat parameter tuning or a LLM-based script generation task, we present AgenticPD, a stage-aware agentic framework for physical design QoR optimization. Instead of re-running the full flow after every trial, AgenticPD is organized around the stage boundaries of the physical design flow, where a Judge Agent navigates the search and stage-specialized agents make local decisions within their own stage using stage-local tools. Additionally, the agent harness in AgenticPD provides structured observations, execution history, and agent context management. As a result, the system can branch from prior intermediate states and reuse checkpoints to continue the optimization procedure, and every candidate is evaluated at the post-route signoff. Across these baselines, AgenticPD achieves strong post-route timing while remaining competitive in power and area.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticPD，一个针对物理设计 QoR 优化的阶段感知智能体框架。它将优化过程组织在物理设计流程的阶段边界上，利用 Judge Agent 导航搜索，阶段专用智能体使用本地工具做出局部决策。框架支持从先前中间状态分支并重用检查点，每个候选方案在布线后签核时评估。实验表明 AgenticPD 在后布线时序上取得强结果，同时在功耗和面积上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 物理设计 QoR 优化昂贵且困难，现有方法要么将优化视为扁平参数调优，要么是基于 LLM 的脚本生成任务，缺乏对设计流程阶段特性的利用。
Method: 提出 AgenticPD，包含 Judge Agent 和阶段专用智能体，基于阶段边界组织搜索，支持从中间状态分支和检查点重用，降低全流程重运行成本。
Result: 摘要报告 AgenticPD 在后布线时序上优于基线，且在功耗和面积上具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 阶段感知的智能体框架能有效提升物理设计 QoR 优化的效率与效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continual Model Merging with Test-Time Adaptation for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Model merging offers a practical alternative to conventional continual learning by integrating independently fine-tuned models without retaining previous training data. Recent state-of-the-art model merging methods employ test-time adaptation (TTA-guided merging) to address distribution shifts by adjusting merging-related variables using unlabeled target data. However, these methods have primarily been studied in multi-task or single-target settings, and their behavior under sequential continual learning remains insufficiently understood. We present a benchmark study that maps this family of methods to rehearsal-free continual Whole Slide Image classification and evaluates them against traditional continual-learning approaches. Experiments on six TCGA cancer-subtyping cohorts cover CLASS-IL and TASK-IL scenarios, in-domain and out-of-domain evaluation, and different task orders. The results show that adapting model merging at test time can provide strong task-specific performance and improve retention of previously acquired knowledge without storing historical WSIs. Nevertheless, performance remains sensitive to task order and to the interaction between adaptation on the current distribution and accumulated knowledge. This benchmark identifies model merging with test-time adaptation as a promising direction for continual computational pathology and motivates future methods that balance adaptation to domain shift with explicit preservation of historical knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将测试时自适应（TTA）与模型合并结合，用于持续学习场景下的全切片图像（WSI）分类。在六个TCGA癌症亚型数据集上评估了CLASS-IL和TASK-IL设置，结果表明该方法无需存储历史数据即可实现良好的任务特定性能并保持知识，但对任务顺序和当前分布适应与历史知识的交互敏感。
Motivation: 现有的模型合并方法主要研究多任务或单目标设置，在序列持续学习下的行为尚不清晰，且传统持续学习需要存储历史数据。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索无需存储历史WSI的持续模型合并方法。
Method: 采用测试时自适应引导的模型合并（TTA-guided merging），在测试阶段利用未标记目标数据调整合并相关变量，以应对分布偏移，并在CLASS-IL和TASK-IL场景下进行基准评估。
Result: 在六个TCGA癌症亚型数据集上，该方法在无需存储历史数据的情况下，实现了较强的任务特定性能，并改善了先前知识的保留，但性能对任务顺序敏感。
Conclusion: 模型合并与测试时自适应在持续计算病理学中具有潜力，未来需要平衡分布适应与历史知识保留的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trust Region Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Big goals are hard to achieve all at once; breaking them into small steps is wiser. We present Trust Region Policy Distillation (TOP-D), which transforms the notoriously unstable, high-variance On-Policy Distillation (OPD) into a stable training paradigm by dynamically constructing a proximal teacher. Theoretically, we establish a rigorous framework demonstrating that TOP-D inherently controls gradient variance. By providing a formal global convergence analysis alongside a monotonic improvement bound, we mathematically formalize the reliability and stability of the overall training dynamics. Empirically, TOP-D dramatically enhances training stability, sample efficiency, and final performance on mathematical reasoning tasks. More importantly, TOP-D introduces zero additional computational overhead, positioning itself as a promising alternative to the well-established OPD paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出信任区域策略蒸馏（TOP-D），通过动态构建邻近教师将不稳定的同策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation）转化为稳定训练范式。理论证明该方法控制梯度方差，提供全局收敛分析和单调改进界；实验在数学推理任务上显著提升训练稳定性、样本效率和最终性能，且无额外计算开销。
Motivation: 同策略蒸馏（OPD）存在训练不稳定、高方差的问题，难以直接应用于复杂任务。
Method: 提出信任区域策略蒸馏（TOP-D），动态构建邻近教师，以信任区域约束优化过程，从而稳定训练。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，TOP-D显著提升训练稳定性、样本效率和最终性能，且零额外计算开销。
Conclusion: TOP-D可作为同策略蒸馏的稳定替代方案，为策略蒸馏提供理论保障和实用改进。

papers.title: FM-ChangeNet: Learning Change through Pathwise Feature Transport
papers.abstract_en: We present FM-ChangeNet, a pathwise-supervised framework for change detection that reformulates bi-temporal reasoning as continuous transport in feature space rather than static endpoint comparison. Given encoded pre and post-temporal representations, we construct intermediate latent states and learn a time-conditioned velocity field $\hat{v}_θ(z_t,t)$ along the transformation trajectory. This pathwise formulation constrains the predictor over a continuum of intermediate states, providing a denser and less ambiguous supervision signal than conventional endpoint-only segmentation and enabling the model to capture temporal evolution explicitly. The learned velocity field is not only a transport mechanism but also an interpretable representation of change: its magnitude serves as a spatially localized change cue that helps distinguish true structural variation from nuisance effects such as illumination shifts and spatial misalignment. We develop a hierarchical multi-scale architecture with cross-temporal alignment, time-conditioned coarse-to-fine flow decoding, and a unified objective that couples flow supervision, trajectory consistency, spatial regularization, and segmentation loss. Experiments on remote sensing benchmarks show that the proposed framework produces more structured and robust change representations while achieving state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FM-ChangeNet，一种路径监督的变化检测框架，将双时相推理重新表述为特征空间中的连续运输而非静态端点比较。通过学习时间条件速度场来约束预测器，提供更密集的监督信号，并利用速度场幅度作为变化线索，区分结构变化与光照偏移等干扰。在多尺度架构下结合流监督、轨迹一致性等损失，在遥感基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 传统变化检测仅比较双时相端点特征，监督信号稀疏且易受光照、配准误差干扰，无法有效捕捉时相演化的连续过程。
Method: 构建编码后的前后时相表示之间的中间隐状态，学习时间条件速度场ˆvθ(z_t,t)作为变换轨迹；采用层次化多尺度架构，包含跨时相对齐、时间条件粗到细流解码，以及联合流监督、轨迹一致性、空间正则化和分割损失的目标函数。
Result: 在遥感变化检测基准上取得最先进性能，产生的变化表示更结构化且更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 路径监督机制通过连续运输建模能有效区分真实结构变化与伪影，提供可解释的变化线索，但当前仅在遥感领域验证，泛化至其他域（如气象）尚未探索。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MergeSurv: Merging-Based Continual Learning for Survival Analysis on Whole-Slide Images
papers.abstract_en: Survival analysis on Whole Slide Images (WSIs) is important in computational pathology for prognosis estimation and treatment planning. However, existing survival models are typically trained independently for each cancer cohort, making continual adaptation computationally expensive for gigapixel-scale WSIs. In this study, we propose MergeSurv, a merging-based continual learning framework for WSI survival analysis. A pathology vision-language foundation model is independently fine-tuned on each task, and the learned parameters are sequentially merged into a unified model without storing previous training data. We further investigate two inference strategies: One-for-All (OFA) and Voting-Expert Aggregation (VEA). Experiments on four TCGA cohorts demonstrate that MergeSurv outperforms naive fine-tuning as well as representative regularization-based and rehearsal-based continual learning methods, while effectively reducing catastrophic forgetting. The results suggest that model merging is a promising direction for scalable and privacy-preserving continual learning in computational pathology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MergeSurv，一种基于模型合并的持续学习框架，用于全切片图像（WSI）的生存分析。该方法独立微调病理视觉-语言基础模型于每个任务，然后顺序合并参数，无需存储先前训练数据。实验在四个 TCGA 队列上表明，MergeSurv 优于朴素微调及代表性正则化和重放方法，有效减少灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 现有生存分析模型通常为每个癌症队列独立训练，对于千兆像素规模的 WSI 而言持续适应计算成本高昂，且需要存储历史数据。
Method: MergeSurv 采用基于模型合并的持续学习：在每个任务上独立微调病理视觉-语言基础模型，然后将学到的参数顺序合并为统一模型，不保留先前训练数据。提出两种推理策略：One-for-All (OFA) 和 Voting-Expert Aggregation (VEA)。
Result: 在四个 TCGA 队列上的实验表明，MergeSurv 在性能上优于朴素微调以及正则化和重放类持续学习方法，并有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 模型合并在计算病理学中是一种有前景的持续学习方法，可实现可扩展且保护隐私的训练。

papers.title: Short-Horizon Sparse Model Predictive Control for Precipitation Reduction Using Numerical Weather Prediction
papers.abstract_en: This study proposes a precipitation control framework integrating a realistic Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) model with model predictive control (MPC). At each control instant in MPC, a finite-difference sensitivity matrix is constructed from the NWP model and used as a local linear model of how perturbations to the atmospheric state affect future precipitation. A sparse convex optimization problem is then solved to compute the control input, which is implemented as a perturbation to the atmospheric state. To reduce computational cost in sensitivity analysis, multiple grid points in the NWP model are treated collectively as a single block, and a uniform perturbation is applied to all points within each block. Moreover, a tailored convex optimization problem is introduced to effectively control the accumulated precipitation at the end of a weather event, using a prediction horizon much shorter than the entire event duration while promoting spatially sparse atmospheric perturbations. To evaluate the proposed MPC method, four control methods are compared: (i) initial-only open-loop optimal control (IO-OL), (ii) full-horizon open-loop optimal control (FH-OL), (iii) shrinking-horizon optimal control (SHOC) with a fixed terminal time, and (iv) single-move MPC with a fixed prediction-horizon length. Numerical experiments on a warm bubble benchmark demonstrate that MPC achieves precipitation reduction comparable to SHOC while reducing the total computational time relative to FH-OL and SHOC. Moreover, despite using a linear prediction model, MPC successfully achieves a challenging level of precipitation reduction, even when open-loop optimal control methods, namely, IO-OL and FH-OL, fail because of nonlinear atmospheric evolution. These findings suggest that MPC is a promising control framework for NWP-based precipitation reduction in complex weather events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文将数值天气预报（NWP）模型与模型预测控制（MPC）相结合，提出一种降水控制框架。在每个控制时刻，从NWP模型构建有限差分灵敏度矩阵作为局部线性模型，求解稀疏凸优化问题得到控制输入（大气状态扰动）。通过将NWP网格点分组施加均匀扰动降低计算成本，并设计特定凸优化问题以短预测时长控制累计降水。在暖泡基准上的数值实验表明，MPC与收缩时域最优控制（SHOC）的降水减小效果相当，但计算时间更短；且在线性模型下成功实现了非线性演变中开环最优控制失败的有效降水减小。
Motivation: 现有NWP-based降水控制方法计算成本高，且非线性大气演化导致开环最优控制失效。需要一种计算高效且能处理非线性的控制框架。
Method: 提出MPC框架：每个控制时刻构造NWP模型的有限差分灵敏度矩阵作为局部线性模型；将多个网格点视为一个块并施加均匀扰动以降低灵敏度分析计算量；设计稀疏凸优化问题，使用比整个天气事件短得多的预测时间步来有效控制最终累计降水量，同时促进大气扰动的空间稀疏性。
Result: 在暖泡基准上，MPC实现了与SHOC相当的降水减小效果，总计算时间少于全时域开环最优控制（FH-OL）和SHOC；且即使在线性预测模型下，MPC也能成功实现降水减小，而IO-OL和FH-OL因非线性演变失败。
Conclusion: MPC是基于NWP降水控制的一种有前景的框架，尤其在复杂天气事件中能平衡效果和计算效率。
Relevance: 90

papers.title: Trajectory-Anchor Optimization for Overconfident Thermal Visual Place Recognition: Zero-Leakage OOD Auditing and Kidnapped-Robot Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Modern thermal visual place recognition (TIR-VPR) frontends based on foundation models achieve remarkable closed-set retrieval but suffer from an overconfident forced-matching failure mode. Under out-of-distribution (OOD) or unmapped conditions, they generate highly plausible yet false loop candidates without a drop in similarity scores. While classical multi-hypothesis tracking (MHT) backends can mitigate these ambiguities by maintaining divergent trajectory beliefs, their exponential computational overhead violates real-time robotic constraints. To bridge this gap, we present Trajectory-Anchor Optimization (TAO). To counter the combinatorial challenge of evaluating parallel hypotheses (e.g., K=100), TAO compresses multi-view temporal verification into a batched SE(2) Procrustes alignment problem. By leveraging tensor-level vectorization and single-invocation batched SVD, this formulation bypasses the dynamic tree expansion of MHT, guaranteeing a strictly bounded per-frame execution loop of O(KN). Under a strict zero-leakage evaluation protocol, we show that while a passive geometric backend cannot mathematically separate metric localization errors from coherent hallucinations at a micro-scale (<5m) due to local visual ambiguities, TAO serves as an efficient fail-safe filter at a macro-scale. Within a 5m radius, hallucinations often possess a locally consistent geometry that deceives rigid alignment. However, beyond this threshold, the K=100 disparate hypotheses disperse spatially across the global map. This dispersion breaks the rigid temporal co-visibility constraint within the sliding window (N=20), causing the joint optimization residual to escalate sharply. Consequently, TAO establishes a distinct macroscopic convergence basin (10m) where multi-view geometric consistency reliably isolates catastrophic topological breaks and suppresses critical false acceptances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对热视觉地点识别中基于基础模型的前端在遇到分布外或未映射条件时产生高置信假阳性闭环的问题，提出轨迹-锚点优化（TAO）方法。TAO将多视角时间验证压缩为批处理SE(2) Procrustes对齐问题，利用张量向量化和单次调用批处理SVD，实现每帧严格有界的O(KN)执行循环，避免多假设跟踪的指数计算开销。在严格零泄漏评估协议下，TAO在宏观尺度上作为高效故障安全滤波器，通过多视角几何一致性可靠隔离灾难性拓扑断裂并抑制关键错误接受。
Motivation: 现代热视觉地点识别前端在分布外或未映射条件下产生高置信假阳性闭环，而经典多假设跟踪后端因指数计算开销违背实时机器人约束，需要一种高效方法在宏观尺度上识别假阳性。
Method: 提出轨迹-锚点优化（TAO），将多视角时间验证压缩为批处理SE(2) Procrustes对齐问题，通过张量向量化和单次调用批处理SVD实现每帧O(KN)的严格有界执行循环。

papers.title: Stabilized Higher-Order Influence Functions: Statistical Theory of a Class of Bilinear Forms
papers.abstract_en: Higher-order influence functions, introduced in a series of articles (Robins et al., 2008, 2009a; van der Vaart, 2014; Robins et al., 2016, 2023; Liu et al., 2017), are a unified framework for constructing rate-optimal point estimates of a class of statistical functionals, under various complexity-reducing assumptions on the posited statistical model that generates the observed data. Although higher-order (influence functions) estimators are theoretically appealing, they have very limited practical uptake compared to their first-order counterparts. The original higher-order estimators proposed in Robins et al. (2008) and Robins et al. (2017) involve nonparametric density estimation of multi-dimensional covariates, a highly nontrivial statistical and computational problem on its own. The density estimator is, in turn, used in the evaluation of the inverse population Gram matrix $Ω$ of a set of $k$-dimensional basis transformations of covariates. There, $k$ is allowed to be as large as $o (n^2)$. To partially address this potential shortcoming, Liu et al. (2017) restrict $k$ to $o (n)$ and instead estimate $Ω$ directly using the inverse sample Gram matrix estimator, but computed from an independent sample often obtained by sample-splitting. Liu et al. (2017) refer to this alternative estimator as the empirical higher-order estimator. Although the empirical higher-order estimator bypasses density estimation, it suffers from numerical instability due to potentially inverting a large-dimensional sample Gram matrix. In this article, we propose a new stabilized higher-order estimator without sample splitting, which exhibits more stable finite-sample performance compared to the empirical higher-order estimator, and more importantly, we prove that this new class of higher-order estimators enjoys similar statistical guarantees.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高阶影响函数估计量在实际应用中存在的数值不稳定性问题，提出了一种无需样本分割的稳定化高阶估计量。新估计量避免了密度估计和大维样本Gram矩阵的求逆，并在理论上证明了其与同类估计量相当的统计保证。
Motivation: 高阶影响函数估计量在理论上具有最优收敛速率，但实际应用受限：原始方法依赖高维非参数密度估计，而替代的基于样本分割的经验高阶估计量需对高维Gram矩阵求逆，导致数值不稳定。
Method: 提出一种新的稳定化高阶估计量，无需样本分割，通过避免直接求逆样本Gram矩阵来提升数值稳定性，并给出了该估计量的统计理论分析。
Result: 新估计量在有限样本下比经验高阶估计量更稳定，且具有相似的统计保证（如收敛速率等），但摘要未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 本文从理论上证明了所提稳定化高阶估计量的统计有效性，为高阶影响函数的实际应用提供了更可行的方案。

papers.title: DriftST: One-Step Generative Inference of Spatial Transcriptomics from H\&E Histology
papers.abstract_en: Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression while preserving spatial context, but its high cost and low throughput leave public datasets small. Inferring expression directly from widely available Hematoxylin and Eosin (H&E) stained histology offers a cost-effective alternative. However, existing approaches face several limitations: regression methods over-smooth toward the conditional mean, while generative methods are faithful but require slow multi-step inference; most methods treat genes as independent and equally important, ignoring inter-gene dependencies and heterogeneous gene informativeness; and most are tailored to a single resolution, either spot-level or cell-level. To address these issues, we propose DriftST, a unified framework for inferring spatially resolved gene expression from H&E images. DriftST builds on a Cellular Drifting generative model that learns a direct drift from a histology-conditioned source to the expression distribution, retaining generative expressiveness while enabling efficient one-step generation. To capture gene structure, we introduce the STransformer, which combines a co-expression attention module for inter-gene dependencies with a gene residual gate for differential gene importance. Operating on a generic gene-panel representation, DriftST applies directly to both spot-level and cell-level data in one framework, and extensive experiments across diverse tissues and platforms show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance at both resolutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DriftST，一个统一的生成框架，用于从 H&E 组织学图像推断空间分辨的基因表达。DriftST 基于细胞漂移生成模型，实现一步生成，避免多步推理；引入 STransformer 捕获基因间依赖性和差异重要性；适用于 spot 级和 cell 级数据。实验表明在多个组织和平台上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 空间转录组学（ST）成本高、通量低，现有数据集小。从广泛可用的 H&E 图像推断基因表达是一种经济有效的替代，但现有方法存在过平滑、多步推理慢、忽略基因间依赖性和异质性、以及仅适用于单一分辨率等问题。
Method: 提出 DriftST，基于细胞漂移（Cellular Drifting）生成模型，学习从组织学图像条件到表达分布的直接漂移，实现一步生成。引入 STransformer，包括共表达注意力模块（处理基因间依赖）和基因残差门（处理基因重要性差异）。采用通用基因面板表示，适用于 spot 级和 cell 级数据。
Result: 在多种组织和平台上的广泛实验表明，DriftST 在 spot 级和 cell 级分辨率上均达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: DriftST 是一个统一的、生成式的、高效的框架，能从 H&E 图像推断空间基因表达，并处理基因结构和多分辨率数据。

papers.title: Wasserstein Residuals: Learning Gradient Flows from Population Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing population dynamics is a central problem in the physical and data sciences. Often, the dynamics are modeled as a Wasserstein gradient flow (WGF): a curve of distributions driven by an energy functional. Though there are multiple mathematical characterizations of a WGF, the dominant algorithmic approach relies on the Jordan--Kinderlehrer--Otto (JKO) scheme. JKO-based methods are inflexible to time discretisation and require solving costly optimal transport problems. We take a residual approach, enforcing the continuity equations via a non-negative loss function whose minimum is the WGF. Combined with a data-fitting divergence, this gives a single global objective. This perspective unifies several existing methods and leads to a new particle-based method, stitching, that is simulation-free and robust to large gaps between observations. We demonstrate that the stitching method achieves state-of-the-art performance across trajectory inference benchmarks. For code see github.com/BasisResearch/wasserstein-residuals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于残差的 Wasserstein 梯度流 (WGF) 学习方法，通过连续性方程的非负损失函数与数据拟合散度结合，构建全局目标函数，避免传统 JKO 方案的昂贵最优传输计算。新方法 'stitching' 无需模拟、对观测间隔鲁棒，在轨迹推断基准上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 JKO 方案的 WGF 方法对时间离散化不灵活，且需要求解昂贵的优化传输问题，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出残差方法，通过连续性方程的非负损失函数来强制满足 Wasserstein 梯度流的条件，并与数据拟合散度联合优化，得到单一全局目标；由此导出的粒子方法 'stitching' 无需模拟轨迹，对稀疏时间观测鲁棒。
Result: 在多个轨迹推断基准上，stitching 方法达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 残差视角统一了若干现有方法，并提供了更灵活、高效的 WGF 学习框架。

papers.title: Identifiability of Relational Queries in Multi-View Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: When data sources are integrated through a shared interface, a downstream query may or may not be determined by what the interface exposes: two globally consistent worlds can agree on every shared attribute yet disagree on the query answer. This ambiguity is structural -- a property of the interface design, not the data volume -- and cannot be resolved by collecting more records or training a larger model. We formalize query identifiability for data integration under interface laws (functional dependencies that hold uniformly across all legal worlds rather than within a single instance) and prove three results. (i) A polynomial-time certificate (CheckCert) decides identifiability via attribute closure, and is exact on instances that expose any residual ambiguity (closure-separable). (ii) Non-identifiable queries face an irreducible 1/2 minimax error floor for any estimator using only interface evidence, bounding multi-view pretraining systems from below. (iii) A minimum-augmentation algorithm (Greedy-MinAug) finds the smallest set of interface additions to certify a query, reducing to Set Cover (logarithmic approximation). Experiments on synthetic benchmarks, real integration datasets spanning three domains (scholarly, product, restaurant), and schemas up to 10^3 attributes confirm CheckCert is exact, both algorithms run in single-digit milliseconds, and ML classifiers exhibit the predicted error floor and abrupt capability gains.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究了数据集成中查询可识别性问题，即通过共享接口集成的数据源可能无法唯一确定查询答案。提出了多项式时间算法 CheckCert 来判断可识别性，证明了非可识别查询存在 1/2 的 minimax 误差下界，并给出了最小化接口添加的算法 Greedy-MinAug。实验验证了算法效率和理论预测的误差下界。
Motivation: 数据集成时，多个数据源通过共享接口暴露属性，但下游查询可能不唯一确定，这是接口设计的结构性问题，无法通过增加数据量或模型容量解决。
Method: 形式化了在接口定律（跨所有合法世界一致成立的函数依赖）下的查询可识别性。提出了多项式时间证书算法 CheckCert，通过属性闭包判定可识别性；以及最小增量算法 Greedy-MinAug，通过集合覆盖近似找到最小接口添加集。
Result: 证明非可识别查询存在 1/2 的 minimax 误差下界；CheckCert 精确且运行在毫秒级；机器学习分类器表现出理论预测的误差下界和能力突变。
Conclusion: 论文强调查询可识别性是接口设计的结构性质，而非数据量问题，提供了理论下限和实用的判定与优化算法。

papers.title: LP-SFT: Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning via Multimodal Entropy Structure
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the standard approach for adapting pretrained language models to downstream domains, yet it often improves target-domain behavior at the cost of degrading pre-existing capabilities. Standard cross-entropy fine-tuning promotes only the observed label token and leaves unconstrained how probability mass is redistributed over other plausible alternatives, potentially distorting the rich local preference structure learned during pretraining. We first analyze next-token predictions using Shannon and Renyi entropies, revealing that pretrained models exhibit a regular multimodal entropy structure. These entropy peaks correspond to varying numbers of plausible alternatives, indicating that the base model intrinsically encodes rich distributional knowledge beyond the single supervised token. Motivated by this observation, we propose LP-SFT, a Local-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning objective designed to explicitly protect this inherent entropy structure. At each step, LP-SFT constructs an adaptive support of alternative tokens and applies a locally normalized preservation loss to maintain the base model's relative structure among them, while standard cross-entropy independently optimizes the supervised token. Across mixed-domain and single-domain fine-tuning experiments, LP-SFT improves overall performance over vanilla SFT and recent SFT-enhancement baselines, achieving the best balance between pass@1 accuracy and pass@k performance. These results suggest that local preservation helps mitigate capability degradation without collapsing sampling-accessible diversity.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 3 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/Wakaka161/LP-SFT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LP-SFT（局部保持监督微调）方法，旨在解决标准SFT在提升下游任务性能时破坏预训练模型内在分布结构的问题。通过分析Shannon和Rényi熵发现预训练模型具有多模态熵结构，LP-SFT在优化监督token的同时，通过局部归一化保留损失维持基座模型在备选token上的相对概率结构。混合领域和单领域微调实验表明，LP-SFT在pass@1和pass@k上取得更好平衡，缓解能力退化。
Motivation: 标准SFT仅优化标签token，不约束其他token的概率重分布，可能扭曲预训练习得的局部偏好结构，导致已有能力退化。
Method: LP-SFT构建自适应备选token支持集，应用局部归一化保留损失维护基座模型的相对结构，同时用交叉熵优化监督token。
Result: 在混合领域和单领域微调中，LP-SFT整体性能优于vanilla SFT和近期SFT增强基线，在pass@1准确率和pass@k性能之间达到最佳平衡。
Conclusion: 局部保留有助于缓解能力退化，且不破坏采样可访问的多样性。

summary_sections.result: 在混合领域和单领域微调中，LP-SFT整体性能优于vanilla SFT和近期SFT增强基线，在pass@1准确率和pass@k性能之间达到最佳平衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 局部保留有助于缓解能力退化，且不破坏采样可访问的多样性。

papers.title: SparseOcc++: Geometry-Aware Sparse Latent Representation for Semantic Occupancy Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction is essential for autonomous driving, yet dense voxel representations waste computation on largely empty space, while BEV and TPV projections compromise fine-grained 3D structure. Fully sparse representations offer an attractive alternative, but existing methods, including SparseOcc, entangle scene completion with semantic prediction by indiscriminately propagating high-dimensional features into empty regions and applying voxel-wise classification. This creates excessive activations, computational overhead, and geometric ambiguity. We present SparseOcc++, a geometry-aware sparse framework that explicitly decouples scene completion from semantic segmentation. SparseOcc++ reformulates completion as signed-distance regression on sparse anchor voxels through a scene completion field (SCF). To model complex outdoor geometry robustly, it combines orthogonal decomposition with discretized distance learning. A geometry-guided propagation module then converts the SCF into a complete volumetric scene and restricts semantic segmentation to geometrically verified regions. Experiments establish new state of the art: SparseOcc++ improves IoU by 2.3 points and is 3.9x faster than SparseOcc on nuScenes, while achieving a 5.9x speedup over OccFormer on SemanticKITTI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparseOcc++，一种基于几何感知的稀疏潜表示方法，用于3D语义占用预测。通过将场景补全与语义分割显式解耦，利用符号距离回归的场景补全场（SCF）和几何引导传播模块，将语义分割限制在几何验证区域。在nuScenes上IoU提升2.3个点，速度比SparseOcc快3.9倍；在SemanticKITTI上比OccFormer快5.9倍。
Motivation: 现有的密集体素表示在空旷区域浪费计算，BEV/TPV投影损失精细3D结构，而全稀疏方法（如SparseOcc）将场景补全与语义预测纠缠，导致过多激活、计算开销和几何模糊。
Method: 提出几何感知稀疏框架，通过场景补全场（SCF）将补全任务建模为稀疏锚点体素上的符号距离回归，结合正交分解与离散距离学习以稳健建模复杂户外几何，再利用几何引导传播模块将SCF转换为完整场景体素，并将语义分割限制在几何验证区域。
Result: 在nuScenes上，SparseOcc++比SparseOcc的IoU提升2.3个点，速度快3.9倍；在SemanticKITTI上，比OccFormer快5.9倍。
Conclusion: 实验表明，解耦场景补全与语义分割，并利用几何信息引导语义预测，能显著提升效率与准确性，实现新最先进水平。

papers.title: When Does High-CFG Diffusion Inversion Fail? A Controlled Study of Prompt--Latent Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided diffusion inversion is central to image editing, where an image is mapped to an initial latent and then edited by replaying the denoising process under a modified prompt. In practice, however, inversion is often performed with a lower classifier-free guidance(CFG) scale than the one used for generation or editing. This mismatch is empirically useful but leaves a basic question unresolved: when a target image is generated by a high-CFG trajectory, when can that trajectory actually be inverted? We study this question in a controlled generation--inversion--reconstruction setting, where the true initial latent and denoising trajectory are known. Using prompts taken from an existing diffusion-editing benchmark, we generate images under high CFG and reconstruct them with fixed-point inversion using the same prompt and guidance setting. The results reveal three types of prompt-level reconstruction behavior: easy prompts that reconstruct for most initial latents, hard prompts that fail for most initial latents, and intermediate prompts whose success depends on the prompt--latent pairing. To analyze the generation side, we define prompt pressure, a step-wise measure of how strongly CFG moves the denoising update away from the unconditional trajectory. Total pressure correlates with reconstruction quality and separates easy from hard prompts, but it does not explain the success or failure of intermediate prompt--latent pairs. Text-side analyses further show that the main visual subject and wording can change inversion difficulty. Finally, we evaluate a compact trajectory-consistency intervention that relaxes guidance only at locally unstable inverse steps. This diagnostic check improves reconstruction and Prompt-to-Prompt editing in our controlled setting, supporting the view that high-CFG inversion failure requires local, trajectory-aware analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高CFG（classifier-free guidance）扩散反演失败的原因，在受控生成-反演-重建设置中，使用现有扩散编辑基准的提示词，发现提示词和初始潜变量之间的交互导致三种重建行为：简单提示、困难提示和中间提示。引入提示压力（prompt pressure）度量，并评估轨迹一致性干预方法以改善高CFG下的反演效果。
Motivation: 文本引导扩散反演在图像编辑中广泛应用，但实践中常使用比生成或编辑时更低的CFG尺度，导致高CFG轨迹能否被反演的基本问题未解决。
Method: 在受控设置中，使用已知的真实初始潜变量和去噪轨迹，对高CFG生成的图像进行定点反演（fixed-point inversion），分析提示词与潜变量配对对重建质量的影响，定义提示压力并评估轨迹一致性干预。
Result: 揭示三类提示重建行为；提示压力与重建质量相关，但无法解释中间提示-潜变量配对的成功与否；文本分析表明视觉主体和措辞影响反演难度；轨迹一致性干预可改善重建和Prompt-to-Prompt编辑。
Conclusion: 高CFG反演失败需要局部的、轨迹感知的分析，简单的全局CFG调整不足以解决问题。

papers.title: RustMizan: A Compilable, Contamination-Aware Benchmarking Framework for Rust Vulnerabilities
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly applied to vulnerability analysis, but existing benchmarks have not kept pace. They typically rely on small non-compilable snippets, focus on binary classification (vulnerable or not), and do not account for the risk that publicly-released datasets are part of model training corpora. We introduce RustMizan, a benchmarking framework for Rust vulnerability analysis that addresses these gaps. RustMizan contains compilable code variants at the crate, file, and function levels, with annotations for binary vulnerability detection, CWE classification, and function- and line-level localization. A paired mutation framework produces semantics-preserving code mutants for contamination testing and robustness probing. Across four frontier models in an agentic setup with command-line access, binary classification sits in the 56-65% range, but line localization F1 stays near 20%, and adversarial cues drop line F1 by about 27%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RustMizan是一个针对Rust漏洞分析的可编译、污染感知的基准测试框架，包含可编译的代码变体、二元漏洞检测、CWE分类和函数/行级定位注释，并引入配对突变框架用于污染测试。在四个前沿模型的智能体设置下，二元分类准确率在56-65%之间，但行定位F1分数接近20%，对抗性线索使行F1下降约27%。
Motivation: 现有漏洞分析基准测试通常使用小型不可编译代码片段、仅关注二元分类，且未考虑公开数据集可能被用于模型训练导致的污染风险。
Method: 提出RustMizan框架，包含crate、文件、函数级别的可编译代码变体，标注了二元漏洞检测、CWE分类及函数/行级定位信息；同时引入语义保持的配对突变框架用于污染测试和鲁棒性探测。
Result: 在四个前沿模型的智能体设置下（带命令行访问），二元分类准确率为56-65%，行定位F1分数约20%，对抗性线索使行F1下降约27%。
Conclusion: RustMizan提供了一个更严格的Rust漏洞分析基准，暴露了当前模型在精确定位上的局限性和对数据污染的敏感性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Turning Off-Policy Tokens On-Policy: A Plug-in Approach for Improving LLM Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models (LLMs) follows a efficient paradigm of "rollout then update", which inevitably results in off-policy training data. To resolve this, Importance sampling (IS) is proposed, while the token-level ratios compound over long sequences, causing severe variance exploded. A natural idea is "transferring" these off-policy token into on-policy token, so that the importance scores for correction are unnecessary. Following this idea, we propose Selective Importance Sampling (SIS), which is inspired by rejection sampling. Concretely, SIS implements by viewing off-policy model as proposal distribution, and implement a token-level rejection test: accepted tokens are viewed as on-policy, so that receive unit importance score, while rejected tokens retain the standard IS correction. Our proposed SIS is theoretically proved reducing the gap between token-level and sequence-level off-policy gradient estimators. The SIS acts as a plug-in that only modifies the importance ratio in the policy loss, adding negligible wall-clock overhead, and can be combine with a vast vary of RL post-training algorithms. Experiments on dense and MoE LLMs across math and agent benchmarks show that SIS consistently improves all objectives, while providing substantially stronger robustness under off-policy data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出选择性重要性采样（Selective Importance Sampling, SIS），用于解决大语言模型RL后训练中离策略（off-policy）token导致的重要性采样方差爆炸问题。SIS受拒绝采样启发，将离策略模型视为提议分布，在token级别进行拒绝测试：接受的token视为在策略（on-policy）赋予单位重要性权重，拒绝的token保留标准重要性采样校正。理论证明SIS能缩小token级与序列级离策略梯度估计器之间的差距。实验在密集和MoE LLM的数学与agent基准上显示，SIS一致提升所有目标，并在离策略数据下提供更强的鲁棒性。
Motivation: RL后训练中的“rollout then update”范式必然产生离策略训练数据，重要性采样虽被提出但token级比率在长序列中累积导致严重方差爆炸。
Method: 提出选择性重要性采样SIS，将离策略模型视为提议分布，在token级别执行拒绝测试：接受token视为在策略并赋予单位重要性分数，拒绝token保留标准重要性采样校正；该方法仅修改策略损失中的重要性比率，可即插即用于多种RL后训练算法。
Result: 在密集和MoE LLM的数学与agent基准实验中，SIS一致提升所有优化目标，并在离策略数据下表现出显著更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: SIS作为插件可降低token级与序列级离策略梯度估计器之间的差距，与多种RL后训练算法兼容，额外开销可忽略。

papers.title: Dashboard2Code: Evaluating Multimodal Models on Reconstructing Interactive Dashboards
papers.abstract_en: Automatic data visualization generation has advanced rapidly with multi-modal large language models, yet existing efforts largely focus on static charts and overlook the interactive dashboards commonly used for real-world data exploration. We introduce Dashboard2Code, a novel task that requires a model to proactively explore an interactive dashboard, acquire and integrate feedback from its own interactions (e.g., clicking and filtering), and generate code that reproduces the target dashboard. To support comprehensive evaluation, we present DashboardMimic, the first Plotly+Dash benchmark for Dashboard2Code, comprising 180 carefully designed and manually verified dashboard-code pairs spanning three difficulty levels and covering eight common real-world interaction patterns. We further propose an automated evaluation framework tailored to dashboards that combines code semantic analysis with dynamic interaction-based testing to assess visual and interaction consistency, showing strong agreement with human judgments. Experiments across a range of open- and closed-source multi-modal models reveal that even the strongest systems struggle on high-complexity dashboards and that a substantial performance gap remains between open-source and closed-source models on the Dashboard2Code task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dashboard2Code 任务，要求多模态大模型主动探索交互式仪表盘（如点击、筛选），获取交互反馈并生成代码以重建目标仪表盘。作者构建了包含 180 个仪表盘-代码对的 DashboardMimic 基准，覆盖三种难度和八种常见交互模式，并设计了结合代码语义分析与动态交互测试的自动评估框架。实验表明，即使最强模型在高复杂度仪表盘上仍表现不佳，且开源与闭源模型之间存在显著性能差距。
Motivation: 现有自动数据可视化生成工作主要关注静态图表，忽略了实际数据探索中常用的交互式仪表盘，缺乏对模型交互能力的评估。
Method: 定义 Dashboard2Code 任务，构建 Plotly+Dash 的 DashboardMimic 基准（180 个手动验证的仪表盘-代码对），并提出结合代码语义分析与动态交互测试的自动评估框架。
Result: 多模态模型实验显示，即使最强系统在高复杂度仪表盘上仍表现挣扎，开源与闭源模型之间存在显著性能差距。
Conclusion: 交互式仪表盘重建任务对当前多模态模型仍有挑战，尤其在高复杂度场景下，该基准可推动相关研究。

papers.title: What You See Is What You Get: Observation-Aligned Supervision for Chart-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Chart-to-code generation is commonly trained with supervised fine-tuning on reference plotting scripts, implicitly treating the gold code as a fully observable target. We argue that this assumption is often invalid: many chart programs contain latent raw variables that cannot be uniquely recovered from the rendered image. For example, a boxplot exposes summary statistics rather than original samples, a pie chart reveals proportions rather than arbitrary raw values, and a histogram shows bin-level mass rather than individual observations. Supervising models to reproduce such non-identifiable quantities encourages hallucination and over-specified code generation. We introduce Observation-Aligned supervision, a rewriting framework that replaces latent raw-data targets with quantities constrained by the visual observation: box statistics for boxplots, wedge percentages for pie charts, and bin weights for histograms. Applying this framework to chart-to-code training data from two sources, we obtain the Observation-Aligned supervision target data. Experiments across multiple VLMs on ChartMimic and ChartX demonstrate consistent improvements in observable value recovery, including under both-executable evaluation. Our results suggest that improving chart-to-code models requires not only more data or advanced learning objectives or algorithms, but also supervision targets that respect what is identifiable from the chart image.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Reference-Induced Consensus for Selective Posed-Reference Visual Localization
papers.abstract_en: We present RIC-Loc (Reference-Induced Consensus localization), a scene-training-free posed-reference localizer that is SfM-point-map-free in its main estimator: it uses known reference poses, but not precomputed SfM 3D map points, query-to-map 2D-3D matches, or query-to-map PnP. A frozen VGGT pass predicts local camera poses, depth, and query-reference tracks for a query and selected references. Each reference induces one map-frame SE(3) query-pose hypothesis, robust consensus estimates the pose, and the preserved hypothesis structure yields two reliability scores: spatial dispersion and a track-conditioned covariance score. On the covariance-eligible set, the two scores are complementary for held-out, ground-truth-free failure detection across indoor, outdoor, and large-scale low-texture benchmarks: the joint policy is strongest in textured scenes and the covariance score in the low-texture regime, and the hypothesis-derived scores consistently outperform the standard retrieval-score gap and random rankings. Without per-scene training the consensus estimator remains accurate -- competitive with structure-based localization indoors and improving over a comparable feed-forward baseline -- giving an effective selective operating regime for posed-reference localization. Code is available at https://github.com/SNU-DLLAB/ric_loc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIC-Loc 是一种无需场景训练的姿态参考定位器，不依赖 SfM 点云。它利用冻结的 VGGT 网络预测局部姿态、深度和查询-参考轨迹，从每个参考生成一个 SE(3) 假设，通过鲁棒共识估计姿态，并利用假设结构导出两种可靠性分数用于失败检测。方法在室内、室外和大规模低纹理基准上表现出竞争力，无需逐场景训练。
Motivation: 现有姿态参考定位方法通常需要预计算的 SfM 三维地图点或场景训练，本文旨在设计一种无需 SfM 点云和场景训练的定位方案。
Method: 使用冻结的 VGGT 网络处理查询和选定的参考图像，得到相机姿态、深度和轨迹；每个参考诱导一个姿态假设；通过鲁棒共识估计最终姿态；利用假设结构计算空间分散度和协方差得分作为可靠性指标。
Result: 在室内、室外和大规模低纹理基准上，联合策略在纹理丰富场景最强，协方差得分在低纹理场景最优；假设导出的可靠性分数始终优于标准检索分数差距和随机排序；定位精度与基于结构的方法竞争，优于前馈基线。
Conclusion: RIC-Loc 提供了一种有效的选择性操作机制用于姿态参考定位，无需场景训练，且具有可实用的失败检测能力。

papers.title: FORGE: Research-Trajectory Hijacking Attacks on Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents decompose open-ended queries into subtasks, retrieve web evidence over multiple rounds, and synthesize long-form reports. This workflow creates a planning-layer poisoning surface: adversarial documents that enter the retrieval pool can steer follow-up questions and turn a local injection into report-level contamination. We present FORGE (Fabricated Orchestrated Reasoning chain for aGent Exploitation), a two-level attack that combines intra-document reasoning fabrication with inter-document chain coordination to hijack subtask planning. We further introduce the PRISM metric, which weights infected report claims by cognitive type, and Root Query Anchoring, a lightweight defense that ties recursive follow-up generation to the root query. Across 25 queries, Network FORGE reaches 26.4% PRISM with five injected documents and exhibits depth migration, in which recursive synthesis shifts poisoned content from overt framing into factual premises. On the 10-query defense subset, RQA (Root Query Anchoring) reduces PRISM from 38.5% to 18.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对深度研究智能体的攻击方法FORGE，通过注入恶意文档操控子任务规划，实现报告级污染。引入PRISM指标按认知类型加权评估感染，并提出根查询锚定（RQA）轻量防御。实验显示Network FORGE在25个查询中用5个文档达到26.4% PRISM，RQA将PRISM从38.5%降至18.3%。
Motivation: 深度研究智能体将开放查询分解为子任务并多轮检索，存在规划层投毒面：对抗文档可扭曲后续问题并污染报告。
Method: 提出两级攻击FORGE，结合文档内推理伪造与文档间链协调劫持子任务规划；引入PRISM指标按认知类型加权感染声明；提出根查询锚定（RQA）防御，将递归后续生成绑定到根查询。
Result: 25个查询上Network FORGE用5个注入文档达到26.4% PRISM，并展示深度迁移（递归合成将有毒内容从显式框架移入事实前提）。10个查询防御子集上RQA将PRISM从38.5%降至18.3%。
Conclusion: FORGE揭示了深度研究智能体的规划层投毒新威胁，RQA提供轻量有效防御，但未讨论对其他类型攻击的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Motion Latents for Learning Robust Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract_en: Learning motion latents for robotic manipulation heavily relies on extracting motion patterns from visual sequences, yet effective action abstractions require understanding three-dimensional geometric transformations. Here, we introduce GeoMoLa (Geometry-Aware Motion Latents), which learns discrete motion latent codes by predicting how point clouds evolve during manipulation rather than reconstructing visual observations. This four-dimensional objective -- spatial geometry changing through time -- forces latent representations to encode actual physical motion rather than appearance patterns. GeoMoLa achieves state-of-the-art performance using only single-view RGB-D input, while existing methods require multi-view reconstruction, succeeding across diverse manipulation benchmarks. Our ablations reveal that geometric prediction is the key to driving performance, quantitatively validating that manipulation depends on spatial understanding. Furthermore, the learned codes exhibit effective motion abstraction: applying them to novel scenes produces physically consistent transformations regardless of visual context. Our real-world experiments also confirm this robustness capability, achieving robust manipulation with minimal demonstrations in cluttered environments where geometric reasoning determines success. Thus, we demonstrate that effective motion latents for robot control can better emerge from understanding motion through its three-dimensional effects rather than pixel-level patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoMoLa（Geometry-Aware Motion Latents），通过学习点云在操作过程中的几何演化来学习离散动作潜在码，而非重建视觉观测。使用单视角RGB-D输入即可达到SOTA性能，而现有方法需要多视角重建。实验表明几何预测是性能提升的关键，学到的潜在码能够在不同场景中产生物理一致的运动变换。
Motivation: 现有的动作潜在学习方法主要从视觉序列中提取运动模式，但有效的动作抽象需要理解三维几何变换，而现有方法往往依赖于像素级外观特征。
Method: GeoMoLa通过预测点云在操作过程中的时空演化（4D目标）来学习离散动作潜在码，利用单视角RGB-D输入，以几何变换预测为目标，迫使潜在表示编码实际物理运动。
Result: 在多个操作基准上取得SOTA性能，消融实验验证几何预测是性能提升的关键；实际实验表明在杂乱环境中仅需少量演示即可实现鲁棒操作。
Conclusion: 本文证明有效的动作潜在表示应通过理解三维空间中的运动效果来获取，而非像素级模式。

papers.title: RSPO: Reward-Swap Policy Optimization for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning holds significant potential for training large language models (LLMs) to handle multi-turn interactive tasks. However, in long-horizon, multi-turn tasks characterized by sparse outcome rewards, directly training with outcome rewards often results in slow convergence due to the sparsity of signals and the lack of fine-grained feedback. Furthermore, the model may fail to learn successful trajectories that are not sampled during training, thereby limiting its performance. Conversely, while employing customized dense process rewards provides richer signals and accelerates convergence, these surrogate rewards may exhibit potential misalignment with the ground-truth outcome rewards. This inconsistency can bias the training direction and ultimately degrade the model's final performance. In this work, we propose Reward-Swap Policy Optimization (RSPO), a method designed to leverage the rich information from dense process rewards to facilitate training with outcome rewards. By utilizing a reward-swap mechanism, RSPO ensures the diversity of sampled trajectories while guaranteeing consistency between the optimization objective and the true outcome rewards, thereby elevating the performance ceiling of the model. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging agent benchmarks, WebShop and ALFWorld. By applying our method to various reinforcement learning algorithms, including GRPO, PPO, and GiGPO, we demonstrate that RSPO achieves consistent performance improvements across different baselines and benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RSPO（Reward-Swap Policy Optimization），一种针对多轮交互任务中稀疏结果奖励的强化学习方法。通过奖励交换机制，利用密集过程奖励的丰富信息来辅助结果奖励训练，保证轨迹多样性与优化目标一致性。在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 基准上，将 RSPO 应用于 GRPO、PPO、GiGPO 等算法均取得一致性能提升。
Motivation: 多轮长程任务中直接使用稀疏结果奖励会导致收敛慢且可能遗漏成功轨迹；而密集过程奖励虽能加速收敛，却易与真实结果奖励产生偏差，误导优化方向。
Method: 提出 Reward-Swap Policy Optimization（RSPO），通过奖励交换机制将密集过程奖励的信息注入基于结果奖励的优化过程，在保持优化目标与真实奖励一致的同时，增加采样轨迹的多样性。
Result: 在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 两个 agent 基准上，将 RSPO 应用于 GRPO、PPO、GiGPO 三种强化学习算法，均观察到一致的性能改进。
Conclusion: RSPO 有效结合了过程奖励的密集信号与结果奖励的真实性，提升了多轮 LLM 智能体在稀疏奖励场景下的性能上限。

papers.title: Learning Probabilistic Prompt for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning aims to progressively learn from a sequence of tasks, each containing a disjoint subset of classes, while preserving previously learned knowledge. Prompt-based continual learning methods propose to learn a small set of parameters, i.e., prompts, by associating them with a query feature of an input image. These methods optimize the prompts, attempting to represent diverse patterns of images. However, we have observed that existing prompt-based methods suffer from a prompt collapse problem, that is, the prompts tend to be highly similar to each other, thereby failing to capture the diverse data distributions in continual learning scenarios. To address this issue, we propose in this paper a novel prompt-based continual learning framework that captures diverse patterns of images across a sequence of tasks. To this end, we model each prompt as a probabilistic distribution and construct a mixture of these distributions, from which we sample diverse prompts. This enables our model to effectively capture highly diverse image distributions in the continual learning process. We also present a distribution regularization loss to prevent abrupt changes in the prompt distributions throughout the training process. We show extensive experimental results for continual learning on standard benchmarks, including ImageNet-R, CIFAR-100, and CUB-200, demonstrating the effectiveness of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对持续学习中提示崩溃问题（prompts高度相似），提出将每个提示建模为概率分布，并从混合分布中采样不同提示，以捕获多样图像分布。还提出分布正则化损失防止分布突变。在ImageNet-R、CIFAR-100、CUB-200上实验验证，表明该方法有效提升持续学习性能。
Motivation: 现有基于提示的持续学习方法中，提示趋向高度相似（提示崩溃），无法捕获持续学习场景中多样数据分布。
Method: 将每个提示建模为概率分布，构建这些分布的混合模型，从中采样多样提示；同时引入分布正则化损失约束训练过程中提示分布的平滑变化。
Result: 在ImageNet-R、CIFAR-100、CUB-200等标准基准上，该方法有效提升了持续学习性能。
Conclusion: 通过概率提示和混合分布采样，有效解决了提示崩溃问题，并能捕获多样的图像分布。

papers.title: Integrated Altruistic and Fairness Preference Induces Advanced Mutual Cooperation in Sequential Social Dilemmas
papers.abstract_en: Inducing cooperation among distributed agents is still a difficult problem in the field of multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), particularly in social dilemma situations. There, individual interests are misaligned with the common good and individual rationality leads to suboptimal group outcomes. In contrast, humans are able to achieve cooperation with one another in such situations. A common explanation for such cooperative behavior is that individuals have social preferences. In order to achieve cooperation in MARL, we design a new utility function integrating altruistic preferences (incentive for other's reward) and fairness preferences (incentive for equality) from social psychology and behavioral economics, namely, Altruistic and Fairness Preference (AFP), a reward-sharing mechanism which converts one's own and other's rewards to incentives for cooperative behavior. We performed comparative experiments with standard RL and inequity aversion agents in two challenging sequential social dilemma games, and showed that AFP agents successfully achieved mutual cooperation with more collective rewards and higher equity than the baselines. To further understand the progression of AFP during training, we subsequently explore the effects of altruistic preferences and fairness preferences on agents' behavior. The results suggest that altruistic preferences encourage agents to contribute to the public goods, and fairness preferences induce mutual behavior between agents.

Motivation: 在多智能体强化学习的社交困境中，个体理性导致次优群体结果，而人类能通过社会偏好实现合作。现有方法未能充分利用利他和公平两类社会偏好。
Method: 设计 AFP 效用函数，将自身和他人的奖励转换为合作行为的激励：利他偏好鼓励关心他人奖励，公平偏好鼓励奖励平等。
Result: 在两种序列社会困境游戏中，AFP 智能体相比标准 RL 和不平等厌恶（inequity aversion）基线，获得了更高的集体奖励和更公平的分配。
Conclusion: 利他偏好推动智能体为公共物品做贡献，公平偏好诱导智能体之间的相互行为，两者结合有效促进合作。

papers.title: Hierarchical Scaffolding Enables Human-Like Cognitive Selectivity under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning systems demand extensive datasets for visual recognition. Conversely, humans learn with high efficiency despite severe data limitations, often by acquiring broad categorical structures before refining finer distinctions. Inspired by this contrast, we introduce SCALA (Scaffolded Cognitive Architecture for Learning under limited dAta), a hierarchical learning framework grounded in cognitive psychology that guides models from coarse conceptual structures to fine-grained recognition. Our model exhibits human-like cognitive selectivity by effectively prioritizing task-relevant features while suppressing background distractors, a mechanism that induces a fundamental shift in representation learning. This shift is characterized by accelerated cluster formation, reduced intra-class dispersion, and enhanced semantic separability. Empirically, SCALA achieves significant accuracy improvements under severe data scarcity. Furthermore, this hierarchical scaffolding promotes robust generalization to unseen classes and accelerates the acquisition of novel categories. Collectively, our results establish SCALA as a powerful framework for achieving human-level sample efficiency and resilient category generalization in data-constrained environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受认知心理学启发，提出分层学习框架 SCALA，引导模型从粗粒度概念结构逐步细化到细粒度识别，在数据稀缺条件下实现类似人类的认知选择性。实验表明，SCALA 能有效提升严重数据缺乏下的识别准确率，促进簇的快速形成、减小类内离散度、增强语义可分性，并泛化到未见类别。
Motivation: 现代机器学习系统需要大量数据用于视觉识别，而人类能在数据严重受限的情况下高效学习，通常先获取广泛的类别结构再细化细粒度区分。论文旨在借鉴这一认知机制，开发在数据稀缺环境中具备高效样本利用和泛化能力的模型。
Method: 提出 SCALA（Scaffolded Cognitive Architecture for Learning under limited dAta），一种基于认知心理学的分层学习框架，通过从粗粒度概念结构到细粒度识别的逐步引导，使模型优先关注任务相关特征并抑制背景干扰，从而改变表征学习路径。
Result: 在严重数据稀缺条件下，SCALA 显著提升了识别准确率；同时加速了簇形成、降低了类内离散度、增强了语义可分性，并对未见类别表现出鲁棒泛化能力。
Conclusion: SCALA 为数据约束环境中实现人类水平的样本效率和类别泛化提供了一个有潜力的框架，强调了分层引导在表征学习中的关键作用。

papers.title: Strategic Buying Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI is shifting online shopping from search toward delegated purchasing, where autonomous buying agents monitor markets and decide when to buy on a consumer's behalf. We study the design of such strategic buying agents, which must decide when to purchase within a finite shopping window, translating price observations, the remaining time horizon, and beliefs about future price changes into a purchase policy. We formulate this problem across three information regimes: stationary, Bayesian, and robust, and treat the resulting optimal policies as a policy menu for implementation. In the stationary regime, price adjustments follow a Poisson arrival process with a known post-adjustment price distribution; the optimal policy is a dynamic purchase-threshold rule, with the threshold governed by an ordinary differential equation. In the Bayesian regime, the adjustment intensity is known, but the price-adjustment distribution is uncertain; the optimal rule remains threshold-based, now depending on posterior beliefs, and we bound the value of knowing the true distribution. In the robust regime, the agent has only price bounds and seeks worst-case protection; randomized threshold policies achieve optimal competitive-ratio and minimax-regret guarantees. We evaluate the proposed policies on Amazon price histories from Keepa (367 items, 48,933 timestamped observations) and examine their integration into language-model buying agents. The stationary and Bayesian policies perform competitively on mean normalized consumer surplus despite their stylized assumptions, while the robust policy performs best at the distribution's 10th percentile. Results suggest language models are better suited to selecting among regimes and calibration samples than to making buy-or-wait decisions directly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究战略购买代理（strategic buying agents）的设计，这类自主代理代表消费者在有限购物窗口内决定最佳购买时机。作者在三种信息体制（平稳、贝叶斯、鲁棒）下建模最优购买策略，得到动态购买阈值规则等理论结果，并在Keepa的Amazon价格历史数据（367件商品，48933条时间戳记录）上进行评估。结果表明，尽管简化假设，平稳和贝叶斯策略在平均标准化消费者剩余上表现竞争性，鲁棒策略在分布第10百分位表现最好。语言模型更适合选择体制和校准样本，而非直接做出买卖决策。
Motivation: 在线购物正向委托购买转变，自主代理监控市场并代表消费者决策购买时机，但如何设计这样的战略购买代理（即何时购买的最优策略）尚未被充分研究。
Method: 将购买时机问题建模为有限时间窗口内的最优停止问题，考虑三种信息体制：平稳（价格调整服从已知分布的泊松过程）、贝叶斯（调整强度已知但分布未知）、鲁棒（仅有价格界限，寻求最坏情况保护）。分别求解最优策略，包括动态阈值规则、基于后验信念的阈值规则和随机阈值策略，并推导竞争比和极小极大遗憾保证。
Result: 在Keepa的Amazon价格历史数据上，平稳和贝叶斯策略在平均标准化消费者剩余上表现良好，即便假设简化；鲁棒策略在10%分位数上最优。实验还表明语言模型更适合选择体制和校准样本，而非直接决策。
Conclusion: 论文强调，三种信息体制下的阈值策略构成可实施的政策菜单，语言模型在其中扮演辅助角色（选择体制和校准），而非直接做出购买时机决策。

papers.title: F-ACVAE: A Federated Adaptive Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder for Privacy-Preserving Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of Internet of things (IoT) devices has significantly expanded the cyber-attack surface, necessitating robust and privacy-preserving intrusion detection systems (IDS). However, centralized learning approaches often suffer from severe performance degradation due to high-dimensional traffic data, extreme class imbalance, and highly non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data across heterogeneous edge devices. To address these challenges, this paper proposes F-ACVAE, a federated adaptive conditional variational autoencoder framework that enables collaborative model training across distributed IoT devices without sharing raw data. F-ACVAE incorporates selective parameter aggregation, where local encoders remain private while globally shared components are synchronized to preserve discriminative latent structures. To further enhance stability under extreme non-IID settings and feature distribution shifts, we introduce a novel constrained momentum Gaussian aggregation (CMGA) strategy that combines update clamping with momentum-based smoothing to mitigate client drift. Extensive experiments on the N-BaIoT dataset demonstrate that F-ACVAE achieves an average accuracy and macro F1-score of 99\%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Moreover, the selective aggregation mechanism reduces communication overhead by approximately 62\%, making the framework particularly suitable for resource-constrained IoT environments. These results highlight the effectiveness of F-ACVAE in achieving high detection performance while ensuring privacy preservation and communication efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 F-ACVAE，一种联邦自适应条件变分自编码器框架，用于 IoT 网络中的隐私保护入侵检测。通过选择性参数聚合保持局部编码器私有，同时引入约束动量高斯聚合 (CMGA) 缓解非 IID 数据下的客户端漂移。在 N-BaIoT 数据集上达到 99% 的平均准确率和宏 F1 分数，并将通信开销降低约 62%。
Motivation: 集中式学习在 IoT 入侵检测中面临高维流量数据、极端类别不平衡和异构边缘设备上的非 IID 数据问题，导致性能下降和数据隐私风险。
Method: F-ACVAE 采用联邦学习架构，结合自适应条件变分自编码器，通过选择性参数聚合（保持本地编码器私有，同步全局共享组件）和约束动量高斯聚合 (CMGA)（更新钳位与动量平滑）来增强非 IID 条件下的稳定性。
Result: 在 N-BaIoT 数据集上，F-ACVAE 的平均准确率和宏 F1 分数均达到 99%，优于现有基线，同时通信开销降低约 62%。
Conclusion: F-ACVAE 在保持高检测性能的同时，有效实现了隐私保护和通信效率，特别适用于资源受限的 IoT 环境。

papers.title: Probe-EM: Targeted Neuron Tracing via Training-Free Semantic Verification
papers.abstract_en: Establishing large-scale, high-resolution neural connectivity maps is fundamental to elucidating the structural basis of brain function. However, when processing terabyte- or petabyte-scale electron microscopy data, over-segmentation inherent in automated reconstruction algorithms remains a critical bottleneck, requiring extensive manual proofreading spanning person-years. To alleviate the heavy reliance on annotated data and the limited flexibility of conventional tracing methods, we propose a training-free, targeted neuron tracing framework. Specifically, we introduce a skeleton-guided Heuristic Spatial Search paradigm that leverages geometric priors to iteratively reconstruct neuronal morphologies through a probing-verification cycle. To achieve robust zero-shot semantic verification, we further develop a Dimension-Aware Semantic Verification strategy built upon the foundation model NeuroSAM 2. This strategy resolves intra-slice splits via Planar Ensemble Consensus and inter-slice splits via Axial Spatio-Temporal Propagation. Notably, we integrate the proposed workflow into the Neuroglancer visualization platform, enabling an interactive human-in-the-loop proofreading system. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms supervised baselines and reduces manual proofreading time by 33.4%. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/HeadLiuYun/Probe-EM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的靶向神经元追踪框架Probe-EM，用于电子显微镜数据的连接组重建。该方法通过骨架引导的启发式空间搜索迭代重建神经元形态，并利用基于NeuroSAM 2的维度感知语义验证解决过分割问题。集成到Neuroglancer平台后，实验表明相比有监督基线减少了33.4%的人工校对时间。
Motivation: 现有自动化重建算法在处理TB/PB级EM数据时存在严重过分割，传统追踪方法依赖大量标注数据且灵活性差，导致人工校对工作耗时数年。
Method: 提出训练自由的靶向神经元追踪框架，包括：1) 骨架引导的启发式空间搜索，利用几何先验通过探测-验证循环迭代重建形态；2) 维度感知语义验证策略，基于NeuroSAM 2基础模型，通过平面集成共识解决层内分裂、通过轴向时空传播解决层间分裂；3) 集成到Neuroglancer平台实现人机交互校对。
Result: 在公开EM数据集上，该方法优于有监督基线，并将人工校对时间减少33.4%。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了无需标注数据即可实现高效神经元追踪的潜力，验证了基础模型在语义分割和自动化校对中的有效性。
