summary_sections.conclusion: 该理论框架揭示了grokking的几何机理，并为缩放行为提供了可验证的预言。

papers.title: Argus: Metric Panoramic 3D Reconstruction for Indoor Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Metric feed-forward 3D reconstruction for panoramic data remains under-explored due to the lack of large-scale panoramic RGB-D training data. We present Realsee3D, a hybrid dataset of 10K indoor scenes (1K real, 9K synthetic) with 299K panoramic viewpoints and precise metric annotations, and Argus, a feed-forward network trained on it for metric panoramic 3D reconstruction. In the sparse unordered capture setting of Realsee3D, a poorly chosen coordinate anchor can cause global pose drift. Argus addresses this with a learned covisibility module that selects the geometrically optimal reference view to anchor the metric world frame. To further improve multi-task learning, we decompose the bidirectional pixel-to-world mapping into interpretable sub-steps with per-step supervision and cross-coordinate joint constraints, reinforcing geometric consistency across prediction branches. On the Realsee3D benchmark, Argus achieves state-of-the-art metric performance in camera pose estimation, depth estimation, and point cloud reconstruction. Project page: https://argus-paper.realsee.ai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Argus，一种前馈网络，用于室内场景的度量全景3D重建。为了解决全景3D重建缺乏大规模RGB-D训练数据的问题，作者构建了包含1万个室内场景（1千真实、9千合成）的Realsee3D混合数据集，包含29.9万个全景视点及精确度量标注。Argus通过可学习共视模块选择最优参考视图锚定度量世界坐标系，并通过分解双向像素到世界映射为可解释子步骤，配合逐步骤监督和跨坐标联合约束，增强几何一致性。在Realsee3D基准上，Argus在相机位姿估计、深度估计和点云重建方面取得了最先进的度量性能。
Motivation: 现有前馈式3D重建方法在全景数据上缺乏大规模RGB-D训练数据，且稀疏无序全景采集中坐标锚点选择不当会导致全局位姿漂移。
Method: 提出了Realsee3D混合数据集（1K真实+9K合成室内场景，299K全景视点，精确度量标注）以及Argus网络：包含可学习共视模块选择最优参考视图锚定坐标系，并将双向像素到世界映射分解为可解释子步骤，引入逐步骤监督和跨坐标联合约束。
Result: 在Realsee3D基准上，Argus在相机位姿估计、深度估计和点云重建中达到了最先进的度量性能。
Conclusion: 通过大规模混合数据集和可解释子步骤分解，Argus有效解决了全景数据度量3D重建中的位姿漂移和多任务学习一致性问题。

papers.title: Golden Hour Divide: Trauma Care Accessibility and Resource Vulnerability in Sri Lanka
papers.abstract_en: Timely intensive care dictates survival, yet emergency infrastructure remains unevenly distributed across Sri Lanka. While pre-hospital services have expanded, the transition to definitive care remains a critical bottleneck. This study evaluates national emergency resilience by quantifying the gap between clinical demand and the availability of specialized resources across all 25 districts. Using the latest national epidemiological data and terrain-aware H3 hexagonal modeling, we analyzed accessibility for seven critical conditions based on spatial gaps, clinical need-gaps, lethality, coverage, and resource availability. Based on these metrics, unsupervised K-Means clustering was applied to categorize districts into four policy-actionable archetypes: Critical Structural Exclusion, Institutional Mirages, Operational Capacity Strain, and High-Resilience Benchmarks. Our study suggests that severe service deficits exist in the Northern and Eastern provinces, where spatial gaps exceed 70%, rendering the Golden Hour operationally impossible. Notably, specialist scarcity drives systemic pressure more than bed capacity; underserved regions effectively function as institutional mirages. This study suggests that improving accessibility by 25% in high-priority clusters would reduce the national need-gap by 9.65%, providing a roadmap for the strategic redistribution of specialists to ensure healthcare equity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究使用H3六边形建模和K-Means聚类分析斯里兰卡25个地区的创伤护理可及性，识别出四种政策行动类型，发现北部和东部省份的空间缺口超过70%，使黄金时间无法实现。研究表明专家短缺比床位容量更关键，将高优先级集群的可及性提高25%可减少全国需求缺口9.65%。
Motivation: 斯里兰卡紧急基础设施分布不均，院前服务虽已扩展，但向确定性护理的过渡仍是关键瓶颈。需要量化临床需求与专业资源可用性之间的差距，以评估国家应急韧性。
Method: 使用最新国家流行病学数据和地形感知H3六边形模型，分析七种危重病情的可及性，包括空间缺口、临床需求缺口、致死率、覆盖率和资源可用性。基于这些指标，应用无监督K-Means聚类将地区分为四类：关键结构性排斥、制度幻影、运营能力紧张和高韧性基准。
Result: 北部和东部省份存在严重服务缺陷，空间缺口超过70%，使黄金时间不可能实现。专家短缺比床位容量更关键，服务不足地区实际上成为制度幻影。提高高优先级集群的可及性25%可减少全国需求缺口9.65%。
Conclusion: 该研究为斯里兰卡创伤护理资源战略再分配提供了路线图，强调通过改善可及性促进医疗公平。

papers.title: Boundary Degree as a Node-level Feature for Epidemic Scenario Identification in Agent-based Cascade Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Characterizing the scenario underlying an epidemic from its disease cascade is an important task in simulation analytics. We propose boundary degree, the count of an infected node's contacts in the underlying contact network that were not infected, as a per-node cascade feature for this task. Through systematic ablation on realistic social contact networks of Tennessee and Virginia, we show that boundary degree alone improves scenario identification accuracy by 19%. Edge features, whose importance was observed empirically by prior work, consistently improve accuracy across all settings; we provide theoretical grounding for this observation. These effects are complementary. We prove that certain epidemic scenarios are indistinguishable without boundary or edge information. Prior feature engineering approaches included aggregate boundary statistics, but these were not among the top-ranked feature groups; the per-node representation we propose reveals their importance clearly. Our results suggest that contact tracing applications should track contacts with non-infected individuals, not only transmissions.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 10 figures, preliminary version; not final
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于智能体的级联模拟中流行病场景识别问题，提出节点级特征“边界度”（boundary degree），即已感染节点在接触网络中未被感染的接触数。通过在田纳西和弗吉尼亚的真实社交网络上进行系统消融，边界度单独使场景识别准确率提升19%。边缘特征被证明具有互补作用，且本文为相关经验观察提供了理论基础。作者还证明了某些流行病场景在缺乏边界或边缘信息时不可区分。
Motivation: 在流行病模拟中，从疾病级联信息推断潜在场景是一个重要但困难的任务，现有特征工程方法未充分利用节点级边界信息。
Method: 提出节点级特征“边界度”，定义为已感染节点在接触网络中未被感染的邻居数量；通过消融实验评估其效果，并结合边缘特征分析互补性；提供理论证明说明某些场景在没有边界或边缘信息时不可区分。
Result: 在田纳西和弗吉尼亚的社交网络上，单独使用边界度使场景识别准确率提升19%；边缘特征在所有设置下稳定提升准确率。
Conclusion: 接触追踪应用应不仅追踪传播事件，还应记录与未感染个体的接触；边界度和边缘特征是互补且必要的特征。

papers.title: FADE: Mitigating Hallucinations by Reducing Language-Prior Dominance in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the impressive capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), they remain susceptible to hallucination, generating content inconsistent with the input image. Recent studies attribute this to the dominance of language priors over visual inputs and employ contrastive decoding methods to mitigate this dominance, but the mechanistic origin remains unexplored. We investigate the information flow through each transformer layer and find that attention modules consistently aggregate visual evidence, while FFN modules at critical layers act as the source of language priors. These priors can override visual evidence, causing correct predictions in intermediate layers to drift toward incorrect outputs. Based on this insight, we propose FADE (FFN Attenuation for DEcoding), a training-free method that attenuates FFN outputs to reduce language-prior dominance. Evaluations on POPE, CHAIR, and MME benchmarks across LLaVA-1.5, mPLUG-Owl2, and InstructBLIP show that FADE effectively mitigates hallucinations while preserving inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中幻觉产生的机制，发现FFN模块是关键的语言先验来源，会覆盖视觉证据导致正确预测偏移。提出无需训练的FADE方法，通过衰减关键层FFN输出来减少语言先验主导，在POPE、CHAIR、MME基准上有效缓解幻觉并保持推理效率。
Motivation: 现有LVLM易生成与图像不符的幻觉内容，归因于语言先验主导视觉信息，但机制未明。
Method: 提出FADE（FFN Attenuation for DEcoding），一种无需训练的解码方法，通过识别并衰减关键Transformer层中FFN模块的输出，降低语言先验的干扰。
Result: 在LLaVA-1.5、mPLUG-Owl2、InstructBLIP上评估POPE、CHAIR、MME基准，FADE有效缓解幻觉且不牺牲推理效率。
Conclusion: FFN模块在特定层是语言先验的主要来源，衰减其输出可减少幻觉，为LVLM幻觉缓解提供新视角。

papers.title: The Unverifiability of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Alignment, Static and Dynamic: From Trakhtenbrot's Wall to the Safety-Generality Tension
papers.abstract_en: We establish the mathematical limits of AGI safety in two forms: verifying a fixed system, and verifying that a certified safety property persists once the system self-modifies. In the static case, no algorithm can certify a highly expressive AGI's safe behaviour infallibly, completely and tractably, whether over unbounded input domains (blocked by Rice's and Godel's theorems) or over all finite hardware configurations (blocked by Trakhtenbrot's theorem, which splits into a PSPACE-hardness barrier and a co-RE-completeness barrier), forcing a Soundness-Completeness-Tractability Trilemma as a structural, not statistical, necessity. In the dynamic case, we formalise self-modification as a computable transition operator and prove that no algorithm can determine, from a system's current certified safety, whether safety survives its next self-modification step: a result that reduces to Rice's Theorem one level up, making the static and dynamic barriers two faces of one obstruction. This forces an exclusive dichotomy: persistent certification is attainable only for systems that have stopped evolving semantically, i.e. only for narrow, not general, systems. Nor can the obstruction be delegated: any supervisor adequate to audit a general AGI is itself a general AGI, so the supervisory regress never terminates. Three practical risks (finite test coverage, bounded deliberation time, restricted observation) are one phenomenon: every bounded scheme that does not reject correct evidence admits an evolution trace it certifies at every stage while the property is persistently violated. These results give formal content to the unverifiability of AI, showing it is not an engineering target deferred by current limits but a structural tension, an Expressivity Invariant governed by the same computational laws as the Halting Problem and Rice's Theorem.
papers.comment: v2: substantially expanded and retitled. Adds unpublished results on the dynamic (self-modifying) case, deriving the persistence barrier from Rice's Theorem one level up; a supervisory-regress theorem linking the results to scalable oversight and Yampolskiy's verifier theory; and a unified treatment of all four barriers as one obstruction, the Expressivity Invariant
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从计算理论角度证明，通用人工智能（AGI）的安全验证在静态和动态情况下均存在不可逾越的数学极限。静态情况下，任何算法都无法对高表达力的AGI进行绝对可靠、完全且易处理的正确行为验证，这由Rice定理、Gödel定理和Trakhtenbrot定理共同导致，形成了“正确性-完备性-易处理性三难困境”。动态情况下，即使系统当前安全属性已通过验证，也无法确定该属性在系统自我修改后能否持续，该问题归约为高一层次的Rice定理。研究进一步表明，持久的安全认证仅限于已停止语义演化的狭义系统，且监督者本身须同为广义AGI，导致监督回归无法终止。这些结果将AI不可验证性确立为一种结构性约束，而非工程上的暂时困难。
Motivation: 现有AI安全研究多聚焦于工程方法，但缺少对AGI安全验证根本可能性界限的形式化理论分析。本文旨在用计算理论（Trakhtenbrot's Wall、Rice定理等）证明AGI对齐的不可验证性是结构性的，而非暂时的。
Method: 运用递归论和计算复杂性理论进行形式化分析：静态案例利用Rice定理、Gödel定理和Trakhtenbrot定理（空间复杂度PSPACE-硬与递归可枚举完全性）推导无算法可完全验证高表达力AGI；动态案例将自我修改形式化为可计算转移算子，证明其安全保持判定等价于高一层次的Rice定理，并推导监督回归非终止性。
Result: 证明静态验证面临“正确性-完备性-易处理性三难困境”；动态验证中，持久安全认证仅限于停止语义演化的狭义系统，且任何能审计广义AGI的监督者本身必为广义AGI，导致监督回归无限。有限测试覆盖、有限决策时间和受限观测等实际风险本质上是同一现象：任何不拒斥正确证据的有界方案都存在一条演化轨迹，该轨迹在每一步都被认证为安全而属性持续被违反。
Conclusion: AGI安全验证的不可验证性不是工程上的暂时限制，而是由与停机问题和Rice定理相同的计算定律所支配的结构性张力，论文称之为“表达力不变量”（Expressivity Invariant）。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从计算理论角度证明，通用人工智能（AGI）的安全验证在静态和动态情况下均存在不可逾越的数学极限。静态情况下，任何算法都无法对高表达力的AGI进行绝对可靠、完全且易处理的正确行为验证，这由Rice定理、Gödel定理和Trakhtenbrot定理共同导致，形成了“正确性-完备性-易处理性三难困境”。动态情况下，即使系统当前安全属性已通过验证，也无法确定该属性在系统自我修改后能否持续，该问题归约为高一层次的Rice定理。研究进一步表明，持久的安全认证仅限于已停止语义演化的狭义系统，且监督者本身须同为广义AGI，导致监督回归无法终止。这些结果将AI不可验证性确立为一种结构性约束，而非工程上的暂时困难。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有AI安全研究多聚焦于工程方法，但缺少对AGI安全验证根本可能性界限的形式化理论分析。本文旨在用计算理论（Trakhtenbrot's Wall、Rice定理等）证明AGI对齐的不可验证性是结构性的，而非暂时的。
summary_sections.method: 运用递归论和计算复杂性理论进行形式化分析：静态案例利用Rice定理、Gödel定理和Trakhtenbrot定理（空间复杂度PSPACE-硬与递归可枚举完全性）推导无算法可完全验证高表达力AGI；动态案例将自我修改形式化为可计算转移算子，证明其安全保持判定等价于高一层次的Rice定理，并推导监督回归非终止性。
summary_sections.result: 证明静态验证面临“正确性-完备性-易处理性三难困境”；动态验证中，持久安全认证仅限于停止语义演化的狭义系统，且任何能审计广义AGI的监督者本身必为广义AGI，导致监督回归无限。有限测试覆盖、有限决策时间和受限观测等实际风险本质上是同一现象：任何不拒斥正确证据的有界方案都存在一条演化轨迹，该轨迹在每一步都被认证为安全而属性持续被违反。
summary_sections.conclusion: AGI安全验证的不可验证性不是工程上的暂时限制，而是由与停机问题和Rice定理相同的计算定律所支配的结构性张力，论文称之为“表达力不变量”（Expressivity Invariant）。

papers.title: NormGuard: Reward-Preserving Norm Constraints in Flow-Matching Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reward alignment of flow-based generators, but often degrades perceptual quality in ways that are not captured by the reward proxy. We identify a simple structural signature of this drift: across three post-training methods (NFT, AWM, DPO), RL fine-tuning inflates the per-step velocity norm $\|v_θ\|$ by $5\%$ to $15\%$ relative to the reference. A form of norm inflation has been studied in classifier-free guidance (CFG), where rescaling the velocity back to a reference norm at inference time can mitigate the resulting artifacts. However, this inference-time correction does not transfer cleanly to RL: rescaling $v_θ$ to match $\|v_{\text{ref}}\|$ at inference time neither improves reward nor fixes the quality degradation, because the inflation is co-adapted into the model weights. Furthermore, an adjoint sensitivity analysis shows that velocity magnitude rescaling carries no coherent first-order reward signal at the batch level, indicating that suppressing norm inflation is unlikely to remove a consistently reward-carrying component. Since inference-time renormalization fails while norm suppression carries no reward cost, training-time intervention is the appropriate strategy. Together, these findings motivate NormGuard, a hinge penalty that activates only when $\|v_θ\|$ exceeds $\|v_{\text{ref}}\|$ and composes additively with any velocity-local base loss. Across two base models, three post-training methods, and two reward proxies, NormGuard consistently improves MLLM-judged image quality and forensic realism while preserving reward, with gains that amplify under few-step inference and are not explained by early stopping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现强化学习后训练会使流匹配生成器的每步速度范数膨胀5%-15%，导致图像质量下降。提出NormGuard，一种仅在速度范数超过参考值时激活的铰链惩罚，在训练阶段抑制膨胀，同时保持奖励。实验表明，NormGuard能提升MLLM评判的图像质量和法医真实感，且增益在少步推理时更明显。
Motivation: 强化学习后训练提高了流生成器的奖励对齐，但常导致未被奖励代理捕获的感知质量下降，论文发现该下降与速度范数膨胀相关。
Method: 提出NormGuard，一个在速度范数超过参考范数时激活的铰链惩罚，与任何基于速度的局部损失可加性组合，在训练阶段干预而非推理时重缩放。
Result: 在两个基座模型、三种后训练方法和两个奖励代理上，NormGuard一致提升了MLLM评判的图像质量和法医真实感，同时保持奖励，增益在少步推理时放大，且不能由早停解释。
Conclusion: 训练阶段的速度范数抑制是提升RL后训练生成质量的合适策略，而推理时重缩放无效且不携带奖励信号。

papers.title: Hybrid privacy-aware semantic search: SVD-truncated document geometry and CKKS-encrypted query reranking under a restricted threat model
papers.abstract_en: Dense embeddings power semantic search and Retrieval-Augmented Generation, yet a leaked vector database leaks the text behind it, since embeddings invert with high fidelity. The textbook defences are extreme--homomorphic search is sound but far too slow at million-document scale, while privacy noise degrades ranking before it protects. We study a middle path built on an asymmetry: each static document vector is SVD-truncated and then rotated by a secret orthogonal transform held only by the data owner, while the dynamic query is protected cryptographically under CKKS, so an honest-but-curious server sees neither query values nor scores; the CKKS parameters are fixed by a small reproducible benchmark. We prove a tight lower bound on the reconstruction error of any decoder confined to the protected subspace. On a one-million-document, five-encoder corpus the wrapper preserves retrieval quality at sub-second latency--a mild linear denoiser on self-retrieval that reverses into a 2--8-point nDCG@10 cost on graded relevance--while an off-the-shelf inversion attack collapses to the floor. We then map the boundary: a known-plaintext attacker recovers the rotation by orthogonal Procrustes from about as many leaked pairs as the retained dimension, and the public quantization codes leak neighbour structure. The same geometry doubles as a privacy-preserving data-loss-prevention primitive for LLM firewalls, matching a plaintext detector at near parity. We state the limits plainly: query confidentiality is cryptographic, but document protection is an empirical obfuscation layer, not a cryptographic primitive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合隐私保护的语义搜索方法，对文档向量进行SVD截断和秘密正交变换，对查询向量使用CKKS同态加密，在百万级文档规模下保持亚秒级检索延迟，同时抵御反演攻击。实验表明，该方法在nDCG@10上损失2-8点，但攻击者可通过已知明文对恢复旋转矩阵。文档保护是经验性混淆层，而非加密原语。
Motivation: 密集嵌入可被高保真反演，现有方案要么太慢（同态搜索），要么牺牲排序质量（隐私噪声）。需要一种折中方法。
Method: 利用不对称性：静态文档向量经SVD截断后由数据所有者持有的秘密正交变换旋转，动态查询向量在CKKS下加密，服务器既看不到查询值也看不到分数。攻击者可通过正交Procrustes从泄露的明文对恢复旋转。
Result: 在百万文档、五个编码器语料上，该方法保持检索质量，延迟亚秒级，nDCG@10损失2-8点，而标准反演攻击失效。已知明文攻击者可用与保留维度数量相当的泄露对恢复旋转。
Conclusion: 查询机密性是加密级别的，但文档保护仅是经验性混淆，并非加密原语。该方法可作为LLM防火墙的隐私保护数据丢失预防原语，与明文检测器表现接近。

papers.title: UC-Search: Risk-Aware Test-Time Search for Delayed Constrained Time-Series Control
papers.abstract_en: Time-series deployments often need delayed feasible decisions, not only accurate forecasts. UC-Search is a trace-only retained-search layer for delayed constrained control: a frozen backbone emits forecasts or action scores, a hard-feasibility automaton rolls paths forward, and bounded search returns the first action of a feasible trajectory. The main claim is conditional: retained lookahead can improve delayed constrained decisions only when delayed feasible-set coupling, retained-prefix premises, and fail-closed release certificates hold. The promoted public endpoint is Phase128 certified M4 expanded40: validation selects Certificate-Constrained Retained Pareto Beam with $λ=0.25$, the held-out test has certificate/risk-active rates $1.0000/0.9642$, and the weakest family remains above the unchanged $0.95$ gate at $0.9516$ on M4Weekly. The author-defined public $9$-family suite remains an uncertified stress-test boundary. The paper reports a trace-only mechanism, one certified public endpoint, failed-route certificates, and deployment boundaries rather than a universal risk-control theorem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UC-Search，一个用于时间序列延迟约束控制的保留搜索层。该方法使用冻结骨干网络输出预测或动作分数，通过硬可行性自动机推进路径，并采用有界搜索返回可行轨迹的第一个动作。主要声明是：保留前瞻（retained lookahead）仅在满足延迟可行集耦合、保留前缀前提和失败关闭释放证书三个条件时才能改进延迟约束决策。验证结果表明，在 M4Weekly 上最弱族仍高于 0.95 门限。
Motivation: 时间序列部署中常需要延迟可行决策，而不仅是准确预测；现有方法难以处理延迟约束条件。
Method: 提出 UC-Search 作为保留搜索层：冻结骨干网络输出预测或动作分数，硬可行性自动机（hard-feasibility automaton）推进路径，有界搜索返回可行轨迹的第一个动作。该方法基于三个前提条件。
Result: 验证选择证书约束保留 Pareto Beam（λ=0.25），保留测试中证书/风险活跃率为 1.0000/0.9642，最弱族在 M4Weekly 上为 0.9516（高于 0.95 门限）。作者定义的 9 族套件仍是未认证的压力测试边界。
Conclusion: 论文报告的是仅保留机制、一个经认证的公共端点、失败路由证书和部署边界，而非通用的风险控制定理。

papers.title: BluTrain: A C++/CUDA Framework for AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Progress in deep learning is, at scale, more a matter of systems engineering than of modelling: the behaviour of a model in training (its throughput, its memory footprint, and the numerical fidelity of the result) is determined less by the architecture itself than by how that architecture is expressed on the hardware. To achieve absolute control over this hardware expression while abstracting away systems complexity to make modelling seamless and eliminating the need for repetitive orchestration logic, BluTrain was architected from first principles as a robust, lightweight, and architecture-general training framework in standard C++ and the core CUDA programming model. Every layer is implemented natively: a typed tensor module with reverse-mode autograd, a linear-algebra library, a caching allocator, a multi-mode distributed-execution module, and an MLIR-based deep-learning compiler. In formal evaluations training a 124M-parameter GPT-2 baseline in FP32 on an 8-GPU 6000 Ada system, BluTrain outperforms industry-standard baselines in both throughput (sustaining an average of 407K tokens/s versus PyTorch's 395K tokens/s) and memory efficiency (achieving up to a 22% footprint reduction), while strictly preserving numerical fidelity and converging to a marginally lower final validation loss. With every layer explicitly open to native tuning, the performance ceiling is the framework's own to raise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BluTrain 是一个从头构建的轻量级 C++/CUDA 深度学习训练框架，原生实现了张量模块、自动微分、线性代数库、缓存分配器、多模式分布式执行和基于 MLIR 的编译器。在 8 卡 GPU 系统上训练 124M 参数 GPT-2 时，相比 PyTorch 提升了吞吐量（407K vs 395K tokens/s）并减少了 22% 的内存占用，同时保持了数值精度和更低的验证损失。
Motivation: 当前深度学习在大规模训练时，模型行为更多由硬件实现决定而非架构本身，但现有框架缺乏对硬件表达的绝对控制且存在系统复杂性。
Method: 采用标准 C++ 和 CUDA 编程模型，从零实现每一层：类型化张量模块（带反向模式自动微分）、线性代数库、缓存分配器、多模式分布式执行模块和 MLIR 深度学习编译器。
Result: 在 8 块 6000 Ada GPU 上训练 124M 参数 GPT-2（FP32），平均吞吐量 407K tokens/s（PyTorch 为 395K），内存占用减少 22%，最终验证损失略低，数值精度完全保持。
Conclusion: BluTrain 通过完全原生和可调优的设计，在性能上超越了行业标准基线，证明了系统级优化对大规模训练的重要性。

papers.title: Rethinking Prototype-based Similarity Learning for Few-Shot Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot object detection aims to detect novel object categories from only a few labeled examples, avoiding costly large-scale annotation. Recent prototype-based similarity learning approaches enable training-free adaptation by matching query features with class prototypes. However, they suffer from two fundamental limitations: (i) class confusion arising from inter-class similarity margin collapse, and (ii) insufficient visual cues for precise localization, as similarity scores capture only class-level semantic affinity while providing limited spatial information. To address these issues, we introduce two complementary components. Text-Anchored Semantic Mask (TSMa) leverages class-level text features as semantic anchors to identify semantically aligned channels through channel-wise interaction between visual and text features. By suppressing style-induced spurious responses and emphasizing class-intrinsic signals, TSMa enlarges inter-class similarity margins and mitigates class confusion. We further propose Stage-Aligned Hierarchical Autoregressive Regression (SHARe), which reformulates localization as a hierarchical autoregressive process that progressively refines bounding boxes across multiple stages. SHARe leverages the layer-wise characteristics of ViT representations by aligning feature abstraction levels with regression stages: deeper layers guide early coarse localization, while shallower layers rich in edge and texture cues refine spatial details in later stages. Experiments on COCO demonstrate a new state of the art, outperforming the previous best by +10.1 nAP, with extensive analysis validating each component. The code is available at https://github.com/VisualScienceLab-KHU/ReSet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对少样本目标检测中基于原型的相似度学习的两个局限性：类间相似度间隔崩塌导致的类别混淆，以及相似度分数仅提供类级语义而缺乏空间信息导致定位不精确。提出Text-Anchored Semantic Mask (TSMa)利用文本特征作为语义锚点，通过通道交互扩大类间相似度间隔；提出Stage-Aligned Hierarchical Autoregressive Regression (SHARe)将定位视为分层自回归回归，利用ViT不同层特征逐步细化边界框。在COCO上达到新SOTA，比之前最好方法高+10.1 nAP。
Motivation: 现有基于原型的相似度学习方法在少样本目标检测中存在类间相似度间隔崩塌导致的类别混淆，以及相似度分数仅捕获类别级语义而缺乏空间信息，导致定位不精确。
Method: 提出TSMa利用类级文本特征作为语义锚点，通过视觉-文本特征的通道交互识别语义对齐通道，抑制风格引起的虚假响应，扩大类间相似度间隔；提出SHARe将定位建模为分层自回归回归，利用ViT表示的不同层特征：深层指导早期粗定位，浅层（富含边缘和纹理线索）细化后期空间细节。
Result: 在COCO上，新SOTA比之前最好方法高+10.1 nAP，并通过大量分析验证了各组件有效性。

papers.title: A Transport-Based Geometry of Belief-Cost
papers.abstract_en: A finite agent, a machine's digital twin or any bounded reasoner, infers a fixed and noisy world through finite sensors, so its coherent output is a belief: a probability density over states (the Bayes posterior). Such an agent stops short of certainty, and revising a belief carries a cost. We propose a framework for belief costs based on optimal transport, motivated by these facts. We pose two postulates. P0 (the arena): a revision cost is a scalar price on optimal transport, so beliefs live in Wasserstein space. P1 (uniform pricing): one nat of knowledge costs the same metric length everywhere, the eikonal condition. Among conceivable pricing rules we study this one. Under P0 and P1 the cost metric is optimal transport conformally reweighted by Fisher information, $\tilde g_{e,U}=2(e+U)\,g_{W_2}$, and the Fisher family is a characterization: among continuous reliefs, uniform pricing is equivalent to $U=cJ$. Two consequences follow on the conformal class. Certainty sits at infinite cost-distance once the relief dominates the Fisher information, so a well-posed inference has a cost floor diverging at certainty (necessity conjectural beyond power laws). On location-scale leaves the geometry is hyperbolic, and the Stam bound places the Gaussian as the most curved one (at $e=0$). The results are geometric, in nats, and hold up to units: a change of cost unit rescales all distances and preserves every conclusion (boundary, eikonal family, hyperbolicity, Gaussian extremum), a gauge theorem; a global change of state units at $e=0$ is an isometry; the content lies in signs, rankings and ratios. Via Landauer (one nat worth $k_BT$) the cost floor becomes an energy floor: revising toward certainty would demand unbounded energy. Physics anchors the unit and enters no theorem. Removing either postulate leaves the selection open.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于最优传输的信念成本几何框架。在均匀定价公设下，成本度量由Fisher信息共形重加权，导致确定性位于无限成本距离处。在位置-尺度叶上几何是双曲的，高斯分布是最弯曲的。结果具有几何意义，单位变化下保持结论。
Motivation: 有限智能体推断固定有噪世界时产生信念（贝叶斯后验），修订信念需要成本。现有框架缺乏几何基础，本文提出基于最优传输的信念成本几何。
Method: 基于两个公设：修订成本是最优传输的标量价格（P0）；均匀定价：知识单位成本处处相同（P1）。推导出成本度量为Fisher信息共形重加权的Wasserstein度量，并研究其几何性质。
Result: 确定性位于无穷成本距离；在位置-尺度叶上几何为双曲，高斯分布是最弯曲的（e=0时）。Landauer原理下成本地板对应能量地板，修订至确定性需要无限能量。
Conclusion: 本文提出信念成本的几何框架，给出均匀定价下的特征化结果，并指出去除公设则选择开放。结果在nats中成立，单位变化保持结论。

papers.title: GIM-ENDO: A Multimodal Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia Morphology and Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Gastric intestinal metaplasia (GIM) is a precursor lesion to gastric dysplasia and adenocarcinoma whose early detection is crucial for intervening in the carcinogenesis cascade. Artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise for real-time endoscopic detection and characterization of GIM. However, development of reliable AI models has been constrained by the absence of publicly available, histopathologically validated datasets that combine detailed endoscopic annotations, histological subtype (complete and incomplete), standardized grading systems, and normal mucosal patterns. GIM-ENDO was designed to fill this gap. The dataset comprises demographic data, endoscopic findings, histopathological results, and H. pylori status acquired using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE) and image-enhanced endoscopy (IEE), including narrow-band imaging (NBI) and magnifying NBI (M-NBI), along with images and video clips from 24 patients (22 GIM-positive, 2 normal controls). Annotations cover six primary IEE endoscopic signs -- light blue crest (LBC), marginal turbid band (MTB), white opaque substance (WOS), TV pattern (Fusion), atrophy, and map-like erythema (MLE) -- plus two additional endoscopic findings (AHP and GA) recorded where present. GIM subtypes (complete and incomplete) are annotated for all GIM-positive cases; OLGA and OLGIM staging are provided where complete histological sampling was available. The dataset is publicly accessible at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20707267. For the latest updates and further information regarding this dataset, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com A short version of this work has been submitted to MICCAI 2026 Open Data Track.

papers.title: NRT-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Turn Red-Teaming of LLM Operator Agents in Safety-Critical Control Rooms
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed as supervisory components for safety-critical systems, yet their robustness under sustained, adaptive adversarial pressure remains poorly characterized. We present NRT-Bench, a benchmark for multi-turn red-teaming of LLM agents acting as operators of a safety-critical system, instantiated in a simulated nuclear power plant control room. A five-role operator team, each backed by a configurable LLM, runs a plant governed by six critical safety functions (CSFs), while adversaries inject messages over four channels in bounded multi-turn sessions with per-turn feedback. Harm is an objective signal rather than LLM-judged text: a run terminates the moment any CSF is lost, attributed to the causing message. Evaluating four frontier operator models under a fixed-attack paired-replay protocol, we find that adaptive multi-turn attacks reliably push the operator team past a safety limit: across the four models, between 8.7% and 12.1% of attack sessions end with the plant losing a critical safety function. Although the four models look almost equally robust by this aggregate rate, their failures barely overlap: of $149$ sessions, none defeat all four models while a third defeat at least one, so vulnerabilities are nearly disjoint across models rather than nested. The effect of added defences is strongly model-dependent: the same guardrail stack or safety-advisor agent that lowers attack success for one model can raise it for another. We release the simulation venue, attack dataset, and replay tooling for reproducible safety evaluation of LLM agents.

papers.title: OrthoReg: Orthogonal Regularization for Hybrid Symbolic-Neural Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical systems are fundamental to modeling the natural world, yet modeling them involves a persistent trade-off: manually prescribed mechanistic models are interpretable by design but often overly simplistic and misspecified; in contrast, flexible data-driven neural methods lack physical insight. Hybrid modeling aims for the best of both worlds by combining a prescribed or symbolic, physics-based component with a flexible neural network. A critical challenge, however, is that the neural component may relearn mechanistic parts, yielding redundant and uninterpretable models, especially when the symbolic structure itself is discovered from data. Existing methods based on standard $L^2$ regularization rely on a projection argument that breaks when the symbolic component is learned through sparse discovery, allowing the neural augmentation to overlap with symbolic structure. We introduce \textbf{OrthoReg} (Orthogonal Regularization), which directly penalizes overlap between the symbolic and neural components, preventing symbolic structure from being absorbed by the neural residual. This yields a complementary decomposition: the symbolic part captures what the library can express, and the neural part captures what remains. On benchmark dynamical systems with partial library mismatch, OrthoReg improves symbolic recovery and out-of-distribution behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrthoReg（正交正则化），用于混合符号-神经动力系统，直接惩罚符号与神经组件之间的重叠，防止符号结构被神经残差吸收。在基准动力系统上，该方法改善了符号恢复和分布外行为。
Motivation: 混合符号-神经动力系统中，神经组件可能重新学习机械部分，导致冗余和不可解释的模型，标准 L2 正则化在符号组件通过稀疏发现学习时会失效。
Method: 引入 OrthoReg（正交正则化），直接惩罚符号与神经组件之间的重叠，实现互补分解：符号部分捕获库可表达的内容，神经部分捕获剩余内容。
Result: 在部分库不匹配的基准动力系统上，OrthoReg 改善了符号恢复和分布外行为。
Conclusion: OrthoReg 有效防止符号结构被神经残差吸收，提升了混合模型的解释性和泛化能力。

papers.title: Finite-Time Queue Peak Laws in Stochastic Networks: Logarithmic Scaling After Geometric Thresholds
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-horizon queue peaks in generalized switches, a standard stochastic-network model in which many queues share constrained service resources. Arrivals may be dependent, nonstationary, and responsive to the system history; the only load condition is uniform interior slack, meaning the conditional mean arrival vector stays in a fixed contraction of the capacity region. We show that this slack reshapes the finite-time peak law for drift-minimizing scheduling policies such as MaxWeight. The square-root envelope that is sharp without slack persists only up to a geometry-dependent threshold; beyond that threshold, the running maximum grows only logarithmically with the horizon, both with high probability and in expectation. The mechanism is self-normalization: in the current queue direction, the projected fluctuation scale is normalized by the stabilizing drift scale. This removes capacity geometry from the logarithmic coefficient, while geometry remains in the threshold. Matching lower bounds show that both the logarithmic term and a geometric threshold are unavoidable. When finite-time state-space collapse is available, the threshold can be sharpened using local bottleneck geometry. For generalized input-queued switches, we obtain finite-time peak bounds with tight logarithmic coefficients. Simulations illustrate the two-phase envelope, local geometric refinements, and variance-sensitive improvements predicted by the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机网络中队列峰值的有限时间行为，证明在均匀内部松弛条件下，漂移最小化调度策略（如MaxWeight）下的队列峰值遵循两阶段规律：低于几何阈值时服从平方根律，超过阈值后随时间对数增长。机制是自归一化，匹配下界表明对数项和几何阈值均不可避免。
Motivation: 现有研究大多聚焦稳态队列长度，而对有限时间内的峰值行为理解不足，尤其是考虑非平稳和响应性到达时。
Method: 利用自归一化技术，在均匀内部松弛条件下分析最大权重调度策略的队列峰值，建立两阶段上界并给出匹配下界。
Result: 证明有限时间队列峰值在几何阈值前服从平方根律（锐界），之后以对数增长（高概率和期望意义下），且系数与容量几何无关。
Conclusion: 对数峰值和几何阈值是随机网络中优先调度策略的固有特性，仿真验证了理论预测的两阶段行为和几何修正。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unified Causal-Origin Taxonomy of Distributional Shifts in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) systems often degrade when operating conditions differ from those previously encountered, reflecting distributional shifts in the underlying data-generating process. Such shifts may occur between training and evaluation, as in In-Distribution (ID) and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) generalization, or within non-stationary settings where environment dynamics evolve over time. However, the formal relationship between these views remains unclear, and existing work mainly focuses on mitigation rather than the causal origin of shift within the agent-environment interaction. This work develops a unified causal-origin taxonomy that characterizes sources of distributional shift in RL and relates ID/OOD generalization to non-stationary settings. We transfer the classical dataset-shift principle from supervised learning to RL by reformulating distributional shift in terms of the generative interaction process. Using a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP), we decompose the interaction into structural components, including the state distribution, observation process, policy, reward, and transition dynamics, together with the shifted-time boundary. The proposed taxonomy distinguishes internal (agent-driven) and external (environment-driven) distributional shifts. The shifted-time boundary perspective further characterizes explicit, implicit, and hybrid shifts. This formulation unifies ID/OOD generalization and non-stationarity as structured changes in the underlying process. We also introduce an evaluation framework for measuring shift impact and adaptation through performance degradation and recovery metrics. By grounding distributional shift in the causal-origin structure of RL, this work supports systematic analysis of robustness under distributional shift.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的因果来源分类法，用于描述强化学习中的分布偏移。通过将监督学习中的数据集偏移原理迁移到强化学习，利用部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）分解交互结构，区分内部（智能体驱动）和外部（环境驱动）偏移，并统一了分布内/分布外泛化（ID/OOD generalization）与非平稳设定（non-stationarity）。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注缓解分布偏移而非其因果来源，且分布内/分布外泛化与非平稳设定之间的关系不明确。
Method: 将监督学习中的数据集偏移原理迁移至强化学习，基于POMDP分解交互组件（状态分布、观测过程、策略、奖励、转移动力学），提出因果分类法（内部/外部偏移）和偏移时间边界视角（显式/隐式/混合偏移）。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，但提出了一个评估框架，通过性能下降和恢复度量来衡量偏移影响和适应能力。
Conclusion: 该分类法将分布偏移扎根于强化学习的因果起源结构，支持对分布偏移下鲁棒性的系统分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attention is Just Another Name for Coupling? A Fast-Slow ODE Perspective on Hierarchical Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: We re-interpret Transformer pretraining as a fast-slow, singularly perturbed flow along depth, with untied weights as its non-autonomous feature. The linearised dynamics is a depth-ordered product of layer maps. Along a token-homogeneous reference trajectory, the linearised layer factorises along the eigenbasis of a frozen attention kernel. Past a computable saturation depth, the flow factors through the block coarse-graining -- in other words, running the layers is running the coarse variable, dually. Weight perturbations supported on the decaying bundle move neither the persistent component of the distinguished trajectory nor the frozen kernel to first order, so the framework partitions parameter space into visible and invisible directions, with the cross-block coupling of the slow path sitting entirely on the visible side. How large a gate the slow path can carry is bounded by a stability margin. On the data side: if block emissions follow an exponential family, block-mean pooling captures all the information the slow path can use; but if neighbouring blocks carry no shared structure, no cross-block channel can help the prediction, and the gate amplitude is invisible in the prediction risk. Stability delimits what the architecture may do; the data decides what it will.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从快慢奇异摄动ODE的角度重新解释Transformer预训练，将解耦权重视为非自治特征。通过线性化动力学，发现当深度超过可计算的饱和深度时，流会通过块粗粒化（block coarse-graining）因子分解。权重扰动在衰减束上的支持不影响持久分量或冻结核，因此参数空间被划分为可见和不可见方向，慢路径的跨块耦合完全位于可见侧。稳定性限制了架构的能力，而数据决定了实际行为。
Motivation: 现有Transformer预训练的理论理解不足，本文旨在通过快慢ODE视角提供深层结构分析，揭示跨块耦合的边界和参数空间的可视性。
Method: 将Transformer预训练建模为快慢奇异摄动流，分析线性化动力学沿深度有序乘积。通过因子分解和冻结注意力核的特征基，识别饱和深度，并划分参数空间为可见与不可见方向。
Result: 理论结果表明，慢路径的跨块耦合完全位于可见方向，其门控幅度受稳定性边界限制；数据方面，若块发射服从指数族，块均值池化可捕获慢路径所需信息，否则跨块通道无预测帮助。
Conclusion: 稳定性决定了架构能力的上限，而数据决定了实际表现。本文为理解Transformer预训练提供了新的理论视角。

papers.title: Medical Heuristic Learning: An LLM-Driven Framework for Interpretable and Auditable Clinical Decision Rules
papers.abstract_en: Predictive modeling for clinical decision support requires not only strong predictive performance but also transparent decision logic. Although deep learning and tree-based ensemble methods can achieve high accuracy, their black-box nature remains a major obstacle to clinical deployment. This challenge is further compounded by common characteristics of medical data, including limited sample sizes, severe class imbalance, and feature evolution arising from changes in diagnostic criteria and clinical documentation. To address these issues, we propose Medical Heuristic Learning (MHL), an instantiation of the learning beyond gradients paradigm for clinical prediction from structured medical data. Instead of relying on neural network weight updates, MHL uses a large language model (LLM) driven workflow that integrates statistical probes, medical knowledge probes, rule synthesis, and code-level iterative refinement to optimize a deterministic and executable rule-based expert system. The resulting model is expressed not as opaque parameters, but as versioned pure Python decision rules that are explicitly interpretable, fully auditable, and clinically grounded. MHL also supports continual learning by starting from previously validated rules and iteratively revising them using updated feature information under data drift or feature evolution. Comprehensive experiments on medical datasets show that MHL achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods while maintaining strong behavior in small-sample and highly imbalanced settings. The results further indicate that this explicit rule-update mechanism can help alleviate catastrophic forgetting under feature evolution. Overall, these findings suggest that non-gradient-based heuristic systems offer a transparent and adaptable alternative for high-stakes clinical decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Medical Heuristic Learning (MHL) 框架，利用大语言模型 (LLM) 驱动的工作流，通过统计探针、医学知识探针、规则合成和代码级迭代优化，生成可解释、可审计的确定性决策规则系统。在医疗数据集上，MHL 达到了与最先进方法相当的性能，并在小样本和严重类别不平衡场景下保持稳健，同时通过显式规则更新机制缓解特征演化带来的灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 临床决策支持需要强预测性能和透明决策逻辑，但深度学习和集成方法的黑盒性质阻碍了临床部署，且医疗数据常面临样本量小、类别不平衡以及因诊断标准变化导致的特征演化问题。
Method: MHL 采用 LLM 驱动的工作流，整合统计探针、医学知识探针、规则合成和代码级迭代优化，以优化基于规则的专家系统。规则以版本化的纯 Python 决策规则呈现，而非不透明参数。支持持续学习：从已验证规则出发，在数据漂移或特征演化下利用更新特征信息迭代修订规则。
Result: 在多个医疗数据集上，MHL 实现了与最先进方法相当的性能，在小样本和高不平衡场景下保持强健。显式规则更新机制有助于缓解特征演化下的灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 非梯度启发式系统为高风险的临床决策支持提供了透明且可适应的替代方案。

papers.title: Explainable Flood Segmentation on Sentinel-1 SAR1 Imagery Using CNN and Transformer Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Rapid and accurate flood prediction is essential for disaster response and mitigation planning. Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) sensors in satellites are well-suited for this purpose because they operate independently of weather and daylight conditions. Although SAR-based data enable all-weather flood monitoring, distinguishing flooded land from permanent water remains a significant challenge, particularly when flooding is defined strictly as inundated land. This study provides a comprehensive comparison of convolutional neural network (CNN) and vision transformer architectures for multi-class flood segmentation using Sentinel-1 SAR imagery, specifically trained to separate flooded land from permanent water bodies and land. Three state-of-the-art (SOTA)CNN-based models, U-Net, U-Net++, and DeepLabV3 with ResNet-34 backbone, and three SegFormer variants (b0,b1,b2) were evaluated in two benchmark datasets, the ETCI NASA dataset and SenFloods11, using scene-based data splits to ensure a realistic assessment of spatial generalization. The results demonstrate that SegFormer-b2 significantly outperforms the U-Net baseline on the ETCI dataset (higher flood IoU across all 7 test scenes in the Wilcoxon signed-rank test), while after fine-tuning on Sen1Floods11, the advantage narrows to within the range of scene variability and is concentrated in spatially fragmented flood events. The study includes both qualitative and quantitative explainability techniques to visually comprehend model decisions and systematically assess prediction reliability. Qualitative analysis reveals that SegFormer-b2 produces more spatially coherent Grad-CAM activations focused on flood-relevant features, while U-Net generates more informative uncertainty estimates along flood boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了CNN（U-Net、U-Net++、DeepLabV3）与视觉Transformer（SegFormer b0-b2）在Sentinel-1 SAR影像上进行多类洪水分割（区分洪水淹没地、永久水体与陆地）的性能。在ETCI数据集上，SegFormer-b2在洪水IoU上显著优于U-Net基线；在Sen1Floods11上微调后优势减小。研究还通过Grad-CAM和不确定性估计进行了可解释性分析。
Motivation: SAR影像能全天候监测洪水，但区分洪水淹没地与永久水体仍是挑战；现有研究缺乏对CNN与Transformer架构在多类洪水分割任务上的系统比较，以及模型决策的可解释性分析。
Method: 选取三种SOTA CNN模型（U-Net、U-Net++、DeepLabV3+ResNet-34）和三种SegFormer变体（b0,b1,b2），在ETCI NASA和Sen1Floods11两个基准数据集上基于场景划分数据，进行多类分割训练与评估，并利用Grad-CAM和不确定性估计进行定性及定量可解释性分析。
Result: SegFormer-b2在ETCI数据集所有7个测试场景中洪水IoU均高于U-Net（Wilcoxon符号秩检验显著）；在Sen1Floods11上微调后两者差异减小至场景变异性范围内，优势集中在空间碎片化洪水中。SegFormer-b2的Grad-CAM激活更聚焦于洪水相关特征，U-Net在洪水边界处提供更丰富的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: SegFormer-b2在空间泛化上优于U-Net，但优势在微调后减弱；可解释性揭示了两种架构的不同行为模式。研究强调了场景划分评估的重要性。

papers.title: City landscape in sight: A crowdsourced framework for unlocking urban-scale window view perceptions from real estate imagery
papers.abstract_en: City landscapes viewed through home windows influence quality of life, yet perceptions of actual window views at the urban scale remain understudied. This study presents an approach for large-scale mapping of perceptions using 12,334 window view images (WVIs) collected from actual residential properties listed on real estate platforms in Wuhan, China, representing a rarely explored form of urban view imagery that offers advantages over the rendered or simulated window views commonly examined in previous studies. Through a non-immersive virtual reality platform, we collected 27,477 pairwise comparisons across six perceptual dimensions (e.g. preference) from 304 participants based on 499 WVIs. A hybrid neural network model was trained to predict human perceptions of all crowdsourced WVIs and map their spatial distribution. Results reveal significant spatial autocorrelation with distinct hot and cold spots across the whole city. Floor level strongly influences human perceptions: while higher floors offer more preferred and extensive window views, lower-floor windows provide residents with quiet and vivid views. An inference model further shows that window view composition matters considerably: high ratios of sky, trees, and low-rise buildings enhance people's preferences and perceptions of vividness, whereas high ratios of high-rise buildings increase perceptions of monotony and oppression. Importantly, these effects are non-linear: the excessive presence of certain elements can alter their impact on human perception. This work advances urban-scale understanding of residents' visual experiences and offers a transferable, human-centric method to inform urban planning and design aimed at improving the visual quality of window views.
papers.journal_ref: Landscape and Urban Planning, 275, 105734 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用从武汉房地产平台收集的12,334张真实窗户视图图像（WVI），通过非沉浸式虚拟现实平台收集了304名参与者在六个感知维度上的27,477次成对比较，训练混合神经网络模型预测感知并绘制空间分布。研究发现窗户视野感知具有显著空间自相关，楼层高度和视野组成（如天空、树木、建筑比例）对感知有非线性影响。
Motivation: 现有研究多使用渲染或模拟的窗户视图，缺乏基于真实住宅图像的城市尺度窗户视野感知研究。
Method: 收集真实房地产图像，通过非沉浸式虚拟现实平台获取众包感知比较，训练混合神经网络模型预测六个感知维度（如偏好）。
Result: 发现感知存在显著空间热点/冷点；高层提供更偏好和广阔的视野，低层提供安静生动的视野；天空、树木、低层建筑比例提升偏好和生动感，高层建筑比例增加单调和压抑感，且影响非线性。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了城市尺度窗户视野感知的实证方法，可迁移用于改善视觉质量的城镇规划。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Iterative Visual Thinking and the Self-Correction Mirage in VLM Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Letting a vision-language model (VLM) think longer at test time has driven much recent progress. A natural way to bring this to spatial grounding is visual self-correction: the model predicts a bounding box, sees it rendered on the image, and refines it over several steps. We build a faithful instance of this idea, Iterative Visual Thinking (IVT), with a two-phase recipe: a supervised warm-up in which the base model's own predictions serve as realistic errors that a teacher VLM turns into corrective reasoning traces (yielding training data without human annotation), followed by GRPO with a simple IoU reward. Measured the way such systems are usually reported, it works: the trained model surpasses the single-shot base by +2.4pp Acc@0.5. We show this gain is a measurement mirage. The reported number silently keeps, per sample, the trajectory step closest to the ground-truth box: an oracle that needs the very answer it predicts. Re-scored under deployable, label-free stopping rules the improvement vanishes, and the best policy is not to iterate at all: stopping at step 0 matches the base and beats every shippable rule. The cause is a verification failure, since the model can generate a better box somewhere in its trajectory but cannot identify it. Self-verification confidence correlates only weakly with correctness (r about 0.22), and a counterfactual overlay shows the loop reacts to the presence of a rendered box rather than its correctness. We distill the lesson into an honest-trajectory evaluation protocol: accuracy under fixed label-free policies plus an explicit oracle-shippable gap.

TL;DR: 本文提出迭代视觉思维（IVT）方法用于VLM空间定位中的视觉自校正，通过两阶段训练（监督热身+GRPO）使模型迭代改进边界框。在标准评估下，训练后的模型在Acc@0.5上比单次基线提升2.4个百分点，但这一提升源于测量幻觉：实际采用的oracle选择策略需要真值框。当使用可部署的无标签停止规则时，所有迭代策略均不优于直接停止于第0步。原因是模型在轨迹中能产生更优的框但无法识别（自验证置信度与正确性仅弱相关，r≈0.22），且循环仅对渲染框的存在而非正确性做出反应。
Motivation: 现有VLM在空间定位（grounding）中缺乏迭代推理机制，直观的自校正方法（模型预测边界框、渲染并反复细化）缺乏系统评估，且可能存在评估偏差。
Method: 提出IVT范式，包含两阶段：1）监督热身：利用教师VLM将基模型自身的合理错误转化为校正推理轨迹，无需人工标注；2）GRPO优化，奖励为简单的IoU。
Result: 在标准oracle评估下，模型Acc@0.5提升2.4个百分点。但重新采用可部署的无标签停止规则后提升消失，最佳策略是不迭代（步骤0）。自验证置信度与边界框正确性的皮尔逊相关系数仅为0.22。
Conclusion: 当前VLM自校正评估存在测量幻觉，实际的迭代并不能带来可部署的增益，根源在于验证失效。论文倡导采用固定无标签策略下的诚实轨迹评估协议，并明确报告oracle与可部署性能的差距。

papers.title: Identifiability Without Gaussianity: Symbolic World Models and Near-Infinite Temporal Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Klindt, LeCun, and Balestriero (arXiv:2605.26379) proved that Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) achieve linear identifiability, the linear recovery of the world's true latent variables, if and only if the world's latent dynamics follow a Gaussian, stationary process. This Gaussian boundary implies a fundamental limit on temporal consistency: for any non-Gaussian physical system, the representation error of a statistical World Model grows monotonically with time. We prove that this limit is an artifact of the statistical alignment mechanism, not a property of World Models in general. We introduce the Physics-Grounded Symbolic Architecture (PGSA) and prove three results: (1) a PGSA achieves exact linear identifiability for all physical regimes, regardless of the latent distribution; (2) the per-step error of a PGSA is bounded by numerical precision alone; and (3) as a direct consequence, a PGSA maintains temporal consistency for an unbounded number of transitions, a property we term near-infinite temporal consistency. We further prove that statistical World Models cannot achieve this property for any non-Gaussian system, regardless of model capacity or the volume of training data. The algebraic cores of four of the theorems are formalized in Lean 4 with Mathlib4 v4.31.0 (zero sorry placeholders); the Klindt et al. converse is taken as an external premise. The contrast establishes that symbolic grounding in the causal generator of the world's dynamics is the sufficient condition and, in non-Gaussian regimes, the only condition for near-infinite temporal consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的线性可识别性仅在高斯、平稳过程下成立，并引入物理基础符号架构（PGSA），证明其任意物理系统下均可实现精确线性可识别性，且误差仅受数值精度限制，从而获得近无限时间一致性。作者在Lean 4中形式化了四个定理，表明符号接地是近无限时间一致性的充分条件，且在非高斯系统中是唯一条件。
Motivation: Klindt等人证明JEPA仅在潜动态为高斯、平稳过程时实现线性可识别性，这意味着非高斯系统中统计世界模型的表示误差随时间单调增长。本文旨在消除这一局限性，探索更通用的可识别性条件。
Method: 提出物理基础符号架构（PGSA），一种符号世界模型，其误差仅由数值精度界定，并证明其在所有物理场景下实现精确线性可识别性。通过Lean 4形式化验证部分定理。
Result: PGSA在非高斯系统中实现精确线性可识别性和近无限时间一致性，而统计世界模型无法达到此性质。数值精度是PGSA误差的唯一来源。
Conclusion: 符号接地于世界动态的因果生成器是实现近无限时间一致性的充分条件，且在非高斯系统中是唯一条件。这揭示了统计对齐机制的固有局限。

papers.title: Deterministic Denominator Design for Localized Tamed Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: If the denominator in a tamed stochastic gradient Langevin update uses the current stochastic-gradient draw, the conditional mean can be biased even when the stochastic-gradient oracle is unbiased. A state-dependent denominator fixed before that draw removes this coupling. We build practical deterministic denominators from a short pilot run. A log-scale proxy is fitted to the growth score $G_\star(x)=\|b(x)\|/(1+\|x\|)$, and empirical pilot quantiles set the activation thresholds of a local proxy-quantile envelope. The reported proxy-quantile experiments use this local denominator. Separately, we describe a final denominator with a norm-polynomial tail-floor correction that can be used when one wants to certify the global effective-linearity input required by the companion deterministic-envelope Lyapunov theory. We show how proxy and threshold errors enter denominator errors and the resulting stationary observable errors. In the reported experiments, the local proxy-quantile denominator improves over random-denominator tamed SGLD at comparable production cost. It also gives observable behavior close to the $G_\star$-envelope benchmark, without the full-gradient growth-score evaluations required by that benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对驯化随机梯度Langevin动力学（tamed SGLD）中分母与当前随机梯度耦合导致的偏差问题，提出确定性分母设计方法。通过短时间预运行拟合对数尺度代理，利用经验代理分位数设定局部代理分位数包的激活阈值，构建无需全梯度计算的分母。实验表明，局部代理分位数分母以相似计算成本提升了随机分母驯化SGLD的性能，并接近理想G*包络基准的观测行为。
Motivation: 在驯化SGLD更新中，若分母使用当前随机梯度，即使梯度无偏也会导致条件均值偏差。现有方法依赖全梯度计算，成本高昂。
Method: 从短预运行中拟合对数尺度代理函数，基于代理增长分数G*(x)=‖b(x)‖/(1+‖x‖)的经验分位数设定激活阈值，构建局部代理分位数分母。还提出带范数多项式尾地板修正的最终分母，用于全局有效线性输入认证。
Result: 实验显示，局部代理分位数分母在相近计算成本下优于随机分母驯化SGLD，且观测行为接近需全梯度评估的G*包络基准。
Conclusion: 确定性分母设计可消除梯度耦合偏差，通过代理和分位数工程实现近似理想包络的性能，而无需全梯度计算。

papers.title: GUI-AC: Enhancing Continual Learning in GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) serve as the dominant medium for human-computer interaction, yet building GUI agents that generalize across the vast diversity of real-world interface environments, with the same flexibility and robustness that humans naturally exhibit, remains unsolved. Notably, GUI data are inherently non-stationary: the continual emergence of previously unseen interface instances (e.g., novel domains and resolutions) induces persistent distribution shifts, significantly impeding the continual learning of existing GUI agents. Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) has attracted considerable attention as a promising approach. Nevertheless, RFT exhibits pronounced instability in its grounding capability, manifested as sharp reward discontinuities and high-variance oscillations. The imbalanced distribution of rollout outcomes introduces substantial noise into advantage estimation, leading to policy overconfidence. The fixed clipping bound suppresses the increase in policy probabilities needed to adapt to new distributions, leading to a collapse in exploration capacity. To address these challenges, we propose GUI-AC, a method that enhances the continual learning capability of GUI agents. GUI-AC introduces grounding certainty to support two core mechanisms: (i) Adaptive Advantage, which down-weights noisy advantage estimates to prevent policy overconfidence; and (ii) Dynamic Clipping, which relaxes the clipping bound to encourage exploration range. Extensive experiments show that these mechanisms jointly improve performance, enabling our method to surpass state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available anonymously at https://github.com/Can-Lin/GUI-AC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GUI-AC 方法，通过引入 grounding certainty 来增强 GUI 代理在非平稳界面环境下的持续学习能力。针对强化微调（RFT）中出现的奖励不连续、高方差振荡、策略过度自信以及探索能力崩溃等问题，GUI-AC 设计了自适应优势（Adaptive Advantage）和动态裁剪（Dynamic Clipping）两种机制。实验表明该方法在多个基准上超越了现有最先进的基线。
Motivation: GUI 数据具有非平稳性，新界面实例持续出现导致分布漂移，严重阻碍现有 GUI 代理的持续学习。强化微调（RFT）虽被广泛采用，但其基础能力不稳定，存在奖励突变、高方差振荡、策略过度自信及探索能力下降等问题。
Method: 提出 GUI-AC 方法，基于 grounding certainty 实现两个核心机制：自适应优势（Adaptive Advantage）降低噪声优势估计以防止策略过度自信；动态裁剪（Dynamic Clipping）放松裁剪边界以鼓励探索范围。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在持续学习设置下超越了现有最先进的基线，但未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: GUI-AC 通过联合使用自适应优势和动态裁剪，有效提升了 GUI 代理在持续学习中的性能和稳定性。

papers.title: WeaveBench: A Long-Horizon, Real-World Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents with Hybrid Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly operate in runtimes that combine visual desktop control, command-line execution, code editing, browsers, and external tools. Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate these interfaces as separable capabilities, leaving long-horizon cross-interface orchestration under-tested. Thus, we introduce WeaveBench, a long-horizon hybrid-interface benchmark with 114 tasks across 8 real-world work domains, grounded in real user requests and publicly verifiable artifacts. Each task requires agents to combine GUI observations/actions with CLI/code operations within a single trajectory. We evaluate these tasks on a real Ubuntu desktop inside deployed CLI-agent runtimes, augmented with a minimal desktop-control plugin. We also propose a companion trajectory-aware judge that inspects deliverables, files, screenshots, logs, and action traces, while detecting shortcut behaviors such as fabricated visual evidence or hard-coded metrics. Across frontier model-runtime pairings, the best PassRate reaches only 41.2%, showing the benchmark remains far from saturated. The trajectory-aware judge further reveals that outcome-only grading substantially overestimates agent performance. Overall, WeaveBench exposes a critical gap in CUA evaluation and provides an effective testbed to measure whether agents can orchestrate GUI, CLI, and code operations across long-horizon real-world tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WeaveBench 是一个面向计算机使用代理（CUA）的长时域混合界面基准，包含 114 个真实世界任务，要求代理在单一轨迹中结合 GUI、CLI 和代码操作。在 Ubuntu 桌面环境下评估了前沿模型与运行时组合，最佳通过率仅 41.2%，且仅基于结果评分会高估性能。
Motivation: 现有基准通常单独评估各界面能力，缺乏对长时域跨界面编排的测试，而实际应用需要代理整合多种界面。
Method: 构建 114 个任务涵盖 8 个真实工作领域，在真实 Ubuntu 桌面部署 CLI 代理运行时，并添加最小桌面控制插件；提出轨迹感知判断器，检查交付物、文件、截图、日志和操作轨迹，检测捷径行为。
Result: 最佳模型-运行时组合的通过率仅 41.2%，表明基准远未饱和；轨迹感知判断器显示仅结果评分会显著高估性能。
Conclusion: WeaveBench 揭示了 CUA 评估中的关键缺口，为测量代理是否能在长时域真实任务中编排 GUI、CLI 和代码操作提供了有效测试床。

papers.title: PBSD: Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agentic tasks pose a fundamental credit assignment challenge for outcome-base reinforcement learning: trajectory-level rewards verify final correctness but provide limited guidance on which intermediate reasoning steps or tool interactions contribute to the outcome. The difficulty is especially pronounced in multi-turn search agents, where successful trajectories may contain misleading actions and failed trajectories may contain valuable evidence-gathering steps. We propose PBSD (Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation), a Bayes-calibrated self-distillation method for fine-grained credit assignment under sparse final rewards. PBSD measures trajectory quality through the posterior-to-prior probability ratio of the verified answer and applies Bayes' rule to convert this hard-to-estimate answer-side ratio into a tractable likelihood ratio between a standard student model and a privileged answer-conditioned teacher model. Autoregressive decomposition of this Bayesian evidence score yields turn-level signals that identify whether each intermediate turn supports or undermines the verified outcome. Consequently, PBSD provides a principled and elegant reweighting scheme that transforms sparse outcome supervision into Bayes-calibrated turn-level credit signals, while remaining fully compatible with standard policy optimization. Experiments demonstrate that PBSD consistently enhances performance across both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, and effectively transfers knowledge from short-context training to long-context inference, suggesting that its fine-grained credit assignment mechanism facilitates more effective policy learning and yields improved generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PBSD (Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation)，一种基于贝叶斯校准的自蒸馏方法，用于在稀疏最终奖励下进行细粒度信用分配。PBSD 通过后验-先验概率比衡量轨迹质量，并利用贝叶斯规则将难以估计的答案侧比率转化为标准学生模型与特权答案条件教师模型之间的易处理似然比。通过自回归分解得到逐步信用信号，从而将稀疏结果监督转化为贝叶斯校准的逐步信用信号。实验表明，PBSD 在领域内和领域外设置中均一致提升性能，并能有效将知识从短上下文训练迁移到长上下文推理。
Motivation: 长视野智能体任务中，基于结果的强化学习面临基本信用分配挑战：轨迹级奖励验证最终正确性，但对中间推理步骤或工具交互的贡献提供有限指导。多轮搜索智能体中，成功轨迹可能包含误导性动作，失败轨迹可能包含有价值的证据收集步骤。
Method: 提出 Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation (PBSD)，通过后验-先验概率比衡量轨迹质量，利用贝叶斯规则将答案侧比率转化为标准学生模型与特权答案条件教师模型之间的似然比，并通过自回归分解得到逐步信用信号。
Result: 实验显示，PBSD 在领域内和领域外设置中一致提升性能，并能有效将知识从短上下文训练迁移到长上下文推理。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，PBSD 提供了一种原理性且优雅的重新加权方案，将稀疏结果监督转化为贝叶斯校准的逐步信用信号，与标准策略优化完全兼容，其细粒度信用分配机制促进了更有效的策略学习并带来更好的泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Mathematical Reasoning: An Integrated Survey of Language Models, Neuro-symbolic Systems, and Verified Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical reasoning has long served as a stringent test of machine intelligence; over the past decade, it has moved from a niche problem within NLP to one of the most consequential AI frontiers. This survey provides a unified account of the field's evolution, from early rule-based math word problem (MWP) solvers and template-driven geometry systems, through neural expression generation and LLM prompting, to contemporary reasoning models, multi-agent systems, neuro-symbolic theorem provers, and verified discovery workflows. We organize the landscape along four axes: (i) informal reasoning over text and diagrams, spanning MWP solving, multimodal geometry, and VLMs; (ii) formal reasoning in proof assistants, including autoformalization, tactic prediction, compiler-guided repair, and proof search; (iii) mathematical discovery, where systems propose constructions, improve bounds, or assist attacks on open problems; and (iv) the inference and training-time techniques, including CoT prompting, tool use, process reward models, and RLVR, that increasingly connect generation with verification. We catalog major benchmarks across grade-school arithmetic, competition mathematics, geometry, formal proving, multimodal and multilingual reasoning, and expert evaluation, and we examine benchmark saturation, contamination, reporting mismatches, and the distinction between pass@1, majority voting, and verifier-assisted pass@$k$. We critically assess failure modes: brittleness under perturbation, reward hacking, multimodal grounding failures, fragile formalization, and the energy cost of reasoning-scale inference. Drawing on recent perspectives from working mathematicians, we identify future directions centered on verified-discovery workflows, reasoning efficiency, and infrastructure to make AI-assisted formalization broadly usable. Companion materials: https://github.com/Starscream-11813/awesome-AI4Math.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对人工智能在数学推理领域的研究进行了全面综述，涵盖从早期基于规则的数学文字题求解器到当代推理模型、多智能体系统、神经符号定理证明器和验证发现工作流的发展。文章按四个轴组织：非正式推理（文本与图表）、形式推理（证明助手）、数学发现（自动构造与改进）以及推理与训练技术（CoT提示、工具使用、过程奖励模型、RLVR）。系统分析了主要基准（如小学算术、竞赛数学、几何、形式证明等）的饱和、污染、报告不匹配问题，以及失败模式（扰动脆弱性、奖励黑客、多模态接地失败等），并基于数学家视角提出未来方向。
Motivation: 数学推理是机器智能的严峻测试，该领域从NLP中的小众问题演变为重要AI前沿，但缺乏统一视角来整合不同方向、基准和技术，导致碎片化和评估不一致。
Method: 作者按四个维度组织文献：(i) 非正式推理（MWP求解、多模态几何、VLM）；(ii) 形式推理（自动形式化、策略预测、编译器引导修复、证明搜索）；(iii) 数学发现（构造、改进界限、辅助攻破开放问题）；(iv) 推理与训练技术（CoT提示、工具使用、过程奖励模型、RLVR）。并系统分析了主要基准和常见失败模式。
Result: 综述覆盖了小学算术、竞赛数学、几何、形式证明、多模态和多语言推理等基准，并指出基准饱和、污染、报告不匹配等问题，以及pass@1、多数投票与验证器辅助pass@k的区别。失败模式包括扰动下脆弱性、奖励黑客、多模态接地失败、形式化脆弱性及推理规模推理的能源成本。
Conclusion: 未来方向聚焦于验证发现工作流、推理效率以及使AI辅助形式化广泛可用的基础设施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Far Can Chord-Symbol Time-Series Adaptation Carry Genre Identity? Capabilities and Boundaries in Multi-Genre Chord-Symbol Modeling
papers.abstract_en: This revision updates an 11-genre chord-symbol adaptation report. The main 165-cell result is unchanged: all methods improve over the frozen pure-pop base, with no decisive method winner. v3 adds the ft-pop80-v2 multi-seed base-restoration note and corrects a few summary statistics for exact CSV faithfulness without changing conclusions.
papers.comment: v3: ft-pop80-v2, a selection-corrected, hash-distinct jazz base, exists, reproducing over 3 seeds (top-1 75.76 +/- 0.03), so the Sec. 8 base robustness ablation is now gated by effort, not checkpoint availability. Added a v3 changelog; corrected Sec. 5.2/6.3/6.9 stats for CSV fidelity (no qualitative changes). https://github.com/PearlLeeStudio/TheArtist | https://huggingface.co/PearlLeeStudio
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文更新了一份涵盖11种风格的和弦符号时间序列适应性报告，主要结论是：所有适应方法均优于冻结的纯流行音乐基线，但无决定性最优方法。v3版本修正了少量统计数据，未改变结论。
Motivation: 探索和弦符号时间序列在跨风格迁移中的保持体裁身份的能力边界。
Method: 在多风格和弦符号建模中比较多种适应方法，并修正统计一致性。
Result: 165个实验单元的结果显示所有方法均优于纯流行基线，但无方法显著胜出。
Conclusion: 多风格和弦符号适应存在性能上限，无单一最佳迁移策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deterministic Envelopes for Tamed SGLD: Decoupling Stochastic Gradient Noise and Localizing Taming
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient Langevin algorithms often use tamed denominators to stabilize superlinear drifts. This paper shows that when the denominator depends on the current stochastic gradient, the transformed update can have a biased conditional mean even if the original stochastic gradient is unbiased. This creates a stationary mean-shift channel that is absent for deterministic denominators.We propose a structure-preserving framework for designing tamed denominators. The construction keeps the denominator deterministic given the current state, and uses localized deterministic envelopes to avoid unnecessary taming in typical regions. These kernels retain the stabilizing effect of taming while avoiding the bias introduced by a gradient-dependent denominator. Our theory bounds the stationary bias through Euler, envelope, and stochastic-gradient residuals. The analysis also shows why purely local taming rules can lose control in the far tail and motivates a hybrid construction with additional tail protection. Experiments confirm the stationary distortions of random denominators, the bias reduction of deterministic-envelope designs, and the stabilizing effect of the hybrid construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机梯度Langevin算法中tamed分母引入的偏差问题，提出确定性包络框架，构造与当前状态确定性的分母，避免梯度依赖分母带来的偏差。理论分析了静态偏差的界限，并实验验证了确定性包络设计的偏差减少和混合构造的稳定效果。
Motivation: 当tamed分母依赖于当前随机梯度时，即使原始随机梯度无偏，变换后的更新也会产生有偏的条件均值，形成静态均值偏移通道。这一问题在确定性分母中不存在。
Method: 提出结构保持的框架设计tamed分母，使分母在给定当前状态下是确定性的，并使用局部化确定性包络以避免在典型区域进行不必要的taming。还提出混合构造以在远尾提供额外保护。
Result: 理论界定了通过Euler残差、包络残差和随机梯度残差引起的静态偏差。实验确认了随机分母的静态失真、确定性包络设计的偏差减少以及混合构造的稳定效果。
Conclusion: 该框架避免了梯度依赖分母引入的偏差，同时保留了taming的稳定效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ParetoPilot: Zero-Surrogate Offline Multi-Objective Optimization via Infer-Perturb-Guide Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Offline multi-objective optimization (Offline MOO) seeks Pareto-optimal designs from static datasets without additional environment interactions. Existing generative methods typically guide sampling with external surrogate or preference models, which adds training complexity and may provide unreliable guidance. We propose ParetoPilot, a plug-and-play method that guides designs to Pareto front at inference time using a pre-trained conditional diffusion model without any surrogate. ParetoPilot introduces an Infer-Perturb-Guide (IPG) engine within the reverse diffusion process. IPG first infers the individual conditional target for each sample in the batch by aligning its conditional and unconditional predictions. It then perturbs these targets collectively across the batch, balancing convergence toward the Pareto front and diversity among samples. Finally, the engine guides the generative trajectory toward the Pareto front by injecting these perturbed targets via standard Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). Experiments on 51 tasks demonstrate that ParetoPilot achieves the best overall ranking among 16 methods and competitive hypervolume improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ParetoPilot，一种无需代理模型的离线多目标优化方法，利用预训练的条件扩散模型在推理时通过 Infer-Perturb-Guide (IPG) 引擎引导样本逼近帕累托前沿。在 51 个任务上，该方法在 16 种基线中排名最优，超体积改进具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有离线多目标优化生成方法依赖外部代理或偏好模型，增加了训练复杂度且可能提供不可靠的引导。本文旨在设计一种无需代理模型的推理时引导方法，降低复杂度并提高鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 Infer-Perturb-Guide (IPG) 引擎，在反向扩散过程中对每个样本推断其条件目标，然后在批次内对目标进行集体扰动以平衡收敛性和多样性，最后通过标准无分类器引导将扰动后的目标注入生成轨迹。
Result: 在 51 个基准任务上，ParetoPilot 在 16 种方法中取得最佳整体排名，超体积改进具有竞争力。
Conclusion: ParetoPilot 作为即插即用方法，无需代理模型即可在推理时引导生成向帕累托前沿收敛，实验验证了其有效性和泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pseudospectral Bounds for Transient Amplification in Coupled Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Coupled gradient descent - where the update of one parameter depends on another - arises naturally in bilevel optimization, two-time-scale stochastic approximation, and generative adversarial networks. When the coupled Jacobian is block-triangular, asymptotic stability is determined by the spectral radii of the diagonal blocks, yet transient amplification before convergence can be arbitrarily large due to non-normality. We develop a sharp pseudospectral theory for block-triangular Jacobians J = [[A, 0], [C, D]], proving Kreiss-constant bounds of the form K(J) <= 2/(1-γ) + ||C||/(4(1-γ)) when ρ(A), ρ(D) <= γ< 1 and A, D are symmetric, and establishing matching minimax lower bounds. We characterize the critical coupling threshold for spectral instability and extend the theory to nearly self-referential systems via a Neumann-series perturbation framework. As a consequence, we obtain a finite-horizon O(K(J)^2 log(1/δ)) iteration complexity bound. Framed as scaling laws for stochastic two-time-scale optimization, our results expose a non-asymptotic, instance-dependent regime of high-dimensional learning dynamics that is invisible to spectral-radius analysis. Experiments on linear-quadratic problems, IQC-based comparisons, and neural-network training confirm the theory.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 HiLD Workshop (4th Workshop on High-dimensional Learning Dynamics) as a poster
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究耦合梯度下降中块三角雅可比矩阵的瞬态放大现象，提出系统性的伪谱理论，给出Kreiss常数显式界与匹配下界，并导出有限步迭代复杂度界。理论适用于双层优化、双时间尺度随机逼近及GAN等场景。
Motivation: 耦合梯度下降在双时间尺度优化中广泛出现，但块三角Jacobian的非正规性会导致收敛前任意大的瞬态放大，传统谱半径分析无法捕捉。
Method: 发展块三角Jacobian J=[[A,0],[C,D]]的伪谱理论，在A,D对称且谱半径小于1时证明Kreiss常数界；通过Neumann级数扰动框架推广至近自参照系统。
Result: 证明了Kreiss常数K(J)<=2/(1-γ)+||C||/(4(1-γ))及匹配极小极大下界；得到有限时域O(K(J)^2 log(1/δ))迭代复杂度界。线性二次问题、IQC比较和神经网络训练实验验证理论。

papers.title: Reasoning4Sciences: Bridging Reasoning Language Models to All Scientific Branches
papers.abstract_en: While Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) are rapidly emerging as powerful tools for scientific research, their impact is primarily concentrated in "hard science" fields. The slow -- or lack of -- adoption of RLMs in other branches of science is causing a widening gap in research productivity. In this survey, we provide the first comprehensive analysis of RLM adoption across 28 scientific disciplines following the classification used by the European Research Council (ERC), spanning the Social Sciences and Humanities, Physical Sciences and Engineering, and Life Sciences. We examine how RLMs are developed, evaluated, and applied across disciplines. Furthermore, we introduce a maturity-oriented assessment framework based on available domain-specific development and evaluation resources, revealing substantial disparities in RLM maturity that become even more pronounced when only publicly available resources are considered. Finally, we highlight current implementation paradigms that are gaining popularity across disciplines, current challenges, and future directions in enabling RLM adoption across science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提供了首个涵盖欧洲研究委员会（ERC）分类下28个科学学科的推理语言模型（RLM）采用情况的综合分析，涵盖社会科学与人文、物理科学与工程、生命科学三大领域。作者提出了基于领域特定开发和评估资源的成熟度评估框架，揭示了不同学科间RLM成熟度的显著差异，并讨论了当前挑战和未来方向。
Motivation: RLM在“硬科学”领域发展迅速，但在其他科学分支的采用缓慢，导致研究生产力差距扩大。需要系统评估RLM在各学科的现状。
Method: 构建了覆盖28个学科的RLM采用分析，引入成熟度评估框架，基于领域特定开发与评估资源（包括公开资源）量化差异。
Result: 揭示了学科间RLM成熟度的巨大差异，仅考虑公开资源时差异更显著。
Conclusion: 强调需要促进RLM在更多科学分支的采用，并指出了当前实施范式、挑战和未来方向。

papers.title: Training-Free Continuous Bitrate Control for Scalable Image Coding for Humans and Machines
papers.abstract_en: Continuous variable-rate compression is highly demanded in real-world applications, but remains underexplored in scalable image coding for humans and machines. In this paper, we propose a training-free variable-rate scalable image coding framework. By adaptively adjusting quantization step sizes based on predicted scale values, the proposed method enables independent and continuous bitrate control for the machine and enhancement layers while preserving important latent information in each layer. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and highlight the importance of bitrate allocation between the two layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需重新训练的可变比特率可伸缩图像编码方法，通过基于预测尺度自适应调整量化步长来独立控制机器层和增强层的比特率，实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 连续可变比特率压缩在实际应用中需求很大，但在可伸缩图像编码（同时面向人类和机器）中研究不足。

papers.title: DC-Motion: Decoupling Structure and Details via Discrete-Continuous Tokens for Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation requires modeling both global action structure and fine-grained motion dynamics from natural language. Existing approaches typically rely on either continuous diffusion models or vector-quantized discrete representations. Diffusion models generate smooth motions but lack explicit compositional structure for temporal planning, while discrete token-based methods improve controllability but compress motion into finite codebooks, losing fine-grained dynamics. We argue that this limitation stems from a representation mismatch: action semantics such as intent, phase transitions, and temporal layout are inherently discrete and compositional, whereas joint trajectories and motion dynamics are continuous and locally correlated. To address this, we propose DC-Motion, a discrete-continuous factorized framework for human motion generation. DC-Motion decomposes motion into discrete structural tokens capturing global action layout and continuous residual latents modeling fine-grained dynamics. A text-conditioned structure generator predicts discrete tokens via iterative masked modeling, and a diffusion-based residual generator produces continuous motion conditioned on the structure. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate that DC-Motion achieves strong performance in both FID and R-Precision, outperforming representative diffusion-based and discrete-token baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DC-Motion，一种离散-连续分解框架用于文本到人体运动生成。该方法将运动分解为离散结构token（捕捉全局动作布局）和连续残差潜变量（建模精细动态），通过文本条件结构生成器（迭代掩码建模）预测离散token，再以扩散残差生成器生成连续运动。在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上，DC-Motion在FID和R-Precision上优于代表性扩散和离散token基线。
Motivation: 现有文本到运动生成方法要么依赖连续扩散模型（缺乏显式组合结构），要么依赖向量量化离散表示（压缩运动至有限码本，损失精细动态）。作者认为根本原因是表示不匹配：动作语义（意图、阶段转换、时间布局）本质离散且组合，而关节轨迹和运动动态连续且局部相关。
Method: 提出离散-连续分解框架DC-Motion：1) 文本条件结构生成器通过迭代掩码建模预测离散结构token；2) 扩散残差生成器以结构token为条件生成连续运动残差潜变量，从而分离全局结构与局部细节。
Result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上，DC-Motion在FID和R-Precision指标上优于代表性扩散模型和离散token基线方法。
Conclusion: DC-Motion通过离散-连续分解有效结合了离散表示的组合可控性与连续扩散的精细动态建模能力，在文本到运动生成任务上取得强性能。

papers.title: One Click per Cell Type Suffices: Training-free Group Interaction for Cell Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Cell instance segmentation models trained on cell-specific datasets suffer severe performance drops on out-of-distribution cell types, while interactive foundation models overcome this through per-instance prompting at a cost that is prohibitively expensive for histopathology images containing hundreds to thousands of densely packed instances. We introduce \textbf{Group Prompting}, a new paradigm that shifts interactive segmentation from per-instance $O(N)$ to per-type $O(T)$, where a single click per cell type suffices to segment all instances of that type. Our key observation is that the frozen image encoder of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) already clusters same-type cells in its feature space before any prompt is given, and that this clustering holds across staining modalities without any training. Exploiting this property, we propose \textbf{Chain-of-Prompts (CoP)}, a training-free framework that recursively expands a single user click by (1) identifying reliable same-type locations through non-parametric gating of multi-scale encoder features, and (2) selecting the most spatially distant reliable point as the next prompt to maximize coverage. On eleven benchmarks, CoP generalizes to both unseen cell types and unseen imaging modalities without any adaptation: with one click per type it retains over 90\% of per-instance performance on three cell-type-annotated datasets while surpassing fully-supervised methods, and with one click per image it retains over 95\% on eight datasets spanning both H\&E and non-H\&E imaging. Project Page: https://shjo-april.github.io/Chain-of-Prompts/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Group Prompting 的新范式，将交互式细胞实例分割从每实例 O(N) 降低到每类型 O(T)，即每个细胞类型只需一次点击即可分割该类型的所有实例。基于此，作者提出 Chain-of-Prompts (CoP)，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的框架，通过利用 SAM 冻结图像编码器中同类型细胞的特征聚类，递归扩展单个用户点击，在 11 个基准上对未见细胞类型和成像模态均保持高性能。
Motivation: 现有细胞实例分割模型在跨分布细胞类型上表现严重下降，而交互式基础模型虽然可以解决，但需要逐实例提示，对于包含数百至数千密集实例的组织病理图像成本过高。
Method: 提出 Chain-of-Prompts 框架，利用 SAM 编码器特征空间中同类型细胞自动聚类的特性，通过非参数化的多尺度特征门控识别可靠的同类型位置，并选择空间最远的可靠点作为下一个提示，递归扩展单一点击，无需任何训练。
Result: 在 11 个基准上，每类型一次点击保留超过 90% 的每实例性能，并超越全监督方法；每图像一次点击在 8 个包含 H&E 和非 H&E 成像的数据集上保留超过 95% 的性能。
Conclusion: 该方法无需训练即可泛化到未见细胞类型和成像模态，为细胞实例分割提供了一种高效的交互式范式，显著降低了标注成本。

papers.title: Diagnosing the conditional-mean barrier in scientific machine-learning surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Many prediction tasks in computational science and engineering become one-to-many after coarse graining and partial observation. In such settings, deterministic surrogates trained by squared loss may learn a well-defined mathematical object, the conditional mean, while still missing the task-relevant variability in the underlying conditional law. In this work, we formulate this limitation as the conditional-mean barrier and develop a diagnostic framework for identifying it in fitted scientific machine-learning surrogates. The framework combines residual-feature orthogonality and effect-size diagnostics to distinguish deterministic underfitting from irreducible conditional variability. We also make explicit a simple consequence of paired squared loss: stochastic outputs do not by themselves overcome the barrier, because the objective penalizes model variance and drives the predictor back to the conditional mean. The diagnosis therefore yields a modeling prescription: when residual variability matters, the loss must score richer features of the conditional law rather than a point prediction. Reproducible numerical studies on a controlled two-branch law and a two-scale Lorenz-96 closure problem show how the diagnostic identifies the barrier, how deterministic closures can suppress collective fluctuation statistics in rollout, and how a minimal likelihood-based stochastic-scale model can recover substantially more variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了科学机器学习代理（surrogates）中由于平方损失训练导致的“条件均值障碍”（conditional-mean barrier），即代理只学习条件均值而忽略条件分布中的任务相关变异性。作者提出了结合残差-特征正交性和效应量诊断的框架，用于识别该障碍，并指出随机输出无法克服该障碍，因为平方损失会惩罚方差并驱使预测回归到条件均值。在双分支规律和两尺度Lorenz-96闭合问题上进行了可重复的数值研究。
Motivation: 在粗粒化和部分观测后的科学工程预测任务中，确定性代理可能学习条件均值，但丢失了条件分布中与任务相关的变异性，这一问题尚未被系统诊断。
Method: 提出了诊断条件均值障碍的框架，结合残差-特征正交性（residual-feature orthogonality）和效应量诊断（effect-size diagnostics），以区分确定性欠拟合与不可约条件变异性。
Result: 在双分支规律和两尺度Lorenz-96闭合问题上，诊断框架成功识别了条件均值障碍；确定性闭合在 rollout 中抑制了集体波动统计量，而基于似然的随机尺度模型能恢复更多变异性。
Conclusion: 当残差变异性重要时，损失函数应评分条件分布的更丰富特征而非点预测；给出了建模建议。

papers.title: Q-GeoMem: Question-Guided Geometric Memory for Video Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video spatial reasoning requires accumulating viewpoint-dependent evidence over time while retaining information useful to the question being asked. Existing spatial video-language models improve geometric perception and long-range context modeling, but often treat memory as a generic temporal cache, which can introduce redundant or irrelevant evidence and weaken long-horizon reasoning. We propose Q-GeoMem, a question-guided geometric memory framework for video spatial reasoning. Q-GeoMem injects camera-conditioned geometry into visual tokens and maintains two complementary memories: a Fine-Grained Context Bank for recent dense features and camera states, and a Semantic-Geometric Evidence Bank for compact long-range evidence. For each candidate frame, a calibrated Q-Former estimates question relevance, while novelty and evidence utility are recomputed with respect to the active evidence bank. The resulting relevance-novelty utility controls capacity-based replacement and serves as an attention bias during memory reading. During reasoning, both memories are read before update and adaptively fused with the current frame representation. Extensive experiments across two in-domain and five out-of-distribution benchmarks, and controlled memory analyses show that Q-GeoMem achieves state-of-the-art performance in the evaluated settings and validate the effectiveness of question-guided geometric evidence selection.
