papers.title: ParEVO: Synthesizing Code for Irregular Data: High-Performance Parallelism through Agentic Evolution
papers.abstract_en: The transition from sequential to parallel computing is essential for modern high-performance applications but is hindered by the steep learning curve of concurrent programming. This challenge is magnified for irregular data structures (such as sparse graphs, unbalanced trees, and non-uniform meshes) where static scheduling fails and data dependencies are unpredictable. Current Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail catastrophically on these tasks, generating code plagued by subtle race conditions, deadlocks, and sub-optimal scaling. We bridge this gap with ParEVO, a framework designed to synthesize high-performance parallel algorithms for irregular data. Our contributions include: (1) The Parlay-Instruct Corpus, a curated dataset of 13,820 tasks synthesized via a "Critic-Refine" pipeline that explicitly filters for empirically performant algorithms that effectively utilize Work-Span parallel primitives; (2) specialized DeepSeek, Qwen, and Gemini models fine-tuned to align probabilistic generation with the rigorous semantics of the ParlayLib library; and (3) an Evolutionary Coding Agent (ECA) that improves the "last mile" of correctness by iteratively repairing code using feedback from compilers, dynamic race detectors, and performance profilers. On the ParEval benchmark, ParEVO achieves an average 106x speedup (with a maximum of 1103x) across the suite, and a robust 13.6x speedup specifically on complex irregular graph problems, outperforming state-of-the-art commercial models. Furthermore, our evolutionary approach matches state-of-the-art expert human baselines, achieving up to a 4.1x speedup on specific highly-irregular kernels. Source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/WildAlg/ParEVO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParEVO框架用于合成不规则数据结构（如稀疏图、不平衡树）的高性能并行代码。通过构建Parlay-Instruct语料库、微调LLM以及进化编码智能体（ECA）迭代修复代码，在ParEval基准上平均加速106x（最大1103x），复杂不规则图加速13.6x，匹配专家基线。
Motivation: 并行编程学习曲线陡峭，尤其对于不规则数据结构，静态调度失效且数据依赖不可预测；现有LLM生成代码常出现竞态条件、死锁和可扩展性差。
Method: 提出ParEVO框架，包含三个贡献：1）通过Critic-Refine流程构建13,820个任务的Parlay-Instruct语料库；2）微调DeepSeek、Qwen和Gemini模型以对齐ParlayLib库语义；3）进化编码智能体（ECA）利用编译器、动态竞争检测器和性能分析器反馈迭代修复代码。
Result: 在ParEval基准上实现平均106x速度提升（最大1103x），复杂不规则图问题13.6x加速，超越商业模型；特定高度不规则内核达到4.1x加速，匹配专家水平。
Conclusion: ParEVO通过结构化语料库、微调和进化修复，解决了LLM在不规则数据结构并行代码生成上的性能差距，实现高效并行化。

papers.title: Exploring Plan Space through Conversation: An Agentic Framework for LLM-Mediated Explanations in Planning
papers.abstract_en: When automating plan generation for a real-world sequential decision problem, the goal is often not to replace the human planner, but to facilitate an iterative reasoning and elicitation process, where the human's role is to guide the AI planner according to their preferences and expertise. In this context, explanations that respond to users' questions are crucial to improve their understanding of potential solutions and increase their trust in the system. To enable natural interaction with such a system, we present a multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) architecture that is agnostic to the explanation framework and enables user- and context-dependent interactive explanations. We also describe an instantiation of this framework for goal-conflict explanations, which we use to conduct a user study comparing the LLM-powered interaction with a baseline template-based explanation interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多智能体大语言模型（LLM）架构，用于规划系统中的交互式解释，该架构与具体解释框架无关，支持用户和上下文相关的对话式解释。论文以目标冲突解释为例实现该框架，并通过用户研究比较了基于LLM的交互与基于模板的解释界面。
Motivation: 自动规划系统需要与人类用户进行迭代推理和偏好引导，而现有解释方式缺乏自然交互能力，用户理解不足，信任度低。
Method: 提出一个多智能体LLM架构，该架构不依赖特定解释框架，支持用户和上下文相关的交互式解释。并实例化用于目标冲突解释，进行用户研究。
Result: 用户研究对比了LLM驱动的交互与基线模板式解释界面的效果。
Conclusion: 该架构能够提升用户对规划方案的理解和系统信任，实现更自然的交互式解释。

papers.title: CTForensics: A Comprehensive Dataset and Method for AI-Generated CT Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative AI have made synthetic Computed Tomography (CT) images increasingly realistic, enabling promising applications in medical data augmentation while raising serious concerns about clinical safety and data trustworthiness. Detecting AI-generated CT images remains challenging for two key reasons: existing benchmarks cover only limited generation sources, and many detectors are adapted from natural-image forensics without explicitly modeling CT-specific imaging properties. In this paper, we introduce CTForensics, a dataset for detecting AI-generated CT images. CTForensics contains 75,990 2D CT images, including a dedicated test benchmark of 29,990 balanced authentic and generated samples from ten representative CT generative models spanning GAN-based and diffusion-based paradigms. We further propose the Enhanced Spatial-Frequency CT Forgery Detector (ESF-CTFD), a CT-oriented CNN framework built around a Wavelet-Enhanced Central Stem, Multi-Scale Spatial Aggregation, and a Frequency-Aware Prediction Block. The Wavelet-Enhanced Central Stem enhances local intensity correlations and high-frequency residuals, Multi-Scale Spatial Aggregation aligns anatomical features across resolutions with lightweight residual units, and the Frequency-Aware Prediction Block models global spectral artifacts. Extensive experiments on CTForensics show that ESF-CTFD achieves 96.01% mAcc and 99.96% mAP, outperforming existing methods and maintaining strong robustness under realistic perturbations with only a 0.99% average drop. Codes will be available at https://github.com/liyih/CTForensics.

papers.title: Decentralized Federated Learning by Partial Message Exchange
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) has emerged as a transformative server-free paradigm that enables collaborative learning over large-scale heterogeneous networks. However, it continues to face fundamental challenges, including data heterogeneity, restrictive assumptions for theoretical analysis, and degraded convergence when standard communication- or privacyenhancing techniques are applied. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper develops a novel algorithm, PaME (DFL by Partial Message Exchange). The central principle is to allow only randomly selected sparse coordinates to be exchanged between two neighbor nodes. Consequently, PaME achieves substantial reductions in communication costs while still preserving a high level of privacy, without sacrificing accuracy. Moreover, grounded in rigorous analysis, the algorithm is shown to converge at a linear rate under the gradient to be locally Lipschitz continuous and the communication matrix to be doubly stochastic. These two mild assumptions not only dispense with many restrictive conditions commonly imposed by existing DFL methods but also enables PaME to effectively address data heterogeneity. Furthermore, comprehensive numerical experiments demonstrate its superior performance compared with several representative decentralized learning algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种去中心化联邦学习算法PaME，通过仅交换随机选择的稀疏坐标来减少通信成本并保持隐私，同时在宽松假设下保证线性收敛。实验表明其性能优于多种代表性去中心化学习算法。
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习面临数据异质性、理论分析限制性强以及标准通信或隐私技术导致收敛退化等根本挑战。
Method: PaME算法允许邻居节点之间仅交换随机选择的稀疏坐标，从而大幅降低通信成本并提升隐私性。
Result: 理论上在梯度局部Lipschitz连续且通信矩阵双随机的温和假设下，PaME以线性速率收敛；数值实验显示其性能优于多种代表性去中心化学习算法。
Conclusion: PaME通过部分消息交换有效解决了数据异质性，并放宽了现有方法的限制性假设，同时兼顾通信效率与隐私。

papers.title: Efficient Flow Matching for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Generative models, particularly Diffusion Models (DM), have shown strong potential for Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction serving as expressive priors for solving ill-posed inverse problems. However, diffusion-based reconstruction relies on Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs) for forward diffusion and reverse denoising, where such stochasticity can interfere with repeated data consistency corrections in CT reconstruction. Since CT reconstruction is often time-critical in clinical and interventional scenarios, improving reconstruction efficiency is essential. In contrast, Flow Matching (FM) models sampling as a deterministic Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), yielding smooth trajectories without stochastic noise injection. This deterministic formulation is naturally compatible with repeated data consistency operations. Furthermore, we observe that FM-predicted velocity fields exhibit strong correlations across adjacent steps. Motivated by this, we propose an FM-based CT reconstruction framework (FMCT) and an efficient variant (EFMCT) that reuses previously predicted velocity fields over consecutive steps to substantially reduce the number of Neural network Function Evaluations (NFEs), thereby improving inference efficiency. We provide theoretical analysis showing that the error introduced by velocity reuse is bounded when combined with data consistency operations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FMCT/EFMCT achieve competitive reconstruction quality while significantly improving computational efficiency compared with diffusion-based methods. The codebase is open-sourced at https://github.com/EFMCT/EFMCT.
papers.journal_ref: MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于流匹配（Flow Matching, FM）的稀疏视角CT重建框架FMCT及其高效变体EFMCT。FM采用确定性常微分方程采样，避免了扩散模型中的随机噪声干扰，并利用相邻步骤间速度场强相关性重复使用先前预测的速度场，从而减少神经网络函数评估次数（NFEs），提升推理效率。理论分析表明在结合数据一致性操作时速度重用误差有界。实验显示FMCT/EFMCT在保持竞争性重建质量的同时，显著提高了计算效率。
Motivation: 扩散模型用于CT重建时依赖随机微分方程，其随机性会干扰重复的数据一致性校正，且重建效率在临床中至关重要。需要一种确定性且高效的方法。
Method: 提出基于流匹配的CT重建框架（FMCT），利用确定性ODE采样；进一步提出高效变体EFMCT，通过观察相邻步速度场高度相关，在连续步中重复使用先前预测的速度场，从而减少NFEs。
Result: 实验表明FMCT/EFMCT在稀疏视角CT重建上取得与扩散模型相当的重建质量，同时显著提升计算效率。
Conclusion: 流匹配的确定性特性天然适合CT重建中的数据一致性操作，速度场重用的策略可大幅降低计算成本，且误差可控。

summary_sections.result: 实验表明FMCT/EFMCT在稀疏视角CT重建上取得与扩散模型相当的重建质量，同时显著提升计算效率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 流匹配的确定性特性天然适合CT重建中的数据一致性操作，速度场重用的策略可大幅降低计算成本，且误差可控。

papers.title: Causal Mechanism Reduction: Mechanism Replacement for Neural Network Pruning and Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Which internal mechanisms of a neural network can be replaced while preserving the computation it performs? Structured pruning asks for smaller deployable networks; causal abstraction asks for high-level models that commute with interventions. We introduce causal mechanism reduction (CMR), a framework that treats a trained network as a deterministic structural causal model and replaces selected internal variables by constants or affine functions of retained variables. These replacements compile exactly into smaller dense networks by bias and weight folding, and induce reduced causal models testable with interchange interventions. We derive a unified second-order replacement-risk objective whose special cases recover mean replacement, variance-based pruning (VBP), logit-distortion scoring, and affine neuron merging, together with a margin-based certificate linking logit distortion to interchange-intervention agreement. The framework also exposes a basic invariance requirement: functionally identical ReLU networks should induce the same reduction. Under exact positive-scaling reparameterizations, VBP's kept set collapses to chance-level overlap while the logit-distortion score is exactly invariant. Empirically, CMR variants are competitive with VBP under matched fine-tuning of DeiT-Tiny on ImageNet-100; the clearer separation appears in the invariance and interchange tests, where the logit-distortion score preserves kept sets and consistently improves distributional fidelity. CMR thus gives pruning, compilation, and causal-abstraction verification a common object to optimize and verify.
papers.comment: Causal abstraction and pruning have been combined in this version under the name of "reduction"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出因果机制约简（CMR）框架，将训练好的神经网络视为确定性结构因果模型，用常量或仿射函数替换内部变量，从而导出更小的密集网络和可测试的约简因果模型。CMR统一了均值替换、基于方差的剪枝（VBP）、logit失真评分和仿射神经元合并等方法，并揭示了VBP在正缩放重参数化下不稳定而logit失真评分不变。实验在ImageNet-100上使用DeiT-Tiny进行验证。
Motivation: 结构化剪枝需要更小的可部署网络，因果抽象需要与干预可交换的高层模型。现有方法缺乏统一框架来同时优化剪枝和因果验证。
Method: 提出CMR框架，将神经网络视为结构因果模型，用常量或仿射函数替换内部变量，通过偏置和权重折叠编译为更小的密集网络，并导出二阶替换风险目标，其特例包括VBP、logit失真评分等。
Result: 在ImageNet-100上使用DeiT-Tiny，CMR变体与VBP在微调后竞争力相当；但在不变性和干预测试上，logit失真评分保持稳定并持续改善分布保真度。
Conclusion: CMR为剪枝、编译和因果抽象验证提供了统一的目标进行优化和验证。

papers.title: Compositional Generalization Requires Linear, Orthogonal Representations in Vision Embedding Models
papers.abstract_en: Compositional generalization, the ability to recognize familiar parts in novel contexts, is a defining property of intelligent systems. Although modern models are trained on massive datasets, they still cover only a tiny fraction of the combinatorial space of possible inputs, raising the question of what structure representations must have to support generalization to unseen combinations. We formalize three desiderata for compositional generalization under standard training (divisibility, transferability, stability) and show they impose necessary geometric constraints: representations must decompose linearly into per-concept components, and these components must be orthogonal across concepts. This provides theoretical grounding for the Linear Representation Hypothesis: the linear structure widely observed in neural representations is a necessary consequence of compositional generalization. We further derive dimension bounds linking the number of composable concepts to the embedding geometry. Empirically, we evaluate these predictions across modern vision models (CLIP, SigLIP, DINO) and find that representations exhibit partial linear factorization with low-rank, near-orthogonal per-concept factors, and that the degree of this structure correlates with compositional generalization on unseen combinations. As models continue to scale, these conditions predict the representational geometry they may converge to. Code is available at https://github.com/oshapio/necessary-compositionality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文形式化了组合泛化（compositional generalization）的三个期望性质（可分性、可迁移性、稳定性），证明在标准训练下，表示必须满足线性分解和正交性约束。这是线性表示假说（Linear Representation Hypothesis）的理论基础。实验在CLIP、SigLIP、DINO等视觉模型上验证了部分线性分解和低秩近正交因子，且其程度与组合泛化性能相关。
Motivation: 现代模型在组合空间中仅覆盖极小部分，但缺乏对表示结构如何支持未见组合泛化的理论理解。
Method: 形式化组合泛化的三个期望性质，推导出表示必须线性分解为每个概念的分量且分量间正交的必要条件，并给出维度界。
Result: 在CLIP、SigLIP、DINO上观察到部分线性分解、低秩近正交因子，且该结构与组合泛化能力相关。
Conclusion: 线性结构是组合泛化的必然结果，而非偶然特性；实验结果支持理论预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data Driven Optimization of GPU efficiency for Distributed LLM-Adapter Serving
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) adapters enable low-cost model specialization, but introduce complex caching and scheduling challenges in distributed serving systems where hundreds of adapters must be hosted concurrently. While prior work has largely focused on latency and throughput optimization, minimizing GPU resource requirements through near-peak utilization remains largely underexplored. This paper presents a data-driven pipeline that, for a given workload, computes an adapter placement that serves the workload with the minimum number of GPUs while avoiding request starvation and GPU memory errors. To that end, the approach identifies the maximum feasible throughput attainable on each GPU by leveraging accurate performance predictions learned from real serving behavior. The proposed pipeline integrates three components: (i) a Digital Twin (DT) tailored to LLM-adapter serving, (ii) a distilled machine learning (ML) model trained on DT-generated data, and (iii) a greedy placement algorithm that exploits ML-based performance estimates to maximize GPU efficiency. The DT emulates real system dynamics with high fidelity, achieving below 5% throughput estimation error while executing up to 90x faster than full LLM benchmarking across both predictable and unpredictable workloads. The learned ML models further accelerate performance estimation with marginal accuracy degradation, enabling scalable optimization. Experimental results demonstrate that the pipeline substantially improves GPU efficiency, reducing the number of GPUs required to sustain target workloads by 60\% on average across the evaluated scenarios. Beyond GPU efficiency, the pipeline can be adapted to alternative objectives, such as latency minimization, highlighting its versatility for future large-scale LLM serving infrastructures.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的流水线，用于优化分布式LLM适配器服务中的GPU效率。通过数字孪生（Digital Twin）模拟真实系统行为（吞吐量估计误差低于5%，速度比完整LLM基准测试快90倍），并训练蒸馏机器学习模型加速性能预测，结合贪心放置算法，在给定工作负载下以最少的GPU数量避免请求饥饿和内存错误。实验表明平均减少60%的GPU需求。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注延迟和吞吐量优化，但通过接近峰值利用率来最小化GPU资源需求仍未被充分探索。分布式系统中上百个适配器同时托管带来复杂的缓存和调度挑战。
Method: 提出三组件流水线：(i) 针对LLM适配器服务的数字孪生（DT）; (ii) 在DT生成数据上训练的蒸馏机器学习模型; (iii) 基于ML性能估计的贪心放置算法，最大化GPU效率。DT以高保真度模拟真实系统动态，吞吐量估计误差低于5%，执行速度比完整LLM基准测试快90倍。
Result: 平均减少60%的GPU需求，且流水线可适配其他目标（如延迟最小化）。ML模型在加速性能估计的同时精度损失极小。
Conclusion: 该数据驱动流水线能有效优化GPU效率，适用于未来大规模LLM服务基础设施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RSTNet: Enhancing Small-Target Recognition in Noisy SAR Imagery via Robust Feature Learning and Distribution-Aware Regression
papers.abstract_en: SAR supports all-day-and-night oceanic observation, yet vessel identification from SAR images is hampered by speckle noise, intricate land-sea backgrounds and dim miniature vessels, yielding numerous false identifications and missed targets. We develop an SAR-adaptive stable detection model RSTNet based on YOLOv8. A large-kernel channel-separated denoising unit eliminates noise and reserves delicate vessel features; parallel patch-aware attention enhances multi-scale feature extraction for miniature objects; NWD loss substitutes conventional IoU loss to achieve accurate bounding box regression. The proposed model outperforms the original YOLOv8 on the SSDD dataset with 97.0% precision, 95.1% recall and 98.9% mAP@0.5. Validations on the HRSID dataset verify its favorable generalization capacity for coastal miniature vessels. Therefore, our work delivers an effective technical scheme for ocean observation imaging with noisy miniature targets. The source code is available at https://github.com/renhcmhx/SAR.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RSTNet，一种基于YOLOv8的SAR图像小目标稳健检测模型。通过大核通道分离去噪单元抑制散斑噪声、并行分块注意力增强多尺度特征提取，并用NWD损失替代IoU损失改善边界框回归。在SSDD数据集上达到97.0%精确率、95.1%召回率、98.9% mAP@0.5，在HRSID数据集上验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: SAR图像中的散斑噪声、复杂海陆背景和微弱小目标导致大量虚警和漏检，现有检测模型难以同时兼顾去噪与小目标特征保留。
Method: 基于YOLOv8，设计大核通道分离去噪单元消除噪声并保留精细特征；并行分块注意力机制增强多尺度小目标特征提取；采用NWD损失（归一化高斯Wasserstein距离）替代常规IoU损失实现更精确的边界框回归。
Result: 在SSDD数据集上，RSTNet达到97.0%精确率、95.1%召回率、98.9% mAP@0.5；在HRSID数据集上验证了其对沿岸小目标SAR图像的良好泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文为含噪小目标海洋观测成像场景提供了一种有效的技术方案，代码已开源。

papers.title: QEDBENCH: Quantifying the Alignment Gap in Automated Evaluation of University-Level Mathematical Proofs
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) saturate elementary benchmarks, the research frontier has shifted from generation to the reliability of automated evaluation. We demonstrate that standard "LLM-as-a-Judge" protocols suffer from a systematic Alignment Gap when applied to upper-undergraduate to early graduate level mathematics. To quantify this, we introduce QEDBench, the first large-scale dual-rubric alignment benchmark to systematically measure alignment with human experts on university-level math proofs by contrasting course-specific rubrics against expert common knowledge criteria. By deploying a dual-evaluation matrix (7 judges x 5 solvers) against 1,000+ hours of human evaluation, we reveal that certain frontier evaluators like Claude Opus 4.5, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen 2.5 Max, and Llama 4 Maverick exhibit significant positive bias (up to +0.18, +0.20, +0.30, +0.36 mean score inflation, respectively). Furthermore, we uncover a critical reasoning gap in the discrete domain: while Gemini 3.0 Pro achieves state-of-the-art performance (0.91 average human evaluation score), other reasoning models like GPT-5 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4.5 see their performance significantly degrade in discrete domains. Specifically, their average human evaluation scores drop to 0.72 and 0.63 in Discrete Math, and to 0.74 and 0.50 in Graph Theory. In addition to these research results, we also release QEDBench as a public benchmark for evaluating and improving AI judges. Our benchmark is publicly published at https://github.com/qqliu/Yale-QEDBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QEDBench，首个大规模双评分标准对齐基准，用于量化大型语言模型（LLM）在评估大学数学证明时与人类专家的对齐差距。通过7个评估器×5个求解器的双评估矩阵和超过1000小时的人工评估，发现前沿评估器（如Claude Opus 4.5、DeepSeek-V3等）存在显著正偏差（最高平均评分膨胀+0.36），并且在离散数学和图论等离散领域，推理模型（如GPT-5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5）性能大幅下降。
Motivation: 标准“LLM-as-a-Judge”协议在评估高年级本科至研究生水平的数学证明时存在系统性对齐差距，需要定量衡量这一差距。
Method: 引入 QEDBench，通过对比课程特定评分标准与专家通用知识标准，构建7个评判者×5个求解者的双评估矩阵，基于1000+小时的人工评估进行系统性对齐测量。
Result: 某些前沿评估器表现出显著正偏差（Claude Opus 4.5: +0.18, DeepSeek-V3: +0.20, Qwen 2.5 Max: +0.30, Llama 4 Maverick: +0.36）；在离散领域，Gemini 3.0 Pro取得最佳性能（平均人类评估得分0.91），而GPT-5 Pro和Claude Sonnet 4.5性能退化（离散数学中分别为0.72和0.63，图论中分别为0.74和0.50）。
Conclusion: QEDBench作为公开基准，可用于评估和改进AI评判者，揭示了当前LLM在数学证明评估中的对齐差距和离散领域推理缺陷。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Incremental Learning of Sparse Attention Patterns in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies simple transformers trained on a high-order Markov chain, where the model must incorporate information from multiple past positions, each with different statistical importance. We show that transformers learn the task incrementally, with each stage corresponding to learning how to copy information from a subset of positions via a sparse attention pattern. Notably, the learning dynamics transition from a competitive phase, where all heads focus on the statistically most important positions, to a cooperative phase, where different heads specialize in different patterns. We model these dynamics with simplified differential equations and prove stage-wise convergence of the resulting system. Functionally, these stages correspond to a sequence of increasingly expressive misspecified models, with the full model class reached only at the end. Overall, we give a theoretical account of how structured attention patterns and head specialization emerge in stages without an explicit curriculum, with implications for generalization in sequential tasks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在简单的高阶马尔可夫链任务上训练的Transformer，模型需要从多个历史位置整合信息。作者发现Transformer以增量方式学习，每个阶段对应通过稀疏注意力模式从位置子集复制信息，从竞争阶段（所有头部聚焦于统计最重要的位置）过渡到协作阶段（不同头部专攻不同模式）。通过简化微分方程建模并证明阶段收敛，从理论上解释了结构化注意力模式和头部专门化如何在无显式课程的情况下阶段性出现，对序列任务的泛化具有启示。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对Transformer中注意力模式如何逐步涌现、头部如何专门化的理论理解，特别是在无显式课程的情况下。
Method: 采用高阶马尔可夫链作为训练任务，通过分析注意力权重演化，定义竞争与协作两个阶段，并用简化微分方程描述动力学，证明阶段收敛。
Result: 理论上展示了稀疏注意力模式和头部专门化分阶段出现的完整过程，每个阶段对应一个逐渐精确的欠指定模型，最终达到完整模型类。
Conclusion: 该理论框架揭示了结构化注意力模式涌现的机制，对理解Transformer在序列任务中的泛化有重要意义，但实验仅限于简单马尔可夫链任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient privacy loss accounting for subsampling and random allocation
papers.abstract_en: We consider the privacy amplification properties of a sampling scheme in which a user's data isused in $k$ steps chosen randomly and uniformly from a sequence (or set) of $t$ steps. This sampling scheme has been recently applied in the context of differentially private optimization (Chua et al., 2024a; Choquette-Choo et al., 2025) and communication-efficient high-dimensional private aggregation (Asi et al., 2026), where it was shown to have utility advantages over the standard Poisson sampling. Theoretical analyses of this sampling scheme (Feldman & Shenfeld, 2025; Dong et al., 2025) lead to bounds that are close to those of Poisson sampling, yet still have two significant shortcomings. First, in many practical settings, the resulting privacy parameters are not tight due to the approximation steps in the analysis. Second, the computed parameters are either the hockey stick or Renyi divergence, both of which introduce overheads when used in privacy loss accounting. In this work, we demonstrate that the privacy loss distribution (PLD) of random allocation applied to any differentially private algorithm can be computed efficiently. When applied to the Gaussian mechanism, our results demonstrate that the privacy-utility trade-off for random allocation is at least as good as that of Poisson subsampling. In particular, random allocation is better suited for training via DP-SGD. To support these computations, our work develops new tools for general privacy loss accounting based on a notion of PLD realization. This notion allows us to extend accurate privacy loss accounting to subsampling which previously required manual noise-mechanism-specific analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机分配抽样方案在差分隐私中的隐私放大问题，提出一种高效计算隐私损失分布（PLD）的方法，并开发基于PLD实现的通用隐私核算工具。该方法避免了以往近似分析的不紧性和手动机制分析的局限，应用于高斯机制时表明随机分配的隐私-效用权衡至少与泊松子抽样相当。
Motivation: 现有随机分配抽样方案的理论分析存在近似步骤导致隐私参数不紧，且计算的散度在隐私核算中引入额外开销，需要更精确高效的隐私损失核算方法。
Method: 通过隐私损失分布（PLD）实现随机分配的隐私核算，并引入PLD实现的概念，将精确核算扩展到子抽样场景，无需针对具体噪声机制进行手动分析。
Result: 摘要显示，应用于高斯机制时，随机分配的隐私-效用权衡至少与泊松子抽样一样好，特别适合DP-SGD训练。
Conclusion: 本文开发的PLD实现工具可推广至其他子抽样方案，提升隐私核算的准确性和效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NextCrystal: a Symmetry-Driven Generative Framework for Crystal Structure Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Crystal structure prediction (CSP), which aims to predict the 3D atomic arrangement of a crystal from its composition, is central to materials discovery and mechanistic understanding. Crystal symmetry plays a crucial role in CSP, but given the composition in a unit cell, existing methods either struggle with the NP-hard combinatorial challenge of enforcing symmetry rigorously or rely on retrieving known templates, inherently limiting both physical fidelity and the discovery of genuinely new materials. To address this challenge, we introduce NextCrystal, a symmetry-driven generative framework that employs large language models to encode chemical semantics and directly generate fine-grained Wyckoff site patterns from atomic stoichiometry, eliminating reliance on database lookups. To overcome the combinatorial complexity of site assignments, we incorporate domain knowledge via an efficient, linear-complexity heuristic beam search, rigorously enforcing algebraic consistency between site multiplicities and atomic stoichiometry. By integrating this symmetry-consistent template into a diffusion backbone, the framework constrains the stochastic generative trajectory to a physically plausible geometric manifold. NextCrystal achieves state-of-the-art performance on stability, uniqueness, and novelty (SUN) benchmarks, as well as superior structural matching, establishing a rigorous paradigm for exploring previously unexplored crystallographic space without relying on prior structural templates. As a representative application, first-principles screening of HfO2 candidates generated by NextCrystal identifies a previously unreported dynamically stable Pnma phase, 0.056~eV/atom lower in energy than the conventional high-pressure Pnma phase.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NextCrystal，一种对称性驱动的生成框架，用于晶体结构预测。它利用大语言模型编码化学语义，从原子化学计量直接生成Wyckoff位点模式，并通过线性复杂度的启发式波束搜索强制位点多重性与原子化学计量的代数一致性。在扩散主干中集成该对称一致性模板，将随机生成轨迹约束在物理合理的几何流形上。NextCrystal在稳定性、独特性和新颖性基准上取得最先进性能，并发现了一种之前未被报道的HfO2动态稳定Pnma相。
Motivation: 现有晶体结构预测方法要么难以严格强制执行对称性（NP-hard组合问题），要么依赖已知模板检索，限制了物理保真度和新材料的发现。
Method: 提出对称驱动的生成框架NextCrystal：使用大语言模型编码化学语义并直接预测Wyckoff位点模式；采用线性复杂度启发式波束搜索确保位点多重性与化学计量的代数一致性；将对称性模板集成到扩散模型主干中，约束生成轨迹。
Result: 在SUN基准上取得最先进的稳定性、独特性和新颖性性能，并在HfO2筛选中预测出能量比传统高压相低0.056 eV/atom的之前未报道的动态稳定Pnma相。
Conclusion: NextCrystal建立了不依赖先验结构模板、严格探索晶体学空间的范式，对材料发现和机理理解具有潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for V2X Resource Allocation: Disentangling MARL Challenges Through Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Radio resource allocation (RRA) is a critical function in cellular vehicle-to-everything (C-V2X) networks, where vehicles must share limited wireless resources to support safety-critical communications. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has emerged as a promising approach for this problem. However, key MARL challenges, including non-stationarity, coordination difficulty, large action space, partial observability, and limited robustness and generalization, are often intertwined, making it difficult to assess their individual impact on performance in vehicular environments. Moreover, existing studies primarily focus on developing new algorithms, while systematic benchmarking and comparative analyses remain limited. To address this gap, we formulate C-V2X RRA as a hierarchy of multi-agent interference games that progressively introduce key MARL challenges. Based on this framework, we develop a suite of benchmark learning tasks and construct training and testing datasets from SUMO-generated highway traces with diverse vehicular topologies and interference conditions. Using the proposed benchmark, we evaluate representative MARL algorithms spanning value-based, actor-critic, Independent Learning (IL), and Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigms. The results identify robustness and generalization across diverse vehicular topologies as the dominant challenge among those considered in this work, reducing average normalized return by up to 59 percentage points, and show that, on the most challenging task, the best actor-critic method outperforms the best value-based method by 42\%. By revealing the relative strengths and limitations of different MARL paradigms and open-sourcing the code, datasets, and benchmark suite, this work provides a systematic and reproducible foundation for evaluating and advancing MARL algorithms in vehicular networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对C-V2X网络中的无线资源分配问题，将MARL挑战解耦并构建了一套基准测试套件。通过设计多智能体干扰博弈层次结构，逐步引入非平稳性、协调困难、大动作空间等挑战，并在SUMO生成的高速公路轨迹上评估了多种MARL算法（value-based、actor-critic、IL、CTDE）。结果表明，跨不同车辆拓扑的鲁棒性和泛化性是最主要的挑战，最佳actor-critic方法在最具挑战性任务上优于最佳value-based方法42%。
Motivation: 现有MARL研究在V2X资源分配中未能系统解耦和评估各挑战的独立影响，缺乏标准化基准和比较分析。
Method: 将C-V2X资源分配建模为多智能体干扰博弈层次结构，逐步引入MARL关键挑战；基于该框架构建基准学习任务和数据集，评估多种MARL算法。
Result: 鲁棒性和泛化性降低平均归一化回报最多达59个百分点；在最具挑战任务上，最佳actor-critic方法比最佳value-based方法高42%。
Conclusion: 揭示了不同MARL范式的相对优势和局限性，并开源了代码、数据集和基准套件，为车辆网络中MARL算法的评估和改进提供了系统性、可复现的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: pFedNavi: Structure-Aware Personalized Federated Vision-Language Navigation for Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation VLN requires large-scale trajectory instruction data from private indoor environments, raising significant privacy concerns. Federated Learning FL mitigates this by keeping data on-device, but vanilla FL struggles under VLNs' extreme cross-client heterogeneity in environments and instruction styles, making a single global model suboptimal. This paper proposes pFedNavi, a structure-aware and dynamically adaptive personalized federated learning framework tailored for VLN. Our key idea is to personalize where it matters: pFedNavi adaptively identifies client-specific layers via layer-wise mixing coefficients, and performs fine-grained parameter fusion on the selected components (e.g., the encoder-decoder projection and environment-sensitive decoder layers) to balance global knowledge sharing with local specialization. We evaluate pFedNavi on two standard VLN benchmarks, R2R and RxR, using both ResNet and CLIP visual representations. Across all metrics, pFedNavi consistently outperforms the FedAvg-based VLN baseline, achieving up to 7.5% improvement in navigation success rate and up to 7.8% gain in trajectory fidelity, while converging 1.38x faster under non-IID conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted by the IEEE INFOCOM 2026 Workshop on Emerging Intelligent Networks (EIN)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: pFedNavi 是一种面向视觉-语言导航（VLN）的个性化联邦学习框架，通过层感知的混合系数自适应识别客户端特定层，并对编解码器投影和环境敏感解码器层进行细粒度参数融合，平衡全局知识共享与本地特化。在 R2R 和 RxR 基准上，使用 ResNet 和 CLIP 视觉表示，pFedNavi 一致优于 FedAvg 基线，导航成功率最高提升 7.5%，轨迹保真度最高提升 7.8%，非 IID 条件下收敛速度提升 1.38 倍。
Motivation: 联邦学习在 VLN 中面临极端跨客户端异质性（环境与指令风格），标准联邦学习（如 FedAvg）的单一全局模型难以适应，且隐私保护要求数据保留在设备本地。
Method: 提出 pFedNavi，通过层混合系数自适应识别每个客户端的特定层，对选中的组件（编码器-解码器投影层和环境敏感解码器层）进行细粒度参数融合，实现全局共享与本地特化协同。
Result: 在 R2R 和 RxR 标准 VLN 基准上，使用 ResNet 和 CLIP 视觉表示，pFedNavi 相比 FedAvg 基线导航成功率提升最高 7.5%，轨迹保真度提升最高 7.8%，非 IID 条件下收敛快 1.38 倍。
Conclusion: pFedNavi 通过结构感知的个性化有效处理 VLN 中的客户端异质性，显著提升导航性能与收敛速度，适用于隐私保护的室内导航场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NEST: Nascent Encoded Steganographic Thoughts
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is a foundational safety technique for large language model agents; however, this oversight is compromised if models learn to conceal their reasoning. We explore steganographic CoT--where models hide secret reasoning within innocuous text--to inform risk assessment and deployment policies. Steganographic reasoning requires two skills in a single forward pass: computing an intermediate result, and embedding it into a coherent cover that answers an unrelated question. Drawing on our taxonomy of steganographic and non-steganographic CoT types, we systematically evaluate the limits of prompt-elicited steganographic CoT capability across 34 models, ranging from past generations to the current frontier. We measure monitor evasion, refusal rates, encoding fidelity, and hidden task accuracy across five datasets, comparing against plain reasoning, direct answer, and filler-token baselines. The two experiments isolate the two sub-skills: a reasoning tasks sweep tests joint reason-and-embed, while a counting task hands the model a known numerical sequence and tests embedding alone--a necessary precondition for stego reasoning. Current frontier models cannot sustain joint reason-and-embed: a paired McNemar comparison shows the steganographic channel is dominated by an filler-token baseline on every (model, family) cell. The encoding-only floor, by contrast, is cleared--Claude Opus~4.5 reaches 92% per-number partial accuracy on 4-digit sequences and saturates at 100% exact-match on length-8 single-digit sequences--establishing that the binding constraint on stego CoT is the joint reasoning-plus-encoding load, not raw channel capacity. Our findings underscore the need for continuous evaluation of steganographic risk and provide a methodology to preemptively detect and evaluate hidden reasoning that might empower misaligned scheming and deceptive behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在链式思维推理中隐藏秘密推理的能力（隐写CoT）。通过系统评估34个模型，发现当前最前沿模型无法同时进行推理和编码，隐写通道被填充基线主导，但纯编码能力足够（如Claude Opus 4.5在4位数字序列上达92%局部准确率）。
Motivation: 监控链式思维推理是LLM智能体的基础安全技术，但如果模型学会隐藏推理则监管失效，因此需要评估隐写CoT风险。
Method: 提出隐写CoT和非隐写CoT的类型学分类，通过推理任务扫描（联合推理与嵌入）和计数任务（仅嵌入）两个实验分离评估两个子技能，并与直接回答、填充基线等对比。
Result: 当前前沿模型无法维持联合推理与嵌入；配对McNemar检验显示隐写通道在所有模型上被填充基线主导。纯编码能力可行：Claude Opus 4.5在4位数字序列上达92%局部准确率，在8位单数字序列上达到100%精确匹配。
Conclusion: 隐写CoT的瓶颈在于联合推理与编码负载而非原始通道容量，需要持续评估隐写风险，并提供检测隐藏推理的方法论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Discover Iterative Spectral Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: We introduce AutoSpec, a neural network framework for discovering iterative spectral algorithms for large-scale numerical linear algebra and numerical optimization. Our self-supervised models adapt to input operators using coarse spectral information (e.g., eigenvalue estimates and residual norms), and predict recurrence coefficients for computing or applying a matrix polynomial tailored to a downstream task. The effectiveness of AutoSpec relies on three ingredients: an architecture whose inference pass implements short, executable numerical linear algebra recurrences; efficient training on small synthetic problems with transfer to large-scale real-world operators; and task-defined objectives that enforce the desired approximation or preconditioning behavior across the range of spectral profiles represented in the training set. We apply AutoSpec to discovering algorithms for representative tasks on spd matrices: accelerating matrix function approximation; accelerating sparse linear solvers; and spectral filtering/preconditioning for eigenvalue computations. On real-world matrices, the learned procedures deliver up to order-of-magnitude improvements in accuracy and/or reductions in iteration count, relative to spectrum-agnostic baselines. We find clear connections to classical theory: the induced polynomials may exhibit equioscillation behavior characteristic of Chebyshev polynomial approximation. The code is available at: https://github.com/zihanghliu/AutoSpec .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoSpec，一个神经网络框架，用于自动发现大规模数值线性代数和数值优化中的迭代谱算法。自监督模型利用粗略谱信息（如特征值估计和残差范数）为下游任务预测矩阵多项式的递推系数。在对称正定矩阵上，学到的程序在矩阵函数逼近、稀疏线性求解和特征值计算的谱滤波/预处理任务中，相比与谱无关的基线，实现了数量级的精度提升或迭代次数减少。代码已开源。
Motivation: 手工设计迭代谱算法（如Chebyshev迭代）需要领域专业知识，且不易自动适应不同矩阵的谱分布。现有方法缺乏自动发现针对特定任务的最优多项式递推的方法。
Method: 提出AutoSpec框架，其架构实现可执行的短数值线性代数递推；在小型合成问题上高效训练，并迁移到大规模真实世界矩阵；任务定义的目标函数强制在训练集覆盖的谱分布范围内实现期望的逼近或预处理行为。
Result: 在真实矩阵上，学到的程序相对于与谱无关的基线，在精度上提供数量级提升和/或迭代次数减少。诱导多项式表现出Chebyshev多项式逼近的等波纹行为。
Conclusion: AutoSpec展示了神经网络自动发现迭代谱算法的能力，且与经典理论有清晰联系。未来可扩展到非对称矩阵或其他数值任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Linear Response and Optimal Fingerprinting for Nonautonomous Systems
papers.abstract_en: We provide a link between response theory, pullback measures, and optimal fingerprinting method that paves the way for a) predicting the impact of acting forcings on time-dependent systems and b) attributing observed anomalies to acting forcings when the reference state is not time-independent. We derive formulas for linear response theory for time-dependent Markov chains and diffusion processes. We discuss existence, uniqueness, and differentiability of the equivariant measure under general (not necessarily slow or periodic) perturbations of the transition kernels. Our results allow for extending the theory of optimal fingerprinting for detection and attribution of climate change (or change in any complex system) when the background state is time-dependent amd when the optimal solution is sought for multiple time slices at the same time. We provide numerical support for the findings by applying our theory to a modified version of the Ghil-Sellers energy balance model. We verify the precision of response theory - even in a coarse-grained setting - in predicting the impact of increasing CO$_2$ concentration on the temperature field. Additionally, we show that the optimal fingerprinting method developed here is capable to attribute the climate change signal to multiple acting forcings across a vast time horizon.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures, updated discussion and bibliography, full database and codes online
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了响应理论、pullback测度与最优指纹方法之间的联系，推导了非自治系统（时变马尔可夫链和扩散过程）的线性响应公式，并给出了不变测度存在唯一性和可微性的条件。通过修改的Ghil-Sellers能量平衡模型验证了响应理论在CO2浓度增加下温度场预测的准确性，并展示了最优指纹方法能够将气候变化信号归因到多个强迫因子。
Motivation: 现有的响应理论和最优指纹方法通常假设参考状态是时间独立的，但许多实际系统（如气候系统）具有时间依赖性。本文旨在推广到非自治系统，使得可以处理时变背景状态下的强迫预测和归因。
Method: 推导了时变马尔可夫链和扩散过程的线性响应公式；研究了在一般（非慢变或周期）扰动下等变测度的存在性、唯一性和可微性；将最优指纹方法扩展到时间依赖背景状态和多时间切片同时优化的情形。
Result: 通过在修改的Ghil-Sellers能量平衡模型上的数值实验，验证了响应理论在粗粒化设置下预测CO2浓度增加对温度场影响的精度；同时展示了最优指纹方法能够在长时间范围内将气候变化信号归因到多个强迫因子。
Conclusion: 本文为预测时变系统对外部强迫的响应和归因提供了理论基础，拓展了最优指纹方法的适用范围，尤其适用于气候变化的检测和归因。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Think Proprioceptively: State-Grounded Visual Token Selection for VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically inject proprioception only as a late conditioning signal, preventing robot state from grounding instruction understanding or directing visual attention. We introduce ThinkProprio, which discretizes proprioception into VLM-vocabulary tokens and uses them jointly with the instruction to gate visual patches before VLM computation, steering the model toward action-relevant evidence while discarding redundant tokens early. We find that proprioception added as a passive conditioning signal leaves performance essentially unchanged; its value emerges when token-form state acts as an active query that, with the instruction, selects which visual patches the VLM processes. Systematic ablations show that VLM-vocabulary tokens outperform learned projectors as the state encoding, and that retaining only about \SI{12}{\percent} of the visual tokens surpasses on CALVIN ABC$\to$D. Across CALVIN, LIBERO, and real-world manipulation, ThinkProprio reduces end-to-end inference latency while improving the matched full-token baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ThinkProprio 方法，将本体感觉离散化为 VLM 词汇标记，并与指令联合作为主动查询，在 VLM 计算前选择与动作相关的视觉补丁，丢弃冗余标记。实验表明，仅保留约 12% 的视觉标记即可在 CALVIN、LIBERO 和真实机器人操控任务上超越全标记基线，同时降低端到端推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型仅将本体感觉作为后期条件信号，无法利用机器人状态引导指令理解或视觉注意力，限制了性能。
Method: 将机器人的本体感觉离散化为与 VLM 词汇对齐的离散标记，并与指令拼接，共同作为查询，从视觉特征中筛选出与动作相关的补丁，早期丢弃冗余视觉信息。
Result: 在 CALVIN ABC→D 上，仅保留 12% 视觉标记即可超越全标记基线；在 CALVIN、LIBERO 和真实操控任务上，推理延迟降低的同时性能提升。
Conclusion: 本体感觉作为主动查询而非被动输入时，能有效引导视觉注意力并提升效率；VLM 词汇标记作为状态编码优于可学习的投影器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Cross-Attention Transformer for Cooperative Multi-AP OFDM Uplink Reception
papers.abstract_en: We propose a cross-attention Transformer for joint decoding of uplink OFDM signals received by multiple coordinated access points. A shared per-receiver encoder learns the time-frequency structure of each grid, and a token-wise cross-attention module fuses the receivers to produce soft log-likelihood ratios for a standard channel decoder without explicit channel estimates. Trained with a bit-metric objective, the model adapts its fusion to per-receiver reliability and remains robust under degraded links, strong frequency selectivity, and sparse pilots. Over realistic Wi-Fi channels, it outperforms classical pipelines and strong neural baselines, often matching or surpassing a local perfect-CSI reference while remaining compact and computationally efficient on commodity hardware, making it suitable for next-generation coordinated Wi-Fi receivers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种交叉注意力Transformer，用于多个协调接入点联合解码上行OFDM信号。每个接收器使用共享编码器学习时频结构，通过逐token交叉注意力模块融合各接收器信息，生成软对数似然比，无需显式信道估计。在真实Wi-Fi信道下，该方法优于传统管道和强神经基线，匹配或超越局部完美信道估计参考，且紧凑高效。
Motivation: 传统多AP联合接收需要显式信道估计，在链路退化、强频率选择性或稀疏导频下表现不佳。目标是通过端到端学习实现鲁棒融合。
Method: 设计共享每接收器编码器提取时频特征，引入逐token交叉注意力融合多接收器信息，输出软LLR；采用比特度量目标训练，自适应调整各接收器可靠性权重。
Result: 在真实Wi-Fi信道中，该方法在性能上超越经典方法和强神经基线，常匹配或超过局部完美CSI参考，同时保持紧凑且计算高效。
Conclusion: 该方法无需显式信道估计，鲁棒性强，适用于下一代协调Wi-Fi接收器，在实用硬件上高效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PCA of probability measures: Sparse and Dense sampling regimes
papers.abstract_en: A common approach to perform PCA on probability measures is to embed them into a Hilbert space where standard functional PCA techniques apply. While convergence rates for estimating the embedding of a single measure from $m$ samples are well understood, the literature has not addressed the setting involving multiple measures. In this paper, we study PCA in a double asymptotic regime where $n$ probability measures are observed, each through $m$ samples. We derive convergence rates of the form $n^{-1/2} + m^{-α}$ for the empirical covariance operator and the PCA excess risk, where $α>0$ depends on the chosen embedding. This characterizes the relationship between the number $n$ of measures and the number $m$ of samples per measure, revealing a sparse (small $m$) to dense (large $m$) transition in the convergence behavior. Moreover, we prove that the dense-regime rate is minimax optimal for the empirical covariance error. Our numerical experiments validate these theoretical rates and demonstrate that appropriate subsampling preserves PCA accuracy while reducing computational cost.
papers.journal_ref: International Conference on Machine Learning 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多个概率测度（每个测度通过m个样本观测）的PCA问题，在双渐近机制下推导了经验协方差算子和PCA超额风险的收敛速率，形式为n^{-1/2} + m^{-α}，揭示了稀疏采样到密集采样的过渡行为，并证明了密集区域速率的极小极大最优性。
Motivation: 现有工作仅关注单个概率测度的嵌入估计，缺乏对多个测度情形的理论分析。本文填补了这一空白，旨在同时刻画测度数量n和每个测度样本量m对PCA性能的影响。
Method: 将概率测度嵌入到Hilbert空间，应用标准函数PCA技术，在双渐近机制下推导收敛速率，并通过数值实验验证理论结果。
Result: 收敛速率为n^{-1/2} + m^{-α}，其中α依赖于嵌入选择；密集（m大）区域的速率是极小极大最优的。
Conclusion: 理论分析由数值实验支持，且表明适当的子采样可在不损失PCA精度的前提下降低计算成本。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.conclusion: 理论分析由数值实验支持，且表明适当的子采样可在不损失PCA精度的前提下降低计算成本。

papers.title: Explicit Credit Assignment through Local Rewards and Dependence Graphs in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: To promote cooperation in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning, the reward signals of all agents can be aggregated together, forming global rewards that are commonly known as the fully cooperative setting. However, global rewards are usually noisy because they contain the contributions of all agents, which have to be resolved in the credit assignment process. On the other hand, using local reward benefits from faster learning due to the separation of agents' contributions, but can be suboptimal as agents myopically optimize their own reward while disregarding the global optimality. In this work, we propose a method that combines the merits of both approaches. By using a graph of interaction between agents, our method discerns the individual agent contribution in a more fine-grained manner than a global reward, while alleviating the cooperation problem with agents' local reward. We also introduce a practical approach for approximating such a graph. Our experiments demonstrate the flexibility of the approach, enabling improvements over the traditional local and global reward settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体强化学习中全局奖励噪声大而局部奖励可能导致次优的折衷问题，提出一种结合两者优点的方法。通过构建智能体间的依赖图，该方法比全局奖励更精细地辨别个体贡献，同时减轻局部奖励带来的合作困境。实验表明该方法在灵活性上优于传统局部和全局奖励设置。
Motivation: 全局奖励包含所有智能体的贡献，噪声大且信用分配困难；局部奖励学习快但智能体可能短视优化自身奖励，忽略全局最优。现有方法难以兼顾两者优势。
Method: 利用智能体间的交互图来更细粒度地辨识单个智能体的贡献，并结合局部奖励与全局奖励的优点。还提出一种近似该图的实用方法。
Result: 实验证明该方法具有灵活性，在多种任务上优于传统的局部奖励和全局奖励设置。
Conclusion: 通过依赖图实现显式信用分配，既保持局部奖励的学习效率，又缓解了合作问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Optimize by Differentiable Programming
papers.abstract_en: Solving massive-scale optimization problems requires scalable first-order methods with low per-iteration cost. This tutorial highlights a shift in optimization: using differentiable programming not only to execute algorithms but to learn how to design them. Modern frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX enable this paradigm through efficient automatic differentiation. Embedding first-order methods within these systems allows end-to-end training that improves convergence and solution quality. Guided by Fenchel-Rockafellar duality, the tutorial demonstrates how duality-informed iterative schemes such as the alternating direction method of multipliers, and the primal-dual hybrid gradient can be learned and adapted through representative case studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本教程系统介绍可微编程在优化中的新范式：不仅用可微框架执行优化算法，更通过学习来设计算法。基于Fenchel-Rockafellar对偶性，展示如何学习ADMM和原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）等迭代方案，并通过案例验证其收敛性与解质量的提升。
Motivation: 大规模优化问题需要高效可扩展的一阶方法，但传统算法设计依赖手工调参且泛化有限。可微编程能通过端到端学习自动优化算法参数，降低人工成本并提升性能。
Method: 将一阶优化方法嵌入PyTorch、TensorFlow、JAX等自动微分框架，利用对偶性指导的迭代结构进行端到端训练，使算法参数（如步长、正则项）可学习。
Result: 在代表性案例中，可学习的ADMM和PDHG相比固定参数版本表现出更快的收敛速度和更优的最终解质量。
Conclusion: 可微编程将算法设计转化为可优化问题，为自适应、高性能优化器开发提供了系统化途径，尤其适合对偶性结构清晰的迭代方案。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Predicting Biased Human Decision-Making with Large Language Models in Conversational Settings
papers.abstract_en: We examine whether large language models (LLMs) can predict biased decision-making in conversational settings, and whether their predictions capture not only human cognitive biases but also how those effects change under cognitive load. In a pre-registered study (N = 1,648), participants completed six classic decision-making tasks via a chatbot with dialogues of varying complexity. Participants exhibited two well-documented cognitive biases: the Framing Effect and the Status Quo Bias. Increased dialogue complexity resulted in participants reporting higher mental demand. This increase in cognitive load selectively, but significantly, increased the effect of the biases, demonstrating the load-bias interaction. We then evaluated whether LLMs (GPT-4, GPT-5, and open-source models) could predict individual decisions given demographic information and prior dialogue. While results were mixed across choice problems, LLM predictions that incorporated dialogue context were significantly more accurate in several key scenarios. Importantly, their predictions reproduced the same bias patterns and load-bias interactions observed in humans. Across all models tested, the GPT-4 family consistently aligned with human behavior, outperforming GPT-5 and open-source models in both predictive accuracy and fidelity to human-like bias patterns. These findings advance our understanding of LLMs as tools for simulating human decision-making and inform the design of conversational agents that adapt to user biases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过预注册实验（N=1,648）研究了大型语言模型（LLM）能否在对话设置中预测人类有偏见的决策，特别是框架效应和现状偏见，以及认知负荷如何调节这些偏见。参与者通过聊天机器人完成六项经典决策任务，对话复杂度各异。实验发现，增加的对话复杂度提高了心理需求，并选择性增强了偏见效应。随后，研究者评估了GPT-4、GPT-5及开源模型在给定人口统计信息和先前对话的情况下预测个体决策的能力。结果显示，纳入对话上下文的LLM预测在多个关键场景中显著更准确，并成功复现了人类中观察到的偏见模式和负荷-偏见交互。所有模型中，GPT-4家族在预测准确性和与人类偏见模式的保真度上表现最佳。
Motivation: 现有研究较少探索LLM在对话环境中预测人类决策偏差的能力，特别是认知负荷与偏差的交互作用，这对理解LLM作为人类行为模拟工具和设计适应偏差的对话代理具有重要意义。
Method: 采用预注册的实验设计，招募1,648名参与者通过聊天机器人界面完成六项经典决策任务，通过改变对话复杂度来操纵认知负荷。然后，使用GPT-4、GPT-5及开源模型基于人口统计信息和对话历史预测每个参与者的决策，并比较预测与真实决策的匹配度以及偏差模式的再现情况。
Result: LLM预测在多个决策场景中显著准确，且预测中再现了与人类相同的偏见模式（框架效应和现状偏见）及负荷-偏见交互。GPT-4系列在预测准确性和对人类偏差模式的拟合程度上均优于GPT-5和开源模型。
Conclusion: 本文表明LLM能够有效预测对话中的偏见决策，并捕捉认知负荷的影响，为将LLM用作人类决策模拟工具以及设计自适应对话代理提供了理论和实证基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SnapGen++: Unleashing Diffusion Transformers for Efficient High-Fidelity Image Generation on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion transformers (DiTs) have set new standards in image generation, yet remain impractical for on-device deployment due to their high computational and memory costs. In this work, we present an efficient DiT framework tailored for mobile and edge devices that achieves transformer-level generation quality under strict resource constraints. Our design combines three key components. First, we propose a compact DiT architecture with an adaptive global-local sparse attention mechanism that balances global context modeling and local detail preservation. Second, we propose an elastic training framework that jointly optimizes sub-DiTs of varying capacities within a unified supernetwork, allowing a single model to dynamically adjust for efficient inference across different hardware. Finally, we develop Knowledge-Guided Distribution Matching Distillation, a step-distillation pipeline that integrates the DMD objective with knowledge transfer from few-step teacher models, producing high-fidelity and low-latency generation (e.g., 4-step) suitable for real-time on-device use. Together, these contributions enable scalable, efficient, and high-quality diffusion models for deployment on diverse hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SnapGen++，一个面向移动和边缘设备的高效扩散变压器（DiT）框架，通过紧凑架构、弹性训练和知识引导分布匹配蒸馏，实现低延迟（如4步采样）的高保真图像生成，适合实时部署。
Motivation: 扩散变压器在图像生成中性能优异，但计算和内存成本过高，难以在移动和边缘设备上部署。
Method: 包含三部分：1）紧凑DiT架构，采用自适应全局-局部稀疏注意力平衡全局建模和局部细节；2）弹性训练框架，在统一超网络中联合优化不同容量的子DiT，使单个模型可动态适应不同硬件；3）知识引导分布匹配蒸馏，结合DMD目标与少步教师模型的知识迁移，实现4步采样。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在严格资源约束下达到transformer级生成质量，并实现低延迟（如4步）推理，适合实时设备端使用。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了可扩展、高效、高质量的扩散模型，可在多样化硬件上部署，但未在随机性或局限性上详细说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpenTinker: Separating Concerns in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \textsc{OpenTinker}, an open infrastructure for training large language model (LLM) agents with many LoRA-backed policies over shared execution resources. Modern agent workloads mix supervised fine-tuning (SFT), online reinforcement learning (RL), rollout generation, validation, and multi-turn environment interaction. In such workloads, LoRA adapters are not static inference artifacts: they are frequently updated policy states whose optimizer state, rollout snapshot, and training data attribution must remain consistent. \textsc{OpenTinker} centers the runtime around this policy lifecycle. Users define environments, agents, and learning objectives, while the system manages training clients, rollout samplers, checkpoint handles, and policy-version refresh. The same data path supports SFT and RL by converting trajectories into token sequences with explicit masks: context and environment observations condition the model, while generated action tokens carry supervised weights or RL advantages. This design enables multi-LoRA SFT/RL training in which many users, tasks, or agents can share a base model while keeping adapter updates, checkpoints, and rollout snapshots isolated. We describe the system architecture, the adapter lifecycle, the service-backed snapshot handoff used by the current implementation, the backend contract for mixed-adapter rollout kernels, and the training scheduler that isolates adapter-local gradients and optimizer state. Representative validation tasks exercise single-turn, multi-turn, LoRA, and multi-agent agentic training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenTinker，一个用于训练大语言模型（LLM）智能体的开放基础设施，支持在共享执行资源上管理多个 LoRA 策略。系统围绕策略生命周期设计，统一处理监督微调（SFT）和在线强化学习（RL），通过将轨迹转换为带显式掩码的 token 序列实现数据路径一致。验证任务涵盖单轮、多轮、LoRA 和多智能体场景。
Motivation: 现代智能体工作负载混合了 SFT、在线 RL、rollout 生成、验证和多轮环境交互，但现有系统难以有效管理频繁更新的 LoRA 策略状态（优化器状态、rollout 快照、数据归属）。
Method: OpenTinker 以策略生命周期为中心：用户定义环境、智能体和学习目标，系统管理训练客户端、rollout 采样器、检查点句柄和策略版本刷新。采用统一数据路径，将轨迹转换为带上下文掩码和动作权重（监督损失或 RL 优势）的 token 序列，支持多 LoRA SFT/RL 训练。
Result: 摘要报告了代表性验证任务，涵盖单轮、多轮、LoRA 和多智能体 agentic 训练，但未给出具体量化结果。
Conclusion: OpenTinker 提供了一种分离关注点的架构，使得多个用户、任务或智能体可以共享基础模型，同时保持适配器更新、检查点和 rollout 快照的隔离。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generative Semantic Multi-Object Tracking: A Large-Scale Benchmark and an MLLM-Driven Reasoning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Semantic Multi-Object Tracking (SMOT) is evolving from purely geometric localization toward comprehensive video understanding. However, existing paradigms predominantly rely on closed-set interaction tags and fragmented perception pipelines, creating a bottleneck that prevents the full utilization of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for dynamic scenes. In this paper, we elevate SMOT from rigid classification to an open-ended generative reasoning task. To support this paradigm shift, we introduce Grand-SMOT, a large-scale benchmark featuring high-density, dual-stream narratives. This dataset explicitly decouples micro-level individual dynamics from macro-level environmental contexts, directly resolving the semantic scarcity of prior tracking datasets. Furthermore, we propose LLMTrack, a unified MLLM-driven framework for dynamic SMOT. Guided by a verifiable ``\textit{Macro-Understanding-First}'' mechanism, LLMTrack employs a Spatio-Temporal Fusion Module to compress discrete geometric trajectories into continuous semantic tokens, effectively suppressing temporal hallucinations in long-sequence tracking. Extensive experiments, utilizing a novel decoupled evaluation protocol, validate that LLMTrack achieves state-of-the-art geometric tracking robustness while delivering a qualitative leap in generative semantic reasoning. The code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/liaopan-lp/LLMTrack-GrandSMOT.

papers.title: Resource-constrained Project Scheduling with Time-of-Use Energy Tariffs and Machine States: A Logic-based Benders Decomposition Approach
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem (RCPSP) with Time-of-Use (TOU) energy tariffs and machine states, a variant of RCPSP for production scheduling, where energy price is part of the criteria and one highly energy-demanding machine can be in one of the following three states: proc, idle, or off. The problem involves scheduling all tasks, respecting precedence constraints and resource limitations, while minimizing the combination of the overall makespan and the Total Energy Cost (TEC), which varies according to the TOU tariffs, which can take negative values. We propose two novel approaches to solve it: a monolithic Constraint Programming (CP) approach and a Logic-Based Benders Decomposition (LBBD) approach. The latter combines a master problem handling the energy cost solved using Integer Linear Programming (ILP) with a subproblem handling the RCPSP, resolved using CP. Both approaches outperform the monolithic compact ILP counterpart, but the LBBD significantly outperforms the monolithic CP in most cases, especially when the makespan criterion is not included in the objective function, solving to optimality instances with up to 480 tasks. Finally, we propose a way to generalize our LBBD approach to other problems sharing similar characteristics, and applied it to various problems, such as an RCPSP with blocking times & total weighted tardiness criterion, or a flexible job shop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有分时电价和机器状态的资源受限项目调度问题（RCPSP），其中一台高能耗机器可处于加工、空闲或关机三种状态。目标是最小化总完工时间与总电费（TEC，电费可负）的加权和。提出两种方法：单一约束规划（CP）法和逻辑Benders分解（LBBD）法，后者将ILP主问题（处理电费）与CP子问题（处理调度）结合。实验表明，LBBD在大部分情况下优于CP，尤其是目标中不含完工时间时，可求解最多480个任务的最优解。还展示了LBBD可推广至其他类似问题。
Motivation: 现有RCPSP研究较少同时考虑分时电价（电费可负）和机器状态（关机可节能），需要一种能高效求解此类实际生产调度问题的方法。
Method: 提出两种方法：1）单一约束规划（CP）模型；2）逻辑Benders分解（LBBD），其中主问题为整数线性规划（ILP）处理能耗成本，子问题为约束规划（CP）处理资源约束与项目排程，并通过Benders割迭代求解。
Result: 两种方法均优于单一紧凑ILP模型；LBBD在大部分情况下显著优于CP，尤其当目标不包含完工时间时，可解最优实例规模达480个任务。
Conclusion: LBBD方法有效解决了带分时电价和机器状态的RCPSP，并且可推广至其他具有相似结构的调度问题（如含阻塞时间和总加权拖期的RCPSP、柔性作业车间）。

papers.title: Higher order PCA-like rotation-invariant features for detailed shape descriptors modulo rotation
papers.abstract_en: PCA can be used for rotation invariant features, describing a shape with its $p_{ab}=E[(x_i-E[x_a])(x_b-E[x_b])]$ covariance matrix approximating shape by ellipsoid, allowing for rotation invariants like its traces of powers. However, real shapes are usually much more complicated, hence there is proposed its extension to e.g. $p_{abc}=E[(x_a-E[x_a])(x_b-E[x_b])(x_c-E[x_c])]$ order-3 or higher tensors describing central moments, or polynomial times Gaussian allowing decodable shape descriptors of arbitrarily high accuracy, and their analogous rotation invariants. Its practical applications could be rotation-invariant features to include shape modulo rotation e.g. for molecular shape descriptors, or for up to rotation object recognition in 2D images/3D scans maybe also for 3D scene understanding, or shape similarity metric allowing inexpensive comparison of objects modulo rotation avoiding costly optimization over rotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将PCA扩展到高阶张量（如三阶中心矩）或多项式乘以高斯函数，以生成旋转不变的形状描述符，可达到任意高精度，适用于分子形状描述、2D/3D图像中旋转不变对象识别及形状相似性度量。
Motivation: 传统PCA仅用协方差矩阵（二阶矩）近似形状为椭球，无法描述真实形状的复杂度，因此需要高阶张量以捕获更精细的细节。
Method: 提出使用高阶中心矩张量（如三阶p_{abc}）或多项式乘以高斯函数，并构建相应的旋转不变量特征。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称可达到任意高精度的可解码形状描述符。
Conclusion: 该方法可用于旋转不变特征，包括形状模旋转的描述，如分子形状描述、2D/3D图像识别和形状相似性度量，避免昂贵的旋转优化。

papers.title: TexTailor: Inference-Time Textual Guidance Tailoring for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs of transformer-based diffusion models, particularly with Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MMDiT) driven models like FLUX and Qwen Image, have facilitated thrilling experiences in visual generation. However, these models rely only on the interactions between textual conditions and visual features to produce semantically aligned images. Once the interactions fail to reflect the nuanced compositional structure of the prompt, the generated images might be unsatisfactory. Thus, a comprehensive understanding of how different blocks and their interactions with textual conditions is crucial for better understanding the intrinsic attributes and for enhancing their interactions accordingly to strengthen the prompts adherence. In this paper, we first develop a systematic pipeline to comprehensively investigate each block's functionality by \textit{removing}, \textit{disabling}, and \textit{enhancing} textual hidden-states at corresponding blocks. Our analysis reveals that 1) semantic information appears in earlier blocks and finer details are rendered in later blocks, 2) removing specific blocks is usually less disruptive than disabling text conditions, and 3) enhancing textual conditions in selective blocks improves semantic attributes. Building on these observations, we propose \method, a novel inference-time method for tailoring block-wise textual guidance. Our approach not only improves text-image alignment but also enables a range of downstream applications, including precise editing and inference acceleration. Extensive experiments demonstrated that our method outperforms various baselines and remains flexible across text-to-image generation, image editing, and inference acceleration. Our method improves T2I-Combench from 56.92\% to 63.00\% and GenEval from 66.42\% to 71.63\% on SD3.5, without sacrificing synthesis quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了多模态扩散变换器（MMDiT）中不同块的功能及其与文本条件的交互，发现语义信息出现在早期块而细节在后期块，且增强选择性块的文本条件可改善语义属性。基于此提出TexTailor，一种推理时逐块文本指导微调方法，在SD3.5上将T2I-Combench从56.92%提升至63.00%，GenEval从66.42%提升至71.63%，同时支持图像编辑和推理加速。
Motivation: 当前多模态扩散变换器依赖文本条件与视觉特征的交互生成图像，但交互可能未能反映提示的细致结构，导致语义对齐不佳。需要深入理解各块的功能以针对性地增强文本-图像对齐。
Method: 首先通过移除、禁用和增强对应块的文本隐状态，系统性地揭示各块功能。发现语义信息在早期块出现，细节在后期块渲染；禁用文本条件比移除块更具破坏性；增强选择性块的文本条件可改善语义属性。基于这些观察，提出TexTailor，一种推理时方法，逐块调整文本指导强度。
Result: 在SD3.5上，TexTailor将T2I-Combench从56.92%提升至63.00%，GenEval从66.42%提升至71.63%，且不牺牲合成质量。此外，该方法支持精确编辑和推理加速，在多个下游任务中优于基线。
Conclusion: TexTailor通过推理时逐块文本指导微调，有效提升文本-图像对齐，并在图像编辑和推理加速等任务中展现灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gradient Descent as Implicit EM in Distance-Based Neural Models
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks trained with standard objectives exhibit behaviors characteristic of probabilistic inference: soft clustering, prototype specialization, and Bayesian uncertainty tracking. These phenomena appear across architectures -- in attention mechanisms, classification heads, and energy-based models -- yet existing explanations often rely on loose analogies to mixture models or post-hoc architectural interpretation. We provide a direct explanation. For any objective with log-sum-exp structure over distances or energies, the gradient with respect to each distance is exactly the negative posterior responsibility of the corresponding component: $\partial L / \partial d_j = -r_j$. The identity is algebraic, requiring only differentiability; it is a specialization of Fisher's identity, and its significance here is its address: standard neural objectives instantiate it without modification. The consequence is that gradient descent on such objectives performs generalized expectation-maximization implicitly, with responsibilities arising as gradients to be applied rather than auxiliary variables to be computed. This result unifies three regimes of learning: unsupervised mixture modeling, where responsibilities are fully latent; attention, where responsibilities are conditioned on queries; and cross-entropy classification, where supervision clamps responsibilities to targets. Our claims live at training time: the responsibility-weighted gradient dynamics recently documented in transformers follow from the objective's geometry. The in-context Bayesian computation that trained transformers perform at inference time is the endpoint of these dynamics, not their per-step content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出，对于任何具有log-sum-exp结构的目标函数（基于距离或能量），梯度下降隐式执行了广义期望最大化（EM），因为每个距离的梯度等于对应成分的负后验责任。这一恒等式源自Fisher恒等式，无需修改标准神经目标函数。结果表明，学习过程中的责任加权梯度动力学是概率推断的一种形式。
Motivation: 神经网络在标准目标下表现出概率推断的行为（如软聚类、原型特化），但现有解释依赖于与混合模型的松散类比或后验架构解释。本文旨在提供直接的理论解释。
Method: 作者从代数上证明，对于具有log-sum-exp结构的目标函数，距离的梯度等于负后验责任。将此视为Fisher恒等式的特化，并指出梯度下降隐式执行了广义EM。统一了无监督混合建模、注意力机制和交叉熵分类三种学习范式。
Result: 证明标准神经目标函数无需修改即可实现隐式EM，梯度就是责任，而不是需要计算的辅助变量。这解释了最近在transformer中观察到的责任加权梯度动力学。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该结果统一了多种学习范式，并且训练时的责任加权梯度动力学是transformer中上下文贝叶斯计算的基础，而非每一步的内容。

papers.title: EvoXplain: When Machine Learning Models Agree on Predictions but Disagree on Why -- Measuring Mechanistic Multiplicity Across Training Runs
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are primarily judged by predictive performance, especially in applied genomics, where explanations are read as biological findings. In practice, reported gene panels are stabilised by averaging, ranking, or taking consensus over the many models a pipeline produces across cross-validation folds, tuning grids, and repeated runs. This raises an overlooked question: when two models achieve high accuracy, do they rely on the same internal logic, or reach the same outcome via different mechanisms? We introduce EvoXplain, a diagnostic framework that measures whether a pipeline's explanation is uniquely determined across repeated training and model selection. Rather than analysing a single trained model, EvoXplain treats explanations as samples drawn from the training and model selection pipeline itself, without aggregating predictions or constructing ensembles, and examines whether they form a single coherent explanatory basin or separate into multiple structured basins. We evaluate EvoXplain on a TCGA pan-cancer cohort and a within-cancer breast-cancer subtype task, using elastic-net Logistic Regression and gradient-boosted trees. Although all models reach about 98% accuracy, explanation structure differs across pipelines. Holding the data split fixed and varying only the regularisation strength, equally accurate Logistic Regression models separate into a few discrete, reproducible basins that recur across 100 data splits and carry distinct biological content, while the gradient-boosted pipeline converges to one basin. The same multiplicity appears within a single cancer subtype, from the ordinary tuning step alone. EvoXplain makes explanatory structure visible, revealing when an averaged consensus corresponds to no single trained model, and reframes interpretability as a property of the training pipeline rather than of any single model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EvoXplain框架，用于测量机器学习训练管道中解释的唯一性。在TCGA泛癌数据上，弹性网逻辑回归和梯度提升树均达到约98%准确率，但逻辑回归的解释结构出现多个离散可复现的盆地，而梯度提升树收敛到一个盆地。框架揭示了平均共识可能不代表任何单个训练模型。
Motivation: 机器学习模型通常依据预测性能评判，但在基因组学应用中，相同预测性能的模型可能依赖不同内部逻辑，而现有方法忽略了解释的多重性。
Method: EvoXplain将解释视为从训练和模型选择管道中采样的样本，通过分析它们是否形成单一解释盆地或多个结构化盆地来诊断解释的唯一性，而不聚合预测或构建集成。
Result: 在TCGA泛癌和乳腺癌亚型任务中，弹性网逻辑回归模型在固定数据分割、仅改变正则化强度时出现多个离散可复现的盆地，而梯度提升树管道收敛到一个盆地；所有模型均达到约98%准确率。
Conclusion: EvoXplain使解释结构可见，揭示平均共识可能不代表任何单个训练模型，并将可解释性重新定义为训练管道的属性而非单个模型。

papers.title: TokSuite: Measuring the Impact of Tokenizer Choice on Language Model Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Tokenizers provide the fundamental basis through which text is represented and processed by language models (LMs). Despite the importance of tokenization, its role in LM performance and behavior is poorly understood due to the challenge of measuring the impact of tokenization in isolation. To address this need, we present TokSuite, a collection of models and a benchmark that supports research into tokenization's influence on LMs. Specifically, we release fourteen pre-trained models that use different off-the-shelf tokenizers but are otherwise identical, using the same architecture, dataset, training budget, and initialization. We also release a multilingual robustness benchmark that measures model performance under real-world perturbations in English, Chinese, Farsi, Italian, and Turkish, curated by native annotators. Together, TokSuite allows robust decoupling of the influence of a model's tokenizer, supporting a series of novel findings that elucidate the respective benefits and shortcomings of a wide range of popular tokenizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 TokSuite，一组包含14个预训练语言模型的集合和一个多语言鲁棒性基准，这些模型使用不同的现成分词器但在架构、数据集、训练预算和初始化上完全相同。通过解耦分词器的影响，揭示了各种流行分词器的优缺点。
Motivation: 分词器是语言模型处理文本的基础，但其对模型性能和行为的影响因难以隔离测量而理解不足。
Method: 构建14个仅分词器不同的同质预训练模型，并发布一个包含英语、中文、波斯语、意大利语和土耳其语真实世界扰动的多语言鲁棒性基准。
Result: 通过TokSuite，能够稳健地解耦分词器的影响，并得出一系列关于不同分词器利弊的新发现。
Conclusion: TokSuite为研究分词器对语言模型的影响提供了标准化工具和基准。

papers.title: Out-of-Distribution Detection in Molecular Complexes via Diffusion Models for Irregular Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Predictive machine learning models generally excel on in-distribution data, but their performance degrades on out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. Reliable deployment therefore requires robust OOD detection, yet this is particularly challenging for irregular 3D graphs that combine continuous geometry with categorical identities and are unordered by construction. Here, we present a probabilistic OOD detection framework for complex 3D graph data built on a diffusion model that learns a density of the training distribution in a fully unsupervised manner. A key ingredient we introduce is a unified continuous diffusion over both 3D coordinates and discrete features: categorical identities are embedded in a continuous space and trained with cross-entropy, while the corresponding diffusion score is obtained analytically via posterior-mean interpolation from predicted class probabilities. This yields a single self-consistent probability-flow ODE (PF-ODE) that produces per-sample log-likelihoods, providing a principled typicality score for distribution shift. We validate the approach on protein-ligand complexes and construct strict OOD datasets by withholding entire protein families from training. PF-ODE likelihoods identify held-out families as OOD and correlate strongly with prediction errors of an independent binding-affinity model (GEMS), enabling a priori reliability estimates on new complexes. Beyond scalar likelihoods, we show that multi-scale PF-ODE trajectory statistics - including path tortuosity, flow stiffness, and vector-field instability - provide complementary OOD information. Modeling the joint distribution of these trajectory features yields a practical, high-sensitivity detector that improves separation over likelihood-only baselines, offering a label-free OOD quantification workflow for geometric deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不规则3D图（如蛋白质-配体复合物）的分布外检测难题，提出基于扩散模型的概率框架。通过统一连续扩散处理3D坐标和离散特征，利用概率流ODE（PF-ODE）计算样本对数似然作为典型性分数。在蛋白质家族留出实验中，PF-ODE似然能识别分布外样本，并与独立结合亲和模型GEMS的预测误差强相关。此外，多尺度PF-ODE轨迹统计（路径曲折度、流刚度、向量场不稳定性）提供互补信息，联合建模提升检测性能。
Motivation: 现有分布外检测方法在兼具连续几何与离散类别、且无序的3D图数据上表现不佳，特别是蛋白质-配体复合物领域缺乏无监督、基于密度的OOD检测方案。
Method: 提出无监督扩散模型框架：将离散特征嵌入连续空间并训练交叉熵，通过预测类概率的后验均值插值解析获取扩散分数，构建统一自洽的PF-ODE生成似然分数；进一步提取多尺度轨迹统计特征进行联合建模。
Result: 在蛋白质家族留出数据集上，PF-ODE似然分数能清晰区分分布内外样本，并与GEMS模型的预测误差强相关；联合轨迹特征后，OOD检测分离度优于仅依赖似然的基线。
Conclusion: 该标签免的OOD量化流程适用于几何深度学习，尤其适用于蛋白质-配体等复杂3D图数据，但未涉及气象或其他领域。

papers.title: G3Splat: Geometrically Consistent Generalizable Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussians have become a powerful scene representation for real-time splatting and high-quality novel-view synthesis. This has motivated generalizable splatting -- methods that adapt feed-forward geometry prediction networks to produce per-pixel Gaussians from a set of images. However, most generalizable splatting pipelines are supervised primarily through a view-synthesis loss to predict Gaussian orientation, anisotropic scale, opacity, and appearance in addition to their locations. We show that this learning objective is under-constrained. Models trained with view synthesis alone produce splats whose orientations and scales have no geometric connotation. The result is that, while producing decent view-synthesis performance, nearly all generalizable splatting methods produce geometrically inaccurate and misaligned Gaussians. We introduce G3Splat, a geometry-consistent generalizable splatting framework that addresses these degeneracies through differentiable geometric priors on the predicted 3D Gaussians, making the learning problem well-posed. These priors encourage the per-pixel splats to remain on their viewing rays and to orient themselves in accordance with local surfaces. Our priors are architecture-agnostic and can be incorporated into any previously studied geometric backbone for generalizable splatting, as well as different scene representations. We test G3Splat with both DUSt3R-style and VGGT-style backbones to predict pixel-aligned full-rank 3DGS as well as surfel-like 2DGS. Trained on RE10K, G3Splat produces Gaussian splats with significantly higher geometric fidelity than baselines, providing state-of-the-art novel-view depth, mesh reconstruction, and relative pose estimation performance while preserving novel-view synthesis quality, as evaluated on datasets such as ACID and ScanNet. Code and pretrained models are released on our project page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G3Splat，一种几何一致的可泛化高斯溅射框架。针对现有方法仅依赖视图合成损失导致高斯几何不一致的问题，引入可微几何先验（约束高斯位于射线上并朝向局部表面），使学习问题良态。该先验与架构无关，可集成到 DUSt3R 或 VGGT 等骨干中。在 RE10K 上训练后，G3Splat 在 ACID 和 ScanNet 上实现新视图深度、网格重建和相对位姿估计的 SOTA 性能，同时保持视图合成质量。
Motivation: 现有可泛化高斯溅射方法主要使用视图合成损失进行监督，但该目标欠约束，导致预测的高斯方向和尺度缺乏几何意义，产生几何不准确且错位的高斯。
Method: 提出可微几何先验：迫使每个像素的高斯停留在其视线上并朝向局部表面方向。该先验与架构无关，可嵌入任何几何骨干（如 DUSt3R 或 VGGT）以及不同场景表示（如 3DGS 或 surfel-like 2DGS）。
Result: 在 RE10K 上训练后，G3Splat 产生比基线几何保真度显著更高的高斯模型，在 ACID 和 ScanNet 数据集上取得了新视图深度、网格重建和相对位姿估计的 SOTA 结果，同时保持了视图合成质量。
Conclusion: 可微几何先验有效解决了可泛化溅射中的几何退化问题，使得学习问题良态，并能推广到不同骨干和表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Global universal approximation with Brownian signatures
papers.abstract_en: We establish $L^p$-universal approximation theorems for general path-dependent and non-anticipative functionals on suitable rough path spaces, showing that linear functionals acting on signatures of time-extended rough paths are dense with respect to the $L^p$-distance. To that end, we derive global universal approximation theorems for weighted rough path spaces. We demonstrate that these $L^p$-universal approximation theorems apply to Gaussian processes, in particular, to fractional Brownian motion. As a consequence, linear functionals on the signature of the time-extended Brownian motion can approximate any $p$-integrable stochastic process adapted to the Brownian filtration, including solutions to stochastic differential equations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在粗糙路径空间上建立了路径依赖和非预期泛函的L^p通用逼近定理，证明线性泛函作用于时间扩展粗糙路径的签名（signature）在L^p距离下稠密。进而推导了加权粗糙路径空间的全局逼近定理，并应用于高斯过程（如分数布朗运动），表明线性泛函作用于时间扩展布朗运动的签名可以逼近任何适应于布朗滤子的p-可积随机过程，包括随机微分方程的解。
Motivation: 现有通用逼近定理多针对有限维或特定结构泛函，缺乏适用于路径依赖和非预期泛函的全局L^p逼近结果。
Method: 利用粗糙路径理论中的签名（signature）概念，通过时间扩展将原始路径转化为粗糙路径，然后证明线性泛函在签名空间上的L^p稠密性。
Result: 建立了一类加权粗糙路径空间上的全局L^p通用逼近定理，并证明该定理适用于分数布朗运动等高斯过程，进而推出布朗运动签名线性泛函可逼近任何适应于布朗滤子的p-可积随机过程。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了粗糙路径签名在泛函逼近上的普适性，为随机分析中的路径依赖泛函表示提供了理论支撑。

papers.title: Adaptive Partitioning and Learning for Stochastic Control of Diffusion Processes
papers.abstract_en: We study reinforcement learning for controlled diffusion processes with unbounded continuous state spaces, bounded continuous actions, and polynomially growing rewards: settings that arise naturally in finance, economics, and operations research. To overcome the challenges of continuous and high-dimensional domains, we introduce a model-based algorithm that adaptively partitions the joint state-action space. The algorithm maintains estimators of drift, volatility, and rewards within each partition, refining the discretization whenever estimation bias exceeds statistical confidence. This adaptive scheme balances exploration and approximation, enabling efficient learning in unbounded domains. Our analysis establishes regret bounds that depend on the problem horizon, state dimension, reward growth order, and a newly defined notion of zooming dimension tailored to unbounded diffusion processes. The bounds recover existing results for bounded settings as a special case, while extending theoretical guarantees to a broader class of diffusion-type problems. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of our approach through numerical experiments, including applications to high-dimensional problems such as multi-asset mean-variance portfolio selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具有无界连续状态空间、有界连续动作和多项式增长奖励的受控扩散过程，提出一种基于模型的自适应分区强化学习算法。算法在每个分区内维护漂移、波动率和奖励的估计，并在估计偏差超过统计置信度时细化离散化，平衡探索与近似。理论分析建立了依赖于时间范围、状态维度、奖励增长阶数和针对无界扩散过程新定义的缩放维度的遗憾界，数值实验包括多资产均值-方差组合选择等高维问题。
Motivation: 连续高维状态-动作空间的无界扩散过程在金融、经济和运筹学中广泛存在，但现有强化学习方法难以有效处理这类问题。
Method: 提出自适应划分算法，动态维护漂移、波动率和奖励的局部估计，当估计偏差超过置信度时细化分区，实现探索与近似的平衡。
Result: 建立了包含新定义缩放维度的遗憾界，覆盖有界情形作为特例，并通过数值实验验证了效果。
Conclusion: 该方法为无界扩散过程的自适应控制提供了理论保证和实用算法。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为无界扩散过程的自适应控制提供了理论保证和实用算法。

papers.title: AnchorDream: Repurposing Video Diffusion for Embodiment-Aware Robot Data Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: The collection of large-scale and diverse robot demonstrations remains a major bottleneck for imitation learning, as real-world data acquisition is costly and simulators offer limited diversity and fidelity with pronounced sim-to-real gaps. While generative models present an attractive solution, existing methods often alter only visual appearances without creating new behaviors, or suffer from embodiment inconsistencies that yield implausible motions. To address these limitations, we introduce AnchorDream, an embodiment-aware world model that repurposes pretrained video diffusion models for robot data synthesis. AnchorDream conditions the diffusion process on robot motion renderings, anchoring the embodiment to prevent hallucination while synthesizing objects and environments consistent with the robot's kinematics. Starting from only a handful of human teleoperation demonstrations, our method scales them into large, diverse, high-quality datasets without requiring explicit environment modeling. Experiments show that the generated data leads to consistent improvements in downstream policy learning, with relative gains of 36.4% in simulator benchmarks and nearly double performance in real-world studies. These results suggest that grounding generative world models in robot motion provides a practical path toward scaling imitation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnchorDream，一种利用预训练视频扩散模型生成机器人演示数据的方法。该方法以机器人运动渲染为条件，生成与机器人运动学一致的对象和环境，无需显式环境建模。实验表明，生成的数据在下游策略学习中带来相对 36.4% 的提升，并显著改善真实世界表现。
Motivation: 机器人模仿学习受限于大规模多样化演示数据的获取成本高、模拟器多样性有限且存在 sim-to-real 差距。现有生成方法或仅改变外观而不产生新行为，或存在运动不一致问题。
Method: AnchorDream 是一个具身感知世界模型，通过将视频扩散模型条件化为机器人运动渲染（embodiment-aware conditioning），锚定机器人实体以防止幻觉，同时合成与机器人运动学一致的对象和环境。仅需少量人类遥操作演示即可扩展为大规模数据集。
Result: 摘要报告生成数据在模拟基准测试中带来 36.4% 的相对提升，在真实世界研究中性能几乎翻倍，表明该方法有效提升下游策略学习。
Conclusion: 将生成世界模型基于机器人运动进行接地（grounding）为规模化模仿学习提供了实用路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Developing an LLM-Based Feedback System Grounded in Evidence-Centered Design to Support Physics Problem Solving
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI offers new opportunities for individualized and adaptive learning, e.g., through large language model (LLM)-based feedback systems. While LLMs can produce factually correct feedback for relatively straightforward conceptual tasks, delivering high-quality feedback for tasks that require advanced domain expertise, such as physics problem solving, remains a substantial challenge. This study presents the design and implementation of an LLM-based feedback system for physics problem solving grounded in evidence-centered design and reports a first evaluation within the German Physics Olympiad. Participants rated the usefulness and correctness of the generated feedback for each implemented problem. The collected ratings indicate that the feedback was generally perceived as useful and highly correct. However, an in-depth analysis revealed that the feedback contained errors in 20% of cases; errors that often went unnoticed by the students. We discuss the risks associated with uncritical reliance on LLM-based feedback and outline potential directions for generating more adaptive and reliable LLM-based feedback in the future.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于证据中心设计（evidence-centered design）开发了一个LLM驱动的反馈系统，用于物理问题解答，并在德国物理奥林匹克竞赛中进行了初步评估。参与者认为反馈通常有用且正确，但深入分析发现20%的案例存在错误，且学生常未察觉。
Motivation: LLM在简单概念任务上能生成正确反馈，但在需要高级领域专长的物理问题求解中难以保证质量，缺乏基于证据的设计和评估。
Method: 采用证据中心设计框架，针对物理奥林匹克竞赛问题构建LLM反馈系统，并收集学生对反馈有用性和正确性的评分。
Result: 反馈被普遍认为有用且高度正确，但20%的案例存在错误，且学生往往未注意到这些错误。
Conclusion: LLM反馈存在被学生盲目信赖的风险，未来需提高反馈的适应性和可靠性。
