papers.title: CLARITY: Medical World Model for Guiding Treatment Decisions by Modeling Context-Aware Disease Trajectories in Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Clinical decision-making in oncology requires predicting dynamic disease evolution, a task current static AI predictors cannot perform. While world models (WMs) offer a paradigm for generative prediction, existing medical applications remain limited. Existing methods often rely on stochastic diffusion models, focusing on visual reconstruction rather than causal, physiological transitions. Furthermore, in medical domain, models like MeWM typically ignore patient-specific temporal and clinical contexts and lack a feedback mechanism to link predictions to treatment decisions. To address these gaps, we introduce CLARITY, a medical world model that forecasts disease evolution directly within a structured latent space. It explicitly integrates time intervals (temporal context) and patient-specific data (clinical context) to model treatment-conditioned progression as a smooth, interpretable trajectory, and thus generate physiologically faithful, individualized treatment plans. Finally, CLARITY introduces a novel prediction-to-decision framework, translating latent rollouts into transparent, actionable recommendations. CLARITY demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in treatment planning. On the MU-Glioma-Post dataset, our approach outperforms recent MeWM by 12\%, and significantly surpasses all other medical-specific large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLARITY 是一个医学世界模型（world model），在结构化潜在空间中预测疾病演化轨迹，用于指导治疗决策。它显式整合时间间隔（temporal context）和患者特定数据（clinical context），建模治疗条件下的疾病进展，并引入预测到决策的框架，将潜在 rollout 转换为可解释的治疗建议。在 MU-Glioma-Post 数据集上，CLARITY 相比 MeWM 提升 12%，并显著超越其他医学大语言模型。
Motivation: 现有临床决策中的 AI 预测器是静态的，无法预测动态疾病演化；而已有的医学世界模型（如 MeWM）忽略了患者特定的时间和临床上下文，且缺乏将预测关联到治疗决策的反馈机制。
Method: CLARITY 在结构化潜在空间中预测疾病演化，通过编码时间间隔（temporal context）和患者临床上下文，将治疗条件下的进展建模为平滑、可解释的轨迹，并利用潜在 rollout 生成个性化治疗计划。
Result: 在 MU-Glioma-Post 数据集上，CLARITY 治疗规划性能超过 MeWM 12%，并显著优于其他医学专用大语言模型。
Conclusion: CLARITY 展示了世界模型在医疗决策中的潜力，通过上下文感知的潜在空间轨迹生成生理上可信的个性化治疗方案，并提供了从预测到决策的透明框架。

papers.title: InverseCrafter: Efficient Video ReCapture as a Latent Domain Inverse Problem
papers.abstract_en: Recent approaches in controllable novel view video generation often rely on fine-tuning pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs). This dominant paradigm is computationally expensive and frequently suffers from catastrophic forgetting of the model's original generative priors. To address this challenge, here we propose InverseCrafter, a VDM training-free framework that reformulates novel view video generation as an inpainting-based inverse problem in the latent space, eliminating the need for any annotated 4D training data. The core of our method is to establish operator equivalence by employing a lightweight latent mask encoder to define a latent-domain masking operation via a continuous, multi-channel representation. This principled representation faithfully models the forward process in the latent domain, enabling efficient, backpropagation-free solvers while bypassing the costly bottleneck of repeated VAE operations. InverseCrafter achieves high-fidelity, spatio-temporally coherent novel view synthesis with near-zero additional inference overhead and excels at general-purpose video inpainting and editing by fully preserving the pre-trained VDM's generative capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出InverseCrafter，一种无需训练的视频新视角生成框架，将问题转化为潜在空间中的修补逆问题。通过轻量潜在掩码编码器定义连续多通道表示的掩码操作，避免了重复VAE操作，实现高效、无反向传播的求解。在保持预训练VDM生成能力的同时，实现高质量、时空一致的新视角合成，并适用于通用视频修补和编辑。
Motivation: 现有可控新视角视频生成依赖微调预训练视频扩散模型（VDM），计算昂贵且易导致灾难性遗忘。本文旨在解决这一挑战。
Method: 提出InverseCrafter，基于修补的逆问题框架，无需VDM训练或标注的4D数据。核心是使用轻量潜在掩码编码器定义潜在域掩码操作（连续多通道表示），实现前向过程建模，无需反向传播和重复VAE运算。
Result: 实现近零额外推理开销的高保真、时空一致新视角合成，并完全保留预训练VDM的生成能力，在通用视频修补和编辑中表现优异。
Conclusion: 本文证明潜在域逆问题方法可有效替代微调范式，实现高效视频重捕获和编辑。

papers.title: Turbo-Muon: Almost-Orthogonal Pre-Conditioning for Fast Muon Updates
papers.abstract_en: Orthogonality-based optimizers, such as Muon, have recently shown strong performance across large-scale training and community-driven efficiency challenges. However, these methods rely on a costly gradient orthogonalization step. Even efficient iterative approximations such as Newton-Schulz remain expensive, typically requiring dozens of matrix multiplications to converge. We introduce a pre-conditioning procedure that improves the initialization of the Newton--Schulz iterations while incurring negligible overhead. Furthermore, our pre-conditioning reduces the initial polar error and enables the removal of one Newton-Schulz iteration (out of the five iterations usually used in practice). The resulting implementation significantly reduces Muon's overhead. At the end-to-end training level, we observe consistent runtime improvements across speed-run and standard benchmarks, including $\sim$3% reductions in training time on multiple fast training benchmarks, while matching reference performance on both language and vision tasks. Crucially, these improvements require no hyperparameter tuning and can be adopted as a simple drop-in replacement. Beyond empirical gains, we provide theoretical insight into the geometry of the update and its potential robustness against feature collapse. Our code is publicly available on github, in optax and huggingface kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种预条件方法（Turbo-Muon），通过改进Newton-Schulz迭代的初始化来加速Muon优化器中的梯度正交化步骤，从而减少一次迭代（从5次降至4次）并降低计算开销。在多个快速训练基准上观察到约3%的训练时间减少，同时在语言和视觉任务上保持参考性能，且无需超参数调整。论文还提供了关于更新几何结构及其对抗特征崩溃鲁棒性的理论见解。
Motivation: 正交优化器（如Muon）依赖昂贵的梯度正交化步骤，即使使用迭代近似（如Newton-Schulz）仍需多次矩阵乘法，导致训练开销较大。
Method: 引入一种预条件处理，改进Newton-Schulz迭代的初始估计，以几乎为零的额外开销实现更快的收敛，从而允许移除一次迭代（通常使用五次，现减为四次）。
Result: 在多个快速训练基准上实现约3%的训练时间缩减，在语言和视觉任务上匹配参考性能，且无需超参数调整，可即插即用。
Conclusion: 该预条件方法能够显著降低Muon优化器的计算开销，同时保持性能，并提供理论上的几何洞察，表明更新对特征崩溃具有鲁棒性。代码已在GitHub、optax和huggingface内核中公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Z-Image: An Efficient Image Generation Foundation Model with Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract_en: The landscape of high-performance image generation models is currently dominated by proprietary systems, such as Nano Banana Pro and Seedream 4.0. Leading open-source alternatives, including Qwen-Image, Hunyuan-Image-3.0 and FLUX.2, are characterized by massive parameter counts (20B to 80B), making them impractical for inference, and fine-tuning on consumer-grade hardware. To address this gap, we propose Z-Image, an efficient 6B-parameter foundation generative model built upon a Scalable Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer (S3-DiT) architecture that challenges the "scale-at-all-costs" paradigm. By systematically optimizing the entire model lifecycle -- from a curated data infrastructure to a streamlined training curriculum -- we complete the full training workflow in just 314K H800 GPU hours (approx. $630K). Our few-step distillation scheme with reward post-training further yields Z-Image-Turbo, offering both sub-second inference latency on an enterprise-grade H800 GPU and compatibility with consumer-grade hardware (<16GB VRAM). Additionally, our omni-pre-training paradigm also enables efficient training of Z-Image-Edit, an editing model with impressive instruction-following capabilities. Both qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our model achieves performance comparable to or surpassing that of leading competitors across various dimensions. Most notably, Z-Image exhibits exceptional capabilities in photorealistic image generation and bilingual text rendering, delivering results that rival top-tier commercial models, thereby demonstrating that state-of-the-art results are achievable with significantly reduced computational overhead. We publicly release our code, weights, and online demo to foster the development of accessible, budget-friendly, yet state-of-the-art generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Z-Image 是一个 6B 参数的高效图像生成基础模型，采用可扩展单流扩散变压器 (S3-DiT) 架构，挑战“无缩放不模型”范式。通过优化数据基础设施和训练课程，仅用 314K H800 GPU 小时完成训练。其蒸馏版本 Z-Image-Turbo 可在企业级 H800 GPU 上实现亚秒级推理，并兼容消费级硬件（<16GB VRAM）。实验表明，Z-Image 在逼真图像生成和双语文本渲染方面达到或超越领先的商业模型。
Motivation: 当前高性能图像生成模型多为闭源系统，开源模型参数量巨大（20B-80B），在消费级硬件上难以推理和微调。Z-Image 旨在以显著降低的计算开销实现最先进性能，使高质量生成模型更易获取。
Method: 提出可扩展单流扩散变压器 (Scalable Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer, S3-DiT) 架构，系统优化模型全生命周期，包括精心策划的数据基础设施和精简的训练课程。采用几步蒸馏方案结合奖励后训练，得到 Z-Image-Turbo；同时通过全预训练范式支持 Z-Image-Edit 编辑模型。
Result: Z-Image 在多种维度上达到或超越领先竞品，尤其在逼真图像生成和双语文本渲染方面与顶级商业模型相当。训练总成本约 314K H800 GPU 小时（约 63 万美元），Z-Image-Turbo 推理延迟亚秒级且适配消费级硬件。

papers.title: Exploring the Rashomon Set for Concept-Based Models
papers.abstract_en: In many machine learning problems, there may exist multiple models that achieve nearly identical predictive performance while relying on fundamentally different internal logic. However, standard training procedures produce a single model, offering no practical way to explore alternatives that may better suit downstream needs. The set of these equally accurate models is known as the Rashomon set. Exploring the Rashomon set is particularly challenging in large and complex hypothesis spaces, such as Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs), which are widely used in computer vision to make predictions through intermediate, human-understandable concepts. In this paper, we provide a method for efficiently exploring the Rashomon set of CBMs. Our framework introduces a specialized parallel adapter-based construction, combined with a checkpointing scheme and a concept diversity objective, to generate multiple equally accurate CBMs from a single training process. Empirical results show that our method finds models with better diversity than baselines while using much less memory. We further demonstrate that access to these diverse yet accurate CBMs enables trustworthy model selection, resolution of inter-class confusion, and reliable abstention in decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种高效探索概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的Rashomon集合的方法，通过并行适配器、检查点机制和概念多样性目标，从单次训练中生成多个等精度但内部逻辑不同的CBM。实验表明该方法在保持多样性同时节省内存，并支持可信模型选择、类间混淆解决和可靠弃权。
Motivation: 许多机器学习问题中存在多个等精度但逻辑不同的模型，标准训练只产生一个模型，无法探索适合下游需求的替代方案，而CBM的假设空间大且复杂，探索其Rashomon集合尤为困难。
Method: 提出一个框架，引入专门设计的并行适配器，结合检查点（checkpointing）和概念多样性目标，在单次训练中生成多个等精度的CBM。
Result: 实验表明该方法在比基线更好的多样性和更少内存使用下找到模型，并且访问这些多样且准确的CBM能够实现可信模型选择、解决类间混淆和可靠弃权。
Conclusion: 该方法有效地探索了CBM的Rashomon集合，提供了实用工具。

papers.title: Do Flat Minima Improve Sparse Novel View Synthesis?
papers.abstract_en: Despite the success of recent novel view synthesis methods, they tend to struggle in sparse-view settings. This poor generalization to unseen viewpoints is an inherent challenge when training with limited data. To address this, we investigate the relationship between loss sharpness and generalization in novel view synthesis-an underexplored direction. Interestingly, while pursuing flatter minima is widely known to improve generalization in deep learning, reducing loss sharpness is not always beneficial in novel view synthesis. We demonstrate that this difference arises because high-detail regions inherently require a sharp loss landscape for accurate reconstruction, whereas low-detail regions benefit from a flat loss landscape for improving generalization. Based on this insight, we introduce structure-aware sharpness, defined within structure-adaptive neighborhoods, and propose to adaptively adjust the sharpness regularization weight according to the local image structure. This strategy encourages flatter minima for generalization while preserving the loss sharpness necessary to reconstruct fine details. Across various datasets and configurations, our strategy consistently improves a wide range of baselines. Code is available at https://bbangsik13.github.io/FASR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究损失锐度与稀疏新视图合成中泛化性能的关系。发现对于高细节区域需要尖锐的损失景观才能准确重建，而低细节区域平坦的损失景观有助于泛化。基于此提出结构感知锐度（structure-aware sharpness），在结构自适应邻域内定义，并自适应调整锐度正则化权重，平衡细节保留与泛化。在多个数据集和配置下显著提升基线模型性能。
Motivation: 稀疏视角设置下新视图合成泛化能力差，现有研究未系统探索损失锐度与泛化的关系。需要理解何时平坦最小值有益、何时有害。
Method: 提出结构感知锐度，在结构自适应邻域内计算损失锐度，并根据局部图像结构自适应调整锐度正则化权重。在训练中鼓励平坦最小值以提升泛化，同时在高细节区域保持损失锐度以重建细节。
Result: 在多个数据集和配置下，该方法一致地提升多种基线模型的性能。
Conclusion: 损失锐度的作用在稀疏新视图合成中是非平凡的；高细节区域需要尖锐景观，低细节区域需要平坦景观。自适应锐度正则化是有效的策略。

papers.title: Equivalence of Context and Parameter Updates in Modern Transformer Blocks
papers.abstract_en: Recent research has established that the impact of context in a vanilla transformer can be represented implicitly by forming a token-dependent, rank-1 patch to its MLP weights. This work extends that foundational theory to the diverse architectures of modern Large Language Models. We first demonstrate a precise, analytical solution for a Gemma-style transformer block, proving that the entire effect of a context can be perfectly mapped to rank-1 patches on its MLP weight matrices and a patch to the RMSNorm scale. We then generalize this result, providing a constructive proof and algorithm for multi-layer models. To unify these findings, we introduce a general framework centered on two core properties: input controllability and output controllability. We prove that a perfect implicit weight patch is possible for any MLP block where the inner function is input-controllable and the outer function is output-controllable. This provides a simpler and more powerful lens for understanding how transformer models transmute prompts into effective weights. This setup generalizes to a wide range of modern LLM architectures including gating, pre-/post-norm, mixture of experts and sequential/parallel transformer blocks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，在现代 Transformer 块（如 Gemma 架构）中，上下文信息可以完全表示为 MLP 权重矩阵和 RMSNorm 尺度的秩-1 修补（rank-1 patch），并推广到门控、预/后归一化、混合专家等架构，建立了输入可控性和输出可控性的统一框架。
Motivation: 此前研究表明标准 Transformer 中上下文对 MLP 的影响可表示为隐式权重修补，但该理论尚未扩展到现代 LLM 的多样化架构。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 通过解析构造证明 Gemma 风格 Transformer 块中上下文的全部效果可映射为 MLP 权重矩阵的秩-1 修补和 RMSNorm 尺度的修补；然后针对多层模型给出构造性证明和算法；最后提出基于输入可控性和输出可控性的统一框架，证明该结果适用于包括门控、预/后归一化、混合专家和顺序/并行 Transformer 块在内的广泛架构。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但给出了理论证明和算法，并声称框架统一了多种现代 LLM 架构。
Conclusion: 本文为理解 Transformer 如何将提示转换为有效权重提供了更简单、更强大的视角，并推广到多种现代架构。

papers.title: RoMa v2: Harder Better Faster Denser Feature Matching
papers.abstract_en: Dense feature matching aims to estimate all correspondences between two images of a 3D scene and has recently been established as the gold standard due to its high accuracy and robustness. However, existing dense matchers still fail or perform poorly for many hard real-world scenarios, and high-precision models are often slow, limiting their applicability. In this paper, we attack these weaknesses on a wide front through a series of systematic improvements that together yield a significantly better model. In particular, we construct a novel matching architecture and loss, which, combined with a curated diverse training distribution, enables our model to solve many complex matching tasks. We further make training faster through a decoupled two-stage matching-then-refinement pipeline, and at the same time, significantly reduce refinement memory usage through a custom CUDA kernel. Finally, we leverage the recent DINOv3 foundation model along with multiple other insights to make the model more robust and unbiased. In our extensive set of experiments, we show that the resulting novel matcher sets a new state-of-the-art, being significantly more accurate than its predecessors. Code is available at https://github.com/Parskatt/romav2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一系列系统改进提出了RoMa v2，一种更优的密集特征匹配模型。作者构建了新的匹配架构和损失函数，结合精心筛选的多样化训练数据，使模型能解决许多复杂的匹配任务。同时采用解耦的两阶段匹配-精炼流水线加速训练，并通过自定义CUDA内核显著减少精炼阶段的内存占用。此外，利用DINOv3基础模型和其他技巧增强了模型的鲁棒性和无偏性。实验表明，该模型在多个基准上大幅超越前代，达到了新的最佳水平。
Motivation: 现有密集特征匹配方法在众多困难实际场景中仍会失败或表现不佳，且高精度模型往往速度较慢，限制了其应用范围。
Method: 构建新型匹配架构与损失函数，采用解耦的两阶段匹配后精炼流水线以提高训练速度，通过自定义CUDA内核降低精炼阶段内存消耗，并利用DINOv3基础模型及多项改进提升模型鲁棒性与无偏性。
Result: 在广泛的实验评估中，RoMa v2显著优于此前的最优方法，达到了新的最高精度。
Conclusion: 本文通过多方面的系统性改进，同时提升了密集特征匹配的精度、速度与鲁棒性，代码已开源。

papers.title: Can Stationary Distributions of Scale-Invariant Neural Networks Be Described by the Thermodynamics of an Ideal Gas?
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the training dynamics of deep neural networks remains a major open problem, with physics-inspired approaches offering promising insights. Building on this perspective, we develop a thermodynamic framework to describe the stationary distributions of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with weight decay for scale-invariant neural networks, a setting that both reflects practical architectures with normalization layers and permits theoretical analysis. We establish analogies between training hyperparameters (e.g., learning rate, weight decay) and thermodynamic variables such as temperature, pressure, and volume. Starting with a simplified isotropic noise model, we uncover a close correspondence between SGD dynamics and ideal gas behavior, validated through theory and simulation. Extending to training of neural networks, we show that key predictions of the framework, including the behavior of stationary entropy, align closely with experimental observations. This framework provides a principled foundation for interpreting training dynamics and may guide future work on hyperparameter tuning and the design of learning rate schedulers.
papers.comment: Accepted at IJCAI-ECAI 2026 (the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发展了一个热力学框架来描述带有权重衰减的随机梯度下降（SGD）在尺度不变神经网络中的平稳分布。通过将学习率、权重衰减等超参数类比为温度、压力、体积等热力学变量，发现SGD动力学与理想气体行为存在密切对应关系。实验验证了平稳熵等关键预测与观测一致，为解释训练动力学和超参数调优提供了理论基础。
Motivation: 深度神经网络的训练动力学仍是一个未解决的开放问题，物理启发的方法提供了有前景的见解。本文旨在利用热力学视角建立理论框架，以理解尺度不变神经网络中SGD的平稳分布。
Method: 建立超参数（学习率、权重衰减）与热力学变量（温度、压力、体积）之间的类比。从简化各向同性噪声模型出发，揭示SGD动力学与理想气体行为的对应关系，并通过理论和仿真验证。然后扩展到实际神经网络训练，检验框架的关键预测。
Result: 框架的关键预测（包括平稳熵的行为）与实验观测紧密吻合。验证了SGD动力学和理想气体行为之间的类比。
Conclusion: 该框架为解释训练动力学提供了原则性基础，可能指导未来的超参数调优和学习率调度器设计。

papers.title: Large Language Models Develop Novel Social Biases Through Adaptive Exploration
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are adopted into frameworks that grant them the capacity to make real decisions, it is increasingly important to ensure that they are unbiased. In this paper, we argue that the predominant approach of simply removing existing biases from models is not enough. Using a paradigm from the psychology literature, we demonstrate that LLMs can spontaneously develop novel social biases about artificial demographic groups even when no inherent differences exist. These biases result in highly stratified task allocations, which are less fair than assignments by human participants and are exacerbated in newer and larger models. In humans, emergent biases like these have been shown to result from exploration-exploitation trade-offs, where the decision-maker explores too little, allowing early observations to strongly influence impressions about entire demographic groups. To alleviate this effect, we explore a series of interventions targeting model inputs, problem structure, and explicit steering. While most interventions have limited effect, explicitly incentivizing exploration robustly reduces stratification, highlighting the need for better multifaceted objectives to mitigate bias. These results reveal that LLMs are not merely passive mirrors of human social biases, but can actively create new ones from experience, raising urgent questions about how these systems will shape societies over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明大语言模型（LLM）能够自发产生针对人工人口群体的新型社会偏见，即使群体间无内在差异。这种偏见导致高度分层的任务分配，其不公平性超过人类参与者，且在新模型和更大模型中更为严重。实验表明，鼓励探索的干预可以有效减少分层，而其他干预效果有限。
Motivation: 当前去偏见方法仅移除已有偏见，但LLM能在决策中主动创造新偏见，这构成了未被充分认识的风险。
Method: 采用心理学中的偏见范式，让LLM在模拟环境中与虚构人口群体交互，通过任务分配观察偏见涌现，并测试输入修改、问题结构调整和显式引导等干预措施。
Result: LLM产生显著的任务分层，其不公平性高于人类；鼓励探索的干预能稳健降低分层，而多数其他干预效果甚微。
Conclusion: LLM并非被动反映人类偏见，而是能通过自适应探索主动产生新偏见，需要更全面的多目标优化目标来缓解偏见。

papers.title: PuzzleMoE: Efficient Compression of Large Mixture-of-Experts Models via Sparse Expert Merging and Bit-packed inference
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have shown strong potential in scaling language models efficiently by activating only a small subset of experts per input. However, their widespread deployment remains limited due to the high memory overhead associated with storing all expert parameters, particularly as the number of experts increases. To address this challenge, prior works have explored expert dropping and merging strategies, yet they often suffer from performance drop at high compression ratios. In this paper, we introduce PuzzleMoE, a training-free MoE compression method that achieves both high accuracy and efficient inference through two key innovations: First, PuzzleMoE performs sparse expert merging by identifying element-wise weight redundancy and specialization. It uses a dual-mask to capture both shared and expert-specific parameters. Second, to avoid the overhead of storing binary masks and signs, PuzzleMoE introduces a bit-packed encoding scheme that reuses underutilized exponent bits, enabling efficient MoE inference on GPUs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PuzzleMoE can compress MoE models by up to 50% while maintaining accuracy across various tasks. Specifically, it outperforms prior MoE compression methods by up to 16.7% on MMLU at 50% compression ratio, and achieves up to 1.28\times inference speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PuzzleMoE，一种无需训练的混合专家（MoE）模型压缩方法。通过稀疏专家合并（识别元素级权重冗余和特化，使用双重掩码捕获共享和专家特定参数）和位打包编码方案（重用未充分利用的指数位），在保持精度的同时将模型压缩50%，并在MMLU上以50%压缩率比先前方法提升最多16.7%，实现最高1.28倍推理加速。
Motivation: MoE模型因存储所有专家参数导致高内存开销，限制了部署。现有专家丢弃和合并方法在高压缩比下性能下降显著。
Method: PuzzleMoE采用两个创新：1）稀疏专家合并，通过双掩码（dual-mask）识别共享和专家特定权重；2）位打包编码（bit-packed encoding），重用未利用的指数位以避免存储掩码和符号的开销。
Result: 实验表明，PuzzleMoE可将MoE模型压缩50%而保持精度，在50%压缩率下MMLU上比先前方法高16.7%，推理速度最高提升1.28倍。
Conclusion: PuzzleMoE是一种高效的训练后压缩方法，在速度和质量上均优于现有技术，适用于大规模MoE模型部署。

papers.title: Optimal-Agent-Selection: State-Aware Routing Framework for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of multi-agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) has unlocked new frontiers in complex task-solving, enabling diverse agents to integrate unique expertise, collaborate flexibly, and address challenges unattainable for individual models. However, the full potential of such systems is hindered by rigid agent scheduling and inefficient coordination strategies that fail to adapt to evolving task requirements. In this paper, we propose STRMAC, a state-aware routing framework designed for efficient collaboration in multi-agent systems. Our method separately encodes interaction history and agent knowledge to power the router, which adaptively selects the most suitable single agent at each step for efficient and effective collaboration. Furthermore, we introduce a self-evolving data generation approach that accelerates the collection of high-quality execution paths for efficient system training. Experiments on challenging collaborative reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, achieving up to 23.8% improvement over baselines and reducing data collection overhead by up to 90.1% compared to exhaustive search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STRMAC，一个面向多智能体系统的高效协作框架，通过状态感知路由机制在每一步自适应选择最合适的单个智能体，并引入自演进数据生成方法加速高质量执行路径的收集。在协作推理基准上，该方法相比基线提升高达23.8%，数据收集开销降低高达90.1%。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统存在调度僵化和协调策略低效的问题，无法适应动态任务需求，限制了系统潜力。
Method: 提出STRMAC框架，包含状态感知路由器，分别编码交互历史和智能体知识，自适应选择单智能体；同时提出自演进数据生成方法，高效收集高质量执行路径以训练系统。
Result: 在协作推理基准上达到最优性能，相比基线提升高达23.8%，数据收集开销降低高达90.1%。
Conclusion: STRMAC通过状态感知路由和自演进数据生成有效提升了多智能体协作的效率和效果。

papers.title: APEX: Approximate-but-exhaustive search for ultra-large combinatorial synthesis libraries
papers.abstract_en: Make-on-demand combinatorial synthesis libraries (CSLs) like Enamine REAL have significantly enabled drug discovery efforts. However, their large size presents a challenge for virtual screening, where the goal is to identify the top compounds in a library according to a computational objective (e.g., optimizing docking score) subject to computational constraints under a limited computational budget. For current library sizes -- numbering in the tens of billions of compounds -- and scoring functions of interest, a routine virtual screening campaign may be limited to scoring fewer than 0.1% of the available compounds, leaving potentially many high scoring compounds undiscovered. Furthermore, as constraints (and sometimes objectives) change during the course of a virtual screening campaign, existing virtual screening algorithms typically offer little room for amortization. We propose the approximate-but-exhaustive search protocol for CSLs, or APEX. APEX utilizes a neural network surrogate that exploits the structure of CSLs in the prediction of objectives and constraints to make full enumeration on a consumer GPU possible in under a minute, allowing for exact retrieval of approximate top-k sets. To demonstrate APEX's capabilities, we develop a benchmark CSL comprised of more than 10 million compounds, all of which have been annotated with their docking scores on five medically relevant targets along with physicohemical properties measured with RDKit such that, for any objective and set of constraints, the ground truth top-k compounds can be identified and compared against the retrievals from any virtual screening algorithm. We show APEX's consistently strong performance both in retrieval accuracy and runtime compared to alternative methods.
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出APEX协议，用于超大规模组合合成库（CSL）的近似但穷尽搜索。APEX利用神经网络代理模型预测目标和约束，可在消费级GPU上不到一分钟内完成全枚举，实现精确检索近似Top-k集合。作者构建了包含超过1000万化合物的基准CSL并标注了对接分数和物化性质，实验表明APEX在检索准确性和运行时间上优于替代方法。
Motivation: 当前组合合成库规模达数百亿化合物，常规虚拟筛选只能评分不到0.1%的化合物，可能遗漏大量高分化合物；且现有算法难以在不同约束和目标下重复利用计算。
Method: APEX协议利用神经网络代理模型，利用CSL的结构特性预测目标和约束，实现完整枚举并精确检索近似Top-k集合。
Result: 在包含超过1000万化合物的基准CSL上，APEX在检索准确性（与真实Top-k比较）和运行时间方面均一致优于替代方法，可在消费级GPU上不到一分钟完成全枚举。
Conclusion: APEX为超大规模组合合成库的虚拟筛选提供了一种高效且准确的近似穷尽搜索方案，适用于动态约束和目标调整的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UNDREAM: Bridging Differentiable Rendering and Photorealistic Simulation for End-to-end Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models deployed in safety critical applications like autonomous driving use simulations to test their robustness against adversarial attacks in realistic conditions. However, these simulations are non-differentiable, forcing researchers to create attacks that do not integrate simulation environmental factors, reducing attack success. To address this limitation, we introduce UNDREAM, the first software framework that bridges the gap between photorealistic simulators and differentiable renderers to enable end-to-end optimization of adversarial perturbations on any 3D objects. UNDREAM enables manipulation of the environment by offering complete control over weather, lighting, backgrounds, camera angles, trajectories, and realistic human and object movements, thereby allowing the creation of diverse scenes. We showcase a wide array of distinct physically plausible adversarial objects that UNDREAM enables researchers to swiftly explore in different configurable environments. This combination of photorealistic simulation and differentiable optimization opens new avenues for advancing research of physical adversarial attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UNDREAM 是首个连接可微分渲染 (differentiable rendering) 与逼真模拟 (photorealistic simulation) 的软件框架，支持在任意 3D 物体上端到端优化对抗扰动 (adversarial perturbations)。该框架允许完全控制天气、光照、背景、相机角度、轨迹等环境因素，从而生成多样化的场景，用于创建物理上合理的对抗性物体。
Motivation: 现有安全关键应用（如自动驾驶）中的模拟器不可微，导致对抗攻击无法整合环境因素，攻击成功率低。
Method: 提出 UNDREAM 框架，将可微分渲染器与逼真模拟器结合，实现端到端优化，支持环境参数（天气、光照等）的完全控制。
Result: 展示了多种物理上合理的对抗性物体，可在不同可配置环境中快速探索。
Conclusion: 该方法为物理对抗攻击研究开辟了新途径，但摘要未提及定量结果或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Octax: Accelerated CHIP-8 Arcade Environments for Reinforcement Learning in JAX
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) research requires diverse, challenging environments that are both tractable and scalable. While modern video games may offer rich dynamics, they are computationally expensive and poorly suited for large-scale experimentation due to their CPU-bound execution. We introduce Octax, a high-performance suite of classic arcade game environments implemented in JAX, based on CHIP-8 emulation, a predecessor to Atari, which is widely adopted as a benchmark in RL research. Octax provides the JAX community with a long-awaited end-to-end GPU alternative to Atari games, offering image-based environments, spanning puzzle, action, and strategy genres, all executable at massive scale on modern GPUs. Our JAX-based implementation achieves orders-of-magnitude speedups over traditional CPU emulators. We demonstrate Octax's capabilities by training RL agents across multiple games, showing significant improvements in training speed and scalability compared to existing solutions. The environment's modular design enables researchers to easily extend the suite with new games or generate novel environments using large language models, making it an ideal platform for large-scale RL experimentation. Our open-source framework is available at https://github.com/riiswa/octax/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Octax是一个基于JAX的CHIP-8街机游戏环境套件，专为大规模强化学习设计。它提供图像环境，涵盖解谜、动作和策略类型，并可在现代GPU上大规模执行。相比传统CPU模拟器，Octax实现了数量级的速度提升，并通过训练RL agent验证了其训练速度和可扩展性。
Motivation: 现代视频游戏在RL研究中计算昂贵且依赖CPU，不适合大规模实验。Octax旨在提供GPU加速的端到端替代方案，解决Atari等基准的规模瓶颈。
Method: 基于CHIP-8模拟的JAX实现，支持图像输入环境，模块化设计允许通过大语言模型生成新游戏或扩展现有游戏。
Result: 在多个游戏中训练RL agent，相比传统CPU模拟器，训练速度提升数个数量级，可扩展性显著增强。
Conclusion: Octax为大规模RL实验提供了一个高效、可扩展的平台，其模块化设计便于社区扩展和自动生成环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interactive Learning for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Existing multi-agent learning approaches have developed interactive training environments to explicitly promote collaboration among multiple Large Language Models (LLMs), thereby constructing stronger multi-agent systems (MAS). However, during inference, they require re-executing the MAS to obtain final solutions, which diverges from human cognition that individuals can enhance their reasoning capabilities through interactions with others and resolve questions independently in the future. To investigate whether multi-agent interaction can enhance LLMs' independent problem-solving ability, we introduce ILR, a novel co-learning framework for MAS that integrates two key components: Dynamic Interaction and Perception Calibration. Specifically, Dynamic Interaction first adaptively selects either cooperative or competitive strategies depending on question difficulty and model ability. LLMs then exchange information through Idea3, an innovative interaction paradigm designed to mimic human discussion, before deriving their respective final answers. In Perception Calibration, ILR employs Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to train LLMs while integrating one LLM's reward distribution characteristics into another's reward function, thereby enhancing the cohesion of multi-agent interactions. We evaluate the effectiveness of ILR across three LLMs from two model families of varying scales on five mathematical, one coding, one general question answering, and one scientific reasoning benchmarks. Experimental results show that ILR consistently outperforms single-agent learning, yielding an improvement of up to 5% over the strongest baseline. We further discover that Idea3 can enhance the robustness of stronger LLMs during multi-agent inference, and dynamic interaction types can boost multi-agent learning compared to pure cooperative or competitive strategies.

papers.title: Quadratic Programming Approach for Nash Equilibrium Computation in Multiplayer Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract_en: There has been significant recent progress in algorithms for approximation of Nash equilibrium in large two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games and exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer strategic-form games. While counterfactual regret minimization and fictitious play are scalable to large games and have convergence guarantees in two-player zero-sum games, they do not guarantee convergence to Nash equilibrium in multiplayer games. We present an approach for exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer imperfect-information games that solves a quadratically-constrained program based on a nonlinear complementarity problem formulation from the sequence-form game representation. This approach capitalizes on recent advances for solving nonconvex quadratic programs. Our algorithm is able to quickly solve three-player Kuhn poker after removal of dominated actions. Of the available algorithms in the Gambit software suite, only the logit quantal response approach is successfully able to solve the game; however, the approach takes longer than our algorithm and also involves a degree of approximation. Our formulation also leads to a new approach for computing Nash equilibrium in multiplayer strategic-form games which we demonstrate to outperform a previous quadratically-constrained program formulation.

TL;DR: 本文针对多人不完全信息博弈中纳什均衡的精确计算问题，提出基于序列形式和非线性互补问题的二次约束规划方法。算法在三人Kuhn扑克中快速求解，并优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有算法在多人博弈中不保证收敛到纳什均衡，而精确计算是一个挑战。
Method: 基于非线性互补问题的序列形式表示，构建二次约束规划（quadratically-constrained program），利用非凸二次规划的最新进展求解。
Result: 算法在三人Kuhn扑克中快速求解，且比Gambit软件中的logit方法更快、更精确。
Conclusion: 提供了精确计算多人不完全信息博弈纳什均衡的新途径，并衍生出多人策略形式博弈的新计算方案。

papers.title: VISOR++: Universal Visual Inputs based Steering for Large Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As Vision Language Models (VLMs) are deployed across safety-critical applications, understanding and controlling their behavioral patterns has become increasingly important. Existing behavioral control methods face significant limitations: system prompting approaches could easily be overridden by user instructions, while applying activation-based steering vectors requires invasive runtime access to model internals, precluding deployment with API-based services and closed-source models. Finding steering methods that transfer across multiple VLMs is still an open area of research. To this end, we introduce universal visual input based steering for output redirection (VISOR++), to achieve behavioral control through optimized visual inputs alone. We demonstrate that a single VISOR++ image can be generated for an ensemble of VLMs to emulate each of their steering vectors. By crafting universal visual inputs that induce target activation patterns, VISOR++ eliminates the need for runtime model access while remaining deployment-agnostic. This means that when an underlying model supports multimodal capability, model behaviors can be steered by inserting an image input replacing runtime steering vector based interventions. We first demonstrate the effectiveness of the VISOR++ images on open-access models such as LLaVA-1.5-7B and IDEFICS2-8B along three alignment directions: refusal, sycophancy and survival instinct. Both the model-specific steering images and the jointly optimized images achieve performance parity closely following that of steering vectors for both positive and negative steering tasks. We also show the promise of VISOR++ images in achieving directional behavioral shifts for unseen models including both open-access and closed-access ones. Furthermore, VISOR++ images are able to preserve 99.9% performance on 14,000 unrelated MMLU evaluation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VISOR++ 通过优化视觉输入来实现对视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的行为控制，无需运行时内部访问。该方法生成通用视觉输入图像，可模拟多个VLM的 steering vectors，在拒绝、谄媚和生存本能等对齐方向上取得与 steering vectors 相当的效果，并保持 MMLU 性能的 99.9%。
Motivation: 现有行为控制方法存在局限性：系统提示易被用户覆盖，激活 steering vectors 需要运行时内部访问，不适用于API服务和闭源模型。需要一种无需运行时访问、可跨模型迁移的通用控制方法。
Method: 提出 VISOR++，通过优化视觉输入图像来诱导目标激活模式，生成单个图像可同时应用于多个VLM，替代运行时 steering vector 干预。
Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 和 IDEFICS2-8B 上，模型特定和联合优化的 VISOR++ 图像在拒绝、谄媚和生存本能任务上达到与 steering vectors 相当的性能；在未见过的开放和封闭模型上显示出方向性行为迁移；在 14,000 个无关 MMLU 任务上保留 99.9% 性能。
Conclusion: VISOR++ 提供了一种部署无关、无需运行时内部访问的 VLM 行为控制方案，通过视觉输入实现跨模型迁移，但当前仅在有限模型和方向上验证，且需要进一步研究其通用性和潜在副作用。

papers.title: Towards a more realistic evaluation of machine learning models for bearing fault diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Reliable detection of bearing faults is essential for maintaining the safety and operational efficiency of rotating machinery. While recent advances in machine learning (ML), particularly deep learning, have shown strong performance in controlled settings, many studies fail to generalize to real-world applications due to methodological flaws, most notably data leakage. This paper investigates the issue of data leakage in vibration-based bearing fault diagnosis and its impact on model evaluation. We demonstrate that common dataset partitioning strategies, such as segment-wise and condition-wise splits, introduce spurious correlations that inflate performance metrics. To address this, we propose a rigorous, leakage-free evaluation methodology centered on bearing-wise data partitioning, ensuring no overlap between the physical components used for training and testing. Additionally, we reformulate the classification task as a multi-label problem, enabling the detection of co-occurring fault types and the use of prevalence-independent metrics based on the ROC curve. Beyond preventing leakage, we also examine the effect of dataset diversity on generalization, showing that the number of unique training bearings is a decisive factor for achieving robust performance. We evaluate our methodology on four widely adopted datasets: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU), Paderborn University (PU), University of Ottawa (UORED-VAFCLS) and Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST bearing). This study highlights the importance of leakage-aware evaluation protocols and provides practical guidelines for dataset partitioning, model selection, and validation, fostering the development of more trustworthy ML systems for industrial fault diagnosis applications.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了机器学习在轴承故障诊断中的数据泄漏问题，提出以轴承为单位的数据划分方法避免泄漏，并将分类任务重构为多标签问题以检测复合故障。在四个公开数据集上的实验表明，轴承级划分和训练轴承数量是影响泛化性能的关键因素。
Motivation: 现有轴承故障诊断的机器学习研究常因数据泄漏（如段级或工况级划分）导致性能虚高，无法泛化到实际工业场景。需要一种无泄漏的评估框架来获得可信的性能指标。
Method: 提出基于轴承单元的数据划分策略（确保训练和测试集无物理轴承重叠），并将单标签分类改为多标签分类以检测共现故障类型，同时采用基于ROC曲线的与患病率无关的评估指标。
Result: 在CWRU、PU、UORED-VAFCLS和HUST轴承四个数据集上的实验表明，传统的段级/工况级划分会因泄漏而高估性能，而轴承级划分给出了更真实的评估；训练轴承数量是决定鲁棒性能的关键因素。
Conclusion: 强调泄漏感知的评估协议对工业故障诊断的重要性，并为数据集划分、模型选择和验证提供了实用指南，以促进更可信的ML系统开发。

papers.title: Interpretable Nanoporous Materials Design with Symmetry-Aware Networks
papers.abstract_en: Nanoporous materials hold promise for diverse sustainable applications, yet their vast chemical space poses challenges for efficient design. Machine learning offers a compelling pathway to accelerate the exploration, but existing models lack either interpretability or fidelity for elucidating the correlation between crystal geometry and property. Here, we report a three-dimensional periodic space sampling method that decomposes large nanoporous structures into local geometrical sites for combined property prediction and site-wise contribution quantification. Trained with a constructed database and retrieved datasets, our model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and data efficiency for property prediction on gas storage, separation, and electrical conduction. Meanwhile, this approach enables the interpretation of the prediction and allows for accurate identification of significant local sites for targeted properties. Through identifying transferable high-performance sites across diverse nanoporous frameworks, our model paves the way for interpretable, symmetry-aware nanoporous materials design, which is extensible to other materials, like molecular crystals and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种三维周期空间采样方法，将大型纳米多孔结构分解为局部几何位点，用于联合性质预测和位点贡献量化。模型在气体存储、分离和电导率预测上达到最先进精度，同时提供可解释的预测，并识别关键局部位点。该方法可推广至分子晶体等其他材料。
Motivation: 纳米多孔材料的化学空间巨大，现有机器学习模型缺乏可解释性或保真度，难以阐明晶体几何与性质之间的关联。
Method: 报告一种三维周期空间采样方法，将大型纳米多孔结构分解为局部几何位点，结合构建的数据库和检索数据集进行训练，实现性质预测与位点贡献量化。
Result: 模型在气体存储、分离和电导率预测任务上达到最先进精度和数据效率，并能够准确识别对目标性质重要的局部位点。
Conclusion: 该方法为可解释、对称感知的纳米多孔材料设计铺平道路，并可扩展至其他材料如分子晶体。

papers.title: Quantum Variational Activation Functions Empower Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
papers.abstract_en: Variational quantum circuits (VQCs) are central to quantum machine learning, while recent progress in Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) highlights the power of learnable activation functions. We unify these directions by introducing the quantum variational activation function (QVAF), a general framework in which parameterized quantum circuits serve as learnable activation functions; in this work we study an efficient single-qubit instantiation called DatA Re-Uploading ActivatioN (DARUAN). We show that DARUAN with trainable data-preprocessing weights can realize an exponentially growing accessible frequency support with the number of re-uploading repetitions; for an explicit geometric choice of these weights, this gives a capacity-level exponential parameter reduction relative to independently parameterized Fourier activations. Embedding DARUAN into KAN yields the quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (QKAN), which retains the interpretability of the KAN architecture while improving parameter efficiency, expressivity, and generalization. We further introduce layer extension and the hybrid QKAN (HQKAN) architecture to improve scalability and computational efficiency, enabling QKAN modules to act as compact replacements for multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) in large-scale models. We provide theoretical analysis and extensive experiments on function regression, image classification, and autoregressive generative language modeling, demonstrating the efficiency and scalability of QKANs. Because the single-qubit circuits are efficiently simulable on classical quantum simulators, QKANs have quantum-inspired advantage in parameter efficiency and training stability; DARUANs and QKANs serve as present-day validation of the QVAF concept, and the trained DARUANs are directly executable and feasible on current noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware for inference validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子变分激活函数（QVAF）框架，将参数化量子电路用作可学习激活函数，并实例化为单比特数据重上传激活（DARUAN）。嵌入KAN形成量子启发式KAN（QKAN），在参数效率、表达能力和泛化性上优于传统方法。实验包括函数回归、图像分类和自回归语言建模。
Motivation: 变分量子电路在量子机器学习中很重要，而KAN展示了可学习激活函数的潜力。本文旨在统一这两个方向，提出量子变分激活函数以提升KAN的性能。
Method: 提出QVAF框架，具体实现DARUAN：单比特量子电路通过数据重上传实现可训练激活函数。理论分析表明，通过训练数据预处理权重，DARUAN可实现在指数级增长的频率支持。进一步将DARUAN嵌入KAN得到QKAN，并引入层扩展和混合QKAN（HQKAN）架构以提高可扩展性。
Result: 在函数回归、图像分类和自回归语言建模等任务上展示了QKAN的高效性和可扩展性，参数效率优于传统方法，且单比特电路可在经典模拟器上高效模拟，训练后的DARUAN可直接在NISQ硬件上运行。
Conclusion: QKAN作为QVAF概念的当前验证，具有量子启发的参数效率和训练稳定性优势，且适用于现有NISQ硬件。

summary_sections.method: 提出QVAF框架，具体实现DARUAN：单比特量子电路通过数据重上传实现可训练激活函数。理论分析表明，通过训练数据预处理权重，DARUAN可实现在指数级增长的频率支持。进一步将DARUAN嵌入KAN得到QKAN，并引入层扩展和混合QKAN（HQKAN）架构以提高可扩展性。
summary_sections.result: 在函数回归、图像分类和自回归语言建模等任务上展示了QKAN的高效性和可扩展性，参数效率优于传统方法，且单比特电路可在经典模拟器上高效模拟，训练后的DARUAN可直接在NISQ硬件上运行。
summary_sections.conclusion: QKAN作为QVAF概念的当前验证，具有量子启发的参数效率和训练稳定性优势，且适用于现有NISQ硬件。

papers.title: ICR-RL: Deep Reinforcement Learning via In-Context Regression
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in machine learning have largely been driven by foundation models (FMs) trained on large, diverse datasets, enabling them to generalize effectively to new, related tasks. However, extending this paradigm to reinforcement learning (RL), where an agent interacts with an environment to select actions, remains a significant challenge. Most existing approaches train FMs directly on sets of control tasks, but developing diverse RL environments and scaling training across them can be costly and complex. In this study, we explore a simpler alternative approach based on a classical reduction from RL to regression. We demonstrate that a foundation model pre-trained for regression tasks, when used as an in-context regression (ICR) model, can be directly applied to RL problems. Building on this insight, we introduce a gradient-free method, ICR-RL, that requires no additional training and leverages an ICR foundation model to tackle RL tasks. We evaluate our approach by applying the ICR model with the recently proposed TabPFN, which is trained on a wide range of regression tasks. Experiments conducted on the Gymnasium classic-control benchmark indicate that ICR-RL can compete with commonly used methods, including DQN, PPO and TRPO. These results show that ICR foundation models can effectively solve RL tasks without fine-tuning, demonstrating their potential as a foundation for RL-oriented models.

Motivation: 将基础模型扩展到强化学习面临挑战，现有方法需要多样化的RL环境和昂贵训练。本文探索更简单的替代方案：将RL约化为回归问题，利用预训练回归模型直接应用。

papers.title: On a Geometry of Interbrain Networks
papers.abstract_en: Effective analysis in neuroscience benefits significantly from robust conceptual frameworks. Traditional metrics of interbrain synchrony in social neuroscience typically depend on fixed, correlation-based approaches, restricting their explanatory capacity to descriptive observations. Inspired by the successful integration of geometric insights in network science, we propose leveraging discrete geometry to examine the dynamic reconfigurations in neural interactions during social exchanges. Unlike conventional synchrony approaches, our method interprets inter-brain connectivity changes through the evolving geometric structures of neural networks. This geometric framework is realized through a pipeline that identifies critical transitions in network connectivity using entropy metrics derived from curvature distributions. By doing so, we significantly enhance the capacity of hyperscanning methodologies to uncover underlying neural mechanisms in interactive social behavior.

papers.title: Convergence Analysis of the ProbAbilistic Gradient Estimator Algorithm for Weakly Convex Finite-Sum Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The ProbAbilistic Gradient Estimator algorithm (PAGE), a stochastic algorithm introduced by Li et al. in 2021, was designed to find stationary points for the average of smooth nonconvex functions. In this work, we study PAGE within the broad framework of $τ$-weakly convex functions, providing a continuous interpolation between the general nonconvex $L$-smooth regime ($τ=L$) and the convex regime ($τ=0$). We establish new convergence rates for PAGE, showing that its complexity improves as $τ$ decreases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对概率梯度估计器算法（PAGE）在弱凸有限和优化问题上的收敛性进行分析，建立了在τ-弱凸函数框架下的收敛速率，表明复杂度随弱凸参数τ的减小而改善。
Motivation: PAGE算法最初用于非凸光滑函数的随机优化，但其在弱凸情景下的收敛性尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 将PAGE算法推广到τ-弱凸函数框架，该框架平滑插值了非凸L-光滑（τ=L）和凸（τ=0）两种情况，并推导了新的收敛速率。
Result: PAGE在弱凸问题中的复杂度随τ减小而提升，即更接近凸性的问题收敛更快。
Conclusion: 结论是该算法适用于广泛的弱凸有限和优化问题，并且收敛性分析统一了现有结果。

papers.title: Sequential Cohort Selection under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of fair cohort selection under uncertainty, motivated by university admissions where applicant outcomes are only partially observed. We consider both a one-shot setting, where a fixed policy is applied to a population, and a sequential setting, where policies are updated over time using data from previous admission years. We propose a policy optimization framework that combines probabilistic modeling of outcomes with policy gradient methods, supporting both logistic and neural network policies. In the sequential setting, the approach jointly updates the policy and the underlying models to adapt to evolving applicant populations. Experiments on a simulator grounded in real admission data show that adaptive policies substantially outperform static baselines in term of expected utility, especially under higher admission costs. Neural policies consistently achieve higher utility and adapt more effectively than simpler models, while maintaining favorable fairness properties over time. Our results demonstrate the importance of adaptivity and model expressiveness for decision-making under uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不确定性下的公平队列选择问题，受大学招生场景启发，其中申请结果仅部分可观测。论文提出了结合概率建模与策略梯度方法的策略优化框架，支持逻辑回归和神经网络策略，并在基于真实招生数据的模拟器上验证了自适应策略的效用优势。
Motivation: 大学招生等场景中，申请结果（如录取后是否成功）往往无法完全观测，传统静态策略难以应对不确定性，且可能产生不公平。需要一种能利用部分反馈、动态调整策略的方法。
Method: 构建策略优化框架：用概率模型（逻辑回归或神经网络）预测申请者结果，结合策略梯度方法优化录取策略。在序列设置中，联合更新策略和预测模型以适应群体演化。
Result: 基于真实招生数据的模拟实验表明，自适应策略在期望效用上显著优于静态基线，尤其在录取成本较高时；神经网络策略比简单模型效用更高、适应性更强，且随时间保持较好公平性。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了在不确定性决策中自适应性和模型表达能力的重要性，但未涉及降水、天气等气象领域问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Semantic Alignment and Integration in Collaborative Model-Based Systems Engineering Using SysML v2
papers.abstract_en: Cross-organizational collaboration in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) faces many challenges in achieving semantic alignment across independently developed system models. SysML v2 introduces enhanced structural modularity and formal semantics, offering a stronger foundation for interoperable modeling. Meanwhile, GPT-based Large Language Models (LLMs) provide new capabilities for assisting model understanding and integration. This paper proposes a structured, prompt-driven approach for LLM-assisted semantic alignment of SysML v2 models. The core contribution lies in the iterative development of an alignment approach and interaction prompts, incorporating model extraction, semantic matching, and verification. The approach leverages SysML v2 constructs such as alias, import, and metadata extensions to support traceable, soft alignment integration. It is demonstrated with a GPT-based LLM through an example of a measurement system. Benefits and limitations are discussed.

papers.title: EGRA:Toward Enhanced Behavior Graphs and Representation Alignment for Multimodal Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: MultiModal Recommendation (MMR) systems have emerged as a promising solution for improving recommendation quality by leveraging rich item-side modality information, prompting a surge of diverse methods. Despite these advances, existing methods still face two critical limitations. First, they use raw modality features to construct item-item links for enriching the behavior graph, while giving limited attention to balancing collaborative and modality-aware semantics or mitigating modality noise in the process. Second, they use a uniform alignment weight across all entities and also maintain a fixed alignment strength throughout training, limiting the effectiveness of modality-behavior alignment. To address these challenges, we propose EGRA. First, instead of relying on raw modality features, it alleviates sparsity by incorporating into the behavior graph an item-item graph built from representations generated by a pretrained MMR model. This enables the graph to capture both collaborative patterns and modality aware similarities with enhanced robustness against modality noise. Moreover, it introduces a novel bi-level dynamic alignment weighting mechanism to improve modality-behavior representation alignment, which dynamically assigns alignment strength across entities according to their alignment degree, while gradually increasing the overall alignment intensity throughout training. Extensive experiments on five datasets show that EGRA significantly outperforms recent methods, confirming its effectiveness.

TL;DR: 针对多模态推荐中行为图构建和模态-行为对齐的局限性，提出EGRA方法。首先利用预训练多模态推荐模型的表示构建项目-项目图来增强行为图，以更好地平衡协同与模态语义并缓解噪声；然后引入双级动态对齐权重机制，根据实体对齐程度动态分配强度，并在训练中逐步增加整体对齐强度。在五个数据集上的实验表明EGRA显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态推荐方法使用原始模态特征构建项目-项目边，未能充分平衡协同与模态语义，且忽视模态噪声；同时采用统一且固定的对齐权重，限制了模态-行为对齐的效果。
Method: 1) 采用预训练多模态推荐模型生成的表示构建项目-项目图，替代原始模态特征，增强行为图对协同和模态相似性的捕获能力，并提升对模态噪声的鲁棒性。2) 提出双级动态对齐权重机制：在实体级别根据对齐程度动态分配权重，在训练过程级别逐步增加整体对齐强度。

Conclusion: 通过增强行为图构建和动态对齐权重机制，EGRA有效提升了多模态推荐的性能。

papers.title: VISOR: Visual Input-based Steering for Output Redirection in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly being used in a broad range of applications, bringing their security and behavioral control to the forefront. While existing approaches for behavioral control or output redirection, like system prompting in VLMs, are easily detectable and often ineffective, activation-based steering vectors require invasive runtime access to model internals--incompatible with API-based services and closed-source deployments. We introduce VISOR (Visual Input-based Steering for Output Redirection), a novel method that achieves sophisticated behavioral control through optimized visual inputs alone. By crafting universal steering images that induce target activation patterns, VISOR enables practical deployment across all VLM serving modalities while remaining imperceptible compared to explicit textual instructions. We validate VISOR on LLaVA-1.5-7B across three critical alignment tasks: refusal, sycophancy and survival instinct. A single 150KB steering image matches steering vector performance within 1-2% for positive behavioral shifts while dramatically exceeding it for negative steering--achieving up to 25% shifts from baseline compared to steering vectors' modest changes. Unlike system prompting (3-4% shifts), VISOR provides robust bidirectional control while maintaining 99.9% performance on 14,000 unrelated MMLU tasks. Beyond eliminating runtime overhead and model access requirements, VISOR exposes a critical security vulnerability: adversaries can achieve sophisticated behavioral manipulation through visual channels alone, bypassing text-based defenses. Our work fundamentally re-imagines multimodal model control and highlights the urgent need for defenses against visual steering attacks.

papers.title: Context Misleads LLMs: The Role of Context Filtering in Maintaining Safe Alignment of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown significant advancements in performance, various jailbreak attacks have posed growing safety and ethical risks. Malicious users often exploit adversarial context to deceive LLMs, prompting them to generate responses to harmful queries. In this study, we propose a new defense mechanism called Context Filtering, an input pre-processing method designed to filter out untrustworthy and unreliable context while identifying the primary prompts containing the real user intent to uncover concealed malicious intent. Given that enhancing the safety of LLMs often compromises their helpfulness, potentially affecting the experience of benign users, our method aims to improve the safety of the LLMs while preserving their original performance. We evaluate the effectiveness of our model in defending against jailbreak attacks through comparative analysis, comparing our approach with state-of-the-art defense mechanisms against six different attacks and assessing the helpfulness of LLMs under these defenses. Our model demonstrates its ability to reduce the Attack Success Rates of jailbreak attacks by up to 92% while maintaining the original LLMs' performance, achieving state-of-the-art Safety and Helpfulness balance. Notably, Context Filtering is a plug-and-play method that can be applied to all LLMs, including both white-box and black-box models, to enhance their safety without requiring any fine-tuning of the models themselves. Our model is available for research purposes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文过滤（Context Filtering）机制，一种输入预处理方法，用于滤除不可信的上下文，识别用户真实意图，从而防御针对大型语言模型（LLM）的越狱攻击。该方法在六种攻击下将攻击成功率降低高达92%，同时保持模型原有性能，且无需微调即可应用于所有LLM。
Motivation: 现有越狱攻击利用对抗性上下文欺骗LLM生成有害响应，而提升安全性往往牺牲有用性。需要一种在不影响良性用户体验的前提下增强LLM安全性的方法。
Method: 提出Context Filtering，一种即插即用的输入预处理方法，通过滤除不可信上下文、识别主提示中的真实用户意图，来揭露隐藏的恶意意图。不要求模型微调，适用于白盒和黑盒LLM。
Result: 在六种越狱攻击下，攻击成功率降低最多92%，同时保持原始LLM的性能，实现了安全性和有用性的平衡，达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: Context Filtering是一种有效的轻量级防御机制，可应用于任意LLM以增强安全性，无需牺牲性能。方法即插即用，便于部署。

papers.title: Algorithmic Shortlisting in Participatory Budgeting
papers.abstract_en: Participatory budgeting is a democratic innovation that allows citizens to propose and vote on public investment projects. To help organizers manage large volumes of submissions, we design and test privacy-preserving methods for algorithmic shortlisting. These algorithms predict which projects are likely to be funded using only project features and anonymous historical voting data. We demonstrate the limitations of a naive approach that uses a large language model to rank projects based on past success and propose a vote-based pipeline that enables state-of-the-art LLMs to perform on par with classical machine learning. Our findings indicate that user preferences in participatory budgeting are stable enough to allow algorithmic shortlisting to approximate an initial selection of projects effectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文设计并测试了参与式预算（participatory budgeting）中用于项目初筛的隐私保护算法，该方法仅使用项目特征和匿名历史投票数据预测项目可能被资助的概率。实验表明，简单利用大语言模型（LLM）根据历史成功排序效果有限，而基于投票的管道可使先进LLM达到与经典机器学习相当的性能。
Motivation: 参与式预算中大量项目提交给组织者带来筛选困难，现有方法缺乏隐私保护或效率不足，需设计可预测项目资助可能性且保护隐私的自动初筛算法。
Method: 提出两种算法管道：一是直接使用LLM根据项目特征和历史成功案例排序；二是基于投票数据的管道，将项目特征与匿名选民偏好结合，再训练或利用LLM进行预测。
Result: 摘要报告基于投票的LLM管道在预测项目资助可能性上与经典机器学习性能相当，且隐私保护；而简单LLM排序方法效果有限。
Conclusion: 用户偏好在此任务中足够稳定，使得算法初筛可有效近似人工初选，但方法依赖历史投票数据，可能受数据偏差影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAVER: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via Style-Aware Visual Early Revision
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) recently achieve significant breakthroughs in understanding complex visual-textual contexts. However, hallucination issues still limit their real-world applicability. Although previous mitigation methods effectively reduce hallucinations in photographic images, they largely overlook the potential risks posed by stylized images, which play crucial roles in critical scenarios such as game scene understanding, art education, and medical analysis. In this work, we first construct a dataset comprising photographic images and their corresponding stylized versions with carefully annotated caption labels. We then conduct head-to-head comparisons on both discriminative and generative tasks by benchmarking 13 advanced LVLMs on the collected datasets. Our findings reveal that stylized images tend to induce significantly more hallucinations than their photographic counterparts. To address this issue, we propose Style-Aware Visual Early Revision SAVER, a novel mechanism that dynamically adjusts LVLMs' final outputs based on the token-level visual attention patterns, leveraging early-layer feedback to mitigate hallucinations caused by stylized images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAVER achieves state-of-the-art performance in hallucination mitigation across various models, datasets, and tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted at AAAI 2026. 24 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/llizhaoxu/SAVER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在风格化图像上容易出现幻觉的问题，构建了包含摄影图像及其风格化版本的数据集，并通过对比实验证实风格化图像导致显著更多的幻觉。提出风格感知视觉早期修正（SAVER）机制，利用token级视觉注意力模式和早期层反馈动态调整输出，在多个模型和任务上取得幻觉缓解的最优性能。
Motivation: 现有LVLM幻觉缓解方法主要关注摄影图像，忽略了风格化图像（如游戏场景、艺术教育、医学分析）中潜在的高幻觉风险。
Method: 首先构建摄影-风格化图像配对数据集并人工标注；然后提出SAVER，基于token级视觉注意力模式利用早期层反馈动态修正LVLM输出。
Result: 在13个先进LVLM上的判别和生成任务中，风格化图像比摄影图像引发更多幻觉；SAVER在多个模型、数据集和任务上取得幻觉缓解的SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 通过动态调整基于风格化图像注意力模式的输出，SAVER有效缓解LVLM在风格化图像上的幻觉问题。

papers.title: GlaBoost: A Multimodal Structured Framework for Glaucoma Risk Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Early and accurate glaucoma detection is critical to prevent irreversible vision loss, yet existing AI methods often rely on unimodal inputs and lack interpretability. We present GlaBoost, a multimodal gradient boosting framework that unifies three complementary signals for glaucoma risk prediction: fundus image embeddings from a pretrained convolutional encoder,free-text neuroretinal rim assessments encoded by a transformer-based language model, and structured ophthalmic biomarkers. These modalities are fused into a single representation and classified by an enhanced XGBoost model.On two real-world annotated datasets, GlaBoost consistently outperforms unimodal and generic multimodal baselines. Feature importance analysis highlights the cup-to-disc ratio, rim thinning, and the ISNT rule as the dominant predictors, yielding clinically consistent and interpretable decisions. GlaBoost offers a transparent and scalable foundation for multimodal decision support in ophthalmology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GlaBoost，一个多模态梯度提升框架，融合眼底图像嵌入、自由文本视神经盘评估和结构化眼科生物标志物，用于青光眼风险分层。在两个真实数据集上，GlaBoost优于单模态和通用多模态基线。特征重要性分析表明杯盘比、边缘变薄和ISNT规则是主导预测因子，提供了临床一致的决策。
Motivation: 现有AI青光眼检测方法多依赖单模态输入且缺乏可解释性，难以满足临床需求。
Method: GlaBoost框架：使用预训练卷积编码器提取眼底图像嵌入，Transformer语言模型编码自由文本视神经盘评估，结合结构化眼科生物标志物，融合后由增强XGBoost分类。
Result: 在两个真实数据集上，GlaBoost一致优于单模态和通用多模态基线。
Conclusion: GlaBoost为眼科多模态决策支持提供了透明且可扩展的基础。

papers.title: Diffusion Models are Open-World Affordance Learners: Leveraging Generative Priors for 3D Affordance Learning
papers.abstract_en: 3D affordance grounding aims to understand how diverse objects can be manipulated, making it a cornerstone of embodied interaction. However, prior works struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution, open-world scenarios, leaving a critical gap between limited dataset performance and real-world application needs. Inspired by the saying: \textit{\textbf{``What I can not create, I do not understand''}}, we find generative models can generate semantically valid HOI images, which indicates inherent encoding of affordance concepts. Building on this insight, we propose DAG, the first innovative diffusion-based 3D affordance grounding framework that extracts general affordance knowledge from text-to-image diffusion models for 3D affordance prediction. Specifically, we extract the affordance priors from a diffusion model to encode HOI priors, and design an affordance block with a multi-source affordance decoder for dense 3D affordance prediction. Extensive experiments show that DAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods and exhibits strong open-world generalization, even in the challenging one-shot setting. The code of our method is released on \textcolor{blue}{\textit{https://github.com/hq-King/DAG}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAG，首个基于扩散模型（diffusion models）的3D affordance grounding框架，从文本到图像扩散模型中提取通用affordance知识用于3D affordance预测。实验表明DAG在多个基准上超越现有方法，并在单样本设置下展现出强大的开放世界泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有3D affordance grounding方法难以泛化到分布外场景（开放世界），而生成模型能够生成语义合理的HOI图像，暗示其内在地编码了affordance概念。
Method: 从文本到图像扩散模型中提取affordance先验编码HOI先验，并设计包含多源affordance解码器的affordance模块进行密集3D affordance预测。
Result: DAG在多个基准上一致优于现有方法，并在挑战性的单样本设置下表现出强大的开放世界泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文展示了扩散模型作为开放世界affordance学习器的潜力，为从生成先验到3D理解提供了有效途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Time-step Training for Enhancing Spike-Based Neural Radiance Fields
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) provide an energy-efficient computing paradigm for neural rendering, but existing spike-based Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) models usually use a fixed inference time step for all scenes. This fixed temporal budget is inefficient because NeRF follows a scene-specific training paradigm, and different scenes require different temporal capacities to preserve rendering quality. This paper proposes Pretraining-based Adaptive Time-step Adjustment (PATA), a scene-wise adaptive time-step training framework for spike-based NeRF. PATA parameterizes the target inference time step as a trainable variable and optimizes it through a two-stage training process. A hybrid input mode strengthens early time-step outputs, while full-step soft supervision, smoothed rendering loss, and temporal-budget loss jointly maintain rendering fidelity and reduce temporal computation. The learned target time step is shared by all ray samples within a scene, preserving the parallel rendering structure of NeRF. Experiments on INGP-NeRF and TensoRF backbones across Synthetic-NeRF, Mip-NeRF 360, and LLFF show that PATA consistently reduces inference cost while maintaining competitive rendering quality. PATA reduces the estimated inference energy by up to 57.57\% on INGP-NeRF and 68.90\% on TensoRF, demonstrating its effectiveness across different neural rendering representations.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: PATA能有效减少spike-based NeRF的推理计算量，同时保持具有竞争力的渲染质量，且在不同神经渲染表示中均表现有效。

papers.title: Toward Efficient Uncertainty in LLMs through Evidential Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate uncertainty quantification remains a key challenge for standard LLMs, prompting the adoption of Bayesian and ensemble-based methods. However, such methods typically necessitate computationally expensive sampling, involving multiple forward passes to effectively estimate predictive uncertainty. In this paper, we introduce an approach enabling uncertainty estimation in LLMs without incurring the heavy inference latency typically associated with sampling methods. Specifically, we distill uncertainty-aware teachers - originally requiring multiple forward passes - into single-pass students, fine-tuned using LoRA. We compare two distinct distillation strategies: one in which the student employs traditional softmax-based outputs, and another in which the student leverages Dirichlet-distributed outputs to explicitly model epistemic uncertainty via evidential learning. Empirical evaluation on classification tasks demonstrate that such students can achieve comparable predictive and uncertainty quantification performance relative to their teachers, while requiring only a single forward pass.
papers.comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Machine Learning (ECML PKDD) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过证据知识蒸馏（evidential knowledge distillation）使大语言模型（LLM）能够高效估计不确定性，避免传统贝叶斯或集成方法所需的多次前向传播。具体地，将需要多次前向传播的不确定性感知教师模型蒸馏为单次前向传播的学生模型，使用LoRA微调，并比较了基于softmax和Dirichlet输出的两种蒸馏策略。实验表明，在分类任务上，学生模型在预测性能和不确定性量化方面可与教师匹敌，但仅需单次前向传播。
Motivation: 贝叶斯和集成方法能有效量化LLM的不确定性，但需要多次前向传播，计算成本高，限制了实际部署。
Method: 将不确定性感知的教师模型（需多次前向传播）蒸馏为单次前向传播的学生模型，通过LoRA微调。对比两种蒸馏策略：学生使用传统softmax输出，或使用Dirichlet分布输出以显式建模认知不确定性（evidential learning）。
Result: 在分类任务上，学生模型在预测性能和不确定性量化方面达到与教师模型相当的水平，但推理时仅需单次前向传播，大幅降低延迟。
Conclusion: 所提出的蒸馏方法能够实现LLM的高效不确定性估计，在不牺牲性能的前提下显著降低推理成本。

papers.title: Last Layer Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: We explore the use of Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) sampling as a probabilistic last layer approach for deep neural networks (DNNs). While HMC is widely regarded as a gold standard for uncertainty estimation, the computational demands limit its application to large-scale datasets and large DNN architectures. Although the predictions from the sampled DNN parameters can be parallelized, the computational cost still scales linearly with the number of samples (similar to an ensemble). Last layer HMC (LL-HMC) reduces the required computations by restricting the HMC sampling to the final layer of a DNN, making it applicable to more data-intensive scenarios with limited computational resources. In this paper, we compare LL-HMC against five last layer probabilistic deep learning (LL-PDL) methods across three real-world video datasets for driver action and intention. We evaluate the in-distribution classification performance, calibration, and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. Due to the stochastic nature of the probabilistic evaluations, we performed five grid searches for different random seeds to avoid being reliant on a single initialization for the hyperparameter configurations. The results show that LL-HMC achieves competitive in-distribution classification and OOD detection performance. Additional sampled last layer parameters do not improve the classification performance, but can improve the OOD detection. Multiple chains or starting positions did not yield consistent improvements.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 16 figures, 7 tables, currently under submission
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Hamiltonian Monte Carlo（HMC）的最后一层概率方法（LL-HMC），用于深度神经网络的不确定性估计。通过在最后一层进行HMC采样，LL-HMC在有限计算资源下实现了具有竞争力的分布内分类性能和分布外检测能力，并在三个真实世界驾驶员动作视频数据集上与五种概率方法进行了比较。
Motivation: HMC被视为不确定性估计的黄金标准，但其计算成本限制了在大规模数据集和大模型上的应用；现有最后一层概率方法虽降低计算开销，但性能与全模型HMC存在差距。
Method: 将HMC采样限制在深度神经网络的最后一层（LL-HMC），从而在保持不确定性估计能力的同时大幅降低计算成本；实验中使用多个随机种子进行网格搜索以避免初始化依赖。
Result: LL-HMC在分布内分类和OOD检测上达到与全模型HMC竞争的性能，但增加最后一层参数样本量不提升分类性能，仅可能改善OOD检测；多链或不同起始位置未带来一致改进。
Conclusion: LL-HMC是一种适用于计算受限场景的实用概率方法，但在驾驶员动作识别视频数据集上，额外的采样并不保证性能提升，且多链策略效果不稳定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Region-Aware Multimodal Large Language Model via SlowFast Tokenization and Pseudo-Mask Guidance for 3D CT Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Current CT report generation frameworks predominantly rely on global feature representations, often failing to capture region-specific details and potentially missing certain abnormalities. To overcome this limitation, we propose MedRegion-CT, a region-focused multimodal large language model framework featuring three key innovations. First, we revisit the SlowFast strategy to jointly model global and fine-grained information and adapt it to the medical domain via a Region-based SlowFast Tokenizer that extracts tokens guided by clinically meaningful regions. Second, generated pseudo-masks guide the model to attend to diagnostically important anatomical regions, facilitating a systematic understanding of the overall scan context. Third, quantitative lesion information, including size, diameter, and spatial location, is encoded as structured textual prompts, enabling context-aware and clinically informed report generation. To enable rigorous evaluation, we validate our framework on multi-institutional structured report generation benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that MedRegion-CT achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing approaches in both linguistic quality and clinical accuracy. All code is publicly available at: https://github.com/babbu3682/MedRegion-CT.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 15 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MedRegion-CT，一个面向3D CT报告生成的区域感知多模态大语言模型框架。通过基于区域的SlowFast Tokenizer、伪掩码引导和量化病灶文本提示，联合建模全局与局部信息，在多个机构的报告生成基准上达到最高语言质量和临床准确性。
Motivation: 现有CT报告生成方法依赖全局特征表示，难以捕获区域特定细节，可能遗漏异常。
Method: 提出三个创新：1) 基于区域的SlowFast Tokenizer，将临床有意义区域作为token提取；2) 生成的伪掩码引导模型关注诊断重要解剖区域；3) 将病灶尺寸、直径、空间位置等量化信息编码为结构化文本提示。
Result: 在多机构结构化报告生成基准上，MedRegion-CT在语言质量和临床准确性方面均取得最优性能。
Conclusion: 框架通过区域感知机制显著提升CT报告生成质量，代码已公开。

papers.title: Bayesian Invariance Modeling of Multi-Environment Data
papers.abstract_en: Invariant prediction [Peters et al., 2016] analyzes feature/outcome data from multiple environments to identify invariant features - those with a stable predictive relationship to the outcome. Such features support generalization to new environments and help reveal causal mechanisms. Previous methods have primarily tackled this problem through hypothesis testing or regularized optimization. Here we develop Bayesian Invariant Prediction (BIP), a probabilistic model for invariant prediction. BIP encodes the indices of invariant features as a latent variable and recover them by posterior inference. Under the assumptions of Peters et al. [2016], the BIP posterior targets the true invariant features. We prove that the posterior is consistent and that greater environment heterogeneity leads to faster posterior contraction. To handle many features, we design an efficient variational approximation called VI-BIP. In simulations and real data, we find that BIP and VI-BIP are more accurate and scalable than existing methods for invariant prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯不变预测（BIP），一种用于多环境数据中不变特征识别的概率模型。BIP将不变特征索引视为潜在变量，通过后验推断恢复。理论证明后验一致性，环境异质性越大后验收缩越快。为处理高维特征，设计了高效变分近似VI-BIP。模拟和真实数据表明BIP和VI-BIP在准确性和可扩展性上优于现有不变预测方法。
Motivation: 不变预测是识别在多环境中与结果保持稳定预测关系的特征，有助于泛化新环境和揭示因果机制。现有方法多基于假设检验或正则化优化，缺乏概率建模框架。
Method: 将不变特征索引编码为潜在变量，构建贝叶斯概率模型，通过后验推断同时恢复不变特征索引和预测参数。设计了变分近似VI-BIP以扩展至高维特征。
Result: 在模拟和真实数据上，BIP和VI-BIP在不变特征识别的准确性和计算可扩展性上优于现有方法。理论上证明了后验一致性，并指出环境异质性加速后验收缩。
Conclusion: BIP为不变预测提供了概率框架，兼具理论保证和计算效率，适用于多环境数据中的特征选择与因果推断。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Policy Improvement with Style-Specific Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Proficient game agents with diverse play styles enrich the gaming experience and enhance the replay value of games. However, recent advancements in game AI based on reinforcement learning have predominantly focused on improving proficiency, whereas methods based on evolution algorithms generate agents with diverse play styles but exhibit subpar performance compared to RL methods. To address this gap, this paper proposes Mixed Proximal Policy Optimization (MPPO), a method designed to improve the proficiency of existing suboptimal agents while retaining their distinct styles. MPPO unifies loss objectives for both online and offline samples and introduces an implicit constraint to approximate demonstrator policies by adjusting the empirical distribution of samples. Empirical results across environments of varying scales demonstrate that MPPO achieves proficiency levels comparable to, or even superior to, pure online algorithms while preserving demonstrators' play styles. This work presents an effective approach for generating highly proficient and diverse game agents, ultimately contributing to more engaging gameplay experiences.
papers.comment: The article has been accepted by Frontiers of Computer Science (FCS), with the DOI: {10.1007/s11704-026-60230-8}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合近端策略优化 (MPPO)，一种通过利用风格特定的演示来提升现有次优游戏智能体熟练度同时保留其独特风格的方法。MPPO 统一在线和离线样本的损失目标，并引入隐式约束调整经验分布以近似演示策略。实验表明该方法能在多种环境达到或超越纯在线算法的熟练度水平，同时保持演示者的玩法风格。

Conclusion: 该工作为生成高熟练度且多样的游戏智能体提供了有效途径，有助于提升游戏体验。

summary_sections.result: 在多种规模环境中，MPPO 达到与纯在线算法相当甚至更优的熟练度，同时成功保留演示者的玩法风格。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为生成高熟练度且多样的游戏智能体提供了有效途径，有助于提升游戏体验。

papers.title: AI's Blind Spots: Geographic Knowledge and Diversity Deficit in Generated Urban Scenario
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based text-to-image models are increasingly used for urban analysis and scenario generation, but their geographic knowledge and representational biases remain poorly understood. We evaluate FLUX 1-schnell and Stable Diffusion 3.5-Large in the United States by generating 150 street-view images for each state, each state capital, and a generic "USA" prompt. Images are embedded with DINO-v2 ViT-S/14 and compared with Fréchet Inception Distance (FID). Pairwise FID clustering shows that geographically proximate states and capitals often group together, indicating implicit geographic structure. However, the generic ``USA'' prompt collapses this diversity into a metropolitan stereotype: frontier, desert, tropical, rural, and small-city environments are underrepresented or distant in FID space. These results show that diffusion models can encode fine-grained geography while still reproducing narrow national-scale visual stereotypes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了扩散模型（FLUX 1-schnell 和 Stable Diffusion 3.5-Large）在美国各州及首都生成街景图像时的地理知识表示偏差。通过 DINO-v2 嵌入和 Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) 聚类，发现地理邻近的州和首都在 FID 空间中往往聚集，表明模型隐含地理结构；但通用提示词“USA”生成的图像却坍缩为都市刻板印象，忽视了边疆、沙漠、热带、农村和小城市等环境。
Motivation: 扩散模型在城镇分析和场景生成中应用日益广泛，但其地理知识准确性和表示偏差尚未得到系统理解。
Method: 分别以美国每个州、每个州首府以及通用“USA”为提示词，生成 150 张街景图像，使用 DINO-v2 ViT-S/14 提取嵌入，并计算成对 FID 进行聚类分析。
Result: 成对 FID 聚类显示地理邻近的州和首府常常聚集，表明模型编码了隐式地理结构；但通用“USA”提示词产生的图像在 FID 空间中远离多样性环境，呈现都市刻板印象。
Conclusion: 扩散模型能够编码细粒度地理信息，但同时会复现狭窄的国家尺度视觉刻板印象，提示使用生成图像进行城镇分析时需注意地理偏差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Chasing Moving Targets with Online Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for Safer Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Conventional large language model (LLM) safety alignment relies on a reactive, disjoint loop: attackers exploit a static model, then defenders patch exposed vulnerabilities. This sequential setup leads to attackers overfitting obsolete exploits while defenders perpetually lag behind emerging threats. To address this, we introduce Self-RedTeam, the first fully online self-play multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm that continuously co-evolves attacker and defender for robust safety alignment. A single policy self-plays as both attacker and defender, generating adversarial prompts and defending against them, with a reward model adjudicating outcomes. Each role uses hidden chain-of-thought for strategic planning. Grounded in two-player zero-sum game theory, we establish a theoretical safety guarantee: if the game converges to Nash Equilibrium, the defender produces safe responses against any adversarial input. Empirically, Self-RedTeam generalizes across five models from the Llama and Qwen families, uncovering more diverse attacks (+17.80% SBERT) and improving safety of RLHF-trained models by up to 95% across 14 benchmarks. Our work motivates a shift from reactive patching to proactive co-evolution, enabling LLM safety self-improvement via online self-play MARL. Link to code: https://github.com/mickelliu/selfplay-redteaming
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Self-RedTeam，一种在线自博弈多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法，用于大语言模型（LLM）安全对齐。该方法让同一个策略同时扮演攻击者和防御者，通过隐藏思维链进行策略规划，并在两玩家零和博弈框架下理论保证若收敛到纳什均衡则防御者对所有对抗输入产生安全响应。实验在 Llama 和 Qwen 系列的五个模型上验证，攻击多样性提升 17.80%（SBERT），14 个安全基准上 RLHF 模型的安全性最高提升 95%。
Motivation: 传统 LLM 安全对齐是被动、分离的循环：攻击者利用静态模型，防御者修补已知漏洞，导致攻击者过拟合过时漏洞，防御者滞后于新兴威胁。需要一种能连续协同进化攻击者和防御者的方法。
Method: 提出 Self-RedTeam，第一个完全的在线自博弈多智能体强化学习算法。单一策略通过自博弈同时作为攻击者（生成对抗提示）和防御者（生成安全响应），奖励模型评判结果，每个角色使用隐藏思维链（hidden chain-of-thought）进行战略规划。基于两玩家零和博弈理论，若收敛到纳什均衡则保证安全。
Result: 在 Llama 和 Qwen 系列五个模型上，攻击多样性提升 17.80%（SBERT），RLHF 训练模型在 14 个安全基准上的安全性最高提升 95%。
Conclusion: 论文呼吁从被动修补转向主动协同进化，通过在线自博弈 MARL 实现 LLM 安全的自我改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InverseScope: Scalable Activation Inversion for Interpreting Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the internal representations of large language models (LLMs) is a central challenge in interpretability research. Existing feature interpretability methods often rely on strong structural assumptions--such as linearity or sparsity--that may not hold in practice. In this work, we introduce InverseScope, an assumption-light and scalable framework for interpreting neural activations via input inversion. Given a target activation, InverseScope characterizes its encoded information by generating natural-language inputs that produce nearby activations, grounding abstract internal states in concrete language. To overcome the prohibitive cost of sampling in high-dimensional activation spaces, we propose a novel control-layer conditioning architecture that substantially improves sample efficiency compared to prior token-prepending approaches. We demonstrate that InverseScope reveals rich geometric structure in LLM representation spaces, including sentence-level linear analogies. The framework scales to state-of-the-art open-source models of up to 14B parameters and generalizes to out-of-distribution inputs, enabling systematic analysis of activation neighborhoods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InverseScope，一种无需强假设且可扩展的神经网络激活解释框架，通过输入反转将抽象内部状态映射为具体自然语言文本。该方法采用控制层条件架构，显著提高高维激活空间中的采样效率，可扩展至 14B 参数的开源模型，并揭示了 LLM 表示空间中的句级线性类比等几何结构。
Motivation: 现有特征可解释方法常依赖线性性或稀疏性等强结构假设，这些假设在实际中可能不成立，因此需要一种假设更少、可扩展的激活解释方法。
Method: 给定目标激活，InverseScope 通过生成产生相近激活的自然语言输入来表征编码信息；为克服高维空间中采样的高昂成本，提出控制层条件架构，相比之前的 token 前缀方法显著提升样本效率。
Result: 该方法揭示了 LLM 表示空间中的丰富几何结构（如句级线性类比），可扩展至 14B 参数模型，并泛化到分布外输入，实现对激活邻域的系统分析。
Conclusion: InverseScope 为理解 LLM 内部表示提供了一种可扩展、轻假设的工具，适用于大规模模型和分布外场景。
Relevance: 0
