papers.title: AquaStereo: Enabling Underwater Stereo Matching via Depth-Conditioned Diffusion and Geometry Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based stereo matching models struggle in underwater environments due to scarce in-domain data and the difficulty of extracting discriminative correspondences from degraded imagery. In this work, we present $\textbf{AquaStereo}$, a perception-enhanced framework with a data simulation pipeline and a self-distillation strategy that jointly address data scarcity and feature degradation in underwater stereo matching. First, a depth-conditioned diffusion pipeline renders underwater stereo pairs while preserving binocular geometry, with a lightweight left-right consistency module ensuring geometric alignment. Training on this synthetic corpus effectively narrows the terrestrial-underwater gap and improves zero-shot robustness. Second, a frozen binocular teacher trained on clean terrestrial pairs guides a student exposed to rendered underwater pairs with perturbations. A stage-weighted sequence loss is performed to align the student's disparities with the teacher's geometry, while a clean-branch supervision with shared pseudo targets prevents scale drift. To further enhance feature stability under turbidity and low texture, we introduce learnable perception frames, a perception-enhanced feature formulation that constructs robust matching descriptors by fusing temporal cues from two auxiliary views encoded by a video backbone with semantic features extracted by a strong image encoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that $\textbf{AquaStereo}$ substantially improves robustness and zero-shot generalization in challenging underwater scenarios. The code is available at https://github.com/qz-wei/AquaStereo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AquaStereo 是一个针对水下立体匹配的感知增强框架，结合深度条件扩散数据模拟管道和几何自蒸馏策略，解决水下数据稀缺和特征退化问题。通过合成水下立体对训练，利用冻结的双目教师指导学生网络，并引入可学习感知帧以提升浑浊和低纹理环境下的匹配鲁棒性。实验表明在挑战性水下场景中显著提升了零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 基于学习的立体匹配模型在水下环境中因域内数据稀缺和退化图像中判别性对应提取困难而表现不佳。
Method: 提出深度条件扩散管道生成保持双目几何的水下立体对，并采用轻量级左右一致性模块保证几何对齐；采用冻结的陆地双目教师指导学生网络，通过阶段加权序列损失对齐视差，并用干净分支监督防止尺度漂移；引入可学习感知帧，融合视频骨干的时序线索和图像编码器的语义特征构建鲁棒匹配描述符。
Result: 摘要报告 AquaStereo 在挑战性水下场景中显著提升了零样本泛化能力和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: AquaStereo 通过数据合成和自蒸馏有效缓解水下立体匹配中的数据稀缺和特征退化问题，可学习感知帧进一步增强了特征稳定性。

papers.title: HiFA4: Training-Free 4-bit FlashAttention on Ascend HIF4 NPUs for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: We present HiFA4, a post-training operator-level design that executes both QK^T and PV in FlashAttention as 4-bit HIF4 Cube GEMMs for LLM inference on Ascend NPUs, while maintaining the online softmax state in FP16. To our knowledge, HiFA4 is the first Ascend-HIF4-targeted design of this kind evaluated on standard NLP benchmarks. HiFA4 combines two mechanisms. Smooth-QK applies a calibration-static per-channel equivalent rescaling to Q and K after RoPE, transferring quantization difficulty from K to Q without per-tile online reduction at inference. P-Reordering accumulates the softmax normalizer from the same quantized attention weights P_hat used in the PV GEMM, rather than from a higher-precision reconstruction. We show that this inconsistent formulation introduces a coherent output-scaling error, and validate the effect on a Qwen3-8B Layer-0 MMLU trace, where all 3.6M measured attention tiles exhibit net probability-mass loss with median epsilon_bar = -0.064. P-Reordering also allows the normalizer to be fused into the PV Cube GEMM. Across five LLMs, HiFA4 reduces quantization-induced decision drift. On Qwen3-8B, it recovers 37.5% of the accuracy gap introduced by direct HIF4 quantization, narrows the sample-weighted accuracy loss from 1.12 pp to 0.70 pp, reduces BF16-inconsistent MMLU predictions from 16.3% to 8.2%, and cuts MMLU accuracy regressions by 57% (1071 to 465). On Gemma2-9B, mild smoothing keeps HiFA4 within 0.7 pp of BF16 while reducing MMLU regressions by 27%. On LLaMA3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Phi-4B, where Smooth-QK is disabled, P-Reordering with the adopted Q-Mean auxiliary still reduces full-set MMLU regressions by 41-52%. A preliminary instruction-scheduling analysis projects a 35.4% critical-path latency reduction relative to BF16 by fusing the softmax normalizer into the PV Cube GEMM; on-hardware validation is left to future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiFA4，一种无需训练的操作级设计，在 Ascend HIF4 NPU 上以 4-bit HIF4 Cube GEMM 执行 FlashAttention 的 QK^T 和 PV 步骤，同时保持 online softmax 状态为 FP16。通过 Smooth-QK（静态每通道重缩放）和 P-Reordering（使用量化注意力权重累加 softmax 归一化因子）两种机制，在多个 LLM 上减少了量化引起的精度损失，并估计了延迟收益。
Motivation: 现有低精度注意力在 Ascend NPU 上缺乏针对 HIF4 硬件的优化，导致较大量化误差和推理效率低下。
Method: 提出两个机制：Smooth-QK 在 RoPE 后对 Q 和 K 进行校准静态每通道等效重缩放，将量化难度从 K 转移到 Q；P-Reordering 从用于 PV GEMM 的同一量化注意力权重 P_hat 累加 softmax 归一化因子，避免高精度重建并允许融合到 PV Cube GEMM 中。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上恢复 37.5% 的精度损失，MMLU 样本加权精度损失从 1.12 pp 降至 0.70 pp，BF16 不一致预测从 16.3% 降至 8.2%，MMLU 精度回退减少 57%。Gemma2-9B 上保持 0.7 pp 内精度，回退减少 27%。其他模型上 P-Reordering 减少 41-52% 的 MMLU 回退。初步分析预测关键路径延迟降低 35.4%。
Conclusion: HiFA4 是首个面向 Ascend HIF4 的 4-bit FlashAttention 设计，通过重新组织 softmax 归一化计算实现了精度与效率的平衡，但硬件验证留待未来工作。

papers.title: CausalGame: Benchmarking Causal Thinking of LLM Agents in Games
papers.abstract_en: Building AI Scientist agents with Large Language Models (LLMs) has recently attracted growing attention. Since scientific discovery fundamentally relies on uncovering causal relationships from observations, the capability of causal thinking, i.e., distinguishing causation from correlation and recognizing hidden biases, is essential to LLM agents. Although a number of benchmarks exist for AI Scientists, none explicitly incorporate challenges from selection bias, measurement error, and hidden confounders that widely exist in real-world scientific discovery. To this end, we present CausalGame, a benchmark that evaluates the causal thinking capabilities of LLM agents through interactive games. CausalGame asks LLM agents to actively design experimental protocols, collect observation data, and derive a final solution with an explanation report. To emulate realistic scientific discovery challenges, we design 14 scenarios that incorporate selection bias, measurement error, and hidden confounders. Across 30 LLM agents, none demonstrates reliable causal thinking: the best model reaches only 68.0% survival against analytical optima of 78-85%, and merely 5-7% of sessions receive credits on the causal-reasoning rubrics. CausalGame provides a scalable and controlled testbed for evaluating the causal thinking of AI Scientist agents.
papers.comment: Zhenhao, Yongqiang, and Chenxi contributed equally to the project. A short version is accepted at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026 as an Oral presentation. Project website https://causalgame.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CausalGame，一个通过交互式游戏评估 LLM Agent 因果推理能力的基准。基准包含 14 个场景，涵盖选择偏差、测量误差和隐藏混杂因素。评估 30 个 LLM Agent 后，最佳模型仅达到 68.0% 的生存率（分析最优 78-85%），只有 5-7% 的会话获得因果推理评分。
Motivation: 现有 AI 科学家基准未明确包含真实科学发现中普遍存在的选择偏差、测量误差和隐藏混杂因素等挑战，难以评估 LLM Agent 的因果思维。
Method: 设计 14 个交互式游戏场景，要求 LLM Agent 主动设计实验协议、收集观测数据并生成最终解决方案及解释报告，场景包含选择偏差、测量误差和隐藏混杂因素。
Result: 30 个 LLM Agent 均未展示可靠的因果推理：最佳模型生存率 68.0%（分析最优 78-85%），仅 5-7% 的会话在因果推理评分中获得信用。
Conclusion: CausalGame 为评估 AI 科学家 Agent 的因果思维提供了可扩展且受控的测试平台，并指出现有 LLM 在因果推理上的不足。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Agentic SABRE: An Uncertainty-Aware Neuro-Symbolic Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Ransomware Detection
papers.abstract_en: Ransomware has evolved into a complex, adaptive, and fast-moving adversary category in which static signatures and monolithic classifiers fail to generalise under concept drift, evasion, and behavioural polymorphism. In this paper, we present Agentic SABRE (Semantic-Behavioural Arbitration for Ransomware Evaluation), an uncertainty-aware, neuro-symbolic, multi-agent framework for adaptive ransomware detection. SABRE fuses semantic, representation-based evidence with behavioural, time-window forensic telemetry and employs Monte Carlo Dropout inference to quantify epistemic uncertainty for each agent. We introduce a decision-layer orchestrator that performs risk- and uncertainty-aware triage using two interpretable thresholds: a risk score and an uncertainty budget. High-confidence, high-risk samples are automatically contained, while uncertain or borderline cases are escalated to human analysts, establishing a flexible computational contract between autonomous response and analyst oversight. To support auditability and trust, SABRE integrates post-hoc explainability mechanisms, including gradient saliency, permutation importance, and counterfactual analysis, enabling both local and global interpretation of agent decisions. Extensive evaluation on RDset and RanSMAP demonstrates that Agentic SABRE preserves perfect discrimination on saturated semantic datasets, with AUC equal to 1.0, while improving robustness under weak behavioural signals. It achieves up to a 4.9 percent relative reduction in false escalations at equal recall while maintaining calibrated predictive uncertainty. Counterfactual analysis further shows that semantic and behavioural decisions can be reversed with bounded perturbation cost, indicating stable and interpretable decision boundaries.

TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic SABRE，一个不确定性感知的神经符号多智能体框架，用于自适应勒索软件检测。它融合语义和行为证据，使用蒙特卡洛Dropout量化不确定性，并通过决策层编排器进行风险感知分诊，将高置信度高风险样本自动隔离，不确定或临界案例升级给人类分析师。在RDset和RanSMAP上评估，AUC达到1.0，在弱行为信号下鲁棒性提升，误报减少4.9%，反事实分析显示决策边界稳定可解释。
Motivation: 勒索软件演变为复杂、自适应、快速移动的对手，静态签名和单一分类器在概念漂移、规避和行为多态性下无法泛化。
Method: 提出Agentic SABRE框架，融合语义表示证据和行为时间窗取证，使用蒙特卡洛Dropout量化每个智能体的认知不确定性。决策层编排器使用风险评分和不确定性预算两个可解释阈值进行分诊，高风险高置信度样本自动隔离，不确定或临界案例升级给人类分析师。集成后验可解释机制包括梯度显著性、置换重要性和反事实分析。
Result: 在RDset和RanSMAP数据集上，AUC达到1.0；在弱行为信号下鲁棒性提升，在相等召回率下误报相对减少4.9%；预测不确定性校准良好；反事实分析显示语义和行为决策可以通过有界扰动代价逆转，表明决策边界稳定可解释。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了自主响应与分析师监督之间的灵活计算契约，支持审计和信任，并通过反事实验证了稳定可解释的决策边界。

papers.title: Agentic-V2X: Small Language Model Agents for Deadline-Aware V2X Scheduling in 5G/6G Networks
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are proposed as control interfaces for next-generation networks, but their latency, hallucinations, and lack of control guarantees make them unsuitable for near-real-time packet schedulers, especially in dynamic V2X environments. This paper introduces Agentic-V2X, an architecture where a small, locally deployed language model acts as a periodic non-real-time rApp-inspired policy creator, while a lightweight xApp-like controller executes validated policies at intervals suitable for scheduling. The framework targets deadline-aware 5G NR V2X scheduling with heterogeneous services (teleoperated driving, cooperative awareness, HD map sharing, and sensor sharing). Given a scenario summary, service objective, and telemetry, the LLM generates a structured policy containing service priorities, weight bounds, and safety constraints. A validator checks and repairs the policy before the controller enforces it via scheduler-weight adaptation in ns-3/ns3-ai. The evaluation compares proportional fair scheduling, static expert policies, a heuristic xApp, static LLM policies, and adaptive LLM-rApp policies over 126 completed runs. Metrics include deadline-constrained packet reception ratio, tail latency, deadline violations, throughput, fairness, policy validity, and safety interventions. Results show that the adaptive LLM-rApp/xApp design generates valid and executable policies and remains competitive at several operating points, including improved mean critical reliability over PF at the highest density. However, paired statistical analysis shows that the adaptive method is not the best aggregate method and remains below the strongest static policies overall. These results support Agentic-V2X as a safe, executable small-LLM policy-generation architecture rather than a universally dominant scheduler.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对5G/6G网络中V2X调度的近实时控制挑战，提出Agentic-V2X架构，利用小型本地部署语言模型作为非实时策略生成器，并结合轻量级控制器执行验证后的策略。在ns-3仿真中，该方法与多种基准对比，在截止时间约束下表现出竞争力，但整体上并非最优。
Motivation: 大语言模型(LLM)在延迟、幻觉和控制保证方面存在不足，难以直接用于近实时V2X分组调度器，需要一种既利用LLM灵活性又保证可执行性的架构。
Method: 设计Agentic-V2X框架：小型语言模型作为rApp风格的非实时策略创建者，根据场景摘要、服务目标和遥测生成结构化策略（含服务优先级、权重边界和安全约束）；验证器检查和修复策略；xApp控制器通过调度器权重调整执行策略。
Result: 在126次运行中与比例公平调度、静态专家策略等对比，自适应LLM-rApp/xApp设计在最高密度下改善了平均关键可靠性，但配对统计分析显示其并非最佳聚合方法，整体弱于最强的静态策略。
Conclusion: Agentic-V2X被支持为一种安全、可执行的小型LLM策略生成架构，而非通用最优调度器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Risk-Constrained Freshness-Aware Semantic Caching for Open-Web Retrieval-Augmented LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Semantic caching reduces the latency and cost of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) by serving cached answers to semantically similar queries, but most existing methods do not model the time-varying freshness of open-web evidence. We present FreshCache, a three-tier semantic cache that treats cache reuse as a risk-constrained temporal inference problem: before approving a cache hit, FreshCache estimates the probability that the cached result is stale using a fitted exponential decay model enhanced by a learned MLP, and approves reuse only when that probability falls below a per-tier error budget across answers (epsilon = 0.10), URL lists (epsilon = 0.20), and page content (epsilon = 0.35). This allows the system to degrade gracefully as entries age rather than forcing a binary choice between a stale hit and a full pipeline execution. We introduce FreshCache-Bench, a benchmark of 8,072 base queries across five freshness classes with ground truth staleness labels drawn from real web snapshots at 1, 12, 24 hours, and 7 days after a baseline crawl, expanded to 31,201 queries via paraphrase generation. At the 24-hour evaluation window, FreshCache_MLP achieves 97% search API savings at 0.1% hash-based stale error, and an LLM-judge evaluation on 396 confirmed change pairs shows that only 34.3% of detected content changes actually affect answer correctness, placing true answer-affecting stale error at approximately 0.034%. The rule-based FreshCache achieves 98% search savings at 3.3% stale error under a temporal holdout calibration, outperforming SemanticTTL (14.9% stale, 72% saved), vCache (7.2% stale, 47% saved), and SCALM (5.2% stale, 96% saved). Ablations show the temporal risk gate accounts for an 11.6 point reduction in stale error over similarity-only reuse, and the learned MLP reduces stale error a further 3.2 points over the rule-based model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FreshCache，一种三层语义缓存系统，用于开放网络检索增强生成（RAG）中的LLM。通过将缓存重用建模为风险受限的时间推理问题，利用指数衰减模型和MLP估计缓存结果的陈旧概率，并仅在概率低于每层错误预算时允许重用。在FreshCache-Bench基准上，测试了24小时窗口内新旧查询的匹配，实现了高搜索API节省和低陈旧错误率，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有语义缓存方法未考虑开放网络证据随时间变化的时效性，导致缓存命中时可能返回陈旧结果，而全流水线执行成本高。需要一种能在缓存重用中权衡风险与新鲜度的机制。
Method: FreshCache采用三层缓存结构（答案、URL列表、页面内容），每层有独立错误预算。使用指数衰减模型联合MLP学习的时间衰减函数估计缓存条目失效概率，仅在概率低于错误预算时批准缓存命中。
Result: 在24小时窗口，FreshCache_MLP以0.1%哈希陈旧错误实现97%搜索API节省；基于规则的FreshCache实现98%搜索节省、3.3%陈旧错误，优于SemanticTTL（14.9%陈旧、72%节省）、vCache（7.2%陈旧、47%节省）和SCALM（5.2%陈旧、96%节省）。消融实验显示时间风险门控比纯相似性重用降低11.6个百分点陈旧错误，MLP进一步降低3.2个百分点。
Conclusion: 本文证明通过风险受限的时效性建模，语义缓存可以在大幅减少搜索API调用的同时保持极低的真实陈旧错误率，使系统能够随缓存条目老化而优雅降级，而非二元决策。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Learning for Dynamic Programming with Recursive Utility
papers.abstract_en: We propose the first deep learning algorithm, the Certainty Equivalent Learning (CEL) algorithm, for solving high-dimensional discrete-time dynamic programming problems with recursive utility. Dynamic programming with recursive utility is numerically challenging because the recursive utility does not have an explicit representation and the Bellman equation contains a certainty equivalent that is difficult to evaluate. The CEL algorithm learns this certainty-equivalent value directly with neural networks and jointly approximates value functions, policy functions, and certainty-equivalent functions. The CEL algorithm is mesh-free and simulation-based, allowing high-dimensional state and control spaces, and does not rely on Euler equations, first-order conditions, or differentiability of the state transition function. The CEL algorithm also works for dynamic programming problems with expected utility as expected utility is a special case of recursive utility. We apply the CEL to discounted linear exponential quadratic Gaussian control, small-noise robust control, Epstein-Zin DSGE, and multivariate strategic asset allocation problems. Compared with closed-form and VFI-based benchmarks, the CEL delivers accurate value and policy approximations, remains effective in high-dimensional problems, achieves accuracy comparable to VFI in the small-noise robust-control case, and produces out-of-sample Bellman errors and Euler or first-order residuals that are in the range from 1.0e-4 to 1.0e-3 for most problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出确定性等价学习（CEL）算法，用于求解高维离散时间动态规划问题，具有递归效用。该方法用神经网络直接学习确定等价价值函数，联合逼近值函数、策略函数和确定性等价函数，采用无网格、基于模拟的方式，不依赖Euler方程或一阶条件。在多个经济金融问题（包括Epstein-Zin DSGE、战略资产配置）上验证，误差在1e-4到1e-3量级。
Motivation: 递归效用的动态规划数值求解困难，因为递归效用缺乏显式表示，Bellman方程中的确定性等价难以评估。
Method: CEL算法用神经网络直接学习确定性等价价值，联合逼近值函数、策略函数和确定性等价函数；无网格、基于模拟，不依赖Euler方程或可微性。
Result: 在折扣线性二次指数高斯控制、小噪声鲁棒控制、Epstein-Zin DSGE和多变量战略资产配置问题上，相比封闭解和VFI基准，CEL给出准确的值和策略近似，误差在1e-4到1e-3之间。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限，但指出适用于一般递归效用和期望效用，算法有效处理高维问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Reference in Large Language Models: The Introspection Threshold for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of self-evolving AI raises a critical question: when is autonomous self-improvement sustainable rather than degenerative? Drawing an analogy to von Neumann's complexity threshold for self-reproducing automata, we argue that sustainable recursive self-improvement in Large Language Models (LLMs) requires a functional analogue: introspection -- the system's capacity to simulate its own operations and target modifications. Grounded in Kleene's Second Recursion Theorem, we demonstrate the theoretical existence of such introspective programs. However, an empirical review reveals that while current LLMs exhibit quasi-introspection (e.g., partial metacognition), they fall short of true introspection due to structural bottlenecks: a lack of complete self-access, the feedforward nature of the Transformer, and computational class constraints that prevent fixed-point iteration. We conclude by outlining architectural paths to cross this complexity threshold and discussing the associated safety implications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文类比冯·诺依曼的自复制自动机复杂性阈值，提出大型语言模型（LLM）实现可持续递归自我改进需要功能类似的内省（introspection）——系统模拟自身操作并定位修改的能力。基于克莱尼第二递归定理证明此类内省程序的理论存在性，但实证综述表明当前LLM仅具备准内省（例如部分元认知），因结构瓶颈（缺乏完全自访问、Transformer的前馈性质、计算类约束阻碍不动点迭代）而无法实现真正内省。最后概述跨越该复杂性阈值的架构路径及相关安全影响。
Motivation: 追求自进化AI需要明确何时自主自我改进是可持续的而非退化的，当前缺乏理论基础和实证评估来判断LLM递归自我改进的条件。
Method: 通过引入内省作为递归自我改进的功能类比，利用克莱尼第二递归定理证明内省程序的理论存在性，并基于实证综述分析当前LLM在结构上面临的瓶颈。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，但指出当前LLM仅表现出准内省（部分元认知），因缺乏完整自访问、Transformer前馈特性及计算类约束而无法完成不动点迭代，无法实现真正内省。
Conclusion: 论文主张LLM需要架构上的跨越才能达到内省阈值，并指出了相关安全考量，但未提供具体实现方案或实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EMPURPLE: A Free Lunch for Diffusion Distillation based on the Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models achieve impressive image-generation quality but remain expensive at inference time. Diffusion distillation reduces sampling steps, yet many distilled models, including SDXL-Lightning and distribution matching distillation methods, suffer from degraded Fréchet Inception Distance (FID). We analyze this phenomenon through a PAC-style generalization bound. Our analysis suggests that aggressive early-step redirection of the velocity field makes the distillation target harder to learn, enlarging the train-test gap. As a result, early-step output distributions differ between training and inference, causing distribution mismatch in the intermediate noisy latent used as next-step inputs. We empirically validate this mechanism by showing reduced diversity in both intermediate features and final outputs. To address this issue, we propose EMPURPLE, a simple training-free method that recycles intermediate latents sampled from the original model. EMPURPLE is model-agnostic and improves FID by 7\% to 20\% across DMD2, Hyper-SD, FlashSD, and SDXL-Lightning. The repo is: https://github.com/TheLovesOfLadyPurple/Empurple-Training-Free-Algorithm-To-enhance-Diversity-of-The-Diffusion-Distillation-Model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过PAC泛化界分析了扩散蒸馏模型中FID退化的原因，指出早期步骤的速度场重定向导致训练-测试分布不匹配，并提出一种无需训练的EMPurPLE方法，通过重用原始模型采样的中间潜变量来提升多样性，在DMD2、Hyper-SD等模型上改善FID 7%-20%。
Motivation: 扩散蒸馏模型在减少采样步数的同时常出现FID退化，例如SDXL-Lightning和分布匹配蒸馏方法，作者希望从理论上解释并解决这一问题。
Method: 基于PAC泛化界分析，提出EMPurPLE方法，无需额外训练，通过回收原始扩散模型采样过程中的中间潜变量来缓解分布不匹配，作为蒸馏模型推理时的输入。
Result: 在DMD2、Hyper-SD、FlashSD和SDXL-Lightning等多个蒸馏模型上，FID提升7%至20%，且方法具有模型无关性。
Conclusion: EMPurPLE是一种简单、即插即用的方法，有效提升蒸馏模型的多样性，但可能仅在特定蒸馏设置下有效，且未与其他后处理方法对比。

papers.title: LBR: Towards Mitigating Length Bias in Large Language Models for Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful backbones for recommender systems by reformulating recommendation as a token-level generation task. Despite their promise, we identify a pervasive yet underexplored issue: $\textit{Length Bias}$. Because items are represented by textual descriptions of varying lengths, LLM-based recommenders can be systematically biased in two ways. On the input side, longer item descriptions occupy more tokens in the context and thus receive disproportionately large aggregate attention mass during user preference modeling. On the output side, decoding based on summed autoregressive log-likelihood score inherently disfavors long items. Worse still, conventional length normalization can introduce an additional bias and even degrade recommendation performance. To address this problem, we propose $\textbf{LBR}$ ($\textbf{L}$ength $\textbf{B}$ias $\textbf{R}$eduction), a lightweight and model-agnostic framework for mitigating length bias in LLM-based recommendation. LBR mitigates input-side bias via Length-Aware Attention Calibration, which incorporates a length-dependent offset into attention logits to neutralize attention skew. For the output side, LBR introduces Effective Information Length Normalization, replacing naive token count with an information-theoretic length surrogate derived from the branching structure of the prefix tree. Extensive experiments on three real-world Amazon datasets and two representative LLM-based recommenders demonstrate that LBR substantially alleviates length bias while consistently improving recommendation accuracy and fairness, with negligible additional training and inference overhead (with an average NDCG@5 gain of 16.82%). The code is available at https://github.com/Void-JackLee/LBR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出基于大型语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统中存在长度偏差问题：输入侧长描述获得过多注意力，输出侧自回归解码长度归一化反而引入额外偏差。提出轻量级模型无关框架LBR，通过长度感知注意力校准和有效信息长度归一化分别缓解输入/输出侧偏差。在三个Amazon数据集和两个LLM推荐器上，LBR平均提升NDCG@5 16.82%，同时改善公平性。
Motivation: 现有LLM推荐器因物品文本描述长度不同而产生系统性长度偏差，且常规长度归一化可能加剧问题，影响推荐准确性和公平性。
Method: LBR框架包含两项技术：长度感知注意力校准（在注意力logits中加入长度相关偏置以消除注意力倾斜）和有效信息长度归一化（基于前缀树分支结构的信息论长度替代简单token计数）。
Result: 在三个Amazon数据集和两个代表性LLM推荐器上，LBR显著缓解长度偏差并持续提升推荐准确性和公平性，平均NDCG@5提升16.82%，且额外训练和推理开销可忽略。
Conclusion: LBR是一种有效的轻量级方法，能减轻LLM推荐中的长度偏差，同时提升性能与公平性。

papers.title: HALO-WA: Hybrid-Attention Latent-Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World-action (WA) models can generate long-horizon action chunks for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but they remain vulnerable to calibration, perception, and contact-dynamics errors in real-world precision tasks, often failing in the final few millimeters of alignment or insertion. We propose HALO-WA, a hybrid-attention latent-guided online reinforcement learning (RL) framework for WA models, which leverages latent features and action priors from the WA generation process through a lightweight actor-critic adapter to enable fast online adaptation to real deployment errors. HALO-WA introduces a hybrid-attention structure that preserves the temporal consistency of action chunks while reading task-relevant information from WA latents conditioned on visual context and end-stage correction requirements, thereby producing refined action chunks. We validate HALO-WA on four real-world precision manipulation tasks, where it improves the average success rate from 26.4\% for WA-base to 87.1\%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 19.2 percentage points while requiring only 45--75 minutes of online training per task. To facilitate reproducibility, we further conduct supplementary simulation experiments in RoboTwin and release the code at https://github.com/YeanRoot/HALO-WA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HALO-WA，一种混合注意力潜在引导的在线强化学习框架，用于世界-动作模型。该方法通过轻量级actor-critic适配器利用WA生成过程中的潜在特征和动作先验，快速在线适应真实部署误差。在四个真实世界精密操作任务上，平均成功率从26.4%提升到87.1%，超过最强基线19.2个百分点，在线训练仅需45-75分钟。
Motivation: 世界-动作模型在真实世界精密任务中容易因标定、感知和接触动力学误差而失败，尤其是在最后几毫米的对准或插入阶段。
Method: 提出了混合注意力潜在引导的在线RL框架，包含一个混合注意力结构，在保持动作块时间一致性的同时，从WA潜在中读取视觉上下文和末端修正需求信息，从而产生精细化的动作块。
Result: 在四个真实世界精密操作任务上，平均成功率从26.4%提升到87.1%，超过最强基线19.2个百分点，在线训练仅需45-75分钟。还进行了RoboTwin模拟实验以促进可复现性。
Conclusion: HALO-WA通过混合注意力和潜在引导的在线RL，有效提升了WA模型在精密操作中的成功率，且训练时间短。

papers.title: On Preserving Geometrical Invariance for Superpixel Image Classification using Graph Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Vision Transformer (ViT) for image classification exploit a dense grid of pixels containing redundant information. Consequently, for a larger image dataset, CNNs and ViTs face deployability challenges due to high computational complexity. Representing images as graphs of superpixels offers an efficient alternative that preserves key information while eliminating pixel-level redundancy. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been utilized on such graphs to perform image classification. However, GNNs are known to struggle with capturing long-range dependencies which is important in the domain of image classification. Furthermore, a majority of these superpixel-based image classification approaches do not explicitly preserve translation/rotation invariance. Nevertheless, preserving translation/rotation invariance is important for robust image classification. Thus, this paper proposes SuperGT, a Graph Transformer-based framework for image classification, which captures the long range dependencies, along with a pre-processing scheme that preserves translation/rotation invariance. We evaluate SuperGT on CIFAR-10 dataset and observe that it performs significantly better than many baselines. Furthermore, we note that the overall performance of SuperGT is comparable to the previous state-of-the-art model, namely, ShapeGNN, without relying on coordinates of the boundary points of each superpixel required by ShapeGNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SuperGT，一个基于图 Transformer 的超像素图像分类框架，通过预处理方案显式保持平移/旋转不变性，同时利用 Transformer 捕获长程依赖。在 CIFAR-10 数据集上，SuperGT 显著优于多数基线，性能与先前最优模型 ShapeGNN 相当，且不依赖超像素边界点坐标。
Motivation: CNN 和 ViT 在密集像素网格上计算复杂度高，超像素图表示虽高效，但现有 GNN 难以捕获长程依赖且多数方法未显式保持平移/旋转不变性，影响分类鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 SuperGT 框架，采用图 Transformer 架构处理超像素图，并设计预处理方案（如坐标变换）以保持平移/旋转不变性。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，SuperGT 性能显著优于多个基线，与 ShapeGNN 相当，且不需要超像素边界点坐标。
Conclusion: SuperGT 通过结合图 Transformer 和几何不变性预处理，为超像素图像分类提供了高效且鲁棒的方案。

papers.title: Shortcut Learning in Legal Judgment Prediction: Empirical Evidence from the UK Employment Tribunal
papers.abstract_en: Current Legal Judgment Prediction (LJP) is constrained by its reliance on post-hoc judicial materials, increasing the likelihood that models perform retrospective classification rather than true forecasting. This paper empirically investigates shortcut learning in this context by studying claim-level outcome prediction in UK Employment Tribunal (UKET) decisions. Using a corpus of 33,158 individual claims, we predict outcomes from claim texts and LLM-extracted case summaries, evaluating models ranging from interpretable TF-IDF-based classifiers to black-box LLMs. While headline predictive performance figures appear strong, we demonstrate that such performance in LJP systems trained on post-hoc judicial text can be driven by the retrospective nature of the source material. Stratifying the test data by human judgments of leakage reveals that performance increases where outcome-revealing cues are embedded in the narrative. Moreover, a model trained on just the 4% of features identified as leakage achieves high performance, outperforming human experts. These findings substantiate concerns that LJP performance may be exaggerated by linguistic artefacts. Yet this vulnerability is not fatal to the research agenda. Instead, post-hoc judgments might be treated as potentially contaminated texts, requiring active auditing. Retraining models after masking leakage features results in only a negligible reduction in Macro-F1. Hence, while models will opportunistically exploit shortcuts when available, they remain capable of extracting useful predictive signals when these artefacts are removed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证研究法律判决预测（LJP）中的快捷学习（shortcut learning）问题，使用英国就业法庭的33,158个案件，从诉状文本和LLM提取的案例摘要预测结果。尽管表面性能强，但研究发现模型性能主要源于事后司法文本中的数据泄露（leakage），仅用4%的泄露特征训练的模型即可超越人类专家。屏蔽泄露特征后，模型Macro-F1下降很小，表明模型仍能提取有用信号。
Motivation: 当前LJP依赖事后司法材料，导致模型更可能进行回顾性分类而非真正预测，性能可能被语言伪像夸大。
Method: 使用可解释的TF-IDF分类器到黑盒LLM等多种模型，基于诉状文本和LLM提取的摘要预测案件结果，并通过人工判断数据泄露对测试数据进行分层分析，评估快捷学习的影响。
Result: 仅用4%的泄露特征训练的模型性能超过人类专家；屏蔽泄露特征后，模型Macro-F1仅略有下降，表明模型仍能提取有用预测信号。
Conclusion: LJP性能可能被事后司法文本中的语言伪像夸大，但通过主动审计和屏蔽泄露特征，模型仍能有效预测，该研究方向并非不可行。

papers.title: AdaptiveSplat:Texture Aware Controllable 3D Gaussian Allocation for Feed-Forward Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Current feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods predict pixel aligned Gaussian primitives, resulting in highly redundant representations. A natural solution is to prune the redundant Gaussians, but naive pruning introduces severe artifacts and often requires inference time fine-tuning, breaking the feed-forward paradigm. Based on previous works, high frequency regions require more Gaussian primitives, while low frequency regions can be represented with significantly fewer primitives. Motivated by this, we propose a novel approach to explicitly control the number of Gaussians by leveraging local texture information. Our approach achieves this through three key components: (1) texture estimation to capture spatial variation in scene detail, (2) texture-aware pruning that removes redundant Gaussians from low frequency regions, and (3) an adaptive Gaussian head that predicts the modified attributes of the retained primitives without breaking the feed-forward paradigm. Experiments on RE10K, ACID, DL3DV, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, while ablation studies validate the contributions of its key components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaptiveSplat，一种前馈式 3D 高斯重建方法，通过纹理感知的高斯数量控制来减少冗余，避免 naive prunning 带来的伪影和微调需求。方法包括纹理估计、纹理感知剪枝和自适应高斯头，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 当前前馈式 3D 重建方法预测像素对齐的高斯基元，导致高度冗余；简单剪枝会引入严重伪影且需推理时微调，破坏前馈范式。
Method: 提出三个关键组件：(1) 纹理估计，捕捉场景细节的空间变化；(2) 纹理感知剪枝，从低频区域移除冗余高斯；(3) 自适应高斯头，预测保留基元的修改属性，保持前馈范式。
Result: 在 RE10K、ACID、DL3DV、Tanks and Temples 和 DTU 数据集上验证了有效性，消融研究证实了各组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式利用局部纹理信息控制高斯数量，在减少冗余的同时避免了伪影和微调，保持了前馈重建的效率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出三个关键组件：(1) 纹理估计，捕捉场景细节的空间变化；(2) 纹理感知剪枝，从低频区域移除冗余高斯；(3) 自适应高斯头，预测保留基元的修改属性，保持前馈范式。
summary_sections.result: 在 RE10K、ACID、DL3DV、Tanks and Temples 和 DTU 数据集上验证了有效性，消融研究证实了各组件的贡献。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法通过显式利用局部纹理信息控制高斯数量，在减少冗余的同时避免了伪影和微调，保持了前馈重建的效率。

papers.title: Air-Plan: Query-Optimized Topology Selection for Over-the-Air Decentralized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Over-the-air (OTA) aggregation exploits the superposition property of wireless multiple-access channels to aggregate model updates from multiple devices within a single transmission slot, significantly reducing communication latency. While OTA computation has been extensively studied for centralized federated learning (FL), its integration with decentralized federated learning (DFL) remains largely unexplored, and principled communication topology selection is absent from existing work. We present AIRPLAN, a query-optimized topology selection framework for Over-the-Air Decentralized Federated Learning (OTA-DFL). AIRPLAN establishes a formal equivalence between OTA-DFL and distributed query processing, enabling topology selection to be formulated as a cost-based query optimization problem. Using privacy-preserving Count-Min Sketch statistics, AIRPLAN estimates workload characteristics, evaluates a graph-aware cost model across candidate topologies, and selects the communication graph that minimizes training cost while satisfying a target accuracy SLA. Experiments across five graph families, three vision benchmarks, four client scales, and multiple SNR settings show that AIRPLAN matches the oracle-optimal topology in 91.4% of workloads while introducing less than 1.8% overhead. We further derive theoretical error bounds for topology-aware sparsification, demonstrating that well-connected topologies better tolerate aggressive compression. AIRPLAN introduces a systems-oriented perspective that bridges wireless federated learning and distributed query optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AIRPLAN，一个查询优化的拓扑选择框架，用于空中聚合去中心化联邦学习（OTA-DFL）。它建立了OTA-DFL与分布式查询处理的形式等价性，利用Count-Min Sketch隐私统计估计工作负载，并通过图感知代价模型选择通信图。在多种图族、视觉基准和SNR设置下，AIRPLAN在91.4%的工作负载中匹配最优拓扑，且开销低于1.8%。还推导了拓扑感知稀疏化的理论误差界。
Motivation: 空中聚合（OTA）在集中式联邦学习中已被广泛研究，但在去中心化联邦学习（DFL）中的集成尚待探索，且缺乏原则性的通信拓扑选择方法。
Method: 提出AIRPLAN框架，将OTA-DFL建模为查询优化问题，通过隐私保护的Count-Min Sketch估计工作负载，基于图感知代价模型在候选拓扑中选择最小化训练成本且满足准确率SLA的通信图。
Result: 实验在5种图族、3个视觉基准、4种客户端规模和多种SNR下，AIRPLAN在91.4%的工作负载中匹配oracle最优拓扑，引入少于1.8%的开销。
Conclusion: AIRPLAN提供了系统视角，桥接了无线联邦学习与分布式查询优化，并证明良好连接的拓扑能更好地容忍激进压缩。

papers.title: Beyond Random Sampling: Distribution-Aware Alignment for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Precise medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, yet relies heavily on expensive expert annotations. Semi-supervised medical image segmentation (SSMIS) offers a cost-effective solution but typically operates under the assumption of independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) data, defaulting to random sampling. While statistically valid at scale, this strategy suffers from severe representation bias in low-data regimes, failing to capture the heterogeneous medical data manifold. To address this, we propose a highly data-efficient framework driven by distribution alignment. First, we introduce an offline Distribution-Aware Sample Selection strategy. By leveraging Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) and our designed Density-K-Center algorithm, we explicitly identify representative structural anchors, establishing a more representative labeled domain. Second, to bridge the remaining distribution gap, we propose the Memory-guided Copy-Paste (MCP) module. Tailored for the inherent class imbalance in medical scans, MCP leverages a semantic memory mechanism to retrieve historically consistent priors for cross-domain alignment, encouraging semantic consistency. Coupled with an easy-to-hard progressive schedule, this framework effectively mitigates early-stage pseudo-label noise. Extensive experiments on six diverse 2D and 3D datasets demonstrate strong segmentation performance, particularly in extremely low-labeled scenarios (\eg, 1/16 ratio).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对半监督医学图像分割中随机抽样导致的表示偏差问题，提出一种基于分布对齐的高效数据框架。通过离线分布感知样本选择策略（利用视觉基础模型和密度K中心算法）和记忆引导的复制粘贴模块，在极低标注比例下提升了分割性能。
Motivation: 半监督医学图像分割通常假设数据独立同分布并使用随机采样，但在低数据 regime 下会产生严重的表示偏差，无法捕获异质医学数据流形。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 离线分布感知样本选择策略，借助视觉基础模型和密度K中心算法识别代表性结构锚点；2) 记忆引导的复制粘贴模块，利用语义记忆机制检索历史一致先验进行跨域对齐，并配合易到难的渐进式训练。
Result: 在六个2D和3D数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在极低标注比例（如1/16）下取得了强分割性能。
Conclusion: 本框架通过分布对齐有效缓解了早期伪标签噪声，在半监督医学图像分割场景中具有高数据效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Signal or Noise? Understanding Generative Models for Real-World Sensor Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have changed how machine learning represents complex data distributions, especially in language and vision, yet many real-world systems are observed instead as continuous, high-dimensional, and noisy sensor time series. Existing generative modeling of sensor data, however, remains fragmented across modalities, datasets, and task formulations, limiting a systematic understanding of when, how, and why generative models succeed or fail in real-world settings. To address this gap, we introduce SensorGen, a large-scale study of sensor-signal generation spanning 14 settings across 4 domains, 7 datasets, and 12 signal modalities. Leveraging SensorGen, we systematically evaluate generative models from five major families and uncover three key findings: (1) flow-matching models provide strong overall performance across most settings; (2) signal properties matter, with demographic covariates improving longitudinal generation and time-frequency modeling improving high-frequency signal generation; and (3) generated signals have practical utility beyond visual realism, with scaling improving generation quality and synthetic data improving downstream performance. Together, SensorGen establishes a broader understanding of design choices, evaluation protocols, and failure modes in real-world sensor data generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模研究SensorGen，系统评估了五个生成模型家族在跨4个领域、7个数据集、12种信号模态的传感器时间序列生成上的表现，发现流匹配模型整体表现最佳，信号特性（如人口统计协变量、时频建模）影响生成质量，且生成信号在下游任务中具有实用价值。
Motivation: 现有传感器数据生成研究分散于不同模态、数据集和任务，缺乏系统性理解生成模型在真实场景中成功或失败的条件。
Method: 构建涵盖14种设置、4个领域、7个数据集、12种信号模态的SensorGen基准，对五个主要生成模型家族（如流匹配、扩散模型等）进行统一评估。
Result: 流匹配模型在多数设置下表现强劲；人口统计协变量改善纵向生成，时频建模提升高频信号生成；生成信号的可扩展性提升质量且合成数据改善下游性能。
Conclusion: 传感器生成需要关注信号特性与设计选择，流匹配是强候选，但不同模态适用不同策略，揭示了失败模式与评估协议。

papers.title: Quantize the Target, Quantize the Drafter: Efficient Inference with Qwen3.5-4B
papers.abstract_en: This report describes our approach to the Efficient Qwen Competition, where the goal is to enable low-latency serving of Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained NVIDIA A10G GPU. Our system combines a quantized target model with speculative decoding. To recover accuracy, we apply quantization-aware distillation to the target model while retaining the original quantization grid. To speed up decoding, a block-diffusion drafter specialized for the quantized target model is trained using a two-stage procedure: first learning from the high-precision target and then adapting to the low-precision target. Because the drafter is invoked at every speculative decoding step, we further reduce its overhead with quantization and sliding-window attention, preserving draft-token acceptance while improving long-context decoding latency. As a result, our submission achieves a 6.978$\times$ average speedup over the baseline while satisfying the required quality thresholds, ranking 3rd overall. We hope these results provide useful insights for practical LLM inference. The code and resources are available at https://github.com/nota-github/adaptfm-quant-dflash
papers.comment: All authors contributed equally. Our submission to Efficient Qwen Competition, ICML 2026 Workshop on AdaptFM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了在资源受限的NVIDIA A10G GPU上为Qwen3.5-4B模型实现低延迟推理的方法。系统结合了量化目标模型和推测解码，采用量化感知蒸馏恢复精度，并使用块扩散草稿模型（block-diffusion drafter）加速解码。草稿模型经过两阶段训练，并进一步通过量化和滑动窗口注意力降低开销。最终在满足质量阈值的前提下实现了6.978倍的平均加速，在ICML 2026 Efficient Qwen竞赛中排名第三。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在资源受限的GPU上推理延迟高，需要有效的压缩和加速技术来同时满足低延迟和质量要求。
Method: 使用量化目标模型结合推测解码；对目标模型应用量化感知蒸馏（保持原始量化网格）；为量化模型训练专用的块扩散草稿模型（先学习高精度目标再适配低精度目标）；对草稿模型进行量化和滑动窗口注意力以减少推理开销。
Result: 在A10G GPU上实现6.978倍平均加速，满足质量阈值，竞赛排名第三。
Conclusion: 结合量化目标模型和专门训练的草稿模型可以有效加速LLM推理，为实际部署提供实用见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HeartVolMesh: Cardiac Volumetric Mesh Reconstruction via Covariance-Guided Graph Deformation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate patient-specific tetrahedral cardiac meshes are essential for in-silico trials, yet common segmentation-then-modelling pipelines can blur thin-wall anatomy and offer limited cross-case correspondence. We propose HeartVolMesh, which lifts each template vertex to an anisotropic Gaussian kernel and uses a 3D CNN-GNN to predict per-vertex displacements and Cholesky-parameterized covariances from volumetric images. Training is guided by a covariance-aware negative log-likelihood loss with lightweight mesh regularization. For volumetric meshing, we warp a fixed tetrahedral template to the reconstructed surface via staged alignment, non-rigid registration, and deformation propagation, preserving connectivity and correspondence by construction, with resolution controlled by template density. Experiments show consistent gains over deformation-based baselines in surface mesh accuracy and volumetric mesh fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HeartVolMesh，一种从体积图像重建病人特异性心脏四面体网格的方法。通过将模板顶点提升为各向异性高斯核，并利用 3D CNN-GNN 预测位移和协方差，训练采用协方差感知的负对数似然损失。网格生成通过将固定四面体模板变形到重建表面，保持连接性和对应关系，分辨率由模板密度控制。实验表明在表面网格精度和体积网格保真度上优于基于变形的基线方法。
Motivation: 现有分割-建模流水线会模糊薄壁解剖结构，且缺乏跨病例对应关系，而精确的病人特异性心脏四面体网格对虚拟临床试验至关重要。
Method: 提出 HeartVolMesh，将模板顶点提升为各向异性高斯核，用 3D CNN-GNN 预测位移和 Cholesky 参数化的协方差，训练使用协方差感知的负对数似然损失和轻量网格正则化。网格生成通过分阶段对齐、非刚性配准和变形传播将固定四面体模板变形到重建表面。
Result: 摘要报告在表面网格精度和体积网格保真度上持续优于基于变形的基线方法。
Conclusion: HeartVolMesh 提供了一种保持连通性和对应关系的病人特异性心脏体积网格重建方法，分辨率由模板密度控制。

papers.title: Progress- and Reliability-Oriented Group Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective paradigm for improving large language model agents on long-horizon interactive tasks. To obtain finer-grained policy updates than trajectory-level optimization, recent work has moved toward step-level group-based RL, where intermediate steps are grouped and compared within a rollout batch. However, step-level advantage estimation is sensitive to how groups are formed: grouping by broad state keys improves coverage but may compare actions taken under different histories, while enforcing historical consistency yields fairer comparisons at the cost of fragmented groups and missing peer-comparison signal. In this paper, we propose ProGPO (Progress- and Reliability-Oriented Group Policy Optimization), a learned-critic-free method for context-consistent step-level learning. ProGPO keeps exact-prefix action comparison, and complements sparse peer comparisons with transition credit derived from rollout-based state potentials. To estimate these potentials reliably, ProGPO combines semantic expansion with inverse-variance fusion across history depths. We evaluate ProGPO on two challenging agentic tasks, ALFWorld and WebShop, with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Results show that ProGPO improves over matched agentic RL baselines under comparable computational overhead, and additional Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct experiments further test the scalability of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体强化学习中基于步骤的组策略优化中的优势估计敏感性问题，提出ProGPO（面向进展和可靠性的组策略优化）。该方法无需学习评论员，通过保持精确前缀动作比较并结合基于 rollout 状态势能的过渡信用，实现上下文一致的步骤级学习。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 任务上使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 评估，结果显示在相当计算开销下优于匹配的智能体 RL 基线。
Motivation: 现有基于步骤的组级强化学习中，优势估计对分组方式敏感：按历史状态键分组可能导致比较不公，而强制历史一致性会导致组碎片化和缺失同行比较信号。需要一种既能保持历史一致性又能获得可靠比较信号的方法。
Method: 提出 ProGPO，一种无需学习评论员的方法，采用精确前缀动作比较，并通过基于 rollout 状态势能的过渡信用来补充稀疏的同行比较。为可靠估计势能，结合语义扩展和跨历史深度的逆方差融合。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 两个挑战性智能体任务上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 进行实验，ProGPO 在相当计算开销下优于匹配的智能体 RL 基线，并在更大模型上验证了可扩展性。
Conclusion: ProGPO 提供了一种有效的步骤级组策略优化方法，避免了学习评论员的需求，并处理了分组一致性与比较信号之间的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Multi-to-Single-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Disruption Prediction in EAST
papers.abstract_en: Plasma disruption is a critical threat to tokamak safety. Existing data-driven predictors mainly rely on time-series diagnostic signals, while visible images provide complementary spatial cues including plasma deformation, local brightening, and radiation-structure evolution. Although the image modality improves the model's discriminative capability, it also substantially increases the computational cost during inference. To address this issue, we propose a hierarchical multi-to-single-modal knowledge distillation framework for disruption prediction on a synchronized EAST multimodal dataset. During training, visible images and time-series signals are used to train a multimodal teacher, which learns disruption precursor representations through Transformer-based encoders and a prototype-guided spatiotemporal hypergraph module. During inference, only the time-series student is retained, with multimodal knowledge transferred through graph-structure-level, representation-level, and decision-level distillation. On the 640-discharge EAST dataset, the results demonstrate that the proposed framework can preserve the discriminative advantages of multimodal learning while substantially reducing inference cost, and providing an effective route for efficient disruption prediction in EAST. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EAST托卡马克等离子体破裂预测中的计算成本问题，提出层次化多到单模态知识蒸馏框架。训练时利用可见光图像和时间序列信号训练多模态教师模型，推理时仅保留时间序列学生模型，通过图结构级、表示级和决策级蒸馏迁移知识。在640次放电的EAST数据集上，该方法保留了多模态学习的判别优势并降低了推理成本。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的破裂预测主要依赖时间序列诊断信号，而可见光图像虽能提供空间线索但大幅增加推理计算成本，需要在不牺牲性能的前提下降低开销。
Method: 提出层次化多到单模态知识蒸馏框架：训练时使用Transformer编码器和原型引导的时空超图模块构建多模态教师；推理时仅保留时间序列学生，并通过图结构级、表示级和决策级蒸馏迁移多模态知识。
Result: 在640次放电的EAST数据集上，该方法在保持多模态学习判别优势的同时显著降低了推理成本。
Conclusion: 该框架为EAST装置的高效破裂预测提供了有效途径，代码将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Biological Motifs for Agentic Control
papers.abstract_en: The transition of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive generators to autonomous agents has introduced significant challenges in reliability, security, and state management. Current agentic architectures are often constructed ad-hoc, prone to hallucination cascades, infinite loops, and prompt injection attacks. This paper argues that many of these failure modes can be analyzed using control motifs long studied in systems biology, provided the comparison is made at the level of typed interfaces and coordination structure rather than literal biological mechanism. We develop a typed interface correspondence between Gene Regulatory Networks and agentic software systems using polynomial functors and wiring diagrams. Five biological motifs are mapped to composable software design patterns: Coherent Feed-Forward Loops for noise suppression, Adaptive Immunity for layered security, Mitochondrial Signaling for resource governance, Endosymbiosis for neuro-symbolic integration, and Morphogen Diffusion for spatially varying coordination. An epistemic topology layer derives Kripke-style knowledge operators from the wiring diagram's observation structure and proves four predictive theorems for multi-agent scaling. The core contributions are: (1) the Agentic Operad, a typed syntax for agent composition with provable error suppression bounds for feed-forward topologies; (2) an epistemic topology with four theorems (error amplification, sequential penalty, parallel acceleration, and tool density scaling) whose qualitative predictions are consistent with published multi-agent benchmarks; and (3) a six-layer progression from structure through development, grounded in autonomous learning frameworks and convergence proxies from the empirical literature. A reference implementation with 1,813 tests and 116 examples illustrates practical feasibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型从被动生成器向自主智能体转变时出现的可靠性、安全性和状态管理问题，提出使用系统生物学中的控制基序（motifs）来分析这些失效模式。通过多项式函子（polynomial functors）和接线图（wiring diagrams）建立基因调控网络与智能体软件系统之间的类型接口对应，并将五种生物基序映射为可组合的软件设计模式。核心贡献包括：Agentic Operad（一种具有可证明错误抑制边界的智能体组合类型语法）、一个认识论拓扑（包含四个预测定理）以及一个六层结构发展框架。参考实现包含1813个测试和116个示例。
Motivation: 当前大型语言模型作为自主智能体时的架构往往是临时构建的，容易出现幻觉级联、无限循环和提示注入攻击等故障。论文旨在利用系统生物学中长期研究的控制基序来分析和缓解这些故障，前提是比较是在类型接口和协调结构层面而非字面生物机制层面进行。
Method: 发展了一种基于多项式函子和接线图的类型接口对应关系，将基因调控网络与智能体软件系统联系起来。将五种生物基序映射为可组合软件设计模式：相干前馈环路（噪声抑制）、适应性免疫（分层安全）、线粒体信号（资源治理）、内共生（神经符号集成）和形态素扩散（空间变化协调）。此外，还提出了一个认识论拓扑层，从接线图的观测结构推导出克里普克风格的知识算子，并证明了四个预测定理。
Result: 证明了四个定理（错误放大、顺序惩罚、并行加速和工具密度缩放），其定性预测与已发表的多智能体基准一致。参考实现包含1813个测试和116个示例，证明了实际可行性。
Conclusion: 论文通过生物基序的映射为自主智能体系统提供了可组合的设计模式和理论保证，但强调这种对应是在类型接口和协调结构层面，而非字面生物机制。六个层次结构从结构到发展，基于自主学习框架和经验文献中的收敛代理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Bayes-Assisted Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Bayes-assisted conformal prediction combines the strengths of Bayesian modelling with exact, distribution-free frequentist coverage guarantees. Although conformal validity is preserved even when the Bayesian working model (BWM) is misspecified, the size of the resulting prediction sets can degrade substantially when the prior is poorly aligned with the observed data. We address this limitation by introducing RoBAS (Robust Bayes-Assisted Shrinkage): a Bayes-assisted framework for constructing robust nonconformity scores, with two instantiations: one induced by a heavy-tailed BWM, and a closed-form empirical Bayes shrinkage score. The resulting scores adapt to the quality of the working information encoded in the prior: when this information is reliable, they exploit it to produce efficient prediction sets; when it is weak or inaccurate, they revert to the Distance-To-Average (DTA) score, a robust non-informative baseline. We evaluate the proposed scores on tabular and image regression tasks where the training distribution may differ from the calibration and test distributions, while the calibration and test data themselves remain exchangeable. We find that they are competitive with widely used scores in the absence of such shift, while substantially reducing interval widths in shifted settings.
papers.comment: Accepted to AISTATS 2026. 44 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoBAS（稳健贝叶斯辅助收缩）框架，用于构建稳健的非一致性评分，结合贝叶斯建模与分布无关的频率覆盖保证。当先验信息可靠时，利用先验生成高效预测集；当先验不准确时，退化为稳健无信息基线 DTA 分数。在表格和图像回归任务上评估，在无分布偏移时与常用评分相当，在有偏移时显著减少区间宽度。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯辅助共形预测在贝叶斯工作模型（BWM）误指定且先验与数据对齐不良时，预测集大小会严重恶化。需要一种框架来自适应地利用先验信息质量。
Method: 提出 RoBAS 框架，包含两种实例化：一种由重尾 BWM 诱导，另一种为闭合形式经验贝叶斯收缩评分。评分自适应调整：当先验信息可靠时利用其产生高效集，否则回退到 DTA 评分。
Result: 在表格和图像回归任务中，无分布偏移时与常用评分相当；在训练分布与校准/测试分布不同但校准与测试数据可交换的偏移设置下，显著减少区间宽度。
Conclusion: RoBAS 提供了一种结合贝叶斯建模与稳健共形预测的方法，在保持分布无关覆盖保证的同时，对先验误指定具有稳健性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SoftVTBench: A Safety-Aware Visuo-Tactile Benchmark for Physically Constrained Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects
papers.abstract_en: Deformable object manipulation poses challenges beyond task completion: successful execution must also maintain safe physical interaction, holding the object stably without slip or drop while avoiding excessive deformation. However, existing manipulation benchmarks are predominantly success-oriented and rarely evaluate whether a policy remains physically safe throughout execution. We present SoftVTBench, a safety-aware visuo-tactile benchmark for physically constrained deformable object manipulation. Built in Isaac Sim with finite-element-simulated deformable objects, SoftVTBench provides multi-view RGB observations, RGB tactile sensing with marker motion, proprioception, and language instructions, and defines four matched task suites over object type (deformable vs. rigid) and variation axis (object vs. spatial). It separately reports Goal Success and Safety Success; the latter additionally requires no drop and peak deformation below a calibrated object-specific threshold, measured from policy-hidden privileged Finite Element Method (FEM) states. We implement pi0.5-based baselines under this protocol. Experiments show that success-only evaluation substantially overstates policy performance, as a large fraction of goal-completing rollouts still violate physical safety. Furthermore, incorporating tactile sensing improves Safety Success (e.g., from 21.4% to 35.6% on object-centric deformable tasks) and reduces object deformation during execution, while maintaining comparable Goal Success. SoftVTBench provides a reproducible benchmark for studying visuo-tactile deformable manipulation under physical interaction constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SoftVTBench，一个面向物理约束下软体物体操作的安全感知视触觉基准。基准基于Isaac Sim和有限元仿真，提供多视角RGB、触觉传感、本体感知和语言指令，并分别报告任务成功和安全成功指标。实验表明仅考虑任务成功会高估策略性能，而触觉传感可提升安全成功率和降低变形。
Motivation: 现有操作基准大多只关注任务完成，缺乏对操作过程中物理安全性的评估，如避免掉落和过度变形。
Method: 在Isaac Sim中构建有限元仿真的软体物体，设计四种任务套件（软体vs刚性物体，物体vs空间变化轴），提供多模态观测和语言指令，并利用策略隐藏的有限元状态计算安全成功指标（无掉落且峰值变形低于阈值）。
Result: 仅以目标完成评价会严重高估策略性能，大量完成目标的轨迹违反物理安全；引入触觉传感将安全成功率从21.4%提升至35.6%（面向软体物体任务），同时保持相近的任务成功率。
Conclusion: SoftVTBench为研究物理交互约束下的视触觉软体操作提供了可复现的基准，强调安全评估的必要性及触觉传感的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unified convergence analysis for gradient descent optimization methods in the training of deep neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Gradient based optimization methods are nowadays the methods of choice for training deep neural networks (DNNs) in artificial intelligence (AI) systems. In practically relevant DNN training problems, one does usually not apply the standard gradient descent (GD) optimization method but instead one employs suitable sophisticated GD optimization methods, which incorporate adaptivity and/or acceleration techniques, such as the famous Adam optimizer. It is a key contribution of this work to provide a general unified convergence analysis for GD optimization methods in the training of DNNs with analytic activations such as the softplus and the popular Gaussian error linear unit (GeLU) activation. Our general unified convergence result applies to a large class of gradient based optimization methods such as the standard GD, the momentum, the Nesterov accelerated gradient (NAG), the RMSprop, the Adam, the Adamax, the Nadam, the Nadamax, the Adan, the AdaBelief, the AMSGrad, and the Yogi optimizers. Our analysis employs the theory of Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz (KL) inequalities to establish convergence to critical points in the training of DNNs. To the best of our knowledge, the generality of our convergence analysis is also just in the special situation of the Adam optimizer a new contribution to the literature on the analysis of AI optimization algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为深度神经网络训练中使用的多种梯度下降优化方法（包括标准GD、动量法、NAG、RMSprop、Adam、Adamax、Nadam、Nadamax、Adan、AdaBelief、AMSGrad、Yogi等）提供统一的收敛性分析。利用Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz不等式理论，在解析激活函数（如softplus和GeLU）条件下，证明了这些优化器在训练过程中收敛到临界点。该分析在Adam优化器情形下也是文献中的新贡献。
Motivation: 实际深度神经网络训练中常使用Adam等改进优化器，但缺乏统一的收敛性理论。本文旨在为一大类梯度下降优化方法建立通用的收敛性分析框架。
Method: 基于Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz不等式理论，对多种梯度下降优化器（包括自适应和加速方法）进行统一的收敛性分析，适用于解析激活函数。
Result: 证明了在深度神经网络训练中，标准GD、动量、NAG、RMSprop、Adam、Adamax、Nadam、Nadamax、Adan、AdaBelief、AMSGrad、Yogi等优化器均收敛到临界点。
Conclusion: 该统一收敛性分析是理论贡献，特别是在Adam优化器上也是新的。但分析限于解析激活函数，适用范围有待扩展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AI-RAN on NPUs: Baseband Processing Without Baseband Chips
papers.abstract_en: AI-RAN aims to unify artificial intelligence and radio access network workloads on a shared compute substrate. While this paradigm has so far been demonstrated primarily on Graphics Processing Units (GPUs), it remains unclear whether Neural Processing Units (NPUs), which are AI accelerators optimized for inference, can also support wireless baseband processing. Here, we provide the first affirmative answer by resolving the fundamental mismatch between baseband workloads and NPU architecture. A computational isomorphism exists: matrix and vector engines NPUs dedicate to inference inherently cover physical-layer operations. Yet NPU architectures are natively shaped for dense-tensor AI inference, not baseband. This architectural mismatch surfaces as opposing optimization objectives: traditional baseband minimizes arithmetic operations, whereas NPU performance demands maximizing engine utilization. We close this gap by reconstructing communication algorithms onto AI compute primitives, prioritizing engine utilization over arithmetic count. We validate this with a complete OFDM transceiver on an Ascend 310B1 edge NPU, demonstrating end-to-end over-the-air transmission via USRP X300 at 3.0 GHz.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to npj Wireless Technology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次证明NPU可以支持无线基带处理，通过将通信算法重构为AI计算原语，解决基带负载与NPU架构之间的不匹配，并在Ascend 310B1 NPU上验证了完整的OFDM收发器。
Motivation: 传统基带处理依赖专用基带芯片，而AI-RAN通常使用GPU，但NPU作为AI推理加速器是否也能支持无线基带处理尚不清楚。
Method: 识别基带操作与NPU矩阵/向量引擎之间的计算同构性，通过将通信算法重构为AI计算原语，优先考虑引擎利用率而非算术运算次数，从而弥合架构不匹配。
Result: 在Ascend 310B1边缘NPU上实现了完整的OFDM收发器，并通过USRP X300在3.0 GHz进行了端到端空中传输验证。
Conclusion: 摘要表明NPU可以替代基带芯片执行基带处理，为AI-RAN提供了新的计算平台选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detecting Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation through Grounding-Aware Sensitivity by Perturbation (GASP)
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reduces but does not eliminate hallucination, and existing detectors return a single answer-level score that does not indicate which sentence is unsupported, or why. To close this gap, we introduce Grounding-Aware Sensitivity by Perturbation (GASP), a span-level detector that scores each answer sentence by how strongly its likelihood depends on the retrieved evidence, a quantity we term grounding sensitivity. GASP holds the answer fixed and re-scores it under the full context, under no context, and with each chunk removed, then measures the log-likelihood drops and Jensen-Shannon divergences (JSD). The likelihood of a grounded sentence collapses once its supporting passage is removed, whereas a hallucinated sentence is almost unaffected, a contrast we interpret by casting decoding as a random nonlinear iterated function system (RNIFS). We evaluate GASP on three benchmarks (RAGTruth, TofuEval, RAGBench) with three instruction-tuned scorers from two model families (Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and SmolLM2-1.7B) under a leakage-clean protocol. On RAGTruth it reaches a response-level area under the ROC curve (AUC) of about 0.73 and a span-level AUC of about 0.67, improving significantly over perplexity and by clear margins over length, whole-context natural language inference (NLI), and self-consistency baselines. The only baseline competitive at the span level is a well-configured chunk-level entailment verifier, which requires a separate model, whereas a training-free threshold on the grounding features matches the trained classifier without labeled data and serves as the default detector. Beyond RAGTruth, the signal transfers to TofuEval but not to short-answer question answering in RAGBench, showing GASP is best suited to outputs constructed from the retrieved context rather than answers recoverable from parametric knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为GASP的span-level幻觉检测方法，用于检索增强生成（RAG）。GASP通过扰动上下文并计算每个答案句子的grounding sensitivity（即其似然对检索证据的依赖程度）来识别幻觉。在RAGTruth、TofuEval和RAGBench三个基准上，使用Qwen2.5等模型评估，GASP在响应级和span级AUC上优于困惑度、长度、NLI和自一致性基线，且无需训练即可达到与训练分类器相当的性能。但该方法在短答案QA任务上效果不佳。
Motivation: 现有RAG幻觉检测器只输出单个答案级分数，无法定位具体哪个句子未被证据支持，也无法解释原因。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供细粒度的span级检测。
Method: GASP固定答案，分别在全上下文、无上下文和逐块移除上下文的情况下重新评分，测量对数似然下降和Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD），以此计算每个句子的grounding sensitivity。同时将解码过程解释为随机非线性迭代函数系统（RNIFS），以解释幻觉与可支撑句子的不同行为。
Result: 在RAGTruth上，响应级AUC约0.73，span级AUC约0.67，显著优于困惑度、长度、全上下文NLI和自一致性基线。在TofuEval上信号可迁移，但在RAGBench的短答案QA上不适用，表明GASP更适合基于检索上下文生成的回答。
Conclusion: GASP是一种有效的基于扰动的span级幻觉检测方法，其训练无关的阈值可替代训练分类器，适用于长文本RAG输出，但不宜用于依赖参数知识的短答案。

papers.title: Unsupervised Features Mining via Activation Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability methods aim to reveal the features represented inside large language models (LLMs). Many existing methods begin with labeled examples of a human-defined concept that may reflect human biases, and then identify how that concept is represented within the model, for example in its activation space or through other decomposition methods. We introduce \emph{Mining via Activation Geometry} (MAG), a simple unsupervised framework for extracting reasoning features from model activations by prepending the same natural-language instruction $Q$ to every input $p$, where $Q$ defines the reasoning feature of interest, such as ``Can this object be found in the desert?'' or ``Is this prompt malicious?'' We measure how the instruction changes the model's internal representation using $m(Q \mid p) - m(p)$ at a single readout point. We explore eight different MAGs. The extracted reasoning features predict the models' own world understanding and judgment, can be approximated into a single activation direction, we found that some features are more linearly represented and some less, this linear representation, which is vector steering, can change the LLMs' decisions through activation steering by injecting reasoning features. Finally, we use the same method to select the best training datasets for prompt-injection classifier probes: while similarity between ordinary activations is almost unrelated to downstream performance, RFD-based similarity achieves $94.7\%$ Top-1 and $100\%$ Top-2 accuracy.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026, workshop on Failure Modes in Agentic AI (FAGEN)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无监督特征挖掘方法（MAG），通过预置相同自然语言指令到每个输入，测量指令如何改变模型内部表示，从而提取推理特征。实验表明提取的特征可预测模型自身判断，可通过激活引导改变决策，并用于选择最佳训练数据集达到高准确率。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法通常依赖人工标注概念，可能引入人类偏见。本文旨在无监督地从模型激活中提取推理特征。
Method: 提出基于激活几何的无监督框架MAG，通过向每个输入预置相同指令Q，计算表示差异m(Q|p)-m(p)来提取特征。探索了8种MAG，并将特征近似为单一激活方向。
Result: 提取的推理特征可预测模型自身理解，通过激活引导可改变决策。基于RFD的相似性在选择数据集时达到94.7% Top-1和100% Top-2准确率。
Conclusion: MAG能无监督地提取推理特征，并可用于下游任务如数据集选择，但未讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic IoT: Architectures, Applications, and Challenges Toward the Internet of Agents
papers.abstract_en: The integration of AI into Internet of Things (AIoT) systems has gradually transformed them from passive data collection infrastructures into intelligent systems capable of anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, classification, forecasting, and optimization. However, most existing solutions still rely on task-specific models that infer from sensor data; thus, system-wide capabilities such as real-time reasoning, adaptive planning, autonomous coordination, learning, tool use, and contextual decision-making remain limited. This paper examines Agentic IoT as a next-generation cognitive IoT paradigm that integrates the perception, reasoning, planning, learning, and action capabilities of autonomous AI agents with cyber-physical systems. Agentic IoT aims to transform IoT from data-centric sensing and inference infrastructures into distributed cognitive agent ecosystems operating across the device/edge-fog-cloud continuum. The paper first grounds this transition as a paradigm shift and positions Agentic IoT in relation to AIoT, edge intelligence, multi-agent systems, and the Internet of Agents. It then systematically reviews current studies, presents a holistic architectural framework, discusses domain-specific application potential, and identifies key technical, operational, and research challenges together with future research directions.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, Author's preprint version. The manuscript may be revised based on peer-review feedback and publication requirements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic IoT作为下一代认知物联网范式，将自主AI代理的感知、推理、规划、学习与行动能力集成到网络物理系统中，旨在将物联网从数据中心的感知推理基础设施转变为分布于设备-边缘-雾-云连续体的分布式认知代理生态系统。文章通过系统文献综述、提出整体架构框架、讨论领域应用潜力，并识别关键技术、操作和研究挑战及未来方向。
Motivation: 现有AIoT系统仍依赖从传感器数据推断的任务特定模型，缺乏实时推理、自适应规划、自主协调、学习、工具使用和情境决策等系统级能力。
Method: 系统性地综述当前研究，提出一个整体架构框架，并讨论领域特定应用潜力。
Conclusion: 文章指出Agentic IoT面临关键技术、操作和研究挑战，并提出了未来研究方向。

papers.title: Channel-Adaptive Robust Aggregation for Over-the-Air Federated Learning in Heterogeneous Networks
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for privacy-preserving, data-intensive applications such as IoT, augmented reality, and autonomous systems positions Federated Learning (FL) as a key enabler in 6G networks. Over-the-Air FL (OTA-FL) leverages the superposition property of the wireless multiple access channel for efficient aggregation via simultaneous transmissions. Existing methods rely on fixed aggregation schedules and do not jointly address noise, fading, and client heterogeneity. We propose CHARGE-FL (CHannel-Adaptive Robust agGrEgation), a framework that adaptively schedules aggregation based on channel dynamics and application readiness. By combining a tailored optimization strategy with a dual-purpose precoding mechanism, CHARGE-FL mitigates channel distortion and bias from partial updates, achieving superior accuracy, stability, and convergence under realistic wireless conditions. Empirical results under realistic wireless conditions show that CHARGE-FL significantly improves accuracy, stability, and convergence over state-of-the-art OTA-FL methods, particularly in straggler-prone and noisy scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP) 2026, pp. 1161-1165 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CHARGE-FL框架，用于异构网络中的空中联邦学习（OTA-FL）。该框架根据信道动态和应用就绪情况自适应调度聚合，结合优化策略和双重预编码机制，缓解信道失真和部分更新偏差。在真实无线条件下，CHARGE-FL在准确性、稳定性和收敛性上显著优于现有OTA-FL方法，尤其是在易掉队和噪声场景中。
Motivation: 现有OTA-FL方法依赖固定聚合调度，未能联合考虑噪声、衰落和客户端异质性，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出CHARGE-FL，包含自适应聚合调度、针对性的优化策略以及双重功能的预编码机制，以补偿信道效应和部分更新的偏差。
Result: 在真实无线条件下，CHARGE-FL在准确性、稳定性和收敛性上显著优于现有OTA-FL方法，尤其在存在掉队节点和噪声的情况下。
Conclusion: 自适应调度和联合优化可有效提升OTA-FL在异构网络中的鲁棒性和效率。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Sangam: Efficiently Serving Diffusion LLMs with the AR Stack
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising a masked response and can commit multiple output positions per model invocation. Their bidirectional attention prevents exact autoregressive-style KV caching, since committing one position shifts the KV activations of all others. Approximate caching techniques such as Fast-dLLM and dKV-Cache refresh KV activations repeatedly and reuse them across intervening decodes, inducing a repeated prefill/decode structure. This makes AR serving mechanisms relevant to dLLMs, but not directly applicable. dLLM decodes are block-sized rather than token-sized, prefills recur, and bidirectional attention precludes the chunked prefill mechanism used for stall-free colocated serving. We present Sangam, a serving system for cached dLLM inference. Sangam introduces a deficit token-budget scheduler that admits in-flight decodes first, admits whole indivisible prefills only when the accumulated token budget allows, and carries unused budget forward. This achieves amortized stall-free scheduling. Disaggregated serving avoids prefill-decode interference but suffers from prefill/decode resource partitioning problem. Sangam adopts a hybrid serving strategy, overflowing prefills onto decode workers to relieve prefill under-provisioning, and uses the same deficit-budget scheduler to protect those workers' decodes from the overflow. We show that like AR serving, dLLM serving design space is governed by prefill-decode interference and prefill/decode partitioning. Colocated serving is most effective on decode-heavy workloads, cutting mean latency by 9-20% over hybrid execution on LLaDA-8B ShareGPT; while hybrid execution is most effective on prefill-heavy workloads, cutting mean latency by 8-20% over colocated execution on Dream-7B arXiv. Sangam is available at https://github.com/UT-InfraAI/sangam.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Sangam，一个为缓存扩散语言模型(dLLM)设计的服务系统。dLLM通过迭代去噪生成文本，其双向注意力机制使得精确的自动回归式KV缓存不可行，近似缓存导致重复的预填充/解码结构。Sangam引入赤字令牌预算调度器，实现分摊的无停顿调度，并采用混合服务策略将预填充溢出到解码worker。实验表明，在解码重负载下共置服务降低平均延迟9-20%，在预填充重负载下混合执行降低平均延迟8-20%。
Motivation: 扩散LLM的双向注意力机制使现有AR服务机制无法直接适用，且近似缓存技术带来重复预填充/解码结构，导致预填充-解码干扰和资源分区问题，亟需专门的服务系统。
Method: Sangam包含赤字令牌预算调度器和混合服务策略。调度器优先处理进行中的解码，只当累积令牌预算允许时处理不可分割的预填充，并结转未用预算。混合服务将预填充溢出到解码worker以缓解预填充不足，同时用同一调度器保护解码不被干扰。
Result: 在LLaDA-8B ShareGPT解码重负载下，共置服务降低平均延迟9-20%；在Dream-7B arXiv预填充重负载下，混合执行降低平均延迟8-20%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调dLLM服务设计空间受预填充-解码干扰和分区支配，共置服务对解码重负载最有效，混合执行对预填充重负载最有效。

papers.title: Topology-Driven Transferability Estimation for 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: The growing number of medical vision foundation models highlights the need for effective model selection. However, mainstream selection methods rely on exhaustive fine-tuning, which is computationally expensive. Most of the existing Transferability Estimation (TE) metrics are primarily designed for image-level classification. They fail to preserve spatial relationships and fine-grained boundary details, which are crucial for the segmentation task. Additionally, while image-level tasks typically process a single feature vector per input, dense prediction tasks in 3D medical imaging require voxel-wise evaluation against dense annotations. To bridge these gaps, we propose a \textit{non-parametric, topology-driven} framework that estimates transferability directly from the alignment between the sparse 1-skeleton graph of dense features and semantic labels via Minimum Spanning Trees (MST). We decouple the alignment into two complementary geometric scales: Local Boundary-Aware Topological Consistency (LBTC) to assess boundary separability, where we prove that the MST leakage rate serves as a finite-sample lower bound on the Bayes error; and Global Representation Topology Divergence (GRTD) to evaluate the overall anatomical layout. Crucially, we formally justify a counterintuitive mechanism: Although without fine-tuning, the randomly initialized segmentation decoder acts as a topology-preserving spatial projector, reducing the variance of pairwise distance estimates and stabilizing global alignment evaluation. Fused via a task-adaptive gating mechanism, these dual metrics adapt to diverse clinical complexities. Evaluated on a large-scale benchmark of 114,000 3D medical volumes across diverse anatomical tasks, our topological framework achieves state-of-the-art transferability estimation with an average weighted Kendall (outperforming by 0.36) while accelerating evaluation by 56 times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种非参数、拓扑驱动的迁移性估计框架，用于3D医学视觉基础模型的选择。该方法通过最小生成树（MST）对齐稀疏1-骨架图与语义标签，从局部边界感知拓扑一致性和全局表示拓扑发散性两个几何尺度评估模型的可迁移性，并随机初始化解码器作为拓扑保持投影器。在114,000个3D医学体数据的大规模基准上，该方法在加权Kendall指标上平均提升0.36，且评估速度加快56倍。
Motivation: 现有迁移性估计方法主要针对图像级分类，无法保留分割任务所需的细粒度边界和空间关系；同时主流选择依赖耗时的完全微调。
Method: 提出非参数拓扑驱动框架：通过MST构建稀疏1-骨架图，计算局部边界感知拓扑一致性（LBTC）与全局表示拓扑发散度（GRTD），并用任务自适应门控机制融合。理论证明LBTC中的MST泄漏率是贝叶斯误差的有限样本下界，并解释随机初始化解码器的拓扑保持特性。
Result: 在114,000个体数据上，加权Kendall指标平均领先现有方法0.36，评估速度提升56倍。
Conclusion: 该框架无需微调即可高效评估3D医学分割基础模型的迁移性，拓扑度量有效捕捉空间与边界信息。

papers.title: Exploring Convolutional Neural Processes for Weather Downscaling
papers.abstract_en: Global reanalysis products such as ERA5-Land provide spatially complete weather fields but at resolutions too coarse for local applications, particularly in mountainous regions where temperature can vary by several degrees over short distances. This project investigates Convolutional Conditional Neural Processes (ConvCNPs) for statistical downscaling of daily maximum temperature from the ~11km resolution ERA5-Land grid to ~1km resolution over Switzerland, building upon the architecture of Vaughan et al. (2022) and adapting it to the topographically complex Swiss domain with high-resolution elevation features from the swisstopo DHM25. The best model, trained on ten years of data (2014-2023) with five-fold temporal cross-validation, achieves a mean absolute error of 1.31 Celsius and a CRPS-based skill score of 0.524 relative to bilinear interpolation, reducing the expected prediction error by more than half. An ablation study reveals that the elevation MLP is the indispensable component - without it, the model diverges entirely - while explicit seasonal features and Topographic Position Index provide secondary benefits. Under sparse on-grid input the model degrades gracefully, maintaining positive skill down to approximately 10% of the input grid; however, zero-shot deployment on off-grid station observations does not achieve positive skill at any density tested. All configurations exhibit severely overconfident uncertainty estimates, a structural limitation of the Gaussian likelihood training objective. These results demonstrate that ConvCNPs are a viable and effective approach to climate downscaling in complex terrain, and identify uncertainty calibration and native support for non-gridded input as the key challenges for operational deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了卷积条件神经过程（ConvCNPs）用于统计降尺度，将ERA5-Land的日最高温度从~11km分辨率降至~1km分辨率，应用于瑞士复杂地形区域。基于十年数据训练的最佳模型平均绝对误差为1.31°C，相对于双线性插值的CRPS技能分数为0.524，将期望预测误差降低一半以上。消融研究表明高程MLP不可或缺，而季节性特征和地形位置指数有次要贡献。模型在稀疏网格输入下性能优雅退化，但在离网站点观测的零样本部署中未取得正技能分数，且所有配置都存在置信度估计过度自信的问题。
Motivation: 全球再分析产品如ERA5-Land的空间分辨率（~11km）对局地应用（尤其是山区）过于粗糙，温度在短距离内可能变化几度，需要有效的统计降尺度方法。
Method: 采用ConvCNP架构，基于Vaughan et al. (2022)并针对瑞士复杂地形进行适配，融入高分辨率高程特征（swisstopo DHM25），使用十年数据（2014-2023）进行五折时间交叉验证训练。
Result: 最佳模型MAE为1.31°C，CRPS技能分数0.524；高程MLP缺失时模型完全发散；稀疏输入下保持正技能直至约10%网格点；离网站点零样本部署无正技能；所有模型置信度过高。
Conclusion: ConvCNPs是复杂地形气候降尺度的可行且有效方法，但不确定性校准和对非网格输入的原生支持是实际部署的关键挑战。

papers.title: SpecGradFilter: A Spectral Gradient Filtering Framework for Taming Federated Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) is fundamentally challenged by statistical heterogeneity, where non-identically distributed (non-IID) data induces client drift that severely hampers global convergence. While existing approaches attempt to mitigate this drift through spatial-domain gradient correction or regularization, they overlook the intrinsic spectral structure of optimization signals. In this work, we revisit client drift from a novel frequency-domain perspective and uncover a critical Spectral Bias of Drift: inter-client gradient divergence is predominantly concentrated in low-frequency components which encode client-specific distributional shifts, while high-frequency components representing fine-grained features remain relatively consistent. Motivated by this, we propose SpecGradFilter, a unified Spectral Gradient Filtering Framework that tames heterogeneity by suppressing discordant low-frequency signals. Crucially, we demonstrate that SpecGradFilter is a generalizable principle, effective not only via precise FFT-based truncation but also through spatial approximations like Gaussian detrending. Extensive experiments on benchmarks such as CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny-ImageNet demonstrate that SpecGradFilter significantly performs better performance in highly Non-IID settings with negligible communication overhead, establishing a new paradigm for robust federated optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从频域角度重新审视联邦学习中的统计异质性，发现客户端漂移的低频成分编码了分布偏移，而高频成分相对一致。为此提出SpecGradFilter框架，通过抑制不一致的低频信号（如FFT截断或高斯去趋势）来减轻漂移。在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny-ImageNet等高度Non-IID设定下，该方法显著提升性能且通信开销极小。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习方法多在空间域进行梯度校正或正则化，忽略了优化信号的频谱结构。本文发现客户端漂移在频域存在偏差：低频成分主要反映客户端特有分布偏移，而高频成分保持一致性。
Method: 提出SpecGradFilter框架，从频域统一地抑制不一致的低频梯度信号，可基于FFT精确截断或采用空间近似（如高斯去趋势）实现。
Result: 在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny-ImageNet等基准的极度Non-IID设定下，SpecGradFilter显著优于现有方法，且几乎不增加通信开销。
Conclusion: 本文表明抑制低频梯度信号是一种通用且有效的联邦异质性处理原则，可扩展至空间近似方法，为鲁棒联邦优化提供了新范式。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Graph Learning with Uncertainty Awareness for Open-Set Domain Generalization in Fault Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent industrial maintenance critically relies on reliable fault diagnosis of rotating machinery. However, it faces formidable challenges from unknown fault types and domain shifts induced by varying operating conditions, which is formally formulated as the open-set domain generalization (OSDG) problem. Existing methods are mainly data-driven, thereby overlooking the cascaded propagation of uncertainty across feature extraction, topological learning, and decision-making stages.To tackle this challenge, we propose PGU-OD, a novel Physics-Informed Graph Learning framework with Uncertainty Awareness for Open-set Domain generalization. First, it designs a physics-informed spectral attention module to extract condition-robust fault features, thereby suppressing perceptual uncertainty caused by frequency shifts. Further, it constructs an uncertainty aware adaptive graph learning mechanism to dynamically adjust the edge weights of the sample graph guided by class-scale Gaussian distribution parameters, which mitigates the structural propagation of uncertainty. Finally, a Gaussian-distribution-based adaptive boundary loss function and a dual-criteria open-set inference strategy are developed to optimize decision boundaries and reliably reject unknown faults. Extensive experimental evaluations on two public and widely used rotating machinery fault datasets demonstrate that the proposed PGU-OD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both known fault classification and unknown fault rejection under domain shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对旋转机械故障诊断中的开集域泛化（OSDG）问题，提出一种物理信息图学习框架PGU-OD。该框架通过物理信息谱注意力模块提取工况鲁棒特征，设计不确定性感知自适应图学习机制抑制结构传播，并采用高斯分布自适应边界损失和双准则开集推理策略，在已知故障分类和未知故障拒绝上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动方法忽略特征提取、拓扑学习和决策阶段的不确定性级联传播，且难以同时处理未知故障类型和工况域偏移。
Method: 提出PGU-OD框架，包含三个核心：1）物理信息谱注意力模块提取对频率偏移鲁棒的特征；2）不确定性感知自适应图学习，利用类级高斯分布参数动态调整样本图边权重；3）基于高斯分布的自适应边界损失和双准则开集推理策略。
Result: 在两个公开旋转机械故障数据集上，PGU-OD在已知故障分类和未知故障拒绝两方面均优于当前最先进基准方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过显式建模不确定性传播和引入物理先验，有效提升了开集域泛化场景下的故障诊断可靠性。

summary_sections.result: 在两个公开旋转机械故障数据集上，PGU-OD在已知故障分类和未知故障拒绝两方面均优于当前最先进基准方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过显式建模不确定性传播和引入物理先验，有效提升了开集域泛化场景下的故障诊断可靠性。

papers.title: A Clustering-Based Framework for Identifying Suspicious Trading Patterns in Capital Market
papers.abstract_en: Market manipulation is the dubious practice of manipulating stock prices in order to make a quick profit, which truly degrades confidence on trading platforms. We implemented an unsupervised fraud-detection toolkit that begins with K-Means++ clustering to address this issue. A dataset of roughly one million financial transactions from 2012 to 2024 is used. In order to identify fraudulent trades and categorize them using market practice heuristic thresholds, the study suggests a clustering-based pipeline. The method highlights 2.02% of trades as suspicious where 51.10% clearly indicate spoofing, 0.10% indicate pump and dump, 0.55% indicate insider trading, 1.43% indicate a fake breakout, and 46.83% are unclassified. Despite the lack of ground truth, the model's performance is confirmed by a Silhouette Score of 0.561.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Photonics, Artificial Intelligence & Networking (QPAIN), 2026. This is the authors preprint version. The final version is available via IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于K-Means++聚类的无监督欺诈检测框架，用于识别资本市场中的可疑交易模式。使用2012-2024年的约100万条金融交易数据，通过市场启发式阈值对交易进行分类，标记出2.02%的交易为可疑，其中51.10%为欺骗（spoofing），0.10%为拉高出货（pump and dump），0.55%为内幕交易（insider trading），1.43%为假突破（fake breakout），46.83%未分类。由于缺乏真实标签，使用轮廓系数0.561验证模型性能。
Motivation: 市场操纵行为破坏交易平台公信力，需要无监督方法高效检测可疑交易模式，以维护市场公平。
Method: 采用K-Means++聚类算法对交易数据进行分组，并结合市场实践中定义的启发式阈值，对聚类结果中的可疑交易进行识别和分类。
Result: 在约100万笔交易中，2.02%被标记为可疑，各可疑类型比例明确；轮廓系数0.561，表明聚类结构合理。
Conclusion: 该框架为无监督欺诈检测提供了可行方案，但缺乏真实标签验证，未来需引入标注数据或外部验证方法。
