papers.title: CritiqueDriveVLM: From Verifier-Guided Reinforcement Learning to Latent Thought Distillation for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show immense potential in autonomous driving. However, standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) often suffers from reasoning hallucinations and conservative biases. While traditional tool-augmented frameworks and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) approaches mitigate these issues, they incur exorbitant token consumption and unacceptable latency, rendering real-time deployment impractical. To resolve this reliability-efficiency trade-off, we propose CritiqueDriveVLM, a novel unified three-stage framework internalizing reasoning directly into the VLM. First, we introduce Critique-Driven Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning (RL) guided by a multi-dimensional verifier. By providing granular scalar feedback and a multi-turn penalty, we force the policy to internalize logical deduction, cultivating a robust System-2 Teacher that achieves high accuracy without fragile external tools. Subsequently, we propose Latent Thought Distillation to overcome the latency bottleneck. By aligning the Student's latent representations with the Teacher's fully converged reasoning states, we compress deep logical capabilities into a fast, CoT-free System-1 Student. Extensive experiments on the widely-used DriveLMM-01 benchmark demonstrate remarkable improvements. Compared to the base model, our tool-free Teacher significantly boosts Multiple Choice Quality (MCQ) from 55.54% to a state-of-the-art 76.54%. Crucially, our distilled Student preserves competitive reasoning depth while drastically minimizing generation length to an average of merely 28 tokens. This slashes inference latency by 88% (from 3482 ms to 416 ms), paving a highly robust pathway for low-latency autonomous driving.Our source code is available at https://github.com/MICLAB-BUPT/CritiqueDriveVLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CritiqueDriveVLM 提出一个三阶段框架，通过验证器引导的多轮强化学习（Critique-Driven Multi-Turn RL）培养 System-2 Teacher，再通过潜在思维蒸馏（Latent Thought Distillation）将推理能力压缩到 System-1 Student，实现无需外部工具的高效推理。在 DriveLMM-01 基准上，Teacher 将多项选择质量 (MCQ) 从 55.54% 提升至 76.54%，Student 的推理延迟降低 88%（至 416 ms），平均 token 数仅 28。
Motivation: 标准监督微调 (SFT) 在端到端视觉语言模型 (VLM) 中存在推理幻觉和保守偏差；传统工具增强框架和思维链 (CoT) 方法 token 消耗高、延迟大，无法实时部署。需要解决可靠性-效率的权衡。
Method: 提出三阶段统一框架：1) 使用多维验证器提供粒度标量反馈和多轮惩罚，进行验证器引导的多轮强化学习 (RL)，培养高精度无外部工具的 System-2 Teacher；2) 通过潜在思维蒸馏，对齐 Student 的潜在表示与 Teacher 的收敛推理状态，压缩为快速无 CoT 的 System-1 Student。
Result: 在 DriveLMM-01 基准上，Teacher 的 MCQ 从 55.54% 提升至 76.54%；Student 保持竞争性推理深度，平均生成仅 28 tokens，推理延迟从 3482 ms 降至 416 ms（降低 88%）。
Conclusion: 该框架通过内部化推理而非依赖外部工具，实现了高可靠性与低延迟的权衡，为低延迟自动驾驶提供了稳健路径。

papers.title: XS-VLA: Coupling Coarse-grained Spatial Distillation with Latent Flow Matching for Lightweight Robotic Control
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong multimodal understanding and spatial grounding, but their computational cost limits real-time robotic control. In contrast, lightweight models are suitable for edge deployment but often suffer from "spatial blindness", namely weak native spatial prediction ability. Training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on mixed human demonstrations can also degrade policy performance due to highly diverse behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose XS-VLA, a two-stage framework for efficient and spatially grounded robotic manipulation. First, we distill spatial semantic knowledge from Qwen3-VL-4B into the SmolVLM2-0.25B backbone by fine-tuning on curated coarse-grained spatial descriptions, turning the lightweight model into a spatially grounded engine. Second, we use this enhanced backbone to condition a Latent Flow Matching policy. Unlike deterministic controllers, our policy combines a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) with Flow Matching dynamics to model complex multimodal action distributions. On the LIBERO benchmark, XS-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance among models with fewer than 0.5B parameters. It improves average success rates by up to 7.2 percent, including a 23 percent gain on LIBERO-Long, over the SmolVLA 0.25B baseline, and outperforms the larger 2.2B vanilla SmolVLA. Ablations show that spatial tuning and generative latent flow control substantially improve lightweight VLA performance, delivering a 3.2 times speedup in mission execution over the previous lightweight flow matching policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XS-VLA提出了一个两阶段框架，用于轻量级机器人操控：首先通过粗粒度空间描述蒸馏将大视觉语言模型的空间语义知识迁移到小模型，然后利用潜流匹配策略建模多模态动作分布。在LIBERO基准上，XS-VLA在参数少于0.5B的模型中达到最优，平均成功率提升高达7.2%，其中LIBERO-Long提升23%，同时执行速度比先前轻量流匹配策略快3.2倍。
Motivation: 大视觉语言模型计算成本高，不适合实时机器人控制；轻量模型存在空间盲区，且混合人类演示训练会降低策略性能。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段从Qwen3-VL-4B蒸馏空间语义知识到SmolVLM2-0.25B骨干网络，通过微调粗粒度空间描述；第二阶段用增强骨干网络条件化潜流匹配策略，结合条件变分自编码器和流匹配动力学建模复杂多模态动作分布。
Result: 在LIBERO基准上，XS-VLA在参数少于0.5B的模型中达到最优，平均成功率提升最多7.2%，LIBERO-Long提升23%，超过更大的2.2B SmolVLA；执行速度比先前轻量流匹配策略快3.2倍。
Conclusion: 空间调优和生成式潜流控制显著提升轻量VLA性能，证明了所提框架在高效且空间 grounded 的机器人操控中的有效性。

papers.title: FedFFT: Taming Client Drift in Federated SAM via Spectral Perturbation Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables decentralized training without data sharing, but suffers from statistical heterogeneity across clients, leading to client drift, poor generalization, and sharp minima compared to centralized training. Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) has emerged as a promising approach to improve generalization, yet its application in federated learning still suffers from divergence problems, since perturbations are computed locally and reflect client-specific loss geometries. To better understand this issue, we provide experimental evidence from a new perspective, the frequency domain, for SAM perturbations in federated settings, revealing that inter-client perturbation inconsistencies are predominantly concentrated in the low-frequency spectrum. Motivated by this insight, we propose Federated learning with Frequency-domain Filtering of SAM perturbations (FedFFT). It is a lightweight and plug-and-play method that filters out low-frequency components of SAM perturbations without requiring additional communication, thereby suppressing inconsistent components in client updates while preserving consistent learning signals. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and diverse backbones demonstrate that FedFFT consistently outperforms SAM-based FL methods, particularly under severe non-IID distributions. These results highlight the effectiveness, scalability, and general applicability of our frequency-domain perspective for sharpness-aware federated optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中客户端漂移问题，从频域角度分析SAM扰动的特性，发现客户端间扰动不一致主要集中在低频部分。提出FedFFT方法，通过滤波去除SAM扰动的低频成分，无需额外通信，在多个基准上优于现有SAM联邦学习方法，尤其在严重非IID分布下效果显著。
Motivation: 联邦学习中统计异质性导致客户端漂移，SAM虽能提升泛化但局部扰动加剧发散问题，现有方法未从频域理解不一致性。
Method: 提出FedFFT，一种轻量级即插即用方法，对SAM扰动进行频域滤波，滤除低频不匹配成分，保留一致学习信号，不增加通信开销。
Result: 在多个基准和不同骨干网络上，FedFFT一致优于基于SAM的联邦学习方法，尤其在严重非IID数据分布下表现突出。
Conclusion: 频域视角对锐度感知联邦优化有效，FedFFT兼具有效性、可扩展性和通用适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry of Ordinal Representations in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent work showed that language models represent character counts on curved 1D manifolds, with attention heads performing geometric transformations to enable computation. We test whether this generalizes across four ordinal tasks (bracket depth, indentation, table position, numeric magnitude) in Gemma-2-2B, Gemma-2-9B, and Qwen3-4B. We find that 1D manifolds with place-cell feature tiling emerge for tasks where the ordinal variable is locally computable from token identity, while tasks requiring cross-position integration or semantic extraction produce higher-dimensional or incoherent representations. Geometric computation is architecture-dependent: Qwen3-4B shows substantially stronger twisting than Gemma models for indentation, and its twisters preserve ordinal order, unlike its numeric twisters. Activation patching confirms that the identified manifold subspaces concentrate task-relevant information, with manifold-direction ablation causing dramatically larger probe accuracy drops than random-direction controls.
papers.journal_ref: Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型中序数表示（ordinal representations）的几何结构，发现对于局部可计算的序数变量（如括号深度），模型形成带位置细胞特征平铺的一维流形；而对于需要跨位置集成或语义提取的任务，表征变为高维或不连贯。几何计算依赖架构，例如Qwen3-4B在缩进任务上显示出比Gemma模型更强的扭曲性。激活修补实验确认了流形子空间集中了任务相关信息。
Motivation: 探索语言模型在序数任务（括弧深度、缩进、表格位置、数值大小）中是否普遍存在类似字符计数的弯曲一维流形表示，以及这种表示的几何结构与任务属性和模型架构的关系。
Method: 在Gemma-2-2B、Gemma-2-9B和Qwen3-4B上分析四种序数任务的内部表征，通过流形发现、特征平铺（place-cell feature tiling）分析、扭曲性（twisting）测量以及激活修补（activation patching）和流形方向消融（manifold-direction ablation）来验证表征的因果相关性。
Result: 局部可计算序数任务产生一维流形和位置细胞特征平铺；跨位置集成或语义任务导致更高维或不连贯表征。Qwen3-4B在缩进任务中扭曲性更强，且其扭曲器保持序数顺序，与数值扭曲器不同。流形方向消融导致探针准确率大幅下降，而随机方向消融影响小。
Conclusion: 语言模型的序数表示几何取决于任务是否支持局部计算和模型架构，但空间表征机制在序数推理中具有普遍性。

papers.title: Piercing Gilbreath's Conjecture: From Deep Number Theory Insights to Fintech and Cybersecurity
papers.abstract_en: I propose a new methodology to attack the fascinating Gilbreath's conjecture about prime numbers, first posted in 1878 and unsolved to this day. The problem statement is rudimentary: kids can understand it. However, despite decades of research, almost no progress has been made. This paper changes the game by presenting a new approach based on sieving, a number of new results with proof, a precise path to the solution, and solid references. It also introduces the concept of reverse sieving, along with applications to testing randomness, pattern and fraud detection, cybersecurity, synthetic data, sequence categorization and normalization, or to detect and quantify a new type of chaos in time series including Brownian motions. Magic primes, forbidden prime number constellations, cellular automata, and reduction via classes of equivalent sequences, are some of the innovative and promising topics discussed in the paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于筛法的新方法研究Gilbreath猜想（1878年提出的素数猜想至今未解），引入反向筛概念，并探讨了在随机性测试、模式检测、欺诈检测、网络安全、合成数据、序列分类和标准化以及布朗运动时间序列混沌分析中的应用。
Motivation: Gilbreath猜想自1878年提出以来几乎无进展，缺乏有效研究方法。
Method: 提出基于筛法的新方法，包括反向筛、通过等价序列类约简、幻素数、禁止素数星座和细胞自动机等创新概念。
Result: 提供了若干带证明的新结果、一个精确的求解路径和可靠参考文献。
Conclusion: 该方法有望解决Gilbreath猜想，并具有跨领域应用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SeeMe: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models through Effective Visual Token Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding tasks such as image captioning and visual question answering. However, they remain susceptible to hallucinations, generating content that is inconsistent with the actual visual input. Existing methods primarily intervene at the decoding stage, while overlooking a critical source of hallucinations: irrelevant or noisy visual tokens that mislead the decoding process. To address this issue, we propose SeeMe, a training-free framework that introduces the concept of feature engineering from traditional machine learning into LVLMs. SeeMe restructures visual tokens through a three-stage token engineering process to suppress hallucination sources while preserving informative visual evidence. Experiments on MME, POPE, and AMBER benchmarks across four LVLMs demonstrate that SeeMe consistently reduces hallucinations and improves output consistency, providing a novel perspective for mitigating hallucinations in LVLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeeMe 是一种无需训练的框架，通过从传统机器学习引入特征工程概念，对视觉 token 进行三阶段工程化处理，以抑制无关或噪声视觉 token 导致的幻觉，在 MME、POPE 和 AMBER 基准上对四个大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）的评估显示，SeeMe 能持续减少幻觉并提升输出一致性。
Motivation: 现有缓解 LVLM 幻觉的方法主要关注解码阶段干预，忽视了无关或噪声视觉 token 作为幻觉的关键来源。
Method: 提出 SeeMe 框架，通过三阶段 token 工程（token engineering）重构视觉 token，抑制幻觉源同时保留信息性视觉证据，无需额外训练。
Result: 在 MME、POPE 和 AMBER 基准上对四个 LVLM 进行实验，SeeMe 持续减少幻觉并提升输出一致性。
Conclusion: SeeMe 为缓解 LVLM 幻觉提供了新视角，通过视觉 token 工程有效抑制噪声 token 的影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ACE: Agentic Control for Embodied Manipulation via Zero-shot Workflow Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended tabletop manipulation requires agents to not only understand natural language but also adapt to dynamic environments and execution failures. We present ACE (Agentic Control for Embodied Manipulation), a zero-shot workflow reasoning framework for tabletop pick-and-place from natural language. Rather than relying on direct low-level action mapping, ACE combines agentic workflow reasoning with two robot-facing executable skills: a visual grounding interface and a reusable pick-and-place primitive. To bridge semantic reasoning and physical control, the active sub-goal is grounded into a mask-mediated vision-action interface. This unified mask specifies the target object and destination, is tracked over time, exposed for human verification, and ultimately passed to a task-agnostic downstream policy for execution. Crucially, ACE operates in a closed loop supported by a multi-timescale memory. After an action is executed, the system automatically verifies whether the intended sub-goal succeeded, using the outcome to advance, retry, repair, or replan. This enables online adaptation to user corrections, scene changes, and physical failures. We evaluate ACE on logically complex, long-horizon tasks, including zero-shot multi-step equation formation with number cubes and constraint-based object retrieval. ACE demonstrates task-level zero-shot generalization on novel semantic constraints and randomized tabletop scenes without task-specific retraining. Specifically, while standard end-to-end baselines struggle to complete these logically demanding tasks, ACE achieves a 50% success rate in equation formation and a 70% success rate in constraint retrieval. This contrast demonstrates that explicit workflow reasoning and mask-mediated control offer a robust, practical route toward adaptable robotic manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACE，一个零样本工作流推理框架，用于桌面拾取和放置操作。ACE结合智能体工作流推理与视觉接地接口和可复用拾取-放置原语，通过掩码中介的视觉-动作接口连接语义推理和物理控制，并利用多时间尺度记忆实现闭环验证和在线适应。实验表明，在逻辑复杂的长期任务中，ACE实现了50%的等式形成成功率和70%的约束检索成功率，展现了零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 开放式的桌面操作需要智能体理解自然语言并适应动态环境和执行失败，现有方法难以处理逻辑复杂的长时域任务。
Method: ACE采用零样本工作流推理框架，包含视觉接地接口和拾取-放置原语，通过掩码中介的视觉-动作接口将主动子目标接地，并利用多时间尺度记忆进行闭环验证，支持重试、修复或重新规划。
Result: 在零样本多步等式形成和约束检索任务中，ACE分别达到50%和70%的成功率，而标准端到端基线难以完成。
Conclusion: 显式的工作流推理和掩码中介控制为自适应机器人操作提供了稳健且实用的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedProIn: Mitigating Client Drift for Learnable Prototypes in Federated Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is severely hindered by statistical heterogeneity due to variations in scanners, acquisition protocols, and patient populations. Such non-IID data induces client drift during local optimization, leading to unstable convergence and suboptimal global models when parameter-based aggregation is applied. We propose a prototype-based, influence-aware federated learning framework (FedProIn) that uses multiple learnable class prototypes to capture shared semantic structures across heterogeneous clients. We introduce feature divergence loss and prototype contrastive loss to mitigate client drift by decomposing it into feature drift and prototype drift. In addition, we propose a normalized influence aggregation strategy that adaptively weights client prototypes according to their contribution to the global representation, reducing the impact of biased or low-quality updates. Experimental results on two publicly available medical datasets, HAM10000 and Matek-19, demonstrate that FedProIn achieves accuracies of (83.5% IID, 81.1% non-IID) on HAM10000 and (96.2% IID, 95.8% non-IID) on Matek-19, respectively, outperforming existing baselines in both conditions. Our code is available at https://github.com/harsh-kmr/FedProIn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedProIn，一个基于原型的、影响感知的联邦学习框架，用于缓解医学影像中由于数据异构性导致的客户端漂移。通过引入特征发散损失和原型对比损失，分别处理特征漂移和原型漂移，并采用归一化影响聚合策略自适应加权客户端原型。在 HAM10000 和 Matek-19 两个公开医学数据集上的实验表明，FedProIn 在 IID 和非 IID 设置下均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 联邦学习受限于统计异构性（如扫描仪、协议、患者群体的差异），导致客户端漂移和不稳定收敛，参数聚合方法效果不佳。
Method: 提出可学习的多类原型以捕获跨客户的共享语义结构；设计特征发散损失和原型对比损失来分解并缓解客户端漂移；采用归一化影响聚合策略，根据客户端对全局表示的贡献自适应加权。
Result: 在 HAM10000 上达到 IID 83.5%、非 IID 81.1% 的准确率；在 Matek-19 上达到 IID 96.2%、非 IID 95.8% 的准确率，均优于现有基线。
Conclusion: FedProIn 通过原型学习和影响感知聚合有效缓解了医学影像联邦学习中的客户端漂移问题，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Language models guide symbolic equation discovery by controlling search
papers.abstract_en: Scientific equation discovery must combine broad domain priors with strict numerical testing. Symbolic regression supplies numerical grounding but faces a combinatorial search space, whereas many language-model systems ask the model to propose or select formulas directly. We test a different division of labour. We compare role specifications in which the language model acts as equation author, candidate decider or search controller, alongside end-to-end language-model and purely numerical baselines. In the controller setting we propose here, implemented as LLM-PySR, language models specify variables, operators, transformations and search depth; symbolic regression enumerates and fits expressions; and deterministic metrics govern retention. Across 74 AI-Feynman equations and seven complex formula-recovery tasks, search control achieved the strongest observed balance of accuracy, complexity, stability and cost. On an independent battery dataset, LLM-PySR identified a compact piecewise-linear relation between early voltage-curve displacement and cycle life. The results suggest that language models should shape hypothesis exploration rather than decide which equations survive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将语言模型作为搜索控制器（controller）来引导符号回归搜索的流程，称为LLM-PySR。语言模型指定变量、算子、变换和搜索深度，由符号回归进行枚举和拟合，确定性指标控制保留。在74个AI-Feynman方程和7个复杂公式恢复任务中，搜索控制模式在精度、复杂度、稳定性和成本之间取得了最佳平衡。在独立电池数据集上，LLM-PySR识别出一个分段线性关系。
Motivation: 科学方程发现需要结合领域先验与数值验证，但纯符号回归面临组合爆炸，而直接让语言模型提议公式缺乏数值保证。需要一种更好的分工。
Method: 将语言模型用作搜索控制器：LLM指定变量、算子、变换和搜索深度；符号回归枚举并拟合表达式；确定性指标（如复杂度-精度权衡）决定保留哪些方程。
Result: 在74个AI-Feynman方程和7个复杂公式恢复任务中，搜索控制模式在精度、复杂度、稳定性和成本上均优于语言模型作为作者或决策者以及纯数值基线。在电池数据集上发现了分段线性关系。
Conclusion: 语言模型应塑造假设探索（shape hypothesis exploration）而非决定哪些方程存活，即作为控制器比作为直接作者或决策者更有效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Information-Geometric Superposed Vowel Evaluation: Part 1. Moraic Syllabary (Japanese)
papers.abstract_en: This paper explains the principles and provides examples of a new method for distinguishing between FAKE human speech synthesized by generative AI and natural speech. Since synthetic speech is generated based on information from a limited set of training spectra, the variety of vowels - which are key to identifying individuals - is limited. In contrast, natural speech exhibits a more diverse distribution of vowel spectra due to the flexibility of the human articulatory organ. In this paper, using Japanese - a Syllabary limited to five vowel phonemes, each of which corresponds one-to-one with a specific sound - as an example, we outline a method for distinguishing between synthetic and natural speech reading the same text by analyzing the spectral distributions. If we normalize the spectra of speech sounds and regard them as probability density functions for the frequency bands received by the hair cells of the human cochlea, and evaluate the distance between spectra using the Wasserstein metric, the Wasserstein distances between the vowels of synthetic speech are short. By preserving this distance and performing a topological mapping using persistent homology, the spectral probability density functions of synthetic and natural speech can be decomposed into clusters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于信息几何的新方法，利用Wasserstein距离和持续同调分析元音谱的分布，以区分生成式AI合成的语音和自然语音。以日语为例，因为日语五个元音音素与特定声音一一对应，合成语音的元音间Wasserstein距离较短，自然语音谱分布更多样，通过拓扑映射可分解为簇，从而实现区分。
Motivation: 生成式AI合成的语音在元音多样性上受限，难以模拟自然语音的灵活分布，需要有效的方法进行区分。
Method: 将语音频谱归一化为概率密度函数，用Wasserstein距离度量频谱之间的距离，再通过持续同调进行拓扑映射，分解合成与自然语音的谱概率密度函数为簇。
Result: 合成语音的元音间Wasserstein距离较短，而自然语音谱分布更多样，通过拓扑映射可分辨合成与自然语音。
Conclusion: 该方法为区分合成与自然语音提供了一种基于谱分布的新途径，特别适用于元音音素有限的音节系统（如日语）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mask-based Predictive Representations for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based deep reinforcement learning involves dealing with high-dimensional inputs of image information. It is crucial to abstract effective states from high-dimensional image inputs and limited samples for sample-efficient reinforcement learning. To address this challenge, inspired by fields such as natural language processing and computer vision, we propose a self-supervised task based on mask prediction as an auxiliary task for reinforcement learning. This non-reconstruction method uses the sequence information collected by the agent from the environment and the context information in the sequence to predict the masked information, thereby strengthening the agent's understanding of the task and learning effective representations. Combined with transformers, we find that the model reconstructs the masked input sequence in the latent space. By feeding the compressed representations learned by this method into reinforcement learning models, we observe an improvement in the sample efficiency of reinforcement learning. Moreover, the model outperforms state-of-the-art sample-efficient reinforcement learning methods on multiple continuous and discrete control benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对视觉强化学习中高维图像输入和样本有限的问题，本文提出一种基于掩码预测的自监督辅助任务，结合 Transformer 在潜在空间重建掩码序列，学习压缩表示。实验表明该方法在多个连续和离散控制基准上提升了样本效率，并超越现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 高维图像输入和有限样本使得从数据中提取有效状态表示成为样本高效强化学习的关键挑战。
Method: 受自然语言处理和计算机视觉中掩码预测启发，将掩码预测作为强化学习的辅助任务，利用 Transformer 在潜在空间重建被掩码的输入序列，从而学习环境序列的上下文表示。

papers.title: Perceiving Better Moments: Cover Frame Reselection and Enhancement for Live Photos with the Live2K Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Modern smartphones capture Live Photos, short video bursts surrounding a still image, offering a dynamic and engaging photographic experience. However, the cover photo and video components are generated by two distinct imaging pipelines: the photo stream undergoes full computational photography processing, while the video stream is constrained by real-time efficiency and heavy compression. This intrinsic separation produces a substantial quality gap in resolution, color fidelity, and dynamic range between the cover photo and video frames. When users reselect an alternative frame from the video to replace an imperfect cover, the chosen frame often suffers from severe degradation, making direct replacement visually unsatisfactory. Restoring such frames requires simultaneous enhancement of spatial detail and color appearance, a task considerably more challenging than ordinary super-resolution or color enhancement. To address this, we define the Live Photo Cover Frame Reselection and Enhancement (LPRE) task, which leverages the intrinsic cues available within each Live Photo: the high-quality cover image as a structural and color reference, the user-reselected low-quality frame as the reconstruction target and several adjacent video frames providing temporal cues. Building upon this formulation, we construct Live2K, a real-world dataset of 2,042 Live Photos, and develop a unified one-stage baseline that integrates multi-frame fusion, guided color enhancement and super-resolution, establishing the first benchmark for Live Photo enhancement research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义了Live Photo封面帧重新选择与增强（LPRE）任务，指出由于拍摄管道分离导致封面照片与视频帧之间存在质量差距。构建了包含2042个真实Live Photo的Live2K数据集，并提出了一个统一的单阶段基线，融合多帧、引导颜色增强和超分辨率，为该方向建立首个基准。
Motivation: 现存Live Photo的封面照片与视频帧质量差距大，用户重新选择视频帧替换封面时，所选帧质量差，直接替换效果不佳；需要同时增强空间细节和颜色，任务比普通超分或颜色增强更困难。
Method: 定义LPRE任务，利用每个Live Photo内固有的线索：高质量封面图像作为结构和颜色参考，低质量用户重选帧作为重建目标，以及相邻视频帧提供时间线索。构建Live2K真实数据集，并提出统一单阶段基线，集成多帧融合、引导颜色增强和超分辨率。
Result: 摘要未报告定量结果，仅说明建立了首个基准。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确总结局限或未来工作，但提出该任务和数据集作为新方向。

papers.title: Beyond Scene Priors: Fine-Grained Traffic Scene Reasoning with Benchmarking and Query-Guided Small-Object Focus
papers.abstract_en: In safety-critical traffic scenarios, answering complex questions relies on minute, localized visual cues. However, standard Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) tend to over-attend to backgrounds, overwhelming crucial small objects during visual-language alignment, a failure mode we term 'critical evidence dilution.' Furthermore, existing visual question answering (VQA) datasets rarely expose this flaw, as they lack large-scale, distractor-heavy evaluations that require pinpointing local evidence. To bridge this evaluation and architecture gap, we introduce the Fine-Grained Traffic Reasoning Benchmark (FGTR-Bench) and the Text-Guided Small-Object Reasoning MLLM (TSR-MLLM). FGTR-Bench comprises 40,236 single-image Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) created via multi-agent generation, consistency checks, and expert audits, alongside a disjoint 4,947-sample blind test split. To resolve evidence dilution, TSR-MLLM, built on Qwen3-VL-4B, uses a query-conditioned Text-Guided Small-Object Focus (TG-SOF) map. Applied once at the decoder boundary, the map adds sparse Top-K gated residuals to the most question-relevant vision slots while leaving text tokens unchanged. Together with lightweight decoder adaptation, TSR-MLLM preserves single-pass inference without external detectors or image re-encoding. Under matched settings, TSR-MLLM outperforms the strongest 4B baseline by 2.1 points on FGTR-Bench (74.1% overall), with larger gains on evidence-local tracks. Furthermore, it remains competitive on DriveQA-V (CARLA Signs) under greedy decoding without task-specific fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在交通场景中易忽略小目标关键证据的问题，提出细粒度交通推理基准FGTR-Bench和文本引导的小目标推理模型TSR-MLLM。TSR-MLLM通过查询条件化的文本引导小目标聚焦图，在解码器边界施加稀疏Top-K门控残差，增强对问题相关视觉线索的关注，在4B尺度模型上取得领先性能。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在安全关键交通场景中过度关注背景而稀释小目标关键证据，且缺乏包含大量干扰项的细粒度VQA基准来暴露该问题。
Method: 构建包含40,236道单选题的FGTR-Bench基准；提出TSR-MLLM，基于Qwen3-VL-4B，在解码器边界使用文本引导的小目标聚焦图（TG-SOF），对最相关的视觉槽位添加稀疏Top-K门控残差，保持单次推理。
Result: TSR-MLLM在FGTR-Bench上达74.1%准确率，比最强4B基线高2.1个点，在证据定位子集上增益更大；在DriveQA-V（CARLA Signs）上无需微调即可保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 论文声称所提方法有效缓解了关键证据稀释问题，在不依赖外部检测器或图像重编码的前提下提升了细粒度交通场景推理能力。

papers.title: HCSU: A Dataset and Benchmark for Fine-Grained Historical Calligraphy Style Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Automated fine-grained perception of calligraphy styles--a task vital to cultural heritage preservation--remains a critical challenge for Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), largely constrained by existing datasets that suffer from modal mixture and flattened labels. To bridge this gap, we introduce HCSU, the first comprehensive dataset tailored for fine-grained Historical Calligraphy Style Understanding. HCSU comprises 39,307 meticulously curated character images from 49 historically prominent calligraphers across 10 dynasties, systematically decoupling authentic ink manuscripts (Tie) from stone rubbings (Bei) to resolve the long-standing modal mixture problem. Moving beyond conventional flattened labels, HCSU provides hierarchical expert-written aesthetic descriptions, enabling two rigorous evaluation protocols: fine-grained style discrimination and interpretable aesthetic reasoning. Extensive evaluations reveal a persistent gap between calligraphy-related knowledge and visually grounded style perception: state-of-the-art LVLMs show non-trivial performance but remain sensitive to script-level, textual, and source-specific cues, and often struggle to ground aesthetic judgments in fine-grained brushwork evidence. Ultimately, the HCSU benchmark exposes fundamental limitations in current multimodal architectures, aiming to inspire the evolution of expert-level visual reasoning for cultural heritage preservation. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Tongji209/HCSU.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. 17 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍HCSU数据集，首个面向细粒度书法风格理解的大规模数据集，包含49位书法家、10个朝代的39,307张字符图像，区分墨迹（Tie）和拓本（Bei），并提供专家撰写的美学描述。评估发现当前多模态大模型在书法风格理解上存在视觉与知识的鸿沟。
Motivation: 现有书法风格数据集存在模态混合和扁平化标签问题，限制了大语言模型对书法风格的细粒度感知能力，亟需一个解耦模态、层级标注的数据集。
Method: 构建HCSU数据集：39,307张字符图像，解耦墨迹和拓本，提供专家书写的层级美学描述，并设计细粒度风格判别和可解释美学推理两种评估协议。
Result: 当前最先进的视觉-语言模型在HCSU上表现有提升，但对字体级别、文本内容和来源线索敏感，难以基于笔触证据进行美学判断。
Conclusion: HCSU暴露了当前多模态架构在专家级视觉推理上的根本局限，旨在推动文化遗产保护中的视觉推理发展。

papers.title: !Imperio, smolVLA: The Implications of Data Poisoning on Open Source Robotics
papers.abstract_en: This work establishes that trigger-word data poisoning of vision language action models is practical, while at the same time the open-source robotics ecosystem holds trust assumptions about community contributions. A few poisoned samples can silently embed a backdoor that disables a robot on command. We evaluate this threat against smolVLA on a real-world pick-and-place task, training on three poison ratios and evaluating across different prompts on the LeRobot platform. Three poisoned episodes in 320 clean episodes suffice for a complete denial of service. Success rate drops to 0.0 plus minus 0.0% across all trigger-word conditions and the robot locks into a fixed joint configuration rather than executing any task-relevant motion. Clean-prompt behaviour holds at approx. 50% success rate across all poison ratios, confirming the attack is stealthy under normal operation. A single poisoned episode already reduces success rate to 6.7 plus minus 6.7%. The robot still moves, but no longer completes the task. The attack generalises to front, middle, and end trigger placements despite training exclusively on front-placed triggers. These findings establish that the threat is practical, low-cost, and stealthy, and warrant treating dataset provenance as a first-class concern in open-source robotics ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明在视觉语言动作模型中进行触发词数据投毒是可行的，且开源机器人生态系统的信任假设存在安全隐患。在真实世界的拾取放置任务中，少量中毒样本即可嵌入后门，使机器人按指令失效。摘要报告在320个干净片段中仅需3个中毒片段即可实现完整的拒绝服务，成功率降至0.0%，且清洁提示行为保持在约50%，攻击隐蔽。
Motivation: 开源机器人社区依赖社区贡献的模型和数据集，但缺乏对数据来源的验证，容易遭受数据投毒攻击，威胁实际部署安全。
Method: 在视觉语言动作模型smolVLA上，通过在训练数据中嵌入触发词中毒样本，训练不同中毒比例，并在LeRobot平台上进行真实机器人拾取放置任务评估。
Result: 3个中毒片段在320个干净片段中即可实现完全拒绝服务，成功率为0.0%；单个中毒片段使成功率降至6.7%；攻击能泛化到不同的触发词位置。
Conclusion: 该研究证实了针对开源机器人系统的数据投毒威胁是实际、低成本且隐蔽的，建议将数据集来源作为第一级关注点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Binary Iterative Method for Non-targeted Adversarial Attack
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks guide and provide additional training and test data for both adversarial training and adversarial robustness validation, and expose the 'piecewise linearity' of deep learning based models. Since adversarial attacks and adversarial robustness are mathematically defined problems that can be optimised directly with end-to-end differentiable search, adversarial robustness is more widely applicable than other robustness metrics such as corruption and perturbation robustness, and new kinds of adversarial attacks are beneficial for robustness testing. Attacks are targeted or non-targeted depending on whether the image is modified to misclassify to a particular class or to any incorrect class; we focus on the non-targeted setting. Finding the optimal input data points and hyper-parameters for generating non-targeted adversarial attacks remains a challenge for current methods like the Fast Gradient Method, Basic Iterative Method and Virtual Adversarial Method. We propose a new method, the "Binary Iterative Method" (BinIM), which uses a divide-and-conquer paradigm to optimise parameters and hyper-parameters for the generation of non-targeted attacks. We compare our method to other gradient-based adversarial attacks evaluated over pre-trained networks (InceptionV3, InceptionV2, ResNet V2 152) on classification tasks. On 1000 randomly-sampled images from the standard ImageNet dataset, the Binary Iterative Method outperforms all other gradient-based methods, qualitatively making the classifier misclassify with confidence up to 0.995 while reducing the probability of the true label to 2.21e-09 (approximately 0).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于分治策略的非定向对抗攻击方法Binary Iterative Method (BinIM)，用于生成非定向对抗样本。该方法在ImageNet数据集上使用InceptionV3等预训练网络进行测试，相比Fast Gradient Method、Basic Iterative Method等梯度方法，能够以高达0.995的置信度使分类器误分类，并将真实标签概率降至接近0。
Motivation: 现有非定向对抗攻击方法（如快速梯度法、基础迭代法）在优化参数和超参数方面仍存在挑战，需要更有效的方法来生成高质量对抗样本。
Method: 提出Binary Iterative Method (BinIM)，采用分治范式（divide-and-conquer）来优化非定向攻击的参数和超参数。
Result: 在ImageNet数据集1000张随机采样图像上，BinIM在InceptionV3、InceptionV2、ResNet V2 152等预训练网络上优于所有对比的梯度方法，攻击置信度达0.995，真实标签概率降至2.21e-09。
Conclusion: BinIM是一种高效的梯度式非定向攻击方法，可显著提高攻击成功率并降低真实标签概率。

papers.title: CSB: A Counting and Sampling tool for Bit-vectors
papers.abstract_en: Satisfiability modulo theory (SMT) solvers have significantly advanced automated reasoning due to their effectiveness in solving problems across various fields. With the advancement in SMT solvers, there is growing interest in exploring capabilities beyond mere satisfiability, similar to the progression observed in Boolean satisfiability solvers that expanded into counting and sampling. In this study, we investigate the following question: Can we rely on modern CNF model counters and CNF samplers to extend modern SMT solvers to handle the problems of counting and sampling over bit-vectors? The main contribution of this work is the development of an efficient and user-friendly tool, csb, that solves a bunch of problems around model counting and sampling on the theory of bit-vectors, namely exact and approximate projected and non-projected model counting, along with the almost-uniform and uniform-like sampling. In the case of exact counting, projected counting, and uniform sampling. Our tool csb converts the bit-vector formula into a CNF formula using bit-blasting techniques before applying CNF model counters or samplers to perform counting or sampling. Our experiments demonstrate significant performance improvements over existing methods.

papers.title: Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning for Cross-Dataset EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) shows strong potential for cross-dataset transfer by improving feature representation and generalization. However, its application to EEG-based emotion recognition remains largely unexplored. Existing SSL methods struggle to capture the intricate spatiotemporal dependencies of EEG signals under varying channel configurations, extract fine-grained representations resilient to noise, and derive global features that generalize well across subjects. To address these challenges, we propose Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning (MGCRL), a novel SSL framework specifically designed for EEG-based emotion recognition. Built upon a region-aware spatiotemporal encoder, MGCRL integrates generative and contrastive learning to achieve both fine-grained and global discriminative representations for cross-dataset generalization. MGCRL introduces three key designs: 1) a spatiotemporal encoder that incorporates region-based graph convolution to capture localized spatial and functional relationships, enhancing region-specific feature learning and mitigating the impact of varying EEG channel configurations across datasets; 2) a generative learning mechanism based on the joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that utilizes masked features to capture noise robustness fine-grained representations, improving the model's capability to characterize subtle emotional states; and 3) a contrastive learning strategy that leverages masked and original features to learn temporally stable and cross-subject-invariant representations across the same stimuli, boosting emotion discrimination and cross-subject generalization. Under these designs, MGCRL exhibits remarkable ability to learn universal representation. Extensive experiments involving pretraining on the large FACED dataset and fine-tuning on multiple SEED-series datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of MGCRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning (MGCRL)，一种针对跨数据集脑电图（EEG）情绪识别的自监督学习框架。它结合生成式与对比式学习，在区域感知的时空编码器上捕获细微和全局特征，解决EEG通道配置差异、噪声鲁棒性和跨主体泛化问题。在大规模FACED数据集上预训练后在多个SEED系列数据集上微调，验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有自监督学习方法在EEG情绪识别中难以处理不同通道配置下的复杂时空依赖、提取抗噪声的细粒度表示以及获得跨主体泛化的全局特征。
Method: 基于区域感知的时空编码器，集成区域图卷积捕获局部空间与功能关系；采用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）进行生成式学习，从掩码特征中学习噪声鲁棒的细粒度表示；结合对比学习，利用掩码与原始特征学习跨刺激的时间稳定和跨主体不变表示。
Result: 在FACED数据集预训练后在多个SEED系列数据集上微调，实验表明MGCRL能学习到通用表示，跨数据集泛化能力显著。
Conclusion: MGCRL通过整合生成式与对比式学习，有效提升了EEG情绪识别的跨数据集性能，尤其适用于不同通道配置和噪声环境。

papers.title: MDL Meets Latent Confounders: LNML-based Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery with nonlinear mechanisms and latent confounders remains challenging. Existing methods often rely on either linear assumptions or causal sufficiency, limiting their applicability. We propose an MDL-based causal discovery framework that explicitly accounts for latent confounders while allowing flexible nonlinear mechanisms by minimizing the luckiness normalized maximum likelihood (LNML) code-length. The causal relationship between each variable pair is determined by selecting the shortest code-length of the causal model, and we introduce the notion of $Δ$-pseudo-collinearity to identify dependencies induced by latent confounders. Based on these ideas, we develop a greedy algorithm, termed Pseudo-Collinearity Guided Causal Discovery (PCG-CD). Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method accurately recovers directed causal relationships and effectively detects latent confounders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于MDL的因果发现框架，通过最小化LNML码长来处理非线性机制和潜在混淆变量，并引入Δ-伪共线性概念识别混淆依赖，开发了贪心算法PCG-CD。实验表明该方法能准确恢复有向因果关系和检测潜在混淆变量。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法常依赖线性假设或因果充分性，难以处理非线性机制和潜在混淆变量并存的情况。
Method: 提出MDL框架，用LNML码长作为模型选择准则，引入Δ-伪共线性识别潜在混淆变量导致的依赖，并设计贪心算法PCG-CD。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，该方法能准确恢复有向因果关系并有效检测潜在混淆变量。
Conclusion: 该方法为存在潜在混淆变量的非线性因果发现提供了有效途径，但摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Real-Time LiDAR Gaussian Splatting SLAM
papers.abstract_en: We present a real-time LiDAR-based framework for Gaussian Splatting SLAM that tightly couples fast G-ICP registration with spherical rasterization-based dense mapping for large-scale sequences. Leveraging LiDAR geometry rather than appearance, we reuse tracking-estimated local covariances to initialize Gaussians with range-aware scales and to derive surface normals for geometry-aware map optimization. We further introduce a covariance-derived geometry score that measures local complexity and drives pruning in planar regions and selective densification in structurally rich areas, while optimized Gaussians and LiDAR-specific confidence cues are fed back to improve tracking robustness. On the Newer College dataset, our method achieves an F-score of 86.78\% using purely online trajectories at real-time speed ($>$20 FPS), and additional experiments on other datasets confirm its stability and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于LiDAR的实时高斯泼溅SLAM框架，通过紧密耦合快速G-ICP配准与球面光栅化稠密建图，利用LiDAR几何信息初始化高斯并优化地图。在Newer College数据集上达到86.78%的F-score，速度超过20 FPS。
Motivation: 现有高斯泼溅SLAM主要针对视觉数据，缺乏对LiDAR几何信息的有效利用，且实时性与建图质量难以兼顾。
Method: 框架包括快速G-ICP配准、球面光栅化稠密建图，利用跟踪估计的局部协方差初始化高斯并导出表面法线进行几何优化，引入协方差几何分数驱动剪枝与加密，并将置信度反馈至跟踪模块。
Result: 在Newer College数据集上，使用纯在线轨迹实现86.78%的F-score，运行速度超过20 FPS；其他数据集验证了稳定性和可扩展性。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了实时、高精度的LiDAR高斯泼溅SLAM，并通过几何感知优化提升了建图和跟踪的鲁棒性。

papers.title: FRFDet: Efficient UAV Small Object Detection with Symmetric Sampling and Scalable Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Small object detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery remains challenging under adverse conditions, including complex weather, low illumination, and sensor noise. These challenges mainly stem from severe background clutter, fine-grained detail degradation, and suboptimal semantic-spatial feature fusion, which jointly hinder robust small-object representation. To this end, we propose FRFDet, a lightweight yet effective single-stage detector tailored for UAV-based small object detection. FRFDet proposes two plug-and-play modules: Inverse Bidirectional Sampling (IBS) and Scale-Feature Relationship Cross-Fusion (SFRCF). IBS preserves critical spatial details via channel expansion-compression and bidirectional pattern reconstruction, improving feature alignment. SFRCF explicitly models scale-dependent fusion behaviors, revealing that inter-group element-wise multiplication favors compact models, while inter-group additive fusion benefits larger architectures. Extensive experiments on VisDrone, UAVDT, HazyDet, and MS COCO demonstrate that FRFDet achieves state-of-the-art performance among lightweight detectors with low computational cost, compact parameters, and fast inference, making it well suited for resource-constrained UAV platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FRFDet，一种面向无人机小目标检测的轻量级单阶段检测器。通过逆双向采样（IBS）和尺度特征关系交叉融合（SFRCF）两个即插即用模块，解决了复杂天气、低照度等不利条件下的背景杂波和特征融合问题。在 VisDrone、UAVDT、HazyDet 和 MS COCO 数据集上，FRFDet 以低计算量和紧凑参数实现了轻量级检测器中的最优性能。
Motivation: 无人机图像中的小目标检测在复杂天气、低照度、传感器噪声等不利条件下表现不佳，主要原因是背景杂波严重、细粒度细节退化以及语义-空间特征融合不足。
Method: 提出 FRFDet，包含两个即插即用模块：逆双向采样（IBS）通过通道扩展-压缩和双向模式重建保留空间细节；尺度特征关系交叉融合（SFRCF）显式建模尺度相关的融合行为，发现组间逐元素乘法适合紧凑模型，而组间加法融合适合大规模架构。
Result: 在 VisDrone、UAVDT、HazyDet 和 MS COCO 数据集上，FRFDet 以低计算成本、紧凑参数和快速推理达到轻量级检测器中的最优性能。
Conclusion: FRFDet 适合资源受限的无人机平台，为无人机小目标检测提供了高效解决方案。

papers.title: Conflict-Based Lazy Search for Fast Multi-Manipulator Planning
papers.abstract_en: Employing multiple manipulators can boost efficiency and accomplish tasks that a single manipulator cannot do. However, real-time planning for multiple manipulators in a cluttered workspace still poses significant challenges for planning algorithms. This article proposes a new planning algorithm called Conflict-Based Lazy Search (CBLS) for multimanipulator planning. CBLS is built on Conflict-Based Search (CBS), an efficient multiagent pathfinding (MAPF) algorithm that has shown an order of magnitude speedup over previous approaches [1], [2]. CBS addresses MAPF by solving many single-agent pathfinding (SAPF) problems. Thus, its planning time directly depends on the efficiency of the SAPF algorithm adopted. Our CBLS algorithm enhances CBS with precomputation and lazy search. First, a lazily evaluated graph with controlled sparsity is precomputed for a single manipulator. Second, we propose the Lazy Edged-based A* (LEA*) for efficient SAPF. Since edge evaluation is the computational bottleneck of manipulator planning, LEA* uses lazy search and an edge queue to reduce the number of edge evaluations. We show that LEA* is optimally vertex efficient and has improved edge efficiency compared to A*. We apply the proposed CBLS to multi-manipulator planning problems and show its superior performance by comparing it with CBS and a sampling-based algorithm, namely, RRT-Connect.

papers.title: CertMix: Certified, Data-Efficient Metamaterial Design by Affine Mixing of Aligned Neural-Implicit Weight Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Inverse design of mechanical metamaterials seeks a periodic unit cell whose homogenized elastic properties meet a prescribed target, but current learning-based methods are data-hungry, mostly interpolative, and provide no guarantee that the generated design satisfies the specification. We introduce CertMix, a data-efficient framework that represents each exemplar unit cell as a small periodic neural implicit field, specifically a SIREN signed-distance decoder overfit from a shared anchor, so that exemplar weight vectors become aligned and directly comparable. The key observation is that, in this aligned weight space, the homogenized elasticity tensor is approximately linear in the mixing coefficients. Targeted design therefore reduces to a small constrained affine-mixing problem solved with a differentiable periodic homogenizer in the loop. Negative coefficients enable extrapolation beyond the exemplar range, a linearity-mismatch trust region keeps blends valid, and split-conformal calibration converts the mismatch signal into a distribution-free certificate on achieved-property error. From as few as 50 exemplars, CertMix attains a scaled property error of $10^{-4}$, roughly two to three orders of magnitude below conditional generative baselines trained on 1000 cells. It remains accurate far outside the exemplar range, is $57\times$ faster than per-target topology optimization while avoiding checkerboards and enclosed voids, and extends to spatially graded fields, 3D triply periodic surfaces, and a certified running-shoe midsole application.

TL;DR: 本文提出 CertMix，一种数据高效的机械超材料逆设计框架。通过将每个单元胞表示为过拟合的 SIREN 符号距离解码器，使得权重向量对齐并可比较。观察到在齐次化弹性张量在混合系数下近似线性，从而将目标设计转化为带约束的仿射混合问题。使用可微齐次化器和分裂保形校准提供分布无关的误差保证。仅需 50 个样本即可达到 10^{-4} 的尺度属性误差，比基于条件生成的基线方法低两到三个数量级，且速度比每目标拓扑优化快 57 倍。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的超材料逆设计方法数据需求大、多为插值、且无法保证生成设计满足规格，缺乏可认证性。
Method: 将每个单元胞表示为与共享锚点对齐的 SIREN 隐式场，使权重空间对齐；利用弹性张量在混合系数下的近似线性，构建带约束的仿射混合问题；通过可微齐次化器求解，并利用分裂保形校准提供属性误差的分布无关证书。
Result: 仅用 50 个样本，CertMix 达到 10^{-4} 的尺度属性误差，比基于条件生成的方法（使用 1000 个样本）低两到三个数量级；在外推范围外仍保持准确，且比每目标拓扑优化快 57 倍，避免棋盘格和封闭空洞。
Conclusion: CertMix 实现了数据高效的、可认证的超材料设计，并能扩展到空间梯度场、3D 三周期曲面及实际跑步鞋中底应用，展示了仿射混合在对齐隐式权重空间中的有效性。

papers.title: SOV-CAD: Stepwise Orthographic Views Guided CAD Modeling Sequence Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing Computer-Aided Design (CAD) modeling sequences from images is crucial for preserving design intent and supporting parametric editing. However, existing methods typically generate full CAD sequences holistically, overlooking the iterative, feedback-driven nature of human design workflows. We address this limitation by introducing the rich stepwise visual supervision: at each modeling step, the system observes the target's orthographic projections, the projections of the incrementally constructed model, and the active sketch, enabling informed action selection. To effectively leverage this on-the-fly feedback, we propose SOV-CAD, a framework that formulates CAD reconstruction as a sequential decision-making task and employs offline reinforcement learning with a Decision Transformer architecture. This design incorporates continuous visual feedback guided by geometric alignment rewards, resulting in a more accurate and human-like modeling process. Extensive experiments show that SOV-CAD surpasses state-of-the-art methods in CAD sequence reconstruction while exhibiting strong data efficiency. Code of SOV-CAD is available at: https://github.com/LukePhong/SOV-CAD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SOV-CAD 框架，将 CAD 建模序列重建视为序列决策任务，利用逐步的正交投影视觉反馈和离线强化学习，以 Decision Transformer 架构生成更符合人类设计流程的 CAD 序列。实验表明该方法在重建精度和数据效率上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 CAD 建模序列重建方法通常一次性生成完整序列，忽视了人类设计过程中迭代、反馈驱动的特性，导致难以捕捉设计意图。
Method: 提出 SOV-CAD 框架，在每个建模步骤中引入目标正交投影、增量模型投影和活动草图的视觉反馈，并结合几何对齐奖励的离线强化学习（Decision Transformer）进行序列决策。
Result: 在 CAD 序列重建任务上超越当前最优方法，并展现出较强的数据效率。
Conclusion: 逐步视觉监督和离线强化学习可有效提升 CAD 建模序列重建的准确性和拟人性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parametric Memory Decoding for Zero-Shot Routing in LoRA-Based External Parametric Memory
papers.abstract_en: With the rise of parametric memory, LoRA-based External Parametric Memory (EPM) has emerged as a modular solution, but existing routing methods often introduce additional training, deployment, and maintenance overhead. This raises a natural question: can a LoRA-based EPM bank be routed without maintaining an additional routing component? However, existing zero-shot LoRA routing methods still face two problems under the EPM setting: (1) their evaluations are scattered across different task settings rather than organized around EPM access, and (2) their routing signals lack a unified perspective to guide systematic improvement. To address these problems, we organize PMD-Bench, covering document-level, domain-level knowledge, and task-skill, and propose Parametric Memory Decoding (PMD), the first framework designed to systematically improve zero-shot LoRA routing by reframing it as decoding activations over external parametric memory. Based on PMD, we further instantiate PMDRouter, which scores each LoRA by its response magnitude from a single base-model prefill. Experiments on PMD-Bench show that PMDRouter achieves the strongest internal-signal performance across multiple zero-shot routing settings. These results demonstrate the feasibility of zero-shot LoRA routing and suggest that PMD can serve as a general framework for improving zero-shot routing methods. Sources: Github (https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Parametric-Memory-Decoding-872A/)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LoRA外部参数化记忆（EPM）的零样本路由问题，提出参数化记忆解码（PMD）框架，将路由重新定义为在外部参数化记忆上的激活解码。基于PMD实例化的PMDRouter通过单次基础模型预填充计算每个LoRA的响应幅度作为分数，在构建的PMD-Bench基准上实现了最强的内部信号性能。
Motivation: 现有LoRA路由方法需要额外的训练、部署和维护开销，而零样本路由方法在EPM设置下存在评估分散和缺乏统一视角的问题。
Method: 提出PMD框架，将零样本LoRA路由重构成在外部参数化记忆上的激活解码，并实例化PMDRouter，通过单次基础模型预填充计算每个LoRA的响应幅度进行评分。
Result: 在PMD-Bench（涵盖文档级、领域级知识和任务技能）上，PMDRouter在多个零样本路由设置中达到最强的内部信号性能。
Conclusion: 结果证明了零样本LoRA路由的可行性，并表明PMD可以作为改进零样本路由方法的通用框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GlacierCastAI: Predicting Glacier Retreat from Multi-Modal Satellite Imagery and Climate Signals
papers.abstract_en: ERA5 seasonal climate variables contain predictive information about future glacier retreat beyond what satellite imagery alone provides, yet existing deep learning methods focus on mapping current boundaries rather than forecasting future ones. This paper presents GlacierCastAI, which reframes glacier boundary prediction as a multi-modal spatiotemporal forecasting problem, fusing multi-temporal Landsat imagery with ERA5 reanalysis climate variables and Copernicus DEM terrain features to forecast glacier boundaries across five glaciers spanning four climate regimes. The architecture couples a ResNet50 spatial encoder with a ConvLSTM temporal model and a cross-attention climate fusion module. Because forecasting is inherently more uncertain than mapping current boundaries, the reported IoU values (0.320-0.337) are not directly comparable to state-of-the-art mapping models. Comparisons are against traditional baselines and experimental conditions. Through a pre-registered ablation study, adding ERA5 climate signals improves image-only IoU from 0.326 to 0.337 (+3.4%), suggesting that atmospheric forcing carries predictive information beyond imagery alone. All deep learning models substantially outperform persistence and linear trend baselines (IoU 0.160 and 0.169 respectively), with improvements of 89-99% relative IoU. A lightweight climate-only MLP baseline (661K parameters) achieves an IoU of 0.320 (98% of image-only performance) using 85x fewer parameters, suggesting that ERA5 variables encode substantial predictive signal independently of satellite imagery. SHAP attribution analysis suggests that spring solar radiation (MAM) is the dominant climate driver, consistent with the known role of spring insolation in setting melt season trajectories.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Code available at GitHub
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlacierCastAI将冰川边界预测重构为多模态时空预测问题，融合多时相Landsat影像、ERA5再分析气候变量和Copernicus DEM地形特征，预测五个不同气候区冰川的边界。实验表明，加入ERA5气候信号将仅用影像的IoU从0.326提升至0.337（+3.4%），且轻量级气候-only MLP基线（66.1万参数）达到影像-only性能的98%（IoU 0.320）。SHAP分析显示春季太阳辐射是主导气候因子。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法仅关注当前冰川边界制图，无法预测未来退缩；ERA5季节性气候变量包含超越卫星影像的预测信息，但未被充分利用。
Method: 提出 GlacierCastAI 架构，结合ResNet50空间编码器、ConvLSTM时序模型和交叉注意力气候融合模块，融合多模态数据（Landsat、ERA5、DEM）进行冰川边界未来预测。
Result: GlacierCastAI 在五个冰川上达到 IoU 0.320-0.337，显著优于持久性基线（IoU 0.160）和线性趋势基线（IoU 0.169），相对IoU提升89-99%；气候-only MLP以85倍少参数达到0.320 IoU。
Conclusion: ERA5气候变量携带独立于卫星影像的预测信号，春季太阳辐射是关键驱动因子；但预测IoU较低（0.32-0.34），与现有制图模型不直接可比。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Asymptotic-Preserving A Posteriori Analysis of Diffusion and Flow-Matching Samplers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow-matching samplers integrate a learned probability-flow ODE from a large noise scale down to a small terminal floor $σ_{\min}$, at which the score is stiff and the flow develops a boundary layer. We treat $σ_{\min}$ as a singular-perturbation parameter and determine which fixed-step samplers are asymptotic-preserving (AP), that is, stable and uniformly accurate as $σ_{\min}\to0$, casting the criteria as an a posteriori audit: residual functionals with $σ_{\min}$-uniform coefficients, computable on a pretrained checkpoint without ground-truth scores or exact trajectories. On the terminal layer, Euler in the $σ$-clock, the deterministic DDIM update, is the unique layer-exact discretization up to affine reparameterization, with rectified flow its flow-matching counterpart; the $λ$-clock is stable only for steps $h\le h_\star=1+W(1/e)$, and the uniform-$σ^2$ heat clock stalls a $σ_{\min}$-independent distance from the data. On two solvable models (rank-deficient Gaussian, symmetric two-point mixture), deterministic samplers remain first-order uniformly accurate with no $\log(1/σ_{\min})$ factor, even across a symmetric posterior-switching interface whose distributional budget is a universal constant; the logarithm is charged entirely to the Itô term of stochastic samplers, whose path-KL scales as $Λ^2/N$ against the ODE's $O(Λ^2/N^2)$ budget, with $Λ=\log(σ_{\max}/σ_{\min})$. On the EDM CIFAR-10 checkpoint, spectra measured once predict held-out residual budgets across step count, schedule, and noise level against pre-specified gates with no per-configuration refitting, and calibrate the Itô coefficient at $M_1=1.00\pm0.01$. The clock decides stability; the noise, not the geometry, charges the logarithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种渐近保持（AP）后验分析框架，用于评估扩散和流匹配采样器中固定步长离散化方法的稳定性和精度，将最小噪声尺度 σ_min 视为奇异摄动参数。通过设计具有 σ_min 一致系数的残差泛函，无需真实分数或精确轨迹即可在预训练检查点上进行后验检验。结果表明，在 σ-时钟下的欧拉方法（DDIM）是唯一的层精确离散化，λ-时钟的稳定性步长受限于 h ≤ h_*，而均匀 σ² 热时钟与数据存在 σ_min 无关的偏差。在可解模型上，确定性采样器保持一阶一致精度，无对数因子，而对数成本完全由随机采样器的伊藤项承担。在EDM CIFAR-10检查点上，谱测量可预测预留残差预算，并标定伊藤系数为1.00±0.01。
Motivation: 扩散和流匹配采样器在最小噪声尺度 σ_min 附近会出现分数刚性（stiff）和边界层，导致数值离散化可能不稳定或精度损失。现有分析缺乏统一的后验准则来判断哪些离散化方法是渐近保持的（即当 σ_min→0 时稳定且一致精确）。
Method: 将 σ_min 作为奇异摄动参数，通过构造具有 σ_min 一致系数的残差泛函，对固定步长采样器进行后验分析，确定其渐近保持性。该方法无需真实分数或精确轨迹，仅依赖预训练检查点。
Result: 在可解模型（秩亏高斯、对称两点混合）上，确定性采样器保持一阶一致精度，且无 log(1/σ_min) 因子；该对数成本完全来自随机采样器的伊藤项，其路径KL为 Λ²/N，而ODE仅为 O(Λ²/N²)。在EDM CIFAR-10上，谱测量可预测预留残差预算，并标定伊藤系数为1.00±0.01。
Conclusion: 时钟（时间参数化）决定稳定性，噪声（而非几何结构）承担对数成本。DDIM（σ-时钟欧拉）是唯一的层精确离散化，而 λ-时钟和均匀 σ² 热时钟各有稳定性限制或精度损失。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DynaVieW: Schema-Guided World Modeling for Understanding Hierarchical Visual Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs struggle to systematically model the temporal evolution of visual scenes in videos or multi-image sequences. Such inputs require models to predict or simulate multiple levels of dynamic constituents, such as actions taken in the visual sequence, and the associated changes to the visual environment that result. To address this challenge, we propose a dynamic schema-guided world model, DynaVieW, optimized for visual dynamic prediction and simulation. DynaVieW achieves an in-depth understanding of visual dynamics by learning interleaved state-transition sequences, where states cover broad visual scenes from video keyframes, and transitions capture comprehensive dynamic constituents within a hierarchical schema. DynaVieW jointly models transition prediction and state simulation under a mixture-of-experts architecture, with a cross-expert selective attention and a schema token re-weighted loss, to ensure effective and robust learning. DynaVieW's understanding of visual dynamics boosts its downstream performance in visual narrative creation and world simulation, showing improved consistency, controllability, and instruction-following.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 多模态LLM不能系统建模视频或多图像序列中场景的时间演化，需要预测多个层次的动态成分（如动作和环境变化），现有方法缺乏对此的结构化建模。
Method: 使用动态模式引导的世界模型DynaVieW，学习交错状态-转移序列，其中状态来自视频关键帧的广泛场景，转移在层次化模式中捕捉动态成分。采用混合专家架构，通过跨专家选择性注意力和模式令牌重加权损失，联合训练转移预测和状态模拟。

Conclusion: 通过层次化模式引导和混合专家架构，可以有效建模视觉动态，提升多模态世界模拟性能。

papers.title: Dictionaries, Not Darwin: Set-Level Selection Beats LLM Evolution in Scientific Equation Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used as evolutionary engines for scientific discovery: generate candidates, select winners, feed them back as parents, and repeat. We audit whether this loop actually compounds discovery in scientific equation discovery, a setting where finite samples make structure underdetermined and interpolation easy. Under matched LLM-call budgets, parent-conditioned evolution is indistinguishable from fresh independent sampling: median OOD NMSE is 0.045 vs. 0.049, instructed multi-parent crossover is worse, final success is predicted by initial proposal quality, and multiple iteration schemes fail to add solved problems. Operationally, the loop reduces to what it produces: a dictionary of candidate terms. We turn that diagnosis into PTB-Search, a one-generation method for componentized scientific discovery. PTB-Search samples independent LLM proposals once, extracts reusable terms into a per-problem dictionary, and performs train-only set-level sparse selection with least-squares coefficients. Its central principle is that underdetermined data identifies the joint behavior of term sets, not reliable per-term credit. On identical dictionaries and zero additional LLM calls, set-level selectors solve 165--169 of 717 cells, while single-term reductions solve only 74--78. On the official 239-problem LLM-SRBench split, PTB-Search reaches 73.2% Acc0.1 with Llama-3.1-8B and 77.0% with a single-seed DeepSeek-V4 anchor, versus 49.2% for the best reported baseline, using one tenth of the standardized call budget. A program-domain stress test gives a scoped boundary: generation count remains unreliable, while retained external state can help in harder non-linear spaces. Across these results, LLMs are best understood as material suppliers; discovery is carried by external set-level selection over reusable components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了以LLM为进化引擎的科学方程发现循环，发现父代条件进化与独立采样无显著差异（中位OOD NMSE 0.045 vs 0.049），多父代交叉更差，最终成功由初始提案质量决定。基于此，提出一代方法PTB-Search：独立采样一次LLM提案，提取可重用术语构建字典，然后通过最小二乘系数进行训练时集级稀疏选择。在717个单元上，集级选择器解决165-169个，单术语缩减仅74-78个；在239问题LLM-SRBench基准上，PTB-Search以十分之一调用预算达到73.2% Acc0.1（Llama-3.1-8B）和77.0%（DeepSeek-V4），远超最佳基线49.2%。结论认为LLM是材料供应商，发现由外部集级选择驱动。
Motivation: 现有LLM进化循环在科学方程发现中是否真正积累发现？审计表明其等价于独立采样，未产生复合增益。
Method: 提出PTB-Search，一次性采样LLM提议，提取可重用术语到字典，然后基于最小二乘系数进行训练时集级稀疏选择，避免逐术语归因。
Result: 集级选择器在717个单元中解决165-169个，单术语缩减仅74-78个；在239问题LLM-SRBench上，PTB-Search以十分之一调用预算达73.2% Acc0.1（Llama-3.1-8B）和77.0%（DeepSeek-V4），优于最佳基线49.2%。
Conclusion: LLM应被视为材料供应商，发现由外部集级选择驱动；生成计数不可靠，但保留外部状态在非线性空间中有帮助。

papers.title: Governing Generative AI Across Financial Institutions: An SR 26-2-Compatible Framework for Generative AI Risk Control
papers.abstract_en: The release of SR 26-2 marks a significant modernization of U.S. model risk management by replacing SR 11-7 with a more risk-based and materiality-sensitive supervisory framework. However, generative and agentic AI are excluded, creating an important governance challenge for banking organizations and other financial institutions. Although generative AI may not directly estimate credit risk or make underwriting decisions, its outputs can materially affect the surrounding control environment through monitoring interpretation, policy analysis, or adverse-action language drafting. These uses may influence how regulated financial decisions are explained, challenged, documented, and governed. This paper proposes the Generative AI Control Framework (GAICF), an SR 26-2-compatible governance framework for generative AI-enabled financial workflows. The framework translates core model risk management principles into a layered control structure for generative AI applications that operate outside the formal model boundary but remain embedded within regulated banking processes. GAICF provides a practical approach for financial institutions seeking to align emerging generative AI governance practices with the risk-based supervisory expectations reflected in SR 26-2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对美国金融监管更新（SR 26-2）中未涵盖生成式AI的治理空白，提出生成式AI控制框架（GAICF），旨在帮助金融机构在正式模型边界之外管理生成式AI风险，并与SR 26-2的监管期望对齐。
Motivation: SR 26-2取代SR 11-7后，虽采用更基于风险和重要性的监管框架，但明确排除生成式AI和代理式AI，造成金融机构在生成式AI用于监控解读、政策分析、行动理由起草等场景时的治理挑战。
Method: 提出GAICF，将核心模型风险管理原则转化为适用于生成式AI应用的分层控制结构，这些应用虽在正式模型边界之外，但仍嵌入受监管银行流程中。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验或量化结果，仅描述框架的设计及其与SR 26-2兼容性。
Conclusion: GAICF为金融机构提供一种实用方法，使其新兴生成式AI治理实践与SR 26-2基于风险的监管期望保持一致。

papers.title: The Multipath Blind Spot: $K$-Agnostic Robust Calibration for Sparse-Anchor Metric Depth from Frozen Foundations
papers.abstract_en: Monocular depth foundations predict domain-general relative depth but lack absolute scale; a handful of sparse metric anchors from a range sensor can calibrate them to metric depth, an attractive alternative to metric-supervised training. Existing sparse-anchor calibration methods, however, assume the anchors are clean, whereas real sensors produce outliers that are present with the wrong value -- time-of-flight multipath, mixed pixels -- not merely missing. We show that the established residual-on-CFA calibration recipe collapses under such outliers, and that the strongest publicly deployed method, VI-Depth, has a structural multipath blind spot: robust to missing anchors, it falls behind an unprotected baseline on three of four datasets when anchors are present but wrong. We propose Multipath-Robust Anchor Calibration (MRAC), a parameter-free, inference-time wrapper that gates anchors by foundation consistency -- a Theil--Sen fit and a median-absolute-deviation test against the foundation's own relative-depth ordering -- before a single call to the calibration head. MRAC adds no learned parameters, runs its selection in $\approx 50\,μ$s on CPU, and serves anchor budgets $K \in [5,200]$ from one checkpoint. On a $320$-cell benchmark with a same-backbone, same-architecture control, MRAC strictly wins $84\%$ of same-backbone cells across all four outlier families and, against VI-Depth, wins all twelve corrupted multipath cells and all sixteen KITTI cells, reducing KITTI multipath AbsRel by $3.2\times$ ($0.489$ to $0.151$) at zero retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示现有稀疏锚点标定方法对传感器异常值（如多路径效应）的脆弱性，并指出VI-Depth存在结构性多路径盲点。作者提出无参数的推理时包装器MRAC，通过Theil-Sen拟合和中位数绝对偏差检验，基于基础模型的相对深度顺序过滤异常锚点，无需重新训练即可显著提升鲁棒性。在KITTI多路径场景中，MRAC将AbsRel从0.489降至0.151（降低3.2倍），并在84%的测试细胞中优于同骨干网对照。
Motivation: 现有稀疏锚点标定方法假设锚点干净，但实际传感器会输出错误值（如多路径、混合像素），导致传统方法崩溃。VI-Depth对缺失锚点鲁棒但对错误锚点脆弱，存在结构性的多路径盲点。
Method: 提出Multipath-Robust Anchor Calibration (MRAC)，一种无参数推理时包装器：通过Theil-Sen拟合和基于基础模型相对深度排序的中位数绝对偏差检验来门控锚点，然后调用标定头。锚点选择约50μs，支持锚点数量K∈[5,200]。
Result: 在320个细胞基准中，MRAC在84%的相同骨干网细胞中严格优于对照，并在所有12个多路径细胞和16个KITTI细胞中击败VI-Depth，将KITTI多路径AbsRel从0.489降至0.151（降低3.2倍），无需重新训练。
Conclusion: MRAC是一种无参数、即插即用的方法，通过基础一致性门控有效抵御传感器异常值，且无需重新训练模型。

papers.title: Sparse4D-Radar: An Efficient and Robust Framework for Surround-View 3D Object Detection via 4D Radar-Camera Fusion
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, 4D imaging radar has gained wide attention in autonomous driving for its robustness against harsh weather and ability to output target velocity. Nevertheless, mainstream 4D radar-camera fusion methods only support front-view perception, lacking mature solutions for surround-view sensing. Directly expanding these pipelines to full 360° coverage introduces excessive computation cost and limits real-world deployment. To tackle these limitations, this work proposes Sparse4D-Radar, an efficient robust surround-view multi-modal fusion framework. We first design a Deformable Fusion module to embed radar-camera features into sparse queries, constructing the lightweight base version Sparse4D-Radar-Base. Two dedicated modules are further introduced to boost localization accuracy and modality stability: Velocity-Consistency Sampling (VCS) refines features via radar velocity cues for motion awareness, and Adaptive Modality Gating (AMG) dynamically adjusts cross-modal fusion weights according to feature confidence. Combining all components, we build Sparse4D-Radar-Acc for high-precision detection demands. Comprehensive experiments on OmniHD-Scenes verify that our approach achieves state-of-the-art surround-view 3D detection performance. Compared with prior arts, our method obtains over 7% mAP and 10% ODS improvements under complex driving scenes while running at nearly 10 FPS, striking a favorable trade-off among detection accuracy, environmental robustness and inference efficiency. Our open-source code is available at https://github.com/Aiuan/Sparse4D-Radar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sparse4D-Radar，一种面向环绕视图的4D雷达-相机多模态融合框架，用于3D目标检测。通过可变形融合模块将雷达-相机特征嵌入稀疏查询，并引入速度一致性采样 (VCS) 和自适应模态门控 (AMG) 提升定位精度与模态稳定性。在 OmniHD-Scenes 数据集上，该方法在复杂驾驶场景下相比先前方法 mAP 提升超过7%，ODS 提升超过10%，运行速度约10 FPS。
Motivation: 现有4D雷达-相机融合方法仅支持前视感知，缺乏成熟的环绕视图方案，直接扩展至360°会引入过高计算成本，限制实际部署。
Method: 设计可变形融合模块将雷达-相机特征嵌入稀疏查询，构建基础版本 Sparse4D-Radar-Base；进一步提出速度一致性采样 (VCS) 利用雷达速度信息增强运动感知，以及自适应模态门控 (AMG) 根据特征置信度动态调整跨模态融合权重，构成高精度版本 Sparse4D-Radar-Acc。
Result: 在 OmniHD-Scenes 数据集上，该方法在复杂驾驶场景下 mAP 提升超过7%，ODS 提升超过10%，运行速度约10 FPS，实现了检测精度、环境鲁棒性和推理效率的良好权衡。
Conclusion: Sparse4D-Radar 为环绕视图3D目标检测提供了一种高效鲁棒的融合框架，并在开源代码中实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Forethought: Verifiable Reasoning from Neurosymbolic Primitive Programming
papers.abstract_en: Current agentic workflows usually involve decomposing user requests into sequences of tool calls with correctly resolved parameters, the results of which are processed through reasoning traces in the language model's context window. The prevailing route to improve such reasoning is test-time scaling, which trains models to search over long chains of thought; but the resulting capability is entangled in model weights, is not verifiable step-by-step, and is costly at inference. We present Forethought, a neurosymbolic reasoning system that instead treats reasoning as an explicit, verifiable program, that builds from a library of symbolic and neural primitives which are composed through a domain-specific language. The result are reasoning programs, which are concrete representations of the model's work, and as such can be inspected and modified before deployment. Instantiated as a tool-calling execution kernel and evaluated across five benchmarks, Forethought improves base-model accuracy by about 30% relative and outperforms vanilla prompting, reinforcement learning scaffolds, and prompt-evolution methods, enabling small models to match or exceed frontier models capabilities. In a direct comparison, a non-reasoning model augmented with Forethought competes with a dedicated reasoning model while requiring roughly three orders of magnitude less post-training investment, and remains model-agnostic and auditable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Forethought，一种神经符号推理系统，将推理过程视为显式、可验证的程序，通过领域特定语言组合符号与神经原语库，生成可检查、可修改的推理程序。在五个基准测试上，该方法使基础模型准确率相对提升约 30%，超越标准提示、强化学习框架和提示进化方法，使小模型能够匹敌或超越前沿推理模型，且训练投入降低约三个数量级，保持模型无关与可审计性。
Motivation: 当前智能体工作流依赖上下文窗口中的推理轨迹，主流改进方法（测试时扩展）使能力纠缠于模型权重、无法逐步验证且推理成本高，亟需一种可审计、可检查的替代方案。
Method: Forethought 将推理构建为显式、可验证的程序，从符号原语和神经原语库出发，通过领域特定语言进行组合，生成具体的推理程序，并实例化为工具调用执行内核。
Result: 在五个基准上，Forethought 使基础模型准确率相对提升约 30%，优于标准提示、强化学习框架和提示进化方法；非推理模型借助 Forethought 可与专用推理模型竞争，同时后训练投入约少三个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Forethought 是模型无关且可审计的，生成的推理程序可在部署前检查和修改，使小型非推理模型具备竞争性推理能力，且大幅降低后训练成本。

papers.title: Target-Aware Interaction-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Black-Box Node Injection Attacks on Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable performance in graph representation learning, yet their inherent vulnerability to adversarial attacks poses severe security risks. Especially, black-box node injection attacks have become a major threat to GNNs since they inject malicious nodes without altering the original graph topology. However, they typically decouple the generation of malicious node features and edge connections, thereby resulting in suboptimal attack efficacy under stringent budgets. To address this critical issue, this study proposes a novel Target-aware Interaction-guided Reinforcement learning for Black-box node injection Attacks on GNNs (TIRBA), which formulates the attack as a Markov Decision Process and jointly optimizes node feature generation and edge construction in a heterogeneous action space. Firstly, TIRBA designs a target-aware interaction encoder to fuse information of node features and edges. Further, it introduces a class-center guidance mechanism to utilize prior class distribution information, thereby guiding efficient exploration of the high-dimensional feature space. Finally, a topology difference-aware state value evaluation is adopted to explicitly capture local structural anomalies caused by injected nodes, thereby stabilizing the reinforcement learning training process. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed TIRBA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art black-box node injection attack methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图神经网络（GNN）的黑盒节点注入攻击，提出一种目标感知交互引导的强化学习方法（TIRBA）。该方法将攻击建模为马尔可夫决策过程，在异质动作空间中联合优化恶意节点特征生成与边连接。通过目标感知交互编码器、类中心引导机制和拓扑差异感知状态值评估，显著提升攻击效果。实验表明TIRBA优于现有最先进的黑盒节点注入攻击方法。
Motivation: 现有黑盒节点注入攻击通常解耦恶意节点特征与边连接的生成，导致在严格预算下攻击效果次优，亟需联合优化方法。
Method: 将攻击建模为马尔可夫决策过程，设计目标感知交互编码器融合节点特征与边信息，引入类中心引导机制利用先验类别分布引导高维特征空间探索，并采用拓扑差异感知状态值评估捕获注入节点引起的局部结构异常以稳定强化学习训练。
Result: 实验结果显示，所提TIRBA在多个基准上显著优于当前最先进的黑盒节点注入攻击方法。
Conclusion: 联合优化节点特征与边连接的强化学习框架能有效提升黑盒节点注入攻击的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PLACEMEM: Toward a Compute-Aware Memory Plane for Lifelong Agents
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong agents need more than larger context windows and better retrieval. They need memories that can persist, evolve, and be corrected without forcing the serving stack to recompute the same history on every turn or silently reuse stale runtime state. We present PLACEMEM as a systems position on lifelong-agent memory, instantiated by an executable control-plane prototype. The central claim is that agent memory should be represented as versioned capsules that unify semantics, provenance, validity, and reusable runtime state under one correction-aware identity. In the current prototype, capsules drive prompt-level text retrieval, KV-aware routing, and cascading invalidation over live streamed backends; prospective layer-frontier replay is intentionally framed as a deeper integration agenda rather than a claimed engine feature. We describe a vLLM-first prototype with persistent capsule state, concurrency-safe invalidation, an OpenAI-compatible routing sidecar, a typed metadata contract, and a benchmark harness that measures live first-token latency, reuse, and post-correction behavior. The result is both an executable artifact that demonstrates correction-aware control-plane behavior today and a concrete roadmap for replay-aware serving integration in future lifelong-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PLACEMEM，一个面向终身智能体的计算感知记忆平面系统设计。核心主张是将智能体记忆表示为版本化胶囊，统一语义、来源、有效性和可重用运行时状态。当前原型实现了提示级文本检索、KV-aware 路由和级联失效机制，并基于 vLLM 构建，支持持久化胶囊状态、并发安全失效和 OpenAI 兼容路由侧车。
Motivation: 终身智能体需要持久、可演化且可纠正的记忆机制，而现有方法依赖更大的上下文窗口或更好的检索，无法避免每次交互重新计算历史或复用过时状态。
Method: 提出版本化胶囊作为记忆基本单元，统一语义、来源、有效性及可重用运行时状态。原型使用 vLLM 实现，包含持久化胶囊状态、并发安全失效、OpenAI 兼容路由侧车和类型化元数据契约，并通过基准测试评估第一令牌延迟、复用率和纠正后行为。
Result: 原型展示了修正感知控制平面行为，并提供了通往重放感知服务集成的具体路线图。
Conclusion: 本文定位为系统设计立场，强调通过版本化胶囊实现计算感知记忆平面，为未来终身智能体系统提供可执行的参考实现和发展方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Submitted and Diagnostic Analysis of Full-Text Temporal Retrieval for LongEval-Sci
papers.abstract_en: LongEval-Sci evaluates scientific retrieval under collection change, where a system should be effective on the current corpus and remain usable as documents accumulate over time. This paper reports both official Task 1 results and development diagnostics for LongEval-Sci 2026. We compare the official PyTerrier BM25 and Qwen3 dense baselines with full-text BM25, additive and router variants, temporal full-text retrieval, temporal+citation retrieval, RM3 query expansion, cross-encoder reranking, and reciprocal rank fusion (RRF). In the official DCTR evaluation, the temporalized full-text runs are our strongest submissions: FT BM25+temporal and FT BM25+temporal+citation obtain the best ARP on all three snapshots (0.285, 0.267, and 0.180 nDCG@10) and reduce snapshot-3 relative change from 0.481 for the BM25 pivot to 0.368. Citation features match the temporal-only variant but do not provide a measurable additional gain in the official summary. Our internal snapshot-1 diagnostics show a complementary pattern: full-text BM25 is the strongest single development retriever (DCTR nDCG@10 = 0.3302, MAP = 0.2853), RRF gives the best deep recall (Recall@1000 = 0.9667), and some uncalibrated overlays can sharply degrade top-rank quality. We therefore conclude that full-text retrieval is the strongest foundation, temporal integration can improve official longitudinal effectiveness when applied to that foundation, and citation evidence still requires cleaner ablation and calibration. Beyond ranking, we also report a qualitative weekly IR-system update-monitoring analysis based on ingestion velocity and stale-coverage drift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了LongEval-Sci 2026任务1的官方结果和开发诊断，比较了多种检索方法，包括全文BM25、时间集成检索、引用检索等。实验表明，全文BM25结合时间集成在官方评价中表现最佳，而引用特征没有带来额外增益。内部诊断显示全文BM25是最强的单一检索器，RRF提供最佳深度召回。结论是全文检索是最强基础，时间集成可改善纵向效果。
Motivation: LongEval-Sci评估在语料库变化下的科学检索性能，要求系统在当前语料上有效且随时间积累仍保持可用。论文旨在通过比较多种检索策略来提升纵向检索效果。
Method: 比较了PyTerrier BM25、Qwen3稠密基线、全文BM25、加性变体、路由器变体、时间全文检索、时间+引用检索、RM3查询扩展、交叉编码器重排序和倒数秩融合（RRF）。
Result: 官方DCTR评估中，时间化全文检索（FT BM25+temporal和FT BM25+temporal+citation）在所有三个快照上获得最佳ARP（nDCG@10分别为0.285、0.267、0.180），并将快照3的相对变化从BM25基线的0.481降至0.368。内部诊断中，全文BM25是最强单检索器（DCTR nDCG@10=0.3302，MAP=0.2853），RRF获得最佳深度召回（Recall@1000=0.9667）。
Conclusion: 全文检索是最强基础，时间集成可改善官方纵向效果，引用证据仍需更干净的消融和校准。论文还报告了基于摄入速度和陈旧覆盖漂移的定性周更新监控分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FedSPM: Routing-Enabled Federated Learning under Dual Heterogeneity via Semiparametric Mixture
papers.abstract_en: Routing-prediction federated learning has emerged as a new paradigm that reframes inter-client heterogeneity as a resource for system-level intelligence: at inference time, the server routes each external query to the best-matched client for prediction. Existing approaches, however, typically treat each client as internally homogeneous, overlooking latent subpopulations within local data. For example, patients with the same diagnosis at one hospital may exhibit morphologically distinct disease subtypes. The coexistence of inter-client and intra-client heterogeneity, which we call dual heterogeneity, can impair both routing and prediction. To address this challenge, we propose FedSPM, a routing-enabled semiparametric mixture framework that represents each client using client-specific latent components. Each component combines a predictive distribution for classification with a feature distribution for routing. To flexibly model feature distributions while effectively sharing information across clients, FedSPM models their density ratios relative to a common nonparametric measure estimated via empirical likelihood. We develop a federated expectation-maximization algorithm that optimizes a tractable surrogate and prove convergence of the exact profiled objective at the standard $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate when the surrogate errors are properly controlled. Experiments on controlled benchmarks and real-world medical data demonstrate consistent improvements in routing and prediction under dual heterogeneity. Code is available at https://github.com/zijianwang0510/FedSPM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedSPM，一个支持路由的半参数混合联邦学习框架，用于处理同时存在客户端间和客户端内异质性（dual heterogeneity）的场景。每个客户端由多个潜在组件表示，每个组件包含分类预测分布和用于路由的特征分布。通过经验似然估计密度比相对于公共非参数测度，并开发联邦期望最大化算法，以 O(1/√T) 速率收敛。实验在受控基准和真实医疗数据上展示了路由和预测的改进。
Motivation: 现有路由-预测联邦学习假设每个客户端内部是同质的，忽略了本地数据中的潜在子种群（如医院中同一诊断的不同亚型），这种双重异质性会损害路由和预测性能。
Method: 提出 FedSPM 框架，每个客户端由多个潜在组件表示，每个组件包含分类预测分布和用于路由的特征分布。特征分布的密度比通过经验似然相对于公共非参数测度建模，并开发联邦 EM 算法优化可处理代理目标，证明精确剖面目标在代理误差受控时以标准 O(1/√T) 速率收敛。
Result: 在受控基准和真实医疗数据上的实验表明，FedSPM 在双重异质性下一致提升了路由和预测性能。
Conclusion: FedSPM 通过半参数混合模型有效处理了双重异质性，为联邦学习中的路由-预测范式提供了新方法。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Unified Framework for In-Context Learning with Causal and Masked Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) has emerged as a central capability of pretrained language models, yet its theoretical analysis has focused primarily on causal language models trained by left-to-right autoregressive prediction, such as GPT-style models. Masked language models instead recover masked tokens from bidirectional context, and their role in ICL remains less understood. We develop a statistical learning framework that represents the context examples by their empirical measure and models prediction as a function of the context and the query. This formulation places autoregressive and masked pretraining objectives within a common excess-risk analysis. Under Wasserstein-type regularity conditions, we relate pretraining with T tasks and N samples per task to k-shot excess risk at inference, obtaining same-order upper bounds for masked and autoregressive objectives. We also study task-distribution shift, where pretraining tasks are sampled from P and inference tasks from Q; the resulting bound contains an additional term controlled by the lifted Wasserstein distance between P and Q. The bounds further imply an order-optimal allocation under a fixed pretraining data budget and refined rates under intrinsic low-dimensional structure. Experiments on controlled function-learning tasks show that the Masked Pair Encoder (MPE) can achieve performance comparable to GPT-2-style causal Transformers, suggesting that ICL behavior is not specific to causal language models.

Method: 提出一个统计学习框架，用经验测度表示上下文示例，将预测建模为上下文与查询的函数；在Wasserstein型正则条件下，统一分析自回归和掩码预训练目标下的k-shot超额风险，并处理任务分布偏移（预训练分布P与推理分布Q之间的Wasserstein距离控制额外项）。
Result: 对于掩码和自回归目标，得到了相同阶数的k-shot超额风险上界；推导了在固定预训练数据预算下的最优分配，以及在低维内在结构下的改进速率。实验表明MPE可达到与GPT-2相当的ICL性能。
Conclusion: ICL行为并非因果语言模型特有，统一框架支持两类模型；实验验证了理论预测，但受控函数学习任务与真实自然语言场景存在差距。

papers.title: Seeing Once is Enough? Online Geometry-Aware Token Pruning for 3D Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Recent Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on 2D question answering tasks. However, extending these models to the 3D question answering remains challenging, as they typically require multiple views of the scene, which incurs substantial computational cost at inference. To mitigate this issue, existing solutions rely on strategic frame selection or token-merging algorithms that require preprocessing in advance all frames of the scene, i.e., an offline fashion. In contrast, we propose the first online token-pruning method that can be integrated seamlessly with current MLLM models for 3D question answering tasks, without additional training and with lower memory usage.Our key insight is to project each input frame into a shared voxel space using depth information and camera pose, identifying spatially-overlapped regions across frames and selectively pruning redundant image tokens before they enter the language model. Our method enables efficient online processing while reducing up to 50% of token usage. We apply this approach to Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B, demonstrating improved performance on the ScanQA, SQA3D, and OpenEQA-HM3D benchmarks.
papers.comment: published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Efficient Spatial Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个在线几何感知的token剪枝方法，用于3D问答任务中的多模态大语言模型。该方法利用深度信息和相机位姿将输入帧投影到共享体素空间，识别跨帧的空间重叠区域，在进入语言模型前选择性剪枝冗余图像token，无需额外训练且内存更低。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B上应用后，在ScanQA、SQA3D和OpenEQA-HM3D基准上性能提升，同时减少高达50%的token使用。
Motivation: 现有3D问答MLLM依赖多视图场景，推理计算成本高，且现有解决方法是离线预处理所有帧，缺乏在线高效方案。
Method: 提出在线token剪枝方法：利用深度和相机位姿将每帧投影到共享体素空间，检测空间重叠区域，据此剪枝冗余图像token，再送入语言模型。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B上，该方法在ScanQA、SQA3D、OpenEQA-HM3D基准上提升性能，同时减少最多50%的token使用。
Conclusion: 该方法首次实现3D问答中的在线token剪枝，无需训练即可集成到现有MLLM，降低推理开销。
