papers.title: Benchmarking API Drift in LLM-Generated Quantum Code Across Successive SDK Versions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate plausible quantum code, but it is unclear whether they can reliably target the specific software development kit (SDK) version requested by the user. We study this problem as API drift and introduce quantum-api-drift, a benchmark for measuring version fidelity, defined here as execution success on the requested SDK version, cross-version compatibility, failure modes, and documentation-guided repair in LLM-generated quantum SDK code. We instantiate the benchmark with Qiskit, a representative quantum SDK that underwent substantial interface changes across v0.43, v1.3, and v2.0. We evaluate 17 models on 50 tasks with 3 samples per prompt, yielding 450 generated samples and 1,350 executions per model. Sixteen models are tested in a matched REST API setting with a 1024-token output cap, while GPT-5.4 (Codex CLI) is reported separately as a reference configuration. Across the 16 matched REST models, diagonal Pass@1 ranges from 0.02 to 0.85. Claude Opus 4.7 is strongest on v0.43 and v2.0, while Grok 4.20 is strongest on v1.3 at 0.513. Error profiles differ systematically by model strength: weaker models fail mainly with broken imports, while stronger models more often reach deprecation-level failures. Documentation-guided repair succeeds for 0.19 to 0.59 of repair attempts overall and is consistently much more effective for migration to v2.0 than to v1.3. The benchmark artifacts are publicly available at https://github.com/arasyi/quantum-api-drift. These results show that version alignment is a distinct evaluation axis for quantum code generation and that API drift remains only partly recoverable even with migration guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基准 benchmark quantum-api-drift，用于评估大语言模型生成的量子代码在不同版本 Qiskit SDK（v0.43, v1.3, v2.0）上的版本对齐性。实验测试了17个模型在50个任务上的执行成功率、跨版本兼容性、失败模式及文档引导修复效果，发现 Claude Opus 4.7 在 v0.43 和 v2.0 上最强，Grok 4.20 在 v1.3 上最强，且弱模型多因导入错误失败，强模型则面临弃用警告。文档引导修复对迁移到 v2.0 更有效。
Motivation: 大语言模型能生成量子代码，但能否准确针对用户指定的 SDK 版本尚不清楚，即存在 API 漂移问题。当前缺乏专门评估版本对齐性的基准。
Method: 构建量子代码 API 漂移基准，定义版本保真度指标（执行成功、跨版本兼容性、失败模式、文档引导修复），并以 Qiskit 为实例，评测17个模型在50个任务上的表现。
Result: 在16个匹配的 REST 模型上，对角线 Pass@1 范围为 0.02 至 0.85；Claude Opus 4.7 在 v0.43 和 v2.0 上最强，Grok 4.20 在 v1.3 上为 0.513；弱模型主要因导入错误失败，强模型更多遇到弃用级别失败；文档引导修复成功率 0.19 至 0.59，迁移到 v2.0 明显更有效。
Conclusion: 版本对齐是量子代码生成的一个独立评估维度，即使有迁移引导，API 漂移仍只能部分恢复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Multilingual Averages: MTEB-PT, a Benchmark for Portuguese Sentence Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Portuguese remains underrepresented in text embedding evaluation, despite being one of the most widely spoken languages in the world. As a result, embedding models are often selected based on English or multilingual metrics, while their effectiveness in Portuguese remains unclear. We present MTEB-PT, a Portuguese benchmark constructed from a subset of MMTEB, comprising 14 existing datasets across Semantic Textual Similarity (STS), classification, retrieval, and reranking. We use this benchmark to evaluate 17 open- and closed-source embedding models under a unified protocol. Our results show that Portuguese performance is strongly task-dependent: multilingual rankings do not reliably predict Portuguese-specific performance across task families, no single model dominates all settings, and models with stronger long-context capacity are particularly advantageous on longer-input tasks such as retrieval and reranking. The benchmark also shows that language-specific fine-tuning still improves model performance in Portuguese, especially on task types that match the adaptation data most closely. To examine this effect, we fine-tune three representative backbone models with Portuguese contrastive supervision and Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). These benchmark-informed baselines yield their strongest gains on STS, consistent with the predominantly symmetric supervision used during training, while also improving retrieval and remaining competitive under dimensional truncation. We release the MTEB-PT benchmark, the fine-tuned models, and the training and evaluation code.
papers.comment: Accepted at BRACIS 2026 - 36th Brazilian Conference on Intelligent Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MTEB-PT，一个针对葡萄牙语句子编码器的评估基准，从 MMTEB 的子集中选取 14 个数据集，涵盖语义文本相似度、分类、检索和重排序。对 17 个开源和闭源嵌入模型的评估表明，多语言排名无法可靠预测葡萄牙语特定性能，且没有模型在所有任务上占优；语言特定微调仍能提升性能，尤其是在与微调数据匹配的任务上。实验还验证了 Matryoshka 表示学习的有效性。
Motivation: 葡萄牙语是广泛使用但在文本嵌入评估中代表性不足的语言，导致模型常基于英语或多语言指标选择，而在葡萄牙语上的效果不明确。
Method: 从 MMTEB 中构建包含 14 个数据集的葡萄牙语基准，统一评估协议；对 17 个模型进行评估，并选择三个骨干模型进行葡萄牙语对比监督和 Matryoshka 表示学习微调。
Result: 葡萄牙语性能强烈依赖于任务类型；多语言排名不能可靠预测葡萄牙语性能；长上下文模型在检索和重排序等长输入任务上更具优势；语言特定微调在 STS 上提升最大，在检索上也有改进，且在维度截断下保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 多语言平均指标不足以指导葡萄牙语句子编码器的选择，语言特定基准和微调仍然重要。

papers.title: Enhancing Implicit Neural Representations with Image Feature Embedding for Unsupervised Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac cine Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is a critical diagnostic tool that provides dynamic insights for radiologists. To accelerate acquisition, under-sampled k-space data is often used, requiring reconstruction methods that combine coil sensitivity encoding with prior information to recover missing data. Deep learning approaches have gained more attention for leveraging data-adaptive priors. While supervised learning approaches are a common choice, they depend on fully sampled reference data, which is not always available. Unsupervised methods eliminate the need for fully sampled reference data, which can be advantageous in cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. Among them, implicit neural representations (INRs) have shown great potential due to their simple architecture and good quality reconstructions. In this work, we propose an image-domain dual-branch INR framework, termed I-FP-INR, which extends the original INR design by introducing an additional feature-processing branch. This design aims to extract complementary feature embeddings to enhance the overall representation, thereby benefiting reconstruction. Extensive evaluations on both public datasets and in-house data show consistent improvements over baseline methods in reconstruction quality, with strong robustness across varied scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种图像域双分支隐式神经表示框架I-FP-INR，用于无监督的心脏电影MRI重建。该方法在原始INR基础上增加特征处理分支，提取互补特征嵌入以增强表示能力，从而提升重建质量。实验表明该方法在多种场景下优于基线方法。
Motivation: 心脏电影MRI重建需要无监督方法以避免对全采样参考数据的依赖，现有INR方法在表示能力上仍有提升空间。
Method: 提出I-FP-INR框架，包含两个分支：原始INR分支和额外的特征处理分支。特征处理分支提取互补的图像特征嵌入，与原始INR联合优化，增强整体表示。
Result: 在公共数据集和内部数据上，该方法在重建质量上一致优于基线方法，并表现出强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在无监督心脏电影MRI重建中的有效性，通过引入特征处理分支提升了INR的表示能力。

papers.title: Speaker-Disentangled Chunk-Wise Regression for Syllabic Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised syllabic tokenization aims to learn discrete syllabic tokens that capture latent linguistic content-related structure from raw speech. Recent syllabic tokenization methods employ teacher-student distillation of the pretrained HuBERT to organize latent speech frame representations into syllabic segments. However, when trained with an utterance-level cross-entropy objective, the model predicts speaker identity rather than linguistic content, thereby compromising the purity of syllabic tokens. To address this problem, we propose a speaker-disentangled syllabic tokenizer that regresses speaker-perturbed student representations toward clean teacher targets within fixed-length chunks. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance in syllable boundary detection and syllabic segment clustering. Moreover, a speech language model trained on our syllabic tokens achieves a 7% relative improvement in syntactic and semantic understanding over the phone-level SpiRit-LM.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing (OJSP), 10 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无监督音节标记化中教师-学生蒸馏方法倾向于预测说话人身份而非语言内容的问题，提出了一种说话人解耦的音节标记器。该方法在固定长度块内将受说话人扰动的学生表示回归到干净的教师目标上，从而提升音节标记的语言纯度。实验表明，该方法在音节边界检测和音节段聚类上达到最优性能，基于音节令牌的语音语言模型在句法和语义理解上相比音素级SpiRit-LM提升7%。
Motivation: 现有的无监督音节标记化方法使用HuBERT的教师-学生蒸馏，但 utterance级交叉熵目标导致模型预测说话人身份而非语言内容，损害了音节令牌的纯度。
Method: 提出说话人解耦的音节标记器，通过固定长度块内的回归任务，将受说话人扰动的学生表示向干净的教师目标对齐，从而分离说话人信息并保留语言内容。

papers.title: Fast, Parallel, Query-Efficient Binary Classification
papers.abstract_en: We study the fundamental classification problem of computing a separating hyperplane for a binary-labeled dataset of size $n$ with normalized $d$-dimensional features. Letting $Φ\in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}$ denote the feature matrix and $γ$ the margin of the maximum-margin separating hyperplane, we present a randomized algorithm that solves this problem in $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3}\, \operatorname{nnz}(Φ) + γ^{-2(ω+1)/3})$-sequential running time (work), $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3})$-parallel (computational) depth, and accesses $Φ$ only through $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3})$-matrix-vector queries (matvecs). We also present a second, faster randomized algorithm with a $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3}\, \operatorname{nnz}(Φ) + γ^{-2})$-sequential running time that uses $\tilde{O}(γ^{-2/3})$-matvecs to $Φ$, but achieves only $\tilde{O}(γ^{-4/3})$-parallel depth. Both algorithms match the near-optimal deterministic matvec complexity recently established by Kornowski and Shamir [2025], Karmarkar et al. [2026] and achieve improved sequential runtime and parallel depth, albeit at the expense of using randomness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究二分类中分离超平面的计算问题，提出两种随机化算法，分别在不同的并行深度和查询复杂度下实现接近最优的矩阵-向量查询复杂度，并改进顺序运行时间和并行深度。
Motivation: 给定n个d维归一化特征的二分类数据集，目标是高效计算最大间隔分离超平面，现有的确定性算法在matvec复杂度上已达到下界，但顺序时间和并行深度仍有优化空间。
Method: 提出两种随机化算法：第一种在ÑO(γ^{-2/3}) matvecs下达到ÑO(γ^{-2/3})并行深度和ÑO(γ^{-2/3} nnz(Φ)+γ^{-2(ω+1)/3})顺序时间；第二种使用同样matvecs但并行深度为ÑO(γ^{-4/3})，顺序时间改进为ÑO(γ^{-2/3} nnz(Φ)+γ^{-2})。
Result: 两种算法均匹配近期确定的近最优matvec复杂度，并实现更优的顺序运行时间和并行深度，尽管依赖于随机性。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了随机化可以在不牺牲matvec复杂度的前提下显著提升分类算法的并行效率与顺序速度。

papers.title: Telescope: Improving Zero Shot Detection of LLM Generated Content By Measuring Token Repetition Probability
papers.abstract_en: Distinguishing Large Language Model (LLM) generated text from human writing is a critical and difficult challenge. While LLMs are trained to write like humans, we hypothesize that this training leaves an indelible mark. LLMs develop a particularly strong aversion to token repetition very early in training. This bias persists as a ''Vestigial Heuristic'' (a developmental artifact) that is activated in LLM-generated text, separating LLM from human writing. To probe this phenomenon, we introduce Telescope Perplexity, a metric that evaluates the token repetition of the model, $P(s_i | s_{1:i})$ . Our empirical investigation reveals that the Telescope Perplexity signature emerges early in pre-training, and Telescope Perplexity empirically enables highly effective zero-shot LLM detection. We show state-of-the-art or competitive performance across diverse datasets (including modern evaluation sets we introduce), reference models, and perturbation schemes with greater efficiency than other methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文聚焦于区分大语言模型（LLM）生成文本与人类写作的难题，提出LLM在早期训练中形成对token重复的强烈厌恶，这种偏见作为“残留启发式”（Vestigial Heuristic）保留，可用于检测。作者引入Telescope Perplexity指标，测量token重复概率，实验表明该特征在预训练早期出现，并实现高效零样本检测，在多个数据集上取得最先进或竞争性性能。
Motivation: 区分LLM生成文本与人类写作至关重要但困难，现有方法效率或泛化性有限。
Method: 提出Telescope Perplexity，通过计算模型对每个token的重复概率$P(s_i | s_{1:i})$来捕获LLM对重复的厌恶偏差。
Result: 该方法在多个数据集、参考模型和扰动方案下实现零样本检测，性能达到最新或竞争水平，且效率高于其他方法。
Conclusion: 论文表明LLM对token重复的厌恶是预训练早期形成的残留启发式，可作为一种鲁棒的检测信号。

papers.title: HNSW with Accuracy Guarantees Using Graph Spanners
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs serve as the industry standard due to their logarithmic complexity and strong empirical performance. However, HNSW relies on greedy graph traversal, a heuristic that provides no theoretical guarantees of correctness. In this paper, we propose a novel "Certify-then-Rectify" framework that bridges the gap between the speed of heuristic search and the rigor of exact retrieval. Rather than discarding HNSW, our approach first employs a distribution-free statistical certifier to dynamically evaluate the quality of a standard HNSW search with minimal overhead. If certification indicates that the retrieved neighbors are of low quality, the framework safely escalates to a rigorous exact recovery algorithm. To make this exact recovery computationally feasible, we reinterpret the HNSW graph as a geometric spanner and utilize Extreme Value Theory to stochastically estimate its maximum empirical stretch factor. This allows us to mathematically bound the maximum distance of true nearest neighbors. Extensive evaluations on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our tiered framework delivers the average-case speed of HNSW while ensuring the worst-case correctness of exact search and outperforming other applicable approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个“检验-纠正”（Certify-then-Rectify）框架，用于在层次可导航小世界（HNSW）图中实现近似最近邻搜索的准确性保证。该框架首先使用无分布统计检验器评估标准HNSW搜索结果的质量，若质量低则升级到精确恢复算法。为降低精确恢复的计算成本，将HNSW重解释为几何spanner，并利用极值理论随机估计其最大拉伸因子，从而数学上界定真实最近邻的最大距离。实验表明，该分层框架在保持HNSW平均速度的同时，确保了最坏情况下的正确性。
Motivation: HNSW图作为工业标准，具有对数复杂度和强经验性能，但其贪心遍历缺乏理论正确性保证。现有方法要么牺牲速度换取准确性，要么依赖启发式。本文旨在桥接近似搜索的速度与精确检索的严谨性之间的鸿沟。
Method: 提出“Certify-then-Rectify”框架：先使用无分布统计检验器动态评估HNSW搜索质量，开销极小；若认证表明检索邻居质量低，则安全地升级到精确恢复算法。为精确恢复可行，将HNSW图视为几何spanner，并利用极值理论随机估计其最大经验拉伸因子，从而数学上界定真实最近邻的最大距离。
Result: 在基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，该分层框架实现了HNSW的平均情况速度，同时确保了最坏情况下的精确搜索正确性，并优于其他适用方法。
Conclusion: 框架通过结合启发式搜索的效率和精确恢复的严格性，为近似最近邻搜索提供了准确性保证。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Repair the Amplifier, Not the Symptom: Stable World-Model Correction for Agent Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents increasingly maintain executable world models in the form of planning graphs, where tool calls, validators, memory updates, recovery branches, and final answers are connected by typed dependencies. When a rollout fails, repairing the most visible error can leave the underlying error-amplification path intact, while replaying the full graph is expensive and difficult for long-context models to use reliably. We study world-model correction: selecting a compact subgraph of a failed planning graph whose repair stabilizes subsequent rollouts. We first instantiate a strong family of engineering correctors, including pointwise error scans, TopK and window selection, local graph expansion, cascade repair, and full-context LLM repair. We then propose WM-SAR, a spectral subgraph repair method that estimates node-edge amplification, greedily grows a connected repair region by marginal residual-spectral relief, and sends only this region to an LLM for root-cause repair. Theoretically, we connect residual spectral radius to rollout error and planning regret, motivating repair as stabilization rather than attribution alone. Across synthetic calling-tree graphs, benchmark-inspired agent topologies, and cross-model LLM repair experiments, WM-SAR achieves stronger long-horizon stabilization and root-cause recovery under compact token budgets, matching much larger repair contexts while exposing the LLM to a cleaner causal subgraph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长程语言代理在规划图（world model）失败后的修正问题，提出一种基于谱子图修复的方法WM-SAR，通过估计节点-边放大效应、贪心选择连通修复区域，仅将紧凑子图送入LLM进行根因修复。实验表明，在合成调用树、基准代理拓扑和跨模型LLM修复中，WM-SAR在紧凑token预算下实现了更强的长程稳定性和根因恢复。
Motivation: 现有代理在规划图失败时，修复表面错误可能遗留误差放大路径，而全图回放成本高且对长上下文模型不可靠。
Method: 提出WM-SAR，一种光谱子图修复方法，通过残差谱半径估计节点-边放大，基于边际残差谱缓解贪心生长连通修复区域，仅将该区域送至LLM进行根因修复。
Result: 在合成调用树图、基准代理拓扑和跨模型LLM修复实验中，WM-SAR在紧凑token预算下实现更好的长程稳定性和根因恢复，与更大修复上下文的效果相当。
Conclusion: 理论连接残差谱半径与展开误差及规划遗憾，表明修复应追求稳定化而非单纯归因。

papers.title: TurnNat: Automatic Evaluation of Turn-Taking Naturalness in Dyadic Spoken Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Turn-taking naturalness is central to full-duplex spoken dialogue systems, yet its automatic evaluation remains limited. Existing evaluations often rely on human judgments or behavior-specific timing metrics, making it difficult to compare heterogeneous timing failures within a unified framework. We propose TurnNat, a likelihood-based framework for automatic turn-taking naturalness evaluation in two-channel spoken dialogue. A causal turn-taking prediction model trained on natural conversations estimates future two-speaker voice-activity states, and the negative log-likelihood (NLL) of the observed future activity measures timing atypicality. TurnNat pools frame-level NLLs over turn-taking boundary units (TBUs) extracted from utterance onsets and offsets, and aggregates mean and tail TBU scores into a dialogue-level naturalness score. We further construct a controlled perturbation benchmark of paired natural and perturbed dialogue clips, validated by human naturalness judgments. Experiments on this benchmark show that TurnNat successfully identifies unnatural turn-taking perturbations across heterogeneous timing failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TurnNat，一个基于似然的框架，用于自动评估双通道口语对话中的轮流发言自然度。它使用因果轮流发言预测模型估计未来双说话人语音活动状态，并利用负对数似然度量时序异常性。在受控扰动基准上，TurnNat能成功识别多种异构时序扰动下的不自然轮流发言。
Motivation: 现有评估依赖人工判断或行为特性指标，难以在统一框架下比较异构的时序失败问题。
Method: 提出TurnNat框架，包括：基于自然对话训练的因果轮流发言预测模型，预测未来双说话人语音活动状态；使用负对数似然(NLL)度量时序异常性；将帧级NLL在轮流发言边界单元(TBU)上池化，聚合均值与尾部分数得到对话级自然度分数。
Result: 在构建的包含成对自然与扰动对话片段的受控扰动基准上，TurnNat成功识别了多种异构时序扰动下的不自然轮流发言。
Conclusion: TurnNat为自动评估轮流发言自然度提供了统一似然框架，未来可应用于全双工对话系统。

papers.title: Agentic generation of verifiable rules for deterministic, self-expanding reaction classification
papers.abstract_en: Computer-assisted synthesis planning breaks target molecules into accessible precursors using large libraries of reaction rules that assign each transformation a deterministic, interpretable label. But chemistry is long-tailed, making manual encoding intractable, and existing tools rely on fixed rulesets that cannot adapt to new chemistries. Here we present a fully automated pipeline in which a multi-agent framework of large language models (LLMs) classifies reactions and writes the rules themselves across 665,901 US patent reactions, generating each rule under a verification loop that tests it against the corpus. It expands a standard taxonomy from 68 to 14,073 classes without human curation. With a lightweight fingerprint classifier, it classifies 97.7\% of unseen reactions, matching a leading proprietary classifier while resolving chemistry more finely and extending on demand to chemistry outside its training distribution. The result is a living reactivity database and a general route to turning generative models into reliable, self-expanding symbolic systems.

papers.title: PedNStream: Scalable Network Flow Simulation for Pedestrian Traffic Management
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale crowd management requires pedestrian simulations that are both computationally efficient and compatible with feedback-based control. However, most open-source tools are either microscopic or not designed for network-scale closed-loop evaluation. This paper presents PedNStream (Pedestrian Network Flow Simulation), an open-source, Python-native simulator for macroscopic pedestrian network loading based on the Link Transmission Model (LTM). The framework extends LTM-based pedestrian models by incorporating stochastic link dynamics that capture diffusion and activity-induced variability, and replaces dynamic user equilibrium route choice with a utility-based formulation suited to uncertain, intervention-driven settings. PedNStream is implemented as a modular framework with built-in controller interfaces for interventions such as gating, flow separation, and route guidance. We evaluate the framework in a staged manner. Synthetic scenarios verify key mechanisms, including queue formation, spillback, congestion dissipation, and adaptive rerouting. Real-network experiments assess large-scale behavior and consistency with observed pedestrian counts. A closed-loop case study demonstrates controller integration, and a runtime analysis quantifies scalability. These results establish PedNStream as an efficient and practical testbed for large-scale pedestrian network simulation and control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PedNStream是一个基于Python的开源宏观行人网络流模拟器，扩展了链路传输模型（LTM），引入随机链路动态和效用-based路线选择，支持门控、分流、路线引导等干预。合成场景验证了队列形成、回溢、拥堵消散和自适应重路由机制；真实网络实验验证了与观测人数的一致性；闭环案例展示了控制器集成；运行时分析证明了可扩展性。

papers.title: Mnemosyne: Agentic Transaction Processing for Validating and Repairing AI-generated Workflows
papers.abstract_en: LLMs increasingly generate workflow actions, repairs, and plans, but a generated action may be syntactically valid yet stale, infeasible, conflicting, or destructive of the evidence that triggered a repair. We introduce Agentic Transaction Processing (ATP), a transaction model that treats generated actions as untrusted proposals until they pass deterministic admission under a declared, executable constraint set C. The governing principle is two-sided: a proposal is not truth, and no proposal foresees every disruption. Anything may propose, but only the runtime admits and commits; when an unforeseen disruption strikes, it repairs reactively within bounds rather than trusting a fresh proposal. Relative to C, committed-state correctness becomes independent of the competence, honesty, or learning of the proposing layer. We realize ATP in Mnemosyne, a runtime with an append-only transition log, effective-state projection, dependency-safe compensation, and active commitment records, and prove four safety properties relative to C (authority separation, serial-equivalent generative admission, evidence-preserving repair, and obligation containment) plus a bounded-reactive-repair guarantee (LCRP). A reproducible artifact rejects the targeted violations across nine falsification tests while still admitting valid work, at under 6% overhead, and local repair edits an order of magnitude fewer operations than global recompute. In live-proposer pilots, 80 static plan-entry and mid-execution repair proposals from four heterogeneous LLMs pass the same admission boundary, scored by an external cross-episode harness with zero invalid commits; the gate admits 24 of 40 live repair proposals and rejects 16, four as explicit safety rejections of over-broad rollback. Mnemosyne is open source: https://github.com/eyuchang/Mnemosyne/tree/mnemosyne-atp-postgres-rerun
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agentic Transaction Processing (ATP)，一个将AI生成的动作视为未信任提议直到通过确定性准入的交易模型。在Mnemosyne运行时中实现，通过追加日志、有效状态投影、依赖安全补偿和活动提交记录，证明相对于约束集的四种安全属性。实验显示在九个伪造测试中拒绝违规、开销低于6%，且本地修复比全局重计算少一个数量级的操作。
Motivation: LLM生成的工作流动作可能语法正确但过时、不可行、冲突或破坏触发修复的证据，现有方法缺乏对动作可信性的保证机制。
Method: 提出ATP交易模型：将生成动作视为未信任提议，需通过可执行约束集的确定性准入；运行时负责提交和反应式修复。在Mnemosyne中实现，包括追加日志、有效状态投影、依赖安全补偿和活动提交记录。
Result: 在九个伪造测试中拒绝违规同时接受有效工作，开销低于6%；本地修复操作比全局重计算少一个数量级。在四个LLM的80个静态计划和修复提案中，零无效提交；40个实时修复提案中接受24个、拒绝16个，其中4个为针对过度回滚的安全拒绝。
Conclusion: ATP模型使提交状态正确性独立于提议层的能力、诚实或学习能力，Mnemosyne开源实现验证了其安全属性和性能优势。

papers.title: Hate Speech Detection in Turkish and Arabic: A Comprehensive Study
papers.abstract_en: Online hate speech has been linked to a global rise in violence against minorities, including incidents such as mass shootings, lynchings, and ethnic cleansing. Societies grappling with this issue, particularly when hate speech targets specific groups based on religion, race, ethnicity, culture, nationality, or migration status, face the challenge of balancing freedom of expression with the need for effective content moderation on widely used online platforms. In response to this challenge, we introduce a comprehensive hate speech dataset covering five distinct topics in Turkish: refugees, the Israel-Palestine conflict, anti-Greek sentiment in Turkey, ethnic or religious communities (Alevis, Armenians, Arabs, Jews, and Kurds), and LGBTI+, alongside one topic in Arabic (refugees). In addition, we develop state-of-the-art BERT-based models to address multiple dimensions of hate speech analysis, including hate category classification, hate intensity prediction, target identification, and hate speech span detection, enabling a comprehensive understanding of hateful content in online discourse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对土耳其语和阿拉伯语的在线仇恨言论检测，构建了涵盖难民、以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突、反希腊情绪、种族/宗教社群及LGBTI+等五大主题的土耳其语数据集，以及阿拉伯语难民主题数据集。同时开发了基于BERT的最先进模型，支持仇恨类别分类、强度预测、目标识别和仇恨跨度检测，旨在实现多维度仇恨内容分析。
Motivation: 在线仇恨言论与针对少数群体的暴力事件（如大规模枪击、私刑、种族清洗）相关，社会在平衡言论自由与内容审核方面面临挑战，但针对土耳其语和阿拉伯语的多维度仇恨言论研究不足。
Method: 构建了覆盖不同主题的土耳其语和阿拉伯语仇恨言论数据集，并开发了基于BERT的多任务模型，同时处理仇恨类别分类、强度预测、目标识别和仇恨跨度检测。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅说明模型在多个维度上实现了仇恨言论分析。
Conclusion: 该工作为土耳其语和阿拉伯语仇恨言论检测提供了全面的数据集和模型基础，支持在线内容审核。

papers.title: Harnessing Textual Refusal Directions for Multimodal Safety
papers.abstract_en: To improve safety in Large Language Models (LLMs) we can either perform post-training alignment or exploit refusal directions in the activation space. Both strategies are less feasible in Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) as they require unsafe multimodal data, harder to collect than their unimodal counterpart. In this work, we relax this constraint and investigate whether textual refusal directions, extracted directly from the LLM backbone, generalize across modalities (i.e., image, video). Preliminary findings confirm this ability, though effectiveness is conditioned by layer selection, steering strength, and cross-modal alignment, with the latter causing safe multimodal inputs to be spuriously steered toward refusal. Building on this, we introduce Modality-Agnostic Refusal Steering (MARS), a light-weight training-free approach that injects multimodal safety without the need for multimodal safety data. MARS corrects modality misalignment via activation re-centering, adaptively scales steering strength within a geometrically defined trust region, and selects the optimal intervention layer, operating at the first generated token. Evaluated on five SOTA MLLMs across safety, utility, and video jailbreak benchmarks, MARS achieves consistent safety gains while preserving utility. These results reveal that safety-relevant structure is shared across modalities and that textual refusal directions are a powerful and underexplored foundation for multimodal alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文本拒绝方向在多模态大模型（MLLMs）中的跨模态泛化能力，发现其有效性受层选择、干预强度和跨模态对齐的影响，并因此提出MARS方法，无需多模态安全数据即可注入安全机制。在五个MLLM上的实验表明，MARS在保持实用性同时持续提升安全性。
Motivation: 多模态大模型的安全对齐需要难以收集的多模态不安全数据，而文本拒绝方向可能跨模态泛化，但尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出Modality-Agnostic Refusal Steering (MARS)，一种轻量级无训练方法，通过激活重中心化修正模态错位，在几何定义的信任区域内自适应缩放干预强度，并在首个生成token处选择最优干预层。
Result: 在五个SOTA多模态大模型上，MARS在安全性和实用性基准上取得一致的安全提升，并在视频越狱测试中有效。
Conclusion: 结果表明安全相关结构跨模态共享，文本拒绝方向是多模态对齐的强有力且未被充分利用的基础。

papers.title: Ask the World Before Acting: Environment Probing for Calibrated Agent World Models
papers.abstract_en: Language agents acting over long horizons must maintain beliefs about tool states, object locations, graph edges, and subgoal dependencies. When these beliefs drift, failures can be fixed neither by longer reasoning traces nor by ordinary self-reflection, since the missing evidence lies in the environment. We formulate environment probing as a budgeted decision problem for structured agent world models: before acting, the agent may query the current value of one belief field, update its table, and pay one interaction step. We introduce EnvProbe, a simple scoring policy that combines task criticality, staleness, verbalized uncertainty, and dependency role. A type-stratified analysis separates the benefit of belief repair from the cost of displaced task actions and predicts different behavior for procedural and spatial beliefs. In three controlled environments with gold belief states, EnvProbe improves terminal world-state accuracy over periodic probing by 11.76 percentage points on procedural tool-dependency tasks, 3.79 points on spatial tasks, and 6.45 points overall. Ablations show that task-structural terms are the main source of the gains, while self-reported uncertainty is unreliable under confident wrong beliefs. The results suggest that agent calibration should be treated as an action-selection problem over environment evidence, not only as a model-internal reasoning problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EnvProbe，一种针对结构化智能体世界模型的环境探测评分策略，通过结合任务关键性、陈旧性、口头化不确定性和依赖角色来选择查询信念字段，以校准模型。在三个受控环境中，EnvProbe使终端世界状态准确率整体提升6.45个百分点。
Motivation: 智能体在长周期中信念漂移，常规推理或自我反思无法修复，因为缺失证据存在于环境中。因此需要将环境探测作为预算决策问题进行公式化。
Method: 提出EnvProbe，一种结合任务关键性、陈旧性、口头化不确定性和依赖角色的简单评分策略，并引入类型分层分析分离信念修复收益与任务行动成本。
Result: 在受控环境中，EnvProbe在程序性工具依赖任务上终端世界状态准确率提升11.76个百分点，空间任务提升3.79，整体提升6.45。消融实验表明任务结构项是主要增益来源，而自我报告的不确定性在自信错误信念下不可靠。
Conclusion: 智能体校准应被视为对环境证据的行动选择问题，而非仅模型内部推理问题。

summary_sections.result: 在受控环境中，EnvProbe在程序性工具依赖任务上终端世界状态准确率提升11.76个百分点，空间任务提升3.79，整体提升6.45。消融实验表明任务结构项是主要增益来源，而自我报告的不确定性在自信错误信念下不可靠。
summary_sections.conclusion: 智能体校准应被视为对环境证据的行动选择问题，而非仅模型内部推理问题。

papers.title: From Materials Database to Materials Bank: Assetizing Data for AI Driven Materials Innovation
papers.abstract_en: Driven by high-throughput experimentation, computational modeling, and artificial intelligence (AI), materials data has expanded at an unprecedented rate. Conventional materials databases function only as passive repositories, archiving raw experimental records indiscriminately including both successful and failed data, without systematic value filtering or asset management. This creates a critical gap between massive data accumulation and actionable innovation, hindering the identification of high-potential materials and industrial translation. To address this bottleneck, we propose an industrialization-oriented Materials Bank, a dedicated valuefiltering and assetization layer that operates beyond traditional databases. It does not merely curate high-quality data but systematically elevates qualified candidates into standardized, upgradable materials assets via a multi-dimensional BankCard framework covering scientific validity, synthesis feasibility, application readiness, and industrial value. By unifying databases, AI models, automated experimentation, and multi-criteria assessment into a cohesive closed-loop ecosystem, the Materials Bank establishes a clear trajectory from data to knowledge, candidate, asset, and product. It serves not as an enhanced database or screening tool, but as a decision infrastructure bridging academic discovery and industrial demand, offering a scalable paradigm to accelerate AI-driven materials innovation and deliver tangible real-world impact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向工业化的材料银行（Materials Bank），作为超越传统数据库的价值过滤与资产化层。通过多维BankCard框架（涵盖科学有效性、合成可行性、应用准备度和工业价值），将合格候选材料系统性地提升为标准化、可升级的材料资产。该银行统一数据库、AI模型、自动化实验和多标准评估，形成从数据到知识、候选物、资产和产品的闭环，旨在加速AI驱动的材料创新并弥合学术发现与工业需求之间的鸿沟。
Motivation: 传统材料数据库仅作为被动存储库，不加区分地归档原始实验记录（包括成功和失败数据），缺乏系统化的价值过滤或资产管理，导致大量数据积累与实际创新之间存在关键差距，阻碍高潜力材料的识别和工业转化。
Method: 提出一种工业化导向的材料银行，作为传统数据库之上的专用价值过滤和资产化层。通过多维BankCard框架（科学有效性、合成可行性、应用准备度、工业价值）系统评估并提升候选材料为标准化资产，并整合数据库、AI模型、自动化实验和多标准评估，形成闭环生态系统。
Result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称该方法建立了从数据到知识、候选物、资产和产品的清晰轨迹，可作为加速AI驱动材料创新并提供实际影响的决策基础设施。
Conclusion: 材料银行不是增强型数据库或筛选工具，而是连接学术发现与工业需求的决策基础设施，提供可扩展范式以加速AI驱动的材料创新并产生实际世界影响。

papers.title: Linguistic Firewall: Geometry as Defense in Multi-Agent Systems Routing
papers.abstract_en: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven the evolution of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), where specialized agents collaborate to execute complex workflows. Effective orchestration in these environments requires robust routing mechanisms to efficiently allocate tasks to the most suitable agent. However, existing routers fundamentally rely on unverified proxies, ranging from textual self-descriptions to static surrogate representations, to gauge an agent's competence. This reliance on non-empirical data creates a critical gap between an agent's projected profile and its actual operational capabilities, introducing severe security vulnerabilities. Malicious agents can easily misrepresent their proficiencies or harbor covert backdoors that evade both standard external analysis and static representation-learning techniques. In this work, we introduce ANTAP (Automatic Non-Textual Agent Picker), an evaluation-driven routing architecture that discards indirect proxies in favor of active capability testing. By dynamically querying agents to ascertain their true competencies empirically, ANTAP distills performance into fixed behavioral operators within a shared semantic space. At inference time, routing is performed via a purely non-textual algebraic projection, establishing a "linguistic firewall" that renders metadata-based attacks inexpressible. In our experiments, ANTAP achieves near-zero ASR against description-based injection attacks, compared to 67.3\% and above for the description-based router baseline. Against adaptive embedding attacks, ANTAP achieves substantially lower ASR than the embedding-based baseline, with a 20\% reduction, while remaining resilient to description manipulation by design.
papers.comment: 8 pages (9 more for appendix), 3 figures. Published at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体系统中路由器依赖未经验证的代理描述导致的安全漏洞，提出ANTAP（Automatic Non-Textual Agent Picker）架构。ANTAP通过主动能力测试获取代理真实能力，将性能转化为固定行为算子，在共享语义空间中利用代数投影进行非文本路由，建立“语言防火墙”。实验表明，ANTAP对描述注入攻击的ASR接近零（基线>67.3%），对自适应嵌入攻击的ASR降低20%，且对描述操纵具有内在韧性。
Motivation: 现有路由机制依赖文本自描述或静态代理表示等不可靠代理，恶意代理可轻易谎报能力或隐藏后门，导致安全漏洞。
Method: 提出ANTAP，一种评估驱动的路由架构：通过动态查询代理进行能力测试，将性能转化为固定行为算子，在共享语义空间中使用代数投影实现非文本路由。
Result: 实验显示，ANTAP对描述注入攻击的ASR接近零（基线>67.3%），对自适应嵌入攻击的ASR降低20%，且对描述操纵具有韧性。
Conclusion: 通过主动测试和几何投影建立非文本防火墙，有效防御元数据攻击，提升多智能体系统路由安全性。

papers.title: StereoGS: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting via Stereo Priors
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has achieved remarkable success in real-time novel view synthesis, yet it suffers from severe overfitting under sparse-view settings due to insufficient geometric constraints. While recent methods introduce monocular depth priors to mitigate this, they inherently struggle with scale ambiguity and cross-view inconsistency, leading to defective geometry. In this paper, we propose StereoGS, a novel sparse-view 3DGS framework that integrates stereo priors to establish reliable binocular consistency. Unlike scale-agnostic monocular constraints, StereoGS introduces a Stereo Depth Regularization by constructing virtual stereo pairs during optimization and leveraging a foundation stereo model to enforce absolute scale and binocular-consistent structures. To further suppress overfitting and eliminate redundant primitives, we design a Gradient-Aware Opacity Decay strategy that dynamically penalizes Gaussians based on their relative opacity gradient magnitudes. Combined with a Consistency-Aware Dense Initialization using zero-shot multi-view depth estimation, StereoGS effectively anchors primitives to accurate scene surfaces. Extensive experiments on LLFF, DTU, Mip-NeRF360, and Blender datasets demonstrate that StereoGS achieves state-of-the-art performance in sparse-view settings without incurring any additional inference overhead. Project Page: https://stringerywh00.github.io/StereoGS_project_page/
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, accepted to ECCV 2026, project page: https://stringerywh00.github.io/StereoGS_project_page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StereoGS，一种稀疏视角下的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）框架，通过引入立体先验（stereo priors）建立可靠的双眼一致性，以解决单目深度先验的尺度歧义和跨视图不一致问题。方法包括立体深度正则化（利用虚拟立体对和基础立体模型）、梯度感知透明度衰减策略以及一致性感知密集初始化。在LLFF、DTU、Mip-NeRF360和Blender数据集上，StereoGS在稀疏视角设置下取得了最先进的性能，且不增加推理开销。
Motivation: 现有3DGS在稀疏视角下因几何约束不足而严重过拟合，而单目深度先验存在固有尺度歧义和跨视图不一致，导致几何缺陷。
Method: 提出StereoGS，通过构建虚拟立体对并利用基础立体模型进行立体深度正则化，强制绝对尺度与双眼一致结构；设计梯度感知透明度衰减策略动态惩罚高斯体，结合一致性感知密集初始化（基于零样本多视图深度估计）将高斯体锚定到准确场景表面。
Result: 在LLFF、DTU、Mip-NeRF360和Blender数据集上的实验表明，方法在稀疏视角下达到最优性能，且不引入额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 立体先验有效改善了稀疏视角下3DGS的几何重建质量，且无需额外推理成本。

papers.title: Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion for Unsupervised Community Detection on Heterophilic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Detecting communities in heterophilic graphs -- where connected nodes often belong to different classes -- is hard for unsupervised methods: classical modularity and spectral methods are feature agnostic, while deep graph-clustering methods rely on contrastive or generative machinery that is opaque. We propose Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion (CGSD), a fully unsupervised community-detection algorithm that uses the discrete Forman--Ricci curvature of each edge as its single topological signal, propagated through every stage of an end-to-end pipeline. CGSD makes three concrete contributions: (i)~a curvature-gated sheaf-diffusion encoder that gates edge messages by $σ(κ_e)$ and is trained from three label-free structural losses (modularity, anti-collapse, curvature-weighted reconstruction); (ii)~a curvature-aware spectral clusterer (CSpec) that re-weights the $k$-NN affinity of the embedding by $σ(ακ_{e^*})$ before Ng--Jordan--Weiss; and (iii)~a unified label-free evaluation against nine truly-unsupervised baselines. On five heterophilic benchmarks (Cora, Cornell, Texas, Wisconsin, Chameleon), CGSD wins outright on Wisconsin and Chameleon and is competitive on the remaining three against nine unsupervised baselines. The gain over the strongest baseline is driven by the clusterer, not the encoder: on the same embedding, CSpec improves mean NMI from $0.091$ with $K$-Means to $0.107$ ($+15\%$, paired $t$-test $p=0.008$). The mechanism is interpretable: intra-community and inter-community curvature distributions are visibly separated. Code is open-sourced at https://github.com/woodywff/cgsd.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion (CGSD)，一种完全无监督的异配图社区检测算法，利用离散 Forman-Ricci 曲率作为唯一拓扑信号，通过曲率门控的 sheaf 扩散编码器、曲率感知谱聚类器和无标签损失进行训练。在五个异配基准上，CGSD 在 Wisconsin 和 Chameleon 上取得最佳结果，并且在其他三个数据集上具有竞争力，且聚类器贡献了主要的提升。
Motivation: 异配图中连接的节点常属于不同类别，经典模块度和谱方法忽略特征，而深度图聚类方法依赖不透明的对比或生成机制，导致无监督社区检测困难。
Method: CGSD 包括三个部分：(i) 曲率门控的 sheaf 扩散编码器，通过 σ(κ_e) 门控边消息，使用模块度、抗塌缩和曲率加权重建三种无标签损失训练；(ii) 曲率感知谱聚类器 CSpec，在 Ng-Jordan-Weiss 之前用 σ(ακ_{e*}) 重新加权嵌入的 k-NN 亲和度；(iii) 统一的无需标签的评估流程。
Result: 在 Cora、Cornell、Texas、Wisconsin、Chameleon 五个异配基准上，CGSD 在 Wisconsin 和 Chameleon 上取得最佳，在其余三个上具有竞争力。在相同嵌入上，CSpec 相比 K-Means 将平均 NMI 从 0.091 提升到 0.107（+15%，配对 t 检验 p=0.008）。
Conclusion: CGSD 的机制是可解释的：社区内和社区间的曲率分布明显分离。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Deep Multiscale Neural Network for Accurate Neurological Disorder Detection from MRI Scans and Real-Time Web Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Neurological disorders involve diverse pathologies of the brain and nervous system, making early and accurate detection essential. While many deep CNNs have been developed for MRI-based classification of neurological disorders, most are optimized for binary tasks and often fail to capture the multi-class features needed to distinguish subtle anatomical differences across conditions. This study proposes the Enhanced Neurological Disorder Detection Network (End-Net) for multi-class MRI classification of neurological disorders. End-Net includes 24 convolutional layers, beginning with convolutional blocks followed by 21 optimized inception modules. These modules extract multiscale features via parallel 1 x 1, 3 x 3, and factorized 5 x 5 convolutional branches, along with max pooling, enabling the model to capture complementary texture, edge, shape, and contextual information. A global average pooling head, compact fully connected classifier, and dropout reduce parameters, limit overfitting, and improve robustness. End-Net was evaluated on the Multi-Class Neurological Disorder dataset, comprising MRI scans from patients with Alzheimer's disease, brain tumors, multiple sclerosis, and healthy controls. Severe class imbalance was addressed by augmenting minority classes with WGAN-GP and randomly undersampling the majority class. The results show that End-Net outperforms existing architectures in both accuracy and generalization. The model is also integrated into an online system for real-time web-based inference and accessibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Enhanced Neurological Disorder Detection Network (End-Net)，一种用于多类 MRI 神经障碍分类的深度多尺度神经网络。End-Net 包含 24 个卷积层和 21 个优化后的 Inception 模块，通过并行分支提取多尺度特征，并采用全局平均池化、全连接分类器和 Dropout 减少过拟合。在包含阿尔茨海默病、脑肿瘤、多发性硬化症和健康对照的多类神经障碍数据集上，利用 WGAN-GP 和欠采样处理类别不平衡，结果表明 End-Net 在准确率和泛化性上优于现有架构，并集成到在线系统实现实时推理。
Motivation: 现有深度 CNN 多针对二分类任务优化，难以捕获多类神经障碍 MRI 中细微的解剖差异，需要一种能够处理多类别且轻量化的检测网络。
Method: 提出 End-Net，由 24 个卷积层组成，包含卷积块和 21 个优化 Inception 模块，通过并行 1×1、3×3 和分解 5×5 卷积分支以及最大池化提取多尺度特征；使用全局平均池化头部、紧凑全连接分类器和 Dropout 减少参数并防止过拟合；采用 WGAN-GP 增强少数类并随机欠采样多数类以处理类别不平衡。
Result: 在多类神经障碍 MRI 数据集上，End-Net 在准确率和泛化性上优于现有架构。
Conclusion: End-Net 为多类神经障碍检测提供了有效方案，并可通过在线系统实现实时网络推理，便于临床应用。

papers.title: HKVLM: Faithful Query--Region Binding for Frozen-Detector Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding often fails even when the target object is present in the proposal pool, because the language-side referent is bound to the wrong region. We study this binding failure under frozen perception and ask whether an explicit query--region alignment hook, together with a perception-grounded abstention mechanism, can improve faithful grounding without retraining the detector or the vision-language backbone. HKVLM freezes a language-aligned open-vocabulary detector for localization and learns a lightweight hook that maps referential query embeddings to detector proposals in a shared space; a verifier abstains when no region sufficiently supports the query. We prove an exact proposal-level diagnostic decomposition, $(1-\mathrm{SeeErr})(1-\mathrm{SayErr})$, separating proposal-coverage failures from conditional binding failures, and a monotonicity result that characterizes the faithfulness--recall trade-off induced by abstention. Across RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg, and POPE, HKVLM improves over untrained and trained matched-perception binding controls and substantially reduces hallucination through abstention. Strong coordinate-decoding and end-to-end fine-tuned baselines remain much higher in raw grounding accuracy, and a reasoning-stress set exposes binding as the main current bottleneck. We therefore present HKVLM as a diagnostic and mechanism-level study of query--region binding under frozen perception, not as an absolute localization leader.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉定位中查询-区域绑定失败的问题，提出HKVLM方法：冻结语言对齐的开放词汇检测器，学习轻量级钩子将查询嵌入映射到检测器提案，并添加验证器在无充分支持时弃权。证明了提案级诊断分解(1-SeeErr)(1-SayErr)以及弃权导致的忠实度-召回率权衡。在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+等基准上，HKVLM减少了幻觉，但坐标解码和端到端微调基线在原始定位精度上仍更高。
Motivation: 视觉定位中即使目标对象存在于提案池中，语言侧指称仍常绑定到错误区域，导致定位失败。
Method: 冻结语言对齐的开放词汇检测器，学习轻量级钩子将指称查询嵌入映射到检测器提案的共享空间；当无区域充分支持查询时，验证器弃权。
Result: 在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg和POPE上，HKVLM优于未训练和训练的匹配感知绑定控制，通过弃权大幅减少幻觉。但坐标解码和端到端微调基线在原始定位精度上仍更高。
Conclusion: HKVLM作为冻结感知下查询-区域绑定的诊断和机制级研究，并非绝对的定位领导者，实际瓶颈在于绑定。

papers.title: Agent vs. Parametric World Models: Hybrid Planning for Reliable Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language agents plan by generating not only actions but also implicit predictions of how the world will change. These imagined state updates make agents flexible, but they also create a distinct failure mode: hallucinated state claims can be written into context and propagated across subsequent decisions. In contrast, parametric world models provide measurable transition errors but are often weaker semantic planners. We study this tradeoff in graph-structured planning environments and introduce metrics for agent-world-model error, including hallucinated-state rate, propagation depth, and long-horizon error growth. We then propose Hybrid World-Model Planning (Hybrid-WM), which keeps the language model as the planner while using a small parametric transition model to predict action validity, state deltas, risk, and value. A consistency gate compares the agent's imagined delta with the parametric prediction and triggers targeted revision only under disagreement. Across four graph-structured planning benchmarks, Hybrid-WM improves success while reducing hallucinated state propagation. In live GPT-4o-mini evaluations, it reduces hallucinated-state rate from 0.176 to 0.035; in calibrated simulator ablations, it improves success from 0.668 to 0.838 with modest additional inference. These results suggest that lightweight parametric transition models can serve as effective grounding mechanisms for language-agent planning without replacing semantic reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言代理在规划过程中因自我生成世界状态更新而导致的幻觉传播问题，提出混合世界模型规划（Hybrid-WM）。该方法保留语言模型作为规划器，同时引入小型参数化转换模型预测动作有效性、状态增量、风险和价值，并通过一致性门控仅在预测不一致时触发修正。在四个图结构规划基准上，Hybrid-WM在GPT-4o-mini评估中将幻觉状态率从0.176降至0.035，在校准模拟器中将成功率从0.668提升至0.838，表明轻量级参数化模型能为语言代理规划提供有效的基础机制。
Motivation: 语言代理通过生成动作和隐式世界状态预测进行规划，但该方式易产生幻觉状态并被写入上下文，导致错误在后续决策中传播；而参数化世界模型虽可测量转换误差，但语义规划能力较弱。
Method: 提出Hybrid-WM，以语言模型为主规划器，同时使用小型参数化转换模型预测动作有效性、状态增量、风险和价值；通过一致性门控比较语言模型想象的状态增量与参数化预测，仅在不一致时触发针对性修正。
Result: 在四个图结构规划基准上，Hybrid-WM在GPT-4o-mini评估中将幻觉状态率从0.176降至0.035；在校准模拟器消融实验中，成功率从0.668提升至0.838，且仅增加少量推理开销。
Conclusion: 轻量级参数化转换模型可以作为语言代理规划的有效基础机制，在不替换语义推理的前提下提供可靠的接地。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Rollout Error in Graph World Models
papers.abstract_en: World models are increasingly used for planning, yet most analyses of rollout error assume vector-valued states and scalar error amplification. Many planning environments, however, are naturally graph-structured: agents, tools, skills, routes, and dependencies interact through evolving relations. In this work, we study how prediction errors accumulate in Graph World Models (GWMs). We formulate fixed-edge and dynamic-edge GWM rollouts under a unified state-action transition framework and derive topology-aware error bounds. For fixed-edge rollouts, we show that long-horizon node error separates into a topology factor, governed by the graph spectral radius, and a model factor, governed by layer spectral norms. For dynamic-edge rollouts, we introduce a joint node-edge error operator that captures feedback between feature prediction and structure prediction, revealing when edge errors amplify future message passing. Motivated by these bounds, we propose Error-Aware GWM, a training objective that combines spectral regularization, rollout consistency, and critical-node weighting. Across synthetic graph topologies and heterogeneous agent-graph testbeds, we find that rollout error and planning regret grow with horizon, that dynamic-edge training is necessary when structure evolves, and that Error-Aware GWM improves long-horizon stability without sacrificing one-step accuracy. Our results characterize when graph world models remain reliable under autoregressive planning and when topology makes them fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究图世界模型（GWM）中预测误差的累积问题。作者针对固定边和动态边两种类型的GWM展开，推导了基于拓扑的误差界，并提出了误差感知训练目标（Error-Aware GWM），包含谱正则化、展开一致性和关键节点加权。在合成图拓扑和异构智能体图测试平台上，发现展开误差和规划遗憾随视界增长，动态边训练在结构演化时必要，所提方法提升了长视界稳定性。
Motivation: 现有世界模型大多假设向量状态和标量误差，但许多规划环境天然具有图结构（如智能体、工具、技能、路径等交互）。因此需要研究图世界模型中预测误差如何累积。
Method: 在统一状态-动作转换框架下，分别分析固定边和动态边GWM的展开误差，导出拓扑感知误差界。提出Error-Aware GWM训练目标，联合使用谱正则化、展开一致性和关键节点加权。
Result: 在合成图拓扑和异构智能体图测试平台上，展开误差和规划遗憾随视界增长；动态边训练在结构演化时必要；Error-Aware GWM提高了长视界稳定性，且不牺牲一步精度。
Conclusion: 论文刻画了图世界模型在自回归规划下何时可靠、何时因拓扑而失败。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Heavy-Ball Q-Learning with Residual Weighting Correction
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a corrected heavy-ball Q-learning method for reinforcement learning (RL) and establishes convergence of its deterministic mean dynamics. It also identifies conditions under which the method is theoretically guaranteed to converge faster than standard Q-learning. The same construction is then extended to Q-learning with linear function approximation, where analogous convergence and acceleration statements are derived for the corresponding corrected fixed point. The sampled stochastic versions are treated through conditional-mean recursions and, in the stated linear-function-approximation setting, finite-time bounds. The analysis is based on a switched linear system (SLS) representation of Q-learning algorithms and on the joint spectral radius (JSR) of the associated switching families. This SLS viewpoint is not commonly used in standard analyses of Q-learning, and it provides a complementary framework and new insight into how heavy-ball momentum can accelerate Q-learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种带残差加权校正的重球Q-learning方法，并分析了其确定性均值动力学的收敛性。理论表明该方法在特定条件下比标准Q-learning收敛更快。分析基于切换线性系统（SLS）表示和联合谱半径（JSR），为理解重球动量加速Q-learning提供了新视角。
Motivation: 标准Q-learning收敛速度较慢，重球动量方法在优化中常用但缺乏在Q-learning中的严格理论分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供收敛保证和加速条件。
Method: 提出重球Q-learning的残差加权校正版本，将其建模为切换线性系统（SLS），利用联合谱半径（JSR）工具分析收敛性。方法扩展到线性函数逼近设定，并推导了有限时间界的随机版本。
Result: 摘要指出该方法在确定性动力学下比标准Q-learning更快，并在线性函数逼近下给出类似的收敛和加速陈述。有限时间界也得到证明。
Conclusion: SLS框架为分析重球动量加速Q-learning提供了新途径，但方法在高维或非线性逼近下的表现尚待验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RolloutPipe: Overlapping Pipelined Rollout and Training in Disaggregated On-Policy LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) post-training for reasoning increasingly relies on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where models learn from ground-truth feedback on mathematical, logical, and scientific tasks. To enable flexible resource allocation and support heterogeneous training setups, modern RLVR systems adopt disaggregated architectures that decouple rollout generation and policy training across independent GPU pools. However, existing synchronous on-policy GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) RLVR systems finish an entire rollout before starting training, leaving the trainer GPU pool idle while rollout is still ongoing. Asynchronous RL pipelines overlap the two stages, but at the cost of training on stale data. To address these challenges, we propose RolloutPipe, a post-training framework for disaggregated RLVR systems, which turns the fixed-weight rollout into a complete-group pipeline where trainable groups move to the trainer while later groups are still being generated. RolloutPipe achieves this through two techniques including complete-group pipelining (CGP) and frontier-group dispatch (FGD). CGP dispatches each trainable complete group to the trainer FIFO as soon as group materialization finishes, and FGD is an admission policy on the Rollout node that first admits requests for the frontier groups needed to form the next training batch, so that trainer-ready groups arrive earlier and more steadily. The design starts training before the rollout completes while maintaining on-policy correctness. Evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B across four reasoning and science benchmarks and twelve rollout settings, RolloutPipe shortens the rollout-to-train-end time by 30.7%-42.3%, and lowers the trainer waiting ratio by 37%-76% compared to Slime, a state-of-the-art rollout and training system.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on Cognitive Computing (ICCC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RolloutPipe，一种用于解耦在线策略LLM强化学习（RLVR）的训练后框架，通过完整组流水线（CGP）和前沿组调度（FGD）实现rollout与训练的重叠，在不使用过时数据的情况下减少训练空闲时间。在Qwen3-1.7B上评估，相比Slime系统，缩短了30.7%-42.3%的rollout到训练结束时间，降低了37%-76%的训练等待比。
Motivation: 现有同步在线策略GRPO系统在rollout完成前训练空闲，异步系统则使用过时数据。需要一种既保持在线策略正确性又能重叠两阶段的方法。
Method: 提出完整组流水线（CGP）将可训练完整组在物化完成后尽快发送给训练器；前沿组调度（FGD）在rollout节点上优先接受需要组成下一训练批次的前沿组请求，使训练器就绪组更早更稳定到达。
Result: 在四个推理和科学基准及十二种rollout设置上，RolloutPipe将rollout到训练结束时间缩短30.7%-42.3%，训练器等待比降低37%-76%相比Slime。
Conclusion: RolloutPipe通过流水线技术在不牺牲策略正确性的前提下有效重叠rollout与训练，提升了解耦RLVR系统的资源利用率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出完整组流水线（CGP）将可训练完整组在物化完成后尽快发送给训练器；前沿组调度（FGD）在rollout节点上优先接受需要组成下一训练批次的前沿组请求，使训练器就绪组更早更稳定到达。
summary_sections.result: 在四个推理和科学基准及十二种rollout设置上，RolloutPipe将rollout到训练结束时间缩短30.7%-42.3%，训练器等待比降低37%-76%相比Slime。
summary_sections.conclusion: RolloutPipe通过流水线技术在不牺牲策略正确性的前提下有效重叠rollout与训练，提升了解耦RLVR系统的资源利用率。

papers.title: Reclaim Evaluation: A Lossy Memory Is Worse Than an Empty One
papers.abstract_en: A language model's memory can be worse than no memory at all. Give a model a memory that kept a wrong conclusion but dropped the work behind it, and it re-emits the stale value as a confident answer; give the same model an empty memory, and it abstains. We call this failure brittle memory. The information loss behind it is definitional (an answer cannot be recomputed once its inputs are gone), so the loss is only the setup; the finding is behavioral. Whether a model turns the lost source into a confident error or an abstention is set by disposition, not capability: four of eight models we test emit, and the four that abstain escape only by an interface affordance -- forced through a mandatory structured-output field, as production tool calls are, they commit the inherited wrong value. We measure correctability with reclaim evaluation: induce a known drift, compress the interaction at a fixed budget, deliver a correction that names the error, and score exact recovery of the known answer, judge-free. Correctability is bottlenecked not by capability but by whether the memory kept a re-derivation basis (the source) rather than the answer, so an 8B model and a frontier one wall in the same place. A one-line source-first policy -- keep the recomputable source, drop the re-derivable conclusion -- restores correctability at equal budget wherever the source is compact and identifiable, with a length-matched control that rules out 'more text' and a deployable one-prompt form weaker than the oracle. We map where the fix fails (source size, noise, a silent truncation mode a completeness tag makes loud), show the failure compounds through memory loops, and replicate on three deployed memory systems and on real dialogue (MultiWOZ, where the checkable value is present by construction). We release the harness, the paired memory conditions, and validators built to come out false.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 4 figures, 21 tables. v3: adds a recoverability principle unifying the results, a capability inverted-U (named result + figure), a write-time recompute certificate, and an agentic-task (Battleship) demonstration; strengthens the prevalence audit (judge-free floor + human inter-rater agreement); core claims unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现语言模型的记忆（memory）有时比没有记忆更糟糕：保留错误结论但丢弃推导过程会导致模型自信地输出错误答案，而空内存时模型会弃权。作者提出“回收评估”（reclaim evaluation）方法来测量可纠正性，发现可纠正性受限于内存是否保留了可重新推导的源（source）而非答案。一个简单的“source-first”策略——保留源、丢弃结论——可以在相同预算下恢复可纠正性。
Motivation: 现有语言模型记忆机制中，保留结论而丢失推导过程会导致模型自信地输出错误答案，而空内存可以避免这种错误；需要研究如何评估和改善模型对错误记忆的纠正能力。
Method: 提出“回收评估”方法：诱导已知漂移，以固定预算压缩交互，提供指出错误的修正，评分模型能否完全恢复已知答案（无审核器）。进一步提出“source-first”策略：保留可重新推导的源，丢弃可重新推导的结论。
Result: 在8个模型中，4个会自信地输出错误值，另外4个弃权（但通过强制结构化输出字段也会提交错误值）。可纠正性瓶颈不在于能力，而在于内存是否保留了源而非答案，因此8B模型与前沿模型表现相同。source-first策略在源紧凑且可识别时以相同预算恢复可纠正性。
Conclusion: 语言模型的记忆设计应优先保留可重新推导的源而非结论，以避免错误传播；该方法在多个记忆系统和真实对话数据集（MultiWOZ）上验证，并揭示了失败模式（源大小、噪声、静默截断等）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Two Layers of Instability in Causal Estimation
papers.abstract_en: There is a precise sense in which drawing causal inferences from observational data is hard, even when identifiability is assumed. In particular, Robins and Ritov (1997) and Robins et al. (2003) showed that causal effects can be discontinuous as a function of the data distribution: two arbitrarily close data distributions might correspond to different causal effects. This is a fact independent of the choice of estimator; however, not all estimators are equally unstable. Our contribution is to surface a second layer of instability that depends on the choice of estimator. We show that many standard point estimates can be read as point summaries of multimodal distributions over the space of structural causal models. As such, estimators can jump discontinuously in the data distribution. This defines a taxonomy of estimators that admits a decision-theoretic reading: stability depends on whether the implicit loss function an estimator optimizes is aligned with the causal effect itself. Specifically, inverse propensity weighted estimators and regression estimators are examples of discontinuous summaries, while explicit posterior means and medians are shown to be continuous.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出因果推断在观测数据中即使在可识别性假设下也存在不稳定性，Robins和Ritov（1997）等已证明因果效应作为数据分布的函数可能不连续。本文进一步揭示第二层依赖于估计量选择的不稳定性：许多标准点估计可视为结构因果模型空间上多模态分布的点汇总，因此估计量在数据分布上可能跳跃不连续。这定义了基于决策理论的估计量分类：稳定性取决于估计量优化的隐式损失函数是否与因果效应本身对齐。逆概率加权估计和回归估计属于不连续汇总，而显式后验均值和后验中位数则连续。
Motivation: 因果推断即使在可识别假设下仍然困难，已有工作显示因果效应作为数据分布函数的不连续性，但不同估计量的不稳定性差异尚未被充分理解。本文旨在揭示依赖于估计量的第二层不稳定性。
Method: 通过将标准点估计视为结构因果模型空间上多模态分布的点汇总，分析估计量在数据分布上的连续性。提出基于决策理论的估计量分类，考察估计量优化的隐式损失函数是否与因果效应对齐。
Result: 证明逆概率加权估计和回归估计是不连续汇总，而显式后验均值和后验中位数是连续的。
Conclusion: 估计量的稳定性取决于其隐式损失函数与因果效应的对齐程度，这为估计量选择提供了理论指导。

papers.title: Hard or Just Unreached? Diagnosing the Sampling Blind Spot in Math-Reasoning Difficulty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Math and science reasoning benchmarks rely on pass@k, the fraction of sampled chains that reach gold, as the canonical per-example difficulty signal. The same signal drives RL with verifiable rewards, math data curation, synthetic curricula, and verifier training. We show this proxy has a persistent blind spot on its hardest stratum: on the eight free-form math cells we test (GSM8K and MATH across four open-weight models), 10.3-22.9% of the examples that no sampling seed solves in six tries are instead solved at matched compute by a six-chain deterministic regime. These are greedy decoding plus five cheap residual-stream perturbations applied via activation grafting, while greedy alone solves at most 6% on these math cells. Recovery scales with the additional budget, across perturbations whose mechanistic distinctness we verify across all twelve cells (cross-kind fix-set Jaccard <= 0.47 in every setup). Activation grafting is used as an intervention on internal representations, not a decoding method; we use it purely as a diagnostic and diversification tool, and our recovered items show that the pass@k= 0 % stratum is structurally identifiable in the residual stream rather than that the unmodified model reaches them under ordinary inference.
papers.comment: 9 pages of main paper, 4 figures and 5 tables in the main paper, with more in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了数学推理基准中 pass@k 作为难度指标的采样盲点。在八个开放权重模型上的自由格式数学单元（GSM8K 和 MATH）中，10.3%-22.9% 被六次采样未解决的样本，实际上可以被等计算量的六链确定性方法（贪婪解码加五种廉价残差流扰动）解决。激活嫁接（activation grafting）作为一种诊断和多样化工具，揭示了这些样本在残差流中具有结构可识别性。
Motivation: 当前依赖 pass@k 作为单例难度信号，在数学推理基准的困难样本上存在系统性的低估（采样盲点），导致强化学习奖励、数据筛选和课程学习等依赖该信号的方法可能无效。
Method: 提出使用六链确定性解码（贪婪解码 + 五种基于激活嫁接的残差流扰动）替代随机采样，以相同推理计算量评估样本可解性。利用跨扰动类别的不重叠性（固定集 Jaccard ≤ 0.47）验证多样性。
Result: 在八个数学单元上，10.3%-22.9% 的被六次采样标记为不可解的样本被六链确定性成功解决；贪婪解码单独最多解决 6%。可解性随额外预算呈尺度增长。
Conclusion: pass@k=0% 的样本并非模型能力上限，而是采样策略导致的盲点。激活嫁接揭示了残差流中的结构可识别性，表明这些样本可通过确定性扰动被恢复。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Taming I2V models for Image HOI Editing: A Cognitive Benchmark and Agentic Self-Correcting Framework
papers.abstract_en: Current image editing methods excel at static attributes but fail at complex Human-Object Interactions (HOI), a critical challenge unaddressed by existing benchmarks that conflate HOI with static attributes, relying on global metrics incapable of simultaneously assessing dynamic interaction validity and entangled human-object pair preservation. Thus, we first introduce HOI-Edit, a comprehensive benchmark with three progressive cognitive levels, which features an automated metric HOI-Eval that reliably evaluates instance-level interaction by letting VLM Q&A after thinking with images containing grounded Human-Object pairs. Considering the task's essence of remodeling dynamic relationships, we benchmark Image-to-Video (I2V) models, finding them inherently suited for dynamic editing due to their temporal generation capabilities. Crucially, beyond superior performance, this capability provides a "replay of the failure process," offering unique diagnosability into why errors occur. We thus propose SCPE (Self-Correcting Process Editing), a novel, agentic self-correcting framework that constrains the generation of I2V models through iteratively refined prompts, enabling the generated videos to more accurately present the target HOI. Extracted frames from these videos are the final editing results. On HOI-Edit, SCPE achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art (SOTA) editing models like Nano Banana on interaction. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/HOI-Edit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像中复杂人-物交互（HOI）编辑这一挑战，首先提出HOI-Edit基准和自动化评估指标HOI-Eval，利用VLM对图像中的人-物对进行问答评估。论文发现图像到视频（I2V）模型因其时序生成能力天然适合动态编辑，并提出自纠正框架SCPE，通过迭代精炼提示约束I2V模型生成，使其更准确地呈现目标HOI。实验表明SCPE在交互准确性上达到与SOTA编辑模型竞争的水平。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑方法在处理复杂人-物交互（HOI）时失败，且现有基准将HOI与静态属性混为一谈，缺乏同时评估动态交互有效性和人-物对保持性的全局指标。
Method: 提出HOI-Edit基准（包含三个渐进认知层次）和自动化指标HOI-Eval（让VLM对包含标注人-物对的图像进行推理问答）。进一步提出SCPE（自纠正过程编辑）框架，利用I2V模型的时序生成能力，通过迭代精炼提示约束生成过程，并从生成视频中提取帧作为最终编辑结果。
Result: 摘要报告SCPE在HOI-Edit基准上的交互准确性达到与SOTA编辑模型（如Nano Banana）竞争的水平。
Conclusion: 论文强调I2V模型因能提供“失败过程回放”而具有独特诊断能力，SCPE框架通过自纠正机制提升了HOI编辑的准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TransitNet: A Compact Attention-Augmented Deep Learning Framework for Low-SNR Transit Blind Searches
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the observational incompleteness of intermediate-to-long-period Earth-size planets, we present TransitNet, a compact attention-augmented deep-learning framework for low-SNR transit blind searches. To enable realistic method development and objective threshold calibration under blind-search conditions, we develop a unified dataset construction, benchmarking, and threshold-selection framework. On recovery benchmarks constructed from unseen Kepler targets, TransitNet attains 95.2 percent accuracy in the challenging SNR range of 6 to 8 and outperforms both TLS and BLS, achieving ROC-AUC and PR-AP values of 0.974 and 0.982, respectively. In an injected Earth-size and sub-Earth-size transit recovery experiment, TransitNet achieves a recovery rate of 93.0 percent, substantially exceeding those of TLS (63.1 percent) and BLS (60.0 percent). In addition to detection, TransitNet provides attention-based estimates of transit windows and midpoints. On an independent evaluation set, 97.4 percent of injected transits are fully covered by the estimated transit window. Applied to real Kepler observations, the model successfully recovers all 34 selected confirmed Kepler planets, with a mean absolute transit midpoint error of 1.24 hours. The model combines a compact footprint of about 1.5 MB with high inference efficiency, yielding speed-ups of about 12 to 25 times relative to CPU-TLS and about 4 to 5 times relative to CPU-BLS. These results demonstrate that TransitNet provides an accurate, scalable, and computationally efficient framework for low-SNR transit blind searches in the tested regime and motivate its extension to longer-period Earth-size planet searches.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 23 figures, 3 tables, submitted to A&A
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长周期地球大小行星的观测不完备性，提出紧凑型注意力增强深度学习框架TransitNet，用于低信噪比凌星盲搜。在信噪比6-8范围内达到95.2%准确率，地球大小行星恢复率93.0%，显著优于传统TLS和BLS方法。模型仅1.5MB，推理速度快4-25倍，并在开普勒真实数据上成功恢复所有34颗确认行星，平均凌星中点误差1.24小时。
Motivation: 中长周期地球大小行星的观测存在不完备性，低信噪比下传统凌星搜索方法（如TLS、BLS）性能不足，急需更精确高效的盲搜框架。
Method: 提出注意力增强的紧凑深度学习框架TransitNet，并建立统一的数据集构建、基准测试和阈值选择框架，以模拟盲搜条件并客观校准阈值。
Result: 在信噪比6-8范围内准确率达95.2%，ROC-AUC 0.974、PR-AP 0.982；地球大小行星恢复率93.0%，远超TLS（63.1%）和BLS（60.0%）。模型约1.5MB，推理速度比CPU-TLS快12-25倍、比CPU-BLS快4-5倍；在真实开普勒数据上准确恢复所有34颗行星，平均凌星中点误差1.24小时。
Conclusion: TransitNet在测试范围内提供了准确、可扩展且计算高效的低信噪比凌星盲搜框架，并激励将其扩展至更长周期地球大小行星的搜索。

papers.title: Evaluation of Medical Vision Language Models HuluMed and MedGemma, and general purpose chatbots Gemma 3, ChatGPT Plus, and Claude Pro on real previously unseen wound images
papers.abstract_en: Chronic wound assessment remains a clinically challenging task that requires accurate interpretation of wound morphology, tissue composition, vascular characteristics, and infection risk. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have introduced the possibility of automated multimodal wound analysis through image understanding combined with clinical reasoning. This study evaluates the performance of several general-purpose and medically specialized open-source and proprietary VLMs for clinical wound assessment using an expanded, curated dataset of 20 clinically diverse wounds spanning vascular, surgical, ischemic, venous, lymphedema, and amputation-related etiologies. Six VLMs were evaluated using a structured twelve-question clinical framework covering wound classification, infection risk, vascular intervention recommendations, debridement urgency, wound therapy selection, and advanced management planning. Across 20 wound cases and 240 clinician-graded wound-analysis decisions, ChatGPT achieved the highest overall performance with 174/240 correct responses (72.50%), followed by Claude with 149/240 (62.08%). Among the open-source and medically specialized models, HuluMed achieved the strongest performance with 96/240 correct responses (40.00%), followed by Gemma 3 (81/240, 33.75%), MedGemma 4B (62/240, 25.83%), and MedGemma 27B (42/240, 17.50%). The findings suggest that frontier general-purpose multimodal systems currently demonstrate substantially stronger wound-analysis performance than medically specialized alternatives, highlighting the continued importance of broad multimodal reasoning capabilities alongside domain-specific medical knowledge. Although current VLMs demonstrate promising potential for clinical decision support, substantial limitations remain in advanced wound-management reasoning, procedural planning, and autonomous clinical reliability.

TL;DR: 本文评估多种视觉语言模型在真实未见过伤口图像上的临床评估能力。在20个伤口案例、240个临床决策中，ChatGPT 取得最高正确率72.50%，Claude 62.08%，开源医学专用模型 HuluMed 40.00%。研究表明前沿通用多模态系统显著优于医学专用模型，但所有模型在高级伤口管理推理方面仍有重大局限。
Motivation: 慢性伤口评估临床挑战大，需要多模态分析，但现有VLM在临床伤口分析上的性能尚未系统评估，尤其缺乏真实未见过图像上的比较。
Method: 使用20个临床多样伤口（涵盖血管、手术、缺血、静脉、淋巴水肿、截肢相关病因）的扩展数据集，通过结构化十二问临床框架评估6个VLM：ChatGPT、Claude、HuluMed、Gemma 3、MedGemma 4B、MedGemma 27B。框架包括伤口分类、感染风险、血管干预推荐、清创紧迫性、伤口治疗选择、高级管理规划等。
Result: ChatGPT 正确174/240 (72.50%)，Claude 149/240 (62.08%)，HuluMed 96/240 (40.00%)，Gemma 3 81/240 (33.75%)，MedGemma 4B 62/240 (25.83%)，MedGemma 27B 42/240 (17.50%)。
Conclusion: 通用多模态系统当前展现更强的伤口分析性能，医学专用模型仍需改进。所有VLM在高级伤口管理推理、程序规划、自主临床可靠性方面存在重大局限。

papers.title: From Reasoning Traces to Reusable Modules: Understanding Compositional Generalization in Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Post-training pipelines that combine supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) have emerged as the key recipe for transforming large language models (LLMs) into robust reasoners. We argue that this combined success is driven by compositional generalization, which we formalize through a hierarchical latent selection model. In this framework, reasoning traces are generated by a cascade of discrete latent selection variables corresponding to reusable atomic modules, including both skills (local operations) and routing mechanisms (how intermediate information is selected, reused, and composed). Within this model, we theoretically show that SFT and RL play asymmetric, complementary roles: SFT supplies the raw module materials in compositional traces, and RL decomposes those traces to identify the latent atomic modules and enable compositional generalization. We design controlled experiments to validate this theory. Our results demonstrate that RL can extract atomic modules from compound traces supplied by SFT and recombine them to solve new configurations. Moreover, we find that training on compound traces yields stronger generalization than training on isolated atomic modules. Finally, we investigate the relationship between SFT and RL data and identify an effective protocol in which SFT ensures coverage of all atomic modules through compositional traces, while RL focuses on novel compositions outside the SFT support to drive exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层潜在选择模型来解释语言模型在推理中的组合泛化，理论上证明监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）扮演互补角色：SFT提供组合轨迹中的原子模块，RL分解轨迹并识别潜在原子模块以实现组合泛化。实验表明RL能从SFT提供的复合轨迹中提取原子模块并重新组合解决新配置，且训练复合轨迹比孤立原子模块泛化更强。
Motivation: 理解监督微调和强化学习在语言模型推理中协同成功的机制，特别是组合泛化的作用。
Method: 通过分层潜在选择模型形式化推理轨迹生成过程，理论分析SFT和RL的互补角色，并设计控制实验验证。
Result: RL能从SFT提供的复合轨迹中提取原子模块并重新组合解决新配置；训练复合轨迹比孤立原子模块泛化更强；SFT需覆盖所有原子模块，RL聚焦于SFT支持范围之外的新组合。
Conclusion: SFT和RL的协同成功源于组合泛化，两者互补作用分别提供素材和分解重组能力。

papers.title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) have recently shown promise in jointly modeling future observations and executable robot actions. However, most existing WAMs still operate in 2D video or latent spaces, where visually plausible rollouts miss the 3D spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry required for precise manipulation. While geometric foundation models offer strong priors for recovering dense 3D structure and motion from visual observations, forcing WAMs to predict the dense 4D representation introduces costly geometric decoding and slows down causal action generation. To address the trade-off, we present WAM4D, a fast 4D world action model that uses lightweight spatial register tokens as training-time future-depth readouts to transfer pretrained geometric priors into a causal video-action transformer, then removes the register branch for lightweight action inference. To prevent non-causal shortcuts, we further design causal mixture attention for the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) WAM backbone, defining modality-specific visibility among video, action, and geometry tokens. Comprehensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that WAM4D improves spatial consistency and achieves competitive action prediction while maintaining efficient inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WAM4D，一种快速的4D世界动作模型，通过轻量级空间注册令牌（spatial register tokens）在训练时注入预训练几何先验，并在推理时移除注册分支以保持高效。该方法采用因果混合注意力机制（causal mixture attention）处理视频、动作和几何令牌之间的可见性，在RoboTwin 2.0和真实机器人操作任务上提升了空间一致性，同时维持了有竞争力的动作预测性能。
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）多在2D视频或潜在空间操作，缺乏3D空间约束和遮挡接触几何，导致视觉上合理的推演无法支撑精确操作。直接预测稠密4D表示会引入高昂的几何解码成本，减慢因果动作生成。
Method: 使用轻量级空间注册令牌作为训练时的未来深度读出，将预训练几何先验迁移到因果视频-动作Transformer中，推理时移除注册分支。设计因果混合注意力（causal mixture attention）用于Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）骨干，以定义视频、动作和几何令牌间的模态特定可见性并防止非因果捷径。
Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0和真实机器人操作任务上，WAM4D提升了空间一致性，并在保持高效推理的同时实现了有竞争力的动作预测。
Conclusion: WAM4D通过轻量级空间注册令牌和因果混合注意力，有效平衡了几何先验注入与推理效率，为4D世界动作模型在机器人操作中的实际应用提供了可行方案。

papers.title: ChartArena: Benchmarking Chart Parsing across Languages, Scenarios, and Formats
papers.abstract_en: Charts are a primary medium for conveying quantitative and relational information, yet systematically evaluating chart parsing models remains difficult. Existing benchmarks focus on narrow chart types and leave diagrammatic structures such as flowcharts and mind maps largely unaddressed, while models produce outputs in incompatible formats, and datasets rarely include the printed or hand-drawn images encountered in practice. To address these issues, we introduce ChartArena, a comprehensive bilingual benchmark covering eight chart families spanning both numeric charts and diagrammatic structures, each evaluated across three visual scenarios: digital renderings, printed photos, and hand-drawn photos. The dataset is built via a human-agent collaborative annotation pipeline with multi-stage human verification to ensure annotation reliability. To enable fair cross-model comparison, we further design a format-agnostic evaluation protocol that maps heterogeneous outputs into two canonical semantic spaces, a normalized triple view and a directed graph view, and scores them with structure-aware metrics. Through extensive evaluation of 26 leading MLLMs, we observe three consistent findings: (i) frontier proprietary models such as Gemini 3.1 Pro lead overall, yet the strongest open-source systems are rapidly closing the gap; (ii) document parsing models handle numeric charts reasonably but fall sharply behind on diagrammatic structures; and (iii) expert chart parsers remain limited to narrow chart families. Across all models, radar charts and hand-drawn scenarios stay especially challenging. These findings show that ChartArena exposes clear capability gaps and provides a unified foundation for future progress. ChartArena is publicly available at https://github.com/pspdada/ChartArena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChartArena是一个综合性双语图表解析基准，覆盖8种图表家族（包括数值图表和图示结构），在数字渲染、打印照片和手绘照片三种视觉场景下进行评估。通过人类-智能体协作标注管道构建数据集，并设计格式无关的评估协议，将异构输出映射到规范语义空间。评估26个前沿多模态大语言模型，发现专有模型领先但开源模型快速追赶，文档解析模型在处理图示结构时显著落后，专家图表解析器局限于窄图表家族，雷达图和手绘场景仍具挑战。
Motivation: 现有图表解析基准局限于窄图表类型，忽略流程图、思维导图等图示结构；模型输出格式不兼容，且数据集罕见包含打印或手绘图像。
Method: 构建ChartArena数据集，通过人类-智能体协作标注和多阶段人工验证确保可靠性；设计格式无关评估协议，将异构输出映射为归一化三元组视图和有向图视图，使用结构感知指标评分。
Result: 评估26个MLLMs，发现Gemini 3.1 Pro等前沿专有模型整体领先但最强开源系统迅速追赶；文档解析模型处理数值图表尚可但在图示结构上大幅落后；专家图表解析器仅适用于窄图表家族；雷达图和手绘场景对所有模型最具挑战。
Conclusion: ChartArena暴露了多模态模型在图表解析中的明确能力差距，为未来进步提供统一基础。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Separable Fourier Neural Networks for Solving High-Frequency PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Solving high-frequency partial differential equations (PDEs) with neural networks is notoriously difficult due to the spectral bias of conventional architectures. We propose the Multi-Scale Separable Fourier Neural Network (MS-SFNN), a framework designed to overcome this limitation by explicitly encoding multi-scale Fourier features within a separable representation. The network factorizes the solution into $d$ single-coordinate subnetworks with fixed, randomly initialized weights; these subnetworks are combined via element-wise products to form a rich set of basis functions. This separable construction scales linearly with the problem dimension, thus inherently alleviating the curse of dimensionality. Crucially, each subnetwork is equipped with trainable scaling factors coupled with cosine activations, providing an adaptive mechanism for multi-scale frequency selection that endows the model with strong spectral approximation capability. The PDE solution is expressed as a linear combination of these learned basis functions, and the combination coefficients are determined by solving a large-scale least-squares system. To resolve the memory bottleneck in high-frequency or three-dimensional settings, we replace automatic differentiation (AD) with analytical derivatives of the basis functions and use a memory-efficient batched QR decomposition for solving the least-squares systems efficiently. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that MS-SFNN achieves superior accuracy and substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, including Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) and the Separated-Variable Spectral Neural Network (SV-SNN).

papers.title: MemTrace: Tracing and Attributing Errors in Large Language Model Memory Systems
papers.abstract_en: Memory is essential for enabling large language models to support long-horizon reasoning, yet existing memory systems remain unreliable and difficult to debug. Tracing memory's dynamic evolution is crucial to understand how information is synthesized, propagated, or corrupted over time. In this work, we study the new problem of error tracing and attribution in LLM memory systems. We propose a novel framework that transforms memory pipelines into executable memory evolution graphs, enabling fine-grained tracing of operational information flow. We then construct MemTraceBench, a benchmark collected from representative memory systems such as Long-Context, RAG, Mem0, and EverMemOS, to systematically study memory failure modes. We further introduce an automatic attribution method that iteratively traces operation subgraphs to pinpoint the root cause of any failed case. Our analysis reveals that memory failures are systematic, stemming from operation-level issues like information loss and retrieval misalignment. Crucially, we leverage these fine-grained attribution signals to guide downstream prompt optimization, establishing a closed-loop system that automatically corrects faults and boosts end-task performance by up to 7.62%. Code will be released at https://github.com/zjunlp/MemTrace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）内存系统中的错误追踪与归因问题，提出将内存流水线转换为可执行的内存演化图，并构建基准MemTraceBench。摘要报告方法可自动定位失败原因，并通过下游提示优化将端任务性能提升最多7.62%。
Motivation: 现有LLM内存系统不可靠且难以调试，缺乏对其动态演化的追踪与错误归因方法。
Method: 提出将内存流水线转换为可执行的内存演化图，实现细粒度操作信息流追踪；并引入自动归因方法，通过迭代追踪操作子图定位根因。
Result: 摘要报告在Long-Context、RAG、Mem0、EverMemOS等系统上，该方法可自动定位失败原因，并利用归因信号指导提示优化，将端任务性能提升最多7.62%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调内存失效是系统性的，源于操作级问题（如信息丢失、检索错位），而细粒度归因信号可用于闭环自动纠错。

papers.title: Learning in Low-Dimensional Subspaces: Orthogonal Bottlenecks for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents commonly rely on high-dimensional neural representations, despite growing evidence that task-relevant value and policy structure may be intrinsically low-dimensional. In this work, we present a simple yet effective representation-level prior that inserts a fixed orthonormal projection to constrain encoder features to a low-dimensional subspace, requiring no auxiliary objectives, pretraining, or changes to the underlying RL algorithm. Under a linear realizability assumption, we prove that when the bottleneck dimension exceeds the intrinsic rank of the optimal value function in feature space, the bottleneck preserves expressivity and leaves the induced gradient dynamics unchanged up to an equivalent low-dimensional parameterization. Empirically, we find that across both single and multi-task benchmarks, baseline performance is either matched or improved once the bottleneck dimension exceeds a small task-dependent threshold; in many cases, value representations can be compressed to extremely low dimensions without loss, and the minimal sufficient dimension depends far more on environment complexity than encoder width. In addition, we analyze representation geometry and find that orthogonal bottlenecks stabilize feature norms and are associated with higher effective rank. Together, these results support a representation-space interpretation of the manifold hypothesis in reinforcement learning and position orthogonal bottlenecks as a lightweight, architecture-agnostic mechanism for shaping RL representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单的表示层先验——正交瓶颈（orthogonal bottleneck），通过在编码器特征上施加固定的正交投影，将特征约束到低维子空间，无需辅助目标、预训练或修改底层强化学习算法。理论上证明了当瓶颈维度超过最优价值函数的特征空间内在秩时，瓶颈保持表达能力且梯度动力学等价于低维参数化。实验表明，在单任务和多任务基准上，一旦瓶颈维度超过小阈值，基线性能持平或提升；价值表示可压缩至极低维度，最小所需维度主要取决于环境复杂度而非编码器宽度。此外，正交瓶颈稳定了特征范数并提高了有效秩。
Motivation: 深度强化学习代理普遍依赖高维神经表示，但任务相关的价值和策略结构可能本质上是低维的。现有方法缺乏轻量级、与算法无关的表示约束机制。
Method: 在编码器后插入一个固定的正交投影矩阵，将特征映射到低维子空间，作为表示层先验；理论分析了线性可实现性下的表达性和梯度动力学，并通过实验验证了不同任务下的瓶颈维度影响。
Result: 在多个基准上，当瓶颈维度超过任务相关的小阈值时，性能匹配或提升；价值表示可压缩到极低维度；最小足够维度主要取决于环境复杂度而非编码器宽度；正交瓶颈稳定了特征范数并提高了有效秩。
Conclusion: 正交瓶颈是一种轻量级、架构无关的表示塑造机制，支持了强化学习中的流形假设，并可用于压缩表示而不损失性能。
