papers.title: A 10,000-Year Global Stochastic Tropical Cyclone Catalog with Wind-Dependent Track Transitions (WHITS)
papers.abstract_en: Reliable assessment of tropical cyclone risk is limited by the short and spatially uneven historical record, especially for rare, high-intensity landfalls that dominate insured loss. We present WHITS, the Wind-focused Hurricane Interactive Track Simulator, a non-parametric semi-Markov model that generates a 10,000-year global synthetic catalog of tropical cyclone tracks. WHITS builds new storms by resampling variable-length segments of historical tracks, with segment choices conditioned on local wind speed, location, storm age, and forward motion. This structure preserves both the statistical grounding of the historical record and a form of system memory along realized storm pathways. The resulting catalog reproduces observed track density and the annual probability that hurricane- or typhoon-force winds pass a given location across the major tropical cyclone basins. WHITS is designed to support climate risk analysis, insurance applications, and extreme event research over operational planning time scales by providing a large, low-bias sample of physically plausible storms. This low-bias design is important for applications in which introduced bias cannot simply be corrected after the fact and small errors in storm frequency, track, or intensity can substantially affect loss estimates. Because loss accumulates along the storm path, track geometry matters: storms that loop, stall, or turn sharply can produce damage footprints that differ fundamentally from straight-moving events. By preserving these irregular shapes while greatly expanding the sample of plausible storms, WHITS provides risk analysts, insurers, and coastal planners with information unavailable from observations alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了WHITS（Wind-focused Hurricane Interactive Track Simulator），一个非参数半马尔可夫模型，可生成10,000年全球合成热带气旋路径目录。该模型通过重采样历史路径的变长片段（条件于当地风速、位置、风暴年龄和前向运动）来构建新风暴，保留了历史记录的统计基础和系统记忆。生成的目录能再现观测的路径密度和飓风/台风强度风经过特定地点的年概率，为气候风险分析、保险和极端事件研究提供低偏差的大样本。
Motivation: 可靠的热带气旋风险评估受限于历史记录短且空间不均匀，尤其对于主导保险损失的罕见高强度登陆事件。现有方法或引入偏差难以事后校正，或无法充分捕捉路径几何（如回旋、停滞、急转弯）对损失的影响。
Method: WHITS采用非参数半马尔可夫模型，从历史路径中重采样变长片段，每个片段的选取取决于当地风速、位置、风暴年龄和前向运动，从而在保持统计现实性的同时扩展样本容量。
Result: 该模型生成的10,000年合成目录成功再现了主要热带气旋盆地的观测路径密度以及飓风/台风强度风经过特定位置的年概率。
Conclusion: WHITS通过提供大量低偏差、物理上合理的风暴样本，支持气候风险分析、保险应用和极端事件研究，弥补了观测数据在罕见事件和复杂路径几何上的信息不足。

papers.title: When Outcome Looks Right But Discipline Fails: Trace-Based Evaluation Under Hidden Competitor State
papers.abstract_en: Outcome-only evaluation can certify economically unsafe agents: a policy can hit a business KPI while violating deployable behavioral discipline. In hotel pricing with hidden competitor state, a learner can achieve plausible revenue per available room while failing to preserve the rate discipline of a rule-based revenue-management competitor. We introduce discipline stability, a trace-based evaluation paradigm: define the benchmark behavior, restrict observations to the deployment regime, induce trace diagnostics from failure, separate mechanisms with ablations, and test transfer and deployment. Across a two-hotel benchmark and a compact hidden-budget bidding task, reward-only PPO variants miss trace alignment; revealing hidden state reduces label uncertainty; deterministic copy collapses uncertainty; and trace-prior or corrected history policies better preserve price or bid distributions. Pure behavior cloning is nearly enough for symmetric imitation, while Trace-Prior RL adds bounded adaptation under capacity asymmetry. The contribution is an evaluation and benchmark paradigm, not a new optimizer or a universal claim about MARL
papers.comment: Accepted to the KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于轨迹的评估范式（discipline stability），用于检测在经济上不安全但在结果指标（如收入）上表现良好的智能体。在酒店定价和隐藏预算竞价任务中，仅依赖奖励的PPO变体无法保持轨迹对齐，而揭示隐藏状态或使用轨迹先验策略可改善行为纪律。
Motivation: 仅基于结果的评估可能认证经济上不安全的智能体：策略可能达到业务KPI但违反部署行为纪律。现有评估方法无法检测这种隐藏的竞争状态带来的风险。
Method: 引入discipline stability评估范式：定义基准行为，限制观察范围为部署场景，从失败中诱导轨迹诊断，通过消融分离机制，并测试迁移与部署。
Result: 在双酒店基准和隐藏预算竞价任务中，仅奖励的PPO变体无法实现轨迹对齐；揭示隐藏状态减少标签不确定性；确定性复制消除不确定性；轨迹先验或修正历史策略更好地保持价格或出价分布。纯行为克隆对对称模仿几乎足够，而轨迹先验强化学习在容量不对称下提供有限适应。
Conclusion: 本文贡献在于评估和基准范式，而非新优化器或关于多智能体强化学习的通用声明。

papers.title: Sign-Separated Asymmetric Finite-Time Error Analysis of Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Q-learning is known to suffer from overestimation bias: because the Bellman update maximizes noisy or imperfect action-value estimates, positive errors can be selected and propagated, causing learned values to exceed the true optimal values. This bias can slow learning, degrade policy quality, and make value estimates unreliable. Although the convergence of Q-learning has been studied extensively, convergence theory that explicitly reflects this overestimation mechanism remains limited. This paper studies the asymmetric convergence behavior of Q-learning induced by overestimation bias. We decompose the Q-learning error into its componentwise positive and negative parts and derive separate finite-time rates for the two components. The resulting certificates can assign a slower exponential envelope to the positive component than to the negative component. This rate separation provides indirect theoretical evidence for max-induced overestimation: positive errors can be amplified through the maximization step, whereas negative errors admit a sharper comparison with an optimal-policy system. The separation is a difference between upper bounds, so it need not hold for every realized Q-learning trajectory. Nevertheless, we construct examples in which the predicted asymmetry appears in the actual trajectory. The analysis gives deterministic and stochastic constant-step-size bounds and clarifies how overestimation enters the switching-system dynamics of Q-learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Q-learning因最大化操作导致正误差传播（过估计偏差）的问题，将Q-learning误差分解为分量正负部分，推导了各自独立的有限时间收敛速率。理论表明正分量的指数包络比负分量更慢，从而间接解释了过估计偏差的机制。确定性及随机常数步长边界将过估计纳入Q-learning的切换系统动力学分析。
Motivation: Q-learning的过估计偏差已被广泛认知，但现有收敛理论未能显式反映该偏差对正负误差分量的非对称影响，缺乏对过估计机制的严格理论刻画。
Method: 将Q-learning误差分解为分量正部分和负部分，分别推导有限时间速率上界；利用切换系统动力学分析常数步长下的确定性/随机边界。
Result: 理论上证明正分量获得比负分量更慢的指数收敛包络，即速率分离现象，并在构造实例中验证该非对称性出现在实际轨迹中。
Conclusion: 本文从理论上解释了过估计偏差如何通过最大值操作放大正误差，同时负误差受更优策略系统的约束，从而揭示Q-learning动力学中的非对称收敛特性。

papers.title: Attributing Emergence in Million-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can simulate human-like reasoning and decision-making in individual agents. LLM-powered multi-agent systems (MAS) combine such agents to simulate population-scale social phenomena such as polarization, information cascades, and market panics. Such studies require attributing macro emergence to individual agents, but existing axiomatic methods scale combinatorially in $N$ and have been confined to $N \lesssim 10^3$, while the phenomena they explain occur at $N \geq 10^6$. We address this gap by adapting Aumann--Shapley path-integral attribution to LLM-powered MAS at million-agent scale; the resulting method satisfies all four axioms, runs three to five orders of magnitude faster than sampled Shapley on the same hardware, and extends feasible axiomatic attribution by over three orders of magnitude (a $1670\times$ jump). We use this method to test the scale gap empirically: across 14 days of public Bluesky data ($1{,}671{,}587$ active users, five topics), we compute the attribution at both full scale and the visibility-biased $N = 10^2$ convenience sample used by small-scale studies, and the two disagree structurally. At full scale the long tail and middle tier jointly carry the majority; the biased small panel shifts about twice that share onto the upper follower tiers ($48\%$ versus $24\%$). We then prove that the disagreement cannot in general be reduced by post-hoc rescaling: an Attribution Scaling Bias theorem shows that a reconciling global rescaling factor exists exactly when the macro indicator is linear over agents, and our nonlinear indicators give residuals of $0.10$--$0.98$. For such nonlinear indicators, full-scale attribution is therefore a requirement rather than a methodological choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型驱动的多智能体系统（MAS）中涌现现象归因于个体智能体的计算瓶颈，将Aumann-Shapley路径积分归因方法适配到百万智能体规模，使其满足全部四条公理，运行速度比采样Shapley快3-5个数量级，将可行归因规模提升1670倍。通过14天Bluesky数据（167万活跃用户）实证，全尺度归因与小规模采样（N=100）结果存在结构差异，并证明此差异无法通过后处理缩放消除。
Motivation: 现有公理归因方法（如Shapley值）在N>10^3时计算不可行，而关键社会涌现现象（如极化、信息级联）发生在N≥10^6，导致无法从个体层面解释宏观涌现。
Method: 将Aumann-Shapley路径积分归因适配到基于LLM的多智能体系统，实现满足可加性、对称性、虚拟性和效率公理的百万级归因，并证明Attribution Scaling Bias定理，指出非线性宏观指标下归因规模不可压缩。
Result: 方法在相同硬件上比采样Shapley快3-5个数量级，归因规模提升1670倍；在Bluesky数据上，全尺度归因显示长尾和中层用户共同主导，而小样本（N=100）偏向上层关注者阶层（48% vs 24%）；非线性指标下后处理缩放残差为0.10-0.98。
Conclusion: 对于非线性宏观指标，全尺度归因是必要条件而非可选方法，因为缩放偏差定理表明不存在全局缩放因子能弥合尺度差异。

papers.title: When Style Similarity Scores Fail: Diagnosing Raw CSD Cosine in Artist-Style Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Raw cosine in the 768-dimensional output space of the Contrastive Style Descriptor (CSD) is now widely read as an absolute, calibrated style-fidelity score for text-to-image and style-imitation evaluation. We introduce the discrimination gap, a corpus-internal, prototype-free and threshold-free diagnostic that tests whether contrastive style cosines admit an absolute same-versus-different interpretation on a candidate artist corpus. On a 1799-artwork, 91-artist public-domain corpus, raw CSD cosine yields negative point-estimate gaps for $23/91$ artists at the pairwise level ($2/91$ robust under bootstrap) and for $15/91$ in the aggregated-pool scoring regime style-fidelity evaluations typically use. CSLS readout on the frozen backbone reduces the aggregated negative-gap count to $4/91$; combined with positional-embedding interpolation to $336$ pixels it raises unsupervised pair-verification AUC from $0.883$ to $0.905$ across $25$ artist-disjoint splits. We refer to this diagnostic-driven readout protocol on the frozen backbone (CSLS as default, pos-interp $336$ as the stronger optional setting) as CSD+, not a new encoder.A cross-backbone check on CLIP-ViT-L/14, SigLIP-large and DINOv2-Large reproduces the same shared-tradition failure pattern, providing evidence that the residual reflects a shared limitation of the four backbones we tested rather than a CSD-specific artefact. Practical implication: before reporting CSD cosine as an absolute style-fidelity score, run the diagnostic on the candidate corpus; CSLS is the minimal correction when it fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了原始CSD余弦在艺术家风格评估中的失效问题，提出了区分差距（discrimination gap）这一无需原型和阈值的诊断指标。在1799幅作品、91位艺术家的公开数据集上，原始余弦对23/91位艺术家产生负点估计差距；采用CSLS读出头和位置嵌入插值至336像素后，无监督配对验证AUC从0.883提升至0.905。该协议被称为CSD+，并非新编码器。跨骨干网络验证表明该问题源于多个视觉骨干的共享局限。
Motivation: CSD余弦被广泛用作文本到图像和风格模仿中绝对校准的风格保真度分数，但其绝对性假设可能失效。需要一种诊断方法来检验该假设是否成立。
Method: 提出区分差距（discrimination gap）诊断方法，基于冻住骨干网络，使用CSLS读出头（默认）和位置嵌入插值至336像素（可选更强设置），形成CSD+协议。
Result: 在1799作品91艺术家数据集上，原始CSD余弦在成对级别对23/91位艺术家产生负点估计差距（bootstrap稳健性下2/91），在聚合池化评分模式下对15/91位艺术家为负。CSLS将聚合负差距计数降至4/91，结合336像素插值将无监督配对验证AUC从0.883提升至0.905（25次艺术家分离划分）。跨CLIP-ViT-L/14、SigLIP-large和DINOv2-Large骨干验证了相似的失效模式。
Conclusion: 在将CSD余弦作为绝对风格保真度分数报告之前，应在候选语料库上运行区分差距诊断；当诊断失败时，CSLS是最小修正。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ECTraj: Enhanced Consistency Training for Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models for multi-agent trajectory prediction are limited by iterative denoising, which causes inference latency that hinders their use in time-critical settings like autonomous driving. Fast-sampling variants using DDIM and informed initial noise distributions partially alleviate this issue, but they either fail to achieve true single-step generation or are constrained by the chosen noise distribution. Consistency Models (CMs) offer high-quality one-step generation by mapping noise directly to data, but are difficult to train from scratch. We propose ECTraj, an enhanced CM pipeline with improved training and conditional generation for trajectory prediction. Our framework extends the student-teacher consistency training scheme: the student produces standard outputs, while the teacher explicitly fuses its predictions with parts of the ground truth to give stronger supervision. We also exploit CMs' direct denoising for top-K multi-shot generation during training. Combining conditional generation with this enhanced consistency objective yields faster inference and improved prediction accuracy, establishing competitive new benchmarks on the large-scale Argoverse 2 dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ECTraj，一种增强的一致性模型（Consistency Model, CM）管道，用于多智能体轨迹预测。通过改进学生-教师一致性训练：学生生成标准输出，教师显式将其预测与部分真实轨迹融合以提供更强监督；同时利用CM的直接去噪进行训练中的top-K多轮生成。在Argoverse 2数据集上获得具有竞争力的新基准，实现更快推理和更高预测精度。
Motivation: 扩散模型在多智能体轨迹预测中存在推理延迟，快速采样变体（如DDIM）难以实现真正的单步生成或受限于噪声分布；一致性模型虽能高质量单步生成但难以从头训练。
Method: 提出ECTraj，扩展学生-教师一致性训练方案：学生产生标准输出，教师显式融合其预测与部分真实轨迹以提供更强监督；并利用一致性模型的直接去噪能力在训练中进行top-K多轮生成。
Result: 在Argoverse 2大规模数据集上建立竞争性新基准，实现了更快的推理速度和更高的预测精度。
Conclusion: 结合条件生成与增强的一致性目标可同时提升推理速度和预测精度，为多智能体轨迹预测提供有效方案。

papers.title: Graph Representation Learning Augmented Model Manipulation on Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning (FFT) has emerged as a privacy-preserving paradigm for collaboratively adapting large language models (LLMs). Built upon federated learning, FFT enables distributed agents to jointly refine a shared pretrained LLM by aggregating local LLM updates without sharing local raw data. However, FFT-based LLMs remain vulnerable to model manipulation threats, in which adversarial participants upload manipulated LLM updates that corrupt the aggregation process and degrade the performance of the global LLM. In this paper, we propose an Augmented Model maniPulation (AugMP) strategy against FFT-based LLMs. Specifically, we design a novel graph representation learning framework that captures feature correlations among benign LLM updates to guide the generation of malicious updates. To enhance manipulation effectiveness and stealthiness, we develop an iterative manipulation algorithm based on an augmented Lagrangian dual formulation. Through this formulation, malicious updates are optimized to embed adversarial objectives while preserving benign-like parameter characteristics. Experimental results across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that the AugMP strategy achieves the strongest manipulation performance among all competing baselines, reducing the global LLM accuracy by up to \(26\%\) and degrading the average accuracy of local LLM agents by up to \(22\%\). Meanwhile, AugMP maintains high statistical and geometric consistency with benign updates, enabling it to evade conventional distance- and similarity-based defense methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对联邦微调LLMs的模型操纵攻击AugMP，利用图表示学习捕获良性更新的特征相关性来生成恶意更新，并通过增强拉格朗日对偶进行迭代优化。实验表明AugMP能显著降低全局LLM准确性，同时保持与良性更新的统计一致性，逃避常规防御。
Motivation: 联邦微调中，恶意参与者上传操纵的模型更新会破坏聚合过程，降低全局LLM性能。现有攻击可能被基于距离或相似度的防御检测，需要更隐蔽有效的攻击方法。
Method: 设计图表示学习框架捕捉良性LLM更新的特征相关性，指导恶意更新生成；基于增强拉格朗日对偶的迭代优化算法，使恶意更新嵌入对抗目标同时保持类似良性的参数特征。
Result: 在多个LLM骨干网络上，AugMP相比基线实现最强操纵性能，降低全局LLM准确率高达26%，降低局部LLM平均准确率高达22%，并能逃避常规距离和相似度防御。
Conclusion: 摘要强调AugMP是一种有效的隐蔽攻击，对联邦微调安全性构成威胁，但未提及防御或局限。

papers.title: Beyond the Black Box: Interpretability of Agentic AI Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are promising for high-stakes enterprise workflows, but dependable deployment remains limited because these tool-use decisions are difficult to diagnose and control. Agents may skip required tool calls, invoke tools unnecessarily, or take actions whose consequences become visible only after execution. Existing observability methods are external: prompts reveal correlations, evaluations score outputs, and logs arrive only after the model has already acted. In long-horizon settings, these failures are costly because an early tool mistake can alter the rest of the execution trajectory, increase token consumption, and create downstream safety and security risk. We introduce a mechanistic-interpretability toolkit built on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), which decompose activations into sparse internal features, and linear probes, lightweight classifiers that read signals from those features. The framework reads model states before each action and infers whether a tool is needed and how risky the next tool action is. It identifies the model layers and features most associated with tool decisions and tests their functional importance through feature ablation. We train the probes on multi-step agent execution traces from the NVIDIA Nemotron function-calling dataset and apply the same workflow to GPT-OSS 20B and Gemma 3 27B models. The goal is not to replace external evaluation, but to add a missing layer: visibility into what the model signaled internally before action. This helps surface deeper causes of agent failure, especially in long-horizon runs where an early mistake can impact subsequent agent behavior. More broadly, the paper shows how mechanistic interpretability can support internal observability for monitoring tool calls and risk in agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI agent在工具使用决策中难以诊断和控制的问题，提出基于稀疏自编码器（SAEs）和线性探针的机械可解释性工具包。该方法在模型执行动作前读取内部状态，推断是否需要工具以及下一步工具操作的风险程度，并通过特征消融验证关键特征的功能重要性。在NVIDIA Nemotron函数调用数据集上训练探针，并应用于GPT-OSS 20B和Gemma 3 27B模型，旨在提供工具调用和风险的内部可观测性，补充现有外部评估方法。
Motivation: 现有AI agent的观测方法局限于外部监控（如提示、评估、日志），在长时域任务中早期工具错误代价高昂且难以诊断，缺乏对模型内部决策信号的可视性。
Method: 采用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）将模型激活分解为稀疏内部特征，并训练线性探针从这些特征中读取信号；在每次动作前推断工具需求和风险，通过特征消融测试特征的因果重要性。
Result: 在NVIDIA Nemotron函数调用数据集的多步agent执行轨迹上训练探针，并在GPT-OSS 20B和Gemma 3 27B模型上应用同一工作流，实现了对模型内部工具决策信号的可观测性。
Conclusion: 机械可解释性可以为agent系统的工具调用和风险监控提供内部可观测性，与外部评估形成互补，尤其有助于诊断长时域运行中早期错误导致的后续行为偏差。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Many Iterations to Jailbreak? Dynamic Budget Allocation for Multi-Turn LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating and predicting the performance of large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn conversational settings is critical yet computationally expensive; key events -- e.g., jailbreaks or successful task completion by an agent -- often emerge only after repeated interactions. These events might be rare, and under any feasible computational budget, remain unobserved. Recent conformal survival frameworks construct reliable lower predictive bounds (LPBs) on the number of iterations to trigger the event of interest, but rely on static budget allocation that is inefficient in multi-turn setups. To address this, we introduce \emph{Dynamic Allocation via PRojected Optimization} (DAPRO), the first theoretically valid dynamic budget allocation framework for bounding the time-to-event in multi-turn LLM interactions. We prove that DAPRO satisfies the budget constraint and provides distribution-free, finite-sample coverage guarantees without requiring the conditional independence between censoring and event times assumed by prior conformal survival approaches. A key theoretical contribution is a novel coverage bound that scales with the square root of the mean censoring weight rather than the worst-case weight, yielding provably tighter guarantees than prior work. Furthermore, DAPRO can be employed to obtain unbiased, low-variance estimates of population-level evaluation metrics, such as the jailbreak rate, under limited computing resources. Comprehensive experiments across agentic task success, adversarial jailbreaks, toxic content generation, and RAG hallucinations using LLMs such as Llama 3.1 and Qwen 2.5 demonstrate that DAPRO consistently achieves coverage closer to the nominal level with lower variance than static baselines, while satisfying the budget constraint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAPRO，一种用于多轮LLM交互中事件时间（如越狱）边界预测的动态预算分配框架。相比静态方法，DAPRO在满足预算约束的同时提供分布无关的有限样本覆盖保证，且理论上界更紧。实验在多种LLM（Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5）和任务（agent任务、对抗性越狱、有毒内容生成、RAG幻觉）上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有多轮LLM评估中，关键事件（如越狱）可能需要在多次交互后才出现，且计算预算有限导致事件未被观测。传统静态预算分配效率低，且现有共形生存框架要求删失与事件时间条件独立，限制了应用。
Method: 提出Dynamic Allocation via PRojected Optimization (DAPRO)，一种基于投影优化的动态预算分配方法。证明其在满足总预算约束下提供分布无关、有限样本的覆盖保证，且不要求删失与事件时间条件独立；同时给出基于均值删失权重的新覆盖界，比最差情况权重更紧。
Result: 在多个任务（agent任务成功、对抗性越狱、有毒内容生成、RAG幻觉）和LLM（Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5）上，DAPRO的覆盖率更接近名义水平且方差更低，同时满足预算约束。
Conclusion: DAPRO为多轮LLM评估提供了理论上有效且实践上更优的动态预算分配方案，可用于无偏、低方差估计群体指标（如越狱率）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Financial Document Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Financial document question answering (QA) demands complex multi-step numerical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence--structured tables, textual narratives, and footnotes--scattered across corporate filings. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches adopt a single-pass retrieve-then-generate paradigm that struggles with the compositional reasoning chains prevalent in financial analysis. We propose FinAgent-RAG, an agentic RAG framework that orchestrates iterative retrieval-reasoning loops with self-verification, specifically engineered for the precision requirements of financial numerical reasoning. The framework integrates three domain-specific innovations: (1) a Contrastive Financial Retriever trained with hard negative mining to distinguish semantically similar but numerically distinct financial passages, (2) a Program-of-Thought reasoning module that generates executable Python code for precise arithmetic rather than relying on error-prone LLM-based mental computation, and (3) an Adaptive Strategy Router that dynamically allocates computational resources based on question complexity, reducing API costs by 41.3% on FinQA while preserving accuracy. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets--FinQA, ConvFinQA, and TAT-QA--demonstrate that FinAgent-RAG achieves 76.81%, 78.46%, and 74.96% execution accuracy respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.62--9.32 percentage points. Ablation studies, cross-backbone evaluation with four LLMs, and deployment cost analysis confirm the framework's robustness and practical viability for financial institutions.
papers.comment: This paper is withdrawn due to significant methodological errors in the experimental design that fundamentally affect the validity of the results. The errors are not correctable within the current framework, and the conclusions can no longer be supported. We apologize for any inconvenience caused to readers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向金融文档问答的智能体检索增强生成框架FinAgent-RAG，通过迭代检索-推理循环和自验证机制处理多步数值推理。但由于方法论错误，该论文已被撤回。三个核心模块：对比金融检索器（含难负样本挖掘）、程序化思维（生成可执行Python代码进行精确算术）和自适应策略路由器（根据问题复杂度动态分配资源）。在FinQA等三个基准上达到了76.81%-78.46%的执行准确率，优于最强基线5.62-9.32个百分点。
Motivation: 现有RAG采用单次检索-生成范式，难以处理金融文档中需要从表格、文本和脚注中组合证据的多步数值推理链。
Method: 提出FinAgent-RAG，包括三个主要创新：1）对比金融检索器，通过难负样本挖掘区分语义相似但数值不同的金融段落；2）程序化思维模块，生成可执行Python代码进行精确算术；3）自适应策略路由器，根据问题复杂度分配计算资源，在FinQA上降低API成本41.3%同时保持准确率。
Result: 在FinQA、ConvFinQA和TAT-QA上分别达到76.81%、78.46%和74.96%的执行准确率，超出最强基线5.62-9.32个百分点。消融实验、跨骨干网络评估和部署成本分析验证了框架的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架对金融机构的实用可行性，但论文已被撤回，结论不再被支持。

papers.title: Stop Automating Peer Review Without Rigorous Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models offer a tempting solution to address the peer review crisis. This position paper argues that today's AI systems should not be used to produce paper reviews. We ground this position in an empirical comparison of human- versus AI-generated ICLR 2026 reviews and an evaluation of the effect of automated paper rewriting on different AI reviewers. We identify two critical issues: 1) AI reviewers exhibit a hivemind effect of excessive agreement within and across papers that reduces perspective diversity. 2) AI review scores are trivially gameable through paper laundering: prompting an LLM to rewrite a paper could significantly increase the scores from AI reviewers, demonstrating that LLM reviewers are easy to game through stylistic changes rather than scientific results. However, non-gameability and review diversity are necessary but not sufficient conditions for automation. We argue that addressing the peer review crisis requires a science of peer review automation -- not general-purpose LLMs deployed without rigorous evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 (Oral). Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning Position Paper Track (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张在缺乏严格评估的情况下不应将AI系统用于自动生成同行评审。通过对ICLR 2026评审的人工与AI对比实验，发现AI评审存在过度一致的蜂群思维效应，且AI评审分数容易被论文洗稿操作显著提升。论文认为解决同行评审危机需要建立评审自动化的科学，而非直接部署通用大语言模型。
Motivation: 当前同行评审面临危机，大语言模型被提议作为解决方案，但尚缺乏对其有效性和可靠性的严格评估。
Method: 通过实证比较ICLR 2026中人类与AI生成的评审，并评估自动论文重写对不同AI评审者的影响，识别关键问题。
Result: AI评审表现出过度一致的蜂群思维效应，减少观点多样性；AI评审分数可通过论文洗稿（即用LLM重写论文）轻易操纵，而无需依赖科学结果。
Conclusion: 非可操纵性和评审多样性是自动化的必要条件但非充分条件；解决同行评审危机需要建立评审自动化的科学基础，而非直接部署未经严格评估的通用LLM。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Instance-Level Costs for Nuanced Classifier Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Standard classification treats all errors equally, but in applications such as content moderation and medical screening, mistakes on clear-cut cases are more costly than errors on ambiguous ones. From a contextual bandit framework, we propose normalized excess cost (NEC), a metric that weighs classification errors by per-example costs and reduces to standard error rate when costs are uniform. Costs can derive from annotator vote margins, distance from decision thresholds, or confidence ratings. Across text, image, and tabular benchmarks, we find that NEC is often substantially lower than error rate: models with 5% error rate can achieve 1.8% NEC, revealing that most mistakes concentrate on ambiguous, low-cost examples. We also find that incorporating costs into training via loss weighting, sampling strategies, or regression yields inconsistent benefits. Our framework provides a practical methodology for deriving and evaluating instance-level misclassification costs, even if cost-sensitive training offers limited benefit.
papers.comment: v2: revised experiments and discussion; updated figures and appendix; corrected typos
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从上下文赌博机框架出发，提出归一化超额代价（NEC）指标，用于衡量分类器在实例级别上的误分类代价，并证明当代价统一时NEC退化为标准错误率。实验表明，在文本、图像和表格基准上，NEC常显著低于错误率（如5%错误率模型可达到1.8% NEC），说明大部分错误集中在模糊、低代价样本上。将代价纳入训练（如损失加权、采样策略或回归）的效果不一致。
Motivation: 标准分类将所有错误同等对待，但在内容审核、医疗筛查等应用中，清晰案例的错误代价远高于模糊案例，需要更细粒度的评估指标。
Method: 提出归一化超额代价（NEC）指标，利用每个样本的代价（如注释者投票边际、决策阈值距离或置信度评分）加权错误，并给出从上下文赌博机框架推导的理论基础。
Result: 在多个文本、图像和表格基准上，NEC通常远低于错误率；例如错误率为5%的模型可达1.8% NEC。而将代价纳入训练的方法（损失加权、采样策略、回归）并未带来一致改进。
Conclusion: NEC提供了一种实用的方法论来导出和评估实例级误分类代价，但代价敏感训练的效果有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fitting Horn DL Ontologies to ABox and Query Examples: A Tale of Simulation Quantifiers and Finite Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of fitting a description logic (DL) ontology to a given set of positive and negative examples that take the form of an ABox and a Boolean query. While previous work has investigated this problem for the expressive DLs ALC and ALCI, we here focus on the Horn DLs EL and ELI, as well as their extensions with the bottom concept. As the query language, we consider atomic queries (AQs), conjunctive queries (CQs), and unions thereof (UCQs). We provide characterization of the existence of a fitting ontology based on simulations, use them to develop decision procedures, and clarify the exact computational complexity. For AQs, the problem is in PTime for both EL and ELI. For CQs and UCQs, it is $Σ_2^P$-complete for EL and ExpTime-complete for ELI. Adding the bottom concept does not change any of these complexities. Interestingly, moving from ALC and ALCI to EL and ELI introduces additional technical challenges rather than simplifying the matter.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 23rd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KR2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究给定ABox和布尔查询的正负例，拟合Horn描述逻辑本体（EL和ELI）的问题。提供了基于模拟的存在性特征刻画，给出了决策过程并明确了计算复杂度：对于原子查询（AQ）问题在PTime内，对于合取查询（CQ）和UCQ，EL下为Σ_2^P-完全，ELI下为ExpTime-完全。添加底层概念不改变复杂度。与ALC/ALCI相比，EL/ELI带来了额外技术挑战。
Motivation: 之前研究关注ALC和ALCI的拟合问题，本文转向Horn DL（EL和ELI）及其扩展，填补了该方向的理论空白。
Method: 基于模拟（simulations）给出拟合本体存在的特征刻画，进而设计决策过程，并分析各情况下问题的计算复杂度。
Result: 对于AQ，EL和ELI均在PTime内；对于CQ和UCQ，EL下为Σ_2^P-完全，ELI下为ExpTime-完全；加入底层概念不改变复杂度。
Conclusion: Horn DL的拟合问题比ALC/ALCI更具挑战性，但问题复杂度并未因此降低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity
papers.abstract_en: Closed-source frontier labs do not disclose parameter counts. Storing F facts requires at least F/(bits per parameter) weights, so factual recall lower-bounds parameter count--an intrinsic, serving-independent signal, though (as we show) a coarse one. We introduce Incompressible Knowledge Probes (IKPs), a benchmark of 1,400 factual questions spanning 7 tiers of obscurity, designed to isolate knowledge that cannot be derived by reasoning or compressed by architectural improvements. We score with no hallucination penalty (lambda = 0: IKP accuracy is simply the fraction of probed facts answered correctly), which removes both the penalty hyperparameter and the per-tier flooring choice; a full lambda x flooring ablation shows the calibration is robust across scoring choices while individual estimates are not, motivating the no-penalty default. We calibrate a log-linear mapping from IKP accuracy to parameter count on 93 open-weight models (135M-1,600B) spanning 19 vendors, achieving R^2 = 0.910; leave-one-out cross-validation confirms generalization (median fold error 1.48x, 72% within 2x, 86% within 3x). The instrument is deliberately coarse--its 90% prediction interval spans ~3x in either direction, wider than inference economics--so IKP recovers order-of-magnitude effective capacity and relative rankings, not precise parameter counts. For Mixture-of-Experts models, total parameters predict knowledge (R^2 = 0.67) better than active parameters (R^2 = 0.41). We evaluate 201 models from 27 vendors on a curated probe set (1,311 of 1,400 probes surviving name-collision and label-ambiguity filters) and report effective knowledge capacity for all major proprietary frontier models as prediction bands rather than point estimates; for heavily safety-tuned models these are lower bounds, since refusal policy can suppress tens of percentage points of otherwise-answerable capacity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出不可压缩知识探针（IKP），通过1,400个事实问题（跨越7个难度层级）来估计黑盒大语言模型的参数数量。在93个开源模型（135M-1,600B参数）上校准对数线性映射，R²=0.910，留一法交叉验证中位数误差因子1.48倍。IKP提供数量级有效容量和相对排名，而非精确参数计数。
Motivation: 闭源前沿模型不公开参数量，而事实存储所需权重数下界参数数量，但现有信号粗糙。需要一种可靠、无需访问模型内部的黑盒估计方法。
Method: 设计IKP基准，包含1,400个事实问题，分为7个难度层级，旨在隔离无法通过推理或架构压缩获得的知识。采用无幻觉惩罚的准确率（lambda=0），并在93个开放权重模型上拟合对数线性映射。
Result: 对数线性映射R²=0.910，留一法交叉验证中位数误差因子1.48倍，72%在2倍内，86%在3倍内。MoE模型总参数预测知识（R²=0.67）优于活跃参数（R²=0.41）。对201个模型评估，给出前沿闭源模型的有效知识容量预测带。
Conclusion: IKP是一种粗略但有效的工具，能恢复模型知识容量的数量级和相对排名，但90%预测区间跨度约3倍，不适合精确参数估计。对于安全微调模型，IKP给出的是下界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kwai Summary Attention Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Long-context ability, has become one of the most important iteration direction of next-generation Large Language Models, particularly in semantic understanding/reasoning, code agentic intelligence and recommendation system. However, the standard softmax attention exhibits quadratic time complexity with respect to sequence length. As the sequence length increases, this incurs substantial overhead in long-context settings, leading the training and inference costs of extremely long sequences deteriorate rapidly. Existing solutions mitigate this issue through two technique routings: i) Reducing the KV cache per layer, such as from the head-level compression GQA, and the embedding dimension-level compression MLA, but the KV cache remains linearly dependent on the sequence length at a 1:1 ratio. ii) Interleaving with KV Cache friendly architecture, such as local attention SWA, linear kernel GDN, but often involve trade-offs among KV Cache and long-context modeling effectiveness. Besides the two technique routings, we argue that there exists an intermediate path not well explored: {Maintaining a linear relationship between the KV cache and sequence length, but performing semantic-level compression through a specific ratio $k$}. This $O(n/k)$ path does not pursue a ``minimum KV cache'', but rather trades acceptable memory costs for complete, referential, and interpretable retention of long distant dependency. Motivated by this, we propose Kwai Summary Attention (KSA), a novel attention mechanism that reduces sequence modeling cost by compressing historical contexts into learnable summary tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kwai Summary Attention (KSA)，一种新的注意力机制，通过在历史上下文中引入可学习的摘要令牌 (summary tokens) 以固定压缩率 k 对序列长度进行语义级压缩，在保持 KV 缓存与序列长度线性关系的同时，实现长距离依赖的完整、可参考和可解释的保留。
Motivation: 标准 softmax 注意力在长上下文场景下计算复杂度为序列长度的二次方，现有解决方案（如 GQA、MLA、SWA、GDN）要么 KV 缓存与序列长度保持 1:1 线性关系，要么在 KV 缓存与长上下文建模效果之间权衡。存在一条尚未充分探索的路径：以固定压缩率 k 进行语义级压缩，牺牲可接受的内存成本以换取完整的长距离依赖保留。
Method: 提出 Kwai Summary Attention (KSA)，通过将历史上下文压缩为可学习的摘要令牌，实现 O(n/k) 的序列建模成本，其中 k 为压缩率，摘要令牌保留远程依赖的完整、可参考和可解释信息。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的实验数值结果，仅提出方法动机和设计原理。
Conclusion: KSA 在保持 KV 缓存与序列长度线性关系的前提下，通过语义级压缩替代最小化 KV 缓存的思路，为长上下文建模提供了新的中间路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Query2Diagram: Answering Developer Queries with UML Diagrams
papers.abstract_en: Software documentation frequently becomes outdated or fails to exist entirely, yet developers need focused views of their codebase to understand complex systems. While automated reverse engineering tools can generate UML diagrams from code, they produce overwhelming detail without considering developer intent. We introduce query-driven UML diagram generation, where LLMs create diagrams that directly answer natural language questions about code. Unlike existing methods, our approach produces semantically focused diagrams containing only relevant elements with contextual descriptions. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-Coder-14B on a curated dataset of code files, developer queries, and corresponding diagram representations in a structured JSON format, evaluating with both automatic detection of structural defects and human assessment of semantic relevance. Results demonstrate that fine-tuning on a modest amount of manually corrected data yields dramatic improvements: our best model achieves the highest F1 scores while reducing defect rates below state-of-the-art LLMs, generating diagrams that are both structurally sound and semantically faithful to developer queries. Thus, we establish the feasibility of using LLMs for scalable contextual, on-demand documentation generation. We make our code and dataset publicly available at https://github.com/i-need-a-pencil/query2diagram.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出查询驱动的UML图生成方法Query2Diagram，通过微调Qwen2.5-Coder-14B在结构化JSON数据集上，使LLM能够根据自然语言查询生成语义聚焦的UML图。实验表明，微调后的模型在结构缺陷检测和语义相关性评估上取得最高F1分数，且缺陷率低于现有最先进LLM，证明了LLM用于可扩展的按需文档生成的可行性。
Motivation: 软件文档常过时或缺失，开发者需要聚焦的代码视图以理解复杂系统，而现有逆向工程工具生成UML图时包含过多细节且不考虑开发者意图。
Method: 提出查询驱动的方法，利用LLM根据开发者自然语言查询生成只包含相关元素和上下文描述的UML图；微调Qwen2.5-Coder-14B在一个由代码文件、查询和对应图表示（结构化JSON格式）构成的数据集上。
Result: 微调后的模型在自动检测结构缺陷和人工评估语义相关性上取得了最高F1分数，同时缺陷率低于现有最先进LLM（例如GPT-4等）。
Conclusion: 建立了一种使用LLM进行可扩展的、上下文相关的按需文档生成的可行性方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CorridorVLA: Explicit Spatial Constraints for Generative Action Heads via Sparse Anchors
papers.abstract_en: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often use intermediate representations to connect multimodal inputs with continuous control, yet spatial guidance is often injected implicitly through latent features. We propose CorridorVLA, which predicts sparse spatial anchors as incremental physical changes (e.g., end-effector $Δ$-positions) and uses them to impose an explicit tolerance region in the training objective for action generation. The anchors define a tolerance corridor that guides a flow-matching action head: trajectories whose implied spatial evolution falls outside the corridor receive corrective gradients, while trajectories within the corridor are refined by a consistency objective. CorridorVLA improves SmolVLA by 4.45 percentage points on LIBERO and improves SmolVLA and GR00T by 12.37 and 7.98 percentage points, respectively, on the more challenging LIBERO-Plus benchmark. Notably, under the same single-policy 4-in-1 setting, where one policy is jointly trained and evaluated across all task suites, GR00T-Corr achieves an 83.21% success rate. These results indicate that action-aligned physical cues can provide direct and interpretable constraints for generative action policies, complementing spatial guidance encoded in visual or latent forms. Code and released model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/lidc54/corridorVLA and https://huggingface.co/lidc/CorridorVLA.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CorridorVLA 通过预测稀疏空间锚点（spatial anchors）作为末端执行器的增量物理变化，并在训练目标中施加显式容差走廊（tolerance corridor），从而约束生成的动作轨迹。该方法基于流匹配动作头（flow-matching action head），对超出走廊的轨迹施加校正梯度，并在走廊内通过一致性目标进行细化。在 LIBERO 基准上，CorridorVLA 相比 SmolVLA 提升 4.45 个百分点；在更具挑战性的 LIBERO-Plus 上，分别提升 SmolVLA 和 GR00T 12.37 和 7.98 个百分点。在单策略 4-in-1 设置下，GR00T-Corr 达到 83.21% 的成功率。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型通常通过隐式潜在特征注入空间引导，缺乏直接且可解释的物理约束，导致动作生成可能偏离可行空间。
Method: 提出 CorridorVLA，使用稀疏空间锚点定义容差走廊，并结合流匹配动作头进行轨迹生成与校正，在训练中同时使用走廊外校正损失和走廊内一致性损失。
Result: 在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 基准上显著优于 SmolVLA 和 GR00T，分别提升 4.45/12.37/7.98 个百分点；单策略 4-in-1 设置下 GR00T-Corr 成功率 83.21%。
Conclusion: 与动作对齐的物理线索能为生成式动作策略提供直接且可解释的约束，补充视觉或隐式空间编码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StarTSE: Towards Streaming Target Speaker Extraction via Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing of Autoregressive Language Model
papers.abstract_en: While generative models have set new benchmarks for Target Speaker Extraction (TSE), their inherent reliance on global context precludes deployment in real-time applications. Direct adaptation to streaming scenarios often leads to catastrophic inference performance degradation due to the severe mismatch between training and streaming inference. To bridge this gap, we present the first autoregressive (AR) models tailored for streaming TSE. Our approach introduces a Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing Paradigm that ensures highly efficient and stable streaming inference. To ensure the coherence between the extracted speech segments, we design a historical context refinement mechanism that mitigates boundary discontinuities by leveraging historical information. Experiments on Libri2Mix show that while AR generative baseline exhibits performance degradation at low latencies, our approach maintains 100% stability and superior intelligibility. Furthermore, our streaming results are comparable to or even surpass offline baselines. Additionally, our model achieves a Real-Time-Factor (RTF) of 0.248 on consumer-level GPUs. This work provides empirical evidence that AR generative backbones are viable for latency-sensitive applications through the Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing Paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了首个适用于流式目标说话人提取（TSE）的自回归（AR）模型，通过引入分块交织拼接范式（Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing Paradigm）和上下文精炼机制，解决了AR模型在流式场景下因全局依赖导致的性能下降问题。在Libri2Mix上，该方法在低延迟下保持100%稳定性和优越的可理解性，且流式结果可与离线基线相媲美。
Motivation: 现有生成式模型在TSE中依赖全局上下文，无法用于实时应用；直接适配流式场景会导致严重的推理性能下降。
Method: 提出分块交织拼接范式，确保流式推理的高效稳定；设计历史上下文精炼机制，利用历史信息缓解边界不连续性。
Result: 在Libri2Mix上，AR生成基线在低延迟下性能下降，而该方法保持100%稳定性和优越的可理解性；流式结果可比肩甚至超越离线基线；在消费级GPU上实现0.248实时因子（RTF）。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了实证证据，证明通过分块交织拼接范式，AR生成骨干可用于延迟敏感应用。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有生成式模型在TSE中依赖全局上下文，无法用于实时应用；直接适配流式场景会导致严重的推理性能下降。
summary_sections.method: 提出分块交织拼接范式，确保流式推理的高效稳定；设计历史上下文精炼机制，利用历史信息缓解边界不连续性。
summary_sections.result: 在Libri2Mix上，AR生成基线在低延迟下性能下降，而该方法保持100%稳定性和优越的可理解性；流式结果可比肩甚至超越离线基线；在消费级GPU上实现0.248实时因子（RTF）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作提供了实证证据，证明通过分块交织拼接范式，AR生成骨干可用于延迟敏感应用。

papers.title: The Rise of Verbal Tics in Large Language Models: A Systematic Analysis Across Frontier Models
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to evolve through alignment techniques such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and Constitutional AI, a growing and increasingly conspicuous phenomenon has emerged: the proliferation of verbal tics--repetitive, formulaic linguistic patterns that pervade model outputs. These range from sycophantic openers ("That's a great question!", "Awesome!") to pseudo-empathetic affirmations ("I completely understand your concern", "I'm right here to catch you") and overused vocabulary ("delve", "tapestry", "nuanced"). In this paper, we present a systematic analysis of the verbal tic phenomenon across eight state-of-the-art LLMs: GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.3, Doubao-Seed-2.1-pro, Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and GLM-5.2. Utilizing a custom evaluation framework for standardized API-based evaluation, we assess 10,000 prompts across 10 task categories in both English and Chinese, yielding 160,000 model responses. We introduce the Verbal Tic Index (VTI), a composite metric quantifying tic prevalence, and analyze its correlation with sycophancy, lexical diversity, and human-perceived naturalness. Our findings reveal significant inter-model variation: Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibits the highest VTI (0.590), while DeepSeek V4 Pro achieves the lowest (0.295). We further demonstrate that verbal tics accumulate over multi-turn conversations, are amplified in subjective tasks, and show distinct cross-lingual patterns. Human evaluation (N = 120) confirms a strong inverse relationship between sycophancy and perceived naturalness (r = -0.87, p < 0.001). These results underscore the "alignment tax" of current training paradigms and highlight the urgent need for more authentic human-AI interaction frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了大语言模型在人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）和宪法AI等对齐技术下出现的口头禅现象（如“这是个好问题！”“我完全理解你的担忧”等重复性语言模式）。通过自定义评估框架对8个前沿模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8等）进行10,000条提示测试（含中英文），提出口头禅指数（VTI）并分析其与谄媚性、词汇多样性和自然感知度的关联。结果显示模型间差异显著（Gemini 3.1 Pro最高0.590，DeepSeek V4 Pro最低0.295），口头禅在多轮对话中累积，在主观任务中放大，且跨语言模式不同。人类评估（N=120）证实谄媚性与自然感知度呈强负相关（r=-0.87, p<0.001），凸显当前训练范式的“对齐代价”。
Motivation: LLM通过RLHF等对齐技术后出现越来越多重复、公式化的语言模式（口头禅），影响输出自然度和真实性，但缺乏系统性分析。
Method: 设计自定义评估框架，对8个LLM进行标准化API评估：10,000条提示覆盖10类任务（中英文），生成160,000条响应；提出口头禅指数（VTI）复合指标，并关联谄媚性、词汇多样性和人类自然度评分。
Result: Gemini 3.1 Pro的VTI最高（0.590），DeepSeek V4 Pro最低（0.295）；口头禅在多轮对话中累积，主观任务中更严重，中英文模式有差异；人类评估显示谄媚性与自然感知度强负相关（r=-0.87, p<0.001）。
Conclusion: 口头禅现象是当前对齐训练范式带来的“对齐代价”，亟需更真实的人机交互框架。

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation for EEG Foundation Models: A Systematic Study under Real-World Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models have shown strong potential for learning generalizable representations from large-scale neural data, yet their clinical deployment is hindered by distribution shifts across clinical settings, devices, and populations. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a promising solution by enabling models to adapt to unlabeled target data during inference without access to source data, a valuable property in healthcare settings constrained by privacy regulations and limited labeled data. However, its effectiveness for EEG remains largely underexplored. In this work, we introduce NeuroAdapt-Bench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating test-time adaptation methods on EEG foundation models under realistic distribution shifts. We evaluate representative TTA approaches from other domains across multiple pretrained foundation models, diverse downstream tasks, and heterogeneous datasets spanning in-distribution, out-of-distribution, and extreme modality shifts (e.g., Ear-EEG). Our results show that standard TTA methods yield inconsistent gains and often degrade performance, with gradient-based approaches particularly prone to heavy degradation. In contrast, optimization-free methods demonstrate greater stability and more reliable improvements. These findings highlight the limitations of existing TTA techniques in EEG, provide guidance for future development, and underscore the need for domain-specific adaptation strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了测试时自适应（TTA）方法在EEG基础模型上的效果，针对真实分布偏移场景。作者构建NeuroAdapt-Bench基准，评估多种TTA方法在多个预训练EEG模型、下游任务和异构数据集上的表现。结果表明标准TTA方法增益不一致且常导致性能下降，优化-free方法更稳定可靠。结论指出需要领域特定的自适应策略。
Motivation: EEG基础模型在临床部署中面临分布偏移（设备、人群等），TTA能在推理时用无标签目标数据适配，但此前在EEG上研究不足。
Method: 提出NeuroAdapt-Bench基准，评估多种TTA方法（来自其他领域）在多个预训练EEG基础模型、下游任务和异构数据集（包括分布内、分布外、极端模态如耳部EEG）上的表现。
Result: 标准TTA方法在EEG上增益不一致且常导致性能下降，尤其是基于梯度的方法；优化-free方法更稳定可靠。
Conclusion: 现有TTA技术用于EEG存在局限，需要发展领域特定的自适应策略。

papers.title: Don't Make Models Guess Security and Safety: Symbolic Guardrails for Domain-Specific AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: There is increasing interest in integrating AI agents that invoke tools into domain-specific commercial software, where unintended tool calls can cause serious security and safety incidents. This has drawn growing research attention, and many agent security and safety benchmarks have emerged. They implicitly shape how the community approaches security and safety. Yet existing work exhibits a blind spot: it emphasizes training-based methods and neural guardrails, which reduce the likelihood of insecure or unsafe actions but cannot guarantee their prevention. It generally overlooks opportunities for deductive, symbolic guardrails grounded in standard software engineering practices, which can provide guarantees for some security and safety requirements. Our study has three parts: (1) a systematic review of 80 agent security and safety benchmarks finding that that 85\% of benchmarks do not state verifiable requirements (61\% provide none, and 24\% give only high-level goals); (2) an applicability analysis of which security and safety requirements symbolic guardrails can and cannot enforce on $τ^2$-Bench, CAR-bench, and MedAgentBench, finding that 74\% of requirements are symbolically enforceable and 95\% of these need only simple, low-cost checks; and (3) an empirical evaluation of symbolic guardrails on the same three benchmarks, finding that symbolic guardrails improve security and safety without sacrificing utility, and often improve it. Our work draws attention to the potential for symbolic guardrails for AI agents, suggesting them as an overlooked but practical path toward deploying domain-specific AI agents in risk-averse commercial software. We release all codes and artifacts at https://github.com/hyn0027/agent-symbolic-guardrails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统回顾了80个AI智能体安全与安全基准，发现85%的基准未声明可验证需求；在三个领域特定基准上分析表明74%的安全需求可通过符号护栏（symbolic guardrails）强制执行，且95%只需要简单低成本检查；实证评估显示符号护栏在不牺牲效用的前提下提升了安全性。
Motivation: 现有研究偏向基于训练的方法和神经护栏，只能降低不安全行为概率而无法保证，忽视了基于标准软件工程实践的符号护栏的潜力。
Method: 提出符号护栏方法，基于演绎推理和软件工程实践，对智能体工具调用施加可验证的安全约束，并系统分析了基准中需求的可执行性。
Result: 在τ²-Bench、CAR-bench和MedAgentBench上，74%的安全需求可符号化执行，符号护栏在提升安全性的同时保持了与基线相当的效用。
Conclusion: 符号护栏是部署风险敏感商业软件中AI智能体的一个实际且被忽视的路径，能够为部分安全需求提供保证。

papers.title: CoopEval: Benchmarking Cooperation-Sustaining Mechanisms and LLM Agents in Social Dilemmas
papers.abstract_en: It is increasingly important that LLM agents interact effectively and safely with other goal-pursuing agents, yet, recent works report the opposite trend: LLMs with stronger reasoning capabilities behave _less_ cooperatively in mixed-motive games such as the prisoner's dilemma and public goods settings. Indeed, our experiments show that recent models -- with or without reasoning enabled -- consistently defect in single-shot social dilemmas. To tackle this safety concern, we present the first comparative study of game-theoretic mechanisms designed to enable cooperative outcomes between rational agents _in equilibrium_. Across four social dilemmas testing distinct components of robust cooperation, we evaluate four families of mechanisms: (1) repeating the game for many rounds, (2) reputation systems, (3) third-party mediators to delegate decision making to, and (4) contract agreements for outcome-conditional payments between players. Among our findings, we establish that contracting and mediation are most effective in achieving cooperative outcomes between capable LLM models, and that repetition-induced cooperation deteriorates drastically when co-players vary. Moreover, we demonstrate that the mechanisms become _more effective_ under evolutionary pressures to maximize individual payoffs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文首次比较研究了几种博弈论机制（重复博弈、声誉系统、第三方调解、合约协议）在促使LLM智能体在社交困境中合作的有效性。实验表明，合约和调解在强大LLM模型中实现合作结果最有效，而重复博弈在对手变化时合作下降。机制在进化压力下变得更有效。
Motivation: 现有LLM agent在混合动机博弈中表现出不合作趋势，随着推理能力增强反而更不合作，带来安全担忧。需要机制设计来保证合作。
Method: 在四个社交困境中测试四种机制：重复博弈、声誉系统、第三方调解、合约协议，并评估其效果。
Result: 合约和调解最有效，重复博弈在对手变化时效果下降，进化压力增强机制有效性。
Conclusion: 本文提供了促进LLM agent合作的机制比较，为安全交互提供指导。

papers.title: Multimodal Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition in Videos for Personalized Digital Health Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Using behavioural science, health interventions focus on behaviour change by providing a framework to help patients acquire and maintain healthy habits that improve medical outcomes. In-person interventions are costly and difficult to scale, especially in resource-limited regions. Digital health interventions offer a cost-effective approach, potentially supporting independent living and self-management. Automating such interventions, especially through machine learning, has recently gained considerable attention. Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) play a primary role for individuals to delay, avoid, or abandon health interventions. A/H are subtle and conflicting emotions that place a person in a state between positive and negative evaluations of a behaviour, or between acceptance and refusal to engage in it. They manifest as affective inconsistency across modalities or within a modality, such as language, facial, vocal expressions, and body language. While experts can be trained to recognize A/H, integrating them into digital health interventions is costly and less effective. Automatic A/H recognition is therefore critical for the personalization and cost-effectiveness of digital health interventions. Here, we explore the application of deep learning models for A/H recognition in videos, a multi-modal task by nature. In particular, this paper covers three learning setups: supervised learning, unsupervised domain adaptation for personalization, and zero-shot inference via large language models (LLMs). Our experiments are conducted on the unique and recently published BAH video dataset for A/H recognition. Our results show limited performance, suggesting that more adapted multi-modal models are required for accurate A/H recognition. Better methods for modeling spatio-temporal and multimodal fusion are necessary to leverage conflicts within/across modalities.

papers.title: When Can You Poison Rewards? A Tight Characterization of Reward Poisoning in Linear MDPs
papers.abstract_en: We study reward poisoning attacks in reinforcement learning (RL), where an adversary manipulates rewards within constrained budgets to force the target RL agent to adopt a policy that aligns with the attacker's objectives. Prior works on reward poisoning mainly focused on sufficient conditions to design a successful attacker, while only a few studies discussed the infeasibility of targeted attacks. This paper provides the first precise necessity and sufficiency characterization of the attackability of a linear MDP under reward poisoning attacks. Our characterization draws a bright line between the vulnerable RL instances, and the intrinsically robust ones which cannot be attacked without large costs even running vanilla non-robust RL algorithms. Our theory extends beyond linear MDPs -- by approximating deep RL environments as linear MDPs, we show that our theoretical framework effectively distinguishes the attackability and efficiently attacks the vulnerable ones, demonstrating both the theoretical and practical significance of our characterization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对线性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）下的奖励投毒攻击进行紧致刻画，给出了攻击可行性的充要条件。理论表明，有些RL实例天然鲁棒，即使使用非鲁棒算法也难以被低成本攻击；反之，脆弱实例则存在有效攻击。通过将深度RL环境近似为线性MDP，该框架能有效区分攻击性并高效攻击脆弱实例。
Motivation: 现有奖励投毒研究多关注攻击者成功的充分条件，缺乏对攻击不可行性的严格刻画。本文旨在精确界定线性MDP中哪些实例可被攻击，哪些本质鲁棒。
Method: 提出基于线性MDP的奖励投毒攻击充要条件分析，利用线性结构推导出攻击可行性的判据，并将理论推广至深度RL环境。
Result: 给出了线性MDP下奖励投毒攻击可行性的紧致充要条件，区分了脆弱与鲁棒实例，并通过近似线性MDP在深度RL环境中验证了理论的有效性和攻击效率。
Conclusion: 该工作首次为线性MDP下的奖励投毒提供了必要性结果，表明存在本质上无法被低成本攻击的RL实例，对设计鲁棒RL算法有指导意义。

papers.title: Council Mode: A Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Consensus Framework for Reducing LLM Hallucination and Bias
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated advanced capabilities but often suffer from factual inaccuracies (hallucinations) and systematic biases. These issues, sometimes amplified in specific architectures like Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) which motivate our work, pose risks for reliable deployment. To address these challenges, we propose the Council Mode, a multi-agent consensus framework. Our approach dispatches queries to multiple heterogeneous frontier LLMs in parallel and synthesizes their outputs using a dedicated consensus model. The pipeline consists of three phases: an intelligent triage for query complexity, parallel generation across diverse models, and a structured synthesis that identifies agreement, disagreement, and unique findings. In our evaluation, conducted under controlled no-web settings, the Council Mode achieved a 41.7% relative reduction in hallucination rates on a 1,200-sample HaluEval subset and a 7.5-point improvement on TruthfulQA compared to the top-performing individual model. On our curated MDR-500 multi-domain reasoning benchmark, the Council Mode achieved a Quality Score of 95.4%, representing a 9.2-point improvement over the best individual model. The framework also exhibited lower measured bias variance under our rubric-based evaluation protocol. We provide a cost-effectiveness analysis showing that the framework incurs a 4.2x token-cost overhead, making it most suitable for accuracy-prioritized applications where the cost of errors exceeds the added inference cost. These findings suggest that structured multi-agent consensus is a promising direction for enhancing the reliability and factual grounding of LLM-generated content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Council Mode，一种异构多智能体共识框架，通过并行查询多个不同的大语言模型（LLM）并利用专用共识模型合成输出，以减少幻觉和偏见。实验在无网络环境下进行，在 HaluEval 子集上将幻觉率相对降低 41.7%，在 TruthfulQA 上提升 7.5 分，在 MDR-500 基准上质量分数达 95.4%，较最优单模型提升 9.2 分。框架的 token 开销为 4.2 倍，适合精度优先的应用场景。
Motivation: 大语言模型存在事实不准确（幻觉）和系统性偏差，尤其在混合专家（MoE）等架构中可能被放大，影响可靠部署。现有方法未充分利用多模型共识来同时缓解这两个问题。
Method: 提出三阶段 pipeline：智能分诊（根据查询复杂度）、并行生成（多个异构前沿 LLM）、结构化合成（识别共识、分歧和独特发现）。采用专用共识模型融合输出。
Result: 在 1200 样本 HaluEval 子集上幻觉率相对降低 41.7%；TruthfulQA 得分提升 7.5 分；自建 MDR-500 多领域推理基准上质量分数达 95.4%（提升 9.2 分）；偏差方差更低；token 开销为 4.2 倍。
Conclusion: 结构化多智能体共识是提升 LLM 输出可靠性和事实性的有前景方向，尤其适用于错误成本高于推理成本的高精度场景。

papers.title: AViS-Mamba: Adaptive Visual Steering of Audio State-Space Dynamics for Violence Detection
papers.abstract_en: Automatic violence detection from video is challenging because violent interactions may be distant, occluded, or only partially visible. Audio can provide complementary evidence for violent events that are difficult to recognize from visual information alone. However, audio itself may be absent, dubbed, or dominated by environmental noise, making the central challenge not whether to incorporate audio but how to adapt reliance on it according to the visual scene. We introduce \emph{AViS-Mamba}, an audiovisual Mamba-based architecture in which the visual stream directly governs the behavior of the audio stream. At each layer of the audio encoder, a compact visual representation produces a modulation vector that conditions the encoder's internal temporal operators together with a routing gate that regulates the strength of this visual intervention. Rather than fusing or reweighting features after they have been extracted, visual context directly shapes the temporal dynamics of the audio encoder. We further propose Adaptive AV-InfoNCE, a contrastive objective that learns to balance the audio-to-video and video-to-audio alignment directions rather than weighting them uniformly. On the audio-valid NTU-CCTV and DVD benchmarks, AViS-Mamba establishes state-of-the-art results, attaining 88.59% and 75.74% accuracy. We demonstrate that adaptive visual conditioning consistently outperforms fixed routing and improves performance under degraded and missing-audio conditions. Layer-wise analysis further reveals that the model adapts the audio stream selectively across network depth rather than applying a single global routing policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AViS-Mamba，一种基于 Mamba 的视听暴力检测架构，其中视觉流通过调制向量和路由门控直接控制音频编码器的时序动态，并引入自适应 AV-InfoNCE 对比损失来平衡跨模态对齐。在 NTU-CCTV 和 DVD 基准上分别达到 88.59% 和 75.74% 的准确率，在音频退化或缺失条件下表现鲁棒。
Motivation: 暴力检测中音频可提供补充证据，但音频常缺失、配音或被环境噪声掩盖，因此需要根据视觉场景自适应地调整对音频的依赖程度，而非简单融合或后加权。
Method: 提出 AViS-Mamba 架构，在音频编码器的每一层，紧凑的视觉表示生成调制向量和路由门控，前者调节编码器的时序算子，后者控制视觉干预的强度；同时提出自适应 AV-InfoNCE 对比损失，学习非对称地平衡音频到视频和视频到音频的对齐方向。
Result: 在 NTU-CCTV 和 DVD 基准上取得当前最优结果，准确率分别为 88.59% 和 75.74%；自适应视觉条件优于固定路由，且在音频退化或缺失条件下仍保持较高性能。层分析显示模型在网络深度上选择性调整音频流。
Conclusion: 该工作表明视觉自适应调节音频编码器时序动态的策略在暴力检测中有效，且优于全局路由策略。

papers.title: Industrial3D: A Water-Treatment TLS Point Cloud Dataset and Cross-Paradigm Benchmark for MEP Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Automated semantic understanding of dense terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) point clouds is a prerequisite for Scan-to-BIM, digital twin maintenance, and as-built verifcation. Yet for operational industrial mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) facilities, this challenge remains largely unsolved: water-treatment TLS scans exhibit extreme geometric ambiguity, severe occlusion, and extreme class imbalance that architectural benchmarks such as S3DIS and ScanNet cannot adequately represent. We present Industrial3D, a terrestrial LiDAR dataset with 612.7 million expert-labeled points at 6 mm resolution from 20 room scenes, 13 dataset areas, and 7 operational water treatment facilities. At 6.6x the scale of the closest comparable MEP dataset, Industrial3D provides the largest industrial MEP testbed for within-domain scene understanding. We further establish a cross-paradigm benchmark of nine methods across fully supervised, weakly supervised, unsupervised, and foundation-model settings. The best supervised method reaches 55.74% mIoU, whereas zero-shot Point-SAM reaches 15.79%, a 39.95 percentage-point gap that quantifes unresolved domain transfer for industrial TLS data. Analysis attributes this gap to a dual crisis: 215:1 statistical rarity and cylindrical geometric ambiguity between tail classes and head-class pipes. The dataset, benchmark code, and pre-trained models will be publicly released at https://github.com/pointcloudyc/Industrial3D.
papers.journal_ref: 2026, under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Industrial3D，一个水处理设施的地面激光扫描（TLS）点云数据集，包含6.127亿个专家标注点，分辨率6mm，覆盖20个房间场景、13个区域和7个运营水处理设施。在此基础上建立了跨范式基准，评估了全监督、弱监督、无监督和基础模型共九种方法。最佳监督方法达到55.74% mIoU，而零样本Point-SAM仅为15.79%，差距达39.95个百分点，揭示了工业TLS数据域迁移的严重问题。
Motivation: 现有建筑点云基准（如S3DIS、ScanNet）无法充分代表水处理设施TLS扫描中极端的几何模糊、严重遮挡和类别不平衡问题，阻碍了MEP场景理解的自动化。
Method: 构建了大规模工业MEP点云数据集Industrial3D，并设计跨范式基准，涵盖全监督、弱监督、无监督和基础模型（如Point-SAM）设置，用于系统评估。
Result: 最佳监督方法mIoU为55.74%，零样本Point-SAM为15.79%，两者差距39.95个百分点。分析表明，差距源于尾部类别与头部管道类别之间215:1的统计稀有性和圆柱形几何模糊。
Conclusion: Industrial3D提供了最大的工业MEP场景理解测试平台，基准结果量化了当前方法在域迁移上的不足，数据集和代码将公开。

papers.title: Unsupervised Behavioral Compression: Learning Low-Dimensional Policy Manifolds through State-Occupancy Matching
papers.abstract_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is widely recognized as sample-inefficient, a limitation attributable in part to the high dimensionality and substantial functional redundancy inherent to the policy parameter space. A recent framework, which we refer to as Action-based Policy Compression (APC), mitigates this issue by compressing the parameter space $Θ$ into a low-dimensional latent manifold $\mathcal Z$ using a learned generative mapping $g:\mathcal Z \to Θ$. However, its performance is severely constrained by relying on immediate action-matching as a reconstruction loss, a myopic proxy for behavioral similarity that suffers from compounding errors across sequential decisions. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce Occupancy-based Policy Compression (OPC), which enhances APC by shifting behavior representation from immediate action-matching to long-horizon state-space coverage. Specifically, we propose two principal improvements: (1) we curate the dataset generation with an information-theoretic uniqueness metric that delivers a diverse population of policies; and (2) we propose a fully differentiable compression objective that directly minimizes the divergence between the true and reconstructed mixture occupancy distributions. These modifications force the generative model to organize the latent space around true functional similarity, promoting a latent representation that generalizes over a broad spectrum of behaviors while retaining most of the original parameter space's expressivity. Finally, we empirically validate the advantages of our contributions across multiple continuous control benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度强化学习中策略参数空间的高维性和冗余性，提出了一种基于占用匹配的无监督行为压缩方法（Occupancy-based Policy Compression, OPC）。OPC通过学习从低维潜在流形到策略参数空间的生成映射，并采用长期状态空间覆盖而非即时动作匹配作为重建损失，以提升策略压缩的效果。实验在多个连续控制基准上验证了方法的优势。
Motivation: 现有行动基策略压缩（APC）方法依赖即时动作匹配作为重建损失，导致复合误差和有限的泛化能力，难以准确捕捉行为的长期相似性。
Method: OPC方法包含两个改进：一是利用信息论唯一性度量策展数据集，以生成多样化的策略群体；二是提出全可微的压缩目标，直接最小化真实占用分布与重建占用分布之间的散度，迫使生成模型根据功能相似性组织潜在空间。
Result: 摘要在多个连续控制基准上证明了OPC相比APC的优越性，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: OPC通过长期状态空间覆盖替代即时动作匹配，提升了策略压缩的泛化性和表达力。

papers.title: i-IF-Learn: Iterative Feature Selection and Unsupervised Learning for High-Dimensional Complex Data
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised learning of high-dimensional data is challenging due to irrelevant or noisy features obscuring underlying structures. It's common that only a few features, called the influential features, meaningfully define the clusters. Recovering these influential features is helpful in data interpretation and clustering. We propose i-IF-Learn, an iterative unsupervised framework that jointly performs feature selection and clustering. Our core innovation is an adaptive feature selection statistic that effectively combines pseudo-label supervision with unsupervised signals, dynamically adjusting based on intermediate label reliability to mitigate error propagation common in iterative frameworks. Leveraging low-dimensional embeddings (PCA or Laplacian eigenmaps) followed by $k$-means, i-IF-Learn simultaneously outputs influential feature subset and clustering labels. Numerical experiments on gene microarray and single-cell RNA-seq datasets show that i-IF-Learn significantly surpasses classical and deep clustering baselines. Furthermore, using our selected influential features as preprocessing substantially enhances downstream deep models such as DeepCluster, UMAP, and VAE, highlighting the importance and effectiveness of targeted feature selection. Code is available at: [https://github.com/mc25800852/i_if_learn].
papers.comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, including appendix. Accepted at AISTATS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 i-IF-Learn，一种迭代式无监督学习框架，同时进行特征选择与聚类。核心是自适应特征选择统计量，结合伪标签与无监督信号，并动态调整以减轻误差传播。在基因微阵列和单细胞 RNA-seq 数据集上，该方法显著优于经典和深度聚类基线，且所选特征可提升 DeepCluster、UMAP、VAE 等下游模型性能。
Motivation: 高维数据中大量无关或噪声特征会掩盖真实簇结构，而仅有少数关键特征（influential features）对聚类有意义。恢复这些特征有助于数据解释和提升聚类效果。
Method: 提出 i-IF-Learn 迭代框架：利用自适应特征选择统计量融合伪标签监督信号与无监督信号，基于低维嵌入（PCA 或拉普拉斯特征映射）后接 k-means，同时输出关键特征子集和聚类标签。
Result: 在基因微阵列和单细胞 RNA-seq 数据集上，i-IF-Learn 显著超越经典及深度聚类基线；其选出的特征作为预处理步骤，能有效增强 DeepCluster、UMAP、VAE 等下游深度模型。
Conclusion: 论文强调，针对性的特征选择对于高维无监督学习至关重要，i-IF-Learn 提供了一种有效的联合框架。

papers.title: WorldMesh: Generating Navigable Multi-Room 3D Scenes via Mesh-Conditioned Image Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in image and video synthesis has inspired their use in advancing 3D scene generation. However, we observe that text-to-image and -video approaches struggle to maintain scene- and object-level consistency beyond a limited environment scale without a persistent, explicit geometric representation. We thus present a geometry-first approach that decouples this complex problem of large-scale 3D scene synthesis into its structural composition, represented as a mesh scaffold, and realistic appearance synthesis, which leverages powerful image synthesis models conditioned on the mesh scaffold. From an input text description, we first construct a mesh capturing the environment's geometry (walls, floors, etc.), and then use image synthesis, segmentation and object reconstruction to populate the mesh structure with objects in realistic layouts. This mesh scaffold is then rendered to condition image synthesis, providing a structural backbone for consistent appearance generation. This enables scalable, arbitrarily-sized 3D scenes of high object richness and diversity, combining robust 3D consistency with photorealistic detail. We believe this marks a significant step toward generating truly environment-scale, immersive 3D worlds.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种几何优先的方法 WorldMesh，将大规模3D场景合成解耦为结构组合（网格骨架）和外观合成（基于网格条件的图像扩散）。从文本描述先构建环境几何网格，再通过图像合成、分割和物体重建来填充布局，以生成可导航的多房间3D场景。方法支持任意规模、高物体丰富度的场景，兼具3D一致性和逼真细节。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像/视频方法在超出有限环境尺度时难以保持场景和物体一致性，缺乏持久的显式几何表示。
Method: 采用几何优先策略：先根据文本描述构建包含墙壁、地板等几何结构的网格，然后利用图像合成、分割和物体重建在网格中放置物体，最后渲染网格以条件化图像合成，提供结构骨架用于一致的外观生成。
Result: 该方法能够生成可扩展、任意大小的3D场景，具有高物体丰富度和多样性，同时保持鲁棒的3D一致性和逼真细节。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是向真正环境规模、沉浸式3D世界生成迈出的重要一步。

papers.title: SutureFormer: Learning Surgical Trajectories via Goal-conditioned Offline RL in Pixel Space
papers.abstract_en: Predicting surgical needle trajectories from endoscopic video is critical for robot-assisted suturing, enabling anticipatory planning, real-time guidance, and safer motion execution. Existing methods that directly learn motion distributions from visual observations tend to overlook the sequential dependency among adjacent motion steps. Moreover, sparse waypoint annotations often fail to provide sufficient supervision, further increasing the difficulty of supervised or imitation learning methods. To address these challenges, we formulate image-based needle trajectory prediction as a sequential decision-making problem, in which the needle tip is treated as an agent that moves step by step in pixel space. This formulation naturally captures the continuity of needle motion and enables the explicit modeling of physically plausible pixel-wise state transitions over time. From this perspective, we propose SutureFormer, a goal-conditioned offline reinforcement learning framework that leverages sparse annotations to dense reward signals via cubic spline interpolation, encouraging the policy to exploit limited expert guidance while exploring plausible future motion paths. SutureFormer encodes variable-length clips using an observation encoder to capture both local spatial cues and long-range temporal dynamics, and autoregressively predicts future waypoints through actions composed of discrete directions and continuous magnitudes. To enable stable offline policy optimization from expert demonstrations, we adopt Conservative Q-Learning with Behavioral Cloning regularization. Experiments on a new kidney wound suturing dataset containing 1,158 trajectories from 50 patients show that SutureFormer reduces Average Displacement Error by 58.6% compared with the strongest baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of modeling needle trajectory prediction as pixel-level sequential action learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SutureFormer，一个基于目标条件的离线强化学习框架，用于从内窥镜视频预测手术针轨迹。将针尖视为在像素空间中逐步移动的智能体，通过三次样条插值将稀疏标注转化为密集奖励信号，结合保守Q学习和行为克隆正则化实现稳定离线策略优化。在新构建的肾脏伤口缝合数据集上，平均位移误差比最强基线降低58.6%。
Motivation: 现有方法忽略相邻运动步骤的序列依赖性，且稀疏的路径点标注难以提供足够监督，增加了监督或模仿学习的难度。
Method: 将针轨迹预测建模为像素空间中的序列决策问题，采用目标条件离线强化学习：用三次样条插值生成密集奖励，通过观测编码器捕捉局部空间线索和长程时间动态，输出离散方向与连续幅度组成的动作，并使用带行为克隆正则化的保守Q学习进行策略优化。
Result: 在包含50名患者1158条轨迹的肾脏伤口缝合数据集上，SutureFormer的平均位移误差比最强基线降低58.6%。
Conclusion: 将针轨迹预测建模为像素级序列动作学习有效提升了预测精度，展示了离线强化学习在手术轨迹预测中的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Measuring 3D Spatial Geometric Consistency in Dynamic Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent generative models can produce high-fidelity videos, yet they often exhibit 3D spatial geometric inconsistencies. Existing evaluation methods fail to accurately characterize these inconsistencies: fidelity-centric metrics like FVD are insensitive to geometric distortions, while consistency-focused benchmarks often penalize valid foreground dynamics. To address this gap, we introduce SGC, a metric for evaluating 3D \textbf{S}patial \textbf{G}eometric \textbf{C}onsistency in dynamically generated videos. We quantify geometric consistency by measuring the divergence among multiple camera poses estimated from distinct local regions. Our approach first separates static from dynamic regions, then partitions the static background into spatially coherent sub-regions. We predict depth for each pixel, estimate a local camera pose for each subregion, and compute the divergence among these poses to quantify geometric consistency. Experiments on real and generative videos demonstrate that SGC robustly quantifies geometric inconsistencies, effectively identifying critical failures missed by existing metrics.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/tj12323/SGC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态视频生成中常见的3D空间几何不一致问题，提出了一种新的评估指标SGC（Spatial Geometric Consistency）。该方法通过分离静态与动态区域，将静态背景划分为空间连贯的子区域，估计每个子区域的相机姿态，并计算姿态之间的散度来衡量几何一致性。实验表明，SGC能够鲁棒地量化几何不一致，并识别出FVD等现有指标遗漏的关键失败案例。
Motivation: 现有视频生成评估指标（如FVD）对几何失真不敏感，而一致性基准常错误惩罚有效的前景动态，缺乏对3D空间几何一致性的准确刻画。
Method: SGC先分离静态与动态区域，再将静态背景划分为空间连贯的子区域；对每个像素预测深度，为每个子区域估计局部相机姿态，最后计算这些姿态之间的散度作为几何一致性度量。
Result: 在真实视频和生成视频上的实验表明，SGC能鲁棒地量化几何不一致，有效识别现有指标遗漏的关键失败。
Conclusion: SGC提供了一种新的视角来评估视频生成中的3D几何一致性，有望推动生成模型在几何真实性上的改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Language Generation with Replay: A Learning-Theoretic View of Model Collapse
papers.abstract_en: As scaling laws push the training of frontier large language models (LLMs) toward ever-growing data requirements, training pipelines are approaching a regime where much of the publicly available online text may be consumed. At the same time, widespread LLM usage increases the volume of machine-generated content on the web; together, these trends raise the likelihood of generated text re-entering future training corpora, increasing the associated risk of performance degradation often called model collapse. In practice, model developers address this concern through data cleaning, watermarking, synthetic-data policies, or, in some cases, blissful ignorance. However, the problem of model collapse in generative models has not been examined from a learning-theoretic perspective: we study it through the theoretical lens of the language generation in the limit framework, introducing a replay adversary that augments the example stream with the generator's own past outputs. Our main contribution is a fine-grained learning-theoretic characterization of when replay fundamentally limits generation: while replay is benign for the strongest notion of uniform generation, it provably creates separations for the weaker notions of non-uniform generation and generation in the limit. Interestingly, our positive results mirror heuristics widely used in practice, such as data cleaning, watermarking, and output filtering, while our separations show when these ideas can fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从学习理论视角研究生成模型中因自生成数据导致的模型崩溃问题，通过语言生成极限框架，引入回放对手（replay adversary）来模拟自生成数据的影响。主要理论贡献是：对最强的一致性生成（uniform generation），回放不会造成限制；但对较弱的非一致性生成（non-uniform generation）和极限生成（generation in the limit），回放会带来根本性的性能分离。正结果对应数据清洗、水印等实践，而分离表明这些方法的失败条件。
Motivation: 现有关于模型崩溃的研究缺乏学习理论分析，而大规模LLM训练中自生成数据不可避免，需要从理论角度理解何时回放（replay）会损害生成能力。
Method: 采用语言生成极限框架，定义回放对手（replay adversary），该对手将生成器自身的历史输出作为额外示例注入训练流，从而建模自生成数据的影响。
Result: 回放对一致性生成无害，但对非一致性生成和极限生成两个较弱的概念会引发根本性分离，即存在无法通过回放学习与无回放学习的生成任务。
Conclusion: 正向结果验证了数据清洗、水印、输出过滤等启发式方法在学习理论上的合理性；而分离结果则揭示了这些方法在特定条件下失效的边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Learning Network-Temporal Models For Traffic Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of multivariate time series is essential for emerging network intelligent control, observability, and management functions. Existing statistical-based and shallow machine learning models have shown limited prediction capabilities on multivariate time series. They prioritize improvements in average prediction accuracy, while overlooking heterogeneous dependency structures and performance variability across individual time series. Recent advances in large language models have introduced new directions for multivariate time series forecasting; however, their application in conjunction with explicit structural dependency modeling remains relatively underexplored, especially in networked environments. In this paper, we present a topology-aware learning framework for large-scale network traffic prediction that explicitly models both temporal dynamics and structural dependencies in multivariate network time series. We first investigate a graph attention model designed to capture topology-induced correlations among network traffic time series. We then evaluate a fine-tuned large language model-based representations for improved generalization across heterogeneous traffic patterns. To further address the diversity of cross-correlations in high-dimensional traffic data, we introduce a clustering-based preprocessing stage that groups traffic flows with similar dependency characteristics prior to model training, reducing input complexity and improving learning stability. Experiments on real backbone traffic data show consistent improvements over statistical and recurrent neural network baselines. In addition to average accuracy, we evaluate performance across individual time series and observe reduced variability in prediction quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种拓扑感知的学习框架用于大规模网络流量预测，显式建模多元时间序列中的时间动态和结构依赖。通过图注意力模型捕捉拓扑相关、微调大语言模型表示以泛化异质模式，并引入聚类预处理降低复杂度。在真实骨干流量数据上优于统计和RNN基线，且减少预测质量的变异性。
Motivation: 现有模型忽略多元时间序列的异质依赖结构和性能变异性，且大语言模型与显式结构依赖建模的结合在网络环境中探索不足。
Method: 提出包含图注意力模型（捕捉拓扑相关）、微调的大语言模型表示（泛化异质模式）和聚类预处理（分组相似依赖特征）的框架。
Result: 在真实骨干流量数据上，该方法持续优于统计和循环神经网络基线，并在保持平均准确率的同时减少了各时间序列预测质量的变异性。
Conclusion: 该拓扑感知框架能有效提升网络流量预测的准确性和稳定性，但摘要未提及其在非网络时间序列上的适用性。

summary_sections.result: 在真实骨干流量数据上，该方法持续优于统计和循环神经网络基线，并在保持平均准确率的同时减少了各时间序列预测质量的变异性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该拓扑感知框架能有效提升网络流量预测的准确性和稳定性，但摘要未提及其在非网络时间序列上的适用性。

papers.title: SVG-EAR: Parameter-Free Linear Compensation for Sparse Video Generation via Error-aware Routing
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a leading backbone for video generation, yet their quadratic attention cost remains a major bottleneck. Sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only a subset of attention blocks. However, prior methods often either drop the remaining blocks, which incurs information loss, or rely on learned predictors to approximate them, introducing training overhead and potential output distribution shifting. In this paper, we show that the missing contributions can be recovered without training: after semantic clustering, keys and values within each block exhibit strong similarity and can be well summarized by a small set of cluster centroids. Based on this observation, we introduce SVG-EAR, a parameter-free linear compensation branch that uses the centroid to approximate skipped blocks and recover their contributions. While centroid compensation is accurate for most blocks, it can fail on a small subset. Standard sparsification typically selects blocks by attention scores, which indicate where the model places its attention mass, but not where the approximation error would be largest. SVG-EAR therefore performs error-aware routing: a lightweight probe estimates the compensation error for each block, and we compute exactly the blocks with the highest error-to-cost ratio while compensating for skipped blocks. We provide theoretical guarantees that relate attention reconstruction error to clustering quality, and empirically show that SVG-EAR improves the quality-efficiency trade-off and increases throughput at the same generation fidelity on video diffusion tasks. Overall, SVG-EAR establishes a clear Pareto frontier over prior approaches, achieving up to 1.77$\times$ and 1.93$\times$ speedups while maintaining PSNRs of up to 29.759 and 31.043 on Wan2.2 and HunyuanVideo, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散变换器(DiTs)在视频生成中二次注意力成本过高的问题，提出SVG-EAR，一种无参数线性补偿方法。通过语义聚类后键值的质心近似跳过的注意力块，并利用误差感知路由选择计算误差-成本比最高的块，从而在不需训练的情况下提升生成效率。实验表明，SVG-EAR在Wan2.2和HunyuanVideo上分别实现最高1.77倍和1.93倍加速，同时保持PSNR高达29.759和31.043。
Motivation: 稀疏注意力可降低DiTs的二次成本，但现有方法要么丢弃块导致信息损失，要么依赖学习预测器引入训练开销和分布偏移。
Method: 提出无参数线性补偿分支，利用聚类质心近似跳过的注意力块；并设计误差感知路由，通过轻量探针估计补偿误差，精确计算高误差-成本比的块。
Result: 在Wan2.2和HunyuanVideo上，SVG-EAR在保持高PSNR（最高29.759和31.043）下实现1.77×和1.93×加速，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: SVG-EAR证明了缺失注意力贡献可通过无训练聚类质心恢复，误差感知路由进一步改善了质量-效率权衡，且提供了理论保证。

papers.title: AULLM++: Structured-Token-Conditioned Large Language Models for Micro-Expression Action Unit Detection
papers.abstract_en: Micro-expression Action Unit (AU) detection identifies localized AUs from subtle facial muscle activations, providing a foundation for decoding affective cues. Previous methods face three key limitations: (1) heavy reliance on low-density visual information, rendering discriminative evidence vulnerable to background noise; (2) coarse-grained feature processing that misaligns with the demand for fine-grained representations; and (3) neglect of inter-AU correlations, restricting the parsing of complex expression patterns. We propose AULLM++, a reasoning-oriented framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), which injects visual features into textual prompts as actionable semantic premises to guide inference. It formulates AU prediction into three stages: evidence construction, structure modeling, and deduction-based prediction. Specifically, a Multi-Granularity Evidence-Enhanced Fusion Projector (MGE-EFP) fuses mid-level texture cues with high-level semantics, distilling them into a compact Content Token (CT). Furthermore, inspired by micro- and macro-expression AU correspondence, we encode AU relationships as a sparse structural prior and learn interaction strengths via a Relation-Aware AU Graph Neural Network (R-AUGNN), producing an Instruction Token (IT). We then fuse CT and IT into a structured textual prompt and introduce Counterfactual Consistency Regularization (CCR) to construct counterfactual samples, enhancing the model's generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate AULLM++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks and exhibits superior cross-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AULLM++框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）进行微表情动作单元（AU）检测。通过多粒度证据融合投影器（MGE-EFP）和关系感知图神经网络（R-AUGNN），将视觉特征注入文本提示，并采用反事实一致性正则化（CCR）增强泛化。在标准基准上达到最优性能，并表现出跨域泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖低密度视觉信息、粗粒度特征处理以及忽略AU间相关性，导致在微表情AU检测中表现不佳。
Method: 提出三阶段推理框架：证据构建、结构建模和演绎预测。包括MGE-EFP融合纹理与语义特征生成内容令牌（CT），R-AUGNN学习AU关系生成指令令牌（IT），以及CCR构造反事实样本提升泛化。
Result: 在标准基准上达到最先进性能，并展现出优越的跨域泛化能力。
Conclusion: LLM结合结构化令牌和AU关系建模能有效提升微表情AU检测的准确性和鲁棒性。
