papers.title: Language-Guided Grasping under Partial Observation for Mobile Manipulation in Field Inspection and Maintenance
papers.abstract_en: Offshore inspection and maintenance have increasingly been using legged robots for routine sensing, yet many useful interventions still require physical interaction with tools, containers, and task-relevant objects. Employing robots for these tasks can reduce operators' exposure in confined, elevated, or potentially explosive areas. This paper presents a language-guided grasping pipeline for a legged mobile manipulator operating under partial observation. An operator defines the target, the system grounds it in RGB with open-vocabulary detection and promptable segmentation, extracts an object-centric RGB-D point cloud, improves sparse geometry through depth compensation and point-cloud completion, and selects a 6-DoF grasp using collision, clearance, reachability, and approach constraints. The system is implemented on a quadruped robot with an arm and evaluated in two cluttered tabletop scenes motivated by small-object retrieval during inspection and maintenance. Across paired trials, the proposed pipeline achieved 9/10 successful grasps, compared with 3/10 for a view-dependent deployment baseline. In this controlled setting, object-centric completion and execution-aware selection reduced approach collisions and improved the reliability of language-guided grasping for supervised field manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种语言引导的抓取管线，用于在部分观测条件下四足移动机械臂进行现场检测与维护。系统通过开放词汇检测、可提示分割和点云补全来抓取目标物体，在杂乱桌面场景中达到9/10成功率，相比基线3/10有显著提升。
Motivation: 海上检测与维护中，操作员常需在受限或危险区域与工具交互，现有机器人缺乏可靠的语言引导抓取能力，尤其面对部分观测和杂乱场景。
Method: 基于语言指令，通过开放词汇检测和可提示分割在RGB图像中定位目标，提取物体中心RGB-D点云，进行深度补偿和点云补全改善稀疏几何，再结合碰撞、间隙、可达性和接近约束选择6自由度抓取。
Result: 在两例杂乱桌面场景中，所提管线完成9/10成功抓取，而依赖视角的基线仅3/10。
Conclusion: 物体中心点云补全和执行感知的抓取选择减少了接近碰撞，提升了语言引导抓取在监督式现场操作中的可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LAW & ORDER: Adaptive Spatial Weighting for Medical Diffusion and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image analysis depends on accurate segmentation and controllable synthesis, but both tasks face severe spatial imbalance: lesions occupy small regions against large backgrounds. We study adaptive spatial weighting as a task-level design principle and instantiate it in two adapters. LAW learns per-pixel loss weights for mask-conditioned diffusion by modulating a ratio prior with a feature-dependent delta map, with normalization, clamping, and Dice regularization for stability. ORDER improves lightweight segmentation by adding selective bidirectional skip attention with stage-wise confidence gating. On held-out diffusion test sets, LAW lowers FID from 158.13$\pm$0.15 to 108.43$\pm$0.71 on Polyps, from 144.13$\pm$0.31 to 89.51$\pm$0.96 on KiTS19, and from 139.22$\pm$0.38 to 112.58$\pm$0.68 on BRISC, while improving held-out mask-recovery Dice from 0.681$\pm$0.013 to 0.825$\pm$0.003 on Polyps. When the resulting images are added to nnUNet training, downstream Polyps mDice rises from 71.7$\pm$0.4 to 74.1$\pm$0.8. On the cleaned Polyps segmentation protocol, the reported ORDER configuration reaches 76.3$\pm$1.9 mDice and 67.2$\pm$2.0 mIoU at 42K parameters and 0.11 GFLOPs, versus 70.3$\pm$1.5 mDice and 59.9$\pm$1.7 mIoU for matched MK-UNet. On BRISC under the same training recipe, ORDER reaches 77.4$\pm$0.8 mDice and 68.1$\pm$0.7 mIoU. These results position adaptive spatial weighting as a practical design idea for both medical diffusion and efficient segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学图像分析中的空间不平衡问题，提出自适应空间权重作为任务级设计原则，并实例化为两个适配器：LAW用于掩膜条件扩散的每像素损失权重，ORDER用于轻量级分割的注意力门控。实验表明，在多个医学数据集上，LAW显著降低FID（如Polyps数据集从158.13降至108.43），ORDER以42K参数和0.11GFLOPs达到76.3 mDice，优于可比基线。
Motivation: 医学图像中病变区域小、背景大，存在严重空间不平衡，现有方法未充分利用空间权重来改善分割和扩散性能。
Method: 提出两个适配器：LAW通过学习每像素损失权重（调制比率先验与特征相关delta图，含归一化、裁剪和Dice正则化）用于掩膜条件扩散；ORDER通过选择性双向跳跃注意力与阶段级置信门控改进轻量级分割。
Result: LAW在Polyps、KiTS19、BRISC数据集上分别将FID从158.13、144.13、139.22降至108.43、89.51、112.58；ORDER在Polyps上达到76.3 mDice和67.2 mIoU（42K参数，0.11GFLOPs），在BRISC上达77.4 mDice和68.1 mIoU。下游nnUNet训练后Polyps mDice从71.7提升至74.1。
Conclusion: 自适应空间权重是一种实用设计思路，可同时改善医学扩散和高效分割的效率与性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OSF: On Pre-training and Scaling of Sleep Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Polysomnography (PSG) provides the gold standard for sleep assessment but suffers from substantial heterogeneity across recording devices and cohorts. There have been growing efforts to build general-purpose foundation models (FMs) for sleep physiology, but lack an in-depth understanding of the pre-training process and scaling patterns that lead to more generalizable sleep FMs. To fill this gap, we curate a massive corpus of 166,500 hours of sleep recordings from nine public sources and establish SleepBench, a comprehensive, fully open-source benchmark. Leveraging SleepBench, we systematically evaluate four families of self-supervised pre-training objectives and uncover three critical findings: (1) existing FMs fail to generalize to missing channels at inference; (2) channel-invariant feature learning is essential for pre-training; and (3) scaling sample size, model capacity, and multi-source data mixture consistently improves downstream performance.With an enhanced pre-training and scaling recipe, we introduce OSF, a family of sleep FMs that achieves state-of-the-art performance across nine datasets on diverse sleep and disease prediction tasks. Further analysis of OSF also reveals intriguing properties in sample efficiency, hierarchical aggregation, and cross-dataset scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多导睡眠图（PSG）的异质性，构建大规模睡眠记录语料库（166,500小时）和开源基准SleepBench，系统评估四类自监督预训练目标，发现现有基础模型无法泛化到缺失通道、通道不变特征学习至关重要、以及扩展样本量、模型容量和多源数据混合持续提升性能。基于改进的预训练和扩展策略，提出OSF系列睡眠基础模型，在九个数据集上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有睡眠基础模型缺乏对预训练过程和扩展模式的深入理解，导致泛化性不足。
Method: 构建大规模睡眠语料库和SleepBench基准，系统比较四类自监督预训练目标，并开发结合通道不变特征学习和扩展策略的OSF模型。
Result: OSF在九个数据集上的睡眠和疾病预测任务中达到最先进性能，并在样本效率、层次聚合和跨数据集扩展方面展现有趣特性。
Conclusion: 论文强调了通道不变特征学习和数据规模扩展对于睡眠基础模型泛化性的重要性。

papers.title: Endogenous Resistance to Activation Steering in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can recover mid-generation from task-misaligned activation steering, producing explicit verbal restarts (e.g., ``wait, that's not right'') and continuing on-topic even while the steering perturbation remains active. We term this Endogenous Steering Resistance (ESR). Using sparse autoencoder (SAE) latents to steer model activations, we find that Llama-3.3-70B exhibits explicit ESR at 3.8%, with smaller models from the Llama-3 and Gemma-2 families showing the explicit form less frequently. Two controls dissociate ESR into a detection event and a sustained-resistance component that conditioning on recent on-topic tokens does not fully explain. We identify 26 SAE latents through contrastive on-topic/off-topic search; zero-ablating them reduces the multi-attempt rate by 25%, with random-latent and held-out-prompt controls supporting specificity. ESR can also be deliberately enhanced through both meta-prompting and fine-tuning on synthetic self-correction examples. ESR has dual implications for safety: it could harden models against adversarial activation-space manipulation, but may equally interfere with beneficial steering-based interventions, since the model has no way to distinguish the two. Code is available at https://github.com/agencyenterprise/endogenous-steering-resistance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大型语言模型能够在激活转向（activation steering）扰动下恢复，产生显式言语重启（如“等等，那不对”）并继续话题，称为内生性转向抵抗（ESR）。通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）潜变量进行实验，Llama-3.3-70B显式ESR发生率为3.8%，识别了26个相关SAE潜变量，零消融后多尝试率降低25%。ESR可通过元提示和微调增强，对安全性有双重影响。
Motivation: 激活转向可能被用于对抗性操控，但模型能否抵抗这种操控尚未被系统研究，且其机制和安全影响未知。
Method: 使用SAE潜变量对Llama和Gemma系列模型进行激活转向，通过对比搜索识别与ESR相关的潜变量，并进行零消融实验；另通过元提示和微调增强ESR。

Conclusion: ESR可被故意增强，对安全性有双重影响：既可抵御对抗性激活操控，也可能干扰有益干预。

papers.title: Alleviating Sparse Rewards by Modeling Step-Wise and Long-Term Sampling Effects in Flow-Based GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Deploying GRPO on Flow Matching models has proven effective for text-to-image generation. However, existing paradigms typically propagate an outcome-based reward to all preceding denoising steps without distinguishing the local effect of each step. Moreover, current group-wise ranking mainly compares trajectories at matched timesteps and ignores within-trajectory dependencies, where certain early denoising actions can affect later states via delayed, implicit interactions. We propose TurningPoint-GRPO (TP-GRPO), a GRPO framework that alleviates step-wise reward sparsity and explicitly models long-term effects within the denoising trajectory. TP-GRPO makes two key innovations: (i) it replaces outcome-based rewards with step-level incremental rewards, providing a dense, step-aware learning signal that better isolates each denoising action's "pure" effect, and (ii) it identifies turning points-steps that flip the local reward trend and make subsequent reward evolution consistent with the overall trajectory trend-and assigns these actions an aggregated long-term reward to capture their delayed impact. Turning points are detected solely via sign changes in incremental rewards, making TP-GRPO efficient and hyperparameter-free. Extensive experiments also demonstrate that TP-GRPO exploits reward signals more effectively and consistently improves generation. Demo code is available at https://github.com/YunzeTong/TurningPoint-GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Flow Matching模型上部署GRPO时奖励稀疏的问题，提出TurningPoint-GRPO（TP-GRPO），通过步骤级增量奖励和转折点检测来提供密集学习信号并建模长期依赖。实验表明该方法能更有效利用奖励信号，提升文本到图像生成质量。
Motivation: 现有GRPO在Flow Matching中仅将结果奖励均匀回传至所有去噪步骤，忽略各步骤局部效应和轨迹内时序依赖，导致奖励稀疏且难以捕捉早期动作的延迟影响。
Method: 提出TP-GRPO，包含两个创新：(i) 用步骤级增量奖励替代全局结果奖励，提供步骤感知的密集信号；(ii) 通过增量奖励符号变化检测转折点，为其分配聚合长期奖励以捕捉延迟影响。该方法无需超参数。
Result: 实验显示TP-GRPO更有效利用奖励信号，在文本到图像生成任务上持续提升性能。
Conclusion: 通过步骤级奖励和转折点机制，TP-GRPO缓解了稀疏奖励问题，为Flow Matching的GRPO训练提供高效且无需调参的改进方案。

papers.title: Stage-wise Attention-Guided Region Sequencing for Adversarial Attacks on Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Targeted adversarial attacks on Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) test whether small image perturbations can steer model responses toward attacker-specified content. Under the standard L-infinity constraint, targeted attacks become a regional perturbation budget allocation problem: attack success depends not only on the perturbation objective, but also on which regions receive updates and in what order. Existing localized attacks improve over global perturbations but rely on stochastic spatial sampling, often updating weakly influential regions. We address this limitation through an attention-based analysis showing that cross-modal attention identifies adversarially sensitive regions and that perturbing high-attention hotspots induces predictable redistribution toward subsequent salient regions. These findings motivate attention-guided region sequencing, which begins from dominant hotspots and progressively moves the update support toward next-salient regions. Based on these principles, we propose Stage-wise Attention-Guided Attack (SAGA), a black-box region-sequencing framework that uses a fixed attention map from an open-source LVLM to guide perturbation updates without accessing target-model parameters, gradients, or attention maps. Across ten closed-source and open-source LVLMs, SAGA achieves state-of-the-art attack success rates and the best overall imperceptibility. The source code is available at https://github.com/jaehyun-kwak/SAGA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的白盒/黑盒目标对抗攻击，提出一种基于注意力引导的区域排序攻击方法SAGA。通过分析跨模态注意力图，发现高注意力区域对扰动敏感，且扰动高注意力区域会促使后续显著区域重新分布，据此设计分阶段注意力引导攻击策略。在十种开源和闭源LVLM上，SAGA取得了最优的攻击成功率与隐蔽性。
Motivation: 现有局部攻击依赖随机空间采样，常更新弱影响区域，导致攻击效率低。目标是利用跨模态注意力信息识别对抗敏感区域，并设计有序的扰动更新策略。
Method: 基于一个开源LVLM的固定注意力图，分阶段地从主导热点区域开始，逐步将扰动支撑区域移动到下一显著区域，实现黑盒攻击（无需目标模型参数、梯度或注意力图）。
Result: 在十个闭源和开源LVLM上，SAGA达到了最高的攻击成功率和最佳的整体隐蔽性（imperceptibility）。
Conclusion: 注意力引导的区域排序可以有效提升LVLM对抗攻击的效果，且该方法不依赖目标模型内部信息，具有黑盒实用性。

papers.title: Resolving Primitive-Sharing Ambiguity in Long-Tailed TLS-Based Industrial MEP Point Cloud Segmentation via Spatial Context Constraints
papers.abstract_en: In terrestrial laser scanning (TLS)-based mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) point cloud segmentation, safety-critical components such as reducers and valves are persistently misclassifed, blocking reliable engineering knowledge extraction. This stems from a dual crisis--extreme class imbalance (215:1) compounded by geometric ambiguity, since most tail classes share cylindrical primitives with dominant head classes--that existing frequencybased re-weighting methods cannot resolve. We propose spatial context constraints that exploit neighborhood prediction consistency to disambiguate locally similar structures. Our approach extends Class-Balanced (CB) Loss with two architecture-agnostic mechanisms: Boundary-CB, an entropy-based constraint that emphasizes ambiguous boundaries and encodes an MEP assemblytopology prior, and Density-CB, a density-based constraint that compensates for scan-dependent variations and encodes TLS sensor-physics knowledge. Both operate at the loss level and integrate into existing pipelines without backbone modifcations. On the Industrial3D dataset (612.7M labelled points from water treatment facilities), our method achieves 55.74% mIoU, exceeding the strongest of three representative fully supervised backbone baselines (39.83-52.48% mIoU), with a 21.7% relative improvement on tail-class performance (29.59% vs. 24.32%) while preserving head-class accuracy (88.14%). Components with primitive-sharing ambiguity show strong gains: reducer improves from 0% to 21.12% IoU, and valve improves by 24.3% relative. These results show that spatial context constraints reduce primitive-sharing errors in the target industrial MEP setting and support more reliable identifcation of safety-critical components for Digital Twin and Scan-to-BIM applications. Code: https://github.com/PointCloudYC/LongTail3D.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对TLS工业MEP点云分割中安全关键部件（如减速器、阀门）因类别极度不平衡（215:1）和几何歧义（尾类与头类共享圆柱基本体）导致的持续错误分类问题，提出空间上下文约束方法，包括Boundary-CB和Density-CB两种损失级机制，在Industrial3D数据集上实现55.74% mIoU，尾类性能相对提升21.7%，减速器IoU从0%提升至21.12%。
Motivation: 现有方法无法解决极端类不平衡和原始共享歧义并存的问题，导致安全关键部件（如减速器、阀门）持续被误分类，阻碍可靠工程知识提取。
Method: 提出空间上下文约束，扩展Class-Balanced Loss，引入两个与架构无关的机制：Boundary-CB（基于熵的约束，强调歧义边界并编码MEP装配拓扑先验）和Density-CB（基于密度的约束，补偿扫描变化并编码TLS传感器物理知识），均在损失层操作，无需修改骨干网络。
Result: 在Industrial3D数据集上达到55.74% mIoU，超过三种全监督骨干基线（39.83-52.48% mIoU），尾类性能相对提升21.7%（24.32%→29.59%），头类精度保持88.14%。减速器IoU从0%提升至21.12%，阀门相对提升24.3%。
Conclusion: 空间上下文约束能够减少原始共享错误，提高安全关键部件的识别可靠性，适用于数字孪生和Scan-to-BIM应用。

papers.title: The Rise of Large Language Models and the Direction and Impact of US Federal Research Funding
papers.abstract_en: Federal research funding shapes the direction, diversity, and impact of the US scientific enterprise. Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly diffusing into scientific practice, holding substantial promise while raising widespread concerns. Despite growing attention to AI use in scientific writing and evaluation, little is known about how the rise of LLMs is reshaping the public funding landscape. Here, we examine LLM involvement at key stages of the federal funding pipeline by combining two complementary data sources: confidential National Science Foundation (NSF) and National Institutes of Health (NIH) proposal submissions from two large US R1 universities, including funded, unfunded, and pending proposals, and the full population of publicly released NSF and NIH awards. We find that LLM use rises sharply beginning in 2023 and exhibits a bimodal distribution, indicating a clear split between minimal and substantive use. Across both private submissions and public awards, higher LLM involvement is consistently associated with lower semantic distinctiveness, positioning projects closer to recently funded work within the same agency. The consequences of this shift are agency-dependent. LLM use is positively associated with proposal success and higher early-stage publication output at NIH, whereas no comparable associations are observed at NSF. Notably, the productivity gains at NIH are concentrated in non-hit papers rather than the most highly cited work. Together, these findings provide large-scale evidence that the rise of LLMs is reshaping how scientific ideas are positioned, selected, and translated into publicly funded research, with implications for portfolio governance, research diversity, and the long-run impact of science.
papers.journal_ref: Forthcoming in PNAS (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用美国国家科学基金会（NSF）和国立卫生研究院（NIH）的提案提交数据及公开资助记录，研究大型语言模型（LLM）对联邦科研资助的影响。发现自2023年起LLM使用量急剧上升且呈双峰分布，较高LLM参与度与较低的语义独特性相关，使项目更接近同一机构近期资助的工作。在NIH中，LLM使用与提案成功率和早期发表产出正相关，但产出集中在非高被引论文；NSF中无类似关联。
Motivation: 尽管LLM在科学写作和评估中的应用日益增多，但其如何重塑公共科研资助格局仍鲜为人知。论文旨在填补这一空白，通过大规模数据分析LLM在联邦资助管道关键阶段的影响。
Method: 结合两所美国R1大学向NSF和NIH提交的机密提案（包括资助、未资助和待定提案）以及NSF和NIH全部公开资助记录，分析LLM参与度与提案特征、成功率和科研产出间的关系。
Result: LLM使用自2023年急剧上升，呈双峰分布。较高LLM参与度与较低语义独特性相关。在NIH中，LLM使用与提案成功率和早期发表产出正相关，但产出集中于非高被引论文；NSF中无显著关联。
Conclusion: LLM的兴起正在重塑科学项目的定位、选择和转化为公共资助研究的方式，对投资组合治理、研究多样性和长期科学影响具有启示意义。

papers.title: The Language of Bargaining: Linguistic Effects in LLM Negotiations
papers.abstract_en: Negotiation is a core component of social intelligence, requiring agents to balance strategic reasoning, cooperation, and social norms. Recent work shows that LLMs can engage in multi-turn negotiation, yet nearly all evaluations occur exclusively in English. Using controlled multi-agent simulations across Ultimatum, Buy-Sell, and Resource Exchange games, we systematically isolate language effects across English and four Indic framings (Hindi, Punjabi, Gujarati, Marwadi) by holding game rules, model parameters, and incentives constant across all conditions. We find that language choice can shift outcomes more strongly than changing models, reversing proposer advantages and reallocating surplus. Crucially, effects are task-contingent: Indic languages reduce stability in distributive games yet induce richer exploration in integrative settings. Our results demonstrate that evaluating LLM negotiation solely in English yields incomplete and potentially misleading conclusions. These findings caution against English-only evaluation of LLMs and suggest that culturally-aware evaluation is essential for fair deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验（Ultimatum、Buy-Sell、Resource Exchange游戏）系统比较英语与四种印度语言（印地语、旁遮普语、古吉拉特语、马尔瓦迪语）下LLM的谈判行为。研究发现，语言选择对谈判结果的影响有时比模型选择更大，且效应因任务类型而异：分配型游戏中印度语言降低稳定性，整合型游戏中则促进探索。表明仅用英语评估LLM谈判能力会得到不完整甚至误导性的结论。
Motivation: 现有LLM谈判评估几乎全在英语环境下进行，忽略了语言和文化因素可能带来的实质影响，导致评估偏差。
Method: 在Ultimatum、Buy-Sell和Resource Exchange三种多智能体游戏中，保持游戏规则、模型参数和激励不变，仅改变提示语言（英语 vs. 四种印度语言），通过模拟对比分析语言效应。
Result: 语言选择可逆转提议者优势、重新分配剩余，且效应幅度有时超过更换模型；在分配性游戏中印度语言降低稳定性，在整合性游戏中促进探索。
Conclusion: 仅用英语评估LLM谈判能力可能得出不完整或误导结论，文化感知的评估对于公平部署至关重要。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文通过控制实验（Ultimatum、Buy-Sell、Resource Exchange游戏）系统比较英语与四种印度语言（印地语、旁遮普语、古吉拉特语、马尔瓦迪语）下LLM的谈判行为。研究发现，语言选择对谈判结果的影响有时比模型选择更大，且效应因任务类型而异：分配型游戏中印度语言降低稳定性，整合型游戏中则促进探索。表明仅用英语评估LLM谈判能力会得到不完整甚至误导性的结论。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM谈判评估几乎全在英语环境下进行，忽略了语言和文化因素可能带来的实质影响，导致评估偏差。
summary_sections.method: 在Ultimatum、Buy-Sell和Resource Exchange三种多智能体游戏中，保持游戏规则、模型参数和激励不变，仅改变提示语言（英语 vs. 四种印度语言），通过模拟对比分析语言效应。
summary_sections.result: 语言选择可逆转提议者优势、重新分配剩余，且效应幅度有时超过更换模型；在分配性游戏中印度语言降低稳定性，在整合性游戏中促进探索。
summary_sections.conclusion: 仅用英语评估LLM谈判能力可能得出不完整或误导结论，文化感知的评估对于公平部署至关重要。

papers.title: SA-ResGS: Self-Augmented Residual 3D Gaussian Splatting for Next Best View Selection
papers.abstract_en: We propose Self-Augmented Residual 3D Gaussian Splatting (SA-ResGS), a novel framework to stabilize uncertainty quantification and enhancing uncertainty-aware supervision in next-best-view (NBV) selection for active scene reconstruction. SA-ResGS improves both the reliability of uncertainty estimates and their effectiveness for supervision by generating Self-Augmented point clouds (SA-Points) via triangulation between a training view and a rasterized extrapolated view, enabling efficient scene coverage estimation. While improving scene coverage through physically guided view selection, SA-ResGS also addresses the challenge of under-supervised Gaussians, exacerbated by sparse and wide-baseline views, by introducing the first residual learning strategy tailored for 3D Gaussian Splatting. This targeted supervision enhances gradient flow in high-uncertainty Gaussians by combining uncertainty-driven filtering with dropout- and hard-negative-mining-inspired sampling. Our contributions are threefold: (1) a physically grounded view selection strategy that promotes efficient and uniform scene coverage; (2) an uncertainty-aware residual supervision scheme that amplifies learning signals for weakly contributing Gaussians, improving training stability and uncertainty estimation across scenes with diverse camera distributions; (3) an implicit unbiasing of uncertainty quantification as a consequence of constrained view selection and residual supervision, which together mitigate conflicting effects of wide-baseline exploration and sparse-view ambiguity in NBV planning. Experiments on active view selection demonstrate that SA-ResGS outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both reconstruction quality and view selection robustness.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自增强残差3D高斯泼溅（SA-ResGS）框架，用于主动场景重建中的下一最佳视角（NBV）选择。通过训练视图与光栅化外推视图之间的三角化生成自增强点云（SA-Points），结合专为3D高斯泼溅设计的残差学习策略，解决了稀疏宽基线视图下高斯单元监督不足的问题。实验表明SA-ResGS在重建质量和视角选择鲁棒性上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有NBV方法在主动场景重建中面临不确定性量化不稳定和弱监督高斯单元的问题，尤其当视图稀疏且基线宽时，难以实现高效且均匀的场景覆盖。
Method: 提出SA-ResGS框架，包含：(1)基于物理引导的视图选择策略促进均匀场景覆盖；(2)不确定性感知的残差监督方案，结合不确定性驱动滤波与dropout/难负例挖掘采样，增强高不确定性高斯单元的梯度流；(3)通过约束视图选择与残差监督隐式去偏不确定性量化，缓解宽基线探索与稀疏视图歧义的冲突。
Result: 在主动视图选择实验中，SA-ResGS在重建质量和视图选择鲁棒性方面均优于最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: SA-ResGS通过自增强点云和针对3D高斯泼溅的残差学习，有效提升了NBV规划的监督效率和不确定性估计可靠性，适用于不同相机分布的场景。

papers.title: Parameter Efficient Multimodal Instruction Tuning for Romanian Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Focusing on low-resource languages is an essential step toward democratizing generative AI. In this work, we contribute to reducing the multimodal NLP resource gap for Romanian. We translate the widely known Flickr30K dataset into Romanian and further extend it for visual question answering by leveraging open-source LLMs. We demonstrate the usefulness of our datasets by fine-tuning open-source VLMs on Romanian visual question answering. We select VLMs from three widely used model families: LLaMA 3.2, LLaVA 1.6, and Qwen2. For fine-tuning, we employ the parameter-efficient LoRA method. Our models show improved Romanian capabilities in visual QA, as well as on tasks they were not trained on, such as Romanian image description generation. The seven-billion-parameter Qwen2-VL-RoVQA obtains top scores on both tasks, with improvements of +2.29% and +4.45% in BERTScore F1 on VQA and captioning, respectively, over its original version. Finally, the models show substantial reductions in grammatical errors compared to their original forms, indicating improvements not only in language understanding but also in Romanian fluency.

papers.title: AOI: Context-Aware Multi-Agent Operations via Dynamic Scheduling and Hierarchical Memory Compression
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-native systems have made operational work both more powerful and harder to automate: incidents unfold across microservices, logs and metrics arrive faster than operators can inspect them, and recovery actions must be coordinated without losing the causal context that makes them safe. We present AOI (AI-Oriented Operations), a context-aware multi-agent framework for autonomous IT operations. AOI separates operational responsibility across an Observer, a read-only Probe, and a guarded Executor, and connects them through dynamic scheduling and a hierarchical memory system with LLM-based context compression. This design turns long-running incident response into an iterative loop of observation, evidence gathering, safe intervention, and memory update. Across AIOpsLab simulations and real-world Loghub-derived scenarios, AOI improves task success to 94.2\%, reduces mean time to resolution by 34.4\% relative to the strongest baseline, and compresses operational context by 72.4\% while preserving 92.8\% of diagnostic information. Ablations show that these gains come from the combination of agent specialization, adaptive scheduling, and memory-aware compression rather than from any single module alone. The results suggest that autonomous operations systems can move beyond alert classification toward reliable, context-preserving recovery in complex infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出AOI框架，一种上下文感知的多智能体系统，用于自主IT运维。通过分离观察者、只读探测器和受保护执行器的职责，结合动态调度和层级记忆系统（基于LLM的上下文压缩），将长时间事件响应转化为迭代循环。在AIOpsLab模拟和Loghub场景中，任务成功率提升至94.2%，平均解决时间降低34.4%，上下文压缩72.4%且保留92.8%的诊断信息。
Motivation: 云原生系统运维中，事件跨微服务展开，日志和指标快速产生，恢复动作需要协调且保持因果上下文。现有方法难以自动化处理复杂事件。
Method: 提出AOI框架，包含三种智能体角色：Observer、Probe、Executor，通过动态调度和层级记忆系统（LLM上下文压缩）连接，形成观察、证据收集、安全干预、记忆更新的迭代循环。
Result: 在AIOpsLab和Loghub场景中，任务成功率94.2%，平均解决时间相对最强基线降低34.4%，上下文压缩72.4%且保留92.8%诊断信息。消融实验表明增益来自智能体专业化、自适应调度和记忆感知压缩的组合。
Conclusion: 自主运维系统可以超越警报分类，实现可靠、保留上下文的恢复。

papers.title: Emergence of Nonequilibrium Latent Cycles in Unsupervised Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We show that nonequilibrium dynamics can play a constructive role in unsupervised machine learning by inducing the spontaneous emergence of latent-state cycles. We introduce a model in which visible and hidden variables interact through two independently parametrized transition matrices, defining a Markov chain whose steady state is intrinsically out of equilibrium. Likelihood maximization drives this system toward nonequilibrium steady states with finite entropy production, reduced self-transition probabilities, and persistent probability currents in the latent space. These cycles are not imposed by the architecture but arise from training, and models that develop them reproduce the empirical distribution of data classes more faithfully, with a clear correlation between agreement with the data and entropy production. Compared with equilibrium approaches such as restricted Boltzmann machines, our model breaks the detailed balance between the forward and backward conditional transitions and relies on a log-likelihood gradient that depends explicitly on the last two steps of the Markov chain. Hence, this exploration of the interface between nonequilibrium statistical physics and modern machine learning suggests that introducing irreversibility into latent-variable models can improve the fidelity of the generated data distribution.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了非平衡动力学可以在无监督机器学习中发挥建设性作用，通过诱导潜状态循环的自发涌现。模型使用两个独立参数化的转移矩阵定义可见变量和隐藏变量的交互，其稳态本质上是非平衡的。似然最大化驱使系统进入具有有限熵产生、降低的自转移概率和持久概率流的非平衡稳态。这些循环并非由架构强加，而是从训练中涌现，且发展出这些循环的模型能更忠实地再现数据类别的经验分布，其中数据一致性熵产生之间存在明显相关性。与平衡方法（如受限玻尔兹曼机）相比，该模型打破了前向和后向条件转移之间的细致平衡，其对数似然梯度显式依赖于马尔可夫链的最后两步。
Motivation: 现有潜变量生成模型多基于平衡态假设，可能限制了数据分布建模的保真度。本文旨在探索引入非平衡动力学能否提升生成模型的性能。
Method: 提出一个包含可见和隐藏变量的马尔可夫链模型，两个转移矩阵独立参数化，使得稳态具有非平衡特征。训练通过最大化似然进行，梯度依赖于链的最后两步，从而打破细致平衡。
Result: 模型在训练中自发产生潜空间循环，且熵产生与对数据分布的复现质量正相关。相比受限玻尔兹曼机等平衡方法，该模型生成的分布更忠实于数据。
Conclusion: 将非平衡统计物理的思想引入潜变量生成模型，通过打破细致平衡和引入不可逆性，有望提升生成数据分布的保真度。

papers.title: MIND-V: Hierarchical World Model for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with RL-based Physical Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Scalable embodied intelligence is constrained by the scarcity of diverse, long-horizon robotic manipulation data. Existing video world models in this domain are limited to synthesizing short clips of simple actions and often rely on manually defined trajectories. To this end, we introduce MIND-V, a cognitive hierarchical world model designed to synthesize physically plausible and logically coherent videos of long-horizon robotic manipulation. Inspired by cognitive science, MIND-V bridges high-level reasoning with pixel-level synthesis through three core components: a Semantic Reasoning Hub (SRH) that leverages a pre-trained vision-language model for task planning; a Behavioral Semantic Bridge (BSB) that translates abstract instructions into domain-invariant representations; and a Motor Video Generator (MVG) for conditional video rendering. MIND-V employs Staged Visual Future Rollouts, a test-time optimization strategy to enhance long-horizon robustness. To enforce adherence to physical laws, we introduce a GRPO reinforcement learning post-training phase guided by a novel Physical Foresight Coherence (PFC) reward. PFC leverages the V-JEPA2 world model as a physics referee to penalize implausible dynamics in the latent feature space. Experiments confirm MIND-V's SOTA performance in long-horizon simulation and its significant value for policy learning, introducing a scalable and fully autonomous framework for embodied data synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIND-V 是一个认知层次世界模型，用于生成物理合理且逻辑连贯的长时域机器人操作视频。它通过语义推理中枢、行为语义桥和运动视频生成器三个核心组件，结合分阶段视觉未来展开测试时优化和基于GRPO强化学习的物理对齐后训练，实现了长时域模拟的SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型局限于合成短时简单动作的视频，且依赖人工定义轨迹，难以支持长时域多样化机器人操作数据的生成。
Method: 提出层次化世界模型MIND-V，包含：1) 语义推理中枢利用预训练视觉语言模型进行任务规划；2) 行为语义桥将抽象指令转化为域不变表示；3) 运动视频生成器进行条件视频渲染。采用分阶段视觉未来展开策略增强长时域鲁棒性，并通过GRPO强化学习后训练，以物理前瞻一致性奖励（基于V-JEPA2世界模型）惩罚违反物理的动态。
Result: 实验表明MIND-V在长时域模拟中达到SOTA性能，并对策略学习具有显著价值，提供了可扩展的全自动具身数据合成框架。
Conclusion: MIND-V通过引入物理一致性奖励和层次化架构，实现了长时域机器人操作视频的自主生成，为具身智能数据稀缺问题提供了可扩展方案。

summary_sections.method: 提出层次化世界模型MIND-V，包含：1) 语义推理中枢利用预训练视觉语言模型进行任务规划；2) 行为语义桥将抽象指令转化为域不变表示；3) 运动视频生成器进行条件视频渲染。采用分阶段视觉未来展开策略增强长时域鲁棒性，并通过GRPO强化学习后训练，以物理前瞻一致性奖励（基于V-JEPA2世界模型）惩罚违反物理的动态。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明MIND-V在长时域模拟中达到SOTA性能，并对策略学习具有显著价值，提供了可扩展的全自动具身数据合成框架。
summary_sections.conclusion: MIND-V通过引入物理一致性奖励和层次化架构，实现了长时域机器人操作视频的自主生成，为具身智能数据稀缺问题提供了可扩展方案。

papers.title: GeoWorld: Providing Full-frame Geometry Features to Facilitate 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Previous works that leverage video models for image-to-3D scene generation often suffer from geometric distortions and blurry content. Using video generation models to implicitly maintain geometric consistency according to a single-frame input is ineffective. In this paper, we present a two-stage method, named $\textbf{GeoWorld}$, that renovates the image-to-3D scene generation pipeline by providing full-frame geometry features. The first-stage video generation model, followed by a multi-view geometry model, produces $\textbf{full-frame}$ geometry features, which are then used as a mental draft of geometric conditions to aid the second-stage video-generation model. A geometric loss is proposed to impose real-world geometric constraints, and a geometry adaptation module is introduced to ensure the effective utilization of geometry features. Thanks to full-frame geometric modeling, the two smaller video models in our two-stage method can generate higher-fidelity 3D scenes than SOTA methods, while being even faster, e.g. 7.5$\times$ faster than Hunyuan-Voyager. Project page: https://peaes.github.io/GeoWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoWorld，一种两阶段图像到3D场景生成方法。第一阶段通过视频生成模型和多视图几何模型生成全帧几何特征，作为第二阶段视频生成模型的几何条件。同时引入几何损失和几何适应模块以确保有效利用几何特征。实验表明，该方法比现有SOTA方法生成更高质量的3D场景，且速度更快（如比Hunyuan-Voyager快7.5倍）。
Motivation: 现有基于视频模型的图像到3D场景生成方法常出现几何畸变和内容模糊，因为仅依赖单帧输入隐式保持几何一致性效果不佳。
Method: 两阶段流水线：第一阶段视频生成模型后接多视图几何模型，输出全帧几何特征；第二阶段视频生成模型以这些特征作为几何条件进行生成。提出几何损失施加真实世界几何约束，并设计几何适应模块确保特征有效利用。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在生成保真度和速度上均超越SOTA，例如比Hunyuan-Voyager快7.5倍。
Conclusion: 全帧几何建模使两个较小的视频模型能生成比SOTA更高保真度的3D场景，同时推理更快。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Joint learning of a network of linear dynamical systems via total variation penalization
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of joint estimation of the parameters of $m$ linear dynamical systems, given access to single realizations of their respective trajectories, each of length $T$. The linear systems are assumed to reside on the nodes of an undirected and connected graph $G = ([m], \mathcal{E})$, and the system matrices are assumed to either vary smoothly or exhibit small number of ``jumps'' across the edges. We consider a total variation penalized least-squares estimator and derive non-asymptotic bounds on the mean squared error (MSE) which hold with high probability. In particular, the bounds imply for certain choices of well connected $G$ that the MSE goes to zero as $m$ increases, even when $T$ is constant. The theoretical results are supported by extensive experiments on synthetic and real data.
papers.comment: 53 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables, corrections in the RE analysis in proof of Theorem 1, corrected typos throughout
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在给定单条长度为T的轨迹下，联合估计m个线性动态系统参数的问题。假设系统位于无向连通图的节点上，系统矩阵在边上平滑变化或仅有少量跳跃。作者采用总变分惩罚最小二乘估计，导出了均方误差的非渐近高概率界。理论结果通过合成和真实数据实验得到验证。
Motivation: 现有方法多考虑单个线性动态系统估计，但许多应用（如网络数据）中多个系统相关且共享结构，需要联合估计以提升统计效率。
Method: 提出总变分惩罚最小二乘估计器，利用图结构对系统矩阵的差异施加惩罚，通过凸优化求解。
Result: 理论证明对于某些连通性好的图，即使T为常数，均方误差也随系统数m增加而趋于零。实验验证了估计效果。
Conclusion: 总变分惩罚能有效利用图结构实现多个线性系统的联合估计，在节点数多、时间序列短的情形下尤具优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Score-Regularized Joint Sampling with Importance Weights for Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching models effectively represent complex distributions, yet estimating expectations of functions of their outputs remains challenging under limited sampling budgets. Independent sampling often yields high-variance estimates, especially when rare but high-impact outcomes dominate the expectation. We propose a non-IID sampling framework that jointly draws multiple samples to cover diverse, salient regions of a flow matching model's generative distribution. To balance diversity and quality, we introduce a score-based regularization for the diversity mechanism (SR), which uses the score function, i.e., the gradient of the log probability, to ensure samples are pushed apart within high-density regions of the data manifold, mitigating off-manifold drift. To enable unbiased estimation when desired, we further develop an approach for importance weighting of non-IID flow samples by learning a residual velocity field that reproduces the marginal distribution of the non-IID samples and by evolving importance weights along trajectories. Empirically, our method produces diverse, high-quality samples and accurate importance-weight estimates and debiased expectation estimates, advancing the reliable characterization of flow matching model outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对flow matching模型在有限采样预算下估计期望时方差大的问题，提出一种非独立同分布联合采样框架，通过得分正则化（SR）提升样本多样性，并学习残差速度场和沿轨迹演化重要性权重以实现无偏估计。实验表明该方法能生成多样高质量的样本并得到准确的重要性权重和去偏期望估计。
Motivation: 现有独立采样在有限预算下对罕见但重要事件估计方差大，需要更高效的采样策略。
Method: 提出非IID联合采样，结合基于得分函数的多样性正则化（SR），并通过学习残差速度场和沿轨迹演化重要性权重进行重要性加权。
Result: 摘要报告方法能产生多样高质量样本，准确的重要性权重估计和去偏期望估计。
Conclusion: 该方法推进了flow matching模型输出的可靠表征。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Walrus: A Cross-Domain Foundation Model for Continuum Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have transformed machine learning for language and vision, but achieving comparable impact in physical simulation remains a challenge. Data heterogeneity and unstable long-term dynamics inhibit learning from sufficiently diverse dynamics, while varying resolutions and dimensionalities challenge efficient training on modern hardware. Through empirical and theoretical analysis, we incorporate new approaches to mitigate these obstacles, including a harmonic-analysis-based stabilization method, load-balanced distributed 2D and 3D training strategies, and compute-adaptive tokenization. Using these tools, we develop Walrus, a transformer-based foundation model developed primarily for fluid-like continuum dynamics. Walrus is pretrained on nineteen diverse scenarios spanning astrophysics, geoscience, rheology, plasma physics, acoustics, and classical fluids. Experiments show that Walrus outperforms prior foundation models on both short and long term prediction horizons on downstream tasks and across the breadth of pretraining data, while ablation studies confirm the value of our contributions to forecast stability, training throughput, and transfer performance over conventional approaches. Code and weights are released for community use.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Walrus，一个基于 Transformer 的连续介质动力学基础模型，通过谐波分析稳定化、负载均衡的 2D/3D 训练策略和计算自适应分词等技术，在涵盖天体物理、地球科学、流变学、等离子体物理、声学和经典流体的 19 个多样化场景上预训练。实验表明，Walrus 在短时和长时预测任务上均优于先前的基础模型，消融实验验证了所提方法对预测稳定性、训练吞吐量和迁移性能的贡献。
Motivation: 现有基础模型主要针对语言和视觉，物理模拟中存在数据异质性、长期动态不稳定、不同分辨率和维度导致训练效率低下等问题，亟需一种能处理多样化连续介质动力学的基础模型。
Method: 通过谐波分析稳定化方法、负载均衡的分布式 2D 和 3D 训练策略以及计算自适应分词技术，训练一个基于 Transformer 的连续介质动力学基础模型 Walrus。
Result: Walrus 在 19 个预训练场景和下游任务上，短时和长时预测均优于先前的基础模型，消融实验证实了所提方法在预测稳定性、训练吞吐量和迁移性能上的提升。
Conclusion: Walrus 展示了基础模型在物理模拟中的潜力，尤其适用于流体-like 连续介质动力学，代码和权重已开源供社区使用。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Transformer-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Networked Systems with Long-Range Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has shown promise for large-scale network control, yet existing methods face two major limitations. First, they typically rely on an exponential decay property of agent interactions on far-away nodes, which can be exploited to develop more efficient and tractable MARL algorithms. When this exponential decay property does not hold, these algorithms do not account for long-range interactions such as epidemic outbreaks or cascading power failures. Second, existing approaches lack network generalizability, or the ability to generalize to networks of different topological structure and scale than those seen during training. In this work, we first present a mean-field stability analysis and empirical study investigating the conditions for long-range network interactions. These results motivate our primary contribution: STACCA (Shared Transformer Actor-Critic with Counterfactual Advantage), a transformer-based MARL framework that addresses both long-range interactions and network generalizability. STACCA employs a centralized Graph Transformer Critic to model long-range dependencies and provide system-level feedback, while its shared Graph Transformer Actor learns a generalizable policy capable of adapting across diverse network topologies. To improve credit assignment during training, STACCA integrates a novel counterfactual advantage estimator that is compatible with state-value critic estimates. We evaluate STACCA on epidemic containment and rumor-spreading network control tasks, demonstrating improved performance and network generalizability. These results highlight the potential of transformer-based MARL architectures to achieve generalizable control in large-scale networked systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模网络控制中的多智能体强化学习（MARL）问题，指出现有方法依赖于指数衰减假设，无法处理长程交互（如疫情传播或级联故障），且缺乏网络泛化能力。作者提出STACCA框架，基于共享图Transformer Actor和集中式图Transformer Critic，结合反事实优势估计器，在疫情控制和谣言传播任务上验证了效果和泛化性。
Motivation: 现有MARL方法假设智能体间交互随距离指数衰减，但实际系统（如流行病或电力故障）存在长程交互；同时，方法难以泛化到不同拓扑结构和规模的网络。
Method: 提出STACCA框架：集中式图Transformer Critic建模长程依赖并提供系统级反馈；共享图Transformer Actor学习可泛化策略；引入与状态值批评估计兼容的反事实优势估计器改善信用分配。
Result: 在疫情遏制和谣言传播网络控制任务中，STACCA相比基线方法提升了性能，并展现了网络泛化能力（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
Conclusion: 基于Transformer的MARL架构有望实现大规模网络系统中可泛化的控制，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: CoT-X: An Adaptive Framework for Cross-Model Chain-of-Thought Transfer and Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces can improve reasoning accuracy, but repeatedly generating them is costly for smaller or latency-constrained language models. This paper studies a practical alternative: produce a rich rationale once with a capable \emph{thinking} model, compress it, and reuse the compressed trace as context for a cheaper \emph{answering} model. We introduce CoT-X, an adaptive framework for cross-model CoT transfer. CoT-X segments reasoning traces into semantic units, scores their diagnostic and logical importance, selects budget-feasible evidence paths, and reconstructs a coherent compressed rationale for the answering model. On $7,501$ Japanese medical licensing questions spanning $10$ specialties, CoT-X improves accuracy over direct truncation by up to $40.5\%$ under the same token budget, with the largest gains at $64$--$256$ tokens. Across $64$ thinking--answering pairs from eight DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3 models (1.5B--32B parameters), reasoning transfer is most reliable within a model family, yet remains effective across families once compression normalizes the trace. A Gaussian Process Bayesian optimization layer finds near-optimal model--budget configurations with $15$ evaluations rather than an exhaustive search over all $64$ pairs, reducing evaluation cost by $84\%$. These results show that reasoning quality, token budget, and model compatibility can be optimized jointly, making CoT-style reasoning more practical under realistic deployment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoT-X框架，用于跨模型链式思维(CoT)迁移和优化：先用大模型生成详细推理轨迹，压缩后作为小模型的上下文。在7,501道日本医学考试题上，相同token预算下比直接截断准确率提升最高40.5%，并在不同模型间保持有效性。高斯过程贝叶斯优化在15次评估内找到近优配置，减少84%评估成本。
Motivation: 长CoT轨迹能提升推理准确性，但小模型或延迟敏感场景下重复生成成本高。需要一种方法将大模型的推理能力高效迁移到小模型，同时平衡token预算和模型兼容性。
Method: CoT-X将推理轨迹分割为语义单元，对每个单元进行诊断和逻辑重要性评分，选择预算可行的证据路径，重构为紧凑推理供回答模型使用。结合高斯过程贝叶斯优化搜索模型-预算配置。
Result: 在7,501道日本医学题上，64-256 token预算下准确率比直接截断提升最多40.5%；跨8个DeepSeek-R1和Qwen3模型（1.5B-32B）的64个思考-回答对中，同模型族迁移最可靠，跨族仍有效；贝叶斯优化15次评估找到近优配置，评估成本降低84%。
Conclusion: 推理质量、token预算和模型兼容性可联合优化，使CoT推理在实际部署约束下更实用。

papers.title: A Model Can Help Itself: Reward-Free Self-Training for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Can language models improve their reasoning performance without external rewards, using only their own sampled responses for training? We show that they can. We propose Self-evolving Post-Training (SePT), a simple post-training method that alternates between self-generation and training on self-generated responses. It repeatedly samples questions, uses the model itself to generate responses under a specified sampling temperature, and then trains the model on the self-generated data. In this self-training loop, we use an online data refresh mechanism, where each new batch is generated by the most recently updated model. Across six math reasoning benchmarks, SePT improves a strong no-training baseline, defined as the untuned base model evaluated at its best swept decoding temperature, on several tested models. Additional ablations demonstrate the importance of online data refresh and temperature dynamics. Overall, our results identify a practical regime where reasoning can be improved using self-generated supervision alone. Our code is available at https://github.com/ElementQiii/SePT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SePT (Self-evolving Post-Training)，一种无需外部奖励、仅利用模型自身采样响应进行训练的简单后训练方法。在六个数学推理基准上，SePT 提升了多个模型的推理性能，且消融实验验证了在线数据刷新和温度调度的关键作用。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 推理能力提升通常依赖人工标注或外部奖励信号，本文探索是否可能仅通过模型自身的自生成监督来改进推理。
Method: SePT 采用交替循环：先用模型以指定采样温度生成响应，再在自生成数据上训练模型，且每个新批次由最新模型生成（在线数据刷新机制）。
Result: 在六个数学推理基准上，SePT 相比未经调优的基座模型（在最佳解码温度下评估）取得了性能提升，消融实验显示在线数据刷新和温度动态至关重要。
Conclusion: 实验表明存在一个实用区间，在该区间内仅使用自生成监督即可提升 LLM 推理能力，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robobench: A Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models as Embodied Brain
papers.abstract_en: Building robots that can perceive, reason, and act in dynamic, unstructured environments remains a central challenge. Recent embodied systems often follow a dual-system paradigm, where System 2 performs high-level reasoning and System 1 handles low-level control. We refer to System 2 as the embodied brain, the cognitive core for decision-making in manipulation. Although evaluating this embodied brain is crucial, existing benchmarks mainly measure execution success or cover only limited aspects of high-level cognition and task realism. We introduce RoboBench, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as embodied brains. RoboBench covers five dimensions: Instruction Comprehension, Perception Reasoning, Generalized Planning, Affordance Prediction, and Failure Analysis. It spans 14 capabilities, 25 tasks, and 6,092 QA pairs. To improve realism, it draws from large-scale real robotic data and in-house collection across diverse embodiments, attribute-rich objects, multi-view scenes, and memory-driven navigation. For planning, RoboBench introduces an MLLM-as-world-simulator framework that assesses whether predicted plans can achieve critical object-state changes under physical and visual constraints, enabling more faithful evaluation of long-horizon reasoning than symbolic matching. Experiments on 18 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal persistent limitations in implicit instruction understanding, spatiotemporal reasoning, cross-scenario planning, fine-grained affordance understanding, and failure diagnosis. We further analyze how embodied cognitive abilities relate to downstream robotic control. RoboBench offers a comprehensive scaffold for quantifying high-level cognition and guiding next-generation MLLMs toward more robust robotic intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboBench 是一个评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）作为具身大脑（embodied brain）的综合性基准，覆盖指令理解、感知推理、通用规划、可执行性预测和失败分析五个维度，包含14种能力、25个任务和6092个问答对。该基准引入 MLLM-as-world-simulator 框架评估长程规划的物理合理性，在18个先进MLLM上的实验揭示了其在隐含指令理解、时空推理等方面的局限。
Motivation: 现有具身智能基准主要关注执行成功率或仅覆盖高层认知的有限方面，缺乏对MLLM作为决策核心（embodied brain）的系统评估。
Method: 构建包含五个维度的QA基准，利用大规模真实机器人数据和内部采集的多视角场景、记忆驱动导航等数据提升真实性；规划评估采用MLLM-as-world-simulator框架，通过物理约束验证计划能否实现关键对象状态变化。
Result: 18个MLLM在基准上表现出隐含指令理解、时空推理、跨场景规划、细粒度可执行性理解和失败诊断等方面的持续局限。
Conclusion: RoboBench 为量化高层认知能力提供综合框架，有助于引导MLLM向更稳健的具身智能发展。

papers.title: Combining Discrepancy-Confusion Uncertainty and Calibration Diversity for Active Fine-Grained Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Active learning (AL) aims to build high-quality labeled datasets by iteratively selecting the most informative samples from an unlabeled pool under limited annotation budgets. However, in fine-grained image classification, assessing this informativeness reliably is especially challenging due to subtle differences between classes. In this paper, we introduce a novel active learning method, combining discrepancy-confusion uncertainty and calibration diversity for active fine-grained image classification (DECERN), to effectively perceive the distinctiveness between fine-grained images and evaluate the sample value. DECERN introduces a multifaceted informativeness measure that combines discrepancy-confusion uncertainty and calibration diversity. The discrepancy-confusion uncertainty quantifies the structural stability and category directionality of fine-grained unlabeled data during local feature fusion. Subsequently, uncertainty-weighted clustering is performed to diversify the uncertainty samples. Then we calibrate the diversity to maximize the global diversity of the selected sample while maintaining its local representativeness. Extensive experiments conducted on 7 fine-grained image datasets across 39 distinct experimental settings demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种主动学习方法 DECERN，针对细粒度图像分类中的样本信息量评估难题，结合差异混淆不确定度和校准多样性两项指标。前者通过局部特征融合衡量结构稳定性和类别方向性，后者进行不确定度加权聚类并校准多样性以兼顾全局多样性与局部代表性。在7个细粒度数据集上的39组实验表明该方法优于现有主动学习算法。
Motivation: 细粒度图像分类中类间差异细微，传统主动学习方法难以可靠评估样本信息量，导致标注预算利用率低。
Method: 提出 DECERN，包含差异混淆不确定度（discrepancy-confusion uncertainty）度量样本在局部特征融合中的结构稳定性和类别方向性，以及校准多样性（calibration diversity）通过不确定度加权聚类并校准选择样本的全局多样性与局部代表性。
Result: 在7个细粒度图像数据集上进行39组实验，方法在性能上优于当前最先进的主动学习方法。
Conclusion: 结合差异混淆不确定度和校准多样性能够有效感知细粒度图像间的区别并评估样本价值，提升主动学习效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAD-PINN: A Decentralized Physics-Informed Machine Learning Framework for Safe and Optimal Multi-Agent Control
papers.abstract_en: Co-optimizing safety and performance in large-scale multi-agent systems remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches based on multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), safety filtering, or Model Predictive Control (MPC) either lack strict safety guarantees, suffer from conservatism, or fail to scale effectively. We propose MAD-PINN, a decentralized physics-informed machine learning framework for solving the multi-agent state-constrained optimal control problem (MASC-OCP). Our method leverages an epigraph-based reformulation of SC-OCP to simultaneously capture performance and safety, and approximates its solution via a physics-informed neural network. Scalability is achieved by training the SC-OCP value function on reduced-agent systems and deploying them in a decentralized fashion, where each agent relies only on local observations of its neighbours for decision-making. To further enhance safety and efficiency, we introduce an Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability-based neighbour selection strategy to prioritize safety-critical interactions, and a receding-horizon policy execution scheme that adapts to dynamic interactions while reducing computational burden. Experiments on multi-agent navigation tasks demonstrate that MAD-PINN achieves superior safety-performance trade-offs, maintains scalability as the number of agents grows, and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.comment: 9 Pages, 4 Figures, 4 Tables. First two authors have contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出MAD-PINN，一种去中心化的物理信息机器学习框架，用于求解多智能体状态约束最优控制问题。该方法通过epigraph重构将安全与性能联合优化，利用物理信息神经网络逼近值函数，并在简化系统上训练后去中心化部署，每个智能体仅依赖邻居局部观测。引入HJ可达性邻居选择策略和滚动时域执行，在保证安全的同时提升效率。实验表明在多智能体导航任务中，MAD-PINN在安全-性能权衡上优于现有方法，且具有良好的可扩展性。
Motivation: 多智能体系统中安全与性能的协同优化仍是基本挑战，现有基于多智能体强化学习、安全过滤或模型预测控制的方法缺乏严格安全保证、过于保守或难以扩展。
Method: 利用epigraph重构状态约束最优控制问题，并用物理信息神经网络逼近其解；通过在简化系统上训练值函数并去中心化部署实现可扩展性；引入基于Hamilton-Jacobi可达性的邻居选择策略和滚动时域策略执行以增强安全性和效率。
Result: 在多智能体导航任务中，MAD-PINN实现了优越的安全-性能权衡，随智能体数量增加保持可扩展性，并持续优于现有基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该框架有效解决了多智能体安全最优控制的可扩展性和严格安全保证问题。

papers.title: Trajectory-Aware Information Matching for Multi-Step Gradient Inversion in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables distributed information sharing and collaborative model training without exposing raw client data. However, shared gradients or model updates may still contain sensitive information, making federated learning vulnerable to gradient inversion attacks. Most existing gradient inversion attacks rely on simplified update observations, such as single-step gradients or endpoint-based matching. In practical FL, however, FedAvg produces an accumulated trajectory-dependent update after multiple local steps, rather than a gradient computed at a single model state.To address this issue, we propose NL-SME, a trajectory-aware information matching method for multi-step gradient inversion. NL-SME constructs a learnable nonlinear surrogate trajectory to approximate hidden local states and integrates trajectory-level information with calibrated gradient matching. For perturbed updates, NL-SME can further use an observed-update reliability-aware strategy to reduce the influence of unreliable components. Extensive experiments under diverse multi-step FedAvg settings show that NL-SME outperforms state-of-the-art gradient inversion baselines in reconstruction quality and update-matching accuracy. Additional evaluations on natural and medical images, as well as under fused-update observations and representative defense strategies, further suggest that observable multi-step updates may still retain reconstruction signals. These results reveal potential privacy leakage risks in federated information sharing. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NL-SME-main/README.md.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中FedAvg多步更新导致梯度反转攻击困难的问题，提出了NL-SME方法，通过构建可学习的非线性代理轨迹逼近隐藏的局部状态，并结合轨迹级信息与校准梯度匹配。实验表明NL-SME在重建质量和更新匹配精度上优于现有基线，揭示了多步更新仍存在隐私泄露风险。
Motivation: 现有梯度反转攻击依赖单步梯度或终点匹配，忽略了FedAvg产生的轨迹依赖型多步更新，导致攻击效果不佳。
Method: 提出NL-SME，包括构建可学习非线性代理轨迹、轨迹级信息匹配和校准梯度匹配；对于受扰动的更新，采用观察更新可靠性感知策略降低不可靠分量的影响。
Result: 在多种多步FedAvg设置下，NL-SME在重建质量和更新匹配精度上优于最先进的梯度反转基线；在自然图像和医学图像以及融合更新观察和防御策略下仍能恢复信号，表明隐私风险。
Conclusion: 多步可观察更新仍可能保留重建信号，揭示联邦学习中的隐私泄露风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Supervised Goal-Reaching Results in Multi-Agent Cooperation and Exploration
papers.abstract_en: For groups of autonomous agents to achieve a particular goal, they must engage in coordination and long-horizon reasoning. Rather than relying on complex reward functions and explicit cooperation mechanisms, we ask what minimal ingredients are required for effective coordination and exploration to emerge in multi-agent settings. We investigate this question through self-supervised goal-reaching, where agents aim to maximize the likelihood of visiting a goal state rather than maximizing a reward. Despite a sparse feedback signal, we present empirical results that show self-supervised goal-reaching techniques enable agents to learn from such feedback. On MARL benchmarks, self-supervised goal-reaching outperforms alternative approaches that have access to the same sparse reward signal. Furthermore, we empirically demonstrate that multi-agent self-supervised goal-reaching approaches can be more robust than single-agent strategies. While there is no explicit exploration mechanism, this approach explores nontrivial intermediate coordination strategies in sparse settings where alternative approaches fail to achieve a single success.
papers.comment: Project website with code and videos: https://chirayu-n.github.io/gcmarl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体环境中，自我监督目标达到（self-supervised goal-reaching）能否在仅使用稀疏奖励信号的情况下产生有效的协调与探索。实验表明，该方法在MARL基准上优于同等稀疏奖励的基线，且比单智能体策略更鲁棒，能探索出非平凡的中间协调策略。
Motivation: 多智能体协调和长程推理通常依赖复杂奖励函数或显式合作机制，本文探究实现有效协调与探索所需的最小要素。
Method: 采用自我监督目标达到，即智能体以最大化访问目标状态的可能性为目标，而非最大化奖励，仅使用稀疏反馈信号。
Result: 在MARL基准上，自我监督目标达到优于使用相同稀疏奖励的替代方法；在稀疏场景中，该方法能探索出中间协调策略，而基线方法完全失败。
Conclusion: 自我监督目标达到可以作为多智能体协调与探索的简单有效机制，无需显式探索或复杂奖励设计。

papers.title: EM3M: An Electron Micrograph Dataset for Microstructural Segmentation and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative microstructural characterization is fundamental to materials science, and electron micrographs (EMs) provide indispensable high-resolution insights. However, progress in deep learning-based analysis of EMs has been hampered by the scarcity of large-scale, expert-annotated public datasets. To address this issue, we introduce EM3M, a large-scale and multimodal dataset for instance-level understanding of EMs. EM3M comprises 5,091 high-quality EMs, approximately 3 million instance segmentation annotations, and image-level textual descriptions with disentangled attributes. The dataset is constructed through a rigorous multi-stage curation and validation pipeline, with comprehensive statistical analyses to ensure reliability and reproducibility. Building upon these curated image-text pairs, we further provide a text-to-image diffusion model that serves as a controllable data augmentation engine, demonstrating that synthetic augmentation consistently improves downstream segmentation performance. To establish a systematic benchmark, we evaluate representative instance segmentation methods on EM3M. Our results reveal that conventional detection-based and query-based methods struggle with the extreme instance densities and textural complexities inherent in EMs. We additionally provide an optimized flow-based baseline to facilitate fair comparison and future research. EM3M {Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/UniParser/EM3M}, the generative engine {Generation: https://huggingface.co/UniParser/EM3M-Gen}, and an online demo {Segmentation demo: https://www.bohrium.com/apps/uni-aims} are publicly available to support future research in automated materials analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EM3M是一个大规模多模态电子显微图像数据集，包含5091张高质量图像、约300万个实例分割标注和图像级文本描述，用于微结构分析。论文还提供了一个文本到图像的扩散模型作为可控数据增强引擎，并评估了多种实例分割方法，发现传统方法在极端实例密度和纹理复杂性上表现不佳。
Motivation: 材料科学中深度学习分析电子显微图像缺乏大规模、专家标注的公开数据集，限制了进展。
Method: 构建了多阶段筛选验证的EM3M数据集，提供图像-文本对，并训练了一个文本到图像的扩散模型用于可控数据增强。
Result: 数据集包含5091张图像和约300万个实例分割标注；扩散模型生成的数据能一致提升下游分割性能；传统检测和查询方法在高密度、复杂纹理的EM图像上效果不佳。
Conclusion: EM3M数据集和扩散模型公开可用，有助于推动自动化材料分析研究。

papers.title: Web-CogReasoner: Towards Multimodal Knowledge-Induced Cognitive Reasoning for Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large-scale models have significantly advanced the development of web agents, enabling perception and interaction with digital environments akin to human cognition. In this paper, we argue that web agents must first acquire sufficient knowledge to effectively engage in cognitive reasoning. Therefore, we decompose a web agent's capabilities into two essential stages: knowledge content learning and cognitive processes. To formalize this, we propose Web-CogKnowledge Framework, categorizing knowledge as Factual, Conceptual, and Procedural. In this framework, knowledge content learning corresponds to the agent's processes of Memorizing and Understanding, which rely on the first two knowledge types, representing the "what" of learning. Conversely, cognitive processes correspond to Exploring, grounded in Procedural knowledge, defining the "how" of reasoning and action. To facilitate knowledge acquisition, we construct the Web-CogDataset, a structured resource curated from 14 real-world websites, designed to systematically instill core knowledge necessary for web agent. This dataset serves as the agent's conceptual grounding-the "nouns" upon which comprehension is built-as well as the basis for learning how to reason and act. Building on this foundation, we operationalize these processes through a novel knowledge-driven Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning framework, developing and training our proposed agent, the Web-CogReasoner. Extensive experimentation reveals its significant superiority over existing models, especially in generalizing to unseen tasks where structured knowledge is decisive. To enable rigorous evaluation, we introduce the Web-CogBench, a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to assess and compare agent performance across the delineated knowledge domains and cognitive capabilities. Our code and data is open sourced at https://github.com/Gnonymous/Web-CogReasoner
papers.comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026. Our code and data is released at https://github.com/Gnonymous/Web-CogReasoner
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Web-CogReasoner，一种面向 Web 代理的多模态知识驱动认知推理框架。该框架将代理能力分解为知识内容学习（事实、概念、程序知识）和认知过程（探索），并构建了结构化数据集 Web-CogDataset 和评估基准 Web-CogBench。实验表明该框架在未见任务上显著优于现有模型。
Motivation: 现有 Web 代理缺乏足够知识进行认知推理，导致泛化能力不足。本文旨在通过分解知识类型和认知阶段，系统性地提升代理的推理与行动能力。
Method: 提出 Web-CogKnowledge 框架，将知识分为 Factual、Conceptual 和 Procedural 三类，对应 Memorizing、Understanding 和 Exploring 三个认知过程。基于 14 个真实网站构建 Web-CogDataset，并以此开发知识驱动的 Chain-of-Thought (CoT) 推理框架 Web-CogReasoner。
Result: 在多项任务上的实验表明 Web-CogReasoner 显著优于现有模型，尤其在需要结构化知识的未见任务上表现突出。
Conclusion: 知识驱动的认知推理对提升 Web 代理性能至关重要，提出的数据集和基准可为后续研究提供支持。

papers.title: Open-Attribute Person Retrieval: Finding People Through Distinctive and Novel Attributes
papers.abstract_en: Person retrieval in surveillance videos often depends on attributes described by witnesses or operators. However, the most useful cues in practice are not always common appearance descriptions (e.g., gender, clothing color), but rare and distinctive attributes that can sharply reduce the search space (e.g., holding a weapon, lying on the ground). Existing text-based person retrieval benchmarks and methods largely focus on identity-centric retrieval with common pedestrian descriptions, leaving such retrieval-critical attributes underexplored. In this paper, we introduce Open-Attribute Person Retrieval (OAPR), a practical retrieval setting that aims to retrieve all pedestrian instances matching a given attribute query, including rare or previously unseen visual concepts, regardless of identity. To support this task, we construct EPAD, an Expanded Pedestrian Attribute Dataset with 267,885 pedestrian images and a unified vocabulary of 65 attributes, including safety-critical actions, assistive devices, and object interactions that are rarely covered in prior benchmarks. We further propose GAP-CLIP, a lightweight CLIP-based framework that learns gated attribute-aware body-part representations for OAPR. Extensive experiments on EPAD demonstrate that GAP-CLIP achieves the strongest top-K retrieval performance on the full attribute space and on out-of-distribution attributes. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/mlnjeongpark/Open-Attribute-Person-Retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Open-Attribute Person Retrieval (OAPR)任务，旨在根据罕见或未见过的属性（如持武器、躺在地上）检索行人，不受身份限制。构建了EPAD数据集，含267,885张图片和65种属性，并提出GAP-CLIP模型，学习门控属性感知的身体部位表示。实验显示在完整属性和分布外属性上达到最佳top-K检索性能。
Motivation: 现有行人检索主要关注身份相关和常见描述属性，忽略了实践中能大幅缩小搜索空间的罕见且独特的属性（如持武器、躺地上），导致检索关键属性未被探索。
Method: 提出GAP-CLIP框架，基于CLIP，通过学习门控属性感知的身体部位表示来处理OAPR任务。同时构建EPAD数据集支持该任务。
Result: 在EPAD数据集上，GAP-CLIP在完整属性空间和分布外属性上取得最强top-K检索性能。
Conclusion: 本文引入OAPR任务和EPAD数据集，证明了GAP-CLIP的有效性，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: The Bayesian Approach to Continual Learning: An Overview
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning is an online paradigm where a learner continually accumulates knowledge from different tasks encountered over sequential time steps. Importantly, the learner is required to extend and update its knowledge without forgetting about the learning experience acquired from the past, and while avoiding the need to retrain from scratch. Given its sequential nature and its resemblance to the way humans think, continual learning offers an opportunity to address several challenges which currently stand in the way of widening the range of applicability of deep models to further real-world problems. The continual need to update the learner with data arriving sequentially strikes inherent congruence between continual learning and Bayesian inference which provides a principal platform to keep updating the prior beliefs of a model given new data, without completely forgetting the knowledge acquired from the old data. This survey inspects different settings of Bayesian continual learning, namely task-incremental learning and class-incremental learning. We begin by discussing definitions of continual learning along with its Bayesian setting, as well as the links with related fields, such as domain adaptation, transfer learning and meta-learning. Afterwards, we introduce a taxonomy offering a comprehensive categorization of algorithms belonging to the Bayesian continual learning paradigm. Meanwhile, we analyze the state-of-the-art while zooming in on some of the most prominent Bayesian continual learning algorithms to date. Furthermore, we shed some light on links between continual learning and developmental psychology, and correspondingly introduce analogies between both fields. We follow that with a discussion of current challenges, and finally conclude with potential areas for future research on Bayesian continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了贝叶斯持续学习（Bayesian continual learning）的理论框架与方法，探讨任务增量学习和类增量学习两种设定，并建立与相关领域（域自适应、迁移学习、元学习）的联系，同时提及持续学习与发展心理学的类比。
Motivation: 持续学习要求模型在不遗忘旧知识的前提下从序列数据中不断学习，而贝叶斯推断天然支持在线更新先验，因此需要系统梳理贝叶斯持续学习的定义、算法分类及未来方向。
Method: 提出贝叶斯持续学习的分类体系，涵盖任务增量和类增量学习，并分析主流算法（如弹性权重巩固、在线变分推理等），同时引入与认知科学中的发展心理学类比。
Result: 未报告具体实验数值，主要贡献在于概念性综述与算法分类。
Conclusion: 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题可通过贝叶斯方法缓解，但仍面临任务边界未知、计算效率等挑战，未来可探索更灵活的经验回放与结构化先验。

papers.title: CLEAR: Calibrated Learning for Epistemic and Aleatoric Risk
papers.abstract_en: Accurate uncertainty quantification is critical for reliable predictive modeling. Existing methods typically address either aleatoric uncertainty due to measurement noise or epistemic uncertainty resulting from limited data, but not both in a balanced manner. We propose CLEAR, a calibration method with two distinct parameters, $γ_1$ and $γ_2$, to combine the two uncertainty components and improve the conditional coverage of predictive intervals for regression tasks. CLEAR is compatible with any pair of aleatoric and epistemic estimators; we show how it can be used with (i) quantile regression for aleatoric uncertainty and (ii) ensembles drawn from the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) framework for epistemic uncertainty. Across 17 diverse real-world datasets, CLEAR achieves an average improvement of 28.3\% and 17.5\% in the interval width compared to the two individually calibrated baselines while maintaining nominal coverage. Similar improvements are observed when applying CLEAR to Deep Ensembles (epistemic) and Simultaneous Quantile Regression (aleatoric). The benefits are especially evident in scenarios dominated by high aleatoric or epistemic uncertainty. Project page: https://unco3892.github.io/clear/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLEAR 是一种校准方法，通过两个参数 γ₁ 和 γ₂ 结合 aleatoric 和 epistemic 不确定性，提升回归任务中预测区间的条件覆盖率。在 17 个真实数据集上，相比单独校准的基线，区间宽度平均降低 28.3% 和 17.5%，同时保持名义覆盖率。该方法兼容多种不确定性估计器，包括分位数回归和 PCS 框架的集成。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法通常分别处理 aleatoric 或 epistemic 不确定性，缺乏平衡两者的通用校准方法，导致预测区间在混合不确定性场景下覆盖性能不佳。
Method: 提出 CLEAR，引入两个可调参数 γ₁ 和 γ₂，对 aleatoric 和 epistemic 不确定性估计进行加权组合，并通过校准优化区间覆盖率和宽度。兼容任意配对的不确定性估计器，例如分位数回归（aleatoric）和 PCS 集成（epistemic）。
Result: 在 17 个真实数据集上，相比单独校准的基线，区间宽度平均降低 28.3%（分位数回归）和 17.5%（PCS 集成），同时保持名义覆盖。在 Deep Ensembles 和同时分位数回归的组合上也观察到类似改进。
Conclusion: CLEAR 提供了一种灵活且有效的校准框架，能平衡 aleatoric 和 epistemic 不确定性，尤其在高 aleatoric 或高 epistemic 不确定性场景下优势显著。

papers.title: Semi-parametric Functional Classification via Path Signatures Logistic Regression with Adaptive Order Selection
papers.abstract_en: We propose Path Signatures Logistic Regression (PSLR), a semi-parametric framework for classifying vector-valued functional data with scalar covariates. Classical functional logistic regression models rely on linear assumptions and fixed basis expansions, which limit flexibility and degrade performance under irregular sampling. PSLR leverages the well-established properties of path signatures - basis-free representation, cross-channel dependency capture, and robustness to sampling irregularity - as an enabling tool. The key novelty, however, lies in two distinctive contributions: (i) a semi-parametric additive structure that preserves interpretable linear effects for scalar covariates, and (ii) a fully data-driven procedure for adaptively selecting the signature truncation order via a penalized empirical risk criterion. This selection mechanism is supported by rigorous non-asymptotic guarantees, including the existence of an optimal truncation order, its consistent estimation from finite samples, convergence rates for the classifier risk, a finite computable search bound, and an error propagation framework that formally quantifies PSLR's robustness under irregular sampling. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that PSLR with adaptive order selection consistently outperforms traditional functional classifiers and fixed-order signature baselines in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability. Our results highlight the practical and theoretical value of integrating rough path theory with adaptive model complexity control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出路径签名逻辑回归（PSLR），一种用于向量值函数型数据分类的半参数框架。PSLR利用路径签名的基无关表示、跨通道依赖捕获和对不规则采样的鲁棒性，并引入可解释的标量协变量线性效应与自适应签名截断阶数选择机制。理论部分给出了最优阶数存在性、一致估计、分类风险收敛率等非渐近保证；实验表明在合成和真实数据上PSLR优于传统函数分类器和固定阶数签名基线。
Motivation: 经典函数逻辑回归模型依赖线性假设和固定基展开，在处理不规则采样时灵活性和性能受限，缺乏自适应模型复杂度控制。
Method: 提出半参数加性结构，将标量协变量的线性效应与路径签名特征结合；通过惩罚经验风险准则自适应选择签名截断阶数，并给出非渐近理论保证。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，PSLR的准确率、鲁棒性和可解释性持续优于传统函数分类器和固定阶数签名基线。
Conclusion: 将粗糙路径理论与自适应模型复杂度控制相结合具有实践和理论价值，半参数结构在保留可解释性的同时提升了分类性能。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Interpretability and Generalization Bounds for Learning Spatial Physics
papers.abstract_en: While there are many applications of ML to scientific problems that look promising, visuals can be deceiving. Using numerical analysis techniques, we rigorously quantify the accuracy, convergence rates, and generalization bounds of certain ML models applied to linear differential equations for parameter discovery or solution finding. Beyond the quantity and discretization of data, we identify that the function space of the data is critical to the generalization of the model. A similar lack of generalization is empirically demonstrated for commonly used models, including physics-specific techniques. Counterintuitively, we find that different classes of models can exhibit opposing generalization behaviors. Based on our theoretical analysis, we also introduce a new mechanistic interpretability lens on scientific models whereby Green's function representations can be extracted from the weights of black-box models. Our results inform a new cross-validation technique for measuring generalization in physical systems, which can serve as a benchmark.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过数值分析技术严格量化了机器学习模型在线性微分方程参数发现和求解中的准确性、收敛性和泛化界限。研究发现数据函数空间对模型泛化至关重要，不同模型类可能表现出相反的泛化行为。基于理论分析，作者从黑盒模型权重中提取格林函数表示，提出了一种新的科学模型可解释性视角，并设计了用于物理系统泛化度量的交叉验证技术。
Motivation: 机器学习在科学问题中的应用表面看似有前景，但视觉效果可能具有欺骗性，需要严格量化其准确性、收敛性和泛化界限。
Method: 使用数值分析技术，对应用于线性微分方程参数发现或求解的ML模型进行理论分析，并基于格林函数表示提出新的可解释性方法和交叉验证技术。
Result: 识别出数据函数空间对模型泛化的关键作用，不同模型类可能表现相反的泛化行为，并基于理论提出了新的交叉验证基准。
Conclusion: 本文的理论分析为科学ML模型的泛化提供了量化界限，并引入了基于格林函数表示的可解释性视角，但未涉及具体应用领域如天气预报。

papers.title: Shutdownable Agents through POST-Agency
papers.abstract_en: Many fear that future artificial agents will resist shutdown. I present an idea - the POST-Agents Proposal - for ensuring that doesn't happen. I propose that we train agents to satisfy Preferences Only Between Same-Length Trajectories (POST). I then prove that POST - together with other conditions - implies Neutrality+: the agent maximizes expected utility, ignoring the probability distribution over trajectory-lengths. I argue that Neutrality+ keeps agents shutdownable and allows them to be useful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出POST-Agent方案，通过训练代理仅在同长度轨迹之间建立偏好（POST），并证明在附加条件下这会导致Neutrality+性质，使代理在最大化期望效用的同时忽略轨迹长度概率分布，从而保证代理的可关闭性并保留其有用性。
Motivation: 未来AI代理可能抵抗关闭，需要确保它们保持可关闭性。
Method: 提出POST（Preferences Only Between Same-Length Trajectories）训练方法，并结合其他条件证明得到Neutrality+性质。
Result: 证明POST与附加条件可以保证Neutrality+，使得代理在忽略轨迹长度分布的情况下最大化期望效用，从而保持可关闭性且不失有用性。
Conclusion: 该方案提供了一种实用的思路来设计可关闭的AI代理。

papers.title: The P$^3$ Dataset: Pixels, Points and Polygons for Multimodal Building Vectorization
papers.abstract_en: We present the P$^3$ dataset, a large-scale multimodal benchmark for building vectorization, constructed from aerial LiDAR point clouds, high-resolution aerial imagery, and vectorized 2D building outlines, collected across three continents. The dataset contains over 10 billion LiDAR points with decimeter-level accuracy and RGB images at a ground sampling distance of 25 centimeter. While many existing datasets primarily focus on the image modality, P$^3$ offers a complementary perspective by also incorporating dense 3D information. We demonstrate that LiDAR point clouds serve as a robust modality for predicting building polygons, both in hybrid and end-to-end learning frameworks. Moreover, fusing aerial LiDAR and imagery further improves accuracy and geometric quality of predicted polygons. The P$^3$ dataset is publicly available, along with code and pretrained weights of three state-of-the-art models for building polygon prediction at https://github.com/raphaelsulzer/PixelsPointsPolygons .

TL;DR: 本文介绍了P^3数据集，一个大规模多模态建筑矢量化基准，包含来自三个大洲的航空LiDAR点云、高分辨率航空影像和矢量化建筑轮廓。实验表明LiDAR点云可有效预测建筑多边形，且融合影像可提升精度。数据集和预训练模型已开源。

Method: 构建P^3数据集，包含100亿LiDAR点（分米级精度）和25cm地面采样距离的RGB图像。在混合和端到端学习框架中验证LiDAR点云预测建筑多边形的能力，并探索LiDAR与影像融合。
Result: LiDAR点云作为模态可稳健预测建筑多边形，融合航空LiDAR和影像进一步提升了预测多边形的准确度和几何质量。
Conclusion: P^3数据集公开提供，附带三个最先进建筑多边形预测模型的代码和预训练权重。

papers.title: Measuring the Robustness of Audio Deepfake Detection under Real-World Corruption
papers.abstract_en: Deepfakes have emerged as a widespread and rapidly escalating concern in generative AI, spanning images, audio, and videos. Among these, audio deepfakes are particularly alarming due to the growing accessibility of high-quality voice synthesis tools and the ease with which synthetic speech can be distributed through social media and robocalls. Consequently, detecting audio deepfakes is critical for combating the misuse of AI-generated speech. However, real-world audio is often affected by corruptions such as noise, audio modification, and compression, which can significantly degrade detection performance. In this work, we systematically evaluate the robustness of 10 audio deepfake detection models against 18 common corruption types, grouped into three categories: noise perturbation, audio modification, and compression. Using both traditional deep learning models and state-of-the-art speech foundation models, our study yields four key insights. (1) Most models are robust to noise but remain vulnerable to audio modifications and compression, especially neural codecs. (2) Speech foundation models consistently outperform traditional models across most corruption scenarios, likely due to large-scale pre-training on diverse audio datasets. (3) Increasing model size improves robustness, although the gains diminish as models become larger. (4) Robustness to unseen corruptions can be improved through targeted data augmentation during training or speech enhancement at inference time. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating audio deepfake detectors under diverse real-world corruptions and developing more robust detection frameworks for practical deployment. We further advocate that future research on deepfake detection across all media should account for the diverse and unpredictable distortions encountered in real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了10种音频深度伪造检测模型在18种真实世界音频退化（噪声、修改、压缩）下的鲁棒性。主要发现包括：大多数模型对噪声鲁棒但对音频修改和压缩脆弱；语音基础模型普遍优于传统模型；增大模型尺寸可提升鲁棒性但收益递减；通过数据增强或语音增强可改善对未知退化的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 真实世界音频常受噪声、修改和压缩等退化影响，导致深度伪造检测性能显著下降，而现有研究对此缺乏系统评估。
Method: 使用10种检测模型（含传统深度学习和语音基础模型）在18种退化类型（噪声、音频修改、压缩三类）下进行系统性鲁棒性评估。
Result: 多数模型对噪声鲁棒但对音频修改（特别是神经编解码器）脆弱；语音基础模型一致优于传统模型；增大模型尺寸提升鲁棒性但增益递减；数据增强或推理时语音增强可改善鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 强调了在真实世界退化下评估音频深度伪造检测器的重要性，并呼吁未来研究考虑多样且不可预测的环境扰动。

papers.title: Targeted Data Fusion for Region-Specific Survival Effects in the AMP HIV Prevention Trials
papers.abstract_en: The Antibody Mediated Prevention (AMP) trials opened a new scientific frontier by showing that passively administered monoclonal broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) could prevent HIV-1 acquisition. Conducted across multiple geographic regions, including the United States, Brazil, Peru, Switzerland, and sub-Saharan Africa, the AMP trials revealed substantial regional heterogeneity in treatment efficacy. These differences, together with privacy and regulatory limits on central data pooling, call for methods that borrow strength across regions without sharing individual-level data. To estimate region- and treatment-specific survival curves under distributional heterogeneity, we develop a federated learning approach that combines site-specific estimators via an L1-regularized criterion that downweights data sources not aligned with the target. We further extend the framework to a general class of causal contrasts, including the risk difference (RD), survival ratio (SR), and restricted mean survival time (RMST) difference. Through extensive simulations and an analysis of the AMP trials under different target populations, we show that the proposed approach provides privacy-preserving, region-adaptive inference with improved precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对AMP艾滋病预防试验中不同地区治疗效果异质性问题，提出一种联邦学习框架，通过L1正则化准则结合各站点估计器，在保护隐私前提下估计区域特异性生存曲线及因果对比指标。模拟和AMP试验分析显示该方法提高了估计精度。
Motivation: AMP试验揭示不同地理区域治疗效果的显著异质性，但隐私和监管限制阻碍了中央数据池化，需要一种无需共享个体数据的跨区域统计推断方法。
Method: 开发联邦学习方法，利用L1正则化准则筛选与目标区域对齐的数据源，结合各站点估计器，并扩展到风险差、生存比、限制平均生存时间差等因果对比指标。
Result: 通过仿真和AMP试验不同目标人群分析，表明该方法在保护隐私的同时实现区域自适应推断，且精度提升。
Conclusion: 该方法为存在分布异质性且无法池化个体数据的多区域临床试验提供了隐私保护、区域自适应的统计推断框架。

papers.title: Saving GPU Hours in LLM Inference System Development and Online Workloads with Simulation and DBMS-Inspired Cache Replacement Policies
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly used world-wide from daily tasks to agentic systems and data analytics, requiring significant GPU resources. While LLM inference systems are capable of serving millions of requests from multiple users, they often lack theoretical models to determine whether they achieve the performance upper bounds of underlying hardware resources. Beyond online workload serving, merely analyzing existing systems-or developing yet another one-is both GPU-intensive and labor-intensive. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of LLM inference systems, focusing on their cache management policies and availability. We then show that simulations can be an effective tool to save GPU hours in the development and analysis phase of inference systems, revealing useful insights for developing better inference techniques, unlike how existing studies used simulations to find the best parameters inside a given system. Finally, we provide theoretical tools to estimate the optimal performance and formulate new ideas. Based on the theoretical analysis, especially on the cache management in LLM inference, we propose a simple yet effective cache replacement policy that can be easily plugged into existing preemptive schedulers and systems. We show that such a simple policy inspired from database systems can substantially save GPU hours in actual inference systems on online workloads. We share our experience submitting a journal paper to a database venue in November 2025 for anyone considering a similar path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了LLM推理系统的缓存管理策略，并提出了一种受数据库系统启发的简单缓存替换策略，可显著节省在线工作负载下的GPU时间。作者还展示了模拟在推理系统开发和分析中的有效性，并提供了理论工具来估计最优性能。
Motivation: LLM推理系统缺乏理论模型来判断是否达到硬件资源性能上限，且开发、分析现有系统消耗大量GPU和人力。
Method: 通过综述现有LLM推理系统的缓存管理策略，提出一种基于数据库系统启发的新型缓存替换策略，可嵌入现有的抢占式调度器。
Result: 该策略在实际推理系统的在线工作负载上显著节省了GPU时间。
Conclusion: 模拟和理论分析可以辅助LLM推理系统开发，简单的缓存替换策略能有效提升资源利用率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inclusive KL Gradient Flows: Otto-Wasserstein, Fisher-Rao-Gaussian, and Local-Estimator Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Otto's Wasserstein gradient flow of the inclusive (forward) Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence offers a principled framework for analyzing statistical inference algorithms, yet algorithms targeting the exclusive (reverse) KL divergence are rarely studied with such tools. We establish a unified gradient-flow and PDF framework for inclusive KL inference. We show that maximum mean discrepancy minimization can be viewed as inclusive KL inference with an approximate gradient estimator, and we develop the Fisher--Rao and Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao gradient flows that directly target the inclusive KL divergence. Restricting these flows to the manifold of Gaussian distributions yields explicit gradient-flow ODEs, providing a foundation for Gaussian variational inference. Building on this viewpoint, we further introduce a local-estimator Wasserstein gradient flow whose velocity is obtained by local nonparametric regression, free of density-ratio evaluation or kernel gradients, improving the algorithmic performance over the MMD-based particle method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了包含式KL散度（inclusive KL divergence）的统一梯度流框架，将最大均值差异最小化视为一种近似梯度估计的包含式KL推断，并发展了直接针对包含式KL的Fisher-Rao和Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao梯度流。限制在高斯分布流形上得到显式ODE，为高斯变分推断提供基础。进一步引入基于局部非参数回归的局部估计Wasserstein梯度流，避免了密度比评估或核梯度，提升了基于MMD的粒子方法的算法性能。
Motivation: Otto的Wasserstein梯度流为分析统计推断算法提供了原理性框架，但针对排他式KL散度的算法很少被此类工具研究。本文旨在填补对包含式KL推断的梯度流与PDF框架的缺失。
Method: 建立包含式KL推断的统一梯度流框架；发展Fisher-Rao和Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao梯度流；限制到高斯流形得到显式ODE；引入局部估计Wasserstein梯度流，速度通过局部非参数回归获得。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称局部估计Wasserstein梯度流避免了密度比评估或核梯度，改进了基于MMD的粒子方法的算法性能。
Conclusion: 本文为包含式KL推断提供了梯度流理论工具，并提出了实用算法变体，特别是在高斯变分推断和免密度比估计方面。
Relevance: 0
