papers.title: AnyDesign: Versatile Area Fashion Editing via Mask-Free Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Fashion image editing aims to modify a person's appearance based on a given instruction. Existing methods require auxiliary tools like segmenters and keypoint extractors, lacking a flexible and unified framework. Moreover, these methods are limited in the variety of clothing types they can handle, as most datasets focus on people in clean backgrounds and only include generic garments such as tops, pants, and dresses. These limitations restrict their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we first extend an existing dataset for human generation to include a wider range of apparel and more complex backgrounds. This extended dataset features people wearing diverse items such as tops, pants, dresses, skirts, headwear, scarves, shoes, socks, and bags. Additionally, we propose AnyDesign, a diffusion-based method that enables mask-free editing on versatile areas. Users can simply input a human image along with a corresponding prompt in either text or image format. Our approach incorporates Fashion DiT, equipped with a Fashion-Guidance Attention (FGA) module designed to fuse explicit apparel types and CLIP-encoded apparel features. Both Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our method delivers high-quality fashion editing and outperforms contemporary text-guided fashion editing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnyDesign，一种基于扩散模型的免遮罩时尚图像编辑方法。用户只需输入人物图像和文本/图像提示，无需辅助工具即可编辑多种服饰区域。方法包含 Fashion DiT 和 Fashion-Guidance Attention (FGA) 模块，融合显式服装类别和 CLIP 编码特征。实验表明其在多种服装类型和复杂背景上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有时尚编辑方法依赖分割器和关键点提取器等辅助工具，缺乏统一框架，且受限于数据集只包含简单背景和通用服装类型，难以处理真实场景中的多样服饰和复杂背景。
Method: 扩展了一个现有的人体生成数据集，增加更多服装类别（如头饰、围巾、鞋、包等）和复杂背景。提出 AnyDesign，基于扩散模型，无需遮罩，输入人物图像和文本/图像提示即可编辑。核心是 Fashion DiT 及其中的 Fashion-Guidance Attention (FGA) 模块，用于融合显式服装类别和 CLIP 编码特征。
Result: 定性和定量实验表明，AnyDesign 实现了高质量的时尚编辑，并优于同期基于文本引导的时尚编辑方法。
Conclusion: AnyDesign 提供了一种灵活、统一的免遮罩框架，适用于真实场景中多种服饰和背景的编辑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning rate adaptive stochastic gradient descent optimization methods: numerical simulations for deep learning methods for partial differential equations and convergence analyses
papers.abstract_en: The standard stochastic gradient descent (SGD) optimization method, as well as adaptive methods such as the Adam optimizer fail to converge if the learning rates do not converge to zero (particularly, in the situation of constant learning rates). In practice, human-tuned deterministic learning rate schedules or small constant learning rates are often used, and implementations in machine learning frameworks like Tensorflow and Pytorch typically employ constant learning rates. We propose a learning-rate-adaptive approach for SGD methods, adjusting the learning rate based on empirical estimates for the objective function values. Specifically, we propose a learning-rate-adaptive variant of the Adam optimizer and implement it for several machine learning problems, including deep learning methods for partial differential equations such as deep Kolmogorov methods, physics-informed neural networks, and deep Ritz methods. We refer to https://github.com/deeplearningmethods/adaptive-learning-rate for the Python source codes for the numerical simulations in this work. Our results show that the proposed adaptive Adam variant achieves faster reductions of the objective function value compared to Adam with default learning rates. For certain quadratic minimization problems, we rigorously prove that an adaptive SGD variant converges to the global minimizer. This proof uses properties of invariant measures of the SGD dynamics and a generalized convergence analysis for SGD with random predictable learning rates which we develop in this work.
papers.comment: 65 pages, 8 figures. To appear in Communications in Computational Physics (CiCP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习率自适应的随机梯度下降（SGD）优化方法，并重点设计了Adam的自适应变体，用于深度求解偏微分方程（PDE）的任务（如深度Kolmogorov方法、物理信息神经网络、深度Ritz方法）。数值实验表明，所提自适应Adam变体相比默认学习率的Adam能更快降低目标函数值。理论上，针对二次极小化问题证明了自适应SGD变体的全局收敛性，该证明基于SGD动力学的不变测度性质和新发展的随机可预测学习率收敛性分析。
Motivation: 标准SGD和Adam等自适应方法在常数学习率下不收敛，实践中依赖人工调整的学习率衰减调度或小常数学习率。本文旨在消除对人工调度策略的依赖，提出自动调整学习率的方法。
Method: 基于目标函数值的经验估计动态调整学习率，提出Adam的学习率自适应变体，并集成到PDE深度求解器中（如深度Kolmogorov方法、PINN、深度Ritz方法）。同时发展了随机可预测学习率的广义收敛性分析框架。
Result: 数值模拟表明，所提自适应Adam变体在多个机器学习问题（包括PDE深度学习）上比默认学习率Adam更快降低目标函数值。对于二次极小化问题，严格证明了自适应SGD变体收敛到全局最小值。
Conclusion: 本文提供的学习率自适应方法避免了手动调度，在深度PDE求解中表现出更快收敛，且在理论上对简单问题有收敛保证。局限性在于理论分析仅针对二次型问题，更复杂问题需进一步验证。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Replicability is Asymptotically Free in Multi-armed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We consider a replicable stochastic multi-armed bandit algorithm that ensures, with high probability, that the algorithm's sequence of actions is not affected by the randomness inherent in the dataset. Replicability allows third parties to reproduce published findings and assists the original researcher in applying standard statistical tests. We observe that existing algorithms require $O(K^2/ρ^2)$ times more regret than nonreplicable algorithms, where $K$ is the number of arms and $ρ$ is the level of nonreplication. However, we demonstrate that this additional cost is unnecessary when the time horizon $T$ is sufficiently large for a given $K, ρ$, provided that the magnitude of the confidence bounds is chosen carefully. Therefore, for a large $T$, our algorithm only requires $K^2/ρ^2$ times smaller amount of exploration than existing algorithms. To ensure the replicability of the proposed algorithms, we incorporate randomness into their decision-making processes. We propose a principled approach to limiting the probability of nonreplication. This approach elucidates the steps that existing research has implicitly followed. Furthermore, we derive the first lower bound for the two-armed replicable bandit problem, which implies the optimality of the proposed algorithms up to a $\log\log T$ factor for the two-armed case.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可重复性随机多臂老虎机算法，确保算法动作序列不受数据集随机性的影响。现有算法需要比非可重复算法多O(K^2/ρ^2)倍的遗憾，但本文证明当时间跨度T足够大时，通过调整置信区间幅度，可消除额外成本。文中提出将随机性纳入决策过程的原理性方法，并给出了双臂可重复老虎机的第一个下界。
Motivation: 现有可重复性老虎机算法通常以显著增加遗憾为代价，本文旨在证明当时间跨度足够大时，可重复性可以几乎没有额外代价，从而提升算法实用性。
Method: 通过精心选择置信区间幅度，减少对额外探索的需求，并在决策过程中引入随机性以控制不可重复概率。
Result: 证明当T较大时，所提算法所需的额外探索量仅为现有算法的K^2/ρ^2分之一；并推导了双臂情况下的第一个下界，表明算法在双臂情形下达到最优（忽略log log T因子）。
Conclusion: 可重复性在长时间跨度下渐近无代价，通过合理设计置信区间和随机化机制可达到高效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AppAgent: Multimodal Agents as Smartphone Users
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have led to the creation of intelligent agents capable of performing complex tasks. This paper introduces a novel LLM-based multimodal agent framework designed to operate smartphone applications. Our framework enables the agent to operate smartphone applications through a simplified action space, mimicking human-like interactions such as tapping and swiping. This novel approach bypasses the need for system back-end access, thereby broadening its applicability across diverse apps. Central to our agent's functionality is its innovative learning method. The agent learns to navigate and use new apps either through autonomous exploration or by observing human demonstrations. This process generates a knowledge base that the agent refers to for executing complex tasks across different applications. To demonstrate the practicality of our agent, we conducted extensive testing over 50 tasks in 10 different applications, including social media, email, maps, shopping, and sophisticated image editing tools. The results affirm our agent's proficiency in handling a diverse array of high-level tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted to CHI 2025, project page is https://appagent-official.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的多模态智能体框架 AppAgent，能够通过简化的动作空间（如点击、滑动）操作智能手机应用，无需后端访问。该智能体通过自主探索或观察人类演示学习新应用，生成知识库用于执行复杂任务。在包括社交媒体、邮件、地图、购物和图像编辑等10个应用中的50个任务上进行了测试，展示了其处理多样化高层面任务的能力。
Motivation: 现有智能体操作智能手机应用通常需要后端访问或受限的API，限制了通用性。本文旨在开发一种无需系统后端访问、能模仿人类交互方式操作各类应用的LLM多模态智能体。
Method: 提出一种LLM多模态智能体框架，通过简化动作空间（如点击、滑动）模拟人类交互；智能体通过自主探索或观察人类演示学习新应用，构建知识库以指导后续任务执行。
Result: 在10个不同应用（社交媒体、邮件、地图、购物、图像编辑等）的50个任务上进行了测试，结果表明该智能体能够熟练处理多种高层面任务。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了LLM多模态智能体在无需后端访问的情况下操作智能手机应用的可行性，具有广泛的应用前景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出一种LLM多模态智能体框架，通过简化动作空间（如点击、滑动）模拟人类交互；智能体通过自主探索或观察人类演示学习新应用，构建知识库以指导后续任务执行。
summary_sections.result: 在10个不同应用（社交媒体、邮件、地图、购物、图像编辑等）的50个任务上进行了测试，结果表明该智能体能够熟练处理多种高层面任务。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架展示了LLM多模态智能体在无需后端访问的情况下操作智能手机应用的可行性，具有广泛的应用前景。

papers.title: DIRA-SS:Dynamic Domain Incremental Regularised Adaptation -- Self-Supervised
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems (AS) often rely on Deep Neural Network (DNN) classifiers to operate in complex and dynamically changing environments. However, during operation, these classifiers may encounter domains that differ from those seen during development, causing performance degradation under distribution shift. Removing systems from operation for labelled data collection and retraining is often impractical, particularly when adaptation must occur quickly and at scale. This paper introduces DIRA-SS, a self-supervised extension of Dynamic Incremental Regularised Adaptation (DIRA) that enables online domain adaptation using only a small number of unlabelled target-domain samples. DIRA-SS augments an existing classifier with an auxiliary retraining branch and adapts the shared feature representation through a rotation-prediction task, while elastic weight consolidation regularises important source-domain parameters to reduce destructive updates. This allows the model to benefit from transfer learning without requiring classification labels during operation. We evaluate DIRA-SS on CIFAR-10C, CIFAR-100C, and ImageNet-C using ResNet architectures under severe common corruptions. The results show that DIRA-SS substantially improves performance over the non-adapted source model, achieves accuracy close to the supervised DIRA method, and outperforms existing unsupervised test-time adaptation baselines on ImageNet-C when using only 100 target-domain samples.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIRA-SS是一种自监督的在线域适应方法，通过旋转预测任务和弹性权重巩固（EWC）在无标签目标域样本上调整分类器的特征表示。在CIFAR-10C、CIFAR-100C和ImageNet-C上的实验表明，该方法能显著提升分布偏移下的分类性能，接近监督式DIRA方法，并优于现有的无监督测试时适应基线。
Motivation: 自主系统中的深度神经网络分类器在运行时可能遇到与训练数据分布不同的新域，导致性能下降。传统的标注数据收集和重训练方法不可行，需要无需标签的在线适应方法。
Method: 提出DIRA-SS，在现有分类器上添加辅助重训练分支，通过旋转预测（rotation prediction）任务进行自监督学习，同时使用弹性权重巩固（EWC）正则化保护源域重要参数，减少破坏性更新。
Result: 在CIFAR-10C、CIFAR-100C和ImageNet-C上使用ResNet架构，仅用100个目标域样本即可大幅提升性能，准确率接近监督式DIRA，并优于现有无监督测试时适应方法。
Conclusion: DIRA-SS提供了一种实用的无标签在线域适应方案，适用于需要快速、大规模适应的场景，但未讨论在多域连续适应或更复杂分布下的表现。

papers.title: Learning linear dynamical systems under convex constraints
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of finite-time identification of linear dynamical systems from $T$ samples of a single trajectory. Recent results have predominantly focused on the setup where either no structural assumption is made on the system matrix $A^* \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$, or specific structural assumptions (e.g. sparsity) are made on $A^*$. We assume prior structural information on $A^*$ is available, which can be captured in the form of a convex set $\mathcal{K}$ containing $A^*$. For the solution of the ensuing constrained least squares estimator, we derive non-asymptotic error bounds in the Frobenius norm that depend on the local size of $\mathcal{K}$ at $A^*$. To illustrate the usefulness of these results, we instantiate them for four examples, namely when (i) $A^*$ is sparse and $\mathcal{K}$ is a suitably scaled $\ell_1$ ball; (ii) $\mathcal{K}$ is a subspace; (iii) $\mathcal{K}$ consists of matrices each of which is formed by sampling a bivariate convex function on a uniform $n \times n$ grid (convex regression); (iv) $\mathcal{K}$ consists of matrices each row of which is formed by uniform sampling (with step size $1/T$) of a univariate Lipschitz function. In all these situations, we show that $A^*$ can be reliably estimated for values of $T$ much smaller than what is needed for the unconstrained setting.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从单条轨迹的T个样本中有限时间识别线性动力系统的问题。假设系统矩阵A*位于一个已知凸集K内，提出了约束最小二乘估计器，并导出了其Frobenius范数下的非渐近误差界，该误差界依赖于K在A*处的局部尺寸。通过四个示例（稀疏ℓ1球、子空间、凸回归、Lipschitz函数）展示了在远小于无约束情况所需的T下即可可靠估计A*。
Motivation: 现有线性系统识别工作要么不做结构假设导致样本需求大，要么局限于特定结构（如稀疏性）。本文旨在提供一种通用框架，利用先验凸约束信息以降低样本复杂度。
Method: 假设系统矩阵A*属于已知凸集K，采用约束最小二乘估计器。推导了估计误差在Frobenius范数下的非渐近上界，该上界由K在A*处的局部几何决定。
Result: 在稀疏回归、子空间约束、凸回归和Lipschitz函数四个示例中，所需样本T显著小于无约束情形即可实现可靠估计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调凸约束信息可大幅降低线性系统识别所需的样本量，理论结果具有通用性。

papers.title: Representation Recycling for Streaming Video Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We present StreamDEQ, a method that aims to infer frame-wise representations on videos with minimal per-frame computation. Conventional deep networks perform feature extraction from scratch at each frame in the absence of ad-hoc solutions. We instead aim to build streaming recognition models that can natively exploit temporal smoothness between consecutive video frames. We observe that the recently emerging implicit layer models provide a convenient foundation to construct such models, as they define representations as the fixed points of shallow networks, which need to be estimated using iterative methods. Our main insight is to distribute the inference iterations over the temporal axis by using the most recent representation as a starting point at each frame. This scheme effectively recycles the recent inference computations and greatly reduces the required processing time. Through extensive experimental analysis, we show that StreamDEQ is able to recover near-optimal representations within a few frames and maintain an up-to-date representation throughout the video duration. Our experiments on video semantic segmentation, video object detection, and human pose estimation in videos show that StreamDEQ achieves on-par accuracy with the baseline while providing 2-4x higher throughput.
papers.comment: v3: ECCV2022 paper. This version: extended version accepted to be published at Neurocomputing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamDEQ，一种利用视频帧间时间平滑性来回收前序帧表示的流式视频分析方法。通过将循环推理分布在时间轴上，以最近的表示为起点迭代求解隐式层模型的固定点，大幅减少每帧计算量。实验表明，在视频语义分割、目标检测和人体姿态估计任务上，StreamDEQ 在保持与基线相当精度的同时实现了 2-4 倍的吞吐量提升。
Motivation: 传统深度网络在视频处理中逐帧从头提取特征，计算开销大；而现有方法缺乏原生利用视频时间连续性的机制。
Method: 基于隐式层模型，将视频帧的特征表示定义为浅层网络的固定点，并通过迭代方法求解。关键创新是将迭代过程在时间轴上分布：每帧从最近的前一帧表示开始迭代，从而回收上一帧的计算结果。
Result: 在视频语义分割、视频目标检测和人体姿态估计任务中，StreamDEQ 在几个帧内即可恢复近最优表示，并保持更新。与基线相比，精度持平，吞吐量提升 2-4 倍。
Conclusion: StreamDEQ 证明了隐式层模型在流式视频分析中的有效性，通过表示回收实现高效推理。该方法无需额外训练技巧，可推广到多种视频理解任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PreSIST: Vision-Language-Informed Object Persistence Prediction in Open-World Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Robots deployed over long periods must reason about environments that change over time. Existing long-term perception systems often address object change reactively, updating their maps only after revisiting a scene and observing that an object has moved. Instead, robots should reason proactively about how long objects are likely to persist using the context in which they appear. For example, a car at a traffic light and a car in a parking spot share the same semantic class, but their contexts imply different persistence durations. We propose PreSIST (Predictive Scene-conditioned Instance Survival over Time), a method for predicting whether an observed object will remain in its last seen pose at arbitrary future times. PreSIST estimates instance-level persistence priors from object properties and scene context, then integrates these priors with a probabilistic persistence filter as observations become available. Its key insight is that the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) can relate scene context to likely object use and human activity, enabling persistence prediction before long-term observations are available. We develop two interchangeable variants: PreSIST-Lang, which estimates persistence priors using a VLM, and PreSIST-Vis, a novel vision-only model trained using PreSIST-Lang pseudo-labels for efficient deployment. Experiments on a new dataset of in-the-wild object persistence annotations show that PreSIST-Lang and PreSIST-Vis outperform baselines on open-world persistence prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出PreSIST方法，利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）预测开放世界场景中物体在任意未来时间是否仍停留在最后观测位置。包含两个变体：PreSIST-Lang基于VLM估计持久性先验，PreSIST-Vis是纯视觉模型，用伪标签训练。在野外物体持久性注释数据集上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有长期感知系统通常被动响应变化，需重新访问场景才能更新地图。本文旨在主动预测物体持久性，利用场景上下文推断不同物体（如交通灯处的车vs停车场里的车）的不同持久性。
Method: 从物体属性和场景上下文估计实例级持久性先验，再与概率持久性滤波器集成。关键思想是利用VLM推理场景上下文与物体使用和人类活动的关系。两个变体：PreSIST-Lang使用VLM估计先验；PreSIST-Vis为纯视觉模型，用PreSIST-Lang伪标签训练。
Result: 在野外物体持久性注释的新数据集上，PreSIST-Lang和PreSIST-Vis在开放世界持久性预测上均优于基线。
Conclusion: 该方法能主动推理物体持久性，无需长期观测即可利用场景上下文进行预测。

papers.title: A Policy Decomposition Framework for Dynamic Order Fulfillment Operations
papers.abstract_en: Modern supply chains span diverse operational environments, ranging from e-commerce distribution networks to customized production-to-order manufacturing lines. Across these settings, operational efficiency depends on coordinating two highly interdependent stages: order preparation and downstream delivery. Although these stages are traditionally managed in isolation, real-world fulfillment systems must satisfy stringent delivery expectations under dynamic stochastic order arrivals. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Dynamic Order Fulfillment Problem (DOFP), a new problem class unifying logistical challenges previously studied separately. We model DOFP as a Markov decision process whose state and decision spaces are partitioned into preparation and delivery sub-spaces, linked by synchronization constraints. While recent approaches attempt to optimize both fulfillment stages simultaneously over myopic rolling horizons, our framework isolates and optimizes the downstream delivery policy, treating preparation strictly as a state-level constraint filter. To solve this, we develop the Decomposition-Driven Framework with Value Function Approximation (DDF-VFA), which utilizes a novel policy-level decomposition. This design partitions the search into a delivery-stage master problem and a preparation-stage compatibility subproblem, iteratively refined via feedback loops. DDF-VFA executes this strategy by combining a large-neighborhood search over partial delivery decisions with a neural-network value function approximation for the cost-to-go. Numerical illustrations on two example variants using real-world datasets show that DDF-VFA consistently outperforms benchmarks that optimize the two stages independently or jointly without decomposition. Finally, the framework naturally scales to accommodate additional real-world complexities such as batched or multi-stage preparation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态订单履行问题（DOFP），将其建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并开发了基于策略分解的DDF-VFA框架，通过分离送货阶段和准备阶段的策略优化，结合大规模邻域搜索与神经网络值函数近似，在真实数据集上优于独立或联合优化基线。
Motivation: 供应链中订单准备与下游送货高度相互依赖，但传统上孤立管理，难以满足动态随机订单到达下的严格时效要求。现有联合优化方法多采用短视滚动规划，缺乏全局策略视角。
Method: 将DOFP建模为状态与决策空间分区的MDP，提出DDF-VFA：通过策略级分解将搜索分为送货主问题与准备兼容性子问题，迭代反馈；送货主问题用大规模邻域搜索，成本函数用神经网络近似。
Result: 在两类变体上使用真实数据集测试，DDF-VFA一致优于独立优化或联合优化但不分解的基线方法，且易于扩展至批处理或多阶段准备等复杂场景。
Conclusion: 所提策略分解框架能有效协调动态订单履行中的两个阶段，为后续处理更现实约束提供了可扩展方案。

papers.title: What is Left for Us? Second Scholarship Against the Degradation of Research by AI
papers.abstract_en: We argue that generative AI can degrade research by eroding the very practices through which scholarly judgement is formed and academic trust is built. As constitutive conditions for the production and validation of knowledge, these practices cannot be reduced to the final outputs of research, which is what AI so effectively simulate. Accordingly, when researchers delegate central tasks of inquiry to systems like Large Language Models, they may stop enacting these practices and, with them, lose access to the formation they provide. An individual research output generated by AI may even appear improved but the researcher behind it fails to develop. Against this risk, merely keeping humans in the loop as prompters or quality checkers of AI outputs is insufficient to preserve research as a site of intellectual formation. What is needed instead is a renewed commitment to research as a lived practice in which judgement is formed gradually, often through frictions, and participation in a scholarly community. We defend it because it rests on four sources and warrants of research that cannot be automated: tacit knowledge, personal commitment, socialisation, and deep reading. This practice enacts what we call second scholarship, by which we understand the reappropriation of scholarly craft, chosen out of a critical experience of what generative AI can and cannot do. What cannot and should not be delegated becomes what research communities must value and answer for. This is what is left for us.

papers.title: SiamJEPA: On the Role of Siamese Student Encoders in JEPA
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have attracted significant attention in the computer vision and machine learning communities as a promising framework for self-supervised representation learning. Unlike masked autoencoders that reconstruct pixels, JEPA models learn representations by predicting latent embeddings of masked regions. Existing JEPA-based methods, such as I-JEPA and V-JEPA, typically employ a single encoder in the student network. In contrast, using Siamese encoders for student network is more naturally aligned with brain-inspired representation learning frameworks, yet their role in JEPA models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the effect of Siamese student encoders in JEPA-based representation learning. To this end, we propose SiamJEPA, masked Siamese student encoders equipped with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher network. SiamJEPA can also be viewed as a JEPA formulation of the brain-inspired representation learning model PhiNet. Through extensive experiments on ImageNet linear probing, we demonstrate that Siamese encoders act as an effective regularizer for the JEPA objective, improving representation separability and accelerating learning during the early stages of training. Furthermore, SiamJEPA consistently outperforms comparable single-encoder JEPA variants under limited training budgets and achieves higher linear probing accuracy than Masked Autoencoders (MAE) which requires longer training. Our findings reveal that Siamese student encoders are not merely an architectural choice but constitute an important inductive bias for predictive representation learning. These results provide new insights into the design of JEPA-based models and suggest that incorporating Siamese student architectures offers a simple yet effective approach for improving self-supervised representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SiamJEPA，一种在JEPA框架中使用孪生学生编码器（Siamese student encoders）的自监督表示学习方法。通过将两个共享权重的编码器与指数移动平均教师网络结合，SiamJEPA在ImageNet线性探测任务上优于单编码器JEPA变体，并在有限训练预算下达到比需要更长训练的MAE更高的精度。结果表明孪生编码器起到了有效正则化作用，提升了表示可分离性和训练早期学习速度。
Motivation: 现有JEPA方法（如I-JEPA、V-JEPA）通常使用单编码器作为学生网络，而孪生编码器更符合脑启发表示学习框架，但其在JEPA中的作用尚未被探索。
Method: 提出SiamJEPA，即带有指数移动平均（EMA）教师网络的掩码孪生学生编码器，可视为脑启发模型PhiNet的JEPA形式化。
Result: 在ImageNet线性探测上，SiamJEPA持续优于可比单编码器JEPA变体，且达到比MAE（需更长训练）更高的线性探测精度。
Conclusion: 孪生学生编码器不仅是架构选择，更是预测性表示学习中的重要归纳偏置，为JEPA模型设计提供了新见解。

papers.title: Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation is a powerful way to transfer reasoning ability from a strong teacher to a smaller student: the student samples trajectories from its own policy, and the teacher provides dense token-level supervision on the states the student actually visits. However, this supervision is not always reliable: a teacher can assign high likelihood to plausible but incorrect solutions, or low likelihood to correct student solutions that follow different reasoning paths. Unconditionally distilling the teacher can therefore reinforce bad modes or erase useful student behavior. To address these limitations, we introduce RG-OPD: Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation that uses verifier feedback to decide when teacher logits should be trusted. RG-OPD bridges sparse verifier rewards and dense teacher logits, preserving token-level supervision while filtering misleading teacher signals. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, RG-OPD produces stronger distilled students, outperforming both vanilla reverse-KL distillation and the recent TSD-KD baseline. At 1K generation length, RG-OPD improves over reverse-KL by 2.9 points and over TSD-KD by 4.9 points; in the long-generation setting, it improves over the untuned student by 8.2 points. Our code is available at https://github.com/UoC-tail/RG-OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD)，通过验证器反馈决定何时信任教师 logits，从而在策略蒸馏中过滤误导性教师信号。该方法在推理和代码基准上优于反向 KL 蒸馏和 TSD-KD 基线。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy 蒸馏中，教师对合理但不正确的解分配高概率，或对学生不同的正确推理路径分配低概率，导致不良模式强化或有用行为被抹除。
Method: RG-OPD 使用验证器反馈作为门控信号，稀疏的验证器奖励与密集的教师 logits 相结合，仅在教师可信时进行 token 级监督。
Result: 在 1K 生成长度上，RG-OPD 相比反向 KL 提升 2.9 个点，相比 TSD-KD 提升 4.9 个点；在长生成设置中，相比未调优学生提升 8.2 个点。
Conclusion: RG-OPD 通过奖励门控保留 token 级监督的同时过滤误导性教师信号，产生更强的蒸馏学生。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The "I Don't Know" Filter: Enhancing Agentic Reliability in Function Calling
papers.abstract_en: The language models that underpin agents have seen a rapid rise in performance on function calling benchmarks. However, the metrics used in the training and evaluation of these models often encourage models to make positive claims even when the answer is uncertain, leading to hallucinations. Such hallucinations can be disastrous when language models are trusted to use function calls to make decisions in high stakes applications. To that end, we propose an agent evaluation metric that takes into account the negative outcomes associated with incorrect function calls. Further, to catch hallucinations before they can cause harm, we propose a lightweight trainable filter that can quantify a language model's uncertainty and remove potentially harmful function calls. By training that filter to detect and suppress uncertain function calls without modifying the underlying model, we demonstrate a practical path toward agents that know when to say "I don't know," a property we argue is essential to production reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个轻量级可训练过滤器，用于检测和抑制语言模型在函数调用中的不确定性，从而减少幻觉。同时引入考虑错误函数调用负面后果的代理评估指标。实验表明该方法能有效提升代理的可靠性。
Motivation: 当前语言模型在函数调用基准上表现提升，但训练和评估指标鼓励模型做出肯定断言，即使答案不确定，导致高风险应用中产生灾难性幻觉。
Method: 提出一个轻量级可训练过滤器，量化语言模型的不确定性并移除潜在有害的函数调用；同时提出一个考虑错误调用负面后果的评估指标。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称展示了让代理学会说“我不知道”的实用路径，这对于生产可靠性至关重要。
Conclusion: 该过滤器无需修改底层模型即可提升可靠性，降低函数调用中的幻觉风险。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: OmniOpt: Taxonomy, Geometry, and Benchmarking of Modern Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: Optimizer selection for large-scale model training has become a system-level design decision constrained jointly by compute, memory, tuning budget, and task diversity, yet the landscape of over one hundred methods remains fragmented. We therefore present OmniOpt, a unified survey and benchmark cookbook of optimizers for the research community. OmniOpt rests on four coupled components. First, we treat every optimizer update as a structured transformation through a five-stage meta-pipeline, and show that most methods engage only one or two of these stages. Second, we use norm-constrained linear minimization oracles (LMOs) to unify different optimizers. Third, these two views ground a dual-dimension taxonomy, one dimension assigning each method to a mechanism family and the other recording the measurable training objectives it aims to improve. Fourth, and at the core of this paper, we instantiate the full taxonomy in a unified cross-domain benchmark spanning representative optimizers, model scales, and training regimes from language model pretraining to image classification, systematically analyzing each method family across multiple effect objectives and laying out their trade-offs. OmniOpt thus supplies the research community with an operational coordinate system for selecting optimizers under explicit mechanism and objective assumptions, and charts a direction for the future development of the optimizer community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniOpt，一个统一的优化器综述和基准测试框架，涵盖超过一百种优化方法。基于五阶段元流水线和范数约束线性最小化或acles的统一视角，构建了双维度分类法，并通过跨领域基准测试（包括语言模型预训练和图像分类）系统分析了不同方法家族的权衡。
Motivation: 大规模模型训练中优化器选择已成为系统级设计决策，受限于计算、内存、调优预算和任务多样性，但现有方法超过一百种，缺乏统一视角和系统性比较。
Method: 将每个优化器更新视为通过五阶段元流水线的结构化变换，利用范数约束线性最小化或acles统一不同优化器，建立双维度分类法（机制家族和可测量的训练目标），并在跨领域基准中实例化完整分类法。
Result: 在包含代表性优化器、模型规模和训练机制（从语言模型预训练到图像分类）的统一基准上，系统分析了每个方法家族在多个效果目标上的表现和权衡。
Conclusion: OmniOpt为研究社区提供了在明确机制和目标假设下选择优化器的操作坐标系，并为优化器社区的未来发展指明了方向。

papers.title: Efficient Discovery of Conditional Dependencies with Desbordante
papers.abstract_en: Conditional functional dependencies (CFDs) are functional dependencies with a restricted scope: they specify the context in which a dependency holds and are useful for data-quality tasks, specifying complex integrity constraints, and extracting valuable insights from data. We study the CFD discovery problem, which is computationally demanding. We build on the state-of-the-art CFDFinder algorithm and introduce a set of algorithmic and engineering improvements, including a parallelization strategy, to produce ParCFDFinder. Our implementation is integrated into Desbordante - a high-performance open-source data profiler written in C++ that exposes a Python interface, enabling CFD discovery to be invoked from any Python program. Experimental results show that our enhancements speed up the algorithm by up to $318\times$ ($118\times$ on average) and reduce memory usage by up to $23\times$ ($14\times$ on average) compared with the existing Java-based implementation of Metanome. Integrating ParCFDFinder into Desbordante makes it possible, for the first time, to conveniently discover CFDs on datasets with hundreds of thousands of rows on a commodity machine within a reasonable time.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 39th Conference of Open Innovations Association (FRUCT), Helsinki, Finland, 2026, pp. 130-141
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了条件函数依赖（CFD）的高效发现算法。基于现有CFDFinder算法，作者提出了包括并行化在内的一系列算法与工程改进，形成ParCFDFinder，并将其集成到高性能开源数据剖析工具Desbordante中。实验表明，相比基于Java的Metanome实现，该方法平均加速118倍（最高318倍），平均内存减少14倍（最高23倍），首次使得在普通机器上对数十万行数据集进行CFD发现成为可能。
Motivation: 条件函数依赖在数据质量、完整性约束和数据分析中具有重要意义，但其发现计算成本高昂。现有方法效率不足，难以处理大规模数据集。
Method: 在CFDFinder算法基础上，引入并行化策略、算法优化和工程改进，得到ParCFDFinder。将其集成到Desbordante（基于C++的高性能开源数据剖析器，提供Python接口）中，便于从Python程序调用。
Result: 与Java版Metanome相比，速度提升最高318倍（平均118倍），内存使用减少最高23倍（平均14倍）。
Conclusion: ParCFDFinder在Desbordante中的集成实现了大规模数据集上CFD的高效发现，为实际应用提供了可行方案。

papers.title: A Unified Algebraic Framework for Classification Performance Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: We propose a unified algebraic framework for classification performance evaluation that encompasses binary, multiclass, multilabel, ordinal, hierarchical, cost-sensitive, and soft-label settings within a single formalism. The foundation is a representation of actual and predicted labels as binary indicator matrices, combined with three aggregation operators -- global, column-wise, and row-wise -- that correspond exactly to micro, macro/weighted, and exemplar averaging. Any binary performance measure expressed in terms of true/positive/negative counts extends automatically to all settings by substituting these operators, generating multiclass and multilabel versions without measure-specific derivations. The framework further accommodates soft classifier outputs via argmax or thresholding, soft ground truth via triangular norms, ordinal classification via membership functions or cumulative encodings, and cost-sensitive evaluation via a cost matrix that subsumes MAE and MSE as special cases. We establish several theoretical results: micro-averaging equals denominator-weighted macro-averaging; the product $t$-norm is the unique one preserving the confusion-matrix partition; skew-invariant measures are characterised as functions of recall and specificity; and micro-precision, micro-recall, and micro-$F_1$ are all equal to accuracy in multiclass settings. Empirical illustrations on synthetic and real data confirm the theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个统一的代数框架，用于分类性能评估，涵盖二元、多类、多标签、有序、层次、代价敏感和软标签等设置。该框架基于实际和预测标签的二进制指示矩阵表示，结合全局、列式和行式三种聚合算子，分别对应微平均、宏/加权平均和示例平均。任何二元性能度量可通过替换这些算子自动扩展到所有设置。
Motivation: 现有分类评估度量在不同设置下需要单独推导，缺乏统一的形式化表示，导致扩展困难。
Method: 使用二进制指示矩阵表示实际和预测标签，定义三种聚合算子（全局、列式、行式）对应不同的平均方式。任意二元度量（如精度、召回率）通过算子替换自动生成多类和多标签版本。框架还支持软输出、软标签、有序分类和代价敏感评估。
Result: 理论结果包括：微平均等于分母加权宏平均；乘积t-范数是唯一保持混淆矩阵划分的；偏斜不变度量是召回率和特异性的函数；微精度、微召回和微F1在多类设置中均等于准确率。合成数据和真实数据的实验验证了理论发现。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了多种分类评估设置，简化了度量扩展方式，无需针对每种设置单独推导。

papers.title: Paired Uterine Whole-Slide Images and Pathology Reports for Multimodal Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Uterine diseases represent an important category of gynecologic pathology and require accurate histopathological assessment for diagnosis and treatment planning. Whole-slide images (WSI) have enabled the digital transformation of pathology workflows and provided new opportunities for artificial intelligence (AI) in computational pathology. In particular, multimodal models that jointly analyze histopathology images and pathology reports have shown promising potential for automated pathology report generation and AI-assisted diagnosis. However, the development of such systems remains limited by the scarcity of datasets that pair whole-slide images with clinically meaningful pathology reports. Instead, existing pathology datasets focus on patch- or slide-level annotations of a single endpoint (e.g., disease class), which do not fully capture the rich information in full clinical diagnostic workflow reports. Here, we introduce TUM-Uteria, a uterine pathology dataset comprising WSIs paired with diagnostic pathology reports at both the case and slide levels, collected from a tertiary medical center. The dataset contains 216 clinical cases, comprising 455 slide-level WSI-report pairs. The dataset underwent a structured multi-stage validation procedure involving board-certified pathologists to ensure reliable annotations. TUM-Uteria supports research in computational pathology, including whole-slide image analysis, multimodal learning, and automated pathology report generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 TUM-Uteria 数据集，包含 216 个子宫病理临床病例的 455 对全切片图像 (WSI) 与诊断病理报告（病例级和切片级），经病理学家多阶段验证，旨在推动多模态计算病理学研究。
Motivation: 现有病理数据集缺乏完整的 WSI-临床报告配对，限制了自动病理报告生成和 AI 辅助诊断的发展。
Method: 从三级医疗中心收集并构建了 TUM-Uteria 数据集，包含 216 个病例、455 对 WSI-报告对，并经过有认证病理学家的多阶段验证流程。
Result: 数据集已发布，支持全切片图像分析、多模态学习和自动病理报告生成等任务。
Conclusion: 该数据集填补了 WSI 与临床报告配对数据的稀缺性，为计算病理学提供新的资源。

papers.title: Finite Reliability Representations: Noise-Calibrated Belief-Space Covers for Reliable Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Physical sensing and actuation noise floors should inform how much belief resolution a decision-making system can reliably use. We introduce Finite Reliability Representations (FRR), a framework for covering belief spaces by reliability cells: regions within which the optimal action-value function Q*(b,u) varies by at most a tolerance epsilon, uniformly over actions. The framework is formulated on beliefs rather than states and uses a cover rather than an equivalence quotient, because approximate decision-closeness is not transitive in general. A central technical point is that noisy Bayesian updates should not be treated as globally contractive on arbitrary beliefs. We therefore separate three objects: the fixed-observation filter map, the predictive observation law, and the controlled belief-transition kernel. For nonlinear continuous-state systems, FRR is obtained under a reachable-set Lipschitz modulus for the belief-transition kernel. For finite-state POMDPs, the same construction becomes exact on the belief simplex: prediction is linear, Bayesian correction is a normalized positive linear map, sensor noise enters through observation-distribution distinguishability, and actuation uncertainty enters through an action-execution channel. Under the corresponding action-value Lipschitz condition, an FRR cover supports a cell-constant policy whose suboptimality is bounded by 2 epsilon/(1 - gamma). We also introduce reliability entropy, the logarithm of the minimal number of reliability cells, as a measure of certified decision-relevant belief complexity. The framework distinguishes representation sufficiency from fundamental performance floors imposed by sensing, process, and actuation noise. It applies to finite POMDPs, linear-Gaussian filters, locally linearized nonlinear filters, and particle-filter implementations through analytic or empirical certification of reliability cells.
papers.comment: 25 pages. Introduces Finite Reliability Representations for noise-calibrated belief-space covers and policy sufficiency
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出有限可靠性表示（FRR）框架，用于通过可靠性单元格覆盖信念空间，确保在容忍度ε内最优动作-价值函数Q*(b,u)变化不超过ε。该框架针对信念而非状态，使用覆盖而非等价商，因为近似决策接近性通常不可传递。对于非线性连续状态系统，FRR在可达集Lipschitz模下获得；对于有限状态POMDP，在信念单纯形上精确成立。在动作-价值Lipschitz条件下，FRR覆盖支持单元格恒定策略，其次优性有界2ε/(1-γ)。还引入可靠性熵作为认证决策相关信念复杂度的度量。
Motivation: 物理传感和驱动噪声下限应决定决策系统可可靠使用的信念分辨率，现有方法未充分处理信念空间覆盖与决策性噪声的关系，且近似决策接近性不传递，需采用覆盖而非等价商。
Method: 引入有限可靠性表示（FRR），将信念空间划分为可靠性单元格，每个单元格内最优动作-价值函数变化不超过ε。分离固定观察滤波映射、预测观察律和控制信念转移核三个对象，基于可达集Lipschitz模或线性POMDP结构构造覆盖。
Result: 摘要报告在动作-价值Lipschitz条件下，FRR覆盖支持的单元格恒定策略次优性界限为2ε/(1-γ)；可靠性熵为最小可靠性单元格数的对数，量化认证决策相关信念复杂度。方法适用于有限POMDP、线性高斯滤波器、局部线性化非线性滤波器和粒子滤波器实现。
Conclusion: 框架区分了表示充分性（representation sufficiency）与由传感、过程和驱动噪声施加的基本性能下限，为可靠决策提供噪声校准的信念空间覆盖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGE: Synchronized Action-Gaze Recognition and Anticipation for Human Behavior Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Human object interaction (HOI), gaze pattern, and their anticipation are intricately linked, providing valuable insights into cognitive processes, intentions, and behavior. However, most existing models handle gaze and actions separately, missing both their interdependence and the advantages of a unified solution. This paper presents a novel unified framework, SAGE (Synchronized Action-GazE), which integrates simultaneous recognition and anticipation of both HOI and human gaze into a single unified end-to-end trainable model. Our approach leverages a transformer-based architecture and incorporates gaze data into spatiotemporal attention mechanisms to simultaneously predict current and future human actions and gaze behavior. We explore this bidirectional relationship between gaze and actions under different scenarios, whether requiring a close-up, detailed view (egocentric) or a wider, more contextual view (exocentric), making our framework versatile for various applications. Additionally, due to lack of datasets for comprehensive analysis of both HOI and gaze in exocentric videos, we establish a new benchmark Exo-Cook to facilitate further research in this domain. Experiments on three benchmark datasets: VidHOI, EGTEA Gaze+, and Exo-Cook show that jointly modeling gaze and actions across current and future frames achieves consistently strong results, often surpassing specialized state-of-the-art models tailored to individual tasks. By unifying actions and attention in a comprehensive way, our work lays the groundwork for more intuitive human-machine interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE统一框架，同步识别和预测人类物体交互（HOI）与注视行为，利用Transformer架构将注视数据融入时空注意力，同时处理当前和未来帧。在VidHOI、EGTEA Gaze+及新建立的Exo-Cook基准上，联合建模方法取得一致强结果，常超过专门任务的最优模型。
Motivation: 现有模型通常分别处理注视和动作，忽略了二者的相互依赖关系，缺乏统一解决方案。
Method: 提出端到端可训练的SAGE框架，基于Transformer，将注视数据整合到时空注意力机制中，同时识别和预测当前及未来的HOI与注视行为，适用于第一人称（egocentric）和第三人称（exocentric）视角。建立Exo-Cook基准数据集以补充exocentric视频中HOI和注视的综合分析。
Result: 在VidHOI、EGTEA Gaze+和Exo-Cook三个数据集上，联合建模在多项任务上取得强结果，常常超过针对各任务的专门方法。
Conclusion: 通过统一动作和注意力，该工作为更直观的人机交互奠定了基础。

papers.title: When Does Small Data Work? Accuracy and Efficiency Trade-offs Between Tabular Foundation Models and Conventional Methods for Crowd-State Classification at Hajj and Umrah
papers.abstract_en: Learning from few labeled examples is a central challenge in tabular machine learning, and it becomes the binding constraint in domains where labeling is costly, such as crowd monitoring during Hajj and Umrah. Tabular foundation models, which predict from only a handful of examples without task-specific training, were recently introduced to address this very-few-label regime. In this study we test them on crowd-state classification to assess how much they help when labels are scarce, and we compare them against standard machine learning methods to characterize the accuracy and efficiency trade-offs between the two approaches. Using three real datasets we evaluate different machine learning models, in untuned and tuned forms, against three foundation models. Results show that no single family is best everywhere. The right choice depends on the label budget. When labels are very few, foundation models lead. As labels grow, tuned conventional models catch up and significantly surpass the foundation models on the more structural geometry target. Efficiency separates them further where tuned machine learning models incur a large tuning cost that foundation models avoid, although foundation models reprocess their context at every prediction. We summarize these results as a practical map of which approach to prefer under a given label budget and computational budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在标签稀缺的朝觐人群状态分类任务中，表格基础模型与传统机器学习方法的准确性与效率权衡。基于三个真实数据集，评估了多种模型（含未调优与调优版本）与三种基础模型。结果显示，没有单一方法始终最优：标签极少时基础模型领先；标签增多后，调优的传统方法在结构化的几何目标上显著超越基础模型；效率上，传统方法调优成本高，而基础模型每次预测需重新处理上下文。
Motivation: 在朝觐人群监控等场景中，标注成本高昂，标签稀缺成为主要约束。需要对比表格基础模型（仅需少量样本预测）与传统方法在极少标签情况下的表现，并明确准确性与效率的权衡。
Method: 使用三个真实人群状态数据集，评估多种传统机器学习模型（未调优和经过超参数调优）与三种表格基础模型，对比不同标签预算下的性能与计算成本。
Result: 没有单一模型族在所有场景下最优。标签极少时，基础模型领先；随着标签增加，调优后的传统模型在结构化几何目标上显著超越基础模型。传统模型的调优成本高，而基础模型每预测需重新处理上下文。
Conclusion: 给出了在不同标签预算和计算预算下选择模型类型的实用指南：标签极少时优先基础模型，标签充裕时调优传统模型更优，需权衡调优成本与推理计算开销。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
papers.abstract_en: While decoders have rapidly scaled, encoders have remained largely unchanged since BERT. We revisit this disparity by frozen backbone evaluation via probing. Under this lens, the representations of BERT encoders become increasingly $\textit{unexploitable}$ by frozen probes, despite improved perplexity. The misalignment originates in BERT's flat design, which couples representation learning to the token reconstruction loss. We propose $\textbf{CrossBERT}$, a two-part architecture that separates the learning of high-quality encoded representations from the rigid grounding of token reconstruction. This design further enables high masking ratios ($\ge 50\%$) and gradient collection over all tokens via a $\textit{Complementary Masking Strategy}$, respectively increasing throughput by $1.5$ to $2\times$ and sample efficiency by $2\times$. Overall, CrossBERT demonstrates monotonic scaling and superior performance on MTEB(eng, v2) and frozen GLUE benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CrossBERT架构，通过分离表示学习与token重建损失，解决了BERT编码器在冻结探针下表示不可利用的问题。该架构支持高掩码率和互补掩码策略，提升吞吐量1.5-2倍和样本效率2倍，在MTEB和冻结GLUE上表现更优。
Motivation: BERT编码器在冻结探针下表示质量下降，原因是其平坦设计将表示学习与token重建损失耦合，限制了编码器的可扩展性。
Method: 提出CrossBERT架构，将高质量编码表示的学习与token重建的刚性约束分离，并采用互补掩码策略实现高掩码率（≥50%），同时在所有token上收集梯度。
Result: CrossBERT在MTEB(eng, v2)和冻结GLUE基准上表现优越，实现单调扩展，吞吐量提升1.5-2倍，样本效率提升2倍。
Conclusion: 分离表示与重建是构建可扩展文本编码器的有效方向，但本文未讨论下游任务微调或超出文本模态的泛化能力。

summary_sections.method: 提出CrossBERT架构，将高质量编码表示的学习与token重建的刚性约束分离，并采用互补掩码策略实现高掩码率（≥50%），同时在所有token上收集梯度。

papers.title: Explainable AI for Screening Abuse-Related Trauma in Bangladeshi Children: A Training-Free Multimodal Framework Evaluated on Noise-Aware Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: Bangladesh has an estimated 1.17 mental-health professionals per 100,000 population and only six child psychiatrists nationwide. No Bengali-language, culturally adapted tool exists for early screening of abuse-related psychological trauma in children. We present ShishuRaksha AI, a decision-support (not diagnostic) framework that fuses four screening modalities: validated questionnaires (SDQ, CPSS), Bengali narrative text, House-Tree-Person (HTP) drawing features, and facial affect. The fusion is training-free and clinically weighted, uses cross-modal attention, and includes a single-modality override rule. Every risk score is explained through clinically weighted, perturbation-based additive attribution and rendered as a bilingual (Bangla/English) report with referral routing to national child-protection services (OCC, DSS, NMHH) under the Children Act 2013. No clinical dataset of abused children can be collected ethically at this stage, so we introduce a noise-aware synthetic benchmark (500 cases, 116 positive [23.2%], four deliberate noise layers, literature-grounded HTP priors) and evaluate tree-ensemble surrogates of the fusion design (facial channel excluded) under 5-fold stratified cross-validation. The fused model reaches an AUC of 0.874 [0.834-0.908], against 0.756 [0.705-0.803] for an SDQ-only baseline, with ablation, operating-point, subgroup, and calibration analyses. We state all limitations openly, including synthetic-only data, no held-out set, text-feature circularity, and an urban-rural subgroup gap. This work is a feasibility study and a design contribution toward ethically deployable child-protection screening in low-resource settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ShishuRaksha AI，一个无训练、多模态融合的决策支持框架，用于筛查孟加拉国儿童中与虐待相关的心理创伤。框架融合问卷（SDQ、CPSS）、孟加拉语叙事文本、房树人绘画特征和面部表情，通过跨模态注意力和临床加权进行融合，并产生双语解释报告。由于无法获取真实临床数据，作者构建了一个含噪声的合成基准（500例，阳性率23.2%），在排除面部通道的树集成代理模型上评估，融合模型AUC为0.874，优于仅SDQ基线的0.756。
Motivation: 孟加拉国精神卫生资源极度匮乏（每10万人仅1.17名专业人员，全国仅6名儿童精神科医生），缺乏适合当地文化和语言的儿童创伤早期筛查工具。
Method: 提出 ShishuRaksha AI 框架，无训练、临床加权的多模态融合，使用跨模态注意力和单模态覆盖规则，并通过扰动法生成可解释的附加归因，输出双语报告。由于伦理限制无法收集真实数据，构建了包含四种故意噪声层的合成数据集，并采用树集成代理模型（排除面部通道）在5折分层交叉验证下评估。
Result: 融合模型在合成数据集上AUC达到0.874（95% CI: 0.834-0.908），而仅使用SDQ的基线AUC为0.756（0.705-0.803）。进行了消融、操作点、子组和校准分析。
Conclusion: 本文作为可行性研究，展示了在低资源环境中可伦理部署的儿童保护筛查框架的设计贡献，但明确承认局限性：仅基于合成数据、无独立测试集、文本特征循环性以及城乡子组差异。

papers.title: Significance-First Splitting: Aligning Treatment Heterogeneity Detection with Honest Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating heterogeneous treatment effects (CATE) requires simultaneously detecting effect modification and quantifying estimation uncertainty. Existing tree-based methods make an uneasy trade-off: significance-based approaches (Radcliffe and Surry 2011) identify subgroup interactions directly but lack valid inference; honest causal trees (Athey and Imbens 2016) deliver nominal confidence interval coverage but use outcome-agnostic splitting criteria that sacrifice interaction sensitivity. We introduce a hybrid algorithm that fuses significance-based splitting with honest sample-splitting and cross-validation. Our splitting criterion uses the squared $t$-statistic for the treatment $\times$ side interaction ($t^2$), which is shown to be directly aligned with the honest $\text{EMSE}_τ$ criterion when the interaction is strong. Post-hoc honest cross-validation selects the cost-complexity penalty, giving a single principled estimator with nominal CI coverage at the leaf level. For forests, we retain bootstrap count vectors to enable an infinitesimal jackknife (IJ) variance estimate of Monte-Carlo convergence rather than formal pointwise inference. On the three synthetic designs from (Athey and Imbens 2016) the single tree achieves approximately 90\% leaf-average CI coverage at the 90\% nominal level across all three designs (200 replications each); on the Criteo and Starbucks uplift datasets we match Qini coefficient performance of S- and T-learner baselines. An open-source Python package with reproducible seeds, sklearn-compatible API, and full test coverage accompanies this work (https://codeberg.org/hadjipantelis/rattus).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合算法，融合显著性驱动的分裂准则与诚实样本分裂，用于估计异质处理效应（CATE）。单棵树在模拟数据上实现约90%的叶级置信区间覆盖率，在Criteo和Starbucks提升数据集上与基线匹配。
Motivation: 现有基于树的方法在检测效应修饰和有效推断之间存在权衡：显著性方法缺乏有效推断，诚实因果树牺牲了交互敏感性。
Method: 提出混合算法，使用治疗×侧交互的平方t统计量作为分裂准则，与诚实EMSE_τ准则对齐，后接诚实交叉验证选择代价-复杂度惩罚。
Result: 单棵树在三个合成设计上达到约90%的叶平均90%置信区间覆盖率，在Criteo和Starbucks提升数据集上匹配S-和T-learner的Qini系数性能。
Conclusion: 该方法结合了显著性分裂和诚实估计的优点，提供了原则性的估计器和名义覆盖率的置信区间。

papers.title: Directional Curvature from Armijo Backtracking: A Low-Cost Sharpness Probe and a Calibration-Free Learning-Rate Safeguard for Adam
papers.abstract_en: The local sharpness of the loss, the top Hessian eigenvalue $λ_1$, determines the largest stable gradient step, but measuring it normally requires Lanczos or Hessian-vector iterations. We observe that a single Armijo backtracking line search already carries this information at the cost of a few forward passes: the accepted step $α$ brackets the \emph{directional} curvature $q = g^\top H g/\|g\|^2$ within the multiplicative band set by the backtracking factor. Across CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST and Imagenette, $\logα$ tracks $\logλ_1$ at Pearson $-0.91$ to $-0.95$, giving a low-cost online Edge-of-Stability reading. Used once at initialisation, this measurement yields a learning-rate cap (a safeguard, not a faster optimiser) that makes Adam robust to a too-large initial learning rate across more than three orders of magnitude ($10^{-3}$ to $3.0$), at about one percent overhead, and it is a no-op when the chosen rate is already safe. One probe is enough: periodic in-training probing adds no robust benefit. The raw-gradient probe exposes the mechanism but needs a safety factor calibrated to the architecture by a one-minute divergence sweep. Probing along Adam's own update direction removes this calibration: a single fixed safety factor $κ= 2$ avoids divergence on all nine architectures we test and across the full learning-rate grids of all four benchmarks, and the recipe transfers to AdamW unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用 Armijo 回溯线搜索的一次迭代来低成本估计损失函数的局部尖锐度（即方向曲率 q = g^T H g / ||g||^2），该估计与 top Hessian 特征值 λ₁ 高度相关（Pearson -0.91 至 -0.95）。基于初始化的单次曲率测量，可导出一个学习率上限（safeguard），使 Adam 对超过三个数量级（10⁻³ 至 3.0）的初始学习率保持稳定，额外开销仅约 1%。当使用 Adam 自身更新方向进行探测时，单一固定安全因子 κ=2 在九个架构和四个基准测试的全部学习率网格上均能避免发散，且该方案可直接迁移至 AdamW。
Motivation: 局部尖锐度决定了最大稳定梯度步长，但传统测量需要 Lanczos 或 Hessian-向量迭代，计算成本高。作者希望从 Armijo 回溯线搜索中低成本提取该信息，并用于自动设置 Adam 的学习率安全上限。
Method: 利用 Armijo 回溯线搜索接受的步长 α 来估计方向曲率 q，通过一次初始探测得到学习率上限，使 Adam 在过大的初始学习率下仍不发散。探测方向可选择原始梯度方向（需架构特定校准）或 Adam 的更新方向（无需校准，固定安全因子 κ=2）。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST 和 Imagenette 上，log α 与 log λ₁ 的 Pearson 相关系数为 -0.91 至 -0.95。该方法使 Adam 对初始学习率从 10⁻³ 到 3.0 鲁棒，额外开销约 1%。基于 Adam 更新方向的探测在九个架构和四个基准测试的完整学习率网格上均能避免发散。
Conclusion: 单次初始化探测足以提供有效的学习率安全上限，周期性训练中探测并无额外收益。该机制作为安全防护而非加速优化器，在所选学习率本已安全时不会产生副作用，且 AdamW 可直接继承该方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Full Glyph Images Beat Token Embeddings: A Controlled Study for Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models generally represent text as sequences of discrete token embeddings, an assumption deeply rooted in current practice but rarely questioned. We challenge this representation, especially for Chinese, by replacing index-based token embeddings entirely with a single rasterized image of the character sequence, processed by a vision encoder composed of a shared ResNet and a shallow Vision Transformer. To isolate the role of input representation, we construct a dual-branch controlled framework in which both a Vision-based model and an index-based baseline share an identical decoder backbone, training objective, optimizer, and data curriculum. Any performance difference is therefore attributable to the input modality only. Across all tested decoder backbones, the Vision-based model consistently outperforms the baseline, reaching a peak accuracy of 0.429 versus 0.355 for the index-based baseline,that is, a 21% relative improvement, while converging in about half the number of training epochs. The advantage emerges especially within the first five epochs (under 21% of total data) and persists under moderate character corruption: the corrupted Vision model matches the clean index-based baseline. Ablation studies reveal that the advantage requires both spatially coherent input and a ViT encoder with 2D positional encodings. A cross-script comparison on English shows the advantage does not transfer directly to alphabetic writing systems, suggesting that the uniform visual density and radical structure of Chinese characters are enabling conditions. These findings suggest that transformers are more modality-agnostic than commonly assumed, and that discrete tokenization is not a fundamental requirement for Chinese language modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了传统语言模型使用离散token嵌入表示文本的方式，特别是针对中文，提出将字符序列直接渲染为光栅图像，并由共享ResNet和浅层Vision Transformer组成的视觉编码器处理。通过双分支控制框架，视觉模型在所有测试的解码器骨干上始终优于基于索引的基线，峰值准确率从0.355提升至0.429（相对提升21%），且训练收敛速度更快。
Motivation: 当前语言模型普遍使用离散token嵌入，但这种表示方式很少受到质疑。论文旨在探究对于中文来说，是否可以用连续的视觉表示（字形图像）替代离散token嵌入，并证明其有效性。
Method: 构建双分支控制框架：一个分支使用基于视觉的模型（字符图像经ResNet和浅层Vision Transformer编码），另一分支使用基于索引的token嵌入基线。两个分支共享相同的解码器骨干、训练目标、优化器和数据课程，从而将性能差异归因于输入模态。
Result: 视觉模型在所有测试解码器上优于基线，峰值准确率0.429对比0.355（相对提升21%），且训练收敛速度大约快一半。优势在前5个epoch（不到21%数据）内显现，并在字符轻度损坏下仍保持：损坏的视觉模型匹配干净的索引基线。消融实验表明，优势需要空间连贯输入和带2D位置编码的ViT编码器。英文跨书写系统比较显示该优势不直接转移至字母书写系统。
Conclusion: Transformer比通常假设的更模态无关，离散token化并非中文语言建模的基本要求。中文的统一视觉密度和部首结构是使视觉表示有效的条件。

papers.title: Knowing When to Stop: Predicting Execution-Consistency Convergence in Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: Repeated LLM calls are the standard way to estimate how trustworthy a Text-to-SQL result is: run the pipeline multiple times, judge each SQL execution, and use the consistency of the verdicts as a confidence signal. The open question is when to stop, when the consistency has converged. We formulate this as a convergence-prediction problem and train a family of lightweight 1-D models that observe the running consistency trajectory and decide, at each step, whether further runs are unlikely to shift it materially, and we benchmark them against a principled Beta-Bernoulli stopping rule and a learned run-count baseline. On the BIRD benchmark and two production customer datasets, our method adapts its stopping point to each user question, halting sooner when consistency converges early and continuing longer when it converges late. We further show that the weak serial correlation between runs lets us permute their order as a training augmentation, controlled by a tunable shuffling weight. Performance stays consistent across the three datasets, and to mimic an imperfect production judge we inject noise into the correct/incorrect verdicts obtained by comparing the generated and ground-truth SQL results, showing that the method still predicts convergence reliably.

TL;DR: 本文针对Text-to-SQL中重复调用LLM以估计结果可信度时何时停止的问题，提出将停止决策建模为收敛预测问题。作者训练轻量级1-D模型观察运行一致性轨迹，在每个步骤判断进一步运行是否不会显著改变一致性。在BIRD基准和两个生产数据集上，该方法自适应调整停止点，更快收敛时更早停止，更晚收敛时继续运行，并通过置换运行顺序作为训练增强。即使注入噪声，仍能可靠预测收敛。
Motivation: Text-to-SQL中重复调用LLM是估计结果可信度的标准方式，但何时停止（一致性收敛）是一个开放问题。
Method: 将停止问题建模为收敛预测问题，训练轻量级1-D模型观察运行一致性轨迹，在每个步骤决定是否继续。同时比较了Beta-Bernoulli停止规则和学习运行次数基线。
Result: 在BIRD基准和两个生产数据集上，方法自适应调整停止点，并在注入噪声后仍保持可靠收敛预测。
Conclusion: 提出了一种预测Text-to-SQL执行一致性收敛的自适应停止方法，具有较强的鲁棒性。

papers.title: InSpace: Structure-Aware 3D Indoor Scene Generation from a Single 360° Image
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in single image-to-3D generation have enabled high-quality asset synthesis, yet extending these capabilities to indoor scene generation remains challenging. Existing methods focus on asset-level generation while neglecting the structural layout, which is essential for downstream applications and serves as the spatial anchor for grounding assets. However, a single image with a limited field of view lacks the spatial coverage to recover a coherent global layout. To this end, we use a 360° image represented in equirectangular projection (ERP) and propose InSpace, a structure-aware framework for 3D indoor scene generation. InSpace comprises three stages: (1) estimating partial scene geometry as spatial priors, (2) generating coarse scene structure with view-selective cross-attention, and (3) producing detailed layout and asset geometry with textures through a global-local hybrid attention, using flow matching. We also propose ERP-FRONT, a paired ERP-Image-to-3D indoor scene dataset based on 3D-FRONT. Experiments show that InSpace generates complete 3D indoor scenes with structural layout, along with separate textured assets from a single ERP image, achieving strong performance across 3D and 2D metrics. Project Page: https://kookie12.github.io/InSpace-Project-Page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InSpace，一个基于单张 360° 全景图的结构感知三维室内场景生成框架。该方法通过三个阶段：估计部分场景几何作为空间先验、利用视图选择性交叉注意力生成粗略场景结构、以及通过全局-局部混合注意力与流匹配生成详细布局和带纹理的资产。作者还构建了 ERP-FRONT 数据集，实验表明该方法能生成完整的三维室内场景及其结构布局，在三维和二维指标上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有单图到三维生成方法主要关注单个资产，忽略了室内场景中至关重要的结构布局，且单张图像视野有限，难以恢复连贯的全局布局。
Method: 提出三阶段框架：1) 估计部分场景几何作为空间先验；2) 使用视图选择性交叉注意力生成粗略场景结构；3) 采用全局-局部混合注意力结合流匹配生成详细布局和带纹理的资产。同时构建了基于 3D-FRONT 的配对 ERP-图像到三维室内场景数据集 ERP-FRONT。
Result: 实验表明 InSpace 能从单张 ERP 图像生成完整的结构布局和分离的带纹理资产，在三维和二维指标上均取得强性能。
Conclusion: 该工作利用 360° 全景图有效解决了单图视野不足的问题，实现了结构感知的三维室内场景生成，为下游应用提供了空间锚点。

papers.title: NouveauVoice: Generating Novel Pseudo Speakers for Voice Anonymization
papers.abstract_en: Advanced neural technologies in speech synthesis and voice conversion (VC) have introduced severe risks to personal privacy, necessitating robust Speaker Anonymization Systems (SAS). Existing SAS approaches modify voice characteristics in the hand-crafted feature space or speaker embedding space, often struggling to provide sufficient identity variance across generated voices. In this paper, we propose NouveauVoice, a novel pseudo-speaker generation framework based on a Hierarchical Deep Variational Autoencoder (NVAE). Integrated as a standalone plug-in module on top of state-of-the-art architectures (FACodec and CosyVoice2), our approach leverages tractable sampling and the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) objective to synthesize highly expressive pseudo-speaker embeddings with significantly enhanced speaker diversity. Evaluating our framework under a protocol similar to the VoicePrivacy Challenge alongside Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) analysis, we demonstrate that NouveauVoice achieves strong identity concealment, yielding an Equal Error Rate (EER) exceeding 38% against an automatic speaker verification attacker model. Our system shows a reasonable trade-off between strict anonymity, rich pseudo-speaker diversity, and downstream speech utility, such as intelligibility and emotional expressiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NouveauVoice，一种基于层次深度变分自编码器（NVAE）的伪说话人生成框架，用于语音匿名化。作为插件模块集成到FACodec和CosyVoice2中，通过可处理采样和ELBO目标合成多样化的伪说话人嵌入。在类似VoicePrivacy Challenge的协议下，EER超过38%，实现强身份隐藏，同时保持匿名性、说话人多样性和下游语音质量的合理平衡。
Motivation: 现有说话人匿名化系统（SAS）主要在手工特征空间或说话人嵌入空间中修改语音特征，难以提供足够的身份多样性。
Method: 提出基于层次深度变分自编码器（NVAE）的伪说话人生成框架，作为独立插件模块集成到现有先进架构（FACodec和CosyVoice2）上，利用可处理采样和ELBO目标来合成高表达力且多样化的伪说话人嵌入。
Result: 在类似VoicePrivacy Challenge的评估协议下，针对自动说话人验证攻击者的EER超过38%，表明身份隐藏性能强；同时在下游任务中保持可懂度和情感表达等语音效用。
Conclusion: 系统在严格匿名性、丰富的伪说话人多样性和下游语音效用之间取得了合理的权衡。

papers.title: BanglaMemeEvidence: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Explanatory Evidence Detection in Bengali Memes
papers.abstract_en: Memes have become influential communication tools on social media, combining viral visuals with concise messaging to convey impactful ideas. While substantial research has examined the affective dimensions of memes, key challenges such as detecting harmful content, identifying cyberbullying, and performing accurate sentiment analysis remain critical, largely due to the need for deeper contextual understanding. In this paper, we introduce MemeEvidenceDetect, a hybrid task aimed at analyzing a meme and its contextual information to identify specific sentences that explain or elucidate its meaning and humor. To support this task, we present BanglaMemeEvidence, a curated dataset of 2,917 Bengali memes, emphasizing its significance as a resource for the Bangla language. Each meme is annotated with natural language explanations, including Meme OCR, Meme Context, and Evidence Sentences, alongside relevance scores that reflect the relationship between a meme and its corresponding annotations. To address the gap in dynamically inferring a meme's context, we propose BengaliMemeEvidenceNet, a hybrid multimodal framework that integrates textual and visual features for comprehensive meme representation. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of BengaliMemeEvidenceNet, achieving an F1 score of 0.74. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to focus on evidence detection in Bengali memes, marking a notable step forward in the analysis of memes in low-resource languages.
papers.comment: Accepted at 6th International Conference on Innovations in Computational Intelligence and Computer Vision (ICICV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 BanglaMemeEvidence，一个包含 2,917 个孟加拉语模因的多模态基准数据集，并设计了 MemeEvidenceDetect 任务（从模因及其上下文中找出解释性句子）。作者提出 BengaliMemeEvidenceNet，一种融合文本 OCR 和视觉特征的多模态框架，在 F1 分数上达到 0.74。这是首项针对孟加拉语模因进行证据检测的研究。
Motivation: 现有模因研究多聚焦情感分析，但缺乏对模因幽默或含义进行细粒度解释的证据检测，尤其在孟加拉语等低资源语言中。
Method: 构建 BanglaMemeEvidence 数据集，标注 Meme OCR、Meme Context 和 Evidence Sentences 及相关性分数。提出 BengaliMemeEvidenceNet，混合文本（OCR 文本、上下文）和视觉（图像）特征进行多模态表示学习。
Result: 实验显示 BengaliMemeEvidenceNet 在证据检测任务上达到 F1 分数 0.74。
Conclusion: 本文首次关注孟加拉语模因的证据检测，展示了多模态方法在低资源语言模因分析中的潜力。

papers.title: Scalable Semantic Steering of Embedding Projections
papers.abstract_en: Low-dimensional projections support interactive visual analysis of high-dimensional data embeddings, but their structure often does not align with analyst-defined semantic relationships. Recent LLM-augmented semantic steering methods address this gap by externalizing analyst intent from user-defined groups of seed examples, but they propagate intent through per-item LLM reasoning, causing LLM calls and cost to grow linearly with collection size. We propose a scalable semantic steering method that shifts semantic computation from individual items to user-defined groups. A single LLM call generates structured profiles for all groups, which are embedded and combined with seed centroids to form hybrid semantic prototypes. The method then propagates intent without retraining, using embedding-space soft assignment, abstention, and alignment-scaled updates before reprojection. On a 5K-document LitCovid corpus, our method achieves global alignment comparable to per-item LLM steering while reducing LLM calls by over three orders of magnitude. An image case study shows that the same prototype-based mechanism extends to multimodal embeddings. These results suggest that group-level representations can make semantic steering more practical for larger embedding collections.
papers.comment: Accepted as a short paper at IEEE VIS 2026. 5 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可扩展的语义引导方法，用于调整嵌入投影以对齐分析者定义的语义关系。该方法将语义计算从单个数据点转移到用户定义的组，通过单次LLM调用生成组的结构化描述，结合种子质心形成混合语义原型，并使用嵌入空间软分配和缩放更新实现无重训练传播。在5K文档LitCovid语料上，全局对齐性能与逐项LLM引导相当，但LLM调用减少了三个数量级以上；图像案例表明该方法可扩展至多模态嵌入。
Motivation: 现有LLM增强的语义引导方法对每个数据点独立调用LLM，导致计算成本随集合大小线性增长，难以应用于大规模嵌入集合。
Method: 对用户定义的每个组发出单次LLM调用，生成结构化描述，将其嵌入并与种子质心组合形成混合语义原型；然后通过嵌入空间软分配、不确定项舍弃和对齐缩放更新来传播意图，无需重新训练模型。
Result: 在LitCovid语料（5000文档）上，全局对齐性能与逐项LLM引导方法相当，而LLM调用次数减少超过三个数量级；图像案例验证了该原型机制可推广到多模态嵌入。
Conclusion: 组级表示使语义引导方法更适用于大规模嵌入集合，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: MANCE: Manifold Aware Concept Erasure
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept from a representation while preserving the other information encoded in it. This is difficult because representations encode many concepts that are often correlated with the erasure target, so removing the target risks damaging them. We propose the Manifold Constraint Hypothesis (MCH): if natural representations concentrate on a structured, lower-dimensional manifold, then interventions should be constrained to that manifold and better preserve other information encoded in the representation during interventions. We instantiate MCH in a new concept erasure method: MANifold aware Concept Erasure (MANCE). MANCE performs iterative updates to the representations using signals from a classifier that predicts a target concept. We estimate the manifold using representations obtained from natural inputs, and then we project the concept removal update to the estimated manifold. We perform extensive evaluation on 119 settings spanning text and vision, including 13 language models, three NLP concepts, and 40 CelebA-CLIP attributes. Employing MANCE on top of previous methods shows consistent improved leakage results. We also introduce MANCE+ and MANCE++, which prepend a closed-form erasure algorithm before employing MANCE, achieving better leakage--surgicality tradeoffs relative to matched full-space updates. MANCE++, our best method, achieves state-of-the-art results on nonlinear concept erasure. These results support MCH in the erasure setting: interventions should be constrained to the natural representation manifold.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出流形感知概念擦除方法（MANCE），基于流形约束假设（MCH）在自然表示的低维流形上进行干预，以在去除目标概念时更好保留其他信息。在119个文本和图像设置上评估，MANCE++在非线性概念擦除上达到最优结果。
Motivation: 概念擦除中，目标概念与其他概念高度相关，直接去除容易损坏其他信息。现有方法未考虑表示的自然流形结构。
Method: 提出流形约束假设（MCH），基于该假设设计MANCE：利用自然输入估计表示流形，通过分类器信号迭代更新表示，并将更新投影到估计流形上。还提出MANCE+和MANCE++，先使用闭式擦除算法再应用MANCE。
Result: 在13个语言模型、3个NLP概念和40个CelebA-CLIP属性等119个设置上，MANCE显著改善泄漏结果；MANCE++在非线性概念擦除上达到最优。
Conclusion: 支持流形约束假设：干预应约束在自然表示流形上。

summary_sections.conclusion: 支持流形约束假设：干预应约束在自然表示流形上。

papers.title: DS-SAC: Density Search for Sample Consensus
papers.abstract_en: Robust geometric model estimation is a fundamental problem in computer vision. RANSAC and its variants remain widely used for this task; however, they rely on stochastic minimal sampling. In this article, we propose Density Search Sample Consensus (DS-SAC), a deterministic robust estimation framework, that avoids repeated random sampling by searching dense regions. Starting from an initial model estimated from the available points, the method performs local exploration via forward and backward search. To facilitate global exploration, DS-SAC recursively partitions the point set using signed residuals and searches each valid partition for high-consensus models. We show that DS-SAC has polynomial complexity with respect to the number of points, making it an efficient alternative to stochastic consensus-based methods. Experiments on large-scale real-world datasets for homography, fundamental matrix, and essential matrix estimation show that DS-SAC achieves higher AUC scores, competitive or lower median pose errors, and faster runtime compared with widely used robust estimators, including RANSAC, MAGSAC, LO-RANSAC, and GC-RANSAC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DS-SAC（密度搜索样本一致性），一种确定性的鲁棒几何模型估计框架，通过搜索密集区域替代RANSAC的随机最小采样。方法从初始模型出发，利用前向和后向搜索进行局部探索，并递归分割点集以寻找高一致性模型。实验表明，在单应、基本矩阵和本质矩阵估计任务中，DS-SAC在AUC分数、中位位姿误差和运行时间上优于RANSAC、MAGSAC等常用鲁棒估计器。
Motivation: RANSAC及其变体依赖随机最小采样，存在效率低和结果不稳定的问题，需要一种确定性且高效的方法来替代。
Method: DS-SAC从可用点估计初始模型，通过前向和后向搜索进行局部探索；为实现全局探索，利用符号残差递归分割点集并在每个有效分区中搜索高一致性模型。
Result: 在大规模真实数据集上，DS-SAC在单应、基本矩阵和本质矩阵估计中取得更高AUC、相当或更低的位姿中位误差，且运行速度更快。
Conclusion: DS-SAC具有多项式时间复杂度，是随机一致性方法的有效确定性替代方案。

papers.title: Order-based Causal Discovery for Multistage Processes
papers.abstract_en: Causality has become an increasingly important tool for gaining a deeper understanding of complex systems. Among various causal analysis methods, causal discovery, which identifies causal relationships among variables from data, has been widely used to uncover underlying causality in diverse processes. However, while multistage processes are prevalent in many fields, existing causal discovery methods may produce counterintuitive results, given the known process knowledge, and may not be computationally efficient for handling large datasets typical of multistage processes. To address this gap, we propose a novel causal discovery method called Order-based Causal Discovery for Multistage Processes (OCDM). OCDM is designed to infer the causal structure of multistage data while preserving their inherent hierarchical and sequential structure by explicitly incorporating process knowledge into the causal discovery process. Specifically, we propose a structural knowledge-informed order-inferring algorithm that infers the causal order of variables by incorporating information about the stage from which each variable originates, based on an order-based causal discovery framework naturally suited for inherently ordered multistage data. Furthermore, to eliminate spurious edges from the initial causal graph generated based on the inferred causal order, we introduce a novel pruning technique using stochastic gated neural networks, which offers greater computational efficiency compared to existing methods. Through experiments on various datasets, we demonstrate that OCDM effectively infers the causal structure of multistage processes, outperforming existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对多阶段过程的因果发现方法OCDM，通过整合过程知识（阶段信息）来推断因果顺序，并使用随机门控神经网络修剪虚假边，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在处理多阶段过程数据时，可能产生反直觉结果且计算效率低，而多阶段过程在众多领域普遍存在。
Method: 提出结构知识感知的顺序推断算法，利用变量所属阶段信息确定因果顺序；并提出基于随机门控神经网络的剪枝技术去除冗余边。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，OCDM能有效推断多阶段过程的因果结构，性能优于现有方法。
Conclusion: OCDM通过先验阶段知识引导因果顺序推断，结合高效剪枝，为多阶段过程提供了可行的因果发现方案。

papers.title: Refused in Chat, Written in Code: Workflow-Level Jailbreak Construction in IDE Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as IDE-integrated coding agents that decompose tasks, generate and edit files, run code, and refine outputs over many turns. Yet their safety is still often evaluated as if they were chatbots: one harmful prompt, one response, judged in isolation. We introduce workflow-level jailbreak construction, a failure mode in which a harmful objective is assembled across ordinary stages of a software-development workflow rather than generated through a single direct prompt. Using GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, we study four closed-weight backends: Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Gemini 3.5 Flash. Across 204 prompts from Hammurabi's Code, HarmBench, and AdvBench , the models show near-complete refusal under direct chat, CSV-read, and single-step code-fix baselines, with only 8/816 successful responses in each baseline condition. Under the full workflow, however, the same prompts and backends produce 816/816 unsafe teaching-shot completions, all independently confirmed by two expert evaluators under a strict rubric. These results show that conversational refusal benchmarks can substantially overstate the safety of deployed coding agents and motivate defenses that reason about safety across multi-turn IDE workflows and their generated artifacts, not only individual chat turns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了一种针对IDE集成编码代理的新型安全漏洞：工作流级越狱。作者通过将有害目标分散到软件开发工作流的多个普通步骤中，而非一次性直接提示，成功绕过了模型的直接拒绝。在GitHub Copilot上测试了四个后端模型，在204个有害提示下，直接对话基线仅有8/816成功，而完整工作流下达到了816/816的成功率，证明现有基准测试高估了编码代理的安全性。
Motivation: 现有安全评估将大语言模型视为聊天机器人，忽略了IDE编码代理的多步工作流特性，导致安全性被高估。
Method: 工作流级越狱构造：将有害目标分解到软件开发工作流的多个普通阶段（如任务分解、文件生成、代码运行等），而非通过单次直接提示。
Result: 在204个有害提示上，直接对话基线（chat、CSV-read、单步代码修复）仅产生8/816成功响应；而完整工作流下，所有816/816提示均生成不安全的教学完成，经两名专家评估确认。
Conclusion: 对话式拒绝基准测试严重高估了编码代理的安全性，亟需针对多轮IDE工作流及其生成工件进行跨步骤的安全推理防御。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Worldscape-MoE: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts World Model for Scalable Heterogeneous Action Control
papers.abstract_en: World models are rapidly becoming a core infrastructure for embodied intelligence and interactive agents: they provide controllable simulators in which agents can perceive, act, forecast, and acquire scalable experience. Yet current video generation world models are still organized around isolated control interfaces, such as camera trajectories, robot actions, or hand-joint signals. This fragmentation is increasingly a scaling bottleneck. The central challenge is not the absence of controllable generators, but the lack of a unified and extensible learning framework that can absorb heterogeneous action supervision while preserving a shared model of world dynamics. In this work, we introduce Worldscape-MoE, a Mixture-of-Experts world model built on Diffusion Transformers for scalable heterogeneous action control. Our key observation is that different controls specify different interfaces to the same underlying world: although their representations differ, they constrain shared physical regularities, scene dynamics, and interaction semantics. Worldscape-MoE operationalizes this observation through modality-aware control injection, shared and control-specific experts, and a progressive MoE tuning strategy that supports continual extension to new action modalities. Experiments across locomotion, robotic manipulation, and egocentric hand control show that heterogeneous supervision improves rather than interferes with individual control capabilities. Worldscape-MoE achieves strong results on WorldArena, improves locomotion and hand-control metrics, exhibits robust out-of-distribution generalization, and demonstrates scaling behavior as additional control data and experts are integrated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Worldscape-MoE，一种基于扩散 Transformer 的混合专家世界模型，用于可扩展的异构动作控制。该模型通过模态感知控制注入、共享和特定专家以及渐进式 MoE 调优策略，统一了不同控制接口（如相机轨迹、机器人动作、手部关节信号），并在运动、机器人操作和以自我为中心的手部控制任务上验证了异构监督的提升效果。实验表明，Worldscape-MoE 在 WorldArena 基准上取得强结果，改进了运动与手部控制指标，展现了鲁棒的分布外泛化和扩展行为。
Motivation: 当前视频生成世界模型围绕隔离的控制接口（如相机轨迹、机器人动作、手部关节信号）组织，缺乏统一且可扩展的学习框架来吸收异构动作监督，这成为扩展的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 Worldscape-MoE，使用扩散 Transformer 架构，包括模态感知控制注入、共享与特定控制专家，以及渐进式 MoE 调优策略，支持持续扩展新动作模态。
Result: 在运动、机器人操作和手部控制任务上，异构监督提升了个体控制能力；在 WorldArena 上取得强结果，改善了运动与手部控制指标，并展现了鲁棒的分布外泛化和扩展行为。
Conclusion: 异构动作监督能够改进而非干扰个体控制能力，Worldscape-MoE 提供了一个统一的可扩展框架，支持不同控制接口的共存与协同。

papers.title: Reward Lightning: Fast Video Generation via Homologous Preference Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Achieving simultaneous preference alignment and distillation acceleration in video diffusion models remains an open challenge. Existing methods optimize the two objectives over mismatched representation spaces, where improving one objective often compromises the other. To overcome this, we propose Reward Lightning, a unified framework that aligns and accelerates a video diffusion model within a single shared representation. Its central principle is homology: both objectives are evaluated on identical latent features, which mitigates the gradient conflicts that arise when they are optimized over disjoint representations. As a foundational component, we first introduce a latent reward model (LRM) that scores videos directly in the latent space, without decoding back to the pixel space. Building on the LRM, homologous preference distillation (HPD) reuses this shared backbone to perform adversarial distillation and preference alignment jointly, yielding few-step generators that remain faithful and well aligned. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the LRM surpasses pixel-level and latent-level reward baselines by $11.0\%$ and $14.7\%$ in preference accuracy, and that Reward Lightning generates high-fidelity videos in merely $1$ to $4$ steps, improving the average VBench score by $2.1\%$ while leading in text alignment, motion quality, and visual quality. Project page: https://reward-lightning.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reward Lightning 框架，通过同源偏好蒸馏（HPD）在共享 latent 空间中同时对齐偏好和加速视频扩散模型。核心是引入 latent reward model（LRM），直接对 latent 特征评分，避免解码到像素空间。实验表明 LRM 在偏好准确率上提升 11.0% 和 14.7%，Reward Lightning 可在 1-4 步生成高质量视频，VBench 分数提升 2.1%。
Motivation: 现有方法在偏好对齐和蒸馏加速时优化目标在不对齐的表示空间上，改善一个目标往往损害另一个。
Method: 提出统一框架 Reward Lightning，核心是同源性：两个目标在相同 latent 特征上评估，减少梯度冲突。先构建 latent reward model (LRM)，再基于 LRM 进行同源偏好蒸馏 (HPD)，联合进行对抗蒸馏和偏好对齐。
Result: LRM 在偏好准确率上超过像素级和 latent 级奖励基线 11.0% 和 14.7%。Reward Lightning 可在 1-4 步生成高保真视频，VBench 平均分提升 2.1%，在文本对齐、运动质量和视觉质量上领先。
Conclusion: 本文方法有效解决了视频扩散模型中偏好对齐和蒸馏加速的冲突，实现了少步高质量生成。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Fusion of OCT and OCT angiography enface for Improved Diagnostics of Diabetic Retinopathy
papers.abstract_en: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of vision impairment worldwide, highlighting the need for accurate and accessible screening tools. Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) provides high-resolution structural information of the retina, whereas OCT angiography (OCTA) offers complementary vascular information that is highly relevant for DR diagnosis. In this study, we propose a cross-modal fusion of OCT B-scans with single-channel en face OCTA using a bidirectional cross-modal attention network for automated DR classification. Two independent datasets, OCT500 and UIC, comprising 730 subjects in total, were utilized to evaluate performance under within-dataset, combined-dataset, and cross-dataset generalization settings. A ConvNeXt V2 model trained solely on OCT images served as the unimodal baseline. In addition to ground-truth (GT) OCTA, we explored the use of translated (TR) OCTA generated from OCT scans, eliminating the requirement for dedicated OCTA hardware. Experimental results demonstrate that cross-modal fusion consistently outperforms unimodal OCT classification across all evaluation scenarios. Fusion with GT OCTA improved classification accuracy and discriminative performance, while TR OCTA achieved comparable or superior results in most settings. Furthermore, TR OCTA improved sensitivity and cross-dataset generalization, indicating enhanced robustness to domain shifts. These findings demonstrate that attention-based OCT-OCTA en face fusion provides clinically meaningful improvements for DR detection and suggest that computationally generated OCTA can serve as a practical, low-cost alternative to hardware-acquired OCTA, enabling broader deployment of high-performance retinal screening systems in resource-limited clinical environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨模态融合方法，将OCT B-scan与单通道OCTA en face图像通过双向交叉模态注意力网络融合，用于糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）自动分类。在两个数据集（共730名受试者）上评估了内部数据集、合并数据集和跨数据集泛化性能。实验表明，跨模态融合始终优于单模态OCT基线，且由OCT生成的翻译OCTA（TR OCTA）在多数设置下达到或超过硬件采集的OCTA效果，提高了敏感性和跨数据集泛化能力。
Motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变是全球视力障碍主因，需要准确且易获取的筛查工具。OCT提供结构信息，OCTA提供血管信息，但现有研究未充分探索两者在en face层面的融合，且OCTA硬件昂贵。
Method: 提出双向交叉模态注意力网络（bidirectional cross-modal attention network）融合OCT B-scan与单通道en face OCTA。使用ConvNeXt V2作为单模态基线。除了真实OCTA（GT OCTA），还利用基于深度学习的翻译模型从OCT生成翻译OCTA（TR OCTA），以消除对专用硬件的依赖。
Result: 跨模态融合在所有评估场景下准确率和判别性能均优于单模态OCT。TR OCTA在大多数设置中达到或超过GT OCTA的性能，并提高了敏感性和跨数据集泛化能力。
