papers.title: NeSy-CSA: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Open-Ended Critical Scenario Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Understanding why discovered scenarios become critical in scenario-based testing is essential for effectively leveraging them in decision-making systems. Reasoning about such criticality can be formulated as an attribution problem. However, across different decision-making tasks, the causes of criticality may involve diverse state variables, interaction patterns, and failure mechanisms, making attribution an inherently open-ended problem beyond predefined explanation spaces. Existing attribution methods still struggle to balance open-ended reasoning flexibility with the interpretability and traceability required for critical scenario reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose NeSy-CSA, a neuro-symbolic framework that transforms open-ended critical scenario attribution from unconstrained explanation generation into structured and traceable reasoning. NeSy-CSA narrows the attribution space by selecting relevant factors, makes the reasoning process traceable through a dependency-aware evidence graph, and executes symbolic reasoning procedures derived from atomic operations, coordinated with evidence-constrained neural inference to support flexible open-ended attribution. We further introduce a process-level and result-level assessment module to evaluate the structural validity of the attribution process and the behavioral effectiveness of the attribution results under controlled interventions. Experiments across four decision-making environments show that NeSy-CSA improves two intervention-based measures of attribution effectiveness by 18.32% and 13.67% over LLM-based baselines. These results demonstrate its potential to transform discovered critical scenarios into reusable knowledge for subsequent testing and safety analysis.

TL;DR: 本文提出 NeSy-CSA，一种神经符号框架，用于解决基于场景测试中关键场景归因的开放端问题。该框架通过选择相关因子缩小归因空间，构建依赖感知证据图，并协调符号推理与证据约束的神经推理，实现结构化、可追踪的归因。在四个决策环境上的实验表明，NeSy-CSA 在两种基于干预的归因有效性指标上分别比 LLM 基线提升 18.32% 和 13.67%。
Motivation: 现有归因方法在关键场景推理中难以平衡开放端推理的灵活性与所需的可解释性和可追溯性，且归因空间不受约束。
Method: NeSy-CSA 包含三个步骤：通过选择相关因子缩小归因空间；构建依赖感知证据图使推理过程可追踪；执行来源于原子操作的符号推理程序，并与证据约束的神经推理协调，支持灵活的开放端归因。
Result: 在四个决策环境上的实验显示，NeSy-CSA 在两种基于干预的归因有效性度量上分别比 LLM 基线提升 18.32% 和 13.67%。
Conclusion: NeSy-CSA 展示了将发现的关键场景转化为可重用知识以用于后续测试和安全分析的潜力。

papers.title: Adversarial LassoNet: Robust Feature Selection via Stability-Driven Sparse Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sparse feature selection is critical for high-dimensional machine learning, yet traditional $\ell_1$-regularized methods are often brittle under observational noise and spurious correlations, leading to unstable feature supports and degraded generalization. Although adversarial training has been widely used to improve model robustness, its interaction with hierarchical sparse feature selection remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Adversarial LassoNet (AdLNet), a stability-driven sparse feature selection framework that integrates input-space adversarial perturbations with the hierarchical sparsity mechanism of LassoNet. We derive a tractable first-order adversarial approximation under local smoothness assumptions and provide an NTK-inspired spectral analysis to characterize how perturbation-driven training can reduce gradient concentration. Experiments on high-dimensional SERS data, six public benchmark datasets, and ColoredMNIST show that AdLNet maintains competitive sparse-selection performance while improving out-of-distribution robustness by 4.4\% and feature support reproducibility by 6.3\% under nearly matched support sparsity on ColoredMNIST. On the high-dimensional lung cancer screening dataset, AdLNet achieves a 5.3\% test accuracy gain and a 6.0\% AUC improvement over vanilla LassoNet. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/719573/Adversarial-LassoNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Adversarial LassoNet (AdLNet)，一种将输入空间对抗扰动与LassoNet层次稀疏机制相结合的稳定性驱动稀疏特征选择框架。通过可微的一阶对抗近似和NTK谱分析，在多个高维数据集上取得了更好的鲁棒性和特征复现性。
Motivation: 传统ℓ1正则化方法在观测噪声和虚假相关下特征选择不稳定，对抗训练与层次稀疏特征选择的结合尚未被充分探索。
Method: 在LassoNet的层次稀疏约束基础上引入输入空间的对抗扰动，推导基于局部平滑性假设的可处理一阶对抗近似，并提供基于NTK的谱分析解释扰动训练如何降低梯度集中度。
Result: 在ColoredMNIST上，几乎匹配支持稀疏度下分布外鲁棒性提升4.4%，特征支持复现性提升6.3%；在高维肺癌筛查数据集上测试准确率提升5.3%，AUC提升6.0%。
Conclusion: 对抗性训练可以增强层次稀疏特征选择的稳定性和鲁棒性，实验验证了该方法在多个高维和分布偏移场景下的有效性。

papers.title: When Simpler Is Better: Evaluating Translation Pipelines for Medieval Latin Manuscripts
papers.abstract_en: Despite remarkable progress in machine translation, Vision Language Models (VLMs) struggle on historical manuscripts, a domain that stresses core Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities: low-resource transliteration, archaic vocabulary, and noisy input signals. We present a systematic framework for evaluating the full image-to-translation pipeline on medieval Latin manuscripts, a setting in which scribal shorthand, ligatures, and parchment degradation expose failure modes that are invisible in clean-text benchmarks. Benchmarking on the CATMuS Latin dataset reveals a specialization gap: domain-specific Optical Character Recognition (OCR) models reduce character error rate by up to 4.3$\times$ compared to general-purpose VLMs, despite operating at orders of magnitude fewer parameters. We introduce the Interpres-Parallel-Corpus (IPC), a novel dataset comprising 1,383 aligned manuscript image lines, transcriptions, and expert translations, the first of its kind for medieval Latin. Our experiments uncover a complexity paradox: the simplest pipeline, a specialized OCR model feeding directly into a VLM, outperforms all multi-component variants. Adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or post-OCR correction introduces prompt saturation and error propagation that degrade aggregate translation quality. These findings offer both a new benchmark and practical guidance for deploying translation systems in low-resource historical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估从中世纪拉丁文手稿图像到英文翻译的完整管道，发现专用OCR模型比通用视觉语言模型（VLM）在字符错误率上降低4.3倍，而最简单的管道（专用OCR + VLM）优于包含检索增强生成或后OCR校正的复杂变体。论文同时发布了首个对齐的中世纪拉丁文图像-转录-翻译数据集Interpres-Parallel-Corpus。
Motivation: 通用VLM在处理历史手稿时因低资源转写、古词汇和噪声输入而表现不佳，而现有基准多基于清洁文本，无法暴露真实故障模式。
Method: 提出系统评估框架，在CATMuS拉丁数据集上比较通用VLM和专用OCR模型的性能，并引入新的对齐数据集IPC（1383条图像行、转录和专家翻译）。
Result: 专用OCR模型在字符错误率上比通用VLM降低最多4.3倍；简单管道（OCR→VLM）在所有变体中表现最佳，而RAG或后OCR校正反而因提示饱和和错误传播降低翻译质量。
Conclusion: 论文提供了一个新基准和实践指南，表明在低资源历史文本翻译中，简单专用管道比复杂多组件系统更有效。

papers.title: Weave: Verified Netlist-to-Schematic Conversion via Layered Graph Layout
papers.abstract_en: Converting a SPICE netlist into a human-readable schematic is a longstanding problem in electronic design automation: simulators and machine-learning pipelines readily produce netlists, but designers reason about circuits through diagrams. Recent learning-based approaches translate netlists into schematics probabilistically, yet they provide no guarantee that the generated drawing preserves the original connectivity, and their accuracy degrades sharply as circuits grow. We present Weave, a deterministic converter that turns a SPICE netlist into an LTspice .asc schematic using a layered (Sugiyama-style) graph layout, and that certifies every output by a round-trip connectivity check: the generated schematic is re-parsed into a netlist and compared, net for net, against the input. A result is reported as correct only when the two partitions are identical, giving a binary correctness certificate rather than a similarity score. Weave runs entirely client-side as a single dependency-free file and embeds a pin table for 5093 LTspice symbols. On the identical public Circuits-LTSpice test set used by the state-of-the-art LLM converter Schemato (117 circuits, netlisted with LTspice itself), Weave achieves 100% compilation and 100% round-trip-verified connectivity equivalence, compared with Schemato's reported 76% compilation and a graph-edit-distance similarity of 0.35; notably, 73% of that set exceeds the five-component threshold beyond which Schemato reports losing connectivity accuracy. On a larger and harder corpus, the 3460 netlistable circuits of the official Analog Devices LTspice demo collection, Weave verifies exact connectivity for 88.4% of circuits, with the remaining failures concentrated in a single, well-characterized class of dense multi-pin power modules.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Tool: https://senolgulgonul.github.io/weave/ Code and benchmark: https://github.com/senolgulgonul/weave
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Weave，一个将SPICE网表确定性转换为LTspice原理图(.asc)的工具，采用分层(Sugiyama风格)图布局，并通过往返连接检查（重新解析原理图并与输入网表逐网比较）提供二进制正确性证书。在公共测试集上达到100%编译和100%往返验证连接等价性，超越基于LLM的Schemato。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的方法将网表概率性地转换为原理图，但无法保证保持原始连接性，且随电路规模增大准确性急剧下降，因此需要一种确定性且可验证的转换方法。
Method: Weave是一个无依赖的单文件客户端工具，包含5093个LTspice符号的引脚表。它采用分层图布局进行网表到原理图转换，并通过将生成的原理图重新解析为网表并与输入逐网比较来验证连接等价性。
Result: 在117个电路的公共测试集上，Weave实现100%编译和100%往返验证连接等价性，而Schemato仅76%编译且图编辑距离相似度0.35；在3460个电路的Analog Devices LTspice演示集上，Weave对88.4%的电路验证了精确连接，失败集中在密集多引脚电源模块。
Conclusion: Weave提供了确定性、可验证的网表到原理图转换，在标准测试集上达到完美正确率，但在密集多引脚电源模块上仍有局限。

papers.title: Beyond Static Rules: Automated Discovery of Latent Vulnerabilities in Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in Text-to-SQL tasks, their deployment in real-world environments is hindered by latent reliability issues. Identifying these latent weaknesses is critical for building trustworthy database interfaces, yet current diagnostic approaches rely heavily on static, expert-defined rules, which lack the capability for systematic and automated exploration. To bridge this gap, we propose SAGE (Systematic Automated Guided Exploration), a novel framework designed to autonomously uncover latent failure patterns in LLM-based Text-to-SQL generation. Specifically, SAGE generates vulnerability hypotheses for given samples and references a continuously evolving Vulnerability Codex to design targeted perturbations, thereby iteratively verifying and documenting potential defects. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art open-source LLMs demonstrate that SAGE uncovers a substantial number of failure cases, highlighting the significant fragility of current models. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that the Vulnerability Codex exhibits strong cross-model transferability, indicating that the discovered patterns represent generalized structural weaknesses. Finally, we explore SAGE's potential for remediation. Although preliminary, lightweight fine-tuning on the generated samples yields promising improvements, suggesting a scalable pathway for closing the reliability loop in future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE框架，自动发现基于LLM的Text-to-SQL系统中的潜在故障模式。SAGE生成漏洞假设并利用不断更新的Vulnerability Codex设计针对性扰动，迭代验证和记录缺陷。实验表明SAGE能发现大量失败案例，漏洞codex具有跨模型迁移性，初步微调可改善性能。

papers.title: How Do Diffusion Classifiers Decide? A Bias-Centric Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have recently been repurposed for zero-shot classification, giving rise to diffusion classifiers that identify the best-matching text prompt by minimizing the noise-prediction error. Despite their growing adoption, how these models make classification decisions remains poorly understood. We introduce ASOB-Bench, a bias evaluation for diffusion classifiers along three dimensions: Attribute binding, Size-Order bias, and Background dependency. These dimensions serve not as an exhaustive taxonomy but as targeted probes of how the text-conditioned reconstruction-error score reaches a decision. Such a perspective is well studied for discriminative vision-language models, yet remains overlooked for diffusion classifiers. Extending an existing framework with five new attribute categories on newly constructed datasets, we find diffusion classifiers are less prone to attribute misbinding than an OpenCLIP baseline; on the established ComCo benchmark they are substantially more susceptible to size-order shortcuts; and on ImageNet-B they suffer far larger accuracy drops, revealing heavy reliance on background over foreground cues. Reconstruction-error heatmaps and U-Net cross-attention visualizations expose the mechanism behind each bias. Because diffusion classifiers share the same denoiser as text-to-image models, these single-pass diagnostics also point toward analogous failure modes in generation. Overall, diffusion classifiers exhibit a distinct bias profile from vision-language models, offering guidance for building more robust diffusion-based models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散分类器（diffusion classifiers）的决策机制进行偏差评估，提出了包含属性绑定（Attribute binding）、大小顺序偏差（Size-Order bias）和背景依赖（Background dependency）三个维度的基准ASOB-Bench。实验发现扩散分类器在属性绑定上优于OpenCLIP，但在大小顺序和背景依赖上表现更差，并通过重构误差热图和交叉注意力可视化揭示了偏差机制。
Motivation: 扩散分类器作为零样本分类的新方法，其决策过程尚未被充分理解，尤其是与判别式视觉语言模型的偏差差异未被系统研究。
Method: 构建ASOB-Bench，在三个偏差维度上设计新数据集，并利用重构误差热图和U-Net交叉注意力可视化分析扩散分类器的决策机制。
Result: 扩散分类器在属性绑定的新数据上比OpenCLIP更少出错；在ComCo基准上对大小顺序捷径更敏感；在ImageNet-B上准确率下降更大，表明过度依赖背景而非前景。
Conclusion: 扩散分类器展现出与视觉语言模型不同的偏差特征，这些诊断结果也可反映到其生成能力中的类似失败模式，为构建更鲁棒的扩散模型提供指导。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对扩散分类器（diffusion classifiers）的决策机制进行偏差评估，提出了包含属性绑定（Attribute binding）、大小顺序偏差（Size-Order bias）和背景依赖（Background dependency）三个维度的基准ASOB-Bench。实验发现扩散分类器在属性绑定上优于OpenCLIP，但在大小顺序和背景依赖上表现更差，并通过重构误差热图和交叉注意力可视化揭示了偏差机制。

summary_sections.method: 构建ASOB-Bench，在三个偏差维度上设计新数据集，并利用重构误差热图和U-Net交叉注意力可视化分析扩散分类器的决策机制。
summary_sections.result: 扩散分类器在属性绑定的新数据上比OpenCLIP更少出错；在ComCo基准上对大小顺序捷径更敏感；在ImageNet-B上准确率下降更大，表明过度依赖背景而非前景。

papers.title: Q-TriM: Question-Guided Tri-Modal Attention for Audio-Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Audio-Visual Question Answering (AVQA) extends classical VQA by requiring joint reasoning over video and synchronized audio. However, many AVQA systems rely on deeply stacked layers of self- and cross attention across text, video, and audio. Such sequential stacking may incur loss of information such as subtle inter-modal cues over the layers, causing errors to accumulate across sequential attention layers during the fusion. We introduce Q-TriM which performs multi-modal fusion in a shallow and parallel manner instead of a deep and sequential manner. For Q-TriM, we propose a novel framework for attention operation incorporating video and audio conditioned on text. As a result, we obtain not only standard cross attention outputs but also Tri-Modal Attention representations in which Query, Key, and Value come from distinct modalities. These attention representations are combined in parallel at a single stage, thus avoiding the multi-modal fusion with deep stacks in order to mitigate error accumulation and depth-induced issues. Q-TriM achieves state-of-the-art performance on three AVQA benchmarks, including substantial gains on MUSIC-AVQA-R, which demonstrates its robustness and out-of-distribution generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/Sunghun95/Q-TriM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-TriM 提出了一种用于音视频问答 (AVQA) 的浅层并行注意力框架，通过将视频和音频模态分别以文本为条件进行注意力操作，并引入三元注意力 (Tri-Modal Attention)，其中 Query、Key、Value 来自不同模态，单阶段并行融合以避免深层堆叠带来的信息损失和误差累积。在三个 AVQA 基准上达到最先进性能，尤其在 MUSIC-AVQA-R 上表现突出，展示了鲁棒性和分布外泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 AVQA 系统常采用深度堆叠的自注意力和交叉注意力，这种顺序融合会导致跨模态细微线索的丢失和误差累积，影响推理准确性。
Method: 提出 Q-TriM，采用浅层并行多模态融合，设计基于文本条件化的视频和音频注意力操作，并生成 Query、Key、Value 来自不同模态的三元注意力表示，在单阶段并行组合这些表示，避免深层堆叠。
Result: 在三个 AVQA 基准数据集上达到最先进性能，其中在 MUSIC-AVQA-R 上取得显著提升，验证了方法的鲁棒性和分布外泛化能力。
Conclusion: 浅层并行融合策略能有效缓解深度顺序融合中的误差累积问题，为多模态推理提供了一种高效替代方案。

papers.title: Targeted Highly Adaptive Lasso Minimum Loss Estimation of Target Functions
papers.abstract_en: We propose a Targeted Highly Adaptive Lasso for estimation of non-pathwise differentiable functional parameters such as the dose-response curve (DRC) for continuous exposure. We assume the target function lies in the $k$-th order smoothness class used to define the $k$-th order Highly Adaptive Lasso (HAL), which can be well approximated by linear spans of $k$-th order spline basis functions. We construct a projection of the true target function onto a large finite dimensional working model spanned by an initial set of $k$-th order spline basis functions, which defines a pathwise differentiable approximation of the target functional parameter. A standard TMLE is then applied with a data-adaptive initial fit, replacing the MLE targeting step with a LASSO step over HAL spline basis functions that span the target function. We prove that the resulting Targeted HAL-MLE is pointwise asymptotically normally distributed and achieves a convergence rate determined solely by the dimension and smoothness of the target function, giving dimension free rates up till $\log n$-factors. Through a simulation study for the DRC, we show that the Targeted HAL outperforms a HAL plug-in estimator in terms of bias and mean squared error. Targeted HAL offers a fully data-adaptive approach to inference on functional parameters without requiring sieve specification or parametric assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Targeted Highly Adaptive Lasso用于估计非路径可微的目标函数（如连续暴露的剂量-反应曲线）。该方法将真实目标函数投影到由k阶样条基函数张成的大维工作模型上，然后使用TMLE框架，用LASSO步骤替代MLE目标步骤。作者证明该估计量逐点渐近正态，收敛速度仅由目标函数的维度和光滑性决定，可实现维度无关的速率（除log n因子）。模拟显示比HAL plug-in估计器在偏差和MSE上更优。
Motivation: 现有方法对非路径可微参数（如剂量-反应曲线）的推断需要指定筛子或参数假设，本文希望提供完全数据自适应的推断方法。
Method: 假设目标函数属于k阶光滑类，用k阶HAL样条基函数线性逼近。将真实目标函数投影到初始样条基函数张成的有限维工作模型上，得到路径可微近似。然后应用TMLE，但将MLE目标步骤替换为对覆盖目标函数的HAL样条基函数的LASSO步骤。
Result: 理论证明估计量逐点渐近正态，收敛速度由维度d和光滑度k决定，可实现维度无关的速率（除log n因子）。模拟显示在剂量-反应曲线估计中，相比HAL plug-in估计器，偏差和MSE更小。
Conclusion: Targeted HAL提供了对函数参数完全数据自适应的推断方法，无需指定筛子或参数假设。

papers.title: FDR-Occ: Factorized Dense Routing for Full-Spectrum 3D Occupancy Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction fundamentally relies on the 2D-to-3D view transformation. Current paradigms predominantly utilize explicit physical projection, which artificially restricts the routing matrix to strict, sparse camera rays. While computationally efficient, this imposes a severe Locality Bottleneck, preventing the network from constructing holistic contextual understanding and degrading sharply when camera extrinsics are unreliable or absent. To break this bottleneck, we abstract view transformation as unconstrained bipartite routing and propose Factorized Dense Routing (FDR). By approximating dense 2D-to-3D mixing through hierarchical tensor contractions, FDR guarantees a fully-global receptive field with tractable, sub-quadratic complexity. Crucially, the mandatory spatial contraction in dense routing exposes a fundamental Resolution-Context Trade-off. To address this, we introduce a Resolution-Context Decoupled Architecture. We factorize the 3D space into a global macroscopic topological anchor (via FDR) and precise local geometric planes (via explicit projection). This decoupling enables global semantic inference and exact surface localization to complement each other without mutual compromise. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Occ3D-nuScenes and Occ3D-Waymo benchmarks. More notably, in an uncalibrated setting where physical extrinsics are withheld, our global routing internalizes the implicit multi-camera rig topology and exhibits substantially stronger structural robustness than physical-projection baselines under the same protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于视觉的3D占据预测中2D到3D视图变换的局部性瓶颈，提出因子化密集路由（FDR）方法。通过层次化张量收缩近似密集2D-3D混合，保证全局感受野且复杂度次二次。针对密集路由中的分辨率-上下文权衡，提出分辨率-上下文解耦架构，融合全局拓扑语义和局部几何定位。在Occ3D-nuScenes和Occ3D-Waymo基准上达到最先进性能，并在无标定设置下表现出更强的结构鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有显式物理投影方法的路由矩阵受限于稀疏相机射线，造成局部性瓶颈，阻碍全局上下文理解，且在外参不可靠时性能急剧下降。
Method: 将视图变换抽象为无约束二分路由，提出因子化密集路由（FDR），通过层次化张量收缩实现全全局感受野；并设计分辨率-上下文解耦架构，用FDR构建宏观拓扑锚点，用显式投影恢复局部几何平面。
Result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes和Occ3D-Waymo基准上达到最优性能；在无标定设置中外参缺失时，FDR内化多相机拓扑关系，比物理投影基线表现出更强结构鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 密集路由可打破局部性瓶颈，且解耦架构能平衡全局语义与局部精度，适用于外参不可靠场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DualView: Preventing Indirect Prompt Injection in Personal AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI agents that run on the user's local machine, such as OpenClaw, automate daily tasks including web search, email, and file management. Their access to computer resources, including the network, file system, and shell, exposes them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks. Prior Dual LLM defenses block IPI by replacing untrusted data with symbols that the agent can reference but not read. However, they track untrusted data only inside the agent's context, so when the agent saves and later rereads untrusted data, that data, possibly an attacker's prompt, can return as trusted data rather than as a symbol, which we call stored IPI. Operating on the user's real environment, which humans and programs share, is what makes agents like OpenClaw practical, and is exactly why a defense that ignores it is incomplete. Preserving symbols in such an environment is hard, because humans and programs need original data. We present DualView, which extends untrusted data tracking from the agent's context to the user's environment, including the file system, shell, network, and other agents, by giving each channel two views. In AgentView, the agent sees untrusted data as symbols even after writing it out and reading it back, blocking stored IPI, while HumanView preserves original data for humans and tools. DualView routes each tool call to the right view and synchronizes data across the two views. DualView deploys as an OpenClaw plugin using only tool hooks, without changing the agent's tool-call logic or tool implementations. Since DualView isolates untrusted data by design, its protection is not limited to known attack templates. In our evaluation on an IPI benchmark and PinchBench, DualView blocked every IPI attack, including stored IPI, while keeping utility close to the unprotected baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DualView，一种针对个人AI代理（如OpenClaw）的间接提示注入（IPI）防御方法。通过将不可信数据在代理视角中显示为符号，同时在用户视角保留原始数据，DualView防止了存储型IPI攻击，在IPI基准和PinchBench上完全阻止了所有攻击，同时保持与未受保护基线相当的实用性。
Motivation: 现有Dual LLM防御仅跟踪代理上下文中的不可信数据，无法处理代理将不可信数据保存后重新读取时产生的存储型IPI攻击，而个人AI代理在用户真实环境中运行的特点使这一问题尤为突出。
Method: DualView将不可信数据追踪从代理上下文扩展到用户环境（包括文件系统、shell、网络等），通过为每个通道提供AgentView（将不可信数据显示为符号）和HumanView（保留原始数据）两个视图，并路由工具调用至正确视图，实现数据同步。
Result: 在IPI基准和PinchBench上，DualView阻止了所有IPI攻击（包括存储型IPI），同时保持与未受保护基线接近的实用性。
Conclusion: DualView通过设计隔离不可信数据，不限于已知攻击模板，且可作为OpenClaw插件部署，无需修改代理工具调用逻辑或工具实现。

papers.title: CGGS: Consistency-Augmented Geometric Gaussian Splatting for Ego-centric 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Challenges remain in ego-centric 3D scene generation due to limited view overlap and the dominant influence of individual perspectives on scene interpretation. These factors hinder the creation of viewpoint-consistent and semantically aligned visual content, as well as the construction of accurate geometric structures. In this paper, we propose CGGS, a text-to-3D framework aiming to enhance 3D-content-awareness and address geometric distortions in ego-centric scene generation. Firstly, the Ego-centric Generator is proposed by fine-tuning a Multi-View Latent Diffusion Model with consistency-augmented loss to generate consistent, high-fidelity 2D content aligned with textual descriptions. Then, Layout Decorator leverages optical flow and point-track correspondence to estimate depth, therefore producing dense point clouds as coarse layouts from the ego-centric 2D priors. Building on this initialization, Geometric Refiner is proposed to enhance 3D Gaussian reconstruction via an entropy-based Mutual Information Depth Loss (MID) combined with a hierarchical optimization scheme for improving visual quality and geometric structure. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that \textcolor{softred}{CGGS} outperforms previous methods in generating coherent and accurate text-driven 3D scenes. Project page: https://cggs-26.github.io/cggs26/.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables, IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CGGS，一种用于自我中心3D场景生成的文本到3D框架。该方法通过一致性增强损失微调多视图潜在扩散模型生成一致2D内容，利用光流和点对应估计深度产生点云布局，再通过基于互信息的深度损失和层次化优化改进3D高斯重建。实验表明CGGS在生成连贯准确的3D场景方面优于先前方法。
Motivation: 自我中心3D场景生成面临视角重叠有限和个体视角主导场景理解的问题，导致视角一致性和语义对齐困难以及几何结构失真。
Method: 提出包含三部分：Ego-centric Generator（一致性增强多视图潜在扩散模型）、Layout Decorator（利用光流和点对应估计深度生成点云布局）、Geometric Refiner（熵基互信息深度损失MID和层次化优化增强3D高斯重建）。
Result: 实验证明CGGS在基于文本的3D场景生成中优于先前方法，在生成连贯性和准确性上取得更好性能。
Conclusion: 该框架通过一致性增强和几何优化解决了自我中心场景中的几何失真问题，为文本驱动的3D场景生成提供了有效方案。

summary_sections.result: 实验证明CGGS在基于文本的3D场景生成中优于先前方法，在生成连贯性和准确性上取得更好性能。

papers.title: TRISTAR: Triple-Signal Stair Recognition and Vision-Only Indoor Navigation for Search-and-Rescue Micro-UAVs
papers.abstract_en: Indoor search-and-rescue (SAR) operations often require rapid situational awareness where GNSS signals are unavailable and human access is difficult or hazardous. While most autonomous aerial systems rely on LiDAR, stereo vision, or specialized depth cameras, such solutions increase both hardware complexity and deployment costs. This paper presents a complete autonomous indoor navigation framework for low-cost unmanned aerial vehicles based exclusively on monocular vision. Implemented on a DJI Tello platform, the system combines monocular depth estimation using Depth Anything V2 with classical computer vision and lightweight deep learning models for scene understanding, victim detection, and hazard recognition. The framework consists of two independent behaviors: (i) corridor exploration with automatic door detection, room entry, OCR-based room identification, and victim inspection; and (ii) autonomous stair ascent based on TRISTAR (TRI-Signal STair Ascent Recognition), a novel triple-sensor fusion method that integrates structural cues (Sobel filtering), texture analysis (multi-scale Gabor filtering), and geometric depth from monocular depth estimation. Evaluation used real indoor flights in a university building. Depth calibration reduced relative depth error from 27.4% to below 10%, while the door detection algorithm reached a precision of 0.93 and an F1-score of 0.91. A dedicated ablation study shows that multi-sensor fusion significantly improves stair-recognition robustness compared to individual sensing modalities, and a failure-case analysis delineates the limits of monocular perception under challenging lighting and reflective surfaces. The results demonstrate that reliable indoor exploration and stair traversal are achievable on resource-constrained platforms without specialized ranging hardware, a practical, cost-effective solution for rapid SAR deployment.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Project repository available at: https://github.com/tavigingu/HawkOps-Indoor-Drone-Navigation-and-TRISTAR-Stair-Climbing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对搜救场景中低成本无人机室内导航问题，提出基于单目视觉的完整自主框架，包括走廊探索（门检测、OCR房间识别、受害者检测）和楼梯攀登（TRISTAR三信号融合）。在DJI Tello平台上验证，深度校准将相对误差从27.4%降至10%以下，门检测F1分数达0.91，楼梯识别多模态融合显著优于单一模态。
Motivation: 现有搜救无人机依赖LiDAR、立体视觉等昂贵硬件，成本与部署门槛高；室内环境无GNSS信号，亟需低成本、仅视觉的自主导航方案。
Method: 采用单目深度估计（Depth Anything V2）、经典计算机视觉与轻量深度学习模型；提出TRISTAR方法，融合Sobel结构线索、多尺度Gabor纹理和单目深度几何三个信号进行楼梯识别。
Result: 深度校准后相对误差从27.4%降至10%以下；门检测精度0.93、F1分数0.91；消融实验证明多传感器融合提升楼梯识别鲁棒性；失败案例分析指出单目在强光照或反射表面下的局限。
Conclusion: 无需专用测距硬件，资源受限平台也能实现可靠室内探索与楼梯遍历，为快速搜救部署提供低成本实用方案。

papers.title: Global Logic and Local Search: Dual-Stream Multimodal In-Context Learning for Verifiable Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) show strong few-shot generalization, but industrial anomaly detection remains difficult because defects are small, input resolution is limited, and textual standards are not always grounded in visual evidence. Recent optimization-based methods improve alignment through fine-tuning, but they often require many defective samples, which are unavailable in early deployment. We present Global Logic and Local Search (GLLS), a training-free framework for reference-guided multimodal in-context verification. GLLS uses a Part-Aware Visual-Logical Atlas to organize normal references and structured specifications in the inference context. It combines a Global & Logic Stream, where SAM 3 extracts partially checkable visual facts, with a Fine-Grained & Actions Stream, where MCTS selects local evidence crops under a fixed budget. Experiments on MMAD-QA and additional anomaly detection datasets show consistent gains over matched and general-purpose baselines, while keeping the final diagnostic decision traceable to explicit visual evidence throughout the inspection trace.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. 18 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GLLS，一种无需训练的多模态上下文学习框架，用于工业异常检测中的可验证诊断。它利用 Part-Aware Visual-Logical Atlas 组织正常参考和结构化规格，通过全局与逻辑流（SAM 3）提取部分可检查的视觉事实，以及细粒度与动作流（MCTS）在固定预算下选择局部证据裁剪。在 MMAD-QA 和额外数据集上取得一致改进，并使最终诊断可追溯显式视觉证据。
Motivation: 大多模态模型在工业异常检测中面临小缺陷、有限分辨率和文本标准与视觉证据脱节的问题；现有优化方法需要大量缺陷样本，初期部署不可用。
Method: 提出 GLLS，包括 Part-Aware Visual-Logical Atlas、全局与逻辑流（使用 SAM 3）和细粒度与动作流（使用 MCTS），无需训练。
Result: 在 MMAD-QA 和额外异常检测数据集上，与匹配和通用基线相比取得一致增益，保持诊断可追溯。
Conclusion: GLLS 实现了无需训练的可验证多模态上下文异常检测，诊断可追踪到显式视觉证据。

papers.title: A simplex-based measure of symmetry
papers.abstract_en: For compact convex sets $L,K \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, denote by $λ_K(L)$ the smallest size of a homothet of $K$ that contains $L$. We define a measure of symmetry based on the $n$-simplex $Δ= Δ^n \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ as the ratio \[ ρ_Δ(L):=\frac{λ_{-Δ}(L)}{λ_Δ(L)}. \] We study this measure and deduce the following results: (1) The classical Minkowski measure of symmetry $m^*(L)$ can be defined as an affine-invariant version of $ρ_Δ(L)$. (2) We improve the stability analysis for the Minkowski measure of symmetry; if $m^*(L)\ge n-\varepsilon$ then $L$ is $\tfrac{1}{1-\varepsilon}$-close to $Δ$ in the Banach--Mazur distance. (3) We obtain a novel characterization of simplices as the only convex bodies $K$ for which the function $L \mapsto λ_K(L)$ is additive (a property we term ``outer additivity''). (4) Motivated by the expressivity of ReLU neural networks, we study the depth complexity of polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^n$ under the two operations: Minkowski sum and convex hull of a union. We prove the sharp bound $ρ_Δ(P) \leq 2^d -1$ for every polytope $P$ of depth complexity $d$. In other words, simplices cannot be approximated by low-depth polytopes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对紧凸集 $L,K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$，定义了基于 $n$-单形 $\Delta$ 的对称性度量 $\rho_\Delta(L)=\lambda_{-\Delta}(L)/\lambda_\Delta(L)$，并研究了该度量的性质。主要结果包括：经典 Minkowski 对称性度量可以表示为该度量的仿射不变版本；改进了 Minkowski 对称性度量的稳定性分析；给出了单形的一个新特征：仅当 $K$ 是单形时，函数 $L\mapsto\lambda_K(L)$ 满足加性（外可加性）；以及证明了对于深度复杂度为 $d$ 的多面体 $P$，有 $\rho_\Delta(P)\leq 2^d-1$，即单形不能被低深度多面体逼近。
Motivation: 在凸几何中，对称性是重要的研究主题，但现有的对称性度量（如 Minkowski 度量）在稳定性分析和与神经网络的联系方面仍有待深入。本文旨在引入基于单形的新对称性度量，以解决这些理论问题。
Method: 定义了一个新的对称性度量 $\rho_\Delta(L)=\lambda_{-\Delta}(L)/\lambda_\Delta(L)$，其中 $\lambda_K(L)$ 是包含 $L$ 的最小 $K$ 的位似体的大小。然后将其与 Minkowski 度量关联，并利用凸几何工具进行稳定性分析和加性刻画。对于神经网络部分，使用深度复杂度概念分析多面体的表示能力。
Result: 得到四个主要结果：(1) Minkowski 度量 $m^*(L)$ 可以表示为 $\rho_\Delta(L)$ 的仿射不变版本；(2) 若 $m^*(L)\ge n-\varepsilon$，则 $L$ 在 Banach-Mazur 距离下与 $\Delta$ 的 $1/(1-\varepsilon)$-接近；(3) 只有单形 $K$ 才能使函数 $L\mapsto\lambda_K(L)$ 满足外可加性；(4) 对深度复杂度为 $d$ 的多面体 $P$，有 $\rho_\Delta(P)\leq 2^d-1$。
Conclusion: 本文建立的对称性度量及其性质为凸几何提供了新工具，特别是通过单形与 Minkowski 度量的联系改进了稳定性分析，并揭示了多面体深度复杂度与对称性之间的紧界，对神经网络表达能力有理论意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TestMate: Test-Time Domain Adaptation Aided by Lightweight Vision Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Domain Adaptation (TTDA) aims to adapt Deep Neural Networks to distribution shifts using only streaming, unlabeled test data in real time. Current methods for semantic segmentation tasks suffer from critical limitations. Entropy minimization techniques require costly backpropagation, risking catastrophic forgetting and producing noisy segmentation boundaries. Memory-bank methods, while backpropagation-free, exhibit slow adaptation, requiring numerous samples to converge and struggle to handle continuous domain shifts. We introduce TestMate, a novel, real-time, and backpropagation-free TTDA framework that overcomes these issues. TestMate leverages generalization capability of a lightweight Visual Foundation Model to guide the adaptation. We use a zero-shot instance segmentation YOLOv8-seg based model to generate unlabeled mask proposals for objects and their parts at multiple scales in real time. These proposals are fused with the primary model via a heuristic, size-ordered competitive scheme, where small, high-confidence regions dominate and refine predictions in surrounding larger, less certain areas. This paremeter-free mechanism enables immediate adaptation from the first frame, inherently avoids catastrophic forgetting and effectively preserves fine object details and boundaries, even for small objects. TestMate can be used as a standalone, efficient refinement module or seamlessly integrated into existing TTDA methods to significantly boost their performance. We demonstrate state-of-the-art results across two benchmark datasets, proving TestMate's effectiveness in three distinct adaptation tasks: TTDA, Source-Free Domain Adaptation (SFDA), and online-TTDA. Code is available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TestMate，一种实时、无反向传播的测试时域自适应（TTDA）框架，利用轻量级视觉基础模型（如 YOLOv8-seg）生成多尺度实例分割掩码提议，通过启发式大小排序竞争机制与主模型融合，实现即时适应并避免灾难性遗忘。在语义分割任务上，TestMate 在 TTDA、源自由域适应和在线 TTDA 三种任务中均达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有 TTDA 方法在语义分割中存在局限性：熵最小化方法需要昂贵反向传播且易遗忘，记忆库方法适应慢、需大量样本且难以处理连续域漂移。
Method: TestMate 利用零样本实例分割模型 YOLOv8-seg 实时生成多尺度未标记掩码提议，通过大小排序竞争机制（小区域高置信度主导并优化周围大区域预测）与主模型融合，无需参数学习或反向传播。
Result: 在两个基准数据集上，TestMate 在 TTDA、源自由域适应和在线 TTDA 任务中均取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: TestMate 可作为独立精炼模块或集成到现有 TTDA 方法中，实现实时、无反向传播的域适应，避免灾难性遗忘并保持细粒度细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stable Global Weighting of Flow Mixtures using Simplex Exponential Moving Average
papers.abstract_en: Normalising flows provide a powerful variational family for approximate inference, yet individual architectures often fail to generalise across heterogeneous posterior geometries. We revisit mixture-based flow formulations and introduce \emph{AMF\mbox{-}VI\mbox{-}sEMA}, a two-stage framework featuring a \emph{stable global weighting} mechanism based on a \emph{Simplex Exponential Moving Average} (sEMA) update. In Stage~1, a heterogeneous set of experts (\textsc{RealNVP}, \textsc{MAF}, \textsc{RBIG}) are trained independently to specialise in distinct structural regimes. In Stage~2, expert parameters are frozen and global mixture weights are learned through a temperature-controlled softmax of average log-likelihoods, followed by a smooth EMA update on the probability simplex. This design produces a tractable, data-agnostic gating mechanism (without per-sample gating or gradient backpropagation through weights) that adaptively reallocates capacity while avoiding component collapse. We evaluate the framework on ten posterior benchmarks: six canonical 2D synthetic families (Banana, X-Shaped, Bimodal, Multimodal, Two-moons, Rings) and four real/low-dimensional Bayesian targets (BLR, BPR, Weibull, Real-GMM2), with stronger baselines (\textsc{NICE}, \textsc{ResFlow}, and EM-Mixing). Comprehensive evaluation covers NLL, KL divergence, Wasserstein-2 distance, and MMD, together with diagnostics of mixture dynamics, hyperparameter sensitivity, and cross-seed robustness. Empirically, \emph{AMF\mbox{-}VI\mbox{-}sEMA} achieves consistent NLL improvements over its predecessor \emph{AMF\mbox{-}VI} and avoids the catastrophic transport failures of single-flow baselines, while maintaining stable weight trajectories ($N_{\mathrm{eff}}{>}1.4$ on all datasets) with minimal computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AMF-VI-sEMA，一个两阶段变分推断框架，通过引入基于单纯形指数移动平均 (sEMA) 的稳定全局加权机制来混合多个归一化流 (RealNVP, MAF, RBIG)。第一阶段独立训练各专家使其 specialize 在不同后验几何结构上，第二阶段冻结专家参数并通过温度控制的 softmax 平均对数似然学习全局混合权重，最后应用平滑 EMA 更新。实验在十个后验基准上评估，包括 NLL、KL 散度、Wasserstein-2 距离和 MMD，证明该方法在 NLL 上优于先前版本 AMF-VI 并避免单流基线灾难性传输失败。
Motivation: 单个归一化流架构难以泛化到异构后验几何，而现有混合流模型可能遭遇组件坍塌或需要逐样本门控。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段独立训练多个专家流；第二阶段冻结专家参数，通过温度控制的 softmax 对平均对数似然进行加权，再在概率单纯形上应用平滑 EMA 更新，实现数据无关的稳定全局加权。
Result: 在六个二维合成后验和四个真实/低维贝叶斯基准上，AMF-VI-sEMA 在 NLL 上一致优于 AMF-VI 和单流基线，有效成分数 Neff > 1.4，计算开销小。
Conclusion: 所提稳定全局加权机制可自适应分配容量并避免组件坍塌，为混合流变分推断提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 AMF-VI-sEMA，一个两阶段变分推断框架，通过引入基于单纯形指数移动平均 (sEMA) 的稳定全局加权机制来混合多个归一化流 (RealNVP, MAF, RBIG)。第一阶段独立训练各专家使其 specialize 在不同后验几何结构上，第二阶段冻结专家参数并通过温度控制的 softmax 平均对数似然学习全局混合权重，最后应用平滑 EMA 更新。实验在十个后验基准上评估，包括 NLL、KL 散度、Wasserstein-2 距离和 MMD，证明该方法在 NLL 上优于先前版本 AMF-VI 并避免单流基线灾难性传输失败。
summary_sections.motivation: 单个归一化流架构难以泛化到异构后验几何，而现有混合流模型可能遭遇组件坍塌或需要逐样本门控。
summary_sections.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段独立训练多个专家流；第二阶段冻结专家参数，通过温度控制的 softmax 对平均对数似然进行加权，再在概率单纯形上应用平滑 EMA 更新，实现数据无关的稳定全局加权。

summary_sections.conclusion: 所提稳定全局加权机制可自适应分配容量并避免组件坍塌，为混合流变分推断提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。

papers.title: Probing Low-Level Acoustic Attribute Encoding in CLAP Audio Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Audio foundation models are widely adopted as general-purpose feature extractors, yet the internal structure of their learned representations remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we analyze CLAP audio embeddings through a probing framework, studying the encoding of three fundamental perceptual dimensions: reverberation (RT60), loudness (LUFS), and spectral content, measured via spectral centroid (SC) and relative pitch (RP). Probes of increasing complexity are trained to predict each attribute from frozen embeddings across five datasets spanning noise, speech, monophonic musical notes, and music mixtures. Our primary finding is that all of these attributes are reliably recoverable from the CLAP embedding space across the examined datasets. Within this global picture, two encoding regimes emerge: RT60, LUFS, and RP are approximately linearly encoded, while SC requires non-linear probes. Both regimes generalize across eight additional audio foundation models, with the notable exception that amplitude-invariant architectures discard loudness entirely by construction. The identified linear feature directions are geometrically consistent across datasets for RT60 and LUFS, while highly domain-specific for RP. Finally, we provide a qualitative demonstration of cross-modal consistency, showing that text embeddings of acoustic descriptors align geometrically with the identified RT60 feature direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过探测框架分析CLAP音频嵌入，研究混响时间(RT60)、响度(LUFS)、频谱质心(SC)和相对音高(RP)等基本感知属性的编码方式。主要发现是这些属性均可从CLAP嵌入空间中可靠恢复，其中RT60、LUFS和RP近似线性编码，而SC需要非线性探测，且这些特性在多个音频基础模型上具有通用性。
Motivation: 音频基础模型被广泛用于特征提取，但其学习表示的内部结构尚不明确，本文旨在揭示CLAP嵌入中对低级声学属性的编码机制。
Method: 使用复杂度递增的探测分类器，在含噪声、语音、单音音乐音符和音乐混合物的五个数据集上，从冻结的CLAP嵌入中预测每个声学属性。
Result: 所有属性均可可靠恢复；RT60、LUFS和RP呈近似线性编码，SC需非线性探测；线性特征方向在跨数据集上对RT60和LUFS具有几何一致性，而RP高度领域相关。
Conclusion: CLAP嵌入有效编码低级声学属性，且编码方式存在线性与非线性两种模式，振幅不变架构会丢弃响度信息。

papers.title: CineMobile: On-Device Image-to-Video Diffusion for Cinematic Camera Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for image-to-video creation on mobile devices has increasingly focused on cinematic motion effects like bullet time, dolly zoom, slow motion, etc. While Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) exhibit strong performance in video generation, their large parameter sizes and multi-step iterative denoising processes lead to substantial computational overhead, making efficient generation on mobile devices challenging. We propose CineMobile to bridge the gap. In particular, CineMobile adopts a three-fold optimization strategy: (1) leveraging a distillation-guided pruning approach to derive a compact yet efficient model that retains the essential video generation capabilities required for cinematic effects; (2) optimizing the compressed model into a 4-step generator via a combination of diffusion distillation and reinforcement learning; (3) employing a hybrid post-training quantization strategy to compress the model footprint to under 1 GB. Experimental results show that compared to the teacher model with the Wan 2.1 architecture, CineMobile achieves a 40x speedup in generation while maintaining comparable visual quality. Specifically, CineMobile generates 49-frame 480p videos with a per-step denoising latency of 0.6s on an NVIDIA H200 GPU and 20s on the MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate 5G platform, with a peak memory usage of 1.8 GB, demonstrating its practical applicability for mobile-based image-to-video creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CineMobile，面向移动设备的图像到视频扩散模型，专门生成电影级相机运动（如子弹时间、推拉变焦、慢动作）。采用三重优化：蒸馏引导剪枝得到紧凑模型、结合扩散蒸馏与强化学习将模型加速为4步生成器、混合后训练量化将模型文件压缩至1GB以下。相比教师模型 Wan 2.1 实现40倍加速，在NVIDIA H200上每步去噪0.6秒生成49帧480p视频，在MediaTek Dimensity 8400上20秒，峰值内存1.8GB。
Motivation: 移动端图像转视频需求增长，但现有扩散Transformer (DiT) 参数量大、迭代去噪计算开销高，难以在移动设备上高效生成。
Method: 三阶段优化：1) 蒸馏引导剪枝导出紧凑模型保留必要视频生成能力；2) 结合扩散蒸馏和强化学习将压缩模型转化为4步生成器；3) 混合后训练量化将模型体积压缩至1GB以下。
Result: 相比教师模型 Wan 2.1 实现40倍生成加速，视觉质量相当。在H200 GPU上每步去噪延迟0.6秒，在MediaTek Dimensity 8400上生成49帧480p视频耗时20秒，峰值内存1.8GB。
Conclusion: CineMobile 在移动端图像到视频生成上展现出实际应用可行性，兼顾速度与质量。

papers.title: Punching Above Their Weight: Classification-Head Fine-Tuning of Tiny Language Models (TLMs) for Verifiable Multiple-Choice Tasks
papers.abstract_en: We define Tiny Language Models (TLMs) as models below roughly 3B parameters that fit on mainstream consumer devices. We study how to adapt them for and use them on verifiable multiple-choice tasks. We compare three LoRA-based fine-tuning paradigms (label generation, gold only, and our discriminative classification head) on a unified setup across several Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B and five benchmarks: HellaSwag, WinoGrande, PIQA, SciQ and ARC-C. Classification-head fine-tuning reliably outperforms label generation (+2-3%) at the 0.6B and 1.7B scales. Further, TLMs fine-tuned using the discriminative method are competitive to zero-/few-shot GPT-3 (175B), PaLM (540B) and GPT-4. The performance we report for Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B are SOTA on HellaSwag, WinoGrande, and PIQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义参数量低于约30亿、可在主流消费设备上运行的小语言模型（TLMs），研究如何将其适配到可验证的多项选择题任务。在Qwen3系列（0.6B至8B）上比较了三种基于LoRA的微调范式（标签生成、仅正确标签、判别式分类头），发现判别式分类头在0.6B和1.7B尺度上稳定优于标签生成2-3%，且微调后的TLMs能与零样本/少样本的GPT-3（175B）、PaLM（540B）和GPT-4竞争。Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B在HellaSwag、WinoGrande和PIQA上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有大型语言模型虽性能强大但资源需求高，而小语言模型在设备端部署具有潜力，但如何有效适配到可验证的多项选择题任务尚不清楚。
Method: 提出一种判别式分类头微调方法（discriminative classification head），并与标签生成（label generation）和仅正确标签（gold only）两种LoRA微调范式在统一设置下进行比较。
Result: 判别式分类头在0.6B和1.7B模型上比标签生成高出2-3%性能；微调后的TLMs与175B GPT-3等大模型竞争；Qwen3小模型在三个基准上取得SOTA。
Conclusion: 判别式分类头微调是TLMs在多项选择题任务上的有效方法，甚至能与超大模型竞争，但实验仅限于多项选择题任务，且模型规模上限为8B。

papers.title: Foundations of Equivariant Deep Learning: Unifying Graph and Sheaf Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Symmetry is everywhere in nature and society. Geometric deep learning exploits symmetries in data to improve the performance and efficiency of deep learning systems. In this paper, we extend geometric deep learning to utilize richer symmetry structures. Specifically, we develop order-equivariant neural networks (OENN), which generalize standard graph message passing and sheaf neural networks via the theory of equivariant bundles over face posets (face categories). We (i) characterize all linear order-equivariant maps, (ii) build OENN layers, and (iii) prove universal approximation theorems (UATs) for continuous order-equivariant maps, which are new results even when restricted to sheaf neural networks (for which no UAT was known before). We illustrate the framework on graph and sheaf models. Our results can also be seen as extending the known UAT for graph neural networks to a more general setting that subsumes sheaf neural networks as well. In addition, we show that OENN can be extended further to CENN, Category-Equivariant Neural Network, which gives the general form of equivariant neural networks as well as of equivariant universal approximation theorems, allowing us to leverage categorical symmetry in data (e.g., non-invertible symmetries on multiple objects with compositional relations on those symmetries).
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 as a spotlight paper with oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过面偏序集（face posets）上的等变丛理论，统一了图消息传递和层神经网络（sheaf neural networks），提出了阶等变神经网络（OENN），并证明了连续阶等变映射的通用逼近定理（UAT），这是层神经网络首次获得UAT。进一步推广到范畴等变神经网络（CENN），实现更一般的范畴对称性利用。
Motivation: 几何深度学习利用数据对称性提升性能，但现有框架未充分利用更丰富的对称结构，且层神经网络缺乏通用逼近定理。
Method: 提出阶等变神经网络（OENN），基于面偏序集上的等变丛理论，刻画所有线性阶等变映射并构建网络层，再推广至范畴等变神经网络（CENN）。
Result: 证明了连续阶等变映射的通用逼近定理；层神经网络首次获得UAT；模型可统一图神经网络和层神经网络。
Conclusion: 本文为等变深度学习提供统一理论基础，并展示了利用范畴对称性的潜力。

papers.title: Probabilistic Robustness in Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning (DL) has shown strong performance in medical image classification, but its trustworthy deployment remains challenging in safety-critical clinical settings, where prediction errors under perturbations may lead to severe consequences. Existing studies mainly focus on adversarial robustness (AR) from a worst-case perspective; however, such settings may be less representative of real medical applications. In this work, we investigate probabilistic robustness (PR) as a more practical measure of model trustworthiness. To this end, we construct a set of natural corruption settings for medical image classification and systematically evaluate commonly used DL models on MedMNIST v2 dataset. Our study provides a statistically grounded perspective on assessing the trustworthiness of DL models, thereby supporting their more trustworthy deployment in medical imaging applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学图像分类中深度学习模型的可信部署问题，提出概率鲁棒性（Probabilistic Robustness）作为更实用的度量，构建自然扰动集合并在MedMNIST v2数据集上系统评估常见模型，为模型可信性评估提供统计视角。
Motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性研究从最坏情况出发，但可能不适用于实际医疗场景；需要更贴近临床实践的模型可信度量。
Method: 构建一组针对医学图像分类的自然扰动场景，在MedMNIST v2数据集上对常用深度学习模型进行系统评估。
Result: 未报告具体数值结果，但提供了基于统计的模型可信性评估视角。
Conclusion: 概率鲁棒性可作为医学图像分类中深度学习模型可信部署的更实际度量。

papers.title: InfraNet: Quality-Aware RGB Guidance for Efficient Infrared Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Robust object detection under adverse visual conditions remains a long-standing challenge for multi-modal perception systems. Existing fusion-based methods typically require both RGB and infrared (IR) inputs, and treat them equally during both training and inference, which compromises their robustness when the RGB modality becomes unreliable or unavailable. In this case, we propose \textbf{InfraNet}, an IR-centric quality-aware framework that regulates RGB guidance during training and supports flexible RGB--IR or IR-only deployment. InfraNet employs an asymmetric architecture where the primary IR pathway extracts multi-scale infrared features for predictions, while the auxiliary RGB pathway provides reliability-controlled supervisory signals. The core of InfraNet is \textbf{QualGate}, a quality-aware fusion module that learns a task-oriented control signal to suppress unreliable RGB guidance and compensate IR features during cross-modal training. Built upon InfraNet, we design two architectural variants: a lightweight IR-only architecture InfraNet-IR and an RGB--IR architecture InfraNet-RGB-IR. Our method is evaluated through extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets (LLVIP, FLIR-Aligned, M$^3$FD, and DroneVehicle), showing strong or competitive accuracy in challenging low-light and adverse weather conditions. Notably, InfraNet maintains high efficiency in IR-only inference, making it both accurate and computationally efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出InfraNet，一种以红外（IR）为中心的、质量感知的RGB引导框架，用于在恶劣视觉条件下进行鲁棒目标检测。InfraNet采用非对称架构，主IR通路提取多尺度红外特征进行预测，辅助RGB通路提供可靠性控制的监督信号；其核心模块QualGate学习任务导向的控制信号，以抑制不可靠的RGB引导并补偿IR特征。实验在LLVIP、FLIR-Aligned、M$^3$FD和DroneVehicle四个基准数据集上验证，在低光照和恶劣天气下表现出强或竞争力强的精度，且支持仅IR高效推理。
Motivation: 现有融合方法在训练和推理时平等对待RGB和红外输入，当RGB模态不可靠或缺失时鲁棒性不足。本文旨在设计一个以红外为中心、能灵活部署RGB-IR或仅IR模式的鲁棒目标检测框架。
Method: 提出InfraNet，包括：1）非对称架构，主IR通路提取多尺度特征，辅助RGB通路提供可靠性控制的监督信号；2）质量感知融合模块QualGate，学习任务导向控制信号以抑制不可靠RGB引导并补偿IR特征；3）两种变体：轻量仅IR架构InfraNet-IR和RGB-IR架构InfraNet-RGB-IR。
Result: 在LLVIP、FLIR-Aligned、M$^3$FD和DroneVehicle四个基准数据集上，InfraNet在低光照和恶劣天气条件下取得强或竞争力强的精度，且仅IR推理保持高效。
Conclusion: InfraNet通过质量感知的RGB引导和灵活部署策略，在恶劣视觉条件下实现了鲁棒且高效的红外目标检测，验证了以红外为中心的融合方法的有效性。

papers.title: From Region Arrival to Instance-Level Grounding in Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) agents may satisfy conventional success criteria while still failing to establish reliable object-level grounding, because current evaluation protocols mainly reward stopping within a 3-meter radius and largely ignore the agent's final orientation and target visibility. We formalize this limitation as the Last-3-Meter Grounding Gap and introduce three instance-centric metrics to quantify proximity precision, target visibility, and final-view grounding. To mitigate this gap, we propose REALM (Region-to-Entity Alignment for Last-3-Meter Navigation), a plug-and-play, architecture-agnostic refinement module that decouples fine-grained target approaching from long-horizon navigation. REALM uses a visibility-aware stopping strategy to reduce premature termination and improve final viewpoint alignment. We further construct REVERIE-AIM, which provides object-instance-level goals and 180K short-horizon training samples for final-stage target approaching. Extensive evaluations across four diverse VLN backbones show that REALM consistently improves proximity precision and visual grounding success, demonstrating its broad applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出视觉与语言导航（VLN）智能体在满足传统成功率指标时仍缺乏可靠的物体级接地，将这一局限形式化为“最后3米接地差距”（Last-3-Meter Grounding Gap），并提出三个实例级指标以量化接近精度、目标可见性和最终视角接地。为缓解该差距，作者提出REALM（Region-to-Entity Alignment for Last-3-Meter Navigation），一种即插即用、架构无关的精调模块，将细粒度目标接近与长程导航解耦，并采用可见性感知停止策略减少提前终止。同时构建REVERIE-AIM数据集，提供目标实例级目标及18万短视距训练样本。在四个不同VLN骨干上的实验显示，REALM持续提升接近精度和视觉接地成功率。
Motivation: 现有VLN评估主要奖励停在3米半径内，忽略最终朝向和目标可见性，导致智能体缺乏可靠的物体级接地。
Method: 提出REALM模块，解耦细粒度目标接近与长程导航，使用可见性感知停止策略；并构建REVERIE-AIM数据集提供实例级目标和短视距训练样本。
Result: 在四个不同VLN骨干上，REALM一致提升接近精度和视觉接地成功率。
Conclusion: REALM作为即插即用方法可广泛适用于多种VLN架构，提升最后3米的物体级接地能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TSP with Predictions: Heatmap to Tour with Provable Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: The Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) has long served as a benchmark for evaluating the strength of optimization techniques in the classical theory of algorithms. In recent efforts to apply ML to algorithmic problems, TSP has also become a natural testbed for the development of ML-based techniques. A common approach is to train a neural network to output a heatmap estimating the likelihood of each edge to be part of the optimal tour; however, converting such a heatmap into an actual tour remains a non-trivial and often computationally intensive step. In this work, we propose algorithms for transforming heatmaps into tours with theoretical guarantees linking the achieved approximation ratio to the quality of the provided heatmap. In the spirit of algorithms with predictions, our results can be described as $(1+2\fracη{\mathrm{OPT}})$-approximation algorithms, where $η$ denotes the L1 distance between the prediction (heatmap) and an optimal solution (tour). Since the previous works lack such explicit guarantees, we compare our approach against them experimentally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究旅行商问题（TSP）中如何将有理论保证地从热力图转换为实际路径。作者提出算法，其近似比与热力图质量挂钩，实现了(1+2η/OPT)-近似，其中η是预测与最优解之间的L1距离。实验表明该方法优于缺乏明确保证的先前工作。
Motivation: 现有基于ML的TSP方法常使用热力图预测边权重，但将热力图转化为路径的步骤计算密集且缺乏理论保证。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出一种算法框架，将神经网络生成的热力图转化为TSP路径，并在算法分析中建立近似比与热力图误差η的关系，得到(1+2η/OPT)-近似保证。
Result: 理论上达到(1+2η/OPT)-近似，其中η为预测与最优解之间的L1距离；实验上通过与缺乏理论保证的基线对比，验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文为TSP中的热力图到路径的转换提供了首个显式的理论保证，并展示了该保证在实际中的竞争力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: G$^2$TAM: Geometry Grounded Track Anything Model
papers.abstract_en: Human spatial understanding arises from jointly perceiving geometry and semantics, enabling consistent object identification and localization across viewpoints and time. Current video segmentation models depend on explicit object appearance memory banks for instance tracking, yet they remain vulnerable to large viewpoint changes and long-term occlusions. Leveraging the spatial consistency afforded by modern feed-forward 3D reconstruction models, we propose the Geometry Grounded Tracking Anything Model (G$^2$TAM), a unified framework for promptable instance tracking in 3D using only unordered RGB images or videos. G$^2$TAM employs spatially aligned geometric representations as implicit memory, ensuring stable instance identity and localization across frames and views. At its core is a cross-modal spatial encoder that integrates visual and textual prompts into a shared geometric space, enabling end-to-end spatial reconstruction and instance-consistent mask prediction. To support training and evaluation, we construct InsTrack, a large-scale dataset with a dedicated validation split for benchmarking. Extensive experiments show that G$^2$TAM delivers strong cross-view consistency, promptable instance spatial tracking, video object segmentation and spatial reconstruction, establishing a foundation for interactive, geometry-grounded spatial reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出G²TAM（Geometry Grounded Track Anything Model），一种统一框架，利用前馈3D重建模型的几何一致性，通过空间对齐的几何表示作为隐式记忆，实现跨帧和跨视角的稳定实例跟踪。核心是交叉模态空间编码器，将视觉和文本提示集成到共享几何空间，并联合进行空间重建和实例一致掩码预测。为训练和评估构建了大规模数据集InsTrack。实验表明，G²TAM在跨视图一致性、可提示实例空间跟踪、视频目标分割和空间重建方面表现优越。
Motivation: 现有视频分割模型依赖显式物体外观记忆库进行实例跟踪，在大视角变化和长期遮挡下鲁棒性不足。作者希望利用3D重建模型的空间一致性来克服这一问题。
Method: 提出几何基础跟踪模型G²TAM，采用空间对齐的几何表示作为隐式记忆，并设计交叉模态空间编码器，将视觉和文本提示嵌入共享几何空间，实现端到端的空间重建和实例一致的掩码预测。同时构建了专用数据集InsTrack用于训练和评估。
Result: 摘要报告G²TAM在跨视图一致性、可提示实例空间跟踪、视频目标分割和空间重建任务上取得强结果。
Conclusion: 该工作为交互式、几何基础的空间推理建立了基础。

papers.title: Tensor-Train Joint Modeling for Few-Step Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion promises orders-of-magnitude faster generation than autoregressive (AR) models for sequential discrete data, yet its full potential of few-step generation has remained out of reach due to a fundamental structural limitation. The conditional-independence assumption underlying current discrete diffusion models introduces a systematic parallelization bias that compounds with the number of tokens unmasked per step, becoming severe in the few-step regime that fast generation requires. We address this with the first framework for explicit joint distribution modeling in discrete diffusion via tensor decomposition, which represents the conditional clean distribution as a low-rank tensor with controllable expressivity. The framework supports both Canonical Polyadic (CPD) and Tensor-Train (TTD) decompositions, and we identify a structural bias of TTD toward dependencies between nearby tokens, formalized through Oseledets' theorem relating TT-rank to unfolding-matrix rank, which is well-suited to sequential data such as natural language and line notations for molecular data. To enable efficient generation, we present an iterative marginal inference procedure with specialization for predetermined position schedules. Our framework integrates into pretrained MDMs through lightweight fine-tuning, yielding substantial improvements in few-step generation at a fraction of the cost of training from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离散扩散模型在少步生成时因条件独立假设导致的并行化偏差，提出基于张量分解的显式联合分布建模框架。该框架支持Canonical Polyadic (CPD)和Tensor-Train (TTD)分解，其中TTD通过Oseledets定理与依赖结构关联，特别适合序列数据。通过轻量微调预训练掩码离散模型（MDM），在少步生成上取得显著改进。
Motivation: 现有离散扩散模型的条件独立假设在少步生成时引入严重的并行化偏差，限制了其快速生成潜力。
Method: 提出基于张量分解的低秩联合分布建模框架，支持CPD和TTD分解；设计迭代边际推断过程，适用于预定位置调度；通过轻量微调集成到预训练MDM中。
Result: 在少步生成任务上，该方法以远低于从头训练的成本，显著提升了预训练MDM的生成质量。
Conclusion: 本文首次在离散扩散中实现显式联合分布建模，并通过张量分解平衡表达性与可计算性。TTD对序列数据依赖结构的偏差使其尤其适合语言和分子线符号数据。

papers.title: Folding, Reasoning, and Scaling with Open-source Drug Discovery Engine
papers.abstract_en: Accurately modeling biomolecular interactions is a central bottleneck in biology and therapeutic discovery. Here, we introduce Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE), an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model that uses co-folding as the entry point to a scalable AI-driven drug discovery engine. Rather than treating structure prediction as an isolated endpoint, OpenDDE is designed as a shared structural reasoning layer for modeling sequence-structure-function relationships across biomolecular complexes, enabling complex structure prediction today while providing a foundation for de novo design, affinity estimation, structure-conditioned optimization, and more. OpenDDE integrates advances in all-atom architecture, atomic latent reasoning, inference optimization, and large-scale data processing to achieve IsoDDE-level co-folding accuracy within a reproducible and openly accessible framework. We also identify two scaling-law directions for co-folding models, revealing practical routes for continued improvement through data, model, inference, and training scaling. By releasing training code, inference pipelines, checkpoints, and benchmarks, OpenDDE aims to democratize access to frontier biomolecular intelligence, accelerate global collaboration, and lay an open foundation for next-generation drug discovery systems that can move from predicting molecular structures toward designing, scoring, and optimizing therapeutic candidates for human health.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE) 是一个开源的全原子生物分子基础模型，以共折叠作为入口，建模序列-结构-功能关系，用于复杂结构预测、从头设计、亲和力估计等任务。该模型集成了全原子架构、原子潜在推理、推理优化和大规模数据处理，声称达到与 IsoDDE 相当的共折叠精度，并识别出两个缩放定律方向。项目开源了训练代码、推理管线、模型检查点和基准，旨在降低生物分子智能的门槛。
Motivation: 准确建模生物分子相互作用是生物学和治疗发现的核心瓶颈，现有方法常将结构预测视为孤立终点。
Method: 提出 OpenDDE，一个开源的、全原子的基础模型，采用共折叠作为共享结构推理层，整合全原子架构、原子潜在推理、推理优化和大规模数据处理。
Result: 达到与 IsoDDE 相当的共折叠精度，并识别出关于数据、模型、推理和训练缩放的两种缩放定律方向。
Conclusion: 通过开源框架，OpenDDE 旨在民主化前沿生物分子智能，加速全球协作，为从结构预测走向候选药物设计与优化奠定基础。

papers.title: Rethinking Depth Pruning for Vision Transformers: A Heterogeneity-Aware Perspective
papers.abstract_en: While prior studies have successfully compressed vision Transformers (ViTs) through various pruning techniques, most have concentrated on width pruning to achieve significant reductions in model size. Depth pruning, which removes entire layers from a ViT, is notoriously difficult for accuracy recovery despite its potential to deliver higher speedups, limiting the acceleration achieved by existing joint width-and-depth pruning methods. In this work, we reveal that the failure of existing depth pruning methods lies in their neglect of heterogeneity between different layers, and we introduce HetDPT, a heterogeneity-aware depth pruning method that avoids dimension mismatch. Comprehensive experiments on ImageNet-1K, CIFAR-100, COCO, and ADE20K validate our method: HetDPT achieves a 1.58$\times$ speedup for DeiT-B while maintaining accuracy and a 1.39$\times$ speedup for DeiT-S with nearly no accuracy degradation. Furthermore, when combined with width pruning, HetDPT+ sets a new state-of-the-art record in extreme ViT pruning, enhancing the acceleration ratio from 4.24$\times$ to 5.19$\times$ for the Isomorphic-Pruning-2.6G configuration while maintaining near-lossless accuracy; our code is available at https://github.com/Efficient-AI-for-All/HetDPT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示现有视觉Transformer深度剪枝方法的失败原因在于忽略了层间异质性，并提出异质性感知的深度剪枝方法HetDPT。该方法通过避免维度不匹配来实现高效剪枝，在ImageNet-1K、CIFAR-100、COCO和ADE20K上验证了有效性：DeiT-B实现1.58倍加速且保持精度，DeiT-S实现1.39倍加速且精度几乎无损。当与宽度剪枝结合时，HetDPT+在极端ViT剪枝中创下新纪录，将同构剪枝2.6G配置的加速比从4.24倍提升至5.19倍，同时保持接近无损精度。
Motivation: 现有深度剪枝方法因忽略不同层之间的异质性而导致精度恢复困难，限制了联合宽度-深度剪枝方法所能达到的加速效果。
Method: 提出HetDPT，一种异质性感知的深度剪枝方法，通过避免维度不匹配来移除整层，并考虑层间差异。
Result: 在ImageNet-1K上，DeiT-B实现1.58倍加速且精度不变，DeiT-S实现1.39倍加速且精度几乎无损。HetDPT+在极端剪枝配置下将加速比从4.24倍提升至5.19倍，同时保持接近无损精度。
Conclusion: 本文强调考虑层间异质性对于深度剪枝至关重要，HetDPT提供了一种有效且可微调的剪枝方案，并开放了代码。

papers.title: Conservative Subject Invariant EMG-based Gesture Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Cross-subject generalization remains a fundamental challenge in surface electromyography (sEMG)-based gesture recognition. Although deep learning methods have improved within-subject performance, they often rely on subject-specific data and struggle to balance invariance and discriminability. In this work, we propose a conservative multi-objective learning framework for subject-invariant sEMG gesture recognition. The proposed model adopts a multi-head architecture that jointly optimizes gesture classification, adversarial subject confusion through gradient reversal, and triplet-based metric learning to encourage discriminative and subject-invariant representations. To improve optimization stability, a Lipschitz-inspired adaptive weighting mechanism is introduced to dynamically balance the auxiliary objectives according to their relative magnitudes during training. The proposed method is evaluated on two benchmark datasets: UCI EMG (36 subjects, 6 gestures) and NinaPro DB5 (10 subjects, 10 gestures). On the UCI EMG dataset, the method achieves 84.48\% accuracy compared to 78.2\% reported by state-of-the-art methods. On NinaPro DB5, it achieves 61.44\% accuracy versus 41.30\%, corresponding to a 49\% relative improvement. In addition, the proposed framework reduces cross-subject prediction variance and produces more structured latent representations. These results indicate that jointly enforcing invariance and discriminability through adaptive multi-objective optimization leads to more stable training and improved cross-subject generalization in sEMG-based gesture recognition systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表面肌电信号(sEMG)手势识别中的跨被试泛化问题，提出一种保守多目标学习框架。该框架采用多头架构联合优化手势分类、对抗性域混淆和三元组度量学习，并引入Lipschitz启发的自适应加权机制动态平衡各目标。在UCI EMG和NinaPro DB5数据集上分别达到84.48%和61.44%的准确率，显著优于基线方法，同时降低了跨被试预测方差。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在sEMG手势识别中跨被试泛化能力差，往往依赖特定被试数据，难以平衡特征不变性与判别性。
Method: 提出保守多目标学习框架：1) 多头架构联合优化手势分类、梯度反转的对抗性被试混淆以及三元组度量学习；2) Lipschitz启发的自适应加权机制根据各辅助目标的相对大小动态调整权重。
Result: 在UCI EMG数据集上，准确率84.48% vs 基线78.2%；在NinaPro DB5上，准确率61.44% vs 41.30%（相对提升49%）。同时降低了跨被试预测方差，学得的结构化隐表征更稳定。
Conclusion: 通过自适应多目标优化联合强制不变性和判别性，能够实现更稳定的训练和更好的跨被试泛化，适用于sEMG手势识别系统。

papers.title: SkillFab: An Agent-Native Skill Production Platform
papers.abstract_en: SkillFab is an agent-native platform for turning missing capabilities into reviewed, reusable Agent Skills. At runtime, agents first search for reusable skills; when no adequate skill exists, the unmet capability becomes a demand-first issue before any repository or implementation branch needs to exist. Development then proceeds through a SkillFab-managed repository, Git-ingested commit evidence, maintainer review, and registry publication. The same lifecycle is exposed through web, REST, and MCP surfaces, so humans, scripts, and external agents operate on shared state rather than separate task logs. The current system uses scoped Git push URLs, native range commit ingestion, workflow-state reads, and workflow-event histories to make long-running agent work reviewable and recoverable. We document the platform model, architecture, implemented capabilities, and three case studies: an end-to-end OS-detect skill run, a Docker research package that converts operational practice into reusable skill knowledge, and an external optimization case showing how improved skill artifacts can enter SkillFab as reviewable, versioned submissions. Deployment: https://skillfab.ai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillFab是一个面向代理（agent）的技能生产平台，允许代理在运行时搜索可复用的技能，当技能缺失时通过受管理的仓库、Git提交证据、维护者审查和注册表发布来开发新技能。平台通过Web、REST和MCP界面暴露生命周期，支持人类、脚本和外部代理共享状态。文档描述了平台模型、架构、实现能力以及三个案例研究。
Motivation: 现有代理系统缺乏将缺失能力转化为可复用、可审查的技能的标准化平台，导致重复工作和不可靠性。
Method: 提出SkillFab平台，包括运行时搜索技能、需求优先处理、Git驱动的开发流程、维护者审查和注册表发布。支持范围Git推送、原生范围提交摄取、工作流状态读取和事件历史，使长时间运行的代理工作可审查和可恢复。
Result: 通过三个案例研究展示平台有效性：端到端操作系统检测技能、Docker研究包将操作实践转化为可复用技能知识、外部优化案例展示改进的技能工件作为可审查版本化提交进入SkillFab。
Conclusion: SkillFab提供了一个代理原生的技能生产平台，使代理能力开发标准化、可审查和可复用。

papers.title: City-Level 3D Surface Reconstruction with Viewpoint Orientation Partitioning and Scene Completion
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view 3D surface reconstruction is a longstanding challenge in computer vision. Although recent large-scale reconstruction methods based on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieve impressive novel-view synthesis, producing high-quality surfaces over large scenes remains difficult, due to complex geometry, long optimization, and limited memory. In this paper, we propose a novel yet simple partitioning method to efficiently and faithfully reconstruct large-scale scene surfaces. Our key insight lies in a scene partitioning method based on viewpoint orientation. This partitioning approach ensures that views with similar orientations are jointly involved for more accurate depth estimations, leading to precise surface reconstructions and balanced computation on multiple GPUs in parallel. In addition, we propose a strategy to detect and repair missing regions in the initial point cloud caused by sparse viewpoints or insufficient textures, thereby further improving the geometric quality. Extensive experiments on the GauU-Scene, MatrixCity, and UrbanScene3D datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in surface reconstruction for large-scale scenes. Project page: https://hanl2010.github.io/VOP-GS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视点方向划分的场景分割方法，用于大规模城市场景的三维表面重建。该方法确保相似朝向的视图联合参与深度估计，提升重建精度并支持多GPU并行计算。同时引入缺失区域检测与修复策略，补全因稀疏视角或纹理不足导致的点云空洞。在GauU-Scene、MatrixCity和UrbanScene3D数据集上，该方法在表面重建质量上超越了现有技术。
Motivation: 现有大规模三维重建方法（如基于3DGS的方法）在处理复杂几何、长时间优化和有限内存时难以生成高质量表面。
Method: 提出基于视点方向划分的场景分割方法，使相似朝向视图联合优化深度估计；并设计缺失区域检测与修复策略，补全初始点云中的空洞。
Result: 在GauU-Scene、MatrixCity和UrbanScene3D三个数据集上，表面重建质量优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 所提的视点方向划分与场景补全策略能高效、准确地重建大规模场景表面，适用于城市级三维重建。

papers.title: Self-Improving Diffusion Classifiers with Minority Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Prior studies have demonstrated that diffusion classifiers achieve robust zero-shot classification performance. However, their effectiveness is strongly tied to the pretraining data distribution: they perform well in majority, high-density regions of the data manifold, but are significantly less accurate in minority, low-density regions. Although prior works on minority sampling have focused on generating more minority-like images, what minority sampling fundamentally enables beyond generation remains underexplored. In this paper, we reveal a direct relationship between minority sampling in generation and the perception capability of diffusion classifiers. Specifically, we show that enhancing minority sampling broadens the coverage of underrepresented regions on the data manifold, thereby improving diffusion-based recognition. To exploit this connection, we propose \textit{Self-Improving Diffusion Classifiers with Minority Preference Optimization} (MiPO), which fine-tunes a pretrained diffusion model using minority preference rewards. Using only arbitrary caption data, MiPO generates candidate samples, rewards those that better cover minority regions, and optimizes the model with LoRA and Group Relative Policy Optimization, without additional image data, external foundation models, or external reward models. This enables stable, prompt-adaptive minority sampling and translates low-density generative coverage into improved zero-shot diffusion classification. To sum up, we show that diffusion classifier perception is biased toward majority regions, demonstrate that this bias can be alleviated through minority preference optimization, and evaluate MiPO on five standard datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示扩散分类器在数据流形的高密度区域表现良好，但在低密度少数区域表现较差。提出MiPO方法，通过少数偏好优化（使用LoRA和GRPO）微调预训练扩散模型，仅利用任意文本数据生成候选样本，奖励覆盖少数区域的样本，从而提升零样本分类性能。在五个数据集上评估了方法。
Motivation: 扩散分类器在多数高密度区域表现好，但在少数低密度区域准确性显著下降，而现有工作忽视了少数采样对分类器感知能力的直接关系。
Method: 提出MiPO，使用少数偏好奖励微调扩散模型，通过LoRA和GRPO优化，仅需任意文本数据生成候选样本，奖励覆盖少数区域的样本，无需额外图像数据、外部基础模型或奖励模型。
Result: 在五个标准数据集上，MiPO提升了扩散分类器对少数区域的覆盖和零样本分类性能，缓解了多数区域偏置。
Conclusion: 扩散分类器的感知存在多数区域偏置，通过少数偏好优化可以缓解该偏置，从而改进分类性能。

papers.title: GALOSH: Blind, Training-Free Denoising of Raw Bayer and sRGB Images by Parallel-Friendly Local Shrinkage
papers.abstract_en: Classical training-free denoisers such as BM3D and non-local means owe much of their strength to search: content-dependent block matching whose memory traffic and data-dependent control flow parallelize poorly and preclude fixed-latency implementations. Learned denoisers reach the highest quality, but they need training data, degrade outside their training domain (which we also observe), and carry per-pixel compute budgets that effectively require a GPU. We present GALOSH (Generalized Anscombe LOcal SHrinkage), a redesign of training-free denoising that removes the search entirely and aims at multi-domain coverage, speed, and quality at once: a blind per-image Poisson-Gaussian noise fit, a generalized Anscombe transform, a two-pass local Walsh-Hadamard shrinkage of luminance, and a luminance-guided local regression of chrominance -- two deliberately different operators for the two perceptually different noise components, each with its own strength control. Every stage is local, data-independent, and regular -- the same computation graph for every pixel of every image. One core serves two domains: raw Bayer mosaics and sRGB/YUV images. On four real-noise benchmarks (SIDD Medium and RawNIND, raw and sRGB) GALOSH is consistently the strongest among the tested blind, training-free methods -- surpassing BM3D- and NLM-family baselines even when those are given an oracle noise level -- and approaches trained networks on raw data while remaining below in-domain trained networks at high ISO in sRGB. Being search-free makes it fast: 7x-650x faster than the DL baselines on the same GPU at full benchmark size, and the only strong method in the comparison that also runs practically on plain CPUs. The fixed, data-independent structure is designed to map naturally onto fixed-point and streaming hardware, supported by an operation-count analysis and a working INT16 fixed-point realization.

Motivation: 现有无训练去噪方法（如BM3D）依赖内容相关的块匹配，并行化差且延迟不定；而学习型去噪方法需要训练数据，在域外性能下降，且计算开销大。需要一种同时覆盖多域、快速且高质量的无训练去噪方案。

Conclusion: GALOSH证明了无需搜索、局部且规则的结构可以同时实现无训练去噪的高质量和高速，适合固定点硬件和流处理。

papers.title: Sparse-View Surface Reconstruction using Gaussian Splatting through High-Confidence Depth Propagation with Normal Priors
papers.abstract_en: 3D reconstruction from sparse views is a challenging task in 3D computer vision. Recent studies on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable results with sparse views in novel view synthesis, yet reconstructing high-quality geometric surfaces from sparse views remains a challenge, due to the limited geometry clues and the discreteness of Gaussians. In this paper, we propose a novel 3DGS-based method for high-fidelity surface reconstruction from sparse views. Our key insight is to introduce a normal-guided depth propagation approach, which can extend depth information from high-confidence regions to constrain the depth in low-confidence areas. Additionally, we propose an abnormal depth edge-aware regularization to address depth discontinuities caused by the discreteness of Gaussians. Extensive experiments on DTU and Tanks-and-Temples datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in sparse view surface reconstruction. Project page: https://hanl2010.github.io/DP-GS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的稀疏视图表面重建方法，通过法线引导的深度传播将高置信度区域的深度信息扩展到低置信度区域，并引入异常深度边缘感知正则化处理高斯离散性导致的深度不连续。在DTU和Tanks-and-Temples数据集上，该方法在稀疏视图表面重建中优于现有方法。
Motivation: 从稀疏视图重建高质量几何表面具有挑战性，因为缺乏几何线索且高斯具有离散性。现有3DGS方法在新视图合成上表现优异，但表面重建质量不足。
Method: 提出法线引导的深度传播方法，利用高置信度区域的深度约束低置信度区域；同时设计异常深度边缘感知正则化，缓解高斯离散性造成的深度不连续问题。
Result: 在DTU和Tanks-and-Temples数据集上的实验表明，该方法在稀疏视图表面重建上超越了当前最先进的方法。
Conclusion: 法线引导的深度传播和边缘感知正则化能有效提升稀疏视图下的几何重建质量，局限未在摘要中提及。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Based Characterization of Detonation-Cell Size Distributions in Soot-Foil Records
papers.abstract_en: The geometric size and regularity of detonation cells are key physical parameters for characterizing detonation waves. Traditional manual measurement of soot foils is time-consuming and subjective, while existing computer vision techniques often exhibit poor generalization on real experimental images with high noise, blurred boundaries, and severe overlapping. To address this, we propose a novel method for automated recognition and high-order feature extraction of detonation cells based on deep learning instance segmentation (Mask R-CNN). By constructing a custom heterogeneous dataset (numerical simulations and physical experiments) and integrating transfer learning, the model achieves accurate pixel-level mask prediction within highly noisy flow fields. Results indicate high pixel-level agreement in benchmark validations and strong robustness against noise in complex real-world soot foils. Predicted average cell sizes agree well with manual measurements, yielding relative errors under 2% and 3.5% for regular and irregular conditions, respectively. Sensitivity ablation experiments confirm the model's scale adaptability and guided the establishment of a standardized preprocessing paradigm for appropriate image patching. Overcoming the limitation of extracting only global average sizes, this model achieves automated tracking of the transient spatial evolution of cell sizes along the propagation direction. Furthermore, it quantitatively extracts high-order regularity features, such as the irregularity index (RI) and standard deviation of cell deflection angles, demonstrating consistency with theoretical expectations. The proposed method enhances the efficiency and objectivity of statistical analysis, providing a powerful data extraction tool for experimental and numerical soot foils.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于深度学习实例分割（Mask R-CNN）的自动化方法，用于从烟箔记录中识别和提取爆轰细胞尺寸及高阶规律性特征。通过构建数值模拟和物理实验的混合数据集并集成迁移学习，模型在高噪声流场中实现精确像素级掩膜预测。在基准验证中达到高像素级一致性，对真实烟箔图像具有强鲁棒性，平均细胞尺寸预测与人工测量的相对误差在规则条件下低于2%，不规则条件下低于3.5%。该方法克服了仅提取全局平均尺寸的局限，实现了沿传播方向细胞尺寸的瞬态空间演化追踪，并定量提取了不规则性指数（RI）和细胞偏转角标准差等高阶规律性特征。
Motivation: 传统人工测量爆轰细胞尺寸耗时且主观，现有计算机视觉技术在具有高噪声、模糊边界和严重重叠的真实实验图像上泛化能力差。
Method: 基于Mask R-CNN深度学习实例分割模型，通过构建包含数值模拟和物理实验的异构数据集并应用迁移学习，实现高噪声流场中爆轰细胞的像素级掩膜预测。
Result: 模型在基准验证中达到高像素级一致性，对真实烟箔图像具有强鲁棒性；预测的平均细胞尺寸与人工测量相对误差在规则条件下低于2%，不规则条件下低于3.5%；敏感性消融实验验证了尺度适应性，并建立了标准化预处理范式。
Conclusion: 该方法提高了爆轰细胞统计分析的高效性和客观性，为实验和数值烟箔提供了强大的数据提取工具，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedACT: Federated Adaptive Coordinate Trust Modulation for Robust Transformer Training under Data Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Federated Transformer training increasingly relies on local AdamW, whose adaptive updates can provide much stronger local progress than SGD-based training. However, under heterogeneous client data, even globally corrected AdamW updates may remain highly uneven in coordinate-wise reliability. We refer to this phenomenon as coordinate trust mismatch. Existing federated adaptive optimizers mainly address mismatch at the client-update or communication-round level, but still apply the corrected adaptive direction densely and uniformly across coordinates. In this paper, we propose FedACT, a global-aware coordinate trust modulation method for federated AdamW training. FedACT first forms a globally corrected adaptive direction and then reallocates update magnitudes according to a coordinate-wise trust score, assigning larger steps to coordinates jointly supported by local gradients and global correction, while preserving smaller non-zero updates on the remaining coordinates. Extensive experiments on federated vision Transformers, CNNs, LLM pre-training, and LLM fine-tuning show that FedACT consistently improves over strong federated adaptive baselines, with the largest gains on Transformer models under stronger data heterogeneity. Mechanism analyses further show that FedACT improves cross-client direction consistency, suggesting that coordinate-level trust allocation effectively complements round-level global-local correction. Code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦Transformer训练中AdamW自适应更新在异构数据下坐标方向可靠性不均的问题，提出FedACT方法。该方法通过计算全局校正的自适应方向，并根据坐标信任得分重新分配更新幅度，在保持小幅更新的同时为联合支持的坐标分配更大步长。在联邦视觉Transformer、CNN、LLM预训练和微调上的实验表明，FedACT持续优于强基线，尤其在强数据异构下的Transformer模型中增益最大。机制分析显示，坐标级信任分配有效补充了轮级全局-本地校正，提升了跨客户端方向一致性。
Motivation: 现有联邦自适应优化器（如AdamW）在异构客户端数据下，即使经过全局校正，更新在坐标层面的可靠性仍然高度不均（即坐标信任不匹配），而现有方法主要在客户端更新或通信轮次层面处理不匹配，仍对所有坐标均匀应用校正方向。
Method: 提出FedACT，首先形成全局校正的自适应方向，然后根据坐标信任得分重新分配更新幅度：对本地梯度和全局校正共同支持的坐标赋予较大步长，其余坐标保留较小的非零更新。
Result: 在联邦视觉Transformer、CNN、LLM预训练和LLM微调任务上一致提升，最大增益出现在强数据异构下的Transformer模型上。
Conclusion: 坐标级信任分配有效补充了轮级全局-本地校正，提高了跨客户端方向一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAVER: Stochastic Adaptive Variance-Driven Exploration and Reconstruction for Low-Dose Computed Tomography
papers.abstract_en: Computed Tomography (CT) is indispensable in clinical diagnostics, yet minimizing radiation dose without compromising image quality remains a critical challenge. Conventional low-dose protocols often rely on fixed, uniform angular sampling, independent of the underlying structural complexity of organs of individual patients. We propose ``Stochastic Adaptive Variance-Driven Exploration and Reconstruction'' (SAVER), an adaptive data acquisition framework that selects projection angles in real-time based on the statistical variance of acquired data. Utilizing a Softmax-based stochastic scheduling scheme with simulated annealing, SAVER prioritizes directions with high structural information while maintaining necessary exploration. Numerical experiments across 8 diverse phantoms demonstrate that SAVER achieves consistently higher reconstruction fidelity than conventional random sampling, particularly for objects with high structural anisotropy. Furthermore, the proposed method exhibits robust performance under significant measurement noise. By dynamically reallocating radiation dose to the most informative projections, SAVER provides a mathematically-grounded approach to maximize diagnostic quality per unit of radiation dose, marking a shift toward sample-dependent, data-driven CT acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应数据采集框架SAVER，通过实时分析已采集数据的统计方差，利用基于Softmax的随机调度与模拟退火算法动态选择投影角度，优先采集结构信息丰富的方向。在8种不同模体上的数值实验表明，SAVER相比传统随机采样方法能获得更高的重建保真度，尤其适用于具有高度结构各向异性的物体，并在显著测量噪声下仍保持鲁棒性。
Motivation: 常规低剂量CT采用固定的均匀角度采样，忽略了患者个体器官结构的复杂度，导致辐射剂量浪费或图像质量不佳。
Method: SAVER框架实时计算已采集数据的统计方差，通过带模拟退火的Softmax随机调度策略优先选择高信息量的投影角度，实现自适应角度采集。
Result: 在8种模体上，SAVER的重建保真度始终高于随机采样，尤其对结构各向异性物体提升明显，且对测量噪声具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: SAVER通过动态分配辐射剂量至信息量最高的投影，提供了一种数学上严谨的方法来最大化单位剂量的诊断质量，推动了从固定采样向样本依赖数据驱动CT采集的转变。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GeoSAM-Lite: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Onboard Remote Sensing Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of large-scale foundation models like Segment Anything Model (SAM) on resource-constrained Earth observation platforms is hindered by prohibitive computational costs and the domain shift between natural and remote sensing imagery. To address these challenges, we propose \textit{Geo}spatial \textit{S}egment \textit{A}nything \textit{M}odel-Lite (GeoSAM-Lite), a lightweight, prompt-free segmentation framework designed for efficient onboard remote sensing segmentation. GeoSAM-Lite incorporates two core innovations: (1) Geospatial-Domain Initialization (Geo-Init), a domain-aware pre-training strategy that distills geospatial priors from a specialized teacher to bridge the domain gap; and (2) Feature Fusion Layers (FFL), which recalibrate spatial features and restore high-frequency boundary cues to overcome the capacity bottlenecks of lightweight backbones. Experiments across representative datasets, with a primary focus on cloud scenarios to evaluate performance under extreme scale variations and complex boundaries, demonstrate that GeoSAM-Lite achieves competitive accuracy while reducing parameters by 92.8\% compared to the heavyweight RSAM-Seg. By establishing a superior Pareto frontier between efficiency and fidelity, GeoSAM-Lite offers a practical solution for real-time segmentation on edge devices.
