papers.title: Exploring SAM Supervision for Fine-Grained UAV Target Segmentation under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) target segmentation remains challenging due to the small size of objects, appearance variations, cluttered backgrounds, and the scarcity of densely annotated data. These factors hinder the performance and practical deployment of lightweight segmentation models in real-world UAV applications. To address this problem, this paper investigates the use of SAM3 (Segment Anything Model 3) as a pseudo-label generator for training compact segmentation networks. Specifically, two supervision paradigms are explored: (i) direct pseudo-supervision using unaltered SAM3-generated masks, and (ii) a refinement strategy that re-applies SAM3 to localized image patches for improved mask quality. Based on these paradigms, a two-stage SAM3-guided pseudo-label generation framework is proposed. In the first stage, SAM3 generates coarse masks for initial object localization. The localized regions are subsequently cropped into patches and processed by SAM3 again to generate fine masks with accurate object boundaries and discard false positives. The resulting coarse and fine masks are then used as pseudo-labels to optimize a lightweight network, termed IPS-Seg, which consists of three components: an IdentityFormer backbone for feature extraction, an Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling module for multi-scale context aggregation, and a PixelShuffle-based decoder for spatial resolution recovery. Extensive experiments under multiple supervision settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The results show that IPS-Seg achieves a favorable trade-off between segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency while benefiting consistently from the proposed pseudo-label generation strategy. These findings highlight the potential of large-scale foundation models as annotation sources for training compact task-specific segmentation networks in low-label vision domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机目标分割中目标小、背景杂乱以及标注数据稀缺的问题，探索使用SAM3（Segment Anything Model 3）作为伪标签生成器来训练轻量分割网络IPS-Seg。提出两阶段伪标签生成框架：首阶段SAM3生成粗粒度掩码用于定位，第二阶段对局部图像块再次应用SAM3以改善边界质量。实验表明，IPS-Seg在分割精度与计算效率间取得良好折中。
Motivation: 无人机目标分割因目标小、外观变化大、背景杂乱且密集标注数据稀缺，导致轻量模型性能不足，难以实际部署。
Method: 提出两阶段SAM3引导的伪标签生成框架：第一阶段用SAM3生成粗掩码定位目标；第二阶段将定位区域裁剪成小块再次输入SAM3生成精细掩码。以粗/细掩码作为伪标签训练轻量网络IPS-Seg（IdentityFormer骨干+ASPP+PixelShuffle解码器）。
Result: 在多种监督设置下，IPS-Seg取得分割精度与计算效率的良好权衡，且伪标签策略带来一致提升。
Conclusion: 大规模基础模型可作为低标注视觉领域的伪标签来源，有效训练紧凑型任务特定分割网络。

papers.title: EmCom-Diffusion: Probing Visual Reflection in Emergent Languages via Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Measuring the extent to which emergent languages encode the visual content of their inputs is an open problem. We refer to this property as visual reflection: the extent to which emergent messages preserve information about their source images that can be recovered without appeal to the speaker-listener pair that produced them. Existing metrics measure it only indirectly, through proxies such as human-defined concept inventories, natural-language captions, structural distance correlations, or Referential Game accuracy, each of which can either miss visual content the message encodes or credit content it does not. We propose EmCom-Diffusion, an evaluation framework that measures visual reflection directly: it reconstructs each input image from its emergent message and compares the reconstruction with the original image itself, rather than with human-defined targets. Concretely, it finetunes a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model on (image, emergent-message) pairs and scores visual reflection as the perceptual similarity between the reconstructed and original images, operating generatively rather than discriminatively. Instantiating it on MS-COCO with a Referential Game, we validate the metric against random and fixed-token baselines under three pretrained visual encoders, and compare it against four existing metrics (CBM, supervised translation, TopSim, and R@1). EmCom-Diffusion captures visual content the other metrics miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对涌现语言中视觉信息编码程度的测量问题，提出EmCom-Diffusion框架，通过微调预训练文本到图像扩散模型，从涌现消息中重建输入图像，并以重建图像与原始图像的感知相似度作为视觉反射（visual reflection）的直接度量。在MS-COCO和参考游戏上的实验表明，该框架能够捕捉其他指标遗漏的视觉内容。
Motivation: 现有度量涌现语言视觉编码程度的方法（如基于人类定义概念清单、自然语言标题、结构距离相关或参考游戏准确率）均为间接测量，可能遗漏或错误归因视觉内容。
Method: 提出EmCom-Diffusion评估框架，直接测量视觉反射：对预训练文本到图像扩散模型在（图像, 涌现消息）对上进行微调，然后通过生成重建图像并计算其与原始图像的感知相似度来评分。
Result: 在MS-COCO和参考游戏上，该方法与随机和固定令牌基线对比，并优于CBM、监督翻译、TopSim和R@1四种现有指标，能够捕捉其他指标遗漏的视觉内容。
Conclusion: EmCom-Diffusion提供了一种直接、生成式的涌现语言视觉反射度量方法，但可能受限于扩散模型的重建能力和计算成本。

papers.title: Bridging Interleaved Multi-Modal Reasoning as a Unified Decision Process
papers.abstract_en: Unified multi-modal models (UMMs) have shown promising interleaved text-image reasoning capabilities, yet effectively optimizing such multi-turn generation via reinforcement learning (RL) remains an open challenge. Existing approaches apply RL exclusively to text steps, relegating image generation to supervised surrogates, preventing policy gradients from propagating through the full interleaved trajectory across heterogeneous modalities. This leaves the potential of RL for UMMs largely untapped. In the paper, we introduce \textbf{BRAID} (\textbf{B}ridging inte\textbf{R}le\textbf{A}ved mult\textbf{I}-modal reasoning as a unified \textbf{D}ecision process), a simple framework that casts multi-turn text-image-text reasoning as a unified Markov decision process (MDP), enabling joint optimization of textual and visual generation via a single, principled RL objective. BRAID computes a shared trajectory-level advantage and propagates it coherently into both text tokens and image denoising paths, each optimized through its modality-native policy gradient mechanism. To further address long-horizon credit assignment, BRAID employs a vision-language model (VLM) judge that scores each intermediate image on its reasoning utility, supplying dense turn-level feedback to sharpen learning at critical visual branches. Experiments on spatial reasoning and visual perception benchmarks show that BRAID consistently outperforms various baselines, confirming that a unified MDP formulation with vision-thinking guidance is essential for effective multi-modal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BRAID 框架，将交错的文本-图像-文本推理建模为统一马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），通过强化学习联合优化文本 Token 和图像去噪路径，并引入 VLM 裁判提供稠密回合级反馈。实验表明该方法在空间推理与视觉感知基准上优于多种基线。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）的强化学习仅应用于文本步骤，图像生成由监督替代物处理，导致策略梯度无法跨异构模态传播，限制了强化学习在 UMMs 中的潜力。
Method: BRAID 将多轮文本-图像推理视为统一 MDP，计算共享轨迹级优势并分别通过模态原生策略梯度机制传播到文本 Token 和图像去噪路径；同时使用 VLM 裁判对中间图像的推理效用评分，提供稠密反馈以改善长期信用分配。
Result: 在空间推理与视觉感知基准上，BRAID 一致优于多种基线，验证了统一 MDP 公式与视觉思维指导对有效多模态推理的必要性。
Conclusion: 统一 MDP 与视觉推理指导可有效提升交错多模态推理中的强化学习优化效果。

papers.title: Can Conversational Temporal Dynamics Improve Depression Detection in Dyads? A Preliminary Investigation in Multi-Modality Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: Automatic depression detection from clinical interviews typically models the semantic content and acoustic characteristics of participant speech. However, the interactional timing between the clinician and participant remains comparatively under-modeled. We investigate conversational temporal dynamics, specifically dyadic turn-pair timing, as a primary modality fused with self-supervised encoders. Evaluated on the DAIC-WOZ dataset, we compare a compact 24-dimensional timing module against frozen WavLM-large and RoBERTa-large baseline detectors. This temporal module achieves the highest single-modality performance on the development set. Furthermore, a convex-weighted late fusion strategy improves overall performance to 0.804 and 0.669 macro-F1 on the development and test sets, respectively. The learned fusion effectively assigns zero weight to acoustics, demonstrating that conversational timing serves as a lightweight, interpretable complement for dyadic depression screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文初步研究对话时间动态（dyadic turn-pair timing）作为抑郁症检测的多模态特征之一。在DAIC-WOZ数据集上，一个紧凑的24维时间模块独立达到了开发集上的最佳单模态性能；与自监督编码器（WavLM-large、RoBERTa-large）凸加权融合后，在开发集和测试集上分别达到0.804和0.669的macro-F1。融合权重将声学特征权重归零，表明对话时序可作为轻量、可解释的补充模态。
Motivation: 现有抑郁症自动检测主要建模语义和声学特征，但忽略了临床访谈中双方交互的时间动态，本文旨在探索时序特征的潜力。
Method: 提取双人对话中的turn-pair时序特征（24维），分别与冻结的WavLM-large（声学）和RoBERTa-large（文本）自监督编码器进行凸加权后期融合。
Result: 时间模块在开发集上单模态最优；融合后在开发集macro-F1=0.804，测试集macro-F1=0.669；融合权重将声学特征权重置零。
Conclusion: 对话时间动态可作为轻量且可解释的补充模态用于双人抑郁症筛查，其性能优于声学特征。

papers.title: Triple-Phase Multimodal Knowledge Aggregation Framework for Microbial Keratitis Subtype Diagnosis on Slit-Lamp Photography
papers.abstract_en: Microbial keratitis requires rapid pathogen identification to guide treatment, but culture- and PCR-based diagnostics are slow and resource-intensive. We developed a triple-phase multimodal framework for bacterial-versus-fungal keratitis classification using slit-lamp photographs acquired under blue-light, sclerotic-scatter, and white-light illumination, together with clinical metadata. The model combines cross-modality contrastive learning, modality-specific fine-tuning, and feature-level multimodal ensemble learning for patient-level prediction. We evaluated the framework on a multicenter dataset of 1,645 patients and 17,158 images from India and the United States. The model achieved 85.84% accuracy, 84.46% average F1-score, and 0.885 AUC. Site-specific evaluation showed that pooled results were overly optimistic, whereas resampling- and balance-based re-evaluation provided a more realistic assessment of cross-site generalization. Under all settings, our framework remained the top-performing approach. Upon acceptance, the code will be released and dataset access will be provided subject to University of Michigan data-sharing clearance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对微生物角膜炎的细菌与真菌亚型分类，提出一种三阶段多模态框架，整合蓝光、巩膜散射和白光照明下的裂隙灯照片及临床元数据。该框架结合跨模态对比学习、模态微调和特征级多模态集成进行患者级预测。在多中心1645例患者、17158张图像的数据集上，达到85.84%准确率、84.46%平均F1分数和0.885 AUC。跨站点评估表明汇总结果过于乐观，需重新采样和平衡评估。
Motivation: 现有微生物角膜炎病原体鉴定依赖培养和PCR，速度慢且资源密集，亟需快速诊断方法。
Method: 提出三阶段多模态聚合框架：跨模态对比学习预训练、模态特定微调、特征级多模态集成学习，融合蓝光、巩膜散射、白光照明图像及临床元数据。
Result: 在多中心1645例患者、17158张图像上，模型准确率85.84%，平均F1 84.46%，AUC 0.885。跨站点评估显示汇总结果有偏，重新评估后仍为最优。
Conclusion: 该框架在所有评估设置下表现最佳，将开源代码，数据集在密歇根大学数据共享审批通过后提供。

summary_sections.method: 提出三阶段多模态聚合框架：跨模态对比学习预训练、模态特定微调、特征级多模态集成学习，融合蓝光、巩膜散射、白光照明图像及临床元数据。
summary_sections.result: 在多中心1645例患者、17158张图像上，模型准确率85.84%，平均F1 84.46%，AUC 0.885。跨站点评估显示汇总结果有偏，重新评估后仍为最优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架在所有评估设置下表现最佳，将开源代码，数据集在密歇根大学数据共享审批通过后提供。

papers.title: A Failure-Mode Benchmark for Polymorphic Sybil Poisoning in RAG
papers.abstract_en: We release a benchmark and failure-mode-aware evaluation framework for grounded QA under coordinated retrieval poisoning. The framework partitions reader outputs into four mutually exclusive categories (\emph{gold}, \emph{hijack}, \emph{abstention}, \emph{drift}), with instance-level paired clean-to-poison transition matrices and a Forced Exposure protocol isolating reader-side conflict resolution from retrieval variance. We introduce \emph{polymorphic sybil poisoning}, a coordinated attack class in which $S$ lexically diverse passages jointly support an attacker-chosen target while evading lexical near-duplicate filters that fully detect monomorphic baselines (capturing the residual 14.2\% with E5 cosine raises false-positive rate 9$\times$ on legitimate same-topic pairs). A monomorphic-polymorphic ablation under Forced Exposure isolates the diversity dimension and reveals a $+$18.8pp hijack amplification (95\% paired bootstrap CI $[+15.4, +22.4]$, $B{=}5{,}000$): monomorphic copies register only 4.0\% as hijack while polymorphic surface diversity recovers 22.8\% -- a 5.7$\times$ amplification of the ASR-visible attack channel. ASR alone treats every non-target output identically; under attack, abstention and drift together hold 47-66\% of output mass, unmonitored by ASR+ACC, and two readers at nearly identical ASR (within 0.2pp) differ by 16.5pp on abstention and 17.2pp on drift -- failure profiles invisible to ASR. We release the frozen benchmark (3{,}145 questions, 2{,}982 retained sybil groups; $S{=}6$ chosen to dominate top-10 retrieval slots, §\ref{sec:setup}), the official four-way evaluator, paired-transition utilities, and the Forced Exposure harness across five readers (7B-120B), two retrievers, and two cross-validation datasets (TriviaQA, 2Wiki), under CC~BY-SA~4.0 (data) and MIT (software); release information in §\ref{sec:release}.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Corresponding author: Juntae Kim. Dataset and code to be released upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对检索增强生成（RAG）中多态Sybil投毒攻击的基准和评估框架，通过四类输出划分和强制暴露协议隔离读者侧冲突解决与检索方差，揭示了多态攻击相比单一变体攻击的显著放大效应。
Motivation: 现有基准无法检测多态Sybil攻击，且评估指标忽视不同失败模式的差异。
Method: 引入了多态Sybil投毒攻击类型，构建了包含3145个问题的基准，并提供了强制暴露协议和四类输出评估工具。
Result: 多态攻击相比单一变体攻击将劫持率放大5.7倍，且ASR+ACC指标无法捕捉到拒答和漂移等失败模式。
Conclusion: 基准和框架能够揭示RAG系统中隐藏的安全漏洞，并建议使用更细致的失败模式评估。

papers.title: Attending to Multimodal Generation One Token at a Time
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate responses autoregressively, integrating visual and linguistic information in an evolving context. Prior work on interpretability has focused on individual layers and circuits (where), leaving the token-level dynamics of multimodal computation during generation (when) underexplored. We address this gap and study attention shifts as per semantic role; tracking model attention to image, text, instruction, and previously generated tokens, One Token at a Time (OTaT). We introduce multimodal tasks that require explicit switching between visual and textual context within a single response. Across two mainstream model families and four open-weight MLLMs of varying sizes, we establish consistent patterns: attention to image peaks at tokens requiring image-derived information, instruction tokens are revisited during task transitions, and attention to previously generated tokens increases as the generation progresses. Causal attention blocking interventions validate the functional role of these trends. We profile model behavior under disrupted attention and observe responses falling back to language priors, or exhibiting cross-modal leakage, denial, or recovery. Finally, informed of the attention dynamics through our novel analysis, we propose a simple test-time intervention to boost attention to the relevant modality at the right time, significantly improving multimodal task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在生成过程中token级别的注意力动态，发现注意力模式随语义角色变化：对图像的注意力在需要图像信息时达到峰值，指令token在任务转换时被重新访问，对已生成token的注意力随生成过程增加。通过因果注意力阻断干预验证了这些趋势的功能作用，并提出一种测试时干预方法，在正确时间增强对相关模态的注意力，显著提升多模态任务性能。
Motivation: 现有可解释性工作关注单层和电路（where），而token级别的多模态计算动态（when）尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出逐token注意力跟踪方法（OTaT），分析模型对图像、文本、指令和已生成token的注意力变化。设计需要显式切换视觉与文本上下文的多模态任务，并通过因果注意力阻断干预验证注意力模式的功能性。
Result: 在两种主流模型家族和四种不同规模的开权MLLM上发现一致模式：注意力峰值与信息需求对应；干预导致回退到语言先验、跨模态泄漏、拒绝或恢复等行为。基于发现的测试时干预显著提升多模态任务性能。
Conclusion: 揭示了MLLM生成过程中注意力动态的规律，并提出有效干预方法改善多模态生成。

papers.title: ProxyUp: Training-Free Proxy-Conditioned Video Generation for Controllable Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Precise control over complex dynamics remains challenging for modern video generative models, as text prompts alone often cannot specify physically plausible, fine-grained motion and interactions. We introduce $\textit{proxy-conditioned video generation}$, where a coarse proxy video from physics-based simulation or real-world recording serves as a dynamics carrier to control foreground object motion. Given a proxy video and a text prompt, the goal is to synthesize a new video that preserves the proxy dynamics while generating novel content and plausible interactions aligned with the prompt. Since paired proxy-target videos are difficult to obtain, we propose $\textbf{ProxyUp}$, a training-free framework built on pretrained video generative models. ProxyUp first inverts the proxy video into an intermediate latent representation and applies $\textbf{region-wise latent noising}$, preserving motion-critical proxy latents while injecting noise into regions intended for text-driven regeneration. To mitigate the distribution mismatch and weak foreground-background coupling introduced by this heuristic latent composition, we further propose $\textbf{Stochastic Flow Relaxation (SFR)}$, which progressively relaxes the composed latent toward the model's learned distribution before ODE sampling. Experiments on both simulation and real-world proxies show that ProxyUp outperforms strong video editing and motion transfer baselines in dynamic fidelity and text alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProxyUp，一种无需训练的代理条件视频生成框架，利用物理模拟或真实录制的粗代理视频控制前景物体运动，同时生成与文本提示一致的新内容。通过区域隐空间加噪和随机流松弛（SFR）技术，在保持运动动态的同时实现文本驱动的生成。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以通过文本提示精确控制复杂动态，如物理合理、细粒度的物体运动和交互。
Method: 提出ProxyUp框架，基于预训练视频生成模型，通过逆过程将代理视频编码到隐空间，对运动关键区域施加隐空间加噪，对其他区域注入噪声以便文本驱动重生成；并引入随机流松弛（SFR）缓解隐空间分布不匹配和前景-背景耦合弱的问题。
Result: 在仿真和真实代理视频实验上，ProxyUp在动态保真度和文本对齐方面优于现有视频编辑和运动转移基线。
Conclusion: ProxyUp实现了无需额外训练即可控制视频生成中复杂动态的方法，适用于基于物理模拟或真实录制的代理视频。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoGen3D: An Agentic Human-AI Co-Design Pipeline for 3D Asset Generation for Virtual Reality
papers.abstract_en: Creating 3D assets for virtual reality requires modeling expertise, which restricts the authorship of immersive experiences. Existing generative AI tools rely on unconstrained, command-driven prompting, lacking the conversational scaffolding needed for users to articulate their intent and validate designs prior to rendering. To address this, we introduce CoGen3D, an agentic human-AI co-design pipeline that proactively guides users through conversational intent elicitation, a concept image confirmation, and image-to-3D generation that directly deploys to immersive scenes. We evaluated this system through a user study (N=120) across six affectively diverse immersive scenes, observing 60 Design group participants who co-created 3D assets for the scenes, and 60 Validation group participants who experienced the scenes with generated assets. Our findings show that co-designed assets are associated with higher scene engagement and shifted affective responses, while participants generally preferred concept images over the final 3D assets, with no increased leniency toward degradation in their own creations. Analysis of the human-AI conversations further shows that target environments shape users' conversational patterns. Our results suggest that our staged, intent-based co-design can democratize virtual reality authoring and shift immersive content creation from technical execution toward collaborative spatial design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍CoGen3D，一个智能人机协同设计管道，用于VR的3D资产生成。它通过对话式意图引导、概念图像确认和图像到3D生成来辅助用户。用户研究(N=120)表明协同设计的资产提高了场景参与度并改变了情感反应，但用户更偏好概念图像而非最终3D资产。
Motivation: 现有生成式AI工具缺乏对话式引导，用户难以表达意图并在渲染前验证设计。CoGen3D旨在通过分步协同设计降低VR创作门槛。
Method: CoGen3D采用智能体驱动的流程：先通过对话引导用户意图，然后确认概念图像，最后将图像转换为3D资产并部署到沉浸式场景中。
Result: 用户研究显示协同设计的资产与更高的场景参与度和情感反应变化相关；用户普遍偏好概念图像而非最终3D资产，且对自身创作的降质没有更多宽容。
Conclusion: 分阶段的基于意图的协同设计可以普及VR创作，将沉浸式内容创作从技术执行转向协作空间设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniTacTune: Policy-Agnostic Real-World RL for Tactile Residual Adaptation of Visual Policies
papers.abstract_en: Visual policies learned from human videos, teleoperation, and robot demonstrations offer scalable motion priors, but often fail in contact-rich manipulation, where success significantly depends on local force and contact geometry. Tactile sensing provides these complementary signals, yet tactile data remain costly to collect and hard to generalize across sensors, robots, and tasks. We introduce OmniTacTune, a policy-agnostic real-world RL pipeline that adapts tactile feedback to pretrained visual policies through residual correction. OmniTacTune uses a two-stage design: it first bootstraps tactile-aware learning from autonomous base-policy rollouts, then learns a lightweight tactile residual policy through online interaction. Extensive experiments show that OmniTacTune generalizes across diverse contact-rich tasks, visual base policies, and tactile representations. Across four real-world contact-rich tasks, it improves visual base policies from 5-40% success to 85-100% within 40-80 minutes, demonstrating an efficient path for adapting tactile feedback to scalable visual robot policies. Project page: https://colinyu1.github.io/omnitactune-site/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniTacTune，一种策略无关的真实世界强化学习流水线，通过残差修正将触觉反馈适应到预训练的视觉策略。该流水线采用两阶段设计：首先从自主基础策略 rollout 中引导触觉感知学习，然后通过在线交互学习轻量级触觉残差策略。在四个真实世界接触密集型任务上，该方法将视觉基础策略的成功率从 5-40% 提升至 85-100%，训练时间为 40-80 分钟，展示了将触觉反馈高效适配到可扩展视觉机器人策略的路径。
Motivation: 视觉策略在接触密集型操作中往往失败，因为成功依赖于局部力和接触几何信息；触觉传感提供互补信号，但触觉数据收集成本高且难以在传感器、机器人和任务间泛化。
Method: OmniTacTune 是一种策略无关的实世界 RL 管线：第一阶段利用基础策略的自主 rollout 来引导触觉感知学习；第二阶段通过在线交互学习一个轻量级触觉残差策略。
Result: 在四个真实世界接触密集型任务上，OmniTacTune 将视觉基础策略的成功率从 5-40% 提升到 85-100%，且训练仅需 40-80 分钟。
Conclusion: 该工作证明存在一种高效的方式将触觉反馈适配到可扩展的视觉机器人策略，为接触密集型操作提供实用路径。

papers.title: Leveraging Pathology Co-occurrence for Test-Time Adaptation in Chest X-Ray Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging models often degrade when deployed at new clinical sites due to differences in imaging equipment, protocols, and patient populations. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses this by updating a pretrained model using only unlabeled target data, without access to source data. However, existing TTA methods were designed for single-label classification on natural image benchmarks, minimizing entropy uniformly across all samples without considering label dependencies. This overlooks a key property of multi-label medical imaging: pathologies do not occur independently but exhibit structured co-occurrence patterns. In this work, we propose Co-occurrence Weighted Adaptation (CoWA), which leverages disease co-occurrence patterns as a reliability signal for adaptation. CoWA estimates label co-occurrence structure from model predictions and downweights samples that deviate from expected patterns, enabling adaptation to rely more on consistent predictions while reducing the impact of noisy ones. We evaluate CoWA on chest X-ray benchmarks under domain shifts and demonstrate consistent improvements over established baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Co-occurrence Weighted Adaptation (CoWA) 方法，利用疾病共现模式作为可靠性信号，在测试时适应无标签目标数据，减少噪声预测的影响，提升胸部X光诊断模型在域迁移下的性能。
Motivation: 现有测试时适应方法针对自然图像单标签分类设计，忽略多标签医学影像中病理共现的结构化规律，导致域迁移下性能下降。
Method: CoWA 从模型预测中估计标签共现结构，对偏离预期模式的样本赋予较低权重，使适应过程更依赖一致预测。
Result: 在胸部X光基准上多个域迁移场景下，CoWA 持续优于现有基线方法。

papers.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Traffic Signal Control
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for adaptive traffic signal control. However, in safety-critical infrastructure like traffic control, the opaque, black-box nature of deep RL models poses challenges for transportation agency acceptance, regulatory compliance, operational trust, troubleshooting, and fine-tuning. To bridge this gap between high-performance optimization and human-comprehensible interpretability, this effort introduces a novel, explainable entity centric RL framework for safe and transparent traffic signal control. Rather than processing traffic states through monolithic, flat vectors, the proposed architecture disaggregates real-time intersection observations into distinct, high-dimensional lane entities and phase temporal configurations to inherently preserve the structural topology and geometric configurations of the intersection. Relational dependencies and inter-lane conflicts are dynamically extracted via a dual-stage attention network featuring sequential multi-head cross-attention and self-attention blocks. This design yields a real time affinity matrix that quantifies the direct influence of signal phases on specific approach volumes and queues, providing full visual and analytical interpretability. To ensure strict operational reliability, a deterministic action-masking interface is integrated directly into the Proximal Policy Optimization pipeline, explicitly blocking invalid phase transitions to guarantee absolute compliance with established signal timing and safety constraints. Evaluated in a microscopic simulation environment, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in delay minimization. More importantly, the emergent attention weights align precisely with established traffic engineering principles, offering an auditable, trust-enabling, and deployable architecture for next-generation adaptive traffic control systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的实体中心强化学习框架用于自适应交通信号控制。该框架将交叉口实时观测分解为车道实体和相位时间配置，通过双阶段注意力网络（多头交叉注意力和自注意力）提取空间-时间关系，并生成亲和矩阵以提供完全可视化的解释性。同时，在近端策略优化（PPO）中集成确定性动作屏蔽接口，确保安全约束合规。微观仿真实验表明，该方法在延迟最小化上优于现有基线，且注意力权重与交通工程原理一致。
Motivation: 深度强化学习在交通信号控制中性能优异，但黑箱特性阻碍了交通管理部门的接受、故障排查和微调，缺乏可解释性和可审计性。
Method: 提出可解释实体中心强化学习架构：将交叉口状态分解为高维车道实体和相位时间配置，保持拓扑结构；使用顺序多头交叉注意力和自注意力模块动态提取车道间关系依赖，输出实时亲和矩阵以量化相位对车流的影响；在PPO中集成确定性动作屏蔽接口，禁止无效相位转换，保证安全约束。
Result: 在微观仿真环境中，所提方法在延迟最小化上优于多个现有基线。关键的是，学习到的注意力权重与经典交通工程原理高度吻合，验证了模型的可解释性和可信度。
Conclusion: 提出的可解释强化学习框架兼具高性能和完全透明度，为下一代自适应交通控制系统提供了可审计、可信任的实际部署方案。

papers.title: Agent Reinforcement Learning via Pivotal-Aware Self-Feedback Retry
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong decision-making capabilities in long-horizon interactive tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage failed trajectories: full retries incur high interaction costs, while experience retrieval tends to dilute critical experience signals. To address this, we propose PivoARL, a self-feedback retry framework for experience exploitation in LLM agents. PivoARL identifies the pivotal erroneous turn through structured reflection and performs local retry only from the corresponding pivotal state, thereby reusing the correct prefix and reducing redundant interactions. From an information-gain perspective, we further show that pivotal retry concentrates useful experience signals near the error boundary, mitigating the signal dilution caused by state-agnostic experience utilization. Based on this insight, we design a pivotal-aware credit assignment mechanism that rewards correct prefixes while isolating erroneous suffixes, and optimize reflection quality through implicit reflection returns. We conduct a systematic evaluation on 4 agent tasks and 7 search-based QA benchmarks. Results show that PivoARL achieves significant improvements on Pass@2/3 across all tasks, with an average gain of about 11.5\% over MetaRL. Moreover, benefiting from contrastive preference signals induced by pivotal turns, PivoARL also consistently improves Pass@1 on over 80\% of the tasks. On Minesweeper environment, PivoARL improves over GiGPO by more than 45\% and reduces interaction turns by about 42\% on average compared with full-retry methods. Code is available at https://github.com/yuki-younai/PivoARL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PivoARL，一种基于关键转折点自反馈重试的LLM智能体强化学习框架。通过结构化反思识别错误回合，仅从关键状态局部重试，减少交互成本。设计关键感知信用分配机制，利用隐式反思回报优化反思质量。在4个智能体任务和7个搜索QA基准上，Pass@2/3平均提升约11.5%，Pass@1在80%以上任务提升，Minesweeper环境中交互回合减少约42%。
Motivation: LLM智能体在长程交互任务中难以有效利用失败轨迹：完全重试成本高，经验检索稀释关键信号。
Method: 提出自反馈重试框架PivoARL，通过结构化反思定位关键错误回合，仅从该状态局部重试；设计关键感知信用分配机制，奖励正确前缀、隔离错误后缀；通过隐式反思回报优化反思质量。
Result: 在4个智能体任务和7个搜索QA基准上，Pass@2/3平均提升约11.5%，Pass@1在80%以上任务提升；Minesweeper环境中相比GiGPO提升超过45%，交互回合相比全重试方法平均减少约42%。
Conclusion: PivoARL通过聚焦关键转折点有效利用失败经验，提升LLM智能体性能并降低交互成本，但局限在于反思质量依赖LLM自身能力，且局部重试可能不适用于所有任务。

papers.title: SABLE: An NDA-Safe Closed-Loop LLM Framework for Analog Circuit Optimization in Industrial EDA Flows
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can propose circuit-optimization decisions, but industrial analog flows cannot expose foundry PDK content, proprietary schematics, absolute simulation paths, or license-bound tool state to a cloud endpoint. We present SABLE (Safe Analog Boundary for LLM-driven EDA), an NDA-safe closed-loop framework that lets LLMs optimize analog circuits through Cadence Virtuoso, Maestro, and Spectre while returning only scrubbed topology intent, numeric metrics, operating-point summaries, and scoped writeback status. "NDA-safe" denotes enforcement under a stated curious-but-passive cloud-provider threat model, not a formal non-interference proof. The framework combines an explicit threat model, a whitelist of 28 scoped SKILL entry points, PDK/path/model scrubbing on every return path, structured Maestro setup and writeback, a strict JSON action contract with six machine-checked stop conditions, and best-so-far state preservation. We evaluate eleven LLM checkpoints from the same documented reset state on two real closed-loop tasks, both run as process-voltage-temperature (PVT) sign-offs across three corners: a 20 GHz LC-VCO tuning-curve task and a two-stage op-amp task. On the LC-VCO task 7 of 11 models pass; on the harder op-amp task, where every metric must hold at the worst corner and a phase-margin gate rejects unstable high-gain points, 4 of 11 pass within a 15-iteration budget. Feedback-path ablations show that removing individual sanitized channels either silently weakens the specification or degrades the search. Model quality differs sharply once the loop requires tool discipline, bias reasoning, and specification repair, yet an NDA-safe boundary still provides enough sanitized feedback for successful analog circuit optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SABLE 是一个 NDA 安全的闭环 LLM 框架，用于工业 EDA 流程中的模拟电路优化。它通过白名单 SKILL 入口、PDK/路径/模型擦除、结构化 Maestro 设置和严格的 JSON 动作契约，确保在云端推理时不泄露代工厂 PDK 内容、专有原理图或绝对仿真路径。在 20GHz LC-VCO 调谐曲线和两级运放两个工业级任务上，分别有 7/11 和 4/11 的 LLM 检查点通过验证。
Motivation: 工业模拟电路流程无法向云端暴露代工厂 PDK 内容、专有原理图、绝对仿真路径或受许可约束的工具状态，因此直接使用 LLM 进行电路优化存在安全隐患。
Method: 提出 SABLE 框架，结合显式威胁模型、28个限定 SKILL 入口点的白名单、每次返回路径的 PDK/路径/模型擦除、结构化 Maestro 设置与回写、带六个机器可检查停止条件的严格 JSON 动作契约以及最优状态保留。
Result: 在 LC-VCO 任务上 11 个模型中有 7 个通过；在更难的两级运放任务上（每个指标必须在最差工艺角成立，且相位裕度门限拒绝不稳定高增益点），15 次迭代预算内 11 个模型中有 4 个通过。反馈路径消融实验表明，移除单个净化通道会无声地削弱规格或降低搜索效果。
Conclusion: 尽管模型质量在需要工具纪律、偏置推理和规格修复时差异显著，但 NDA 安全边界仍能提供足够的净化反馈来成功优化模拟电路。

papers.title: IPDiff: Diffusion-driven ORSI Salient Object Detection with Information Reconstruction and Multi-Prior Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Existing Salient Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Image (ORSI-SOD) methods mainly adopt the static inference strategy, which uses fixed trained model parameters for saliency inference in the testing phase. This means that even if the generated saliency map has errors, it cannot be further optimized. In this paper, we propose the novel IPDiff, a Diffusion-driven ORSI-SOD method with Information Reconstruction and Multi-Prior Guidance. We build IPDiff based on a unique dynamic optimization strategy, which endows IPDiff with the ability to iteratively optimize saliency maps with a dynamic parameter. Specifically, we formulate ORSI-SOD as a conditional diffusion problem in IPDiff. IPDiff first extracts informative conditional priors from ORSIs, including the saliency prior and the hierarchical priors, in the prior network with the assistance of the information reconstruction-driven attention module. The saliency prior can provide positional information of salient objects, while the hierarchical priors can provide specific detail and semantic information of salient objects. Under the guidance of these priors, IPDiff then iteratively denoises random noise as the timestep dynamically changes in the denoising network, generating saliency maps that are close to ground truths. Notably, we simultaneously supervise IPDiff in both spatial and spectral domains through a hybrid loss function to achieve efficient network training. Comprehensive experiments on public ORSSD, EORSSD, and ORSI-4199 datasets demonstrate that our proposed IPDiff achieves the best performance compared to 46 state-of-the-art methods. The code and results of our method are available at https://github.com/MathLee/IPDiff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对光学遥感图像显著性目标检测（ORSI-SOD）中静态推理无法优化错误图的问题，提出IPDiff，一种基于扩散模型的动态优化方法。通过信息重建驱动注意力模块提取显著性先验和层次先验，在去噪网络中迭代去噪生成显著图，并在空间和频谱域用混合损失监督。在三个公开数据集上超过46种SOTA方法。
Motivation: 现有ORSI-SOD方法采用固定参数的静态推理，若生成的显著图有错误则无法进一步优化。
Method: 将ORSI-SOD建模为条件扩散问题，先利用信息重建驱动的注意力模块提取显著性先验和层次先验，再在去噪网络中随时间步动态变化迭代去噪随机噪声，生成接近真实值的显著图，并通过空间-频谱混合损失监督。
Result: 在ORSSD、EORSSD、ORSI-4199数据集上，IPDiff相比46种SOTA方法取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 动态优化策略与多先验引导能有效提升遥感图像显著性检测精度。

papers.title: Social Networks of LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in interacting populations, raising the question of what such populations come to believe collectively. Whether a population aggregates genuine knowledge or collapses into a false consensus directly affects how much such systems can be trusted. Classical social-network models assume that the network itself determines how beliefs combine. This assumption breaks down for LLM agents, whose limited attention takes in only part of what they are exposed to, so these models overstate how much information a population actually pools and cannot tell genuine consensus from herding. We introduce SNLA, a framework that models how much each agent actually influences others, rather than merely how the network connects them. This influence depends on each agent's position in the network and on how sharply attention focuses. Theoretically, we show on a tractable proxy that narrow attention causes herding, where the effective sample size stays bounded regardless of population size, while wide attention recovers wisdom-of-crowds behavior only when the exposure graph is undirected and degree-regular. Empirically, a controlled testbed validates these predictions directly, and the herding-wisdom transition reproduces on operator-controlled variants of three multi-agent LLM benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM智能体群体中的信念聚合问题。经典社交网络模型假设网络结构决定信念融合，但LLM智能体注意力有限，只摄取部分信息，导致模型高估信息聚合程度，无法区分真实共识与从众行为。作者提出SNLA框架，建模每个智能体对其他智能体的实际影响，该影响取决于网络位置和注意力集中程度。理论上证明，在可处理代理模型上，窄注意力导致从众行为，有效样本量不随群体规模增长；宽注意力仅在无向且度正则的网络中恢复群体智慧。实验验证了预测，并在三个多智能体LLM基准上复现了从众-智慧转变。
Motivation: 经典社交网络模型假设网络结构决定信念融合，但LLM智能体注意力有限，只摄取部分信息，导致模型高估信息聚合程度，无法区分真实共识与从众行为。
Method: 提出SNLA框架，建模每个智能体对其他智能体的实际影响力，该影响力取决于网络位置和注意力集中程度。理论上通过可处理代理模型分析，实验使用受控测试台和三个多智能体LLM基准验证。
Result: 理论上证明窄注意力导致从众，有效样本量有界；宽注意力仅在无向且度正则网络中恢复群体智慧。实验验证了预测，并在三个基准上复现从众-智慧转变。

papers.title: Robust Feasible Route Construction through Collaborative Partition Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problems (CVRPs) are commonly solved by partitioning customers into smaller routing problems that can be optimized independently. While this substantially reduces computational complexity, independently constructed routing solutions may leave some customer demand unserved even when sufficient resources exist elsewhere in the fleet. We present Collaborative Routing Constructors (CoRC), a routing framework that enables independently solved subproblems to exchange customers and vehicles during optimization rather than relying solely on a fixed partition or a subsequent global re-optimization stage. Computational experiments on AGS benchmark instances and synthetic instances containing up to 200,000 customers compare CoRC against independent routing, post-routing global re-optimization, and state-of-the-art, end-to-end routing frameworks. Across all evaluated partitioning strategies, CoRC consistently constructs feasible routing solutions where competing partition-based methods do not. Furthermore, it remains effective on problem instances for which the evaluated end-to-end routing frameworks did not produce solutions under the same computational budget. These results demonstrate that collaboration between routing subproblems provides a robust and scalable approach for feasible large-scale route construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出协作路由构造器（CoRC），通过允许独立求解的子问题在优化过程中交换客户和车辆，解决大规模容量车辆路径问题（CVRP）中因固定分区导致部分需求无法满足的问题。实验表明，CoRC能在多种分区策略下始终构建可行解，而竞争的分区方法无法做到，且其效果优于现有端到端路由框架。
Motivation: 大规模CVRP常用分区方法降低计算复杂度，但独立构建子问题可能导致资源未充分利用，即使整体车队有足够容量，部分客户需求仍无法被服务。
Method: 提出CoRC框架，在独立求解的子问题之间允许客户和车辆的协作交换，而非依赖固定分区或后续全局重优化。
Result: 在AGS基准实例和包含多达20万客户的合成实例上，CoRC相比独立路由、全局重优化以及最先进的端到端框架，始终能构建可行解，且在与端到端框架相同计算预算下仍有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调子问题间的协作提供了大规模路由可行解构建的鲁棒且可扩展的方法。

papers.title: PIEFS: Physics-Informed Eigenfunction Features with Learnable Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Spectral methods are widely used to construct representations from the geometry of data, but they often rely on a fixed kernel, graph Laplacian, or manually selected feature scaling. We propose Physics-Informed Eigenfunction Features with Learnable Scaling (PIEFS), a supervised neural representation-learning framework with a spectral inductive bias, based on a modified Dirichlet energy. In PIEFS, scalar coordinate maps are trained under empirical Gram orthogonality, a supervised linear readout, and a Dirichlet penalty in which the input gradient is transformed by a learnable metric $A(x)=Λ(x)U(x)$. The diagonal factor $Λ(x)$ controls anisotropic scaling, while the orthogonal factor $U(x)$ is parameterized by a structured product of Givens rotations. This construction yields task-adaptive Dirichlet-regularized coordinates rather than eigenfunctions of a fixed supervision-independent operator. Experiments on synthetic, tabular, and image-based benchmarks study the effect of identity, diagonal, and rotation-scaling metrics, and compare the resulting coordinates with classical baselines and NeuralEF. The results support PIEFS as a compact supervised spectral representation method and identify optimization stability, validation on explicit operator eigenproblems, and richer metric parameterizations as the main directions for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PIEFS（Physics-Informed Eigenfunction Features with Learnable Scaling），一种具有可学习缩放因子的物理信息特征表示框架。该方法通过修改的 Dirichlet 能量引入谱归纳偏置，训练标量坐标图满足经验 Gram 正交性、监督线性读出和 Dirichlet 惩罚，其中输入梯度由可学习度量 A(x)=Λ(x)U(x) 变换。对角因子 Λ(x) 控制各向异性缩放，正交因子 U(x) 由 Givens 旋转的结构化乘积参数化。在合成、表格和图像基准上的实验比较了单位度量、对角度量和旋转缩放度量的效果，并与经典基线和 NeuralEF 进行了对比。
Motivation: 谱方法在构建数据几何表示时通常依赖固定核、图拉普拉斯或手动选择的特征缩放，缺乏任务自适应性。
Method: 提出 PIEFS 框架，通过可学习度量 A(x) 对 Dirichlet 能量中的输入梯度进行变换，结合经验 Gram 正交性和监督线性读出来学习任务自适应的谱表示。
Result: 在合成、表格和图像基准上，PIEFS 与经典基线和 NeuralEF 相比表现出竞争力，验证了其作为紧凑监督谱表示方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PIEFS 是一种紧凑的监督谱表示方法，并指出优化稳定性、在显式算子特征问题上的验证以及更丰富的度量参数化是未来主要研究方向。

papers.title: Don't Blame the Large Language Model: How Scaffolding Evolution Shapes Coding Agent Quality
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents, autonomous systems that use large language models (LLMs) to resolve software engineering tasks, rely on agentic scaffolding: a middleware layer in between a developer and a large language model that orchestrates system prompts, tool execution, context management, and iterative reasoning loops. While these scaffoldings evolve at extreme velocities, no study has examined how this evolution affects agent quality (i.e., effectiveness and efficiency) over time. Practitioners regularly report quality regressions after scaffolding updates, yet consistently attribute them to the underlying model rather than the scaffolding itself. In this paper, we address this gap by conducting the first controlled longitudinal study that isolates the scaffolding's contribution. Unlike prior work that fixes the scaffolding and varies the model, we fix the model and vary only the scaffolding, evaluating 35 sequential releases to measure their impact on agent effectiveness and efficiency. We first empirically study the development and release evolution of five major open-source scaffoldings (i.e., Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini, OpenCode, and OpenHands), revealing extreme release velocities exceeding two releases per day and thousands of issues within months. We then perform a controlled deep dive into 35 sequential releases of the Qwen Code CLI, evaluating each against 50 stratified SWE-bench Verified tasks while holding the underlying LLM constant. We trace the resulting quality fluctuations to specific development patterns and architectural components, and illustrate our findings with concrete qualitative evidence linking individual pull requests to measured quality shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次通过纵向控制实验，固定底层LLM（如Qwen Code），仅变化35个顺序版本的scaffolding（中间件层），在SWE-bench Verified任务上评估编码代理的有效性和效率。研究揭示scaffolding以每天超过两次的速度演化，其质量波动可直接追溯到特定的拉取请求和架构组件，表明实践中常见的质量退化应归因于scaffolding而非LLM本身。
Motivation: 实践者常将scaffolding更新后的质量退化错误地归因于底层LLM，缺乏对scaffolding演化如何影响代理质量的系统研究。
Method: 固定LLM（Qwen Code），仅变化35个顺序版本的scaffolding，在50个SWE-bench Verified任务上评估有效性和效率，并追溯质量波动到具体开发模式和架构组件。
Result: scaffolding的发布速度极快（每天超过两次），质量波动与特定的拉取请求和架构变化直接相关。
Conclusion: 不应将编码代理的质量退化归咎于LLM，而应关注scaffolding自身的演化。

papers.title: LRX-PINN: A Layer-Resolving XNet Physics-Informed Neural Network with Integrated Cauchy Activations for Convection-Dominated Problems
papers.abstract_en: Convection-dominated convection-diffusion problems often develop thin layers, where the solution has sharp transition profiles and its derivatives are highly localized. This creates a structural mismatch for standard physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), whose trial spaces are not designed to match the value--derivative structure of such layers. We propose a Layer-Resolving XNet Physics-Informed Neural Network (LRX-PINN) based on integrated Cauchy activations. The proposed basis is transition-type at the solution level, while its derivative recovers a localized Cauchy kernel. We show that this structure matches the scaling of convection-dominated layers, inherits the Cauchy approximation mechanism at the derivative-profile level, and identifies \(d/\|w\|\) as the effective physical width of a ridge neuron. For analytic layer profiles, this yields derivative-stable exponential approximation in the stretched coordinate and a layer-scaled estimate for the strong residual of the singularly perturbed operator. Numerical experiments on several convection-dominated benchmarks show that LRX-PINN achieves higher accuracy than PIKAN and Fourier-feature PINNs while using less than \(30\%\) of their trainable parameters. On more challenging benchmarks, embedding the proposed representation into hp-VPINN-based frameworks further improves the best results obtained by existing hp-VPINN-based baselines without changing their original loss functionals or stabilization strategies. These results show that neural representations aligned with layer structure provide a compact and effective approach for convection-dominated problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对流主导的扩散问题中解产生薄层结构、标准PINN难以准确拟合的问题，提出了基于集成柯西激活函数的层解析XNet物理信息神经网络（LRX-PINN）。该方法通过设计过渡型基函数，使其导数恢复局部化的柯西核，从而匹配对流主导层的定标关系。理论分析表明，该方法在拉伸坐标下具有导数稳定的指数逼近能力，并能给出奇异扰动算子的强残差的层缩放估计。数值实验显示，在多个对流主导基准问题上，LRX-PINN以不到PIKAN和傅里叶特征PINN 30%的可训练参数实现了更高精度；嵌入hp-VPINN框架后进一步改进了现有基线的结果。
Motivation: 标准PINN的试验空间无法匹配对流主导问题中薄层的值-导数结构，导致数值误差较大。需要一种神经表示能够与层结构对齐，以实现紧凑且有效的解决方案。
Method: 提出LRX-PINN，使用集成柯西激活函数构造基函数，使得基函数本身为过渡型，而导数恢复局部化的柯西核。通过分析识别出d/||w||为脊神经元的有效物理宽度，并利用拉伸坐标下的指数逼近保证导数稳定性。
Result: 在多个对流主导基准上，LRX-PINN比PIKAN和傅里叶特征PINN精度更高，且参数量不到后者的30%。在更具挑战性的基准上，将LRX-PINN嵌入hp-VPINN框架后，进一步改进了现有hp-VPINN基线的结果，无需改变损失函数或稳定化策略。
Conclusion: 与层结构对齐的神经表示为对流主导问题提供了一种紧凑有效的方法。

papers.title: Rethinking AI-Generated Text Detection: A Strong Baseline and the Distribution-Shift Problem That Remains
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI-generated text detection work often introduces a new benchmark together with a specialized detector tailored to it. We revisit this practice from a baseline-first perspective. Across several benchmarks, we show that a plain, fully fine-tuned RoBERTa matches or exceeds the specialized detectors those benchmarks are built around. This suggests that much of the recent architectural complexity is not what drives strong in-distribution detection. The remaining challenge is the distribution shift. The same strong baseline degrades sharply when the topic domain or generating model changes at test time, and simply adding more source data does not close the gap. We identify a key failure mode: under distribution shift, the detector can assign high-confidence machine labels to human-written text from unseen domains. We then study two lightweight domain adaptation methods to address this problem: $K$-shot adaptation with first-order MAML over LoRA adapters, and a per-sample confidence-weighted ensemble built on top of the adapted detector. Overall, our results suggest that progress in AI-generated text detection should be measured not only by in-distribution performance, but also by robustness under distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从基线优先的角度重新审视AI生成文本检测领域，发现全微调的RoBERTa在多个基准上匹配或超过专门设计的检测器，表明现有架构复杂性并非关键。主要挑战在于分布偏移，当主题域或生成模型变化时，基线性能急剧下降。作者识别了失败模式，并研究了两类轻量级域适应方法：基于LoRA的一阶MAML的K-shot适应和基于置信度加权的集成方法。
Motivation: 现有AI生成文本检测工作往往为新基准设计专用检测器，但缺乏对基线方法的系统评估。本文旨在揭示强基线的真实表现，并强调分布偏移问题是尚未解决的核心挑战。
Method: 使用完全微调的RoBERTa作为强基线，在多个基准上对比专用检测器。针对分布偏移问题，提出两种轻量级域适应方法：一是基于LoRA的一阶MAML进行K-shot适应；二是在适应后的检测器上构建每样本置信度加权集成。
Result: 强基线RoBERTa在分布内性能上匹配或超过专用检测器。但在分布偏移下，检测器会将来自未见域的人类文本高置信度地标记为机器生成。域适应方法可部分缓解该问题。
Conclusion: AI生成文本检测的进展应同时关注分布内性能和分布偏移下的鲁棒性，简单增加训练数据无法解决分布偏移问题。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有AI生成文本检测工作往往为新基准设计专用检测器，但缺乏对基线方法的系统评估。本文旨在揭示强基线的真实表现，并强调分布偏移问题是尚未解决的核心挑战。
summary_sections.method: 使用完全微调的RoBERTa作为强基线，在多个基准上对比专用检测器。针对分布偏移问题，提出两种轻量级域适应方法：一是基于LoRA的一阶MAML进行K-shot适应；二是在适应后的检测器上构建每样本置信度加权集成。
summary_sections.result: 强基线RoBERTa在分布内性能上匹配或超过专用检测器。但在分布偏移下，检测器会将来自未见域的人类文本高置信度地标记为机器生成。域适应方法可部分缓解该问题。
summary_sections.conclusion: AI生成文本检测的进展应同时关注分布内性能和分布偏移下的鲁棒性，简单增加训练数据无法解决分布偏移问题。

papers.title: Validation-Induced Shapley Shifts: How Validation Structure Distorts Data Valuation
papers.abstract_en: Shapley values are widely used to attribute value to training data based on their marginal contribution to performance on a validation set. Existing practice often assumes these values are stable once the training data and model are fixed. In this work, we uncover a systematic vulnerability: even modest changes to the validation set, such as introducing noises, cause directional shifts in Shapley distributions. As noises are added, Shapley values of training samples compress toward zero. We trace this to a noise-induced neighborhood reshuffling effect: perturbations alter the local rank order between validation and training samples, flattening the valuation landscape. Using the KNN-Shapley framework, we show through synthetic and real data that these shifts are consistent and reproducible. Our findings challenge the assumption of Shapley stability and reveal a new axis of fragility in data valuation. We propose normalization and boundary-aware validation strategies to mitigate these distortions and enable more robust, interpretable valuation in machine learning marketplaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示基于Shapley值的数据估值对验证集结构的系统性脆弱性：验证集的微小变化（如噪声）会导致Shapley值分布发生定向偏移，向零压缩。通过KNN-Shapley框架在合成和真实数据上展示该效应的一致性和可重复性，并提出归一化和边界感知验证策略以缓解失真。
Motivation: 现有实践假设Shapley值在训练数据和模型固定后稳定，但实际中验证集结构改变会扭曲数据估值，挑战其稳定性假设。
Method: 利用KNN-Shapley框架，通过理论分析和实验验证噪声诱导的邻域重排效应，并提出归一化和边界感知验证策略。
Result: 实验表明，验证集噪声导致Shapley值分布向零压缩，且该偏移一致且可重复。
Conclusion: 揭示了数据估值中新的脆弱性轴，提出改进策略以实现更鲁棒、可解释的估值。

papers.title: Diffusion learning reveals viable parameter manifolds and compensation geometry in biological dynamical systems
papers.abstract_en: Models of complex systems often have many parameters, yet are constrained by far fewer experimentally accessible observables: similar activity can emerge from coordinated parameter changes. We formalize these compatible parameter sets as \emph{viable parameter manifolds}: the inverse images of a system's target dynamical behaviors under a parameter-to-feature map. The relevant codimension is not the number of reported features, but the effective rank of that map at the target scale. Co-varying features lower the codimension, while poor conditioning, high curvature, or regime mixing degrade learnability. We train conditional score-based diffusion models on simulated parameter--feature pairs and use them as amortized samplers of prior-weighted viable sets. In the Lorenz system, scalar trajectory statistics generate thin viable sheets, and two-feature conditioning localizes a transition-adjacent corridor. In the Izhikevich neuron model, four firing descriptors lie close to a nearly two-dimensional family of features, and the learned inverse images reveal distinct regular and irregular compensation geometries. In a recent ODE reduction of finite spiking networks, the same framework reveals excitatory--inhibitory compensation, timescale--coupling tradeoffs, and input-dependent viable manifolds across 4--12 parameter dimensions. In this view, robustness, compensation, and hidden parameter dependencies are organized as inverse geometry, with diffusion models providing practical tools for sampling, visualizing, and interrogating that geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对复杂生物动力系统参数空间中可行参数流形（viable parameter manifolds）的几何结构，提出使用条件分数扩散模型（conditional score-based diffusion models）作为先验加权可行集的分摊采样器（amortized sampler）。在Lorenz系统、Izhikevich神经元模型及脉冲网络ODE约化模型中，该方法揭示了参数补偿几何、过渡走廊及隐藏参数依赖关系。
Motivation: 复杂系统模型参数众多，但可观测变量有限，导致参数冗余和补偿效应。现有方法难以系统地表征与目标动力学一致的参数集合的几何结构。
Method: 将目标动力学行为的参数兼容集定义为参数到特征映射的逆像（viable parameter manifolds），并利用条件扩散模型在模拟的参数-特征对上训练，以采样先验加权的可行参数集。
Result: 在Lorenz系统中，标量轨迹统计量产生薄可行片；Izhikevich模型中四个放电描述子接近二维特征族，揭示规则与不规则补偿几何；脉冲网络约化模型中，跨4-12维参数揭示了兴奋-抑制补偿、时间尺度-耦合权衡及输入依赖的可行流形。
Conclusion: 该框架将鲁棒性、补偿和隐藏参数依赖性组织为逆几何问题，扩散模型为采样和可视化该几何提供了实用工具。

papers.title: A Structural Interpretation of GELU and Threshold-Transmission Activations via the First-Order Loss Function
papers.abstract_en: The Gaussian Error Linear Unit is usually motivated as the expected output of an input-dependent stochastic Bernoulli gate. This work gives a complementary interpretation based on the Gaussian complementary first-order loss function: GELU is the signal-transmission term of the expected surplus of a hard linear gate with a Gaussian random threshold. This view separates loss accounting from forward signal transmission and generalises to a threshold-transmission family that includes ReLU, GELU, SiLU/Swish, and hard swish as special cases. The uniform-threshold case recovers a hard-swish-like compact piecewise-polynomial gate with an explicit threshold-width parameter, yielding fixed- and learned-width variants. Controlled experiments on compact vision and language models show that calibrated or learned uniform-threshold gates are consistently competitive with GELU, ReLU, and SiLU/Swish, improve over them in most tested settings, and use the finite transition region nontrivially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从高斯互补一阶损失函数（Gaussian complementary first-order loss function）出发，对GELU激活函数给出结构性解释：GELU是硬线性门（hard linear gate）在随机高斯阈值下期望盈余（expected surplus）的信号传输项。该观点将损失核算与前向信号传输分离，并推广到包含ReLU、GELU、SiLU/Swish和hard swish在内的阈值传输家族。均匀阈值情形产生一种类似hard swish的紧凑分段多项式门，带有显式阈值宽度参数，由此得到固定宽度和学习宽度变体。在紧凑视觉和语言模型上的对照实验表明，校准或学习的均匀阈值门普遍与GELU、ReLU、SiLU/Swish竞争，在大多数测试设置中优于它们，并且有用地利用了有限的过渡区域。
Motivation: 现有对GELU的常见理解是输入相关随机Bernoulli门的期望输出，但缺乏基于损失函数的统一解释。本文旨在提供互补的结构化解释，并统一多种常见激活函数。
Method: 基于高斯互补一阶损失函数，将GELU重新解释为硬线性门在随机高斯阈值下的预期剩余（expected surplus）的信号传输项。由此定义阈值传输家族，包括ReLU（零阈值极限）、GELU（高斯阈值）、SiLU/Swish（逻辑阈值）等，并引入均匀阈值变体（hard-swish-like）及其固定/学习宽度版本。
Result: 在紧凑视觉和语言模型（具体模型未在摘要中说明）上的对照实验表明，校准或学习的均匀阈值门在多数设置中优于GELU、ReLU和SiLU/Swish，且竞争性一致。
Conclusion: 该框架将损失核算与前向信号传输分离，提供了激活函数的统一视角；均匀阈值变体在保持简单性的同时取得有竞争力的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Phase-Preserving Trimodal Transformer for Tropical Forest Biomass Estimation Using Optical and PolInSAR Data
authors: (2) Brazilian Army Research Institute in the Amazon (IPEAM)
papers.abstract_en: The accurate estimation of Above-Ground Biomass (AGB) in mature tropical forests remains a critical challenge in remote sensing, primarily due to the saturation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) signals in high-density areas and persistent cloud cover affecting optical imagery. To overcome these physical limitations, we propose the Trimodal Coherent Co-attention Transformer (TCCT), a physics-informed deep learning architecture. The TCCT natively fuses optical surface reflectance (Landsat-5) with complex-valued Polarimetric SAR Interferometry (PolInSAR) data from both P and L bands. Unlike traditional fusion methods, our architecture employs complex-valued encoders to preserve spatial phase coherence, coupled with a dynamic co-attention mechanism that acts as an adaptive gating module, reducing the weight of cloud-corrupted optical pixels and shifting reliance to microwave phase data. We also derived a localized spatial allometric calibration model via Levenberg-Marquardt optimization, tailored to the specific wood density of the Paracou region in the Amazon basin. Evaluated using a two-stage protocol, the TCCT first underwent a rigorous 5-fold cross-validation to establish robust global weights (achieving a global RMSE of 4.19 m). Subsequently, following a localized spatial fine-tuning phase over 200 epochs, the model attained an absolute RMSE of 3.78 m and an $R^2$ of 0.33 for Canopy Height Models (CHM), outperforming standard Random Forest, CNN, and Vision Transformer baselines. Our ablation study confirms that preserving phase coherence mitigates deep-canopy signal saturation. When converted to AGB, the fine-tuned TCCT map yielded a Relative RMSE (rRMSE) of 4.51% in dense forest areas above 50 Mg/ha. By meeting the European Space Agency (ESA) BIOMASS mission requirement of less than 20% error, the TCCT provides a robust framework for continuous carbon stock mapping in tropical biomes.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, one of which is a TikZ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Trimodal Coherent Co-attention Transformer (TCCT)，用于融合光学和PolInSAR数据估计热带森林地上生物量。通过复数编码器保持相位相干性，动态共注意力机制减少云污染影响。在Paracou地区达到CHM的RMSE 3.78 m，R² 0.33，相对RMSE 4.51%，满足ESA BIOMASS任务误差要求。
Motivation: 合成孔径雷达信号在高密度森林区域饱和，以及光学影像受云覆盖影响，导致传统遥感方法难以准确估计成熟热带森林的地上生物量。
Method: 提出TCCT架构，融合Landsat-5光学反射率与P波段和L波段复数PolInSAR数据。使用复数编码器保持空间相位相干性，动态共注意力机制作为自适应门控模块降低云污染光学像素权重，并利用Levenberg-Marquardt优化推导局部空间异速生长校准模型。
Result: 经5折交叉验证全局RMSE 4.19 m，局部微调后CHM的RMSE 3.78 m，R² 0.33，优于Random Forest、CNN和Vision Transformer基线。转换为AGB后，密集森林区域相对RMSE为4.51%，满足ESA BIOMASS任务误差低于20%的要求。
Conclusion: 摘要强调保持相位相干性可缓解深冠层信号饱和，TCCT为热带生物群落的连续碳储量制图提供了稳健框架。

papers.title: From Geometric Labels to Semantic Understanding of Indoor Building Components Using Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud-based understanding has become an important enabler for facility operation and maintenance involving indoor building components. However, existing methods output only discrete labels without explaining component functions or natural language interactions. This paper proposes Building-MLLM, a point cloud-centered multimodal large language model (MLLM) for indoor components, which models point clouds and instructions to generate responses across Simple Recognition, Complex Captioning, and Multi-Engineering Question Answering tasks. Building-MLLM addresses semantic concentration through four domain-specific mechanisms: Point Information Enhancer for task-relevant semantics, Geometry-Preserving Regularization preventing geometric erosion, fixed textual prefix for domain stabilization, and multi-dimensional LoRA balancing recognition with reasoning. A multi-constraint progressive instruction-generation engine is developed to compile a synthetic point cloud-text dataset with 4198 objects, 37,782 instruction-following pairs, and 47 categories. Experiments show that Building-MLLM achieves 88.00%, 65.10%, and 68.14% on the three task types, respectively, demonstrating superior indoor component language understanding and providing initial generalizability in transfer inference on other real-world datasets.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 13 figures, accepted by Automation in Construction journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Building-MLLM，一种以点云为中心的多模态大语言模型，用于室内建筑组件的语义理解。模型在简单识别、复杂描述和多工程问答三项任务上分别达到88.00%、65.10%和68.14%的性能，并通过合成数据集和四个领域特定机制实现语义集中。
Motivation: 现有基于点云的方法仅输出离散标签，无法解释组件功能或支持自然语言交互，限制了在设施运维中的应用。
Method: 提出Building-MLLM，包含点云信息增强器、几何保持正则化、固定文本前缀和多维LoRA四个机制，并开发多约束渐进指令生成引擎构建合成点云-文本数据集。
Result: 在包含4198个物体、37782个指令对、47类别的数据集上，三项任务准确率分别为88.00%、65.10%和68.14%，并在其他真实数据集上展示了初始泛化能力。
Conclusion: Building-MLLM展示了室内组件语言理解的优越性能，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或后续方向。

papers.title: Sequential Correlations Change In-Context Learning: Effective Context Length and Architectural Mismatch
papers.abstract_en: Modern sequence models have a striking capacity for in-context learning (ICL); they can perform new tasks based only on examples given in the prompt. Understanding how this ability emerges requires theory that captures important properties of natural data. Linear regression has served as a useful sandbox for ICL theory, but existing work has largely focused on prompts with independent examples. In this work, we extend this setting to sequentially correlated data, a basic feature of real sequences. We present a solvable model based on linear attention and test our predictions on realistic transformer architectures. We identify two distinct effects: First, when the query token is independent of the context, within-context correlations induce an effective context length: correlated prompts behave like shorter i.i.d. prompts. Second, when the query is also correlated with its context, test error is reduced, particularly for softmax attention when compared to linear attention. These results suggest that correlated prompts alter not only the effective sample size of in-context learning, but also which attention architectures are best matched to the task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了上下文学习（ICL）的理论模型，从独立样本到序列相关数据。基于线性注意力提出可解模型，并在真实Transformer架构上验证。发现序列相关性会改变有效上下文长度，并且查询与上下文相关时测试误差降低，尤其对softmax注意力。
Motivation: 现有ICL理论大多假设提示中样本独立，但真实序列具有相关性，理解这种相关性如何影响ICL对于理论捕捉数据特性至关重要。
Method: 构建基于线性注意力的可解模型，分析序列相关数据下的ICL行为，并在softmax注意力的Transformer上验证理论预测。
Result: 两个主要效应：1) 查询独立时，上下文内的相关性导致有效上下文长度缩短（相关提示行为类似更短的i.i.d.提示）；2) 查询与上下文相关时，测试误差降低，尤其是softmax注意力相比线性注意力。
Conclusion: 序列相关性不仅改变ICL的有效样本量，还影响注意力架构与任务的匹配程度。

papers.title: A Fair Benchmarking of Deep Relational Database Learning Models
papers.abstract_en: Relational databases (RDBs) are the primary data infrastructure in many enterprises, yet recent deep learning methods designed for RDBs have been evaluated under inconsistent experimental protocols, making fair comparison difficult. We present one of the first systematic benchmarking studies of recently released deep learning methods for RDBs, evaluating them across five relational databases, with one classification and one regression task for each. We refactor all deep RDB models to allow the full range of experimental procedures to be applied consistently across all methods. Our findings indicate that the relational transformer (RT) approach delivers the strongest overall performance on both classification and regression tasks compared to the state-of-the-art graph-based modeling and learning of RDBs. Even for single-table learning tasks, deep learning methods designed for RDBs outperform the leading tabular foundation model, TabPFN 2.5. Extending learning from a single table (hop = 0) to multiple tables (hop = 1, 2) by connecting neighboring tables in relational databases enhances performance, but the additional benefit from higher hops diminishes as computational overhead grows. Deep RDB learning methods have the potential to challenge state-of-the-art tabular foundation models, especially on large-scale enterprise data. The source code for this benchmarking study is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对近期提出的深度关系数据库（RDB）学习方法进行了系统基准测试，在五个关系数据库上评估分类和回归任务，重新实现所有模型以确保实验一致性。结果表明，关系变换器（RT）在整体性能上优于基于图的方法，且深度RDB方法在单表任务上超越前沿表格基础模型TabPFN 2.5。多表连接（hop=1,2）提升性能，但更高跳数收益递减。
Motivation: 当前深度关系数据库学习方法在不同实验协议下评估，缺乏公平比较，本文旨在通过统一基准框架实现公平评估。
Method: 对五种深度RDB模型进行重因子化，确保所有方法应用一致的实验流程，评估五个关系数据库上的分类和回归任务。
Result: 关系变换器（RT）在分类和回归任务上表现最佳；深度RDB方法在单表任务上优于TabPFN 2.5；从单表扩展到多表（hop=1,2）提升性能，但更高跳数收益递减且计算开销增加。
Conclusion: 深度RDB学习方法有潜力挑战前沿表格基础模型，尤其在大型企业数据上，但多表连接的高跳数收益有限。

papers.title: ViPo-MLLM: Visual-Pose Multimodal LLM for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation
papers.abstract_en: Gloss-free Sign Language Translation (SLT) translates sign language videos into spoken-language sentences without gloss annotations, avoiding costly labeling but requiring fine-grained modeling of hands, body, and facial cues. Existing methods often use single-modality or weakly fused features, limiting performance. We propose ViPo-MLLM, a framework that integrates spatio-temporal RGB and human pose features. Dedicated encoders model intra-modal dynamics and cross-modal attention captures long-range dependencies. The fused representation is conditioned with a structured prompt and processed by an LLM trained with contrastive and language modeling objectives. The proposed model was evaluated on the PHOENIX14T and CSL-Daily datasets and achieved new state-of-the-art results on both datasets. Moreover, the ViPo-MLLM model attained competitive performance compared to gloss-based recognition approaches, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed pose cues and cross-modal attention mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViPo-MLLM，一种融合时空RGB和人体姿态特征的多模态大语言模型，用于无标注手语翻译。在PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily数据集上达到新最优性能，且与基于标注的手语方法相比具有竞争力。

Result: 在PHOENIX14T和CSL-Daily上取得新最优结果，且与基于标注的手语识别方法相比具有竞争力。

papers.title: AutoCedar: An Agentic Framework for Verifier-Guided Access Control Policy Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models are increasingly used to turn natural-language requirements into code. In access control, that shortcut is dangerous: a generated policy can compile and read correctly while granting access that no one approved. The difficulty is not only writing policy code. It is fixing what the requirements mean before code is written, and then checking that the final policy actually satisfies that intent. We present AutoCedar, a verifier-guided system that first turns natural-language access-control requirements into a reviewed, checkable target, and then synthesizes Cedar policies against that target. AutoCedar decomposes schema and policy authoring into small intent atoms: reviewable claims about vocabulary and behavior. Once those atoms pass mechanical validation and human intent review, the model proposes a candidate policy, the verifier checks it against the approved target, and each failure is turned into a repair signal that tells the model whether to broaden, narrow, or restructure the policy without changing the target. Because the model's work is split into small problems, each grounded in reviewed intent and backed by verifier feedback, end-to-end policy authoring becomes tractable. AutoCedar converges on all 221 tasks of CedarBench, our benchmark of authorization tasks paired with executable semantic boundaries. Across three requirements-corpus case studies covering healthcare, education, and conference management, AutoCedar converts noisy prose and extracted access-control fragments into reviewed schemas, formal checks, and a globally verified Cedar policy store for each scenario.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoCedar 是一个验证器引导的智能体框架，用于从自然语言访问控制需求中合成 Cedar 策略。它通过将策略编写分解为可审查的意图原子（intent atoms），并利用机械验证和人工审查确保目标正确性，再通过验证器反馈循环逐步修正候选策略。实验表明，AutoCedar 在包含 221 个任务的 CedarBench 基准测试上全部收敛，并在医疗、教育、会议管理三个需求语料库案例研究中成功生成经过验证的策略库。
Motivation: 大语言模型生成访问控制策略时，即使语法正确且可读，也可能包含未授权的访问，因为需求理解的歧义性难以在编写代码之前解决。现有方法缺乏将自然语言需求转化为可审查、可验证目标的机制，导致策略与真实意图之间可能存在差距。
Method: AutoCedar 首先将架构和策略编写分解为小的意图原子（可审查的词汇及行为声明），通过机械验证和人工审查确立形式化目标；然后由语言模型提出候选策略，验证器将其与批准目标比对，每次失败生成具体的修复信号（扩大、缩小或重组策略），在不改变目标的前提下迭代修正。整个过程基于原子化的意图和验证器反馈，使得端到端策略编写可管理。
Result: 在包含 221 个授权任务及其可执行语义边界的 CedarBench 基准上，AutoCedar 所有任务均收敛。在医疗、教育、会议管理三个需求语料库案例研究中，AutoCedar 将嘈杂的文本及提取的访问控制片段转化为经过审查的架构、形式化检查及全局验证的 Cedar 策略库。
Conclusion: 论文认为，通过将策略编写分解为小意图原子并配合验证器反馈，自动化的访问控制策略合成变得可行且更可靠，能够弥合自然语言需求与可执行策略之间的意图缺口。

papers.title: ThreatVisionAI: A Hybrid CNN-ViT Framework for Image-Based Malware Classification
papers.abstract_en: Traditional malware detection methods struggle to generalize to obfuscated or previously unseen threats. This paper introduces ThreatVisionAI, a hybrid malware family classification framework that integrates a raw-image CNN, a wavelet-based CNN, and a Vision Transformer (ViT) to capture complementary spatial, frequency-domain, and global relational features in malware images. The wavelet-based CNN captures multi-scale frequency information that helps distinguish closely related families, while the ViT branch models long-range dependencies across the image. Evaluated on the Malimg dataset, ThreatVisionAI achieves 98.01% accuracy and a weighted F1 score of 0.9742, with wavelet-domain features providing measurable gains on minority and visually similar families. These results confirm that frequency-aware and transformer-based representations improve image-based malware family classification.

papers.title: ELiTeFormer: An Efficient Transformer for FPGAs
papers.abstract_en: Transformer blocks are prevalent in large language model (LLM) but present deployment challenges due to their challenging computational and memory demands. While prior work has typically optimized attention mechanisms or feed-forward networks (FFNs) separately, few hardware (HW) architecture have jointly addressed both components with co-designed hardware acceleration. We present ELiTeFormer (Efficient Linear Ternary Transformer), the first Transformer model architecture that unifies hybrid linear attention with ultra-low-precision (ternary) linear projections, specifically co-designed for field-programmable gate array (FPGA) deployment. ELiTeFormer achieves 10x model weight compression and 12.8x key-value (KV) cache compression compared to LLaMA 3, while maintaining competitive accuracy (31.9% on the MMLU benchmark, within 3.0% of BitNet b1.58). Our key architectural contribution is a novel processing element (PE) micro-architecture that eliminates all multiplications in ternary linear projections through bitmasking operations, significantly reducing resource utilization by completely avoiding dedicated digital signal processing (DSP) blocks. We simulate, synthesize, and deploy ELiTeFormer targeting a Xilinx VCK5000 Versal board using high-level synthesis (HLS) flows. Block-level simulations show 9.6x speedup for FFN operations and 4.4x speedup for attention compared to standard implementations. End-to-end deployment achieves up to 3.9x lower latency and 3.2x better energy efficiency than LLaMA 3 on an NVIDIA A100 graphics processing unit (GPU) at long context lengths. This represents the first FPGA realization combining linear attention with ternary quantization, demonstrating the viability of algorithm-architecture co-design for next-generation LLM acceleration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELiTeFormer 是首个针对 FPGA 部署的统一混合线性注意力与三元线性投影的 Transformer 架构，通过位掩码操作消除乘法，实现 10 倍权重压缩和 12.8 倍 KV 缓存压缩，在 MMLU 上达到 31.9% 准确率，并在 Xilinx VCK5000 上实现端到端部署，相比 A100 GPU 延迟降低 3.9 倍、能效提升 3.2 倍。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 在 FPGA 部署时面临计算和存储资源瓶颈，且注意力与前馈网络常被分开优化，缺乏联合硬件加速方案。
Method: 提出 ELiTeFormer，结合混合线性注意力与三元线性投影，设计新型处理单元微架构，通过位掩码替代乘法运算，完全避免 DSP 块。
Result: 10 倍权重压缩、12.8 倍 KV 缓存压缩，MMLU 准确率 31.9%（与 BitNet b1.58 差距 3.0%），FFN 操作加速 9.6 倍，注意力加速 4.4 倍，端到端延迟降低 3.9 倍，能效提升 3.2 倍。
Conclusion: 这是首个将线性注意力与三元量化结合的可综合 FPGA 实现，验证了算法-架构协同设计在 LLM 加速中的可行性。

summary_sections.conclusion: 这是首个将线性注意力与三元量化结合的可综合 FPGA 实现，验证了算法-架构协同设计在 LLM 加速中的可行性。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Transportation Hub Capacity Planning with Textual Business Inputs
papers.abstract_en: While traditional hub capacity planning models optimize effectively for quantitative inputs, they often fail to digest qualitative business context. We propose a novel framework where a large language model (LLM) agent iteratively proposes hub capacity decisions guided by natural-language business context descriptions. The key mechanism is a chain-of-thought reasoning protocol: the LLM constructs a structured decision table that maps each contextual item to specific capacity adjustments based on the implied direction and magnitude of changes. The new capacity decision is then validated through a feedback loop with an optimization model, which provides routing-based performance metrics to guide the agent's selection. On a real-world 13-hub freight network in the southeastern US, our framework achieves a 2.8% optimality gap relative to the hidden ground-truth, a significant improvement over the 11.0% gap produced by the traditional optimization model without textual business inputs. This demonstrates that LLMs can serve as a contextual bridge, integrating qualitative business insights into Operations Research workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对传统枢纽容量优化模型无法消化定性业务上下文的问题，提出一个框架，使用LLM agent通过思维链协议将自然语言业务描述转化为结构化决策表，并与优化模型迭代反馈。在真实13枢纽货运网络上，该方法达到了2.8%的最优性差距，优于传统优化模型的11.0%。
Motivation: 传统枢纽容量规划模型能高效优化定量输入，但无法消化定性业务上下文，导致对业务洞察的利用不足。
Method: 提出一个LLM agent框架，通过思维链推理协议，LLM构建结构化决策表，将每个上下文项映射到特定的容量调整。然后通过优化模型反馈的路径性能指标验证决策。
Result: 在真实13枢纽美国东南部货运网络上，该方法达到2.8%的最优性差距，相比传统优化模型（11.0%）显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调LLM可以作为上下文桥梁，将定性业务洞察整合到运筹学工作流中，展示了提升实际决策质量的潜力。

papers.title: ClinOCR-Bench: A Comprehensive Clinical Scanned Document Dataset for Optical Character Recognition Model Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Extracting textual information from scanned medical documents, such as external laboratory reports and manually filled forms, has been a major challenge in modern electronic health records (EHRs). Recent advancements in vision language models (VLMs) have shown great promise over traditional OCR tools. However, at this point, most clinical OCR studies were conducted on private, institutional data. To our knowledge, there are few publicly available datasets for evaluating OCR models in the clinical domain. Furthermore, common scanning artifacts that undermine OCR performance are not reflected in those datasets, leaving a systematic evaluation unfeasible. Therefore, we release a publicly available, realistic-looking OCR benchmark dataset, ClinOCR-Bench, with 384 scanned images across 6 subsets: Normal, Handwriting, Poor Quality, Rotation, Tables, and Mix-artifacts. ClinOCR-Bench features: 1) diverse document types and layouts, 2) full coverage of common EHR scan artifacts, 3) protected health information-free, 4) template-aware train/test split, and 5) adequate sample size for OCR benchmarking. Baseline OCR performance was evaluated using state-of-the-art open-weight and proprietary VLMs. The dataset and documentation are available on GitHub (https://github.com/ClinOCR-Bench/ClinOCR-Bench).

papers.title: Do Medical Vision Language Models Actually See? A Counterfactual Grounding Framework and Hard-Negative Contrastive Training for Visually-Reliant Medical VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large vision language models (VLMs) report strong accuracy on medical question-answering, yet it remains unclear whether they reason from visual evidence or exploit textual shortcuts. We introduce a counterfactual evaluation framework that decouples visual and textual contributions by substituting input images with controlled surrogates blank, pixel-shuffled, image-absent, and CLIP-retrieved hard negatives and derive a suite of grounding metrics including the Visual Reliance Score (VRS) and Visual Hallucination Rate (VHR). We further introduce CORAL (COntrastive Retrieval-Augmented Learning), a 7B-parameter LoRA fine-tune of Qwen2.5-VL-7B trained with a Contrastive Grounding Objective (CGO) that penalises answer invariance under hard-negative image swaps. On a paired controlled evaluation across four closed-form medical VQA benchmarks (PathVQA, PMC-VQA, SLAKE, VQA-RAD; n=400 total), CORAL improves macro accuracy by +6.7 pp (P(Delta>0)=0.988) and reduces VHR by 8.0 pp (P<0.001) over the matched Qwen2.5-VL-7B base; neither MedVLThinker RL variant achieves a significant gain on either metric. Cross-domain diagnostics further reveal that image substitution costs only <=6.5 pp on medical benchmarks versus 48-61 pp on general-domain tasks, situating the grounding gap that CGO targets. We discuss evaluation limitations openly including train/eval benchmark overlap and underpowered secondary metrics and release our framework, training code, and model weights to support reproducible grounding audits of medical VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学视觉语言模型（VLM）是否真正依赖视觉证据还是利用文本捷径的问题，提出了反事实评估框架（包括VRS和VHR指标）以及CORAL（对比检索增强学习）方法，通过硬负样本图像交换和对比接地目标来减少视觉幻觉，在四个医学VQA基准上提升了准确率并降低了视觉幻觉率。
Motivation: 现有医学VLM在问答任务上表现良好，但无法区分其推理是基于视觉证据还是文本捷径，缺乏可靠的视觉接地评估方法。
Method: 提出反事实评估框架，通过替换输入图像为空白、像素打乱、缺失图像和CLIP检索的硬负样本来解耦视觉和文本贡献，并定义视觉依赖分数（VRS）和视觉幻觉率（VHR）；引入CORAL方法，基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型进行LoRA微调，使用对比接地目标（CGO）惩罚硬负样本图像交换下的答案不变性。
Result: 在PathVQA、PMC-VQA、SLAKE、VQA-RAD四个医学VQA基准（总计400个样本）上，CORAL将宏平均准确率提升6.7个百分点（P(Δ>0)=0.988），并将VHR降低8.0个百分点（P<0.001）；而MedVLThinker强化学习变体在两项指标上均无显著提升。跨领域诊断显示医学基准上的图像替换代价仅≤6.5个百分点，而通用领域任务上为48-61个百分点。
Conclusion: 本文强调CGO方法能有效提升医学VLM的视觉接地能力，并公开了评估框架、训练代码和模型权重以支持可重复的接地审计，但讨论了训练/评估基准重叠和次要统计功效不足等局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Resource Allocation with Continuous Random Consumption: Regret under Degeneracy
papers.abstract_en: We study online resource allocation when both rewards and consumption sizes may be continuously distributed. Requests arrive sequentially and must be accepted or rejected irrevocably under fixed resource capacities. Each request belongs to one of finitely many observable types; conditional on an observable request type, both the reward and the scalar size are random, and the realized size scales a fixed type-specific resource-consumption vector. The model allows the deterministic fluid relaxation to be degenerate. We show that additive regret is governed by the size-weighted mass of requests whose value-to-size ratios lie near the active acceptance cutoffs. We formalize this quantity through an active weighted-mass exponent p. When p > 1, this cutoff mass is thin, and the problem is genuinely hard: every online policy must incur regret of order at least $T^{1/2 - 1/(2p)}$, and this holds for every p > 1. A sample-path marginal policy matches this lower bound up to polylogarithmic factors; and when p = 1, so that the mass grows linearly near the cutoff, it attains $O((\log T)^2)$ regret. For example, if the size and the value-to-size ratio are independent and uniformly distributed, then p = 1; if instead the size and the reward are independent and uniformly distributed, then p = 2. Thus the policy achieves $o(\sqrt{T})$ regret throughout this regularity class without any fluid non-degeneracy assumption, allowing both primal degeneracy and dual non-uniqueness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续随机消耗的在线资源分配问题，允许流体松弛退化。证明遗憾由价值-大小比率接近截止阈值的请求的加权质量决定，并给出下界和匹配上界的策略。
Motivation: 在线资源分配中奖励和消耗连续随机，且允许退化情况，现有理论未充分处理。
Method: 定义主动加权质量指数 p，基于此导出遗憾下界，并给出样本路径边际策略达到匹配上界。
Result: 当 p>1 时，任何策略遗憾至少为 T^(1/2 - 1/(2p))；当 p=1 时，策略达到 O((log T)^2) 遗憾。
Conclusion: 该策略在整个正则类中实现 o(√T) 遗憾，无需流体非退化假设。

papers.title: A Memory Efficient Unified Algorithm for Online Learning of Linear Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the challenge of stabilizing a general unknown linear dynamical system (LDS) from observations, we study the natural prerequisite of online prediction. Our goal is to achieve sublinear regret with a memory footprint that adapts to the intrinsic complexity of the dynamics rather than the full hidden-state dimension. We focus on the practically central regime of systems with low instability complexity -- eigenvalues outside the real stable interval that do not decay rapidly, together with non-semisimple modes -- potentially embedded in an otherwise stable real spectrum of much higher dimension; we write $k$ for this count. This regime is the primary setting in which stabilization is plausible: we show that many systems with high instability complexity cannot be stabilized without exponentially large controls. Thus, prediction is meaningful for stabilization precisely when the instability complexity is small. Within this regime, we introduce a unified online algorithm that handles every LDS (including non-diagonalizable systems with complex or exploding modes) with a learnable parameter count of $\widetilde{O}(k)$. Finally, we prove a lower bound showing that $k$ is a valid complexity measure: any filter-based predictor needs at least $k$ filters. Experiments corroborate our theory: on a high-dimensional system, our predictor sharply outperforms prior methods at an equal parameter budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性动力系统（LDS）的在线预测问题，提出一种内存高效的统一算法，专注于低不稳定复杂度（k）的系统，参数数量为O~(k)。理论证明任何基于滤波的预测器至少需要k个滤波器，实验显示在高维系统上，该算法在相同参数预算下显著优于先前方法。
Motivation: 稳定未知线性动力系统需要在线预测，但现有方法内存需求依赖隐藏状态维数，而非系统内在复杂度。高不稳定复杂度系统无法稳定，因此预测在低不稳定复杂度设置下才有意义。
Method: 提出统一在线算法，适用于所有LDS（包括不可对角化、复数或爆炸模式），可学习参数数量为O~(k)，其中k为低不稳定复杂度计数。
Result: 理论下界证明任何基于滤波器的预测器至少需要k个滤波器。实验表明，在高维系统上，该算法在相同参数预算下显著优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 该算法在低不稳定复杂度系统中高效，且k是合理的复杂度度量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diversity-aware View Partitioning for Scalable VGGT
papers.abstract_en: Geometry transformers such as VGGT achieve strong performance by jointly reasoning over multiple views with global attention. However, scaling them to large view collections remains challenging due to the quadratic cost of attention. Moreover, our empirical analysis reveals that the reconstruction quality in VGGT is sensitive to the distribution of viewpoints. Simply increasing the number of views without sufficient viewpoint diversity can even degrade performance, as redundant views introduce highly similar tokens that dilute informative geometric signals in the attention mechanism. Motivated by this observation, we propose a training-free and plug-and-play VGGT inference framework that organizes views into diversity-aware balanced chunks. The chunks are constructed through combinatorial graph partitioning over visual dissimilarity and spatial dispersion. This view organization allows the transformer to focus attention on geometrically informative views while reducing redundant attention interactions. To estimate spatial dispersion without full pose estimation, we approximate spatial relationships via a soft pose propagation strategy based on visual similarity from a small set of seed frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved performance in camera pose estimation, multi-view depth prediction, and 3D reconstruction while reducing memory usage and inference latency. Our framework also complements existing VGGT variants, enabling scalable multi-view reconstruction without sacrificing geometric fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对VGGT等几何变换器在大量视图下推理成本高、冗余视图降低重建质量的问题，提出一种无需训练、即插即用的推理框架，通过基于视觉差异和空间分散的图划分将视图组织为多样性感知的平衡块，减少注意力冗余并聚焦于几何信息丰富的视图。在相机位姿估计、多视图深度预测和3D重建任务上取得改进，同时降低内存和延迟。
Motivation: VGGT等全局注意力几何变换器在扩展到大视图集合时面临二次复杂度，且增加视图数量若缺乏多样性反而因冗余视图稀释几何信号而降低性能。
Method: 提出基于组合图划分的视图组织方法，利用视觉差异和空间分散构建多样性感知平衡块；空间分散通过基于视觉相似性的软位姿传播近似估计，无需完整位姿。
Result: 实验证明该方法在相机位姿估计、多视图深度预测和3D重建上性能提升，同时减少内存使用和推理延迟。
Conclusion: 该框架可即插即用于现有VGGT变体，实现可扩展的多视图重建而不损失几何保真度。

summary_sections.motivation: VGGT等全局注意力几何变换器在扩展到大视图集合时面临二次复杂度，且增加视图数量若缺乏多样性反而因冗余视图稀释几何信号而降低性能。
