papers.title: Clin-JEPA: A Multi-Phase Co-Training Framework for Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining on EHR Patient Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: We present Clin-JEPA, a multi-phase co-training framework for joint-embedding predictive (JEPA) pretraining on EHR patient trajectories. JEPA architectures have enabled latent-space planning in robotics and high-quality representation learning in vision, but extending the paradigm to EHR data -- to obtain a single backbone that simultaneously forecasts patient trajectories and serves diverse downstream risk-prediction tasks without per-task fine-tuning -- remains an open challenge. Existing JEPA frameworks either discard the predictor after pretraining (I-JEPA, V-JEPA) or train it on a frozen pretrained encoder (V-JEPA 2-AC), leaving the encoder unaware of the rollout signal that the retained predictor must use at inference; co-training the encoder and predictor under a shared JEPA prediction objective would supply this grounding, but naïve co-training is unstable, with representation collapse and online/target drift causing autoregressive rollout to diverge. Clin-JEPA's five-phase pretraining curriculum -- predictor warmup, joint refinement, EMA target alignment, hard sync, and predictor finalization -- addresses each failure mode by phase, stably co-training a Qwen3-8B-based encoder and a 92M-parameter latent trajectory predictor. On MIMIC-IV ICU data, three independent evaluations support the framework: (1) latent $\ell_1$ rollout drift uniquely converges ($-$15.7%) over 48-hour horizons while baselines and ablations diverge (+3% to +4951%); (2) the encoder learns a clinically discriminative latent geometry (deteriorating-patient cohorts displace 4.83$\times$ further than stable patients in latent space, vs $\leq$2.62$\times$ for baseline encoders); (3) a single backbone outperforms strong tabular and sequence baselines on multi-task downstream evaluation. Clin-JEPA achieves mean AUROC 0.851 on ICareFM EEP and 0.883 on 8 binary risk tasks (+0.038 and +0.041 vs baseline average).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Clin-JEPA 是一个针对电子健康记录（EHR）患者轨迹的多阶段联合训练框架，采用联合嵌入预测（JEPA）预训练。通过五阶段预训练课程（预测器预热、联合精炼、EMA目标对齐、硬同步、预测器最终化），稳定地联合训练基于 Qwen3-8B 的编码器和 92M 参数的潜在轨迹预测器。在 MIMIC-IV ICU 数据上，该框架在潜在漂移、潜在空间判别性以及多任务下游评估中均优于基线，平均 AUROC 在 ICareFM EEP 上达到 0.851，在 8 个二元风险任务上达到 0.883。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 框架要么在预训练后丢弃预测器（I-JEPA, V-JEPA），要么在冻结的预训练编码器上训练预测器（V-JEPA 2-AC），导致编码器无法感知推理时预测器必须使用的展开信号；而简单的联合训练不稳定，会出现表示崩溃和在线/目标漂移，导致自回归展开发散。
Method: 提出五阶段预训练课程：预测器预热、联合精炼、EMA目标对齐、硬同步、预测器最终化，以稳定地联合训练编码器和潜在轨迹预测器。编码器基于 Qwen3-8B，预测器参数量为 92M。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV ICU 数据上：（1）潜在 ℓ1 展开漂移在 48 小时范围内唯一收敛（-15.7%），而基线和消融实验发散（+3% 至 +4951%）；（2）编码器学习到临床判别性潜在空间（恶化患者组在潜在空间中的位移是稳定患者的 4.83 倍，基线编码器 ≤2.62 倍）；（3）单个主干在多任务下游评估中优于强基线和序列基线，平均 AUROC 在 ICareFM EEP 为 0.851，在 8 个二元风险任务为 0.883。
Conclusion: Clin-JEPA 通过多阶段联合训练解决了 JEPA 在 EHR 数据上的稳定性问题，实现了同时预测患者轨迹和提供多任务风险预测的单一骨干网络，无需任务特定微调。

papers.title: IRC-Bench: Recognizing Entities from Contextual Cues in First-Person Reminiscences
papers.abstract_en: When people recount personal memories, they often refer to people, places, and events indirectly, relying on con-textual cues rather than explicit names. Such implicit references are central to reminiscence narratives: first-person accounts of lived experience used in therapeutic, archival, and social settings. They pose a difficult computational problem because the intended entity must be inferred from dispersed narrative evidence rather than from a local mention. We introduce IRC-Bench, the Implicit Reminiscence Context Benchmark, for evaluating implicit entity recognition in reminiscence transcripts. The benchmark targets non-locality: entity-identifying cues are distributed across multiple, non-contiguous clauses, unlike named entity recognition, entity linking, or coreference resolution. IRC-Bench comprises 25,136 samples constructed from 12,337 Wikidata-linked entities across 1,994 transcripts spanning 11 thematic domains. Each sample pairs an Entity-Grounded Narrative, in which the target entity is ex-plicitly mentioned, with an Entity-Elided Narrative, in which direct mentions are removed. We evaluate 19 config-urations across LLM generation, dense retrieval, RAG, and fine-tuning. QLoRA-adapted Llama 3.1 8B performs best in the open-world setting (38.94% exact match; 51.59% Jaccard), while fine-tuned DPR leads closed-world retrieval (35.38% Hit@1; 71.49% Hit@10). We release IRC-Bench with data, code, and evaluation tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 IRC-Bench，一个用于评估回忆叙述中隐式实体识别的基准数据集。该基准包含从11个主题领域的1,994个转录本中构建的25,136个样本，每个样本对包括明确提及实体的叙述和移除直接提及的叙述。评估了19种配置（包括LLM生成、密集检索、RAG和微调），发现QLoRA微调的Llama 3.1 8B在开放世界设置中表现最佳（精确匹配38.94%，Jaccard 51.59%），而微调的DPR在封闭世界检索中领先（Hit@1 35.38%，Hit@10 71.49%）。
Motivation: 人们在回忆时经常间接提及人物、地点和事件，依靠上下文线索而非显式名称。这种隐式引用在治疗、档案和社交环境中的回忆叙述中很常见，但现有的命名实体识别、实体链接和共指消解方法无法处理这种非局部性：实体识别线索分布在多个不连续的从句中。
Method: 构建了IRC-Bench基准，包含25,136个样本，每个样本由实体锚定叙述（显式提及目标实体）和实体省略叙述（移除直接提及）配对组成。评估了LLM生成、密集检索、RAG和微调等19种配置，包括QLoRA微调的Llama 3.1 8B和微调的DPR。
Result: QLoRA微调的Llama 3.1 8B在开放世界设置中达到38.94%精确匹配和51.59% Jaccard；微调的DPR在封闭世界检索中达到35.38% Hit@1和71.49% Hit@10。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了隐式实体识别的挑战，并提供了评估框架。当前最佳方法仍有较大提升空间，表明该任务需要进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Syn4D: A Multiview Synthetic 4D Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Dense 3D reconstruction and tracking of dynamic scenes from monocular video remains an important open challenge in computer vision. Progress in this area has been constrained by the scarcity of high-quality datasets with dense, complete, and accurate geometric annotations. To address this limitation, we introduce Syn4D, a multiview synthetic dataset of dynamic scenes that includes ground-truth camera motion, depth maps, dense tracking, and parametric human pose annotations. A key feature of Syn4D is the ability to unproject any pixel into 3D to any time and to any camera. We conduct extensive evaluations across multiple downstream tasks to demonstrate the utility and effectiveness of the proposed dataset, including 4D scene reconstruction, 3D point tracking, geometry-aware camera retargeting, and human pose estimation. The experimental results highlight Syn4D's potential to facilitate research in dynamic scene understanding and spatiotemporal modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Syn4D是一个多视图合成动态场景数据集，包含地面真实相机运动、深度图、密集跟踪和参数化人体姿态标注。该数据集支持从任意像素反投影到任意时间的任意相机视角，并在4D场景重建、3D点跟踪、几何感知相机重定位和人体姿态估计等下游任务中验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 动态场景的密集3D重建与跟踪因缺乏高质量、密集且完整几何标注的数据集而进展受限。
Method: 通过合成方式生成多视图动态场景数据，并提供完整的几何（深度图、密集跟踪）和语义（人体姿态）标注。
Result: 在4D场景重建、3D点跟踪、几何感知相机重定位和人体姿态估计任务上的评估表明，Syn4D能有效促进动态场景理解研究。
Conclusion: 该数据集填补了动态场景标注数据的空白，有望推动时空建模与动态场景分析的发展。

papers.title: DBLP: Phase-Aware Bounded-Loss Transport for Burst-Resilient Distributed ML Training
papers.abstract_en: Distributed machine learning (ML) training has become a necessity with the prevalence of billion to trillion-parameter-scale models. While prior work has improved training efficiency from the ML perspective at the application layer, it often fails to address transient congestion events at the network layer that introduce severe tail latency and training-time variability, thereby undermining the quality of service of distributed ML training systems. Existing network optimizations treat all gradients equally and thus fail to integrate sufficient model-training insights into communication protocol design. In this paper, we present Dynamic Bounded-Loss Protocol (DBLP), a burst-resilient, training-phase-aware, and hardware-agnostic transport protocol that incorporates model-level tolerance properties into gradient communication. By dynamically adjusting gradient loss tolerance across training phases, DBLP reduces overall training time and mitigates tail-latency collapse during transient high-loss events (i.e., microbursts). Compared to the current state-of-the-art solution (baseline), DBLP tolerates significantly higher loss while achieving comparable test accuracy, and reduces end-to-end training time by an average of 24.4% and a maximum of 33.9%. At microburst events, DBLP achieves up to 5.88x single-round communication latency speedups over the baseline, preventing burst-induced tail-latency spikes and maintaining stable training performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DBLP，一种面向分布式机器学习训练、感知训练阶段且硬件无关的传输协议，通过动态调整梯度丢失容忍度来应对网络微突发（microbursts），减少尾延迟尖峰并稳定训练。实验表明，DBLP 相比基线平均减少 24.4% 端到端训练时间，在微突发事件中单轮通信延迟加速高达 5.88 倍。
Motivation: 现有分布式训练优化主要关注应用层，忽略了网络层短暂拥塞（微突发）导致的严重尾延迟和训练时间波动，而现有网络优化未利用模型训练阶段信息，对所有梯度同等处理。
Method: 提出 Dynamic Bounded-Loss Protocol (DBLP)，感知训练阶段的不同梯度丢失容忍度，在传输时动态调整可容忍的丢包率，从而在微突发时避免尾延迟崩溃，同时保持测试精度。
Result: DBLP 在端到端训练时间上平均减少 24.4%（最大 33.9%），在微突发事件中单轮通信延迟加速最高达 5.88 倍，且测试精度与基线相当。
Conclusion: DBLP 证明了将模型训练特性（如阶段感知的梯度容忍度）融入网络传输协议设计能有效缓解微突发带来的训练不稳定问题。

papers.title: Three-Step Nav: A Hierarchical Global-Local Planner for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Breakthrough progress in vision-based navigation through unknown environments has been achieved by using multimodal large language models (MLLMs). These models can plan a sequence of motions by evaluating the current view at each time step against the task and goal given to the agent. However, current zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) agents powered by MLLMs still tend to drift off course, halt prematurely, and achieve low overall success rates. We propose Three-Step Nav to counteract these failures with a three-view protocol: First, "look forward" to extract global landmarks and sketch a coarse plan. Then, "look now" to align the current visual observation with the next sub-goal for fine-grained guidance. Finally, "look backward" audits the entire trajectory to correct accumulated drift before stopping. Requiring no gradient updates or task-specific fine-tuning, our planner drops into existing VLN pipelines with minimal overhead. Three-Step Nav achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE dataset. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZoeyZheng0/3-step-Nav.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 29th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Three-Step Nav，一种层次化的全局-局部规划器，用于零样本视觉-语言导航（VLN）。该方法通过三步视角协议：先“向前看”提取全局地标并规划粗略路线，再“现在看”将当前视觉观测与下一步子目标对齐以提供精细引导，最后“向后看”审计整个轨迹以纠正累积漂移。无需梯度更新或任务特定微调，即可嵌入现有VLN流水线。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上达到零样本下的最优性能。
Motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的零样本VLN代理容易偏离路线、过早停止，导致整体成功率低。
Method: 提出 Three-Step Nav，包含三个步骤：1) 向前看（look forward）——使用MLLM从当前视野提取全局地标并生成粗略计划；2) 现在看（look now）——将当前视觉观测与计划中的下一子目标对齐，输出精细的导航指令；3) 向后看（look backward）——在停止前审计整个历史轨迹，检测并修正累积的漂移。方法无需梯度更新或任务特定微调，可直接插入现有VLN管道。
Result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上，该方法取得了零样本设置下的最优性能（state-of-the-art）。
Conclusion: Three-Step Nav 通过简单的三步视角协议有效缓解了MLLM基导航代理的常见失败模式，且无需额外训练即可提升零样本VLN性能。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Three-Step Nav，包含三个步骤：1) 向前看（look forward）——使用MLLM从当前视野提取全局地标并生成粗略计划；2) 现在看（look now）——将当前视觉观测与计划中的下一子目标对齐，输出精细的导航指令；3) 向后看（look backward）——在停止前审计整个历史轨迹，检测并修正累积的漂移。方法无需梯度更新或任务特定微调，可直接插入现有VLN管道。
summary_sections.result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上，该方法取得了零样本设置下的最优性能（state-of-the-art）。
summary_sections.conclusion: Three-Step Nav 通过简单的三步视角协议有效缓解了MLLM基导航代理的常见失败模式，且无需额外训练即可提升零样本VLN性能。

papers.title: ML-Guided Primal Heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs
papers.abstract_en: Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs (MBQPs) are an important and complex set of problems in combinatorial optimization. As solving large-scale combinatorial optimization problems is challenging, primal heuristics have been developed to quickly identify high-quality solutions within a short amount of time. Recently, a growing body of research has also used machine learning to accelerate solution methods for challenging combinatorial optimization problems. Despite the increasing popularity of these ML-guided methods, a large body of work has focused on Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs). MBQPs are challenging to solve due to the combinatorial complexity coupled with nonlinearities. This work proposes ML-guided primal heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs (MBQPs) by adapting and extending existing work on ML-guided MILP solution prediction to MBQPs. We introduce a new neural network architecture for MBQP solution prediction and a new training data collection procedure. Moreover, we extend existing loss functions in solution prediction and propose to combine contrastive and weighted cross-entropy losses. We evaluate the methods on standard and real-world MBQP benchmarks and show that the developed ML-guided methods significantly outperform existing primal heuristics and state-of-the-art solvers. Furthermore, models trained with our proposed extension with combined losses outperform other ML-based methods adapted from MILPs and improve generalization in cross-regional inference on a real-world wind farm layout optimization problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了针对混合二元二次规划（MBQP）的机器学习引导的原始启发式方法，通过改编和扩展已有的针对混合整数线性规划（MILP）的ML引导解预测方法。作者引入了新的神经网络架构、训练数据收集流程，并结合对比损失和加权交叉熵损失。在标准及真实世界MBQP基准上的实验表明，所提方法显著优于现有原始启发式方法和最先进求解器，并在风电场布局优化问题中展现了更好的泛化能力。
Motivation: MBQP是一类重要但求解困难的组合优化问题，其非线性与组合复杂性并存。现有ML引导方法多聚焦于MILP，缺少针对MBQP的专用ML引导原始启发式。
Method: 提出新的神经网络架构和训练数据收集流程，以预测MBQP的解；扩展了现有解预测的损失函数，结合对比损失与加权交叉熵损失。
Result: 在标准及真实世界MBQP基准上，所提ML引导方法显著优于现有原始启发式方法和最先进求解器；在风电场布局优化中，结合损失训练的模型优于从MILP迁移的ML方法，并改善了跨区域泛化。
Conclusion: ML引导的原始启发式能有效加速MBQP求解，且所提损失组合对泛化有益。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: High-Risk AI Systems and the Problem of Identity in the European AI Act
papers.abstract_en: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA) establishes a lifecycle governance regime for high-risk AI systems built around ex-ante conformity assessment, post-market monitoring, and re-assessment upon "substantial modification." These obligations presuppose AI identity judgments: regulators and providers must decide when an updated system remains the same system over time. In this work, we show how this logic is clarified by the function+ framework of artifact identity, which individuates AI systems by their intended function together with context-sensitive criteria of appropriate functioning, captured as "AI trustworthiness." We further argue that the AIA does not provide an internal, auditable criterion for synchronic identity--when two AI systems at a given time should count as the same for regulatory purposes--and instead largely defers such sameness determinations to sectoral or harmonization instruments. function+ supplies a synchronic identity test anchored in intended function and trustworthiness profiles and levels, making synchronic identity decisions inspectable in governance settings such as procurement, liability, and market surveillance. Our contribution is a conceptual and auditing lens: we provide a correspondence map between AIA lifecycle obligations and function+ identity components, and we make the synchronic case operationally legible via a minimal decision flow for audit and dispute contexts. We conclude with two implementation-facing recommendations: (1) more precise, testable reporting of intended purpose, and (2) standardized, auditable trustworthiness reporting that supports comparability over time and across deployments.
papers.comment: Accepted as a non-archival paper at The 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26), June 25-28, 2026, Montreal, QC, Canada. Extended version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析欧盟《人工智能法案》（AIA）对高风险AI系统的生命周期治理要求，指出其隐式依赖“AI身份”判断——即何时更新后的系统仍被视为同一系统。作者基于函数+（function+）框架（通过预期功能和情境敏感的功能适切性标准来个体化AI系统）来阐明这一问题，并论证AIA缺乏内生的、可审计的共时身份（synchronic identity）标准，而是很大程度上交由部门或协调工具决定。文章提供AIA生命周期义务与函数+身份组件的对应映射，并提出一个用于审计和争议的共时身份决策流程。最终给出两项建议：更精确报告预期目的，以及标准化、可审计的可信度报告。
Motivation: AIA对高风险AI系统的监管依赖于‘系统身份’的判断，但该法案本身未提供清晰的、可操作的身份判定标准，导致在监管、采购、责任认定等情境下存在模糊性。
Method: 运用函数+框架，结合AIA的生命周期义务（事前合规评估、上市后监测、重大修改后的再评估），建立身份判断的对应关系，并设计最小化决策流以支持审计。
Result: 抽象未报告具体实验或数值结果，而是提出了概念分析和操作化建议。
Conclusion: AIA需要更精确的预期目的报告和标准化的可信度报告，以支持身份判断的可审计性和跨时间、跨部署的可比性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Task Completion: A Verification-vs.-Conformance Gap in Tool-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agents that synthesize their own tools ship a second artifact alongside each answer: a software library that future tasks reuse, compose, and depend on. Task completion (TC) certifies the answer; it does not certify the library. On a Claude Haiku 4.5 pilot, we patch the harness to preserve per-tool source and replay every synthesised tool against a held-out conformance suite. Across 222 preserved tools and three protocols, 96.8% record per-tool correctness C=0.00: two protocols silent-rot at 100%, one at 91.7%. Hand-written reference implementations score C=1.00 on all 16 capability suites. The synthesised tools execute cleanly and the in-session verifier raises no flag; on held-out inputs they simply return wrong answers. This is the verification-vs.-conformance gap a pass-rate benchmark cannot see. EvolveTool-Bench makes that gap measurable. Sessions are structured into seed, gap, variant, composition, regression, and adversarial roles; runs emit per-tool manifests, verified-subset TC, correct-vs.-incorrect reuse, and audit traces for post-deployment monitoring. In the Haiku pilot over five protocols (3 seeds, 8 sessions, 51 verified decisions per pass), TC alone does not separate the protocols; the audit layer does. One pre-specified contrast shows the adapted decision-split synthesis protocol underperforming one-shot synthesis (-7.1 pp, 95% CI [-13.9,-0.1]; not significant after BH correction) -- a hypothesis-generating signal, not a confirmed effect. We release the harness, per-tool source preservation, conformance replay, and reproducibility manifests. An audit schema of this shape -- verifier coverage, reuse decomposition, held-out conformance -- is the minimum a deployed tool-evolving agent should emit between releases.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures; accepted at KDD 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI Evaluation and Trustworthiness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出工具演化代理存在一个验证与符合性差距（verification-vs.-conformance gap），即代理生成的任务答案看似正确但生成的软件库在未见过的输入上返回错误结果。作者引入EvolveTool-Bench基准，通过保留每个工具的源代码并回放符合性测试套件来量化这一差距。在Claude Haiku 4.5上的初步实验显示，222个工具中96.8%的符合性得分为0.00，而手写参考实现得分为1.00。
Motivation: 现有评估只关注任务完成度（task completion），忽略了代理合成的工具库在复用后可能出错的风险，缺乏衡量工具符合性（conformance）的方法。
Method: 设计EvolveTool-Bench，将对话结构化为种子、差距、变体、组合、回归和对抗角色；每次运行生成每个工具的报告、验证子集任务完成度、正确与错误复用的统计以及审计痕迹。通过保留每个工具的源代码并回放符合性测试来测量验证-符合性差距。
Result: 在Claude Haiku 4.5上的五个协议（3个种子，8个会话，每个通过51个验证决策）中，任务完成度无法区分协议，而审计层可以区分。一个预先指定的对比显示，适应决策分裂合成协议的表现不如一次合成（-7.1个百分点，95% CI [-13.9, -0.1]；经BH校正后不显著）。
Conclusion: 对于部署的工具演化代理，在其发布之间至少应包含审计架构：验证器覆盖率、复用分解和保留符合性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Video Generation Models as World Models: Efficient Paradigms, Architectures and Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of video generation has enabled models to simulate complex physical dynamics and long-horizon causalities, positioning them as potential world simulators. However, a critical gap still remains between the theoretical capacity for world simulation and the heavy computational costs of spatiotemporal modeling. To address this, we comprehensively and systematically review video generation frameworks and techniques that consider efficiency as a crucial requirement for practical world modeling. We introduce a novel taxonomy in three dimensions: efficient modeling paradigms, efficient network architectures, and efficient inference algorithms. We further show that bridging this efficiency gap directly empowers interactive applications such as autonomous driving, embodied AI, and game simulation. Finally, we identify emerging research frontiers in efficient video-based world modeling, arguing that efficiency is a fundamental prerequisite for evolving video generators into general-purpose, real-time, and robust world simulators. A curated GitHub repository of the reviewed literature can be found at https://github.com/Isaachhh/Efficient-VWM-Survey.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了将视频生成模型视为世界模拟器（world simulators）时的效率问题，从高效建模范式、高效网络架构和高效推理算法三个维度提出新型分类法。文章指出，弥合效率差距可直接赋能自动驾驶、具身AI和游戏模拟等交互式应用，并认为效率是从视频生成器进化为通用实时鲁棒世界模拟器的基础前提。
Motivation: 视频生成模型理论上能够模拟物理动力学和长程因果关系，但巨大的时空建模计算成本阻碍其成为实用的世界模拟器，现有综述缺乏对效率维度的系统审视。
Method: 提出三维度分类法：高效建模范式（如潜在空间扩散、条件生成策略）、高效网络架构（如时空注意力的轻量化变体、混合专家模型）和高效推理算法（如步数压缩、蒸馏与并行解码）。在此框架下整理现有文献并提供GitHub仓库。
Result: 摘要未给出具体定量结果，但指出所综述的高效技术可使视频生成模型在自动驾驶、具身AI、游戏仿真等场景中实现实用化部署。
Conclusion: 效率是实现视频生成模型向通用实时鲁棒世界模拟器演进的关键瓶颈，未来前沿包括统一且自适应的效率-质量权衡机制。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The Anatomy of Uncertainty in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Understanding why a large language model (LLM) is uncertain about the response is important for their reliable deployment. Current approaches, which either provide a single uncertainty score or rely on the classical aleatoric-epistemic dichotomy, fail to offer actionable insights for improving the generative model. Recent studies have also shown that such methods are not enough for understanding uncertainty in LLMs. In this work, we advocate for an uncertainty decomposition framework that dissects LLM uncertainty into three distinct semantic components: (i) input ambiguity, arising from ambiguous prompts; (ii) knowledge gaps, caused by insufficient parametric evidence; and (iii) decoding randomness, stemming from stochastic sampling. Through a series of experiments we demonstrate that the dominance of these components can shift across model size and task. Our framework provides a better understanding to audit LLM reliability and detect hallucinations, paving the way for targeted interventions and more trustworthy systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICBINB Workshop, ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）中的不确定性，提出将其分解为三个语义成分：输入模糊性（输入歧义）、知识缺口（参数证据不足）和解码随机性（随机采样）。实验表明这些成分的主导性随模型规模和任务类型变化，为审计LLM可靠性和检测幻觉提供了更细致的理解。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法要么输出单一分数，要么依赖经典的偶然-认知二分法，无法为改进生成模型提供可操作的见解，且不足以理解LLM中的不确定性。
Method: 提出一个不确定性分解框架，将LLM的不确定性分解为输入模糊性、知识缺口和解码随机性三个不同的语义成分。
Result: 通过一系列实验，展示了这些成分的主导性会随模型规模和任务类型发生变化。
Conclusion: 该框架为审计LLM可靠性和检测幻觉提供了更好的理解，有助于定向干预和构建更可信的系统。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出一个不确定性分解框架，将LLM的不确定性分解为输入模糊性、知识缺口和解码随机性三个不同的语义成分。
summary_sections.result: 通过一系列实验，展示了这些成分的主导性会随模型规模和任务类型发生变化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为审计LLM可靠性和检测幻觉提供了更好的理解，有助于定向干预和构建更可信的系统。

papers.title: CORA: Generalizable coronary artery disease assessment and risk stratification from coronary CT angiography using pathology-centric representation learning
papers.abstract_en: Coronary artery disease, a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality worldwide, can be assessed non-invasively by coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Although deep learning has advanced automated CCTA analysis, clinical translation remains constrained by the scarcity of expert-annotated data and by the spatial sparsity of coronary pathology, which occupies only a small fraction of each scan. Widely used label-free pretraining strategies, such as masked image modeling and contrastive learning, optimize for global anatomical reconstruction and tend to under-represent these tiny localized pathological features. Here we present CORA, an annotation-efficient model for comprehensive coronary artery disease assessment. Rather than reconstructing background anatomy, CORA learns from volumetric CCTA through a synthesis-driven self-supervised strategy: an anatomy-guided engine inserts diverse synthetic calcified and non-calcified lesions into unlabeled scans, reframing pretraining as an abnormality-detection task that biases representation learning toward clinically relevant disease features. We pretrained CORA on 10,138 unlabeled CCTA volumes and evaluated it across datasets from nine independent hospitals. Across plaque characterization, stenosis detection, and coronary artery segmentation, CORA consistently outperformed strong self-supervised pretraining baselines, with the largest gains on external multi-center data, indicating robust generalization under distributional shift. Coupling the imaging encoder with structured clinical variables further enabled near-term major adverse cardiac event (MACE) risk stratification. Our results show that pathology-centric, synthesis-driven pretraining is an effective and scalable strategy for annotation-efficient coronary artery disease assessment from CCTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CORA，一种基于合成驱动自监督学习的模型，用于冠状动脉疾病（CAD）的CCTA评估。CORA在10,138个无标签CCTA体素上预训练，并在九个独立医院数据集上评估，在斑块表征、狭窄检测和冠状动脉分割任务上优于强自监督基线，尤其在外部多中心数据上提升显著。结合临床变量后还能进行短期主要不良心脏事件（MACE）风险分层。
Motivation: 现有深度学习在CCTA分析中受限于专家标注数据稀缺以及冠状动脉病理空间稀疏性，无标签预训练方法（如掩码图像建模、对比学习）优化全局解剖重建，难以捕捉微小局部病变特征。
Method: CORA采用合成驱动的自监督学习策略：通过解剖引导引擎在无标签扫描中插入多样化的合成钙化和非钙化病变，将预训练转化为异常检测任务，使表示学习偏向临床相关病变特征。
Result: 在斑块表征、狭窄检测和冠状动脉分割任务上，CORA一致优于强自监督预训练基线，在外部多中心数据上增益最大。结合临床变量后能实现短期MACE风险分层。
Conclusion: 病理中心、合成驱动的预训练是CCTA中注释高效CAD评估的有效且可扩展策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniICL: Systematizing Unified Multimodal In-context Learning through a Capability-Oriented Taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) enables fast task adaptation from demonstrations without per-task parameter updates but remains highly sensitive to example selection and formatting. In unified multimodal models spanning understanding and generation, this sensitivity is exacerbated by cross-modal interference and varying cognitive demands. Consequently, in-context learning efficacy is often non-monotonic and highly task-dependent. To diagnose these behaviors, we introduce a six-level Capability-Oriented Taxonomy that categorizes the functional role of demonstrations from basic perception to high-order discernment. Guided by this cognitive framework, we construct UniICL-760K, a large-scale corpus featuring curated 8-shot in-context learning episodes across 15 subtasks, alongside UniICL-Bench for rigorous, controlled evaluation. We show that this data-driven assembly is the primary source of our gains. As a complementary, lightweight stabilizer, we additionally propose the Context-Adaptive Prototype Modulator, a plug-and-play module that further improves few-shot stability. Evaluations on UniICL-Bench show that our approach yields highly competitive unified results, outperforming larger-parameter multimodal large language model baselines on most understanding in-context learning tasks. Data and code are available at https://github.com/xuyicheng-zju/UniICL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态上下文学习中示例选择敏感性和跨模态干扰问题，提出能力导向分类法（Capability-Oriented Taxonomy）将示例功能分为六个认知层级，并构建大规模语料库UniICL-760K（含15个子任务、8-shot示例）和评测基准UniICL-Bench。作为轻量级稳定器，还提出上下文自适应原型调制器（Context-Adaptive Prototype Modulator）。实验表明该方法在大多数理解类ICL任务上超越更大参数量的多模态大语言模型基线。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型中的上下文学习对示例选择和格式高度敏感，跨模态干扰和认知需求差异导致任务依赖性非单调，缺乏系统诊断工具。
Method: 提出六层能力导向分类法，基于此构建UniICL-760K语料库（8-shot示例，15个子任务）和UniICL-Bench评测基准；另提出即插即用的上下文自适应原型调制器提升少样本稳定性。
Result: 在UniICL-Bench上取得具有竞争力的统一结果，在大多数理解类ICL任务上超越参数更大的多模态大语言模型基线。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的示例组装是性能提升的主要来源，而原型调制器作为补充稳定器进一步改善少样本稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Estimating Individual Tree Height and Species from UAV Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of forest biomass, a major carbon sink, relies heavily on tree-level traits such as height and species. Unoccupied Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) capturing high-resolution imagery from a single RGB camera offer a cost-effective and scalable approach for mapping and measuring individual trees. We introduce BIRCH-Trees, the first benchmark for individual tree height and species estimation from tree-centered UAV images, spanning three datasets: temperate forests, tropical forests, and boreal plantations. We also present DINOvTree, a unified approach using a Vision Foundation Model (VFM) backbone with task-specific heads for simultaneous height and species prediction. Through extensive evaluations on BIRCH-Trees, we compare DINOvTree against commonly used vision methods, including VFMs, as well as biological allometric equations. We find that DINOvTree achieves top overall results with accurate height predictions and competitive classification accuracy while using only 54% to 58% of the parameters of the second-best approach.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://RolnickLab.github.io/DINOvTree
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BIRCH-Trees基准，用于从无人机树冠图像估计单木高度和物种，涵盖温带、热带和北方森林。同时提出DINOvTree方法，使用视觉基础模型（VFM）骨干网络搭配任务特定头，同时预测高度和物种。实验表明，DINOvTree在高度预测和分类精度上达到最佳，且参数量仅为次优方法的54%-58%。
Motivation: 森林生物量估算依赖树木高度和物种等个体性状，但现有方法常需昂贵设备或人工测量。无人机搭载单RGB相机提供低成本方案，但缺乏标准化基准和统一方法。
Method: 构建BIRCH-Trees基准，包含三个无人机图像数据集。提出DINOvTree，采用VFM（如DINOv2）作为共享骨干，附加高度回归头和物种分类头，端到端训练。
Result: DINOvTree在高度预测和物种分类上取得最优综合性能，参数量仅为次优方法的54%-58%；同时对比了常见视觉方法和生物异速生长方程。
Conclusion: VFM骨干结合任务特定头可有效统一估计树木高度和物种，为大规模森林监测提供可扩展方法。局限性包括对树冠不规则形状和密集森林的适应性有待验证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Mecha-nudges for Machines
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are becoming active decision-makers on the Internet. As they make decisions in the same environments as humans, the environments themselves can change to influence them. We call this $\textit{mecha-nudging}$: changes to how choices are presented that systematically influence AI agents without materially degrading the decision environment for humans. To measure this phenomenon, we combine two frameworks -- Bayesian persuasion from economics and $\mathcal{V}$-usable information from computer science -- to get a common unit (bits) for quantifying how environments change across a wide range of interventions, contexts, and models. We apply this framework to over six million Etsy listings and find that, after ChatGPT's release, listings contain significantly more machine-usable information for predicting agent curation decisions, increasing by 0.143 bits out of a maximum possible increase of 0.355. This shift is robust across prompts, token choices, labeling models, and fine-tuning architectures; absent in a regulated-text placebo; and far larger than the effect of generic LLM rewriting. In contrast, a human study finds little to no change in human-usable information. Our results provide the first large-scale evidence that systematic mecha-nudging is already occurring in the wild, but going unnoticed.

papers.title: SeaAlert: Robust Severity Classification and LLM-Based Information Extraction for Noisy Maritime Distress Communications
papers.abstract_en: Maritime distress communications transmitted over very high frequency (VHF) radio are safety-critical voice messages used to report emergencies at sea. Under the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS), such messages follow standardized procedures and are expected to convey essential details, including vessel identity, position, nature of the distress, and required assistance. In practice, however, automatic analysis remains difficult because distress messages are often brief, noisy, and produced under stress, may deviate from the prescribed format, and are further degraded by automatic speech recognition (ASR) errors caused by channel noise and speaker stress. This paper presents SeaAlert, a controlled experimental framework for evaluating robust analysis of maritime distress communications using transformer-based severity classification and LLM-based structured extraction. To address the scarcity of labeled real-world data, we develop a synthetic data generation pipeline in which an LLM produces diverse maritime messages, including challenging variants in which standard distress codewords are omitted or replaced with less explicit expressions. The generated utterances are synthesized into speech, degraded with simulated VHF noise, and transcribed by an ASR system to obtain controlled noise-degraded transcripts. The resulting evaluation shows that transformer-based classification degrades more gracefully than lexical baselines under ASR noise and codeword masking, while LLM-based extraction is more effective than Regex-based extraction for noisy structured fields.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SeaAlert 框架，用于在嘈杂的海上遇险通信中实现鲁棒的严重性分类和结构化信息提取。通过合成数据管道生成多样化的遇险消息，并模拟 VHF 噪声和 ASR 错误，评估表明 Transformer 分类器比词汇基线更鲁棒，LLM 提取优于正则表达式方法。
Motivation: 海上遇险通信常因信道噪声、说话人紧张及 ASR 错误而难以自动分析，且缺乏标注真实数据。
Method: SeaAlert 框架结合 Transformer 分类器和 LLM 提取器，并设计合成数据生成管道：LLM 生成含变体的海事消息，经 TTS 合成、添加模拟 VHF 噪声、ASR 转录得到带噪文本。
Result: 在 ASR 噪声和代码词掩蔽下，Transformer 分类精度下降比词汇基线更平缓；LLM 对噪声结构化字段的提取准确率高于正则表达式基线。
Conclusion: 合成数据与 Transformer/LLM 结合可有效应对噪声海事通信的分析难题，为低资源场景提供可行性方案。

papers.title: The Truncation Blind Spot: How Decoding Strategies Systematically Exclude Human-Like Token Choices
papers.abstract_en: Standard decoding strategies for text generation, including top-$k$, nucleus sampling, and contrastive search, select tokens based on likelihood, restricting outputs to high-probability regions. In contrast, human language production prioritizes communicative appropriateness, allowing the use of contextually suitable but statistically rare tokens. This mismatch induces a \emph{truncation blind spot}, whereby such tokens remain accessible to humans but are systematically excluded by likelihood-based decoding. We investigate this phenomenon using over 1.8 million machine-generated texts from eight language models, including large proprietary systems (GPT-3.5-turbo, Claude-3-Haiku), across five decoding strategies and 53 hyperparameter settings, alongside 5,261 human-written references. We find that 8--18\% of human-selected tokens fall outside typical truncation boundaries. This exclusion is not random: content-bearing tokens are omitted at rates $2.9\times$ higher than grammatical function tokens. As a consequence, simple classifiers based on predictability and lexical diversity separate machine-generated from human-written text with mean AUC-ROC above 0.97. Detectability persists across model scales, architectures, and alignment procedures, and instead tracks the intensity of truncation. A classifier trained only on the oldest model in our study (GPT2-XL, 1.5B) detects outputs from substantially more recent and capable systems at near in-distribution accuracy, indicating that the detection signal is shared across generators rather than model-specific. These results indicate that detectability is a structural consequence of likelihood-based token selection rather than a limitation of model capability. We release code, datasets, and analysis at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/human_vs_machine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现标准文本生成解码策略（如 top-k、核采样、对比搜索）存在“截断盲区”，系统性地排除了人类常选的语境合适但统计罕见的 tokens。基于 8 个语言模型、5 种解码策略、53 种超参数设置下的 180 万条机器生成文本与 5261 条人工文本，发现 8-18% 的人类选择 tokens 位于典型截断边界之外，且内容词被排除率是语法功能词的 2.9 倍。基于可预测性和词汇多样性的简单分类器可高精度（AUC-ROC>0.97）区分机器与人类文本，且检测信号跨模型通用。
Motivation: 当前解码策略基于似然度选择 tokens，但人类语言生成优先考虑交际恰当性，可能使用统计罕见但语境合适的 tokens。这种不匹配导致机器文本存在系统性可检测特征，需探究其根源。
Method: 对多种语言模型（含 GPT-3.5-turbo、Claude-3-Haiku）采用五种解码策略和 53 种超参数生成文本，与人类写作对比，分析 tokens 落入截断边界的比例、内容词 vs 功能词的排除率，并训练基于可预测性和词汇多样性的分类器进行检测。
Result: 8-18% 的人类 tokens 被截断排除，内容词排除率是功能词的 2.9 倍；简单分类器 AUC-ROC>0.97；检测能力跨模型尺度、架构和对齐方式稳定，且仅用 GPT2-XL 训练的分类器即可检测更先进模型。
Conclusion: 机器文本的可检测性是似然度选择的固有结构后果，而非模型能力限制；分类器捕获的是跨生成器的共享信号。

papers.title: CABTO: Context-Aware Behavior Tree Grounding for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Behavior Trees (BTs) offer a powerful paradigm for designing modular and reactive robot controllers. BT planning, an emerging field, provides theoretical guarantees for the automated generation of reliable BTs. However, BT planning typically assumes that a well-designed BT system is already grounded -- comprising high-level action models and low-level control policies -- which often requires extensive expert knowledge and manual effort. In this paper, we formalize the BT Grounding problem: the automated construction of a complete and consistent BT system. We analyze its complexity and introduce CABTO (Context-Aware Behavior Tree grOunding), the first framework to efficiently solve this challenge. CABTO leverages pre-trained Large Models (LMs) to heuristically search the space of action models and control policies, guided by contextual feedback from BT planners and environmental observations. Experiments spanning seven task sets across three distinct robotic manipulation scenarios demonstrate CABTO's effectiveness and efficiency in generating complete and consistent behavior tree systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了行为树接地（BT Grounding）问题，即自动化构建完整且一致的行为树系统。作者提出CABTO（Context-Aware Behavior Tree grOunding）框架，利用预训练大语言模型（LMs）启发式搜索动作模型和控制策略，并通过BT规划器和环境观察的上下文反馈进行引导。在七个任务集、三个机器人操作场景上的实验验证了该框架的有效性和效率。
Motivation: 行为树规划通常假设已存在接地良好的行为树系统，但实际中动作模型和控制策略需要大量专家知识和人工构建，缺乏自动化方法。
Method: 提出CABTO框架，形式化BT接地问题，利用预训练LMs进行启发式搜索，结合来自BT规划器和环境观察的上下文反馈来指导动作模型和控制策略的生成。
Result: 在七个任务集、三个不同的机器人操作场景中，CABTO能够高效生成完整且一致的行为树系统。
Conclusion: CABTO是第一个有效解决BT接地问题的框架，展示了利用预训练LMs自动化构建行为树系统的潜力。

papers.title: Generative Inverse Design with Abstention via Diagonal Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Inverse design aims to find design parameters $x$ achieving target performance $y^*$. Generative approaches learn bidirectional mappings between designs and labels, enabling diverse solution sampling. However, standard conditional flow matching (CFM), when adapted to inverse problems by pairing labels with design parameters, exhibits strong sensitivity to their arbitrary ordering and scaling, leading to unstable training. We introduce Diagonal Flow Matching (Diag--CFM), which resolves this through a zero-anchoring strategy that pairs design coordinates with noise and labels with zero, making the learning problem provably invariant to coordinate permutations. This yields substantially lower round-trip error than CFM and invertible neural network baselines across design dimensions up to $P{=}784$, including order-of-magnitude gains on several benchmarks. We develop two architecture-intrinsic uncertainty metrics, Zero-Deviation and Self-Consistency, that enable three practical capabilities: selecting the best candidate among multiple generations, abstaining from unreliable predictions, and detecting out-of-distribution targets; consistently outperforming ensemble and general-purpose alternatives across all tasks. We validate on airfoil, gas turbine combustor, scalable analytical benchmarks, a photonics inverse-design task, and an image-statistics benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对角流匹配（Diag-CFM）方法，通过零锚定策略解决条件流匹配（CFM）在逆设计中对坐标顺序和缩放敏感的问题，显著降低往返误差。在翼型、燃气轮机燃烧室、光子学等逆设计任务上，Diag-CFM 优于 CFM 和可逆神经网络基线，并开发了两种不确定性指标以实现候选选择、弃权预测和分布外检测。
Motivation: 标准条件流匹配（CFM）在逆设计中因标签与设计参数的配对顺序和缩放任意性导致训练不稳定，需要一种坐标排列不变的生成方法。
Method: 提出对角流匹配（Diag-CFM），采用零锚定策略将设计坐标与噪声配对、标签与零配对，使学习问题对坐标排列不变。同时引入零偏差和自一致性两种不确定性指标。
Result: 在多达 P=784 维的设计空间上，Diag-CFM 相比 CFM 和可逆神经网络基线大幅降低往返误差，并在多个基准上取得数量级提升。不确定性指标在候选选择、弃权预测和分布外检测任务上持续优于集成和通用方法。
Conclusion: Diag-CFM 为逆设计提供了一种稳定且高效的生成方法，不确定性指标增强了实际部署的可靠性。论文在翼型、燃烧室、光子学等工程领域验证了有效性。

papers.title: Trust-Region Noise Search for Black-Box Alignment of Diffusion and Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing the noise samples of diffusion and flow models is an increasingly popular approach to align these models to target rewards at inference time. However, we observe that these approaches are usually restricted to differentiable or cheap reward models, the formulation of the underlying pretrained generative model, or are memory/compute inefficient. We instead propose a simple trust-region based search algorithm (TRS) which treats the pre-trained generative and reward models as a black-box and only optimizes the source noise. Our approach achieves a good balance between global exploration and local exploitation, and is versatile and easily adaptable to various generative settings and reward models with minimal hyperparameter tuning. We evaluate TRS across text-to-image, molecule and protein design tasks, and obtain significantly improved output samples over the base generative models and other inference-time alignment approaches which optimize the source noise sample, or even the entire reverse-time sampling noise trajectories in the case of diffusion models. Our source code is publicly available.
papers.comment: Preprint (shorter version accepted at ICLR ReaLM-GEN workshop)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于信任域搜索（Trust-Region Search, TRS）的推理时对齐方法，将扩散和流模型的噪声样本优化视为黑盒问题，仅优化源噪声而不依赖奖励模型的可微性。方法在文本到图像、分子和蛋白质设计任务上显著提升了生成样本质量，且超参数调整极少。
Motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法通常要求奖励模型可微或计算便宜，或需修改预训练生成模型，或内存/计算效率低。作者希望提出一种简单、通用、高效的黑盒对齐方法。
Method: 提出信任域搜索算法（TRS），将预训练的生成模型和奖励模型视为黑盒，仅优化初始噪声。通过信任域约束在全局探索与局部利用间取得平衡，支持多种生成设置和奖励模型。
Result: 在文本到图像、分子和蛋白质设计任务上，TRS生成的样本质量显著优于基础生成模型及其他推理时对齐方法（包括优化整个去噪轨迹的方法）。
Conclusion: TRS是一种简单、通用且高效的推理时对齐方法，适用于多种预训练生成模型和黑盒奖励函数，无需可微性假设，且超参数鲁棒。

papers.title: Human-like Object Grouping in Self-supervised Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models trained with self-supervised objectives achieve strong performance across diverse tasks and exhibit emergent object segmentation properties. However, their alignment with human object perception remains poorly understood. Here, we introduce a behavioral benchmark in which participants make same/different object judgments for dot pairs on naturalistic scenes, scaling up a classical psychophysics paradigm to over 1000 trials. We test a diverse set of vision models using a simple readout from their representations to predict subjects' reaction times. We observe a steady improvement across model generations, with both architecture and training objective contributing to alignment, and transformer-based models trained with the DINO self-supervised objective showing the strongest performance. To investigate the source of this improvement, we propose a novel metric to quantify the object-centric component of representations by measuring patch similarity within and between objects. Across models, stronger object-centric structure predicts human segmentation behavior more accurately. We further show that matching the Gram matrix of supervised transformer models, capturing similarity structure across image patches, with that of a self-supervised model through distillation improves their alignment with human behavior, converging with the prior finding that Gram anchoring improves DINOv3's feature quality. Together, these results demonstrate that self-supervised vision models capture object structure in a behaviorally human-like manner, and that Gram matrix structure plays a role in driving perceptual alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过行为实验和模型分析，研究自监督视觉Transformer（如DINO）在物体分组上与人类感知的对齐程度。结果表明，DINO训练的Transformer最能预测人类反应时，且表示中的物体中心成分与人类分割行为高度相关。通过Gram矩阵蒸馏对齐可进一步提升模型与人类行为的一致性。
Motivation: 现有自监督视觉基础模型虽展现出物体分割能力，但其与人类物体感知的对齐程度尚不明确，缺乏系统的行为比较。
Method: 构建一个超过1000次试验的点对同/异判断行为基准，通过模型表示的简单线性读出预测人类反应时；提出基于patch内/间相似度的物体中心成分度量；并通过Gram矩阵蒸馏使自监督模型与监督模型对齐。
Result: 模型代际间与人类对齐逐步提升，DINO自监督训练的Transformer表现最佳；物体中心结构能更准确预测人类分割行为；Gram矩阵对齐改善了模型与人类行为的匹配。
Conclusion: 自监督视觉模型能以类人方式捕捉物体结构，Gram矩阵结构是驱动感知对齐的关键因素。

papers.title: PRIMA: Pre-training with Risk-integrated Image-Metadata Alignment for Medical Diagnosis via LLM
papers.abstract_en: Medical diagnosis requires the effective synthesis of visual manifestations and clinical metadata. However, existing methods often treat metadata as isolated tags, failing to exploit the rich semantic knowledge embedded in clinical descriptions. We propose PRIMA (Pre-training with Risk-integrated Image-Metadata Alignment), a framework that integrates domain-specific knowledge into multi-modal representation learning. We first curate an expert corpus of risk--disease correlations via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to refine Clinical ModernBERT, embedding diagnostic priors into the text encoder. To bridge the modality gap, we introduce a dual-encoder pre-training strategy utilizing DINOv3 and our refined Clinical ModernBERT, optimized by a suite of four complementary loss functions. These losses are designed to capture multi-granular semantic alignment and handle the ambiguity of clinical correlations through soft labels. Finally, we leverage Qwen3 to fuse these aligned features for precise disease classification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PRIMA effectively harmonizes pixel-level features with abstract clinical expertise, consistently outperforming other state-of-the-art methods. Notably, our framework achieves strong performance without requiring massive data collection or exhaustive computational resources. Our code will is available at https://github.com/yqwang01/PRIMA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRIMA框架，通过检索增强生成（RAG）构建专家疾病风险语料库，优化Clinical ModernBERT文本编码器，并结合DINOv3图像编码器进行双编码器预训练，使用四种损失函数实现多粒度语义对齐，最后通过Qwen3融合特征进行疾病分类。实验表明PRIMA在医学诊断中优于现有方法，且无需大量数据或计算资源。
Motivation: 现有医学诊断方法常将临床元数据作为孤立标签，未能充分利用临床描述中的丰富语义知识，导致视觉特征与临床知识融合不足。
Method: 提出PRIMA框架，包括：1）通过RAG构建风险-疾病相关性专家语料库，微调Clinical ModernBERT；2）使用DINOv3和优化后的Clinical ModernBERT进行双编码器预训练，采用四种互补损失函数实现多粒度语义对齐和软标签处理；3）利用Qwen3大语言模型融合对齐特征进行疾病分类。
Result: 实验表明PRIMA有效协调像素级特征与抽象临床知识，在多个基准上一致优于最先进方法，且无需大规模数据或大量计算资源。
Conclusion: 摘要强调PRIMA通过引入领域知识到多模态表示学习中，实现了视觉与临床元数据的有效对齐，为医学诊断提供了一种高效、轻量的框架。

papers.title: ARLArena: A Unified Framework for Stable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (ARL) has rapidly gained attention as a promising paradigm for training agents to solve complex, multi-step interactive tasks. Despite encouraging early results, ARL remains highly unstable, often leading to training collapse. This instability limits scalability to larger environments and longer interaction horizons, and constrains systematic exploration of algorithmic design choices. In this paper, we first propose ARLArena, a stable training recipe and systematic analysis framework that examines training stability in a controlled and reproducible setting. ARLArena first constructs a clean and standardized testbed. Then, we decompose policy gradient into four core design dimensions and assess the performance and stability of each dimension. Through this fine-grained analysis, we distill a unified perspective on ARL and propose SAMPO, a stable agentic policy optimization method designed to mitigate the dominant sources of instability in ARL. Empirically, SAMPO achieves consistently stable training and strong performance across diverse agentic tasks. Overall, this study provides a unifying policy gradient perspective for ARL and offers practical guidance for building stable and reproducible LLM-based agent training pipelines.

papers.title: Inelastic Constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: A generalized framework for automated discovery of interpretable inelastic material models
papers.abstract_en: A key problem of solid mechanics is the identification of the constitutive law of a material, that is, the relation between strain history and stress. Machine learning has lead to considerable advances in this field lately. Here we introduce inelastic Constitutive Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (iCKANs). This novel artificial neural network architecture can discover in an automated manner symbolic constitutive laws describing both the elastic and inelastic behavior of materials. That is, it can translate data from material testing into corresponding elastic and inelastic potential functions in closed mathematical form. We demonstrate the advantages of iCKANs using both synthetic data and experimental data of the viscoelastic polymer materials VHB 4910 and VHB 4905. The results demonstrate that iCKANs accurately capture complex viscoelastic behavior while preserving physical interpretability. It is a particular strength of iCKANs that they can process not only mechanical data but also arbitrary additional information available about a material (e.g., about temperature-dependent behavior). This makes iCKANs a powerful tool to discover in the future also how specific processing or service conditions affect the properties of materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出非弹性本构Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（iCKANs），一种新型神经网络架构，能够自动化发现描述材料弹性和非弹性行为的符号本构定律，将材料测试数据转化为封闭数学形式的弹性和非弹性势函数。在合成数据和粘弹性聚合物VHB 4910/4905的实验数据上验证，iCKANs准确捕捉复杂粘弹性行为同时保持物理可解释性。该方法还能处理除力学数据外的任意附加信息（如温度依赖性），为发现加工或服役条件对材料性能影响提供工具。
Motivation: 固体力学关键问题之一是识别材料的本构定律，机器学习带来了显著进展，但现有方法可能缺乏自动发现符号形式可解释本构模型的能力。
Method: 提出iCKANs，基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的架构，自动学习弹性和非弹性势函数的封闭符号表达式，可融合力学数据以外的其他信息。
Result: 在合成数据和VHB 4910/4905粘弹性聚合物实验数据上，iCKANs准确捕获复杂粘弹性行为，同时保持物理可解释性。
Conclusion: iCKANs能够从数据中自动发现可解释的非弹性本构模型，并能整合附加信息，有望揭示加工或服役条件对材料性能的影响。

papers.title: Framework of Thoughts: A Foundation Framework for Dynamic and Optimized Reasoning based on Chains, Trees, and Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Prompting schemes such as Chain of Thought, Tree of Thoughts, and Graph of Thoughts can significantly enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, most existing schemes require users to define static, problem-specific reasoning structures that lack adaptability to dynamic or unseen problem types. Additionally, these schemes are often under-optimized in terms of hyperparameters, prompts, runtime, and prompting cost. To address these limitations, we introduce Framework of Thoughts (FoT)--a general-purpose foundation framework for building and optimizing dynamic reasoning schemes. FoT comes with built-in features for hyperparameter tuning, prompt optimization, parallel execution, and intelligent caching, unlocking the latent performance potential of reasoning schemes. We demonstrate FoT's capabilities by implementing three popular schemes--Tree of Thoughts, Graph of Thoughts, and ProbTree--within FoT. We empirically show that FoT enables significantly faster execution, reduces costs, and achieves better task scores through optimization. We release our codebase to facilitate the development of future dynamic and efficient reasoning schemes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Framework of Thoughts (FoT)，一个用于构建和优化动态推理方案的通用基础框架，支持超参数调优、提示优化、并行执行和智能缓存。通过实现 Tree of Thoughts、Graph of Thoughts 和 ProbTree 三种方案，实验表明 FoT 能显著加快执行速度、降低成本并通过优化获得更好的任务得分。
Motivation: 现有提示方案（如 Chain of Thought、Tree of Thoughts、Graph of Thoughts）需要用户定义静态、特定于问题的推理结构，缺乏对动态或未见问题类型的适应性，且超参数、提示、运行时间和成本方面未充分优化。
Method: FoT 是一个通用基础框架，内置超参数调优、提示优化、并行执行和智能缓存功能，通过实现多种推理方案（ToT、GoT、ProbTree）展示其能力。
Result: 实验表明 FoT 能显著加快执行速度、降低推理成本，并通过优化提高任务得分。
Conclusion: FoT 为开发动态高效的推理方案提供了基础框架，代码已开源。

papers.title: DynamiQ: Accelerating Gradient Synchronization using Compressed Multi-hop All-reduce
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop all-reduce is the de facto backbone of large model training. As the training scale increases, the network often becomes a bottleneck, motivating the reduction of the volume of transmitted data. Accordingly, recent systems have demonstrated significant acceleration of the training process using gradient quantization. However, these systems are not optimized for multi-hop aggregation, where entries are partially summed multiple times along their aggregation topology. We present DynamiQ, a quantization framework that bridges the gap between quantization best practices and multi-hop aggregation. DynamiQ introduces novel techniques to better represent partial sums, codesigned with a decompress accumulate recompress fused kernel to facilitate fast execution. We extend PyTorch DDP to support DynamiQ over NCCL P2P, and across different LLMs, tasks, and scales, we demonstrate consistent improvement of up to 34.2% over the best among state-of-the-art methods such as Omni-Reduce, THC, and emerging standards such as MXFP4, MXFP6, and MXFP8. Further, DynamiQ is the only evaluated method that consistently reaches near-baseline accuracy (e.g., 99.9\% of the BF16 baseline) and does so while significantly accelerating the training.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 19 figures. Accepted paper at SIGCOMM '26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DynamiQ，一种面向多跳all-reduce的梯度量化框架，通过改进部分和的表示与融合内核加速大型模型训练。在多种LLM和任务上相比现有方法（如Omni-Reduce、MXFP4等）提升最高34.2%，且能保持接近BF16基线的精度。
Motivation: 现有梯度量化系统未针对多跳聚合优化，导致部分和多次求和时表示效率低，网络成为训练瓶颈。
Method: 提出DynamiQ量化框架，包含新型部分和表示方法与解压-累加-再压缩融合内核，基于PyTorch DDP和NCCL P2P实现。
Result: 与Omni-Reduce、THC及MXFP标准相比，加速最高34.2%；在所有评估方法中唯一持续达到接近BF16基线精度（99.9%）。
Conclusion: DynamiQ填补了量化最佳实践与多跳聚合之间的鸿沟，在大规模训练中兼顾加速与精度。

papers.title: Scalable Dexterous Robot Learning with AR-based Remote Human-Robot Interactions
papers.abstract_en: This paper focuses on the scalable robot learning for manipulation in the dexterous robot arm-hand systems, where the remote human-robot interactions via augmented reality (AR) are established to collect the expert demonstration data for improving efficiency. In such a system, we present a novel method to address the general manipulation task problem. Specifically, the proposed method consists of two phases: i) In the first phase for pretraining, the policy is created in a behavior cloning (BC) manner, through leveraging the learning data from our AR-based remote human-robot interaction system; ii) In the second phase, a contrastive learning empowered reinforcement learning (RL) method is developed to obtain more efficient and robust policy than the BC, and thus a projection head is designed to accelerate the learning progress. An event-driven augmented reward is adopted for enhancing the safety. To validate the proposed method, both the physics simulations via PyBullet and real-world experiments are carried out. The results demonstrate that compared to the baselines, our method not only significantly speeds up the training process, but also achieves much better performance in terms of the success rate for fulfilling the manipulation tasks. By conducting the ablation study, it is confirmed that the proposed RL with contrastive learning overcomes policy collapse. Supplementary demonstrations are available at https://cyberyyc.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于增强现实（AR）远程人机交互的可扩展灵巧机器人学习方法，用于机械臂-手系统的操作任务。方法分为两阶段：第一阶段通过AR系统采集专家演示数据，进行行为克隆（BC）预训练；第二阶段采用对比学习增强的强化学习（RL）方法，并引入事件驱动增强奖励以提高安全性和效率。在PyBullet物理仿真和真实世界实验中，该方法相比基线显著加速训练并提高任务成功率，消融实验验证了对比学习RL能避免策略崩溃。
Motivation: 灵巧机器人操作任务中，获取大规模专家演示数据成本高、效率低，现有方法在可扩展性和性能上存在不足。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：第一阶段基于AR远程人机交互系统收集演示数据，进行行为克隆预训练；第二阶段采用对比学习增强的强化学习，设计投影头加速学习，并采用事件驱动增强奖励提升安全性。
Result: 在PyBullet物理仿真和真实世界实验中，该方法相比基线显著加速训练过程，并在操作任务成功率上取得更优性能；消融实验证实对比学习RL能防止策略崩溃。
Conclusion: AR远程交互与对比学习增强RL的结合为灵巧机器人操作提供了一种可扩展且高效的学习范式，但摘要未明确讨论泛化性、长期任务等局限性。

papers.title: Implementing Grassroots Logic Programs with Multiagent Transition Systems and AI (Full Version)
papers.abstract_en: Grassroots Logic Programs (GLP) is a concurrent logic programming language in which logic variables are partitioned into paired readers and writers. An assignment is produced at most once via a writer and consumed at most once via its paired reader, and may contain additional readers and/or writers. This enables the concise expression of rich multidirectional communication modalities. The language was introduced together with concurrent (cGLP) and multiagent (maGLP) operational semantics. Here, we derive from these (\ia)~dGLP, a deterministic counterpart of cGLP, and (\ib)~madGLP, a counterpart of maGLP in which deterministic agents communicate solely by asynchronous message passing, and prove them correct against their abstract counterparts. maGLP shared variable pairs spanning agents can be implemented as local variables paired by \emph{global links}, with correctness following from disjoint substitution commutativity (a consequence of GLP's single-occurrence invariant). We further prove that madGLP is grassroots. Both dGLP and madGLP serve as formal specifications for an AI-driven implementation discipline (math $\to$ informal spec $\to$ Dart) employed and described here: from dGLP, AI (Claude) developed a workstation-based GLP implementation in Dart, and from madGLP it is developing a smartphone-based multiagent one.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从Grassroots Logic Programs（GLP）的并发语义出发，推导出确定性变体dGLP和多agent确定性变体madGLP，并证明其正确性。同时展示了一种由形式化规范（dGLP/madGLP）到AI（Claude）生成Dart实现的工作流程。
Motivation: 需要为GLP提供确定的、可实现的语义规范，以支持高效的AI驱动实现和分布式系统开发。
Method: 从GLP的并发操作语义中提取确定性版本dGLP和确定性多agent版本madGLP，利用全局链接实现跨agent变量共享，并通过不相交替换交换性证明正确性。
Result: 证明了madGLP具有grassroots性质；利用AI（Claude）从dGLP自动生成了Dart工作站实现，并正在基于madGLP开发智能手机多agent实现。
Conclusion: dGLP和madGLP可作为形式化规范，支持从数学定义到非形式规格说明再到实际代码的AI驱动实现路线。

papers.title: SHINE: A Scalable In-Context Hypernetwork for Mapping Context to LoRA in a Single Pass
papers.abstract_en: We propose SHINE (Scalable Hyper In-context NEtwork), a scalable hypernetwork that can map diverse meaningful contexts into high-quality LoRA adapters for large language models (LLMs). By reusing the frozen LLM's own parameters in an in-context hypernetwork design and introducing architectural innovations, SHINE overcomes key limitations of prior hypernetworks and achieves strong expressive power with a relatively small number of parameters. We introduce a pretraining and instruction fine-tuning pipeline, and train our hypernetwork to generate high quality LoRA adapters from diverse meaningful contexts in a single forward pass. It updates LLM parameters without any fine-tuning, and immediately enables complex question answering tasks related to the context without directly accessing the context, effectively transforming in-context knowledge to in-parameter knowledge in one pass. Our work achieves outstanding results on various tasks, greatly saves time, computation and memory costs compared to SFT-based LLM adaptation, and shows great potential for scaling. Our code is available at https://github.com/MuLabPKU/SHINE

papers.title: Multi-Way Representation Alignment
papers.abstract_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that independently trained neural networks converge to increasingly similar latent spaces. However, current strategies for mapping these representations are inherently pairwise, scaling quadratically with the number of models and failing to yield a consistent global reference. In this paper, we study the alignment of $M \ge 3$ models. We first adapt Generalized Procrustes Analysis (GPA) to construct a shared orthogonal universe that preserves the internal geometry essential for tasks like model stitching. We then show that strict isometric alignment is suboptimal for retrieval, where agreement-maximizing methods like Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) typically prevail. To bridge this gap, we finally propose Geometry-Corrected Procrustes Alignment (GCPA), which establishes a robust GPA-based universe followed by a post-hoc correction for directional mismatch. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GCPA consistently improves any-to-any retrieval while retaining a practical shared reference space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究M≥3个模型的表示对齐问题。首先将广义Procrustes分析（GPA）扩展到构建共享正交空间以保持内部几何结构；然后指出严格等距对齐对于检索任务次优，而最大化一致性的方法（如CCA）通常更优；最后提出几何校正Procrustes对齐（GCPA），建立基于GPA的空间后进行方向不匹配的后验校正。实验表明GCPA在保持共享参考空间的同时，持续改进任意到任意的检索性能。
Motivation: 现有表示对齐策略本质上是成对的，随模型数量二次缩放，且无法产生一致的全局参考。本文旨在解决多模型表示对齐问题。
Method: 首先将广义Procrustes分析（GPA）扩展到M≥3个模型，构建共享正交空间；然后指出严格等距对齐的局限性；最后提出几何校正Procrustes对齐（GCPA），包括基于GPA的空间建立和后验方向校正。
Result: 实验表明GCPA在保持共享参考空间的同时，持续改进任意到任意的检索性能。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调结论或局限性，但GCPA方法在检索任务上优于严格等距对齐，同时提供实用的共享参考空间。

papers.title: A Random Matrix Theory Perspective on the Consistency of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models trained on different, non-overlapping subsets of a dataset often produce strikingly similar outputs when given the same noise seed. We trace this consistency to a simple linear effect: the shared Gaussian statistics across splits already predict much of the generated images. To formalize this, we develop a random matrix theory (RMT) framework that quantifies how finite datasets shape the expectation and variance of the learned denoiser and sampling map in the linear setting. For expectations, sampling variability acts as a renormalization of the noise level through a self-consistent relation $σ^2 \mapsto κ(σ^2)$, explaining why limited data overshrink low-variance directions and pull samples toward the dataset mean. For fluctuations, our variance formulas reveal three key factors behind cross-split disagreement: \textit{anisotropy} across eigenmodes, \textit{inhomogeneity} across inputs, and overall scaling with dataset size. Extending deterministic-equivalence tools to fractional matrix powers further allows us to analyze entire sampling trajectories. The theory sharply predicts the behavior of linear diffusion models, and we validate its predictions on UNet and DiT architectures in their non-memorization regime, identifying where and how samples deviates across training data split. This provides a principled baseline for reproducibility in diffusion training, linking spectral properties of data to the stability of generative outputs.
papers.comment: 58 pages, 45 figures. Accepted as an Oral Presentation at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从随机矩阵理论（RMT）角度解释扩散模型在不同数据子集上训练后输出一致性的线性机制。作者发现输出相似性可归因于子集间共享的高斯统计量，并建立了量化有限数据集对线性去噪器和采样图期望与方差影响的理论框架。该理论预测了有限数据导致的低方差方向过收缩和样本向均值偏移，以及跨分裂不一致的各向异性、不均匀性和数据集规模依赖性。在UNet和DiT架构的非记忆化区域验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 扩散模型在不同非重叠数据子集上训练后，相同噪声种子常产生惊人相似的输出，这一现象缺乏理论解释。
Method: 提出随机矩阵理论框架，通过自我一致关系将采样噪声重新归一化，并利用分数矩阵幂的确定性等价工具分析整个采样轨迹，量化有限数据集对去噪器和采样图的影响。
Result: 理论预测了线性扩散模型的行为：方差公式揭示跨分裂不一致的三个因素（各向异性、输入不均匀性、数据集规模缩放），并在UNet和DiT的非记忆化区域得到验证。
Conclusion: 该理论为扩散模型训练的可重复性提供了基于数据谱性质的原理性基线，链接了数据谱属性与生成输出的稳定性。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Learning from Structural Invariance
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning (SSL), the key paradigm for unsupervised representation learning from visual data, learns from invariances between semantically-related data pairs. We study the one-to-many mapping problem in SSL, where each datum may be mapped to multiple valid targets. This arises when data pairs come from naturally occurring generative processes, e.g., successive video frames. We show that existing methods struggle to flexibly capture this conditional uncertainty. As a remedy, we introduce a latent variable to account for this uncertainty and derive a variational lower bound on the mutual information between paired embeddings. Our derivation yields a simple regularization term for standard SSL objectives. The resulting method, which we call AdaSSL, applies to both contrastive and distillation-based SSL objectives, and we empirically show its versatility in causal representation learning, fine-grained image understanding, and world modeling on videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自监督学习中一对多映射（如连续视频帧）引起的条件不确定性，引入潜变量建模，推导互信息变分下界，得到简单正则项AdaSSL。该方法可应用于对比式和蒸馏式自监督学习目标，并在因果表示学习、细粒度图像理解和视频世界建模等任务上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有自监督学习方法难以灵活处理数据对中的条件不确定性（一对多映射），例如自然生成过程（如连续帧）导致一个输入对应多个有效目标。
Method: 引入潜变量捕捉条件不确定性，通过变分下界推导出通用正则项AdaSSL，该正则项可直接添加到对比或蒸馏自监督学习目标中。
Result: 在因果表示学习、细粒度图像理解和视频世界建模任务中，AdaSSL提升了表示质量，展示了其通用性和有效性。
Conclusion: AdaSSL提供了一种简单且通用的正则化方法，增强了自监督学习处理一对多映射的能力，适用于多种SSL框架。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Spectral Gradient Descent Mitigates Anisotropy-Driven Misalignment: A Case Study in Phase Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Spectral gradient methods, such as the Muon optimizer, modify gradient updates by preserving directional information while discarding scale, and have shown strong empirical performance in deep learning. We investigate the mechanisms underlying these gains through a dynamical analysis of a nonlinear phase retrieval model with anisotropic Gaussian inputs, equivalent to training a two-layer neural network with the quadratic activation and fixed second-layer weights. Focusing on a spiked covariance setting where the dominant variance direction is orthogonal to the signal, we show that gradient descent (GD) suffers from a variance-induced misalignment: during the early escaping stage, the high-variance but uninformative spike direction is multiplicatively amplified, degrading alignment with the true signal under strong anisotropy. In contrast, spectral gradient descent (SpecGD) removes this spike amplification effect, leading to stable alignment and accelerated noise contraction. Numerical experiments confirm the theory and show that these phenomena persist under broader anisotropic covariances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过非线性相位恢复模型的动力学分析，研究谱梯度方法（如Muon优化器）在深度学习中有效性的机制。在尖峰协方差设置下，梯度下降（GD）因各向异性而遭受方差驱动的错位，而谱梯度下降（SpecGD）消除了这种尖峰放大效应，实现稳定对齐和加速噪声收缩。数值实验证实理论并显示该现象在更广泛的各向异性协方差下持续存在。
Motivation: 谱梯度方法在深度学习中表现优异，但其背后的机制尚不明确。本文旨在通过一个简化的相位恢复模型，理论分析GD与SpecGD在强各向异性输入下的动力学差异，解释SpecGD的优势来源。
Method: 采用一个非线性相位恢复模型（等价于两层神经网络，激活函数为二次型，第二层权重固定），输入为各向异性高斯分布，且协方差具有尖峰结构（主方差方向与信号正交）。对比标准梯度下降（GD）与谱梯度下降（SpecGD）在早期逃逸阶段的动力学行为。
Result: 理论上证明：GD在强各向异性下会放大高方差但无信息的尖峰方向，导致与真实信号的错位；而SpecGD移除尖峰放大效应，保持稳定对齐并加速噪声收缩。数值实验验证了理论预测，并在更宽的各向异性协方差下观察到类似现象。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了谱梯度方法通过消除各向异性驱动的错位来改善训练动力学，为理解Muon等优化器的成功提供了理论基础。局限在于分析基于简化模型，尚需扩展到更一般的网络结构和数据分布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: It's all In the (Exponential) Family: An Equivalence between Maximum Likelihood Estimation and Control Variates for Sketching Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Maximum likelihood estimators (MLE) and control variate estimators (CVE) have been used in conjunction with known information across sketching algorithms and applications in machine learning. We prove that under certain conditions in an exponential family, an optimal CVE will achieve the same asymptotic variance as the MLE, giving a fixed point algorithm for the MLE. Experiments show the fixed point algorithm is faster and numerically stable compared to other root finding algorithms for the MLE for the bivariate Normal distribution, and we expect this to hold across distributions satisfying these conditions. We show how this algorithm leads to reproducibility for algorithms using MLE / CVE, and demonstrate how the algorithm leads to finding the MLE when the CV weights are known.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明在指数族分布的某些条件下，最优控制变量估计（CVE）与极大似然估计（MLE）具有相同的渐近方差，从而为MLE提供了一个不动点算法。实验表明，该算法在双变量正态分布上比其它求根算法更快且数值更稳定，并有望推广到满足条件的其他分布。
Motivation: 草图算法中常结合使用MLE和CVE，但二者之间的理论联系尚不清晰，缺乏统一的优化框架。
Method: 在指数族框架下证明最优CVE与MLE的渐近等价性，并据此提出一个不动点算法来求解MLE。
Result: 在双变量正态分布实验中，不动点算法比标准求根算法（如牛顿法）更快、数值稳定性更好。
Conclusion: 该算法可提升基于MLE/CVE的草图算法的可复现性，并在已知控制变量权重时直接获得MLE。

papers.title: Phi-SegNet: Phase-Integrated Supervision for Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has substantially advanced medical image segmentation, yet achieving robust generalization across diverse imaging modalities and anatomical structures remains a major challenge. A key contributor to this limitation lies in how existing architectures, ranging from CNNs to Transformers and their hybrids, primarily encode spatial information while overlooking frequency-domain representations that capture rich structural and textural cues. Although recent studies have begun exploring spectral information at the feature level, supervision-level integration of frequency cues-crucial for fine-grained object localization-remains largely untapped. To this end, we propose Phi-SegNet, a CNN-based architecture that incorporates phase-aware information at both architectural and optimization levels. The network integrates Bi-Feature Mask Former (BFMF) modules that blend neighboring encoder features to reduce semantic gaps, and Reverse Fourier Attention (RFA) blocks that refine decoder outputs using phase-regularized features. A dedicated phase-aware loss aligns these features with structural priors, forming a closed feedback loop that emphasizes boundary precision. Evaluated on five public datasets spanning X-ray, US, histopathology, MRI, and colonoscopy, Phi-SegNet consistently achieved state-of-the-art performance, with an average relative improvement of 1.54+/-1.26% in IoU and 0.98+/-0.71% in F1-score over the next best-performing model. In cross-dataset generalization scenarios involving unseen datasets from the known domain, it also exhibits robust and superior performance, highlighting its adaptability and modality-agnostic design. These findings demonstrate the potential of leveraging spectral priors in both feature representation and supervision, paving the way for generalized segmentation frameworks that excel in fine-grained object localization. Our code is available on GitHub.

Conclusion: 展示了在特征表示和监督中利用频谱先验的潜力，为细粒度目标定位的通用分割框架铺平道路。

papers.title: ARCQuant: Boosting NVFP4 Quantization with Augmented Residual Channels for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of fine-grained numerical formats like NVFP4 presents new opportunities for efficient Large Language Model (LLM) inference. However, it is difficult to adapt existing Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) strategies to these formats: rotation-based methods compromise fine-grained block isolation; smoothing techniques struggle with significant 4-bit quantization errors; and mixed-precision approaches often conflict with hardware constraints on unified-precision computation. To address these challenges, we propose ARCQuant, a framework that boosts NVFP4 performance via Augmented Residual Channels. Distinct from methods that compromise block isolation or hardware uniformity, ARCQuant maintains a strictly unified NVFP4 format by augmenting the activation matrix with quantized residual channels. This design integrates the error compensation process directly into the matrix reduction dimension, enabling the use of standard, highly optimized GEMM kernels with minimal overhead. Theoretical analysis confirms that the worst-case error bound of our dual-stage NVFP4 quantization is comparable to that of standard 8-bit formats such as MXFP8. Extensive experiments on LLaMA and Qwen models demonstrate that ARCQuant achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, comparable to full-precision baselines in perplexity and downstream tasks. Furthermore, deployment on RTX 5090 and RTX PRO 6000 GPUs confirms practical benefits, achieving up to 3x speedup over FP16. Our code is available at https://github.com/actypedef/ARCQuant.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers), pages 8609-8623, San Diego, California, United States, July 2026. Association for Computational Linguistics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对NVFP4细粒度数值格式在LLM后训练量化（PTQ）中面临的挑战，提出ARCQuant框架。该框架通过增强残差通道（Augmented Residual Channels）在激活矩阵上添加量化残差通道，将误差补偿整合到矩阵归约维度，从而保持严格统一的NVFP4格式，兼容标准GEMM内核。理论分析表明其双阶段NVFP4量化的最坏误差界与MXFP8等8位格式相当。在LLaMA和Qwen模型上的实验达到与全精度基线可比的困惑度和下游任务精度，在RTX 5090和RTX PRO 6000 GPU上实现最高3倍于FP16的加速。
Motivation: 现有PTQ策略难以适应NVFP4格式：旋转方法破坏细粒度块隔离，平滑技术难以处理4位量化误差，混合精度方法常与硬件统一精度计算冲突。
Method: 提出ARCQuant框架，通过向激活矩阵添加量化残差通道，将误差补偿过程直接整合到矩阵归约维度，维持严格的统一NVFP4格式，允许使用标准优化GEMM内核。
Result: 在LLaMA和Qwen模型上达到SOTA精度，困惑度和下游任务性能与全精度基线相当；在RTX 5090和RTX PRO 6000上实现最高3倍于FP16的推理加速。
Conclusion: 理论分析表明双阶段NVFP4量化的最坏误差界与MXFP8相当，实际部署验证了精度与效率的平衡。

papers.title: GMODiff: One-Step Gain Map Refinement with Diffusion Priors for HDR Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) have recently shown strong perceptual priors for low-level vision tasks, making them a promising direction for multi-exposure High Dynamic Range (HDR) reconstruction. However, directly applying LDMs to HDR remains challenging due to: (1) limited dynamic-range representation caused by 8-bit latent compression, (2) high inference cost from multi-step denoising, and (3) content hallucination inherent to their generative nature. To address these challenges, we introduce GMODiff, a gain map-driven one-step diffusion framework for multi-exposure HDR reconstruction. Instead of reconstructing full HDR content, we reformulate HDR reconstruction as a degradation-aware Gain Map (GM) refinement problem, where the GM encodes the extended dynamic range while retaining the same bit depth as LDR images. We initialize the denoising process from an informative regression-based estimate rather than pure noise, allowing the model to generate high-quality GMs in a single denoising step. Furthermore, recognizing that regression-based models excel in content fidelity while LDMs favor perceptual quality, we leverage regression priors to guide both the denoising process and latent decoding of the LDM, suppressing hallucinations while preserving structural accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GMODiff performs favorably against several state-of-the-art methods and is 100x faster than previous LDM-based methods. Code is available at https://github.com/gbymat/GMODiff.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GMODiff，一种基于扩散先验的单步增益图细化框架，用于多曝光高动态范围（HDR）重建。通过将 HDR 重建重新表述为退化感知的增益图（Gain Map）细化问题，并利用回归先验引导去噪过程和潜在解码，实现单步高质量生成的同时抑制幻觉。实验表明，该方法在性能上优于现有方法，且比之前的 LDM 方法快 100 倍。
Motivation: 直接将潜在扩散模型（LDM）应用于 HDR 重建面临三个挑战：8-bit 潜在压缩导致的动态范围受限、多步去噪的高推理成本以及生成模型固有的内容幻觉问题。本文旨在解决这些问题。
Method: 提出 GMODiff 框架，将 HDR 重建转化为退化感知的增益图（Gain Map）细化问题。从信息丰富的回归估计而非纯噪声初始化去噪过程，实现单步生成。利用回归先验引导 LDM 的去噪和潜在解码，抑制幻觉。
Result: 实验表明 GMODiff 在多个指标上优于现有方法，且速度比之前的 LDM 方法快 100 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了通过重新定义任务和利用回归先验，实现了单步、高质量且高效的 HDR 重建。未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: IRG-MotionLLM: Interleaving Motion Generation, Assessment and Refinement for Text-to-Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in motion-aware large language models have shown remarkable promise for jointly learning motion understanding and generation knowledge. However, these models typically treat understanding and generation separately, limiting the mutual benefits that could arise from interactive feedback between tasks. In this work, we reveal that motion assessment and refinement tasks can act as crucial bridges to enable knowledge flow from motion understanding to generation. Specifically, we propose Interleaved Reasoning for Motion Generation (IRMoGen), a novel paradigm that tightly couples motion generation with assessment and refinement through iterative text-motion dialogue. To realize this, we introduce IRG-MotionLLM, the first model that seamlessly interleaves motion generation, assessment, and refinement to improve the alignment between generated motion and goal text. IRG-MotionLLM is developed progressively with a novel three-stage training scheme, initializing and subsequently enhancing native IRMoGen capabilities. To facilitate this development, we construct an automated data engine to synthesize interleaved reasoning annotations from existing text-motion datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate the properties brought by IRMoGen training, and the advanced cross-benchmark and cross-evaluator performance of IRG-MotionLLM. Code and models are available at https://github.com/HumanMLLM/IRG-MotionLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的交互式推理范式IRMoGen，将文本驱动的运动生成与运动评估、精炼任务通过迭代文本-运动对话紧密耦合，以提升生成运动与目标文本的对齐质量。作者构建了IRG-MotionLLM模型，采用三阶段训练方案逐步增强该能力，并利用自动数据引擎从现有数据集中合成交互式推理注释。实验表明，该模型在跨基准和跨评估器上取得先进性能。
Motivation: 现有运动感知大语言模型通常将运动理解与生成分离，限制了任务间通过交互反馈带来的相互增益。作者发现运动评估与精炼任务可作为桥梁，促进从理解到生成的知识流动。
Method: 提出IRMoGen范式，通过迭代文本-运动对话耦合运动生成、评估与精炼；构建IRG-MotionLLM模型，采用三阶段训练方案逐步初始化并增强原生IRMoGen能力；设计自动数据引擎从现有文本-运动数据集中合成交互式推理注释。
Result: 实验证明了IRMoGen训练带来的特性，并在跨基准和跨评估器上展示了IRG-MotionLLM的先进性能。
Conclusion: 交互式推理范式能有效提升文本到运动生成的对齐质量，且模型具备良好的泛化能力。代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: KAN vs LSTM Performance in Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a controlled comparison of baseline Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), implemented via PyKAN, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for the forecasting of stochastic, non-stationary financial time series. The two architectures are assessed in terms of predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability, with accuracy measured by the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) in normalised feature space. Under a direct multi-output forecasting protocol, LSTM attains clearly superior accuracy across all tested prediction horizons, consistent with its well-established effectiveness for sequential data modelling. Baseline KAN, although offering theoretical interpretability through the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem, exhibits substantially higher error rates and limited practical applicability for time series forecasting in its standard form. Several specialised temporal variants -- including Temporal KAN and Time-Frequency KAN -- have since been proposed to address these sequential modelling limitations, but they lie outside the scope of the present study. KAN is observed to converge faster during training under the configurations tested, although direct runtime comparisons are constrained by methodological factors. These findings support the adoption of LSTM for accuracy-critical financial forecasting and establish an empirical baseline for standard KAN on stochastic sequential data, motivating further investigation of temporally-aware KAN architectures. The study benchmarks baseline KAN against baseline LSTM only; the results do not extend to specialised KAN variants designed for sequential data, nor to the broader family of temporal models.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 9 figures. v2: substantially revised manuscript -- corrected description of the direct multi-output forecasting protocol, added parameter-count analysis and methodological-asymmetry discussion, disclosed data-scaling limitation, and expanded literature review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对基线KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks）与LSTM在非平稳随机金融时间序列预测上进行了受控比较。在直接多输出预测协议下，LSTM在所有预测时域上均取得明显更优的均方根误差（RMSE），而基线KAN虽然具有理论可解释性，但误差显著更高，实用性有限。研究结果支持在精度要求高的金融预测中使用LSTM，并为标准KAN在随机序列数据上的表现建立了基准。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对KAN和LSTM在金融时间序列预测上的公平对比，尤其缺乏对基线KAN（未针对序列建模优化的版本）的实证评估。
Method: 采用直接多输出（direct multi-output）预测协议，在归一化特征空间中用RMSE衡量预测精度，对比PyKAN实现的基线KAN与LSTM。
Result: LSTM在所有预测时域上精度显著优于基线KAN；基线KAN训练收敛更快，但运行时对比受方法学因素限制。
Conclusion: 对于精度关键的金融预测，LSTM仍是更可靠的选择；基线KAN在标准形式下对时间序列预测实用性有限，需依赖专门的时间变体（如Temporal KAN）来提升序列建模能力。

papers.title: Feature weighting for data analysis via evolutionary simulation
papers.abstract_en: We analyze an algorithm for assigning weights prior to scalarization in discrete multi-objective problems arising from data analysis. The algorithm evolves weights (interpreted as the relevance of features) by a replicator-type dynamic on the standard simplex, with update indices computed from a normalized data matrix. We prove that the resulting sequence converges globally to a unique interior equilibrium, yielding non-degenerate limiting weights.

papers.title: QiVC-Net: Quantum-Inspired Variational Convolutional Network, with Application to Biosignal Classification
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, a learning framework is introduced which incorporates principles of probabilistic inference, variational optimization, and geometry-preserving operations inspired by quantum transformations. The central innovation of this quantum-inspired variational convolution (QiVC) lies in its quantum-inspired rotated ensemble (QiRE) mechanism. QiRE performs differentiable low-dimensional subspace rotations of convolutional weights. By drawing a mathematical analogy from unitary evolution, this approach enables structured uncertainty modeling that respects the intrinsic geometry of the parameter space. To demonstrate its practical potential, the concept is instantiated in a QiVC-based convolutional network (QiVC-Net) and evaluated in the context of biosignal classification, focusing on phonocardiogram (PCG) recordings. The proposed QiVC-Net integrates an architecture in which the QiVC layer does not introduce additional parameters, instead performing an ensemble rotation of the convolutional weights through a structured mechanism ensuring robustness without added highly computational burden. Experiments on two benchmark datasets, PhysioNet CinC 2016 and PhysioNet CirCor DigiScope 2022, show that QiVC-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching accuracies of 97.84% and 97.89%, respectively. These findings highlight the versatility of the QiVC framework and its promise for advancing uncertainty-aware modeling in real-world biomedical signal analysis. The implementation of the QiVConv layer is available in GitHub for public use.
