papers.title: Probing Identity-Specific Motion Signatures: A Controlled Diagnostic Study
papers.abstract_en: Identity recognition (e.g., person, animal re-identification) has traditionally relied heavily on static appearance cues. Yet motion--consistent, individual-specific dynamics--can provide a complementary and potentially more robust signature, especially when appearance is weak or variable. This raises a fundamental question: when identity-specific motion cues are clearly present, to what extent do modern video models use them for recognition? To investigate this question, we conduct a systematic diagnostic study and introduce BALLER120, a controlled benchmark of 120 professional basketball players performing free-throws. By focusing on the same multi-phase action across individuals, BALLER120 reduces action-level variation and identity-correlated acquisition biases, enabling fine-grained analysis of identity-specific kinematic patterns. We find that modern video models can predict identity accurately from RGB videos, but often rely on static appearance cues such as faces and jersey regions, even when informative motion cues are available. Strikingly, when appearance is suppressed through silhouette-only or skeleton-only inputs, the same model architectures shift toward motion micro-patterns (e.g., foot placement and elbow bending). Despite containing less visual information, appearance-suppressed representations achieve competitive accuracy and stronger robustness to appearance shifts. Our qualitative analyses further show that appearance-suppressed models attend to distinctive motion patterns across individuals. Overall, our study demonstrates that identity-specific motion signatures are present, informative, and learnable, but modern video models may overlook them in favor of easier static shortcuts unless appearance cues are explicitly suppressed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BALLER120 基准，包含 120 名职业篮球运动员的罚球视频，用以系统诊断现代视频模型是否利用身份特定的运动特征进行识别。实验发现，模型在 RGB 视频中依赖静态外观（如面部和球衣区域），但使用轮廓或骨架输入抑制外观后，模型能够学习到脚部位置、肘部弯曲等运动微模式，并取得与外观信息相当甚至更鲁棒的效果。研究表明，身份运动特征存在且可学习，但模型在可获取外观时倾向于走捷径。
Motivation: 身份识别传统上依赖静态外观，但运动特征在可变外观下可能提供更鲁棒的信号。核心问题是：当身份特定运动信息明确存在时，现代视频模型是否真的利用它们？
Method: 通过构建 BALLER120 基准，控制动作类型（同一套罚球动作）和身份相关采集偏差，并设计外观抑制（仅用轮廓或骨架）实验，对比模型在 RGB 和抑制条件下的识别表现与注意力模式。
Result: 现代视频模型在 RGB 输入下主要依赖面部和球衣等外观线索；外观抑制后，模型转而关注脚部位置、肘部弯曲等运动微模式，精度虽有下降但仍具竞争力，且对外观变化（如换球衣）的鲁棒性更强。
Conclusion: 身份特定的运动特征是存在、可学习且有用的，但当前模型更容易利用静态外观捷径；显式抑制外观能让模型转向运动特征。

papers.title: Reflected Schrödinger Bridge Matching
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative modeling have enabled the efficient computation of Schrödinger bridges (SB) in high-dimensional settings by leveraging partially simulation-free training methods inspired by flow matching. However, these have not covered SBs with reflecting dynamics, a useful model choice with built-in guarantees that generated samples stay in the data domain. Existing alternatives for reflected SBs instead rely on more complex training based on forward--backward SDE theory, requiring expensive higher-order derivatives and sampling entire paths during training. In this article, we introduce a partially simulation-free framework that allows reflected SBs to be trained similarly to flow matching, using a new sampling method and regression target. We demonstrate our results by coupling pairs of well-known high-dimensional image datasets. Using reflected dynamics incurs negligible additional wall-clock time during both training and inference while maintaining or slightly improving generative performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出反射薛定谔桥匹配（Reflected Schrödinger Bridge Matching），一种部分免模拟训练框架，使得反射动力学下的薛定谔桥（Schrödinger bridge）能够像流匹配（flow matching）一样高效训练。通过引入新的采样方法和回归目标，该方法避免了传统反射SB所需的昂贵高阶导数和完整路径采样。实验表明，在高维图像数据集上，反射动力学仅增加可忽略的墙钟时间，同时生成性能持平或略有提升。
Motivation: 现有反射SB依赖于前向后向SDE理论，训练复杂度高，需要高阶导数和完整路径采样，效率低下。本文旨在设计一种更简洁、高效的训练方式，使反射SB具备流匹配的简便性。
Method: 提出部分免模拟训练框架，包含新的采样方法和回归目标，使反射SB的训练过程类似于流匹配，无需模拟完整路径或计算高阶导数。
Result: 在高维图像数据集上，反射动力学在训练和推理阶段仅引入可忽略的额外墙钟时间，生成性能与标准SB相当或略有改善。
Conclusion: 该框架简化了反射SB的训练，使其兼具反射动力学的域内保证和流匹配的计算效率，为生成模型提供了一种实用的新选择。

papers.title: RADIO1D: Elastic Representations for Condensed Vision Modeling
papers.abstract_en: This paper challenges the assumption that vision-language models (VLMs) require fixed patch-based 2D vision features. Analyzing fine-tuned vision encoders, we find that representations become increasingly abstract and less spatially coherent during VLM training. Notably, models trained with image-text alignment (such as SigLIP2) develop a small number of specialized tokens that effectively summarize global image content. Building on this, we introduce RADIO1D, which compresses images into a compact, variable-length 1D token sequence using multi-teacher knowledge distillation and an autoencoder design. The resulting representations exhibit strong hierarchical summarization, enabling accurate scene understanding - even with a single token - and support improved composition-aware image retrieval. In VLMs, RADIO1D provides flexible accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs through adjustable token counts, delivering competitive performance on diverse multimodal benchmarks with lower computational overhead and better accuracy.
papers.comment: Published as main conference paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑视觉语言模型（VLM）必须使用固定基于块的2D视觉特征的假设。通过分析微调后的视觉编码器，发现表示在VLM训练中变得更抽象且空间一致性减弱；图像-文本对齐模型（如SigLIP2）会发展出少量专门token来总结全局图像内容。为此提出RADIO1D，利用多教师知识蒸馏和自动编码器将图像压缩为紧凑、可变长度的1D token序列。该表示具有强层次总结能力，即使单token也能实现准确场景理解，并支持改进的组成感知图像检索。在VLM中，通过可调token数提供灵活的精度-效率权衡，在多种多模态基准上以较低计算开销取得竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有VLM依赖固定2D patch特征，但研究发现微调后的视觉编码器表示变得抽象且空间不一致，挑战了这一假设，促使探索更紧凑灵活的视觉表示。
Method: 提出RADIO1D，使用多教师知识蒸馏和自动编码器设计，将图像压缩为可变长度的1D token序列，无需固定2D grid。
Result: RADIO1D表示具有层次总结能力，单token即可准确理解场景；在VLM中通过调节token数实现精度-效率可调，在多种多模态基准上以较低计算开销取得竞争性能。
Conclusion: 本文表明弹性1D token表示可替代固定2D patch特征，在保持性能的同时提升效率，为视觉-语言建模提供了新方向。

summary_sections.result: RADIO1D表示具有层次总结能力，单token即可准确理解场景；在VLM中通过调节token数实现精度-效率可调，在多种多模态基准上以较低计算开销取得竞争性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文表明弹性1D token表示可替代固定2D patch特征，在保持性能的同时提升效率，为视觉-语言建模提供了新方向。

papers.title: A Vision Based System for Guided and Collaborative Reconstruction of Fragmented Documents
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the development and evaluation of a collaborative system for real-time reconstruction of fragmented paper documents in the context of cultural heritage preservation. The developed system includes a collaborative robot, or cobot, that can fully manage the positioning of paper fragments using a specially designed vacuum-based suction attachment. This attachment enables gentle and precise positioning, ensuring the preservation of fragile materials. With this device, we are able to achieve a positioning repeatability of 0.57mm for fragments of 8cm^2. The system offers users the flexibility to choose between manual positioning, with visual guidance, or fully automated positioning performed by the cobot. To further improve the reconstruction process, AI methods for image interpretation, specifically for segmentation and positioning tasks, were applied and evaluated for their applicability to template-based reconstruction of damaged paper fragments. Our investigation provides critical insights into the performance of different local feature matching methods under different document types, taking into account rotation, scale robustness, and the degree of damage to the fragments. With a focus on the reconstruction of damaged and optically altered archival material, SE2-LoFTR, a detector-free local feature matching method, was chosen as the preferred method for the system due to its robust performance in our experiments.
papers.comment: The paper was presented at MetroArchaeo 2024 in Malta. Publication in Springer Proceedings is still delayed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个用于文化遗产保护中碎纸文档实时重建的协作系统。系统采用协作机器人（cobot）结合真空吸盘附件，实现对纸质碎片的精确定位，定位重复精度达0.57mm（8cm²碎片）。用户可选择手动（视觉引导）或全自动定位。研究评估了不同局部特征匹配方法在碎片重建中的表现，最终选用SE2-LoFTR方法。
Motivation: 破碎纸质文档的重建在文化遗产保护中具有重要意义，但手动重建耗时且容易造成二次损伤。现有自动化方法在处理脆弱、变形碎片时精度和鲁棒性不足。
Method: 开发了一个包含协作机器人和真空吸盘附件的系统，实现碎片精确定位；并评估多种局部特征匹配方法（如SE2-LoFTR）在碎片分割与配准中的适用性。
Result: 系统达到0.57mm的定位重复精度；SE2-LoFTR在旋转、尺度鲁棒性和损伤程度方面表现最佳，被选为优选方法。
Conclusion: 该系统结合机器人操作与视觉AI，为碎纸文档的自动化重建提供了可行方案，尤其适用于光学变形的档案材料。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IDEAL-Bench: Indoor Dataset and Evaluation suite for Analyzing 3D Layout reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Spatial question answering is the dominant paradigm for evaluating spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), but it leaves a complementary axis of spatial competence under-evaluated: holistic 3D layout inference, which predicts every visible object's pose and extent from a single image in a structured form. To this end, we introduce IDEAL-Bench, an evaluation suite that requires VLMs to predict structured 3D layouts on photorealistic indoor scenes across 10 room types, scored along five numerical dimensions and a perceptual render-and-compare protocol. By operating on semantically realistic scenes with full asset substitution under controlled lighting and viewpoint, IDEAL-Bench moves beyond CLEVR-style simple geometric primitives so that any image-space discrepancy reflects spatial reasoning alone. The benchmark is built on IDEAL-Scenes, a procedurally generated dataset of 1,000 re-renderable Blender environments with ground-truth layouts. Evaluating 15 prominent VLMs reveals three findings: the task remains substantially unsolved, with the strongest model reaching only 62.1/100 overall; all models exhibit a sharp asymmetry between object recognition and geometric regression, indicating that current VLMs are trained to describe scenes rather than to measure them; model rankings partially diverge from those on QA-based and primitive-reconstruction benchmarks: top-tier consensus holds, but mid-tier rankings shift substantially. Collectively, these findings establish IDEAL-Bench as a diagnostic suite, targeting the geometric and structural competencies that QA-based evaluation cannot surface, and paving the way towards more rigorous evaluation of spatial intelligence in next-generation VLMs. Together, these findings position IDEAL-Bench as a principled diagnostic for whether future VLMs achieve genuine spatial understanding rather than linguistic approximations of it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IDEAL-Bench，一个评估视觉语言模型（VLM）3D布局推理能力的基准，包含1000个可渲染的室内场景，要求模型预测结构化的3D布局。评估15个主流VLM发现任务远未解决，最强模型仅62.1/100分，模型在物体识别和几何回归间存在不对称性，且排名与QA基准部分不同。该基准旨在诊断VLM的空间智能。
Motivation: 现有的空间问答评估忽视了全局3D布局推理能力，即从单张图像预测所有可见物体的姿态和范围。
Method: 构建IDEAL-Scenes数据集（1000个Blender环境），包含10种房间类型，受控光照和视角，通过五个数值维度及渲染对比协议评分。
Result: 最强VLM仅62.1/100分；所有模型在物体识别与几何回归间存在严重不对称；模型排名与基于QA和原始重建的基准部分不同。
Conclusion: IDEAL-Bench作为诊断套件，能揭示QA评估无法暴露的几何和结构能力，为下一代VLM空间智能评估奠定基础。

papers.title: Implicit Bias of SGD in Multivariate ReLU Networks: Effective Width Collapse
papers.abstract_en: We study the implicit bias of noisy stochastic gradient descent in training wide two-layer ReLU networks for multivariate regression. In a mean-field regime, the training dynamics are approximated by a Wasserstein gradient flow that converges to a unique stationary measure. We characterize the structure of this stationary measure and the predictor it represents. We show that, despite the network being infinitely overparameterized, the learned predictor admits an effectively finite representation: the input weights and biases align along finitely many directions, leading to an effective width collapse. In particular, the solution function is continuous piecewise affine, with affine regions determined by the cells of a finite hyperplane arrangement. The number of learned directions, and hence hyperplanes, is bounded above by $2\mathcal{P}-1$, where $\mathcal{P}$ denotes the number of linear dichotomies realizable on the training inputs. We further establish a non-redundancy property of the learned representation by proving that each learned direction induces a unique ternary activation pattern on the training data. Consequently, the complexity of the learned predictor is governed by the combinatorial geometry of the training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究噪声随机梯度下降在训练宽两层ReLU网络进行多元回归时的隐式偏置。在平均场机制下，训练动力学由Wasserstein梯度流近似并收敛到唯一平稳测度。研究表明，尽管网络无限过参数化，学习到的预测器实际具有有限表示：权重和偏置沿有限方向对齐，导致有效宽度塌缩。解函数为连续分段仿射函数，其仿射区域由有限超平面排列决定，学习方向数受训练输入可实现线性二分数的约束。
Motivation: 理解深度网络在过参数化情况下的隐式正则化机制，特别是SGD如何导致有限维表示，从而解释泛化性能。
Method: 在平均场框架下建立噪声SGD的Wasserstein梯度流近似，分析稳态分布的结构，并利用组合几何刻画学习表示的方向数量与激活模式。
Result: 学习方向数上限为2P-1（P为训练输入上可实现线性二分数量）；每个学习方向在训练数据上诱导唯一的三元激活模式，表明表示的非冗余性。
Conclusion: 学习预测器的复杂度由训练数据的组合几何控制，而非网络宽度，揭示了无限宽网络的有效容量是有限的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAF3R: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction (F3R) transformers have recently achieved remarkable success. However, scaling them to long image sequences remains challenging, as the quadratic complexity of cross-view global attention quickly becomes the dominant computational bottleneck. While recent efforts attempt to improve efficiency through compressed or sparse attention, they fail to fully exploit the inherent sparsity and dynamic behavior of global attention. In this work, we present a comprehensive analysis of global attention across multiple F3R transformers and reveal that attention patterns are highly heterogeneous, dynamic, and extremely sparse across layers and attention heads. Motivated by these findings, we propose SAF3R, a training-free dynamic sparse attention framework tailored to F3R transformers. SAF3R integrates tailored sparse attention mechanisms with offline head profiling and an efficient online adaptation strategy to match input-dependent attention behaviors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAF3R achieves high sparsity ratios while preserving camera pose estimation and 3D reconstruction quality, translating into substantial end-to-end speedup on F3R transformers compared to existing methods. Code is available at https://github.com/jndeng/SAF3R
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了前馈3D重建（F3R）Transformer中全局注意力机制的模式，发现其具有高度异质性、动态性和稀疏性。由此提出SAF3R，一种无需训练的动态稀疏注意力框架，通过离线头部分析和在线自适应策略实现高效稀疏化。实验表明，该方法在保持相机位姿估计和3D重建质量的同时，显著提升了推理速度。
Motivation: 现有F3R Transformer在处理长图像序列时，交叉视图全局注意力的二次复杂度成为计算瓶颈，而之前的压缩或稀疏注意力方法未能充分利用全局注意力固有的稀疏性和动态特性。
Method: SAF3R结合了定制稀疏注意力机制、离线头部分析（offline head profiling）和在线自适应策略，以匹配输入相关的注意力行为，无需重新训练。
Result: 在多个F3R Transformer上实现高稀疏度，同时保持相机位姿估计和3D重建质量，端到端推理速度相比现有方法有显著提升。
Conclusion: SAF3R证明了利用全局注意力的内在稀疏性和动态性可以有效加速F3R Transformer，且不需要额外训练。

papers.title: A Step Towards Robust Unsupervised Domain Adaptation via Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial robustness in Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) remains a significant challenge due to noisy pseudo labels and inherent distributional shifts between the clean source and adversarially perturbed target domains. Existing approaches often fail to achieve an optimal trade-off between robustness and accuracy, as pseudo-labels generated by domain-adapted models tend to introduce classification errors under adversarial attacks. In this work, we propose \textbf{SFT+RL}, a two-stage robust UDA framework that integrates Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) on top of CLIP's pre-trained visual encoder. In the SFT stage, we adversarially fine-tune a linear classifier using PGD-based perturbations over the labelled source domain while partially unfreezing CLIP's projection layer. It allows adaptation to adversarial noise while preserving CLIP's rich semantic priors. We introduce a confidence-guided pseudo-labeling strategy in the RL stage to annotate unlabeled target samples progressively. Pseudo labels are filtered using a decaying confidence threshold to balance quality and coverage, and the model is trained on a composite dataset formed by combining clean source samples with high-confidence target samples. Adversarial training is applied to mixed batches of clean and adversarial examples to enhance cross-domain robustness. Comprehensive evaluations on three benchmark datasets OfficeHome~\cite{tomm-ude}, PACS~\cite{pacs}, and VisDA~\cite{visda} demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Notably, \textbf{SFT+RL} achieves average improvements of \textbf{10.2\%} in clean accuracy and \textbf{15.8\%} in adversarial robustness across all three datasets, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented at the 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence (ECAI 2025), Bologna, Italy
papers.journal_ref: Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications, Volume 413, ECAI 2025, IOS Press, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无监督域自适应（UDA）中对抗鲁棒性不足的问题，提出SFT+RL两阶段框架，在CLIP视觉编码器基础上结合监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）。SFT阶段通过PGD扰动对线性分类器进行对抗微调，RL阶段使用置信度引导的伪标签策略逐步标注目标域样本。在OfficeHome、PACS和VisDA三个基准上，该方法在干净准确率和对抗鲁棒性上分别平均提升10.2%和15.8%，超越了现有方法。
Motivation: 现有UDA方法在处理对抗扰动时难以平衡鲁棒性与准确率，伪标签容易引入分类错误。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：SFT阶段利用PGD扰动在源域上对抗微调线性分类器并部分解冻CLIP投影层；RL阶段采用置信度衰减阈值的伪标签筛选策略，结合干净与对抗样本的混合批次进行对抗训练。
Result: 在OfficeHome、PACS和VisDA数据集上，SFT+RL的干净准确率平均提升10.2%，对抗鲁棒性平均提升15.8%。
Conclusion: 该两阶段框架有效增强了UDA的对抗鲁棒性，同时保持了较高的干净准确率。

papers.title: They Infer What You Meant: Models Represent Communicative Intent More Reliably Than They Act On It
papers.abstract_en: When a person shares something with a language model, the model often answers the surface of the message rather than what the sender was doing by sending it: share a finished project and it critiques the code; share a raw late-night line and it runs a wellness check. We treat the sender's communicative intent, the Gricean what-was-meant, as a first-class interpretability object, and show the failure is one of readout on top of a robust representation. A linear probe decodes the sender's intent, whether they want a thing recognized or evaluated, from a model's default-pass hidden states, cleanly and surface-independently, across six models and four families and in the base checkpoints. The representation generalizes further, to intent that is only pragmatically inferred, and to a second, lexically clean intent (support versus help). The behavioral half of the story, and every causal test, is established on the recognize/evaluate contrast, where what varies is whether the default output acts on the intent. The readout lags the representation in depth within a model (the intent is decodable several layers before it drives the output); across models, which ones act on it by default is model-specific, an observed stratification (three of six show the failure) that we do not read as a scaling law. Where the gap is open, a direction closely tied to the representation, the discriminative direction at a searched-for layer, is a causal handle: steering it recovers the intended behavior, as well as an explicit instruction does and with no prompt at all. This direction is near-orthogonal to the feedback-offering axis, so it routes a represented intent rather than a generic feedback knob, though at the recovery dose the routed intent can override an explicit request. We support each link with controls against obvious deflations and report the nulls as plainly as the confirmations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在回应时未能捕捉发送者的交际意图（communicative intent）的问题，认为失败在于读出（readout）而非表示（representation）。通过线性探针，作者从模型默认隐藏状态中解码出发送者的意图（如识别或评估），且泛化到其他意图。因果实验表明，在特定层引导（steering）一个与意图紧密相关的方向可以恢复预期行为，效果与显式指令相当且无需提示。
Motivation: 语言模型常回答消息的表面内容而非发送者的真实意图，导致交互失败。本文旨在解释这一现象并探索修复方法。
Method: 将交际意图作为可解释性对象，使用线性探针从模型的隐藏状态中解码意图，并通过因果干预（引导特定方向）来改变模型行为。
Result: 探针能在多种模型和检查点中独立于表面形式解码意图；引导方向可恢复预期行为，且方向与反馈轴近似正交，表明其路由的是意图而非通用反馈旋钮。
Conclusion: 模型内部表示已编码交际意图，但默认输出未能利用；通过因果干预可弥补这一差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Empirical Bayes for correlated Gaussian sequence model
papers.abstract_en: Empirical Bayes methods are among the most widely used statistical methods for large-scale inference. A central paradigm is the NPMLE, whose theoretical guarantees are by now well understood for the independent Gaussian sequence model. In this paper, we study empirical Bayes estimation from dependent observations in the Gaussian sequence model. We show that the maximum Composite Marginal Likelihood (CML) estimator, which ignores all correlations in the likelihood, converges in weighted Hellinger distance at the rate $n_*^{-1/2}$, where $n_*=n/κ_0$ is the `effective sample size' determined solely by the number of observations $n$ and the spectral radius $κ_0$ of the correlation matrix of the Gaussian observations. A complementary minimax lower bound shows that $n_*$ indeed serves as the right complexity measure, and that the CML estimator is nearly rate optimal under general dependence. We consider two concrete applications. In the first, we consider Bayesian linear regression, where the signal prior is estimated via CML applied to the least squares estimator. In the second, we consider the more challenging Bayesian nonlinear single-index model, where prior is estimated by CML applied to a one-step debiased gradient descent. In both applications, although the full likelihood landscape can be arbitrarily complicated and intractable, our CML method is facilitated by exploiting the high-dimensional distribution of the auxiliary statistics through a correlated Gaussian sequence model. The key ingredient in the proof of our results is a sharp local maximal inequality for the log composite marginal likelihood process under dependent Gaussian observations. In contrast to standard empirical process methods, we prove this inequality by leveraging a recent geometric Brascamp-Lieb inequality for Gaussian measures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究相关高斯序列模型下的经验贝叶斯估计，证明忽略相关性的复合边际似然（CML）估计量在加权Hellinger距离下以n_*^{-1/2}速率收敛，其中n_*由观测数n和相关系数矩阵的谱半径κ_0决定。补充极小极大下界表明n_*是合适的复杂度度量，CML估计量在一般相关性下接近最优。
Motivation: 现有经验贝叶斯方法（如NPMLE）在独立高斯序列模型中的理论保证已成熟，但实际观测常存在相关性。本文旨在解决依赖观测下的经验贝叶斯估计问题，并探索忽略相关性的简单估计方法是否仍有效。
Method: 提出最大复合边际似然（CML）估计量，忽略似然中的所有相关性，并利用几何Brascamp-Lieb不等式推导其收敛速率。
Result: CML估计量在加权Hellinger距离下收敛速率为n_*^{-1/2}，且该速率在极小极大意义下最优。
Conclusion: 忽略相关性的CML估计在一般依赖高斯序列中仍具有接近最优的收敛性质，其有效样本量由谱半径决定，该结论适用于贝叶斯线性回归和非线性单指标模型。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Token-Based Affordance Grounding with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Affordance grounding aims to localize image regions that support a specific action, serving as a core capability for physical intelligence and embodied perception. Previous studies have primarily relied on weakly supervised learning with action labels from exocentric images. However, these methods often struggle with visually ambiguous exocentric images containing co-occurring actions; moreover, they fail to distinguish semantically similar actions because existing methods typically rely on brief action phrases that lack rich semantic details for action-specific localization. Although large vision-language models (LVLMs) encode rich action semantics and their action-conditioned textual outputs implicitly contain spatial cues, they do not directly provide action-specific spatial localization. To address these problems, we propose TokAG, a zero-shot affordance grounding framework that exploits the token-level semantic-spatial signals in LVLMs to localize action-relevant regions without external supervision. We observe that attention maps associated with different LVLM output tokens vary significantly, with many attending to irrelevant regions such as the background. Thus, we introduce a spatial-aware token-selection mechanism to systematically evaluate each output token and select the one whose attention maps exhibit dominant activation over the target object, instead of relying on arbitrary attention maps. By extracting these object-focused attention maps, we transform the LVLM's implicit semantic signals into zero-shot affordance heatmaps. Our zero-shot framework consistently outperforms prior weakly supervised approaches across multiple benchmarks, improving NSS by 10.7% on the unseen split of AGD20K and by 29.7% on HICO-IIF. The code and models will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TokAG，一种零样本可供性接地 (affordance grounding) 框架，利用大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM) 的 token 级语义-空间信号来定位与动作相关的图像区域，无需外部监督。该方法通过空间感知的 token 选择机制，从 LVLM 的输出 token 中挑选出注意力图聚焦于目标对象的 token，从而生成零样本可供性热力图。在 AGD20K 和 HICO-IIF 基准上，该方法在未见过的类别上分别将 NSS 提升了 10.7% 和 29.7%，超越以往的弱监督方法。
Motivation: 现有可供性接地方法依赖弱监督学习，但面对视觉模糊的异心图像和语义相似的动作时表现不佳，且缺乏丰富的语义细节来指导动作特定的定位。LVLM 虽隐含动作语义和空间线索，但不能直接提供空间定位。
Method: 提出 TokAG 框架，利用 LVLM 输出 token 的注意力图：通过空间感知 token 选择机制，评估每个输出 token 的注意力图，挑选出对目标对象有主导激活的 token，并将其注意力图转化为零样本可供性热力图。
Result: 在 AGD20K 的未见类别上 NSS 提升 10.7%，在 HICO-IIF 上提升 29.7%，零样本设置下一致优于先前弱监督方法。
Conclusion: TokAG 证明了 LVLM 的 token 级注意力图可以有效地提取空间定位信号，实现无需外部监督的可供性接地，且性能显著超过弱监督方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Discovery and Clinical Validation of Deep Radiomic Signatures in Tumor Classification
papers.abstract_en: Imaging signatures are quantitative features extracted from medical images that provide clinically meaningful information for tumor diagnosis, characterization, prognosis, and treatment planning. Although deep learning has shown great potential for imaging signature discovery, its limited interpretability remains a major barrier to clinical adoption. Existing approaches often achieve high predictive performance but provide little biological insight into the identified signatures. We propose a unified framework for interpretable imaging signature discovery by integrating deep learning based segmentation, explainable classification, and radiomic analysis. A robust segmentation model is first used to accurately delineate tumors, followed by a Grad-CAM guided pipeline that identifies diagnostically important regions as candidate imaging signatures. A mutual information based adaptive thresholding strategy enables patient-specific signature extraction. The resulting signatures are validated using a downstream deep learning classification model, while radiomic features extracted from the signature regions are evaluated with traditional machine learning models and interpreted using SHAP to identify the most discriminative biomarkers. The proposed framework is evaluated on the public BUSI breast ultrasound, KiTS renal CT, and BraTS brain tumor datasets, as well as a private UF Health renal CT cohort. Compared with conventional whole-tumor radiomics, the proposed signature-based approach achieves improved discriminative performance while providing greater biological interpretability. By converting deep learning attention into reproducible quantitative imaging biomarkers, this framework offers an interpretable and reproducible solution for non-invasive tumor characterization and imaging biomarker discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的深度学习框架，用于在肿瘤分类中发现和临床验证深度影像组学特征。该框架结合深度学习分割、Grad-CAM引导的可解释分类和传统影像组学分析，通过互信息自适应阈值提取患者特异性影像特征，并在公共乳腺超声、肾脏CT和脑肿瘤数据集以及私有肾脏CT队列上验证。与传统全肿瘤影像组学相比，该方法在提高鉴别性能的同时提供了更好的生物学可解释性。
Motivation: 深度学习在医学影像特征发现中潜力巨大，但其可解释性不足阻碍了临床采纳；现有方法虽预测性能高，但缺乏对识别特征的生物学洞察。
Method: 提出统一框架，包含三部分：1) 基于深度学习的鲁棒分割模型勾画肿瘤；2) Grad-CAM引导管道识别诊断重要区域作为候选影像特征，并通过互信息自适应阈值实现患者特异性特征提取；3) 下游深度学习分类验证特征，同时用传统机器学习评估影像组学特征并用SHAP解释最判别性生物标志物。
Result: 在BUSI乳腺超声、KiTS肾脏CT、BraTS脑肿瘤和UF Health私有肾脏CT数据集上，所提基于特征的方法相比传统全肿瘤影像组学提高了鉴别性能，并提供了更强的生物学可解释性。
Conclusion: 该框架通过将深度学习注意力转化为可重复的定量影像生物标志物，为非侵入性肿瘤表征和影像生物标志物发现提供了可解释且可重复的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Responsibility Distribution Estimation in Ego-View Accident Videos with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies on multimodal traffic accident understanding have mainly relied on infrastructure-camera footage, satellite imagery, or structured crash records. However, such data sources are costly to deploy and maintain at large scale, and they cannot objectively capture what the driver was actually able to observe before the accident. In contrast, ego-view accident videos directly represent the driver's visual perspective, making them suitable for reasoning about avoidability and driver responsibility. In this paper, we introduce responsibility distribution estimation for ego-view traffic accident videos, a new task in which a model predicts the percentage of responsibility assigned to each involved agent. We construct an LLM-assisted responsibility annotation pipeline and fine-tune multimodal large language models under multiple input settings, including raw frames, segmentation-enhanced input, and textual descriptions. Experimental results establish a strong initial benchmark, demonstrating that multimodal LLMs can effectively perform this nuanced, constraint-based reasoning task. Our findings suggest that ego-centric accident videos provide a promising foundation for socially and legally meaningful multimodal reasoning beyond conventional accident classification and explanation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从自我视角事故视频中估计各参与方责任比例的新任务，利用多模态大语言模型进行标注和推理，建立了初步基准。
Motivation: 现有交通事故理解依赖基础设施摄像头或结构化数据，成本高且无法客观反映驾驶员实际观察视角，自我视角视频更适于分析避免性和责任。
Method: 构建LLM辅助的责任标注流程，在多种输入设置（原始帧、分割增强、文本描述）下微调多模态大语言模型。
Result: 实验建立了初步基准，表明多模态LLM可有效执行此类基于约束的细致推理任务。
Conclusion: 自我视角事故视频为社会和法律意义的多模态推理提供了有前景的基础，超越传统事故分类与解释任务。

papers.title: Tightening Control in Neyman--Pearson Linear Classification
papers.abstract_en: Neyman--Pearson classification prioritizes one class by constraining its accuracy above a prespecified level, and then takes the accuracy of the other class as the utility objective. This paradigm is well suited for disease screening and diagnosis, among other applications. Statistical learning under this framework is complicated since classifier performance determines its acceptability. Furthermore, no learned classifier that is consistent for the oracle classifier can guarantee satisfaction of the control constraint in finite samples. Classical learning theory targets a control-relaxed empirical utility maximization (EUM) classifier. However, even the EUM classifier fails to achieve the desired control level on average. We conjecture that this under-control phenomenon is a manifestation of the over-optimism bias well known in standard statistical learning, and develop asymptotic theory to confirm it. Motivated by this insight, we propose refined learning procedures under two accuracy control strategies for the prioritized class: one controlling accuracy in expectation and the other with high probability. We further develop training-data-based methods to predict and infer class-specific accuracies of the resulting classifiers. Simulation studies demonstrate favorable finite-sample performance, and we illustrate the proposed methods with an application to cancer detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究Neyman-Pearson线性分类中的控制收紧问题，提出在约束控制下优化另一类精度的分类方法，并开发了训练数据驱动的精度预测与推断方法。
Motivation: Neyman-Pearson分类框架在疾病筛查等应用中要求优先类精度高于预设水平，但有限样本下分类器难以保证控制约束满足，存在欠控制现象。
Method: 基于预期控制和高概率控制两种策略，提出改进的学习过程，并开发基于训练数据的方法来预测和推断分类器的类别精度。
Result: 模拟研究显示了良好的有限样本性能，并在癌症检测应用中验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 论文指出欠控制现象是标准统计学习中过度乐观偏差的表现，并提供了渐近理论验证，所提方法能更好满足控制约束。

papers.title: Vision Non-Causal Trapezoidal Mamba: Eliminating Directional Scanning in Vision SSMs with Second-Order Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: State Space Models (SSMs) have emerged as an alternative to Vision Transformers, yet most vision SSMs inherit directional token scanning from causal sequence modeling. While effective for sequential data, directional scanning introduces spatial bias and orientation-sensitive representations. We present Vision Non-Causal Trapezoidal Mamba (VNCT), a second-order non-causal vision SSM that enables all image tokens to interact in a single pass, eliminating direSctional scanning and achieving low single-image inference latency. VNCT exhibits more orientation-robust representations, showing reduced performance degradation under image rotations and flips, while improving Boundary IoU by up to 3.7 points, leading to more accurate boundary preservation and object localization. Across ImageNet-1K classification, COCO object detection and instance segmentation, and ADE20K semantic segmentation, VNCT consistently outperforms both directional-scanning vision SSMs and first-order non-causal SSMs. These results show that directional scanning is unnecessary for high-performance vision SSMs and that second-order non-causal state-space modeling offers a simple, efficient, and robust alternative for visual recognition.

Method: 提出二阶非因果梯形 Mamba (VNCT)，使用非因果状态空间建模，所有图像令牌在一次前向传递中全局交互，无需方向扫描。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上提升分类准确率，在 COCO 上提升检测/分割精度，在 ADE20K 上提升语义分割性能；边界 IoU 最高提升 3.7 点；对图像旋转和翻转的性能下降更小。

papers.title: Graph Classification via Network Usable Information: From Representation Evaluation to Structure Selection
papers.abstract_en: We propose NetinfoGC, a framework for graph classification that extends the Network Usable Information (NUI) paradigm to graph-level learning. Unlike conventional graph neural network approaches that rely on end-to-end training of black-box embeddings, NetinfoGC constructs a family of permutation-invariant graph representations derived from propagation-based mechanisms and classical structural descriptors, including graph centrality measures. To evaluate representation quality, we introduce a training-free NUI estimation procedure based on clustering consistency with ground-truth labels, providing a proxy for task-relevant information without supervised learning. We further exploit the same representations using sparse-group LASSO regularization, enabling automatic selection of informative structural descriptors while suppressing redundant ones. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that classical centrality measures are highly competitive with learned propagation-based representations, and in several cases yield superior performance. Moreover, we observe a strong correlation between estimated NUI and downstream classification accuracy, validating NUI as an effective measure of representation utility. Overall, NetinfoGC provides a unified and interpretable framework for evaluating and exploiting graph representations without requiring end-to-end neural training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NetinfoGC框架，将网络可用信息（NUI）范式扩展到图分类任务。该框架通过传播机制和经典结构描述符（如图中心性度量）构建置换不变的图表示，并引入基于聚类一致性的无训练NUI估计来评估表示质量，同时利用稀疏组LASSO自动选择信息性结构描述符。实验表明，经典中心性度量与学习得到的传播表示性能相当甚至更优，且估计的NUI与下游分类准确率高度相关。
Motivation: 传统图神经网络依赖端到端训练的黑盒嵌入，缺乏对表示质量的显式评估和可解释性，且难以选择任务相关的结构特征。
Method: 构建一系列置换不变的图表示，包括基于传播的表示和经典结构描述符；提出无需监督学习的NUI估计方法（基于聚类一致性与真实标签）；采用稀疏组LASSO正则化自动选择信息性描述符并抑制冗余。
Result: 在基准数据集上，经典中心性度量与传播表示竞争力相当，部分情况下性能更优；估计的NUI与分类准确率呈强相关性。
Conclusion: NetinfoGC提供了一个统一且可解释的框架，无需端到端神经训练即可评估和利用图表示，验证了NUI作为表示效用指标的有效性。

papers.title: Modular Foundation Models for Time-Series Perception in Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Engineering Digital Twins and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) systems rely on robust perception modules to extract actionable information from heterogeneous and non-stationary time-series data. However, most existing approaches remain task-specific, data-hungry, and difficult to integrate into scalable monitoring and decision-making pipelines. Moreover, purely data-driven models often lack robustness and transferability across varying operating conditions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a modular foundation model for time-series perception based on a collection of pretrained representation encoders. The framework leverages self-supervised learning on heterogeneous datasets to learn transferable and task-agnostic representations, which can be reused across multiple PHM tasks. A gating mechanism is introduced to dynamically select relevant encoders for a given target dataset, enabling conditional computation and adaptive model composition. The selected representations are projected into a shared latent space and aggregated using a Transformer-based self-attention module that explicitly models cross-encoder interactions. The resulting architecture supports multiple downstream tasks, including imputation, long-term forecasting, and few-shot learning, through lightweight task-specific heads, while keeping pretrained encoders frozen during adaptation. Extensive ablation studies demonstrate the complementary roles of self-supervised pretraining, encoder selection, representation alignment, and adaptive aggregation. Experimental results on the ETT benchmark show competitive performance across tasks, while a real-world industrial case study on virtual sensing for hydro-generator rotor temperature highlights the practical relevance of the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化基础模型框架，用于数字孪生和PHM系统中的时间序列感知。该框架包含多个自监督预训练的表征编码器，通过门控机制动态选择相关编码器，并利用Transformer自注意力模块聚合跨编码器交互，支持插补、长期预测和少样本学习等下游任务。在ETT基准和工业案例（水轮发电机转子温度虚拟传感）上展示了竞争性能。
Motivation: 现有方法针对特定任务设计，数据需求大，难以集成到可扩展的监测管道中；纯数据驱动模型在变化工况下缺乏鲁棒性和可迁移性。
Method: 提出模块化基础模型：在异构数据集上自监督预训练多个表征编码器；引入门控机制动态选择适用于目标数据集的编码器；将选定表征投影到共享潜在空间，使用Transformer自注意力模块建模跨编码器交互；冻结预训练编码器，仅训练轻量任务头以适应下游任务。
Result: 在ETT基准上，插补、长期预测和少样本学习任务均取得竞争性能；工业案例显示该方法在虚拟传感任务上的实际有效性。
Conclusion: 自监督预训练、编码器选择、表征对齐与自适应聚合的组合对提升时间序列感知性能至关重要，且模块化设计增强了跨任务和跨工况的迁移能力。

papers.title: PLGSA-Transformer: Periocular Landmark-Guided Attention with Occlusion-Adaptive Cosine Thresholding for Cross-Modal Masked and Unmasked Face Recognition
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of facial masks, accelerated by COVID-19 and mandated in security-sensitive settings, has exposed limitations of conventional face recognition systems. Existing approaches relying on fixed cosine thresholds, non-adaptive CNNs, and purely data-driven features fail to generalize when facial regions are occluded, creating a gap between lab performance and real-world deployability. This paper proposes PLGSA-Transformer, a cross-modal face matching framework with three contributions. First, Periocular Landmark-Guided Spatial Attention (PLGSA) uses MediaPipe landmarks to compute Gaussian heatmaps over the eye, brow, and forehead regions, fusing them with EfficientNetB3 features via a learnable residual gate to direct attention toward discriminative visible regions. Second, a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Branch reshapes feature maps into tokens processed by a two-layer Multi-Head Self-Attention encoder, enabling cross-regional dependency modelling. Third, the Occlusion-Adaptive Cosine Threshold (OACT) is a jointly trained head that raises the matching threshold in proportion to predicted occlusion severity. The model is evaluated on 858 images from Zenodo MDMFR (60%), Kaggle CelebA-HQ masked collection (25%), and author-collected images (15%), spanning both genders, ages 21-75, with varied mask types, trained via a unified loss combining contrastive verification, identity classification, and occlusion cross-entropy. PLGSA-Transformer achieves 97.22% pair verification accuracy with ROC AUC 1.0000, surpassing VGG-16-based MUFM (Abdullah et al., 2025; 95.0%), HOG classifiers (Adnan et al., 2020; 85.0%), and Feature-based Structural Measure (Shnain et al., 2017; 86.61%). These results confirm that encoding periocular geometry into attention, with Transformer modelling and occlusion-adaptive thresholds, yields a robust, scalable solution for cross-modal masked face recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLGSA-Transformer，一种跨模态（戴口罩/未戴口罩）人脸识别框架。三个核心贡献：基于眼部地标的空间注意力（PLGSA），利用MediaPipe地标生成高斯热图并与EfficientNetB3特征融合；混合CNN-Transformer分支，将特征图转为token进行自注意力编码；遮挡自适应余弦阈值（OACT），根据预测遮挡程度动态调整匹配阈值。在858张图像上达到97.22%的配对验证准确率，ROC AUC为1.0，优于VGG-16 MUFM（95.0%）等方法。
Motivation: 传统人脸识别系统在面部遮挡（如口罩）下泛化能力差，固定余弦阈值和非自适应CNN方法无法有效处理遮挡区域，导致实验室性能与真实部署之间的差距。
Method: 提出PLGSA-Transformer，包含：1）Periocular Landmark-Guided Spatial Attention (PLGSA)，利用MediaPipe眼部地标生成高斯热图，通过可学习残差门与EfficientNetB3特征融合；2）混合CNN-Transformer分支，将特征图重塑为token，经两层多头自注意力编码器处理；3）Occlusion-Adaptive Cosine Threshold (OACT)，联合训练一个头，根据预测遮挡程度比例提高匹配阈值。
Result: 在858张图像（60%来自Zenodo MDMFR，25%来自Kaggle CelebA-HQ masked collection，15%来自作者收集）上，配对验证准确率达97.22%，ROC AUC为1.0000，超过VGG-16 MUFM (95.0%)、HOG分类器 (85.0%)和基于特征的结构度量 (86.61%)。
Conclusion: 将眼部几何编码到注意力机制中，结合Transformer建模和遮挡自适应阈值，能够提供鲁棒且可扩展的跨模态戴口罩人脸识别方案。

papers.title: When Geometry Aligns: Dihedral Hidden-State Transformations in UNet, ViT, and DiT Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion architectures now encompass convolutional UNets as well as transformer-based designs such as Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), inspired by Vision Transformers (ViTs), yet the effects of structured geometric perturbations within these architectures remain poorly understood. We study this question through a unified framework that applies reflection-based elements of the dihedral group to intermediate hidden states as controlled internal interventions, contrasting geometrically consistent and inconsistent variants. Using activation-level diagnostics, including Self-Consistency Shift (SCS), Activation Mass Scatter (AMS), and Drift, we analyze feature stability and geometric drift. We find that consistent transformations improve stability, while inconsistent ones induce predictable, architecture-specific failures. In the main Stable Diffusion 2.1 U-Net study, we evaluate seven intervention modes over three seeds and complement the internal diagnostics with image-level FID, KID, CLIP score, and LPIPS diversity. Taken together with supporting ViT and controlled DiT analyses, these results establish geometric consistency as a key principle for stable hidden-state interventions in spatially structured vision and diffusion models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过引入二面体群（dihedral group）的反射变换作为可控的内部干预，研究了UNet、ViT和DiT等扩散架构中隐藏状态的几何扰动。使用激活级诊断指标（SCS、AMS、Drift）分析特征稳定性，发现一致变换提升稳定性，不一致变换导致架构特定的可预测故障。在Stable Diffusion 2.1 U-Net上的实验验证了图像级指标（FID、KID、CLIP分数、LPIPS多样性），确立了几何一致性作为空间结构视觉和扩散模型中稳定隐藏状态干预的关键原则。
Motivation: 扩散架构（如卷积UNet和基于Transformer的DiT）中结构化几何扰动的影响尚未被充分理解，缺乏系统的分析框架。
Method: 提出统一框架，将二面体群的反射元素应用于中间隐藏状态作为内部干预，并通过自一致性偏移（SCS）、激活质量扩散（AMS）和漂移等诊断指标分析几何一致性和不一致性的影响。
Result: 一致几何变换提高隐藏状态稳定性；不一致变换导致架构特定的可预测故障。在Stable Diffusion 2.1 U-Net上，七种干预模式结合种子实验验证了图像级指标（FID、KID、CLIP分数、LPIPS多样性）。
Conclusion: 几何一致性是空间结构视觉和扩散模型中稳定隐藏状态干预的关键原则。

papers.title: Motion Estimation Techniques for Volumetric Video Attribute Compression
papers.abstract_en: Point cloud compression relies on techniques to compress both geometry and attributes. Motion-based approaches for dynamic solid point cloud geometry compression within the geometry-based point cloud compression (G-PCC) framework have achieved significant reductions in geometry rate. However, motion-based techniques for attribute compression remain underexplored, making it challenging to achieve significant reductions in the temporal redundancy of attributes. Firstly, this paper proposes a geometry-based inter-coding scheme to compress the attributes of dynamic solid point clouds. Secondly, a graph-based motion-estimation scheme for point-cloud attribute compression is proposed. Thirdly, an interpolation-free fractional-voxel motion estimation method is proposed to refine motion accuracy to fractional-voxel precision. Our experimental results on the MPEG point cloud dataset show that the proposed scheme outperforms G-PCC, GeS-TM, and V-PCC in lossless and lossy geometry conditions. We achieve average bitrate savings of $55.3\%$, $42.3\%$, and $16.5\%$ over G-PCC, GeS-TM, and V-PCC, respectively, under lossy-geometry conditions.

papers.title: Differentiate the Evaluator, Not the Program: An Efficient Runtime Representation for Neuro-Symbolic Learning
papers.abstract_en: AI systems increasingly propose executable scientific models whose value depends on both their symbolic structure and their fitted continuous parameters. This makes parameter calibration the bottleneck of program-and-parameter co-search: an outer loop can generate thousands of candidate programs, but each needs an inner gradient-based optimization before it can be assessed. Staging each candidate into its own differentiable graph makes individual models fast but sacrifices the program-as-data property that keeps search fluid; interpreter-based approaches preserve programs as runtime data but pay interpreter overhead that dominates the numerical work. We present the Native Differentiable Virtual Machine (NDVM), a runtime representation that differentiates executable programs without compiling each candidate into a separate graph. NDVM separates symbolic structure from differentiable numeric state: tags, symbols, environments, and control remain native runtime data, while numeric payloads live in dense batched buffers with exact reverse-mode gradients recorded along the realized execution trace, so one evaluator walk is amortized across large populations of parameter vectors. A locked cost model of a real differentiable self-hosted Scheme interpreter motivates the design. We realize NDVM as a native runtime with forward and gradient equivalence to the reference backend, about 60x per-lane batch amortization, near-linear multicore scaling, and two independent front ends. In fixed-budget co-search over LLM-proposed programs, NDVM reaches high-quality solutions about 24x sooner in wall-clock time, suggesting runtime differentiation as a practical systems foundation for scientific discovery workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Native Differentiable Virtual Machine (NDVM)，一种可微分运行时表示，用于高效执行神经符号学习中的程序-参数联合搜索。NDVM 将符号结构保留为原生运行时数据，而数字参数以密集批处理缓冲区存储，并通过执行轨迹记录精确反向模式梯度，从而将单个评估器的开销分摊到大量参数向量上。在 LLM 提出的程序上进行固定预算联合搜索时，NDVM 比传统方法提前约 24 倍达到高质量解。
Motivation: 程序-参数联合搜索中，外循环生成大量候选程序，每个程序需要内循环梯度优化才能评估。现有方法要么为每个候选程序编译单独的微分图（牺牲程序作为数据的灵活性），要么使用解释器（开销大）。需要一种既能保持程序作为运行时数据、又能高效执行微分的新表示。
Method: 提出 NDVM，一种可微分虚拟机运行时表示。它将符号结构（标签、符号、环境、控制流）保留为原生运行时数据，数字负载存储在密集批处理缓冲区中，沿实际执行轨迹记录精确反向模式梯度。这样一次评估器的遍历可以被大量参数向量分摊。
Result: 摘要报告 NDVM 实现了约 60 倍的每通道批处理分摊，近线性多核扩展，以及两个独立前端。在固定预算的 LLM 提议程序联合搜索中，NDVM 在墙钟时间上约提前 24 倍达到高质量解。
Conclusion: NDVM 通过运行时微分作为科学发现工作流的实用系统基础，有望加速神经符号搜索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Teacher Supervision over Representation Equivalence Classes
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation is usually framed as a choice of what to match in the teacher - its logits, hidden features, or sample relations - which presupposes that the teacher's representation has absolute coordinates to match. It does not: a pretrained representation is identifiable only up to an orthogonal-and-isotropic-scaling equivalence class, so a student should learn the teacher's equivalence class, not its features. The organizing fact is that capability is the teacher's output function, a class invariant that factors through the quotient by the class action, so an objective recovers capability exactly when it is defined there. This makes absolute feature matching ill-posed, and admissible supervision a matter of targeting class invariants (Gram structure, CKA, principal subspaces) or aligning coordinates first, unifying feature matching, relational distillation, alignment, and grafting in one geometric account. We validate our framework on Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.1. A restoration study recovers a corrupted model's representation (CKA ~ 0.99) but not its capability, and an ablation isolates the cause: output-function (logit) matching drives capability, while matching hidden representations aligns geometry without restoring function. Recovery is confined to the corpus-covered region, and a graft study confirms that boundary overlap predicts transplant success but is necessary, not sufficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从表示等价类的视角重新审视知识蒸馏。作者论证教师预训练表示仅在正交各向同性缩放变换下可识别，因此学生应当学习教师的等价类而不是绝对特征。基于该观点，论文统一了特征匹配、关系蒸馏、对齐和嫁接等方法的几何基础，并在Qwen2.5和Llama-3.1上实验验证。结果表明，恢复表示（CKA≈0.99）不等于恢复能力；输出函数（logit）匹配驱动能力恢复，而隐藏表示匹配仅对齐几何结构。
Motivation: 传统知识蒸馏假设教师表示具有绝对坐标可匹配，但预训练表示实际仅能识别到正交各向同性缩放等价类，导致绝对特征匹配不适定。需要建立基于等价类不变量的统一蒸馏框架。
Method: 提出将教师输出函数视为类不变量，通过商空间的视角定义监督目标；学生应匹配Gram结构、CKA、主子空间等类不变量，或先对齐坐标再匹配。该框架统一了现有特征匹配、关系蒸馏、对齐和嫁接等方法。
Result: 在Qwen2.5和Llama-3.1上的恢复实验显示，可恢复表示的CKA约0.99，但模型能力未恢复；消融表明logit匹配驱动能力，隐藏表示匹配只对齐几何。嫁接实验证实边界重叠是移植成功的必要条件但不充分。
Conclusion: 输出函数（logit）匹配是恢复能力的关键，而表示几何对齐不足以恢复功能；恢复能力受限于训练语料覆盖的区域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EPRA U-Net: An Efficient Pyramid Residual Attention Framework for Accurate Infarct Segmentation in Diffusion-Weighted MRI
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Accurate identification of acute ischemic infarcts on diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (DWI) is a critical prerequisite for reliable lesion quantification and effective clinical decision support in the management of cerebrovascular events. Methods: This study presents EPRA U-Net (Efficient Pyramid Residual Attention U-Net), a task-specific integrated architecture for efficient and accurate infarct segmentation of DWI images. In the proposed architecture, an EfficientNet-based encoder was used as a hierarchical feature extractor with a minimized parameterization. In addition, a Residual-Recurrent (R2) block (recurrent unrolling step t = 2, following the original formulation) and Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) were integrated to enhance the performance of spatial dependency modeling. Additionally, a dual attention mechanism was incorporated to highlight lesion-related activations while concurrently enabling the suppression of extraneous background responses. To prioritize lesion detection consistent with clinical imperative, a Tversky loss function was adopted, emphasizing the sensitivity of detection over its specificity during the optimization process. Results: Experimental evaluations were conducted utilizing an in-house dataset comprising 167 patients with 4,895 DWI slices; subsequently, the performance of the proposed EPRA U-Net was assessed in comparison with state-of-the-art models, specifically UNet++, DeepLabV3+, and TransUNet. The experimental results suggest that EPRA U-Net attained superior performance, evidenced by a pixel-aggregated Dice of 0.8984, a per-sample Dice of 0.9469, an IoU of 0.8155, a Recall of 0.8887, a Lesion F1 of 0.9378, and an HD95 of 11.62 px. Furthermore, a clear reduction in the rate of missed lesions, specifically by 16%, 25%, and 29%, was observed when compared with UNet++, DeepLabV3+, and TransUNet, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EPRA U-Net，一种结合EfficientNet编码器、残差循环模块、空洞空间金字塔池化和双重注意力机制的架构，用于扩散加权MRI中的急性梗死分割。在167例患者4895张切片的数据集上，EPRA U-Net在像素级Dice、样本级Dice、IoU、召回率、病变F1和HD95指标上均优于UNet++、DeepLabV3+和TransUNet，并显著降低了漏检率。
Motivation: 准确分割急性缺血性脑梗死对于临床决策支持至关重要，现有方法在漏检率方面仍有改进空间。
Method: 采用EfficientNet编码器减少参数量，集成残差循环模块和空洞空间金字塔池化增强空间建模，引入双重注意力机制突出病变区域并抑制背景，使用Tversky损失函数优化检测敏感性。
Result: 在内部数据集上，EPRA U-Net取得像素级Dice 0.8984、样本级Dice 0.9469、IoU 0.8155、召回率0.8887、病变F1 0.9378、HD95 11.62像素，漏检率相比UNet++、DeepLabV3+和TransUNet分别降低16%、25%和29%。
Conclusion: EPRA U-Net在DWI梗死分割任务上实现了准确性和效率的平衡，尤其显著减少了漏检病例，具有临床实用价值。

papers.title: XPlainVerse: A Million-Scale Benchmark for Explainable Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: As deepfake detection models increasingly produce natural language explanations, their reasoning often remains weakly grounded in visual artifacts, limiting reliability and user trust. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate classification accuracy, overlooking whether explanations reflect the actual manipulations. This gap hinders progress toward deployable, explainable deepfake detection systems. To this end, we introduce XPlainVerse, a large-scale benchmark designed for joint deepfake detection and human-centered explanation. XPlainVerse comprises one million real and manipulated images, pairing authentic images from five established sources with forgeries generated by twelve off-the-shelf image editing and synthesis models. We further propose a multi-stage filtering pipeline, Edit-Check, to verify if manipulations satisfy their intended edits, enabling reliable reasoning supervision at scale. Beyond dataset scale, XPlainVerse provides two complementary explanation styles: technical explanations for expert analysis and simplified explanations optimized for non-technical users. To evaluate explanation quality beyond surface similarity, we propose novel metrics, EntityScore and EvidenceScore, that measure reasoning fidelity by checking whether explanations correctly identify manipulated entities and visual evidence. Human annotations on 2,000 explanation pairs validate our dataset quality against human judgment. We believe XPlainVerse will establish grounded explanation quality as a measurable dimension of deepfake detection and support scalable research on trustworthy, interpretable models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出XPlainVerse，一个百万级可解释深度伪造检测基准，包含来自五种来源的100万对真实与伪造图像（使用12种编辑/合成模型生成）。通过Edit-Check多级过滤管道确保操作可信，并提供技术性和简化型两种解释风格。提出EntityScore和EvidenceScore指标衡量解释的推理忠实度，2000对人工标注验证了数据集质量。
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测模型产生的自然语言解释往往缺乏对视觉伪影的严谨依据，导致可靠性不足；已有基准仅关注分类准确率，忽略了解释质量，阻碍了可部署可解释检测系统的发展。
Method: 构建百万级基准：从5个来源采集真实图像，用12种模型生成伪造图像，通过Edit-Check管道验证操作是否达成预期编辑；为每对图像提供专家级和技术优化两种解释风格；提出EntityScore和EvidenceScore评估解释是否正确识别被操纵实体及视觉证据。
Result: 在2000对解释上的人工标注表明数据集与人类判断一致，基准将推动解释质量成为深度伪造检测的可测量维度。
Conclusion: XPlainVerse旨在将解释质量确立为深度伪造检测的关键维度，支持可信任、可解释模型的规模化研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How to Avoid Debate: Scalable AI Safety via Doubly-Efficient Interactive Proofs
papers.abstract_en: As AI models continue to develop powerful capabilities, it becomes critical that we are able to verify that their output is aligned with our intentions. A recent line of work focuses on verification via debate, a model of interactive proofs where two competing powerful provers, or AI models, debate each other to convince a weak verifier, or a human, of the correctness of their claim. However, debate assumes that the two AI models possess equal abilities and that one of them is truthful, which may not be realistic. In this work, we show \emph{how to avoid debate}: we initiate the study of \emph{single-prover} interactive proofs for AI safety. Prior results in single-prover interactive proofs do not immediately carry over to the AI safety setting: for example, they do not work when the computation has access to an oracle, such as to human judgment or an external database such as the web. We present doubly-efficient single-prover interactive proofs and arguments for oracle-aided computations (also known as relativizing proofs), in the settings where (1) the computation is robust, in the sense that the output does not change if at most a small fraction of the answers to oracle queries are incorrect, or (2) the oracle is a low-degree polynomial. These results suggest that interactive verification is possible even without debate, under structured or noise-tolerant oracle access.

TL;DR: 本文探讨如何避免辩论机制（debate）来实现AI安全验证，提出单证明者交互式证明（single-prover interactive proofs）用于AI安全场景。作者针对具有oracle访问的计算（如人类判断或外部数据库），在计算是鲁棒的或oracle是低阶多项式的情况下，给出了双高效的单证明者交互式证明和论证。这表明即使没有辩论，在结构化或抗噪声的oracle访问下，交互式验证也是可行的。
Motivation: 现有的AI安全验证依赖辩论机制，即两个能力相当且其中一个诚实的AI模型相互辩论，这种假设在现实中可能不成立。本文旨在探索不需要辩论的单证明者交互式证明方案，以更实际地验证AI输出的对齐性。
Method: 提出针对oracle辅助计算（relativizing proofs）的双高效单证明者交互式证明和论证。考虑两种设置：(1) 计算是鲁棒的，即最多一小部分oracle查询答案错误时输出不变；(2) oracle是低阶多项式。
Result: 在鲁棒计算和低阶多项式oracle两种设置下，给出了有效的单证明者交互式证明方案，表明无需辩论即可实现交互式验证。
Conclusion: 在结构化或抗噪声的oracle访问场景下，单证明者交互式证明可以替代辩论机制，为AI安全验证提供更实际的方案。但本工作未涉及更一般的oracle访问场景。

papers.title: Latent Clarity: Bridging World-Model Kinematics to Semantic Manifolds for Video Anomaly Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: Continuous video anomaly detection is dominated by reactive Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) that collapses spatiotemporal features into scalar scores. We introduce PULS (Predictive Unified Latent Space), a continuous semantic world-model pipeline comprising two modules: a 490M-parameter KSD Bridge (Kinematic-to-Semantic Distillation) and a 16.8M-parameter Anticipatory State Predictor (ASP). The KSD Bridge maps V-JEPA 2 physical tensors into the 2048-d Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B text-aligned hypersphere, trained on a subset of UCF-Crime. This translation alone yields a chunk-level AUROC of 0.8994 for UCF-Crime and 0.8162 for out-of-distribution XD-Violence without MIL or hierarchical fusion. We introduce and validate the Latent Clarity Hypothesis: because JEPA's temporal predictor discards aleatoric pixel noise while preserving kinematics, anticipated future representations are more semantically separable than observed presents. The ASP sharpens these anticipated future latents, achieving 44.5% mean 14-way zero-shot VQA accuracy (exceeding observation baseline by +9.6 pp). Applying the ASP to Observation Tensors collapses accuracy to 7.3% (random chance), proving Anticipation and Observation occupy distinct sub-manifolds. A Triple-Track Lead-Time protocol with an L1-surprise gate yields a peak +8.9 pp anticipatory advantage at T-0.5s (p < 0.001, N = 1,000 permutation), separating physical anticipation from static scene priors. Zero-shot transfer to XD-Violence confirms that Newtonian-invariant kinematic representations generalize out-of-distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PULS（Predictive Unified Latent Space）框架，用于连续视频异常预测。该框架包含490M参数的KSD桥接模块（将运动学特征映射到语义流形）和16.8M参数的预测状态预测器（ASP）。在UCF-Crime数据集上，仅通过语义映射即实现0.8994的chunk-level AUROC，无需MIL或层次融合。实验验证了潜在清晰性假说：JEPA预测器丢弃噪声而保留运动学特征，使未来表征比当前观察更具语义可分性。ASP在14路零样本VQA中达到44.5%准确率，超过观察基线9.6个百分点。
Motivation: 连续视频异常检测主要依赖反应式的多实例学习（MIL），该方法将时空特征压缩为标量分数，无法有效利用语义信息进行预测。本文旨在通过构建运动学到语义流形的桥梁，实现视频异常的提前预测。
Method: 提出双模块框架：KSD桥接模块将V-JEPA 2的物理张量映射到Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B的2048维文本对齐超球面；ASP预测器用于锐化未来潜在表征。采用三元跟踪领先时间协议和L1惊奇门控来分离物理预测与静态场景先验。
Result: 在UCF-Crime上chunk-level AUROC达0.8994，在域外XD-Violence上为0.8162。ASP在14路零样本VQA中平均准确率44.5%（超过观察基线+9.6pp），而应用于观察张量时仅7.3%（随机水平）。在T-0.5s时刻获得+8.9pp的预测优势（p<0.001）。零样本迁移到XD-Violence验证了牛顿不变运动学表征的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文验证了潜在清晰性假说，表明通过运动学蒸馏和语义映射，未来表征比当前观察更具语义可分性。所提方法无需MIL或层次融合即可实现高性能异常预测，且零样本迁移到域外数据表现良好。

papers.title: iVISION-2DCD: A Long-Term Change Detection Dataset for Large-Scale Outdoor Construction Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Automation in construction is essential for reducing costs and human errors in large-scale projects. We approach the construction progress monitoring from the aspect of detecting changes in construction sites. As construction buildings continue to evolve in geometry and appearance over time, change detection need to be performed from arbitrary camera viewpoints. This necessitates developing 2D Change Detection (2DCD) algorithms that operate robustly across diverse camera perspectives at construction sites. While developing and evaluating such systems is data-intensive, no open-source benchmark dataset exists at the intersection of 2D change detection and construction automation research. Data collection using Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is gaining its popularity in outdoor large-scale surveying. However, in active construction sites conducting drone missions equipped with high-end sensors imposes safety concerns. Flight trajectory and collected camera viewpoints can be significantly limited. To address this critical gap, we introduce iVISION-2DCD, a large-scale synthetically generated dataset from dense LiDAR point clouds with photorealistic input images and accurate ground truth annotations. Our dataset formally defines the problem of viewpoint-robust 2DCD at construction sites and captures the inherent complexities of real-world deployment. In this paper, we present our systematic methodology for synthetic data generation, developing novel view synthesis techniques to overcome bi-temporal alignment and viewpoint diversity challenges, and implementing semi-automated semantic segmentation with change label generation while preserving challenging real-world cases. Benchmark evaluations using state-of-the-art 2DCD algorithms demonstrate that iVISION-2DCD poses novel research challenges for the computer vision and robotics communities.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026). Project page: https://danielmao2019.github.io/iVISION-2DCD-dataset.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了iVISION-2DCD，一个用于大型室外建筑监控的长期变化检测数据集。该数据集通过合成方式从密集LiDAR点云生成，包含逼真的输入图像和准确的地面真值标注，旨在解决建筑工地视角鲁棒的二维变化检测问题。论文介绍了数据生成方法、新颖的视图合成技术以及半自动语义分割与变化标签生成流程，并利用现有2DCD算法进行基准测试，表明数据集为计算机视觉和机器人学社区提出了新的研究挑战。
Motivation: 建筑自动化中，变化检测对于进度监控至关重要，但目前缺乏针对建筑工地的2D变化检测开源基准数据集。现有无人机数据采集存在安全性和视角限制，亟需一个能模拟真实复杂性的数据集。
Method: 从密集LiDAR点云合成生成大规模数据集，开发新颖的视图合成技术以克服双时相配准和视角多样性挑战，并实现半自动语义分割与变化标签生成，保留具有挑战性的真实世界案例。
Result: 使用现有最先进的2D变化检测算法进行基准评估，结果表明iVISION-2DCD提出了新的研究挑战。
Conclusion: 该数据集填补了2D变化检测与建筑自动化研究的交叉空白，有望推动该领域的发展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: WeightCLIP: Aligning Datasets and Models for Weight Space Learning
papers.abstract_en: Weight space learning aims to learn representations of neural network (NN) weights, enabling different downstream tasks. Existing approaches show promising performance, but lacking a way to shape these weight-space representations using information about the datasets the models were trained on, thus limiting downstream applications. We propose WeightCLIP, a method for learning a dataset-aligned latent space for neural networks, where datasets information is induced during training. The NNs are encoded as latent representations using an autoencoder, while dataset samples are encoded using a dataset encoder. The two representations are aligned using a contrastive objective, effectively reshaping the weight-space representations according to the datasets. We demonstrate that such representations can be used for different downstream tasks, including mapping dataset information to a weight-space representation that decode to strong models. In addition, we introduce a latent refinement process for generating models that outperforms standard fine-tuning. Overall, our results demonstrate that explicitly incorporating dataset information improves what can be achieved with weight-space representations across retrieval, generation, and refinement. Code will be available at https://github.com/HSG-AIML/WeightCLIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WeightCLIP，一种用于神经网络权重空间学习的方法，通过对比学习对齐神经网络权重表示与训练数据集表示。该方法使用自编码器编码网络权重，数据集编码器编码数据集样本，并通过对比目标对齐两者，从而在检索、生成和精炼等下游任务中取得改进。实验表明，显式引入数据集信息能提升权重空间表示的性能。
Motivation: 现有权重空间学习方法未能利用训练数据集信息来指导表示学习，限制了表示在下游任务中的有效性。
Method: WeightCLIP采用自编码器编码神经网络权重，数据集编码器编码数据集样本，通过对比学习目标对齐两种表示，使得权重空间表示融入数据集信息。
Result: 该方法在模型检索、生成和精炼任务上表现优于基线，且通过潜在精炼过程生成的模型在微调中表现更优。
Conclusion: 显式引入数据集信息能够提升权重空间表示的质量，拓展其在多种下游任务中的应用潜力。

papers.title: Applying Answer Set Programming with Fuzzy Membership Functions: a Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Human reasoning often operates through qualitative concepts expressed by linguistic labels such as high, low, expensive, or cheap, whose interpretation depends on context and is usually vague, despite being rooted in numerical data. This paper explores a novel fuzzy-logic-based qualitative extension of Answer Set Programming (ASP) to bridge numerical information and qualitative reasoning. The underlying language, formally introduced in a separate work, provides a principled framework that avoids rigid thresholds and supports robust reasoning under vagueness. Focusing on a representative use case, we illustrate how the framework integrates numerically grounded inputs (such as outputs of machine learning models) with symbolic reasoning over qualitative labels. Key features, including learning-based membership functions and semantically enriched predicates, enable the combination of expert knowledge, contextual factors, and subjective interpretations within a unified declarative setting.
papers.comment: A shorter version of this paper has been accepted at the 24th International Workshop on Nonmonotonic Reasoning (July 17-19, 2026, Lisbon, Portugal)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了一种基于模糊逻辑的定性扩展回答集编程（ASP），旨在桥接数值信息与定性推理。通过一个代表性用例，展示了该框架如何将机器学习模型的数值输出与定性的符号推理相结合，利用学习式隶属函数（membership functions）和语义丰富谓词（semantically enriched predicates）统一处理模糊性。
Motivation: 人类推理常使用诸如“高”、“低”等语言标签，但这些标签的解释依赖于语境且本质模糊，而现有方法常依赖刚性阈值。本文旨在提供一种避免刚性阈值、支持模糊性下稳健推理的框架。
Method: 提出一种基于模糊逻辑的定性扩展ASP，该语言在另一工作中正式定义。框架通过学习式隶属函数和语义谓词将数值输入（如机器学习输出）与定性标签的符号推理整合，支持专家知识、语境因素和主观解释的统一声明式建模。
Result: 通过一个代表性用例，展示了框架如何整合数值输入与定性推理，但摘要未报告定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 该框架能够在一个统一的声明式设置中结合专家知识、语境因素和主观解释，避免刚性阈值并支持模糊性下的推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MentalThink: Shaping Thoughts in Mental SVG World
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MentalThink, a visual-symbolic reasoning paradigm that equips Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) with an executable mechanism for "mental" visualization. The core of MentalThink is a think-with-SVG pipeline, where the model learns to generate, render, and interpret scalable vector graphics (SVG) code as an intermediate visual representation for multi-turn reasoning. By creating structured vector sketches, the model can externalize spatial hypotheses, inspect them through deterministic rendering, and reason within a constrained geometric space, effectively mimicking the human process of mental imagery. We instantiate this paradigm through a two-stage training framework, combining Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for SVG syntactic alignment with multi-turn Reinforcement Learning (RL) to encourage iterative inspection, revision, and refinement of intermediate visual hypotheses. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that MentalThink achieves superior performance on spatial understanding and reasoning benchmarks (e.g., 55.1% on VSIBench, 76.0% on MindCube), showing that executable vector graphics provide a verifiable visual workspace for dynamic perspective taking, visual reflection, and compositional scene construction.

papers.title: Aligning Language Models with Selective Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as critical decision-making components in high-stakes real-world AI systems, rendering LLM reliability a foremost practical concern. In this paper, we focus on enhancing LLM reliability through selective prediction (SP), a strategy that allows an LLM to only predict for inputs where it is likely to be correct (i.e., coverage) and hence reduce the error rate (i.e., risk) on that portion of inputs -- flagging the remaining inputs for future human discretion. In other words, SP improves LLM reliability by balancing the risk-coverage trade-off and enabling seamless human-AI collaboration. To integrate SP into LLMs, we focus on the LLM post-training alignment stage and propose to align LLMs with SP performance metrics, in contrast with existing LLM alignment methods that focus primarily on correctness or calibration metrics. Specifically, we propose a novel alignment framework, Reinforcement Learning for Selection Reward (RLSR), which targets the area under the risk-coverage curve (AURC) -- a popular SP performance metric -- as its alignment objective. RLSR achieves substantially better risk-coverage trade-off compared to multiple alignment baselines on both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICML 2026 Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond Workshop, Project Page: https://sun-umn.github.io/RLSR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过选择性预测（selective prediction）增强大语言模型的可靠性，使模型仅对可能正确的输入进行预测，从而平衡风险-覆盖率权衡。作者在模型后训练对齐阶段引入强化学习框架RLSR，以风险-覆盖率曲线下面积（AURC）为优化目标，在域内和域外任务上均优于多种对齐基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型在高风险场景中作为关键决策组件，其可靠性至关重要。现有对齐方法主要关注正确性或校准指标，未专门优化选择性预测性能。
Method: 提出RLSR（Reinforcement Learning for Selection Reward）框架，将AURC作为对齐目标，通过强化学习优化模型的选择性预测能力，使其在给定覆盖率下降低风险。
Result: 实验表明，RLSR在域内和域外任务上均显著优于多种对齐基线，实现了更好的风险-覆盖率权衡。
Conclusion: 选择性预测对齐是一种有前景的途径，可提升LLM可靠性并促进人机协作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Perceptual Flow Matching for Few-Step Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We propose Perceptual Flow Matching (PFM), a simple yet effective framework for few-step generation in flow-matching models. Rather than performing velocity regression in the conventional VAE latent space, PFM supervises flow matching in a perceptual feature space using pretrained perceptual models. This simple change substantially improves the few-step generation capability of flow-matching models, reducing the number of sampling steps from 35-50 to 4-8 while preserving generation quality. Unlike existing acceleration and distillation approaches, PFM requires neither teacher models nor auxiliary score networks and can be integrated into standard flow-matching training pipelines with minimal modifications. Extensive experiments on image generation, video generation, and image editing tasks demonstrate that PFM consistently produces high-quality results while producing fewer artifacts than existing distillation-based methods. We further show that perceptual supervision shifts the regression minimizer from mean-seeking to mode-seeking, biasing predictions toward on-manifold modes that remain accurate under coarse few-step integration. Our results reveal that standard flow-matching training can naturally yield high-quality few-step generators when supervised in an appropriate representation space. We hope this insight inspires future research into representation-aware objectives for efficient generative modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出感知流匹配（PFM），将流匹配的监督从VAE潜在空间迁移到预训练感知模型的特征空间，从而将采样步数从35-50降至4-8步，同时保持生成质量。PFM无需教师模型或辅助评分网络，可无缝集成到标准流匹配训练流程中。在图像生成、视频生成和图像编辑任务上，PFM生成的伪影少于现有蒸馏方法。分析表明感知监督使回归从均值搜索转向众数搜索，使预测更聚焦于流形上的模式，在粗步长积分下仍保持准确性。
Motivation: 现有流匹配模型需要35-50步采样才能获得高质量结果，而现有的加速和蒸馏方法通常需要教师模型或辅助网络，复杂度高且可能引入伪影。
Method: PFM在预训练感知模型（如LPIPS或DINOv2）的特征空间中对流匹配进行监督，而非在标准VAE潜在空间中进行速度回归。
Result: PFM将所需采样步数从35-50减少到4-8步；在图像生成、视频生成和图像编辑任务上产生更少伪影，且无需教师模型。
Conclusion: 标准流匹配训练在合适的表示空间监督下可以自然产生高质量的少步生成器，希望该发现启发未来对表示感知目标的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Co-Adaptive Multi-Task LoRA: Transfer-Aware, Label-Free Control of Domain Participation
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a single low-rank adapter on many domains at once is multi-task learning: the domains must be co-learned, and how they share the adapter decides whether they help or hurt one another. Most efficient fine-tuning pipelines ignore this and train on a fixed, uniform mixture, leaving two coupled questions unanswered: how much should each domain participate, and which domains should be co-trained given that some transfer positively and others interfere? We show that both answers can be read off cheaply and without labels. A forward pass of the current shared adapter over a small unlabeled probe yields, per domain, a competence signal whose level tracks remaining headroom and whose trajectory tracks learning speed; the drift of these probe representations yields a signed cross-domain affinity that predicts pairwise transfer. We fold both into CoDA, a co-adaptive controller that solves a small entropy-regularized quadratic program on the simplex to set each domain's participation -- jointly its loss weight and its share of the sampled data -- rewarding high-headroom, still-learning, mutually synergistic domains and damping interfering ones. The controller is forward-only, adds no trainable parameters, and wraps any multi-task LoRA pipeline. Across five heterogeneous domains and two backbones, CoDA improves the average over uniform mixing, learned mixtures, gradient-surgery multi-task optimizers, and online data selection while using half the data, and lowers cross-domain gradient conflict. We prove that the competence signal tracks domain risk, that the participation program has a unique fixed point reached by a contraction, and that its solution performs transfer-aware water-filling; analysis, ablations, and controls corroborate each claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoDA（Co-Adaptive Multi-Task LoRA），一种无标签的协同自适应控制器，用于多任务 LoRA 微调中动态调整各领域的参与度（损失权重和采样比例）。通过未标注探针的前向传播获取领域能力信号和跨域亲和度，求解熵正则化的二次规划来分配参与度，使高潜力、易学习、互促的领域获得更高权重，抑制干扰领域。实验在五个异构领域和两个骨干网络上验证，相比均匀混合、学习混合、梯度手术等多任务优化器和在线数据选择方法，CoDA 在使用一半数据的情况下平均性能更优，并降低了跨域梯度冲突。理论证明能力信号追踪领域风险，参与度规划有唯一不动点且为转移感知的水填充。
Motivation: 现有高效微调流水线通常采用固定的均匀混合训练多领域，未解答两个耦合问题：每个领域应参与多少，以及哪些领域应共同训练（因为某些领域正向迁移，另一些相互干扰）。需要一种无标签、低成本的方法以在线调整领域参与度。
Method: CoDA 控制器：在共享 LoRA 适配器上对少量未标注探针进行一次前向传播，得到每个领域的能力信号（其水平跟踪剩余空间，轨迹跟踪学习速度）和跨域亲和度（探针表示的漂移预测成对迁移）。然后求解一个单纯形上的小规模熵正则化二次规划，为每个领域设置参与度（同时作为损失权重和数据采样比例），奖励高潜力、仍在学习、相互协同的领域，压制干扰领域。控制器仅前向，无额外可训练参数，可包装任何多任务 LoRA 流水线。
Result: 在五个异构领域和两个骨干网络上，CoDA 相比均匀混合、学习混合、梯度手术多任务优化器和在线数据选择方法，平均性能更优，且仅使用一半数据。此外，跨域梯度冲突得以降低。理论分析证明能力信号追踪领域风险，参与度规划有唯一不动点且为收缩映射，其解实现转移感知的水填充。
Conclusion: CoDA 提供了一种无标签、轻量级的领域参与控制方法，证明通过探针信号和二次规划可有效管理多任务 LoRA 中的迁移互作用。实验和理论（能力信号风险追踪、不动点唯一性、水填充解释）均支持其有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Convergence of Adam, Revisited
papers.abstract_en: We show that projected Adam for online optimization with arbitrary moment decay parameters $β_1,β_2\in[0,1)$ can have average regret bounded away from zero. A similar result of Reddi-Kale-Kumar from 2018 required $β_1<\sqrt{β_2}$. Similar to their result, we use a three-periodic sequence of linear functions on $[-1,1]$ with slopes $c,-1,-1$, though we use $c$ slightly larger than $2$. This nonzero average regret result extends to Adam variants such as AdamW, RMSProp, NAdam, Adan, AdaMax, Muon, and to an i.i.d. variant of the three-periodic sequence of slopes for Adam.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明投影Adam算法在任意动量衰减参数β1,β2∈[0,1)下，在线优化中的平均遗憾可以远离零。此结果去除了Reddi等人2018年工作中β1<√β2的条件。通过构造三周期线性函数序列（斜率c>2）及其i.i.d.变体，该非零平均遗憾结果扩展至AdamW、RMSProp、NAdam、Adan、AdaMax、Muon等变体。
Motivation: 现有Adam收敛性分析通常要求动量衰减参数满足β1<√β2，本文旨在证明该条件并非必要，即任意参数下Adam都可能产生非零平均遗憾。
Method: 使用三周期线性函数序列，斜率分别为c（略大于2）、-1、-1，作用于区间[-1,1]；同时引入该序列的i.i.d.变体。在投影Adam框架下分析平均遗憾。
Result: 平均遗憾被证明可以远离零；该结果适用于Adam、AdamW、RMSProp、NAdam、Adan、AdaMax、Muon等优化器。
Conclusion: 揭示了Adam类优化器在某些简单序列上存在非零平均遗憾，提示实际应用中动量参数的选择可能影响收敛性保障。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Gaussians-Guided Schedule Design for Brownian Bridge Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Brownian Bridge Diffusion Models (BBDM) offer an appealing framework for image restoration and inverse problems by constructing a stochastic bridge from the clean signal directly to the degraded observation, rather than to pure noise. Despite their promise, the choice of bridge schedule is typically inherited from heuristics, and a principled analytical framework for schedule design has been lacking. In this work, we develop such a framework by offering a novel analysis of BBDM reverse dynamics under a Mixture-of-Gaussians (MoG) prior. This setting yields a closed-form ideal posterior and a corresponding MMSE denoiser, while the BBDM-induced reconstruction law is captured analytically through a tractable surrogate. Building on these expressions, we formulate two complementary schedule-design objectives: a Wasserstein criterion targeting perceptual quality and an MSE criterion targeting reconstruction fidelity. Our work exposes an inherent tradeoff between the two and proves the existence of universal schedules for both that are independent of the degradation and prior. Extensive experiments on controlled MoG settings confirm full alignment between theory and practice, and experiments on the FFHQ dataset across inpainting, deblurring, and super-resolution tasks validate the practical value of our schedule-design criteria.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 基于MoG先验分析BBDM反向动力学，得到闭式后验和MMSE去噪器；推导BBDM诱导的重建律的解析代理；据此提出Wasserstein（感知质量）和MSE（重建保真度）两种调度设计目标，并分析两者之间的权衡。
Result: 在可控MoG设置下理论与实验完全对齐；在FFHQ数据集上的修复、去模糊、超分辨率任务中验证了所提调度准则的实用价值。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了感知质量与重建保真度之间的固有权衡，并证明了存在独立于退化类型和先验的通用调度，为BBDM调度设计提供了理论依据。

papers.title: AGL-1: The Enterprise AI Governance Layer as a Control Plane for Trusted Enterprise Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise artificial intelligence is moving from isolated experimentation toward operational dependency across copilots, retrieval-augmented generation systems, autonomous agents, and AI-enabled business workflows. As this transition accelerates, the primary enterprise challenge is no longer only model access or inference scale. It is governed intelligence operations: the ability to enforce authorization, preserve contextual lineage, control persistent memory, detect stale or conflicting knowledge, constrain agentic execution, and produce audit-ready evidence across distributed AI estates. This paper introduces AGL-1, the Enterprise AI Governance Layer, as a vendor-neutral reference model for the control plane that should operate across foundation models, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, enterprise memory, policy engines, observability systems, tools, APIs, and business applications. Building on governed knowledge-system principles introduced in GKS-5, AGL-1 generalizes the governance problem from retrieval-specific controls to full AI execution-path governance. It identifies recurring failure modes such as unauthorized retrieval, stale grounding, unmanaged memory, weak provenance, policy drift, fragmented observability, and uncontrolled autonomous execution. It then defines seven governance domains: identity-aware retrieval, policy enforcement, provenance management, memory governance, knowledge integrity monitoring, agentic execution control, and trust observability. The central claim is that durable enterprise value from AI will increasingly depend on the ability to govern intelligence at scale. In complex enterprises, trust is not a property of the model alone. It is a property of the system around the model: identity, knowledge, policy, memory, tools, human oversight, and evidence working together as a managed control plane.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AGL-1，一个企业AI治理层参考模型，作为控制平面来管理跨基础模型、检索系统、编排框架等AI组件的信任、授权、上下文、记忆和执行。它定义七个治理域，旨在解决企业AI从实验转向运营依赖时的治理挑战。
Motivation: 企业AI从孤立实验转向运营依赖，面临授权、上下文追溯、记忆控制、知识一致性、代理执行约束和审计证据等治理挑战，现有解决方案缺乏统一的控制平面。
Method: 以GKS-5的知识系统原则为基础，将治理问题从检索扩展到完整AI执行路径，定义七个治理域：身份感知检索、策略执行、来源管理、记忆治理、知识完整性监控、代理执行控制和信任可观测性。
Result: 识别了常见故障模式如未授权检索、过时接地、未管理记忆、弱来源、策略漂移、碎片化可观测性和不受控自主执行，并提出治理域作为解决方案。
Conclusion: 企业AI的持久价值将取决于大规模智能治理能力，信任不是模型本身属性，而是围绕模型的系统属性。

papers.title: Relevance-Based Embeddings: Lightweight Candidate Retrieval via Heavy-Ranker Calls
papers.abstract_en: In many machine learning applications, the most relevant items for a query should be efficiently retrieved. The relevance function is usually an expensive similarity model, making the exhaustive search infeasible. A typical solution is to train another model that separately embeds queries and items to a vector space, where similarity is defined via the dot product or cosine similarity. This allows one to search the relevant items through fast approximate nearest neighbor search at the cost of some reduction in quality. To compensate for this reduction, the found items (candidates) are re-ranked by the expensive ranking model. In this paper, we investigate an alternative approach to candidate selection that utilizes the scores of the expensive model to improve the representations of queries and items. The idea is to describe each query (item) by its relevance to a set of support items (queries) and use these new representations to obtain query (item) embeddings. We theoretically prove that such embeddings are powerful enough to approximate any complex similarity model (under mild conditions). We also investigate the choice of support items, which is a crucial ingredient of the proposed approach. The experiments on diverse academic and production datasets illustrate the power of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于相关性的嵌入方法，通过利用昂贵排序模型的分数来改进查询和物品的表示，从而在候选检索中兼顾效率与质量。理论证明该方法能近似任意复杂相似性模型，实验在学术和生产数据集上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有两阶段检索中，候选生成阶段使用轻量嵌入可能损失质量，而重排序阶段成本高。本文旨在利用重排序模型的分数直接改进嵌入，减少质量损失。
Method: 通过将每个查询（物品）用其对一组支持物品（查询）的相关性分数来描述，得到新的嵌入表示。支持物品的选择是关键因素，论文对其进行了研究。
Result: 实验在多个学术和生产数据集上展示了方法的有效性，理论证明了在温和条件下能近似任意复杂相似性模型。
Conclusion: 提出的相关性嵌入方法为候选检索提供了一种替代方案，利用重排序模型分数改善嵌入，兼具理论保证和实际效果。
