papers.title: AquaGen: Scaling generative models to molecular dynamics precision on thousands of atoms
papers.abstract_en: We present AquaGen, the first all-atom, explicit solvent, periodic-boundary-condition-aware generative model that produces molecular configurations from the Boltzmann distribution at a fraction of the cost of molecular dynamics (MD). This is in contrast with existing generative models that remove degrees of freedom by operating on coarse-grained, vacuum, or implicit solvent systems. Operating at this resolution allows for post-processing through force field energy evaluations and MD simulations, and enables the prediction of relevant properties in a gray-box manner (as ensemble averages of potential energy evaluations over generated samples). We demonstrate the utility of this paradigm on absolute hydration free energy (AHFE), producing estimates 4-10x faster and with comparable accuracy to standard GPU-based MD. By generating uncorrelated samples from alchemical Boltzmann distributions, we create more accurate, interpretable, and refinable ensemble predictions with calibrated uncertainty estimates, unlike regression methods which are entirely black-box predictors. Our approach also yields predictable benefits from increasing train- and test-time compute, realized by scaling model size and generating more samples, respectively. We believe that this approach demonstrates the utility of high-resolution ensemble generation for free energy estimation, with future potential to replace MD in tasks such as the prediction of lipophilicity, membrane permeability, or absolute binding free energy (ABFE) -- whose grounding and interpretability may be critical for the development of new drugs and materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AquaGen，首个全原子、显式溶剂、周期边界条件感知的生成模型，从玻尔兹曼分布生成分子构型，成本远低于分子动力学（MD）。在绝对水合自由能（AHFE）估计上，速度比GPU MD快4-10倍且精度相当。该方法通过生成不相关样本实现更准确、可解释的集成预测，并随计算规模增长展现可预测的收益。
Motivation: 现有生成模型通常基于粗粒化、真空或隐式溶剂，丢失了自由度；而分子动力学昂贵。需要一种低成本且保持原子级别精度的生成模型以加速自由能估计。
Method: 提出全原子、显式溶剂、周期边界条件感知的生成模型AquaGen，直接从玻尔兹曼分布采样分子构型，并通过力场能量评估进行后处理。
Result: 在绝对水合自由能估计上，AquaGen比标准GPU MD快4-10倍，且精度相当；生成的集成预测具有校准的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: 作者认为高分辨率集成生成在自由能估计中很有用，未来有望替代MD用于亲脂性、膜渗透性、结合自由能等任务，对药物和材料开发有价值。

papers.title: CAGE-1: Control, Assurance, and Governance Evaluation for Enterprise Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise artificial intelligence is moving from experimentation into operational workflows. Early programs focused on model access and retrieval-augmented generation, but enterprises are now beginning to deploy agents that plan, retrieve, remember, call tools, update systems, and coordinate work across applications. This changes the evaluation problem. Leaders are no longer asking only whether an answer is accurate or fluent. They need to know who authorized an action, which policy applied, whether evidence was current, whether memory was valid, whether a tool call was permitted, whether the decision can be replayed, and whether the agent can be stopped before it creates business impact. This paper introduces CAGE-1: Control, Assurance, and Governance Evaluation for Enterprise Agentic AI. CAGE-1 is an evaluation framework for deciding whether enterprise agents are ready for deployment. It evaluates authority, policy enforcement, retrieval quality, memory integrity, tool safety, auditability, human oversight, conflict handling, safe failure, Prebind Assurance, operational readiness, and business fitness. CAGE-1 introduces Prebind Assurance to describe the evaluated ability to prove that an agentic action is controlled before it becomes binding, effective, or operationally consequential. The framework tests whether a proposed action is admitted, held, narrowed, refused, escalated, quarantined, or made non-effective before protected consequence forms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAGE-1，一个评估企业级 AI 代理（agentic AI）是否可部署的框架，涵盖授权、策略执行、检索质量、记忆完整性、工具安全性、可审计性、人工监督、冲突处理、安全失效、预绑定保障（Prebind Assurance）、操作就绪度和业务适应性等维度。预绑定保障用于证明代理行动在成为具有约束力的结果之前已受控制。
Motivation: 企业 AI 从实验转向运营，部署的代理能规划、检索、记忆、调用工具、更新系统并跨应用协调工作，传统的评估（如答案准确性或流畅性）不再足够，企业需要知道谁授权了行动、应用了哪些政策、证据是否最新、记忆是否有效、工具调用是否被允许、决策能否重放以及在造成业务影响前能否停止代理。
Method: CAGE-1 框架，定义 12 个评估维度，包括权威性、策略执行、检索质量、记忆完整性、工具安全性、可审计性、人工监督、冲突处理、安全失效、预绑定保障、操作就绪度和业务适应性。引入预绑定保障概念，测试行动在被保护结果形成前是否被允许、保留、缩小、拒绝、升级、隔离或失效。
Result: 本文是技术报告，未报告具体实验数据，而是描述了框架的结构与评估范围。
Conclusion: CAGE-1 为企业代理 AI 的部署准备提供系统化的控制、保证和治理评估框架，强调在行动成为约束性结果前对其进行控制。

papers.title: Flex-Forcing: Towards a Unified Autoregressive and Bidirectional Video Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in large-scale generative models has substantially advanced video generation, yet existing methods remain constrained by a rigid inference paradigm. Bidirectional diffusion models excel at global coherence and visual fidelity but suffer from slow inference, while autoregressive models offer efficient and streaming generation at the cost of long-range consistency and exposure bias. We introduce Flex-Forcing, a unified training and inference framework that enables a video diffusion model to seamlessly operate under both bidirectional and autoregressive generation regimes. The core idea is a flexible chunking mechanism jointly defined over the temporal axis and denoising steps. This design allows the model to (1) perform flexible chunking according to different device budgets, (2) perform bidirectional inference across chunks for global structure planning, while generating frames autoregressively within each chunk for efficient and fine-grained synthesis, and (3) perform any-order, any-timestep autoregressive generation without the strict causal constraint. Extensive experiments on multiple video generation benchmarks demonstrate that Flex-Forcing achieves consistently better video quality, long-video stability than strong baselines with a rigid inference schedule, while offering faster inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flex-Forcing，一个统一的训练和推理框架，使视频扩散模型能够同时支持双向和自回归生成模式。通过灵活的时序分块机制，模型可在不同设备预算下进行分块，跨块双向推理以规划全局结构，块内自回归生成以实现高效细粒度合成，并支持任意顺序、任意时间步的自回归生成。在多个视频生成基准上，Flex-Forcing 在视频质量和长视频稳定性上优于强基线，并实现更快的推理。
Motivation: 现有视频生成方法受限于僵化的推理范式：双向扩散模型全局一致性好但推理慢，自回归模型生成高效但长程一致性差且存在曝光偏差。需要一个统一框架兼具两者优势。
Method: 提出 Flex-Forcing 框架，核心是灵活的时序分块机制，将时间轴与去噪步骤联合定义，使得模型可灵活分块、跨块双向推理、块内自回归生成，并支持任意顺序和任意时间步的自回归生成，无需严格因果约束。
Result: 在多个视频生成基准上，Flex-Forcing 在视频质量和长视频稳定性上持续优于采用固定推理调度的强基线，同时推理速度更快。
Conclusion: Flex-Forcing 实现了双向与自回归扩散模型的统一，兼顾全局计划与局部效率，为视频生成提供了更灵活高效的推理范式。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Flex-Forcing，一个统一的训练和推理框架，使视频扩散模型能够同时支持双向和自回归生成模式。通过灵活的时序分块机制，模型可在不同设备预算下进行分块，跨块双向推理以规划全局结构，块内自回归生成以实现高效细粒度合成，并支持任意顺序、任意时间步的自回归生成。在多个视频生成基准上，Flex-Forcing 在视频质量和长视频稳定性上优于强基线，并实现更快的推理。

papers.title: A Near-Linear-Time Solver for Graph $p$-Laplacian Semi-Supervised Learning via Continuation in $p$
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based semi-supervised learning (SSL) propagates a few labels over a similarity graph by minimizing a Dirichlet-type energy. The standard quadratic ($p=2$) energy reduces to a single graph-Laplacian solve, but it degenerates exactly where SSL is most useful when labels are scarce: gathering more unlabeled data drives the $p=2$ estimate to a near-constant function whenever $d\ge2$ (Nadler-Srebro-Zhou). Well-posedness requires the nonlinear $p$-Laplacian energy with $p>d$. Existing solvers reduce this to a sequence of weighted Laplacian solves, but their reference implementations use a direct sparse factorization or ichol-preconditioned CG instead. Plugging a near-linear Laplacian solver is not straightforward: at large $p$ the conductance weights degenerate near flat-gradient edges, making the system nearly singular and causing stagnation without a damped outer iteration. We close this gap. Recasting $p$-Laplacian SSL as a source-form nonlinear Laplacian flow $Bρ_p(B^\top x)=b$ and solving by damped chord-Newton continuation in $p$, every linearized system stays well-conditioned and can be delegated to a near-linear Laplacian engine. On size-scaled graph families the wall-clock is empirically $m^{0.96}$-$m^{1.02}$ per family (approximate Cholesky default), and a pooled fit across 228 SuiteSparse graphs gives $m^{1.19}$ vs.\ $m^{1.45}$ for direct factorization; the solver handles a $6.8\times10^7$-edge social network in minutes. Memory is the binding constraint: Cholesky fill reaches $10$-$280\times$ the graph nonzeros vs.\ our $O(m)$ hierarchy. Against the released FCL solver we are $1.5$-$14\times$ faster at matched accuracy. On MNIST $10$-NN, $p=3$ scores $64\%$ at one label per class vs.\ $36\%$ for $p=2$. Code: https://github.com/orenlivne/np.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种近线性时间求解图p-Laplacian半监督学习问题的算法。通过将问题重写为源形式非线性Laplacian流并使用阻尼弦牛顿延续法在p上求解，所有线性系统保持良态，可委托给近线性Laplacian引擎。实验表明，在SuiteSparse图上计算复杂度约m^1.19，可处理6.8×10^7边的社交网络图，且比直接分解和FCL求解器更快。
Motivation: 标准二次能量(p=2)在标签稀缺时退化为近似常数函数，而p>d的非线性p-Laplacian能量是良态的。现有求解器依赖直接稀疏分解或预条件CG，难以利用近线性Laplacian求解器，因为大p时电导权重退化导致系统近奇异。
Method: 将p-Laplacian SSL重写为源形式非线性流Bρ_p(B^T x)=b，并采用阻尼弦牛顿延续法在p上求解，使得每个线性化系统保持良态，从而可用近线性Laplacian引擎高效求解。
Result: 在尺寸缩放图族上，实测复杂度为m^0.96至m^1.02；在228个SuiteSparse图上整体复杂度m^1.19，而直接分解为m^1.45。可处理6.8×10^7边的社交网络。与FCL求解器相比，在相同精度下快1.5-14倍。MNIST 10-NN上，p=3每类仅1个标签时准确率64%，p=2为36%。
Conclusion: 该方法首次将p-Laplacian SSL求解的复杂度降至近线性，克服了传统方法在大p时的数值困难，且内存需求为O(m)，远低于Cholesky分解。代码已开源。

papers.title: Reading Between the Dots: Decoding Hidden Computation across Filler Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Frontier LLMs can perform multi-step reasoning over content-free filler tokens like dots or counting sequences, producing correct answers with no visible chain-of-thought (CoT). This is a limit case for behavioral oversight, where surface tokens carry no information about the underlying reasoning. But hidden from the output is not the same as hidden from us. On four task families (fact retrieval, parallel numeric composition, string manipulation, and in-context computation), two open-weights frontier models (DeepSeek V3, Kimi K2) compute over filler tokens in a structured, legible way: attention routes the question through the filler region to the answer, logit-lens readouts show retrieved facts emerging early and their composition crystallizing in late layers, and KV-cache transplants at filler positions causally swap outputs between examples. We introduce an unsupervised decoding pipeline that takes only hidden states as input and recovers intermediate values with 80-95% accuracy (best LLM judge) across both models and all four tasks, without ground-truth labels or training. Hidden computation that defeats behavioral CoT monitoring is, on these tasks, directly readable from the residual stream, suggesting monitorability is a property of the model's full computational trace, not just its surface tokens.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前沿LLM（DeepSeek V3、Kimi K2）如何在无意义填充符（如点）上进行多步推理，输出正确答案而无显式思维链。通过注意力分析、logit透镜和KV缓存移植，发现模型在填充符上执行结构化计算，且可从残差流中无监督解码出中间值，准确率达80-95%。
Motivation: LLM能在填充符上执行隐藏推理，绕过了基于输出token的行为监督，因此需要探究这类隐藏计算的可监控性。
Method: 在事实检索、并行数值组合、字符串操作和上下文计算四类任务上，对开源前沿模型进行注意力路由分析、logit透镜读取和KV缓存因果移植，并设计无监督解码流水线仅利用隐藏状态恢复中间值。
Result: 无监督解码管道无需真实标签或训练，以最佳LLM评判标准在两类模型和全部任务上达到80-95%的中间值恢复准确率。
Conclusion: 隐藏计算虽然击败了行为CoT监控，但可直接从残差流中读取，表明可监控性源于模型完整计算轨迹而非仅表面token。

papers.title: STRATOS: Bridging the Symbolic-to-Numeric Gap in Spatio-Temporal Text-to-SQL for Meteorological Data
papers.abstract_en: Copernicus, the European Union's Earth observation program, produces petabytes of Earth observation and climate data, offering immense potential for research, policy, and applications. However, access to these datasets requires advanced programming skills and familiarity with domain-specific formats such as NetCDF or GRIB. Moreover, general-purpose Text-to-SQL systems fail when applied naively to the meteorological domain due to a profound ``Symbolic-to-Numeric'' gap. To overcome these limitations, we present an end-to-end Text-to-SQL framework specifically engineered for real-world, scalable meteorological data exploration. Our system intercepts natural language to resolve spatial and semantic ambiguities \textit{before} SQL generation. We design STRATOS, a Spatio-Temporal Resolution Agent for Text-to-SQL to dynamically bridge the symbolic-to-numeric gap by mapping fuzzy concepts to a localized ontology and resolving spatial entities via external knowledge bases. Further, our complexity-aware query rewriter rewrites expensive spatial predicates, reducing execution times from hours to seconds. Last, we introduce the STRATOS Evaluation Workload, comprising 7,520 complex query pairs explicitly designed by domain experts to test scalability and symbolic-to-numeric translation across challenging spatio-temporal dimensions previously unexplored by Text-to-SQL systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STRATOS，一个专为气象数据设计的端到端Text-to-SQL框架，解决符号到数值（Symbolic-to-Numeric）的转换问题。系统在SQL生成前解析自然语言中的空间和语义模糊性，通过动态映射模糊概念到本地化本体和外部知识库来桥接符号-数值差距。复杂度感知的查询重写器将昂贵空间谓词执行时间从小时降至秒。同时引入包含7520个复杂查询对的STRATOS评估工作负载。
Motivation: 哥白尼等地球观测数据需高级编程技能和领域特定格式（如NetCDF/GRIB）知识，通用Text-to-SQL系统因符号-数值差距而失效，需要专门面向气象数据探索的框架。
Method: STRATOS包含三个组件：1) 自然语言解析器在SQL生成前解决空间和语义歧义；2) 时空解析Agent动态桥接符号-数值差距，通过外部知识库解析空间实体；3) 复杂度感知查询重写器优化空间谓词，大幅降低执行时间。
Result: 查询重写器将执行时间从小时降至秒。评估工作负载包含7520个复杂查询对，由领域专家设计测试可扩展性和符号-数值转换。
Conclusion: STRATOS为气象数据探索提供可行的Text-to-SQL方案，但局限在于依赖外部知识库和本体，可能未覆盖所有气象数据格式。

papers.title: Towards Standardized Light Field Quality Assessment: Hybrid Subjective Benchmarking and Objective Metric Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking immersive media coding solutions, especially in the standardization context, requires reliable and reproducible subjective quality assessment (QA) procedures, along with objective quality metrics that remain accurate across different distortion types. This paper presents a standardized workflow for light field QA, developed and deployed in the context of JPEG Pleno standardization activities, which integrates benchmark generation, a hybrid subjective evaluation, and objective metric analysis into a common workflow. The benchmark is designed to encompass not only traditional coding-only artifacts but also distortions that arise in processing pipelines in which light field encoding is accompanied with view synthesis and reconstruction techniques. A hybrid subjective method is proposed enabling fine-grained assessment by combining reference-anchored quality rating with targeted pairwise refinement in perceptually ambiguous regions. The reliability of subjective scores is verified using statistical consistency analyses between observers of two cohorts. Finally, a large set of objective metrics is systematically evaluated in terms of global prediction accuracy, local agreement in ambiguous quality regions, and robustness across distortion families. The results show that several metrics achieve strong agreement for coding-only stimuli, but their performance consistently drops when view synthesis distortions are included. The analysis further highlights the importance of view-pooling strategy in the design of future light field quality metrics. The work provides a reproducible and standardization-ready framework for fine-grained light field QA, while identifying key limitations of current objective metrics under emerging coding pipelines. The subjectively annotated dataset is publicly available at https://plenodb.jpeg.org/lfqa/objectivecfp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光场质量问题评估提出标准化工作流，结合混合主观评价和客观指标分析，适用于JPEG Pleno标准。包含编码失真和视图合成失真，通过参考锚定质量评分和成对细化进行细粒度评估。客观指标在仅编码失真时表现良好，但引入视图合成失真后性能下降，强调了视图池化策略的重要性。
Motivation: 现有光场质量评估缺乏标准化流程，且客观指标在复杂处理管道（如编码加视图合成）中准确性不足，亟需可靠且可重复的评估框架。
Method: 提出标准化工作流，包含基准生成、混合主观评价（参考锚定评分结合成对细化）和客观指标系统评估，使用统计一致性分析验证主观评分可靠性。
Result: 多个客观指标在仅编码失真时与主观评分高度一致，但加入视图合成失真后性能下降；视图池化策略对度量设计至关重要。数据集公开。
Conclusion: 提供了可复现的标准化光场质量评估框架，并指出现有客观指标在新兴编码管道中的局限性。

papers.title: Learning to Generate Multiple Objects from Dense and Occluded Layouts
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models fail to generate correct object counts in dense scenes, where overlapping instances collapse into indistinguishable structures despite appearing visually plausible. We identify this as instance ownership collapse: tokens from overlapping objects interact freely through attention, while heavily occluded instances receive weak supervision due to their small visible areas. We address this through layout-aware attention biases that softly bias token interactions toward region-consistent grouping and suppress cross-instance leakage, paired with an amodal-balanced loss that amplifies gradients for occluded objects based on their occlusion level. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce OverlapDepth-45K, a benchmark of densely overlapping scenes with amodal supervision. Our approach substantially improves count accuracy and prevents instance merging while preserving image quality. Project page: https://bachngoh.github.io/AIBL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型在密集场景中无法生成正确对象计数的问题，识别出实例所有权崩溃 (instance ownership collapse) 现象，并提出布局感知注意力偏置 (layout-aware attention biases) 和 amodal 平衡损失 (amodal-balanced loss) 来改善。同时引入 OverlapDepth-45K 基准，用于评估密集重叠场景的生成质量。实验表明该方法显著提升计数准确性并防止实例合并。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在密集遮挡场景中生成的对象数量不准确，重叠实例会合并为不可区分的结构，原因是重叠对象的 token 通过注意力自由交互，而被严重遮挡的实例因可见区域小导致监督信号弱。
Method: 提出布局感知注意力偏置，软性地将token交互偏向区域一致分组并抑制跨实例泄露；结合 amodal 平衡损失，根据遮挡程度放大被遮挡对象的梯度。
Result: 在 OverlapDepth-45K 基准上，该方法显著提升对象计数准确性，防止实例合并，同时保持图像质量。
Conclusion: 本文的方法能有效处理密集遮挡场景中的实例生成问题，所提基准可促进该领域的系统评估。

summary_sections.result: 在 OverlapDepth-45K 基准上，该方法显著提升对象计数准确性，防止实例合并，同时保持图像质量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文的方法能有效处理密集遮挡场景中的实例生成问题，所提基准可促进该领域的系统评估。

papers.title: Towards Diverse and Comprehensive Benchmarks for Mutual Information Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Mutual information (MI) estimation is a central problem in machine learning and statistics; however, existing benchmarks typically evaluate estimators on simplified, low-dimensional distributions, leaving their performance on complex, realistic data largely unexplored. We address this gap with a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in a unified copula-theoretic perspective that subsumes existing benchmarks as special cases. Within this framework, we propose two complementary families of tests: a copula-first family that systematically varies ground-truth MI, dimensionality, and marginal complexity using synthetic and flow-based transformations; and a marginals-first family that couples real-world image data with controlled dependency structures, extending the classic same-class-pairing paradigm. We use this suite to extensively evaluate three classes of estimators: non-parametric, discriminative, and generative. Contrary to prevailing assumptions, our results indicate that there is no universal winner: each category can systematically outperform all other estimators under specific setups. By analyzing these cases, we identify fundamental estimation barriers and propose new tests that more effectively stress these specific limitations. We share the open source code at https://github.com/VanessB/mutinfo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对互信息估计中现有基准过于简化的问题，提出一个基于copula理论的统一框架，包含两个互补的测试族：一类从copula出发系统变化真实MI、维度和边际复杂度，另一类从边际出发将真实图像数据与受控依赖结构结合。评估了非参数、判别式和生成式三类估计器，发现不存在通用最优估计器，不同设置下各类估计器可能系统性胜出，并据此识别了基本估计障碍。
Motivation: 现有互信息估计基准通常基于低维简化分布，无法反映复杂真实数据上的表现，缺乏系统性评估框架。
Method: 提出基于copula理论的统一基准框架，涵盖copula-first和marginals-first两个测试族：前者通过合成和流变换系统控制真实MI、维度和边际复杂度；后者将真实图像数据与受控依赖结构耦合，扩展了经典同类配对范式。
Result: 三类估计器（非参数、判别式、生成式）在特定设置下均能系统性优于其他估计器，不存在通用最优解。
Conclusion: 该基准能够暴露不同估计器的特定局限，并提出了更具挑战性的新测试。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Demonstrating Generalization Failures via Mixtures of Conditional Policies
papers.abstract_en: Post-training of frontier language models is conducted on curated task suites, and inevitably leaves a distribution shift between training and deployment environments. This exposes developers to generalization failures, which are relatively poorly understood. To better understand such generalization failures, we believe the community should construct clean demonstrations under simplified conditions. To facilitate this, we propose a simple and flexible way to construct language models which fail to generalize in controllable ways when subsequently trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL) on a given distribution of training tasks. Our construction uses Supervised Fine-Tuning on a dataset of a mixture of transcripts corresponding to a collection of 'conditional policies', which can each independently be assigned certain behaviors on each different task distribution, to obtain a model that is then well approximated as a 'mixture of conditional policies.' We observe that RL training then selects for policies that obtain the highest reward on the training distribution. This can produce striking behaviors: in a controlled setting with two distributions containing identical questions prepended with two different 'trigger strings', RL training on either distribution actively degrades performance on the other to zero, even though the underlying task is identical. We also use our construction to illustrate two novel ways in which generalization may fail in future language models, corresponding to distribution shifts of task coverage and temporal context respectively. While our construction is deliberately simple and may not closely resemble 'natural' generalization failures, the resulting 'model organisms' are of interest for alignment stress-testing and generalization science, and can be used as existence proofs that training success and generalization can come apart in structured ways.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过监督微调混合条件策略数据集来构建语言模型的方法，使得模型在后续强化学习训练中表现出可控的泛化失败。实验表明，在包含两个带有不同触发字符串的相同问题分布的设置中，RL训练会主动将另一分布的性能降至零。作者还展示了两种新的泛化失败模式，分别对应任务覆盖和时间上下文的分布偏移。
Motivation: 后训练阶段存在训练与部署环境的分布偏移，导致泛化失败难以理解。需要构建简化条件下的清晰演示以促进研究。
Method: 使用监督微调从混合条件策略的轨迹数据集中学习，得到近似为条件策略混合的模型，然后在该模型上进行强化学习训练。
Result: 在受控设置中，两个分布包含相同问题但附加不同触发字符串，RL训练在任一分布上都会使另一分布的性能完全降为零。
Conclusion: 虽然构造简单，但提供了一种存在性证明，表明训练成功与泛化能力可以结构化地分离，有助于对齐压力测试和泛化科学研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhysMirror: Physics-Aware Mirror Object Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing physically accurate mirror reflections remains a fundamental challenge for modern text-to-image diffusion models, which are increasingly critical for generating synthetic training data for embodied AI and robotic perception. These models typically struggle with strict geometric constraints, leading to hallucinations that degrade the utility of the synthetic data. To address this, we introduce a novel, end-to-end physics-aware generation framework namely PhysMirror that natively enforces projective geometry through explicit 3D spatial priors. Our method automatically lifts prompted objects into 3D meshes and constructs a lightweight, mathematically exact mirror scene within a simulated environment. By rendering this explicit 3D scene, we extract precise 2D conditioning elements, such as depth maps and segmentation maps, that serve as robust guiding signals for downstream diffusion models, guiding them to generate images with physically correct mirror reflections. Moreover, we introduce Mirror Consistency Score (MCS), reference-free, fully automated metric that quantifies physical correctness using dense feature matching and vanishing point convergence. Experimental results on our newly constructed MirrOB dataset demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in reflection accuracy and physical realism, while maintaining strong text-to-image semantic alignment, providing a reliable pipeline for embodied AI data generation. The source code is released at https://duyphuc0701.github.io/PhysMirror.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhysMirror，一个端到端的物理感知生成框架，用于合成具有物理正确镜面反射的图像。该方法通过将提示物体提升为3D网格并构建精确的镜子场景，提取深度图和分割图作为条件引导扩散模型，并引入Mirror Consistency Score (MCS)量化物理正确性。在MirrOB数据集上，该方法在反射准确性和物理真实性上超越基线，同时保持文本-图像语义对齐。
Motivation: 现代文本到图像扩散模型在生成物理准确的镜面反射时存在几何约束问题，导致幻觉，影响合成数据在具身AI和机器人感知中的效用。
Method: 提出PhysMirror框架，将物体自动提升为3D网格并构建精确的镜子场景，从显式3D场景渲染深度图和分割图作为条件信号，引导扩散模型生成物理正确的反射。
Result: 在MirrOB数据集上，PhysMirror在反射准确性和物理真实性上优于现有基线，同时保持强文本-图像语义对齐。引入的MCS指标能自动化量化物理正确性。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种可靠的管道用于生成具身AI训练数据，强调了显式3D先验对于物理正确图像生成的重要性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CaresAI at SMM4H-HeaRD 2026: Predicting TNM Staging
papers.abstract_en: This study aims to predict Tumor, Node, and Metastasis (TNM) stage labels independently, with the Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) pathology report as the sixth shared task of SMM4H-HeaRD 2026. The problem is framed as three multi-label classification tasks. We explore both classical and deep learning approaches using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) features and embeddings from ClinicalBERT, BioBERT, and PubMedBERT. These representations are used with Logistic Regression (LR), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), Feed-Forward Neural Networks (FFNN), and Wide Residual Networks (WRN). Our results show that individual embeddings perform similarly to the TNM label classification, while their combination improves its predictive ability. WRN achieves AUROC scores of 0.839 (T), 0.8502 (N), and 0.803 (M) with F1-scores of 0.622, 0.702, and 0.9337, respectively, for the training phase. LightGBM with TF-IDF performs best with AUROC scores of 0.9368 (T), 0.9524 (N), and 0.8311 (M) and F1-scores of 0.7559 (T), 0.7384 (N), and 0.7017 (M) during the training phase. Furthermore, the result of the Codabench for the test sets indicates a Macro-F1 score of 0.978, 0.957, and 0.879 for the T, N, and M categories respectively for test set 1; while test set 2 records a Macro-F1 score for T, N, and M is 0.807, 0.767, 1.0 respectively. However, performance declined during the evaluation phase of the test sets, a drop from 0.938 to 0.858 of test set 1 to 2, for the Macro-F1 score across all stages; suggesting limitations in model generalizability, sensitivity to class imbalance, and challenges in processing lengthy clinical documents. Although this study provides an efficient baseline model and a reproducible pipeline, further optimization and validation are required before it can be considered suitable for use in a real-world clinical setting.
papers.journal_ref: Association for Computational Linguistics 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对SMM4H-HeaRD 2026共享任务，使用TCGA病理报告独立预测TNM分期标签，将其作为三个多标签分类任务。探索了TF-IDF和ClinicalBERT、BioBERT、PubMedBERT嵌入结合Logistic Regression、LightGBM、FFNN、WRN等方法。结果表明单独嵌入表现相似，组合提升预测能力；WRN在训练阶段取得AUROC分别为0.839、0.8502、0.803，LightGBM+TF-IDF取得0.9368、0.9524、0.8311；但测试集上性能下降，表明泛化性有限。
Motivation: 现有TNM分期预测通常依赖人工标注，自动化方法面临类不平衡和长文本处理挑战。
Method: 将TNM分期预测视为三个独立的多标签分类任务，使用TF-IDF和多种BERT嵌入（ClinicalBERT、BioBERT、PubMedBERT）作为特征，分别用LR、LightGBM、FFNN、WRN进行训练。
Result: 训练阶段LightGBM+TF-IDF表现最佳，AUROC最高达0.9524（N），F1达0.7559（T）；WRN也表现不错。但测试集1与2之间Macro-F1从0.938降至0.858，显示泛化能力不足。
Conclusion: 研究提供了可复现的基线模型和流程，但在实际临床使用前仍需优化和验证，特别是解决类不平衡和长文档处理问题。

papers.title: WorldBagel: Uncovering the Power of Unified Multimodal Models for Vision-Language-Action-World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World models aim to capture environment dynamics in ways that support perception, reasoning, and action, and have recently become a central direction in Vision-Language-Action-World (VLAW) modeling. Meanwhile, unified vision-language models have demonstrated strong multimodal generation capabilities, yet their potential as world models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce \texttt{WorldBagel}, a unified VLAW framework built on BAGEL, a modern multimodal unified model, and use it to systematically investigate the role of unification in world modeling. Across multi-task robotic manipulation and cross-domain experiments, \texttt{WorldBagel} consistently outperforms task-specific alternatives and learns action representations that are more structured and semantically aligned with visual and linguistic context. Experiments on LIBERO, Language Table, and Franka show that unification is not only an architectural convenience, but also a key factor in learning effective VLAW models, leading to consistent empirical gains and deeper insights into multimodal world modeling. Code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldBagel，一个基于 BAGEL 的统一多模态 VLAW 框架，用于研究视觉-语言-动作-世界建模中统一的作用。在 LIBERO、Language Table 和 Franka 等多任务机器人操作实验中，WorldBagel 一致优于任务特定模型，并学习到更结构化、语义对齐的动作表示。
Motivation: 现有世界模型主要关注环境动力学，而统一多模态模型作为世界模型的潜力未被充分探索。本文旨在系统研究统一化在世界建模中的关键作用。
Method: 基于 BAGEL 多模态统一模型构建 WorldBagel 框架，在机器人操作任务中比较统一模型与任务特定模型的性能。
Result: 在 LIBERO、Language Table 和 Franka 实验上，WorldBagel 一致优于任务特定替代方案，且学到的动作表示与视觉和语言上下文更对齐。
Conclusion: 统一化不仅是架构上的便利，更是学习有效 VLAW 模型的关键因素，带来一致的实证提升。

papers.title: ADP: Adversarial Dynamics Priors for Physically Grounded Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Adversarial Dynamics Priors (ADP) for perturbation-resilient humanoid locomotion control. Existing motion prior-based methods induce natural motion styles by imitating kinematic motion features, but they do not directly regularize dynamics features, such as CoM motion, centroidal momentum, contact forces, and contact states. To address this limitation, we replace kinematic motion-style feature with selected dynamics features extracted from locomotion trajectories as the target of adversarial regularization.To this end, we use trajectory optimization to construct a reference dataset and train a discriminator to evaluate whether policy-induced temporal windows are consistent with the resulting reference distribution.Without explicit motion tracking, ADP encourages policy rollouts to remain close to the reference support, even after perturbations. Experimental results show that, compared with AMP, the strongest baseline in our evaluation, ADP improves the $80\%$-success impulse threshold ($J_{80}$) by $16.7\%$, while reducing direction-averaged recovery time and velocity tracking error by $47.9\%$ and $35.4\%$, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对抗动力学先验 (ADP) 用于抗扰动的人形机器人运动控制。现有方法通过模仿运动学特征来诱导自然运动风格，但未直接正则化动力学特征（如质心运动、接触力等）。ADP 用轨迹优化构建参考数据集，通过判别器对策略生成的动力学特征窗口进行对抗性正则化，使其在受到扰动后仍接近参考分布。实验表明，相比强基线 AMP，ADP 将 80% 成功扰动阈值提升 16.7%，恢复时间降低 47.9%，速度跟踪误差降低 35.4%。
Motivation: 现有运动先验方法仅模仿运动学特征，缺乏对动力学特征（如质心运动、接触力等）的直接正则化，导致人形机器人在受到扰动时鲁棒性不足。
Method: 使用轨迹优化构建参考数据集，训练一个判别器来评估策略生成的时序窗口是否与参考分布一致；通过对抗性正则化使策略 rollout 在扰动后仍接近参考支撑集，无需显式运动跟踪。
Result: 与 AMP 基线相比，ADP 将 80% 成功扰动阈值（J80）提高 16.7%，方向平均恢复时间降低 47.9%，速度跟踪误差降低 35.4%。

papers.title: Best-of-Better-$N$: Generating Pre-Aligned Responses with In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time alignment methods, such as Best-of-$N$, offer a flexible alternative to training-based alignment by using reward models to select high-quality responses generated by a reference LLM. However, the efficacy of these methods is inherently limited by the response quality: if the reference LLM assigns negligible probability to high-reward responses, no selection strategy will succeed in finding aligned outputs. In this work, we propose Best-of-Better-$N$ (BoBN), an in context learning-based generation framework to address this challenge. Our method utilizes retrieval from high-reward examples relevant to the input query and task. Crucially, we introduce a restyling step where retrieved responses are rewritten by the reference LLM to align with the target task's format and style. These restyled examples are used in-context to shift the sampling distribution toward the high-reward region. We analytically characterize how in-context learning shifts the output distribution of pretrained transformers toward the high-reward region, resulting in provable benefits on the target task. We then evaluate BoBN on safety alignment and mathematical reasoning benchmarks across several reference LLMs. BoBN's higher-quality responses enable better performance to be achieved when the number of responses $N$ is fixed, and smaller $N$ required to achieve a target performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Best-of-Better-N (BoBN) 方法，通过利用与输入查询和任务相关的高奖励示例进行上下文学习，提升推理时对齐的效果。该方法引入重写步骤，将检索到的响应重写为目标任务的格式和风格，并作为上下文示例使用，从而将采样分布向高奖励区域偏移。实验在安全对齐和数学推理基准上验证了 BoBN 在固定 N 时生成更高质量响应，并能以更小的 N 达到目标性能。
Motivation: 现有的推理时对齐方法如 Best-of-N 受限于参考 LLM 的响应质量：若参考 LLM 对高奖励响应的概率极低，则选择策略无法找到对齐输出。
Method: 提出 BoBN 框架，包含检索高奖励示例、重写示例以匹配目标任务格式与风格，并将重写后的示例作为上下文提示，利用上下文学习机制将采样分布向高奖励区域偏移。
Result: 在安全对齐和数学推理基准上，BoBN 生成的响应质量更高，在固定采样数 N 时性能更好，且达到目标性能所需的 N 更小。
Conclusion: 上下文学习可以有效地将预训练 Transformer 的输出分布向高奖励区域偏移，从而提升推理时对齐的效果，尤其适用于参考 LLM 本身难以生成高奖励响应的场景。

papers.title: SkillOpt-Lite: Better and Faster Agent Self-evolution via One Line of Vibe
papers.abstract_en: While skill optimization for autonomous agents has gained traction, existing methods rely on complex pipelines. This leaves a fundamental question unaddressed: What constitutes a minimal viable pipeline for skill optimization, where every component is justified by theory or empirical necessity? We formalize skill optimization via Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization, mapping classical counterparts (central difference, trust regions) to recent literature. Noting that unlike blind numerical perturbations in classical ZO, skill trajectories serve as interpretable debugging feedback. Grounded in Claude Code philosophy and PAC learning, we establish three principles for convergence and generalization: file-system-based trajectory exploration, consensus attribute mining, and independent validation gating. Eliminating redundancies, we propose SkillOpt-Lite. It accelerates convergence and outperforms full SkillOpt: improving LiveMath by +8.8 points on GPT-5.5 and +25.4 points on GPT-5.4-nano, allowing the nano model to surpass standard GPT-5.4 optimized by SkillOpt. Finally, we integrate our framework into production coding agents like VSCode Copilot, enabling developers to evolve agent skills via one line of vibe. Because our framework treats all agent components simply as standard editable code, this minimal pipeline naturally generalizes to full harness optimization (HarnessOpt). On SpreadsheetBench, HarnessOpt enables GPT-5.4-nano to achieve 0.7758 accuracy, outperforming the larger GPT-5.5 running standard pipelines (0.7620). Code is available at https://github.com/EvolvingLMMs-Lab/SkillOpt-Lite.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将技能优化形式化为零阶优化（Zeroth-Order optimization）问题，并提出最小可行管线SkillOpt-Lite，通过文件系统轨迹探索、共识属性挖掘和独立验证门控三个原则，加速收敛并提升性能。实验表明在LiveMath任务上GPT-5.5提升8.8点，GPT-5.4-nano提升25.4点，并使小模型超越大模型；该管线可泛化到完整管线优化（HarnessOpt），在SpreadsheetBench上GPT-5.4-nano达到0.7758精度，超越GPT-5.5标准管线的0.7620。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有技能优化方法依赖复杂管线，缺乏理论或经验上的必要性验证，本文旨在寻找一个最小可行且每部分都有依据的管线。
Method: 将技能优化视为零阶优化，建立基于文件系统的轨迹探索、共识属性挖掘和独立验证门控三个原则，剔除冗余组件，提出SkillOpt-Lite。
Result: 在LiveMath上GPT-5.5提升8.8点，GPT-5.4-nano提升25.4点；在SpreadsheetBench上，HarnessOpt使GPT-5.4-nano达到0.7758精度，超过GPT-5.5标准管线的0.7620。
Conclusion: 该最小管线可自然泛化到完整管线优化，并已集成到VSCode Copilot等生产编码代理中，支持通过一行指令进化代理技能。

papers.title: HiMe: Hierarchical Embodied Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Control
papers.abstract_en: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at robotic manipulation but often struggle with non-Markovian tasks requiring long-term memory and reasoning due to their reliance on immediate observations. Existing solutions face a ''frequency-competence paradox,'' where stronger reasoning models are too slow for real-time control, while faster models lack sufficient reasoning capabilities. To resolve this architectural misalignment, we propose HiMe, a Hierarchical Embodied Memory framework that decouples embodied intelligence into a high-frequency Executor for execution, a Sentry for working memory, and a Planner for long-term strategy. We also introduce a dynamic knowledge system based on cross-modal semantic schemas and active management mechanisms, allowing robots to maintain memory plasticity through ''Add, Update, and Delete'' operations. This hierarchical design effectively balances the conflict between real-time execution and slow thinking planning, significantly improving success rates in long-horizon tasks. Experiments demonstrate that this approach not only outperforms flat memory baselines but also exhibits the novel ability to self-correct its internal knowledge based on human preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiMe，一种层次化具身记忆框架，用于解决长时域视觉-语言-动作控制中的记忆与推理问题。通过将智能体分解为高频执行器、工作记忆哨兵和长期规划器，并引入基于跨模态语义模式的动态知识系统，实现了实时执行与慢思考规划之间的平衡。实验表明该方法在长时域任务上优于平面记忆基线，并展现出基于人类偏好自我修正内部知识的能力。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型依赖即时观测，难以处理非马尔可夫任务中的长时记忆与推理。现有方案存在“频率-能力悖论”：强推理模型太慢，快速模型能力不足。
Method: 提出层次化具身记忆框架，将具身智能解耦为高频执行器、工作记忆哨兵和长期规划器。引入基于跨模态语义模式的动态知识系统，通过“添加、更新、删除”操作维持记忆可塑性。
Result: 实验表明该方法在长时域任务上显著提升成功率，优于平面记忆基线，并展现出基于人类偏好自我修正内部知识的能力。
Conclusion: 该层次化设计有效平衡实时执行与慢思考规划之间的冲突，为长时域机器人控制提供了一种新的记忆架构。

papers.title: TRIAGE: Trustworthy Retrieval Instrumentation And Graph Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) that underpin Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Graph-RAG) are increasingly built automatically by LLM-driven extraction rather than curated by experts. Proper evaluation would require instrumenting all pertinent stages: extraction, graph construction, and inference, coherently enough to localize failures, so that a failure at one stage is not discovered as a wrong answer at the end. We introduce TRIAGE, a stage-aware instrumentation framework for automated, document-grounded graph-RAG that asks not only whether the underlying graph can be trusted but at what cost it can be queried. TRIAGE attaches stage-specific, independently interpretable metrics to three stages: the KG Implementation (triple confidence, source coverage, and schema and canonicalization checks), the KG Validation by expert (graph-level structural quality, with correctness and completeness computed only as offline calibration when a reference is available), and the KG Usage (retrieval coverage, faithfulness, and retrieval cost); the deployed metrics need no gold annotations, the gold-requiring ones serving only as offline calibration. At usage time these metrics form a diagnostic chain of necessary conditions whose first broken link localizes the failure, and the diagnosis maps to the stage levers that can remedy it: extraction, graph and schema, or retrieval. TRIAGE is a theoretical framework with a proof of concept and a reproducible evaluation protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRIAGE，一个阶段感知的仪器化框架，用于评估由 LLM 自动构建的知识图谱在基于图的检索增强生成（Graph-RAG）中的可信度和查询成本。该框架将指标分为 KG 实现、KG 验证和 KG 使用三个阶段，通过诊断链定位失败阶段，并映射到可修复的杠杆（提取、图与模式、检索）。
Motivation: 现有 Graph-RAG 评估缺乏跨阶段的一致性，无法定位故障根源，导致错误只能通过最终答案发现。
Method: TRIAGE 将评估分为三个独立阶段：KG 实现（三元组置信度、源覆盖率、模式与规范化检查）、KG 验证（图结构质量，正确性与完整性仅作为离线校准）、KG 使用（检索覆盖率、忠实性与检索成本）；部署时无需黄金标注，诊断链通过首个断裂环节定位失败。
Result: 该框架提供了一个可复现的评估协议，并附带概念验证，但摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: TRIAGE 是一个理论框架，旨在通过阶段感知的指标链和诊断映射提供可信的 Graph-RAG 评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: No Time Like the Present: Agentic Test-Time Training for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents often degrade over long episodes: as trajectories grow, they revisit explored states, repeat failed actions, and lose strategies that previously worked. Test-time training (TTT) offers a way to adapt model weights to the evolving task state, but existing LLM TTT methods largely adapt once to a fixed input. We study continuous TTT in multi-turn agent episodes, where each update changes the policy that generates later training text. This creates a self-training loop that helps when new trajectory information appears, but can amplify drift when the agent gets stuck and repeatedly trains on similar text. We find that update-text repetition distinguishes these regimes and introduce Agentic Test-Time Training (aTTT), a token-level reweighting method that downweights the loss on tokens appearing in repeated $n$-grams from prior updates while leaving novel tokens fully weighted. To run such updates inside live episodes, we build a concurrent serving system using vLLM's runtime LoRA API, limiting overhead to 1.9$\times$ the no-TTT cost. aTTT improves success by up to 5.0 points on ALFWorld and 4.9 points on SWE-bench Lite. The gains concentrate where models already have task competence but drift over long trajectories, suggesting that aTTT mainly preserves existing competence rather than teaching new abilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM智能体在长交互序列中性能下降的问题，提出了一种智能体测试时训练方法aTTT。该方法通过令牌级重加权，降低出现在先前更新中重复n-gram的令牌的损失权重，从而减轻训练漂移。在ALFWorld和SWE-bench Lite上，aTTT分别提升了5.0和4.9个百分点的成功率，且主要作用是维持已有能力而非学习新技能。
Motivation: LLM智能体在长轨迹中会退化，如重复访问已探索状态、重复失败动作、丢失有效策略。现有测试时训练方法仅针对固定输入一次性适应，无法应对多轮交互中的持续变化。
Method: 提出aTTT，一种令牌级重加权方法，对来自先前更新的重复n-gram中的令牌降低损失权重，而对新颖令牌保留全权重。利用vLLM的运行时LoRA API构建并发服务系统，将开销限制在无TTT成本的1.9倍以内。
Result: 在ALFWorld上成功率提升最多5.0个百分点，在SWE-bench Lite上提升最多4.9个百分点。改进集中在模型已有任务能力但长轨迹中漂移的场景。
Conclusion: aTTT主要通过维持智能体已有能力而非教授新技能来提升性能，适合长任务中的在线适应。

summary_sections.method: 提出aTTT，一种令牌级重加权方法，对来自先前更新的重复n-gram中的令牌降低损失权重，而对新颖令牌保留全权重。利用vLLM的运行时LoRA API构建并发服务系统，将开销限制在无TTT成本的1.9倍以内。
summary_sections.result: 在ALFWorld上成功率提升最多5.0个百分点，在SWE-bench Lite上提升最多4.9个百分点。改进集中在模型已有任务能力但长轨迹中漂移的场景。
summary_sections.conclusion: aTTT主要通过维持智能体已有能力而非教授新技能来提升性能，适合长任务中的在线适应。

papers.title: How Much of the Routing Gap Is Real? Decomposing the Router-to-Oracle Gap into Reproducible Specialist Advantage and Single-Draw Label Noise
papers.abstract_en: Routing among large language models (LLMs) promises better quality at lower cost, motivated by the reported gap between learned routers and a per-instance oracle. But that oracle is computed from a single correctness label per (query, model), so under stochastic decoding it is one Bernoulli draw, not a reproducible property. We recast the question structurally: the expected per-instance oracle decomposes as $O^{\exp}=O^{\mathrm{repro}}+Δ$, into reproducible single-commit headroom $O^{\mathrm{repro}}$ and a non-negative single-commit selection floor $Δ$. Our main result is a recoverability asymmetry: this floor is closed by no single-commit router, yet is recovered by test-time sampling -- best-of-$K$ on the committed model, at the oracle's own budget, dominates the independent-pool single-draw oracle. The cap needs no cross-model independence; we prove it with the exact decomposition and noise-share bounds that shrink as the budget grows. The procedure adds no new router, only resampling. The floor's magnitude is a prospective, conservative localization, not an audit: our primary target LLMRouterBench (33 models, 391,645 instances) defines its oracle as a per-query union over single $T=0.2$ generations -- by construction a union of stochastic single draws. Since $O^{\mathrm{repro}}$ is non-identifiable from the released $k=1$ matrix, we estimate the noise share by fresh $k\ge20$ resampling under one-sided, dependence- and guessing-floor-corrected bounds, recasting 'model-recall failure' as thin-support union inflation. On a controlled open-model re-generation, single-draw noise is a substantial minority of the gap -- larger on an unsaturated benchmark, approaching half on the hardest queries where no model is reliable -- while the majority remains recoverable specialist advantage. We release a multi-sample oracle evaluation protocol for routing benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了LLM路由中学习路由器与实例级oracle之间的差距，发现oracle通常基于单次解码结果，存在随机性。作者将oracle分解为可重现的专门化优势（reproducible specialist advantage）和单次选择地板（single-commit selection floor），并证明后者无法被任何单次路由器克服，但可以通过测试时采样（best-of-K）恢复。通过在LLMRouterBench上的重采样实验，估计了噪声份额。
Motivation: 现有路由评估依赖单次解码的oracle，但该oracle具有随机性，导致路由间隙被高估或误解。需要区分哪些间隙是真实的专门化优势，哪些是单次采样噪声。
Method: 提出oracle的期望分解：O^exp = O^repro + Δ，其中O^repro是可重现的专门化优势，Δ是单次选择地板。通过重采样（k≥20）估计噪声份额，并设计修正依赖和猜测地板的边界。
Result: 在LLMRouterBench上，单次解码噪声是路由间隙的重要部分，在饱和基准上较大，在最难查询上接近一半，但大部分间隙仍是可恢复的专门化优势。
Conclusion: 单次采样噪声可以通过测试时采样恢复，而无需新路由器。建议采用多采样oracle评估协议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Amortising Bayesian Experimental Design for Sequential Information Gathering in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning and world-knowledge capabilities, yet often struggle to gather information effectively across the multi-turn interactions required in sequential decision-making settings. We introduce Amortised Sequential Information Gathering (ASIG), a fine-tuning approach that amortises Bayesian Experimental Design (BED) into LLM policies via a multi-turn extension of Group Relative Policy Optimisation with an Expected Information Gain reward. Evaluated on the 20 Questions task, ASIG more than doubles the success rate of the 7B base model and reduces inference cost by over $25\times$ relative to BED-LLM, a competitive inference-time baseline. Applied to MediQ, a medical diagnosis benchmark unseen during training, ASIG improves information-seeking performance at the 7B scale, suggesting that the learned strategies can transfer out of distribution. Our findings show that amortising BED into LLM policies provides an effective and computationally efficient approach to sequential information gathering.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to FoGen 2026: Foundations of Deep Generative Models: Understanding Memorization, Generalization, and Reasoning, an ICML 2026 workshop (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出摊销序贯信息收集（ASIG），通过多轮扩展的GRPO和期望信息增益奖励，将贝叶斯实验设计（BED）摊销到LLM策略中。在20 Questions任务上，ASIG使7B基础模型成功率翻倍以上，推理成本相比BED-LLM降低25倍以上；在未见过的医疗诊断基准MediQ上，7B模型的信息寻求性能也得到提升。
Motivation: LLM在多轮交互序贯决策中信息收集能力不足，现有贝叶斯实验设计方法推理成本高。
Method: 提出ASIG方法，通过多轮GRPO与期望信息增益奖励相结合，将BED摊销为LLM策略的微调目标。
Result: 在20 Questions任务上，7B模型成功率翻倍以上，推理成本降低超过25倍；在MediQ基准上，7B模型性能提升，表明策略可跨分布迁移。
Conclusion: 将BED摊销到LLM策略中是一种高效且计算可行的序贯信息收集方法，并展现迁移能力。

papers.title: Personalized Causal Recourse: A Human-In-The-Loop Approach
papers.abstract_en: Algorithmic recourse addresses the challenge of providing tailored recommendations to users affected by unfavorable machine learning decisions, in potentially high-stakes scenarios. Traditional approaches to recourse often rely on the closest counterfactual explanations or assume a priori knowledge of a user's causal structure, resulting in interventions that overlook individual contexts and specific feature interactions. To overcome these limitations, we study a human-in-the-loop framework that iteratively approximates the user's structural causal model through interactive queries via Bayesian inference before producing recourse recommendations. This framework exploits humans' feedback to improve the identification of causal effects, allowing personalized recourse that is plausible, cost-effective, and aligned with the actual causal dependencies of each user. As a proof of concept, we evaluate this framework through simulated human responses. Our simulations across linear and non-linear causal models show promising results, though challenges remain in capturing complex, non-linear structures, emphasizing the importance of accurate approximations and robust noise distribution modeling.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于人机协同的个性化因果补救框架，通过贝叶斯推断交互式查询用户的结构因果模型，旨在生成符合个体因果依赖的补救建议。模拟实验在线性和非线性因果模型上展示了初步效果，但处理复杂非线性结构仍面临挑战。
Motivation: 传统算法补救方法依赖最近反事实解释或假设已知用户因果结构，忽略个体上下文和特征交互，导致干预缺乏个性化。
Method: 提出一个包含人类反馈的迭代框架，通过贝叶斯推断交互式近似用户的结构因果模型，从而生成个性化、低成本且符合实际因果依赖的补救建议。
Result: 在线性和非线性因果模型的模拟实验中，该框架展现了有前景的个性化补救效果，但非线性结构下的表现仍需改进。
Conclusion: 该框架能更好地利用用户反馈识别因果效应，但准确近似复杂非线性因果结构和鲁棒噪声分布建模仍是关键挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Securing Multi-Tool AI Agent Chains With Dynamic, Real-Time Compositional Policies
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI agent implementations such as frontier coding agents chain multiple tools at runtime that create a security surface that per-tool guardrails are unable to address, as individually permitted tools can violate organizational policies when composed. We propose the Dynamic Security Control Compositor (DSCC), a two-phase approach to compositional security for multi-tool agent chains. In Phase 1, at session checkout, a Most Restrictive Set (MRS) algorithm composes per-tool security policies into a single effective policy with a formal monotonicity invariant that extending a chain can only tighten the result, blocking incompatible combinations before any tool executes. Outputs of any tool call propagate their classification constraints into a session-level taint state, so subsequent invocations must satisfy the most restrictive constraints seen so far. In Phase 2, at runtime, the system tracks the sensitivity of data the agent touches through a monotonic taint state and revokes the session if the accumulated exposure would make a subsequent tool call a policy violation. Together, these phases provide defense in depth, where static composition prevents unsafe chains from starting, and runtime taint tracking catches violations that emerge from the specific data used. We provide a reference implementation on 32 tools governed by 16 NIST SP 800-53 aligned policies and evaluate it under two composition modes. In the default clearance mode, permitted combinations are partitioned into classification-level clusters, blocking 79.2% of policy pairs and 95.5% of triples. The alternative taint mode admits mixed-classification chains within the exfiltration boundary, blocking 42.5% and 60.5% respectively. We discuss the governance implications for organizations deploying multi-tool agents, including the utility-security tradeoff and the changes needed to operationalize chain-aware policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态安全控制组合器（DSCC），一种针对多工具AI代理链的组合安全方法。DSCC包含两阶段：阶段1通过最严格集（MRS）算法在会话检出时组合策略，阻止不兼容的工具组合；阶段2通过运行时单调污点跟踪撤销违规会话。在32个工具和16个NIST策略下评估，默认清除模式阻止79.2%的策略对和95.5%的三元组。
Motivation: 现有的每个工具独立防护无法处理多工具链运行时产生的组合安全风险，因为单独允许的工具组合后可能违反组织策略。
Method: DSCC采用两阶段方法：第一阶段在会话检出时，使用最严格集（MRS）算法组合每个工具的安全策略，保证单调性；第二阶段在运行时，通过单调污点状态跟踪数据敏感性，并在政策违反时撤销会话。
Result: 在32个工具和16个NIST SP 800-53对齐策略下，默认清除模式阻止79.2%的策略对和95.5%的三元组；替代污点模式阻止42.5%和60.5%。
Conclusion: DSCC提供深度防御，静态组合防止不安全链启动，运行时污点跟踪捕获数据引发的违规，并讨论了组织部署多工具代理的治理权衡。

papers.title: Handwriting Trajectory Recovery with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recovering online pen trajectories from offline handwriting images, often referred to as handwriting trajectory recovery (stroke recovery), is an offline-to-online conversion task with applications in stroke-level editing and forensic analysis. We propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first diffusion-model-based framework for this task. Our method formulates trajectory recovery as image-conditioned generation and uses a denoising diffusion model to sample pen trajectories consistent with the observed ink trace. Through extensive quantitative evaluations on CASIA-OLHWDB (1.0-1.1), we verify that the proposed approach enables accurate recovery even for complex multi-stroke characters, substantially improving both temporal similarity (DTW/LDTW) and shape fidelity (AIoU) over representative prior methods such as PEN-Net and Cross-VAE. We further show that the model captures general stroke-order tendencies and generalizes to classes unseen during training, exemplified by cross-script transfer: a model trained on Chinese characters can recover reasonable stroke orders for Latin letters to some extent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个基于扩散模型（diffusion model）的手写轨迹恢复框架，将离线手写图像中的在线笔迹轨迹重建问题建模为图像条件生成任务。在CASIA-OLHWDB数据集上的定量评估表明，该方法在多笔划复杂字符上显著优于PEN-Net和Cross-VAE等现有方法，在时间相似性（DTW/LDTW）和形状保真度（AIoU）上均有提升，并能泛化到未见过的类别和跨脚本场景。
Motivation: 手写轨迹恢复（笔迹重建）在笔划级编辑和法庭分析中有重要应用，但现有方法在复杂多笔划字符上精度不足，且缺乏利用扩散模型生成高质量轨迹的探索。
Method: 将轨迹恢复视为图像条件生成任务，采用去噪扩散概率模型（denoising diffusion probabilistic model）从离线图像中采样与观测墨迹一致的笔轨迹。
Result: 在CASIA-OLHWDB上，所提方法在时序相似性（DTW/LDTW）和形状保真度（AIoU）上均显著优于PEN-Net和Cross-VAE，并能跨脚本迁移（中文模型对拉丁字母恢复合理笔顺）。
Conclusion: 扩散模型可有效用于手写轨迹恢复，尤其擅长处理复杂多笔划字符，且具备一定的泛化和迁移能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DETECT-3B-Omni is Agnostic of Content and Demographics
papers.abstract_en: A trustworthy and GDPR-compliant deepfake audio detector must base its decisions on acoustic artifacts, not on what is being said or who is speaking. We present a large-scale study of semantic independence for Resemble AI's detector, DETECT-3B-Omni. Using 10,240 audio samples from diverse US English speakers across 30 states, generated through 8 different AI voice-cloning systems, we test whether detection accuracy depends on spoken content (benign versus malicious), speaker gender, speaker age, or speaker region. Using equivalence testing, our results show that the accuracy difference between any two of these groups is at most 2 percentage points, at 99% confidence. The detector therefore identifies AI-generated audio with equivalent accuracy regardless of what the audio says or who the speaker is.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了 Resemble AI 的深度伪造音频检测器 DETECT-3B-Omni 在不同内容（良性 vs 恶意）、说话人性别、年龄和地区下的语义独立性。使用来自30个州、8种AI语音克隆系统生成的10240个音频样本，通过等价性检验，结果显示各组间准确率差异最多2个百分点（99%置信度），表明检测器不受音频内容或说话人影响。
Motivation: 可靠的深度伪造音频检测必须基于声学伪影而非语义内容或说话人身份，现有检测器可能对内容或人群有偏差，违反GDPR等要求。
Method: 大规模等价性检验实验：使用多样本（10240个）、多种AI合成系统（8种）、多样说话人（30个州、不同性别年龄），比较检测准确率在内容类型、性别、年龄、地区上的差异。

papers.title: The S-ICDF Dataset: Sionna-Simulated Dynamic Interference Characterization and Direction Finding
papers.abstract_en: Jamming and spoofing threaten wireless and satellite navigation by disrupting or manipulating radio frequency (RF) signals, undermining availability, integrity, and trust. Robust interference monitoring (i.e., detection, classification, characterization, and direction finding) is therefore essential to identify and localize anomalous signals. While machine learning (ML) promises improved performance in complex environments, its development and validation depend on large-scale datasets that capture realistic signal and channel variability. Collecting such data in the real world is difficult because intentional jamming is illegal and ground-truth attribution is confounded by propagation, hardware, and environmental effects. To address this gap, we create and publish S-ICDF, a large-scale indoor interference dataset generated with Sionna, a GPU-accelerated simulation library for physical-layer wireless communications. S-ICDF covers 102 interference configurations, including diverse antenna array patterns, bandwidths, and simulation settings such as noise level and reflection depth. We further provide baseline results by benchmarking S-ICDF with classical estimation and direction finding (DF) methods (MUSIC, ESPRIT, and CAPON) and with modern ML approaches. The dataset is publicly available at: https://gitlab.cc-asp.fraunhofer.de/darcy_gnss/sicdf_dataset
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文创建并公开了S-ICDF数据集，一个使用Sionna仿真库生成的大规模室内干扰数据集，涵盖102种干扰配置（天线阵列、带宽、噪声水平等）。该数据集旨在支持机器学习方法在射频干扰检测、分类、特征提取和方向发现（DF）上的开发与验证。论文同时提供了经典DF方法（MUSIC、ESPRIT、CAPON）和现代ML方法的基线结果。
Motivation: 实际采集射频干扰数据困难（非法、难以获取真实标签），现有仿真数据集规模有限或缺乏多样性。本文通过GPU加速仿真生成大规模可控的干扰数据集，弥补真实数据不足。
Method: 使用Sionna仿真库生成室内干扰数据集，配置包括不同天线阵列、带宽、反射深度等102种干扰场景，并复现经典DF算法（MUSIC、ESPRIT、CAPON）和ML方法作为基线。
Result: 数据集公开可用，并提供基线性能对比，但摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该数据集旨在促进机器学习在干扰监测中的研究，特别是方向发现任务。

papers.title: Efficient bias mitigation in T2I diffusion models using Concept Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-Image diffusion models often propagate harmful bias inherited from the training data. Existing bias mitigation techniques typically intervene only at the text encoder or provide inference-time guidance, often leading to generations that collapse into semantically incoherent outputs. To address these limitations, we introduce CO-ALIGN (Concept Ontology Alignment), a novel bias mitigation approach based on concept-graph alignment that operates on the model's internal concept ontology. By aligning concepts within the text encoder and denoiser, CO-ALIGN achieves substantial bias reduction while preserving generative integrity. We demonstrate the effectiveness of concept-graph alignment across three paradigms: text-encoders, denoisers and joint text-denoiser ontology alignment. CO-ALIGN outperforms the state of the art, improving fairness by $30\%$, $ΔFID=11.4$ in image quality, $2.8\%$ in image fidelity, all while reducing semantically incoherent outputs by $88\%$. Beyond bias mitigation, we show that CO-ALIGN benefits other downstream tasks as well. In particular, our experiments demonstrate that better-aligned internal ontologies enhance concept unlearning robustness across multiple unlearning techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CO-ALIGN方法，通过概念图对齐（concept-graph alignment）在文本编码器和去噪器中对齐内部概念本体，以减轻文本到图像扩散模型中的有害偏见，同时保持生成完整性。该方法在三个范式（文本编码器、去噪器、联合对齐）上均有效，在公平性、图像质量、保真度方面提升，并减少语义不连贯输出。
Motivation: 现有偏见缓解技术通常在文本编码器干预或推理时引导，导致生成语义不连贯。本文旨在解决这些局限。
Method: 提出基于概念本体对齐（Concept Ontology Alignment）的CO-ALIGN方法，在模型内部概念本体上对齐文本编码器和去噪器中的概念。
Result: 在公平性上提升30%，ΔFID=11.4，图像保真度提升2.8%，语义不连贯输出减少88%。
Conclusion: 该方法的对齐内部本体还有益于其他下游任务，如提升概念遗忘鲁棒性。

papers.title: From Mobile Data to Business Insights: An End-to-End Analytics Framework for Large-Scale Urban Mobility Analysis and Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Real time location data derived from mobile applications is a powerful tool for addressing various urban challenges, including tourism planning, parking management, bus route optimization, and resource allocation. Besides, it offers invaluable insights for shaping strategic decisions in commercial domains such as location based services, market share analysis, and behavioral profiling. In this expansive study, we aim to address all of the aforementioned challenges by investigating the behaviors and patterns of smartphone users within urban environments, particularly in the domains of tourism, transportation, and retail. Our approach encompasses the development of a sophisticated data platform from inception to implementation, which includes the formulation of use cases, architectural design, and implementation of modules. We employ state of the art techniques and technologies, including data anonymization, ETL pipelines, and utilizing Google BigQuery and Vertex AI for data processing and machine learning model development. A modular architecture based on reusable analytical building blocks was developed to generate data products that support multiple stakeholder driven use cases. Additionally, we apply interactive data visualization techniques via Power BI to facilitate the effective interpretation of analytical findings by stakeholders. The developed models address a wide range of mobility analytics tasks, including mobility profiling, frequent trajectory mining, area of influence analysis, traffic anomaly detection, and origin destination pattern analysis. The results demonstrate the framework's ability to capture user mobility dynamics at fine spatial and temporal resolutions, providing actionable insights for urban planning and strategic business decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端分析框架，利用移动应用实时位置数据解决城市流动性问题，包括旅游规划、停车管理、公交优化、资源分配等。框架涵盖数据平台开发、ETL管道、Google BigQuery和Vertex AI处理、模块化可重用分析组件以及Power BI可视化。模型支持移动画像、频繁轨迹挖掘、影响区域分析、交通异常检测和起讫点模式分析。实验表明，该框架能以细粒度时空分辨率捕捉用户流动性动态，为城市规划和商业决策提供可操作洞察。
Motivation: 移动位置数据是解决城市挑战的有力工具，但缺乏从数据采集到决策支持的端到端框架。
Method: 开发从概念到实现的完整数据平台，包括用例定义、架构设计和模块实现。采用数据匿名化、ETL管道、Google BigQuery和Vertex AI进行数据处理和机器学习建模，构建基于可重用分析组件的模块化架构，并通过Power BI进行交互式可视化。
Result: 摘要称该框架能捕捉用户流动性动态的细粒度时空模式，提供可操作的城市规划和商业决策洞察。
Conclusion: 所提出的框架有效支持多种利益相关者驱动的用例，适用于城市流动性分析和战略决策。

papers.title: Scalable Differentially Private Data Compression via Diffusion and Stochastic Codes
papers.abstract_en: The ever-increasing collection of personal data has created mounting pressure to develop technologies that protect sensitive aspects of individual identity. Differential privacy (DP) provides a principled framework with strong formal guarantees and has already achieved practical success. However, releasing high-dimensional data, such as images, has remained elusive: releasing uncompressed privatized data requires significant storage. At the same time, no effective data compression scheme exists that can compress high-resolution data with privacy guarantees. We address this challenge with DP-DiPP, a compression pipeline that combines stochastic codes with diffusion models. DP-DiPP is highly flexible: the practitioner has direct control over the compression rate-privacy-utility tradeoff. As the theoretical backbone, we extend the Poisson private representation (PPR) to encode the outputs of privacy mechanisms. We then combine it with DiffC, a diffusion-based lossy data compression method, to obtain a differentially private image compressor. Our experiments on privatized image classification on CIFAR-10 demonstrate that DP-DiPP significantly outperforms the baseline, achieving a 10-30 times better compression while retaining comparable privacy guarantees and utility.
papers.comment: To appear in ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DP-DiPP，一种结合随机编码和扩散模型的差分隐私压缩管道，用于高维数据（如图像）的私有化压缩。通过扩展 Poisson private representation (PPR) 编码隐私机制输出，并与基于扩散的有损压缩方法 DiffC 结合，实现可调节的压缩率-隐私-效用权衡。在 CIFAR-10 上的实验表明，相比基线，DP-DiPP 在保持相似隐私保证和效用的同时，实现了10-30倍的压缩提升。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私方法在处理高维数据（如图像）时，直接释放未压缩的私有化数据需要大量存储，且缺乏有效的隐私保护压缩方案。
Method: 提出 DP-DiPP 管道，扩展 Poisson private representation (PPR) 以编码隐私机制输出，再与基于扩散的压缩方法 DiffC 结合，实现差分隐私图像压缩。用户可以控制压缩率-隐私-效用的权衡。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 的图像分类任务上，DP-DiPP 比基线方法实现10-30倍更好的压缩，同时保持可比的隐私保证和效用。
Conclusion: DP-DiPP 提供了一种灵活的高维数据隐私压缩方案，但论文未讨论局限性。摘要提到在 CIFAR-10 上验证，未提及其他数据集或场景。

papers.title: TemporalGS: Training-Free Plug-and-Play Acceleration for 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering via Temporal Priors
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has revolutionized novel-view synthesis with its fast and high-fidelity rendering. However, rendering at high FPS and low latency across various scenes remains a challenge, especially when large amounts of 3D Gaussian ellipsoids appear in the scene. To address this issue, we introduce TemporalGS, to the best of our knowledge, the first training-free plug-and-play algorithmic approach to accelerate 3DGS rendering without any post-training or post-processing, implemented on top of tile-based software rasterization. The key idea is that, instead of rendering frames independently as 3DGS, we leverage the temporal priors, represented by novel geometry and appearance buffers, etc., to reduce redundancy of Gaussian preprocessing, sorting, and rasterization operations of consecutive frames. Specifically, we propose two acceleration strategies: (1) temporal dynamic culling, which filters out Gaussians that contribute less to current frame rendering; (2) selective rendering, which renders only a small portion of tiles that cannot be approximated by the temporal priors. By adapting and interleaving these two strategies, TemporalGS yields a simple but effective plug-and-play solution for 3DGS rendering speed-up without any training. Extensive experiments show that TemporalGS achieves comparable or even better performance compared to existing state-of-the-art post-training or post-processing-based 3DGS rendering acceleration approaches. TemporalGS can significantly enhance the rendering speed of various 3DGS methods, achieving up to $1.48\times$ acceleration, while maintaining competitive rendering quality. We further extend our TemporalGS to hardware rasterization-based 3DGS to show the portability of our algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TemporalGS 是一种无需训练、即插即用的 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 渲染加速算法，利用时间先验（几何与外观缓冲）减少连续帧之间的高斯预处理、排序和光栅化冗余。通过时间动态剔除和选择性渲染两种策略，在无需后训练或后处理的情况下实现高达 1.48 倍的渲染加速，同时保持与现有后训练方法相当的渲染质量。
Motivation: 3DGS 在多种场景下实现高 FPS 和低延迟渲染仍具挑战，尤其是当场景中出现大量 3D 高斯椭球体时，现有方法大多依赖后训练或后处理加速。
Method: 提出两种加速策略：(1) 时间动态剔除，过滤掉对当前帧贡献较小的高斯体；(2) 选择性渲染，仅渲染无法由时间先验近似的部分瓦片 (tiles)。两种策略自适应交替，形成无需训练的即插即用方案。
Result: 在多种 3DGS 方法上实现最高 1.48 倍加速，渲染质量与现有最先进的基于后训练或后处理的加速方法相当或更优。
Conclusion: TemporalGS 是首个无需训练、即插即用的 3DGS 渲染加速算法，可移植到硬件光栅化 3DGS，证明了其通用性。

papers.title: When Aggregate Alignment Misleads: Auditing Policy Repair Without Per-State Expert Actions
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems are increasingly used to edit, refine, and repair decision policies, but evaluating these edits is difficult when per-state expert action labels are unavailable. We study this problem in a hotel-pricing simulator where an agentic policy editor receives only region-level diagnostic feedback: summaries of how its price distribution differs from a benchmark policy across time, inventory, and market regions. The editor cannot observe benchmark actions, benchmark source code, reward numbers, or held-out outcomes, and may only propose constrained edits to a target-action table. On 5,000 held-out episodes, a multi-restart LLM editor reaches RevPAR 108.47 (95% CI 107.61 - 109.34), close to the benchmark policy's 108.75 (107.81 - 109.68), with paired gap (LLM minus benchmark) -0.276 and 95% CI [-0.692, 0.146]. A cheap diagnostic projection already recovers much of the revenue (107.90), so the LLM editor's distinctive gain is not raw revenue lift alone: it also reduces episode composition distance from 1.153 to 0.609. This is the strongest non-benchmark repair result. This profile is not explained by restart search alone: non-semantic proposers with up to 2,500 evaluations fall 8.77 - 14.57 RevPAR points short. Nor is it explained by plausible prompt format: a shuffled-diagnostic control breaks region-error correspondence and falls to RevPAR 94.30. The match is genuine but partial. A tree editor achieves stronger pooled alignment, 0.214 versus 0.266, and stronger reference-state D1, 0.328 versus 1.197, yet revenue falls to 98.91. These results show that agentic policy repair should be evaluated by whether diagnostic feedback becomes reliable closed-loop outcome, not by a single behavioral distance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在没有每状态专家动作标签的情况下，评估agentic AI系统对决策策略的修复效果。在酒店定价模拟器中，一个多重启LLM编辑器仅基于区域级诊断反馈（价格分布差异摘要）进行策略编辑，达到了接近基准策略的收入（RevPAR 108.47 vs 108.75），并将情节组成距离从1.153降低到0.609。实验表明，策略修复应通过诊断反馈是否产生可靠的闭环结果来评估，而非单一的行为距离。
Motivation: 现有策略评估通常需要每个状态下的专家动作标签，但实际中这些标签往往不可用，因此需要研究仅基于聚合诊断反馈来评估策略修复的方法。
Method: 构建酒店定价模拟器，使用agentic LLM编辑器，编辑器只能观察到区域级价格分布差异摘要，无法访问基准动作、源代码、奖励或保留结果，只能对目标动作表提出约束性编辑。采用多重启策略进行修复。

Conclusion: 这些结果表明，agentic策略修复应通过诊断反馈是否成为可靠的闭环结果来评估，而非单一的行为距离。

papers.title: A Hierarchy of Policy Learning Problems
papers.abstract_en: Policy learning has received substantial attention with the goal of learning policies from observational data for decision-making. A majority of work in this space has focused on developing algorithms for computing policies that minimize regret compared to the optimal policy. However, in many practical settings, there is insufficient data to obtain low regret. As a result, recent work has shifted attention to alternative objectives, most notably, studying whether it is possible to learn an improving policy that statistically significantly outperforms baseline policies. We argue that there is substantial merit in studying a broader range of policy learning problems. When there is insufficient data to learn an improving policy, there may still be useful questions that can be answered. To this end, we provide a mathematical framework for studying the relationships between policy learning problems. We formalize three problems within our framework: beyond the optimal policy problem and the improving policy problem, we also propose the policy existence problem, which aims to determine if an improving policy exists. Within our framework, we show that the policy existence problem reduces to the improving policy problem, which in turn reduces to the optimal policy problem; these reductions prove that each problem is at least as easy as the next one (in sample complexity). A key question remains: is this hardness strict? We provide partial answers. First, the gap between the optimal policy and improving policy problems is strict. For the improving policy and policy existence problems, we prove that a sublinear polynomial gap exists under natural conditions on improving policy learning algorithms. Thus, we may be able to answer questions about the existence of an improving policy even when we cannot find one. These results highlight the value in studying a broader range of policy learning problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对策略学习（policy learning）问题，提出了一个数学框架来形式化三个层次的问题：最优策略问题（optimal policy problem）、改进策略问题（improving policy problem）以及新提出的策略存在性问题（policy existence problem）。作者证明了这三个问题之间存在归约关系，且样本复杂度依次降低：策略存在性问题归约为改进策略问题，改进策略问题归约为最优策略问题。进一步，他们展示了最优策略与改进策略之间的差距是严格的，而在自然条件下，改进策略与策略存在性之间存在次多项式差距。这些结果表明，即使无法找到改进策略，也可能回答策略是否存在改进的问题。
Motivation: 现有策略学习主要集中在从观测数据中学习最小化遗憾的最优策略，但在许多实际场景中数据不足难以获得低遗憾。因此，需要研究更广泛的策略学习问题，例如能否学习一个统计上显著优于基准的改进策略，以及当无法学习改进策略时，是否还有其他有用问题可以回答。
Method: 本文提供了一个数学框架，形式化定义了三个策略学习问题：最优策略问题、改进策略问题和策略存在性问题。通过归约分析，证明策略存在性问题可归约为改进策略问题，改进策略问题可归约为最优策略问题，从而表明每个问题在样本复杂度上至少与下一个问题一样容易。
Result: 本文证明了最优策略问题与改进策略问题之间的严格差距（严格更困难），并且对于改进策略问题和策略存在性问题，在改进策略学习算法的自然条件下，存在一个次多项式差距。
Conclusion: 本文强调了研究更广泛策略学习问题的价值，因为即使无法找到改进策略，也可能回答关于策略是否存在改进的问题，这为数据不足时的决策提供了新的可能性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Signatures of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapidly growing repository of publicly available large language models (LLMs) presents significant challenges for systematic management and quantification at scale, such as model lineage tracing, licensing, and evaluation. However, task-specific benchmarks are insufficient for this setting, as LLMs differ widely in architectures, scales, and training procedures. To address this challenge, we adopt spectral shape-based metrics for managing and quantifying LLMs based on Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization theory. Our approach uses the shape information of the weight empirical spectral density as a compact spectral signature of each model. This signature captures intrinsic properties of pretrained models and remains robust during post-training, making it suitable for model-level analysis. In addition, this metric is data-free, computationally-efficient, and scale-invariant, enabling large-scale analysis in practice. Moreover, we curate a large and diverse model corpus consisting of major open-source LLM families, and use it to systematically benchmark spectral and non-spectral metrics across models and downstream tasks. We show that our spectral signature supports the tracking of the model lineage, the unsupervised clustering of similar models, and the quantification of the model performance. Overall, the proposed spectral signature provides a meaningful proxy for broad performance trends across LLMs, enabling efficient organization, comparison, and analysis of large model collections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于重尾自正则化（Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization）理论的谱形状指标，作为大型语言模型（LLM）的紧凑谱特征。该特征无需数据、计算高效、尺度不变，可用于模型溯源、无监督聚类和性能量化。基于包含多个开源LLM家族的语料库进行基准测试，证明谱特征能够跟踪模型谱系、聚类相似模型并量化模型性能。
Motivation: 公开可用的LLM迅速增长，对系统化管理和量化（如模型溯源、许可、评估）带来挑战，而任务特定基准不足以应对架构、规模和训练过程的巨大差异。
Method: 基于重尾自正则化理论，利用权重经验谱密度的形状信息构建紧凑谱特征。该特征无需数据、计算高效、尺度不变，且在post-training中保持鲁棒。
Result: 在包含主要开源LLM家族的语料库上，该谱特征支持模型谱系追踪、无监督聚类以及模型性能量化，可作为LLM广泛性能趋势的有意义代理。
Conclusion: 该谱特征为大规模模型集合的组织、比较和分析提供了有效工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Present but Not Remembered: Auditing How Frozen VLAs Encode, Deploy, and Steer Visual History
papers.abstract_en: A frozen vision-language-action model (VLA) receives recent observations at every decision step, yet prior work has focused on adding memory rather than asking how existing history is represented and used. We study this temporal axis using layer-resolved linear probing and causal interchange interventions across three VLAs from two architecture families. We find a three-part dissociation. First, past-frame content remains linearly decodable throughout the network. Second, information unique to history beyond the current frame is nearly absent, indicating that stored history is largely a redundant copy of the present. Third, history is causally deployed only when the current frame is heavily degraded, while the action readout progressively loses dependence on history through the network. Although all models encode history similarly, their deployment strategies differ: under the same occlusion, one architecture increasingly relies on history as a fallback, whereas the other relies on it less. We further introduce a training-free temporal deployment audit that distinguishes these regimes. In the fallback regime, re-injecting history neither repairs occlusion nor disambiguates actions, confirming the redundancy of the stored representation. In the other regime, the same intervention reliably steers the predicted action toward the donor history. These results show that steerability depends on how history is deployed rather than whether it is encoded. VLAs do not forget the past; they largely fail to represent it as information distinct from the present. Our findings suggest that future memory augmentation should inject information unique to the past rather than simply more history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）如何表示和利用历史视觉信息的问题，通过层解析线性探针和因果干预实验，发现三方面解离：过去帧内容在整个网络中可线性解码；历史信息几乎完全冗余于当前帧；历史仅在当前帧严重退化时才被因果调用，且不同架构的调用策略不同。进一步提出无训练的时间部署审计方法，验证历史注入仅在特定部署模式下才能改变动作预测。研究表明VLA并未遗忘过去，但未能将历史表示为区别于当前帧的信息。
Motivation: 现有VLA在决策步骤中接收最近观测，但先前研究聚焦于添加记忆模块，而忽略了冻结模型内部如何表示和使用已有历史信息。
Method: 采用层解析线性探针和因果干预实验，在两类架构族、三个VLA模型上分析历史信息的编码、部署和可操纵性；引入无训练的时间部署审计来区分不同部署模式。
Result: 历史帧内容线性可解码；但历史独有信息几乎缺失，存储的历史本质上是当前帧的冗余拷贝；历史因果调用仅发生在当前帧严重退化时，且不同架构在相同遮挡下表现出相反的历史依赖趋势。审计显示，在回退模式下重注入历史无法修复遮挡或消除动作歧义，而在另一模式下相同干预能稳定地将预测动作导向捐赠历史。
Conclusion: VLA的可操纵性取决于历史的部署方式而非编码方式；未来记忆增强应注入区别于当前帧的独有信息，而非简单增加历史量。

papers.title: Minimax Estimation of Kernel Stein Discrepancy: Trace versus Hilbert-Schmidt Scales
papers.abstract_en: Kernel Stein Discrepancy (KSD) compares a sample to a fixed target distribution known only through its score, and is widely used for goodness-of-fit testing, sample quality assessment, and approximate inference. We study the estimation of $\operatorname{KSD}(P_0,P)$ from $n$ independent observations and identify the sharp spectral constant governing the minimax risk: it is the Hilbert-Schmidt norm of the Stein covariance operator $C_\star$, giving the minimax scale $\sqrt{\|C_\star\|_{\mathrm{HS}}/n}$. This scale is attained by the positive-part square-root U-statistic, whereas the standard plug-in V-statistic remains at the trace scale $\sqrt{\operatorname{tr}(C_\star)/n}$ and is therefore suboptimal by the fourth root of the effective rank of $C_\star$; for a Gaussian target with a fixed-bandwidth Gaussian kernel this factor is exponential in the dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了核Stein差异（KSD）的极小极大估计问题，确定了由Stein协方差算子的Hilbert-Schmidt范数主导的尖锐谱常数，并证明正部分平方根U统计量达到了最优尺度√(‖C_*‖_HS/n)，而标准V统计量处于迹尺度√(tr(C_*)/n)，在有效秩上差四分之一次幂。对于高斯目标与固定带宽高斯核，该因子随维度指数增长。
Motivation: KSD广泛用于拟合优度检验和样本质量评估，但现有估计量的最优性尚不明确，需要确定极小极大风险的基本谱常数。
Method: 通过谱分析刻画Stein协方差算子C_*的Hilbert-Schmidt范数与迹的关系，并利用正部分平方根U统计量实现最优估计。
Result: 极小极大风险尺度为√(‖C_*‖_HS/n)，标准V统计量尺度为√(tr(C_*)/n)，后者子最优因子为有效秩的四分之一次方。
Conclusion: 平方根U统计量在谱意义下达到最优，而V统计量在有效秩较大时显著低效。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 平方根U统计量在谱意义下达到最优，而V统计量在有效秩较大时显著低效。

papers.title: Brand-as-Memory: Vision-Language Models Encode Causal, Mechanistically Localizable Credibility Priors for News Sources
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read news and web content as images, where the publisher's identity is visually present. We show that VLMs carry a strong source-credibility prior keyed on outlet identity, and study it along three axes. (i) Cross-model benchmark. We introduce CueTrust, a cross-model diagnostic that measures which surface source cue overrides an article's content evidence via a Source-Override Index (SOI). Across seven VLMs and five cues, the vulnerability profile is model- and scale-dependent, and the override is outlet-identity-specific and encoding-invariant, firing from the masthead name, the logo image, or the bare domain, but not from a named author, in-text authority, or page layout (clean negative controls). (ii) Mechanistic account. For the brand cue, we give a full mechanistic account: swapping only the masthead moves credibility across an approximately 11 log-odds range that tracks professional ratings (rho = 0.88 with Media Bias/Fact Check). The prior is dual-coded (name and logo), strengthens with scale, is causally formed at layers 19-21, carried by interpretable seed-stable sparse-autoencoder features, and recurs at the same relative locus in a second model family. It overrides content (about 1.8x) as a signal-magnitude effect within a shared pathway, not a privileged route. Steering the localized direction selectively reduces the override (41% reduction) and generalizes to held-out outlets, confirming the prior is causally used, not merely decodable. Deployed VLMs may thus defer to source identity over the evidence in front of them, a reliability failure we can measure across models, localize, and causally probe. We release the stimulus suite and CueTrust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言模型（VLM）如何根据新闻来源的标识（如报头名称、logo、域名）编码并优先使用可信度先验。引入CueTrust诊断工具和源覆盖指数（Source-Override Index）测量七种VLM模型，发现来源标识会覆盖文章内容证据，并且这种覆盖是因果性的、可机械定位的，位于网络层19-21。通过稀疏自编码器特征和因果干预（减少41%覆盖）验证了先验的因果使用。
Motivation: VLM越来越多地以图像形式阅读新闻内容，但可能过度依赖来源标识而非内容本身，导致可靠性问题。现有研究缺乏对VLM中来源可信度先验的跨模型系统性测量和因果机制分析。
Method: 提出CueTrust跨模型诊断方法，通过源覆盖指数（SOI）量化表面线索（如报头名称、logo、域名）对内容证据的覆盖程度。对七种VLM进行五类线索测试，并给出品牌线索的完整机械因果解释：定位到层19-21，使用稀疏自编码器特征，并通过方向干预验证因果性。
Result: 来源标识的覆盖效应与专业评级高度相关（ρ=0.88），且覆盖强度随模型规模增大而增强。品牌先验是双重编码（名称和logo），因果性位于特定层，干预可减少41%覆盖并泛化到未见过的来源。
Conclusion: VLMs可能因来源身份优先于内容证据而导致可靠性失败，该研究提供了跨模型可测量、可定位和可因果探测的方法。

papers.title: CaSPECT: Discovering Causally Homogeneous Subgroups via Directed Spectral Clustering
papers.abstract_en: We propose \textbf{CaSPECT}, a causal spectral clustering framework for discovering causally homogeneous subgroups from observational data. Rather than clustering in covariate space, CaSPECT defines similarity through the topology of a learned directed acyclic graph (DAG); a bootstrap-stabilised PC algorithm recovers the causal skeleton; a novel \emph{Orientation Validation Score} (OVS) combines PC bootstrap evidence with DirectLiNGAM to orient edges robustly; directed edges are weighted by backdoor-identified average treatment effects estimated via OLS or double machine learning. Chung's directed Laplacian provides a spectral embedding in which individuals close together share the same causal propagation pathways. We establish almost-sure consistency of the full pipeline and validate the method through a controlled simulation study and on LaLonde CPS1, IHDP, and 401(k) datasets, where CaSPECT recovers a positive and statistically significant treatment effect within the causally comparable subpopulation and corrects for severe confounding without requiring a pre-specified propensity score model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出CaSPECT框架，通过有向无环图拓扑定义相似性，利用bootstrap稳定的PC算法和Orientation Validation Score进行因果发现，加权边后使用Chung有向拉普拉斯进行谱嵌入，从观测数据中发现因果同质子群。在模拟和真实数据上验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: 传统聚类在协变量空间进行，无法捕捉个体间因果传播路径的相似性，导致子群内因果效应估计不一致。本文旨在发现因果同质子群以纠正混杂偏差。
Method: CaSPECT框架：bootstrap稳定的PC算法恢复因果骨架；Orientation Validation Score结合PC bootstrap证据和DirectLiNGAM定向边；边权通过后门调整的平均处理效应（OLS或DML）估计；Chung有向拉普拉斯谱嵌入。
Result: 在模拟研究和LaLonde CPS1、IHDP、401(k)数据集上，恢复了因果可比子群内的正向统计显著处理效应，纠正严重混杂，无需预先指定倾向得分模型。
Conclusion: 方法具有几乎必然一致性，通过因果图拓扑聚类可有效处理观测数据中的混杂。
