papers.title: Back to Basics: Improving Molecular Understanding in LLMs via SMILES-Graph Translation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in molecular large language models have led to strong performance on molecular understanding and generation tasks, yet these gains often come without reliable structural grounding. In particular, existing approaches conflict with the chemistry principle that structure determines function: despite their downstream success, current molecular LLMs perform poorly on basic structure recognition, suggesting that they fail to capture molecular graphs from canonical SMILES. To remedy this, we propose MolBasic, a structure-first framework that strengthens structural comprehension via SMILES-Graph translation. MolBasic is built around a multi-level structure perception benchmark, where bidirectional SMILES-Graph conversion serves as the core task to align sequential and topological representations. On top of this foundation, we employ a progressive learning scheme with a standardized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to steer models from structure acquisition toward higher-level molecular reasoning. Experiments show that MolBasic substantially improves structural understanding and yields robust gains on downstream tasks, including property prediction and objective optimization, supporting our structure-first paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MolBasic 框架，通过 SMILES-图翻译任务增强分子大语言模型的结构理解能力。框架包含多级结构感知基准，以双向 SMILES-图转换为核心任务对齐序列与拓扑表示，并采用渐进式学习与标准化思维链引导模型从结构获取到高级分子推理。实验表明该方法显著提升结构理解，并在性质预测和目标优化等下游任务上取得稳健改进。
Motivation: 现有分子大语言模型虽在下游任务表现良好，但缺乏可靠的结构基础，与“结构决定功能”的化学原则冲突，且在基础结构识别任务上表现不佳，说明模型未能从规范SMILES中捕获分子图。
Method: 提出 MolBasic，其核心是双向 SMILES-图转换任务以对齐序列与拓扑表示；采用渐进式学习方案和标准化思维链，引导模型从结构获取逐步过渡到高级分子推理。
Result: 实验表明 MolBasic 显著提升结构理解，并在性质预测和目标优化等下游任务上取得稳健改进。
Conclusion: 本文支持“结构优先”范式，强调通过 SMILES-图翻译强化结构理解可提升分子LLM的可靠性和下游性能。

papers.title: PosterHarness: Turning Scientific Poster Generation into an Auditable Instruction-Following Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Text-rich image models can now design poster-scale layouts, but we lack ways to measure whether they honor scientific communication contracts: legible labels, prescribed aspect ratios, and -- above all -- abstaining from fabricated scientific figures. We present POSTERHARNESS, an auditable harness reframing poster generation as measurable instruction-following tasks, with a pilot benchmark and failure taxonomy. POSTERHARNESS uses a placeholder-first contract to separate two jobs models otherwise conflate. The model performs visual-summary design: typography, reading path, color, and background -- but never draws data-bearing figures. Every figure region must be an empty labeled placeholder; a deterministic compositor inserts real source-paper figures at detected coordinates. This makes properties measurable: placeholder count and ID accuracy, blankness, aspect-ratio compliance, abstention from synthesized graphics, public-text hygiene, and source-figure provenance -- with failures logged as explicit rejections, not hidden in plausible-looking output. We instantiate the harness on 12 papers (6 HEP, 6 AI/ML-adjacent) and report three findings. (i) A counterfactual probe shows the placeholder contract drives VLM-counted synthesized figures from 34 to 0 across three papers. (ii) A failure taxonomy identifies blocking contracts: placeholder geometry, placeholder QA, template critic, and public text. (iii) Comparison with Paper2Poster shows a trade-off: PosterHarness yields higher-resolution artifacts, lower white-canvas fraction, and stronger VLM visual preference; the deterministic baseline retains slightly more PosterQuiz-style information and runs faster. We report this as regime characterization, not a superiority claim. All artifacts, prompts, manifests, and audit scripts are released as a reusable evaluation component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出POSTERHARNESS，一个可审计的基准测试，将科学海报生成重构为可衡量的指令遵循任务。采用占位符优先合约，模型只负责视觉摘要设计（排版、阅读路径、颜色、背景），所有图形区域必须放置空标签占位符，由确定性合成器插入真实源论文图形。在12篇论文上测试，发现反事实探针将VLM计数的合成图形从34降至0，并识别出三类失败模式（占位符几何、占位符QA、模板批评和公开文本）。与Paper2Poster比较显示高分辨率、低白画布比例和强视觉偏好，但信息保留略少。所有工件已开源。
Motivation: 现有文本丰富的图像模型能设计海报级布局，但缺乏衡量其是否遵守科学交流约定的方法，尤其是可读标签、规定宽高比，以及避免生成虚假科学图形。
Method: 提出POSTERHARNESS，通过占位符优先合约分离设计任务与数据绘图：模型仅进行视觉摘要设计（排版、阅读路径、颜色、背景），所有图形区域必须为空的带标签占位符；确定性合成器在检测到的坐标处插入真实源论文图形，从而可衡量占位符数量与ID准确率、空白率、宽高比合规性、避免合成图形、公开文本洁净度及源图形溯源。
Result: 在12篇论文上得出三个发现：(i) 反事实探针显示占位符合约将VLM计数的合成图形从34降至0；(ii) 失败分类识别出四种阻塞合约：占位符几何、占位符QA、模板批评和公开文本；(iii) 与Paper2Poster比较，POSTERHARNESS产生更高分辨率、更低白色画布比例和更强的VLM视觉偏好，但确定性基线保留略多的PosterQuiz信息且运行更快。
Conclusion: 该工作作为机制表征，非优越性声明。所有提示、工件、清单和审计脚本已开源，可作为可复用的评估组件。

papers.title: Transfer Learning in High-dimensional Ising Models
papers.abstract_en: In high-dimensional Ising model estimation, target sample sizes are often limited, and effectively using auxiliary binary datasets of unknown relevance remains challenging. To address this, we propose Trans-Ising, a transfer learning method that combines a loss-based source screening rule with a two-stage estimation procedure. The method first identifies informative auxiliary sources using held-out target pseudolikelihood to prevent negative transfer. It then computes an initial estimator via pooled nodewise $\ell_1$-regularized logistic regression, followed by a target-only correction step using a folded-concave penalty. Theoretically, we establish fixed-node $\ell_2$ and $\ell_1$ error bounds, exact graph selection consistency, and the conditional consistency of the screening rule. Through extensive simulations and real-data analyses, we demonstrate that Trans-Ising achieves lower estimation errors than both target-only estimation and naive data pooling.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Trans-Ising，一种针对高维 Ising 模型估计的迁移学习方法，通过基于损失的信源筛选和两阶段估计，在目标样本有限时利用辅助二进制数据集。理论证明误差界和图选择一致性，实验表明优于仅目标估计和朴素数据合并。
Motivation: 高维 Ising 模型估计中目标样本量有限，且辅助二进制数据集的相关性未知，直接使用可能导致负迁移。
Method: 提出 Trans-Ising，包含基于保留目标伪似然的损失筛选规则以识别有用信源，然后通过节点式 ℓ1-正则化逻辑回归得到初始估计，再用折叠凹惩罚进行目标仅校正。
Result: 理论建立固定节点 ℓ2 和 ℓ1 误差界、精确图选择一致性以及筛选规则的条件一致性。仿真和真实数据分析显示 Trans-Ising 的估计误差低于仅目标估计和朴素数据合并。
Conclusion: 该方法有效利用相关辅助数据提升高维 Ising 模型估计精度，并提供理论保证。

summary_sections.motivation: 高维 Ising 模型估计中目标样本量有限，且辅助二进制数据集的相关性未知，直接使用可能导致负迁移。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Trans-Ising，包含基于保留目标伪似然的损失筛选规则以识别有用信源，然后通过节点式 ℓ1-正则化逻辑回归得到初始估计，再用折叠凹惩罚进行目标仅校正。
summary_sections.result: 理论建立固定节点 ℓ2 和 ℓ1 误差界、精确图选择一致性以及筛选规则的条件一致性。仿真和真实数据分析显示 Trans-Ising 的估计误差低于仅目标估计和朴素数据合并。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法有效利用相关辅助数据提升高维 Ising 模型估计精度，并提供理论保证。

papers.title: REAL-OW: Rehearsal-free Open World Object Detection with Low-Rank Adaptation and Dual-Stage Objectness Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Open-World Object Detection (OWOD) requires detectors to identify previously unseen objects as unknown and incrementally incorporate them into the set of known categories, while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Existing frameworks rely heavily on exemplar replay to mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but in some real applications, storing raw data conflicts with data access restrictions and leads to data exposure risks, while incurring significant memory overhead. In this paper, we propose REAL-OW, a novel rehearsal-free framework that decouples incremental knowledge through a collaborative adapter architecture based on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Specifically, we deploy General Adapters (GAs) in the backbone to enable the significance-aware refinement of cross-task universal representations, while Specific Adapters (SAs) in the decoder provide orthogonal storage for task-specific expertise. To resolve representation drift in objectness modeling under rehearsal-free constraints, we introduce Dual-Stage Objectness Modeling (DSOM), which alternates between feature aggregation and boundary consolidation to stabilize objectness distributions while maintaining the separation between known and unknown categories. Furthermore, DSOM is supported by a Calibrated Gaussian Negative Log-Likelihood (CG-NLL) distance tailored for the dispersed feature distributions inherent in rehearsal-free settings. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that REAL-OW achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing exemplar replay methods in both detection precision and unknown discovery. Our approach establishes a new baseline for rehearsal-free OWOD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REAL-OW，一种无需记忆回放的开放世界目标检测框架。该框架通过基于低秩适应（LoRA）的协作适配器架构解耦增量知识，并引入双阶段目标性建模（DSOM）和校准高斯负对数似然（CG-NLL）距离，在无回放条件下稳定目标性分布，实现已知与未知类别的分离。实验表明，REAL-OW超越了现有基于回放的OWOD方法。
Motivation: 现有开放世界目标检测方法依赖样本回放以缓解灾难性遗忘，但回放存在数据访问限制和内存开销问题，亟需无需回放的解决方案。
Method: 提出REAL-OW框架，包括基于LoRA的通用适配器（GA）和特定适配器（SA）分别处理跨任务通用表示和任务特定知识，以及双阶段目标性建模（DSOM）通过特征聚合和边界巩固稳定目标性分布，并采用校准高斯负对数似然（CG-NLL）距离适应无回放场景下的分散特征分布。
Result: 在多个基准上，REAL-OW在检测精度和未知发现能力上达到最先进性能，甚至优于现有基于回放的方法。
Conclusion: REAL-OW为无回放开放世界目标检测建立了新基线，证明了无需存储历史数据即可有效增量学习的可行性。

papers.title: CONFLUX: A Latent Diusion Model for 3D Chest-CT Synthesis with RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Controllable generative models of 3D medical images can synthesize volumes with specified clinical attributes, but this demands samples that are simultaneously high-fidelity, natively 3D, and faithful to the requested conditioning. We present CONFLUX, a latent diffusion model for chest computed tomography (CT): a 3D variational autoencoder compresses each volume, and a rectified-flow transformer generates in the latent space. Generation is conditioned on structured radiological metadata (18 abnormality findings, sex, age, and reconstruction kernel) through adaptive layer normalization. The model leads strong volumetric baselines on tri-planar Frechet distance (FID 32.3 vs. 74.6 for MAISI) while exposing direct control over clinical attributes. To strengthen that control we add an online reinforcement-learning post-training stage (group-relative policy optimization) that rewards how reliably a classifier recovers the requested findings from each generated volume. Judged by a separate, independent classifier, post-training removes 47% of the shortfall relative to real-scan reliability. We release the model and a ~200k synthetic chest-CT dataset with conditioning metadata spanning a wide variety of clinical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CONFLUX是一个用于3D胸部CT合成的潜在扩散模型，使用3D变分自编码器（VAE）压缩体积，并通过整流流变压器在潜在空间中生成。生成条件为结构化放射学元数据（18种异常发现、性别、年龄和重建核），通过自适应层归一化实现。模型在三维平面Fréchet距离上优于强基线（FID 32.3 vs MAISI的74.6），并可直接控制临床属性。通过在线强化学习后训练（组相对策略优化）进一步加强对条件的控制，奖励分类器从生成体积中恢复请求发现的能力。后训练消除了与真实扫描可靠性差距的47%。作者发布了模型和一个约20万张合成胸部CT数据集，附带涵盖广泛临床发现的元数据。
Motivation: 可控生成的3D医学图像需要同时具有高保真度、原生3D特性以及对指定条件的忠实度，现有方法在这些方面存在不足。
Method: 提出CONFLUX框架，包括3D VAE和整流流Transformer，通过自适应层归一化对结构化放射学元数据进行条件控制。后训练阶段使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）的在线强化学习，以分类器恢复条件发现的可靠性作为奖励信号。
Result: 在三维平面Fréchet距离（FID）上达到32.3，优于MAISI的74.6；后训练消除了47%的可靠性差距（与真实扫描相比）。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了高保真、原生3D且条件可控的胸部CT合成，强化学习后训练有效提升了条件控制的可靠性。

papers.title: VISTA: Auditing Semantic Divergence in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models can exhibit visual concept-conditioned divergence: given images containing demographic features, corporate logos, or ideological symbols, some models produce unusually uniform responses that differ from what peer models say about the same input. These behaviors evade text-only audits because visual concepts cannot be isolated or substituted the way text tokens can. We present VISTA (Visual Inconsistency Screening Through Analysis), a black-box cross-model audit that couples semantic entropy with distribution-based divergence to flag model-specific anomalies. In a controlled study, we implant concept-conditioned stances in three VLMs via fine-tuning on small biased datasets and confirm that VISTA detects them. Auditing six VLMs across 19 topics, VISTA surfaces 142 high-suspicion cases (1.2%) and identifies selective refusal as a previously unreported divergence pattern, where models refuse demographic queries at rates varying from 0 to 65% across groups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VISTA，一种黑盒跨模型审计方法，通过结合语义熵与基于分布的分歧度，检测视觉语言模型中的视觉概念条件性分歧。在受控实验中，VISTA成功检测到通过微调植入的偏见；在6个VLM的19个主题上，VISTA标记了142个高可疑案例（1.2%），并识别出选择性拒绝这一此前未报告的分歧模式。
Motivation: 现有文本审计无法检测视觉概念（如人口统计特征、公司标志等）引起的模型行为分歧，因为视觉概念无法像文本令牌一样被隔离或替换。
Method: VISTA（Visual Inconsistency Screening Through Analysis）采用黑盒方式，结合语义熵与基于分布的分歧度，跨模型比较输出分布以标记异常。
Result: 在受控实验中，VISTA检测到通过小规模偏置数据集微调植入的立场；在6个VLM的19个主题上，发现142个高可疑案例（1.2%），并揭示选择性拒绝模式——模型对不同人口统计组的查询拒绝率差异达0%至65%。
Conclusion: VISTA能有效检测视觉概念条件性分歧，并发现此前未知的分歧模式，为视觉语言模型的可审计性提供了新工具。

papers.title: GuideMe: Multi-Domain Task Guidance and Intervention in Streaming Video
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at offline video understanding, an interesting question of how far they are from serving as a real-time procedural coach remains unknown. Such a role typically requires an MLLM to continuously monitor the execution, detect mistakes, and provide corrective guidance in a closed-loop interaction. In this paper, we construct GuideMe, the first multi-domain benchmark for streaming video that supports training and evaluation of MLLMs for closed-loop interactive task guidance. It comprises 2,458 videos spanning 223.7 hours across diverse domains (\eg, cooking, object manipulation, daily-life guidance, and fitness), with 47,775 interaction samples covering next-step instructions, completion feedback, error detection, and corrective guidance. To evaluate existing models on GuideMe, we design a three-component assessment framework to measure the capabilities of representative MLLMs, which consists of temporal-semantic bipartite matching for sequence-level alignment, behavioral classification for intervention timing, and LLM-as-a-Judge for content quality. Extensive experiments highlight a critical performance asymmetry: despite excelling at providing instructions, existing MLLMs consistently fail to identify execution errors and respond with corrective feedback. Code and data are released at https://fawnliu.github.io/project/guideme.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了GuideMe，第一个用于流式视频的多领域基准，支持闭环交互任务指导的训练和评估。包含2458个视频和47775个交互样本，覆盖烹饪、物体操作、日常生活指导和健身等领域。评估框架包括时序语义二分匹配、行为分类和LLM评分。实验表明现有MLLM在提供指令方面表现出色，但在识别执行错误和提供纠正反馈方面存在严重不足。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在离线视频理解上表现优异，但在实时流式视频中作为程序教练进行闭环交互指导的能力尚不清楚，缺乏相应的基准。
Method: 构建GuideMe基准，包含多领域视频和交互样本；设计三组件评估框架：时序语义二分匹配、行为分类和LLM评分。
Result: 实验发现现有MLLM在提供指令方面表现良好，但一致地未能识别执行错误并提供纠正反馈，存在关键性能不对称。
Conclusion: 强调了现有MLLM在实时任务指导和干预中的局限性，特别是错误检测和纠正反馈能力的缺失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MABLE: Masked Autoencoding with Bi-Lipschitz Decoding for Embeddings and Graph Metric Learning
papers.abstract_en: We propose MABLE (Masked Autoencoding with Bi-Lipschitz Decoding for Embeddings and Graph Metric Learning), a self-supervised framework for learning node and graph embeddings from large, heterogeneous graphs, demonstrated here on geospatial mineral-exploration data. MABLE combines masked reconstruction with fixed cosine-similarity losses that align matched augmented views while keeping unpaired embeddings well spread. A bi-Lipschitz feature decoder ties a low-dimensional reconstruction component of each node embedding to feature similarity, while matched-node consistency shapes the remaining context used by graph pooling. Lipschitz-controlled pooling helps stabilize graph-level representations under perturbations of retained node embeddings, while augmentation alignment trains robustness to masking, node dropping, and sampling variation. Across local copper and regional Arabian Shield studies, MABLE embeddings provide complementary downstream signal and produce coherent embedding-derived layers for hypothesis generation without learned discriminators or hard-negative selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MABLE，一种自监督框架，用于从大型异构图中学习节点和图嵌入，并在地球空间矿产勘探数据上验证。MABLE 结合掩码重建和固定余弦相似度损失，利用双利普希茨特征解码器将低维重建与特征相似性关联，并通过利普希茨控制池化稳定图级表示。实验表明，MABLE 嵌入在铜矿和阿拉伯盾区域研究中提供互补的下游信号，无需鉴别器或硬负样本选择。
Motivation: 现有图自监督方法在处理大规模异构地球科学图数据时，难以同时保持嵌入的局部相似性和全局判别性。
Method: 提出 MABLE，包含掩码自编码和双利普希茨解码器，结合固定余弦相似度损失对齐增强视图，并使用利普希茨控制池化增强鲁棒性。
Result: 在铜矿和阿拉伯盾区域研究中，MABLE 嵌入提供了互补的下游信号，生成一致的嵌入层用于假设生成。
Conclusion: MABLE 为图度量学习提供了一种有效的自监督方案，尤其适用于地理空间数据，无需监督信号。

papers.title: Cross-device Collaborative Test-time Adaptation with Zeroth-order Optimization and Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) mitigates domain shifts by using incoming test data to update a model on the fly. The majority of TTA methods require resource-intensive backpropagation (BP) for model updates, particularly demanding large memory sizes, which makes it infeasible to deploy them on resource-limited devices (e.g., edge devices). To address this issue, we integrate two different techniques, zeroth-order optimization (ZOO) and model merging, under the recently established cross-device collaborative TTA (CDC-TTA) framework, where the system is composed of a mixture of resource-abundant and resource-limited devices, and the model information (e.g., model weights obtained on each device) is shared across the devices. Our method is executable on resource-limited devices by introducing ZOO, which requires only forward processing and bypasses the resource-intensive BP optimization. Concurrently, to mitigate the high-dimensional optimization difficulty caused by the side effect of ZOO, we incorporate model merging of the shared multiple models and set the merge coefficients as the optimization objective, which successfully reduces the optimization dimension. In addition, to enhance the synergistic combination of ZOO and model merging, we propose a unique preprocessing strategy that trims intra-model non-influential weights and reduces the inter-model information redundancy. We empirically confirmed the effectiveness of our method using common corruption and style-transferred image benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对资源受限设备上测试时适应（TTA）的反向传播（BP）资源消耗大、不可行的问题，提出结合零阶优化（ZOO）和模型合并的方法。方法在跨设备协同TTA框架下，使用ZOO避免BP，并通过模型合并将优化目标设为合并系数以降低维度；另设计预处理策略修剪非重要权重并减少模型间冗余。在图像损坏和风格转换基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有TTA方法依赖资源密集的反向传播，难以部署在边缘设备等资源受限场景；同时，引入零阶优化会导致高维优化困难。
Method: 在跨设备协同TTA框架下，用零阶优化（ZOO）替代反向传播，仅需前向计算；通过模型合并将优化目标设为合并系数，降低优化维度；并提出预处理策略修剪非重要权重、减少模型间冗余。
Result: 摘要报告在通用图像损坏和风格转换基准上验证了方法的有效性，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该方法使资源受限设备能够参与TTA，并通过模型合并缓解ZOO带来的高维优化问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RePos: Relative-to-Absolute Output Factorization for Cross-Environment WiFi-Based 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Device-free 3D human pose estimation using commodity WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) enables privacy-preserving and illumination-robust human sensing, but its deployment is limited by poor cross-environment generalization. Unlike images, CSI measurements do not have a spatially localized correspondence to body parts and are heavily affected by multipath propagation, causing models that regress absolute poses to entangle body structure with environment-specific location cues. Within a single environment this coupling is benign: an end-to-end absolute-pose variant, RePos-D, already achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on Person-in-WiFi-3D (86.9 mm MPJPE, a 3.4% gain over the previous best WiFi method, DT-Pose). Across environments, however, the same model overfits position and suffers significant performance degradation. We therefore propose RePos, a factorized framework that separates root-relative pose estimation from root localization. By preventing absolute-pose supervision from affecting the structure branch, RePos learns environment-invariant pose representations. Specifically, it groups CSI features into body-part-aware latent tokens that skeleton-guided modeling refines into the pose, while a separate amplitude-based network estimates the root position through a differentiable spatial-decomposition module. Under the strict MM-Fi cross-environment protocol, RePos achieves MPJPEs of 254.4-296.1 mm, a 10-21% reduction over existing WiFi-based methods. The improvement remains consistent across activity protocols, leave-one-environment-out splits, and leakage-free few-shot transfer. Analysis of the learned features shows that relative-pose representations remain largely position-agnostic, while root localization retains environment dependence, indicating distinct generalization behavior for structure and localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RePos，一种将根相对姿态估计与根位置定位解耦的因子化框架，用于跨环境的WiFi信号3D人体姿态估计。通过避免绝对姿态监督影响结构分支，学习环境不变的姿态表示，在MM-Fi跨环境协议下实现MPJPE降低10-21%。
Motivation: 现有WiFi姿态估计方法在跨环境时因绝对姿态监督导致身体结构与位置线索混淆，泛化性能下降。
Method: 将CSI特征分组为身体部位感知的潜在令牌，通过骨架引导建模得到根相对姿态；另设幅度网络通过可微空间分解模块估计根位置。
Result: 在MM-Fi跨环境协议下，MPJPE为254.4-296.1 mm，比现有WiFi方法降低10-21%；在多种评估设置下改善一致。
Conclusion: 相对姿态表示对位置不敏感，而根定位保留环境依赖性，表明结构与定位具有不同的泛化行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Seeking Diagnostic Reasoning with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent reasoning-centric Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant strides, yet they predominantly operate on a passive-inference pattern that assumes complete information. In contrast, real-world clinical intelligence is inherently an iterative investigative process requiring strategic evidence acquisition. To bridge this gap, we formalize medical diagnosis as an Iterative Evidence-Seeking Task. We leverage Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to elicit intrinsic reasoning within a closed-loop environment, guided by a novel suite of rewards that enforce diagnostic precision and examination consistency. To facilitate this, we introduce the Retrieval-Augmented Generation-based Examination Simulator (RAGES), a high-fidelity clinical oracle that provides realistic, knowledge-grounded follow-up evidence. Empirical results across diverse datasets demonstrate that our framework enables LLMs to transition from passive responders to autonomous assistants. Notably, our model demonstrates comparable performance to larger and reasoning-enhanced baselines, while RAGES proves superior to vanilla LLMs in generating biologically plausible clinical feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将医疗诊断形式化为迭代证据寻求任务，利用带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）激发大语言模型在闭环环境中的推理能力，并引入基于检索增强生成的检查模拟器（RAGES）提供逼真的临床反馈。实验表明该方法使LLM从被动应答者转变为主动助手，性能接近更大规模的基线模型。
Motivation: 现有推理型LLM主要采用被动推理模式，假设信息完整，而真实临床诊断需要迭代的证据获取过程。本文旨在弥合这一差距，使LLM学会自主获取证据。
Method: 形式化医疗诊断为迭代证据寻求任务，使用RLVR训练模型，并设计一套奖励函数确保诊断准确性和检查一致性。同时提出RAGES模拟器，基于检索增强生成提供知识驱动的临床反馈。
Result: 在多个数据集上，框架使LLM实现从被动到主动的转变；模型性能与更大规模或经过推理增强的基线相当；RAGES在生成生物学合理的临床反馈方面优于普通LLM。
Conclusion: 通过强化学习和模拟环境，大语言模型能够学会自主进行证据寻求的诊断推理，为临床辅助决策提供了可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhanced Feature Extraction for IoT Network Intrusion Detection Using GNNs and KAN
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in the Internet of Things (IoT) emphasize the urgent need for advanced network security, as IoT networks feature dynamic topologies, imbalanced traffic, and complex attack patterns. Unlike general IT networks, IoT environments exhibit extreme heterogeneity and sparse topologies. Traditional GNN-based intrusion detection methods often struggle to efficiently model node and edge features or capture fine-grained anomalies in such settings. To address this, we propose SKGFusionKAN, a novel IoT-tailored approach enhancing GraphSAGE with a multi-scale selective kernel attention mechanism. This enables adaptive extraction of node and edge features under diverse traffic conditions. Specifically, our edge-oriented message passing strengthens information propagation, while selective kernel attention adaptively weights edge-derived information from different scales to handle heterogeneity. We also introduce a gated fusion process to dynamically integrate multi-scale features, improving robustness against evolving attacks. Finally, we leverage Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) for classification, offering superior nonlinear modeling capabilities essential for detecting intricate, low-frequency attacks. To our knowledge, this work presents a comprehensive integration of GNNs and KAN with dedicated architectural innovations for IoT intrusion detection. Extensive experiments on four NIDS benchmarks show that SKGFusionKAN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in binary and multiclass tasks, demonstrating its potential for IoT security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对物联网（IoT）网络入侵检测中动态拓扑、流量不平衡和复杂攻击模式的问题，提出SKGFusionKAN方法。该方法在GraphSAGE基础上引入多尺度选择性核注意力机制，自适应提取节点和边特征，并通过边缘导向消息传递和门控融合增强特征传播，最终使用KAN（Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks）进行分类。在四个NIDS基准上的实验表明，该方法在二分类和多分类任务上均优于现有技术。
Motivation: IoT网络具有动态拓扑、稀疏结构和极端异质性，传统GNN入侵检测方法难以有效建模节点和边特征或捕获细粒度异常。
Method: 提出SKGFusionKAN，增强GraphSAGE：使用多尺度选择性核注意力机制自适应提取节点和边特征；采用边缘导向消息传递强化信息传播；通过门控融合动态整合多尺度特征；最后利用KAN进行非线性分类。
Result: 在四个NIDS基准数据集上，SKGFusionKAN在二分类和多分类任务中一致优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了GNN与KAN在IoT入侵检测中的综合潜力，对低频率复杂攻击有较好的检测能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Sparse Attention Done Right: Toward Infinite Context Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling modern large language models (LLMs) to long contexts is limited by the quadratic computation cost, and poor length extrapolation of dense attention. Chunk-wise sparse attention offers a promising alternative, but all existing methods fall short of full attention because of their inaccurate chunk selection. We propose Hierarchical Landmark Sparse (HiLS) Attention, a chunk-wise sparse attention mechanism that learns chunk selection end-to-end under the language-modeling (LM) loss. HiLS factorizes attention hierarchically: each query performs attention independently with each retrieved chunk to extract chunk-specific information, and the resulting outputs are fused according to chunk retrieval scores. By incorporating retrieval scores into the forward attention computation, HiLS optimizes them directly with the LM loss, enabling end-to-end retrieval learning and native sparse training. Experimental results show that HiLS-Attention achieves performance comparable to, and in some cases better than, full attention at in-domain context lengths. Meanwhile, HiLS-Attention extrapolates more than $64\times$ the training context length with 90% retrieval accuracy, far beyond full attention. Moreover, existing full-attention models can be converted to HiLS-Attention with lightweight continued pretraining, preserving in-domain performance while acquiring ultra-long-context extrapolation. Together with its sparse KV access and computation, HiLS-Attention breaks the usual efficiency-performance trade-off, enabling long-context LLMs that are both more efficient and more effective on general long-context tasks than their full-attention counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层次化地标稀疏注意力（HiLS Attention），一种端到端学习块选择的分块稀疏注意力机制，通过将检索分数融入前向计算并用语言建模损失优化，实现了与全注意力相当甚至更优的域内性能，同时可外推至训练长度64倍以上。在保持域内性能的前提下，现有全注意力模型可通过轻量继续预训练转换为HiLS，获得超长上下文外推能力。
Motivation: 长上下文LLM受限于二次计算成本和密集注意力的长度外推差，现有分块稀疏注意力因块选择不准确而无法匹敌全注意力性能。
Method: HiLS注意力：每个查询独立与每个检索得到的块进行注意力以提取块特定信息，然后根据检索分数融合输出；通过将检索分数纳入前向计算并用LM损失直接优化，实现端到端检索学习和原生稀疏训练。
Result: 在域内上下文长度上达到与全注意力相当或更优的性能，可外推超过64倍训练长度且检索准确率90%；稀疏KV访问和计算打破了效率-性能权衡。
Conclusion: HiLS注意力使长上下文LLM比全注意力更高效、更有效，且现有全注意力模型可通过轻量继续预训练转换为HiLS，获得超长上下文外推能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Generative Agents with Actions Grounded in Socially Distributed Task Environments using Incognita
papers.abstract_en: Effective agency in social environments depends on when an agent seeks knowledge, when it acts, and whether its actions are justified by acquired information. Existing grounded benchmarks provide executable actions, persistent state, and verifiable outcomes, while social simulation environments provide rich interaction among language agents. We study an evaluation setting that combines these requirements. We define socially distributed task environments as interactive environments where task-relevant knowledge is partitioned across role-isolated participants and consequential actions are accessible only through them. Communication serves as exploration over role-partitioned knowledge, while grounded action serves as exploitation over environment state. We introduce Incognita, a Concordia-based framework that separates social interaction from grounded execution. The evaluated agent routes messages to a user or specialist entities; specialists mediate admissible operations; a deterministic sub-environment executes accepted operations over a canonical state; and an offline evaluator scores outcomes with inherited rewards. Incognita-Retail transforms tau-bench retail into a multi-entity environment while preserving final-state reward semantics. We evaluate three generative agent models on 18 tasks stratified by social breadth, with 540 trials. Progress appears in reward and behavior: success rises from 0 percent to 8.9 percent and 17.2 percent, while premature finalization falls from 100 percent to 87 percent and 58 percent. Stronger models elicit more hidden knowledge, contact more entities, and attempt more grounded writes, yet reliability remains low. These findings show that socially distributed task environments expose behavior before reliable success, including knowledge elicitation, source selection, grounded action attempts, and premature completion belief.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Incognita框架，用于评估生成式智能体在社会分布任务环境中的行为。该框架结合社交交互与可执行操作，将任务相关知识分散在不同角色间，智能体需通过交流获取知识并执行操作。基于tau-bench零售场景构建Incognita-Retail环境，评估三个智能体模型在18个任务上的表现，结果显示成功率从0%提升到8.9%和17.2%，但可靠性仍然较低。
Motivation: 现有基准要么提供可验证的交互环境但缺乏社交维度，要么提供丰富的社交模拟但缺乏可执行操作。本文旨在填补两者之间的空白，研究智能体在社会分布知识环境中的行为。
Method: 提出Incognita框架，将社交交互与可执行操作分离：智能体通过消息与用户或专家实体交互，专家实体执行允许的操作，确定性子环境维护状态并执行操作，离线评估器根据结果打分。Incognita-Retail将tau-bench零售场景改造为多实体环境。
Result: 在18个任务上进行540次试验，三个模型（未具体命名）成功率从0%升至8.9%和17.2%，过早终止比例从100%降至87%和58%。更强模型能获取更多隐藏知识、接触更多实体并尝试更多写操作，但可靠性仍低。
Conclusion: 社会分布任务环境能够暴露智能体在可靠成功之前的行为模式，包括知识获取、源选择、操作尝试和过早完成信念。当前模型可靠性不足，需要进一步改进。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出Incognita框架，将社交交互与可执行操作分离：智能体通过消息与用户或专家实体交互，专家实体执行允许的操作，确定性子环境维护状态并执行操作，离线评估器根据结果打分。Incognita-Retail将tau-bench零售场景改造为多实体环境。
summary_sections.result: 在18个任务上进行540次试验，三个模型（未具体命名）成功率从0%升至8.9%和17.2%，过早终止比例从100%降至87%和58%。更强模型能获取更多隐藏知识、接触更多实体并尝试更多写操作，但可靠性仍低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 社会分布任务环境能够暴露智能体在可靠成功之前的行为模式，包括知识获取、源选择、操作尝试和过早完成信念。当前模型可靠性不足，需要进一步改进。

papers.title: Awakening Diffusion Transformers: Eliciting Stronger Generation and Understanding via Massive Activation Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Massive Activations (MAs) have been widely observed in Transformer-based models, yet their structure and functional roles in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we systematically analyze MAs in representative DiTs and find that they are spatially distributed across image tokens while concentrated in a small set of fixed feature dimensions. We further show that these dimensions are closely aligned with AdaLN residual scaling factors and are primarily modulated by the denoising timestep rather than text conditions. This structure leads to two task-dependent effects: for generation, MAs are critical for fine-grained detail synthesis while having limited influence on global semantics; for understanding, their shared high-magnitude directions make raw DiT features overly similar across spatial tokens and weaken dense feature discrimination. Based on these findings, we introduce Eliciting Massive Activation (EMA), a training-free framework that leverages Massive Activations (MAs) as a unified modulation signal to improve both generative and representational capabilities of DiTs. For generation, EMA proposes MA-driven Detail G}uidance (DG), which suppresses MA dimensions to construct a detail-deficient counterfactual prediction and guides sampling toward finer visual details. DG further supports efficient partial-forward inference, integration with classifier-free guidance, and token-level Local DG for refining selected image regions. For understanding, EMA introduces MA-modulated REPresentation extraction (MREP), which uses pretrained AdaLN channel-wise modulation to reduce MA directional dominance and concatenates spatially normalized MA maps to preserve useful spatial structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EMA consistently improves both the generation quality and representation capability of DiTs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了扩散Transformer（DiT）中的大规模激活（MAs）结构，发现它们集中在固定特征维度且由去噪时间步调控，并提出训练无关的EMA框架：通过抑制MA实现细节引导生成（DG），以及利用AdaLN调制减少MA方向主导性以改进表示提取（MREP），实验表明该方法能同时提升DiT的生成质量与表征能力。
Motivation: Massive Activations (MAs)在Transformer模型中普遍存在，但其在扩散Transformer（DiT）中的结构和功能角色尚未被充分理解，限制了模型生成和表征能力的提升。
Method: 提出EMA框架，包含两部分：一是MA驱动的细节引导（DG），通过抑制MA构造缺失细节的反事实预测并引导采样趋向细致细节，支持高效部分前向推理和无分类器引导；二是MA调制的表示提取（MREP），利用预训练AdaLN逐通道调制减少MA方向主导性，拼接空间归一化的MA图保留空间结构。
Result: 实验证明EMA能一致提升DiT的生成质量和表征能力，但摘要未提供具体数值或基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调MAs的结构具有任务依赖性：对生成至关重要于细粒度细节，但对理解任务则因共享高幅值方向导致特征相似性降低判别力，而EMA通过统一调制信号可同时改善两方面性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rank-Order N-of-M Codes for Sparse Distributed Memory: Disentangling Representation and Learning Effects in Noise Robustness Against Contemporary Neuromorphic Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Large language models remain limited as continual learning systems, motivating renewed interest in Sparse Distributed Memory (SDM) as an explicit online episodic memory. CALM (Nechesov and Ruponen, 2025) identifies its threshold-binary encoder as an open design question. This paper evaluates rank-order N-of-M encoding (Furber et al., 2007) as an alternative. We make three contributions. First, a faithful reimplementation validates the published architecture by confirming exact equivalence between WheelSDM and RankOrderSDM (cosine similarity 1.0000 across 10 seeds) and reproducing the documented divergence of RDLIF neurons under interference. Second, multi-seed capacity experiments show RankOrderSDM outperforming StandardSDM by 13.4 percentage points at saturation in the scaled configuration and by 0.8 percentage points at the published architecture scale. Third, BER robustness experiments disentangle representation and learning effects, showing that the large robustness gain arises primarily from the interaction of rank-order encoding with MAX-Hebbian learning, while the encoder alone provides only a small advantage under matched learning conditions. Experiments on GloVe-100 embeddings confirm this small but consistent encoding benefit on real structured data, whereas sentence embeddings exhibit a ceiling effect at low memory load. A secondary analysis shows that idealized rank-order encoding requires half the component-level encoding energy of SpikingMamba's SI-LIF neurons at four-bit precision, although decoder costs dominate overall system energy. These results identify which components of the original rank-order SDM architecture provide measurable benefits for contemporary memory-augmented AI systems, offering practical guidance for architectures such as CALM.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 8 tables, 2 figures. Revisits rank-order sparse distributed memory for continual learning and memory-augmented AI. Includes comparisons with CALM and SpikingMamba, statistical evaluation, and real embedding experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了稀疏分布式记忆（SDM）中排序 N-of-M 编码的表示与学习效应。通过 faithful 复现确认 WheelSDM 和 RankOrderSDM 等价；多种子容量实验表明 RankOrderSDM 在缩放配置下比 StandardSDM 饱和性能高出 13.4 个百分点；BER 鲁棒性实验将鲁棒性增益主要归因于排序编码与 MAX-Hebbian 学习的交互，而非编码器本身。在 GloVe-100 嵌入上验证了编码优势，但句子嵌入在低内存负载下出现天花板效应。此外，理想化排序编码在四位精度下所需编码能量仅为 SpikingMamba SI-LIF 神经元的一半，但解码器成本占主导。结果为 CALM 等记忆增强架构提供指导。
Motivation: 大语言模型在持续学习方面受限，促使重新关注稀疏分布式记忆作为显式在线情景记忆。现有工作 (CALM) 指出阈值二进制编码器仍是开放设计问题，本文旨在评估排序 N-of-M 编码作为替代方案。
Method: 本文通过 faithful 复现、多种子容量实验和 BER 鲁棒性实验，系统比较了排序 N-of-M 编码与标准 SDM 编码，并设计实验解耦表示与学习效应。
Result: 排序 N-of-M 编码的 SDM (RankOrderSDM) 在缩放配置下饱和性能比 StandardSDM 高 13.4 个百分点；鲁棒性增益主要来自排序编码与 MAX-Hebbian 学习的交互，编码器自身仅提供微小优势。在 GloVe-100 嵌入上有一致的编码优势，句子嵌入出现天花板效应。编码能量消耗仅为 SpikingMamba 神经元的一半，但解码器成本占主导。
Conclusion: 本文识别了原始排序 SDM 架构中提供可测量收益的组件，为 CALM 等当代记忆增强 AI 系统提供实践指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Individual Parameters in Weight-Sparse Transformers Appear Interpretable
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of mechanistic interpretability is to understand how neural networks work and what each individual component does. Dominant circuit-finding approaches focus on a specific behavior and reverse-engineer the role of components on the associated sub-distribution. However, past work has shown that components can have different functions that are active on different subsets of the input distribution. In this work we ask whether a single weight can be understood globally across the full training distribution by characterizing when it matters (the inputs on which ablating it changes the model's predictions). We introduce an automated LLM pipeline that writes a short, human-readable description of when a weight matters and verifies it on held-out text, crediting a weight only if its description generalizes. Across two sparse and two dense transformers, the fraction of weights that are interpretable (in this sense) is higher in sparse transformers than in dense ones, a gap that widens once unreliable descriptions are discarded. Our results show that a meaningful fraction of a sparse transformer model's weights can be interpreted: 12 to 31% of weights have a single short description that identifies what the weight is used for.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏Transformer中单个权重的可解释性，提出自动化LLM管道，描述权重在何时对模型预测重要，并在留出文本上验证。实验表明，稀疏Transformer中12-31%的权重具有单一简短描述，且可解释比例高于密集Transformer。
Motivation: 现有机械可解释性方法聚焦特定行为，但组件在不同输入子分布上可能有不同功能。本文试图全局理解单个权重在整个训练分布上的作用。
Method: 引入自动化LLM管道，为每个权重生成人类可读的描述，说明其在哪些输入上影响预测，并通过留出文本验证描述是否泛化。
Result: 在稀疏和密集Transformer上，稀疏Transformer中可解释权重的比例更高（12-31%），排除不可靠描述后差距更大。
Conclusion: 有意义比例的稀疏Transformer权重可以通过简短描述解释其用途，表明稀疏模型更易于机械可解释性分析。

papers.title: Parallelized Autoregressive Decoding for Omni-Modal Dense Video Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Dense video captioning aims to generate temporally grounded descriptions of video events, benefiting both event-level video understanding and generation. In this domain, autoregressive video large language models have emerged as a prevalent paradigm due to their strong generative and cross-modal modeling capacity. However, generating dense captions under the token-by-token paradigm severely limits inference efficiency and hinders scalability as video length and event density increase. In this work, we propose a parallelized autoregressive framework that not only improves generation efficiency but also enhances temporally grounded captioning performance. Our key insight is to exploit the weak local dependencies across temporally distinct events to restructure the causal dependency graph, thereby enabling lossless parallel generation. Specifically, tokens with weak cross-event dependencies can be decoded in parallel, while tightly coupled tokens within each event retain sequential decoding to preserve local semantic coherence. To realize this insight, we introduce two key components for lossless parallel decoding: (1) a latent global planning mechanism that automatically learns the event-level structure and produces compact tokens encoding global inter-event causality while adaptively aggregating event-level audio-visual semantics, guiding subsequent dependency restructuring and parallel decoding; and (2) an event-factorized parallel decoding mechanism that effectively balances local focus with global inter-event awareness. Experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the clear advantage of our approach in both efficiency and performance in omni-modal event grounding and captioning. Project website: https://github.com/showlab/PadCaptioner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个并行自回归解码框架 PadCaptioner，用于全模态密集视频字幕生成。核心思路是利用时序上不同事件之间的弱局部依赖关系，重构因果依赖图，实现无损并行解码，从而提升推理效率并保持生成质量。框架包含潜在全局规划机制和事件分解并行解码机制。实验表明该方法在效率和性能上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有自回归视频大模型逐 token 生成密集字幕，推理效率低，难以适应视频长度和事件密度的增加。
Method: 提出潜在全局规划机制自动学习事件级结构并编码全局因果信息，以及事件分解并行解码机制，在保持局部语义连贯性的同时实现跨事件并行解码。
Result: 在多个密集视频字幕基准上，该方法在生成效率和时序定位性能上均取得明显优势。
Conclusion: 该并行化框架能有效提升密集视频字幕生成的效率而不牺牲质量，适用于全模态场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overloading Large Vision-Language Models for Jailbreaking
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit remarkable vision-language capabilities and are increasingly deployed in real-world applications such as personal assistants, document analysis systems, and embodied agents. However, their dual-modal attack surfaces make them vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing LVLM jailbreaks rely on simple designs, e.g., short text and out-of-distribution images. Nevertheless, recent advancements in both large language model backbones and multimodal mechanisms undermine these attacks, particularly their transferability among model architectures. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel information overloading method that is equipped with both extensive text and multi-dimensional image attacks. These components are arranged in recursion-based image-typography layouts to exponentially increase multimodal information complexity. This overloading approach amplifies the cross-modal processing required, which undermines the safety alignment in LVLMs. Extensive experiments on both open-sourced and commercial LVLMs establish our method as a new state-of-the-art LVLM jailbreak attack. On open-source models, our method achieves an average ASR of 88.6%; on commercial LVLMs, it reaches an average ASR of 84.0%, exceeding the best baseline by 48.7%. Moreover, our prompts optimized on open-source surrogate models transfer effectively across model families. Beyond empirical results, we probe the safety-critical information flows within victim LVLMs. Our observations reveal that complex image-typography compositions induce intensified cross-modal processing and reduce the model's certainty in generating refusal responses. Together, these findings highlight information overloading as a practical and emerging safety risk for real-world LVLM deployments, underscoring the need for stronger defenses against complex multimodal jailbreak inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种信息过载（information overloading）方法，通过递归式图像排版（image-typography）布局组合大量文本和多维图像攻击，以指数级增加多模态信息复杂度，从而破坏大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的安全对齐。实验在开源和商业LVLM上达到攻击成功率（ASR）88.6%和84.0%，超越现有基线48.7%。
Motivation: 现有LVLM越狱攻击依赖于简单设计（如短文本、分布外图像），但这些攻击在模型架构间的迁移性较差，且随着LLM骨干和多模态机制的进步而失效。
Method: 提出信息过载方法：结合大量文本（extensive text）和多维图像攻击（multi-dimensional image attacks），并以递归式图像排版布局组织，从而指数级增加多模态信息复杂度，迫使模型进行更强的跨模态处理，破坏安全对齐。
Result: 在开源LVLM上平均ASR达88.6%，在商业LVLM上达84.0%，超过最佳基线48.7%；攻击提示在开源代理模型上优化后能有效跨模型家族迁移。
Conclusion: 信息过载是LVLM实际部署中新兴的安全风险，凸显了针对复杂多模态越狱输入加强防御的必要性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出信息过载方法：结合大量文本（extensive text）和多维图像攻击（multi-dimensional image attacks），并以递归式图像排版布局组织，从而指数级增加多模态信息复杂度，迫使模型进行更强的跨模态处理，破坏安全对齐。
summary_sections.result: 在开源LVLM上平均ASR达88.6%，在商业LVLM上达84.0%，超过最佳基线48.7%；攻击提示在开源代理模型上优化后能有效跨模型家族迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 信息过载是LVLM实际部署中新兴的安全风险，凸显了针对复杂多模态越狱输入加强防御的必要性。

papers.title: Incentivizing Vision Language Models to Search for Long Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: We introduce VSeek, an agentic framework that transforms long-video question answering (LVQA) from a passive, single-pass perception task into a multi-turn retrieval process. VSeek utilizes a natural language-driven search to identify relevant context within long videos and is post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly formulate targeted search queries and reason over retrieved clips for LVQA. While RL post-training has revolutionized reasoning in symbolic domains such as mathematics and code, its application to long-video understanding remains hindered by a lack of verified rewards. To ensure that the retrieved context is relevant, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic approach that bridges open-ended natural language with discrete visual verification. Specifically, complex user queries are compiled into formal temporal logic specifications for systematically decomposing natural language questions into a definitive checklist of required atomic visual primitives, such as key objects and activities, along with their temporal ordering. These systematically derived grounding events provide the critical feedback signal for RL post-training, enabling dense, verifiable rewards based on the successful retrieval of these specific visual elements rather than relying entirely on outcome-only answer accuracy. By explicitly optimizing for this verifiable evidence-seeking behavior, VSeek improves Pass@1 scores by up to 8% and Pass@4 scores by 15% on long-video understanding benchmarks compared to base models. We open-source our code at https://utaustin-swarmlab.github.io/VSeek.
papers.comment: To appear at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VSeek，一种将长视频问答转化为多轮检索过程的智能体框架。VSeek 利用自然语言驱动的搜索，通过强化学习后训练联合优化搜索查询和推理，并采用神经符号方法将复杂问题编译为时间逻辑规范，提供可验证的奖励信号。在长视频理解基准上，Pass@1 提升最高 8%，Pass@4 提升 15%。
Motivation: 长视频问答通常是被动单次感知，难以精准定位相关片段；强化学习后训练在长视频理解中缺乏可验证的奖励信号，限制了其应用。
Method: 提出 VSeek 框架，包括自然语言驱动的搜索、基于强化学习的后训练，以及将用户问题编译为时间逻辑规范，用于系统化提取原子视觉原语（如关键物体和活动及其时序顺序），从而提供密集可验证奖励。
Result: 在长视频理解基准上，VSeek 的 Pass@1 提升最高 8%，Pass@4 提升最高 15%。
Conclusion: 通过显式优化可验证的证据搜索行为，VSeek 有效改善了长视频问答性能；代码已开源。

papers.title: ReLo-IRR: Reflection-Guided LoRA Framework for Image Reflection Removal
papers.abstract_en: Single-image reflection removal (SIRR) aims to recover the clean transmission layer from a reflection-contaminated image. Although recent methods achieve promising results with large diffusion models, they rely on image-agnostic adaptation strategies, e.g., fine-tuning or ControlNet, that enforce uniform suppression regardless of reflection severity. As a result, heavy reflections often leave residuals, while weak ones suffer from detail loss. To this end, we propose ReLo-IRR, a reflection-guided LoRA framework built upon the rectified flow model. First, a lightweight estimator is designed to predict the reflection strength descriptor, providing an explicit prior of reflection dominance for each image and enabling image-dependent LoRA modulation. Second, we introduce a time-conditioned mechanism that fuses this reflection descriptor with timestep embeddings, enabling LoRA modulation to evolve consistently with the coarse-to-fine denoising process. By jointly modeling reflection strength and denoising dynamics, our ReLo-IRR achieves robust suppression of diverse reflection conditions. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks validate the effectiveness of ReLo-IRR, demonstrating superior dereflection performance and robust generalization. The code is released at https://github.com/KONGBAI-8080/ReLo-IRR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLo-IRR，一种基于反射引导的 LoRA 框架，用于单图像反射去除。该方法通过轻量估计器预测反射强度描述子，并引入时间条件机制将描述子与时间步嵌入融合，实现与去噪过程一致的 LoRA 调制。在多个基准上验证了优于现有方法的去反射性能和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 SIRR 方法使用图像无关的适应策略（如微调或 ControlNet）统一抑制反射，导致强反射残留、弱反射细节丢失。需要根据反射强度进行自适应调整。
Method: 提出 ReLo-IRR 框架，包含：1) 轻量反射强度估计器输出反射强度描述子，作为图像依赖的先验；2) 时间条件机制将描述子与时间步嵌入融合，使 LoRA 调制随粗到细的去噪过程动态演化。
Result: 在多个挑战性基准上，ReLo-IRR 实现了优于现有方法的去反射性能和鲁棒泛化能力。
Conclusion: 通过联合建模反射强度和去噪动力学，ReLo-IRR 实现了对多样反射条件的鲁棒抑制，代码已开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MORE: A Multilingual Document Parsing Benchmark and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual documents encapsulate rich regional cultures, scientific discoveries, and historical records. Parsing this content into structured, machine-readable formats is critical for unlocking global knowledge. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on high-resource languages like English and Chinese, creating an evaluation blind spot concerning model performance on other languages. While recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) claim support for hundreds of languages, the lack of ground truth makes it impossible to empirically verify these capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce MORE, a large-scale benchmark designed for multilingual document parsing evaluation. MORE distinguishes itself through three key dimensions: (1) Unprecedented Scale: It covers 149 languages, making it the most linguistically diverse benchmark to date; (2) Structural Complexity: Unlike previous works, it extends evaluation beyond plain text to include structural elements such as code blocks, tables, and catalogs; and (3) Data Authenticity: All samples are curated from real-world documents via a model-assisted, human-refined annotation pipeline. We evaluate state-of-the-art models using MORE, establishing new performance baselines for long-tail languages and validating the benchmark's effectiveness in diagnosing model capabilities in realistic, diverse scenarios. The MORE dataset will be available at https://github.com/zimoqingfeng/MORE.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 22 pages, 11 figures. Code and dataset available at https://github.com/zimoqingfeng/MORE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MORE是一个大规模多语言文档解析基准，覆盖149种语言，评估模型在文本、代码块、表格等结构元素上的解析能力。所有样本来自真实文档，通过模型辅助人工精校的管道构建。实验建立了长尾语言的性能基线，并验证了基准在诊断模型能力方面的有效性。
Motivation: 现有基准主要关注英语和中文等高资源语言，导致对其他语言的模型性能评估存在盲区；尽管最新的视觉语言模型声称支持数百种语言，但缺乏标注真值无法验证。
Method: 构建包含149种语言的大规模基准MORE，从真实文档中通过模型辅助、人工精校的管道收集样本，评估范围扩展至文本、代码块、表格和目录等结构元素。
Result: 对当前最优模型进行评估，建立了长尾语言的新性能基线，验证了基准在真实多样化场景下诊断模型能力的有效性。
Conclusion: MORE填补了多语言文档解析评估的空白，为研究长尾语言和复杂结构解析提供了可靠工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Foreign Policy AI Evaluation Gap
papers.abstract_en: We argue that AI systems used in conducting foreign policy tasks - broadly enacting 'statecraft' - should be a priority test case for technical AI governance research. In enacting foreign policy, we refer to the formulation and implementation of external objectives by political actors. Statecraft is a high-consequence deployment domain, with extreme downside risks and structural properties that standard evaluation practices handle poorly. These features include partial observability, unbounded action spaces, contested ground truth, and multidimensional objectives. This paper advocates for a literature-grounded research agenda. Our contribution is threefold: (i) a claim about the structural conditions of foreign policy that combine catastrophic tail risk with technical evaluation complexities, (ii) an ECOSYSTEM review that highlights the asymmetric focus on ASSESSMENT features over ACCESS, VERIFICATION, SECURITY, and OPERATIONALIZATION, and (iii) a demand-side evaluation framework that decomposes foreign-policy workflows into bounded, evaluable sub-tasks with human recombination. As AI systems are already being deployed in the conduct of war and peace, amid limited public evaluation infrastructure from the technical AI governance community, this agenda is an urgent priority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证AI系统在外交政策（statecraft）任务中的应用应成为技术AI治理研究的优先案例。论文指出外交政策领域具有高风险、部分可观测性、无界动作空间、冲突真实标签和多维目标等结构特性，现有评估实践难以应对。作者提出三方面贡献：分析结构性条件、回顾现有评估生态（发现侧重于ASSESSMENT而忽视ACCESS等）、并提出一个将外交政策工作流分解为可评估子任务的需求侧评估框架。
Motivation: 外交政策是高风险领域，现有评估实践无法良好处理其部分可观测性、无界动作空间、冲突真实标签和多维目标等特性，且AI系统已在战争与和平中部署但缺乏公共评估基础设施。
Method: 通过文献回顾和理论分析，提出三部分贡献：1) 揭示外交政策的结构性条件（灾难性尾部风险与评估复杂性并存）；2) 生态系统回顾显示评估特征的不对称关注；3) 需求侧评估框架，将外交政策工作流分解为有界、可评估的子任务并人工重组。
Result: 论文未报告实验性结果，而是提出概念框架和研究议程，强调在AI系统已实际部署的背景下，技术AI治理社区应优先关注外交政策评估。
Conclusion: 作者认为该议程是紧迫的优先事项，呼吁社区构建公共评估基础设施以应对外交政策AI的风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pooling-Based Context Modeling for Convolution-Free Deep Image Prior
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) achieve strong denoising performance by exploiting spatial context from neighboring pixels. Deep Image Prior (DIP) leverages this property to restore images from a single noisy input without requiring large datasets. However, the over-parameterized architecture of DIP often leads to noise fitting during optimization. In this paper, we propose Pool-DIP, a convolution-free architecture that incorporates pooling-based contrast modeling to capture spatial context efficiently. Pool-DIP improves denoising performance while significantly reducing the number of parameters and computational complexity compared to convolution-based DIP models. Experimental results show that Pool-DIP achieves competitive performance across multiple datasets, including a real-world benchmark. Spectral analysis further reveals that Pool-DIP stabilizes the evolution of high-frequency components during optimization and suppresses erroneous high-frequency signals. The proposed architecture also generalizes well to other image restoration tasks such as super-resolution and inpainting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pool-DIP，一种无卷积架构，通过基于池化的上下文建模来高效捕获空间上下文，用于深度图像先验（DIP）中的图像去噪。Pool-DIP 在减少参数和计算复杂度的同时，在多数据集上取得有竞争力的去噪性能，并推广到超分辨率和修复等任务。频谱分析表明，它稳定了优化过程中高频分量的演化并抑制了错误的高频信号。
Motivation: 标准 DIP 的过度参数化架构在优化时容易拟合噪声，且卷积运算计算量大。本文旨在设计一种无卷积架构，在保持去噪能力的同时降低复杂度和过拟合风险。
Method: 提出 Pool-DIP，使用池化操作（pooling-based contrast modeling）替代卷积来建模空间上下文，构建无卷积的深度先验网络。
Result: 实验显示，Pool-DIP 在多个去噪数据集（包括真实世界基准）上取得竞争性能，参数和计算量显著低于卷积版 DIP。频谱分析证实其能更好控制高频分量。此外，该方法在超分辨率和修复任务中也表现良好。
Conclusion: Pool-DIP 表明，通过池化建模上下文可有效替代卷积，实现高效且稳定的图像恢复，为无卷积深度先验提供了新思路。

papers.title: A Precedent-Guided Co-Scientist for Side-Effect-Aware Drug Redesign
papers.abstract_en: We propose PRECEDE, a precedent-guided co-scientist for side-effect-aware drug redesign that revises a parent compound to mitigate a specified side effect while preserving therapeutic function. Rather than isolated molecular generation, PRECEDE frames redesign as evidence-grounded reasoning over drug--side-effect associations, biomedical knowledge graphs, and precedents of safety-driven optimization, coordinated by an LLM orchestrator with explicit policies and human-review checkpoints. We position PRECEDE as a human-supervised AI-for-science workflow in which hypotheses remain auditable, falsifiable, and bounded by prior pharmacology.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on AI for Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRECEDE，一个先例引导的协同科学家系统，用于副作用感知的药物重新设计。它将药物重新设计框架为基于证据的推理，利用药物-副作用关联、生物医学知识图谱和安全驱动优化的先例，由LLM协调器与显式策略和人工审查检查点协同工作。该系统定位为人类监督的AI-for-science工作流程，假设保持可审计、可证伪且受先前药理学约束。
Motivation: 现有药物重新设计方法缺乏对副作用的明确考虑和基于先例的证据推理，导致生成分子可能有效但存在安全隐患。
Method: PRECEDE采用LLM作为协调器，结合药物-副作用关联、生物医学知识图谱和先例，通过显式策略和人工审查检查点进行多步推理，生成修改后的化合物。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但强调该方法通过先例引导和人类监督提高了假设的可审计性和可证伪性。
Conclusion: PRECEDE提供了一个人类监督的AI科学工作流，确保假设基于药理学先例，并保持可审计性，适用于副作用感知的药物重新设计。

papers.title: A Sliding-Window-Based Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Assembly Flow Shop Scheduling with Multi-Product Delivery
papers.abstract_en: Multi-product kitting delivery imposes significant challenges for real-time scheduling in hybrid manufacturing systems that integrate processing and assembly, as dynamic order arrivals simultaneously alter supply dependencies and the set of feasible job-machine assignments. This paper proposes a sliding-window-based reinforcement learning (SWRL) framework for end-to-end online scheduling in the flexible assembly flow shop scheduling problem with complex kitting constraints. The problem is formulated as a heterogeneous graph-based Markov decision process that captures the dual-layer kitting structure and the tail-product bottleneck dynamics that produce a sparse reward landscape. To address the resulting challenges, SWRL integrates a sliding-window filtering mechanism that filters inactive nodes and prioritizes kitting-critical operations, a spatiotemporal graph encoding network that tracks bottleneck shifts across consecutive decision states, and a dynamic action mapping module with a constrained waiting strategy that adapts to the changing action space under variable topologies. Experiments on real-world instances from a home appliance manufacturer demonstrate that SWRL achieves consistent tardiness reductions over classical dispatching rules and existing deep reinforcement learning methods, and exhibits robust performance across varying resource configurations, order loads, and arrival concentrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多产品成套配送的柔性装配流水车间调度问题，提出基于滑动窗口的强化学习（SWRL）框架。该框架将问题建模为异构图马尔可夫决策过程，并集成滑动窗口过滤机制、时空图编码网络和动态动作映射模块，以处理稀疏奖励和动态拓扑。在真实家电制造数据上，SWRL相较于经典调度规则和现有深度强化学习方法持续降低延误时间。
Motivation: 多产品成套配送在混合制造系统的实时调度中带来重大挑战，因为动态订单到达会同时改变供应依赖关系和可行的机器分配集合。
Method: 提出SWRL框架，包含滑动窗口过滤机制（过滤非活动节点，优先关键操作）、时空图编码网络（追踪瓶颈漂移）和动态动作映射模块（带约束等待策略，适应可变拓扑下的动态动作空间）。问题被建模为异构图马尔可夫决策过程，捕获双层成套结构和尾产品瓶颈动态。
Result: 在家电制造商的真实实例上，SWRL相较于经典调度规则和现有深度强化学习方法持续减少延误时间，并在不同资源配置、订单负荷和到达集中度下表现稳健。

papers.title: Missingness as Signal: Channel-Independent Spectrogram Learning for Clinical Time Series Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Clinical time series prediction in intensive care units remains challenging due to heterogeneous physiological variables and informative missingness. The presence or absence of a measurement can reflect clinical decisions and patient severity, and thus missingness can serve as a predictive signal rather than a simple data artifact. This work presents CISM, a Channel-Independent Spectrogram framework with a Missingness stream for clinical multivariate time series prediction. CISM converts each clinical variable into a variable-wise time-frequency spectrogram, preserves variable identity through variable-aligned encoding, and aligns an explicit missingness stream with the spectrogram representation. Experiments on an in-hospital mortality task derived from MIMIC-IV show that CISM achieves the highest mean AUROC (0.7225), AUPRC (0.3308), and F1 (0.3808) among the compared time series, missingness-aware, vision, and time-frequency baselines. Ablation studies further show that observation patterns provide a meaningful informative signal. Pixel-level mask injection improves performance over plain spectrogram inputs and recovers much of this predictive value. The aligned missingness stream contributes a further, complementary gain in both AUROC and AUPRC. These results highlight the importance of modeling observation patterns as structured signals in clinical time series prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CISM框架，将临床多变量时间序列转换为变量级时频频谱图，并显式建模缺失模式作为预测信号，在MIMIC-IV的院内死亡预测任务上取得最佳AUROC、AUPRC和F1。
Motivation: 临床时间序列中存在信息性缺失，测量与否本身反映临床决策和病情严重程度，现有方法未充分利用缺失模式作为预测信号。
Method: 提出CISM（Channel-Independent Spectrogram），将每个变量转换为变量级时频频谱图，通过变量对齐编码保留变量身份，并将显式的缺失流与频谱图表示对齐。
Result: 在MIMIC-IV院内死亡任务上，CISM取得最高平均AUROC（0.7225）、AUPRC（0.3308）和F1（0.3808），优于时间序列、缺失感知、视觉和时频基线。消融实验表明观测模式提供有意义的信号，像素级掩码注入改善性能，缺失流提供额外增益。
Conclusion: 建模观测模式作为结构化信号对临床时间序列预测很重要，但仅在一个任务上验证，需进一步探索不同缺失机制和相关任务。

papers.title: In-span learning: adapting reduced-order models using their own predictions
papers.abstract_en: Reduced-order models compress high-dimensional dynamics into low-dimensional representations that can be evaluated rapidly, but they lose accuracy when online dynamics drift beyond the training data. Adaptive methods address this by updating the subspace online with external, out-of-span information, such as full-order corrections or sensor snapshots. We discovered that a complementary and previously unexploited in-span adaptation channel exists within the current reduced subspace. By streaming the model's own predictions through an incremental singular-value decomposition with forgetting, we obtain a trajectory-informed spectral preconditioner, in which the subspace is unchanged but the basis is reweighted and realigned toward the modes visited by the dynamics. This enables the model to absorb future out-of-span corrections more effectively. We expose aspects of this mechanism on a three-dimensional spiral and confirm it on viscous Burgers and Fisher-KPP dynamics. We also discuss how in-span learning can be viewed as a dynamical-systems analogue of in-context learning. More broadly, in-span learning suggests a new principle for computational science, revealing that model-generated trajectories contain more usable information than previously recognized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的降阶模型自适应方法——in-span learning，利用模型自身预测流通过增量奇异值分解和遗忘机制更新谱预处理，保持子空间不变但重新加权基向量，使其对齐动态模式。该方法无需外部信息即可提高后续外部校正的吸收效率，在粘性Burgers和Fisher-KPP动力学上得到验证。
Motivation: 现有降阶模型在动力学偏离训练数据时会失去精度，自适应方法依赖外部信息，但忽略了模型自身预测中蕴含的信息。
Method: 通过增量奇异值分解（incremental SVD with forgetting）对模型预测流进行流式处理，得到轨迹感知的谱预处理（spectral preconditioner），即对基向量进行重新加权和重新对齐，不改变子空间。
Result: 在三维螺旋上揭示了机制，在粘性Burgers和Fisher-KPP动力学上验证了有效性。表明模型自身轨迹包含更多可用信息。
Conclusion: 作者将in-span learning与上下文学习类比，并提出这是计算科学的新原则，模型生成的轨迹比之前认为的包含更多可用信息。

papers.title: MatPhaseBench: A Semantics-Guided Benchmark for Materials Phase Diagrams Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Materials phase diagrams are a core knowledge representation in materials science, encoding temperature,composition, phase stability, and phase transformation pathways, with their full understanding requiring thermodynamic mechanism analysis and scientific reasoning. Although VLMs have shown promise in scientific image understanding, their systematic evaluation on such logically complex images demanding deep mechanistic interpretation remains limited, and phase diagrams provide a challenging testbed for this purpose. We introduce MatPhaseBench, a high-quality, high-reliability benchmark for complex scientific image understanding, focused on materials phase diagrams. MatPhaseBench is constructed from 3681 papers in classical materials science journals, from which 200 high-quality diagram-text pairs were selected, covering 189 material systems and 70 elements. The benchmark has three key features: (1)targeting complex scientific image understanding-it moves beyond simple objective tests to open-ended tasks requiring deep comprehension; (2)comprehensive image-text alignment-semantic information associated with images is fully preserved during literature mining and matching; (3) high-quality human-supervised text acquisition-all descriptions undergo strict manual validation. Experimental results show that current VLMs remain substantially behind expert-level understanding: they are largely limited to surface visual perception, lack deep reasoning grounded in thermodynamic mechanisms, have limited domain awareness and expert analytical experience, and perform poorly in distinguishing fine-grained differences in composite or multi-diagram settings. Overall, MatPhaseBench constitutes a challenging research-grade benchmark, providing a foundational platform for complex scientific image understanding, phase diagram analysis, and trustworthy multi-modal AI in science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MatPhaseBench，一个针对材料相图理解的高质量基准。该基准从 3681 篇材料科学论文中精选 200 对图-文对，覆盖 189 个材料体系和 70 种元素，设计开放型任务以测试视觉语言模型的深度理解能力。实验表明当前模型在相图理解上远未达到专家水平。
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏对需深层机制解释的科学图像的系统性评估，而相图作为材料科学核心知识表征，为测试视觉语言模型的复杂推理能力提供了理想测试床。
Method: 从经典材料科学期刊论文中构建 200 个高保真图-文对，经人工严格验证文本描述，并设计超越简单客观题的开放任务。
Result: 当前视觉语言模型在相图理解上表现显著落后于专家，仅能进行表面视觉感知，缺乏基于热力学机制的深度推理，领域知识及专家分析经验不足，在多图区分上表现差。
Conclusion: MatPhaseBench 构成具有挑战性的研究级基准，为复杂科学图像理解、相图分析及可信多模态 AI 提供基础平台。

papers.title: PromptPET: Privacy-Utility Optimized Prompt Obfuscation
papers.abstract_en: Privacy is an important challenge when users interact with AI chatbots, since users may share sensitive information, explicitly or implicitly, and AI chatbots can use this information for user profiling. In this paper, we aim to protect user privacy via a user-side mechanism that transforms sensitive information in a user prompt, while preserving enough information to elicit a useful response from the chatbot. This approach faces an inherent tradeoff between protecting privacy (i.e., avoiding profiling) and preserving utility (i.e., getting personalized and task-specific responses). To that end, we consider, evaluate, and compare four different obfuscation actions, namely redaction, abstraction, replacement, and a novel noising/denoising scheme that we introduce. Additional novel insights include: utilizing a data type taxonomy to both identify and obfuscate sensitive information and explicitly taking into account the utility of chat responses in making the obfuscation decision. First, we systematically optimize and evaluate each obfuscation action independently in terms of the privacy-utility tradeoff it achieves. Second, we propose PROMPTPET, an LLM-based agent that selects the best obfuscation action for each sensitive part of the prompt, using a reinforcement-learning inspired rule optimizer, applied for the first time in this context. Using a real-world chat dataset, we show that PROMPTPET matches the best privacy-utility tradeoff attainable by any single obfuscation action and significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对用户与 AI 聊天机器人交互中的隐私保护问题，提出用户端 prompt 混淆机制 PROMPTPET，通过 LLM-based agent 自动选择最佳混淆动作（包括删除、抽象、替换和新增的噪声/去噪方案），在保护隐私与保持回答效用之间取得平衡。摘要显示该方法在真实聊天数据集上匹配最佳隐私-效用权衡并显著优于先前方法。
Motivation: 用户向 AI 聊天机器人提供请求时可能泄露敏感信息，现有方法难以同时达到隐私保护和回答效用。
Method: 提出 PROMPTPET，包含利用数据类型的分类来识别和混淆敏感信息，并采用强化学习启发的规则优化器为 prompt 的每个敏感部分选择最佳混淆动作。
Result: 在真实聊天数据集上，PROMPTPET 匹配了任何单一混淆动作能达到的最佳隐私-效用权衡，并显著优于先前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 强调了用户侧 prompt 混淆机制的有效性，以及自动化选择混淆动作的潜力。

papers.title: VERITAS: Towards a General-Purpose Replication Tool for Scientific Research
papers.abstract_en: AI tools are accelerating scientific publication while the systems that review it struggle to keep up, and independent verification of published research has become both harder and more important. As manual replication is slow and expensive, a growing line of work uses coding agents to automate parts of the process. Existing efforts are largely packaged as benchmarks with companion agents that only run inside the benchmark's own pipeline, and no general-purpose replication tool exists. We present VERITAS, a domain-agnostic replication framework built around CLI coding agents. Given a paper, a code repository, or both, VERITAS extracts the paper's claims, runs the methodology while resolving issues as they arise, and judges each claim against the evidence from experiment runs. The pipeline returns an importance-weighted Replication Score, a severity-rated log of every fix applied, and the patched codebase. We evaluate VERITAS on CORE-Bench and ReplicationBench, 65 papers spanning computer science, social science, medicine, and astrophysics. Against two strong Claude Code baselines on the same model and host environment, VERITAS achieves state-of-the-art performance and leads on every metric on both benchmarks.

papers.title: CL-Anomaly: Layer-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts with Multimodal Large Language Model for Continual Learning in Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in diverse vision tasks, but full-parameter retraining is computationally expensive as real-world knowledge evolves. Existing continual learning methods often suffer from semantic entanglement in parameter spaces across tasks, impeding the continuous deployment of models. This challenge is especially pronounced in Anomaly Detection (AD), which exhibits triple heterogeneity across modalities, domains, and defect scale variability, significantly complicating multi-task knowledge transfer. In this paper, we propose CL-Anomaly, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework based on an isolation-sharing collaboration to enable continual learning for anomaly detection with MLLMs. We introduce the task-private expert PrivLoRA, which physically isolates task-specific subspaces in the parameter space to prevent semantic entanglement of anomaly knowledge in diverse scenarios. The Layer-Adaptive Shared Experts maintain cross-task representations within a unified feature space, enabling knowledge sharing between previous and new tasks. Furthermore, we propose a Layer-Adaptive Knowledge Transfer strategy that automatically selects and dynamically updates the layer-wise key shared experts of each task via a momentum-based mechanism, promoting effective knowledge transfer across related anomaly detection tasks. Extensive experiments across three continual learning scenarios for anomaly detection, including class-incremental, cross-domain, and cross-modal, demonstrate that CL-Anomaly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/WenDongyp/CL-Anomaly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多模态大模型在异常检测中持续学习时面临的任务间语义纠缠问题，本文提出CL-Anomaly框架，采用隔离-共享协作策略：任务私有专家PrivLoRA物理隔离任务子空间，层自适应共享专家维护跨任务表征，并通过动量机制实现层自适应知识迁移。在类增量、跨域、跨模态三种持续学习场景中，该方法优于现有方案。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法在多模态大模型的参数空间中存在语义纠缠，阻碍模型连续部署；异常检测任务具有模态、域和缺陷尺度的三重异质性，加剧了多任务知识迁移的难度。
Method: 提出参数高效微调框架CL-Anomaly，包含：1) 任务私有专家PrivLoRA，在参数空间中物理隔离任务特定子空间；2) 层自适应共享专家，在统一特征空间中保持跨任务表征；3) 基于动量的层自适应知识迁移策略，自动选择并动态更新各任务的关键共享专家。
Result: 在类增量、跨域、跨模态三种持续学习异常检测场景中，CL-Anomaly均优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该工作验证了隔离-共享协作范式在多模态大模型持续學習异常检测中的有效性，代码已开源。

papers.title: Modeling the Impact of Visual Brand Language on Attention, Object Recognition, and Memory Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Visual brand language is the set of visual properties that convey brand identity for a product. What is the impact of visual brand language on a person's ability to recognize and understand the functional identity of an object? Using an empirically supported modeling framework based on the JIM model of object recognition and the LISA model of analogical inference, we simulated the impact of visual brand language on object recognition, the allocation of attention, and retrieval of functional information about objects. Our simulations predict that brand information captures attention and can slow recognition of an object's functional category, with greater degrees of branding causing larger effects. These results have potential implications for the usability and experience of designed objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于JIM物体识别模型和LISA类比推理模型，模拟了视觉品牌语言（visual brand language）对注意力分配、物体识别和功能信息检索的影响。模拟预测品牌信息会捕获注意力并延缓对物体功能类别的识别，品牌化程度越高影响越大。研究结果对设计对象的人机交互和用户体验具有潜在启示。
Motivation: 视觉品牌语言是传达产品品牌身份的视觉属性，但其对人们识别和理解物体功能身份的影响尚不清楚，现有研究缺乏计算建模。
Method: 采用基于JIM物体识别模型和LISA类比推理模型的经验支持建模框架，模拟视觉品牌语言对物体识别、注意力分配和功能信息检索的认知过程。
Result: 模拟预测表明品牌信息会捕获注意力，并显著延缓物体功能类别的识别时间，且品牌化程度越高延缓效果越强。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了视觉品牌语言对认知过程的定量影响，暗示在设计中需平衡品牌表达与功能识别效率，但模拟结果需进一步实证验证。

papers.title: CoFEND: A Cross-Modal Fusion End-to-End Network for Cold-Start Drug-Drug Interaction Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Cold-start drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction for new drugs is critical for minimizing unexpected adverse drug reactions. The key challenge is to capture similarity between new and known drugs. However, such similarity is closely associated with complex relationships and mechanisms among drugs, enzymes, transporters, molecular structures, and other biomedical entities. Existing methods have three limitations in capturing such similarity: (1) only partial relationships and mechanisms are considered, which overlooks cross-modal information and yields incomplete or biased similarity modeling; (2) similarity computation between new and known drugs is conducted separately across modalities and performed offline for cold-start DDI prediction, leading to misalignment between similarity computation and DDI prediction; and (3) existing interpretability analyses are typically single-modality and focus primarily on key determinants of the perpetrator drug, while the underlying causes of susceptibility for the victim drug are seldom investigated. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel Cross-Modal-Fused End-to-End Learning Network (CMF-ELN) with three components. First, diverse multimodal information is leveraged to construct four types of drug-centered knowledge graphs, enabling comprehensive similarity modeling under reconstruction-based supervision. Second, a four-channel graph autoencoder is designed to fuse cross-modal similarity within an end-to-end learning framework. Finally, a two-stage interpretability scheme is devised to precisely localize key factors for both perpetrator and victim drugs. Extensive experiments on two real datasets demonstrate that CMF-ELN achieves significantly higher prediction accuracy and more comprehensive interpretability of mechanisms than its peers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冷启动药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测问题，提出了一种跨模态融合端到端网络（CMF-ELN）。该方法利用多模态信息构建四种药物知识图谱，通过四通道图自编码器实现跨模态相似度的端到端融合，并设计两阶段解释性方案定位施药和受药药物的关键因素。实验表明，该方法在预测准确性和机制可解释性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有冷启动DDI预测方法仅考虑部分关系与机制，忽略跨模态信息导致相似性建模不完整或有偏；相似性计算与DDI预测分离，导致不对齐；可解释性分析通常仅单模态且侧重施药药物，很少研究受药药物的易感性原因。
Method: 提出CMF-ELN：首先利用多模态信息构建四种药物中心知识图谱，在重构监督下进行综合相似性建模；其次设计四通道图自编码器在端到端框架中融合跨模态相似度；最后设计两阶段可解释性方案精准定位施药和受药药物的关键因素。
Result: 在两个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，CMF-ELN在预测准确性和机制可解释性上显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文通过跨模态融合端到端学习有效解决了冷启动DDI预测中的相似性建模和对齐问题，并提供了更全面的可解释性分析。

papers.title: VideoSearcher: Empowering Video Deep Research with Multi-Tool Agentic Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding is moving beyond closed-context perception toward open-world evidence exploration, a paradigm formalized as Video Deep Research (VDR). However, existing multimodal search agents primarily target static images, and the current VDR benchmark relies on text-centric retrieval that discards crucial visual information. To address these limitations, we propose VideoSearcher, a closed-loop agentic framework that empowers Vision-Language Models with multi-tool reasoning for VDR. VideoSearcher unifies temporal localization, spatial focusing, and multimodal search within a single reasoning trajectory, enabling agents to progressively ground visual clues, retrieve relevant evidence, and synthesize answers. To optimize knowledge-intensive reasoning trajectories, we propose Bi-branch Sequence Policy Optimization (BiSPO), a reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples tool-invocation optimization from answer-accuracy optimization. This design provides stable learning signals for both evidence-grounded reasoning and purposeful tool use. Furthermore, we construct VideoSearch-QA, the first benchmark designed to evaluate open-world video information grounding and multimodal search-based reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VideoSearcher significantly outperforms prior open-source agentic baselines across various search-oriented and multimodal understanding benchmarks.
papers.comment: Technical report. Project page: https://stephen-gzk.github.io/VideoSearcher-website/ ; Code: https://github.com/Stephen-gzk/VideoSearcher ; Model & Data on HuggingFace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoSearcher，一个闭环智能体框架，将视觉-语言模型与多工具推理结合用于视频深度研究（Video Deep Research, VDR）。该框架统一了时间定位、空间聚焦和多模态搜索，并引入双分支序列策略优化（BiSPO）强化学习算法，分别优化工具调用和答案准确性。同时构建了第一个面向开放世界视频信息定位与多模态搜索推理的基准 VideoSearch-QA。实验表明，VideoSearcher 在多个搜索导向和多模态理解基准上显著优于现有开源智能体基线。

Method: 提出 VideoSearcher 闭环智能体框架，统一时间定位、空间聚焦和多模态搜索于单一推理轨迹；并设计 BiSPO（双分支序列策略优化）强化学习算法，将工具调用优化与答案准确性优化解耦，提供稳定的学习信号。
Result: 在多个搜索导向和多模态理解基准上，VideoSearcher 显著优于先前的开源智能体基线（摘要未提供具体数值）。
Conclusion: 论文强调了多工具智能体推理和强化学习在视频深度研究中的有效性，并开源了模型、代码和基准。

papers.title: STAC: Selective Spatiotemporal Aggregation and Compression for Video Reasoning Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Video reasoning segmentation demands pixel-accurate object tracking across hundreds of frames under complex natural language queries, producing dense spatiotemporal tokens whose quadratic self-attention cost makes long-video processing prohibitive. Existing methods address this through token compression, yet typically operate on encoder features lacking temporal context, constraining selection before content redundancy can be reliably assessed. Informed compression requires contextual awareness, but acquiring that awareness at full resolution incurs the same quadratic cost compression aims to reduce. State-space models resolve this constraint, as their linear recurrence selectively conditions each token on temporal context at $\mathcal{O}(T)$ cost, producing representations where content redundancy becomes assessable. Building on this, Selective SpatioTemporal Aggregation and Compression (STAC) enriches features via decoupled bidirectional spatial and causal temporal scanning, leveraging recurrence-derived redundancy for hierarchical compression with adaptive thresholds optimised with segmentation objective. STAC achieves 85% token reduction and 1.8$\times$ speedup while surpassing compression-free baselines on reasoning segmentation benchmarks in a zero-shot streaming-compatible setting. Code is available \href{https://github.com/MCG-NKU/nku-video}{here}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STAC（选择性时空聚合与压缩），用于视频推理分割。该方法利用状态空间模型（SSM）的线性递归特性，以O(T)代价为每个token提供时间上下文，从而评估内容冗余并进行层次化压缩。STAC实现85%的token缩减和1.8倍加速，且在零样本流式兼容设置下超越无压缩基线。
Motivation: 现有视频推理分割方法在处理长视频时面临二次自注意力成本问题，且token压缩缺乏时间上下文，导致内容冗余评估不准确。
Method: STAC通过解耦的双向空间扫描和因果时间扫描，利用SSM的递归特性生成可评估冗余的表示，再通过自适应阈值进行层次化压缩，阈值由分割目标优化。
Result: 在推理分割基准上，STAC实现85% token缩减和1.8倍加速，性能超过无压缩基线，且支持零样本流式设置。
Conclusion: 基于状态空间模型的上下文感知压缩可有效降低视频推理分割的计算成本，同时保持或提升精度。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有视频推理分割方法在处理长视频时面临二次自注意力成本问题，且token压缩缺乏时间上下文，导致内容冗余评估不准确。
summary_sections.method: STAC通过解耦的双向空间扫描和因果时间扫描，利用SSM的递归特性生成可评估冗余的表示，再通过自适应阈值进行层次化压缩，阈值由分割目标优化。

summary_sections.conclusion: 基于状态空间模型的上下文感知压缩可有效降低视频推理分割的计算成本，同时保持或提升精度。

papers.title: R3D: Quantitative 3D Spatial Reasoning for Egocentric Wearables
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative 3D spatial reasoning from egocentric RGB-D video is a critical capability for next-generation wearable assistants. Yet existing benchmarks do not reflect the challenges of handling (1) natural egocentric video, (2) posed RGB-D video inputs, and (3) challenging quantitative 3D spatial reasoning Q&A. To fill this gap, we introduce R3D-Bench (Reasoning in 3D), a benchmark of 3,033 quantitative spatial reasoning questions across 15 types -- spanning multiple-choice, distance-based, and volumetric reasoning questions -- built on top of 57 egocentric video sequences from Aria Digital Twin. To set a strong baseline on this dataset, we introduce R3D, a model-agnostic spatial tool-calling framework. In contrast to existing approaches that directly embed 3D information into the model's input representation, R3D constructs a 3D scene from video using segmentation and depth-lifted object representations. It provides this information to an LLM through eight composable spatial tools. On R3D-Bench, R3D with Qwen3-VL 235B achieves 73.5% mean relative accuracy, substantially outperforming the best depth-enabled baseline (CuTR+Tools, 61.9%) and the best RGB-only baseline (Gemini 3 Flash, 46.5%).

papers.title: Harmonic-Aware Transformer for Real-Time Catheter Localization in Interventional Procedures of Magnetic Particle Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic particle imaging (MPI) enables real-time, radiation-free tracking of magnetic nanoparticle-coated instruments, making it highly suitable for interventional procedures. This study proposes a harmonic-aware transformer framework that directly predicts catheter tip positions from raw MPI voltage signals, eliminating the need for image reconstruction and reducing computational latency. The framework incorporates frequency-domain preprocessing to isolate the 2nd to 8th drive-field harmonics, enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio while preserving motion-relevant features. A transformer architecture with six encoder layers and eight attention heads is employed to learn spatio-temporal dependencies across the three receive axes (x, y, z) for accurate three-dimensional position estimation. The model is trained on simulated MPI signals and evaluated on real in vitro datasets under standard, bending, and heartbeat-like motion conditions. The proposed method achieves sub-millimeter localization accuracy, with a minimum L2 error of 0.103 +/- 0.092 mm and mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 0.039 +/- 0.046 mm, 0.054 +/- 0.049 mm, and 0.060 +/- 0.044 mm along the (x, y, z) axes, respectively, for the bending dataset. Across all datasets, the MAE ranges from 0.165 mm to 0.655 mm, demonstrating consistent performance. The optimized inference achieves a latency of 0.55 ms per frame and a throughput of approximately 1800 frames per second, confirming real-time capability. Compared with conventional MPI-guided approaches relying on image reconstruction, the proposed framework provides improved accuracy, reduced latency, and enhanced robustness under complex motion conditions. These results highlight the potential of harmonic-aware transformer models as efficient and scalable solutions for real-time catheter localization in interventional MPI.
papers.journal_ref: Physics in Medicine & Biology, IOP Publishing,volume 71,number 13, 2026
