TL;DR: 本文提出一种谐波感知Transformer框架，直接从原始MPI电压信号预测导管尖端位置，无需图像重建。通过频域预处理提取2-8次驱动场谐波增强信噪比，采用6层编码器、8注意力头的Transformer学习三轴时空依赖。在模拟和数据集上实现亚毫米定位精度（弯曲数据最小L2误差0.103±0.092 mm），推理延迟0.55 ms/帧，吞吐量约1800 fps。
Motivation: 传统MPI引导介入需要图像重建，计算延迟高，且依赖固定运动模型，在复杂运动（如心跳）下鲁棒性不足。
Method: 构建谐波感知Transformer：预处理阶段提取MPI原始信号的2-8次谐波成分，然后由6层编码器、8注意力头的Transformer直接输出三维导管尖端坐标。
Result: 在真实体外弯曲数据集上，L2误差0.103±0.092 mm，三轴MAE分别为0.039、0.054、0.060 mm；所有数据集MAE范围0.165-0.655 mm。推理延迟0.55 ms/帧，吞吐量1800 fps。
Conclusion: 谐波感知Transformer在MPI导管定位中实现了亚毫米精度和实时性能，优于传统图像重建方法，尤其适用于复杂运动场景。

papers.title: Bootstrap Flow-Map Tree Sampling Enables Online Feedback Driven Search
papers.abstract_en: In many scientific and engineering domains, maximizing discovery within a limited sampling budget demands strategic, observation-guided exploration. While generative models have enabled training-free reward alignment, current methods typically excel in local searches within narrow regions of the underlying distribution. These approaches struggle when preferences are unknown a priori and only revealed through sequential feedback-a scenario demanding broad exploration to uncover high-utility regions. To address this, we introduce Bootstrap Flow-Map-Tree (a.k.a BFMT), a novel computationally efficient sampling framework designed for history-aware global search and alignment under sampling budget constraints. BFMT enables full tree-path construction from any tree depth using a single function evaluation, drastically reducing computational overhead while providing critical foresight for sequential sampling. By enabling dynamic transition time steps scheduling, BFMT efficiently allocates its sampling budget, smoothly transitioning from broad global exploration to fine-grained local refinement of high-utility modes discovered through exploration. Extensive experiments and ablations across diverse search and alignment tasks demonstrate that BFMT substantially outperforms baseline approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Bootstrap Flow-Map-Tree (BFMT)采样框架，用于历史感知的全局搜索和对齐，在采样预算约束下通过单次函数评估实现完整树路径构建，并动态调度时间步长以从全局探索过渡到局部精细调整。实验表明BFMT在多种搜索和对齐任务中显著优于基线方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在偏好未知且通过序贯反馈揭示的场景下难以进行广泛探索以发现高效用区域，尤其是在有限采样预算内。
Method: 提出BFMT框架，允许从任意树深度使用单次函数评估构建完整树路径，减少计算开销并提供序贯采样的前瞻性；通过动态转换时间步调度，在全局探索和局部精细调整之间平滑过渡。
Result: 在多种搜索和对齐任务上的大量实验和消融研究表明，BFMT显著优于基线方法。
Conclusion: BFMT为历史感知的全局搜索和对齐提供了高效的计算采样框架，在采样预算约束下有效平衡探索与利用。

papers.title: Oyster-II: Reinforcement Learning for Constructive Safety Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse applications, yet ensuring their simultaneous safety, helpfulness, and trustworthiness remains a persistent challenge. Conventional refusal-oriented alignment strategies mitigate harmful content generation but systematically fail to serve legitimate user needs, often withholding information that could safely and constructively address the underlying intent of sensitive queries. Building upon the constructive safety paradigm pioneered by Oyster-I, which moves beyond blanket refusal toward thoughtful, response-oriented safety alignment, we identify two critical limitations of its Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)-based scheme: insufficient safety generalization to out-of-distribution scenarios and a phenomenon we term safety chain-of-thought (CoT) over-generalization, wherein safety-oriented reasoning patterns are excessively applied to benign queries, degrading helpfulness and user experience. To address these limitations, we propose Oyster-II, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based constructive safety alignment framework that adopts a Zero-RL paradigm combined with a multi-stage reinforcement learning strategy.Evaluated across extensive benchmarks, Oyster-II comprehensively surpasses both Qwen3-14B and its predecessor Oyster-I on safety dimensions, achieving cross-scale performance comparable to Qwen3-Max and Qwen3.5-397B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Oyster-II，一种基于强化学习（RL）的构造性安全对齐框架，旨在克服Oyster-I中监督微调（SFT）方案的安全泛化不足和安全链式思维（CoT）过度泛化问题。采用Zero-RL范式与多阶段强化学习策略，在多个基准上全面超越Qwen3-14B和Oyster-I，跨规模性能与Qwen3-Max和Qwen3.5-397B相当。
Motivation: 现有拒绝导向的安全对齐策略虽能减少有害内容生成，但无法满足合法用户需求；Oyster-I的SFT方案存在安全泛化不足和CoT过度泛化问题，损害有用性。
Method: 提出Oyster-II框架，采用Zero-RL范式和多阶段强化学习策略进行构造性安全对齐。
Result: 在多个基准上，Oyster-II在安全维度上全面超越Qwen3-14B和Oyster-I，跨规模性能与Qwen3-Max和Qwen3.5-397B相当。
Conclusion: Oyster-II通过RL有效改进了构造性安全对齐的泛化和有用性，但未提及在降水预报等领域的应用。

papers.title: See the Emotion: A Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling for EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Despite the high accuracy of EEG-based emotion recognition, existing models remain opaque "black boxes", lacking semantic grounding between abstract neural features and human-interpretable states. In this paper, we reframe EEG explainability as a cross-modal generation task, shifting the paradigm from feature attribution to behavioral visualization. We introduce Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling, a novel framework that translates high-dimensional EEG signals into identity-anonymized facial emojis. Guided by the neuroscientific inspiration of neural-facial association, this approach grounds neural representations in the manifold of observable facial dynamics. Technically, our framework integrates FMENet, a specialized backbone modeling expression-relevant spatial synergies, and the Facial Emoji Learning Branch (FELB), which treats emoji reconstruction as a structured semantic regularizer. Extensive experiments on EAV and MMER benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among EEG-only models. Crucially, it generates semantically faithful facial animations that provide a transparent, privacy-preserving window into the brain's emotional evolution, effectively allowing users to "see the emotion" directly from neural signals. Code is available at https://github.com/xian-sh/SeeEmotion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面部表情符号代理建模（Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling），将EEG信号转换为身份匿名化的面部表情符号，用于情绪识别。在EAV和MMER基准上达到SOTA精度，并生成语义保真度的面部动画，提供可解释的情绪演变过程。
Motivation: 现有EEG情绪识别模型是黑箱，缺乏抽象神经特征与人类可解释状态之间的语义联系。
Method: 提出FMENet骨干网络建模表情相关的空间协同性，以及面部表情符号学习分支（FELB），将表情符号重构作为结构化语义正则化器。
Result: 在EAV和MMER基准上，该方法在仅EEG模型中达到最先进精度，并生成语义保真的面部动画。
Conclusion: 该方法为EEG情绪识别提供了可解释、保护隐私的窗口，使用户能够直接从神经信号“看到情绪”。

papers.title: CoACT: Action-Preserving Observation Compression for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based coding agents solve software-engineering tasks through iterative interactions with development environments, where returned observations accumulate in the context and become a major source of inference cost. Observation compression reduces this cost by shortening observations before they are appended to the context. However, existing methods still exhibit an unsatisfactory efficiency-effectiveness trade-off, as they do not explicitly model how compression affects the agent's subsequent behavior. This paper proposes CoACT, an action-preserving observation compression method for coding agents. CoACT is built on next-action preservation (NAP), which requires a compressed observation to induce the same next action as the raw observation. By checking the agent's immediate next action, NAP provides a practical signal for whether a compression preserves the information needed for continued task solving. During training, a teacher model first generates multiple compressed candidates of each observation. CoACT then uses an action-preservation reward based on NAP to filter out candidates that would change the agent's next action, and uses a length-reduction reward to choose compact candidates as supervision for a lightweight compressor. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified with three agentic models show that CoACT reduces average total token consumption by 33.0% while maintaining task-solving effectiveness close to the uncompressed agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoACT，一种面向编程智能体 (coding agent) 的保持行动 (action-preserving) 的观测压缩方法。该方法基于下一行动保留 (next-action preservation, NAP) 原则，要求压缩后的观测能诱导与原始观测相同的下一行动，从而在压缩观测时保留任务求解所需信息。实验使用三种智能体模型在 SWE-bench Verified 上验证，平均总 token 消耗降低 33.0%，同时保持与未压缩智能体相近的任务求解效果。
Motivation: LLM 编程智能体在迭代交互中累积大量观测，导致上下文过长、推理成本高。现有观测压缩方法未能显式建模压缩对后续行为的影响，效率与效果之间权衡不理想。
Method: CoACT 首先由教师模型为每个观测生成多个压缩候选，然后基于 NAP 使用行动保留奖励筛选不改变智能体下一行动的候选，再使用长度缩减奖励选择紧凑候选作为轻量级压缩器的监督信号。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上使用三种智能体模型，CoACT 平均减少总 token 消耗 33.0%，同时任务求解效果与未压缩基线相当。
Conclusion: CoACT 通过显式保留智能体的下一行动，实现了有效的观测压缩，在不显著牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低推理成本。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 CoACT，一种面向编程智能体 (coding agent) 的保持行动 (action-preserving) 的观测压缩方法。该方法基于下一行动保留 (next-action preservation, NAP) 原则，要求压缩后的观测能诱导与原始观测相同的下一行动，从而在压缩观测时保留任务求解所需信息。实验使用三种智能体模型在 SWE-bench Verified 上验证，平均总 token 消耗降低 33.0%，同时保持与未压缩智能体相近的任务求解效果。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM 编程智能体在迭代交互中累积大量观测，导致上下文过长、推理成本高。现有观测压缩方法未能显式建模压缩对后续行为的影响，效率与效果之间权衡不理想。
summary_sections.method: CoACT 首先由教师模型为每个观测生成多个压缩候选，然后基于 NAP 使用行动保留奖励筛选不改变智能体下一行动的候选，再使用长度缩减奖励选择紧凑候选作为轻量级压缩器的监督信号。
summary_sections.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上使用三种智能体模型，CoACT 平均减少总 token 消耗 33.0%，同时任务求解效果与未压缩基线相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: CoACT 通过显式保留智能体的下一行动，实现了有效的观测压缩，在不显著牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低推理成本。

papers.title: Learning Taxonomic Trees with Hierarchical Representation Regularization for Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Taxonomies provide key information about the semantic relationships between concepts and the inherent organization of vision and language. Despite their impressive capabilities, large multimodal models (LMMs) often lack taxonomic knowledge, leading to low hierarchical visual recognition (HVR) consistency. These models typically only rely on language modeling objectives during fine-tuning and lack explicit taxonomy-aware regularization. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Representation Regularization ($HiR^2$), a simple plug-and-play regularizer that improves hierarchical consistency in LMMs. Specifically, we introduce a semantic-aware visual tree construction framework that extracts coarse-to-fine visual features from intermediate LLM layers guided by textual cues. The regularizer combines two complementary objectives: a taxonomic entailment loss that enforces hierarchy via hyperbolic entailment cones in the Lorentz model, and a discriminative dispersive loss that promotes angular separation of semantically similar embeddings on the unit sphere without disturbing the radial hierarchical structure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that $HiR^2$ effectively captures taxonomic structures across diverse LMMs and fine-tuning methods. Code is available at https://github.com/PKU-ICST-MIPL/HiR2_ICML2026.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层次表示正则化（HiR²），一种即插即用的正则化方法，旨在提高大多模态模型（LMMs）的层次视觉识别一致性。通过引入语义感知的视觉树构建框架和两种互补损失（分类蕴含损失和判别分散损失），该方法在多种LMM和微调方法上有效捕捉分类结构。
Motivation: 大多模态模型在微调时通常仅依赖语言建模目标，缺乏显式的分类感知正则化，导致层次视觉识别一致性较低。
Method: 提出HiR²正则化器，包括语义感知的视觉树构建框架（从LLM中间层提取粗到细的视觉特征），以及两个互补目标：基于洛伦兹模型的双曲蕴含锥的分类蕴含损失，和在不干扰径向层次结构的情况下促进语义相似嵌入在单位球面上角分离的判别分散损失。
Result: 实验表明HiR²在多种LMM和微调方法上有效捕捉分类结构。
Conclusion: HiR²作为一种简单的即插即用正则化器，能提升LMM的层次一致性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Holo-Captioning: Toward the Text Equivalent of 3D Scenes
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces holo-captioning, a novel task that strives to seek the text equivalent of 3D scenes. As the initial step, we formulate holo-captioning as generating a structured textual description that comprehensively depicts all entities within a 3D scene -- including their semantic tags, spatial locations, attributes, and inter-entity relations. To tackle this challenging task, we first develop an effective captioning engine to produce detailed descriptions of individual entity instances and instance pairs, and contribute a large-scale benchmark comprising over 15K scenes for training and evaluation. Building upon this foundation, we propose HoloScribe, a novel model that features an instance-aware decoupled pipeline for generating structured holo-captions, and further incorporates anchor-aware instance linking to identify relational instance pairs. Additionally, we propose a comprehensive evaluation metric named HoloScore, and provide a human-curated test set to ensure reliable model assessment. Experimental results demonstrate that HoloScribe significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 3D dense captioners and 3D LLM generalists, underscoring the effectiveness of our approach. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/holocap/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出全息字幕生成（holo-captioning）任务，旨在为3D场景生成结构化文本描述，涵盖所有实体的语义标签、空间位置、属性和关系。作者构建了包含超过1.5万个场景的大规模基准，并提出HoloScribe模型，采用实例感知的解耦流水线和锚点感知的实例链接来生成结构化全息字幕。实验表明HoloScribe显著优于现有3D密集字幕生成器和3D LLM通用模型。
Motivation: 现有3D场景理解工作缺乏系统性的结构化文本描述方法，难以全面刻画场景中的实体及其关系。
Method: 提出HoloScribe模型，包含实例感知的解耦流水线用于生成结构化全息字幕，并引入锚点感知的实例链接来识别关系对。
Result: 在超过1.5万个场景的基准上，HoloScribe显著优于最先进的3D密集字幕生成器和3D LLM通用模型。
Conclusion: 本文首次提出全息字幕生成任务，并展示了结构化描述方法在3D场景理解中的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProLaViT: Learning Progressive Latent Visual Thoughts in Structured Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress but still struggle with complex visual reasoning tasks requiring multi-step perception and logical deduction. While explicit visual generation incurs prohibitive computational costs, existing latent approaches often rely on external experts or lack rigorous cognitive logic. In this paper, we introduce ProLaViT (Progressive Latent Visual Thought), a framework empowering MLLMs to perform structured visual derivation in the continuous latent space. Unlike works dependent on heterogeneous external models, ProLaViT leverages an endogenous self-distillation mechanism, utilizing the model's own visual encoder to supervise latent thoughts. To facilitate this, we construct a scalable programmatic synthesis pipeline enabling the model to internalize algorithmic precision without inference time tools. We design two reasoning paradigms: (1) Coarse-to-Fine Causal Chain for spatial tasks, guiding attention from global context to local targets. (2) Dialectical Reasoning Chain for logical tasks, incorporating counter-factual thinking for verification. Furthermore, we propose a Distance-Weighted Diversity Loss to impose topology-aware constraints, preventing feature degeneration by enforcing semantic distinctiveness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ProLaViT outperforms baselines on vision-centric benchmarks, achieving superior accuracy and interpretability with high efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProLaViT 提出了一种渐进式潜视觉思维框架，让多模态大语言模型在连续潜空间中进行结构化视觉推理，无需外部专家模型。通过自蒸馏机制和程序合成管道，模型内化算法精度；设计了由粗到细因果链和辩证推理链两种范式，并引入距离加权多样性损失防止特征退化。实验在视觉推理基准上取得优越准确率和可解释性。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在复杂视觉推理（需要多步感知和逻辑演绎）中表现不足，现有方法要么计算开销大，要么依赖外部专家且缺乏认知逻辑。
Method: 提出 ProLaViT 框架，包括：(1) 内生自蒸馏机制，利用自身视觉编码器监督潜思维；(2) 可扩展的程序化合成管道，内化算法精度；(3) 由粗到细因果链（空间任务）和辩证推理链（逻辑任务）；(4) 距离加权多样性损失强化语义区分。
Result: 在视觉推理基准上，ProLaViT 相比基线方法取得更高的准确率和可解释性，同时保持高效率。
Conclusion: ProLaViT 通过纯潜空间推理实现了无需外部工具的复杂视觉推理，平衡了性能与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TIER: Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization for Membership Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Explainability is central to building trustworthy AI, yet explanation interfaces can inadvertently provide adversaries with an expanded privacy-related attack surfaces. Recent studies show that advanced membership-inference attacks succeed by exploiting confidence-drop trajectories, induced through attribution-guided perturbations, as discriminative features, rather than directly using confidence scores or explanation vectors. Existing defenses against membership inference fail to directly mitigate such explanation-driven attacks. In this work, we investigate whether, during training, a model's own gradients can be leveraged as defense signals against such attacks, thereby aligning explanation profiles between members and non-members. To this end, we propose a Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization (TIER) defense that penalizes erratic fluctuations in confidence drops simulated through gradient-guided perturbations and simultaneously minimizes the distributional shifts via KL-divergence. Unlike conventional adversarial training, which emphasizes label robustness, our approach targets explanation robustness by enforcing self-consistency through KL-divergence and reducing the variance of confidence drops between members and non-members. Extensive experiments confirm that our method effectively mitigates these attacks, delivering privacy protection while maintaining model utility and explanation fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对利用解释接口（explanation interfaces）进行成员推理攻击（membership inference attack）的威胁，提出了一种轨迹不变解释正则化（TIER）防御方法。TIER通过惩罚基于梯度引导扰动的置信度下降轨迹的不规则波动，并最小化KL散度分布偏移，从而对齐成员和非成员的解释轮廓。实验表明该方法能有效缓解攻击，同时保持模型效用和解释保真度。
Motivation: 现有成员推理攻击可利用解释界面中基于归因扰动的置信度下降轨迹作为判别特征，而现有防御未直接缓解此类基于解释的攻击。
Method: 提出TIER防御，在训练过程中利用模型自身梯度作为防御信号，通过惩罚置信度下降轨迹的不规则变化（经梯度引导扰动模拟）并最小化成员与非成员之间的KL散度分布偏移，实现解释鲁棒性。
Result: 大量实验证实TIER能有效缓解攻击，在提供隐私保护的同时保持模型效用和解释保真度。
Conclusion: TIER通过强制执行自我一致性（KL散度）和减小成员与非成员之间置信度下降的方差，实现了解释鲁棒性，不同于强调标签鲁棒性的传统对抗训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PPE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating MLLM Unlearning under Private-Public Entanglement
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong capabilities, but they may memorize private information from web data, raising privacy concerns. Machine unlearning offers a way to remove such private knowledge without retraining from scratch. However, existing MLLM unlearning benchmarks have two major limitations. First, they rely on simplified images that contain only the single target individual, failing to reflect the visual complexity of real-world photos. Second, they typically assume that the forget set and retain set are fully separated, ignoring the fact that private information is often visually entangled with benign public information. For example, a private individual may appear with a public figure or in front of a well-known landmark, where unlearning the private target should not damage the public context. To address these limitations, we propose PPE-Bench, a new benchmark for evaluating MLLM unlearning under private-public entanglement. Each image contains a target individual to be forgotten and public information to be preserved, including public figure and landmark. We further introduce two simple but effective methods to better preserve public information during unlearning. Through experiments, we find that existing unlearning methods can reduce private information leakage, but often substantially harm adjacent public information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PPE-Bench，一个评估多模态大语言模型(MLLM)在隐私-公共信息纠缠场景下机器遗忘效果的新基准。每个图像同时包含需遗忘的个体和需保留的公共信息（公众人物或地标）。实验表明现有遗忘方法虽能减少隐私泄露，但常损害相邻公共信息。
Motivation: 现有MLLM遗忘基准存在两大局限：图像过于简化（仅含单个目标个体），且假设遗忘集与保留集完全分离，忽略了真实世界中隐私信息与公共信息的视觉纠缠。
Method: 构建PPE-Bench数据集，每个图像包含一个需遗忘的目标个体和需保留的公共信息（公众人物或地标）。引入两种简单有效的方法，在遗忘过程中更好地保留公共信息。
Result: 现有遗忘方法可降低隐私信息泄露，但通常会大幅损害相邻公共信息的保留。
Conclusion: PPE-Bench揭示了隐私-公共纠缠场景下遗忘的挑战，并为未来方法提供了评估基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Open Problem: Is Interaction Necessary for Order-Optimal 1-bit Mean Estimation?
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether interaction is necessary for order-optimal 1-bit mean estimation over nonparametric finite-moment classes. Adaptive threshold-query protocols achieve the order-optimal 1-bit minimax rate, and the same rate is attainable with general 1-bit queries using only one adaptive transition (i.e., two stages of querying). In the non-adaptive setting, threshold and interval queries are known to be highly suboptimal, but the case of arbitrary non-adaptive quantizers remains unresolved. Can such quantizers match the adaptive rate, yielding an optimal one-shot protocol? Or is the known two-stage estimator stage-optimal, with a single adaptive transition being necessary and sufficient?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个开放问题：在非参数有限矩类上，为了达到阶最优的1比特均值估计，交互是否是必要的。已知自适应阈值查询协议可以达到阶最优率，且仅需一次自适应转换（两个阶段）即可；而非自适应阈值或区间查询已知是高度次优的，但任意非自适应量化器的情况尚未解决。
Motivation: 理解在最小交互下能否达到阶最优的1比特均值估计，对于通信受限下的统计推断具有理论意义。
Method: 论文形式化地提出了开放问题，并比较了自适应阈值查询、两阶段自适应查询和非自适应任意量化器的已知结果与差距。
Result: 未提供新的实证结果或理论证明，仅陈述了当前已知结果和未解决的问题。
Conclusion: 开放问题归结为：能否通过完全非自适应的任意量化器匹配自适应率，从而得到最优的单次协议？或者已知的两阶段估计器是阶段最优的，即单次自适应转换既是必要的也是充分的？
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Selectivity Estimation for Linear Queries via Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based approaches for selectivity estimation in databases have gained significant traction in recent years. However, theoretical studies of these learning-based approaches are essentially limited to fixed query distributions on static databases. In practice, both the underlying database and the query workload can dynamically change over time. In this work, we propose an algorithmic framework for learning selectivity of queries in this more general dynamic setup. Inspired by online learning, we measure the performance of the learning algorithm in this setting by its regret, which compares the cumulative loss incurred by the learning algorithm to that of the best fixed strategy. We establish upper and lower bounds on regret for histogram-based linear queries, such as point, range, and subset selection queries, under standard loss functions, in both static and dynamic database settings.

Method: 借鉴在线学习理论，定义遗憾来比较学习算法与最优固定策略的累积损失，针对直方图线性查询提出算法框架，并分析其在标准损失函数下的理论界。

papers.title: Variable Bit-width Quantization: Learning Per-Group Precision for "Bigger-but-Smaller" Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit quantization shrinks language models but treats precision as a single global hyper-parameter: every weight uses the same bit-width. We introduce Variable Bit-width Quantization (VBQ), a training-time method in which each contiguous group of 64 weights learns its own resolution from {1,2,4,8} bits via a Gumbel-Softmax relaxation, trained jointly by an alternating optimization that gives the precision logits a clean, task-aligned signal. VBQ discovers a consistent, strongly heterogeneous allocation within individual projection types, not merely across layers, impossible to express with per-layer methods: 69% of groups collapse to 1 bit, the LM head averages 1.09 bits, while the first MLP block keeps ~2.5 bits. This pattern is stable enough to freeze into a fixed recipe and reuse without further search. The recipe yields a "bigger-but-smaller" regime: a 131M model at 1.82 mean bits reaches perplexity 4.2 on TinyStories, beating a 55M FP16 model (PPL 4.4) at 3.8x less storage, and lets a 1.46B model on FineWeb-Edu match a 593M FP16 control at ~3.7x less storage with 2.5x more parameters. As quality-per-byte, VBQ is 3.9-8.4x more efficient than FP16. The recipe maps directly to packed low-bit storage, so it also accelerates inference: with custom fused dequantize-and-multiply kernels, memory-bandwidth-bound autoregressive decode is faster at equal output, and the speedup grows with scale (parity at 131M, 1.9x at 1.0B, 4.7x at 9B on Apple silicon). A distributional analysis (KL divergence and argmax-flip rate) reveals a striking mechanism: deeper layers progressively self-heal the quantization error injected by early layers. The win is a from-scratch, train-time phenomenon; scaling the search economically beyond 1.5B parameters remains open. VBQ reframes precision as a learnable, non-uniform resource and shows that spending a fixed bit budget unevenly beats spending it uniformly.

TL;DR: 提出变量位宽量化（VBQ），在训练时让每个64权重的连续组从{1,2,4,8}比特中学习自己的精度，通过Gumbel-Softmax松弛和交替优化实现。结果发现组内精度高度异构：69%的组坍缩到1比特，LM头平均1.09比特，而第一个MLP块保持约2.5比特。该模式可冻结为固定配方，使131M模型在1.82平均比特下在TinyStories上达到困惑度4.2，超过55M FP16模型（PPL 4.4），存储减少3.8倍；1.46B模型在FineWeb-Edu上匹配593M FP16基线，存储减少约3.7倍，参数量多2.5倍。VBQ在每字节质量上比FP16高效3.9-8.4倍，并加速推理。分布分析揭示深层逐层自愈量化误差。
Motivation: 现有低比特量化将精度视为全局超参数，所有权重使用相同位宽，无法利用不同权重组的精度需求差异。
Method: 训练时方法，每个64权重组通过Gumbel-Softmax松弛从{1,2,4,8}比特中学习自身精度，采用交替优化使精度logits获得干净的任务对齐信号。
Result: 131M模型在1.82平均比特下PPL 4.2，超越55M FP16的PPL 4.4，存储减少3.8倍；1.46B模型匹配593M FP16，存储减少约3.7倍；每字节质量比FP16高效3.9-8.4倍；推理加速随规模增长（131M持平，1.0B快1.9倍，9B快4.7倍）。
Conclusion: VBQ将精度重塑为可学习的非均匀资源，表明非均匀分配固定比特预算优于均匀分配。从零训练的搜索现象在1.5B参数以上经济扩展仍待解决。

papers.title: Dynamic Regret for Non-Stationary Linear Bandits via Misspecification Reductions
papers.abstract_en: Many online decision-making problems involve both round-specific feasible actions and drifting reward models: eligible ad impressions, feasible prices, and available treatments can change over time, while user preferences, demand curves, and patient responses may evolve. Motivated by these applications, we study non-stationary linear bandits with round-specific feasible decision sets. Existing methods that obtain the optimal \(\widetilde O(T^{2/3}P_T^{1/3})\) dependence, where \(P_T\) is the path length of the reward-parameter sequence, impose an orthogonal-structure assumption on round-specific decision sets, which can be restrictive in contextual applications. We address this gap through a unified misspecification-reduction viewpoint: after partitioning the horizon into blocks, we relate each block's dynamic regret to regret against a fixed-parameter linear bandit benchmark, with the within-block parameter drift entering as bounded misspecification. Restarting algorithms with misspecification-dependent regret guarantees then yields the optimal \(T^{2/3}P_T^{1/3}\) dynamic-regret dependence for both linear bandits with general compact decision sets and \(K\)-armed contextual linear bandits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过误规范减少的统一视角，研究具有逐回合可行决策集的非平稳线性老虎机问题。现有方法获得最优动态遗憾界依赖于决策集的正交结构假设，限制了上下文应用。本文证明，将时间轴分块后，每个块内的动态遗憾可转化为对固定参数线性老虎机的遗憾加上有界误规范，通过重启算法可获得与现有最优结果相同的动态遗憾界，且适用于一般紧致决策集和K臂上下文线性老虎机。
Motivation: 现有非平稳线性老虎机方法依赖决策集的正交结构假设，在上下文应用中具有限制性，本文旨在去掉该假设并保持最优动态遗憾界。
Method: 提出误规范减少框架：将时间轴划分为块，将每个块内参数漂移视为有界误规范，将动态遗憾转化为对固定参数线性老虎机基准的遗憾，使用具有误规范依赖遗憾保证的算法重启。
Result: 获得了与现有最优结果相同的最优动态遗憾界 O~(T^{2/3}P_T^{1/3})，其中 P_T 是奖励参数序列的路径长度，且适用于一般紧致决策集和 K 臂上下文线性老虎机。
Conclusion: 统一了非平稳线性老虎机在不同决策集结构下的分析，证明了无需正交假设也能达到最优动态遗憾。

papers.title: SPLIT: Training-Free AI-Generated and Partially Edited Video Detection via Spatial Patch-Level Incoherence and Temporal Roughness
papers.abstract_en: Deploying AI-generated video detectors in real-world services demands an ultra-low false positive rate (FPR) on real videos to avoid falsely rejecting authentic content, a regime where standard metrics such as AUROC fail to reflect actual operating behavior. We introduce Spatial Patch-Level Incoherence and Temporal Roughness (SPLIT), a training-free detector that operates on patch tokens from a frozen vision encoder to detect both fully generated and partially edited videos. SPLIT computes two complementary signals: Two-step Temporal Roughness (TTR), capturing non-smooth patch trajectories via one-step and two-step feature variation contrast, and Local Spatial Motion Incoherence (LSMI), measuring spatially inconsistent temporal changes through gradients of a feature-space motion field. The two are fused multiplicatively with gamma correction to sharpen real-fake separation at strict thresholds. We further propose a service-aligned evaluation protocol based on Fake Recall at fixed FPR with real-only threshold calibration and cross-real threshold transfer. Across three benchmarks (FakeParts, GenVideo, and ViF-Bench), SPLIT achieves the highest Fake Recall at FPR = $0.1\%$, substantially outperforming supervised and training-free baselines while remaining robust to post-processing with negligible overhead. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/mldljyh/SPLIT .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需训练的视频检测方法 SPLIT，用于检测完全由 AI 生成或部分编辑的视频。方法利用冻结的视觉编码器的 patch token，通过两步时间粗糙度（TTR）和局部空间运动不一致性（LSMI）两个互补信号，并采用伽马校正的乘法融合来区分真实与伪造视频。在三个基准测试上，SPLIT 在固定低假阳性率下实现了最高的假视频召回率，且对后处理鲁棒。
Motivation: 现实部署中，AI 生成视频检测器需要在真实视频上保持极低的假阳性率，而标准指标如 AUROC 无法反映这种实际需求。
Method: 提出 SPLIT 检测器，基于冻结视觉编码器的 patch token：计算两步时间粗糙度（TTR）和局部空间运动不一致性（LSMI），通过伽马校正的乘法融合得到最终分数。同时提出服务对齐的评估协议，在固定假阳性率下衡量假视频召回率。
Result: 在 FakeParts、GenVideo 和 ViF-Bench 三个基准上，SPLIT 在 FPR=0.1% 时取得了最高的假视频召回率，显著优于监督和无需训练的方法，且对后处理鲁棒。
Conclusion: SPLIT 是一种训练免费、高效且鲁棒的 AI 生成及部分编辑视频检测方法，适合实际部署需求。

papers.title: Where do LLMs Fall Short in CBT-Guided Affective Reasoning?
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) provides a structured framework for understanding a user's mental state by examining the interaction between cognitive and behavioral factors. However, out-of-the-box LLMs respond fluently and empathetically, yet collapse into validation & reflection, regardless of what the user actually needs. They know theoretical CBT (scoring up to 96% accuracy on licensing exam questions) but fail to apply it effectively. We explore this gap with a knowledge-guided framework that treats CBT dialogue as controlled affective reasoning: user narratives are decomposed into Beck's Cognitive Conceptualization structure, grounded in clinical SNOMED CT concepts validated via Natural Language Inference, and a Multiple Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) strategy selection between Validation & Reflection, Socratic Questioning, or Alternative Perspectives. To measure whether such guidance actually changes behavior, we introduce the Protocol Leverage Force (F), a behavior-level metric that captures how far an intervention shifts a model away from its default response. Across three open-weight LLMs and 14 RealCBT-derived case studies, evaluated with human experts, valence-arousal trajectories, and linguistic entrainment, F shows that simply introducing protocol definitions via single chain-of-thought prompting fails to change LLM behavior, while MCoT on these definitions guides strategy selection better. Still, the effect stays within 1% (approx. 1.2-1.3%), and all models remain biased toward Validation & Reflection. These results show CBT knowledge alone does not ensure effective application, giving the affective-computing community instrumentation to measure where LLMs fall short.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, accepted for publication in Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）在认知行为疗法（CBT）引导的情感推理中的表现，发现尽管LLM在理论CBT知识测试中准确率高达96%，但在实际对话中倾向于使用“验证与反思”策略，无法根据用户需求灵活调整。作者提出一个知识引导框架，将CBT对话分解为Beck认知概念化结构，并通过多重链式思维（MCoT）选择治疗策略，引入协议杠杆力（F）作为行为级度量指标。实验表明，仅通过单链式思维提示引入协议定义无法改变LLM行为，而MCoT能够改善策略选择，但效果仅约1.2-1.3%，且模型仍偏向后验与反思。
Motivation: 现有LLM在CBT对话中虽能流畅共情，却机械地采用验证与反思，无法根据用户实际需求调整策略，即理论知识无法转化为有效应用。
Method: 提出知识引导框架：将用户叙述分解为Beck认知概念化结构，基于SNOMED CT临床概念通过自然语言推理验证，并使用多重链式思维（MCoT）在验证与反思、苏格拉底提问、替代视角三种策略中选择。同时定义协议杠杆力（F）作为行为级度量指标。
Result: 在三个开源LLM和14个真实CBT案例上，MCoT引导的策略选择优于单链式思维，但效果仅约1.2-1.3%的提升，且所有模型仍倾向于验证与反思策略。
Conclusion: CBT知识本身不足以保证有效应用，该研究为情感计算社区提供了度量LLM在情感推理中不足的工具。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）在认知行为疗法（CBT）引导的情感推理中的表现，发现尽管LLM在理论CBT知识测试中准确率高达96%，但在实际对话中倾向于使用“验证与反思”策略，无法根据用户需求灵活调整。作者提出一个知识引导框架，将CBT对话分解为Beck认知概念化结构，并通过多重链式思维（MCoT）选择治疗策略，引入协议杠杆力（F）作为行为级度量指标。实验表明，仅通过单链式思维提示引入协议定义无法改变LLM行为，而MCoT能够改善策略选择，但效果仅约1.2-1.3%，且模型仍偏向后验与反思。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM在CBT对话中虽能流畅共情，却机械地采用验证与反思，无法根据用户实际需求调整策略，即理论知识无法转化为有效应用。
summary_sections.method: 提出知识引导框架：将用户叙述分解为Beck认知概念化结构，基于SNOMED CT临床概念通过自然语言推理验证，并使用多重链式思维（MCoT）在验证与反思、苏格拉底提问、替代视角三种策略中选择。同时定义协议杠杆力（F）作为行为级度量指标。
summary_sections.result: 在三个开源LLM和14个真实CBT案例上，MCoT引导的策略选择优于单链式思维，但效果仅约1.2-1.3%的提升，且所有模型仍倾向于验证与反思策略。
summary_sections.conclusion: CBT知识本身不足以保证有效应用，该研究为情感计算社区提供了度量LLM在情感推理中不足的工具。

papers.title: MedCalc-Pro: Solving Complex Medical Calculations with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Current benchmarks for evaluating large language models (LLMs) in medical calculation are largely based on simplified settings, where each patient case corresponds to a single calculator and the required tool is explicitly specified in the query. However, real clinical scenarios often require multiple calculators for joint evaluation, nested-scale calculation, and fuzzy queries that do not directly specify the target calculator. To this end, we propose a new medical calculation benchmark, MedCalc-Pro, which covers three progressively challenging task settings: single-calculator, multi-calculator, and nested-calculator calculation settings. MedCalc-Pro contains 2,268 real-world clinical cases, covering 77 medical calculators across 14 clinical departments. Meanwhile, to address the limited performance of existing frameworks and methods in complex clinical scenarios, we further propose a more generalizable agent framework that supports multi-tool selection and nested-tool calling, while suppressing parameter error propagation through structured validation and evidence review. We conduct systematic comparisons across open-source, closed-source, and medical-specialized LLMs, and the results show that our framework achieves the best performance across all three task settings. This work provides a new benchmark and method for evaluating and applying LLMs in challenging medical calculation scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MedCalc-Pro基准，包含三个复杂任务设置（单计算器、多计算器、嵌套计算器），覆盖77个医疗计算器，2,268个临床病例。同时提出一个通用LLM智能体框架，支持多工具选择和嵌套调用，通过结构化验证和证据审查抑制参数错误传播，在三个设置上取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有医疗计算基准过于简化，每个病例仅对应单一计算器且查询中明确指定工具，无法反映真实临床场景中多计算器联合评估、嵌套计算和模糊查询的需求。
Method: 提出MedCalc-Pro基准及一个LLM智能体框架，该框架支持多工具选择和嵌套工具调用，通过结构化验证和证据审查来抑制参数错误的传播。
Result: 在开源、闭源和医疗专用LLM上系统比较，该框架在所有三个任务设置上均取得最佳性能。
Conclusion: 为评估和部署LLM于复杂医疗计算场景提供了新基准和方法。

papers.title: Determinants and Limits of LLM Security-Tool Orchestration: A Study with HexStrike-AI
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents driving security tool suites over the Model Context Protocol are increasingly common. Yet the factors that bound their capability remain poorly characterized: how much depends on the model versus the client that drives it, whether constraining the agent to the orchestrator's own tools helps, and where capability is limited by reasoning rather than by missing tools. Using HexStrikeAI, an open-source orchestrator that exposes 150+ tools, as a testbed, we follow a methodology that evaluates the system, diagnoses its failures, and applies targeted improvements. We run 86 picoCTF challenges across seven categories and three difficulty tiers, under three tool-access regimes and three model/client configurations (774 trials). We then apply corrections to existing tools, agent-behavior changes, and eleven new capability tools, and re-run the previously-unsuccessful trials. The diagnosis isolates the driving client as a first-order factor for a fixed model (a 2.1 * gap between two DeepSeek clients) and a monotonic difficulty gradient, with the largest gains in the mid tier. The overall solve rate rises from 55.4% to 72.0%, and every configuration improves significantly (paired McNemar p < 0.001, non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals). The residual failures are reasoning- or environment-bound rather than missing-tool. A 60-run stability sub-study finds single-run verdicts reproducible (17/20 unanimous). We discuss what the results imply for how such orchestrators should be evaluated, and we are explicit about the limits: the study uses a single benchmark, the fixes were tuned on the same challenges they were evaluated on, and the client effect is demonstrated for one model only, so its generality to other models remains a hypothesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过HexStrike-AI开源编排器（暴露150多个工具）研究了LLM代理在安全工具套件中的能力限制因素。实验在86个picoCTF挑战上进行了774次试验，比较不同模型/客户端配置和工具访问机制，诊断出客户端是首要因素（两个DeepSeek客户端之间差距2.1倍），整体解决率从55.4%提升到72.0%，残差失败归于推理或环境限制而非缺少工具。
Motivation: 当前LLM代理驱动安全工具套件越来越普遍，但其能力边界因素（模型vs客户端、约束代理到编排器自有工具是否有帮助、能力受限原因是推理还是缺少工具）尚未被很好刻画。
Method: 使用HexStrike-AI作为测试平台，在三个工具访问制度和三个模型/客户端配置下运行86个picoCTF挑战（七个类别、三个难度层级），共774次试验。随后对现有工具进行修正、改变代理行为并添加11个新能力工具，重新运行先前失败的试验。通过诊断隔离驱动客户端作为首要因素。
Result: 对于固定模型，两个DeepSeek客户端之间有2.1倍差距；整体解决率从55.4%提升到72.0%；所有配置均显著改善（配对McNemar p<0.001，95%置信区间不重叠）。残差失败主要是推理或环境问题而非缺少工具。60次稳定性研究发现单次裁决可重复（20次中17次一致）。
Conclusion: 研究结果提示了如何评估此类编排器，但局限性包括仅使用单一基准、修正方案在相同挑战上调整并评估、客户端效果仅对一个模型展示，因此对其他模型的普遍性仍是假设。

papers.title: Poisson-Gamma Modeling of Inter-Relational Dependencies in Dynamic Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic knowledge graphs are ubiquitous in today's AI applications, as we represent molecular structures, social relationships, and language information using these graph models. As knowledge graphs evolve over time and are often noisy and incomplete, modeling their temporal and relational dependencies becomes crucial for downstream tasks. To address these challenges, this paper proposes PGRE (Poisson-Gamma Relational Evolution), a probabilistic model for modeling inter-relational dependencies in dynamic knowledge graphs. PGRE represents multi-relational temporal links via a Poisson-Bernoulli formulation. It introduces Gamma-distributed latent variables to capture entity-factor associations and cross-relation dependencies mediated by shared latent communities. A Gamma Markov process further models the temporal evolution of these latent variables, enabling principled characterization of relational dynamics. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that PGRE achieves competitive performance in link prediction, particularly in sparse settings, while revealing meaningful relational evolution patterns in dynamic knowledge graphs.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026). 20 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PGRE（泊松-伽马关系演化）模型，用于动态知识图谱中跨关系依赖的建模。该模型通过泊松-伯努利公式表示多关系时间链接，引入伽马分布潜变量捕获实体-因子关联和跨关系依赖，并使用伽马马尔可夫过程建模潜变量的时间演化。在基准数据集上，PGRE在链接预测任务中取得有竞争力的性能，尤其在稀疏场景下，并揭示了有意义的动态知识图谱关系演化模式。
Motivation: 动态知识图谱随时间演化且常包含噪声和缺失，建模其时序和关系依赖对下游任务至关重要。
Method: 提出PGRE概率模型，使用泊松-伯努利公式建模多关系时间链接，伽马分布潜变量捕获实体-因子关联和共享潜社区介导的跨关系依赖，伽马马尔可夫过程建模潜变量时间演化。
Result: 在基准数据集上的链接预测任务中达到有竞争力的性能，尤其在稀疏设定下，并揭示了有意义的动态知识图谱关系演化模式。
Conclusion: PGRE能够有效建模动态知识图谱中的跨关系依赖和时间演化，在稀疏链接预测中表现良好。

papers.title: Reward Granularity in RLVR: Comparing Process and Outcome Reward Structures for Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving mathematical reasoning in language models. Yet most RLVR work rewards only the final answer (outcome-based rewards), leaving the impact of step-level process supervision (process rewards) underexplored especially for small models that lack the capacity to self-correct under sparse feedback. We systematically compare five reward conditions applied to Qwen2.5-0.5B fine-tuned with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on GSM8K: a no-RL baseline, process-only, outcome-only, and three hybrid weightings ($λ\in \{0.9, 0.5, 0.1\}$ process weight). Process-only supervision achieves 63.73% test accuracy versus 53.75% for outcome-only, a nearly 10-percentage point gap while yielding reasoning traces with higher step validity and lower deviation from ground-truth chain length. Hybrid rewards generally correlate positively with process weight, with one notable anomaly: the low-process / high-outcome configuration ($λ=0.1$) underperforms pure outcome supervision, suggesting conflicting optimization signals. Error analysis using GPT-4o as a judge reveals distinct failure mode distributions: process models generate structurally inconsistent but arithmetically grounded traces, while outcome models produce concise but derivation-error-prone chains. Our results demonstrate that reward granularity is a first-order design decision for RLVR, with process-level supervision substantially improving both accuracy and trace fidelity in small language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了强化学习（RL）中不同奖励粒度（过程奖励 vs. 结果奖励）对小型语言模型数学推理能力的影响。在Qwen2.5-0.5B模型上使用GRPO算法在GSM8K数据集上进行实验，发现仅使用过程奖励的模型测试准确率达到63.73%，显著高于仅使用结果奖励的53.75%，且推理轨迹的质量更高。混合奖励的表现通常与过程权重正相关，但低过程权重配置表现异常。错误分析揭示了两种奖励类型下不同的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有RLVR工作主要关注最终答案奖励（结果奖励），对步骤级过程监督（过程奖励）的作用研究不足，尤其对于缺乏自我纠正能力的小型模型，稀疏的反馈信号可能限制性能提升。
Method: 采用Qwen2.5-0.5B模型，使用GRPO算法在GSM8K数据集上微调，比较五种奖励条件：无RL基线、仅过程奖励、仅结果奖励以及三种混合权重（过程权重λ∈{0.9,0.5,0.1}）。
Result: 仅过程奖励的测试准确率为63.73%，高于仅结果奖励的53.75%（近10个百分点），且推理轨迹的步骤有效性和与真实链长度的偏差更优。混合奖励中，低过程/高结果配置（λ=0.1）表现最差，甚至不如纯结果奖励。
Conclusion: 奖励粒度是RLVR中的一阶设计决策，过程级监督能显著提升小型语言模型的数学推理准确性和轨迹保真度。

papers.title: E-TraMamba: A New Paradigm for Efficient Long-Term 3D Feature Tracking with Event Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Event-based 3D tracking enables low-latency and high-speed perception, while existing CNN- and Transformer-based trackers struggle to capture long-range spatiotemporal dependencies in sparse, noisy event streams, especially under real-time and efficiency constraints. To address these challenges, we present E-TraMamba, the first Mamba-based framework for 3D feature tracking on event data. This new framework adopts a linear state-space model for efficient long-range modeling and integrates a lightweight affine-transform predictor to maintain stable tracking under motion blur and occlusion. We also design an effective scheme to fuse multi-scale cues -- local spatiotemporal patches, correlation maps, and positional embeddings -- into a unified representation that enables stable and smooth 3D tracking. We construct a large-scale synthetic dataset, named EvD-PointOdyssey, which is generated with monocular rendering and provides synchronized event streams, depth maps, and accurate 3D trajectories for training and evaluating event-based 3D tracking models. Extensive experiments on event-based benchmarks demonstrate that E-TraMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering over $2\times$ longer feature lifetimes under strict accuracy thresholds (e.g., 0.1 m), with higher tracked-feature ratios and lower RMSE than all baselines. These results make E-TraMamba a strong candidate for low-latency visual odometry, real-time SLAM, and interactive robotics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: E-TraMamba 首次将 Mamba 架构用于事件数据的 3D 特征跟踪，采用线性状态空间模型进行高效长程建模，并集成轻量级仿射变换预测器以在运动模糊和遮挡下保持稳定跟踪。该方法通过融合局部时空块、相关图和位置嵌入等多尺度线索，在事件基准上实现了超过 2 倍的特征寿命提升（严格精度阈值如 0.1 米），并具有更高的跟踪特征比和更低的 RMSE。
Motivation: 现有 CNN 和 Transformer 跟踪器难以在稀疏噪声事件流中捕获长程时空依赖性，且受实时性和效率限制。
Method: 提出基于 Mamba 的框架，使用线性状态空间模型进行长程建模，结合轻量级仿射变换预测器和多尺度线索融合（局部时空块、相关图、位置嵌入）。
Result: 在事件基准上，E-TraMamba 在严格精度阈值（如 0.1 m）下实现超过 2× 的特征寿命，更高跟踪特征比和更低 RMSE，达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: E-TraMamba 适用于低延迟视觉里程计、实时 SLAM 和交互式机器人，但摘要未提及其在降水预报等气象领域的适用性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: E-TraMamba 首次将 Mamba 架构用于事件数据的 3D 特征跟踪，采用线性状态空间模型进行高效长程建模，并集成轻量级仿射变换预测器以在运动模糊和遮挡下保持稳定跟踪。该方法通过融合局部时空块、相关图和位置嵌入等多尺度线索，在事件基准上实现了超过 2 倍的特征寿命提升（严格精度阈值如 0.1 米），并具有更高的跟踪特征比和更低的 RMSE。

papers.title: Trading Confidence: Comprehensive Uncertainty Estimation in Algorithmic Trading
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach in financial trading, enabling agents to learn optimal strategies through direct market interaction. However, financial markets are highly uncertain, with price fluctuations driven by stochastic volatility, model limitations, and regime shifts. Traditional RL models struggle in dynamic environments, often failing to adapt to sudden market disruptions, leading to suboptimal trading decisions. To address this challenge, we propose an uncertainty-aware RL framework that integrates distributional, epistemic, and aleatoric uncertainty estimations. Our approach enhances uncertainty estimation using SHAP-weighted reconstruction uncertainty, MC Dropout, and an LSTM-based technical indicator consensus mechanism. Experimental results on five major U.S. stock indices demonstrate that RL agents equipped with uncertainty estimation significantly outperform traditional models in return and risk management. This study advances uncertainty estimation in RL-based financial trading, with future research extending its application to other asset classes and alternative RL architectures for greater adaptability.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Pacific Asia Conference on Information Systems (PACIS 2025). 17 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个不确定性感知的强化学习框架，结合分布性、认知性和偶然性不确定性估计，用于算法交易。通过SHAP加权重建不确定性、MC Dropout和基于LSTM的技术指标共识机制，在五个美国股指上实现了优于传统模型的回报和风险管理。
Motivation: 金融市场高度不确定，传统RL模型在动态环境中难以适应突发事件，导致次优交易决策。
Method: 提出不确定性感知的RL框架，整合分布性、认知性和偶然性不确定性估计，使用SHAP加权重建不确定性、MC Dropout和LSTM技术指标共识机制。

papers.title: Cancelable Biometric Template Protection Based on Multi-Instance Fusion: A Contralateral Iris Approach
papers.abstract_en: Biometric templates are vulnerable to theft if stored without protection. Unlike passwords, a compromised iris cannot be reissued. Although existing cancelable biometric schemes address this problem, most still require an external key or token, introducing an additional attack surface. This paper proposes a cancelable contralateral iris template protection scheme that eliminates the need for a separate token or stored secret, satisfying the three requirements of ISO/IEC 24745: irreversibility, unlinkability, and confidentiality. The method fuses three enrollment samples per eye using Majority Vote Fusion to produce a stable template, and applies a salt-based bit permutation derived from the subject's enrollment ID. Combining the left- and right-permuted templates via a bitwise XOR produces a single Protected Fused Template. Since left and right iris patterns are statistically independent, fusing contralateral irises improves the accuracy of the system. An attacker must possess both iris codes and both salts to recover any useful information, yielding a larger effective key space than single-iris schemes. Experiments on three datasets, CASIA-IrisV4-Interval, CASIA-IrisV2 (two devices), and CASIA-Iris-Thousand, yield EERs of $0.36$\%, $4.88$\%, $10.80$\%, and $3.35$\%, respectively; the highest value reflects the more challenging cross-device scenario. These results demonstrate that our contralateral approach outperforms unprotected baselines while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art cancelable methods. %In addition, an ablation study confirms the benefit on both recognition performance and security. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scheme to combine tokenless multi-instance fusion and contralateral binding under ISO/IEC 24745.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需外部令牌的可取消对侧虹膜模板保护方案，通过多数投票融合三个样本生成稳定模板，并利用基于注册ID的盐进行位置换后对左、右眼模板进行XOR融合得到单一保护模板。实验在CASIA-IrisV4-Interval、CASIA-IrisV2（两个设备）和CASIA-Iris-Thousand四个场景上取得了0.36%、4.88%、10.80%和3.35%的等错误率（EER），其中最高值对应更具挑战的跨设备场景。该方案满足ISO/IEC 24745的不可逆性、不可关联性和机密性要求。
Motivation: 生物特征模板若未加保护易被窃取，且虹膜无法像密码一样重新发行。现有可取消生物特征方案多数需要外部密钥或令牌，引入了额外的攻击面。
Method: 对每只眼睛的三个注册样本采用多数投票融合生成稳定模板，然后利用从受试者注册ID派生的盐进行位置换，最后通过对左、右眼置换后的模板进行按位XOR生成单一受保护融合模板（Protected Fused Template）。
Result: 在CASIA-IrisV4-Interval、CASIA-IrisV2（两个设备）和CASIA-Iris-Thousand数据集上分别获得0.36%、4.88%、10.80%和3.35%的EER。结果表明该方法优于未保护基线，并与最先进的可取消方法性能相当。
Conclusion: 该方案是首个结合无令牌多实例融合和对侧虹膜绑定的方法，满足ISO/IEC 24745的三项要求。摘要强调其有效密钥空间大于单虹膜方案，且对侧虹膜的统计独立性有助于提高系统准确率。

papers.title: EvoOtter: Evolutionary Reproduction Test Generator
papers.abstract_en: Before fixing an issue, it is useful to first reproduce it by generating a bug reproduction test (BRT). However, generating a BRT is itself a challenging task, because issue descriptions tend to be informal, making it difficult to determine whether a candidate BRT indeed fails for the reason in the issue. Prior work has attempted to tackle this problem via inference scaling, using large language models to generate many BRTs and patches, then using execution feedback to select and improve them. Unfortunately, this is expensive and the feedback is unreliable. This paper explores evolutionary programming for BRT generation to sharpen the feedback, while enhancing evolutionary programming to keep costs in check. Our new approach, EvoOtter, controls test execution costs via successive halving. Furthermore, it controls LLM costs via batched crossover for an entire generation in a single LLM call, as well as via rule-based code mutations, with a new fitness score tailored for BRTs. As a result, EvoOtter generates state-of-the-art quality BRTs at the fraction of the cost of prior inference-scaling approaches to this problem. More broadly, this paper points at how to efficiently and effectively combine evolutionary programming with large language models for software engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoOtter 是一种结合进化编程与大语言模型的 bug 复现测试生成方法。它通过逐次减半控制测试执行成本，利用批量交叉和基于规则的代码突变降低 LLM 调用成本，并针对 BRT 设计新的适应度评分。实验表明，EvoOtter 在生成高质量 BRT 的同时，成本远低于先前的推理扩展方法。
Motivation: 已有的推理扩展方法通过大语言模型生成大量 BRT 和补丁，再用执行反馈筛选，但成本高且反馈不可靠。
Method: 提出 EvoOtter，使用逐次减半控制测试执行成本，通过批量交叉（batched crossover）在一次 LLM 调用中完成整个种群的交叉，并采用基于规则的代码突变和针对 BRT 的适应度评分。
Result: 相比先前方法，EvoOtter 以更低的成本生成了 state-of-the-art 质量的 BRT。
Conclusion: 本文展示了如何高效地将进化编程与大语言模型结合用于软件工程任务。

papers.title: Prior Bias in Vision Language Models on UML Diagram Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to software engineering artifacts, especially UML class diagrams whose meaning depends on visual notation. Yet, it is unclear whether VLMs actually read such diagrams or instead answer from pretrained priors about how classes typically relate. We introduce a controlled UML benchmark in which each prior-conforming diagram is paired with its prior-conflicting counterpart that (1) preserves the same class names and layout while (2) reverses only the relation arrow. We evaluate eight open-source VLMs from two model families, InternVL3.5 and Qwen3, alongside two closed-source frontier models GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 Mini. Across the eight open-source models, reversing the arrow reduces relation-direction accuracy by 33.48% on average, while GPT-5.4 Mini retains a 10% gap. In the harder three-class condition, accuracy drops sharply by 45.28% for open-source models, and even 18.62% for the GPT-5.4 family on average. Scaling provides only limited improvements and is family-dependent. Our benchmark presents a diagnostic prior-driven failure in diagram-grounded software understanding. Our artifact is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UMLKnowledgeConflict-8461.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过构建受控的UML类图基准，研究视觉语言模型（VLMs）在解释类图时是否依赖预训练先验而非实际读取视觉符号。实验发现，当反转关系箭头（保持类名和布局不变）时，开源模型的关系方向准确率平均下降33.48%，闭源GPT-5.4 Mini也表现出10%的差距。结果表明当前VLMs存在先验驱动的理解偏差。
Motivation: 尽管VLMs越来越多地应用于软件工程中UML类图等视觉符号任务，但模型是否真正读取图表而非仅依赖预训练先验尚不清楚。
Method: 设计配对UML基准：每个与先验一致的图表对应一个先验冲突版本（仅反转箭头方向，保留类名和布局），评估8个开源和2个闭源VLM。
Result: 箭头反转使开源模型准确率平均下降33.48%（三类别条件下降45.28%），GPT-5.4 Mini下降10%，GPT-5.4系列下降18.62%；模型缩放的效果有限且依赖于模型家族。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了VLMs在图表驱动的软件理解中存在先验驱动的失败模式，现有模型尚不能稳健地处理视觉-语义冲突。

papers.title: Labeled-Data-Free Meta-Learning: Efficient Task Generation Using Pre-trained Models and Unlabeled Data
papers.abstract_en: Meta-learning without labeled data is crucial for real-world applications, where obtaining labeled datasets can be expensive or restricted due to privacy concerns. Data-Free Meta-Learning (DFML) addresses this challenge by leveraging pre-trained models without access to training data. However, existing DFML methods rely on model inversion to generate training data, a process that is generally difficult and computationally expensive due to the need to generate high-dimensional data matching the original distribution. To address this limitation, we propose a novel meta-learning setting that avoids model inversion by jointly leveraging pre-trained models and unlabeled data. Our method generates meta-training tasks by assigning soft labels from pre-trained models to unlabeled data. Since the quality of these tasks can vary, we introduce a task-weighting mechanism based on task confidence and class distribution balance to ensure effective meta-learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach substantially reduces computational cost and improves generalization, achieving up to 104-fold speedup and 8.4 percent to 36.4 percent improvements in few-shot classification accuracy compared to state-of-the-art DFML methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需标签数据的元学习框架，利用预训练模型为无标签数据生成软标签以构建元训练任务，并引入任务加权机制改善任务质量。在few-shot分类任务上，该方法相比现有数据自由元学习（DFML）方法实现了高达104倍加速和8.4%–36.4%的准确率提升。
Motivation: 现有DFML方法依赖模型反演生成训练数据，该过程计算昂贵且在高维空间中难以执行，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出新设定：联合预训练模型和无标签数据，通过预训练模型为无标签数据分配软标签来生成元训练任务；设计基于任务置信度和类别分布平衡的任务加权机制以筛选高质量任务。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在few-shot分类基准上相比SOTA DFML方法取得8.4%–36.4%准确率提升，并实现最高104倍计算加速。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，避免模型反演、直接利用预训练模型和无标签数据可以显著降低元学习的计算开销并提升泛化性能。

papers.title: Object-Centric Environment Modeling for Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve through accumulated experience, but free-form textual memories become difficult to maintain, validate, and reuse as interactions grow. Recent symbolic approaches learn executable skills or programmatic world models, yet often store local procedures or assume simplified dynamics. We propose Object-Centric Environment Modeling (OCM), which organizes experience into an executable object-centric environment model. OCM maintains two connected code bases: object knowledge, which defines environment entities and mechanisms as Python classes, and procedure knowledge, which records reusable interaction patterns that must import and use the object model. OCM works in an online setting: after each episode, OCM reflects on the trajectory, updates both knowledge bases, and verifies that all procedures execute against the updated object model. During future interaction, the agent uses progressive knowledge disclosure to inspect compact code signatures first and read source code only when needed. Experiments show that OCM achieves the best average rank across benchmarks and reduces invalid actions, demonstrating that agents can benefit from building object-centric environment models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对象中心环境建模 (OCM)，让 LLM agent 通过维护两套代码库（对象知识和过程知识）来组织交互经验。OCM 在线更新知识库并验证过程的可执行性，在后续交互中使用渐进式知识披露调用代码。实验表明 OCM 在多个基准测试中取得最佳平均排名并减少无效动作。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 的自由文本记忆难以维护和复用，符号方法存储局部过程或假设简化动力学，缺乏可执行的、可验证的环境模型。
Method: OCM 维护两个相连的代码库：对象知识（Python 类定义环境实体与机制）和过程知识（记录可复用的交互模式，必须导入并使用对象模型）。在线更新后验证所有过程可执行，未来交互时采用渐进式知识披露。
Result: 实验表明 OCM 在多个基准上取得最佳平均排名，并减少了无效动作。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 agent 可以从构建对象中心环境模型中受益，提升了交互效率和可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differential Amplifier-Inspired AmpAttention for Multi-View Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view robotic manipulation methods with the attention mechanism have recently achieved significant progress in both training efficiency and task performance. However, the inherent redundancy, occlusion, and viewpoint dependency in robotic view images often lead to severe attention drift. To address this challenge, we propose AmpAttention, a novel attention mechanism inspired by differential amplifiers in analog circuits. It aims to suppress attention noise and capture high signal-to-noise ratio signals for more reliable perception. Based on this, we introduce the RVAF model, which integrates task-guided intra-view and inter-view AmpAttention. Compared to previous state-of-the-art methods, RVAF achieves the optimal average success rate across 18 RLBench tasks (249 variations) while reducing training time by 33.3\%. RVAF also demonstrates strong potential in real-world high-precision tasks, exemplified by its ability to pick up a dart and accurately insert it into the red bullseye. Furthermore, we extend RVAF to RVAF++ by incorporating the SAM2 image encoder. RVAF++ achieves substantial gains on high-precision tasks, achieving a 91\% success rate on the `insert peg' task. More qualitative results are provided at the anonymous project website https://anonymous.4open.science/w/RVAF-Anonymization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多视图机器人操作中注意力机制的冗余、遮挡和视角依赖导致的注意力漂移问题，提出受差分放大器启发的AmpAttention机制，旨在抑制注意力噪声、捕捉高信噪比信号。基于此构建RVAF模型，集成任务引导的视图内与视图间AmpAttention，在18个RLBench任务（249个变体）上取得最优平均成功率，训练时间减少33.3%。扩展版本RVAF++引入SAM2图像编码器，在"insert peg"高精度任务上达到91%成功率，并在真实世界任务（如捡起飞镖插入红心）中展现潜力。
Motivation: 多视图机器人操作方法虽借助注意力机制取得进展，但视图图像固有的冗余、遮挡和视角依赖性常导致严重注意力漂移，影响感知可靠性。
Method: 提出受模拟电路差分放大器启发的AmpAttention机制，通过抑制噪声并放大高信噪比信号来改进注意力。基于此构建RVAF模型，包含任务引导的视图内和视图间AmpAttention。进一步扩展为RVAF++，使用SAM2图像编码器增强特征提取。
Result: RVAF在18个RLBench任务（249变体）上达到最优平均成功率，同时训练时间减少33.3%。RVAF++在"insert peg"任务上成功率达91%，并在真实世界高精度操作（如捡起飞镖插入红心）中表现良好。

papers.title: CLEAR: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning at Scale for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) aims to directly map raw sensor information to driving actions. Recently, with the rapid advancement of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs), researchers have proposed the paradigm of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for E2E-AD, where it seeks to integrate visual perception, language understanding and action prediction within a single policy. However, existing VLA-based policies largely adopts imitation learning, where it only learns to drive by optimizing distance-based metrics w.r.t. logged expert trajectories. Such distribution shift between open-loop training and closed-loop inference leads to suboptimal performance in closed-loop planning. To close this gap, we present CLEAR, a system that enables closed-loop training using Reinforcement Learning (RL) at scale for E2E-AD. We propose to learn a novel residual waypoint policy around the waypoint prior from pretrained VLA policies, effectively harnessing the knowledge within. On another front, one of the key challenges to scale up RL for vision-based policies is the number of parallel simulation environments since RL is data hungry. To that end, we design a heterogeneous pipeline that places the simulator and the VLA learner on distinct compute groups, which allows us to dramatically increase the number of simulation environments running in parallel while avoiding resource contention and maintaining training stability. We show that with a simple reward, CLEAR significantly outperforms previous methods and sets new state-of-the-art performance on the challenging benchmarks of CARLA longest6 v2 and Bench2Drive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLEAR系统，通过大规模强化学习实现端到端自动驾驶的闭环训练。针对现有VLA模型采用模仿学习导致的开环训练与闭环推理分布偏移问题，CLEAR在预训练VLA策略的路径先验上学习残差路径策略，并设计异构流水线将模拟器与学习器分离以支持大量并行环境。在CARLA longest6 v2和Bench2Drive基准上达到新最优性能。
Motivation: 现有VLA策略基于模仿学习，其开环训练与闭环推理之间的分布偏移导致闭环规划性能次优。
Method: 提出CLEAR系统：在预训练VLA策略的路径先验之上学习残差路径策略，并设计异构计算流水线，将模拟器与VLA学习器置于不同计算集群，以支持大规模并行环境下的强化学习训练。
Result: 使用简单奖励函数，CLEAR在CARLA longest6 v2和Bench2Drive基准上显著超越先前方法，达到新最优性能。
Conclusion: 闭环强化学习可有效弥补VLA策略的开环-闭环差距，且异构流水线扩展了基于视觉的策略的RL训练规模。

papers.title: On the Design Space of Discrete Diffusion Online Adaptation for Molecular Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Molecular optimization often starts from a pretrained generative model that captures a broad prior over valid molecular structures. At test time, however, the goal is not to sample from this prior, but to use a limited oracle budget to shift generation toward task-specific high-reward molecules. We study this adaptation problem for discrete diffusion models. Each online round couples several choices. The loop must decide which candidates to evaluate, how rewards become model updates, which feedback to reuse, and how far to move beyond the pretrained prior. These choices have mostly been studied in isolation, leaving open whether they complement one another, become redundant, or interfere inside a full online adaptation loop. We conduct controlled studies across six small-molecule binding-affinity tasks and three protein-fitness tasks. We find that acquisition, reward shaping, and model debiasing provide complementary routes to higher reward, especially for small molecules. Replay further stabilizes learning, while validity penalties keep small-molecule exploration on the valid molecular manifold. Together, these findings point to a practical recipe for feedback-efficient molecular optimization: online fine-tuning with acquisition, reward shaping, debiasing, replay, and validity control. This recipe outperforms offline fine-tuning and inference-time search baselines under matched oracle-call budgets and GPU-hour accounting. The gains are largest when high-reward candidates require larger shifts from the pretrained prior.
papers.comment: Submitted to The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离散扩散模型在分子优化中的在线适应问题，通过控制实验比较采集函数、奖励塑形、模型去偏、回放和有效性惩罚等设计选择，发现这些组件互补，并提出一个实用的在线微调方案，在分子结合亲和力和蛋白质适应性任务上优于离线微调和推理时搜索基线。
Motivation: 分子优化通常从预训练生成模型开始，但测试时目标是从有限预算的oracle中采样高奖励分子，现有研究孤立地考察各个设计选择，缺乏对完整在线适应循环中各组件相互作用的理解。
Method: 在六类小分子结合亲和力任务和三类蛋白质适应性任务上进行控制实验，系统比较采集、奖励塑形、模型去偏、回放和有效性惩罚等模块，最终整合为在线微调方案。
Result: 摘要报告该方案在匹配oracle调用预算和GPU时间下优于离线微调和推理时搜索基线，且当需要大幅偏离预训练先验时增益最大。
Conclusion: 采集、奖励塑形、模型去偏、回放和有效性控制可互补提升分子优化效率，形成反馈高效的实用方案。

papers.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI models now span vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs), but practical deployment remains fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, backend assumptions, and robot-side glue code, especially on heterogeneous edge devices. Existing inference runtimes are designed mainly for request-response serving and therefore do not satisfy the runtime contract of embodied deployment: multi-rate execution inside closed-loop control, latency-first batch-1 inference on heterogeneous hardware, and extensible embodied interfaces beyond fixed token I/O. We present Embodied$.$cpp, a portable C++ inference runtime for embodied models. Based on an architectural analysis of representative VLA models and WAMs, Embodied$.$cpp captures a shared execution path and organizes it into five layers: input adapters, sequence builders, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adapters. The runtime provides modular multi-rate execution, latency-first fused inference, and extensible operator and I/O support, enabling deployment across heterogeneous devices, robots, and simulators through one backend abstraction. We evaluate Embodied$.$cpp on two VLA models, HY-VLA and pi0.5, and on a preliminary WAM benchmark using a LingBot-VA Transformer block. The VLA deployments achieve successful closed-loop execution with 100.0% and 91.0% task success rates, respectively. The WAM benchmark reduces block memory from 312.2 MiB to 88.1 MiB. These results show that Embodied$.$cpp improves deployment efficiency while preserving high accuracy across diverse embodied model architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Embodied.cpp，一个可移植的 C++ 推理运行时，用于在异构机器人上部署具身 AI 模型。它通过五层架构支持多速率执行、延迟优先融合推理和可扩展接口，在 VLA 模型和世界动作模型上实现了高任务成功率和内存优化。
Motivation: 现有具身 AI 模型部署依赖于模型特定的 Python 栈和后端假设，在异构边缘设备上碎片化严重；现有推理运行时主要面向请求-响应服务，不满足闭环控制中的多速率执行、延迟优先批量1推理和可扩展接口需求。
Method: 通过分析代表性 VLA 模型和 WAM 的通用执行路径，设计五层架构：输入适配器、序列构建器、骨干执行、头部插件和部署适配器。提供模块化多速率执行、延迟优先融合推理和可扩展算子/IO支持，通过统一后端抽象支持异构设备、机器人和模拟器。
Result: 在 HY-VLA 和 pi0.5 上闭环执行任务成功率分别为 100.0% 和 91.0%；在 WAM 基准上，使用 LingBot-VA Transformer 块将块内存从 312.2 MiB 降至 88.1 MiB。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 Embodied.cpp 在保持高精度的同时提升了异构具身模型架构的部署效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Agent-Based Patching of Compiler Missed Optimizations
papers.abstract_en: Compiler missed optimizations refer to cases in which compilers failed to optimize certain code. It takes many compiler developers' efforts to implement or patch such missed optimizations. In this paper, we present a systematic study of how well agents patch compiler missed optimizations. We identify a significant challenge that patching a missed optimization requires more than just fixing the reported case, and instead requires generalizing to similar cases. We construct a benchmark of real-world LLVM missed optimization issues and compare agent-generated patches with patches from developers in terms of optimization scope. Our results show that coding agents often optimize the given examples, but many generated patches either cover only part of the developer-intended scope or partially overlap with it; in some cases, they further generalize beyond the reference patch. We further introduce historical-knowledge augmentation techniques that leverage prior LLVM optimization pull requests through retrieval and distillation, showing that they improve developer-aligned generalization and yield practical benefits when applied to real-world IR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了基于智能体（agent）修补编译器遗漏优化（missed optimizations）的能力。实验发现，修补这类优化需要泛化到相似案例，而不仅仅是修复报告的具体问题。作者构建了LLVM真实遗漏优化基准，比较智能体生成的补丁与开发者补丁在优化范围上的差异，并引入历史知识增强技术（利用检索和蒸馏从先前的LLVM优化PR中学习），提升了泛化能力。
Motivation: 编译器遗漏优化需要大量开发者手动修补，现有智能体在修补时往往只针对报告的具体案例，缺乏泛化能力，无法覆盖开发者意图的全部优化范围。
Method: 构建一个包含真实LLVM遗漏优化问题的基准，比较智能体生成的补丁与开发者补丁的优化范围；进一步提出历史知识增强技术，通过检索和蒸馏利用先前的LLVM优化拉取请求（PR）来提升智能体的泛化效果。
Result: 编码智能体通常能优化给定的例子，但许多生成的补丁仅覆盖部分开发者意图的范围或部分重叠；有些案例中补丁甚至超出了参考补丁的范围。历史知识增强技术能改善与开发者对齐的泛化能力，并在实际IR上带来收益。
Conclusion: 智能体修补编译器遗漏优化时面临泛化挑战；历史知识增强是一种有效的改进方向。

summary_sections.result: 编码智能体通常能优化给定的例子，但许多生成的补丁仅覆盖部分开发者意图的范围或部分重叠；有些案例中补丁甚至超出了参考补丁的范围。历史知识增强技术能改善与开发者对齐的泛化能力，并在实际IR上带来收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 智能体修补编译器遗漏优化时面临泛化挑战；历史知识增强是一种有效的改进方向。

papers.title: GAP-GDRNet: Geometry-Aware Monocular Visual Pose Sensing on a Single-Target Synthetic Spacecraft Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Monocular relative pose sensing is a central perception problem in non-cooperative rendezvous and on-orbit servicing. In spacecraft images, however, weak surface texture, thin appendages, illumination changes, and partial occlusion often leave only sparse and unstable geometric evidence. This article presents GAP-GDRNet, a geometry-aware attention-enhanced framework for monocular RGB-based 6D pose sensing. The method follows the geometry-guided direct regression paradigm of GDR-Net and modifies two points in the pipeline: an attention-based feature refinement (AFR) module is placed before dense geometric prediction, and a patch-level geometric self-attention (PGSA) module is inserted into Patch-PnP. AFR reinforces global spacecraft structure together with local weak-texture cues; PGSA then relates downsampled geometric patches before final pose regression. A Blender-based annotation process supplies target masks, visible-region masks, dense model-coordinate maps, camera intrinsics, and 6D pose labels for supervised training.The primary evaluation uses a single-target synthetic spacecraft dataset built from one CAD model. GAP-GDRNet reaches a rotation error of $1.96^\circ$, a translation error of 0.0165 m, and an ADD@0.02 m accuracy of 95.16\%, exceeding the reproduced GDR-Net baseline by 3.88 percentage points while running at 35.97 FPS for pose-network inference. Supplementary evaluations on T-LESS and LM-O give BOP AR gains of 6.8 and 3.1 percentage points over the reproduced baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAP-GDRNet，一种基于几何感知注意力增强的框架，用于单目 RGB 图像中的非合作航天器 6D 位姿估计。该方法在 GDR-Net 基础上添加注意力特征细化模块和块级几何自注意力模块，并在一个合成航天器数据集上取得优于基线的性能。
Motivation: 非合作交会对接中，航天器图像存在弱纹理、薄附件、光照变化和部分遮挡，导致几何特征稀疏不稳定，现有方法精度不足。
Method: 在 GDR-Net 的几何引导直接回归范式中加入两个模块：注意力特征细化（AFR）模块增强全局结构和局部弱纹理信息，块级几何自注意力（PGSA）模块在 Patch-PnP 中关联下采样几何块。使用 Blender 生成标注数据以监督训练。
Result: 在单目标合成航天器数据集上，旋转误差 1.96°，平移误差 0.0165 m，ADD@0.02 m 精度 95.16%，相比复现的 GDR-Net 基线提升 3.88 个百分点，推理速度 35.97 FPS。在 T-LESS 和 LM-O 上 BOP AR 分别提升 6.8 和 3.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 该方法有效提升了弱纹理和遮挡条件下的位姿估计精度，并在多类物体上验证了泛化性。

papers.title: An Additive MLP-GNN Framework for Characterizing Chemical and Structural Contributions to Aqueous Solubility
papers.abstract_en: Aqueous solubility is a key property in early-stage drug discovery, but most predictive models merge physicochemical descriptors and molecular graph information into a single representation, obscuring whether a prediction is driven by global chemistry, molecular structure, or both. We present an additive deep-learning framework that keeps these two sources of information separate throughout training: physicochemical descriptors are encoded by a multilayer perceptron (the chemical branch) and molecular graph topology by a graph neural network (the structural branch), with the two outputs combined only at the prediction stage through an additive model with an optional multiplicative interaction. This design provides a direct decomposition of chemical and structural components that can be examined separately after training. Furthermore, pretraining on the larger AqSolDB dataset and fine-tuning on the smaller BigSolDB2 dataset substantially improve accuracy and reduce run-to-run variations, indicating generalizability of the learned features from the data-rich settings. We further interpret the fitted model using best linear projections of the branch outputs, molecule-level embedding summaries across solubility classes, and atom-level GNNExplainer masks aggregated over functional groups. These analyses show that the chemical branch aligns with familiar physicochemical descriptors, while the structural branch captures graph-topological and functional-group patterns associated with solubility. Across both datasets, the framework attains competitive predictive performance while making the distinct roles of chemical and structural information more transparent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个加性MLP-GNN框架，将理化描述符（化学分支）和分子图拓扑（结构分支）分开处理，仅在预测阶段通过加性模型（可选乘性交互）合并。在AqSolDB预训练并在BigSolDB2微调后，模型在保持竞争性预测性能的同时，能分别解释化学和结构对水溶性的贡献。
Motivation: 现有水溶性预测模型将理化描述符和分子图信息合并为单一表示，难以区分预测是由全局化学性质、分子结构还是两者共同驱动。
Method: 构建双分支加性深度学习框架：多层感知机编码理化描述符（化学分支），图神经网络编码分子图拓扑（结构分支），输出通过加性模型（含可选乘性交互）合并。在大数据集AqSolDB上预训练，在小数据集BigSolDB2上微调。
Result: 在AqSolDB和BigSolDB2数据集上取得竞争性预测性能；预训练-微调策略显著提升精度并降低运行间变异。通过线性投影、嵌入汇总和GNNExplainer分析，化学分支与已知理化描述符对齐，结构分支捕捉与溶解度相关的图拓扑和官能团模式。
Conclusion: 该框架使化学和结构信息的作用更加透明，有助于理解水溶性的预测来源，并验证了预训练-微调策略的泛化能力。

papers.title: ART for Diffusion Sampling: Continuous-Time Control and Actor-Critic Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study timestep allocation for score-based diffusion sampling, where a learned reverse-time dynamics is discretized on a finite grid. Uniform and hand-crafted schedules are standard choices, but they rely on fixed prescriptions and can therefore be suboptimal. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Reparameterized Time (ART), a continuous-time control formulation that learns a time change by treating the speed of the sampling clock as the control, so that a uniform grid on the learned clock induces adaptive timesteps in the original diffusion time. Based on a leading-order Euler error surrogate, ART provides a principled objective for allocating timesteps along the sampling trajectory. To solve this deterministic control problem, we introduce ART-RL, an auxiliary randomized formulation with Gaussian policies that turns schedule learning into a continuous-time reinforcement learning problem. We prove that the randomized ART-RL formulation is equivalent to ART at the optimizer level, in the sense that its optimal Gaussian policy recovers the optimal ART time-warping rate through its mean. We further establish policy evaluation and policy improvement characterizations and derive trajectory-based moment identities that yield implementable actor--critic updates for learning the schedule. Across experiments ranging from controlled low-dimensional settings to image generation, ART-RL can be plugged into existing diffusion samplers by changing only the timestep grid, consistently improving sample quality over strong baseline schedules at matched budgets while leaving the rest of the sampling pipeline unchanged. The learned schedules also exhibit broad generalization, transferring without retraining across sampling budgets, datasets, solvers, pipelines, and representation spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应重参数化时间（ART）方法，将扩散采样中的时间步分配建模为连续时间控制问题，并利用演员-评论家强化学习（ART-RL）学习最优调度。实验表明，该方法在多种设置下提升采样质量，且学习到的调度可泛化到不同预算、数据集等。
Motivation: 现有扩散采样中的均匀或手工调度是固定的，可能非最优，因此需要自适应的时间步分配。
Method: 提出ART，将采样时钟速度作为控制变量，基于前向欧拉误差代理构建目标；进一步引入ART-RL，通过高斯策略将其转化为连续时间强化学习问题，并证明最优高斯策略的均值恢复最优时间扭曲率。利用策略评估和改进，推导出可实现的演员-评论家更新。
Result: 在从低维到图像生成的实验中，ART-RL只需改变时间步网格即可插入现有采样器，在相同计算预算下持续提升采样质量，且学习到的调度在采样预算、数据集、求解器、流水线和表示空间之间广泛泛化。
Conclusion: 论文展示了连续时间控制框架和强化学习方法在扩散采样调度学习中的有效性，并强调其即插即用和泛化能力。

papers.title: Guided Action Flow: Q-Guided Inference for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching vision-language-action policies generate robot action chunks through an iterative transport process, creating an opportunity for test-time guidance without retraining the base policy. We study this opportunity in Guided Action Flow, an inference-time framework that keeps a pretrained SmolVLA policy frozen and uses a learned action-chunk critic to guide its reverse-time flow sampler. The critic is trained from real success and failure rollouts, can condition on task-description features from the frozen SmolVLA language pathway, and is used only through action gradients during sampling. We evaluate the approach on LIBERO manipulation tasks. A single-task critic improves success from 68.0% to 82.0% on one seed window and from 82.0% to 86.0% on another. A multi-family task-description critic improves validation success from 46.0% to 56.0%, while the locked held-out test gain is positive but modest, from 65.0% to 67.5%. These results support the feasibility of Q-guided inference for frozen flow-matching VLA policies, while showing that critic generalization and uncertainty-aware guidance remain the central bottlenecks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Guided Action Flow，一个针对流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的推理时引导框架。该方法冻结预训练的 SmolVLA 策略，使用从真实成功/失败轨迹中学习的动作块批评者（critic）来引导反向流采样器。在 LIBERO 操作任务上，单任务批评者将成功率从 68.0% 提升至 82.0%，多任务批评者将验证成功率从 46.0% 提升至 56.0%，但测试集提升有限（65.0% 至 67.5%）。结果表明 Q 引导推理对冻结的流匹配 VLA 策略可行，但批评者泛化与不确定感知引导仍是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 流匹配 VLA 策略通过迭代传输过程生成机器人动作块，这为测试时引导提供了机会而无需重新训练基础策略。现有方法缺乏在推理时利用外部引导信号有效改进动作生成的手段。
Method: 提出 Guided Action Flow 框架，保持预训练 SmolVLA 策略冻结，学习一个动作块批评者，该批评者利用冻结策略的语言路径的任务描述特征，通过动作梯度在反向流采样期间引导生成。
Result: 在 LIBERO 任务上，单任务批评者将成功率从 68.0% 提升至 82.0%（一个种子窗口）和从 82.0% 提升至 86.0%（另一窗口）。多任务批评者将验证成功率从 46.0% 提升至 56.0%，但锁定保留测试集提升仅为从 65.0% 到 67.5%。
Conclusion: 支持 Q 引导推理用于冻结的流匹配 VLA 策略的可行性，但指出批评者泛化和不确定感知引导仍是核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Hierarchical Anti-Aesthetics: Protecting Facial Privacy against Customized Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The rise of customized diffusion models has fueled a boom in personalized visual content creation, but it also introduces serious risks of malicious misuse, thereby posing threats to personal privacy. Image aesthetics are strongly correlated with human perception of image quality. Motivated by this observation, we address facial privacy protection from a novel aesthetic perspective by degrading the generation quality of maliciously customized models, thus reducing facial identity leakage. Specifically, we propose a Hierarchical Anti-Aesthetics (HAA) framework that exploits aesthetic cues at multiple perceptual levels. HAA consists of two key branches: (1) Global Anti-Aesthetics, which degrades overall aesthetics and generation quality by constructing a global anti-aesthetic reward mechanism and a corresponding loss; and (2) Local Anti-Aesthetics, which disrupts facial identity by using a local anti-aesthetic reward mechanism and loss to guide adversarial perturbations toward facial regions. By integrating both branches, HAA achieves anti-aesthetic degradation from a global to a local level during customized generation. Extensive experiments show that HAA outperforms existing methods in identity removal, providing an effective tool for protecting facial privacy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对定制化扩散模型带来的面部隐私泄露风险，提出一种分级反美学（Hierarchical Anti-Aesthetics, HAA）框架。该框架从全局和局部两个感知层面利用美学线索，通过反美学奖励机制和损失函数降低恶意定制模型的生成质量，从而实现面部身份移除。实验结果显示HAA在身份去除任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 定制化扩散模型在促进个性化内容创作的同时，也带来了恶意滥用和隐私泄露的严重风险。现有方法忽略了图像美学与人类感知质量之间的强相关性，本文从美学角度出发，试图通过降低生成质量来保护面部隐私。
Method: HAA框架包含两个分支：全局反美学分支通过构建全局反美学奖励机制和损失函数，降低整体美学质量与生成质量；局部反美学分支则通过局部反美学奖励机制和损失函数，引导对抗扰动集中破坏面部区域的身份信息。两者结合实现从全局到局部的反美学退化。
Result: 大量实验表明，HAA在身份移除效果上优于现有方法，为面部隐私保护提供了一种有效工具。
Conclusion: 从美学角度进行反美学退化是保护面部隐私的有效途径，但摘要未提及方法的局限性或泛化性。

summary_sections.method: HAA框架包含两个分支：全局反美学分支通过构建全局反美学奖励机制和损失函数，降低整体美学质量与生成质量；局部反美学分支则通过局部反美学奖励机制和损失函数，引导对抗扰动集中破坏面部区域的身份信息。两者结合实现从全局到局部的反美学退化。
summary_sections.result: 大量实验表明，HAA在身份移除效果上优于现有方法，为面部隐私保护提供了一种有效工具。
summary_sections.conclusion: 从美学角度进行反美学退化是保护面部隐私的有效途径，但摘要未提及方法的局限性或泛化性。

papers.title: ComplexMimic: Human-Scene Interaction Imitation in Complex 3D Environments
papers.abstract_en: Physics-based Human-Scene Interaction (HSI) imitation learning is crucial for embodied intelligence as it bridges the gap between kinematic 3D motions and real-world dynamics. However, most existing methods focus on simplified scene settings, leaving complex environments largely unexplored, which limits their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we focus on HSI mimicry in complex environments. Under this complex setting, we observe an inherent trade-off between successfully performing interaction and maintaining natural, physically plausible motions. To address this challenge, we propose ComplexMimic, a framework that reconstructs diverse HSI by interpreting imperfect MoCap data. First, we introduce a Dual Flow Strategy, which learns two complementary experts: an imitation expert for accurate motion tracking and an interaction expert for collision-aware adaptation in complex scenes. Second, naive multi-expert distillation, which treats all experts equally, often under-samples challenging behaviors, limiting effective learning. To mitigate this issue, we propose a difficulty-aware distillation strategy that adaptively weights supervision and prioritizes hard-yet-learnable trajectories guided by failure statistics and learning progress signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms current state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ComplexMimic框架，用于复杂3D环境中的人-场景交互(HSI)模仿。该框架通过双流策略（模仿专家和交互专家）解决交互与自然物理运动之间的权衡，并采用难度感知蒸馏策略优先处理困难轨迹。在三个基准数据集上，ComplexMimic超越现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有HSI模仿方法多聚焦于简化场景，难以应对复杂环境中的交互与物理合理性之间的固有矛盾。
Method: 提出ComplexMimic，包含双流策略学习两个互补专家（模仿专家和交互专家），以及难度感知蒸馏策略，基于失败统计和学习进度自适应加权监督。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上，ComplexMimic在HSI模仿任务上优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 所提框架能够有效应对复杂环境中的HSI模仿挑战，通过难度感知蒸馏提升学习效率。

papers.title: DL-SLAM: Enabling High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting SLAM in Dynamic Environments based on Dual-Level Probability
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled significant progress in dense dynamic Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM). Prevailing methods typically discard predefined dynamic objects, ignoring that transiently static objects offer valuable geometric constraints for pose estimation. A recent work attempts to leverage this potential by employing per-pixel uncertainty maps to quantify the magnitude of motion. While this approach enables transiently static objects to enhance pose estimation, it erroneously integrates these objects into the static map, resulting in persistent artifacts. Moreover, its reliance on purely geometric information leads to ambiguous object boundaries in the uncertainty maps. To overcome these limitations, we present DL-SLAM, a monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM system built upon a novel dual-level probabilistic framework. Our method computes dynamic probability maps by combining semantic and geometric information. These pixel-level probabilities are lifted to 3D and aggregated to derive an object-level dynamic probability for each instance. Object-level probability enables the categorical pruning of dynamic Gaussians, resulting in an artifact-free static map. The static map, in turn, provides a geometrically consistent guidance to refine the pixel-wise probabilities, enhancing their reliability. Experimental results demonstrate that DL-SLAM outperforms existing approaches, improving tracking accuracy by up to 13\% while generating high-fidelity semantic maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DL-SLAM 提出一种基于双层级概率框架的单目高斯泼溅 SLAM 系统，结合语义和几何信息计算像素级动态概率，并提升至物体级以剪除动态高斯体，生成无伪影的静态地图。实验表明，该方法的跟踪精度最高提升 13%，并生成高保真语义地图。
Motivation: 现有动态环境 SLAM 方法要么直接丢弃预定义动态物体，忽略了瞬态静态物体对位姿估计的几何约束；要么利用逐像素不确定性图，但将瞬态静态物体错误地集成到静态地图中导致持续伪影，且仅依赖几何信息造成边界模糊。
Method: 构建双层级概率框架：首先融合语义和几何信息计算像素级动态概率图；然后将像素级概率提升至 3D 并聚合得到每个实例的物体级动态概率；利用物体级概率对动态高斯体进行类别剪除，得到无伪影的静态地图；静态地图反过来提供几何一致指导以细化像素级概率。
Result: 在跟踪精度上最高提升 13%，同时生成高保真语义地图，在动态环境下优于现有方法。
Conclusion: DL-SLAM 通过双层级概率设计有效分离动态与静态元素，提高了动态场景下 SLAM 的鲁棒性和地图质量。
