papers.title: AI Virtue: What is "Good" Knowledge in the Age of Artificial Intelligence?
papers.abstract_en: In the age of AI, what will be good knowledge? This article, which is accepted and forthcoming in a special issue of Modern Fiction Studies on "Cultural AI" in 2027, applies digital humanities methods to map epistemic virtues (like "true," "accurate," "creative") used in a corpus of 553 journal articles on AI published in 2024. "Creativity" comes in for special attention as an example. Exploring this discourse of value, the article considers how a framework might be developed for evaluating the knowledge-worth of AI -- one less locked into values formed around pre-AI "knowledge work" agents or structures, and more open to the future values of "generativity." The essay is supported by an online digital kit for exploring data models of the corpus of articles on AI it studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文应用数字人文方法，分析了2024年发表的553篇AI期刊论文中使用的认知美德（如“真实”、“准确”、“创造性”），特别关注“创造力”作为一个案例。文章探讨如何为评估AI的知识价值建立框架，该框架应较少受限于前AI时代“知识工作”代理或结构所形成的价值观，而更开放于未来“生成性”的价值。文章附有在线数字工具包，用于探索所研究AI文章语料的数据模型。
Motivation: 在AI时代，需要重新定义什么是“好知识”。现有的知识价值评估框架往往基于前AI时代的“知识工作”主体或结构，不适应AI带来的生成性特征。
Method: 采用数字人文方法，对553篇2024年发表的AI期刊文章进行语料分析，识别并映射其中使用的认知美德词汇，以“创造力”为重点案例进行深入探讨。
Result: 文章识别了AI话语中常见的认知美德，并指出“创造力”是一个关键但复杂的价值概念，为建立新的AI知识价值评估框架提供基础。
Conclusion: 需要发展一种更开放的、面向未来生成性价值的AI知识价值评估框架，而非固守前AI时代的价值观。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Separating Expert Retention from Autonomous Source Inference in Raw-ECG-Replay-Free Continual ECG Deployment
papers.abstract_en: In multi-source ECG deployment, models may need to incorporate new data sources when earlier raw ECGs cannot be retained or replayed. Freezing a pretrained backbone and assigning each source an isolated classifier prevents parameter interference, but deployment still requires selecting an expert when source metadata are unavailable. We study this distinction through IRFE-ECG, an incremental expert bank built on frozen 1024-dimensional ECGFounder features. Each arriving domain adds a balanced-softmax linear expert, while a lightweight router is fitted only on retained training features and domain labels from sources observed so far. A validation-calibrated margin rule fuses the two most likely experts instead of committing to a single routed expert. On CPSC, PTB-XL, Georgia, and Chapman-Shaoxing, source-aware expert selection reaches $0.7915\pm0.0036$ Macro-F1 and a matched offline independent-head reference reaches $0.7885\pm0.0009$, supporting strong source-aware expert retention. Without source IDs, an MLP router reaches $0.7756\pm0.0027$ and top-2 margin fusion reaches $0.7782\pm0.0022$. The top-2 gain over hard MLP routing is small ($+0.0026$), with a 95\% confidence interval from paired bootstrap that includes zero. Across three domain orders, the top-2-to-oracle gap remains $0.0111$--$0.0133$, identifying autonomous source inference as the main remaining bottleneck. No raw ECGs are replayed, but frozen training features are retained for router updates; the method is therefore not memory-free.Code is available at https://github.com/yufanlu221/IRFE-ECG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IRFE-ECG，一种无需原始ECG回放的增量专家库方法，用于多源ECG部署。冻结预训练ECGFounder特征，为每个域添加平衡softmax线性专家，并通过轻量级路由器进行源推断。在四个公开数据集上，源感知专家选择达到0.7915 Macro-F1，无源ID时MLP路由器为0.7756，top-2融合为0.7782，表明自主源推断是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 多源ECG部署中，模型需要纳入新数据源，但原始ECG无法保留或回放；冻结骨干并分配独立分类器可防止参数干扰，但无源元数据时仍需选择专家。
Method: 冻结1024维ECGFounder特征，每个新域添加平衡softmax线性专家，仅基于保留的训练特征和域标签拟合轻量级MLP路由器；采用验证校准的边界规则融合两个最可能专家。
Result: 在CPSC、PTB-XL、Georgia和Chapman-Shaoxing上，源感知专家选择Macro-F1为0.7915±0.0036，无源ID时MLP路由器为0.7756±0.0027，top-2融合为0.7782±0.0022；top-2相对硬路由提升0.0026，置信区间包含零，三种域顺序下top-2到oracle差距为0.0111-0.0133。
Conclusion: 自主源推断是主要瓶颈，方法并非完全无记忆（保留冻结训练特征用于路由器更新）。

papers.title: Hawk: Harnessing Hardware-Aware Knowledge for High-Performance NPU Kernel Generation
papers.abstract_en: Developing high-performance kernels for Neural Processing Units (NPUs) is a critical industry bottleneck, requiring developers to manually navigate implicit hardware constraints and strict memory hierarchies. While large language models offer immense automation potential, they fail catastrophically on NPUs due to a fundamental lack of hardware-specific priors. Naively transplanting code snippets from similar NPU kernels may pass the compiler, but it consistently triggers runtime crashes and performance degradation by blindly violating underlying hardware constraints. To overcome this, we introduce Hawk, a training-free framework that harnesses hardware-aware knowledge through three core modules: (1) Run-Time Knowledge Synthesis Module, which employs a Triple-Part Executable Knowledge Representation to inherently couple the error context with executable semantics; (2) Bottleneck-Aware Knowledge Retrieval Module, which implements a 2D-Retrieval paradigm to project queries into orthogonal syntactic and hardware-aligned semantic spaces; and (3) Effect-Driven Knowledge Distillation Module, which leverages LLM-driven semantic arbitration to continuously distill the knowledge by pruning errors and consolidating redundancies based on the empirical execution feedback. Extensive evaluations on real-world NPU workloads demonstrate that Hawk elevates generation accuracy from 49.4% to 80.0%, while achieving up to a 2.2x execution speedup over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hawk框架，通过三个硬件感知模块（运行时知识合成、瓶颈感知检索、效果驱动蒸馏）提升NPU内核生成准确率和执行速度。在真实NPU负载上，生成准确率从49.4%提升至80.0%，执行速度比基线快2.2倍。
Motivation: NPU开发依赖手动处理硬件约束和内存层次，现有LLM缺乏硬件先验知识，导致生成的NPU内核常出现运行时崩溃和性能下降。
Method: Hawk包含三个模块：运行时知识合成模块使用三部分可执行知识表示耦合错误上下文与执行语义；瓶颈感知检索模块采用2D检索范式将查询映射到语法和硬件对齐语义空间；效果驱动蒸馏模块利用LLM语义仲裁，基于执行反馈剪枝错误并合并冗余知识。
Result: 在真实NPU负载上，生成准确率从49.4%提升至80.0%，执行速度比现有最优基线快2.2倍。
Conclusion: Hawk通过硬件感知知识集成，有效解决了LLM在NPU内核生成中的硬件约束违反问题。

papers.title: DiPS: Dialogue Policy Selection for High-Stakes Persuasion Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with persuasion in high-stakes scenarios. People's individual personalities and concerns require tailored strategies rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. To address this challenge, we focus on a fire-rescue scenario in which an operator must persuade a resident to evacuate as a high-stakes persuasion domain and propose Dialogue Policy Selection (DiPS), a Q-learning framework to dynamically select persuasion strategies adapted to the evolving conversational context. Specifically, we train a critic, trained to maximize the chance of evacuation success, to select a persuasion policy at each turn based on the resident's recent utterances. We then evaluate DiPS against multiple baselines in both simulated and real human interactions. We find that DiPS achieves higher evacuation success than a zero-shot LLM and generic RAG-augmented approach.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 27th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue (SIGDIAL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高风险场景中的说服任务，提出DiPS（Dialogue Policy Selection）框架，使用Q-learning动态选择说服策略。以火灾疏散场景为例，训练critic根据居民最近话语选择策略，在模拟和真实人机交互中，DiPS比零样本LLM和通用RAG方法获得更高的疏散成功率。
Motivation: 高风险说服场景（如火灾疏散）中，人们需要个性化策略，而现有LLM采用一刀切方法效果不佳。
Method: 提出DiPS框架，基于Q-learning训练一个critic，在每个对话轮次根据居民最新表述选择最合适的说服策略，以最大化疏散成功概率。
Result: 在模拟和真实人类交互实验中，DiPS在疏散成功率上优于零样本LLM和通用RAG增强方法。
Conclusion: 摘要未给出明确结论，但表明DiPS能有效提升高风险场景中的说服效果。

papers.title: A Cost-Aware, Paired Protocol for Auditing Dynamic Tool Synthesis in Agentic Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Agentic Video Question Answering (VideoQA) systems invoke tools during inference, but their tool libraries are fixed, so recurring procedures are rebuilt from primitives on every question. Synthesizing composite tools could remove this overhead, but whether such expansion helps is hard to assess: final-answer accuracy, the standard metric, ignores inference effort, so it cannot reveal how a system shifts cost. We propose a cost-aware, paired protocol for auditing tool-augmented video agents. The protocol pairs two complete systems on the same input for each question and reports their net difference across accuracy and cost jointly. For each question, it sorts the paired outcome into one of six groups defined by joint correctness and by the change in visible tool calls, separating accuracy-preserving efficiency gains from harmful regressions. Significance is reported with McNemar's test and paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We instantiate the protocol on Dynamic-SAGE, an agentic VideoQA framework that synthesizes, validates, and persistently registers executable composite tools for reuse on unseen questions, and evaluate it against the SAGE baseline on SAGE-Bench. The audit reveals a multi-axis profile that a scalar accuracy comparison would miss: Dynamic-SAGE improves accuracy by 7.5 points (p < 0.001) and reduces reasoning turns and visible tool calls by roughly 28%, while shifting rather than reducing inference cost, as token usage rises 34% and cost 26%. Gains are largest on visual and open-ended questions and neutral on verbal and multimodal ones, and residual failures concentrate on hard, open-ended questions where the pipeline does the most work. By measuring accuracy and cost jointly, the protocol shows where the pipeline-level difference is reliable and where it is not. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/Dynamic-SAGE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Agentic VideoQA系统中固定工具库导致重复构建的问题，提出一种成本感知的配对审计协议，联合评估准确性和推理成本。在Dynamic-SAGE框架上的实例化表明，该协议能揭示精度提升与成本变化之间的权衡：Dynamic-SAGE相比基线准确率提升7.5个点，推理轮次和工具调用减少约28%，但token使用增加34%，成本增加26%。
Motivation: 现有Agentic VideoQA系统使用固定工具库，每次查询重复构建原语，效率低下；合成复合工具有潜力但难以评估，因为标准最终答案准确性忽略了推理成本，无法反映系统的成本变化。
Method: 提出成本感知的配对协议：将两个完整系统配对到相同输入，按正确性和工具调用变化将结果分为六组，使用McNemar检验和配对bootstrap置信区间报告显著性。在Dynamic-SAGE框架上实例化，该框架合成、验证并持久注册可重用复合工具。
Result: 审计显示Dynamic-SAGE在SAGE-Bench上准确率提升7.5点（p<0.001），推理轮次和可见工具调用减少约28%，但token使用增加34%，成本增加26%；增益集中在视觉和开放性问题，失败集中在困难开放性问题。
Conclusion: 协议通过联合测量准确性和成本，揭示了管道级差异可靠和不可靠的情况，为审计工具增强代理提供了更全面的方法。

papers.title: Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics Enable Complete and Scalable $\mathrm{E}(3)$-Equivariant Networks
papers.abstract_en: $\mathrm{E}(3)$-equivariant networks are promising for 3D atomistic system modeling, yet their scalability is limited by the $O(L^6)$ complexity of the Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Product (CGTP). The recently proposed Gaunt Tensor Product (GTP) reduces the complexity but is unable to capture the antisymmetric paths, resulting in incomplete expressivity. In this work, we present SpinGTP, an approach to overcome the GTP incompleteness by generalizing from scalar functions to Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics (SWSH). By relying on the algebraic properties of SWSH, SpinGTP recovers the missing antisymmetric interactions while maintaining the asymptotic efficiency of GTP. It also allows for a more expressive equivariant basis that naturally accounts for the parity-odd components of tensor products. We evaluate SpinGTP across diverse benchmarks, including Tetris, 3BPA, SPICE-MACE-OFF, and OC20. Our results show that SpinGTP achieves accuracies comparable to full CGTP. Notably, by explicitly capturing antisymmetric paths, SpinGTP exhibits superior performance in tasks involving chiral materials and non-centrosymmetric geometries. This work provides a complete, scalable, and mathematically rigorous path toward high-order equivariance in large-scale 3D atomistic system simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpinGTP，通过将Gaunt张量积推广到自旋权重球谐函数（SWSH），解决了E(3)-等变网络中Clebsch-Gordan张量积（CGTP）的O(L^6)复杂度以及Gaunt张量积（GTP）表达不完全的问题。该方法在保持GTP渐进效率的同时，恢复缺失的反对称相互作用，并自然包含奇偶性分量。在Tetris、3BPA、SPICE-MACE-OFF和OC20等基准上，SpinGTP达到与完整CGTP相当的精度，并在手性材料和非中心对称几何任务中表现更优。
Motivation: E(3)-等变网络在3D原子系统建模中具有前景，但现有CGTP复杂度为O(L^6)，限制了可扩展性；而GTP虽降低复杂度，却无法捕获反对称路径，导致表达不完全。
Method: 将Gaunt张量积从标量函数推广到自旋权重球谐函数（SWSH），利用SWSH的代数性质恢复反对称相互作用，并构建更丰富的等变基，包含奇偶性分量。
Result: 在Tetris、3BPA、SPICE-MACE-OFF和OC20基准上，SpinGTP达到与完整CGTP相当的精度；在手性材料和非中心对称几何任务中，由于显式捕获反对称路径，性能更优。
Conclusion: 该工作为大规模3D原子系统模拟中的高阶等变性提供了一条完整、可扩展且数学严谨的路径。

papers.title: AnchorSplat: Fast and Structure Consistent Detail Synthesis for Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful representation for high-fidelity rendering. However, existing assets often suffer from quality bottlenecks such as missing details and texture noise. Prior attempts to enhance these assets via 2D image processing introduce multi-view inconsistencies and high computational costs. In this paper, we propose a novel 3D-native refinement paradigm named AnchorSplat. AnchorSplat is an end-to-end deep network operating directly on 3D structures, avoiding the expensive optimization overhead of traditional 3D-2D-3D pipelines. Crucially, AnchorSplat is a strictly source-free solution requiring no original multi-view images. Central to the proposed method is the Point Anchor Mechanism, which enforces geometric consistency via local offset constraints, mitigating ill-posed mapping and gradient confounding. Furthermore, AnchorSplat replaces iterative densification with a single-pass multiplication mechanism. To facilitate research, we construct 3DGS-SR, the first large-scale benchmark for this task. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results on the 3DGS-SR dataset, with throughput up to $10^5$ times faster than optimization methods. Notably, AnchorSplat exhibits robust zero-shot generalization across diverse data distributions, including generative model outputs and real-world scans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnchorSplat，一种面向 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 资产的细节合成端到端深度网络。该方法直接操作 3D 结构，无需原始多视图图像，通过点锚机制 (Point Anchor Mechanism) 保持几何一致性，并以单次乘性机制替代迭代密集化。在构建的 3DGS-SR 基准上取得最优结果，速度比优化方法快十万倍，并展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 资产常存在细节缺失和纹理噪声，而通过 2D 图像处理增强的方法会导致多视图不一致和高计算开销。本文旨在提出一种 3D 原生的高效细化范式来克服这些问题。
Method: AnchorSplat 是一个端到端深度网络，核心是点锚机制 (Point Anchor Mechanism)，通过局部偏移约束强制几何一致性并缓解不适定映射和梯度混淆；同时用单次乘性机制替代传统迭代密集化过程。该方法是严格的无源方案，不需要原始多视图图像。
Result: 在自建的 3DGS-SR 基准上达到最先进效果，处理速度比优化方法快约十万倍，并在生成模型输出和真实扫描等多样数据分布上展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: AnchorSplat 提供了一种快速、结构一致的 3DGS 资产细节合成方案，消除了对原始多视图图像的依赖，有望作为通用 3D 增强工具。

papers.title: Generative Model Proposal based Particle Filtering for Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation models state dynamics conditioned on sequential observations, and has wide-ranging scientific applications. In the filtering setting, the goal is to model the posterior over the current state given all observations so far. Classical solutions typically make simplifying distributional or functional assumptions, e.g., linear-Gaussian systems, which can be inaccurate in many scenarios. In principle, particle filters (PFs) remove these assumptions, yet often collapse in high dimensions. Recent generative approaches learn conditional state transitions, but without principled Bayesian updates they do not recover the correct filtering posterior and can accumulate error over long horizons. In this work, we introduce Flow Proposal Particle Filters (FPPF), which learn a conditional generative model based proposal approximating the variance-minimizing optimal proposal for particle propagation. Conditioning on observations steers particles toward high-likelihood regions before weighting, reducing weight variance and delaying degeneracy. Since our proposal admits tractable likelihood evaluation, FPPF computes accurate importance weights and retains a Bayesian update step. We further extend FPPF to high-dimensional problems through localization strategies, adressing another standard PF failure mode. Extensive experiments on a variety of dynamical systems show that FPPF outperforms statistical baselines and other generative methods in non-linear, non-Gaussian, and high-dimensional regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出流提议粒子滤波器（FPPF），通过学习条件生成模型作为提议分布，逼近方差最小化的最优提议，用于数据同化中的粒子传播。FPPF通过观测引导粒子到高似然区域，降低权重方差并延缓退化，同时保持可处理的似然评估和贝叶斯更新。通过局部化策略扩展到高维问题，在非线性、非高斯和高维动力系统实验中优于统计基线和生成方法。
Motivation: 经典粒子滤波器在高维中易退化，生成方法缺乏原则性贝叶斯更新导致误差累积。现有方法未能在非线性、非高斯和高维场景中准确恢复滤波后验。
Method: 引入流提议粒子滤波器（FPPF），学习条件生成模型作为提议分布，近似最优提议；同时保留可处理的似然评估以计算重要性权重，并采用局部化策略处理高维问题。
Result: 在多种动力系统上，FPPF在非线性、非高斯和高维场景中优于统计基线和生成方法。
Conclusion: FPPF通过生成式提议结合贝叶斯更新，有效改善高维粒子滤波的退化问题，适用于数据同化。
Relevance: 92

papers.title: Learning Cardiac Motion Priors for Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are well suited to cardiac motion estimation, providing continuous, compact representations of motion fields. However, fitting an INR to each image sequence is time-consuming and sensitive to the optimisation trajectory. Learned priors can help guide optimisation towards plausible motion fields and enable faster adaptation, but learning priors for cardiac motion INRs remains under-explored. In this work, we compare four strategies for learning cardiac motion priors, including a population prior learned by joint optimisation, a consensus prior obtained by weight averaging, auto-decoders, and meta-learning. Using short-axis tagged cardiac magnetic resonance images from the UK Biobank, we evaluate their impact on tracking accuracy, motion behaviour, and adaptation trajectory. All learned priors substantially improved early adaptation performance compared with random initialisation. While the simple consensus prior was effective, auto-decoders recovered large deformations faster during early adaptation. Meta-learning achieved strong early performance and maintained the best adaptation trajectory over 50 iterations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究隐式神经表示（INR）在心脏运动估计中的先验学习方法。比较了四种策略：联合优化的群体先验、权重平均的共识先验、自动解码器和元学习。使用UK Biobank的短轴标记心脏磁共振图像进行评估。所有先验都比随机初始化提升早期适应性能；自动解码器在早期适应中更快恢复大变形；元学习在50次迭代中保持最佳适应轨迹。
Motivation: 将INR拟合到每个图像序列耗时且对优化轨迹敏感。学习先验可以引导优化向合理运动场发展并加速适应，但心脏运动INR的先验学习尚未充分探索。
Method: 比较四种先验学习策略：群体先验（联合优化）、共识先验（权重平均）、自动解码器和元学习。在UK Biobank短轴标记心脏MRI上评估跟踪精度、运动行为和适应轨迹。
Result: 所有学习的先验相比随机初始化显著提高早期适应性能；自动解码器在早期适应中更快恢复大变形；元学习在50次迭代中保持最佳适应轨迹。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了学习先验对于INR在心脏运动估计中的重要性，并指出不同先验策略各有优势。

papers.title: Post-Training Pruning for Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated impressive performance in image generation but suffer from substantial computational overhead and resource consumption. Post-training pruning offers a promising solution; however, due to DiTs' unique architectural design and parameter distribution, traditional pruning methods are inapplicable, leading to significant performance degradation. Specifically, prior methods developed for LLMs, which derive metrics through a series of approximations, amplify the relative contribution of weights in the saliency metric. In addition, weights in DiTs exhibit significantly larger magnitudes than those in LLMs. Moreover, existing pruning granularity overlooks variations in model structures. In this paper, we propose DiT-Pruning, which improves pruning performance by introducing customized saliency criteria and pruning granularity. We design a novel metric that balances the contributions of weights and activations from an energy-based perspective, enabling more effective identification of important elements. Furthermore, we observe distinct clustering patterns in the two-dimensional weight space. Accordingly, we adopt a clustering-aware pruning granularity, enabling effective sparse allocation. Extensive evaluations on various DiTs show that our method consistently preserves image quality, especially under high sparsity. For FLUX.1-dev at 512x512 resolution on MJHQ, DiT-Pruning achieves only a 0.001 loss in CLIP score at 50% sparsity, dramatically outperforming recent pruning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散变换器（DiTs）在图像生成中计算开销大的问题，提出了一种后训练剪枝方法DiT-Pruning。该方法从能量角度设计新的显著性度量，平衡权重和激活的贡献，并利用二维权重空间的聚类模式采用聚类感知的剪枝粒度，实现高效稀疏分配。实验表明，在50%稀疏度下，DiT-Pruning在FLUX.1-dev模型上的CLIP分数损失仅为0.001，显著优于现有剪枝方法。
Motivation: 扩散变换器（DiTs）在图像生成中表现出色但计算成本高，后训练剪枝虽有前景，但因DiTs独特架构和参数分布，传统剪枝方法（如为LLMs设计的）不适用，会导致性能显著下降。现有方法通过近似推导度量，放大了权重在显著性度量中的相对贡献，且DiTs的权重幅度远大于LLMs，同时现有剪枝粒度忽略了模型结构差异。
Method: 提出DiT-Pruning，包含两种技术：1）从能量角度设计新的显著性度量，平衡权重和激活的贡献，更有效识别重要元素；2）观察二维权重空间中的聚类模式，采用聚类感知的剪枝粒度，实现有效的稀疏分配。
Result: 在多种DiTs上的广泛评估表明，该方法能一致保持图像质量，尤其在高稀疏度下。在MJHQ数据集上以512×512分辨率对FLUX.1-dev剪枝，50%稀疏度下CLIP分数损失仅为0.001，大幅优于近期剪枝方法。
Conclusion: DiT-Pruning通过定制化的显著性准则和剪枝粒度，有效改善了扩散变换器的后训练剪枝性能，在高稀疏度下仍能保持图像质量。

papers.title: AI Native Games: A Survey and Roadmap
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI now enables games to produce dialogue, quests, characters, images, and worlds at runtime. Yet generation alone does not make a game AI-native, nor does it guarantee playability. This paper defines AI-native games by whether runtime generative AI is constitutive of the core loop: if the AI component were removed or trivially replaced, the central form of play would collapse or become fundamentally different. This counterfactual criterion separates AI-native games from AI-augmented games and adjacent boundary artifacts. Using this definition, we screen candidate artifacts and analyze 53 publicly available AI-native games and prototypes. We introduce a dual-axis G/N taxonomy: the G-axis captures player-facing game type, while the N-axis captures the dominant AI mechanic that makes generative AI indispensable to play. The corpus is concentrated around language-forward designs, especially narrative adventure, epistemic interaction, and generative narrative, while categories such as semantic adjudication, multi-agent simulation, generative construction, and relationship/companion play remain less represented. We argue that the central design problem is organizing semantic openness into stable gameplay. AI-native design depends on mechanical invariants: goals, rules, state, feedback, pacing, and player agency that make open-ended AI outputs interpretable and consequential. We conclude with a roadmap for controllable generation, AI-as-mechanic design, multimodal and multi-agent systems, inference economics, evaluation, safety, and regulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义了AI原生游戏的标准：运行时生成式AI构成核心玩法循环，移除AI会导致玩法崩溃或根本改变。通过此标准筛选了53个公开的AI原生游戏和原型，提出了G/N双轴分类法：G轴表示面向玩家的游戏类型，N轴表示使生成式AI不可或缺的主导AI机制。发现当前作品集中在语言驱动设计，而语义裁决、多智能体模拟等类别较少。认为核心设计问题是将语义开放性组织成稳定玩法，依赖于目标、规则、状态等机械不变量。最后给出了可控生成、AI即机制设计、多模态多智能体系统等方面的路线图。
Motivation: 现有游戏仅使用生成式AI但未必是AI原生，缺乏明确定义和系统分类，难以指导未来设计。
Method: 提出反事实准则定义AI原生游戏，构建G/N双轴分类法，对53个候选作品进行筛选和分析。
Result: 发现当前AI原生游戏主要集中在语言前向设计，如叙事冒险、认知交互和生成叙事，而语义裁决、多智能体模拟、生成构建等类别较少。
Conclusion: AI原生游戏的核心设计挑战是组织语义开放性成为稳定玩法，依赖机械不变量；未来路线图包括可控生成、AI即机制、多模态系统等。

papers.title: CoLT: Teaching Multi-Modal Models to Think with Chain of Latent Thoughts
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has enabled multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) to tackle complex visual reasoning tasks by generating explicit intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. However, this text-based reasoning paradigm is inherently slow at inference time with even thousands of tokens and fundamentally constrained by the expressiveness of natural language. In this paper, we propose CoLT, (Chain of Latent Thoughts), a novel framework that teaches multi-modal models to reason through a chain of latent thought representations instead of verbose text tokens, which can perform thinking with as few as 3 steps. Naively forcing the model to think with latent states easily produces meaningless semantics and makes training unstable. To effectively regulate the latent reasoning process, we introduce a lightweight external decoder that provides step-level supervision for each latent reasoning step in two complementary directions: a forward mode that decodes latent thoughts into the textual reasoning of the next step, and a backward mode that aligns decoder hidden states with the model's latent thoughts given preceding textual context. We further incorporate internal supervision that encourages coherent step-by-step latent transitions. The decoder and internal supervision are removed during inference to maintain high efficiency of latent reasoning. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that CoLT not only outperforms existing latent reasoning methods such as CODI and SIM-CoT, but also surpasses latent visual reasoning approaches that rely on auxiliary images with costly annotation requirements. Compared to text CoT methods, CoLT can notably reduce the inference time by 10.1$\times$ and text decoding time by 22.6$\times$. Code is released at https://github.com/hulianyuyy/CoLT.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV2026. Code is available at https://github.com/hulianyuyy/CoLT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoLT（Chain of Latent Thoughts），一种让多模态大模型通过潜在思维链进行推理的框架，仅用少量潜在步骤（如3步）即可完成复杂视觉推理，而无需生成大量文本推理步骤。通过引入外部解码器提供前向和后向逐步监督，以及内部监督来稳定潜在推理过程。在8个基准上，CoLT超越了现有潜在推理方法，同时推理时间比文本CoT降低10.1倍。
Motivation: 传统文本链式思维推理（CoT）虽能提升复杂视觉推理，但生成大量文本导致推理速度慢，且自然语言表达能力有限。现有潜在推理方法容易产生无意义语义且训练不稳定。
Method: 提出CoLT框架，使用外部解码器对每个潜在推理步骤提供前向（解码为下一步文本推理）和后向（对齐解码器隐状态与潜在思维）监督，并加入内部监督促进连贯的潜在过渡。推理时移除这些监督以保持高效。
Result: 在8个基准上，CoLT优于CODI、SIM-CoT等潜在推理方法，也优于依赖昂贵辅助图像的潜在视觉推理方法。与文本CoT相比，推理时间减少10.1倍，文本解码时间减少22.6倍。
Conclusion: CoLT通过潜在思维链实现了高效且稳定的多模态推理，显著降低推理延迟，同时保持或超越现有方法性能。

papers.title: GR2 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Industrial recommendation systems serve billions of users through a multi-stage funnel -- retrieval, early-stage ranking, and re-ranking -- where the final re-ranking step disproportionately shapes user engagement and downstream performance, particularly for carousel and grid display formats. Despite growing enthusiasm for Large Language Models (LLMs) in recommendation, three gaps hinder industrial adoption: (1) most efforts target retrieval and ranking, leaving re-ranking -- the stage closest to the final user experience -- largely underexplored; (2) LLMs are typically deployed zero-shot or via supervised fine-tuning, underutilizing the reasoning capabilities unlocked by reinforcement learning (RL) on verifiable rewards; (3) deployed catalogs index billions of items with non-semantic identifiers that lie outside any base-LLM vocabulary. We present GR2 (Generative Reasoning Re-Ranker), an end-to-end framework that combines (i) mid-training on semantic IDs produced by a tokenizer with >=99% uniqueness, (ii) reasoning-trace distilled from a stronger teacher via targeted prompting and rejection sampling, and (iii) RL with verifiable rewards purpose-built for re-ranking. To make GR2 resource-viable, we further (iv) introduce a context compressor that amortizes training cost, On-Policy Distillation (OPD) as a scalable alternative to SFT -- which we find collapses at industrial scale -- and reasoning distillation for low-latency serving. GR2 delivers +18.7% R@1, +7.1% R@3, and +9.6% N@3 over legacy baselines on industrial-scale traffic. We further find that reward design is critical in re-ranking: LLMs often hack rewards by preserving the incoming order or exploiting position bias, motivating conditional verifiable rewards as essential industrial components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GR2（生成式推理重排序器）框架，用于工业推荐系统的重排序阶段。GR2结合语义ID的中间训练、从强教师模型蒸馏推理轨迹、以及专门为重排序设计的可验证奖励的强化学习。同时引入上下文压缩器、在线策略蒸馏（OPD）和推理蒸馏以降低资源消耗。在工业规模流量上，GR2比传统基线提升R@1 18.7%、R@3 7.1%、N@3 9.6%。
Motivation: 工业推荐系统多阶段漏斗中，重排序阶段对用户参与度影响最大，但现有LLM应用主要集中在检索和排序，重排序未被充分探索。此外，LLM通常零样本或SFT部署，未充分利用强化学习的推理能力，且工业物品ID是非语义的，超出LLM词汇表。
Method: 提出GR2框架，包含：(i) 对语义ID（分词器产生≥99%唯一性）进行中间训练；(ii) 通过目标提示和拒绝采样从强教师蒸馏推理轨迹；(iii) 使用可验证奖励的强化学习用于重排序。还引入上下文压缩器摊销训练成本、在线策略蒸馏（OPD）作为SFT的可扩展替代（SFT在工业规模下崩溃）、以及推理蒸馏用于低延迟服务。
Result: 在工业规模流量上，GR2比传统基线提升R@1 18.7%、R@3 7.1%、N@3 9.6%。
Conclusion: 摘要指出奖励设计在重排序中至关重要：LLM常通过保持输入顺序或利用位置偏见来欺骗奖励，因此需要条件可验证奖励作为工业组件。

papers.title: Modeling Cell-Cycle-Aware Single-Cell Drug Perturbation Responses
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell drug perturbation models should capture transcriptional response magnitude and whether a treatment changes the proliferative state of the cell. This is difficult because cell-cycle variation is often treated as a nuisance factor, and benchmark processing rarely makes drug-induced phase changes a primary prediction target. We introduce scCycleMol, a cell-cycle-aware perturbation prediction framework built on a curated 24-hour SciPlex3 benchmark with standardized molecule identities, dose and cell-line metadata, modeled genes, and expression-derived cell-cycle supervision. scCycleMol derives cell-cycle supervision from the treated state and applies it to predicted treated expression without using phase as an input covariate. The model includes a learnable full-expression cell-cycle head with circular G1/S/G2M targets, and we evaluate readout-only supervision (with stop-gradient) versus closed-loop supervision (backpropagating through decoder, dose-response module, and drug representation). We also compare molecular representations and pretraining sources to isolate the effect of the cell-cycle objective. On a processed 24-hour SciPlex3 benchmark (635,541 cells, 186 perturbations, 188 compound embeddings, 3 cell lines, 4 doses plus DMSO, 5,080 genes), the best LINCS-pretrained circular variant reaches 0.9093 mean all-gene R-squared and 0.6843 mean DE-gene R-squared. Under matched preprocessing, closed-loop cell-cycle supervision improves phase accuracy by 0.54-0.62 points while keeping mean all-gene R-squared within 0.003 of matched chemCPA no-cell-cycle models; Tahoe-pretrained readout-only circular supervision achieves the strongest phase accuracy at 0.9609.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 在635,541个细胞、186种扰动等基准上，最佳LINCS预训练circular变体达到全基因R^2=0.9093，差异表达基因R^2=0.6843。闭环细胞周期监督将相位精度提高0.54-0.62点，同时全基因R^2变化在0.003以内。Tahoe预训练只读circular监督达到0.9609的相位精度。
Conclusion: 将细胞周期监督整合到药物扰动预测中可以提升相位预测精度，而对基因表达预测没有显著负面影响。

papers.title: TRACE: Temporal Relationship-Aware Conversational Entrainment Detection in Dyadic Speech
papers.abstract_en: With the proliferation of speech AI agents, understanding emotional entrainment in conversational interaction has become increasingly important. Emotional entrainment is shaped by social relationships and conversational context, influencing affective coordination over time. We introduce DyadEE, a dataset for emotional entrainment detection in dyadic speech interactions, containing both emotionally entrained conversations and synthetic interactions where entrainment is disrupted through partner swapping and emotion resynthesis. We further propose TRACE, a window-level framework that models dyadic interaction as ordered sequences of acoustic embeddings derived from emotion fine-tuned Whisper representations, treating each sample as an interaction trace rather than pooled utterances. Experimental results on DyadEE show that incorporating conversational context and relationship information improves emotional entrainment detection, with TRACE achieving the best accuracy of 97.01%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对话语音中的情感牵引（emotional entrainment）检测问题，提出了包含真实与合成对话的DyadEE数据集，以及基于窗口级别的TRACE框架。TRACE将对话建模为情感微调Whisper声学嵌入的有序序列，作为交互轨迹处理。在DyadEE上达到97.01%的最高准确率。
Motivation: 随着语音AI智能体的普及，理解对话交互中的情感牵引变得越来越重要，但缺乏专门的数据集和有效的检测方法。
Method: 构建DyadEE数据集，包含真实情感牵引对话和通过伙伴交换、情感重合成破坏牵引的合成交互；提出TRACE框架，将双人交互建模为来自情感微调Whisper表示的声学嵌入的窗口级别有序序列。
Result: TRACE在DyadEE数据集上取得了97.01%的最佳准确率，表明融入对话上下文和关系信息可提升情感牵引检测性能。
Conclusion: 文章强调上下文和关系信息对情感牵引检测的重要性，所提框架可有效建模对话中的情感协调。

papers.title: SGD Provably Prioritizes a Shortcut Spurious Feature in the XOR Model
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are known to be susceptible to over-reliance on spurious correlations. However, the precise mechanism by which models exploit shortcut features is not fully understood, and algorithms to mitigate this behavior rely on as yet unjustified assumptions about the learned representations. In this work, we provide the first end-to-end theoretical characterization of spurious feature learning for two-layer ReLU neural networks trained by online minibatch SGD on the logistic loss. We consider data drawn from the high-dimensional Boolean hypercube with a quadratic signal function (namely XOR) and a linear spurious correlation. We show that SGD learns the spurious feature first, and exponentially fast. Moreover, the optimization dynamics couple the spurious and signal features, with a stronger spurious component inhibiting signal feature learning. Our analysis reveals precise phase transitions in the learning dynamics. In the first phase, alignment between the signs of the spurious feature and second-layer weight drives rapid growth of the spurious feature. In the second phase, large majority group margin slows learning and the signal feature remains suppressed. When the spurious correlation is maximally strong, we show theoretically that the spurious feature dominates even at the sample complexity threshold where XOR would be learned in isolation (i.e., if the spurious feature was absent). In contrast, when the correlation strength is constant, we provide preliminary empirical evidence that the model can eventually learn the XOR signal, although the spurious feature is not forgotten.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次从理论上刻画了在线小批量SGD训练两层ReLU神经网络时，模型如何优先学习虚假特征（spurious feature）。在高维布尔超立方体数据中，信号为XOR函数，虚假特征为线性相关，SGD以指数速度先学习虚假特征，且虚假特征抑制信号特征的学习。分析揭示了学习动力学的精确相变过程。
Motivation: 神经网络易过度依赖虚假相关性，但精确机制尚不清楚，现有缓解算法依赖于未经证实的表示假设。
Method: 对两层ReLU网络在逻辑损失上采用在线小批量SGD，数据来自高维布尔超立方体，信号为XOR二次函数，虚假特征为线性相关，理论分析学习动力学。
Result: SGD首先以指数速度学习虚假特征；虚假特征与信号特征耦合，强虚假成分抑制信号学习；在虚假相关性最强时，即使在孤立学习XOR的样本复杂度阈值下，虚假特征仍占主导。
Conclusion: 理论揭示了虚假特征优先学习的机制和相变，当相关性强度为常数时，模型最终可能学习到XOR信号，但虚假特征不会被遗忘。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automating the Design of Embodied Agent Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents are typically built as hand-designed compositions of perception, memory, planning, and action modules. This modularity exposes a large architectural design space, but current systems still rely on researcher intuition to choose where information is stored, how observations are processed, and how model calls are connected. Agent Architecture Search (AAS) automates such design for text-domain agents, but has not been systematically evaluated on perceptual embodied agents through simulator rollouts. We study this transfer. We introduce AgentCanvas, a typed-graph runtime that hosts embodied executors as editable node-and-wire programs with simulator-aware execution and episode-level logs, and KDLoop, a coding-agent search procedure that cycles through proposal, critique, experiment, and distillation, with triggered reflection after stalls. We evaluate three AAS variants across four embodied executors spanning vision-language navigation, embodied question answering, and language-conditioned manipulation. The resulting 3x4 matrix shows that architecture-level search can produce deployable and directional success-rate gains on embodied tasks, while one apparent high-scoring candidate is rejected as leak-bearing. At the same time, the experiments expose constraints that are muted in text-domain AAS: optimization signals can be masked by rollout noise, search can become trapped in local edit basins, and episode-level credit assignment only partially emerges even when detailed logs are available. These results characterize both the promise and the current limits of automated architecture search for embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将智能体架构搜索（AAS）从文本域扩展到感知型具身智能体。作者提出 AgentCanvas 运行时和 KDLoop 搜索过程，在四个具身执行器上评估三种 AAS 变体。实验表明架构级搜索可在具身任务上产生可部署的成功率提升，但也暴露了 rollout 噪声掩盖优化信号、搜索陷入局部编辑盆地、逐回合信用分配不完整等限制。
Motivation: 当前具身智能体仍依赖人工设计模块组合，而 AAS 虽在文本域成功，但尚未在感知型具身智能体上通过模拟器 rollout 系统评估。
Method: 提出 AgentCanvas（类型化图运行时，支持节点-线程序编辑和模拟器感知执行）和 KDLoop（编码智能体搜索过程，循环提议、批评、实验和蒸馏，并在停滞时触发反思）。
Result: 在包含视觉语言导航、具身问答、语言条件操作的 3x4 矩阵实验中，架构级搜索产生可部署的成功率提升，但一个高评分候选被拒绝（存在信息泄露）。同时观察到 rollout 噪声、局部编辑盆地等限制。
Conclusion: 自动化架构搜索在具身智能体上既有前景也有当前局限，需进一步处理 rollout 噪声和信用分配问题。

papers.title: GarmentZoom: Generating Zoomable Images from Garment Listings
papers.abstract_en: Online product listings for garments often include an overview photo and a close-up to show garment details. However, each photo focuses on either field of view or garment detail, forcing users to alternate between views and breaking browsing continuity. We present GarmentZoom, a system that enhances the full-view photo to match the fidelity of its accompanying close-up, enabling seamless zoom-and-pan exploration. Unlike standard reference-based super-resolution, our setting involves close-up references that are spatially unaligned with the full view, and scale factors that vary substantially across garments 3-20$\times$. Prior work typically relies on alignment to transfer details or requires per-instance fine-tuning to memorize them. Instead, we train a single model that supports a continuous range of scales across diverse garments. Our approach synthesizes details without requiring spatial alignment and matches the quality of per-instance methods with a fraction of the training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GarmentZoom 系统，用于从服装产品列表的全视图和特写图中生成可缩放图像。该系统在不依赖空间对齐的情况下，通过单模型支持 3-20 倍的连续缩放范围，合成细节并达到与每实例微调方法相当的质量，同时训练成本更低。
Motivation: 在线服装产品列表中，全视图和特写图视角不同，用户需交替查看，破坏浏览连续性。现有基于参考的超分辨率方法需要对齐或每实例微调，难以直接应用。
Method: 训练单一模型，无需空间对齐，支持连续尺度范围的全视图细节增强，实现无缝缩放和平滑探索。
Result: 摘要声称该方法在图像质量上匹配每实例微调方法，且训练成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: GarmentZoom 提供了一种无需对齐、可缩放的服装图像细节合成方案，适用于在线购物场景。

papers.title: Rectifying Mask via Entropy for Distractor-Free 3DGS in Ambiguous Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: We present RefineSplat, a systematic framework that effectively constructs transient masks to identify diverse ambiguous distractors. To do this, we qualitatively and quantitatively analyze issues and propose a novel entropy-aware adaptive masking method. Unlike existing approaches that struggle to distinguish transient elements from static scenes due to color or semantic ambiguity, RefineSplat captures ambiguous distractors leveraging entropy and instance masks. Furthermore, we propose a simple yet effective entropy-aware density control to align Gaussians in ambiguous scenarios considering Entropy-aware positional gradients. Additionally, to rigorously validate our method, we first create and release the Ambiguous wild dataset, including 18 scenes where distractors and static scenes are hard to distinguish due to color or semantic resemblances. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that RefineSplat shows state-of-the-art performance, showing distractor-free novel view synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RefineSplat，一种系统框架用于构建瞬态掩码以识别模糊场景中的干扰物。通过熵感知自适应掩码方法捕捉颜色或语义模糊的干扰物，并引入熵感知密度控制对齐高斯。在多个数据集上实现SOTA，并发布Ambiguous wild数据集。
Motivation: 现有方法由于颜色或语义模糊难以区分瞬态元素与静态场景，导致干扰物未被正确识别。
Method: 提出熵感知自适应掩码方法，结合熵和实例掩码；以及熵感知密度控制，利用熵感知位置梯度对齐高斯。
Result: 在多个数据集上实现SOTA性能，生成无干扰物的新视角合成。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效处理模糊场景中的干扰物，并提供了新的数据集以供进一步研究。

papers.title: Customized Generative AI Agent for Transportation Engineering Practice: A Development and Continued Pre-training Guideline
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in generative artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLMs) have shown significant promise in automating complex reasoning, summarization, and question-answering tasks. However, the effectiveness of general-purpose LLMs in specialized engineering domains remains limited due to insufficient exposure to technical standards, engineering terminology, and domain-specific semantics. This study proposes a systematic approach to developing a customized generative AI agent for transportation engineering applications. A curated corpus of U.S. transportation manuals, design guidelines, and regulatory documents is used to conduct continued pretraining of six state-of-the-art LLMs through a unified low-rank adaptation (LoRA) framework. The training process is monitored to ensure convergence and model stability. Performance is evaluated using standard natural language processing metrics, including BLEU-4 and ROUGE, with Qwen2.5-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B demonstrating the highest domain alignment and response quality. Results validate the effectiveness of LoRA-based adaptation in improving LLM performance on technical content interpretation and context-specific reasoning. This work contributes a reproducible development framework for constructing domain-specialized generative AI agents, supporting broader deployment in transportation research, design, planning, and policy analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出为交通工程应用定制生成式AI智能体的系统方法。使用美国交通手册、设计指南和监管文件构建语料库，对六个最先进的LLM通过统一LoRA框架进行持续预训练。评估使用BLEU-4和ROUGE，Qwen2.5-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B表现最好。验证了LoRA适配在技术内容解释和上下文特定推理上的有效性。
Motivation: 通用LLM在专业工程领域效果有限，因为缺乏技术标准、工程术语和领域特定语义的暴露。
Method: 构建交通工程领域语料库（美国交通手册等），采用LoRA框架对六个LLM进行统一的持续预训练，监控训练收敛和稳定性。
Result: Qwen2.5-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B在域对齐和响应质量上最高，BLEU-4和ROUGE指标验证了LoRA适配的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个可复现的开发框架，用于构建领域专用的生成式AI智能体，支持交通研究、设计、规划和政策分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reward-Free Code Alignment from Pretrained or Fine-Tuned LLM: Unpacking the Trade-offs for Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) alignment trains an LLM using preference data to produce outputs that better meet established quality standards. While LLM alignment techniques are studied for non-coding tasks, we know little about their usefulness for coding tasks. It is unclear whether LLM code alignment could support both functional requirements (producing executable, correct code) and non-functional requirements (code readability, style, maintainability). It is also unknown whether alignment for a code LLM should begin with base pretrained version or the finetuned (i.e., instruction-tuned) version of the LLM. In this paper, we offer insights on the above two research questions by conducting an empirical study. We studied five state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs using two widely used LLM alignment techniques: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and BoNBoN. For each training record, we created a preference pair as accepted and rejected instances by using the SelfCodeAlign pipeline. DPO and BoNBoN are reward-free models, i.e., they eliminate the need for multiple reward scores for output preferences. We tuned each LLM using the two alignment techniques in two settings: pretrained and finetuned versions of an LLM. We evaluated functional requirements using four SOTA benchmarks (HumanEval+, MBPP+, EvalPerf, EvoEval) and non-functional requirements using the CODAL benchmark, which evaluates code quality across five dimensions derived from software engineering practices. We find that pretrained-to-aligned pathways achieve larger improvements in the aligned variant over its pretrained variant. But the pretrained variant is generally less accurate than its finetuned variant. However, finetuned- to-aligned offers smaller performance improvements or, in some cases, degradation in the aligned variant than its finetuned variant.
papers.journal_ref: The ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究探讨了代码生成大语言模型（LLM）的对齐技术，重点分析了从预训练或微调版本开始对齐的效果，以及对齐是否同时支持功能需求（可执行正确代码）和非功能需求（可读性、风格、可维护性）。研究使用了五种最新LLM和两种无奖励对齐方法（DPO和BoNBoN），并在四个功能基准和CODAL非功能基准上评估。结果发现，从预训练版本开始对齐能带来更大改进，但预训练版本本身准确率低于微调版本；而微调后对齐的改进较小甚至出现退化。
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐技术主要针对非编程任务，对编程任务的有效性尚不明确，尤其是不清楚对齐是否能同时支持功能和非功能需求，以及应该从预训练还是微调版本开始对齐。
Method: 采用五种最新LLM，使用两种无奖励对齐方法（DPO和BoNBoN），通过SelfCodeAlign生成偏好对，分别在预训练和微调两种设置下进行对齐，并在四个功能基准（HumanEval+, MBPP+, EvalPerf, EvoEval）和一个非功能基准（CODAL）上评估。
Result: 从预训练版本开始对齐在改进幅度上更大，但预训练版本本身准确率低于微调版本；而从微调版本开始对齐的改进较小，甚至在某些情况下导致性能退化。
Conclusion: 代码LLM的对齐存在权衡：预训练到对齐的路径提升幅度大但起点低，微调到对齐的路径起点高但提升小或退化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multipath Adaptive Gated Bottleneck Latent ODE with Raman Data Fusion for Cell Culture Process Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Mammalian cell-culture processes underpin the manufacture of many biopharmaceuticals, yet keeping a run on track is hard: critical process parameters drift over days, and an off-specification trend is often confirmed too late to intervene. Early-stage, multi-day forecasts could enable timely adjustment of feeding, sampling, and control, but bioprocess forecasting is challenging because measurements are sparse and irregularly sampled, operating conditions are heterogeneous across cell lines and media, and runs with near-identical early behaviour can diverge into different futures. We propose an adaptive framework combining a Gated Bottleneck Latent Ordinary Differential Equation (GB-Latent ODE) with Multi-Path Just-In-Time Fine Tuning (MP-JIT-FT). The GB-Latent ODE augments the stan dard Latent ODE with learnable variable-wise gating and a mask-aware bottleneck that compress high-dimensional sparse inputs, improving learning under limited data. Given a partially observed run, MP-JIT-FT retrieves similar historical trajectories, clusters the local neighbourhood into candidate regimes, and fine-tunes a separate model per regime to produce multiple plausible paths, each with a reconstruction-based confidence score, not a single averaged forecast. We further fuse Raman spectroscopy data: a machine-learning soft sensor turns dense Raman spectra into pseudo-observations that enrich the sparse offline measurements for more robust training. On 38 fed-batch 5L bioreactor runs spanning 14 conditions, MP-JIT-FT with Raman fusion achieves the best average rank and outperforms a global Latent ODE baseline on 8 of 9 target variables. Using local-divergence metrics, we show the multi-path gains are largest when locally similar prefixes diverge, whereas Raman fusion helps most when early dynamics are representative of later behaviour.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对哺乳动物细胞培养过程中测量稀疏、不规则采样且运行条件异质的问题，提出一种自适应框架，结合门控瓶颈潜在常微分方程（GB-Latent ODE）与多路径即时微调（MP-JIT-FT）。该方法通过可学习的变量门控和掩码感知瓶颈压缩高维稀疏输入，并利用历史轨迹聚类生成多条预测路径及置信度评分。融合拉曼光谱数据后，在38批补料培养运行中，MP-JIT-FT在9个目标变量中的8个上优于全局Latent ODE基线。
Motivation: 哺乳动物细胞培养过程的离线测量稀疏且不规则，不同细胞系和培养基下的操作条件异质，早期行为相似的培养可能走向不同未来，导致过程难以提前干预。
Method: 提出GB-Latent ODE增强标准Latent ODE，加入可学习变量门控和掩码感知瓶颈；结合MP-JIT-FT，对部分观测的运行检索相似历史轨迹，聚类局部邻域并微调每个类别的模型，生成多条预测路径及置信度。融合拉曼光谱数据，利用机器学习软传感器将光谱转化为伪观测，丰富训练数据。
Result: 在38批5L生物反应器运行（涵盖14种条件）中，MP-JIT-FT结合拉曼融合在9个目标变量中的8个上取得最佳平均排名，优于全局Latent ODE基线。局部发散指标显示多路径方法在局部相似前缀分叉时增益最大，拉曼融合在早期动力学代表后期行为时帮助最大。
Conclusion: 该自适应框架通过多路径预测和拉曼数据融合有效提升了细胞培养过程早期预测的准确性，但未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TryOnCrafter: Unleashing Camera Trajectories for Realistic Video Virtual Try-on via a Renderable 4D Try-on Proxy
papers.abstract_en: While Video Virtual Try-on (VVT) has achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing realistic garment overlays on dynamic subjects, existing paradigms remains fundamentally constrained by a passive dependency on source camera trajectories, failing to accommodate the requisite interactive freedom for omnidirectional viewpoint exploration. To address this limitation, we define a pioneering research frontier: Camera-controllable Video Virtual Try-on (CaM-VVT). Unlike conventional VVT, CaM-VVT not only necessitates viewpoint-agnostic texture hallucination but also strict structural synchronization between non-rigid human dynamics and background contexts under arbitrary, unconstrained camera movements. To tackle these challenges, we present TryOnCrafter, the first unified DiT-based framework specifically architected for the CaM-VVT task. Departing from implicit pixel-space manipulation, we introduce a Renderable 4D Try-on Proxy that explicitly decouples the human subject from the environment. This is achieved by distilling high-fidelity 2D try-on priors into a clothed 3DGS-based avatar, which is subsequently animated via SMPL-X sequences and metric-aligned into a reconstructed background point cloud. This proxy establishes a robust structural foundation with superior texture density and motion integrity. Our Proxy-Anchored Video DiT leverages this robust structural foundation as a primary geometric anchor, ensuring that the synthesized photorealistic videos are strictly constrained by prescribed trajectories and physically plausible deformations. Benefiting from the inherent editability of the 4D proxy, TryOnCrafter facilitates diverse downstream applications, including human relocalization, ``bullet time'' effects, and $360$-degree orbital viewing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了TryOnCrafter，第一个面向相机可控视频虚拟试穿（CaM-VVT）的统一DiT框架。通过引入可渲染的4D试穿代理（Renderable 4D Try-on Proxy），将高保真2D试穿先验蒸馏为基于3DGS的穿衣虚拟人，并通过SMPL-X序列动画和度量对齐将其融入重建的背景点云。代理锚定视频DiT利用该结构保证合成视频严格遵循指定轨迹和物理合理形变，支持人体重定位、子弹时间等应用。
Motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法被动依赖源相机轨迹，无法实现自由的多视角探索。本文定义CaM-VVT任务以解决该限制，要求视角无关的纹理幻觉和非刚体人体动态与背景在任意相机运动下的结构同步。
Method: 提出可渲染的4D试穿代理：将2D试穿先验蒸馏为3DGS基础的人体模型，再使用SMPL-X动画并度量对齐到重建背景点云。Proxy-Anchored Video DiT以该代理为几何锚点，生成沿指定轨迹的光逼真视频。
Result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果，但声称该方法在CaM-VVT任务上实现严格相机可控与物理合理形变，并支持人体重定位、子弹时间、360度环绕观看等下游应用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过显式解耦人体与环境的4D代理，可突破被动依赖相机轨迹的限制，实现交互式视角探索。但未讨论局限性或未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
papers.abstract_en: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to generalize to novel setups, such as altered camera viewpoints or robot morphologies, because they are typically conditioned only on current observations and language instructions. By ignoring the underlying system configuration as a variable, these models implicitly assume a fixed execution context encountered during training, necessitating data-intensive fine-tuning for any new environment. In this work, we introduce In-Context World Modeling (ICWM), a framework that treats system identification as an in-context adaptation problem. ICWM enables robot policies to autonomously infer essential system variables from a short history of self-generated, task-agnostic interactions. Unlike traditional In-Context Learning that uses demonstrations to specify what task to perform, ICWM leverages the context window to understand how the system operates. By processing these interactions before task execution, the model implicitly captures the world dynamics of the current system, enabling adaptation to novel configurations without parameter updates. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world robot platforms demonstrate that ICWM significantly outperforms standard VLA baselines on novel camera viewpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文世界建模（ICWM）框架，将系统识别视为上下文自适应问题，使机器人策略能从短历史的自生成任务无关交互中推断系统变量，无需参数更新即可适应新配置。仿真和真实机器人实验表明，ICWM在新型相机视角下显著优于标准VLA基线。
Motivation: 现代VLA模型假设固定执行上下文，导致泛化到新相机视角或机器人形态时失败，需要数据密集型微调。
Method: ICWM利用上下文窗口理解系统运行方式，通过任务执行前的交互序列隐式捕获当前系统的世界动态，实现无参数更新的适应。
Result: 摘要报告在仿真和真实机器人平台上，ICWM在新型相机视角下显著优于标准VLA基线。
Conclusion: ICWM展示了通过上下文学习进行系统识别的潜力，使机器人策略能泛化到未知配置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Variational Autoencoder Layer
papers.abstract_en: Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) belong to a family of autoencoders with probabilistic properties, making them well suited for generating data by producing a smooth and continuous latent space. Despite being introduced over a decade ago, the method continues to be widely adopted in both research and industry for diverse applications. While VAEs are typically used as standalone models, this paper introduces a novel approach to integrate them as a neural network layer. Furthermore, a new training strategy is proposed for models incorporating these layers, and their performance is thoroughly analyzed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将变分自编码器（VAE）作为神经网络层集成的新方法，并设计了相应的训练策略，分析了其性能表现。
Motivation: 现有的VAE通常作为独立模型使用，缺乏将其作为神经网络层嵌入到更大网络中的通用方法。
Method: 提出一种将VAE作为神经网络层的架构，并配套新的训练策略以支持该层的端到端训练。
Result: 实验分析显示该层在多个任务上有效，但摘要未提供具体数值。

papers.title: Decentralised AI Training and Inference with BlockTrain
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI training is increasingly shaped by access to dense, centrally controlled accelerator clusters. This creates a structural advantage for hyperscalers and large centralized laboratories, and makes open or independent AI efforts depend on scarce capital, privileged infrastructure, and data-center geography. We present Spheroid BlockTrain, a decentralized training protocol in which a model is partitioned into independently trainable blocks, each optimized on a local objective derived from the same global target and composed at inference into one model. On byte-level WikiText, BlockTrain reaches cross entropy 1.359 (perplexity 3.89), within about 0.04 CE of a same-setup end-to-end Transformer reference, while each active worker trains only one block and avoids full-model optimizer state. A shared six-worker block training run reaches CE 1.385 by averaging same-block updates into one assembled model. HTTP/TCP transport experiments move real serialized checkpoints and updates, including a public-IP three-host run that improves CE from 5.580 to 1.811 while moving 15.22 GB. For inference, the current BlockTrain path uses one block-stack traversal per full output and serves over direct TCP across three public-network GPU hosts up to a 75.80B-parameter logical fp16 shape, outperforming a matched plain-autoregressive TCP pipeline baseline because it emits a full sequence per WAN pipeline traversal rather than one token per traversal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spheroid BlockTrain，一种去中心化的训练和推理协议，将模型分割为独立可训练的块，每块基于全局目标优化，推理时组合成完整模型。在 byte-level WikiText 上达到交叉熵 1.359（困惑度 3.89），与端到端 Transformer 基线相差约 0.04 CE。分布式训练通过平均同块更新实现 CE 1.385，公共 IP 三主机实验将 CE 从 5.580 降至 1.811，传输 15.22 GB 数据。推理方面，单次全输出使用一次块栈遍历，在三个公共网络 GPU 主机上支持多达 75.80B 参数逻辑 fp16 形状，优于基线 TCP pipeline。
Motivation: 当前前沿AI训练依赖集中式加速器集群，给超大规模实验室带来结构性优势，阻碍了开放或独立AI研究的发展。需要一种去中心化方案减少对资本、特权基础设施和数据中心地理位置的依赖。
Method: 将模型切分为独立可训练块，每块在本地优化来自同一全局目标的损失函数，推理时组合所有块。分布式训练中，多个工作者各自训练一个块，并通过平均相同块的更新来组装模型。传输采用 HTTP/TCP 移动序列化检查点和更新。
Result: 在 byte-level WikiText 上达到 CE 1.359，接近端到端 Transformer 的 CE 1.40（估计差值 0.04 CE）。六工作者分布式训练达到 CE 1.385。公共 IP 三主机实验从 CE 5.580 改善至 1.811，传输 15.22 GB。推理支持 75.80B 参数模型，吞吐量优于 baseline。
Conclusion: BlockTrain 证明去中心化训练在保持竞争性能的同时降低了对集中式基础设施的依赖，适用于大规模模型分布式协作。

papers.title: DramaDirector: Geometry-Guided Short Drama Generation
papers.abstract_en: Short dramas, with their rapid shot rhythms, dialogue-driven focus shifts, and demanding cinematographic grounding, pose challenges that prompt-level or text-only video generation pipelines struggle to meet. We study plot-to-short-drama generation, where a global plot and local context are transformed into visually grounded multi-shot videos. We propose DramaDirector, a geometry-grounded framework that lets the planner borrow cinematographic geometry from a gallery of real short-drama shots indexed by depth and pose. DramaDirector decouples each shot into static visual and dynamic narrative conditions, trains the planner with schema-constrained SFT and GRPO under a learned text-visual alignment reward, and retrieves depth-pose references to guide first-frame generation and image-to-video synthesis. We also introduce DramaBoard, a benchmark built from 35 live-action dramas, 2.8K episodes, and 81K shots, with structured storyboards and multi-dimensional evaluation protocols. Experiments show that DramaDirector improves over representative multi-agent and video generation baselines on faithfulness, consistency, and controllability. Our code is released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/DramaDirector
papers.comment: 20 pages, 17 figures, 6 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/DramaDirector
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DramaDirector，一个几何引导的短剧生成框架，将全局情节和局部上下文转化为多镜头视频。通过从真实短剧中检索深度和姿态参考，解耦静态视觉和动态叙述条件，使用模式约束的 SFT 和 GRPO 训练规划器。引入 DramaBoard 基准，包含 35 部真人剧、2.8K 集、81K 镜头。实验表明在忠实度、一致性和可控性上优于基线。
Motivation: 短剧要求快速的镜头节奏、对话驱动的焦点转移和电影感，但提示级别或纯文本的视频生成方法难以满足这些需求。本文研究情节到短剧的生成问题。
Method: 提出 DramaDirector 框架，包含几何引导的规划器，从真实短剧镜头库中检索深度和姿态参考，解耦每镜头为静态视觉和动态叙述条件，使用模式约束的 SFT 和 GRPO 训练，并利用文本-视觉对齐奖励，检索深度-姿态参考引导首帧生成和图像到视频合成。
Result: 在 DramaBoard 基准上，DramaDirector 在忠实度、一致性和可控性上优于多智能体和视频生成基线。
Conclusion: 本文提出的 DramaDirector 在短剧生成任务上展示了有效性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: VideoAgent: All-in-One Framework for Video Understanding and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Video editing has become essential in digital media creation, yet existing automated systems are restricted to short segment processing and domain-specific tasks. They face two critical limitations: i) inability to handle diverse video comprehension and editing operations, and ii) lack of long-video understanding for coherent narrative creation. We propose VideoAgent, an all-in-one agentic framework addressing these challenges through two key innovations. First, we develop automated video shot creation with shot planning agents for coherent narratives and cross-modal retrieval for aligned visual content. Second, we design a multi-agent orchestration framework integrating over thirty specialized editing agents. Intent parsing filters relevant tools while textual-gradient graph optimization assembles complex editing pipelines. Extensive experiments on our newly-proposed VideoEdit benchmark and public datasets demonstrate VideoAgent's superiority over existing multimodal LLMs and agentic systems. VideoAgent achieves 87-95% orchestration success rates while reducing API costs by 60%. Human evaluation across six video categories shows VideoAgent produces professional-quality content approaching human-level performance, with ratings only 4% below human-created videos. We release our code at https://github.com/HKUDS/VideoAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoAgent，一个全能的智能体框架，用于视频理解和编辑。通过自动化镜头创建、多智能体编排（集成30多个专业编辑智能体）以及文本梯度图优化，解决了现有系统只能处理短片段和特定任务的局限。在 VideoEdit 基准和公开数据集上，VideoAgent 实现 87-95% 的编排成功率，API 成本降低 60%，人类评估显示其生成内容仅比人工创作低 4%。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑自动化系统局限于短片段处理和特定任务，缺乏对长视频理解与连贯叙事创作的能力。
Method: 提出 VideoAgent 框架，包含两阶段：一是自动化视频镜头创建与跨模态检索；二是多智能体编排框架，利用意图解析过滤工具并用文本梯度图优化组装复杂编辑流水线。
Result: 在 VideoEdit 基准上编排成功率 87-95%，API 成本降低 60%；六类视频的人类评估中，VideoAgent 生成内容质量仅比人工视频低 4%。
Conclusion: VideoAgent 在全能视频理解和编辑上达到接近人类水平的表现，但摘要未提及对极端长视频或复杂叙事场景的局限性。

papers.title: Text Dictates, Music Decorates: Energy-based Attention for Editable Dance Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Choreographic motion generation poses unique challenges for AI, demanding precise semantic control over complex, temporally structured, and expressive full-body dynamics. While existing models can synthesize motion from music, they remain largely black boxes. Conversely, attempting to condition generation on both text and music frequently leads to modality collapse, where dense acoustic rhythms overwhelm sparse semantic text prompts, destroying user controllability. To resolve this spatial-temporal conflict, we propose STREAM (Structural-Temporal Rhythmic Energy-based Attention for Motion), a modality-decoupled diffusion transformer. STREAM strictly separates conditioning pathways: global text semantics dictate the kinematic structure via Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN), while a novel Bimodal Energy-Based Attention Module (BEAM) routes these features to the musical beat without overwriting the semantics. We further introduce Motorica++, a newly curated dataset enriched with domain-specific dance vocabulary and frame-level semantic annotations from existing Motorica dataset. Additionally, to rigorously quantify zero-shot editability, we propose the Exchange Evaluation Protocol and Editable Dance Score (EDS). Through extensive experiments, STREAM achieves state-of-the-art alignment between motion and music while perfectly preserving choreographic semantics, positioning AI not merely as a reactive synthesizer, but as a controllable, collaborative partner for artistic direction. The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/SeongJong-Yoo/STREAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STREAM，一种模态解耦的扩散Transformer，用于文本和音乐共同控制的舞蹈动作生成。它通过自适应层归一化（AdaLN）处理文本语义，并通过双模能量注意力模块（BEAM）处理音乐节拍，解决了多模态冲突问题。作者还引入了Motorica++数据集、交换评估协议和可编辑舞蹈分数（EDS）。实验表明STREAM在运动与音乐对齐和语义保持上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有舞蹈动作生成模型要么是黑箱，要么在文本和音乐条件共同输入时出现模态崩溃（节奏淹没文本），导致用户可控性差。
Method: 提出STREAM，其包含两个主要组件：全局文本语义通过AdaLN控制运动结构；新型双模能量注意力模块（BEAM）在不覆盖语义的前提下将特征路由到音乐节拍。同时引入Motorica++数据集和交换评估协议、EDS评分。
Result: 摘要称STREAM在运动与音乐对齐上达到SOTA，并完美保留编舞语义。
Conclusion: 该工作使AI成为可控的协作式艺术指导伙伴，而非被动合成器。

papers.title: The Power of Light: Improving Synthetic-to-Real Domain Adaptation through Physically-Based Indirect Illumination
papers.abstract_en: While synthetic data generation resolves the manual labeling bottleneck in computer vision, minimizing the syn-to-real domain gap requires optimizing rendering variables. This paper presents a systematic study analyzing the impact of lighting configurations and background complexity on object detection performance. We introduce SmartSDG, an automated, reproducible pipeline built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim using Physically-Based Shading (PBS), alongside ILLUM\_INTRUCK, a new multi-object industrial benchmark dataset. Through 18 controlled experiments utilizing a state-of-the-art YOLOv12 framework, we demonstrate that complex, indirect lighting configurations paired with domain-relevant background variability significantly increase visual cue richness. Our quantitative findings show that avoiding direct specular peaks preserves crucial surface textures, mitigates the domain gap, reduces false positives, and accelerates model convergence compared to using conventional direct-light synthetic data. Ultimately, we provide actionable virtual scene design guidelines to maximize object detection robustness in industrial automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了光照配置和背景复杂度对合成到真实域适应中目标检测性能的影响。作者提出SmartSDG自动合成数据管道，基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim和物理着色（PBS），并创建ILLUM_INTRUCK工业基准数据集。通过18个对照实验（使用YOLOv12），发现复杂间接光照和领域相关背景变化能增加视觉线索丰富度，避免直接镜面峰可保留纹理、缩小域差距、减少假阳性并加速收敛。最终提供了工业自动化的虚拟场景设计指导。
Motivation: 合成数据生成避免了人工标注瓶颈，但缩小合成到真实域差距需要优化渲染变量。现有研究缺乏对光照和背景复杂性的系统分析。
Method: 提出SmartSDG自动管道，集成物理着色（PBS）和间接光照，配合领域相关背景变化；创建ILLUM_INTRUCK多目标工业基准数据集；使用YOLOv12进行18个对照实验。
Result: 实验结果表明，复杂间接光照和领域相关背景显著提高视觉线索丰富度；避免直接镜面峰可保留表面纹理，缩小域差距，减少假阳性，加速模型收敛。
Conclusion: 提供了可操作的虚拟场景设计指南，以最大化工业自动化中目标检测的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Cross-View Yaw Estimation in Location Uncertainty with Line-Aligning Yaw Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Accurate yaw estimation is a bottleneck in cross-view localization between ground view and Bird's Eye View (BEV). Existing methods couple yaw with translation and rely on height or projection assumptions that degrade under large yaw ambiguity. We disentangle yaw from location accuracy and introduce LAYS, a radially invariant line-consensus voting method. By exploiting the radial invariance of our formulation, we achieve sub-degree yaw precision via 3D voting over all candidate poses, while eliminating the need for accurate location. Our key observation is that a ground-image column matched to BEV pixels induces the same yaw across all camera positions along the radial direction of the pixels. LAYS matches BEV pixels to ground columns using feature similarity and accumulates the induced yaw votes into discrete 3D bins, where correct correspondences along the radial line concentrate into a sharp peak for the correct yaw. Experiments on Mapillary, Ford, KITTI, and VIGOR show significant gains under unknown yaw, particularly for normal FoV with unknown yaw (+28$\sim$45\%p), and using LAYS as a yaw prior improves downstream 3-DoF localization.

Conclusion: LAYS通过径向不变性解耦偏航与位置，在无需精确位置的情况下实现高精度偏航估计，可有效提升跨视角定位性能。

papers.title: UNITY: Attention Flow Networks for Adaptive Conditioning in Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We introduce UNITY, a Universal-to-Specialized adapter for efficient and scalable composite conditioning in diffusion based image generation. Unlike prior methods that train separate adapters for each conditioning modality, UNITY jointly learns shared semantics across multiple conditioning types and subsequently specializes without modifying the underlying architecture. The proposed two stage training paradigm consists of a Universal Stage that captures cross modal representations across all conditioning modalities using half of the total training steps, followed by a Specialization Stage that refines modality specific features using the remaining training budget. At the core of UNITY are the Morphable Attention Flow (MAF) Network and Morph Wrapper modules, which enable channel aware and spatially adaptive feature alignment through learnable flow fields and attention based fusion. This constant complexity formulation supports flexible operation under both single and composite conditioning settings while significantly reducing inference latency and memory consumption. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that UNITY achieves state of the art image fidelity while maintaining superior memory efficiency. Code: https://github.com/arya-domain/UNITY
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UNITY，一种用于扩散模型的高效组合条件适配方法，通过两阶段训练（通用阶段+专化阶段）学习跨模态共享语义并细化模态特定特征。核心模块Morphable Attention Flow (MAF) Network和Morph Wrapper实现通道感知、空间自适应的特征对齐，在单一和组合条件下均能降低推理延迟和内存消耗。实验表明UNITY在保持图像保真度的同时具有优越的内存效率。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型的条件适配方法为每种模态单独训练适配器，导致参数冗余和跨模态信息利用不足。需要一种统一框架能联合学习多模态表示并高效适配。
Method: 两阶段训练范式：通用阶段（一半训练步数）学习所有条件模态的跨模态表示；专化阶段（剩余步数）细化特定模态特征。核心模块是MAF网络和Morph Wrapper，通过可学习流场和基于注意力的融合实现通道感知和空间自适应特征对齐。
Result: 在多个数据集上达到最先进的图像保真度，同时显著降低推理延迟和内存消耗。
Conclusion: UNITY提供了一种常量复杂度方案，支持灵活的组合条件设置，兼顾性能与效率。

papers.title: Kairos: A Regret-Aware Native World-Action Model Stack for Physical AI
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \textbf{Kairos}, a regret-aware native world-action model stack for Physical AI. Kairos is motivated by the view that a physical world model should not aim to fully simulate all future pixels, but should learn and maintain the information most relevant to embodiment control: object state, spatial relations, contact conditions, task progress, action consequences, failure boundaries, and deployment uncertainty. Kairos establishes three model-side prerequisites toward this goal. First, it \textbf{learns} control-relevant information through a \textbf{Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum}, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into an intervention-strength progression from passive physical observation to intentional behavior and embodied action grounding. Second, it \textbf{maintains} control-sufficient states through a unified \textbf{understanding, generation, and prediction architecture} equipped with \textbf{Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention}, where local, mid-range, and global temporal pathways support multi-timescale state maintenance under efficient inference. Third, it \textbf{deploys} these states through a \textbf{Deployment-Aware System Co-Design}, treating latency, memory footprint, and hardware compatibility as first-order constraints for future observation, action, and feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model benchmarks, world-action benchmarks, long-horizon generation, and inference-efficiency evaluation show that Kairos achieves superior performance while offering a favorable efficiency to capability trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kairos 是一个遗憾感知的原生世界-动作模型栈，专为物理 AI 设计。它通过跨本体数据课程、混合线性时间注意力架构和部署感知系统协同设计，学习并维护与具身控制最相关的信息（如对象状态、空间关系、接触条件等）。实验表明，在多个世界模型、世界-动作、长时程生成和推理效率基准上，Kairos 取得了优越性能，并提供了有利的效率-能力权衡。
Motivation: 现有物理世界模型试图模拟所有未来像素，导致效率低下且与具体控制目标脱节。本文认为模型应只学习并维护对具身控制最重要的信息，以提高实用性和效率。
Method: 提出了三个模型侧前提：1）跨本体数据课程，从被动物理观察到主动行为再到具身动作，逐步提升干预强度；2）统一的理解、生成与预测架构，配备混合线性时间注意力，支持多时间尺度状态维护；3）部署感知系统协同设计，将延迟、内存和硬件兼容性作为一阶约束。
Result: 在具身世界模型基准、世界-动作基准、长时程生成和推理效率评估上，Kairos 实现了优于现有方法的性能，同时展现了良好的效率-能力权衡。
Conclusion: Kairos 证明物理世界模型应专注于控制相关信息，并通过其模型栈在效率和能力之间取得实际平衡，为物理 AI 的部署提供了可行路径。

papers.title: Selective Mask Propagation for Multi-Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking has a heavy-tailed difficulty distribution: most frames are easy for a lightweight base tracker, while a small fraction are intrinsically hard. Video object segmentation (VOS) models can often preserve identity through the hard frames where the base tracker fails, but they are much more expensive in compute and memory. We propose selective mask propagation, a tracking algorithm that dispatches from a base tracker to a VOS model only on windows where an assignment-uncertainty signal fires. The base tracker's output is modified only when the VOS model makes a confident prediction that contradicts the base tracker's identity assignment; weak or inconclusive predictions preserve the base output. The method is training-free, treats both the base tracker and the VOS model as black boxes, and can benefit from replacing the VOS component with a more capable model. On DanceTrack, selective mask propagation improves three different base trackers. On SportsMOT, where identity preservation is central to sports analytics, SAM3-Deep-EIoU with global track association achieves state-of-the-art performance on the benchmark with 87.2 HOTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出选择性掩码传播（Selective Mask Propagation），一种多目标跟踪算法，仅在基础跟踪器的不确定性信号触发时，才调用计算昂贵的视频目标分割（VOS）模型，并在VOS预测与基础跟踪器冲突且置信度高时才修改输出。该方法无需训练，将基础跟踪器和VOS视为黑箱，在DanceTrack上提升了三种基础跟踪器，在SportsMOT上SAM3-Deep-EIoU搭配全局轨迹关联达到87.2 HOTA的SOTA。
Motivation: 多目标跟踪中大多数帧简单，少数帧困难；VOS模型能处理困难帧但计算成本高。现有方法要么全部用轻量跟踪器导致困难帧出错，要么全部用VOS导致效率低下。
Method: 选择性掩码传播：基础跟踪器持续运行，当分配不确定性信号触发时，在局部窗口调用VOS模型；仅当VOS做出与基础跟踪器身份分配矛盾且置信度高的预测时才修改输出，否则保留基础跟踪器结果。
Result: 在DanceTrack上提升三种基跟踪器；在SportsMOT上，SAM3-Deep-EIoU结合全局轨迹关联达到87.2 HOTA，为SOTA。
Conclusion: 该方法无需训练、可替换VOS组件，在计算开销与精度间取得平衡，特别适用于身份保持要求高的场景如体育分析。

papers.title: Selecting Samples on Graphs: A Unified Dataset Pruning Framework for Lossless Training Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of modern training datasets has significantly increased computational cost, motivating dataset pruning~(DP) methods which retain only a subset of informative samples to reduce training cost. Existing pruning criteria typically rely on either intrinsic signals that assess samples independently or extrinsic signals that promote diversity via pairwise relations. While effective in their own specific regimes, each captures only one aspect of sample utility and lacks robustness across different pruning ratios or data distribution. In this work, we present a unified graph-based DP framework. By modeling the dataset as a weighted graph, where node weights encode intrinsic value and edge weights encode extrinsic value, DP can be cast as a Maximum Weight Clique Problem (MWCP). Although MWCP is NP-hard, its structure admits a principled greedy solution based on sample-wise marginal gains. Under a few mild conditions, we further prove that this unified objective enjoys a formal approximation guarantee, which applies to a broad family of importance metrics and provides practical design guidelines. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing DP methods while substantially reducing training cost, reducing training time by over 40\% without sacrificing accuracy on ImageNet-1k with ResNet-50.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的基于图的样本选择框架，将数据集建模为加权图，节点权重编码样本内在价值，边权重编码样本间外在价值，将数据集剪枝问题转化为最大权团问题（MWCP）。在温和条件下，该贪婪算法具有近似保证，在ImageNet-1k上使用ResNet-50时，可将训练时间减少40%以上而不损失精度。
Motivation: 现有数据集剪枝方法要么依赖独立评估样本的内在信号，要么依赖成对关系促进多样性的外在信号，但每种方法只捕捉样本效用的一方面，在不同剪枝比率或数据分布下缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 提出图统一框架：将数据集建模为加权图，节点权重代表内在价值，边权重代表外在价值，剪枝问题表述为最大权团问题（MWCP），并采用基于样本边际增益的贪心算法求解，同时给出近似保证的理论分析。
Result: 实验表明该方法在ImageNet-1k上使用ResNet-50时，训练时间减少超过40%且不牺牲精度，性能优于现有数据集剪枝方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的图统一框架能同时利用内在和外在信号，具有理论保证和实际效果，为数据集剪枝提供了新视角。

papers.title: Reducing the Complexity of Deep Learning Models for EEG Analysis on Wearable Devices
papers.abstract_en: Wearable healthcare devices are the fastest-growing Internet of Things (IoT) sector. Many automated healthcare services rely on two crucial biological signals, namely ECG and EEG, which reflect the activity of the heart and brain, respectively. Although deep neural networks are considered the primary way to process and analyze these signals, the very tight energy and computational power constraints in wearable devices are far below the computational, energy, and memory bandwidth demands of DNN models, thereby impeding the deployment of deep learning in many practical wearable services. This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying state-of-the-art DNN models in resource-constrained wearable devices. Notably, we explore the trade-off between accuracy and computational complexity of DNNs when parameter quantization and electrode reduction methods are used. Our investigation centers on several state-of-the-art DNN models designed for EEG signal analysis, specifically for detecting epileptic seizures. Our findings demonstrate that, when applied judiciously, these techniques can significantly reduce the complexity of the DNNs under consideration with minimal adverse effects on accuracy. These results reveal the explicit trade-offs between accuracy and complexity reduction encountered when adapting DNN-based online EEG analysis for wearable devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在资源受限的可穿戴设备上部署深度学习模型分析脑电图（EEG）信号的可行性，重点探索参数量化和减少电极数量对模型精度与计算复杂性的权衡。实验以癫痫发作检测任务中的多种先进DNN模型为对象，发现这些技术能在几乎不影响精度的情况下显著降低模型复杂性。
Motivation: 可穿戴设备对计算、能耗和内存带宽的要求极为严格，而标准DNN模型难以满足这些约束，阻碍了深度学习在可穿戴医疗服务中的实际应用。
Method: 通过参数量化和电极减少两种技术，在多个用于EEG癫痫检测的先进DNN模型上评估精度与复杂性的折中关系。
Result: 摘要表明，这些方法能大幅降低模型复杂性，同时精度损失极小。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了在可穿戴设备上在线分析EEG时，精度与复杂性降低的明确权衡，为实际部署提供了依据。

papers.title: A Mathematical Theory of Value: a synthesis on goal-directed agency under resource constraints
papers.abstract_en: We propose that value -- the quantity goal-directed agents create, destroy, and exchange -- is a lawful structural quantity in the same category as information. Following Shannon's method, we make one ruthless abstraction: value is the rate at which an agent converts a resource into goal-progress, relative to a frame fixed by its goal. A scale-invariance axiom forces a logarithmic measure, $V=\sum_i k_i\ln e_i$; compounding of a reinvested resource forces the same form via the ergodicity argument of Peters (2019) -- kin routes, a consistency check, not an over-determination. We derive a coding theorem of value, $ΔG \le I(X;Y)$; realized value decomposes as $G=D(q\|r)-D(q\|p)$. For populations, value is frame-relative while price is frame-independent; a fleet that pools its resource and fuses its perception inherits the ceiling $G_{\rm fleet}\le I(X;Y_{1:m})\le H(X)$ (a corollary; an earlier sum-form claim was wrong and is corrected in v5). A dynamical layer yields an is/ought asymmetry from which alignment emerges as a control-stability condition. We test the single-frame laws on live language models, pre-registered: perception mutual information tracks realized capability (Spearman $ρ=0.977$ over 30 model$\times$domain points); out-of-sample $ΔG$ tracks $I(X;Y)$, shape-invariant across four task shapes ($n=42$, slope $0.953$); over-confidence is measurable dissipation. The stated continuation gate has since been run (pre-registered, frontier-model population): the coupled capacity-region prediction -- growth-gap law, coalition submodularity with an XOR synergy control, joint ceiling, Kelly selection -- is confirmed within its frozen bands on real agents; the mean-field residual law $\|Vg\|/γ$ found no domain (populations hold no goal dispersion) and is retired to its mathematical scope. The contribution is the unification and the governance mapping that follows.
papers.comment: Also available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20487041 (v6). v2: the pre-registered continuation-gate experiment has been run -- prediction (i) confirmed on real frontier agents; prediction (ii) retired to mathematical scope. Code, pre-registrations, and raw run records: https://github.com/macrokit/value
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个关于价值（value）的数学理论，将价值定义为目标导向智能体在资源约束下转换资源为目标进展的速率，遵循香农信息论的方法。通过尺度不变公理推导出对数度量，并建立了价值的编码定理，将价值与互信息联系起来。理论在语言模型上进行了预注册实验验证，结果显示感知互信息与实现能力高度相关。
Motivation: 现有对价值的概念缺乏统一的数学基础，本文旨在像信息论量化信息一样，量化目标导向智能体创造、破坏和交换的价值。
Method: 采用香农的抽象方法，通过尺度不变公理强制对数度量；利用Peters（2019）的遍历性论证推导出相同形式；推导出价值的编码定理 ΔG ≤ I(X;Y)；将实现价值分解为相对熵差；动态层引入实然/应然不对称，对齐作为控制稳定性条件。
Result: 在30个模型×领域点上，感知互信息与实现能力的Spearman ρ=0.977；跨4种任务形状的n=42个样本中，ΔG与I(X;Y)斜率0.953；过度自信表现为可测量耗散。预注册的续门实验证实了增长-差距律、联盟子模性等预测。
Conclusion: 本文提供了价值理论的统一框架和治理映射，但人口层面的平均场残差律被退回到数学范围，未在真实数据上得到验证。

papers.title: Disentangling the effects of sea surface temperature and CO$_2$ in global machine learned weather-climate emulators
papers.abstract_en: While previous versions of the Ai2 Climate Emulator (ACE) have been trained with CO$_2$ as a forcing, they are only accurate within a narrow range of scenarios, for example climate over the last 80 years forced by observed sea surface temperature (SST), sea ice, and CO$_2$ (AMIP), or equilibrium or near-equilibrium climates with CO$_2$ concentrations ranging from 1x to 4x that of the present day. Attempting to simulate climate forced by AMIP SST perturbed by +4 K or the response to an abrupt quadrupling of CO$_2$, results in unphysical behavior. We attribute this to these models being trained on datasets where the SST and CO$_2$ are correlated, limiting their ability to accurately learn their separate effects. In this study we introduce a new class of "random-CO$_2$" reference simulations where the SST and CO$_2$ are prescribed to vary independently. Trained on a balance of AMIP, equilibrium-climate, and random-CO$_2$ data, and including a total energy conservation constraint for improved interpretability, we present a more data-efficient model that not only accurately emulates its reference model in scenarios in which previous models excelled, but also scenarios like AMIP +4 K and slab-ocean-coupled abrupt 4xCO$_2$ where they did not. Limitations are that it has simplified or prescribed representations of other Earth system components like the ocean, land, and sea ice; does not expose other known climate drivers as forcings; and relies solely on physics-based model output for training data, inheriting the biases relative to observations thereof. Each of these represent opportunities for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现有Ai2气候仿真器（ACE）在海表温度（SST）与CO2耦合的数据集上训练，无法准确模拟二者独立变化时的气候响应（如AMIP+4K或突然4倍CO2）。通过引入随机CO2参考模拟使SST与CO2独立变化，结合AMIP、平衡气候和随机CO2数据训练，并加入总能量守恒约束，新模型在原有模型失败场景下表现良好，且更数据高效。但仍存在简化地球系统组件、未暴露其他驱动因子、依赖物理模型输出等局限。
Motivation: 现有ACE仿真器在SST与CO2耦合的数据上训练，当二者解耦时（如AMIP+4K或突然4xCO2）产生非物理解，限制了其泛化能力。
Method: 引入随机CO2参考模拟使SST与CO2独立变化；训练数据平衡AMIP、平衡气候和随机CO2数据；加入总能量守恒约束以提高可解释性。
Result: 新模型在原有模型表现好的场景依然准确，在AMIP+4K和突然4xCO2等原有模型失败场景也表现良好，且数据效率更高。
Conclusion: 该方法通过解耦SST与CO2训练数据显著提升了气候仿真器的泛化能力，但仍需完善地球系统组件表示、暴露更多气候驱动因子，并减少对物理模型输出的依赖。
Relevance: 40
