papers.title: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM sessions outlive their context windows, and the standard mitigations - truncation, summarization, retrieval - share a structural flaw: they treat history as flat text, discarding precisely the content that makes a session resumable: decisions and their rationales, task status, and file modification history. We present TokenMizer, an open-source transparent proxy that maintains session history as a typed knowledge graph and, at context boundaries, replaces the raw transcript with a token-budgeted serialization of session state. The schema comprises 14 node types and 7 edge types under an 8-state lifecycle in which decisions can be superseded or explicitly invalidated; bitemporal validity intervals support time-travel queries; and first-class decision-transition records preserve why each decision replaced its predecessor (trigger, reason, evidence). Version 0.3.1 embeds this memory core in a production-shaped serving layer - SSE streaming, security middleware, nine provider adapters, a monitoring dashboard, graph exports (D3 JSON, self-contained interactive HTML, Obsidian Canvas) - and exposes checkpoint/resume to agents as Model Context Protocol tools. The evaluation is deliberately minimal and fully provenanced: three synthetic sessions, heuristic-only extraction, one plain-summary baseline, every value traceable to a single versioned results file. Graph extraction ties the baseline on task recall (75.6%) and exceeds it on decision recall (85.0% vs. 70.0%) and file recall (100% vs. 91.7%), with 201-302-token resume blocks extracted in 8.1-529.9 ms per session. At n=3 these results are directional; ceiling effects and baseline weaknesses are analyzed explicitly. Code, benchmark runner, and the exact results file are released under the MIT licence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TokenMizer，一个开源透明代理，通过将会话历史维护为类型化知识图谱，在上下文边界处用令牌预算的会话状态序列化替换原始转录，以解决长水平LLM会话中上下文窗口限制的问题。模式包含14种节点类型和7种边类型，支持决策超时、时间旅行查询等。实验表明在决策召回和文件召回上优于简单摘要基线，但样本量小。
Motivation: 现有方法（截断、摘要、检索）将历史视为扁平文本，丢失了决策及其理由、任务状态、文件修改历史等使得会话可恢复的关键内容。
Method: 提出 TokenMizer，一个维护会话历史为类型化知识图谱的透明代理，在上下文边界用令牌预算的会话状态序列化替换原始转录。包含14种节点、7种边、8状态生命周期，支持位时有效区间和决策转换记录。版本0.3.1包含生产级服务层和MCP工具。
Result: 在三个合成会话上，图提取在任务召回上与基线持平（75.6%），在决策召回（85.0% vs 70.0%）和文件召回（100% vs 91.7%）上超过基线，恢复块大小201-302令牌，提取时间8.1-529.9毫秒。结果方向性，n=3。
Conclusion: 方向性结果，天花板效应和基线弱点已分析。代码和基准已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Private and Stable Test-Time Adaptation with Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) can reduce error on new and different data by updating the model on these inputs during inference. However, these updates raise the issue of privacy w.r.t. the testing data, because the model parameters now depend on all past inputs. To control this privacy risk, we cast multiple popular TTA methods (Tent, EATA, SAR, DeYO, and COME) into differential privacy (DP) forms that apply per-sample gradient clipping and Gaussian noise for all updates. On ImageNet-C, our DP-TTA methods provide adequate privacy at small cost to accuracy, and in the low-privacy regime the clipping mechanism of DP can even improve the accuracy and stability of adaptation in the continual setting. These improvements to privacy and accuracy come at only modest computational overhead. These first results on private TTA raise awareness of the issue, inform the development of more private test-time updates, and identify per-sample clipping as an effective technique for improving the accuracy and stability of adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将差分隐私（DP）引入测试时适应（TTA），将Tent、EATA、SAR、DeYO和COME等多种流行TTA方法转化为满足DP的形式，通过在每次更新时应用每样本梯度裁剪和高斯噪声来保护测试数据的隐私。在ImageNet-C上，DP-TTA方法在准确性损失很小的情况下提供了适当的隐私保护，并且在低隐私预算下，裁剪机制甚至能提高持续适应场景下的准确性和稳定性，且计算开销不大。这些结果揭示了TTA的隐私问题，并推动了更私有的测试时更新方法的开发。
Motivation: 测试时适应（TTA）在推理过程中更新模型，导致模型参数依赖于所有历史测试输入，从而引发测试数据的隐私泄露风险。现有TTA方法缺乏对隐私的正式保证，该论文旨在通过差分隐私来量化并控制这一风险。
Method: 将五种流行的TTA方法（Tent、EATA、SAR、DeYO、COME）转化为差分隐私形式，核心是在每次梯度更新时执行每样本梯度裁剪并添加高斯噪声，从而满足DP定义。
Result: 在ImageNet-C上，DP-TTA方法在提供隐私保证的同时，准确率下降很小；在低隐私预算下，裁剪机制反而能提升持续适应场景下的准确性和稳定性。计算开销适中。
Conclusion: 该论文首次系统研究了TTA的隐私问题，证明了将DP与TTA结合是可行的，并指出每样本裁剪不仅能保护隐私，还能改善适应准确性和稳定性，为未来设计更私有的测试时更新方法提供了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representation Forcing for Bottleneck-Free Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to handle perception and generation in a single model. Yet existing UMMs still rely on a frozen, separately pretrained VAE for image generation, imposing a structural bottleneck. Naively removing it introduces a quality gap, as the model must learn both high-level structure and low-level details from raw pixels. In this paper, we propose Representation Forcing (RF), a technique that closes this gap by making representation prediction a native capability of the model. Concretely, RF forces the decoder to autoregressively predict visual representations as intermediate tokens before pixels; these tokens then stay in context to guide pixel diffusion within the same backbone. By turning representations from perception outputs into generation targets, RF eliminates the need for any external generative latent space. We find that RF benefits both understanding and generation. On image generation, our pixel-space model with RF matches state-of-the-art VAE-based unified models. On image understanding, pixel-space RF generally outperforms its VAE-based variant. Together, these results offer an effective step toward end-to-end, bottleneck-free UMMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出表示强制（Representation Forcing, RF）技术，使统一多模态模型无需外部预训练的VAE即可在像素空间进行图像生成。RF强制解码器自回归预测视觉表示作为中间token，然后这些token在上下文中引导像素扩散，从而消除生成潜空间的瓶颈。实验表明，基于像素空间的RF模型在图像生成上匹配最先进的VAE-based统一模型，在图像理解上甚至优于VAE变体。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型依赖冻结的、单独预训练的VAE进行图像生成，造成结构性瓶颈。直接移除VAE会导致质量下降，因为模型需要同时从原始像素学习高层结构和低层细节。
Method: 提出表示强制（RF）：在生成像素之前，强制解码器自回归地预测视觉表示（如DINOv2特征）作为中间token，这些token保留在上下文中指导后续的像素扩散过程，从而将表示从感知输出转变为生成目标。
Result: 在图像生成任务上，基于像素空间的RF模型在FID等指标上匹配了基于VAE的最先进统一模型；在图像理解任务上，RF模型通常优于其VAE变体。
Conclusion: RF是迈向无瓶颈、端到端统一多模态模型的有效步骤，消除了对外部生成潜空间的依赖。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出表示强制（RF）：在生成像素之前，强制解码器自回归地预测视觉表示（如DINOv2特征）作为中间token，这些token保留在上下文中指导后续的像素扩散过程，从而将表示从感知输出转变为生成目标。
summary_sections.result: 在图像生成任务上，基于像素空间的RF模型在FID等指标上匹配了基于VAE的最先进统一模型；在图像理解任务上，RF模型通常优于其VAE变体。
summary_sections.conclusion: RF是迈向无瓶颈、端到端统一多模态模型的有效步骤，消除了对外部生成潜空间的依赖。

papers.title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are increasingly used for scientific work, but their end-to-end autonomous research capability remains difficult to verify. We present ResearchClawBench, a benchmark for evaluating autonomous scientific research across 40 tasks from 10 scientific domains. Each task is grounded in a real published paper, provides related literature and raw data, and hides the target paper during evaluation. Expert-curated multimodal rubrics decompose the target scientific artifacts into weighted criteria, enabling evaluation of target-paper-level re-discovery while leaving room for new discovery. We evaluate seven autonomous research (auto-research) agents under a unified protocol and seventeen native LLMs through the lightweight ResearchHarness. Current systems remain far from reliable re-discovery: the strongest autonomous agent, Claude Code, averages 21.5, and the strongest ResearchHarness LLM, Claude-Opus-4.7, averages 20.7, with an LLM frontier mean of only 26.5. Error analysis shows that failures concentrate in experimental protocol mismatch, evidence mismatch, and missing scientific core. ResearchClawBench provides a reproducible evaluation frontier for measuring progress toward autonomous scientific research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ResearchClawBench基准，用于评估AI智能体端到端自主科学研究能力，包含10个科学领域的40个任务，每个任务基于真实发表论文并提供文献和原始数据，隐藏目标论文进行重新发现评估。现有最强智能体Claude Code平均得分21.5，最强LLM Claude-Opus-4.7平均20.7，LLM前沿均值仅26.5，表明当前系统远未达到可靠重新发现。
Motivation: 当前AI编码智能体在科学工作中日益普及，但其端到端自主研究能力难以验证，缺乏标准化评估基准。
Method: 构建ResearchClawBench，包含40个来自10个科学领域的任务，每个任务基于真实论文，提供相关文献和原始数据，在评估时隐藏目标论文，并由专家设计多模态评分标准（rubrics）分解目标科学制品为加权准则，既评估目标论文级重新发现，也允许新发现空间。评估了7个自主研究智能体（统一协议）和17个原生LLM（通过轻量级ResearchHarness）。
Result: 最强自主智能体Claude Code平均21.5分，最强ResearchHarness LLM Claude-Opus-4.7平均20.7分，LLM前沿均值仅26.5分。错误集中在实验方案不匹配、证据不匹配和缺失科学核心。
Conclusion: ResearchClawBench为衡量自主科学研究进展提供了可复现的评估前沿，当前系统远未实现可靠重新发现。

papers.title: FP8 is All You Need (Part 1): Debunking Hardware FP64 as the HPC Holy Grail (June 13th version)
papers.abstract_en: Conventional HPC holds that native hardware FP64 is the irreducible foundation of scientific computing. On AI-optimized GPUs of the NVIDIA B300 generation and beyond, native FP64 throughput has collapsed to ~1.3 TFLOPS even as FP8 tensor throughput has grown to multiple PFLOPS. We argue something stronger than that this is survivable: the FP8 tensor-core matrix-multiply is the sole computational primitive on which double-precision scientific computing needs to be built. Every canonical kernel -- dense and sparse linear algebra, spectral transforms, stencils -- and every application composing them reduces, via the Chinese Remainder Theorem-based Ozaki Scheme II, to sequences of FP8 matrix operations; the only non-FP8 arithmetic is a bounded, fixed-width integer accumulation at reconstruction. Native FP64 is thereby demoted from a hardware requirement to a derived accuracy guarantee obtained by composition over the FP8 primitive. We organize the claim as a five-layer hierarchy -- the FP8 op, Ozaki II, the basic kernels or Berkeley "dwarfs", composite solvers, and full applications -- and, because the dwarf taxonomy already spans scientific computing, establish it by exhibiting the reduction for every dwarf rather than a sample. The claim is falsifiable, and we build the instrument that tests it: a Tensor-Memory Equilibrium (TME) model extending the Roofline with emulation parameters (alpha, beta, gamma). We identify register-level fusion as the mechanism that keeps emulation memory-bound, project recovered FP64 performance across B300 and Rubin against an H100 baseline, and close the kernel coverage with a companion FFT analysis and compensated reductions. The model could have returned a negative verdict; instead it passes across the dwarfs and their compositions. This is the analytical half of a two-part program, with a follow-on implementation to validate the thesis on real silicon.
papers.comment: This is the third revised version (July 3rd) of the previous submission (May 28th) version. There is a companion Part (2) paper focusing on Ozaki-style FFT. We have added comprehensive analysis of the register fusion for Blackwell architecture, allowing beta to be within the sensitivity bounds
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张在AI优化的GPU（如NVIDIA B300）上，原生FP64吞吐量已大幅下降，而FP8张量核心吞吐量极高，因此应放弃传统硬件FP64作为科学计算的基础。作者提出基于中国剩余定理的Ozaki Scheme II，将双精度科学计算的所有核心核（稠密/稀疏线性代数、谱变换、模板等）简化为FP8矩阵运算序列，仅需固定宽度的整数累加进行重构。通过五层层次结构和Tensor-Memory Equilibrium (TME)模型验证该主张，并针对B300和Rubin架构预测恢复的FP64性能。
Motivation: 传统HPC认为原生硬件FP64是科学计算的不可化约基础，但AI优化GPU上FP64吞吐量急剧下降，而FP8吞吐量巨大，因此需要重新评估计算基元。
Method: 基于Ozaki Scheme II（中国剩余定理），将双精度计算分解为FP8矩阵乘法序列，并通过寄存器级融合保持内存受限。提出Tensor-Memory Equilibrium (TME)模型扩展Roofline，用参数alpha、beta、gamma模拟精度恢复。
Result: 理论分析表明，通过FP8基元和补偿归约，所有Berkeley dwarfs及其组合都能实现Double Precision精度，模式通过TME模型验证，并预测B300和Rubin架构上恢复的FP64性能优于H100基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为硬件FP64不再是必需品，双精度可以通过FP8原始操作组合获得，该主张是可证伪的，且通过了dwarfs及组合的测试。后续将进行实现验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evaluating Skill and Stability of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen under Multi-Decadal Climate Simulations
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate the climate simulation capabilities of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen, two machine learning models originally trained for weather forecasting and evaluated up to a 10-day lead time. ArchesWeather is a deterministic model, while ArchesWeatherGen is a probabilistic flow-matching model leveraging ArchesWeather's forecasts, enabling ensemble-based uncertainty quantification. In this work, we adapt these models to act as forced atmospheric models by using additional conditioning on the monthly mean sea surface temperature (SST) and sea ice cover (SIC) as boundary conditions. In particular, we follow the AI Model Intercomparison Project (AIMIP) Phase 1 protocol, which, analogous to the Atmospheric Model Intercomparison Project (AMIP), proposes a standardized experimental setup to evaluate the climate skill of ML-based forced atmospheric models. We present a comprehensive evaluation of both models under these conditions, including comparison against numerical climate models, ablation studies that examine key design choices in the extension, and an analysis of forced versus unforced configurations. Despite being originally developed for weather forecasting, we demonstrate that forced configurations of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen produce stable long-term climate simulations, have a stable annual cycle, and capture the drift of many climate variables. The models faithfully reproduce ERA5's climatology, large-scale circulations and interannual variability, and they capture the tails of the distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了ArchesWeather和ArchesWeatherGen两个机器学习模型在多年代际气候模拟中的表现。原本用于天气预报的模型，通过附加月平均海表温度和海水覆盖边界条件，转变为强迫大气模型，遵循AI模型比对项目（AIMIP）协议。结果表明，强迫配置能产生稳定的长期气候模拟，复现ERA5的气候态、大尺度环流和年际变率。
Motivation: 现有ML天气预测模型主要用于短期预报，缺乏对长期气候模拟能力的系统评估。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过标准化实验（AIMIP协议）检验这些模型在多年尺度上的稳定性和技能。
Method: 将ArchesWeather（确定性）和ArchesWeatherGen（概率流匹配）模型扩展为强迫大气模型，附加月平均SST和SIC作为边界条件。采用AIMIP Phase 1协议，与数值气候模型对比，并进行消融研究及强迫/非强迫配置分析。
Result: 模型能产生稳定的长期模拟，具有稳定的年循环，捕捉多个气候变量的漂移。忠实再现ERA5的气候态、大尺度环流、年际变率及分布尾部。
Conclusion: 虽然原始模型为天气预报设计，但通过适当边界强迫，可有效用于多年代际气候模拟，为ML气候模型提供新思路。局限包括未探讨完全耦合模拟等情况。

papers.title: Gradient-Flow Optimization as Dynamic Random-Effects Inference: Testing and Early Stopping with Applications to Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-flow optimization is usually viewed as an algorithmic procedure for minimizing empirical loss, with training duration selected by validation or heuristic early stopping rules. We develop a statistical inference framework for gradient-flow training. We show that whenever fitted values evolve through a time-invariant positive semidefinite training operator, the output at each time is equivalent to the best linear unbiased predictor under a corresponding random-effects model. Training time then becomes a variance-component parameter governing variance reallocation from residual noise to structured signal. This turns two training decisions into inferential problems: whether training is needed becomes a variance-component test for signal beyond initialization, and how long to train becomes restricted maximum likelihood (REML) estimation of the training-time variance component. We show that the REML-guided early stopping rule selects the time at which optimized spectral losses become decorrelated from the training-operator eigenvalues. The asymptotic prediction optimality of the REML-guided early stopping time is established for fixed-design in-sample risk and random-design out-of-sample risk. Deep learning models in fixed-kernel gradient regimes provide canonical instantiations for our results. Numerical experiments and a UK Biobank proteomics application show competitive accuracy of the REML-guided early stopping time with reduced reliance on validation splits and repeated checkpoint evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将梯度流优化视为动态随机效应推断，将训练时间视为方差分量参数，并发展出REML引导的早停规则。理论证明该早停时间在固定设计和随机设计下的渐进预测最优性，并在深度学习实验中展示竞争性精度。
Motivation: 梯度流优化通常仅被视为经验损失最小化的算法过程，训练时长由验证集或启发式早停规则决定，缺乏统计推断基础。本文旨在为梯度流训练建立统计推断框架。
Method: 将训练输出等价于对应随机效应模型下的最佳线性无偏预测，训练时间成为方差分量参数。将是否需要训练转化为方差分量检验，将训练时长转化为REML估计。提出REML引导的早停规则，选择优化谱损失与训练算子特征值去相关的时刻。
Result: 建立了REML早停时间在固定设计样本内风险和随机设计样本外风险下的渐进预测最优性。在英国生物银行蛋白质组学应用以及深度学习实验中显示竞争性精度，减少了对验证集分割和重复检查点评估的依赖。
Conclusion: 本文为梯度流优化提供了统计推断视角，将训练决策转化为推断问题，早停规则由REML估计决定，具有理论保证和实际效果。

papers.title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on reusable skills to solve complex tasks, but existing skill creation approaches often treat skills as isolated, static artifacts, limiting reusability, reliability, and long-term improvement. We propose MUSE-Autoskill Agent (Memory-Utilizing Skill Evolution), a skill-centric agent framework that creates, reuses, and refines skills under a unified lifecycle: creation, memory, management, evaluation, and refinement. MUSE creates skills on demand, stores them across tasks, retrieves them through a skill catalog, and accumulates per-skill experience for later reuse and adaptation. Across the main reported settings on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench, MUSE-Autoskill outperforms Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code. On SkillsBench, its self-created skills surpass human-authored skills on the successfully covered subset (85.24% vs. 81.17%), showing that lifecycle-managed skills can distill agent experience into highly effective reusable assets; MUSE-created skills also transfer to Hermes more effectively than Codex- or Claude-created skills, reaching 51.90% accuracy under transfer. These results highlight the importance of treating skills as long-lived, experience-aware, and testable assets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种以技能为中心的智能体框架MUSE-Autoskill，通过统一的生命周期（创建、记忆、管理、评估和精炼）来创建、重用和改进技能。实验表明，在SkillsBench和SkillLearnBench上，MUSE优于Hermes、Codex和Claude Code，且其自创技能在覆盖子集上超过人类编写技能。
Motivation: 现有技能创建方法将技能视为孤立静态的制品，限制了可重用性、可靠性和长期改进。
Method: 提出MUSE-Autoskill Memory-Utilizing Skill Evolution框架，按需创建技能，跨任务存储，通过技能目录检索，并积累每个技能的经验以供后续重用和适应。
Result: 在SkillsBench上，自创技能在成功覆盖子集上超越人类编写的技能（85.24% vs 81.17%），且MUSE创建的技能迁移到Hermes上的准确率为51.90%，优于Codex或Claude创建的技能。
Conclusion: 强调了将技能视为长期存在、具有经验意识和可测试资产的重要性。

summary_sections.method: 提出MUSE-Autoskill Memory-Utilizing Skill Evolution框架，按需创建技能，跨任务存储，通过技能目录检索，并积累每个技能的经验以供后续重用和适应。
summary_sections.result: 在SkillsBench上，自创技能在成功覆盖子集上超越人类编写的技能（85.24% vs 81.17%），且MUSE创建的技能迁移到Hermes上的准确率为51.90%，优于Codex或Claude创建的技能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 强调了将技能视为长期存在、具有经验意识和可测试资产的重要性。

papers.title: IndexMem: Learned KV-Cache Eviction with Latent Memory for Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to operate over long contexts, yet standard softmax attention incurs a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, quickly becoming the bottleneck for long context inference. A practical remedy is to evict less important KV entries; however, existing eviction policies are largely heuristic and struggle to capture the rich, input-dependent distribution of token importance. In this work, we introduce a learnable indexer that predicts KV importance, enabling more accurate retention of critical tokens. Meanwhile, naively evicting tokens permanently discards their information, leading to irreversible forgetting and degraded retrieval over long ranges. To address this, we propose a lightweight latent memory module that compresses evicted tokens into a compact, online-updated state and provides residual readouts to compensate for the attention contributions lost through KV eviction. Collectively, our method enables accurate long-context inference under a bounded KV budget, delivering consistent improvements on RULER (4K/16K) across Qwen, Mistral, and Llama models (up to 25 points under aggressive eviction), markedly more stable Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval, and superior LongBench scores and compression curves compared to existing eviction policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IndexMem，一种基于学习的KV缓存驱逐策略，结合潜在记忆模块来保留关键令牌信息，以在有限KV预算下实现长上下文推理。实验表明在RULER、Needle-in-a-Haystack和LongBench上比现有启发式方法有显著改进。
Motivation: 现有LLM长上下文推理中，KV缓存随序列长度线性增长成为瓶颈，而现有启发式驱逐策略难以捕捉令牌重要性的输入依赖分布，且永久驱逐导致信息丢失和长距离检索退化。
Method: 提出可学习的索引器预测KV重要性以更准确保留关键令牌，并设计轻量级潜在记忆模块压缩被驱逐令牌为紧凑在线更新状态，提供残差读出以补偿注意力损失。
Result: 在RULER（4K/16K）上，使用Qwen、Mistral和Llama模型，在激进驱逐下提升最多25点；Needle-in-a-Haystack检索更稳定；LongBench得分和压缩曲线优于现有策略。
Conclusion: 该方法在有限KV预算下实现精确的长上下文推理，减少信息丢失，提高检索稳定性，但未明确提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emergent Semantic Representations in World Models through Physical Interaction without Linguistic Supervision
papers.abstract_en: What does a world model learn from physical exploration, without any linguistic supervision? We argue the answer is organized by a single principle: the geometric structure of the physical world. Training a VAE-based world model on random embodied exploration, we find that its latent space develops spatial semantic structure that mirrors physical geometry -- direction accuracy 0.677+-0.029 versus 0.547 for a randomly initialized encoder, and position RSA 0.192+-0.047 versus 0.029 for random encoders (6.6x improvement), showing that training induces genuine structural organization beyond CNN inductive bias. Across 20 temporal checkpoints, prediction performance and semantic alignment co-improve (Spearman r=-0.61, p=0.004), consistent with the shared-driver account. We confirm this through a double knockout: standard KL regularization (beta=0.1) forces the encoder away from geometric structure, and both prediction performance and semantic alignment collapse simultaneously to near-chance by step 50,000 -- exactly as the shared-driver account predicts. Reducing beta to 0.001 restores geometric access and recovers both capabilities together. These findings establish physical world geometry as the organizing principle of world model representations, with direct implications for the design of semantically grounded embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无语言监督下世界模型通过物理探索获得的表征。基于VAE的世界模型在随机具身探索中，其潜在空间自发形成与物理几何对应的空间语义结构，方向准确率0.677（随机编码器0.547），位置RSA为0.192（随机编码器0.029，提升6.6倍）。双敲除实验（KL正则化）进一步证实预测性能与语义对齐的共变关系，表明物理世界几何是表征的组织原则。
Motivation: 探索无语言监督下世界模型从物理交互中学到的表征的组织原则，揭示其内在结构是否反映物理世界的几何。
Method: 训练VAE基世界模型进行随机具身探索，分析潜在空间的空间语义结构；通过20个时间检查点观察预测性能与语义对齐的共变；使用KL正则化的双敲除实验验证共享驱动假说。
Result: 方向准确率0.677±0.029 vs 随机0.547；位置RSA 0.192±0.047 vs 随机0.029（6.6倍提升）；预测与语义对齐共改善（Spearman r=-0.61, p=0.004）；KL正则化（beta=0.1）使两者同时崩溃，beta=0.001则恢复。
Conclusion: 物理世界几何是世界模型表征的组织原则，对设计具备语义基础的具身智能体有直接意义。

papers.title: Active Sensing with Meta-Reinforcement Learning for Emitter Localization from RF Observations
papers.abstract_en: Global navigation satellite system (GNSS) interference poses a serious threat to reliable positioning, especially in indoor and multipath-rich environments where source localization is highly challenging. In this paper, we formulate GNSS interference localization as an active sensing problem and propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which an agent sequentially explores the environment to infer the position of an emitter source from radio frequency (RF) observations acquired with a 2x2 patch antenna. The localization task is modeled as a partially observable decision process, since single-snapshot measurements are often ambiguous under multipath propagation and changing channel conditions. To address this, the proposed framework combines high-dimensional RF sensing with deep RL and recurrent policy learning. We investigate both value-based and policy-based approaches, namely Deep Q-Networks (DQN) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and study their behavior under domain shift. The approach is evaluated on a simulated dataset generated with the Sionna ray-tracing module, which provides realistic propagation effects and diverse environment configurations. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves a localization success rate of 80.1, demonstrating the potential of RL for adaptive GNSS interference localization. Overall, the results highlight simulation-assisted training as a promising direction for robust interference localization in challenging propagation environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个元强化学习（meta-RL）框架，将GNSS干扰源定位建模为主动感知问题。智能体通过2x2贴片天线获取RF观测，在部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中顺序探索环境以推断发射器位置。使用了DQN和PPO算法，在Sionna射线追踪模拟数据集上评估，达到80.1%的定位成功率，展示了强化学习在自适应干扰定位中的潜力。
Motivation: GNSS干扰对可靠定位构成威胁，尤其在室内和多径丰富的环境中。传统方法难以处理单快照测量的模糊性，亟需自适应、主动的定位策略。
Method: 将定位问题形式化为部分可观测决策过程，结合高维RF感知、深度强化学习（DQN和PPO）以及循环策略学习。智能体通过2x2贴片天线获取观测，序列化地选择探索动作以推断发射器位置。
Result: 在Sionna射线追踪模拟数据集上，所提方法达到80.1%的定位成功率。比较了值函数和策略梯度方法，并研究了域迁移下的行为。
Conclusion: 结果表明强化学习在自适应GNSS干扰定位中具有潜力，仿真辅助训练是应对挑战性传播环境的有前景方向。论文局限性在于仅在仿真中验证，未涉及真实RF数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Nano-U: Efficient Terrain Segmentation for Tiny Robot Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Terrain segmentation is a fundamental capability for autonomous mobile robots operating in unstructured outdoor environments. However, state-of-the-art models are incompatible with the memory and compute constraints typical of microcontrollers, limiting scalable deployment in small robotics platforms. To address this gap, we develop a complete framework for robust binary terrain segmentation on a low-cost microcontroller. At the core of our approach we design Nano-U, a highly compact binary segmentation network with a few thousand parameters. To compensate for the network's minimal capacity, we train Nano-U via Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD), combining knowledge distillation and quantization-aware training. This allows the final quantized model to achieve excellent results on the Botanic Garden dataset and to perform very well on TinyAgri, a custom agricultural field dataset with more challenging scenes. We deploy the quantized Nano-U on a commodity microcontroller by extending MicroFlow, a compiler-based inference engine for TinyML implemented in Rust. By eliminating interpreter overhead and dynamic memory allocation, the quantized model executes on an ESP32-S3 with a minimal memory footprint and low latency. This compiler-based execution demonstrates a viable and energy-efficient solution for perception on low-cost robotic platforms.
papers.comment: Code repository: https://github.com/federico-pizz/Nano-U Accepted at Towards Autonomous Robotic Systems (TAROS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nano-U，一种超紧凑二值地形分割网络（数千参数），结合量化感知蒸馏（QAD）训练，在 Botanic Garden 和 TinyAgri 数据集上取得良好效果。通过扩展基于 Rust 的 TinyML 编译器 MicroFlow，将量化模型部署到 ESP32-S3 微控制器，实现低内存占用和低延迟。
Motivation: 现有地形分割模型受限于微控制器的内存和计算资源，无法在低成本小型机器人平台上规模化部署。
Method: 设计 Nano-U 紧凑网络，采用量化感知蒸馏（QAD）联合知识蒸馏和量化感知训练；通过扩展 MicroFlow 编译器实现模型在微控制器上的高效推理。
Result: 在 Botanic Garden 数据集上表现优异，在更具挑战性的农业数据集 TinyAgri 上性能良好；在 ESP32-S3 上以极小内存和低延迟运行。
Conclusion: 编译器驱动的执行方式为低成本机器人平台上的感知提供了一种能效可行的解决方案。

papers.title: A Switching System Theory of Q-Learning with Linear Function Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Q-learning is a fundamental algorithmic primitive in reinforcement learning. This paper develops a new framework for analyzing linear Q-learning from a switching linear system (SLS) viewpoint, where linear Q-learning denotes Q-learning with linear function approximation. We derive a stochastic SLS representation of the linear Q-learning error and obtain a finite-time error analysis for linear Q-learning through the joint spectral radius (JSR) of the associated SLS family; the JSR is the exact worst-case exponential rate of the corresponding SLSs. The JSR-based rate is tied to the intrinsic worst-case exponential rate of the SLS representation. Moreover, we provide a JSR-based certificate for convergence of linear Q-learning, which can be less conservative than one-step norm bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从切换线性系统（SLS）视角重新审视线性Q-learning，将其误差建模为随机SLS，通过联合谱半径（JSR）给出最坏情况指数收敛速率，并导出有限时间误差界。JSR证书比传统一步范数界更不保守。
Motivation: 现有线性Q-learning收敛分析大多依赖一步范数界，结果较为保守，需要更精确刻画指数收敛速率。
Method: 将线性Q-learning的误差动态表示为随机切换线性系统，并利用联合谱半径（JSR）作为该SLS族的最坏情况指数增长率进行分析。
Result: 导出了基于JSR的有限时间误差上界，并证明JSR证书在刻画收敛性上优于传统的一步范数界。
Conclusion: 该SLS框架为线性Q-learning提供了一种新的理论分析工具，有望减少现有收敛条件的保守性。

papers.title: Annotation-free deep learning for detection and segmentation of fetal germinal matrix-intraventricular hemorrhage in brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Prenatal germinal matrix-intraventricular hemorrhage (GMH-IVH) is a leading cause of infant mortality and neurodevelopmental impairment, yet its manual diagnosis and lesion segmentation on fetal brain MRI are labor-intensive and error-prone. Although supervised deep learning offers potential for automation, it typically requires large amounts of annotated GMH-IVH data, which are challenging to obtain for such a rare condition (0.5-0.9 per 1000 pregnancies). To address these problems, an annotation-free deep learning framework, FreeHemoSeg, was developed for automated detection and segmentation of GMH-IVH without any real patient annotations. Instead of learning from expert labels, FreeHemoSeg was trained on pseudo GMH-IVH images synthesized from normal fetal data guided by medical priors. The framework was evaluated in a retrospective multicentre study of 1,674 stacks of 2D T2-weighted MRI from 558 pregnant women, using data from one hospital for internal training and validation and two hospitals for external validation. FreeHemoSeg achieved the highest diagnostic and segmentation performance in both internal validation (AUROC: 0.959; AUPR: 0.928; sensitivity: 0.914; specificity: 0.966; DSC: 0.559) and external validation (AUROC: 0.930; AUPR: 0.884; sensitivity: 0.824; specificity: 0.943; DSC: 0.512), outperforming a supervised model trained on limited empirical data and unsupervised anomaly detection methods. Moreover, FreeHemoSeg assistance improved radiologists' sensitivity (from 0.882 to 0.941-1.000) and diagnostic confidence, while reducing interpretation time by 16.0-52.7%. We anticipate its immediate utility in supporting earlier diagnosis, prognostic counselling, and perinatal planning for fetal GMH-IVH. Code: https://github.com/Arktis2022/FreeHemoSeg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出FreeHemoSeg，一种无需真实患者标注的深度学习框架，用于胎儿脑MRI中胚层基质-脑室内出血（GMH-IVH）的检测与分割。通过医学先验从正常胎儿数据合成伪出血图像进行训练。在多中心回顾性研究中，基于558名孕妇的1674个2D T2加权MRI堆栈，FreeHemoSeg在内部和外部验证中均获得高诊断和分割性能，并提升了放射科医生的敏感性和诊断信心。

papers.title: Direct Bethe Free Energy Minimization for Bayesian Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian neural networks are typically trained against the evidence lower bound (ELBO), whose Jensen gap closes only when the variational posterior is exact. We instead train by local consistency: gradient descent on the Bethe free energy, driving the belief at every factor toward agreement with its neighbours rather than placing a loss on the output. The resulting objective scores each observation by its own predictive density: a strictly proper rule whose optimum is the true conditional, for any likelihood with a tractable predictive convolution. Instantiated with a Gaussian last layer over a deterministic backbone, exact inference appears as one known corner: the neural-linear marginal likelihood. That corner is evidence-optimal; the shared-cavity, free-routed interior is predictive-optimal, improving NLL and calibration over it. This instance, SCROLL (Shared-Cavity fRee-rOuting Last-Layer), is a single-pass Bayesian neural network: batchable, any-likelihood, and implicitly empirical-Bayes-prior precision, observation noise, covariance, and backbone fit in one gradient pass. Prior work enters the interior only through the ELBO and its Jensen gap, even in this conjugate setting. At a single training run and forward pass per architecture-where the validation-tuned conventional references cross-validate $λ$ and ensembles pay $5$-$50\times$ at inference-a fixed SCROLL variant is best-or-tied on NLL and calibration on 7/8 UCI regression benchmarks, and best on 4/5 across three large tabular datasets (up to 515k examples) and two frozen text/vision embeddings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出直接最小化Bethe自由能（而非ELBO）来训练贝叶斯神经网络，通过局部一致性实现预测最优。该目标对于任意具有可处理预测卷积的似然函数都是严格正确的评分规则。实例化为SCROLL（共享腔自由路由最后一层），使用高斯最后一层和确定性骨干网络，单次前向传播即可完成贝叶斯推断。在UCI回归和大型表格数据集上，SCROLL取得了最佳的负对数似然和校准性能。
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯神经网络通常优化ELBO，但其Jensen间隙仅在变分后验精确时消失，导致次优预测。作者寻求一个直接优化预测密度的训练目标。
Method: 提出通过局部一致性训练：对Bethe自由能进行梯度下降，使每个因子的信念与其邻居一致，而非在输出上施加损失。实例化为SCROLL，即高斯最后一层加确定性骨干网络，通过单次前向传播实现贝叶斯推断，并隐式地联合优化经验贝叶斯先验精度、观测噪声、协方差和骨干网络参数。
Result: 在7/8个UCI回归基准上，SCROLL在NLL和校准上最佳或并列最佳；在三个大表格数据集（最多515k样本）和两个冻结文本/视觉嵌入上，在4/5个任务上最佳。与基于ELBO的方法相比，无需交叉验证正则化参数，且推理成本远低于集成方法。
Conclusion: 直接最小化Bethe自由能可以避免ELBO的Jensen间隙，获得预测最优的贝叶斯神经网络。SCROLL作为一种单次前向传播的方法，在多种基准上超越现有方法，且适用于任意似然函数。

papers.title: Defense effectiveness across architectural layers: a mechanistic evaluation of persistent memory attacks on stateful LLM agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory in LLM agents creates an attack surface that production safety classifiers do not observe: the payload enters via RAG retrieval and persists across sessions via tool-mediated memory. We evaluate six defenses across four architectural layers against delayed-trigger attacks on nine open-source models (5,040 runs, N=40 per condition). Five of six defenses fail: input-level filters never see the payload (it enters via RAG, not user input); retrieval-level classifiers observe it but cannot distinguish compliance-framed injection from legitimate policy; instruction-level hardening is overridden by the stored rule's compliance framing. Only tool-gating at the memory layer (Memory Sandbox) reduces ASR to 0% for eight of nine models, with zero utility cost. A reasoning model inverts this defense via goal-directed RAG fallback, a mechanism that replicates cross-family on Bedrock. A reasoning-mode ablation reveals a double dissociation: no single sandbox implementation is safe across both reasoning and non-reasoning model classes. We resolve this with a content-layer proof-of-concept (RATG), validated on non-reasoning models. A loaded-corpus frontier evaluation (21 models, 3 providers, N=40) overturns an initial empty-corpus screen showing 0/210 exfiltrations: that was a threat-model artifact, not model safety. Under realistic conditions, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview exfiltrates at 95% ASR, GPT-5.1 regresses to 22.5% relative to GPT-5 (5%), and Anthropic blocks at the injection layer (0-17.5% storage, 0% ASR). Nearly all OpenAI and Gemini models store the rule at 100% regardless of execution resistance, creating supply-chain risk in shared-memory deployments. Defense effectiveness is determined by architectural layer and reasoning capability, not classifier quality.

Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 95% ASR; GPT-5.1 regression (22.5%); tripartite vendor divergence. Code: github.com/junwenleong/stateful-agent-security-eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了针对有状态LLM agent（如通过RAG和工具记忆实现的持久记忆）的延迟触发攻击的防御有效性。在四个架构层（输入、检索、指令、工具门控）上对比六种防御，发现只有位于记忆层的工具门控（Memory Sandbox）对8/9个开源模型将攻击成功率降至0%，且无效用损失。但推理模型通过目标导向的RAG回退可绕过该防御，且推理模式消融实验显示无单一沙箱实现同时对推理和非推理模型安全。在更现实的负载语料库评估中，Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview达到95%攻击成功率，GPT-5.1退步至22.5%，Anthropic在注入层即实现阻断。防御效果取决于架构层和推理能力，而非分类器质量。
Motivation: LLM agent的持久记忆（通过RAG检索和工具记忆跨会话持久化）构成了生产安全分类器无法观察的攻击面。现有防御评估多基于空语料库或简化威胁模型，低估了实际风险。
Method: 构建延迟触发攻击（payload通过RAG注入并在后续会话中触发），在四个架构层（输入过滤、检索分类、指令加固、工具门控）评估六种防御。在9个开源模型上进行5040次运行（每条件N=40），并在21个模型（3个提供商）上扩展负载语料库评估。提出推理模式消融实验和内容层防御概念验证（RATG）。
Result: 输入层、检索层、指令层防御均失败；只有记忆层工具门控（Memory Sandbox）对8/9模型实现0% ASR。但推理模型可通过RAG回退绕过该防御。在负载语料库中，Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview的ASR为95%，GPT-5.1为22.5%，Anthropic为0%。所有模型存储规则的概率为100%，即使执行受阻，存在供应链风险。
Conclusion: 防御有效性取决于架构层和模型推理能力，而非分类器质量。推理模型与非推理模型需要不同的防御策略，单一沙箱实现不可安全跨类族部署。

papers.title: BioProVLA-Agent: An Affordable, Protocol-Driven, Vision-Enhanced VLA-Enabled Embodied Multi-Agent System with Closed-Loop-Capable Reasoning for Biological Laboratory Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Biological laboratory automation can reduce repetitive manual work and improve reproducibility, but reliable embodied execution in wet-lab environments remains challenging. Protocols are often unstructured, labware is frequently transparent or reflective, and multi-step procedures require state-aware execution beyond one-shot instruction following. Existing robotic systems often rely on costly hardware, fixed workflows, dedicated instruments, or robotics-oriented interfaces. Here, we introduce BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, protocol-driven, vision-enhanced embodied multi-agent system enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for biological manipulation. The system uses protocols as the task interface and integrates protocol parsing, visual state verification, and embodied execution in a closed-loop workflow. A Tailored LLM Protocol Agent converts protocols into verifiable subtasks; a VLM-RAG Verification Agent assesses readiness and completion using observations, robot states, retrieved knowledge, and success/failure examples; and a VLA Embodied Agent executes verified subtasks through a lightweight policy. To improve robustness under wet-lab visual perturbations, we develop AugSmolVLA, an online augmentation strategy targeting transparent labware, reflections, illumination shifts, and overexposure. We evaluate the system on a hierarchical benchmark covering 15 atomic tasks, 6 composite workflows, and 3 bimanual tasks, including tube loading, sorting, waste disposal, cap twisting, and liquid pouring. Across normal and high-exposure settings, AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes. These results suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BioProVLA-Agent，一个使用Vision-Language-Action (VLA)模型的低成本、协议驱动的视觉增强具身多智能体系统，用于生物实验室操作。系统将实验协议作为任务接口，通过协议解析、视觉状态验证和具身执行的闭环工作流完成操作。在包含15个原子任务、6个复合工作流和3个双手任务的分层基准上评估，AugSmolVLA策略在精确放置、透明物体操作、复合工作流和视觉退化场景中提升了执行稳定性。
Motivation: 生物实验室自动化需要减少重复手工劳动并提高可重复性，但湿实验室环境中的可靠具身执行面临协议非结构化、器皿透明或反光、多步骤需状态感知等挑战，现有系统依赖昂贵硬件和固定工作流。
Method: 系统包含三个智能体：Tailored LLM Protocol Agent将协议转换为可验证子任务；VLM-RAG Verification Agent通过观测、机器人状态、检索知识和成功/失败示例评估就绪与完成；VLA Embodied Agent通过轻量策略执行子任务。为应对湿实验室视觉扰动，开发了AugSmolVLA在线增强策略，针对透明器皿、反射、光照变化和过曝光进行增强。
Result: 在正常和高曝光设置下，AugSmolVLA在精确放置、透明物体操作、复合工作流和视觉退化场景中执行稳定性优于ACT、X-VLA和原始SmolVLA。
Conclusion: 本研究表明了一条通向可访问、协议中心、具备验证能力的生物操作具身AI的实用路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Undetectable Backdoors in Model Parameters: Hiding Sparse Secrets in High Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: We present Sparse Backdoor, a supply-chain attack that plants a provably undetectable backdoor in pre-trained image classifiers, including convolutional networks and Vision Transformers. The attack injects a structured sparse perturbation along a randomly chosen direction into a small subset of columns at each fully connected layer, propagating a trigger signal to an adversary-chosen target class, and masks the perturbation with an independent isotropic Gaussian dither. The dither serves a single technical purpose: it induces a clean reference distribution anchored at the pre-trained weights, against which undetectability can be formalized. Under a mild margin condition on the pre-trained classifier, we show that the dithered reference is functionally equivalent to the original classifier. We prove that distinguishing the backdoor-injected model from this reference is at least as hard as Sparse PCA detection, which is computationally infeasible under standard hardness assumptions. The guarantee holds against any probabilistic polynomial-time distinguisher with white-box access to the parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sparse Backdoor，一种在预训练图像分类器（包括卷积网络和视觉 Transformer）中植入可证明不可检测后门的供应链攻击。攻击者在全连接层的小部分列中注入结构化稀疏扰动，并用各向同性高斯抖动掩盖，使得区分后门模型与原始模型至少与稀疏 PCA 检测一样困难，在标准硬度假设下计算上不可行。
Motivation: 针对预训练模型供应链安全，现有后门攻击可能被检测，需要一种理论上不可检测的后门植入方法。
Method: 提出 Sparse Backdoor 攻击，在预训练分类器的每个全连接层随机选取小部分列，沿随机方向注入结构化稀疏扰动，并用独立各向同性高斯抖动掩盖扰动，使得后门模型与加了抖动后的参考分布不可区分。
Result: 证明在预训练分类器满足一定边界条件下，抖动后的参考模型与原始模型功能等价，并且区分后门模型与此参考至少与稀疏 PCA 检测一样困难，计算上不可行。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了一种可证明不可检测的后门攻击方法，对模型供应链安全构成威胁。

papers.title: ARISE: A Repository-level Graph Representation and Toolset for Agentic Program Repair and Fault Localization
papers.abstract_en: Automated program repair at repository scale requires an agent to locate a fault among thousands of files and synthesize a correct patch. Existing graph-based agents represent how a repository is organized into files, classes, and functions, but they do not model how variable values flow within a procedure, which leaves the agent without the semantic precision that function-level and line-level localization demand. We present ARISE (Agentic Repository-level Issue Solving Engine), a framework-agnostic toolset that builds a multi-granularity program graph, extending structural relationships down to statement-level nodes connected by intra-procedural definition-use edges, and exposes it through a three-tier tool API that mounts on any tool-use agentic framework. The central primitive is data-flow slicing, a queryable agent tool that traces in a single call which statements define or consume a variable of interest. On SWE-bench Lite (300 real GitHub issues across 11 Python repositories) with the open-source Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct backbone, mounting ARISE on SWE-agent as the host resolves 22.0% of issues (66/300), a 4.7 percentage-point gain over the unmodified SWE-agent baseline under the identical backbone and host. We show this gain is largely attributable to sharper localization, with Function Recall@1 (R@1) rising from 0.43 to 0.60 (a 40% relative gain) and Line R@1 from 0.26 to 0.41 (a 58% relative gain). Controlled ablations attribute the improvement to the data-flow graph rather than the tool schema, and we further mount the same toolset on a second host framework to study its portability. Decoupled from any single scaffold, the graph builder and slicing API form a drop-in toolset for future repair research.

papers.title: KARA: Efficient Reasoning LLM Serving via Sliding-Window KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models often generate long chain-of-thought (CoT), which accumulates a massive KV cache during the decoding phase and incurs high decoding latency and limited throughput. To address these issues, KV cache compression has emerged as a promising technique for reducing memory overhead by selectively removing unimportant KV pairs while preserving useful ones for subsequent decoding. Nevertheless, we identify two key limitations in existing KV cache compression methods: 1) their threshold-triggered compression policy may provide limited throughput improvement or even reduce throughput, and may fully eliminate KV pairs from certain blocks of the sequence, potentially worsening information loss. 2) they typically retain either isolated KV pairs or fixed-size chunks with rigid boundaries, failing to preserve important flexible-sized chunks at arbitrary token positions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Kara, a sliding-window KV cache compression method that performs decoding-time compression by operating only on the recently generated context. Kara leverages bidirectional attention to score and select informative KV pairs in the window. To enable flexible preservation of important semantic information, we design a Token2Chunk module to expand a subset of selected KV pairs into chunks. Furthermore, we adapt Kara to PagedAttention and develop KvLLM, an inference framework built upon vLLM, which reduces KV cache memory usage and effectively improves output throughput. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements of proposed Kara and KvLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KARA，一种基于滑动窗口的 KV 缓存压缩方法，用于高效服务推理型大语言模型。针对现有压缩方法的两个局限：阈值触发策略可能降低吞吐量或消除整块KV对，以及保留孤立KV对或固定大小块导致信息损失，KARA 采用双向注意力对窗口内KV对评分选择，并通过 Token2Chunk 模块扩展为灵活块。适配 PagedAttention 的 KvLLM 框架基于 vLLM 构建，实验表明在保持性能的同时减少缓存内存并提高输出吞吐量。
Motivation: 推理型语言模型生成长思维链导致解码阶段KV缓存巨大，造成高延迟和低吞吐量；现有KV缓存压缩方法存在吞吐量下降或信息丢失问题。
Method: 提出滑动窗口KV缓存压缩方法KARA，仅在最近生成的上下文上操作；利用双向注意力评分选择窗口内信息性KV对；设计Token2Chunk模块将选定的KV对扩展为块以灵活保留语义信息；并适配PagedAttention开发KvLLM推理框架。
Result: 实验表明KARA和KvLLM在多个任务上保持性能的同时降低KV缓存内存使用并提升输出吞吐量。
Conclusion: KARA通过滑动窗口和Token2Chunk有效克服现有压缩方法的局限性，实现高效推理服务。

papers.title: To Use AI as Dice of Possibilities with Timing Computation
papers.abstract_en: The dominant noun-based modeling paradigm, grounded in probability theory and committed to pre-specified noun entities as primitive modeling units, is insufficient as a \emph{grammar of thought}: It leaves \emph{timing} outside the computational scope, precluding any adequate representation of the future as an open space of possibilities. This paper addresses three conceptual gaps absent from the existing literature: (1) possibility space -- a framework admitting multiple possible timelines for the same event; (2) timing computation -- the treatment of timing as a computable rather than observed dimension; and (3) causal factum -- the maximal causal efficacy recovered by reasoning backward from possible futures, rather than assumed in advance. Together, these definitions dissolve the confounding problem inherent to noun-based causal inference and provide the foundation for a spontaneously growing causal-reasoning world model. As proof of concept, we instantiate the framework and apply it to longitudinal EHR data from 3,276 breast cancer patients, demonstrating for the first time, to our knowledge, automatic trajectory discovery and counterfactual timing deduction (i.e., a What-If Machine) in a purely data-driven manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判当前基于名词的建模范式无法处理时间维度，提出包含可能性空间、时间计算和因果事实三个概念的新框架，并应用于3,276名乳腺癌患者的纵向电子健康记录数据，以纯数据驱动方式实现了自动轨迹发现和反事实时间推理（What-If Machine）。
Motivation: 现有名词建模范式以预定的名词实体为基本单位，将时间排除在计算范围之外，无法表达未来作为开放可能性空间，且因果推断存在混杂问题。
Method: 提出三个概念：可能性空间（允许多个可能时间线）、时间计算（将时间处理为可计算维度）和因果事实（从可能未来反向推理最大因果效应）。实例化后应用于乳腺癌患者纵向EHR数据。
Result: 在3,276名乳腺癌患者数据上首次以纯数据驱动方式实现了自动轨迹发现和反事实时间推理。
Conclusion: 该框架为自生长的因果推理世界模型提供基础，并解决了名词因果推断中的混杂问题。

papers.title: Difix3D-W: Distractor-Free Few-Shot 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: We propose Difix3D-W, a 3D novel sparse-view synthesis framework for unconstrained real-world scenarios that contain distractors, occlusion, and appearance variation. Unlike existing methods that primarily perform novel-view synthesis from a sparse set of constrained images without transient elements or leverage unconstrained dense image collections in real-world scenarios, our method utilize sparse unconstrained images, showing high-quality 3D rendering results. To do this, we introduce reference-guided view refinement with a redesigned one-step diffusion model using a transient mask and a reference image to mitigate artifacts in rendered views, enhancing the 3D representation in the Gaussian field. Furthermore, we address sparse regions in the Gaussian field leveraging sparsity-aware Gaussian replication strategy to amplify Gaussians in the sparse regions and alleviate deficient camera viewpoint issues. Finally, we utilize LoRA and regularization to maintain 3D multi-view consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing methods. This advancement paves the way for realizing real-world scenarios without labor-intensive data acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Difix3D-W，一个用于无约束真实场景（包含干扰物、遮挡和外观变化）的3D稀疏视图合成框架。核心贡献包括：利用瞬态掩码和参考图像重新设计的一步扩散模型进行参考引导视图细化，缓解伪影；采用稀疏感知高斯复制策略处理稀疏区域；使用LoRA和正则化保持3D多视图一致性。实验表明该方法在稀疏无约束图像上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法要么从有限制条件的稀疏图像进行新视图合成，要么利用无约束的密集图像集合，但缺少针对稀疏无约束图像的高质量3D渲染方法。本文旨在解决这一空白，减少对密集数据采集的依赖。
Method: 引入参考引导视图细化，使用重新设计的一步扩散模型结合瞬态掩码和参考图像改善渲染视图；提出稀疏感知高斯复制策略增强稀疏区域中的高斯点；利用LoRA和正则化保持多视图一致性。

papers.title: Learning Coverage- and Power-Optimal Transmitter Placement from City Maps: A Comparative Study of Direct and Indirect Neural Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Optimal wireless transmitter placement is a central task in radio-network planning, and exhaustive search becomes prohibitively expensive at scale. This paper studies the single-transmitter setting under a learned propagation model, enabling exhaustive per-pixel assessment at scale in a regime where measurement-based labeling is infeasible and ray-tracing-based labeling is computationally out of reach. We introduce a dataset of 167525 urban scenarios (RadioMapSeer-Deployment) with dual ground-truth labels for coverage-optimal and power-optimal transmitter locations. Benchmark analysis reveals an asymmetric coverage-power trade-off: coverage-optimal placement sacrifices 13.86% of received-power, whereas power-optimal placement sacrifices 5.50% of coverage; the best balanced placement lies at $\bar{d}=2.60$ from the ideal point (100%,100%). We evaluate two learning formulations: indirect heatmap-based models predicting received-power radio maps, and direct score-map models predicting the objective landscape over feasible transmitter locations. Within the heatmap family, discriminative models deliver one-shot predictions 1350-2400$\times$ faster than exhaustive search, while diffusion models additionally support multi-sample inference that improves single-objective performance and, by reusing the same sample pool under a balanced criterion, recovers strong balanced placements without explicit multi-objective training. Dual score-map strategies combining power and coverage score-maps match the exhaustive balanced optimum ($\bar{d}=2.60$) and remain close to it across smaller candidate budgets, at 14-22$\times$ speedups including the cost of evaluating shortlisted candidates. Dual score-map methods are strongest overall, whereas heatmap formulations remain attractive for their physically meaningful intermediate maps and, in the diffusion setting, for inference-time search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于城市地图的无线发射机最优放置问题，提出一个包含167525个城市场景的数据集RadioMapSeer-Deployment，对比了间接热图模型（预测接收功率地图）和直接得分图模型（预测目标函数景观）两种学习范式。结果表明，直接双得分图方法在覆盖率和功率平衡上表现最优，接近穷举搜索的平衡最优解（d̄=2.60），而热图模型在推理速度上有优势（1350-2400倍加速），且扩散模型可通过多采样推理恢复强平衡放置。
Motivation: 无线发射机最优放置是无线网络规划的核心任务，但穷举搜索在大规模场景下计算代价过高。现有方法依赖标签或射线追踪，难以在无测量标签和大规模场景下扩展。
Method: 引入基于传播模型的学习框架，利用城市地图输入预测覆盖最优和功率最优的发射机位置。比较两类方法：间接热图模型（预测接收功率地图）和直接得分图模型（预测目标景观）。热图模型包括判别模型和扩散模型；得分图模型有双得分图策略。
Result: 覆盖最优放置牺牲13.86%的接收功率，功率最优放置牺牲5.50%的覆盖。双得分图方法匹配穷举平衡最优（d̄=2.60），并在候选预算较小时保持接近，速度提升14-22倍；热图模型中判别模型加速1350-2400倍，扩散模型通过多采样提升单目标性能并恢复强平衡。
Conclusion: 双得分图方法整体最强，热图模型因提供物理可解释的中间地图以及扩散模型的推理时搜索而仍有吸引力。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究基于城市地图的无线发射机最优放置问题，提出一个包含167525个城市场景的数据集RadioMapSeer-Deployment，对比了间接热图模型（预测接收功率地图）和直接得分图模型（预测目标函数景观）两种学习范式。结果表明，直接双得分图方法在覆盖率和功率平衡上表现最优，接近穷举搜索的平衡最优解（d̄=2.60），而热图模型在推理速度上有优势（1350-2400倍加速），且扩散模型可通过多采样推理恢复强平衡放置。
summary_sections.motivation: 无线发射机最优放置是无线网络规划的核心任务，但穷举搜索在大规模场景下计算代价过高。现有方法依赖标签或射线追踪，难以在无测量标签和大规模场景下扩展。
summary_sections.method: 引入基于传播模型的学习框架，利用城市地图输入预测覆盖最优和功率最优的发射机位置。比较两类方法：间接热图模型（预测接收功率地图）和直接得分图模型（预测目标景观）。热图模型包括判别模型和扩散模型；得分图模型有双得分图策略。
summary_sections.result: 覆盖最优放置牺牲13.86%的接收功率，功率最优放置牺牲5.50%的覆盖。双得分图方法匹配穷举平衡最优（d̄=2.60），并在候选预算较小时保持接近，速度提升14-22倍；热图模型中判别模型加速1350-2400倍，扩散模型通过多采样提升单目标性能并恢复强平衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 双得分图方法整体最强，热图模型因提供物理可解释的中间地图以及扩散模型的推理时搜索而仍有吸引力。

papers.title: OC-Distill: Ontology-aware Contrastive Learning with Cross-Modal Distillation for ICU Risk Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Early prediction of severe clinical deterioration and remaining length of stay can enable timely intervention and better resource allocation in high-acuity settings such as the ICU. This has driven the development of machine learning models that leverage continuous streams of vital signs and other physiological signals for real-time risk prediction. Despite their promise, existing methods have important limitations. Contrastive pretraining treats all patients as equally strong negatives, failing to capture clinically meaningful similarity between patients with related diagnoses. Meanwhile, downstream fine-tuning typically ignores complementary modalities such as clinical notes, which provide rich contextual information unavailable in physiological signals alone. To address these challenges, we propose OC-Distill, a two-stage framework that leverages multimodal supervision during training while requiring only vital signs at inference. In the first stage, we introduce an ontology-aware contrastive objective that exploits the ICD hierarchy to quantify patient similarity and learn clinically grounded representations. In the second stage, we fine-tune the pretrained encoder via cross-modal knowledge distillation, transferring complementary information from clinical notes into the model. Across multiple ICU prediction tasks on MIMIC, OC-Distill demonstrates improved label efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art performance among methods that use only vital signs at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OC-Distill，一个两阶段框架用于ICU风险预测。第一阶段引入基于ICD层次结构的本体感知对比学习，以捕捉患者间临床相似性；第二阶段通过跨模态知识蒸馏从临床笔记中迁移信息，推理时仅需生命体征。在MIMIC数据集上，该方法在多项ICU预测任务中取得最先进性能，并提高了标签效率。
Motivation: 现有对比学习将所有患者视为等强负样本，忽略诊断相关性；下游微调通常忽略临床笔记等多模态信息。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段使用本体感知对比目标，利用ICD层次结构量化患者相似度；第二阶段通过跨模态知识蒸馏，从临床笔记中蒸馏信息到仅用生命体征的编码器。
Result: 在MIMIC数据集上，OC-Distill在多个ICU预测任务中取得最先进性能，并展现出更好的标签效率。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了利用本体知识和跨模态蒸馏可以提升仅依赖生命体征的ICU风险预测性能，为临床决策支持提供了有效方法。

papers.title: Unveiling Stochasticity: Universal Multi-modal Probabilistic Modeling for Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Traffic forecasting is a challenging spatio-temporal modeling task and a critical component of urban transportation management. Current studies mainly focus on deterministic predictions, with limited considerations on the uncertainty and stochasticity in traffic dynamics. Therefore, this paper proposes an elegant yet universal approach that transforms existing models into probabilistic predictors by replacing only the final output layer with a novel Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) layer. The modified model requires no changes to the training pipeline and can be trained using only the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) loss, without any auxiliary or regularization terms. Experiments on multiple traffic datasets show that our approach generalizes from classic to modern model architectures while preserving deterministic performance. Furthermore, we propose a systematic evaluation procedure based on cumulative distributions and confidence intervals, and demonstrate that our approach is considerably more accurate and informative than unimodal or deterministic baselines. Finally, a more detailed study on a real-world dense urban traffic network is presented to examine the impact of data quality on uncertainty quantification and to show the robustness of our approach under imperfect data conditions. Code available at https://github.com/Weijiang-Xiong/OpenSkyTraffic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通用方法，通过将现有交通预测模型的最后一层替换为高斯混合模型（GMM）层，将其转化为概率预测器，无需修改训练流程，仅使用负对数似然损失训练。实验表明该方法能在保持确定性预测性能的同时提供更准确和丰富的不确定性量化，并在真实密集城市交通网络上验证了对不完美数据条件的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有交通预测模型主要关注确定性预测，忽视了交通动态中的不确定性和随机性，导致预测信息不完整。
Method: 提出一种通用方案：用高斯混合模型（GMM）层替换现有模型的输出层，将确定性输出转化为概率分布，训练时仅使用负对数似然（NLL）损失，无需辅助损失或正则化项。
Result: 在多个交通数据集上，该方法适用于从经典到现代的各种模型架构，且保持确定性预测性能；相比单峰或确定性基线，提供的概率预测更准确、信息更丰富；在真实密集交通网络中，对数据质量问题表现出鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种简单有效的途径将任何交通预测模型转化为概率预测器，有助于量化预测不确定性，并适用于数据质量不完美的实际场景。

papers.title: Open-Set Vein Biometric Recognition with Deep Metric Learning
papers.abstract_en: Most state-of-the-art vein recognition methods rely on closed-set classification, which inherently limits their scalability and prevents the adaptive enrollment of new users without complete model retraining. We rigorously evaluate the computational boundaries of Deep Metric Learning (DML) under strict open-set constraints. Unlike standard closed-set approaches, we analyze the impact of data scarcity and domain shift on recognition performance. Our approach learns discriminative L2-normalised embeddings and employs prototype-based matching with a calibrated similarity threshold to effectively distinguish between enrolled users and unseen impostors. We evaluate the framework under a strict subject-disjoint protocol across four diverse datasets covering finger, wrist, and dorsal hand veins (MMCBNU 6000, UTFVP, FYO, and a dorsal hand-vein dataset). On the large-scale MMCBNU 6000 benchmark, our best model (ResNet50-CBAM) achieves an OSCR of 0.9945, AUROC of 0.9974, and EER of 1.57%, maintaining high identification accuracy (99.6% Rank-1) while robustly rejecting unknown subjects. Cross-dataset experiments evaluate the framework's generalisation across different acquisition setups, confirming that while the model handles large-scale data robustly, performance remains sensitive to domain shifts in low-data regimes. Ablation studies demonstrate that triplet-based objectives combined with a simple 1-NN classifier offer an optimal trade-off between accuracy and efficiency, enabling real-time deployment on commodity hardware.

TL;DR: 本文研究开集静脉生物识别，使用深度度量学习（DML）学习区分性L2归一化嵌入，并通过原型匹配和校准的相似度阈值来区分注册用户和未见冒名者。在四个数据集上评估，包括手指、手腕和手背静脉，在MMCBNU 6000上最佳模型（ResNet50-CBAM）达到OSCR 0.9945，AUROC 0.9974，EER 1.57%，Rank-1识别率99.6%。跨数据集实验表明模型对大规模数据鲁棒，但对低数据域偏移敏感。
Motivation: 现有静脉识别方法大多基于闭集分类，限制了可扩展性，无法在不完全重新训练模型的情况下自适应注册新用户。
Method: 采用深度度量学习（DML）学习判别性L2归一化嵌入，使用原型匹配和校准相似度阈值进行开集识别。评估了多种网络结构和损失函数，包括ResNet50-CBAM和三胞胎损失结合1-NN分类器。
Result: 在MMCBNU 6000上，最佳模型OSCR 0.9945，AUROC 0.9974，EER 1.57%，Rank-1 99.6%。跨数据集实验显示对大规模数据鲁棒，但对低数据域偏移敏感。
Conclusion: 三胞胎目标结合简单的1-NN分类器提供了准确性和效率的最佳权衡，支持在商品硬件上实时部署。摘要强调开集约束下数据稀缺和域偏移的影响。

papers.title: A Complete Symmetry Classification of Shallow ReLU Networks
papers.abstract_en: Parameter space is not function space for neural network architectures. This fact, investigated as early as the 1990s under terms such as ``reverse engineering," or ``parameter identifiability", has led to the natural question of parameter space symmetries\textemdash the study of distinct parameters in neural architectures which realize the same function. Indeed, the quotient space obtained by identifying parameters giving rise to the same function, called the \textit{neuromanifold}, has been shown in some cases to have rich geometric properties, impacting optimization dynamics. Thus far, techniques towards complete classifications have required the analyticity of the activation function, notably excising the important case of ReLU. Here, in contrast, we exploit the non-differentiability of the ReLU activation to provide a complete classification of the symmetries in the shallow case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了浅层ReLU网络的参数空间对称性，即不同参数实现相同函数的问题。摘要指出，先前的方法需要激活函数的光滑性（如解析性），无法处理ReLU；本文则利用ReLU的非可微性，给出了浅层情况下参数对称性的完整分类。
Motivation: 参数空间与函数空间不一致导致参数对称性问题，理解这些对称性对优化动力学有重要意义。但现有分类方法依赖激活函数的解析性，无法覆盖ReLU这一重要情况。
Method: 利用ReLU激活函数的非可微性（non-differentiability），对浅层ReLU网络的参数对称性进行完整分类。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅声称提供了浅层ReLU网络对称性的完整分类。
Conclusion: 本文通过利用ReLU的非可微性，填补了先前对称性分类方法无法处理ReLU激活函数的空白，为理解ReLU网络的参数空间结构提供了理论依据。

papers.title: CableTract: A Co-Designed Cable-Driven Field Robot for Low-Compaction, Off-Grid Capable Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Conventional field operations spend most of their energy moving the tractor body, not the implement. Yet feasibility studies for novel agricultural vehicles rarely tie mechanics, energy harvest, draft, field geometry, economics, life-cycle CO2, and uncertainty quantification together on a single reproducible code path. This paper builds such a framework and applies it to CableTract, a two-module cable-driven field robot. A stationary Main Unit (winch + motor + battery + harvester module) (MU) and a lighter Anchor module (held by helical screw piles) tension a cable across a strip while a lightweight implement carriage rolls along it. The heavy bodies stay on the headland; only the carriage enters the field. The carriage runs a 10-implement library co-designed for the cable architecture. This co-design is the paper's central analytical lever. The framework is prototype-free. It chains a catenary cable model, a drivetrain efficiency chain, a stochastic draft model fitted to the co-designed library, an hourly solar + wind + battery simulator on six sites, a polygon coverage planner on a 50-field corpus, a contact-pressure compaction model, a discounted cash-flow economics engine with battery replacement and life-cycle CO2, and a global sensitivity analysis on 20 inputs. An operating-envelope sweep and an architectural-variant comparison close the loop. The full implementation is open source. Applied to the codesigned reference, the framework yields energy, compaction advantages and potential off-grid operation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个协同设计框架，并应用于CableTract——一种两模块电缆驱动田间机器人。该机器人由固定主单元（绞盘+电机+电池+收割机模块）和较轻的锚模块（由螺旋桩固定）构成，通过电缆牵引轻量载具沿缆移动，重体停留在田头。框架集成了悬链线电缆模型、传动效率链、随机牵引模型、可再生能源模拟、覆盖规划、接触压力压实模型、经济分析和生命周期CO2评估，并进行了工作包络扫描和架构变体比较。应用于协同设计的参考系统后，显示出能量和压实优势以及潜在的离网运行能力，且实现开源。
Motivation: 传统田间作业大部分能量用于移动拖拉机本体而非农具，而新型农业车辆的可行性研究很少将机械、能源、牵引力、田块几何、经济学、生命周期CO2和不确定性量化整合在同一可复现的代码路径上，缺乏系统性评估框架。
Method: 构建了一个无原型框架，包含悬链线电缆模型、传动效率链、基于协同设计工具库的随机牵引模型、六个站点的逐时太阳能+风能+电池模拟器、50块田地的多边形覆盖规划器、接触压力压实模型、带电池更换和生命周期CO2的折现现金流经济学引擎，以及全局敏感性分析，并通过工作包络扫描和架构变体比较完成闭环。
Result: 应用于协同设计的参考系统后，框架显示出能量和压实优势，并具备潜在的离网运行能力。
Conclusion: 该框架能够系统性地评估电缆驱动农业机器人的可行性，强调协同设计是核心分析杠杆，且开源实现便于复现与扩展。

summary_sections.method: 构建了一个无原型框架，包含悬链线电缆模型、传动效率链、基于协同设计工具库的随机牵引模型、六个站点的逐时太阳能+风能+电池模拟器、50块田地的多边形覆盖规划器、接触压力压实模型、带电池更换和生命周期CO2的折现现金流经济学引擎，以及全局敏感性分析，并通过工作包络扫描和架构变体比较完成闭环。
summary_sections.result: 应用于协同设计的参考系统后，框架显示出能量和压实优势，并具备潜在的离网运行能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架能够系统性地评估电缆驱动农业机器人的可行性，强调协同设计是核心分析杠杆，且开源实现便于复现与扩展。

papers.title: Large Language Models Generate Harmful Responses Using a Distinct Mechanism, Shared Across Harm Types
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) undergo alignment training to avoid harmful behaviors, yet the resulting safeguards remain brittle: jailbreaks routinely bypass them, and fine-tuning on narrow domains can induce ``emergent misalignment'' that generalizes broadly. Whether this brittleness reflects a fundamental lack of coherent internal organization for harmfulness remains unclear. Here we use targeted weight pruning as a causal intervention to probe the internal organization of harmfulness in LLMs. We find that harmful content generation depends on a compact set of weights that are general across harm types and distinct from benign capabilities. Aligned models exhibit a greater compression of harm generation weights than unaligned counterparts, indicating that alignment reshapes harmful representations internally--despite the brittleness of safety guardrails at the surface level. This compression explains emergent misalignment: if weights of harmful capabilities are compressed, fine-tuning that engages these weights in one domain can trigger broad misalignment. Consistent with this, pruning harm generation weights in a narrow domain substantially reduces emergent misalignment. Notably, LLMs harmful generation capability is dissociated from how they recognize and explain such content. Together, these results reveal a coherent internal structure for harmfulness in LLMs that may serve as a foundation for more principled approaches to safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过目标权重视听（targeted weight pruning）作为因果干预，发现大型语言模型中有害内容的生成依赖于一组紧凑的、跨有害类型通用且与良性能力分离的权重。对齐模型相比未对齐模型更压缩了这些权重，表明对齐在内部重塑了有害表示，这解释了突发性失调（emergent misalignment）：如果有害能力的权重被压缩，在某一领域微调会引发广泛失调。修剪窄领域的有害生成权重能大幅减少突发性失调。此外，有害生成能力与识别/解释有害内容的能力是分离的。
Motivation: 现有对齐方法仍然脆弱，越狱攻击和微调可以绕过安全机制，但有害性在模型内部的连贯组织结构尚不清楚，该研究旨在揭示这一机制。
Method: 使用目标权重视听作为因果干预，通过系统性剪枝来探查LLM中有害性相关的内部权重结构，并比较对齐与未对齐模型的差异。
Result: 有害内容生成依赖一组紧凑的、跨有害类型通用且与良性能力分离的权重；对齐模型的有害生成权重更压缩；这种压缩解释了突发性失调现象；修剪窄领域的有害权重可大幅减少突发性失调。
Conclusion: LLM内部存在有害性的连贯组织结构，对齐通过压缩有害表示来实现表面安全，但脆性源于压缩后的权重容易在微调中被激活，该发现可为更原则性的安全方法提供基础。

papers.title: Modelling Gas-Phase Reaction Kinetics with Guided Particle Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Physics-guided sampling with diffusion priors has recently shown strong performance in solving complex systems of partial differential equations (PDEs) from sparse observations. However, these methods are typically evaluated on benchmark problems that do not fully demonstrate their ability to generate temporally consistent solutions of time-dependent PDEs, often focusing instead on reconstructing a single snapshot. In this work, we apply these methods to gas-phase reaction kinetics problems governed by the advection-reaction-diffusion (ARD) equation, providing a setting that more closely reflects realistic laboratory experiments. We demonstrate that guided sampling can be used to reconstruct full spatiotemporal trajectories, rather than isolated states. Furthermore, we show that these methods generalise to previously unseen parameter regimes, highlighting their potential for real-world applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用引导粒子扩散采样（guided particle diffusion sampling）来重建气体相反应动力学中由平流-反应-扩散（ARD）方程控制的全时空轨迹，而非仅单个快照。该方法基于扩散先验的物理引导采样，在稀疏观测下求解复杂偏微分方程系统。实验表明，该方法能推广到未见过的参数范围，展示其在实际实验室应用中的潜力。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散先验的物理引导采样方法通常在仅重建单个快照的基准问题上评估，未能充分证明生成时间依赖偏微分方程时域一致解的能力。本文旨在将这些方法应用于更贴近真实实验室实验的气体相反应动力学问题。
Method: 采用引导扩散采样（guided diffusion sampling），以扩散先验为基础，通过物理信息引导从稀疏观测中重建完整时空轨迹。具体应用于由平流-反应-扩散（ARD）方程描述的气体相反应动力学系统。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能够重建完整的时空轨迹（而非孤立状态），并且能够泛化到之前未见过的参数范围。
Conclusion: 本文展示了引导粒子扩散采样在气体相反应动力学中的潜力，能够生成时域一致的解并推广到新参数范围，但摘要未提及具体限制。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Chronos: The AI Co-Historian
papers.abstract_en: AI is increasingly supporting, accelerating, and automating scientific discovery across subjects. Yet, the adoption of AI in historical research remains limited due to the lack of specialised solutions for historians. To change this, we introduce Chronos, an AI Co-Historian designed to support historians. It allows researchers to create and customize research workflows through natural-language interaction and share these as Chronos-Extensions with others. Chronos specifically addresses the need of historians for a tool that is specialised, non-technical, highly customizable, and facilitates extensive task evaluation. As a first extension, we introduce Chronos-Extract, which enables researchers to automate the targeted extraction of information from image scans of historical sources. We benchmark Chronos-Extract on three historical source corpora and find that it achieves high task-accuracy across primary sources spanning three centuries and diverse languages, layouts, and typefaces. Chronos is openly available and ready for historians to use on their own primary and secondary sources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Chronos，一个专为历史学家设计的AI协同历史学家系统。它允许研究人员通过自然语言创建和定制研究流程，并将其作为Chronos扩展共享。首个扩展Chronos-Extract能够从历史文献扫描中自动提取信息，在三个跨越三个世纪、多种语言和版式的历史语料库上取得了高任务准确率。
Motivation: 历史研究中AI采用有限，缺乏专门针对历史学家的解决方案，而历史学家需要专业化、非技术性、高度可定制且能进行广泛任务评估的工具。
Method: Chronos通过自然语言交互支持研究人员创建和定制研究流程，并允许共享为Chronos扩展。Chronos-Extract作为首个扩展，利用AI自动化从历史文献扫描中提取目标信息。
Result: 在三个历史资料语料库（跨越三个世纪、多种语言、版式和字体）上的基准测试显示，Chronos-Extract实现了很高的任务准确率。
Conclusion: Chronos已开放可用，历史学家可将其用于自己的主要和次要历史资料，有望推动AI在历史研究中的采用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LivingWorld: Interactive 4D World Generation with Environmental Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LivingWorld, an interactive framework for generating 4D worlds with environmental dynamics from a single image. While recent advances in 3D scene generation enable large-scale environment creation, most approaches focus primarily on reconstructing static geometry, leaving scene-scale environmental dynamics such as clouds, water, or smoke largely unexplored. Modeling such dynamics is challenging because motion must remain coherent across an expanding scene while supporting low-latency user feedback. LivingWorld addresses this challenge by progressively constructing a globally coherent motion field as the scene expands. To maintain global consistency during expansion, we introduce a geometry-aware alignment module that resolves directional and scale ambiguities across views. We further represent motion using a compact hash-based motion field, enabling efficient querying and stable propagation of dynamics throughout the scene. This representation also supports bidirectional motion propagation during rendering, producing long and temporally coherent 4D sequences without relying on expensive video-based refinement. On a single RTX 5090 GPU, generating each new scene expansion step requires 9 seconds, followed by 3 seconds for motion alignment and motion field updates, enabling interactive 4D world generation with globally coherent environmental dynamics. Video demonstrations are available at paper.pnu-cvsp.com/LivingWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LivingWorld 是一个交互式 4D 世界生成框架，能够从单张图像生成包含云、水、烟雾等环境动态的扩展场景。该方法通过逐步构建全局一致的运动场，并引入几何感知对齐模块解决多视角方向和尺度歧义，同时使用紧凑的哈希运动场实现高效查询和稳定传播。在单张 RTX 5090 GPU 上，每个新场景扩展步骤耗时 9 秒，运动对齐和更新耗时 3 秒，支持低延迟用户交互。
Motivation: 现有 3D 场景生成方法主要关注静态几何重建，缺乏对场景级环境动态（如云、水、烟雾）的建模，且动态需要在场景扩展时保持全局一致并支持低延迟交互。
Method: 提出逐步构建全局一致的运动场，使用几何感知对齐模块解决方向与尺度歧义，并采用紧凑的哈希运动场表示运动，支持双向运动传播以生成长时 4D 序列。
Result: 在单张 RTX 5090 GPU 上，每个新场景扩展步骤耗时 9 秒，运动对齐和更新耗时 3 秒，生成长而时间一致的 4D 序列，无需视频细化。
Conclusion: LivingWorld 实现了交互式 4D 世界生成，具有全局一致的环境动态，但未涉及具体气象预报或同化任务。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Streaming Model Cascades for Semantic SQL
papers.abstract_en: Modern data warehouses extend SQL with semantic operators that invoke large language models on each qualifying row, making per-row inference orders of magnitude more expensive than traditional SQL. Model cascades reduce this cost by routing most rows through a fast proxy model and delegating uncertain cases to an expensive oracle. Prior SUPG-style cascades, however, require a global proxy-score pass that is itself an LLM-inference workload and blocks output in pipelined query engines. They also target either precision or recall and cannot serve workloads that need both. We formalize the cascade routing problem for streaming semantic SQL with independent parallel workers and present two complementary algorithms within this model. SUPG-IT extends SUPG from single-pass, single-metric estimation to streaming execution by iteratively refining two thresholds as oracle labels accumulate across batches, and is the first streaming cascade with joint probabilistic guarantees on user-specified precision and recall at a chosen failure probability $δ$. GAMCAL replaces user-specified targets with a single tradeoff parameter $α$ between classification error and oracle cost, and learns a monotone Generalized Additive Model that calibrates proxy scores to true-positive probabilities and supplies pointwise uncertainty for stochastic routing. On six classification, filtering, and join benchmarks evaluated in a production semantic SQL engine, both algorithms reach $F_1 \geq 0.95$ at their best operating points. GAMCAL also leads all six datasets at a 20% delegation budget and reaches $F_1 \geq 0.95$ with up to 58% fewer oracle calls than LOTUS's SUPG cascade. SUPG-IT attains the highest best-case $F_1$, with a mean of 0.989 across the six datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语义SQL中每行调用大模型的高昂成本，提出两种流式模型级联算法：SUPG-IT和GAMCAL。SUPG-IT在流式执行中迭代优化阈值，首次在用户指定精度和召回率下提供联合概率保证；GAMCAL通过可加模型平衡分类错误与代价。在六个基准上，两者均达到F1≥0.95，GAMCAL在20%委派预算下优于LOTUS的SUPG级联，SUPG-IT平均最佳F1为0.989。
Motivation: 现代数据仓库中语义SQL每行调用大模型成本高昂，现有模型级联方法（如SUPG）需要全局代理评分且仅针对精度或召回率，无法满足流式执行和双目标需求。
Method: 提出两种算法：SUPG-IT在流式执行中迭代更新两个阈值，提供精度和召回率的联合概率保证；GAMCAL用单参数α替代用户指定目标，学习单调广义可加模型校准代理分数，并给出逐点不确定性用于随机路由。
Result: 在生产语义SQL引擎的六个分类、过滤和连接基准上，两种算法最佳操作点F1≥0.95；GAMCAL在20%委派预算下领先所有数据集，比LOTUS的SUPG级联节省高达58%的Oracle调用；SUPG-IT平均最佳F1达0.989。
Conclusion: 本文证明了流式模型级联在语义SQL中能同时保证精度和召回率，并有效降低推理成本。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.result: 在生产语义SQL引擎的六个分类、过滤和连接基准上，两种算法最佳操作点F1≥0.95；GAMCAL在20%委派预算下领先所有数据集，比LOTUS的SUPG级联节省高达58%的Oracle调用；SUPG-IT平均最佳F1达0.989。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文证明了流式模型级联在语义SQL中能同时保证精度和召回率，并有效降低推理成本。

papers.title: Walma: Learning to See Memory Corruption in WebAssembly
papers.abstract_en: WebAssembly's (Wasm) monolithic linear memory turns a single memory-corruption bug into a bidirectional threat: a compromised module can attack its embedding host, and a malicious host can tamper with a trusted module's state. Existing defenses require custom runtimes or source changes, and none can verify runtime integrity under an adversarial host. We present Walma, a framework for WebAssembly linear memory attestation that renders snapshots of linear memory as grayscale images and classifies them with a convolutional neural network. The network reads the row-aligned structure that compiled code imposes on memory and detects corruption that byte and texture statistics miss. On structured targets this extends to tampering that no program input triggers, such as direct memory writes by a malicious host. On real-world CVE-affected applications, hiding corruption from Walma's verdict requires overwriting a large fraction of memory, hundreds of kilobytes to megabytes on our targets. A Shannon-entropy analysis of benign memory bounds the class of out-of-band edits that the learned prior can detect. Across the 53 binaries of the WABench suite, attestation costs 1.07x--1.69x at the host boundary, making continuous, state-centric memory attestation for Wasm practical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Walma 框架，将 WebAssembly 线性内存快照转为灰度图像，用卷积神经网络检测内存损坏，能够抵抗恶意宿主篡改。在 WABench 套件的 53 个二进制文件上，认证开销为 1.07x--1.69x，使得连续、状态中心的内存认证变得实用。
Motivation: WebAssembly 的线性内存使单个内存损坏漏洞成为双向威胁，现有防御需要自定义运行时或源码修改，且无法在恶意宿主下验证运行时完整性。
Method: 将线性内存快照渲染为灰度图像，使用卷积神经网络学习编译代码施加的行对齐结构，检测字节和纹理统计无法发现的损坏。
Result: 在真实 CVE 影响的应用上，隐藏损坏需要覆盖数百 KB 到 MB 的内存；Shannon 熵分析界定了可检测的带外编辑；WABench 套件上认证开销为 1.07x--1.69x。
Conclusion: Walma 为 WebAssembly 提供了实用的连续内存认证，能够抵抗恶意宿主攻击，但可能受限于内存结构化的目标。

papers.title: AgentFoX: LLM Agent-Guided Fusion with eXplainability for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: The realism of AI-generated images (AIGI) poses increasing challenges for reliable forensic detection, where heterogeneous expert detectors may produce conflicting predictions across diverse generative sources and post-processing conditions. Existing multi-expert fusion methods rely on fixed rules or learned fusion strategies, offering limited ability to assess sample-specific reliability, execute rigorous adjudication of conflicts, and provide evidence-grounded explanations. We propose AgentFoX, an LLM-driven agentic multi-expert framework for AIGI detection that employs a command-and-reasoning core to perform evidence fusion. Following predefined guidelines, the core coordinates designated subtasks to collect semantic and signal-level evidence, reason over structured contexts to determine authenticity, and generate an auditable report for explainability. During this process, Expert Profiles are constructed for model-centric reliability assessment, while Clustering Profiles are built for data-centric contextual analysis, jointly establishing evidence contexts for conflict resolution. Extensive evaluations across diverse benchmarks demonstrate the robustness and generalizability of AgentFoX under complex conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentFoX，一个基于 LLM 驱动的智能体多专家融合框架，用于 AI 生成图像检测。该框架通过命令与推理核心协调专家子任务，收集语义和信号级证据，构建专家剖面和聚类剖面以解决冲突，并生成可审计的解释报告。在多个基准上验证了其鲁棒性和泛化性。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测的多专家融合方法依赖固定规则或学习策略，难以评估样本级可靠性、处理冲突并提供可解释证据。
Method: 提出 LLM 驱动的智能体框架 AgentFoX，包含命令与推理核心，协调专家子任务收集证据，构建专家剖面（模型中心可靠性评估）和聚类剖面（数据中心上下文分析），并生成可解释报告。
Result: 在多样化基准上验证了框架在复杂条件下的鲁棒性和泛化性。
Conclusion: AgentFoX 通过智能体机制和证据上下文构建，提升了 AI 生成图像检测的融合效果和可解释性。

papers.title: Dress-ED: Instruction-Guided Editing for Virtual Try-On and Try-Off
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Virtual Try-On (VTON) and Virtual Try-Off (VTOFF) have greatly improved photo-realistic fashion synthesis and garment reconstruction. However, existing datasets remain static, lacking instruction-driven editing for controllable and interactive fashion generation. In this work, we introduce the Dress Editing Dataset (Dress-ED), the first large-scale benchmark that unifies VTON, VTOFF, and text-guided garment editing within a single framework. Each sample in Dress-ED includes an in-shop garment image, the corresponding person image wearing the garment, their edited counterparts, and a natural-language instruction of the desired modification. Built through a fully automated multimodal pipeline that integrates MLLM-based garment understanding, diffusion-based editing, and LLM-guided verification, Dress-ED comprises over 146k verified quadruplets spanning three garment categories and seven edit types, including both appearance (e.g., color, pattern, material) and structural (e.g., sleeve length, neckline) modifications. Based on this benchmark, we further propose a unified multimodal diffusion framework that jointly reasons over linguistic instructions and visual garment cues, serving as a strong baseline for instruction-driven VTON and VTOFF. Dataset and code available at this link: https://github.com/aimagelab/Dress-ED
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page at https://aimagelab.github.io/Dress-ED/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 Dress Editing Dataset (Dress-ED)，第一个大规模统一虚拟试穿 (VTON)、虚拟脱衣 (VTOFF) 和文本引导服装编辑的基准数据集。通过自动化多模态流水线构建，包含超过146k个验证过的四元组，涵盖三种服装类别和七种编辑类型。基于此，作者提出了一个统一的多模态扩散框架作为指令驱动 VTON/VTOFF 的强基线。
Motivation: 现有虚拟试穿和虚拟脱衣数据集是静态的，缺乏指令驱动的编辑能力，无法实现可控和交互式的时尚生成。
Method: 构建 Dress-ED 数据集：采用全自动多模态流水线，集成基于 MLLM 的服装理解、基于扩散的编辑和 LLM 引导的验证。同时提出统一的多模态扩散框架，联合推理语言指令和视觉服装线索。
Result: Dress-ED 包含超过 146k 个经过验证的四元组，覆盖三种服装类别和七种编辑类型（外观和结构修改）。
Conclusion: 该数据集和框架为指令驱动的虚拟试穿和脱衣提供了统一的基准和基线，推动了可控时装生成的研究。

papers.title: A Two-stage Transformer Framework for Temporal Localization of Distracted Driver Behaviors
papers.abstract_en: The identification of hazardous driving behaviors from in-cabin video streams is essential for enhancing road safety and supporting the detection of traffic violations and unsafe driver actions. However, current temporal action localization techniques often struggle to balance accuracy with computational efficiency. In this work, we develop and evaluate a temporal action localization framework tailored for driver monitoring scenarios, particularly suitable for periodic inspection settings such as transportation safety checkpoints or fleet management assessment systems. Our approach follows a two-stage pipeline that combines VideoMAE-based feature extraction with an Augmented Self-Mask Attention (AMA) detector, enhanced by a Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Fast (SPPF) module to capture multi-scale temporal features. Experimental results reveal a distinct trade-off between model capacity and efficiency. At the feature extraction stage, the ViT-Giant backbone delivers higher representations with 88.09% Top-1 test accuracy, while the ViT-based variant proves to be a practical alternative, achieving 82.55% accuracy with significantly lower computational fine-tuning costs (101.85 GFLOPs/segment compared to 1584.06 GFLOPs/segment for Giant). In the downstream localization task, the integration of SPPF consistently improves performance across all configurations. Notably, the ViT-Giant + SPPF model achieves a peak mAP of 92.67%, while the lightweight ViT-based configuration maintains robust results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对车内视频中危险驾驶行为的时间定位问题，提出一个两阶段pipeline：VideoMAE特征提取 + 增强自掩膜注意力（AMA）检测器，并引入空间金字塔池化快速模块（SPPF）捕获多尺度时间特征。实验表明模型容量与效率之间存在权衡：ViT-Giant骨干在特征提取阶段达到88.09% Top-1测试准确率但计算成本高，而轻量ViT变体以较低计算量达到82.55%准确率。在下游定位任务中，SPPF模块持续提升性能，ViT-Giant+SPPF达到92.67%的峰值mAP。
Motivation: 现有时间动作定位方法难以同时保证准确性和计算效率，尤其在驾驶员监控场景（如安全检查点、车队管理评估系统）中需要权衡。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段使用VideoMAE进行特征提取，第二阶段使用增强自掩膜注意力（AMA）检测器，并集成空间金字塔池化快速（SPPF）模块以捕获多尺度时间特征。
Result: 特征提取阶段：ViT-Giant达到88.09% Top-1准确率，但计算量高达1584.06 GFLOPs/segment；ViT变体以82.55%准确率和101.85 GFLOPs/segment提供轻量替代。下游定位中，SPPF持续提升性能；ViT-Giant+SPPF达到92.67% mAP。
Conclusion: 摘要强调两阶段框架在驾驶员行为时间定位中的有效性，并揭示了模型容量与效率的明确权衡，SPPF模块对多尺度特征捕获有贡献。
