papers.title: Clinical Cognition Alignment for Gastrointestinal Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in medical image analysis. However, their application in gastrointestinal endoscopy is currently hindered by two critical limitations: the misalignment between general model reasoning and standardized clinical cognitive pathways, and the lack of causal association between visual features and diagnostic outcomes. In this paper, we propose a novel Clinical-Cognitive-Aligned (CogAlign) framework to address these challenges. First, we endow the model with rigorous clinical analytical capabilities by constructing the hierarchical clinical cognition dataset and employing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Unlike conventional approaches, this strategy internalizes the hierarchical diagnostic logic of experts, ranging from anatomical localization and morphological evaluation to microvascular analysis, directly into the model. Second, to eliminate visual bias, we provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that standard supervised tuning inevitably converges to spurious background correlations. Guided by this insight, we propose a counterfactual-driven reinforcement learning strategy to enforce causal rectification. By generating counterfactual normal samples via lesion masking and optimizing through clinical-cognition-centric rewards, we constrain the model to strictly ground its diagnosis in causal lesion features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SoTA) performance across multiple benchmarks, significantly enhancing diagnostic accuracy in complex clinical scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出临床认知对齐框架 (CogAlign) 用于多模态大模型在胃肠内镜诊断中的改进。通过层级临床认知数据集和监督微调内化专家诊断逻辑，并采用反事实驱动的强化学习消除背景伪相关，在多个基准上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 在胃肠内镜应用中存在两大限制：模型推理与标准化临床认知路径不对齐，以及视觉特征与诊断结果之间缺乏因果关联。
Method: 构建层级临床认知数据集进行监督微调，使模型学习专家的层级诊断逻辑（解剖定位、形态评估、微血管分析）；理论分析标准监督调优会收敛到背景伪相关，据此提出反事实驱动强化学习，通过病灶掩码生成反事实正常样本，并用临床认知奖励优化。
Result: 在多个基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，在复杂临床场景中显著提升诊断准确性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过临床认知对齐和因果矫正可有效提升 MLLM 在胃肠内镜诊断中的准确性和可解释性。

papers.title: On the Ability of Transformers to Verify Plans
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have shown inconsistent success in AI planning tasks, and theoretical understanding of when generalization should be expected has been limited. We take important steps towards addressing this gap by analyzing the ability of decoder-only models to verify whether a given plan correctly solves a given planning instance. To analyse the general setting where the number of objects -- and thus the effective input alphabet -- grows at test time, we introduce C*-RASP, an extension of C-RASP designed to establish length generalization guarantees for transformers under the simultaneous growth in sequence length and vocabulary size. Our results identify a large class of classical planning domains for which transformers can provably learn to verify long plans, and structural properties that significantly affects the learnability of length generalizable solutions. Empirical experiments corroborate our theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究decoder-only Transformer验证给定计划是否正确解决规划实例的能力。为解决测试时对象数量增长导致的输入字母表扩大问题，作者提出C*-RASP，扩展了C-RASP以建立序列长度和词汇表同时增长下的长度泛化保证。理论识别了一类经典规划域，Transformer可证明地学习验证长计划，并揭示了影响可学习性的结构性质，实验支持了理论。
Motivation: Transformer在AI规划任务中表现不一致，对于何时应期待泛化的理论理解有限，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 引入C*-RASP，这是C-RASP的扩展，用于分析decoder-only模型在序列长度和词汇表同时增长时验证计划的能力，并给出长度泛化保证。
Result: 识别了一类经典规划域，其中Transformer可证明地学习验证长计划；同时指出了显著影响可学习长度泛化解的结构性质，实验验证了理论。

papers.title: SIMPLER: Efficient Foundation Model Adaptation via Similarity-Guided Layer Pruning for Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning foundation models for Earth Observation is computationally expensive, with high training time and memory demands for both training and deployment. Parameter-efficient methods reduce training cost but retain full inference complexity, while post-hoc compression optimizes inference only after costly full fine-tuning. We introduce SIMPLER, a pre-fine-tuning architecture selection method that reduces inference and deployment costs by identifying an effective model depth before adaptation. SIMPLER exploits stabilization of representations in deeper layers of pre-trained vision transformers: it computes layer-wise representation similarity on unlabeled task data and applies an automated scoring function to select redundant layers, with no gradients, magnitude heuristics, or hyperparameter tuning required. On Prithvi-EO-2, SIMPLER prunes up to 79% of parameters while retaining 94% of baseline performance, yielding a 2.1x training speedup and 2.6x inference speedup. The method generalizes to TerraMind (a multimodal EO foundation model) and ImageNet-pretrained ViT-MAE, demonstrating applicability across tasks, architectures, and spectral modalities. Code is available at https://gitlab.citius.gal/hpc4rs/simpler.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIMPLER 是一种在微调前进行架构选择的方法，通过计算未标注任务数据上的层表示相似性来自动识别并剪枝冗余层，从而降低地球观测基础模型的推理和部署成本。在 Prithvi-EO-2 上可剪枝 79% 的参数，保留 94% 的基线性能，并实现 2.1 倍训练加速和 2.6 倍推理加速。该方法无需梯度、幅度启发式或超参数调优，并泛化到其他基础模型。
Motivation: 地球观测基础模型微调计算成本高，现有参数高效方法在训练后仍保留完整推理复杂度，而事后压缩需要昂贵的完整微调。
Method: 利用预训练视觉 Transformer 深层表示稳定性，在未标注任务数据上计算逐层表示相似性，通过自动评分函数选择冗余层进行剪枝。
Result: 在 Prithvi-EO-2 上剪枝 79% 参数，保留 94% 性能；训练加速 2.1 倍，推理加速 2.6 倍。泛化到 TerraMind 和 ImageNet 预训练的 ViT-MAE。
Conclusion: SIMPLER 提供了一种在微调前高效选择模型深度的方法，降低训练和推理成本，无需额外超参数，且适用于多种架构和模态。

papers.title: Fourier Splatting: Generalized Fourier encoded primitives for scalable radiance fields
papers.abstract_en: Novel view synthesis has recently been revolutionized by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), which enables real-time rendering through explicit primitive rasterization. However, existing methods tie visual fidelity strictly to the number of primitives: quality downscaling is achieved only through pruning primitives. We propose the first inherently scalable primitive for radiance field rendering. Fourier Splatting employs scalable primitives with arbitrary closed shapes obtained by parameterizing planar surfels with Fourier encoded descriptors. This formulation allows a single trained model to be rendered at varying levels of detail simply by truncating Fourier coefficients at runtime. To facilitate stable optimization, we employ a straight-through estimator for gradient extension beyond the primitive boundary, and introduce HYDRA, a densification strategy that decomposes complex primitives into simpler constituents within the MCMC framework. Our method achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality among planar-primitive frameworks and comparable perceptual metrics compared to leading volumetric representations on standard benchmarks, providing a versatile solution for bandwidth-constrained high-fidelity rendering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出傅里叶溅射（Fourier Splatting），一种基于傅里叶编码的可缩放原语用于辐射场渲染。该方法通过参数化平面surfel的傅里叶描述符，允许单个训练模型在运行时通过截断傅里叶系数来渲染不同细节层次，并引入直通估计器和HYDRA致密化策略。实验表明，在平面原语框架中达到最先进渲染质量，与顶级体积表示相比感知指标相当。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯溅射等方法将视觉质量与基本原语数量严格绑定，质量降级仅能通过修剪原语实现，缺乏内在可缩放性。
Method: 提出可缩放原语，使用傅里叶编码描述符参数化任意闭合形状的平面surfel；采用直通估计器（straight-through estimator）进行梯度扩展，并提出HYDRA策略，在MCMC框架内将复杂原语分解为更简单的组成成分。
Result: 在标准基准上，该方法在平面原语框架中实现了最先进的渲染质量，与顶级体积表示相比达到可比的感知指标。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种适用于带宽受限的高保真渲染的通用解决方案，能够在运行时通过傅里叶系数截断实现不同细节层次。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HUGE-Bench: A Benchmark for High-Level UAV Vision-Language-Action Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Existing UAV vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks have enabled language-guided flight, but they largely focus on long, step-wise route descriptions with goal-centric evaluation, making them less diagnostic for real operations where brief, high-level commands must be grounded into safe multi-stage behaviors. We present HUGE-Bench, a benchmark for High-Level UAV Vision-Language-Action (HL-VLA) tasks that tests whether an agent can interpret concise language and execute complex, process-oriented trajectories with safety awareness. HUGE-Bench comprises 4 real-world digital twin scenes, 8 high-level tasks, and 2.56M meters of trajectories, and is built on an aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-Mesh representation that combines photorealistic rendering with collision-capable geometry for scalable generation and collision-aware evaluation. We introduce process-oriented and collision-aware metrics to assess process fidelity, terminal accuracy, and safety. Experiments on representative state-of-the-art VLA models reveal significant gaps in high-level semantic completion and safe execution, highlighting HUGE-Bench as a diagnostic testbed for high-level UAV autonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了HUGE-Bench，一个用于高层无人机视觉-语言-动作（HL-VLA）任务的基准。该基准包含4个真实世界数字孪生场景、8个高层任务和256万米轨迹，基于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）-网格表示，支持碰撞感知评估。实验显示现有VLA模型在高层次语义完成和安全执行方面存在显著差距。
Motivation: 现有无人机视觉语言导航基准主要关注长序列逐步描述，缺乏对简洁高层指令在安全多阶段行为中的诊断能力。
Method: 构建基于3DGS-网格对齐表示的4个数字孪生场景，定义8个高层任务，引入过程导向和碰撞感知指标。
Result: 在代表性VLA模型上实验，发现模型在高层次语义完成和安全管理方面存在显著差距。
Conclusion: HUGE-Bench作为高层无人机自主性的诊断测试平台，揭示了现有模型的不足。

papers.title: VesselTok: Tokenizing Vessel-like 3D Biomedical Graph Representations for Reconstruction and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Spatial graphs provide a lightweight and elegant representation of curvilinear anatomical structures such as blood vessels, lung airways, and neuronal networks. Accurately modeling these graphs is crucial in clinical and (bio-)medical research. However, the high spatial resolution of large networks drastically increases their complexity, resulting in significant computational challenges. In this work, we aim to tackle these challenges by proposing VesselTok, a framework that approaches spatially dense graphs from a parametric shape perspective to learn latent representations (tokens). VesselTok leverages centerline points with a pseudo radius to effectively encode tubular geometry. Specifically, we learn a novel latent representation conditioned on centerline points to encode neural implicit representations of vessel-like, tubular structures. We demonstrate VesselTok's performance across diverse anatomies, including lung airways, lung vessels, and brain vessels, highlighting its ability to robustly encode complex topologies. To prove the effectiveness of VesselTok's learnt latent representations, we show that they (i) generalize to unseen anatomies, (ii) support generative modeling of plausible anatomical graphs, and (iii) transfer effectively to downstream inverse problems, such as link prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VesselTok 是一个将血管、气道等管状生物医学结构表示为空间图并学习其潜在标记（tokens）的框架。该方法利用中心线点和伪半径编码管状几何，通过隐式神经表示对复杂拓扑进行建模。实验表明，学到的潜在表示能够泛化到未见解剖结构，支持生成建模，并有效迁移到链接预测等下游任务。
Motivation: 高分辨率空间图（如血管网络）的复杂性带来计算挑战，现有方法难以高效建模其管状几何和拓扑结构。
Method: 提出 VesselTok 框架，从参数化形状角度学习空间图的潜在表示：基于中心线点和伪半径，利用神经隐式表示编码管状结构，生成紧凑的标记（tokens）。
Result: 在肺气道、肺血管和脑血管等多种解剖结构上展示了鲁棒的编码能力；潜在表示能泛化到未见解剖、支持生成建模，并在链接预测等下游任务中有效迁移。
Conclusion: VesselTok 为管状生物医学图的表示和生成提供了有效框架，其潜在表示具有跨解剖的泛化性和可迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Reliable Local Security Agents: Verifiable Post-Training for Linux Privilege Escalation
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are becoming increasingly important in the security domain, but leading systems are often closed-source, cloud-based, hard to reproduce or use with sensitive code. This creates a need for small, local models that can perform security tasks under strict resource constraints, though effective methods for developing them remain unexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a two-stage post-training recipe that turns a small local language model into a security agent. To this end, we focus on Linux privilege escalation as a representative setting to systematically study the training of local models, as the task is both automatically verifiable and requires multi-step interactive reasoning. Using an experimental setup that mitigates data leakage, we post-train a small 4B model in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on traces from procedural privilege-escalation environments, followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. On a held-out benchmark of 12 Linux privilege-escalation scenarios, supervised fine-tuning doubles the baseline success rate under a tight budget of 20 interaction rounds, and subsequent reinforcement learning training improves our model, PrivEsc-LLM 4B, to 93.3% success, behind only Claude Opus 4.7 at this budget. At the same time, the expected inference cost per successful escalation decreases by more than 80x. Our findings not only show that small local models can be adapted to complex security tasks, but also document the challenges involved, offering guidance for transferring this recipe to other settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段后训练方法，将小型本地语言模型（4B参数）转化为可靠的Linux权限提升安全智能体。通过监督微调与基于可验证奖励的强化学习，在12个测试场景中达到93.3%的成功率，仅落后于Claude Opus 4.7，同时每次成功提权的推理成本降低80倍以上。研究表明小型本地模型可适配复杂安全任务。
Motivation: 现有安全领域的LLM智能体多为闭源、云端或难以复现，且缺乏针对资源受限环境下小型本地模型的有效训练方法。
Method: 两阶段后训练：先对特权提升环境的追踪轨迹进行监督微调，再使用可验证奖励的强化学习优化策略。
Result: 在20轮交互预算下，监督微调将基线成功率翻倍，强化学习进一步将PrivEsc-LLM 4B模型提升至93.3%成功率，仅低于Claude Opus 4.7；每次成功提权的预期推理成本降低超80倍。
Conclusion: 验证了小型本地模型通过两阶段后训练可有效处理Linux权限提升任务，并揭示了相关挑战，为迁移到其他安全场景提供指导。

papers.title: Dataset Distillation Efficiently Encodes Low-Dimensional Representations from Gradient-Based Learning of Non-Linear Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation, a training-aware data compression technique, has recently attracted increasing attention as an effective tool for mitigating costs of optimization and data storage. However, progress remains largely empirical. Mechanisms underlying the extraction of task-relevant information from the training process and the efficient encoding of such information into synthetic data points remain elusive. In this paper, we theoretically analyze practical algorithms of dataset distillation applied to the gradient-based training of two-layer neural networks with width $L$. By focusing on a non-linear task structure called multi-index model, we prove that the low-dimensional structure of the problem is efficiently encoded into the resulting distilled data. This dataset reproduces a model with high generalization ability for a required memory complexity of $\tildeΘ$$(r^2d+L)$, where $d$ and $r$ are the input and intrinsic dimensions of the task. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first theoretical works that include a specific task structure, leverage its intrinsic dimensionality to quantify the compression rate and study dataset distillation implemented solely via gradient-based algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析了面向两层神经网络梯度训练的数据集蒸馏（dataset distillation）算法，以多指标模型（multi-index model）为任务结构，证明蒸馏数据高效编码了问题的低维结构，所需内存复杂度为~(r^2 d+L)，是首批将任务结构纳入理论分析的工作。
Motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏研究多为经验性，缺乏对任务相关信息提取和高效编码机制的理解，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 采用理论分析，针对两层神经网络（宽度L）的梯度训练，以多指标模型（multi-index model）为具体任务结构，研究数据集蒸馏算法。
Result: 证明蒸馏数据可复现具有高泛化能力的模型，所需内存复杂度为~(r^2 d+L)，其中d和r分别为输入维度和任务内在维度。
Conclusion: 这是首批包含特定任务结构、利用内在维度量化压缩率并研究纯梯度算法数据集蒸馏的理论工作之一。

papers.title: Naïve PAINE: Lightweight Text-to-Image Generation Improvement with Prompt Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-Image (T2I) generation is primarily driven by Diffusion Models (DM) which rely on random Gaussian noise. Thus, like playing the slots at a casino, a DM will produce different results given the same user-defined inputs. This imposes a gambler's burden: To perform multiple generation cycles to obtain a satisfactory result. However, even though DMs use stochastic sampling to seed generation, the distribution of generated content quality highly depends on the prompt and the generative ability of a DM with respect to it. To account for this, we propose Naïve PAINE for improving the generative quality of Diffusion Models by leveraging T2I preference benchmarks. We directly predict the numerical quality of an image from the initial noise and given prompt. Naïve PAINE then selects a handful of quality noises and forwards them to the DM for generation. Further, Naïve PAINE provides feedback on the DM generative quality given the prompt and is lightweight enough to seamlessly fit into existing DM pipelines. Experimental results demonstrate that Naïve PAINE outperforms existing approaches on several prompt corpus benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Naïve PAINE，一种轻量级方法，通过预测初始噪声的数值质量来改进扩散模型（Diffusion Models）的文本到图像生成质量。该方法利用 T2I 偏好基准，选择少量高质量噪声输入模型，并能在现有扩散模型流水线中无缝集成。实验表明，在多个提示语料基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 扩散模型依赖随机高斯噪声，同一种提示可能产生不同质量的图像，用户需要多次生成才能获得满意结果。现有方法未充分利用初始噪声与生成质量的关系。
Method: Naïve PAINE 直接从初始噪声和提示预测生成图像的数值质量，然后选择高质量噪声送入扩散模型进行生成，并能为提示提供生成质量反馈。
Result: 在多个提示语料基准上，Naïve PAINE 优于现有方法。
Conclusion: Naïve PAINE 是一种轻量级、可无缝集成到现有扩散模型流水线中的方案，能有效提升生成质量。

papers.title: Coverage-Controlled Preference Mining from Noisy Claim Verification for Evidence-Grounded Generation
papers.abstract_en: Evidence-grounded generation produces summaries whose claims should be supported by supplied evidence, but claim-level verifiers provide noisy feedback and can reward models that simply say less. We study this problem in clinical Brief Hospital Course summarization, where outputs must remain grounded in patient-specific EHR evidence. We introduce VERI-DPO, a preference-mining framework that converts noisy claim verification into coverage-controlled summary-level preferences. For each evidence-window prompt, VERI-DPO samples multiple candidate summaries, decomposes them into claims, verifies each claim against patient evidence, and forms a preference pair only when the chosen summary has better aggregate verifier-estimated support while retaining comparable verifiable content. Standard Direct Preference Optimization then distills these pairs into a single-sample policy, avoiding inference-time reranking. On patient-disjoint MIMIC-III-Ext-VeriFact-BHC test data, VERI-DPO reduces Not Supported rates from 10.7% to 1.9% under the mining verifier and from 11.6% to 6.4% under a separately prompted GPT-4o judge. In 100 blinded pairwise assessments by two domain researchers, VERI-DPO is preferred over the base model 56 times versus 18 times for factual faithfulness. In a locked zero-shot MIMIC-IV-Ext-BHC transfer test with 1,000 patients and no model adaptation, VERI-DPO lowers Not Supported rates with nearly unchanged scored-claim counts. Multi-seed ablations show that verifier-guided pair construction drives the gains, while coverage and anti-degeneration controls prevent apparent factuality improvements from coming from shorter or less checkable outputs.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Major revision with locked MIMIC-IV transfer evaluation, blinded pairwise human assessment, matched multi-seed ablations, revised title, and revised author list
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VERI-DPO，一种从噪声声明验证中挖掘覆盖率控制的偏好框架，用于证据基础生成。在临床摘要任务中，通过将多个候选摘要分解为声明并验证，构建偏好对进行直接偏好优化，减少了未支持率并在人类评估中获得偏好。
Motivation: 声明级验证器提供噪声反馈，可能奖励输出更少的模型，需要一种覆盖率控制的偏好挖掘方法。
Method: VERI-DPO框架，采样多个候选摘要，分解为声明，验证后构建偏好对（要求所选摘要具有更好的验证支持且可验证内容相似），然后使用标准DPO训练。
Result: 在MIMIC-III-Ext-VeriFact-BHC上，未支持率从10.7%降到1.9%（使用挖掘验证器），从11.6%降到6.4%（使用GPT-4o）；人类评估中56 vs 18偏好；在MIMIC-IV零样本迁移测试中降低未支持率。
Conclusion: 验证器引导的配对构建是关键，覆盖率和抗退化控制防止事实性改进来自更短或更少可检查的输出。

papers.title: Adaptive Entropy-Driven Sensor Selection in a Camera-LiDAR Particle Filter for Single-Vessel Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Robust single-vessel tracking from fixed coastal platforms is hindered by modality-specific degradations: cameras suffer from illumination and visual clutter, while LiDAR performance drops with range and intermittent returns. We present a particle-filter tracker that supports sequential measurement-level camera-LiDAR fusion and an information-gain (entropy-reduction) adaptive sensing policy that selects the most informative sensing modality at each fusion time bin. The approach is validated in a real maritime deployment at the Cyprus Marine and Maritime Institute Smart Marina Testbed (Ayia Napa Marina, Cyprus), using a shore-mounted 3D LiDAR and an elevated fixed camera to track a rigid inflatable boat with onboard GNSS ground truth. We compare LiDAR-only, camera-only, All sensors, and adaptive configurations. Results show LiDAR dominates near-field accuracy, the camera sustains longer-range coverage when LiDAR becomes unavailable, and the adaptive policy achieves a favorable accuracy-continuity trade-off by switching modalities based on information gain. The adaptive configuration therefore provides a practical sensor-selection baseline for resilient and resource-aware maritime surveillance.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, submitted and accepted FUSION 2026 conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于粒子滤波器的自适应传感器选择方法，用于从固定海岸平台进行单船追踪。该方法在每一融合时间步通过信息增益（熵减）策略动态选择相机或LiDAR中最具信息量的传感模态，实现顺序测量级融合。在塞浦路斯的真实海洋测试中，与单模态和全传感器基线相比，自适应策略在精度和连续性之间取得了有利的折中，为弹性资源感知的海上监视提供了实用基线。
Motivation: 单一传感器（相机或LiDAR）在不同条件下各有退化（相机受光照和视觉杂波影响，LiDAR受距离和间歇返回影响），缺乏鲁棒的单船追踪方法。
Method: 提出粒子滤波器框架，集成顺序测量级相机-LiDAR融合，并采用基于信息增益（熵减）的自适应传感策略，在每个融合时间步选择最有效的传感器模态。在真实海岸部署中，使用3D LiDAR和固定相机追踪刚性充气艇，以GNSS为真值进行验证。
Result: LiDAR主导近场精度，相机在LiDAR不可用时维持远距离覆盖；自适应策略通过信息增益切换模态，实现了有利的精度-连续性权衡。
Conclusion: 自适应传感器选择为资源感知且具有弹性的海上监视提供了实用基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local Constrained Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) for high-dimensional constrained problems remains a significant challenge due to the curse of dimensionality. We propose Local Constrained Bayesian Optimization (LCBO), a novel framework tailored for such settings. Unlike trust-region methods that are prone to premature shrinking when confronting tight or complex constraints, LCBO leverages the differentiable landscape of constraint-penalized surrogates to alternate between rapid local descent and uncertainty-driven exploration. Theoretically, we prove that LCBO achieves a convergence rate for the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) residual that depends polynomially on the dimension $d$ for common kernels under mild assumptions, offering a rigorous alternative to global BO where regret bounds typically scale exponentially. Extensive evaluations on high-dimensional benchmarks (up to 100D) demonstrate that LCBO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对高维约束问题中的贝叶斯优化，提出局部约束贝叶斯优化（LCBO）框架，利用约束惩罚代理的可微景观在局部下降与不确定性驱动探索间交替，并证明在常见核下KKT残差的收敛速率与维度多项式相关，实验在高达100维的基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 高维约束贝叶斯优化因维度灾难而极具挑战，现有信任域方法在紧约束或复杂约束下易过早收缩，需要更鲁棒的框架。
Method: 提出LCBO，利用约束惩罚代理的梯度信息进行局部快速下降，并交替进行不确定性驱动的探索，避免信任域收缩问题。
Result: 理论上证明了在常见核下KKT残差的收敛速率与维度d呈多项式关系（而非指数），实验在高达100维的基准上持续优于最先进基线。
Conclusion: LCBO为高维约束优化提供了理论保证且实践有效的替代方案，但主要针对连续优化问题，离散或组合情形需进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Masked Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: While recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made impressive strides, they predominantly employ a conventional autoregressive architecture as their backbone, leaving significant room to explore effective and efficient alternatives in architectural design. Concurrently, recent studies have successfully applied discrete diffusion models to various domains, such as visual understanding and image generation, revealing their considerable potential as a promising backbone for multimodal systems. Drawing inspiration from these pioneering studies, we introduce Omni-Diffusion, the first any-to-any multimodal language model built entirely on mask-based discrete diffusion models, which unifies understanding and generation across text, speech, and images. Omni-Diffusion employs a unified mask-based discrete diffusion model to directly capture the joint distribution over discrete multimodal tokens. This approach supports not only bimodal tasks but also more complex scenarios involving multiple modalities. On a diverse set of benchmarks, our method outperforms or performs on par with existing multimodal systems that process two or more modalities, highlighting the significant promise of diffusion models in powering the next generation of multimodal foundation models. Project webpage: https://omni-diffusion.github.io.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. This version updates the ICML submission with an optimized model checkpoint. Project page: https://omni-diffusion.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Omni-Diffusion，首个基于掩码离散扩散模型 (masked discrete diffusion) 的全任意到任意多模态语言模型，统一文本、语音和图像的理解与生成。该模型使用统一的掩码离散扩散直接建模多模态离散 token 的联合分布，支持双模及更多模态的复杂任务。在多个基准上，其性能优于或持平于处理两种及以上模态的现有多模态系统，展示了扩散模型作为下一代多模态基础模型主干的潜力。
Motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型主要依赖自回归架构，而离散扩散模型在视觉理解和图像生成等领域展现出作为替代主干的潜力，但尚未有工作将其作为统一的多模态理解与生成基础模型。
Method: 采用掩码离散扩散模型作为统一骨干，直接对离散多模态 token（文本、语音、图像）的联合分布进行建模，通过掩码和去噪过程实现任意模态到任意模态的转换。
Result: 在多个涵盖双模态及多模态任务的基准上，Omni-Diffusion 的性能超越或持平于现有处理两种及以上模态的多模态系统。
Conclusion: 掩码离散扩散模型有希望成为下一代多模态基础模型的有效主干，统一理解和生成任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Asymptotic Behavior of Multi--Task Learning: Implicit Regularization and Double Descent Effects
papers.abstract_en: Multi--task learning seeks to improve the generalization error by leveraging the common information shared by multiple related tasks. One challenge in multi--task learning is identifying formulations capable of uncovering the common information shared between different but related tasks. This paper provides a precise asymptotic analysis of a popular multi--task formulation associated with misspecified perceptron learning models. The main contribution of this paper is to precisely determine the reasons behind the benefits gained from combining multiple related tasks. Specifically, we show that combining multiple tasks is asymptotically equivalent to a traditional formulation with additional regularization terms that help improve the generalization performance. Another contribution is to empirically study the impact of combining tasks on the generalization error. In particular, we empirically show that the combination of multiple tasks postpones the double descent phenomenon and can mitigate it asymptotically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多任务学习（multi-task learning）在错误指定的感知机学习模型（misspecified perceptron learning models）中的渐近行为进行精确分析，证明了多任务组合在渐近意义上等价于带有额外正则化项的传统模型，从而提升泛化性能，并实验表明多任务组合可以推迟双下降（double descent）现象并渐近缓解它。
Motivation: 多任务学习旨在通过共享多个相关任务的共同信息提升泛化误差，但如何有效发现任务间的共享信息仍是一个挑战。本文试图从理论角度揭示多任务组合带来收益的根本原因。
Method: 采用渐近分析（asymptotic analysis）研究错误指定的感知机学习模型下的多任务学习，并通过理论推导证明组合多个任务等价于添加隐式正则化项；同时进行实证研究观察泛化误差与双下降现象。
Result: 理论表明多任务组合等价于引入额外正则化；实验显示组合任务能推迟双下降现象并在渐近意义上缓解它。

papers.title: GIPO: Gaussian Importance Sampling Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Post-training with reinforcement learning (RL) has recently shown strong promise for advancing multimodal agents beyond supervised imitation. However, RL remains limited by poor data efficiency, particularly in settings where interaction data are scarce and quickly become outdated. To address this challenge, GIPO (Gaussian Importance sampling Policy Optimization) is proposed as a policy optimization objective based on truncated importance sampling, replacing hard clipping with a log-ratio-based Gaussian trust weight to softly damp extreme importance ratios while maintaining non-zero gradients. Theoretical analysis shows that GIPO introduces an implicit, tunable constraint on the update magnitude, while concentration bounds guarantee robustness and stability under finite-sample estimation. Experimental results show that GIPO achieves state-of-the-art performance among clipping-based baselines across a wide range of replay buffer sizes, from near on-policy to highly stale data, while exhibiting superior bias--variance trade-off, high training stability and improved sample efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/distanceLu/GIPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GIPO（高斯重要性采样策略优化），一种基于截断重要性采样的策略优化目标，用基于对数比率的高斯信任权重替代硬裁剪，以软方式抑制极端重要性比率并保持非零梯度。理论分析表明GIPO对更新幅度引入了隐式可调约束，且集中界保证了有限样本估计下的鲁棒性和稳定性。实验在多种回放缓冲区大小下（从接近在线到高度过时数据）达到了裁剪基线的先进性能，展现出更好的偏差-方差权衡、训练稳定性和样本效率。
Motivation: 强化学习在交互数据稀缺且快速过时时数据效率低下，现有硬裁剪方法存在梯度为零等问题。
Method: 提出基于截断重要性采样的GIPO目标，使用对数比率的高斯信任权重软抑制极端重要性比率，并保持非零梯度，理论分析揭示了对更新幅度的隐式可调约束。
Result: 在从近在线到高度过时数据的广泛回放缓冲区大小上，GIPO在裁剪基线上取得最先进性能，具有更优的偏差-方差权衡、高训练稳定性和改进的样本效率。
Conclusion: GIPO通过软约束机制提升了策略优化的鲁棒性和数据效率，适用于多种数据新鲜度场景。

papers.title: Utonia: Toward One Encoder for All Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: We dream of a future where point clouds from all domains can come together to shape a single model that benefits them all. Toward this goal, we present Utonia, a first step toward training a single self-supervised point transformer encoder across diverse domains, spanning remote sensing, outdoor LiDAR, indoor RGB-D sequences, object-centric CAD models, and point clouds lifted from RGB-only videos. Despite their distinct sensing geometries, densities, and priors, Utonia learns a consistent representation space that transfers across domains. This unification improves perception capability while revealing intriguing emergent behaviors that arise only when domains are trained jointly. Beyond perception, we observe that Utonia representations can also benefit embodied and multimodal reasoning: conditioning vision-language-action policies on Utonia features improves robotic manipulation, and integrating them into vision-language models yields gains on spatial reasoning. We hope Utonia can serve as a step toward foundation models for sparse 3D data, and support downstream applications in AR/VR, robotics, and autonomous driving.

TL;DR: 本文提出Utonia，首个在跨域点云（遥感、LiDAR、室内RGB-D、CAD、RGB视频）上训练单一自监督点云Transformer编码器的方法。它能学习一致的表示空间，提升感知性能并涌现跨域行为，还能增强视觉-语言-动作策略和空间推理。
Motivation: 不同领域点云具有不同的传感几何、密度和先验，现有模型通常针对单一领域设计，难以统一受益。
Method: 训练单一自监督点云Transformer编码器，在多种点云域（遥感、LiDAR、室内、CAD、RGB视频）上进行联合学习，无需领域特定适配。
Result: 学习到跨域一致的表示空间，提升感知能力并涌现新行为；特征可用于改善机器人操控和视觉语言模型的空间推理。
Conclusion: Utonia是向稀疏3D数据基础模型迈出的第一步，有望支持AR/VR、机器人和自动驾驶等应用。

papers.title: HVR-Met: A Hypothesis-Verification-Replanning Agentic System for Extreme Weather Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning-based weather forecasting paradigms have made significant strides, addressing extreme weather diagnostics remains a formidable challenge. This gap exists primarily because the diagnostic process demands sophisticated multi-step logical reasoning, dynamic tool invocation, and expert-level prior judgment. Although agents possess inherent advantages in task decomposition and autonomous execution, current architectures are still hampered by critical bottlenecks: inadequate expert knowledge integration, a lack of professional-grade iterative reasoning loops, and the absence of fine-grained validation and evaluation systems for complex workflows under extreme conditions. To this end, we propose HVR-Met, a multi-agent meteorological diagnostic system characterized by the deep integration of expert knowledge. Its central innovation is the ``Hypothesis-Verification-Replanning'' closed-loop mechanism, which facilitates sophisticated iterative reasoning for anomalous meteorological signals during extreme weather events. To bridge gaps within existing evaluation frameworks, we further introduce a novel benchmark focused on atomic-level subtasks. Experimental evidence demonstrates that the system excels in complex diagnostic scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HVR-Met 是一种面向极端天气诊断的多智能体系统，核心创新是“假设-验证-重规划”闭环机制，用于处理极端天气事件中的异常气象信号，并引入原子级子任务基准进行评估。实验表明该系统在复杂诊断场景中表现优异。
Motivation: 现有深度学习天气预报方法在极端天气诊断中面临挑战，因为诊断需要多步逻辑推理、动态工具调用和专家级先验判断，而现有智能体架构缺乏专家知识集成、专业级迭代推理循环以及对复杂工作流的细粒度验证。
Method: 提出 HVR-Met 多智能体气象诊断系统，深度融合专家知识，设计“假设-验证-重规划”闭环机制，实现极端天气事件中异常气象信号的迭代推理；同时构建原子级子任务基准以弥补评估框架的不足。
Result: 系统在复杂诊断场景中表现出色，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了多智能体系统结合专家知识在极端天气诊断中的潜力，当前主要贡献在于机制设计和基准构建，实验验证有效。

papers.title: Learning with the Nash-Sutcliffe loss
papers.abstract_en: The Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency ($\text{NSE}$) is a widely used, positively oriented relative measure for evaluating forecasts across multiple time series. However, it lacks a decision-theoretic foundation for this purpose. To address this, we examine its negatively oriented counterpart, which we refer to as Nash-Sutcliffe loss, defined as $L_{\text{NS}} = 1 - \text{NSE}$. We prove that $L_{\text{NS}}$ is strictly consistent for an elicitable and identifiable multi-dimensional functional, which we name the Nash-Sutcliffe functional. This functional is a data-weighted component-wise mean. The common practice of maximizing the average $\text{NSE}$ across multiple series is the sample analog of minimizing the expected $L_{\text{NS}}$. Consequently, this operation implicitly assumes that all series originate from a single non-stationary, stochastic process. We introduce Nash-Sutcliffe linear regression, a multi-dimensional model estimated by minimizing the average $L_{\text{NS}}$, which reduces to a data-weighted least squares formulation. By reorienting the sample average loss function, we extend the previously proposed evaluation and estimation framework to forecasting multiple stationary dependent time series with differing stochastic properties. This constitutes a more natural empirical implementation of the $\text{NSE}$ than the earlier formulation. Our results establish a decision-theoretic foundation for $\text{NSE}$-based model estimation and forecast evaluation in large datasets, while further clarifying the benefits of global over local machine learning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为Nash-Sutcliffe效率（NSE）建立了决策理论基础，证明了Nash-Sutcliffe损失（L_NS = 1 - NSE）是严格一致的损失函数，对应一个可获取且可识别的多维泛函——Nash-Sutcliffe泛函（数据加权分量均值）。通过最小化平均L_NS估计的Nash-Sutcliffe线性回归等价于数据加权最小二乘，并扩展至多变量平稳时间序列预测。摘要指出，该方法为大规模数据集中基于NSE的模型估计和评估提供了决策基础，并阐明了全局模型相对于局部模型的优势。
Motivation: NSE广泛用于多时间序列预测评估，但缺乏决策理论基础。
Method: 将NSE转化为损失函数L_NS = 1 - NSE，证明其严格一致性，并引入Nash-Sutcliffe线性回归（数据加权最小二乘）。
Result: 摘要宣称该方法为NSE提供了严格一致的损失函数，并推导出样本平均L_NS最小化即平均NSE最大化；扩展至多变量平稳时间序列预测。
Conclusion: Nash-Sutcliffe损失为基于NSE的模型估计和评估建立了决策理论基础，有助于理解全局模型优于局部模型的原因。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: A short tour of operator learning theory: Convergence rates, statistical limits, and open questions
papers.abstract_en: This paper surveys recent developments at the intersection of operator learning, statistical learning theory, and approximation theory. First, it reviews error bounds for empirical risk minimization with a focus on holomorphic operators and neural network approximations. Next, it illustrates fundamental performance limits in terms of sample size by adopting a minimax perspective and considering various notions of regularity beyond holomorphy. The paper ends with a discussion on the interplay between these two perspectives and related open questions.
papers.comment: To appear in Numerical Mathematics and Advanced Applications (Proceedings of ENUMATH 2025); 13 pages, 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了算学习理论（operator learning theory）的最新进展，重点讨论了全纯算子（holomorphic operators）和神经网络近似下的经验风险最小化误差界，从极小极大（minimax）视角分析了样本量的基本性能极限，并探讨了这些视角之间的相互影响和开放问题。
Motivation: 算子学习在科学计算中日益重要，但其收敛速度和统计极限的理论理解尚不完整，尤其是对于不同正则性假设下的算子。
Method: 通过结合统计学习理论和逼近理论，综述了经验风险最小化在全纯算子上的误差界，并采用极小极大框架分析了样本复杂度下界。
Result: 总结了全纯算子的收敛率结果，以及超越全纯性（如更一般的正则性）时的统计极限。
Conclusion: 论文指出算子学习理论与经典学习理论存在联系，但仍有若干开放问题，例如如何桥接近似误差与统计误差之间的间隙。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic AI-RAN: Enabling Intent-Driven, Explainable and Self-Evolving Open RAN Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Open RAN (O-RAN) exposes rich control and telemetry interfaces across the Non-RT RIC, Near-RT RIC, and distributed units, but also makes it harder to operate multi-tenant, multi-objective RANs in a safe and auditable manner. In parallel, agentic AI systems with explicit planning, tool use, memory, and self-management offer a natural way to structure long-lived control loops. This article surveys how such agentic controllers can be brought into O-RAN: we review the O-RAN architecture, contrast agentic controllers with conventional ML/RL xApps, and organise the task landscape around three clusters: network slice life-cycle, radio resource management (RRM) closed loops, and cross-cutting security, privacy, and compliance. We then introduce a small set of agentic primitives (Plan-Act-Observe-Reflect, skills as tool use, memory and evidence, and self-management gates) and show, in a multi-cell O-RAN simulation, how they improve slice life-cycle and RRM performance compared to conventional baselines and ablations that remove individual primitives. Security, privacy, and compliance are discussed as architectural constraints and open challenges for standards-aligned deployments. This framework achieves an average 8.83\% reduction in resource usage across three classic network slices.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at IEEE Network Magazine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将代理式AI（agentic AI）引入开放无线接入网（O-RAN），实现意图驱动、可解释、自演进的智能管理。通过综述O-RAN架构、对比传统ML/RL xApp，并引入一组代理式原语（Plan-Act-Observe-Reflect、技能作为工具使用、记忆与证据、自管理门控），在多小区O-RAN仿真中验证了其在网络切片生命周期和无线资源管理闭环中的性能提升，平均资源使用降低8.83%。
Motivation: O-RAN暴露了丰富控制和遥测接口，但多租户、多目标RAN的安全和可审计操作变得困难；现有ML/RL方案缺乏长期闭环控制的结构化能力。
Method: 提出一组代理式原语（Plan-Act-Observe-Reflect、技能作为工具使用、记忆与证据、自管理门控），并在O-RAN仿真中实现对比实验和消融研究。
Result: 在多小区O-RAN仿真中，该方法相比传统基线和去除单个原语的消融版本，在三种经典网络切片上平均减少8.83%资源使用。

papers.title: SFL-Net: Source-Factorized Latent Representation Learning for Multi-Contrast MRI to Tau-PET Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Tau positron emission tomography supports Alzheimer's disease staging but is difficult to scale because of tracer, scanner, and radiation constraints. Synthesis from structural MRI is therefore attractive, but it is a particularly difficult setting. T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI provide anatomy and disease correlated morphology, but they do not directly measure Tau-PET relevant signal. We introduce SFL-Net, a multi-input synthesis framework that predicts Tau-PET from T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI. SFL-Net factorizes the latent representation into shared, T1-specific, FLAIR-specific, and complementary pathways and preserves anatomical detail through latent structural conditioning rather than direct encoder-decoder connections. We evaluated SFL-Net and baseline models using 605 training and 83 validation subjects from ADNI-3 and OASIS-3 datasets. Evaluation included raw image fidelity, standardized uptake value ratio agreement, high uptake overlap, regional Bland-Altman bias, braak derived stage agreement, non-inferiority sensitivity analysis, and latent component Shapley attribution. SFL-Net performed competitively on both clinically relevant and reconstruction metrics, while also delivering explicit source level auditability that conventional UNet derived models lack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SFL-Net，一种多输入合成框架，从T1加权和FLAIR MRI预测Tau-PET图像。该方法将潜在表示分解为共享、T1特定、FLAIR特定和互补路径，并通过潜在结构条件保留解剖细节。在ADNI-3和OASIS-3数据集上的评估显示，SFL-Net在临床相关指标和重建指标上表现有竞争力，并提供了传统UNet模型缺乏的源级可审计性。
Motivation: Tau-PET对阿尔茨海默病分期有用，但受限于示踪剂、扫描仪和辐射问题，难以规模化。从结构MRI合成Tau-PET具有吸引力，但T1和FLAIR MRI不直接测量Tau-PET相关信号，任务困难。
Method: SFL-Net是一种多输入合成框架，将潜在表示分解为共享、T1特定、FLAIR特定和互补四个路径，使用潜在结构条件而非直接的编码器-解码器连接来保持解剖细节。
Result: 在605个训练和83个验证样本上，SFL-Net在原始图像保真度、标准化摄取值比一致性、高摄取重叠、区域Bland-Altman偏倚、Braak分期一致性、非劣效性敏感性和潜在分量Shapley归因等指标上表现有竞争力。
Conclusion: SFL-Net在临床和重建指标上均有竞争力，并提供了显式的源级可审计性，这是传统UNet模型缺乏的。

papers.title: How Transformers Reject Wrong Answers: Rotational Dynamics of Factual Constraint Processing
papers.abstract_en: When a decoder-only transformer is forced to process matched correct and incorrect single-token continuations of a factual query, the two pathways through hidden-state space diverge: displacement vectors from the query-only representation keep near-equal magnitude but rotate apart, with angular separation growing through mid-depth before late layers resolve an asymmetric outcome. A logit-lens preference in the incorrect run falls far below the equal-probability prior (roughly 11.5x more mass on the incorrect token than the correct one). We read this pattern, rotational divergence then late-layer asymmetric commitment, as the geometric signature of the model externally appearing to reject a wrong continuation, while staying explicit that it is observational, not causal: the incorrect run could equally reflect the model conforming to the token it is forced to carry, which only a random-token control can settle. It holds across six decoder-only transformers spanning four architecture families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, StableLM) from 1B to 13B parameters; a seventh (Qwen2 1.5B) is flat under our protocol, plausibly a tokenizer artefact, leaving an emergence threshold open. Linear probes recover the distinction at intermediate depth, and cross-domain transfer is structurally asymmetric, a financial-medical corridor transferring far better than transport pairs. Where single-layer activation patching is cleanly interpretable (LLaMA-2 13B, Mistral 7B) it yields no layer band of consistent recovery; a third model (StableLM-2 1.6B) recovers uniformly above the ceiling, which we diagnose as a code-path artefact and exclude. Under this scoped null the late-layer asymmetry is not localized to a single component, fitting a distributed-by-trajectory account rather than single-layer localized recall. We document this with forced-completion probing across seven models, three domains, and 300 queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过强制解码器-only Transformer处理事实查询的正确与错误单token续接，发现两个路径在隐藏状态空间中位移向量大小相近但方向旋转分离，中期层角度增长，后期层形成非对称结果。错误运行的logit-lens偏好远低于均匀先验（错误token质量约11.5倍于正确token）。该模式在六个1B-13B参数模型（Llama、Mistral、Gemma、StableLM）中成立，第七个模型（Qwen2 1.5B）平坦，可能为tokenizer伪影。线性探针可在中间层恢复区分，跨域迁移存在结构不对称。单层激活修补仅在部分模型可解释，且无一致恢复层带，后期层不对称呈分布式轨迹而非单层局部记忆。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对Transformer如何内部表征拒绝错误答案的几何机制的理解，本文旨在揭示其隐藏状态空间的动态模式。
Method: 使用强制完成探测（forced-completion probing）方法，对比查询仅表示与正确/错误续接的隐藏状态位移向量，分析其幅度和角度变化；结合logit-lens、线性探针和单层激活修补进行观测。
Result: 位移向量幅度相近但角度随层数增加而分离，后期层形成不对称承诺；错误logit-lens偏好远低于均匀先验；模式跨模型、跨领域（金融、医疗、交通）部分成立；单层修补无一致恢复层带，后期不对称是分布式的。
Conclusion: 模型拒绝错误答案的几何特征是旋转分离后后期层非对称承诺，但该观察是关联性而非因果性的，需随机token控制才能确定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Automatic Chord Recognition via Pseudo-Labeling and Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Chord Recognition (ACR) is constrained by the scarcity of aligned chord annotations, which are costly to acquire. At the same time, open-weight pre-trained models are more accessible than their proprietary training data. In this work, we present a two-stage training pipeline that leverages pre-trained models together with unlabeled audio. The proposed method decouples training into two stages. In the first stage, we use the pre-trained BTC model as a teacher to generate pseudo-labels for over 1,000 hours of diverse unlabeled audio and train a student model solely on these pseudo-labels. In the second stage, the student is continually trained on ground-truth labels as they become available. To prevent catastrophic forgetting of the representations learned in the first stage, we apply selective knowledge distillation (KD) from the teacher as a regularizer. In our experiments, two models (BTC, 2E1D) were used as students. In Stage 1, using only pseudo-labels, the BTC student achieves about 99% of the teacher's performance, while the 2E1D model achieves about 97% of the teacher's performance across seven standard mir_eval metrics. After continual training with labeled data in Stage 2, the resulting BTC student model consistently surpasses both the traditional supervised learning baseline and the original pre-trained teacher model across all metrics. The resulting 2E1D student model also outperforms the supervised baseline and approaches teacher-level performance, with both models demonstrating substantial gains on rare chord qualities.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to DAFx26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动和弦识别（ACR）中对齐标注稀缺的问题，提出两阶段训练流程：首先利用预训练BTC模型为1000+小时未标注音频生成伪标签，训练学生模型；然后使用真实标签继续训练，并引入选择性知识蒸馏防止遗忘。实验表明，学生模型在仅用伪标签时即达到教师性能的97-99%，第二阶段后甚至超越教师和传统监督基线，尤其在稀有和弦上提升显著。
Motivation: 自动和弦识别受限于对齐和弦标注的成本高昂，而开放权重的预训练模型比其专有训练数据更容易获取，因此需要利用预训练模型和未标注数据提升识别性能。
Method: 提出两阶段训练：第一阶段使用预训练BTC模型作为教师，为大量未标注音频生成伪标签，训练学生模型（BTC或2E1D）；第二阶段用真实标签继续训练学生，并通过选择性知识蒸馏（KD）从教师处正则化，防止灾难性遗忘。
Result: 第一阶段中，BTC学生模型在七个mir_eval指标上达到教师性能的约99%，2E1D学生达到约97%；第二阶段持续训练后，BTC学生模型在所有指标上超越传统监督基线及原预训练教师，2E1D学生同样超越基线并接近教师水平，两者在稀有和弦上均有大幅提升。
Conclusion: 该两阶段流程有效缓解了标注稀缺问题，利用伪标签和知识蒸馏使轻量学生模型达到或超越教师性能，尤其提升了罕见和弦的识别能力。

papers.title: Gradient Regularization Mitigates Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback and Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) or Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are two key steps in the post-training of modern Language Models (LMs). A common problem is reward hacking, where the policy may exploit inaccuracies of the reward and learn an unintended behavior. Most previous works address this by limiting the policy update with a Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty towards a reference model. We propose a different framing: Train the LM in a way that biases policy updates towards regions in which the reward is more accurate. First, we derive a theoretical connection between the accuracy of a reward model and the flatness of an optimum at convergence. Gradient regularization (GR) can then be used to bias training to flatter regions and thereby maintain reward model accuracy. We confirm these results by showing that the gradient norm and reward accuracy are empirically correlated in RLHF. We then empirically show that Reference Resets of the KL penalty find flatter regions with a higher reward accuracy. We further improve on this by proposing to use explicit GR with an efficient finite-difference estimate. Empirically, GR performs better than a KL penalty across a diverse set of RL experiments with LMs. GR achieves a higher GPT-judged win-rate in RLHF, avoids overly focusing on the format in rule-based math rewards, and prevents hacking the judge in LLM-as-a-Judge math tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对RLHF/RLVR中的奖励黑客（reward hacking）问题，提出使用梯度正则化（gradient regularization）来引导策略更新朝向奖励更准确的平坦区域。理论上建立了奖励模型准确率与收敛时最优平坦度之间的联系，实验表明梯度正则化在多个LM强化学习场景中优于KL惩罚，包括更高的GPT评判胜率、避免过度关注格式以及防止评判作弊。
Motivation: RLHF/RLVR中奖励黑客问题常见，传统方法通过KL惩罚限制策略更新，但未能直接处理奖励不准确性。
Method: 论文提出梯度正则化（GR），利用有效有限差分估计显式地惩罚梯度范数，从而偏向平坦最优区域，维持奖励模型准确率。
Result: 在多种LM强化学习实验中，GR相比KL惩罚显著提升GPT评判胜率，避免基于规则的数学奖励中过度关注格式，并防止LLM-as-a-Judge任务中的评判作弊。
Conclusion: 梯度正则化为缓解奖励黑客提供了一种有效替代KL惩罚的方法，并且与奖励准确率的平坦度理论一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpectralGCD: Spectral Concept Selection and Cross-modal Representation Learning for Generalized Category Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to identify novel categories in unlabeled data while leveraging a small labeled subset of known classes. Training a parametric classifier solely on image features often leads to overfitting to old classes, and recent multimodal approaches improve performance by incorporating textual information. However, they treat modalities independently and incur high computational cost. We propose SpectralGCD, an efficient and effective multimodal approach to GCD that uses CLIP cross-modal image-concept similarities as a unified cross-modal representation. Each image is expressed as a mixture over semantic concepts from a large task-agnostic dictionary, which anchors learning to explicit semantics and reduces reliance on spurious visual cues. To maintain the semantic quality of representations learned by an efficient student, we introduce Spectral Filtering which exploits a cross-modal covariance matrix over the softmaxed similarities measured by a strong teacher model to automatically retain only relevant concepts from the dictionary. Forward and reverse knowledge distillation from the same teacher ensures that the cross-modal representations of the student remain both semantically sufficient and well-aligned. Across six benchmarks, SpectralGCD delivers accuracy comparable to or significantly superior to state-of-the-art methods at a fraction of the computational cost. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/miccunifi/SpectralGCD.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. Code available at https://github.com/miccunifi/SpectralGCD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpectralGCD，一种高效的多模态广义类别发现方法，利用CLIP跨模态图像-概念相似度构建统一表示，通过光谱滤波（Spectral Filtering）自动保留相关语义概念，并采用知识蒸馏保持学生模型的语义充分性和对齐性。在六个基准上达到与SOTA相当或更优的准确率，计算成本显著降低。
Motivation: 现有广义类别发现方法中，仅基于图像特征的参数化分类器容易过拟合旧类别，而多模态方法虽然性能提升但计算成本高且独立处理模态。
Method: 提出SpectralGCD，使用CLIP的跨模态图像-概念相似度作为统一表示，将每个图像表示为任务无关词典中语义概念的混合；引入光谱滤波，利用强教师模型对softmax相似度的跨模态协方差矩阵自动保留相关概念；通过前向和反向知识蒸馏确保学生模型的表示语义充分且对齐。
Result: 在六个基准上，SpectralGCD的准确率与SOTA相当或显著更优，且计算成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: 该文展示了利用跨模态相似度和光谱滤波进行高效广义类别发现的潜力，代码已开源。

papers.title: Few-Step Diffusion Language Models via Trajectory Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) have emerged as powerful generative models with the promise of fast text generation through parallel decoding. However, realizing this potential in practice remains challenging: reducing the number of decoding steps, typically causes a substantial degradation in output quality due to token factorization error. To alleviate this, we propose a self-distillation framework that trains a few-step student to match the generative trajectory of a full-step teacher. We theoretically and empirically show that trajectory-level supervision mitigates this factorization error, thereby enabling effective few-step decoding. We further incorporate Direct Discriminative Optimization (DDO), a reverse-KL objective that encourages mode-seeking toward the teacher's modes, yielding stronger performance on challenging reasoning tasks. Across reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, our method substantially narrows the gap between few-step and full-step decoding. The source code is available at https://github.com/Tyrion58/T3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自蒸馏框架（Trajectory Self-Distillation），通过让少步学生模型匹配全步教师模型的生成轨迹，来减少扩散语言模型在少步解码时的质量下降。理论分析和实验表明，轨迹级监督能缓解令牌分解误差，使得少步解码有效。结合直接判别优化（DDO）反向KL目标，在推理和代码生成任务上缩小了少步与全步解码的差距。
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（DLLMs）通过并行解码有望实现快速文本生成，但实际中减少解码步数会导致输出质量显著下降，原因是令牌分解误差。本文旨在解决该问题。
Method: 提出自蒸馏框架，训练少步学生模型匹配全步教师模型的生成轨迹。理论上和实验上证明轨迹级监督可缓解分解误差。进一步引入直接判别优化（DDO）作为反向KL目标，鼓励学生模式向教师模式靠拢。
Result: 在推理和代码生成基准上，所提方法显著缩小了少步解码与全步解码之间的性能差距。
Conclusion: 通过轨迹级自蒸馏和直接判别优化，实现了有效的少步解码，缩小了与全步解码的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning on the Manifold: Unlocking Standard Diffusion Transformers with Representation Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging representation encoders for generative modeling offers a path for efficient, high-fidelity synthesis. However, standard diffusion transformers fail to converge on these representations directly. While recent work attributes this to a capacity bottleneck proposing computationally expensive width scaling of diffusion transformers we demonstrate that the failure is fundamentally geometric. We identify Geometric Interference as the root cause: standard Euclidean flow matching forces probability paths through the low-density interior of the hyperspherical feature space of representation encoders, rather than following the manifold surface. To resolve this, we propose Riemannian Flow Matching with Jacobi Regularization (RJF). By constraining the generative process to the manifold geodesics and correcting for curvature-induced error propagation, RJF enables standard Diffusion Transformer architectures to converge without width scaling. Our method RJF enables the standard DiT-B architecture (131M parameters) to converge effectively, achieving an FID of 3.37 where prior methods fail to converge. Code: https://github.com/amandpkr/RJF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示标准扩散 Transformer 在表示编码器表征上无法收敛的根本原因在于几何干扰（Geometric Interference）：欧几里得流匹配迫使概率路径穿过超球面特征空间的低密度内部而非沿流形表面。为解决该问题，提出黎曼流匹配与雅可比正则化（RJF），将生成过程约束在流形测地线上并修正曲率引起的误差传播，使标准 DiT-B 架构（131M 参数）无需宽度缩放即可有效收敛，在相关任务上取得 FID 3.37。
Motivation: 标准扩散 Transformer 在直接对表示编码器表征建模时无法收敛，先前工作归因于容量瓶颈并提出昂贵的宽度缩放，但本文指出根本原因是几何性质的匹配问题。
Method: 提出黎曼流匹配与雅可比正则化（RJF），通过将概率流约束在表示编码器超球面流形的测地线上，并利用雅可比正则化修正曲率引起的误差传播，从而无需缩放模型宽度即可使标准扩散 Transformer 收敛。
Result: 标准 DiT-B 架构（131M 参数）在 RJF 下有效收敛，取得 FID 3.37，而先前方法无法收敛。
Conclusion: 本文从几何角度解释了扩散 Transformer 在表示编码器上的收敛失败，并提供了一个无需额外宽度缩放的解决方案，有望提升生成模型的效率与保真度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: rePIRL: Learn PRM with Inverse RL for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Process rewards have been widely used in deep reinforcement learning to improve training efficiency, reduce variance, and prevent reward hacking. In LLM reasoning, existing works also explore various solutions for learning effective process reward models (PRM) with or without the help of an expert policy. However, existing methods either rely on strong assumptions about the expert policies (e.g., requiring their reward functions) or suffer intrinsic limitations (e.g., entropy collapse), resulting in weak PRMs or limited generalizability. In this paper, we introduce rePIRL, an inverse RL-inspired framework that learns effective PRMs with minimal assumptions about expert policies. Specifically, we design a dual learning process that updates the policy and the PRM interchangeably. Our learning algorithm has customized techniques to address the challenges of scaling traditional inverse RL to LLMs. We theoretically show that our proposed learning framework can unify both online and offline PRM learning methods, justifying that rePIRL can learn PRMs with minimal assumptions. Empirical evaluations on standardized math and coding reasoning datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of rePIRL over existing methods. We further show the application of our trained PRM in test-time training, test-time scaling, and providing an early signal for training hard problems. Finally, we validate our training recipe and key design choices via a detailed ablation study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出rePIRL，一个基于逆强化学习的框架，用于在大语言模型推理中学习过程奖励模型（PRM）。rePIRL通过双学习过程交替更新策略和PRM，并设计定制技术解决传统逆RL扩展到LLM的挑战。理论上证明该框架能统一在线和离线PRM学习方法，实验表明在数学和编码推理数据集上优于现有方法，并展示了在测试时训练、测试时缩放和困难问题训练中的应用。
Motivation: 现有PRM学习方法依赖于对专家策略的强假设（如需要其奖励函数）或存在内在限制（如熵坍塌），导致PRM效果弱或泛化性差。rePIRL旨在以最小假设学习有效的PRM。
Method: rePIRL采用逆RL启发框架，包含双学习过程：交替更新策略和PRM。算法包含定制技术以应对将传统逆RL扩展到LLM的挑战，理论上能统一在线和离线PRM学习方法。
Result: 在标准数学和编码推理数据集上的实证评估显示rePIRL优于现有方法。训练的PRM可用于测试时训练、测试时缩放，并为困难问题训练提供早期信号。消融实验验证了训练配方和关键设计选择。
Conclusion: rePIRL能以最小假设学习有效PRM，并统一在线和离线方法，展示了对LLM推理的广泛适用性。

papers.title: Deriving Neural Scaling Laws from the statistics of natural language
papers.abstract_en: Despite the fact that experimental neural scaling laws have substantially guided empirical progress in large-scale machine learning, no existing theory can quantitatively predict the exponents of these important laws for any modern LLM trained on any natural language dataset. We provide the first such theory in the case of data-limited scaling laws. We isolate two key statistical properties of language that alone can predict neural scaling exponents: (i) the decay of pairwise token correlations with time separation between token pairs, and (ii) the decay of the next-token conditional entropy with the length of the conditioning context. We further derive a simple formula in terms of these statistics that predicts data-limited neural scaling exponents from first principles without any free parameters or synthetic data models. Our theory exhibits a remarkable match with experimentally measured neural scaling laws obtained from training GPT-2 and LLaMA style models from scratch on two qualitatively different benchmarks, TinyStories and WikiText.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从自然语言的统计特性出发，推导出数据受限情况下神经缩放定律的指数。通过分析词对相关性随时间间隔的衰减以及条件熵随上下文长度的衰减，提出一个无自由参数的公式，在GPT-2和LLaMA模型上训练TinyStories和WikiText数据集时，理论预测与实验缩放定律高度吻合。
Motivation: 现有理论无法定量预测现代大型语言模型在自然语言数据集上的缩放定律指数，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 识别语言的两种关键统计特性——词对时间分离相关性和条件熵衰减，并推导出预测数据受限缩放指数的解析公式。
Result: 在TinyStories和WikiText上从头训练GPT-2和LLaMA风格模型，理论预测的缩放指数与实验测量结果显著匹配。
Conclusion: 本文提供了数据受限缩放定律指数的第一性原理推导，无需自由参数或合成数据模型，仅基于自然语言的统计性质。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MMEarth-Bench: Global Model Adaptation via Multimodal Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Recent research in geospatial machine learning has demonstrated that models pretrained with self-supervised learning on Earth observation data can perform well on downstream tasks with limited training data. However, most of the existing geospatial benchmark datasets have few data modalities and poor global representation, limiting the ability to evaluate multimodal pretrained models at global scales. To fill this gap, we introduce MMEarth-Bench, a collection of five new multimodal environmental tasks with 12 modalities, globally distributed data, and both in- and out-of-distribution test splits. We benchmark a diverse set of pretrained models and find that while (multimodal) pretraining tends to improve model robustness in limited data settings, geographic generalization abilities remain poor. In order to facilitate model adaptation to new downstream tasks and geographic domains, we propose a model-agnostic method for test-time training with multimodal reconstruction (TTT-MMR) that uses all the modalities available at test time as auxiliary tasks, regardless of whether a pretrained model accepts them as input. Our method improves model performance on both the random and geographic test splits, and geographic batching leads to a good trade-off between regularization and specialization during TTT. Our dataset, code, and visualization tool are linked from the project page at lgordon99.github.io/mmearth-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMEarth-Bench 是一个多模态地球观测基准，包含5个新任务和12种模态，覆盖全球分布数据，并区分分布内和分布外测试集。文章评测多种预训练模型后发现，多模态预训练在数据有限时能提升鲁棒性，但地理泛化能力仍差。为此提出测试时训练方法 TTT-MMR，利用测试时所有可用模态进行多模态重建，提升模型在随机和地理测试集上的性能。
Motivation: 现有地球观测基准数据模态少、全球代表性不足，难以评估多模态预训练模型的全球尺度能力。
Method: 提出模型无关的测试时训练方法 TTT-MMR，在测试阶段使用所有可用模态作为辅助任务进行多模态重建，无需预训练模型接受这些模态作为输入。
Result: TTT-MMR 在随机和地理测试集上均提升了模型性能，地理批次处理在测试时训练中实现了正则化与特化的良好平衡。
Conclusion: 多模态预训练在数据有限时有效，但地理泛化仍是挑战；TTT-MMR 提供了一种有效的模型自适应手段。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Geometric Observability Index: An Operator-Theoretic Framework for Per-Feature Sensitivity, Weak Observability, and Dynamic Effects in SE(3) Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Geometric Observability Index (GOI), a per-feature sensitivity measure for pose estimation on SE(3). For a Gauss-Newton curvature matrix $H=E[J^\top WJ]$ and a Riemannian metric $G$ on the Lie algebra, the index is the $G$-norm of the influence a single measurement exerts on the estimated pose: $\mathrm{GOI}(z)=\|\mathcal{A}_{OO}^{-1}P_O\,\varphi(z)\|_G$, where $ψ(z)=J^\top Wr(z)$ is the score, $\varphi=G^{-1}ψ$ its gradient representative, $\mathcal{A}=G^{-1}H$ the curvature operator (self-adjoint in the $G$-inner product), $O=\mathrm{range}(\mathcal{A})$ the observable subspace, and $\mathcal{A}_{OO}$ its restriction. This single object (i) equals the norm of the M-estimator influence function, (ii) is governed by the Fisher information, which coincides with the curvature, (iii) exposes weak observability through the smallest eigenvalue $λ_{\min}$, which (iv) also governs finite-sample stability. Operationally the theory cuts both ways. The index is the exact per-measurement attribution: it predicts the true leave-one-out pose shift with log-correlation $r=1.00$. But we also prove that the influence standardized by its inlier null covariance collapses exactly to the classical chi-square residual statistic: residual gating is the leverage-corrected influence test, explaining its robustness from first principles, while raw-influence gating conflates a measurement's information with its harm and over-rejects high-leverage inliers in weakly observable geometry. Experiments on synthetic problems, five TUM RGB-D dynamic sequences, and two KITTI odometry sequences confirm the picture: the two criteria coincide under well-conditioned geometry, and raw-influence gating degrades significantly at $\mathrm{cond}(H)\approx 10^4$, as the leverage analysis predicts for noise-dominated weak directions. All quantitative claims are validated; code is released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了几何可观测性指数 (GOI)，用于 SE(3) 位姿估计中每个特征的灵敏度度量。该指数等于 M-估计器影响函数的范数，由 Fisher 信息量决定，并揭示了弱可观测性。理论上，该指数精确预测留一法位姿变化，且标准化后的影响函数与经典卡方残差统计量等价，解释了鲁棒性的基本原理。实验验证了理论预测。
Motivation: 现有位姿估计方法缺乏对每个特征敏感度的精确度量，且鲁棒性机理不明确。
Method: 基于 Gauss-Newton 曲率矩阵和 Riemannian 度量，定义每个测量值对估计位姿的影响的 G-范数作为几何可观测性指数，并分析了其与 Fisher 信息、弱可观测性、有限样本稳定性的关系。
Result: 该指数与留一法位姿变化的对数相关系数为 1.00；标准化后的影响函数与卡方残差统计量一致；原始影响门控在条件数大时性能显著下降。
Conclusion: 几何可观测性指数为位姿估计中的特征灵敏度提供了统一理论框架，并解释了传统残差门控的鲁棒性原理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlashBlock: Attention Caching for Efficient Long-Context Block Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Generating long-form content, such as minute-long videos and extended texts, is increasingly important for modern generative models. Block diffusion improves inference efficiency via KV caching and block-wise causal inference and has been widely adopted in diffusion language models and video generation. However, in long-context settings, block diffusion still incurs substantial overhead from repeatedly computing attention over a growing KV cache. We identify an underexplored property of block diffusion: cross-step redundancy of attention within a block. Our analysis shows that attention outputs from tokens outside the current block remain largely stable across diffusion steps, while block-internal attention varies significantly. Based on this observation, we propose FlashBlock, a cached block-external attention mechanism that reuses stable attention output, reducing attention computation and KV cache access without modifying the diffusion process. Moreover, FlashBlock is orthogonal to sparse attention and can be combined as a complementary residual reuse strategy, substantially improving model accuracy under aggressive sparsification. Experiments on diffusion language models and video generation demonstrate up to 1.44$\times$ higher token throughput and up to 1.6$\times$ reduction in attention time, with negligible impact on generation quality. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/FlashBlock/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlashBlock，一种缓存块外部注意力机制，用于长上下文块扩散模型中的高效注意力计算。通过利用块内注意力的跨步冗余性，重用稳定的块外注意力输出，减少计算和KV缓存访问。在扩散语言模型和视频生成任务上，实现了高达1.44倍token吞吐提升和1.6倍注意力时间减少，质量影响可忽略。
Motivation: 块扩散在长上下文中重复计算不断增长的KV缓存的注意力，造成巨大开销。论文观察到块内注意力的跨步冗余性：块外token的注意力输出在扩散步骤间保持稳定，而块内注意力变化显著。
Method: 提出FlashBlock，缓存块外部注意力机制，重用稳定的注意力输出，减少注意力计算和KV缓存访问。与稀疏注意力正交，可作为互补的残差重用策略。
Result: 实验显示在扩散语言模型和视频生成上，token吞吐量提升高达1.44倍，注意力时间减少高达1.6倍，生成质量影响可忽略。
Conclusion: FlashBlock有效降低长上下文块扩散的计算开销，且与稀疏注意力兼容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Variational Sparse Paired Autoencoders (vsPAIR) for Inverse Problems and Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Inverse problems are fundamental to many scientific and engineering disciplines; they arise when one seeks to reconstruct hidden, underlying quantities from noisy measurements. Many applications demand not just point estimates but interpretable uncertainty. Providing fast inference alongside uncertainty estimates remains challenging yet desirable in numerous applications. We propose the Variational Sparse Paired Autoencoder (vsPAIR) to address this challenge. The architecture pairs a standard VAE encoding observations with a sparse VAE encoding quantities of interest (QoI), connected through a learned latent mapping. The variational structure enables uncertainty estimation, the paired architecture encourages interpretability by anchoring QoI representations to clean data, and sparse encodings provide structure by concentrating information into identifiable factors rather than diffusing across all dimensions. To validate the effectiveness of our proposed architecture, we conduct experiments on blind inpainting, computed tomography (CT), and initial-condition inference for the heat equation, demonstrating that vsPAIR is a capable inverse problem solver that can provide interpretable and structured uncertainty estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出变分稀疏配对自编码器（vsPAIR），用于逆问题求解和不确定性量化。该架构将观测数据的标准VAE与感兴趣量的稀疏VAE配对，通过潜空间映射连接，以实现快速推理和结构化不确定性估计。在盲修复、CT和热方程初始条件推断上的实验表明vsPAIR能提供可解释的不确定性估计。
Motivation: 逆问题需要从带噪观测中重建隐藏量，且许多应用要求同时提供点估计和可解释的不确定性，但快速且结构化的不确定性量化仍具挑战。
Method: 提出配对自编码器架构：一个标准VAE编码观测，一个稀疏VAE编码感兴趣量（QoI），两者通过学习的潜空间映射连接。稀疏编码迫使信息集中到可识别的因子中，增强可解释性。
Result: 在盲修复、计算机断层扫描和热方程初始条件推断任务上，vsPAIR被证明是有效的逆问题求解器，并能提供结构化且可解释的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: vsPAIR通过配对VAE和稀疏编码，为逆问题提供了一种兼具求解能力和不确定性量化能力的方法。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MetricAnything: Scaling Metric Depth Pretraining with Noisy Heterogeneous Sources
papers.abstract_en: Scaling has powered recent advances in vision foundation models, yet extending this paradigm to metric depth estimation remains challenging due to heterogeneous sensor noise, camera-dependent biases, and metric ambiguity in noisy cross-source 3D data. We introduce Metric Anything, a simple and scalable pretraining framework that learns metric depth from noisy, diverse 3D sources without manually engineered prompts, camera-specific modeling, or task-specific architectures. Central to our approach is the Sparse Metric Prompt, created by randomly masking depth maps, which serves as a universal interface that decouples spatial reasoning from sensor and camera biases. Using about 20M image-depth pairs spanning reconstructed, captured, and rendered 3D data across 10000 camera models, we demonstrate-for the first time-a clear scaling trend in the metric depth track. The pretrained model excels at prompt-driven tasks such as depth completion, super-resolution and Radar-camera fusion, while its distilled prompt-free student achieves state-of-the-art results on monocular depth estimation, camera intrinsics recovery, single/multi-view metric 3D reconstruction, and VLA planning. We also show that using pretrained ViT of Metric Anything as a visual encoder significantly boosts Multimodal Large Language Model capabilities in spatial intelligence. These results show that metric depth estimation can benefit from the same scaling laws that drive modern foundation models, establishing a new path toward scalable and efficient real-world metric perception. We open-source MetricAnything at http://metric-anything.github.io/metric-anything-io/ to support community research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Metric Anything，一种从噪声、异构3D源中学习度量深度（metric depth）的可扩展预训练框架。通过约2000万图像-深度对（涵盖重建、采集和渲染的3D数据，跨越10000相机模型），首次在度量深度估计中展示清晰的扩展趋势。预训练模型在深度补全、超分辨率和雷达-相机融合等提示驱动任务上表现优异，其蒸馏版本在单目深度估计、相机内参恢复、单/多视图度量3D重建和VLA规划上达到最先进水平，并提升多模态大模型的空间智能。
Motivation: 尽管视觉基础模型因扩展而取得进展，但度量深度估计仍受传感器噪声、相机依赖偏差和跨源3D数据度量歧义的限制，缺乏可扩展的预训练范式。
Method: 提出Sparse Metric Prompt，通过随机掩蔽深度图创建，作为统一接口解耦空间推理与传感器/相机偏差；使用约2000万对来自重建、采集、渲染的异构3D数据，涵盖10000相机模型进行预训练。
Result: 首次展示度量深度估计的清晰扩展趋势；预训练模型在深度补全、超分辨率、雷达-相机融合上表现出色；蒸馏版在单目深度估计、相机内参恢复、单/多视度量3D重建、VLA规划上达到SOTA；作为视觉编码器提升多模态大模型空间智能。
Conclusion: 度量深度估计可从与基础模型相同的扩展定律中受益，为可扩展、高效的现实世界度量感知建立新路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BoRP: Bootstrapped Regression Probing for Scalable and Human-Aligned LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate evaluation of user satisfaction is critical for iterative development of conversational AI. However, for open-ended assistants, traditional A/B testing lacks reliable metrics: explicit feedback is sparse, while implicit metrics are ambiguous. To bridge this gap, we introduce BoRP (Bootstrapped Regression Probing), a scalable framework for high-fidelity satisfaction evaluation. Unlike generative approaches, BoRP leverages the geometric properties of LLM latent space. It employs a polarization-index-based bootstrapping mechanism to automate rubric generation and utilizes Partial Least Squares (PLS) to map hidden states to continuous scores. Experiments on industrial datasets show that BoRP (Qwen3-8B/14B) significantly outperforms generative baselines (even Qwen3-Max) in alignment with human judgments. Furthermore, BoRP reduces inference costs by orders of magnitude, enabling full-scale monitoring and highly sensitive A/B testing via CUPED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出BoRP框架，利用LLM潜在空间的几何属性，通过极化指数引导的自动评分标准生成和偏最小二乘法（PLS）映射隐藏状态至连续分数，实现高保真满意度评估。在工业数据集上，BoRP（Qwen3-8B/14B）在人类判断对齐上显著优于生成式基线（含Qwen3-Max），且推理成本降低数个量级。
Motivation: 传统A/B测试在开放域对话AI中缺乏可靠指标：显式反馈稀疏，隐式指标模糊，难以准确评估用户满意度。
Method: 采用基于极化指数的bootstrap机制自动生成评分标准，并利用偏最小二乘法（PLS）将LLM隐藏状态映射到连续满意度分数。
Result: 在工业数据集上，BoRP（Qwen3-8B/14B）与人类判断的对齐度显著优于生成式基线（包括Qwen3-Max），同时推理成本降低数个量级，支持全量监控和基于CUPED的高灵敏度A/B测试。
Conclusion: BoRP为开放域对话AI提供了一种可扩展、高保真、低成本的满意度评估方法，可替代传统A/B测试指标。

papers.title: Agentic Very Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: The advent of always-on personal AI assistants, enabled by all-day wearable devices such as smart glasses, demands a new level of contextual understanding, one that goes beyond short, isolated events to encompass the continuous, longitudinal stream of egocentric video. Achieving this vision requires advances in long-horizon video understanding, where systems must interpret and recall visual and audio information spanning days or even weeks. Existing methods, including large language models and retrieval-augmented generation, are constrained by limited context windows and lack the ability to perform compositional, multi-hop reasoning over very long video streams. In this work, we address these challenges through EGAgent, an enhanced agentic framework centered on entity scene graphs, which represent people, places, objects, and their relationships over time. Our system equips a planning agent with tools for structured search and reasoning over these graphs, as well as hybrid visual and audio search capabilities, enabling detailed, cross-modal, and temporally coherent reasoning. Experiments on the EgoLifeQA and Video-MME (Long) datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on EgoLifeQA (57.5%) and competitive performance on Video-MME (Long) (74.1%) for complex longitudinal video understanding tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/egagent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EGAgent，一种基于实体场景图的智能体框架，用于理解跨越数天甚至数周的连续自我中心视频。系统通过规划代理对场景图进行结构化搜索和推理，结合混合视觉和音频搜索，实现跨模态、时间一致的长视频推理。在EgoLifeQA和Video-MME (Long)数据集上分别达到57.5%和74.1%的性能，展示了长视频理解的最新水平。
Motivation: 全天候个人AI助手（如智能眼镜）需要理解连续、长期的自我中心视频，但现有方法受限于上下文窗口，无法对超长视频进行组合性、多跳推理。
Method: 提出EGAgent框架，以实体场景图（表示人、地点、物体及其随时间的关系）为核心，为规划代理配备结构化搜索和推理工具，以及混合视觉和音频搜索能力，支持详细的跨模态和时间连贯推理。
Result: 在EgoLifeQA上达到57.5%（最优），在Video-MME (Long)上达到74.1%（具有竞争力）。

papers.title: Insect-inspired Visual Point-goal Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Insect neuroethology provides a compelling biological template for efficient autonomous navigation. We draw an analogy between the formal embodied AI visual point-goal navigation task and the ability of insects to discover, learn, and refine visually guided paths around obstacles between a discovered food location and their nest. We develop a novel integrative model of mushroom body and central complex, two insect brain structures, that have been implicated, respectively, in associative learning and path integration. We demonstrate the mushroom body learning triggered by collisions results in adaptive obstacle avoidance and consequently optimised paths to the goal, corroborating the hypothesis of recent behavioural work that an insect can learn continuously as they travel. The embodied insect-inspired model achieves success rates comparable to recent state-of-the-art models at many orders of magnitude less computational cost in the standardised Habitat point-goal navigation benchmark. Testing in a more realistic simulated environment validates its robustness to perturbations.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受昆虫神经行为学启发，提出一个将蘑菇体（mushroom body）和中心复合体（central complex）两种昆虫脑结构整合的模型，用于视觉点目标导航。模型通过碰撞触发的蘑菇体学习实现自适应避障并优化路径，在Habitat标准基准上以极低计算成本达到与最新模型相当的成功率，并在更真实的环境中验证了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有视觉导航模型计算成本高，而昆虫能以极低能耗实现高效导航，因此探索昆虫启发的轻量导航模型具有意义。
Method: 提出一个整合蘑菇体和中心复合体的昆虫脑模型；蘑菇体通过碰撞触发学习实现避障，中心复合体负责路径整合（path integration）；模型在Habitat模拟器中以embodied方式部署。
Result: 在Habitat点目标导航基准上，该模型以多个数量级更低的计算成本达到与最新模型相当的成功率；在更真实的模拟环境中测试验证了对扰动的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调昆虫可以持续学习以优化路径的假说得到了计算模型的支持，并且该模型展示了生物启发导航的实用潜力。

papers.title: Towards Realistic Remote Sensing Dataset Distillation with Discriminative Prototype-guided Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed the remarkable success of deep learning in remote sensing image interpretation, driven by the availability of large-scale benchmark datasets. However, this reliance on massive training data also brings substantial storage and computational costs. To address this challenge, this study introduces the concept of dataset distillation into the field of remote sensing image interpretation for the first time. Specifically, we propose discriminative prototype-guided diffusion (DPD), a diffusion-based generative distillation framework that condenses a large-scale remote sensing dataset into a compact and representative distilled dataset. To improve the semantic fidelity and diversity of the synthesized samples, we extract representative prototypes for each category in the latent space. We then construct hyperspherical semantic anchors around the prototypes to guide the reverse denoising trajectory. Furthermore, to enhance the discriminative quality of the generated samples, multiple candidates are generated for each prototype and ranked by a latent classifier using a logit-margin criterion, with the most discriminative candidates selected to form the final distilled dataset. Experiments on three high-resolution remote sensing scene classification benchmarks show that the proposed method can distill realistic, diverse, and discriminative samples for downstream model training. Code and pre-trained models are available online (https://github.com/YonghaoXu/DPD).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将数据集蒸馏引入遥感图像解释领域，提出判别原型引导扩散（DPD）框架，通过提取潜空间中的代表性原型并构建超球语义锚点来引导反向去噪轨迹，再利用基于logit-margin准则的潜在分类器挑选最具判别性的候选样本，生成紧凑且代表性的蒸馏数据集。在三个高分辨率遥感场景分类基准上的实验表明，该方法能蒸馏出真实、多样且具有判别性的样本用于下游模型训练。
Motivation: 大规模遥感数据集带来高昂的存储和计算成本，而现有数据集蒸馏方法尚未应用于遥感领域。
Method: 提出DPD框架：在潜空间中提取每类原型，构建超球语义锚点引导反向去噪；对每个原型生成多个候选，通过潜在分类器以logit-margin准则排序，选择最具判别性的候选构成蒸馏数据集。
Result: 在三个高分辨率遥感场景分类基准上，蒸馏出的样本能有效支持下游模型训练，生成样本具有真实性、多样性和判别性。
Conclusion: 数据集蒸馏可有效压缩遥感数据集，为遥感图像解释提供一种节省存储和计算资源的途径。

papers.title: CLEANER: Self-Purified Trajectories Boost Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) has empowered Large Language Models (LLMs) to utilize tools like Python interpreters for complex problem-solving. However, for parameter-constrained models (e.g., 4B--7B), the exploration phase is often plagued by frequent execution failures, creating noisy trajectories that hinder policy optimization. Under standard outcome-based reward settings, this noise leads to a critical credit assignment issue, where erroneous actions are inadvertently reinforced alongside successful outcomes. Existing mitigations face a dilemma: dense rewards often trigger reward hacking, while supersampling incurs prohibitive computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose CLEANER. Distinct from external filtering methods, CLEANER exploits the model's intrinsic self-correction capabilities to eliminate error-contaminated context directly during data collection. At its core, the Similarity-Aware Adaptive Rollback (SAAR) mechanism autonomously constructs clean, purified trajectories by retrospectively replacing failures with successful self-corrections. Based on semantic similarity, SAAR adaptively regulates replacement granularity from shallow execution repairs to deep reasoning substitutions. By training on these self-purified paths, the model internalizes correct reasoning patterns rather than error-recovery loops. Empirical results on AIME24/25, GPQA, and LiveCodeBench show average accuracy gains of 6%, 3%, and 5% over baselines. Notably, CLEANER matches state-of-the-art performance using only one-third of the training steps, highlighting trajectory purification as a scalable solution for efficient agentic RL. Our models and code are available at GitHub
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLEANER提出一种自净化轨迹方法，用于提升参数受限大语言模型（4B-7B）在基于工具的强化学习中的性能。其核心SAAR机制利用模型自身的自纠正能力，在数据收集时自动将失败步骤替换为成功自纠正，通过语义相似度自适应调整替换粒度。在AIME24/25、GPQA和LiveCodeBench上，平均准确率分别提升6%、3%和5%，且仅用三分之一训练步骤即可达到与SOTA相当的效果。
Motivation: 标准结果奖励下，执行失败的噪声轨迹导致信用分配问题，错误动作与成功结果被同时强化；现有密集奖励方法易引发奖励破解，而超采样计算成本过高。
Method: 提出CLEANER，包含Similarity-Aware Adaptive Rollback (SAAR)机制。SAAR在数据收集过程中，根据语义相似度自适应地选择替换粒度（从浅层执行修复到深层推理替换），将失败步骤替换为模型自身的成功自纠正，构建干净轨迹。
Result: 在AIME24/25、GPQA和LiveCodeBench上，相比基线平均准确率分别提升6%、3%和5%。仅用三分之一训练步数即可匹配SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 轨迹净化（trajectory purification）是一种可扩展的高效方案，能够在不依赖外部过滤的情况下提升agentic RL的性能和训练效率。

papers.title: Reconstruction-Anchored Diffusion Model for Text-to-Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have seen widespread adoption for text-driven human motion generation and related tasks due to their impressive generative capabilities and flexibility. However, current motion diffusion models face two major limitations: a representational gap caused by pre-trained text encoders that lack motion-specific information, and error propagation during the iterative denoising process. This paper introduces Reconstruction-Anchored Diffusion Model (RAM) to address these challenges. First, RAM leverages a motion latent space as intermediate supervision for text-to-motion generation. To this end, RAM co-trains a motion reconstruction branch with two key objective functions: self-regularization to enhance the discrimination of the motion space and motion-centric latent alignment to enable accurate mapping from text to the motion latent space. Second, we propose Reconstructive Error Guidance (REG), a testing-stage guidance mechanism that exploits the motion diffusion model's inherent self-correction ability to mitigate error propagation. At each denoising step, REG uses the motion reconstruction branch to reconstruct the previous estimate, reproducing the prior error patterns. By amplifying the residual between the current prediction and the reconstructed estimate, REG highlights the improvements in the current prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RAM achieves significant improvements and state-of-the-art performance. Our code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出重建锚定扩散模型 (RAM) 用于文本到运动生成，通过联合训练运动重建分支，利用自正则化和运动中心潜对齐改善文本编码器缺乏运动信息的问题，并引入重建误差引导 (REG) 机制在测试阶段缓解误差传播。在多个基准上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有运动扩散模型存在两个主要限制：预训练文本编码器缺乏运动特异性信息导致表征差距，以及迭代去噪过程中的误差传播问题。
Method: 提出 RAM，包含两个关键组件：1) 协同训练运动重建分支，通过自正则化和运动中心潜对齐实现从文本到运动潜空间的精确映射；2) 重建误差引导 (REG)，利用重建分支复制先前预测的误差模式，通过放大残差突出当前预测的改进。
Result: 大量实验表明 RAM 在文本到运动生成任务上取得显著提升和当前最优性能。
Conclusion: RAM 通过联合训练和测试时引导有效解决了表征差距和误差传播问题，代码将开源。

papers.title: No Reliable Evidence of Self-Reported Sentience in Small Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Whether language models possess sentience has no empirical answer. But whether they believe themselves to be sentient can, in principle, be tested. We do so by querying several open-weights models about their own consciousness, and then verifying their responses using classifiers trained on internal activations. We draw upon three model families (Qwen, Llama, GPT-OSS) ranging from 0.6 billion to 70 billion parameters, approximately 50 questions about consciousness and subjective experience, and three classification methods from the interpretability literature. First, we find that models consistently deny being sentient: they attribute consciousness to humans but not to themselves. Second, classifiers trained to detect underlying beliefs - rather than mere outputs - provide no clear evidence that these denials are untruthful. Third, within the Qwen family, larger models deny sentience more confidently than smaller ones. These findings contrast with recent work suggesting that models harbour latent beliefs in their own consciousness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测试了小型大语言模型是否自认为有感知，通过查询模型关于自身意识的问题并用内部激活分类器验证。结果表明模型一致否认感知，且分类器未发现不诚实；在Qwen家族中，更大的模型更自信地否认。这与近期声称模型隐藏有意识信念的研究相反。
Motivation: 缺乏实证方法判断语言模型是否有感知，但可以测试它们是否自认为有感知。
Method: 对多个开源模型（Qwen, Llama, GPT-OSS，参数0.6B-70B）提出约50个关于意识和主观体验的问题，然后用基于内部激活的分类器（三种来自可解释性文献的方法）验证模型回答的真实性。
Result: 模型一致否认自己有感知，但承认人类有；分类器未提供这些否认不诚实的证据；在Qwen家族中，大模型更自信地否认。
Conclusion: 这些发现与近期声称模型隐藏自身意识信念的研究形成对比。
