papers.title: Toward Efficient Agents: Memory, Tool learning, and Planning
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have witnessed increasing interest in extending large language models into agentic systems. While the effectiveness of agents has continued to improve, efficiency, which is crucial for real-world deployment, has often been overlooked. This paper therefore investigates efficiency from three core components of agents: memory, tool learning, and planning, considering costs such as latency, tokens, steps, etc. Aimed at conducting comprehensive research addressing the efficiency of the agentic system itself, we review a broad range of recent approaches that differ in implementation yet frequently converge on shared high-level principles including but not limited to bounding context via compression and management, designing reinforcement learning rewards to minimize tool invocation, and employing controlled search mechanisms to enhance efficiency, which we discuss in detail. Accordingly, we characterize efficiency in two complementary ways: comparing effectiveness under a fixed cost budget, and comparing cost at a comparable level of effectiveness. This trade-off can also be viewed through the Pareto frontier between effectiveness and cost. From this perspective, we also examine efficiency oriented benchmarks by summarizing evaluation protocols for these components and consolidating commonly reported efficiency metrics from both benchmark and methodological studies. Moreover, we discuss the key challenges and future directions, with the goal of providing promising insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了大型语言模型在智能体系统中效率问题的最新研究，重点关注记忆、工具学习和规划三个核心组件。通过分析压缩上下文、强化学习奖励最小化工具调用、受控搜索等策略，论文提出了在固定效果下比较成本和在固定成本下比较效果两种互补的效率评估方式，并整理了相关基准和评估指标。
Motivation: 现有智能体系统研究多关注有效性，而效率（如延迟、令牌数、步数等）对实际部署至关重要，但常被忽视。
Method: 从记忆、工具学习和规划三个核心组件出发，综述了多种方法，包括上下文压缩与管理、强化学习奖励设计以最小化工具调用、受控搜索机制等，并通过帕累托前沿分析有效性与成本的权衡。
Result: 论文总结了效率评估的协议和常用指标，指出了当前挑战和未来方向。
Conclusion: 效率是智能体系统实际部署的关键，需要从多个组件和成本维度进行系统性优化。

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks are Heuristics
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks are usually treated as auxiliaries for combinatorial optimization: they imitate algorithms, guide search, or supply scores to classical procedures. We show that this auxiliary role is not intrinsic. A GNN can itself be a heuristic. For the Euclidean Travelling Salesman Problem, we train a non-autoregressive GNN with no labels, rewards, sequential decoding, search, or local improvement. A differentiable Hamiltonian-cycle objective is the only supervision. The trained model produces a complete tour in one forward pass, while dropout and snapshots from a single training trajectory provide solution diversity without engineered moves. The heuristic is therefore learned, not programmed. It is also fast: batched inference remains in the millisecond regime on GPUs. Experiments on TSP100, TSP200, and TSP500 show that the model consistently improves over nearest-neighbor greedy baselines. These results identify unsupervised GNNs as a class of fast learned heuristics for combinatorial optimization.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 tables with 2 figures, code repo included in the manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示图神经网络（GNN）本身可以作为组合优化问题的启发式方法，而不只是传统算法的辅助。针对欧几里得旅行商问题，作者训练了一个非自回归的GNN，无需标签、奖励、序列解码、搜索或局部改进，仅使用可微的哈密顿环目标函数作为监督。模型在一次前向传播中生成完整游览，并通过dropout和单次训练轨迹的快照提供解的多样性。实验表明，在TSP100、TSP200和TSP500上，该模型一致优于最近邻贪婪基线，且推理速度快（GPU上毫秒级）。
Motivation: 传统上，GNN在组合优化中仅被视为辅助工具（如模仿算法、引导搜索或提供分数），本文质疑这一辅助角色是否本质，旨在证明GNN本身可以作为有效的启发式方法。
Method: 提出一个无监督的非自回归GNN，通过可微的哈密顿环目标函数进行训练，无需标签、奖励或搜索。模型使用dropout和单次训练轨迹的快照来增强解的多样性。
Result: 在TSP100、TSP200和TSP500基准上，模型一致优于最近邻贪婪基线，且推理速度快（GPU上毫秒级）。
Conclusion: 本文确定了无监督GNN作为一类快速学习的组合优化启发式方法，挑战了其仅作为辅助工具的传统观点。

papers.title: R$^2$PO: Decoupling Rollout and Inference Policies for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Existing reinforcement learning methods for LLM reasoning implicitly assume that the policy generating training trajectories should coincide with the one producing inference responses. We argue that this is a misleading inductive bias: the optimization-optimal trajectory distribution favors informative gradients, whereas the inference-optimal response distribution emphasizes accuracy and consistency. Forcing both into a single policy entangles their gradients and suppresses exploration. We propose R$^2$PO (Residual Rollout Policy Optimization), which attaches a lightweight Residual Rollout-Head atop the policy to decouple training trajectories from inference responses, diversifying rollouts during training while keeping inference generation intact. Experiments show that R$^2$PO consistently outperforms baselines, with average accuracy gains of 3.4% on MATH-500 and 1.3% on APPS, alongside more diverse rollouts and reduced length bias. Our code is available at https://github.com/RRPO-ARR/Code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM推理中现有强化学习方法将训练轨迹策略与推理响应策略耦合的问题，提出R$^2$PO (Residual Rollout Policy Optimization)，通过在策略上附加轻量级残差 rollout-head 来解耦训练轨迹与推理响应，在保持推理生成不变的同时多样化训练rollout。实验表明，该方法在MATH-500和APPS上分别提升平均准确率3.4%和1.3%，并产生更多样化的rollout和减小长度偏差。
Motivation: 现有RL方法隐式假设训练轨迹策略应与推理响应策略一致，这导致优化最优轨迹分布与推理最优响应分布相冲突，抑制探索并混杂梯度，从而限制性能提升。
Method: 提出R$^2$PO框架，在主干策略上附加一个轻量级残差 rollout-head，使训练时rollout轨迹多样化，同时保持推理时生成策略不变，从而解耦两个过程。
Result: 在MATH-500上平均准确率提升3.4%，在APPS上提升1.3%；rollout多样性增加，长度偏差减小。
Conclusion: 解耦训练轨迹与推理策略能够有效提升LLM推理的准确率和探索效率，且附加残差头的方法轻量易用。

papers.title: One Prompt, Many Sounds: Modeling Listener Variability in LLM-Based Equalization
papers.abstract_en: Conventional audio equalization is a static process that requires manual and cumbersome adjustments to adapt to changing listening contexts (e.g., mood, location, or social setting). In this paper, we introduce a Large Language Model (LLM)-based alternative that maps natural language text prompts to equalization settings. This enables a conversational approach to sound system control. By utilizing data collected from a controlled listening experiment, our models exploit in-context learning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques to reliably align with population-preferred equalization settings. Our evaluation methods, which leverage distributional metrics that capture users' varied preferences, show statistically significant improvements in distributional alignment over random sampling and static preset baselines. These results indicate that LLMs could function as ``artificial equalizers," contributing to the development of more accessible, context-aware, and expert-level audio tuning methods.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 15 figures, 2 tables, Accepted for publication in the IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Signal Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的均衡器，通过自然语言文本提示映射到均衡设置，实现对话式音效系统控制。利用受控听力实验数据，结合上下文学习和参数高效微调，模型能可靠地对齐人群偏好的均衡设置。评估使用分布度量捕捉用户偏好差异，结果表明在分布对齐上显著优于随机采样和静态预设基线。
Motivation: 传统音频均衡是静态过程，需要手动繁琐调整以适应变化的收听环境（如情绪、地点或社交场合），缺乏灵活性和易用性。
Method: 基于LLM，通过自然语言提示映射到均衡设置；利用受控听力实验数据，采用上下文学习和参数高效微调技术。
Result: 分布对齐指标显著优于随机采样和静态预设基线，表明LLM可作为“人工均衡器”实现上下文感知的音频调优。
Conclusion: LLM能够实现更易访问、上下文感知且达到专家级别的音频调优方法，推动音频系统控制的发展。

papers.title: Programming over Thinking: Efficient and Robust Multi-Constraint Planning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-constraint planning involves identifying, evaluating, and refining candidate plans while satisfying multiple, potentially conflicting constraints. Existing large language model (LLM) approaches face fundamental limitations in this domain. Pure reasoning paradigms, which rely on long natural language chains, are prone to inconsistency, error accumulation, and prohibitive cost as constraints compound. Conversely, LLMs combined with coding- or solver-based strategies lack flexibility: they often generate problem-specific code from scratch or depend on fixed solvers, failing to capture generalizable logic across diverse problems. To address these challenges, we introduce the Scalable COde Planning Engine (SCOPE), a framework that disentangles query-specific reasoning from generic code execution. By separating reasoning from execution, SCOPE produces solver functions that are consistent, deterministic, and reusable across queries while requiring only minimal changes to input parameters. SCOPE achieves state-of-the-art performance while lowering cost and latency. For example, with GPT-4o, it reaches 93.1% success on TravelPlanner, a 61.6% gain over the best baseline (CoT) while cutting inference cost by 1.4x and time by ~4.67x. Code is available at https://github.com/DerrickGXD/SCOPE.
papers.comment: 8 pages of main text, 2 pages of references and and limitations, 37 pages of appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多约束规划中现有LLM方法（纯推理或编码策略）的不足，提出 Scalable COde Planning Engine (SCOPE) 框架，通过分离查询推理与通用代码执行，生成可复用的求解函数。在 TravelPlanner 基准上，SCOPE 搭配 GPT-4o 达到 93.1% 的成功率，相比最优基线 CoT 提升 61.6%，同时推理成本降低 1.4 倍、时间减少约 4.67 倍。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有LLM在多约束规划中面临瓶颈：纯推理依赖长链自然语言推理，易产生不一致、错误累积且成本高昂；而结合编码或求解器的策略缺乏灵活性，需从头生成特定问题代码或依赖固定求解器，无法泛化到多样化问题。
Method: 提出 SCOPE 框架，将查询推理（query-specific reasoning）与通用代码执行（generic code execution）解耦，通过分离推理与执行生成一致、确定且可跨查询复用的求解器函数，仅需对输入参数做最小调整。
Result: 以 GPT-4o 为后端，SCOPE 在 TravelPlanner 上达到 93.1% 成功率，较最佳基线 CoT 绝对提升 61.6 个百分点，同时推理成本降低 1.4 倍，运行时间减少约 4.67 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过将推理与执行分离，SCOPE 实现了高效、鲁棒且可扩展的多约束规划，为LLM在复杂规划任务中的应用提供了新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Motion Attribution for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite the rapid progress of video generation models, the role of data in influencing motion is poorly understood. We present Motive (MOTIon attribution for Video gEneration), a motion-centric, gradient-based data attribution framework that scales to modern, large, high-quality video datasets and models. We use this to study which fine-tuning clips improve or degrade temporal dynamics. Motive isolates temporal dynamics from static appearance via motion-weighted loss masks, yielding efficient and scalable motion-specific influence computation. On text-to-video models, Motive identifies clips that strongly affect motion and guides data curation that improves temporal consistency and physical plausibility. With Motive-selected high-influence data, our method improves both motion smoothness and dynamic degree on VBench, achieving a 74.1% human preference win rate compared with the pretrained base model. To our knowledge, this is the first framework to attribute motion rather than visual appearance in video generative models and to use it to curate fine-tuning data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Motive，一个基于梯度的运动归因框架，用于视频生成模型，通过运动加权损失掩码隔离时间动态与静态外观，从而识别影响运动的高影响力数据，指导数据筛选以提升时间一致性和物理合理性。实验表明，使用Motive选择的高影响力数据微调，在VBench上改进了运动平滑度和动态程度，相比预训练基础模型获得了74.1%的人类偏好胜率。这是首个将归因用于视频生成中运动而非视觉外观的工作。
Motivation: 尽管视频生成模型进展迅速，但数据如何影响运动的理解仍然不足。现有归因方法大多关注视觉外观，忽略了运动动态。
Method: 提出Motive框架，采用运动加权损失掩码（motion-weighted loss masks）隔离时间动态，实现可扩展的运动特定影响力计算，适用于大规模高质量视频数据集和模型。
Result: 在文本到视频模型上，Motive识别出对运动有强影响的片段，指导数据筛选；微调后在VBench上改进运动平滑度和动态程度，人类偏好胜率达74.1%。
Conclusion: 这是首个在视频生成模型中归因运动而非视觉外观的工作，并展示了利用归因结果进行数据筛选的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Zero-Shot Distracted Driver Detection via Vision Language Models with Double Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: Distracted driving is a major cause of traffic collisions, calling for robust and scalable detection methods. Vision-language models (VLMs) enable strong zero-shot image classification, but existing VLM-based distracted driver detectors often underperform in real-world conditions. We identify subject-specific appearance variations (e.g., clothing, age, and gender) as a key bottleneck: VLMs entangle these factors with behavior cues, leading to decisions driven by who the driver is rather than what the driver is doing. To address this, we propose a subject decoupling framework that extracts a driver appearance embedding and removes its influence from the image embedding prior to zero-shot classification, thereby emphasizing distraction-relevant evidence. We further orthogonalize text embeddings via metric projection onto Stiefel manifold to improve separability while staying close to the original semantics. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains over prior baselines, indicating the promise of our approach for practical road-safety applications. Code is available at https://github.com/mtakamichi/ZVL-DDD
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE 15th International Symposium on Communication Systems, Networks and Digital Signal Processing (CSNDSP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对驾驶员分心检测任务，指出现有视觉语言模型（VLM）在零样本分类时容易受驾驶员个体外观（如服装、年龄、性别）干扰而忽略行为线索。提出主体解耦框架，从图像特征中提取并移除驾驶员外观嵌入，并通过度量投影到斯提弗尔流形（Stiefel manifold）来正交化文本嵌入，从而提升零样本检测性能。实验表明该方法相较于基线有持续改进。
Motivation: 现有VLM-based驾驶员分心检测在真实场景下性能不佳，主要因为模型将主体外观变化与行为线索纠缠，导致决策依据的是驾驶员身份而非行为。
Method: 提出主体解耦框架，先提取驾驶员外观嵌入，然后在零样本分类前从图像嵌入中移除其影响；同时对文本嵌入进行正交化，通过度量投影到斯提弗尔流形，在保持原始语义的前提下提高可分离性。
Result: 实验表明该方法相较于先验基线有持续增益，表明其在道路安全应用中的潜力。
Conclusion: 该框架通过解耦外观和正交化文本嵌入，有效提升了零样本驾驶员分心检测的性能，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prior Diffusiveness and Regret in the Linear-Gaussian Bandit
papers.abstract_en: We prove that Thompson sampling exhibits $\tilde{O}(σd \sqrt{T} + d r \sqrt{\mathrm{Tr}(Σ_0)})$ Bayesian regret in the linear-Gaussian bandit with a $\mathcal{N}(μ_0, Σ_0)$ prior distribution on the coefficients, where $d$ is the dimension, $T$ is the time horizon, $r$ is the maximum $\ell_2$ norm of the actions, and $σ^2$ is the noise variance. In contrast to existing regret bounds, this shows that to within logarithmic factors, the prior-dependent ``burn-in'' term $d r \sqrt{\mathrm{Tr}(Σ_0)}$ decouples additively from the minimax (long run) regret $σd \sqrt{T}$. Previous regret bounds exhibit a multiplicative dependence on these terms. We establish these results via a new ``elliptical potential'' lemma, and also provide a lower bound indicating that the burn-in term is unavoidable.

papers.title: MUSON: A Reasoning-oriented Multimodal Dataset for Socially Compliant Navigation in Urban Environments
papers.abstract_en: Socially compliant navigation requires structured reasoning about dynamic pedestrians and physical constraints to ensure safe and interpretable decisions. Vision-language models (VLMs) provide a promising foundation for this task because they can integrate visual observations with language-based social knowledge. However, existing untuned VLMs still struggle to reliably understand fine-grained social norms, making task-specific fine-tuning essential. At the same time, no large-scale egocentric dataset is available this task. To address these challenges, we introduce MUSON, a multimodal dataset for short-horizon social navigation containing 10,110 egocentric samples collected across diverse indoor and outdoor social scenes. MUSON adopts a structured five-step chain-of-thought annotation framework comprising perception, prediction, reasoning, action, and explanation. It explicitly models static physical constraints and employs a standardized six-action decision space. Compared with existing social-navigation datasets, MUSON provides consistent annotations for reasoning, actions, and explanations. We evaluate ten representative small-to-medium VLMs on MUSON. Qwen3-VL-8B achieves the strongest decision-level performance, attaining the highest action accuracy of 0.7765 and Macro-F1 score of 0.7490, as well as the lowest collision rate of 0.0609. These results demonstrate that MUSON is an effective and reusable benchmark for advancing socially compliant navigation. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/MUSON-dataset/MUSON/releases/tag/v1.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍MUSON，一个面向城市环境中社会合规导航的多模态数据集，包含10,110个自我中心样本，采用五步链式推理标注框架（感知、预测、推理、动作、解释）。评估了10个小型到中型VLM，其中Qwen3-VL-8B取得最佳决策性能，动作准确率0.7765，Macro-F1 0.7490，碰撞率0.0609。数据集已公开。
Motivation: 现有VLM难以可靠理解细粒度社会规范，且缺乏大规模自我中心数据集用于社会导航任务。
Method: 构建MUSON数据集，采用结构化五步链式推理标注框架，显式建模静态物理约束，使用标准化的六动作决策空间。
Result: Qwen3-VL-8B在MUSON上取得最佳动作准确率0.7765，Macro-F1 0.7490，最低碰撞率0.0609。
Conclusion: MUSON是有效且可复用的社会合规导航基准，数据集已公开。

papers.title: Atlas is Your Perfect Context: One-Shot Customization for Generalizable Foundational Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images is essential for diagnosis and treatment planning. While recent interactive segmentation foundation models enhance generalization through large-scale multimodal pretraining, they still depend on precise prompts and can fail in underrepresented clinical contexts (e.g., small organs-at-risk). We present AtlasSegFM, an atlas-guided framework that customizes off-the-shelf foundation models to new clinical contexts with a single annotated example. AtlasSegFM 1) performs atlas-query registration to generate context-aware prompts, 2) refines the segmentation with a frozen foundation model, and 3) applies a lightweight adaptive fusion module to combine atlas priors with foundation-model inputs and predictions. Extensive experiments on six public and in-house datasets across radiotherapy and vascular scenarios show consistent gains, with the largest improvements on small and delicate structures. AtlasSegFM provides a lightweight, deployable solution for one-shot customization of segmentation foundation models in real-world clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AtlasSegFM 提出一种基于图谱（atlas）的框架，通过单个标注示例将通用医学图像分割基础模型定制到新的临床场景。该方法包括图谱-查询配准生成上下文感知提示、冻结基础模型进行细化分割、以及轻量自适应融合模块。在六个放射治疗和血管数据集上，对小型和精细结构分割提升显著。
Motivation: 现有交互式分割基础模型在未见过的临床场景（如小型危及器官）中依赖精确提示且可能失败，缺乏针对特定解剖上下文的定制能力。
Method: 三步流程：1) 图谱-查询配准生成上下文感知提示；2) 冻结的基础模型使用这些提示进行分割细化；3) 轻量自适应融合模块结合图谱先验与基础模型的输入和预测。
Result: 在六个公开和内部数据集（放射治疗和血管场景）上，AtlasSegFM 持续提升分割性能，尤其是在小型和精细结构上改善最大。
Conclusion: 提供了一种轻量、可部署的解决方案，用于在真实临床工作流中实现分割基础模型的一次性定制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Spatial Trace with Reasoning in Vision-Language Models for Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Spatial tracing, as a fundamental embodied interaction ability for robots, is inherently challenging as it requires multi-step metric-grounded reasoning compounded with complex spatial referring and real-world metric measurement. However, existing methods struggle with this compositional task. To this end, we propose RoboTracer, a 3D-aware VLM that first achieves both 3D spatial referring and measuring via a universal spatial encoder and a regression-supervised decoder to enhance scale awareness during supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Moreover, RoboTracer advances multi-step metric-grounded reasoning via reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) with metric-sensitive process rewards, supervising key intermediate perceptual cues to accurately generate spatial traces. To support SFT and RFT training, we introduce TraceSpatial, a large-scale dataset of 30M QA pairs, spanning outdoor/indoor/tabletop scenes and supporting complex reasoning processes (up to 9 steps). We further present TraceSpatial-Bench, a challenging benchmark filling the gap to evaluate spatial tracing. Experimental results show that RoboTracer surpasses baselines in spatial understanding, measuring, and referring, with an average success rate of 79.1%, and also achieves SOTA performance on TraceSpatial-Bench by a large margin, exceeding Gemini-2.5-Pro by 36% accuracy. Notably, RoboTracer can be integrated with various control policies to execute long-horizon, dynamic tasks across diverse robots (UR5, G1 humanoid) in cluttered real-world scenes. Please see the project page at https://zhoues.github.io/RoboTracer.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://zhoues.github.io/RoboTracer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboTracer 是一种3D感知视觉语言模型，通过通用空间编码器、回归监督解码器和强化微调实现机器人的空间追踪（spatial tracing），即多步度量-基础推理。该模型在室内/室外/桌面场景的大规模数据集TraceSpatial（30M QA对）上训练，并在TraceSpatial-Bench基准上超过Gemini-2.5-Pro约36%准确率，平均成功率达79.1%。实际场景中可集成到UR5、G1人形机器人执行长时动态任务。
Motivation: 现有方法难以处理机器人空间追踪这一组合任务，因为它需要多步度量-基础推理、复杂空间指代和真实世界的度量测量。
Method: 提出RoboTracer，包含通用空间编码器和回归监督解码器，通过监督微调增强尺度感知；再通过强化微调（RFT）结合度量敏感的过程奖励，监督关键中间感知线索以准确生成空间轨迹。同时构建TraceSpatial数据集和TraceSpatial-Bench基准。
Result: RoboTracer在空间理解、测量和指代方面平均成功率达79.1%，在TraceSpatial-Bench上以较大优势超越基线，比Gemini-2.5-Pro准确率高36%。
Conclusion: RoboTracer在空间追踪任务上取得显著提升，并可与多种控制策略集成，应用于不同机器人平台的实际动态场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shapley-based Data Valuation for LLM Alignment via Sequential Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Data valuation is a natural framework for understanding which preference datasets matter most when aligning a Large Language Model (LLM) using multiple sources. The standard game-theoretic approach assigns each dataset a contribution score via the Shapley value. In practice, however, Shapley-based valuation is computationally prohibitive because it requires fine-tuning a separate model for every possible coalition of preference datasets, i.e., an exponential number of alignments. We address this challenge for a broad family of preference-optimization objectives, including DPO and IPO, that learn directly from log-policy ratios with respect to a reference policy. We introduce Sequential Preference Optimization, an offline procedure that applies existing preference optimization methods sequentially, source by source, updating the current policy after each dataset. Under exact optimization, this procedure yields an additive composition rule in reward space and an equivalent arithmetic composition rule in policy space. This observation enables an efficient approximation of the Shapley value: we train one model per preference dataset and reconstruct coalition policies at inference time from the singleton models, reducing the required alignments from exponential to linear in the number of sources. Leveraging this property, we compute Shapley values for several real-world preference datasets and reveal how each source drives model alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对使用多个偏好数据集对齐大语言模型时，如何评估各数据集贡献的问题，提出基于Shapley值的数据估值框架。由于标准Shapley值计算需要指数级数量的偏好优化训练，作者提出顺序偏好优化（Sequential Preference Optimization）方法，通过逐个数据源顺序应用偏好优化算法，使得在奖励空间和政策空间分别满足加性和算术组合规则，从而将所需训练次数从指数级降低到线性级。基于此，作者计算了真实偏好数据集的Shapley值，并揭示了各数据源对模型对齐的驱动作用。
Motivation: 现有Shapley值数据估值方法在LLM对齐场景中计算代价过高，因为需要为每个可能的偏好数据集联盟训练独立模型，导致指数级对齐次数。
Method: 提出顺序偏好优化（Sequential Preference Optimization），一种离线过程，逐个数据源顺序应用现有偏好优化方法（如DPO、IPO），并更新当前策略。在精确优化下，该方法在奖励空间产生加性组合规则，在策略空间产生算术组合规则，从而通过训练每个偏好数据集一个模型并在推理时重构联盟策略，将所需对齐次数从指数级减少到线性级。
Result: 利用该性质，作者计算了多个真实世界偏好数据集的Shapley值，揭示了每个数据源对模型对齐的贡献。
Conclusion: 顺序偏好优化为基于Shapley的数据估值提供了一种计算可行的方法，使得在LLM对齐中评估多源偏好数据的重要性成为可能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FunPhase: A Periodic Functional Autoencoder for Motion Generation via Phase Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Learning natural body motion remains challenging due to the strong coupling between spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Embedding motion in phase manifolds, latent spaces that capture local periodicity, has proven effective for motion prediction; however, existing approaches are tied to fixed skeletons and narrow motion distributions, limiting their applicability across diverse settings. We introduce FunPhase, a functional periodic autoencoder that learns a phase manifold for motion and replaces discrete temporal decoding with a function-space formulation, enabling smooth trajectories that can be sampled at arbitrary temporal resolutions. FunPhase unifies motion prediction and generation within a single interpretable phase manifold, enabling motion generation via latent diffusion, generalizes across skeletons and datasets, and supports downstream tasks such as motion super-resolution and partial-body completion. Our model achieves substantially lower reconstruction error than prior periodic autoencoder baselines, achieving uniform improvements of at least $45\%$ across all metrics, while enabling a broader range of applications and performing on par with state-of-the-art motion generation methods.

papers.title: Is Generation Required for Data-Efficient Perception?
papers.abstract_en: It has been hypothesized that achieving the data efficiency of human visual perception requires a generative approach in which internal representations result from inverting a decoder. Yet today's most successful vision models are non-generative, relying on an encoder that maps images to representations without decoder inversion. This raises the question of whether generation is necessary for data-efficient machine perception. To address this, we study to what extent generative and non-generative methods can achieve compositional generalization, a hallmark of human data efficiency. Under a compositional generative process, we formally characterize the inductive biases required for compositional generalization in decoder-based (generative) and encoder-based (non-generative) methods. We show theoretically that the inductive biases required for an encoder are substantially more complex and generally infeasible to impose explicitly through architectural constraints or regularization. By contrast, the decoder biases take a simple form that can be enforced directly. These results suggest that compositional generalization may be substantially easier to achieve through a generative paradigm of learning and inverting a decoder rather than learning an encoder directly. We examine our theoretical findings empirically by training a range of generative and non-generative methods on synthetic image data. We find that non-generative methods often fail to generalize compositionally and require large-scale pretraining to improve generalization. By comparison, generative methods yield gains in generalization without requiring additional data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了在数据高效的视觉感知中，生成式方法（基于解码器）是否比非生成式方法（基于编码器）更有优势。通过理论分析和合成图像实验，作者发现非生成式方法实现组合泛化所需的归纳偏置更复杂且难以强制执行，而生成式方法可以更简单地实现组合泛化，且无需额外数据。
Motivation: 人类视觉感知的数据效率被认为依赖于生成式方法（通过解码器逆映射得到内部表示），但当前最成功的视觉模型是非生成式的。这引发了一个问题：生成式方法对于数据高效的机器感知是否必要？
Method: 在组合生成过程的假设下，形式化描述了基于解码器（生成式）和基于编码器（非生成式）方法实现组合泛化所需的归纳偏置，并通过理论证明编码器的偏置更复杂且难以通过架构约束或正则化显式施加，而解码器的偏置形式简单且可直接强制。
Result: 理论表明编码器需要更复杂的归纳偏置且难以强制执行；在合成图像数据上的实验显示，非生成式方法经常无法实现组合泛化，需要大规模预训练，而生成式方法在不增加数据的情况下提升了泛化性能。
Conclusion: 组合泛化可能更容易通过生成式范式（学习和逆解码器）实现，而非直接学习编码器。

papers.title: Learning to Generate Human-Human-Object Interactions from Textual Descriptions
papers.abstract_en: The way humans interact with each other, including interpersonal distances, spatial configuration, and motion, varies significantly across different situations. To enable machines to understand such complex, context-dependent behaviors, it is essential to model multiple people in relation to the surrounding scene context. In this paper, we present a novel research problem to model the correlations between two people engaged in a shared interaction involving an object. We refer to this formulation as Human-Human-Object Interactions (HHOIs). To overcome the lack of dedicated datasets for HHOIs, we present a newly captured HHOIs dataset and a method to synthesize HHOI data by leveraging image generative models. As an intermediary, we obtain individual human-object interaction (HOIs) and human-human interaction (HHIs) from the HHOIs, and with these data, we train an text-to-HOI and text-to-HHI model using score-based diffusion model. Finally, we present a unified generative framework that integrates the two individual model, capable of synthesizing complete HHOIs in a single advanced sampling process. Our method extends HHOI generation to multi-human settings, enabling interactions involving more than two individuals. Experimental results show that our method generates realistic HHOIs conditioned on textual descriptions, outperforming previous approaches that focus only on single-human HOIs. Furthermore, we introduce multi-human motion generation involving objects as an application of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出人类-人类-物体交互（HHOI）生成问题，研究两人共同操作一个物体时的交互建模。由于缺乏专用数据集，作者收集了新数据集并利用图像生成模型合成数据。通过分别训练文本到单人-物体交互（HOI）和文本到人际交互（HHI）的扩散模型，再统一为联合采样框架，实现文本描述驱动的HHOI生成。实验表明该方法能生成逼真的HHOI，且优于仅考虑单人的HOI方法。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注单人-物体交互或人际交互，缺乏同时建模两人与物体交互的研究。理解这种复杂情境依赖的行为对于机器理解社交场景至关重要。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：首先从HHOI数据中分解出HOI和HHI，分别训练基于得分扩散模型的文本条件生成器；然后设计统一的逆向采样过程，整合两个模型以生成完整的HHOI。该方法还支持多人（两人以上）交互生成。
Result: 定性实验表明方法能根据文本描述生成合理的HHOI，在交互自然性和物体一致性上优于基线。定量结果未在摘要中报告具体数字。
Conclusion: 本文首次定义HHOI问题并构建了数据集与生成框架，为多人物-物体交互生成提供了新方向。局限性包括依赖合成数据质量及尚未处理更复杂场景。

papers.title: VKnowU: Evaluating Visual Knowledge Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have become adept at recognizing objects, they often lack the intuitive, human-like understanding of the world's underlying physical and social principles. This high-level vision-grounded semantics, which we term visual knowledge, forms a bridge between perception and reasoning, yet remains an underexplored area in current MLLMs. To systematically evaluate this capability, we present VKnowU, a comprehensive benchmark featuring 1,680 questions in 1,249 videos, covering 8 core types of visual knowledge spanning both world-centric (e.g., intuitive physics) and human-centric (e.g., subjective intentions). Evaluation of 28 SOTA MLLMs reveals that leading models still fall short of human performance, with particularly notable gaps in the world-centric. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new dataset, VKnowQA, and VideoKnow+, a baseline model that explicitly incorporates visual knowledge into MLLMs. VideoKnow+ follows a structured See-Think-Answer paradigm and adopts reinforcement learning with visual knowledge reward, achieving a +3.7% improvement on VKnowU and consistent gains on MVBench (+5.4%), Video-MME (+7.0%), and MMVU (+5.7%). Our work highlights visual knowledge as a missing cornerstone for developing more generalizable MLLMs that can not only see but also truly understand our worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VKnowU是一个评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）视觉知识理解能力的基准，包含1680个问题、1249个视频，覆盖8种视觉知识类型。对28个先进MLLM的评估显示，现有模型在理解世界中心（如直觉物理）和人类中心（如主观意图）的视觉知识上均未达到人类水平，尤其在世界中心方面差距显著。为弥补这一差距，论文引入VKnowQA数据集和VideoKnow+基准模型，后者采用See-Think-Answer范式和强化学习，在VKnowU上提升+3.7%，并在MVBench、Video-MME、MMVU上取得一致增益。
Motivation: 当前MLLM虽然擅长物体识别，但缺乏对世界底层物理和社会原则的直观、类人理解，这种高层次的视觉基础语义（即视觉知识）在现有模型中未被充分探索。
Method: 提出VKnowU基准（1680个问题，1249个视频，8种视觉知识类型）和VideoKnow+模型，后者采用See-Think-Answer结构化范式，并引入基于视觉知识奖励的强化学习。
Result: 28个SOTA MLLM评估显示，顶尖模型在视觉知识理解上仍落后于人类；VideoKnow+在VKnowU上提升+3.7%，并在MVBench（+5.4%）、Video-MME（+7.0%）、MMVU（+5.7%）上取得一致增益。
Conclusion: 视觉知识是开发更可推广MLLM的缺失基石，使模型不仅能看见，还能真正理解世界。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: IndustryNav: Exploring Spatial Reasoning of Embodied Agents in Dynamic Industrial Navigation
papers.abstract_en: While Visual Large Language Models (VLLMs) show great promise as embodied agents, they continue to face substantial challenges in spatial reasoning. Existing embodied benchmarks largely focus on passive, static household environments and evaluate isolated capabilities, failing to capture holistic performance in interactive and dynamic complexity of specific domains. To fill this gap, we present IndustryNav, the first dynamic industrial navigation benchmark for active spatial reasoning. IndustryNav leverages 12 manually created, high-fidelity Unity warehouse scenarios featuring dynamic objects and human movement. We proposes a zero-shot PointGoal navigation pipeline that effectively combines egocentric vision with global odometry to assess holistic local-global planning. Furthermore, we introduce the "collision rate" and "warning rate" metrics to measure safety-oriented behaviors. A comprehensive study of fourteen state-of-the-art VLLMs (including models such as GPT-5.2, Claude-4.6, and Gemini-3) reveals that closed-source models maintain a consistent advantage; however, all agents exhibit notable deficiencies in robust path planning, collision avoidance and active exploration. This highlights a critical need for embodied research to move beyond passive perception and toward tasks that demand stable planning, active exploration, and safe behavior in vivid, dynamic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IndustryNav，首个用于动态工业导航的空间推理基准，包含 12 个高保真 Unity 仓库场景和动态物体/人员运动。提出零样本 PointGoal 导航流程，结合自我中心视觉与全局里程计，并引入碰撞率和预警率指标评估安全性。对 14 种 VLLM 的评估表明，闭源模型有优势，但所有智能体在路径规划、避障和主动探索方面存在明显缺陷。
Motivation: 现有具身智能基准多聚焦于静态家庭环境，评估孤立能力，无法反映交互式动态工业领域中的整体表现。需要针对动态工业导航的空间推理基准。
Method: 构建 12 个高保真 Unity 仓库场景，包含动态物体和人员运动；提出零样本 PointGoal 导航流程，融合自我中心视觉与全局里程计；引入碰撞率和预警率作为安全导向指标。
Result: 对 14 种 SOTA VLLM（包括 GPT-5.2、Claude-4.6、Gemini-3）的评估显示，闭源模型保持稳定优势，但所有智能体在鲁棒路径规划、碰撞避免和主动探索方面存在显著不足。
Conclusion: 工业导航任务需要超越被动感知，转向要求稳定规划、主动探索和安全行为的动态环境。

papers.title: Distribution Matching Distillation Meets Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) facilitates efficient inference by distilling multi-step diffusion models into few-step variants. Concurrently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a vital tool for aligning generative models with human preferences. While both represent critical post-training stages for large-scale diffusion models, existing studies typically treat them as independent, sequential processes, leaving a systematic framework for their unification largely unexplored. In this work, we demonstrate that jointly optimizing these two objectives yields mutual benefits: RL enables more preference-aware and controllable distillation rather than uniformly compressing the full data distribution, while DMD serves as an effective regularizer to mitigate reward hacking during RL training. Building on these insights, we propose DMDR, a unified framework that incorporates Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching optimization alongside two dynamic distillation training strategies in the initial stage, followed by the joint DMD and RL optimization in the second stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DMDR achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and prompt adherence among few-step generation methods, even surpassing the performance of its multi-step teacher model.
papers.comment: [ECCV 26] The synergy of reinforcement learning and distribution matching distillation. See more: https://github.com/vvvvvjdy/dmdr
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DMDR框架，将分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）与强化学习（RL）联合优化用于扩散模型蒸馏。RL使蒸馏更加偏好感知和可控，DMD则作为正则化缓解奖励破解。实验表明，DMDR在少步生成中实现了最先进的视觉质量和提示遵循度，甚至超越多步教师模型。
Motivation: 现有研究将DMD和RL视为独立的后训练阶段，缺乏统一框架。本文旨在探索联合优化两者能否带来互惠效果。
Method: 提出DMDR框架，包含奖励倾斜分布匹配（Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching）优化和两种动态蒸馏训练策略（初始阶段），以及第二阶段DMD与RL的联合优化。
Result: 在少步生成方法中达到最先进的视觉质量和提示遵循度，超过多步教师模型。
Conclusion: 联合优化DMD和RL可以相互增强，RL使蒸馏更偏好感知，DMD缓解奖励破解。

summary_sections.result: 在少步生成方法中达到最先进的视觉质量和提示遵循度，超过多步教师模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 联合优化DMD和RL可以相互增强，RL使蒸馏更偏好感知，DMD缓解奖励破解。

papers.title: MGCA-Net: Multi-Grained Category-Aware Network for Open-Vocabulary Temporal Action Localization
papers.abstract_en: Open-Vocabulary Temporal Action Localization (OV-TAL) aims to recognize and localize instances of any desired action categories in videos without explicitly curating training data for all categories. Existing methods mostly recognize action categories at a single granularity, which degrades the recognition accuracy of both base and novel action categories. To address these issues, we propose a Multi-Grained Category-Aware Network (MGCA-Net) comprising a localizer, an action presence predictor, a conventional classifier, and a coarse-to-fine classifier. Specifically, the localizer localizes category-agnostic action proposals. For these action proposals, the action presence predictor estimates the probability that they belong to an action instance. At the same time, the conventional classifier predicts the probability of each action proposal over base action categories at the snippet granularity. Novel action categories are recognized by the coarse-to-fine classifier, which first identifies action presence at the video granularity. Finally, it assigns each action proposal to one category from the coarse categories at the proposal granularity. Through coarse-to-fine category awareness for novel actions and the conventional classifier's awareness of base actions, multi-grained category awareness is achieved, effectively enhancing localization performance. Comprehensive evaluations on the THUMOS'14 and ActivityNet-1.3 benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, our MGCA-Net achieves state-of-the-art results under the Zero-Shot Temporal Action Localization setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放词汇时间动作定位（OV-TAL）中现有方法仅在单一粒度识别动作类别的问题，提出多粒度类别感知网络（MGCA-Net），包含定位器、动作存在预测器、传统分类器和粗到细分类器。通过粗到细分类器识别新动作类别，传统分类器识别基础动作类别，实现多粒度类别感知。在THUMOS'14和ActivityNet-1.3基准上达到最先进性能，在零样本时间动作定位设置下也取得最优结果。
Motivation: 现有OV-TAL方法在单一粒度上识别动作类别，导致基础和新动作类别的识别准确率下降。
Method: 提出MGCA-Net，由四个组件组成：定位器生成类别无关的动作提议；动作存在预测器估计提议属于动作实例的概率；传统分类器在片段粒度预测基础动作类别概率；粗到细分类器先在视频粒度识别动作存在，再在提议粒度将提议分配给粗类别。
Result: 在THUMOS'14和ActivityNet-1.3上达到最先进性能，在零样本时间动作定位设置下也取得最优结果。
Conclusion: 多粒度类别感知有效提升了开放词汇时间动作定位的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SMF-VO: Direct Ego-Motion Estimation via Sparse Motion Fields
papers.abstract_en: Traditional Visual Odometry (VO) and Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) methods rely on a 'pose-centric' paradigm, which computes absolute camera poses from the local map thus requires large-scale landmark maintenance and continuous map optimization. This approach is computationally expensive, limiting their real-time performance on resource-constrained devices. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Sparse Motion Field Visual Odometry (SMF-VO), a lightweight, 'motion-centric' framework. Our approach directly estimates instantaneous linear and angular velocity from sparse optical flow, bypassing the need for explicit pose estimation or expensive landmark tracking. We also employed a generalized 3D ray-based motion field formulation that works accurately with various camera models, including wide-field-of-view lenses. SMF-VO demonstrates superior efficiency and competitive accuracy on benchmark datasets, achieving over 100 FPS on a Raspberry Pi 5 using only a CPU. Our work establishes a scalable and efficient alternative to conventional methods, making it highly suitable for mobile robotics and wearable devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMF-VO 提出了一种轻量级的运动中心视觉里程计框架，通过稀疏光流直接估计瞬时线速度和角速度，避免了传统方法中的显式位姿估计和地标维护。该方法兼容多种相机模型，并在基准数据集上展示了高效率和竞争性精度，在 Raspberry Pi 5 上仅用 CPU 即可达到 100 FPS 以上。
Motivation: 传统视觉里程计（VO）和视觉惯性里程计（VIO）采用姿态中心范式，需要维护大规模地标并持续优化地图，计算成本高，限制了在资源受限设备上的实时性能。
Method: 提出稀疏运动场视觉里程计（SMF-VO），直接从稀疏光流估计线性速度和角速度，无需显式位姿估计或昂贵的地标跟踪；采用广义 3D 射线运动场公式，适用于包括广角镜头在内的多种相机模型。
Result: 在基准数据集上，SMF-VO 实现了高效率和竞争性精度，在 Raspberry Pi 5 上仅使用 CPU 即可达到 100 FPS 以上的帧率。
Conclusion: SMF-VO 建立了一种可扩展、高效的替代方案，特别适用于移动机器人和可穿戴设备。

papers.title: When is a System Discoverable from Data? Discovery Requires Chaos
papers.abstract_en: The deep learning revolution has spurred a rise in advances of using AI in sciences. Within physical sciences the main focus has been on discovery of dynamical systems from observational data. Yet the reliability of learned surrogates and symbolic models is often undermined by the fundamental problem of non-uniqueness. The resulting models may fit the available data perfectly, but lack genuine predictive power. This raises the question: under what conditions can the systems governing equations be uniquely identified from a finite set of observations? We show, counter-intuitively, that chaos, typically associated with unpredictability, is crucial for ensuring a system is discoverable in the space of continuous or analytic functions. The prevalence of chaotic systems in benchmark datasets may have inadvertently obscured this fundamental limitation. More concretely, we show that systems chaotic on their entire domain are discoverable from a single trajectory within the space of continuous functions, and systems chaotic on a strange attractor are analytically discoverable under a geometric condition on the attractor. As a consequence, we demonstrate for the first time that the classical Lorenz system is analytically discoverable. Moreover, we establish that analytic discoverability is impossible in the presence of first integrals, common in real-world systems. These findings help explain the success of data-driven methods in inherently chaotic domains like weather forecasting, while revealing a significant challenge for engineering applications like digital twins, where stable, predictable behavior is desired. For these non-chaotic systems, we find that while trajectory data alone is insufficient, certain prior physical knowledge can help ensure discoverability. These findings warrant a critical re-evaluation of the fundamental assumptions underpinning purely data-driven discovery.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 5 figures; Newly added Stability results and Experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从观测数据唯一确定动力系统方程的条件，发现混沌（chaos）对系统在连续或解析函数空间中的可发现性至关重要。系统在全局混沌时，可从单条轨迹在连续函数空间中唯一识别；在奇怪吸引子上的混沌系统满足几何条件时可解析发现。经典Lorenz系统首次被证明解析可发现。存在首次积分时解析发现不可能，这解释了数据驱动方法在混沌天气预报中的成功，但也揭示了稳定系统（如数字孪生）仅靠轨迹数据不足。
Motivation: 数据驱动方法可能得到完美拟合但缺乏预测能力的非唯一模型，需要明确从有限观测中唯一发现系统方程的条件。
Method: 理论分析：在连续或解析函数空间中，利用混沌的拓扑性质（如拓扑传递性、混合性）和奇怪吸引子的几何条件，研究系统可发现性。
Result: 证明系统在全局混沌时可在连续函数空间中由单条轨迹发现；在奇怪吸引子上的混沌系统在几何条件下可解析发现。首次解析可发现Lorenz系统。存在首次积分时解析发现不可能。
Conclusion: 混沌是数据驱动系统发现的关键，解释其在天气预报等领域的成功，但非混沌系统需先验物理知识。呼吁重新审视纯数据驱动发现的基本假设。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: Resilient by Design -- Active Inference for Distributed Continuum Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Failures are the norm in highly complex and heterogeneous devices spanning the distributed computing continuum (DCC), from resource-constrained IoT and edge nodes to high-performance computing systems. Ensuring reliability and global consistency across these layers remains a major challenge, especially for AI-driven workloads requiring real-time, adaptive coordination. This work-in-progress paper introduces a Probabilistic Active Inference Resilience Agent (PAIR-Agent) to achieve resilience in DCC systems. PAIR-Agent performs three core operations: (i) constructing a causal fault graph from device logs, (ii) identifying faults while managing certainties and uncertainties using Markov blankets and the free energy principle, and (iii) autonomously healing issues through active inference. Through continuous monitoring and adaptive reconfiguration, the agent maintains service continuity and stability under diverse failure conditions. Theoretical validations confirm the reliability and effectiveness of the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布式计算连续体（DCC）中设备异构、故障频繁的问题，提出概率主动推理弹性代理（PAIR-Agent）。该代理通过构建因果故障图、利用马尔可夫毯和自由能原理管理不确定性，并通过主动推理实现自主修复。理论验证表明框架在保障服务连续性和稳定性方面有效。
Motivation: 分布式计算连续体涵盖从资源受限的IoT节点到高性能计算系统，故障是常态。现有方法在实时自适应协调下难以同时保证可靠性和全局一致性。
Method: 提出PAIR-Agent，执行三个核心操作：(i) 从设备日志构建因果故障图；(ii) 使用马尔可夫毯和自由能原理识别故障并管理确定性与不确定性；(iii) 通过主动推理自主修复问题。
Result: 摘要提及理论验证确认了框架的可靠性和有效性，未给出具体实验数据。
Conclusion: 本文是工作进展论文，提出的PAIR-Agent框架为DCC系统的弹性设计提供了新思路，理论验证支持其可行性，未来需进一步实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Provably-Correct and Robust Convex Model for Smooth Separable NMF
papers.abstract_en: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) is a linear dimensionality reduction technique for nonnegative data, with applications such as hyperspectral unmixing and topic modeling. NMF is a difficult problem in general (NP-hard), and its solutions are typically not unique. To address these two issues, additional constraints or assumptions are often used. In particular, separability assumes that the basis vectors in the NMF are equal to some columns of the input matrix. In that case, the problem is referred to as separable NMF (SNMF) and can be solved in polynomial-time with robustness guarantees, while identifying a unique solution. However, in real-world scenarios, due to noise or variability, multiple data points may lie near the basis vectors, which SNMF does not leverage. In this work, we rely on the smooth separability assumption, which assumes that each basis vector is close to multiple data points. We explore the properties of the corresponding problem, referred to as smooth SNMF (SSNMF), and examine how it relates to SNMF and orthogonal NMF. We then propose a convex model for SSNMF and show that it provably recovers the sought-after factors, even in the presence of noise. We finally adapt an existing fast gradient method to solve this convex model for SSNMF, and show that it compares favorably with state-of-the-art methods on both synthetic and hyperspectral datasets.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 10 figures, Accepted in SIAM J. Matrix Anal. Appl. Code available from https://github.com/vleplat/ConvexSmoothSeparableNMF.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非负矩阵分解（NMF）中的可分离性假设，提出平滑可分离NMF（SSNMF）的凸模型并证明其能稳健恢复因子。即使在噪声下，该方法也能唯一识别基向量，并利用靠近基向量的多个数据点。作者还适配了一种快速梯度方法求解该凸模型，在合成和高光谱数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: NMF通常NP难且解不唯一，可分离性假设（SNMF）可以解决但现实场景中基向量附近可能有多个数据点未被利用。本文引入平滑可分离性假设，旨在利用多个靠近基向量的数据点，同时保持可证明的恢复性和鲁棒性。
Method: 提出平滑可分离NMF（SSNMF）的凸优化模型，并证明其在噪声下可恢复真实因子。然后使用快速梯度方法求解该凸模型。
Result: 在合成数据集和高光谱数据集上，该方法与现有最先进方法比较表现更优。
Conclusion: 本文提供的凸模型和求解方法在理论上保证了可恢复性，实验验证了其有效性。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Regression: A Unified Framework based on kernel scores
papers.abstract_en: Regression tasks, notably in safety-critical domains, require reliable uncertainty quantification, yet the literature remains largely classification-focused. To address this, we introduce a family of measures for total, aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainty in multivariate regression based on strictly proper kernel scores. The framework provides a principled recipe for designing new uncertainty measures whose behavior, such as tail sensitivity or out-of-distribution responsiveness, is governed by the choice of the underlying kernel, while also encompassing existing measures under a joint analysis. We prove explicit correspondences between properties of the kernel and behavior of resulting uncertainty measures, yielding concrete design guidelines for practitioners. Extensive experiments across structured regression tasks, including spatial and functional domains, demonstrate effectiveness on downstream tasks such as out-of-distribution detection and active learning, and reveal that different kernel choices lead to distinct trade-offs, offering practitioners guidance for task-specific selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对回归任务中的不确定性量化提出统一框架，基于严格适当的核分数定义总不确定性、偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的度量。框架通过选择不同核函数控制行为（如尾部敏感性、OOD响应），并证明核性质与度量行为的对应关系。实验在结构回归任务（空间、函数域）上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 回归任务的不确定性量化研究较少，且主要关注分类；需要一种通用的框架来设计新的不确定性度量。
Method: 基于严格适当的核分数定义三种不确定性度量，通过核函数选择调节度量行为，并建立核性质与度量行为之间的理论对应关系。
Result: 实验表明不同核选择导致不同的权衡，在OOD检测和主动学习等下游任务上有效。
Conclusion: 框架为实践者提供了针对特定任务选择核的指导。
Relevance: 15

summary_sections.method: 基于严格适当的核分数定义三种不确定性度量，通过核函数选择调节度量行为，并建立核性质与度量行为之间的理论对应关系。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明不同核选择导致不同的权衡，在OOD检测和主动学习等下游任务上有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 框架为实践者提供了针对特定任务选择核的指导。

papers.title: A Unified Geometric Space for Topological Alignment Between Transformer-Based Models and Human Brain Networks
papers.abstract_en: Whether artificial neural networks organize information comparably to the human brain remains unclear. Prior brain--AI alignment studies are constrained by specific inputs and tasks, limiting cross-modal comparison. Here we introduce a brain--model topological alignment space, mapping Transformer attention topology onto human intrinsic connectivity networks (ICNs) to enable task-free, modality-agnostic comparison. Analyzing 151 Transformer-based models with 62,480 attention head graphs, we observe a continuous arc-shaped distribution reflecting varying alignment. Models optimized for global semantics aligned with higher-order ICNs, while local-detail models aligned with sensory ICNs. Non-intuitive findings include reduced alignment in DINOv2 compared to its predecessors and a counterintuitive scaling inversion in distilled DeiT models, while fine-tuning and instruction tuning had limited effect. Alignment scores showed no significant correlation with ImageNet accuracy (r = 0.266, p = 0.156). This work offers a quantitative framework for comparing the organizational principles of artificial and biological systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的几何空间用于脑-模型拓扑对齐，将Transformer注意力拓扑映射到人类内在连接网络（ICNs），实现无任务、无模态的比较。分析了151个Transformer模型（共62,480个注意力头图），发现模型对齐呈现连续的弧状分布：优化全局语义的模型与高阶ICN对齐，局部细节模型与感觉ICN对齐。非直观发现包括DINOv2对齐度下降、蒸馏DeiT模型中的逆缩放，而微调与指令调优影响有限。对齐分数与ImageNet准确率无显著相关（r=0.266, p=0.156）。
Motivation: 现有脑-AI对齐研究受限于特定输入和任务，无法进行跨模态比较，缺乏一个统一的定量框架来比较人工与生物系统的组织原则。
Method: 引入脑-模型拓扑对齐空间，通过将Transformer中注意力头图的拓扑结构映射到人类静息态功能磁共振成像导出的内在连接网络（ICNs），实现任务无关、模态无关的对齐度量。
Result: 在151个Transformer模型上的分析显示：模型对齐呈弧状分布；全局语义模型对齐高阶ICN，局部细节模型对齐感觉ICN；DINOv2对齐度低于前代；蒸馏DeiT模型存在逆缩放现象；微调与指令调优效果不显著；对齐分数与ImageNet准确率无显著相关。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个定量框架用于比较人工神经网络与生物神经系统的组织原则，揭示了模型设计目标与大脑功能网络之间的对齐规律，但对齐与下游任务性能的关联仍需进一步探索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Reason Efficiently with Discounted Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often consume excessive tokens, inflating computational cost and latency. More broadly, in goal reaching sequential decision problems we often want to reach the goal quickly, and LRM reasoning can be viewed through this lens. We challenge the assumption that longer responses improve accuracy. By penalizing reasoning tokens using a discounted reinforcement learning setup (interpretable as a small token cost) and analyzing Blackwell optimality in restricted policy classes, we encourage concise yet accurate reasoning, analogous to preferring shorter successful trajectories in a stochastic shortest path problem. Experiments confirm our theoretical results that this approach shortens chains of thought while preserving accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型（LRM）在推理过程中消耗过多token导致计算成本高和延迟大的问题，提出使用折扣强化学习（discounted reinforcement learning）来惩罚推理token，鼓励模型生成简洁且准确的推理链。通过理论分析Blackwell最优性，并在受限策略类中验证，该方法能缩短思维链（CoT）而不牺牲准确性。实验证实了理论结果。
Motivation: 大型推理模型常生成冗长推理链，消耗大量计算资源和时间，但更长推理不一定带来准确率提升。本文旨在通过强化学习中的折扣机制，在保持准确性的前提下促使模型生成更简洁的推理步骤。
Method: 采用折扣强化学习框架，将推理token视为成本，通过Blackwell最优性分析在受限策略类中优化，类似于随机最短路径问题中偏好较短成功轨迹。
Result: 实验表明，该方法能有效缩短思维链长度，同时保持与原始模型相当的准确性。
Conclusion: 本文证明通过折扣强化学习引入微小token成本，可以在不牺牲准确性的情况下显著提升推理效率，为LRM的实用化提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MetaCaDI: A Meta-Learning Framework for Causal Discovery from Multiple Environments with Unknown Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Uncovering the causal mechanisms of complex real-world systems remains a significant challenge, as these systems often entail high data collection costs and involve unknown interventions. We introduce MetaCaDI, the first framework to cast the identification of unknown interventions as a meta-learning problem, explicitly leveraging a jointly learned causal graph. MetaCaDI is a Bayesian framework that learns a shared causal structure across multiple environments and is optimized to rapidly adapt to new, few-shot intervention target identification tasks. A key innovation is our model's analytical adaptation, which uses a closed-form solution to bypass expensive and potentially unstable gradient-based bilevel optimization. Extensive experiments on synthetic and complex gene expression data demonstrate that MetaCaDI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. It excels at identifying intervention targets from as few as 3 samples - where existing methods collapse to random chance - while robustly recovering the shared causal graph, proving its effectiveness in data-scarce scenarios.
papers.comment: Accepted at UAI 2026. To be published in the Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR). 21 pages, 9 figures. Includes supplementary material in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MetaCaDI，第一个将未知干预识别建模为元学习问题的因果发现框架。它通过贝叶斯方法学习多个环境共享的因果结构，并利用闭式解实现高效的小样本干预目标识别。在合成数据和基因表达数据上，MetaCaDI在仅3个样本时仍显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 复杂现实系统的因果发现面临数据采集成本高和干预未知的挑战，现有方法在小样本场景下表现不佳。
Method: 提出元学习框架MetaCaDI，将未知干预识别视为元学习任务，联合学习因果图，并采用闭式解进行模型自适应，避免基于梯度的双级优化。
Result: 在合成数据和复杂基因表达数据上，MetaCaDI显著优于现有方法；仅需3个样本即可有效识别干预目标，而现有方法在该场景下退化为随机猜测。
Conclusion: MetaCaDI证明了在数据稀缺场景下利用元学习进行因果发现的有效性，尤其适合多环境带未知干预的问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Characterization for Reliable Access Control Policy Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Access control policies are reliability-critical configuration artifacts in cloud systems, yet administrators frequently struggle to verify that a policy permits exactly what they intend. This verification gap cannot be remedied by using LLMs to synthesize policies: we find that reasoning and non-reasoning LLMs fluently explain policy behavior but cannot reason about policy semantics with reliability-grade precision, even when the specification is the LLM's own explanation. We formulate this impasse as the Verifiable Synthesis Paradox: the verification gap persists regardless of how the policy was authored. To remedy this, we introduce PolicySummarizer, a neurosymbolic tool that pairs finite-state automata with an LLM-based simplification to generate precise human-readable characterizations of requests allowed by a policy. PolicySummarizer uses model counting to guarantee the fidelity of the generated characterization by rejecting characterizations that fall below a user-configured threshold in favor of the formally derived one. On 546 AWS, 100 Microsoft Azure, and 100 Google Cloud Platform policies, PolicySummarizer achieves a mean similarity score of 0.93 and a 2.7x improvement over an SMT-based baseline. In a user study, PolicySummarizer raised policy-change-review accuracy from 39% to 93% on the hardest sub-task while reducing self-reported mental demand. We release PolicySummarizer as an open-source tool.
papers.comment: Accepted to ISSRE 2026. Major revision and retitling of arXiv:2510.20692v1. Refocuses the paper on reliable neurosymbolic access-control policy analysis; updates the PolicySummarizer method, multi-cloud evaluation, and user-study results. 13 pages, 6 figures. Corrected arXiv title metadata to match the accepted ISSRE version. No substantive content changes from the previous version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对云系统中访问控制策略验证的可靠性问题，提出神经符号工具PolicySummarizer，结合有限状态自动机与LLM简化，生成策略允许请求的精确可读描述。通过模型计数确保描述保真度，在AWS、Azure和GCP策略上达到0.93平均相似度，比SMT基线提升2.7倍。用户实验将策略变更审查准确率从39%提升至93%。
Motivation: 云系统管理员难以验证访问控制策略是否精确允许预期行为，而LLM虽能流畅解释策略但无法以可靠性级别精度推理策略语义，形成“可验证合成悖论”。
Method: 提出PolicySummarizer，采用神经符号方法：有限状态自动机建模策略语义，LLM生成人类可读简化描述，并通过模型计数自动拒绝低于用户配置保真度阈值的描述，确保形式化等价。
Result: 在546个AWS、100个Azure和100个GCP策略上，平均相似度0.93，比SMT基线提升2.7倍；用户实验中难度最高子任务准确率从39%提升至93%，同时降低自报脑力负荷。
Conclusion: 神经符号方法可有效弥合LLM的流畅性与形式化可靠性之间的差距，为访问控制策略分析提供可靠工具。

papers.title: Conditional Clifford-Steerable CNNs for PDE Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Conditional Clifford-Steerable CNNs (C-CSCNNs), a unified framework that incorporates equivariance to arbitrary pseudo-Euclidean groups and significantly improves the expressivity of standard CSCNNs. We show that the kernel basis of the standard formulation is incomplete, limiting model capacity. To address this, we augment the kernels with equivariant representations of the input feature field. We derive the equivariance constraint for these input-dependent kernels and show how it can be solved efficiently via implicit parameterization. We empirically validate on multiple PDE forecasting tasks, including fluid dynamics and relativistic electrodynamics, where our method consistently outperforms standard CSCNNs and performs on par with state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.journal_ref: The Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件Clifford-Steerable CNN（C-CSCNN），一种统一框架，通过对任意伪欧几里得群保持等变性，并解决标准CSCNN核基不完整导致的表达能力受限问题。该方法通过输入特征场的等变表示扩充核，并利用隐式参数化高效求解等变约束。在流体动力学和相对论电动力学等多个PDE预测任务上，C-CSCNN持续优于标准CSCNN，性能与最新基线相当。
Motivation: 标准Clifford-Steerable CNN的核基不完整，限制了模型容量和表达能力，需要更强大的等变网络来建模复杂PDE系统。
Method: 在标准CSCNN基础上，用输入特征场的等变表示对核进行扩充，推导输入相关核的等变约束，并通过隐式参数化高效求解该约束，从而得到更完整的核基。
Result: 在流体动力学和相对论电动力学等PDE预测任务上，C-CSCNN一致优于标准CSCNN，性能与最先进基线持平，验证了其提升表达力的有效性。
Conclusion: C-CSCNN为PDE建模提供了一个统一的等变框架，通过更完整的核基增强了模型容量，适用于多种物理场预测场景。

papers.title: UniVideo: Unified Understanding, Generation, and Editing for Videos
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models have shown promising results in multimodal content generation and editing but remain largely limited to the image domain. In this work, we present UniVideo, a versatile framework that extends unified modeling to the video domain. UniVideo adopts a dual-stream design, combining a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for instruction understanding with a Multimodal DiT (MMDiT) for video generation. This design preserves the MLLM's original text generation capabilities, enables accurate interpretation of complex multimodal instructions, and maintains visual consistency in the generated content. Built on this architecture, UniVideo unifies diverse video generation and editing tasks under a single multimodal instruction paradigm and is jointly trained across them. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniVideo matches or surpasses state-of-the-art task-specific baselines in text/image-to-video generation, in-context video generation and in-context video editing. Notably, the unified design of UniVideo enables two forms of generalization. First, UniVideo supports task composition, such as combining editing with style transfer, by integrating multiple capabilities within a single instruction. Second, even without explicit training on free-form video editing, UniVideo transfers its editing capability from large-scale image editing data to this setting, handling unseen instructions such as changing the environment or altering materials within a video. Beyond these core capabilities, UniVideo also supports visual-prompt-based video generation, where the MLLM interprets visual prompts and guides the MMDiT during synthesis. To foster future research, we released our model and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniVideo 是一个统一的视频理解、生成与编辑框架，采用双流设计结合多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 和多模态 DiT (MMDiT)，在文本/图像到视频生成、上下文视频生成与编辑等任务上达到或超越专有模型性能，并展现任务组合与零样本编辑等泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型主要局限于图像领域，缺乏能够同时处理视频理解、生成和编辑的统一框架。
Method: 提出 UniVideo，使用 MLLM 进行指令理解，MMDiT 负责视频生成，双流保留文本生成能力，可解释复杂多模态指令并保持视觉一致性，统一训练多个视频任务。

Conclusion: UniVideo 通过统一架构实现了视频任务的多功能集成与泛化，并开放模型和代码以促进研究。

papers.title: TaoSR-AGRL: Adaptive Guided Reinforcement Learning Framework for E-commerce Search Relevance
papers.abstract_en: Query-product relevance prediction is fundamental to e-commerce search and has become even more critical in the era of AI-powered shopping, where semantic understanding and complex reasoning directly shape the user experience and business conversion. Large Language Models (LLMs) enable generative, reasoning-based approaches, typically aligned via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or preference optimization methods like Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). However, the increasing complexity of business rules and user queries exposes the inability of existing methods to endow models with robust reasoning capacity for long-tail and challenging cases. Efforts to address this via reinforcement learning strategies like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) often suffer from sparse terminal rewards, offering insufficient guidance for multi-step reasoning and slowing convergence. To address these challenges, we propose TaoSR-AGRL, an Adaptive Guided Reinforcement Learning framework for LLM-based relevance prediction in Taobao Search Relevance. TaoSR-AGRL introduces two key innovations: (1) Rule-aware Reward Shaping, which decomposes the final relevance judgment into dense, structured rewards aligned with domain-specific relevance criteria; and (2) Adaptive Guided Replay, which identifies low-accuracy rollouts during training and injects targeted ground-truth guidance to steer the policy away from stagnant, rule-violating reasoning patterns toward compliant trajectories. TaoSR-AGRL was evaluated on large-scale real-world datasets and through online side-by-side human evaluations on Taobao Search. It consistently outperforms DPO and standard GRPO baselines in offline experiments, improving relevance accuracy, rule adherence, and training stability. The model trained with TaoSR-AGRL has been successfully deployed in the main search scenario on Taobao, serving hundreds of millions of users.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电商搜索中查询-产品相关性预测问题，提出自适应引导强化学习框架TaoSR-AGRL，包含规则感知奖励塑形（将最终判断分解为密集结构化奖励）和自适应引导重放（识别低准确率轨迹并注入目标真值引导）两大创新。在淘宝搜索真实数据集和在线人类评估中，该方法在相关性准确率、规则遵循度和训练稳定性上持续优于DPO和标准GRPO基线，并已部署到淘宝主要搜索场景服务数亿用户。论文被WWW 2026 Industry Track接收为Oral。
Motivation: 现有LLM相关性预测方法（SFT、DPO等）难以处理长尾和困难案例，强化学习如GRPO因稀疏终端奖励导致多步推理引导不足和收敛慢。
Method: 提出TaoSR-AGRL框架，包含：(1) 规则感知奖励塑形（Rule-aware Reward Shaping），将最终相关性判断分解为与领域标准对齐的密集结构化奖励；(2) 自适应引导重放（Adaptive Guided Replay），在训练中识别低准确率轨迹并注入目标真值引导，使策略转向合规推理路径。
Result: 在大规模真实数据集和淘宝搜索在线人类评估中，TaoSR-AGRL在相关性准确率、规则遵循度和训练稳定性上持续优于DPO和标准GRPO基线。该模型已部署到淘宝主要搜索场景。
Conclusion: 提出的自适应引导强化学习框架有效解决了电商搜索相关性预测中长尾和困难案例的推理能力不足问题，通过密集奖励和引导重放提升了模型性能并成功部署。

papers.title: The Three Regimes of Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a practical paradigm that leverages offline datasets for pretraining and online interactions for fine-tuning. However, its empirical behavior is highly inconsistent: design choices of online fine-tuning that work well in one setting can fail completely in another. Guided by the stability--plasticity principle, we propose a framework that can explain this inconsistency: We argue that efficient fine-tuning must preserve the utility of the stronger offline prior, whether that is the pretrained policy or the offline dataset, while maintaining sufficient plasticity. This perspective identifies three regimes of online fine-tuning, each requiring distinct stability properties. We validate this framework through a large-scale empirical study, finding that the results strongly align with its predictions in 45 out of 63 cases, with only 3 opposite mismatches. This work provides a framework for guiding design choices in offline-to-online RL based on the relative performance of the offline dataset and the pretrained policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于稳定性-可塑性原理的理论框架，用于解释离线到在线强化学习（RL）中微调行为的不一致性。通过大规模实验验证，该框架在63个案例中的45个与预测一致，仅有3个明显不符。工作将在线微调划分为三种模式，每种模式要求不同的稳定性特性。
Motivation: 离线到在线RL的微调设计选择在不同设置下表现高度不一致，缺乏统一的解释框架来指导实践。
Method: 基于稳定性-可塑性原则，提出一个框架，认为高效微调必须保留离线先验（预训练策略或离线数据集）的效用，同时保持足够的可塑性，并据此划分三种在线微调模式。
Result: 通过大规模实证研究，框架预测在63个案例中的45个得到验证，只有3个案例出现相反的不匹配。
Conclusion: 该框架可根据离线数据集和预训练策略的相对性能指导离线到在线RL的设计选择。

papers.title: OctoPipe: Reducing Pipeline Bubbles for Heterogeneous Models via Co-Optimizing Partitioning, Placement, and Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Pipeline parallelism is widely used to train large language models (LLMs). However, increasing heterogeneity in model architectures exacerbates pipeline bubbles, thereby reducing training efficiency. Prior approaches typically optimize a single phase of the pipeline schedule (i.e., partitioning, placement, or scheduling), leaving substantial pipeline bubbles. While promising, co-optimization poses three key challenges: (1) complex performance modeling, (2) a combinatorial search space, and (3) irregular execution orders. To address these challenges, we propose OctoPipe, a pipeline parallelism system to jointly optimize partitioning, placement, and scheduling. First, we build a graph-based pipeline simulator to model heterogeneous pipeline execution for co-optimization. Second, on top of the simulator, we develop an iterative bubble-aware tuner to efficiently explore the combinatorial search space. Third, we implement a unified pipeline executor that dynamically orchestrates computation and communication to support irregular execution orders without deadlocks while maximizing communication-computation overlap. Experiments show that OctoPipe achieves 1.15--1.44x throughput improvement over the state-of-the-art pipeline parallelism approaches across various models and GPU cluster scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OctoPipe，一种针对异构模型流水线并行训练的系统，联合优化分区、放置和调度以减少流水线气泡。该方法包括基于图的流水线模拟器、迭代气泡感知调优器和统一流水线执行器，实验表明在多种模型和 GPU 集群规模下吞吐量提升 1.15-1.44 倍。
Motivation: 现有流水线并行方法通常只优化单个阶段，而模型架构异构性导致大量流水线气泡，降低训练效率。联合优化面临性能建模复杂、搜索空间组合爆炸、执行顺序不规则等挑战。
Method: 提出 OctoPipe，包括三个组件：1) 基于图的流水线模拟器，对异构流水线执行建模；2) 迭代气泡感知调优器，高效探索组合搜索空间；3) 统一流水线执行器，动态编排计算与通信以支持不规则执行顺序并最大化计算通信重叠。
Result: 在多种模型和 GPU 集群规模下，OctoPipe 相比现有流水线并行方法实现 1.15-1.44 倍吞吐量提升。
Conclusion: 论文表明联合优化分区、放置和调度能显著减少流水线气泡，提升异构模型训练效率。

papers.title: Self-Improving Neural Pruning: A Graph Neural Network Framework for Scalable Mixed Bundle Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Mixed bundle pricing is a classic revenue management problem arising in industries such as e-commerce, tourism, and video games. It refers to designing product combinations (i.e., bundles) and determining their prices to maximize expected profit. Exact mixed-bundling formulations capture this structure but are computationally intractable because the number of possible bundles grows exponentially with the number of products. We propose a graph neural network (GNN)-guided pruning framework for scalable (non-)additive bundle pricing. Instead of learning on the exponential bundle-level formulation, we encode each instance as a compact customer-product graph and train an edge-output GNN to learn the product-assignment probabilities from optimal mixed-bundling solutions. The predicted probabilities are then converted into restricted candidate bundle families through fixed cutoff pruning and progressive cutoff pruning; the final prices and assignments are obtained by solving the mixed bundling formulation over the retained bundles. We further introduce a GNN-guided local search and an iterative self-improvement procedure for larger instances. The local search refines the retained bundle family by prioritizing high-confidence add/drop moves, while the iterative self-improvement procedure generates high-quality solutions on larger instances for retraining. Theoretically, we show that under mild distinguishability conditions the proposed edge-output GNN class is expressive enough to recover the optimal product-assignment mapping. Experiments show that the proposed policies recover over 98% of the optimal profit on small instances and outperform bundle-size pricing on larger instances with substantial runtime savings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合捆绑定价中候选捆绑数量随产品数指数增长的问题，提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的剪枝框架。通过将实例编码为客户-产品图，训练边缘输出GNN学习最优混合捆绑解中的产品分配概率，并利用固定剪枝和渐进剪枝转化为受限候选捆绑族，最后在保留的捆绑上求解混合捆绑定价。进一步引入GNN引导的局部搜索和迭代自改进过程以处理更大规模实例。实验表明，该框架在小实例上恢复超过98%的最优利润，在大实例上优于按捆绑大小定价且大幅节省运行时间。
Motivation: 混合捆绑定价的精确公式因候选捆绑数量随产品数指数增长而计算不可行，现有方法难以兼顾最优性和可扩展性。
Method: 提出GNN引导的剪枝框架：将每个实例编码为客户-产品图，训练边缘输出GNN预测最优混合捆绑解中的产品分配概率；通过固定剪枝和渐进剪枝转换为候选捆绑族；引入GNN引导的局部搜索和迭代自改进过程以处理更大实例。理论证明在温和可区分条件下，该GNN类能恢复最优产品分配映射。
Result: 实验显示：在小实例上恢复超过98%的最优利润；在大实例上优于按捆绑大小定价，并显著节省运行时间。
Conclusion: 所提GNN框架能有效缩小候选捆绑规模，在保持接近最优利润的同时大幅提升可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Polarity Detection of Sustainable Development Goals in News Text
papers.abstract_en: The United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) provide a globally recognised framework for addressing major societal, environmental, and economic challenges. While recent advances in natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs) have enabled the automatic identification of SDG-related content, they do not capture whether the described events represent progress toward or regression from a specific goal. To address this gap, we introduce the novel task of SDG polarity detection and present SDG-POD, a benchmark dataset combining manually annotated and synthetically generated examples. We evaluate six state-of-the-art open-source LLMs under both zero-shot and fine-tuning settings and investigate the impact of synthetic data augmentation on model performance. Our results show that SDG polarity detection remains challenging for current LLMs; however, fine-tuned models, particularly QWQ-32B, achieve the best overall performance, with especially strong results on SDG-9, SDG-12, and SDG-15. Furthermore, we demonstrate that synthetic training data consistently improves model robustness and classification performance. This work introduces a new benchmark for SDG polarity detection and provides practical insights into developing LLM-based systems for sustainability monitoring.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可持续发展目标（SDG）极性检测的新任务，并构建了SDG-POD基准数据集，结合人工标注与合成数据。评估了六个开源大语言模型（LLMs）在零样本和微调设置下的性能，发现微调后的QWQ-32B模型整体表现最佳，尤其在SDG-9、SDG-12和SDG-15上效果显著。合成数据增强能持续提升模型的鲁棒性和分类性能。
Motivation: 现有NLP方法只能识别文本是否涉及SDG，无法判断事件是朝向目标前进还是倒退（极性）。缺乏针对SDG极性检测的任务定义、基准数据集和系统性评估。
Method: 定义SDG极性检测任务，构建包含人工标注和合成样本的基准数据集SDG-POD。评估六个开源LLM（零样本与微调），并研究合成数据增强的影响。
Result: SDG极性检测对当前LLM仍具挑战；微调后的QWQ-32B取得最佳整体性能，在SDG-9、SDG-12和SDG-15上尤为突出。合成训练数据一致地提升了模型鲁棒性和分类准确率。
Conclusion: 该工作为SDG极性检测建立了新基准，并提供了开发基于LLM的可持续性监测系统的实用见解。

papers.title: CoDoL: Conditional Domain Prompt Learning for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in pre-training vision-language models (VLMs), e.g., contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP) methods, have shown great potential in learning out-of-distribution (OOD) representations. Despite showing competitive performance, the prompt-based CLIP methods still suffer from: i) inaccurate text descriptions, which leads to degraded accuracy and robustness, and poses a challenge for zero-shot CLIP methods. ii) limited vision-language embedding alignment, which is one important factor affecting generalization performance. To tackle the above issues, this paper proposes a novel Conditional Domain prompt Learning (CoDoL) method, which utilizes readily-available domain information to form prompts and contributes to improved vision-language embedding alignment, which we identify as one factor underlying the observed OOD generalization gains. To capture both instance-specific and domain-specific information, we further propose a lightweight Domain Meta Network (DMN) to generate input-conditional tokens for images in each domain. Extensive experiments on four OOD benchmarks (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome, and DigitDG) validate the effectiveness of our proposed CoDoL method in terms of empirically improves vision-language embedding alignment across four DG benchmarks, which we present as a contributing factor (rather than the sole cause) of the observed OOD gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件域提示学习 (CoDoL) 方法，利用易获取的域信息构建提示，改进视觉-语言嵌入对齐以提升分布外泛化。该方法通过轻量域元网络 (DMN) 生成输入条件令牌，在四个分布泛化基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有提示驱动的CLIP方法存在文本描述不准确和视觉-语言嵌入对齐不足的问题，限制了分布外泛化性能。
Method: 提出CoDoL方法，利用域信息形成提示，并设计轻量域元网络 (DMN) 为每个域中的图像生成输入条件令牌，以捕获实例特定和域特定信息。
Result: 在PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome和DigitDG四个分布外基准上，CoDoL方法提升了视觉-语言嵌入对齐，并带来了泛化增益。
Conclusion: 利用域信息进行条件提示学习可以有效改善视觉-语言嵌入对齐，从而提升分布外泛化。

papers.title: Ask-to-Clarify: Resolving Instruction Ambiguity through Multi-turn Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents are intelligent systems designed to perceive, reason, and act within the physical world. While the robotics community has long strived to build such versatile agents, a fundamental limitation persists: most current VLA-based models operate under a rigid ``Listen-and-Act'' paradigm. These systems assume instructions are unambiguous and execute them in a passive fashion, preventing them from resolving uncertainty through dialogue. To address this, we propose Ask-to-Clarify, a unified end-to-end framework that seamlessly integrates multi-turn disambiguation dialogue with low-level visuomotor control, eliminating the reliance on high-level action primitives or external planners. Specifically, Ask-to-Clarify synergizes a VLM-based Cognitive Planner with a Diffusion-based Motor Executor. To bridge the disparity between high-level disambiguation and low-level execution, we introduce a Semantic-Visual Alignment Adapter, which functions as a cross-modal interface to synthesize semantic intent with visual perceptual streams. Furthermore, we observe severe catastrophic forgetting: visuomotor fine-tuning completely erases dialogue capabilities. To overcome this, we propose a two-stage knowledge-insulation training strategy, effectively decoupling dialogue logic from physical manipulation. Extensive evaluations across 11 real-world tasks demonstrate that \framework{} significantly outperforms existing methods, offering a promising path toward building truly collaborative embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ask-to-Clarify，一个统一端到端框架，使具身智能体能够通过多轮对话解决指令歧义，同时融合低级视觉运动控制。该框架包含VLM认知规划器、扩散运动执行器，并引入语义-视觉对齐适配器弥合高层消歧与低层执行的差距。针对视觉运动微调导致对话能力灾难性遗忘的问题，提出两阶段知识绝缘训练策略。在11个真实世界任务上，该方法显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型遵循被动的“听-行动”范式，假设指令无歧义，无法通过对话解决不确定性。
Method: 提出Ask-to-Clarify框架，集成VLM认知规划器（处理多轮消歧对话）与扩散运动执行器（生成低级动作）。引入语义-视觉对齐适配器作为跨模态接口，结合语义意图与视觉感知流。采用两阶段知识绝缘训练策略，解耦对话逻辑与物理操作。
Result: 在11个真实世界任务上的评估表明，Ask-to-Clarify显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该方法为构建能够通过对话解决歧义并执行复杂任务的真正协作具身智能体提供了有希望的路径。

papers.title: A Systematic Survey on Large Language Models for Evolutionary Optimization: From Modeling to Solving
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated with evolutionary computation to support optimization tasks. This survey primarily focuses on evolutionary optimization, i.e., optimization based on evolutionary computation. For brevity, we use the term optimization throughout to denote this scope. However, existing surveys typically examine isolated roles of LLMs and do not provide a unified view that connects optimization modeling with optimization solving. To address this gap, we systematically review recent developments through a workflow-oriented framework. First, we organize the literature into two primary stages: LLMs for optimization modeling and LLMs for optimization solving (in this survey, the terms optimization modeling and optimization solving are used as concise forms of optimization problem modeling and optimization problem solving, respectively). Second, we divide the solving stage into three paradigms according to the role of the LLM: stand-alone optimizers, low-level components embedded in optimization algorithms, and high-level managers for algorithm selection and generation. Third, we analyze representative methods, identify their technical limitations, and clarify their relationships with traditional optimization approaches. We further substantiate this taxonomy through benchmark systematization, baseline comparisons, and practitioner-oriented guidance, and we review interdisciplinary applications across the natural sciences, engineering, and machine learning. Based on the resulting analysis, we identify research directions toward dynamic, self-evolving, and agentic optimization ecosystems. An up-to-date collection of related literature is maintained at https://github.com/ishmael233/LLM4OPT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该综述系统性地回顾了大语言模型（LLMs）在进化优化中的应用，提出了一个工作流导向的分类框架，将文献分为优化建模和优化求解两个阶段。求解阶段进一步分为三种范式：独立优化器、嵌入优化算法的低层组件以及算法选择和生成的高层管理器。论文通过基准系统化、基线比较和实践指导验证了这一分类，并回顾了跨学科应用，展望了动态、自进化和代理优化的未来方向。
Motivation: 现有关于LLM用于优化的调查通常只关注孤立角色，缺乏连接优化建模与优化求解的统一视角。
Method: 提出了一个工作流导向的框架，将LLM在优化中的角色分为两个主要阶段：优化建模和优化求解。求解阶段进一步细分为三种范式：独立优化器、低层组件和高层管理器。
Result: 通过基准系统化、基线比较和实践者导向的指导来证实分类，并回顾了自然科学、工程和机器学习等跨学科应用。
Conclusion: 识别了向动态、自进化和代理优化生态系统发展的研究方向。

papers.title: DynamixSFT: Dynamic Mixture Optimization of Instruction Tuning Collections
papers.abstract_en: As numerous instruction-tuning datasets continue to emerge, dynamically balancing and optimizing their mixtures has become a critical challenge. To address this, we propose DynamixSFT, a dynamic and automated method for instruction-tuning dataset mixture optimization. We formulate the problem as a multi-armed bandit setup and introduce a Prior-scaled Boltzmann Exploration that softly anchors the updated sampling distribution to the original dataset proportions, thereby preserving the inherent diversity and coverage of the collection. Sampling probabilities are updated using a lightweight 1-Step Look-ahead Reward, reflecting how much the dataset contributes to improving the model's performance at its current state. We demonstrate that DynamixSFT effectively optimizes the Tulu-2-mixture and Tulu-3-mixture collections across 10 benchmarks, while introducing minimal computational overhead over naive sampling. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive analysis and visualizations to offer deeper insights into the adaptive dynamics of our method.
papers.journal_ref: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026, pp. 39590-39603
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DynamixSFT，一种动态自动化方法，用于优化指令微调数据集的混合比例。该方法将问题建模为多臂老虎机，采用Prior-scaled Boltzmann Exploration保持原始数据集的多样性，并通过轻量级的1-Step Look-ahead Reward更新采样概率。在Tulu-2-mixture和Tulu-3-mixture上，该方法在10个基准测试中有效提升了模型性能，同时仅引入极小的计算开销。
Motivation: 随着指令微调数据集不断涌现，如何动态平衡和优化它们的混合比例成为一个关键挑战。
Method: 将指令微调数据集混合优化问题形式化为多臂老虎机设置，提出Prior-scaled Boltzmann Exploration，将更新后的采样分布软锚定到原始数据集比例，从而保持数据集的多样性和覆盖度。采样概率通过轻量级的1-Step Look-ahead Reward更新，该奖励反映数据集在当前状态下对模型性能提升的贡献。
Result: 在Tulu-2-mixture和Tulu-3-mixture集合上，DynamixSFT在10个基准测试中有效优化了混合比例，同时相比朴素采样仅引入极小的计算开销。
Conclusion: DynamixSFT能够动态自适应地优化指令微调数据集的混合，保持原有数据集的多样性和覆盖度，且计算高效。

papers.title: Enhancing Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction with Learned Texture Priors
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the role of texture in monocular 3D hand reconstruction, not as an afterthought for photorealism, but as a dense, spatially grounded cue that can actively support pose and shape estimation. Our observation is simple: even in high-performing models, the overlay between predicted hand geometry and image appearance is often imperfect, suggesting that texture alignment may be an underused supervisory signal. We propose a lightweight texture module that embeds per-pixel observations into UV texture space and enables a novel dense alignment loss between predicted and observed hand appearances. Our approach assumes access to a differentiable rendering pipeline and a model that maps images to 3D hand meshes with known topology, allowing us to back-project a textured hand onto the image and perform pixel-based alignment. The module is self-contained and easily pluggable into existing reconstruction pipelines. To isolate and highlight the value of texture-guided supervision, we augment HaMeR, a high-performing yet unadorned transformer architecture for 3D hand pose estimation. The resulting system improves both accuracy and realism, demonstrating the value of appearance-guided alignment in hand reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
