papers.title: Rational Inverse Reasoning: Few-Shot Imitation by Inferring Intent through Planning
papers.abstract_en: Humans can learn a new manipulation task from one or two demonstrations and then perform it in a new room, with new objects, under new constraints. Modern robot imitation learning, in contrast, typically needs hundreds to thousands of demonstrations and still degrades under modest shifts in layout, geometry, object set or task constraints. We argue this gap is not just about data, but also about the level of abstraction at which learning occurs; generalization requires inferring the latent intent underlying why a demonstrator behaved in a certain way, rather than reproducing how they moved. We present Rational Inverse Reasoning (RIR), which casts few-shot imitation as inference over latent explanation programs: compact, executable descriptions of intent that map an object-centric scene to a structured task-and-motion-planning (TAMP) specification of goals, subgoals and constraints. A vision-language model proposes candidate programs, and a hierarchical planner supplies a bounded-rational likelihood. By combining VLM program proposals, and planner-grounded feedback, RIR iteratively refines the candidate set to approximate a posterior over concise, executable programs. On a 2D reasoning benchmark and a real Franka FR3, RIR recovers transferable task structure from as little as one demonstration. Generalizing to substantially new layouts and object sets, RIR outperforms VLM-planning baselines that lack explicit rationality and planning-grounded inference, increasing downstream success rate by $34$ and $28$ percentage points in the one- and three-shot settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Rational Inverse Reasoning (RIR)，通过推断潜在意图进行少样本模仿学习。将少样本模仿视为对潜在解释程序的推理，结合视觉语言模型（VLM）和层级规划器，在2D基准和真实Franka FR3机器人上，从一个演示中恢复可迁移的任务结构。在1-shot和3-shot设置中，下游成功率分别提升34和28个百分点。
Motivation: 人类可以从一两个演示中学习新操作任务并泛化到新环境，而机器人模仿学习通常需要大量演示且泛化能力差。现有方法缺乏对意图的抽象推理。
Method: 提出Rational Inverse Reasoning，将少样本模仿视为对潜在解释程序的推理。使用VLM提出候选程序，层级规划器提供有界理性似然，通过VLM提议和规划器反馈迭代精炼候选集，近似后验分布。
Result: 在2D推理基准和真实Franka FR3机器人上，RIR从一个演示中恢复可迁移任务结构。在1-shot和3-shot设置中，相比缺乏显式理性和规划器反馈的VLM规划基线，下游成功率分别提升34和28个百分点。

papers.title: Extending Foundational Monocular Depth Estimators to Fisheye Cameras with Calibration Tokens
papers.abstract_en: We propose a method to extend foundational monocular depth estimators (FMDEs), trained on perspective images, to fisheye images. Despite being trained on tens of millions of images, FMDEs are susceptible to the covariate shift introduced by changes in camera calibration (intrinsic, distortion) parameters, leading to erroneous depth estimates. Our method aligns the distribution of latent embeddings encoding fisheye images to those of perspective images, enabling the reuse of FMDEs for fisheye cameras without retraining or finetuning. To this end, we introduce a set of Calibration Tokens as a light-weight adaptation mechanism that modulates the latent embeddings for alignment. By exploiting the already expressive latent space of FMDEs, we posit that modulating their embeddings avoids the negative impact of artifacts and loss introduced in conventional recalibration or map projection to a canonical reference frame in the image space. Our method is self-supervised and does not require fisheye images but leverages publicly available large-scale perspective image datasets. This is done by recalibrating perspective images to fisheye images, and enforcing consistency between their estimates during training. We evaluate our approach with several FMDEs, on both indoors and outdoors, where we consistently improve over state-of-the-art methods using a single set of tokens for both. Code available at: https://github.com/JungHeeKim29/calibration-token; https://github.com/Suchisrit/CalibrationTokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种方法，将基于透视图像训练的基础单目深度估计器（FMDE）扩展到鱼眼图像上。通过引入轻量级的校准令牌（Calibration Tokens）机制，对齐鱼眼图像与透视图像的潜在嵌入分布，从而无需重新训练或微调即可复用FMDE。该方法自监督，利用公开透视图像数据集，无需鱼眼图像，在室内外场景上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有FMDE虽经大量透视图像训练，但对相机校准参数变化（如鱼眼镜头）敏感，导致深度估计错误。传统重校准或投影到规范坐标系会引入伪影和损失。
Method: 引入一组可学习的校准令牌，作为轻量级适配机制，通过调制FMDE的潜在嵌入，将鱼眼图像的嵌入分布与透视图像对齐。训练时，将透视图像重校准为鱼眼图像，并强制两者估计的一致性，实现自监督学习。
Result: 在多个FMDE上，室内外场景均一致优于现有方法，仅需单个令牌集即可处理多种鱼眼配置。
Conclusion: 该方法无需重新训练或微调，利用现有FMDE的潜在空间，通过校准令牌实现鱼眼深度估计，避免了传统方法的伪影，且自监督。

papers.title: Robust Sparse Bayesian Learning Based on Minimum Error Entropy for Noisy High-Dimensional Brain Activity Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Sparse Bayesian learning provides an effective framework to solve high-dimensional problems in brain signal decoding. However, conventional likelihoods regarding data distributions, such as Gaussian or Bernoulli, are potentially inadequate for handling the noisy recordings of brain activity. Hence, this work aims to formulate a robust sparse Bayesian learning framework to address noisy high-dimensional brain activity decoding. Methods: Motivated by the commendable robustness of the minimum error entropy learning criterion for addressing non-Gaussian signals, this study reformulated the sparse Bayesian learning framework under a generalized Bayesian paradigm, in which the model parameter is regulated with the minimum error entropy loss rather than a conventional likelihood function. Results: Our developed SBL-MEE algorithm was evaluated with two real-world brain decoding tasks of regression and classification scenarios, respectively. Experimental results demonstrated that our approach not only realizes superior brain decoding performance than existing methods, but also presents more physiologically interpretable decoder patterns. Conclusion: Although minimum error entropy is not constructed from an arbitrary probabilistic distribution, it is effective to establish noise-robust inference in sparse Bayesian learning method. Significance: This work provides a powerful tool to improve brain activity decoding capability, particularly regarding the noisy high-dimensional setting, thus promoting biomedical engineering applications such as brain-computer interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脑信号解码中传统似然函数无法有效处理噪声的问题，提出基于最小误差熵（minimum error entropy）的鲁棒稀疏贝叶斯学习算法SBL-MEE。该方法在广义贝叶斯框架下用最小误差熵损失替代传统似然，在真实脑解码任务中取得了优于现有方法的性能，并生成更具生理可解释性的解码模式。
Motivation: 稀疏贝叶斯学习在处理高维脑信号时具有优势，但传统高斯或伯努利似然函数对噪声敏感，难以应对实际记录中的非高斯噪声。
Method: 在广义贝叶斯框架下重新定义稀疏贝叶斯学习，用最小误差熵损失作为模型参数的正则化项，替代常规似然函数，从而增强对非高斯噪声的鲁棒性。
Result: 在回归和分类两类真实脑解码任务上，SBL-MEE的脑解码性能优于现有方法，并且其解码模式具有更高的生理可解释性。
Conclusion: 最小误差熵虽然不基于显式概率分布，但能有效建立噪声鲁棒的稀疏贝叶斯推断，提升高维噪声场景下的脑活动解码能力。

papers.title: PLoRA: Efficient Concurrent LoRA Training for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has gained popularity as a fine-tuning approach for Large Language Models (LLMs) due to its low resource requirements and good performance. While numerous studies have investigated ways to improve LoRA serving efficiency by serving multiple LoRAs concurrently, existing methods assume that a wide range of LoRA adapters are available for serving. In our work, we conduct extensive empirical studies to show that current LoRA training paradigms do not efficiently utilize hardware resources and incur high overhead to obtain a performant LoRA adapter. Leveraging these insights, we propose PLoRA, which automatically orchestrates concurrent LoRA fine-tuning jobs under given hardware and model constraints and develops performant kernels to improve training efficiency. Across a range of LLMs and LoRA configurations, PLoRA improves training throughput by up to 12.8x and reduces the overall fine-tuning makespan by up to 7.52x compared to existing approaches.

papers.title: FastCSP: Accelerated Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction with Universal Model for Atoms
papers.abstract_en: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is essential for applications in pharmaceuticals and organic electronics. However, CSP remains challenging and computationally intensive due to the need to explore a large search space with sub-kJ/mol accuracy to distinguish between competing polymorphs. While dispersion-inclusive density functional theory (DFT) offers the necessary precision, its computational cost is impractical for a large number of putative structures. Here, we present FastCSP, an open-source, end-to-end CSP workflow driven entirely by a single pretrained universal machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP), the Universal Model for Atoms (UMA), without any system-specific fine-tuning or DFT calculations. FastCSP integrates conformer generation, random structure generation via Genarris 3, geometry optimization, free energy evaluation, and conformer energy corrections, all powered by UMA. Benchmarked on 28 semi-rigid and 10 flexible molecules spanning 74 experimental polymorphs, FastCSP reliably recovers all known structures, ranking them within 9 kJ/mol of the global minimum. UMA reproduces dispersion-inclusive DFT results with high fidelity across chemically diverse compounds. Conformer corrections are particularly beneficial for flexible compounds with conformational polymorphism, such as ROY. UMA's accuracy, transferability, and computational cost thus eliminate the need for classical force fields in early-stage screening and DFT-based re-ranking in CSP workflows. The open-source release of the entire FastCSP workflow lowers the barrier to accessing CSP, enabling both pharmaceutical-grade and high-throughput polymorph screening within practical computational reach.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 10 figures, 32 pages supplementary information. Code available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/fairchem/tree/main/src/fairchem/applications/fastcsp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FastCSP，一个完全由预训练通用机器学习原子间势（UMA）驱动的开源分子晶体结构预测（CSP）工作流，无需系统特定微调或 DFT 计算。在 28 个半刚性分子和 10 个柔性分子（涵盖 74 个实验多晶型）上，FastCSP 可靠地恢复了所有已知结构，并将它们排名在全局最小值的 9 kJ/mol 以内。UMA 高保真地复现包含色散的 DFT 结果，尤其对柔性化合物（如 ROY）的构象修正有效。
Motivation: 分子晶体结构预测对于药物和有机电子学至关重要，但由于需要以 sub-kJ/mol 精度探索巨大搜索空间以区分竞争多晶型，计算成本高昂。现有 DFT 方法精度够但速度慢，而经典力场精度不足。
Method: FastCSP 工作流集成了构象生成、通过 Genarris 3 的随机结构生成、几何优化、自由能评估和构象能量校正，全部由单个预训练通用机器学习原子间势 UMA 驱动，无需 DFT 计算或系统特定微调。
Result: 在 28 个半刚性和 10 个柔性分子（74 个实验多晶型）上，FastCSP 可靠地恢复了所有已知结构，排名在全局最小值的 9 kJ/mol 以内。UMA 复现色散包含 DFT 结果的高保真度，构象修正对柔性化合物特别有益。
Conclusion: UMA 的精度、迁移性和计算效率消除了在 CSP 早期筛选中使用经典力场以及后续 DFT 重排的需要。开源发布降低了 CSP 的门槛，使药物级和高通量多晶型筛选在实用计算范围内成为可能。

papers.title: Towards Mitigation of Hallucination for LLM-empowered Agents: Progressive Generalization Bound Exploration and Watchdog Monitor
papers.abstract_en: Empowered by large language models (LLMs), intelligent agents have become a popular paradigm for interacting with open environments to facilitate AI deployment. However, hallucinations generated by LLMs-where outputs are inconsistent with facts-pose a significant challenge, undermining the credibility of intelligent agents. Only if hallucinations can be mitigated, the intelligent agents can be used in real-world without any catastrophic risk. Therefore, effective detection and mitigation of hallucinations are crucial to ensure the dependability of agents. Unfortunately, the related approaches either depend on white-box access to LLMs or fail to accurately identify hallucinations. To address the challenge posed by hallucinations of intelligent agents, we present HalMit, a novel black-box watchdog framework that models the generalization bound of LLM-empowered agents and thus detect hallucinations without requiring internal knowledge of the LLM's architecture. Specifically, a probabilistic fractal sampling technique is proposed to generate a sufficient number of queries to trigger the incredible responses in parallel, efficiently identifying the generalization bound of the target agent. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that HalMit significantly outperforms existing approaches in hallucination monitoring. Its black-box nature and superior performance make HalMit a promising solution for enhancing the dependability of LLM-powered systems.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence (ECAI 2025), IOS Press, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HalMit，一种黑盒监视框架，通过概率分形采样技术生成足够多的查询来触发 LLM 智能体的不可信响应，从而建模其泛化边界并检测幻觉。实验表明 HalMit 在幻觉监测上显著优于现有方法，且无需访问模型内部结构。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的智能体在开放环境中常产生与事实不一致的幻觉，损害其可信度。现有幻觉检测方法或依赖白盒访问，或识别不准确，亟需一种无需内部知识的黑盒方法。
Method: 提出 HalMit 框架，包括概率分形采样技术并行生成触发查询，以探索并确定目标智能体的泛化边界，从而在不访问 LLM 架构的情况下检测幻觉。
Result: 实验评估显示，HalMit 在幻觉监测性能上显著超过现有方法。
Conclusion: HalMit 的黑盒特性和优越性能使其成为提升 LLM 驱动系统可靠性的有前景方案。

papers.title: NABLA: Neighborhood Adaptive Block-Level Attention
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in transformer-based architectures has demonstrated remarkable success in video generation tasks. However, the quadratic complexity of full attention mechanisms remains a critical bottleneck, particularly for high-resolution and long-duration video sequences. In this paper, we propose NABLA, a novel Neighborhood Adaptive Block-Level Attention mechanism that dynamically adapts to sparsity patterns in video diffusion transformers (DiTs). By leveraging block-wise attention with adaptive sparsity-driven threshold, NABLA reduces computational overhead while preserving generative quality. Our method does not require custom low-level operator design and can be seamlessly integrated with PyTorch's Flex Attention operator. Experiments demonstrate that NABLA achieves up to 2.7x faster training and inference compared to baseline almost without compromising quantitative metrics (CLIP score, VBench score, human evaluation score) and visual quality drop. The code and model weights are available here: https://github.com/gen-ai-team/Wan2.1-NABLA
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Access, vol. 14, pp. 64655-64665, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NABLA，一种邻域自适应块级注意力机制，用于视频扩散Transformer（DiTs）。通过动态调整稀疏性阈值，NABLA 在保持生成质量的同时，将训练和推理速度提升至多 2.7 倍，且无需自定义低层算子，可无缝集成 PyTorch 的 Flex Attention。
Motivation: 全注意力的二次复杂度仍是高分辨率、长视频序列生成的瓶颈，现有方法缺乏对视频稀疏模式的动态适应。
Method: 提出块级注意力机制，基于自适应稀疏性阈值动态调整注意力计算范围，不依赖自定义低层算子。
Result: 在视频扩散模型中，训练和推理速度提升至多 2.7 倍，CLIP 分数、VBench 分数和人工评估分数几乎无下降。

papers.title: Context Tuning for In-Context Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Context Tuning, a simple and effective method to significantly enhance few-shot adaptation of large language models (LLMs) without weight updates. In-Context Learning (ICL) forms a memory representation of the demonstrations in a single forward pass but cannot refine it when insufficient. Prompt-based methods offer lightweight adaptation by optimizing a trainable prompt or prefix but initialize it independently of the demonstrations. In contrast, Context Tuning leverages the model's inherent ICL ability to initialize a trainable memory representation from demonstrations, then refines it through gradient-based optimization. Extensive evaluations on benchmarks such as CrossFit, UnifiedQA, MMLU, BIG-Bench Hard, and ARC demonstrate that Context Tuning outperforms both ICL and traditional prompt-based adaptation methods while achieving competitive accuracy with Test-Time Training at significantly higher training efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出上下文调优(Context Tuning)方法，无需权重更新即可显著提升大语言模型的少样本适应能力。该方法利用模型内在的上下文学习能力从演示中初始化可训练的记忆表示，并通过梯度优化进一步精炼。在CrossFit、UnifiedQA、MMLU、BIG-Bench Hard、ARC等基准上，Context Tuning优于上下文学习和传统提示方法，与测试时训练性能相当但训练效率更高。
Motivation: 上下文学习无法在演示不足时精炼记忆表示，而提示方法初始化解耦于演示。Context Tuning旨在结合两者优势，利用演示初始化可训练记忆再优化。
Method: 使用模型自身的上下文学习能力从演示中生成初始记忆表示，随后通过基于梯度的优化对该表示进行精炼，无需更新模型权重。
Result: 在CrossFit、UnifiedQA、MMLU、BIG-Bench Hard和ARC等基准上，Context Tuning超过上下文学习和传统提示方法，与测试时训练精度相当但训练效率更高。
Conclusion: Context Tuning有效增强了大语言模型的少样本适应能力，无需权重更新，在效率和精度之间取得良好平衡。

papers.title: Interaction Techniques that Encourage Longer Prompts Can Improve Psychological Ownership when Writing with AI
papers.abstract_en: Writing longer prompts for an AI assistant to generate a story increases psychological ownership, a user's feeling that the writing belongs to them. To encourage users to write longer prompts, we evaluated two interaction techniques that modify the prompt entry interface of chat-based generative AI assistants: pressing and holding the prompt submission button, and continuously moving a slider up and down when submitting a short prompt. A within-subjects experiment investigated the effects of such techniques on prompt length and psychological ownership, and results showed that these techniques increased prompt length and led to higher psychological ownership than baseline techniques. A second experiment further augmented these techniques by showing AI-generated suggestions for how the prompts could be expanded. This further increased prompt length, but did not lead to improvements in psychological ownership. Our results show that simple interface modifications like these can elicit more writing from users and improve psychological ownership.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在AI辅助写作中，两种交互技术（长按提交按钮和滑动滑块）能否促使用户撰写更长的提示词，进而提升心理所有权（psychological ownership）。实验表明这两种技术均能显著增加提示词长度和心理所有权，而额外添加AI扩展建议虽进一步增加长度但未提升心理所有权。
Motivation: 用户在使用AI生成故事时，提示词长度与心理所有权正相关，但现有界面缺乏有效激励用户撰写更长提示词的方法。
Method: 设计两种交互技术：长按提交按钮和滑动滑块，并在第二项实验中额外提供AI生成的提示词扩展建议。通过受试者内实验测量提示词长度和心理所有权。
Result: 长按和滑动技术均比基线显著增加提示词长度和心理所有权；加入AI建议后提示词长度进一步增加，但心理所有权无显著提升。
Conclusion: 简单的界面修改（如长按或滑动）即可激励用户写出更长提示词并改善心理所有权，但AI建议可能削弱用户投入感。

papers.title: Interactive Multi-Objective Probabilistic Preference Learning with Soft and Hard Bounds
papers.abstract_en: High-stakes decision-making involves navigating multiple competing objectives with expensive evaluations. For instance, in brachytherapy, clinicians must balance maximizing tumor coverage (e.g., an aspirational target or soft bound of >95% coverage) against strict organ dose limits (e.g., a non-negotiable hard bound of <601cGy to the bladder). Selecting Pareto-optimal solutions that match implicit preferences is challenging, as exhaustive Pareto frontier exploration is computationally and cognitively prohibitive, necessitating interactive frameworks to guide users. While decision-makers (DMs) often possess domain knowledge to narrow the search via such soft-hard bounds, current methods often lack systematic approaches to iteratively refine these multi-faceted preference structures. Furthermore, DMs often require confidence that they have not overlooked superior alternatives, a paramount necessity in high-stakes scenarios. We present Active-MoSH, an interactive local-global framework designed for this process. Its local component integrates probabilistic preference learning with an active sampling strategy to adaptively refine Pareto subsets while minimizing cognitive burden. To bolster decision confidence, Active-MoSH's global component, C-MoSH, leverages multi-objective sensitivity analysis to identify potentially overlooked, high-value points beyond immediate feedback. We demonstrate Active-MoSH's performance benefits through diverse synthetic and real-world applications. A high-stakes case study with real cervical cancer brachytherapy treatment plans and an image selection user study further validate our hypotheses regarding the framework's ability to improve convergence, enhance DM confidence, and provide expressive preference articulation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Active-MoSH，一个交互式局部-全局框架，用于多目标概率偏好学习，结合软硬界限（如近距离放疗中肿瘤覆盖率和器官剂量约束）。局部组件使用主动采样自适应细化Pareto子集，全局组件C-MoSH利用多目标敏感性分析识别可能被忽略的高价值点。实验在合成数据和实际应用（宫颈癌治疗计划和图像选择）中验证了其改善收敛、增强决策信心和提供表达性偏好表达的能力。
Motivation: 高风险决策中需要在多个竞争目标间权衡，评估昂贵，且决策者拥有领域知识但现有方法缺乏系统地迭代细化偏好结构。需要确保决策者不会错过更优方案。
Method: 提出Active-MoSH框架，包含局部组件和全局组件。局部组件结合概率偏好学习与主动采样策略，自适应细化Pareto子集；全局组件C-MoSH通过多目标敏感性分析识别可能被忽略的高价值点，增强决策信心。
Result: 在多种合成和真实世界应用中展示性能优势，包括宫颈癌近距离放疗病例研究和图像选择用户研究，验证了改善收敛、增强决策信心和提供表达性偏好表达的能力。
Conclusion: Active-MoSH框架能有效利用软硬界限，在高风险决策中提高收敛速度和决策信心，并支持更丰富的偏好表达。

papers.title: Ctrl-Z Sampling: Scaling Diffusion Sampling with Controlled Random Zigzag Explorations
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generate conditional samples by progressively denoising Gaussian noise, yet the denoising trajectory can stall at visually plausible but low-quality outcomes with conditional misalignment or structural artifacts. We interpret this behavior as local optima in a surrogate quality landscape: Once early denoising commits to a suboptimal global structure, later steps mainly sharpen details and seldom correct the underlying mistake. While existing inference-time approaches explore alternative diffusion states via re-noising with fixed strength or direction, they exhibit limited capacity to escape steep quality plateaus. We propose Controlled Random Zigzag Sampling (Ctrl-Z Sampling),a scalable sampling strategy that detects plateaus in quality landscape via a surrogate score, and allocates exploration only when a plateau is detected. Upon detection, Ctrl-Z Sampling rolls back to noisier states, samples a set of alternative continuations, and updates the trajectory when a candidate improves the score, otherwise escalating the exploration depth to escape the current plateau. The proposed method is model-agnostic and broadly compatible with existing diffusion frameworks. Experiments show that Ctrl-Z Sampling consistently improves generation quality over other inference-time scaling samplers across different NFE budgets, offering a scalable compute-quality trade-off. Code available at: https://github.com/ShunqiM/Ctrl-Z-Sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ctrl-Z Sampling 是一种针对扩散模型采样轨迹陷入局部最优（视觉合理但质量低）问题的推理时采样策略。该方法通过代理分数检测质量景观中的平坦区域，仅在这些区域回退到更噪声状态并探索多条替代轨迹，若候选路径未改善分数则加深探索深度。实验表明，该方法在不同 NFE 预算下一致优于其他推理时缩放采样器，提供可扩展的计算-质量权衡。
Motivation: 扩散模型在去噪过程中可能早期就承诺了次优的全局结构，后续步骤主要细化细节而难以修正根本错误，导致条件错位或结构伪影。现有推理时方法（如固定强度的重噪声）逃离质量高原地带的能力有限。
Method: 提出 Controlled Random Zigzag Sampling (Ctrl-Z Sampling)：通过代理分数检测质量景观中的平坦区域，检测到后回退到更噪声状态，采样一组替代连续轨迹，仅当候选改善分数时更新轨迹，否则加深探索深度。模型无关，兼容现有扩散框架。
Result: 在多个 NFE 预算下，Ctrl-Z Sampling 一致改善了生成质量，优于其他推理时缩放采样器，提供了可扩展的计算-质量权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法通过智能分配探索资源来克服扩散采样中的局部最优问题，是一种通用且高效的推理时缩放策略。

papers.title: Counterfactual Operator Relevance for PDE Discovery: Screening, Pruning, and Identifiability
papers.abstract_en: We study operator relevance in data-driven partial differential equation (PDE) discovery. Sparse residual methods can select terms that improve residual fit, but residual contribution is not the same as functional necessity. We formalize this distinction through counterfactual operator interventions, where a candidate term is deleted or perturbed and the factual and intervened trajectories, or observables, are compared. The resulting theory gives six reusable results. A residual--counterfactual gap theorem shows that deletion effects are governed by the inverse linearized PDE map, not by residual magnitude alone. A certified decision theorem gives error margins for relevance, irrelevance, and abstention under neural or numerical surrogate error. An aliasing theorem characterizes experiment-dependent non-identifiability through the null space of the operator-evaluation design. A constraint-manifold theorem shows that operators vanishing on invariant constraint classes cannot be identified from trajectories restricted to those classes. A pruning-consistency theorem proves that sparse screening followed by counterfactual deletion recovers the functionally relevant support under a recall and margin condition. An observable-level adjoint theorem extends relevance testing from full-state deviations to scientific quantities of interest. Validation experiments test these mechanisms on synthetic PDEs with known support and on public geophysical fields from atmospheric reanalysis and NOAA OISST. The real-data results are reported as operator-surrogate diagnostics, not as unconditional recovery of physical laws. The framework provides a rigorous diagnostic layer for distinguishing residual usefulness from counterfactual operator relevance within a specified library, experiment class, norm, and tolerance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据驱动偏微分方程（PDE）发现中的算子相关性，提出反事实算子干预框架，通过删除或扰动候选项并与事实轨迹比较，区分残差有用性与功能必要性。理论部分包含六个定理：残差-反事实间隙定理、认证决策定理、混叠定理、约束流形定理、剪枝一致性定理、可观测水平伴随定理。在合成PDE和真实地球物理场（大气再分析、NOAA OISST）上验证了机制。
Motivation: 现有稀疏残差方法能选择改善残差拟合的项，但残差贡献不等于功能必要性，缺乏严格区分两者的理论框架。
Method: 提出反事实算子干预：删除或扰动候选算子项，比较事实与干预后的轨迹（或可观测量），基于线性化PDE逆映射、误差边界、算子-评估设计零空间等理论导出六个定理，并给出筛查-剪枝一致性（稀疏筛选+反事实删除恢复功能相关支持）。
Result: 在已知支撑的合成PDE上验证了反事实相关性检测机制，在真实地球物理场（大气再分析、NOAA OISST）上得到算子-替代诊断结果，但未声称无条件恢复物理定律。
Conclusion: 该方法为在指定库、实验类、范数和容差下区分残差有用性与反事实算子相关性提供了严密的诊断层，但结果依赖于实验设计和先验知识。
Relevance: 50

papers.title: Local Learning Rules for Out-of-Equilibrium Physical Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: We show that the out-of-equilibrium driving protocol of score-based generative models (SGMs) can be learned via local learning rules. The gradient with respect to the parameters of the driving protocol is computed directly from force measurements or from observed system dynamics. As a demonstration, we implement an SGM in a network of driven, nonlinear, overdamped oscillators coupled to a thermal bath. We first apply it to the problem of sampling from a mixture of two Gaussians in 2D. Finally, we train an oscillator network on the MNIST dataset to generate images of handwritten digits 0 and 1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，基于分数的生成模型（score-based generative models）的非平衡驱动协议可以通过局部学习规则进行学习。梯度直接从力测量或观测到的系统动力学中计算。作者在一个由受驱非线性过阻尼振荡器构成的网络中实现了该模型，该网络与热浴耦合。实验展示了在二维双高斯混合分布上的采样，以及在MNIST数据集上训练振荡器网络以生成手写数字0和1。
Motivation: 现有的生成模型通常依赖全局信息或反向传播，而物理系统中局部学习规则的实现仍面临挑战。本文旨在探索非平衡物理系统中局部学习规则的可能性。
Method: 提出局部学习规则，直接从力测量或系统动力学中计算驱动协议参数的梯度，并在非线性过阻尼振荡器网络中实现基于分数的生成模型。
Result: 成功在二维双高斯混合分布上采样，并在MNIST数据集上训练振荡器网络生成手写数字0和1。
Conclusion: 非平衡物理系统的局部学习规则可以用于实现基于分数的生成模型，为物理计算提供了新途径。

papers.title: Tight Stability Bounds for Robust Distributed Learning: Byzantine Failures Hurt Generalization More than Data Poisoning
papers.abstract_en: Robust distributed learning algorithms aim to maintain reliable performance despite the presence of misbehaving workers. Such misbehaviors are commonly modeled as \textit{Byzantine failures}, allowing arbitrarily corrupted communication, or as \textit{data poisoning}, a weaker form of corruption restricted to local training data. While prior work shows similar optimization guarantees for both models, an important question remains: \textit{How do these threat models impact generalization?} We show, for the first time, a fundamental gap in generalization guarantees between the two threat models: Byzantine failures yield strictly worse rates than those achievable under data poisoning. Our findings are based upon a tight algorithmic stability analysis of robust distributed learning. Specifically, with $f$ out of $n$ workers misbehaving, we prove that: \textit{(i)} under data poisoning, the uniform algorithmic stability of a robust distributed learning algorithm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次证明在鲁棒分布式学习中，拜占庭失败（Byzantine failures）导致的泛化保证严格劣于数据中毒（data poisoning）。通过紧的算法稳定性分析，得出当$n$个工作者中有$f$个行为不端时，两种威胁模型下泛化误差存在根本性差异。
Motivation: 先前工作显示拜占庭失败和数据中毒在优化保证上类似，但它们在泛化上的影响是否相同仍不清楚。本文旨在揭示这一根本差异。
Method: 采用算法稳定性分析（algorithmic stability analysis），推导出在两种威胁模型下鲁棒分布式学习算法的均匀稳定性界限。
Result: 证明拜占庭失败下的泛化率严格差于数据中毒下的泛化率。具体边界依赖于工作者总数$n$和恶意工作者数$f$。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了拜占庭失败对泛化的损害比数据中毒更严重，为分布式学习中的威胁模型选择提供了理论指导。

papers.title: ELBO-T2IAlign: A Generic ELBO-Based Method for Calibrating Pixel-level Text-Image Alignment in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel at image generation. Recent studies have shown that these models not only generate high-quality images but also encode text-image alignment information through attention maps or loss functions. This information is valuable for various downstream tasks, including segmentation, text-guided image editing, and compositional image generation. However, current methods heavily rely on the assumption of perfect text-image alignment in diffusion models, which is not the case. In this paper, we propose using zero-shot referring image segmentation as a proxy task to evaluate the pixel-level image and class-level text alignment of popular diffusion models. We conduct an in-depth analysis of pixel-text misalignment in diffusion models from the perspective of training data bias. We find that misalignment occurs in images with small-sized, occluded, or rare object classes. Therefore, we propose ELBO-T2IAlign--a simple yet effective method to calibrate pixel-text alignment in diffusion models based on the evidence lower bound (ELBO) of likelihood. ELBO-T2IAlign is training-free and generic: it requires no additional annotations, model retraining, or architectural modifications, and it can be directly applied to different diffusion backbones. Extensive experiments on zero-shot referring image segmentation, text-guided image editing, and compositional image generation verify that the proposed calibration improves pixel-text alignment across complementary downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于证据下界（ELBO）的无训练通用方法ELBO-T2IAlign，用于校准扩散模型中像素级文本-图像对齐。通过零样本指代图像分割作为代理任务，分析了训练数据偏差导致的对齐失败（小尺寸、遮挡或罕见类别），并在多个下游任务（分割、编辑、组合生成）中验证了校准效果。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在像素级文本-图像对齐上存在偏差，尤其对小型、遮挡或罕见类别物体，而下游任务依赖完美对齐的假设不成立。
Method: 基于似然的证据下界（ELBO）推导出对齐校准项，无需额外标注、重训练或修改架构，可直接应用于不同扩散骨干网络。
Result: 在零样本指代分割、文本引导图像编辑和组合生成任务上，校准后像素-文本对齐指标得到改善。
Conclusion: ELBO-T2IAlign是一种轻量、通用的扩散模型对齐校准方法，可提升多种下游任务性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Boosting Automatic Exercise Evaluation Through Musculoskeletal Simulation-Based IMU Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Automated evaluation of movement quality can enhance physiotherapeutic treatment and sports training by providing objective, real-time feedback. However, deep learning models that assess movements captured by inertial measurement units (IMUs) are often limited by data scarcity, class imbalance, and label ambiguity. We present a data augmentation method that generates IMU data using musculoskeletal simulations integrated with systematic modifications of movement trajectories. The approach enforces anatomically plausible kinematic constraints and enables automatic labeling by combining inverse kinematic parameters with a knowledge-based evaluation strategy. Across four datasets of varying complexity, augmented variants closely resemble real-world data and contribute to gains in classification accuracy, generalization to unseen subjects, and patient-specific fine-tuning from few examples. The magnitude of these gains varies with dataset properties, in particular class balance and label ambiguity. These findings indicate that musculoskeletal simulation-based augmentation can address common challenges faced by deep learning applications in physiotherapeutic exercise evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于肌肉骨骼模拟的IMU数据增强方法，用于自动评估运动质量。该方法通过系统修改运动轨迹生成仿真IMU数据，保持解剖学约束并实现自动标注。在四个数据集上，增强数据提高了分类准确率和泛化能力，并支持少量样本的个性化微调。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在评估IMU捕获的运动时受限于数据稀缺、类别不均衡和标签模糊。
Method: 提出使用肌肉骨骼模拟结合系统修改运动轨迹来生成IMU数据，并通过逆运动学参数和基于知识的评估策略自动标注。
Result: 在四个不同复杂度的数据集上，增强数据接近真实数据，提升了分类准确率和泛化能力，并支持从少量样本中进行个性化微调。增益大小因数据集特性（如类别平衡和标签模糊）而异。
Conclusion: 肌肉骨骼模拟增强可以解决物理治疗运动评估中深度学习的常见挑战。

papers.title: CDST: Color Disentangled Style Transfer for Universal Style Reference Customization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Color Disentangled Style Transfer (CDST), a novel and efficient two-stream style transfer training paradigm which completely isolates color from style and forces the style stream to be color-blinded. With one same model, CDST unlocks universal style transfer capabilities in a tuning-free manner during inference. Especially, the characteristics-preserved style transfer with style and content references is solved in the tuning-free way for the first time. CDST significantly improves the style similarity by multi-feature image embeddings compression and preserves strong editing capability via our new CDST style definition inspired by Diffusion UNet disentanglement law. By conducting thorough qualitative and quantitative experiments and human evaluations, we demonstrate that CDST achieves state-of-the-art results on various style transfer tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出色彩解耦风格迁移（CDST），一种双流训练范式，将颜色与风格完全分离，使风格流对颜色不敏感。同一模型在推理时无需调参即可实现通用风格迁移，首次以无调参方式解决同时给定风格和内容参考的特性保持风格迁移。通过多特征图像嵌入压缩提升风格相似度，并基于Diffusion UNet解耦定律定义CDST风格以保持编辑能力。定性和定量实验及人类评估表明CDST在多种风格迁移任务上达到最优。
Motivation: 现有风格迁移方法通常依赖调参或无法同时处理风格和内容参考，且颜色和风格耦合限制编辑灵活性。
Method: 提出双流训练范式：一个流处理颜色，另一个流（颜色盲）处理风格；通过多特征图像嵌入压缩增强风格相似度，利用Diffusion UNet解耦定律定义CDST风格。
Result: 在多种风格迁移任务上达到SOTA，定性和定量实验及人类评估验证优越性。
Conclusion: CDST实现了无调参的通用风格迁移，首次解决特性保持风格迁移问题，并保持强编辑能力。

papers.title: Towards Understanding Deep Learning Model in Image Recognition via Coverage Test
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) play a crucial role in the field of artificial intelligence, and their security-related testing has been a prominent research focus. By inputting test cases, the behavior of models is examined for anomalies, and coverage metrics are utilized to determine the extent of neurons covered by these test cases. With the widespread application and advancement of DNNs, different types of neural behaviors have garnered attention, leading to the emergence of various coverage metrics for neural networks. However, there is currently a lack of empirical research on these coverage metrics, specifically in analyzing the relationships and patterns between model depth, configuration information, and neural network coverage. This paper aims to investigate the relationships and patterns of four coverage metrics: primary functionality, boundary, hierarchy, and structural coverage. A series of empirical experiments were conducted, selecting LeNet, VGG, and ResNet as different DNN architectures, along with 10 models of varying depths ranging from 5 to 54 layers, to compare and study the relationships between different depths, configuration information, and various neural network coverage metrics. Additionally, an investigation was carried out on the relationships between modified decision/condition coverage and dataset size. Finally, three potential future directions are proposed to further contribute to the security testing of DNN Models.

TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络在图像识别中的覆盖测试进行实证研究，分析了四种覆盖度量（主要功能、边界、层次和结构覆盖）在不同深度（5-54层）和架构（LeNet、VGG、ResNet）下的关系，并探讨了修改决策/条件覆盖与数据集大小的关系。
Motivation: 目前缺乏对神经网络覆盖度量的实证研究，特别是模型深度、配置信息与覆盖度量之间的关系模式尚不明确。
Method: 选取LeNet、VGG和ResNet三种架构共10个不同深度（5-54层）的模型，通过输入测试用例计算四种覆盖度量，并分析其与模型深度、配置信息及数据集大小的关系。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但报告了不同覆盖度量与模型深度、配置信息的关系模式，以及修改决策/条件覆盖与数据集大小的关系。
Conclusion: 提出了三个未来研究方向，以进一步贡献于深度神经网络的安全测试。

papers.title: An Axiomatic Assessment of Entropy- and Variance-based Uncertainty Quantification in Regression
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification is crucial in machine learning, yet most (axiomatic) studies of uncertainty measures focus on classification, leaving a gap in regression settings with limited formal justification and evaluations. In this work, we provide a formal way of representing uncertainty in continuous space, using a general parametric formulation, allowing for tractable analysis and evaluation of uncertainty measures. Within this framework, we propose a set of axioms that enable rigorous assessment of total, aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainty measures. Together, this allows for a theoretical examination of uncertainty measures and their corresponding properties. As a specific example, we compare the widely used entropy- and variance-based measures with respect to established predictive models and analyze their limitations and challenges in uncertainty quantification. Our work provides a principled way to understand and develop uncertainty measures in supervised regression, offering theoretical insights and practical guidelines for reliable uncertainty assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对回归任务中的不确定性量化（UQ）缺乏公理基础的问题，提出了一套通用的参数化形式来表示连续空间中的不确定性，并定义了一组公理用于严格评估总不确定性、任意不确定性和认知不确定性度量。以熵和方差这两种广泛使用的度量为例，论文通过理论分析揭示了它们在回归UQ中的局限性和挑战，为监督回归中可靠UQ的度量开发和理论理解提供了指导。
Motivation: 现有的不确定性度量公理研究主要集中于分类任务，回归任务中的UQ缺乏形式化论证和系统评估。
Method: 提出一种通用的连续空间不确定性参数化表示框架，在此基础上构建一组公理用以评估总、任意和认知不确定性度量，并通过熵和方差度量进行理论验证。
Result: 理论分析表明熵和方差在回归UQ中存在局限性，例如对预测分布形状的敏感性不足或不满足某些公理性质。
Conclusion: 该工作为监督回归中不确定性度量的理论理解和开发提供了原则性框架和实用指导。

papers.title: AgentDynEx: Nudging the Mechanics and Dynamics of Multi-Agent Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model simulations have the potential to model complex human behaviors and interactions. If the mechanics are set up properly, unanticipated and valuable social dynamics can surface. However, it is challenging to consistently enforce simulation mechanics while still allowing for rich and emergent dynamics. We present AgentDynEx, an AI system that helps set up, track, and repair simulations. Specifically, AgentDynEx introduces milestones that act as checkpoints and failure conditions that act as guardrails to ensure dynamics are relevant and mechanics are respected as the simulation progresses. It also introduces a method called nudging, where the system dynamically reflects on simulation progress and gently intervenes if it begins to deviate from intended outcomes. A technical evaluation found that nudging enables simulations to progress further without reducing the presence notable dynamics compared to simulations without nudging. A case study with AgentDynEx documented instances where real users were able to simulate lived experiences. We discuss the importance of nudging as a technique for guiding agents towards desirable behaviors while preserving their freedom of choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentDynEx，一个AI系统，用于设置、跟踪和修复多智能体大语言模型模拟。系统引入里程碑作为检查点、失败条件作为护栏，以及一种称为'轻推'（nudging）的动态干预机制，在模拟偏离预期时温和引导。技术评估表明，轻推能让模拟推进更远而不减少显著动态。案例研究展示了用户使用该系统模拟真实生活经历。
Motivation: 多智能体大语言模型模拟虽有潜力模拟复杂人类行为，但难以一致地强制执行模拟机制，同时允许丰富涌现的动态。现有方法缺乏在保持动态丰富性的同时确保机制得到遵守的有效手段。
Method: 提出AgentDynEx系统，通过设置里程碑（检查点）和失败条件（护栏）来确保模拟机制和动态的相关性；引入'轻推'方法，动态反思模拟进展并在偏离时温和干预，引导代理朝向期望行为但不剥夺自由选择。
Result: 技术评估发现，与无轻推的模拟相比，轻推使模拟能够推进更远而不减少显著动态。案例研究显示真实用户成功模拟了生活经历。
Conclusion: 强调轻推作为引导代理朝向期望行为同时保留其选择自由的技术的重要性。

papers.title: Neuro-symbolic Weak Supervision: Theory and Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Weak supervision enables machine learning models to learn from limited or noisy labels, but it introduces challenges in reliability and semantic clarity, particularly in multi-instance partial label learning (MI-PLL), where models must resolve both ambiguous supervision signals and uncertain instance-label mappings. This paper proposes a semantics for a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates inductive logic programming (ILP) to structure MI-PLL through relational constraints. In this formulation, ILP defines a hypothesis space over label transitions, formalizes the semantics of per-instance classifiers and provides a relational scaffold for reasoning about weak supervision. Two inductive tasks are studied in this framework: inferring the transition predicate from the observed and classifier predicates, and inferring instance-level classifier assignments from the observed and transition predicates. This formal semantics facilitates constraint specification, consistency checking and the diagnosis of semantic failure modes that bag-level accuracy alone may conceal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号弱监督框架，通过归纳逻辑编程（ILP）为多实例部分标签学习（MI-PLL）提供语义形式化，定义基于关系约束的假设空间，并研究两种归纳任务：从观测谓词和分类器谓词推断转移谓词，以及从观测谓词和转移谓词推断实例级分类器分配。该语义支持约束指定、一致性检查和语义故障诊断。
Motivation: 弱监督学习（如MI-PLL）面临标签噪声和实例-标签映射模糊的挑战，现有方法依赖袋级精度，缺乏语义透明性和故障诊断能力。
Method: 提出神经符号框架，将ILP集成到MI-PLL中，通过关系约束形式化标签转移的假设空间，定义实例级分类器的语义，并提供推理弱监督信号的关系支架。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，但框架通过形式语义实现了约束指定、一致性检查和语义故障诊断。
Conclusion: 该框架为弱监督学习提供了形式化语义基础，有助于揭示袋级精度隐藏的语义失败模式，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: Using Mechanistic Interpretability to Craft Adversarial Attacks against Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Traditional white-box methods for creating adversarial perturbations against LLMs typically rely only on gradient computation from the targeted model, ignoring the internal mechanisms responsible for attack success or failure. Conversely, interpretability studies that analyze these internal mechanisms lack practical applications beyond runtime interventions. We bridge this gap by introducing a novel white-box approach that leverages mechanistic interpretability techniques to craft practical adversarial inputs. Specifically, we first identify acceptance subspaces - sets of feature vectors that do not trigger the model's refusal mechanisms - then use gradient-based optimization to reroute embeddings from refusal subspaces to acceptance subspaces, effectively achieving jailbreaks. This targeted approach significantly reduces computation cost, achieving attack success rates of 80-95\% on state-of-the-art models including Gemma2, Llama3.2, and Qwen2.5 within minutes or even seconds, compared to existing techniques that often fail or require hours of computation. We believe this approach opens a new direction for both attack research and defense development. Furthermore, it showcases a practical application of mechanistic interpretability where other methods are less efficient, which highlights its utility. The code and generated datasets are available at https://github.com/Sckathach/subspace-rerouting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用机械可解释性技术生成对抗性输入的白盒方法，用于攻击大型语言模型（LLMs）。作者首先识别拒绝机制未触发的“接受子空间”，然后通过梯度优化将嵌入从拒绝子空间重路由到接受子空间，实现越狱。该方法在Gemma2、Llama3.2和Qwen2.5等模型上达到80-95%的攻击成功率，且计算成本显著降低，仅需数秒或数分钟。
Motivation: 传统的白盒对抗攻击方法仅依赖梯度计算，忽视模型内部机制；可解释性研究缺乏实际攻击应用。本文旨在将机械可解释性用于实用化对抗攻击。
Method: 首先识别特征向量的接受子空间（不触发拒绝机制），然后利用梯度优化将嵌入从拒绝子空间重路由到接受子空间，实现越狱。
Result: 在Gemma2、Llama3.2和Qwen2.5等先进模型上达到80-95%的越狱成功率，计算时间从小时级降至分钟或秒级。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了机械可解释性在攻击研究中的实用价值，并为防御开发提供了新方向。代码和数据集已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Token Communications: A Large Model-Driven Framework for Cross-modal Context-aware Semantic Communications
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce token communications (TokCom), a large model-driven framework to leverage cross-modal context information in generative semantic communications (GenSC). TokCom is a new paradigm, motivated by the recent success of generative foundation models and multimodal large language models (GFM/MLLMs), where the communication units are tokens, enabling efficient transformer-based token processing at the transmitter and receiver. In this paper, we introduce the potential opportunities and challenges of leveraging context in GenSC, explore how to integrate GFM/MLLMs-based token processing into semantic communication systems to leverage cross-modal context effectively at affordable complexity, present the key principles for efficient TokCom at various layers in future wireless networks. In a typical image semantic communication setup, we demonstrate a significant improvement of the bandwidth efficiency, achieved by TokCom by leveraging the context information among tokens. Finally, the potential research directions are identified to facilitate adoption of TokCom in future wireless networks.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Wireless Communications Magazine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Token Communications (TokCom)，一种大型模型驱动的跨模态语义通信框架，利用生成基础模型和多模态大语言模型，通过令牌（token）作为通信单元实现高效的Transformer-based处理。论文讨论了TokCom的机遇与挑战，并在图像语义通信场景中展示了带宽效率的提升。
Motivation: 现有生成语义通信（GenSC）系统缺乏有效利用跨模态上下文信息的方法，且计算复杂度高。TokCom旨在通过大模型驱动的令牌处理实现高效上下文感知通信。
Method: 提出TokCom框架，基于生成基础模型和多模态大语言模型，在发射机和接收机端采用transformer-based令牌处理，集成跨模态上下文信息以降低复杂度。
Result: 在典型图像语义通信设置中，TokCom通过利用令牌间的上下文信息显著提升了带宽效率。
Conclusion: TokCom为未来无线网络中的语义通信提供了新范式，并指出了多个研究方向。

papers.title: Robust Counterfactual Explanations under Model Multiplicity Using Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, explainability in machine learning has gained importance. In this context, counterfactual explanation (CE), which is an explanation method that uses examples, has attracted attention. However, it has been pointed out that CE is not robust when there are multiple machine-learning models with similar accuracy. These problems are important when using machine learning to make safe decisions. In this paper, we propose robust CEs that introduce a new viewpoint -- Pareto improvement -- and a method that uses multi-objective optimization to generate it. To evaluate the proposed method, we conducted experiments using both simulated and real data. The results demonstrate that the proposed method is both robust and practical. This study highlights the potential of ensuring robustness in decision-making by applying the concept of social welfare. We believe that this research can serve as a valuable foundation for various fields, including explainability in machine learning, decision-making, and action planning based on machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器学习中存在多个相似精度模型时反事实解释（CE）不鲁棒的问题，提出一种基于帕累托改进视角、使用多目标优化生成鲁棒反事实解释的方法。在模拟和真实数据上的实验表明该方法兼具鲁棒性和实用性，并将社会福利概念引入决策鲁棒性保障。
Motivation: 当存在多个精度相近的机器学习模型时，同一输入的反事实解释可能因模型选择而显著变化，影响安全决策的可靠性。现有方法未能有效应对这种模型多重性（model multiplicity）导致的鲁棒性问题。
Method: 引入帕累托改进概念，将鲁棒反事实解释的生成建模为多目标优化问题，同时考虑多个候选模型的约束，生成对所有模型均有效的解释。
Result: 在模拟数据和真实数据上的实验表明，所提方法生成的反事实解释在模型多重性下具有鲁棒性，且计算开销在实用范围内。
Conclusion: 本研究展示了将社会福利等概念应用于机器学习决策鲁棒性保障的潜力，可为可解释性、决策制定及基于机器学习的行动规划等领域提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhanced Vision-Language Models for Diverse Sensor Understanding: Cost-Efficient Optimization and Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved notable progress in aligning visual inputs with text. However, their ability to deeply understand the unique physical properties of non-RGB vision sensor images remains limited. In this paper, we revisit and analyze these limitations and introduce a novel, cost-efficient paradigm that significantly advances sensor image understanding-without requiring extensive training data or any modifications to the existing VLM architectures. Specifically, we propose Sensor-Aware Attributes Fine-Tuning (SAFT) with the Diverse Negative Attributes (DNA) optimization, which leverages minimal sensor-specific data to enable robust learning of non-RGB characteristics and overcome RGB-centric biases inherent in current VLMs. In addition, we present VS-TDX-the first comprehensive, public benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate VLMs' sensor-specific understanding across diverse and realistic scenarios. Through extensive experiments on VLMs and various sensor modalities, we validate that our method consistently delivers superior performance and generalization under resource-constrained and architecture-invariant settings. Our approach provides a practical advance towards scalable deployment of VLMs in increasingly sensor-diverse real-world environments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种低成本、无需修改VLM架构的范式，通过Sensor-Aware Attributes Fine-Tuning (SAFT) 和 Diverse Negative Attributes (DNA) 优化，提升视觉语言模型对非RGB传感器图像的理解能力。同时构建首个全面公开基准VS-TDX，用于评估VLM的传感器特定理解。实验表明该方法在资源受限和架构不变条件下具有优越性能与泛化能力。

Method: 提出SAFT（传感器感知属性微调）与DNA（多样负属性优化），利用少量传感器特定数据进行鲁棒学习，无需大量训练数据或修改VLM架构。
Result: 在多种VLM和传感器模态上，该方法持续提升性能并展现良好泛化性，尤其在资源受限和架构不变场景下。
Conclusion: 该方法为VLM在传感器多样化现实环境中的可扩展部署提供了实用进展，强调了架构不变性和数据效率。

papers.title: GDBR: Label Recovery Attack Against Partial Gradient Encryption in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: The increasing demand for data privacy, alongside the benefits of aggregating data from networked devices, has catalyzed the emergence of federated learning (FL). In FL, clients jointly train a global model by sharing gradients computed over private data. While this paradigm eliminates the need to exchange raw data, inference attacks can still be launched to extract sensitive information from gradients. To this end, partial gradient encryption has emerged as a promising design for balancing privacy and efficiency in practical FL systems, as encrypting only the classification-head gradients is believed to prevent known inference attacks while avoiding the high computational cost of encrypting the entire model. However, this design provides a false sense of privacy. By proposing GDBR, we show that sharing even a single unencrypted layer of gradients can lead to serious privacy leakage. GDBR is the first attack capable of high-fidelity label recovery with partial access to the gradients. It exploits a vulnerability in a commonly used neural building block, constructs a gradient bridge from the unencrypted layer to the final output layer, and approximates the logits information for accurate inference of private labels. These inferred labels not only reveal sensitive information about a client's private dataset but also serve as a prerequisite for many downstream attacks, such as data reconstruction and membership inference. GDBR brings these threats squarely into scope for FL systems employing partial encryption. In addition to theoretical analysis, extensive experiments demonstrate the severity of the problem across a wide variety of datasets and model architectures, including convolutional and transformer-based networks. Overall, our findings challenge the widespread assumption that encrypting only the output layer suffices for privacy protection.

TL;DR: 本文提出GDBR攻击，针对联邦学习中的部分梯度加密（仅加密分类头梯度）设计，证明即使只共享一个未加密层的梯度也能高保真恢复私有标签。GDBR利用神经网络中常用模块的漏洞，从未加密层构建梯度桥接近似logits，实现标签推理。实验在多种数据集和模型架构上验证了攻击的有效性，挑战了部分梯度加密足够保护隐私的普遍假设。

papers.title: Batch effects can impair federated learning in multi-center omics studies
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative analysis of biomedical data without exchanging sensitive patient-level information, but its performance in multi-center studies may be compromised by batch effects which can obscure biological signals. Here, we systematically assess the impact of uncorrected batch effects on FL outcomes using four multi-center omics datasets, including transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic data, and two representative algorithms: federated k-means clustering and federated random forest classification. Our results demonstrate that uncorrected batch effects undermine unsupervised FL and can substantially degrade supervised FL performance, indicating that privacy-aware batch-effect correction is essential for reliable FL. To enable privacy-preserving BEC in distributed bulk omics data, we introduce fedRBE ( https://featurecloud.ai/app/fedrbe ), a federated implementation of limma's removeBatchEffect() method enhanced by secure multi-party computation, suitable for datasets with missing values and non-identical feature sets across clients, including proteomics and metabolomics data.

TL;DR: 论文系统评估了批次效应对联邦学习在多中心组学研究中的影响，使用四个多中心组学数据集（转录组、蛋白质组、代谢组）和两种算法（联邦k-means聚类和联邦随机森林分类）。结果表明未校正的批次效应会损害无监督联邦学习并显著降低有监督联邦学习性能，因此需要隐私感知的批次效应校正。作者介绍了fedRBE，一种基于limma的removeBatchEffect()的联邦实现，结合安全多方计算，适用于缺失值和非一致特征集的数据集。
Motivation: 多中心组学研究中，批次效应可能掩盖生物信号，联邦学习虽能保护隐私，但未校正的批次效应会严重影响其性能。需要系统评估并开发隐私保护的批次效应校正方法。

papers.title: Cell as Point: One-Stage Framework for Efficient Cell Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Conventional multi-stage cell tracking approaches rely heavily on detection or segmentation in each frame as a prerequisite, requiring substantial resources for high-quality segmentation masks and increasing the overall prediction time. To address these limitations, we propose CAP, a novel end-to-end one-stage framework that reimagines cell tracking by treating Cell as Point. Unlike traditional methods, CAP eliminates the need for explicit detection or segmentation, instead jointly tracking cells for sequences in one stage by leveraging the inherent correlations among their trajectories. This simplification reduces both labeling requirements and pipeline complexity. However, directly processing the entire sequence in one stage poses challenges related to data imbalance in capturing cell division events and long sequence inference. To solve these challenges, CAP introduces two key innovations: (1) adaptive event-guided (AEG) sampling, which prioritizes cell division events to mitigate the occurrence imbalance of cell events, and (2) the rolling-as-window (RAW) inference strategy, which ensures continuous and stable tracking of newly emerging cells over extended sequences. By removing the dependency on segmentation-based preprocessing while addressing the challenges of imbalanced occurrence of cell events and long-sequence tracking, CAP demonstrates promising cell tracking performance and is 8 to 32 times more efficient than existing methods. The code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/YXSong000/CAP.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 CAP 的端到端单阶段细胞追踪框架，将细胞视为点，无需显式检测或分割，通过一次阶段联合追踪序列中的细胞。针对数据不平衡和长序列推理问题，引入自适应事件引导采样和滚动窗口推理策略，在保持性能的同时实现 8-32 倍效率提升。
Motivation: 传统多阶段细胞追踪方法依赖每帧的高质量分割掩码，资源消耗大且预测时间长。
Method: 提出 CAP 框架，采用“细胞作为点”的思路，直接利用轨迹相关性进行单阶段联合追踪；并引入自适应事件引导采样（AEG）缓解细胞分裂事件不平衡，以及滚动窗口推理（RAW）确保长序列中新生细胞的稳定追踪。
Result: 在多个细胞追踪基准上，CAP 取得有竞争力的性能，且推理速度比现有方法快 8 到 32 倍。
Conclusion: CAP 通过消除分割预处理并解决事件不平衡和长序列追踪挑战，为细胞追踪提供了一种高效、简化的单阶段方案。

papers.title: TiROD: Tiny Robotics Dataset and Benchmark for Continual Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Detecting objects with visual sensors is crucial for numerous mobile robotics applications, from autonomous navigation to inspection. However, robots often need to operate under significant domains shifts from those they were trained in, requiring them to adjust to these changes. Tiny mobile robots, subject to size, power, and computational constraints, face even greater challenges when running and adapting detection models on low-resolution and noisy images. Such adaptability, though, is crucial for real-world deployment, where robots must operate effectively in dynamic and unpredictable settings. In this work, we introduce a new vision benchmark to evaluate lightweight continual learning strategies tailored to the unique characteristics of tiny robotic platforms. Our contributions include: (i) Tiny Robotics Object Detection~(TiROD), a challenging video dataset collected using the onboard camera of a small mobile robot, designed to test object detectors across various domains and classes; (ii) a comprehensive benchmark of several continual learning strategies on different scenarios using NanoDet, a lightweight, real-time object detector for resource-constrained devices.. Our results highlight some key challenges in developing robust and efficient continual learning strategies for object detectors in tiny robotics.es; (ii) a benchmark of different continual learning strategies on this dataset using NanoDet, a lightweight object detector. Our results highlight key challenges in developing robust and efficient continual learning strategies for object detectors in tiny robotics.

papers.title: DrugAgent: Reliable Multi-Agent Integration of Conflicting Biomedical Evidence for Drug-Target Interaction Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Workflows in drug-target interaction (DTI) assessment require integrating heterogeneous data from predictive models, curated resources, and observations from experimental literature. This evidence can be incomplete or conflicting. DrugAgent is a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent system focused on DTI evidence integration that integrates outputs from machine learning, knowledge graph, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents. DrugAgent converts agent outputs into interpretable representations, then summarizes conflict across the evidence. We evaluated DrugAgent on kinase screening data of 900 pairs spanning 178 kinases and 42 inhibitors, and an androgen receptor antagonist screening benchmark. On the kinase dataset, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation indicated outputs were faithful to input evidence in 98.8% of cases. Biological plausibility of returned summarization was high (scores 3-4 out of 5) across ground-truth classes: 79% of Weak activity labels cases (81% for Moderate/77% Strong); Strong cases received higher scores than Weak/Moderate. Label stability showed 98% agreement across runs. Results on the antagonist benchmark were consistent with the kinase dataset. Retrieved literature provided the greatest benefit when direct drug-target evidence was available, highlighting the importance of evidence availability for RAG-based integration. DrugAgent provides heterogeneous evidence-grounded DTI assessment, complementing standalone DTI prediction. We provide strategies to model agreement, conflict, and uncertainty in biomedical evidence integration. Code: https://github.com/sciluna/DrugAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DrugAgent，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，用于整合药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）评估中的异质证据。系统整合机器学习、知识图谱和检索增强生成（RAG）智能体的输出，将其转化为可解释表示，并总结证据间的冲突。在激酶筛选数据和雄激素受体拮抗剂基准上评估，结果显示输出忠实于输入证据（98.8%），生物学合理性高，标签稳定性达98%。
Motivation: DTI评估需要整合来自预测模型、 curated resources和实验文献的异质数据，但这些证据可能不完整或相互冲突。现有方法缺乏可靠的证据整合机制。
Method: DrugAgent是一个LLM-based多智能体系统，包含机器学习、知识图谱和RAG智能体。系统将各智能体输出转换为可解释表示，然后通过LLM总结冲突，提供证据 grounded的DTI评估。
Result: 在激酶数据集上，LLM-as-a-Judge评估显示98.8%的输出忠实于输入证据；生物学合理性评分在3-4/5之间，弱活性标签79%、中等81%、强77%的案例获得高分；标签稳定性达98%。在雄激素受体拮抗剂基准上结果一致。
Conclusion: DrugAgent提供了异质证据grounded的DTI评估，补充了独立的DTI预测。检索文献在直接药物-靶点证据可用时受益最大，强调了RAG整合中证据可用性的重要性。系统提供了建模证据一致性、冲突和不确定性的策略。

papers.title: On Regularization via Early Stopping for Least Squares Regression
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental problem in machine learning is understanding the effect of early stopping on the parameters obtained and the generalization capabilities of the model. Even for linear models, the effect is not fully understood for arbitrary learning rates and data. In this paper, we analyze the dynamics of discrete full batch gradient descent for linear regression. With minimal distributional assumptions, we characterize the trajectory of the parameters and the expected excess risk. Using this characterization, we show that when training with any learning rate schedule and finite time horizon, the early stopped solution is equivalent to the minimum norm solution for a generalized ridge regression problem. We also prove that early stopping is beneficial for generic data with arbitrary spectrum and for a wide variety of learning rate schedules. We provide an estimate for the optimal stopping time and empirically demonstrate the accuracy of our estimate.

Method: 分析离散全批量梯度下降的动力学，在极小分布假设下刻画参数轨迹和期望超额风险，并与广义岭回归建立等价关系。
Result: 早停解等价于广义岭回归的最小范数解；早停在通用数据和多种学习率调度下有益；给出了最优停止时间的估计。

papers.title: Online Fair Allocation of Perishable Resources
papers.abstract_en: We consider a practically motivated variant of the canonical online fair allocation problem: a decision-maker has a budget of perishable resources to allocate over a fixed number of rounds. Each round sees a random number of arrivals, and the decision-maker must commit to an allocation for these individuals before moving on to the next round. The goal is to construct a sequence of allocations that is envy-free and efficient. Our work makes two important contributions toward this problem: we first derive strong lower bounds on the optimal envy-efficiency trade-off, demonstrating that a decision-maker is fundamentally limited in what she can hope to achieve relative to the no-perishing setting; we then design an algorithm achieving these lower bounds which takes as input (i) a prediction of the perishing order, and (ii) a desired bound on envy. Given the remaining budget in each period, the algorithm uses forecasts of future demand perishing to adaptively choose from one of two carefully constructed guardrail quantities. We demonstrate our algorithm's strong numerical performance, and state-of-the-art, perishing-agnostic algorithms' inefficacy, on simulations calibrated to a real-world dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究易腐资源的在线公平分配问题，决策者在固定轮次中分配预算有限的易腐资源，每轮随机到达人数，需在无嫉妒和效率间权衡。作者证明了最优嫉妒-效率权衡的强下界，并设计算法输入易腐顺序预测和期望嫉妒界限，利用未来需求预测自适应选择保护量。模拟显示算法性能优越，而不考虑易腐性的算法效果不佳。
Motivation: 实际中存在易腐资源（如食品、疫苗）的在线分配，但现有理论假设资源不腐，忽略了易腐性带来的约束。
Method: 提出算法，输入易腐顺序预测和期望嫉妒界限，在每个周期根据剩余预算和未来需求预测自适应地从两个保护量中选择分配。
Result: 推导了最优嫉妒-效率权衡的强下界，表明决策者能力根本受限；在真实数据集校准的模拟中，算法表现优异，现有忽略易腐性的算法无效。
Conclusion: 为易腐资源的在线公平分配提供了理论基础和实用算法，揭示了易腐性带来的根本限制。

papers.title: Hierarchical Bayesian Crowdsourcing with Item Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: In applied statistics and machine learning, the gold standards used for training are often biased and almost always noisy. Dawid and Skene's justifiably popular crowdsourcing model adjusts for rater sensitivity and specificity, but fails to capture distributional properties of rating data gathered for training, which in turn biases training. In this study, we introduce a general purpose measurement-error model with which we can infer consensus categories by adding item-level effects for difficulty, discriminativeness, and guessability. We further show how to constrain the bimodal posterior of these models to avoid adversarial raters. We validate our model's goodness of fit with posterior predictive checks, the Bayesian analogue of $χ^2$ tests, and assess its predictive accuracy using leave-one-out cross-validation. We illustrate our new model with two well-studied data sets, binary rating data for caries in dental X-rays and implication in natural language.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个带项目难度、区分度和猜测度的层次贝叶斯众包模型，用于从有偏噪声的评分数据中推断共识类别，并通过后验预测检验和留一交叉验证验证模型。
Motivation: 现有的Dawid-Skene众包模型调整了评分者敏感性和特异性，但未能捕捉训练评分数据的分布特性，导致训练偏差。
Method: 引入一个通用测量误差模型，在共识推断中加入项目难度、区分度和猜测度的项目级效应，并约束双峰后验以避免对抗性评分者。
Result: 通过后验预测检验（贝叶斯卡方检验）验证模型拟合度，并用留一交叉验证评估预测精度，在牙科X射线龋齿二元评分和自然语言蕴含两个数据集上展示模型。
Conclusion: 该模型能更好地处理评分数据的分布特性，减少训练偏差，并通过约束后验避免对抗性评分者问题。

papers.title: Fortifying Fully Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks for Image Super-Resolution Using Divergence Measures
papers.abstract_en: Super-Resolution (SR) is a time-hallowed image processing problem that aims to improve the quality of a Low-Resolution (LR) sample up to the standard of its High-Resolution (HR) counterpart. We aim to address this by introducing Super-Resolution Generator (SuRGe), a fully-convolutional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-based architecture for SR. We show that distinct convolutional features obtained at increasing depths of a GAN generator can be optimally combined by a set of learnable convex weights to improve the quality of generated SR samples. In the process, we employ the Jensen-Shannon and the Gromov-Wasserstein losses respectively between the SR-HR and LR-SR pairs of distributions to further aid the generator of SuRGe to better exploit the available information in an attempt to improve SR. Moreover, we train the discriminator of SuRGe with the Wasserstein loss with gradient penalty, to primarily prevent mode collapse. The proposed SuRGe, as an end-to-end GAN workflow tailor-made for super-resolution, offers improved performance while maintaining low inference time. The efficacy of SuRGe is substantiated by its superior performance compared to 28 state-of-the-art contenders on 10 benchmark datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SuRGe，一种基于全卷积 GAN 的图像超分辨率架构，通过可学习的凸权重融合不同深度的卷积特征，并引入 Jensen-Shannon 和 Gromov-Wasserstein 损失分别约束 SR-HR 和 LR-SR 分布对，同时使用 Wasserstein 损失与梯度惩罚训练判别器以防止模式崩溃。在 10 个基准数据集上与 28 种现有方法对比，SuRGe 取得了更优的性能并保持低推理时间。
Motivation: 图像超分辨率是一个经典问题，旨在提升低分辨率样本的质量至其高分辨率标准。现有方法在融合不同深度卷积特征以及利用分布信息方面存在改进空间。
Method: SuRGe 使用全卷积 GAN 架构，通过可学习的凸权重组合生成器不同深度的卷积特征；在生成器训练中引入 Jensen-Shannon 损失（SR-HR 对）和 Gromov-Wasserstein 损失（LR-SR 对）；判别器采用 Wasserstein 损失与梯度惩罚。
Result: 在 10 个基准数据集上，SuRGe 的性能优于 28 种现有超分辨率方法，同时保持了低推理时间。
Conclusion: SuRGe 作为专为超分辨率设计的端到端 GAN 工作流，在性能与效率之间取得了良好平衡，验证了联合使用多种分布损失的有效性。

papers.title: TERC: A Transfer Entropy Redundancy Criterion for State Variable Selection in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the most suitable variables to represent the state is a fundamental challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL). These variables must efficiently capture the information necessary for making optimal decisions. In order to address this problem, in this paper, we introduce the Transfer Entropy Redundancy Criterion (TERC), an information-theoretic criterion, which determines if there is entropy transferred from observable state variables to actions during training. We define an algorithm based on TERC that provably excludes variables from the observable state that do not affect the agent's policy during learning. This yields compact state representations that reduce inference time by up to 2.6 times. Our approach is policy-dependent, making it agnostic to the underlying learning algorithm. The efficiency gains we demonstrate arise at retraining and inference time on the reduced state. Our method improves both retraining and inference efficiency. We demonstrate its effectiveness across three distinct algorithm classes, namely tabular Q-learning, Actor-Critic, and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), evaluated in a range of environments. Furthermore, to highlight the differences between the proposed methodology and the current state-of-the-art feature selection approaches, we present a series of controlled experiments on synthetic data, before generalizing to real-world decision-making tasks. We also introduce a representation of the problem that compactly captures the transfer of information from observable state variables to actions as Bayesian networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于信息论的状态变量选择准则TERC，用于强化学习中去除不影响策略的可观测变量，从而压缩状态表示并提升推理效率。实验表明该方法在多个环境和算法（表格Q学习、Actor-Critic、PPO）上将推理时间最多降低2.6倍。
Motivation: 强化学习中状态表示的选择至关重要，现有方法往往包含冗余变量，增加计算开销且可能干扰决策。
Method: 定义转移熵冗余准则（TERC），利用转移熵度量可观测状态变量到动作之间的信息传递，并基于此设计算法在训练过程中排除与策略无关的变量。
Result: 压缩后的状态表示在多种环境和算法上使推理时间最多降低2.6倍，并在重新训练和推理时提升效率。
Conclusion: TERC是一种与具体学习算法无关的状态变量选择方法，能自动识别并去除冗余变量，适用于不同RL范式。

papers.title: Distribution-free Deviation Bounds and The Role of Domain Knowledge in Learning via Model Selection with Cross-validation Risk Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-validation is one of the most widely used tools for risk estimation and model selection in statistics and machine learning, yet its theoretical properties when embedded in a learning procedure remain insufficiently understood. This paper develops a general, distribution-free framework for learning via model selection with cross-validation risk estimation within classical statistical learning theory. We establish VC dimension-based deviation bounds for the entire learning pipeline, providing detailed proofs for both bounded and unbounded loss functions, the latter requiring a novel extension of existing results. A central focus of the analysis is how the structure of the collection of candidate models influences generalization. To this end, we introduce Learning Spaces as collections of candidate models equipped with a partial order whose inclusion structure reflects increasing model complexity. We show how Learning Spaces can be constructed from domain knowledge and analyze how such structural information increases generalization. The framework is illustrated through case studies and a simulation study in high-dimensional linear regression, comparing learning via model selection in two distinct Learning Spaces against ordinary least squares, LASSO, and ridge regression across scenarios of varying alignment between prior knowledge and the true target. The results demonstrate that, when the Learning Space is well-adapted to the target and an efficient search algorithm is employed, learning via model selection can outperform standard methods by orders of magnitude. Through theoretical insights and concrete examples, we provide guidance on selecting the family of candidate models based on domain knowledge to enhance the performance of model selection with cross-validation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在经典统计学习理论中建立了一个基于交叉验证风险估计的模型选择学习的通用无分布框架。作者证明了整个学习流程的基于VC维的偏差界，涵盖了有界和无界损失函数，后者需要现有结果的新扩展。通过引入“学习空间”（Learning Spaces）——配备偏序的候选模型集合，其包含结构反映模型复杂度递增——展示了如何从领域知识构建学习空间，并分析了这种结构信息如何提升泛化能力。在高维线性回归的案例研究和模拟研究中，与普通最小二乘、LASSO和岭回归相比，当学习空间与目标适配且使用高效搜索算法时，模型选择学习可以以数量级优势超越标准方法。
Motivation: 交叉验证是风险估计和模型选择广泛使用的工具，但其嵌入学习过程时的理论性质尚不充分理解。现有研究缺乏一个通用的、无分布的理论框架，以及如何利用候选模型集合的结构信息（如领域知识）提升泛化性能的指导。
Method: 提出一个无分布的理论框架，建立基于VC维的偏差界，并引入学习空间（Learning Spaces）概念——候选模型的偏序集合，体现复杂度递增。通过从领域知识构造学习空间，分析结构信息对泛化的影响，并通过案例和模拟研究（高维线性回归）验证。
Result: 在高维线性回归模拟中，当学习空间与目标适配且使用高效搜索算法时，模型选择学习在性能上可以超越标准方法（普通最小二乘、LASSO、岭回归）数个数量级。
Conclusion: 本文提供了利用领域知识选择候选模型族以提升交叉验证模型选择性能的指导。理论分析和实例表明，学习空间的适当构造能显著增强泛化能力。

summary_sections.result: 在高维线性回归模拟中，当学习空间与目标适配且使用高效搜索算法时，模型选择学习在性能上可以超越标准方法（普通最小二乘、LASSO、岭回归）数个数量级。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文提供了利用领域知识选择候选模型族以提升交叉验证模型选择性能的指导。理论分析和实例表明，学习空间的适当构造能显著增强泛化能力。

papers.title: A Bayesian Approach for the Network Reconstruction of Interdependent Critical Infrastructure Systems from Cascading Failures
papers.abstract_en: Analyzing the behavior of complex interdependent networks requires complete information about the network topology and the interdependent links across networks. For many applications such as critical infrastructure systems, understanding network interdependencies is crucial to anticipate cascading failures and plan for disruptions. However, data on the topology of individual networks are often publicly unavailable due to privacy and security concerns. Additionally, interdependent links are often only revealed in the aftermath of a disruption as a result of cascading failures. We propose a scalable nonparametric Bayesian approach to reconstruct the topology of interdependent infrastructure networks from observations of cascading failures. Metropolis-Hastings algorithm coupled with the infrastructure-dependent proposal are employed to increase the efficiency of sampling possible graphs. Results of reconstructing a synthetic system of interdependent infrastructure networks demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms existing methods in both accuracy and computational time. We further apply this approach to reconstruct the topology of one synthetic and two real-world systems of interdependent infrastructure networks, including gas-power-water networks in Shelby County, TN, USA, and an interdependent system of power-water networks in Italy, to demonstrate the general applicability of the approach.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可扩展的非参数贝叶斯方法，从级联故障的观测数据中重建相互依赖的关键基础设施网络的拓扑结构。该方法使用Metropolis-Hastings算法配合基础设施相关的提议分布来提高采样效率。在合成系统和真实系统（包括美国田纳西州谢尔比县的燃气-电力-水网络和意大利的电力-水网络）上的实验表明，该方法在准确性和计算时间上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 关键基础设施网络的拓扑结构和相互依赖链接数据常因隐私和安全原因无法获取，而相互依赖关系仅在中断后通过级联故障显现。需要一种方法从级联故障观测中重建网络结构，以预测故障和规划中断应对。

Result: 在合成相互依赖基础设施网络中，该方法在重建精度和计算时间上均优于现有方法。进一步应用于一个合成系统和两个真实系统（美国谢尔比县燃气-电力-水网络、意大利电力-水网络），展示了方法的通用性。
Conclusion: 该方法能够有效从级联故障观测中重建相互依赖基础设施网络的拓扑，且具有可扩展性和通用性，适用于多种现实场景。

papers.title: Restricted Bernoulli Matrix Factorization: Balancing the trade-off between prediction accuracy and coverage in classification based collaborative filtering
papers.abstract_en: Reliability measures associated with the prediction of the machine learning models are critical to strengthening user confidence in artificial intelligence. Therefore, those models that provide not only predictions, but also reliability, enjoy greater popularity. In the field of recommender systems, reliability is crucial, since users tend to prefer those recommendations that are sure to interest them, that is, high predictions with high reliabilities. In this paper, we propose Restricted Bernoulli Matrix Factorization (ResBeMF), a new algorithm aimed at enhancing the performance of classification-based collaborative filtering. This model is based on a collection of restricted matrix factorizations that jointly generate, for each user-item pair, a full probability distribution over the possible rating scores. To prove its effectiveness, the proposed model has been compared to other existing solutions in the literature in terms of prediction quality (Mean Absolute Error and accuracy scores), prediction quantity (coverage score) and recommendation quality (Mean Average Precision score). The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model provides a good balance in terms of the quality measures used compared to other recommendation models.

TL;DR: 本文提出Restricted Bernoulli Matrix Factorization (ResBeMF)，一种基于受限矩阵分解的分类协同过滤算法，为每个用户-项目对生成完整的评分概率分布，从而在预测准确性和覆盖率之间取得平衡。实验结果表明，ResBeMF在预测质量（MAE、准确率）、覆盖率和推荐质量（MAP）上优于现有解决方案。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统模型往往只提供预测评分，缺乏可靠性度量，而用户更倾向于高可靠性高预测的推荐。分类协同过滤中存在预测准确性与覆盖率之间的权衡问题。
Method: 提出ResBeMF算法，基于一组受限矩阵分解，每个分解生成用户-项目对的完整概率分布，从而同时输出预测评分和可靠性度量。
Result: 与现有方法相比，ResBeMF在预测质量（MAE、准确率）、覆盖率及推荐质量（MAP）上均取得更好的平衡。
Conclusion: ResBeMF能够有效平衡预测准确性与覆盖率，提高分类协同过滤的性能。

papers.title: Structure-Guided Self-Supervised Matching for One-Shot Medical Landmark Detection
papers.abstract_en: Medical landmark detection usually requires accurate expert annotations, which are laborious and difficult to scale across anatomical regions. In this work, we study an extreme annotation-efficient setting where only a single annotated template image is available. We propose SGB-Match, a structure-guided coarse-to-fine self-supervised matching framework for one-shot medical landmark detection. The framework first learns dense anatomical correspondence from unlabeled augmented image pairs, and then transfers the landmark definition from the annotated template to each target image through feature matching. Different from standard contrastive correspondence learning, where negative candidates are penalized by a structure-agnostic rule, we introduce a structure-guided bias into the contrastive objective. The bias is constructed from relative distance and edge-aware anatomical cues, and explicitly reweights the negative gradients: nearby structure-relevant candidates are weakly repelled, while distant or structure-irrelevant negatives are strongly suppressed. As a result, the learned feature space better preserves local anatomical structures around template landmarks and reduces confusing responses from repeated textures. We further adopt a global-to-local design, where a global encoder provides coarse landmark localization and a local encoder refines the prediction in a cropped region. Extensive experiments on four 2D radiological landmark datasets demonstrate that SGB-Match achieves strong one-shot performance across both public and newly collected datasets and consistently benefits from both structure-guided bias and two-stage refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SGB-Match，一种结构引导的粗到细自监督匹配框架，用于单样本医学地标检测。该方法从无标签增强图像对学习密集解剖对应，然后通过特征匹配将地标定义从单张标注模板图像迁移到目标图像。在对比学习中引入结构引导偏差，基于相对距离和边缘感知解剖线索重新加权负样本梯度，使特征空间更好地保留局部解剖结构。采用全局-局部两阶段设计，全局编码器提供粗定位，局部编码器在裁剪区域细化预测。在四个2D放射学地标数据集上，SGB-Match 实现了强单样本性能。
Motivation: 医学地标检测通常需要精确专家标注，难以跨解剖区域规模化。本文研究极端标注高效场景，即仅有一张标注模板图像可用，旨在解决单样本学习下地标检测的挑战。
Method: 提出 SGB-Match 框架，包含结构引导的自监督对比学习（基于相对距离和边缘感知解剖线索重新加权负样本梯度）和全局-局部两阶段匹配（全局编码器粗定位，局部编码器细化）。
Result: 在四个2D放射学地标数据集上，SGB-Match 取得强单样本性能，且结构引导偏差和两阶段细化均带来一致提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为结构引导的对比学习能更好地保留局部解剖结构，减少重复纹理的混淆响应，全局-局部设计进一步提升了单样本地标检测精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Accelerated Stochastic Variance-Reduced Algorithm for Entropic Wasserstein Barycenters
papers.abstract_en: Fixed-support Wasserstein barycenters average probability distributions while accounting for the geometry of the support. We study the entropically regularized Wasserstein barycenter problem with a fixed regularization parameter and propose an accelerated stochastic variance-reduced primal-dual algorithm. The proposed algorithm uses a semi-dual finite-sum structure in which each stochastic gradient requires only one softmax over the barycenter support. The resulting finite-sum components have dimension-free smoothness bounds, which lead to a complexity result showing that the method improves the support-size dependence of deterministic accelerated gradient by a square-root factor while preserving accelerated dependence on the target accuracy. Experiments on synthetic data, DOTmark images, shape aggregation, and digit-averaging instances are consistent with the theoretical dependence on support size and accuracy and show lower arithmetic costs than the tested first-order baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究固定支撑熵正则化Wasserstein重心问题，提出加速随机方差缩减原始对偶算法。该算法利用半对偶有限和结构，每次随机梯度仅需一次softmax，且有限和分量具有与维度无关的光滑界。理论分析表明，该方法在支持大小依赖上比确定性加速梯度提升平方根因子，同时保持对目标精度的加速依赖。合成数据、DOTmark图像、形状聚合和数字平均实验与理论一致，且算术成本低于一阶基线。
Motivation: 固定支撑Wasserstein重心计算复杂度高，现有方法在支持大小和精度上存在瓶颈。
Method: 提出加速随机方差缩减原始对偶算法，利用半对偶有限和结构，每个随机梯度仅需一次softmax，并利用分量光滑性的维度无关界加速。
Result: 复杂度分析表明，该算法将确定性加速梯度的支持大小依赖降低平方根因子，同时保持加速精度依赖。实验验证了理论结果并显示更低的算术成本。
Conclusion: 该算法在熵正则化Wasserstein重心问题上实现了更好的支持大小和精度权衡，但正则化参数固定，未讨论自适应选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Querying and Repairing Inconsistent Prioritized Knowledge Bases: Complexity Analysis and Links with Abstract Argumentation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we explore the issue of inconsistency handling over prioritized knowledge bases (KBs), which consist of an ontology, a set of facts, and a priority relation between conflicting facts. In the database setting, a closely related scenario has been studied and led to the definition of three different notions of optimal repairs (global, Pareto, and completion) of a prioritized inconsistent database. After transferring the notions of globally-, Pareto- and completion-optimal repairs to our setting, we study the data complexity of the core reasoning tasks: query entailment under inconsistency-tolerant semantics based upon optimal repairs, existence of a unique optimal repair, and enumeration of all optimal repairs. Our results provide a nearly complete picture of the data complexity of these tasks for ontologies formulated in common DL-Lite dialects. The second contribution of our work is to clarify the relationship between optimal repairs and different notions of extensions for (set-based) argumentation frameworks. Among our results, we show that Pareto-optimal repairs correspond precisely to stable extensions (and often also to preferred extensions), and we propose a novel semantics for prioritized KBs which is inspired by grounded extensions and enjoys favourable computational properties. Our study also yields some results of independent interest concerning preference-based argumentation frameworks.

TL;DR: 本文研究优先知识库（包含本体、事实集和事实间优先级关系）的不一致处理，将数据库中的全局、Pareto和完成最优修复概念迁移到知识库设置，并分析在这些修复下的查询蕴含、唯一最优修复存在性和所有最优修复枚举的数据复杂度。此外，揭示了最优修复与论证框架扩展之间的联系，并提出了一种基于基础扩展的新语义。
Motivation: 处理不一致知识库时需考虑优先级信息，但现有最优修复概念在知识库中的复杂性及其与论证框架的关系尚未明确。
Method: 从数据库迁移三种最优修复定义（全局、Pareto、完成）到知识库，对DL-Lite本体进行数据复杂度分析，并通过论证框架的扩展概念建立对应关系。
Result: 提供了DL-Lite方言下核心推理任务数据复杂度的近乎完全刻画；证明Pareto最优修复恰好对应于稳定扩展（通常也是首选扩展）；提出基于基础扩展的新语义，具有良好的计算性质。
Conclusion: 给出了优先知识库不一致处理中推理任务的复杂性结果，并建立了与论证框架的联系，为知识库修复提供了新语义。

papers.title: Less Tokens, Better Forecasts: Sparse Residual Routing for Efficient Weather Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Existing ViT-based weather forecasting models apply uniform computation across all spatial tokens, even though nearby atmospheric grid points often contain similar values and large regions evolve smoothly over time. This makes much of the intermediate per-token computation redundant. Standard token-efficiency methods, such as pruning or merging, reduce cost by removing or fusing tokens. However, weather forecasting is a spatiotemporal dense prediction problem in which a history of atmospheric states must be mapped to future values on the original latitude-longitude grid. Thus, every grid cell must retain a physically meaningful representation, especially under autoregressive rollout. We introduce Sparse-Reslim, a parameter-free plug-in routing module that makes sparse token processing compatible with this fixed-grid requirement. Sparse-Reslim routes only 25% of spatial tokens through the expensive middle transformer blocks and treats those blocks as residual updates: it computes the change produced for the routed tokens and scatters only this delta back to the full sequence. Unselected tokens keep their pre-routing representations exactly, so no grid cell is dropped or replaced by a mask token, and no fusion layer or additional parameters are introduced. Across ERA5 resolutions up to the operational 0.25\textdegree{} standard and two model families, a deterministic Transformer and a diffusion model, Sparse-Reslim improves forecast accuracy on every evaluated variable while substantially reducing cost: training is about 2.5x faster in the main settings and reaches 3.18x speedup at 0.25\textdegree{}, with over 2.2x lower peak memory. A controlled decomposition shows that the accuracy gain comes primarily from sparse routing itself, while random token selection provides an additional regularization benefit without selector overhead.
