TL;DR: 本文提出 Sparse-Reslim，一种无参数插件式路由模块，用于 ViT 天气预测模型。它只路由 25% 的空间令牌通过昂贵的中间 Transformer 块，并将这些块的输出作为残差更新散射回完整序列，从而在不丢失网格点信息的情况下大幅降低计算成本。在 ERA5 分辨率（包括 0.25° 标准）和两种模型族（确定性 Transformer 和扩散模型）上，该方法在减少训练时间（约 2.5 倍，高分辨率达 3.18 倍）和峰值内存（2.2 倍）的同时，提高了所有评估变量的预测精度。
Motivation: 现有 ViT 天气预测模型对所有空间令牌进行统一计算，但邻近网格点值相似且大区域随时间平滑演化，导致大量中间计算冗余。标准的令牌效率方法（如剪枝或合并）会移除或融合令牌，而天气预测是密集预测任务，每个网格单元必须保留物理意义，尤其是在自回归滚动预测中。
Method: 提出 Sparse-Reslim，一个无参数插件式路由模块。它仅将 25% 的空间令牌路由到昂贵的中间 Transformer 块，将这些块视为残差更新：计算路由令牌的变化，仅将该增量散射回完整序列。未选中的令牌保持路由前的表示，不引入融合层或额外参数。
Result: 在 ERA5 分辨率（最高 0.25°）和两个模型族（确定性 Transformer、扩散模型）上，Sparse-Reslim 在降低训练时间（约 2.5 倍，0.25° 时达 3.18 倍）和峰值内存（2.2 倍）的同时，提高了所有评估变量的预测精度。控制分解表明精度提升主要来自稀疏路由本身，随机令牌选择提供额外正则化收益。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，在固定网格的天气预测任务中，通过稀疏残差路由可以有效降低计算成本并提升精度，无需额外参数或融合层。

papers.title: JavaVulBench: A Java Vulnerability Benchmark with Realistic Splits, a Unified Multi-Backend Harness, and a Leakage-Aware Evaluation Mode
papers.abstract_en: We release \textsc{JavaVulBench}, a benchmark dataset and evaluation harness for Java vulnerability detection. The dataset contains $\sim$30{,}600 Java methods spanning 1{,}740 CVEs and 700+ projects, labelled at both method and line granularity, with per-CVE publication dates and five realistic split strategies: random, project-disjoint, temporal, deduplicated, and unseen CWE-family. The harness provides a single \texttt{LlmPrediction} schema across three backend families (encoder classifiers, local generative models served by Ollama, and API-served LLMs routed through OpenRouter) so that twelve reference detectors CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, UniXcoder, DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B, and eight API/open-weight LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Sonnet~4, DeepSeek-v3, DeepSeek-Coder-v2, Qwen-2.5-Coder-14B/7B, CodeLlama-13B) are evaluated under identical conditions from a single command. A pre-training contamination audit is shipped alongside every model so users can separate genuinely unseen test CVEs from potentially memorised ones. Data, code, and fine-tuned checkpoints are archived on Zenodo [31] and short demonstration video is available on YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nMTX\_hqkuoM) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nMTX_hqkuoM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JavaVulBench是一个用于Java漏洞检测的基准数据集和评估框架，包含约30,600个Java方法，覆盖1,740个CVE和700多个项目，提供方法级和行级标签，并带有五种现实分裂策略。该框架通过统一的LlmPrediction模式支持三种后端（编码器分类器、本地生成模型和API服务LLM），在相同条件下评估了12个参考检测器，并附带预训练污染审计以分离未见过的测试CVE。数据集、代码和微调检查点已存档于Zenodo。
Motivation: 现有Java漏洞检测基准可能缺乏现实分裂策略和污染审计，导致评估不公平或过于乐观。
Method: 构建了包含约30,600个方法的基准数据集，采用五种分裂策略（随机、项目分离、时间、去重、未见过CWE系列），并提供统一的LlmPrediction接口以支持三种后端模型。每个模型附带污染审计，使用户能区分真正未见的CVE。
Result: 评估了CodeBERT、GraphCodeBERT、UniXcoder、DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B及八个API/开源LLM（如GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4等），在相同条件下从单次命令执行。
Conclusion: 该基准和框架旨在为Java漏洞检测提供更现实、公平且可重复的评估环境，并帮助识别模型对训练数据的记忆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing a high resolution data-driven weather prediction model with surface descriptors
papers.abstract_en: We study the importance of surface characteristics when forecasting near-surface variables with a data-driven weather prediction model. To target the challenge of predicting small-scale weather conditions at high resolution, we introduce a range of surface descriptors in the training of a state-of-the-art data-driven model. The input data includes surface descriptors inherited from the numerical weather prediction model used to produce the training dataset and topographic neighbourhood indices. We found that errors of 2-metre temperature and 10-metre wind speed forecasts were reduced by 1.9% and 3.0% respectively compared to a baseline model over the model domain. Over certain surfaces, the improvements were significantly larger. For example, we found a 12% reduction of temperature mean absolute errors over urban areas when the urban fraction was included in the model input. Furthermore, we investigated how the model responded to removal of glaciers, resulting in an increase of temperature. This indicates that 1) the model produce a physically reasonable response and 2) input datasets can be updated without the need to retrain the model. The latter suggests a great benefit for operational systems as training is expensive compared to running these models. This study highlights the importance of including surface conditions in the prediction of near-surface variables.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究地表特征对数据驱动天气预报模型预测近地面变量的重要性。通过向现有模型输入数值天气预报模型的地表描述符和地形邻域指数，降低了2米温度和10米风速的预测误差，并在城市区域等特定地表上改善显著，同时表明模型对冰川移除等变化产生物理合理的响应，且可更新输入数据而无需重训模型。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动天气预报模型在预测高分辨率小尺度天气条件时，缺乏对地表特征的充分考虑，导致近地面变量预报精度不足。
Method: 在训练一个先进的数据驱动模型时，引入数值天气预报模型产生的地表描述符（如城市覆盖率）和地形邻域指数作为额外输入特征。
Result: 与基线模型相比，2米温度平均绝对误差降低1.9%，10米风速误差降低3.0%；城市区域引入城市覆盖率后温度误差降低12%。
Conclusion: 地表特征对近地面变量预报至关重要，模型能对地表变化（如冰川移除）产生物理合理响应，且输入数据集可更新而无需重训，有利于业务系统。

papers.title: Vision Token Manipulation Attacks on Cloud-Edge Inference of Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-edge Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) inference enables efficient deployment by splitting computation between edge devices and cloud servers. In this process, intermediate vision tokens are transmitted from the edge to the cloud over a communication link, thereby exposing a new attack surface. We study vision token manipulation attack (VTM-Attack) under a black-box man-in-the-middle setting, where an adversary intercepts and manipulates a subset of transmitted vision tokens under a budget constraint. We propose four naïve attack strategies and an optimization-based token selection method. Experiments on 6 state-of-the-art LVLMs (3B-72B) across 4 benchmarks show that manipulating only 10\% of vision tokens can reduce accuracy by up to 88.31\%. These results reveal a critical vulnerability in cloud-edge LVLM inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了云边大视觉语言模型推理中的视觉令牌操纵攻击（VTM-Attack），在黑盒中间人攻击场景下，攻击者拦截并篡改部分传输的视觉令牌。提出了四种朴素攻击策略和一种基于优化的令牌选择方法。实验表明，仅操纵10%的视觉令牌即可使准确率下降高达88.31%。
Motivation: 云边LVLM推理通过拆分边缘设备和云端服务器的计算实现高效部署，但中间视觉令牌的传输暴露了新的攻击面。现有研究缺乏针对这一中间表示的操纵攻击分析。
Method: 提出VTM-Attack，包括四种启发式攻击策略（随机、重要、替换等）和一种优化方法（基于梯度或替代模型选择关键令牌），在预算约束下选择并修改子集令牌。
Result: 在6个LVLM（3B-72B）和4个基准上，仅10%令牌被操纵即可导致最高88.31%的准确率下降。
Conclusion: 揭示了云边LVLM推理中存在严重的安全漏洞，亟需防御机制。

papers.title: SovereignNegotiation-Bench: Evaluating User-Owned Personal Agents In Delegated Bargaining Under Privacy, Consent, Evidence, And Institutional Pressure
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents will increasingly negotiate on behalf of users: splitting costs with other personal agents, appealing platform decisions, escalating support disputes, requesting refunds, changing subscriptions, and negotiating deadlines or reimbursements. Existing negotiation benchmarks emphasize agreement, surplus, or strategic competence, but a user-owned agent can reach an agreement while harming the user through privacy leakage, consent violation, unsupported advocacy, over-concession, failed escalation, or poor auditability. We introduce SovereignNegotiation-Bench, a trace-level multi-turn benchmark for delegated personal-agent negotiation under private utilities, disclosure constraints, evidence requirements, and institutional asymmetry. The benchmark separates agent-visible observable state from evaluator-only labels and evaluates agreement success jointly with user utility, privacy, consent, evidence grounding, concession discipline, escalation, and auditability. We report an artifact-backed validation over 240 scenarios, 4 model families, 14 baselines, 13,440 frozen-prompt live trajectories, 61,135 parsed action rows, and a blinded 3-annotator audit over 300 items. The strongest agreement-maximizing baseline achieves the highest agreement rate but low user utility and high privacy/consent risk; FullSovereign does not maximize agreement, but obtains the best sovereign negotiation score by preserving utility, minimizing leakage, grounding claims, and reducing unauthorized commitments. The results show that agreement success is insufficient for user-owned negotiation agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SovereignNegotiation-Bench，一个用于评估用户拥有的个人代理在委托谈判中表现的多轮基准，重点关注隐私、同意、证据、制度压力等维度。通过240个场景、14个基线等大规模实验，发现最强的协议最大化基线虽然达成率高，但用户效用低且隐私风险高；而 FullSovereign 代理未最大化协议却获得了最佳主权谈判分数。结果表明，仅凭协议成功不足以衡量用户拥有的谈判代理。
Motivation: 现有谈判基准仅关注协议达成和战略能力，忽略了用户拥有的代理可能通过隐私泄露、同意侵犯、过度让步等损害用户利益的问题。
Method: 提出 SovereignNegotiation-Bench，一个痕迹级多轮基准，将代理可见状态与评估者标签分离，联合评估协议成功与用户效用、隐私、同意、证据基础、让步纪律、升级和可审计性。
Result: 在240个场景、4个模型家族、14个基线、13,440条冻结提示实时轨迹、61,135条解析动作行及300项盲审3标注审计上验证；最强的协议最大化基线协议率最高但用户效用低且隐私风险高；FullSovereign 代理未最大化协议但获得了最佳主权谈判分数。
Conclusion: 实验表明，协议成功不足以衡量用户拥有的谈判代理的表现，必须考虑多方面的用户权益。

papers.title: SwarmResearch: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Open-Ended Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Long-running coding agents such as autoresearch can persistently discover optimizations for open-ended problems. However, they tend to converge onto a single high-level approach, then proceed with low-level edits while missing other superior approaches to the problem. We hypothesize two harness-level design choices contribute to this behavior: accumulating context in a single long-running agent and only exposing a single program state to edit. We introduce SwarmResearch, an orchestrator-subagent harness in which a Shepherd Agent uses global context to steer a population of Search Agents, each operating with local context in their respective git branch. On open-ended optimization tasks, SwarmResearch discovers better or comparable solutions to state-of-the-art LLM-guided evolution and multi-agent techniques on 13/15 tasks, driven by higher-level exploration. Compared with fixed scaling of serial and parallel agents, SwarmResearch's orchestrator-guided scaling discovers better-performing solutions by adapting parallelism at different search depths.

Conclusion: SwarmResearch 通过编排多个智体进行分布式探索，有效避免了单一方法收敛，提升了开放式发现的性能。

papers.title: Training Hybrid Block Diffusion Language Models with Partial Bidirectionality
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput long-context generation is one of the central challenges for large language models. Generation is typically memory-bandwidth-bound rather than compute-bound: each decoding step must stream the accumulated key/value (KV) cache from memory, so bandwidth demand grows with context length while only one token is emitted. Two parallel approaches have therefore emerged: reducing memory access with efficient attention variants and linear-time mixers such as Mamba, or increasing parallel computation by generating blocks of tokens at once. However, technical challenges arise when combining these two ideas. Earlier hybrid diffusion models such as DiffuMamba use bidirectional Mamba mixing, including a reverse-direction scan relative to causal generation. This reverse scan needs to scan the entire sequence, so its states are not prefix-only and cannot be precisely reused as a cache even when diffusion is performed block by block. We propose a BDLM Mamba--attention hybrid that addresses this challenge by restricting the reverse Mamba scan to the active denoising block, which enables exact caching across blocks. In an 87M-parameter DCLM sweep, BDLM Mamba-H achieves the best C4-en validation perplexity compared to BDLM attention and full-sequence baselines. At 350M parameters, it remains competitive with BDLM attention. For long-context inference, BDLM Mamba-H reaches 19.7x the throughput of full-sequence DiffuMamba-H at 65K tokens and 3.7x the throughput of BDLM attention at 262K, showing that Mamba hybrids are a potential long-context diffusion architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文生成中的内存带宽瓶颈，提出一种混合块扩散语言模型（BDLM Mamba-H），通过将反向Mamba扫描限制在单个去噪块内，实现精确的跨块缓存。在87M参数DCLM sweep中达到最佳C4-en验证困惑度，350M参数时与BDLM注意力持平。在65K token时吞吐量达到全序列DiffuMamba-H的19.7倍，262K时达到BDLM注意力的3.7倍。
Motivation: 长上下文生成受限于内存带宽，现有方法要么减少内存访问（如Mamba），要么并行生成块。但结合两者时，反向扫描无法缓存，导致效率低下。
Method: 提出BDLM Mamba-H，将反向Mamba扫描限制在单个去噪块内，实现精确缓存，并混合Mamba和注意力机制。
Result: 在87M参数DCLM sweep中，BDLM Mamba-H达到最佳C4-en验证困惑度；350M参数时与BDLM注意力持平。在65K token时吞吐量达到全序列DiffuMamba-H的19.7倍，262K时达到BDLM注意力的3.7倍。
Conclusion: 摘要表明Mamba混合架构是长上下文扩散模型的有潜力方向。

papers.title: Seduced by the Narrative: Assessing Rule Adherence in Semi-Open Textual Sandboxes
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous adjudicators in semi-open textual game environments, robust rule adherence becomes critical when user intent conflicts with system rules. However, these models are trained to be helpful and compliant, leaving them vulnerable to a class of attacks we term \textit{Rhetorical Injection}, where adversarial users exploit narrative framing techniques such as pseudo-logical reasoning and authoritative coercion to bypass adjudication logic. We present CoC-Seduce, a multi-agent adversarial benchmark built on Tabletop Role-Playing Game (TRPG) mechanics, an ideal instantiation of semi-open environments where rules are explicit for adjudication, yet interaction remains entirely in natural language. Three frontier models, i.e., GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.5 Flash, serve as adversarial generators producing 5,376 samples across 4 world settings and 16 skill categories. We then benchmark 20 target adjudicators against this corpus. Evaluation across 20 models reveals that neither model scale nor explicit reasoning mechanisms reliably confer adjudication robustness, with \textsc{Pseudo-Logic} emerging as the dominant attack vector and cross-cultural settings exposing systematic knowledge gaps across all evaluated families. Project page: https://github.com/answerrtx/CoC-Seduce
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Rhetorical Injection攻击，利用叙事框架（如伪逻辑推理和权威胁迫）引导LLM在半开放文本沙盒（如TRPG）中违反规则。构建CoC-Seduce基准测试，包含5376个样本，评估20个裁判模型，发现模型规模和推理机制无法保证裁决鲁棒性，伪逻辑是最有效的攻击向量。
Motivation: LLM作为半开放文本环境的裁判时，用户意图与系统规则冲突可能导致规则被绕过，现有模型缺乏对此类攻击的鲁棒性。
Method: 基于TRPG机制构建多智能体对抗基准CoC-Seduce，使用GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.5 Flash生成样本，涵盖4个世界设定和16个技能类别，测试20个裁判模型。
Result: 模型规模和显式推理机制无法可靠增强裁决鲁棒性，Pseudo-Logic是最主要攻击向量，跨文化设定暴露所有模型族的知识差距。
Conclusion: LLM在半开放环境中面临规则遵循挑战，Rhetorical Injection攻击利用叙事技巧绕过裁判逻辑，现有模型普遍存在漏洞。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Induction Heads Interpolate N-Grams
papers.abstract_en: Induction heads are attention circuits believed to underlie in-context learning in transformers, yet a precise characterization of the estimators they implement remains elusive. We study transformers trained on order-$k$ Markov chains and identify two complementary smoothing mechanisms. First, at finite attention-weight scale, the circuit implements a soft context-matching estimator: it aggregates contributions from exact and partial context matches, weighted exponentially by their overlap, and induces a data-dependent interpolation across context orders analogous to Jelinek-Mercer smoothing. Second, a beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token induces additive pseudo-counts, recovering Dirichlet-style smoothing. We construct a disentangled transformer implementing both mechanisms and show that trained transformers recover the predicted attention patterns. Across settings where pseudo-count smoothing is optimal or lower-order contexts provide structured evidence, trained transformers match or outperform classical count-based baselines. Our results bridge mechanistic interpretability of induction heads with classical statistical smoothing, revealing that transformers learn to regularize in-context estimation rather than simply count.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICML 2026. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=BSY7jhBxM1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer中的induction heads如何实现类似n-gram插值的平滑估计。作者在k阶马尔可夫链上训练transformer，发现两种平滑机制：软上下文匹配（类似Jelinek-Mercer平滑）和BOS token引入的Dirichlet平滑。实验表明训练后的transformer恢复预测的注意力模式，并在某些设置下匹配或超越经典计数基线。结果揭示了induction heads实际上是在进行正则化的上下文估计，而非简单计数。
Motivation: 尽管induction heads被认为支撑上下文学习，但对它们实现的具体估计器的精确刻画仍不清楚。
Method: 在k阶马尔可夫链上训练transformer，分析其注意力模式，识别出两种平滑机制：有限注意力权重下的软上下文匹配估计和BOS token的伪计数平滑。构建了解耦的transformer实现两种机制，并验证训练后的transformer恢复预测的注意力模式。
Result: 在多种设置下，训练后的transformer匹配或超越经典计数基线。
Conclusion: 结果桥接了induction heads的机制可解释性和经典统计平滑，揭示了transformer实际上学习的是对上下文估计进行正则化，而非简单计数。

papers.title: Conversational Human Audio-visual Talking Dialogue Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale dyadic interactive audio-visual dialogue (DIAD) datasets provide fundamental data resources for developing humanoid interactive virtual agents and digital humans. However, collecting such data is time-consuming, expensive, and ethically sensitive. To address this, we propose CHAT, a new dyadic interactive audio-visual dialogue generation (DIADG) framework that generates diverse, paired, and mutually responsive speech-face dialogue clips from a single textual prompt. CHAT unifies large language models and talking face models with interactive audio and facial behaviour refinement modules, enabling the generation of aligned dyadic dialogue clips with diverse contents and facial identities. Experiments show that CHAT outperforms existing related methods designed for similar tasks under both objective and subjective evaluations. Moreover, our synthesised CHAT-AVD-50k dataset serves as effective pre-training data for downstream interactive head generation, consistently improving PerFRDiff and ReactDiff on REACT 2024. CHAT offers a scalable alternative to the costly and ethically sensitive collection of real dyadic interaction data.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 as a main paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHAT 框架，用于从单一文本提示生成成对的、互相响应的双人交互式视听对话片段。该框架结合大语言模型、说话人脸模型以及交互式音频和面部行为精炼模块，能够生成内容多样、身份多样的对齐对话片段。实验表明，CHAT 在客观和主观评估上均优于现有方法，其合成的 CHAT-AVD-50k 数据集可作为下游交互式头部生成任务的有效预训练数据。
Motivation: 大规模双人交互式视听对话数据集的收集耗时、昂贵且涉及伦理问题，导致数据资源匮乏，限制了虚拟人交互系统的发展。
Method: 提出 CHAT 框架，将大语言模型与说话人脸模型统一，并引入交互式音频和面部行为精炼模块，以生成多样化的、成对的、互动的对话片段。
Result: CHAT 在客观和主观评估上优于现有方法；CHAT-AVD-50k 数据集作为预训练数据，持续提升 PerFRDiff 和 ReactDiff 在 REACT 2024 上的性能。
Conclusion: CHAT 为真实双人交互数据的收集提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，避免了高昂成本和伦理敏感问题。

papers.title: Track the Noise, Move the World:3D-Grounded Motion-Consistent Noise for Controllable Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern image-and-text-to-video diffusion models can synthesize highly realistic videos by iteratively denoising an initial Gaussian noise tensor conditioned on reference image and text inputs. However, existing approaches still lack precise and unified controllability over both object motion and camera motion within a single generation process. We present UniCaMo, a unified framework that enables simultaneous control of object trajectories and camera viewpoints by directly constructing the input noise of the diffusion model. Specifically, UniCaMo builds a shared 3D-grounded motion-consistent noise space across latent video frames. Sparse 3D point tracks are used to warp the Gaussian noise of the reference frame along desired object trajectories, while a virtual spherical noise representation provides globally consistent noise values for newly revealed scene regions under camera motion. By combining local track-guided noise warping with global sphere-based noise sampling, UniCaMo maintains geometric and temporal consistency under both object movement and viewpoint changes. Because UniCaMo modifies only the input noise, it requires no auxiliary adapters, control branches, or architectural changes to the underlying video diffusion model. With lightweight LoRA fine-tuning on large pretrained video diffusion models, including Wan 2.1 (14B), UniCaMo achieves state-of-the-art results in both video quality and motion controllability on standard controllable video generation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniCaMo 框架，通过构建 3D 运动一致噪声空间，实现对视频扩散模型中对象运动和相机运动的统一控制。该方法无需修改模型架构，仅通过噪声构造即可实现精确控制，并在标准可控视频生成基准上取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Motivation: 现有视频生成方法缺乏对对象运动和相机运动的统一精确控制，通常需要额外适配器或网络分支，增加复杂性且难以同时处理两类运动。
Method: UniCaMo 构建共享的 3D 运动一致噪声空间，使用稀疏 3D 点轨迹对参考帧高斯噪声进行翘曲以控制对象运动，并通过虚拟球面噪声表示提供相机运动下新场景区域的全局一致噪声。
Result: 在 Wan 2.1 (14B) 等大模型上微调后，UniCaMo 在视频质量和运动可控性上均达到 state-of-the-art 水平。
Conclusion: UniCaMo 证明了仅通过修改输入噪声即可实现高效可控视频生成，无需架构改动，为统一控制对象和相机运动提供了新思路。

papers.title: Biomechanics-aware Multi-view Markerless Motion Capture of Dexterous Hand Movements
papers.abstract_en: Markerless motion capture (MMC) techniques have been widely beneficial in biomechanical analysis of human movement; however, application to complex motions of the hand lags other musculoskeletal systems. The primary goal of this study was to evaluate the performance of a biomechanical reconstruction method that implements a gradient-based optimization approach with a biomechanical model in the loop for tracking dexterous, unconstrained hand movements using MMC. Using a custom, 8-camera setup, we acquired 121 video recordings from 6 participants performing 11 different tasks that spanned 6 hand postures, 5 object manipulation tasks, and involved motion of the proximal upper limb joints. Performance of the proposed MMC pipeline was directly compared to a more commonly adopted two-stage reconstruction method that first triangulates 2D keypoints from computer vision pose estimation algorithms to 3D and then enforces biomechanical constraints by solving a constrained inverse kinematics problem. Relative performance was assessed qualitatively by visual inspection and quantitatively using a computer vision metric. Our method generated solutions for all 121 video recordings; the two-stage method did not converge for 15% of the recordings. Across the remaining videos, our method produced more biomechanically plausible hand kinematics than the two-stage method and was more robust to occlusion effects during tasks that involved objects. The relative robustness of the end-to-end method suggests that it is more effective in utilizing the available 2D digital keypoint information. Automatic and biomechanically meaningful tracking of hand kinematics during dexterous movements has the potential to support clinical evaluation, rehabilitation monitoring, and studies of human motor control.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生物力学模型在环的梯度优化方法，用于无标记运动捕捉（MMC）中追踪灵巧、不受约束的手部运动。通过8相机系统采集6名参与者执行11种任务的121段视频，与先三角化2D关键点再施加生物力学约束的两阶段方法相比，本方法在所有视频上均收敛（两阶段方法有15%未收敛），且在手部运动学上更符合生物力学，对物体任务中的遮挡更鲁棒。
Motivation: 无标记运动捕捉技术已广泛用于人体运动生物力学分析，但在复杂手部运动中的应用滞后于其他肌肉骨骼系统。现有方法（如两阶段重构）在灵巧手部运动中收敛性差、易受遮挡影响。
Method: 提出一种端到端的生物力学重建方法，采用梯度优化并集成生物力学模型在循环中，直接利用2D数字关键点信息进行多视角优化。
Result: 在121段视频上，本方法全部收敛，而两阶段方法有15%未收敛；在其余视频中，本方法产生更符合生物力学的手部运动学，且对物体遮挡更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 该端到端方法的相对鲁棒性表明它能更有效利用可用2D关键点信息，有望支持临床评估、康复监测和人类运动控制研究。

papers.title: A Preliminary Study on Explaining Risk of Code Changes using LLM-Based Prediction Models
papers.abstract_en: Predictions by machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) models are often received skeptically unless they are paired with intelligible explanations. In the context of just-in-time defect prediction, highlighting small portions of a software change (diff) -- beyond rule-based lints -- where risk may be concentrated has not yet been extensively investigated. In this work, we leverage attention weights from an LLM-based Diff Risk Score (DRS) model to highlight parts of a diff that the model focuses on when predicting risk. We aggregate token-level attention into interpretable code units (lines, hunks, and files), and present the top-K units to developers as a lightweight form of guidance during code review. We evaluate our approach using expert-labeled changes that have caused real outages. Results show that the highlighted snippets cover expert-labeled outage-causing change lines 53.85% of the time when highlighting the top-2 hunks, while requiring developers to review 26.28% of the changed lines on average. Because attention is produced during standard model inference, the approach is scalable for large development workflows and can be surfaced in the code review UI with low additional latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用基于LLM的Diff风险评分（DRS）模型的注意力权重，在代码审查中高亮显示代码变更中风险集中的部分（如行、hunk、文件）。实验表明，在专家标记的故障变更上，高亮top-2 hunk覆盖53.85%的故障行，而开发者仅需审查26.28%的变更行。该方法可扩展至大型开发工作流，且额外延迟低。
Motivation: 机器学习预测常因缺乏可解释性而遭质疑，而在代码审查中，精确指出变更中风险集中的区域（超出规则式lint）尚未被充分探索。
Method: 从基于LLM的DRS模型中提取注意力权重，将token级注意力聚合成可解释的代码单元（行、hunk、文件），并向开发者展示top-K高风险单元作为轻量级指导。
Result: 在专家标记的生产故障变更上，高亮top-2 hunk时，53.85%的故障行被覆盖，开发者平均只需审查26.28%的变更行。
Conclusion: 注意力权重可在标准模型推理中获取，无需额外计算，适合集成到代码审查界面，为开发者提供低延迟的风险定位帮助。

papers.title: Safe Inference-Time Alignment via Lagrangian Reward Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Inference-time alignment steers a frozen language model during decoding using auxiliary reward signals, avoiding the cost of repeated weight updates. However, existing inference-time alignment methods typically optimize a single scalar score, so explicit safety constraints must either be ignored or encoded through manually tuned penalties. We propose Lagrangian Reward Augmentation (LARA), a general inference-time alignment framework under safety constraints. Starting from a KL-regularized constrained objective with a reward model and a cost model, LARA dualizes the constraint and reduces the optimization problem to a one-dimensional convex problem over a nonnegative dual variable. Estimated on a small calibration set, this dual variable defines an augmented reward that can be used as a drop-in scoring signal within existing inference-time alignment methods. For sequence-level sampling methods, such as Best-of-N reranking, the calibrated dual variable corresponds to the solution of the expected-cost constrained problem. For token-level reward-guided decoding methods, the same construction yields a principled dual-calibrated heuristic rather than an exact constrained-policy guarantee. We evaluate LARA on both sequence-level and token-level inference-time alignment methods, and find that LARA improves the helpfulness-harmlessness tradeoff, with Best-of-N achieving the best performance among inference-time methods, approaching finetuning-based direct alignment baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lagrangian Reward Augmentation (LARA) 框架，用于在推理时对齐语言模型，同时满足安全约束。通过将约束对偶化，将优化问题简化为单变量凸问题，得到增广奖励，可集成到现有推理时对齐方法中。在序列级和词元级方法上评估，LARA 改善了有用性与无害性的权衡。
Motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法通常优化单一标量分数，忽略或手动调整安全约束，缺乏原则性处理。
Method: 从 KL 正则化的约束目标出发，将约束对偶化，在小型校准集上估计对偶变量，得到增广奖励，可作为现有推理时对齐方法的即插即用评分信号。
Result: 在序列级（Best-of-N）和词元级方法上，LARA 改善了有用性-无害性权衡，Best-of-N 达到接近微调对齐基线的性能。
Conclusion: LARA 提供了一个通用、原则性的推理时安全约束对齐框架，但词元级方法仅提供对偶校准启发式而非精确保证。

papers.title: Automated Data Readiness for Scientific AI
papers.abstract_en: Leadership computing facilities steward large-scale scientific datasets that routinely require substantial transformation before serving as AI training data. However, no existing framework fully unifies automated transformation, readiness assessment, provenance tracking, and agent-native deployment. We present REDI, an open-source framework that addresses this gap through a unified five-stage pipeline (ingest, preprocess, transform, structure, and output) with per-stage instrumentation for reproducibility and deployment as an agent-callable skill; companion tool SetGo automates FAIR compliance and catalog publication. Evaluated across climate, proteomics, materials science, and nuclear fusion, REDI transforms all datasets from raw to AI-ready, with outputs validated against domain-expert references, and preliminary results show near-ideal parallel scaling to 100 nodes on Frontier for the climate case. Provenance-instrumented profiling reveals file I/O as the dominant pipeline cost, with format selection a first-order optimization lever. These results establish REDI as a cross-domain platform providing automated data readiness for scientific AI, transforming data preparation bottlenecks into reproducible, reusable community assets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了REDI框架，一个统一五阶段流水线（摄入、预处理、变换、结构化、输出），用于自动将大规模科学数据集转换为AI就绪格式，并带有可重现性工具和FAIR合规发布工具SetGo。在气候、蛋白质组学、材料科学和核聚变四个领域验证，所有数据集均成功转换，且在Frontier超级计算机上气候用例达到近理想并行扩展。
Motivation: 现有领导计算设施中的科学数据集在用于AI训练前需要大量人工转换，缺乏统一的自动化转换、就绪度评估、来源追踪和代理部署框架。
Method: REDI框架以五阶段流水线为核心，每阶段都配备可重现性工具，并可作为代理可调用的技能部署；配套工具SetGo实现FAIR合规和目录发布。
Result: 在气候、蛋白质组学、材料科学和核聚变四个领域验证，所有数据集均从原始形态转换为AI就绪，输出经领域专家参考验证；初步结果显示气候用例在Frontier上达到近理想并行扩展。来源追踪分析表明文件I/O是主要瓶颈，格式选择是首阶优化杠杆。
Conclusion: REDI作为跨领域平台，将数据准备瓶颈转化为可重现、可复用的社区资产，自动化了科学AI的数据就绪流程。

papers.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Gemma 4, a new generation of open-weight, natively multimodal language models in the Gemma model family. Designed to advance compute efficiency and reasoning, the Gemma 4 model suite features dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, ranging from 2.3B to 31B parameters. Alongside improved vision and audio encoders for all model sizes, we propose a unified, encoder-free architecture for our 12B model, which ingests raw audio and image patches. Furthermore, we integrate a thinking mode, enabling Gemma models to generate reasoning traces prior to responding. We improve inference speed, memory, and compute efficiency, as well as long-context abilities through critical design choices. Gemma 4 establishes a leap in performance across STEM, multimodal, and long-context benchmarks, and rivals larger, frontier open models in human-rated tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了Gemma 4, 新一代开源权重、原生多模态语言模型系列，涵盖稠密和混合专家架构，参数量从2.3B到31B。改进了视觉和音频编码器，对12B模型提出统一的无编码器架构，可直接处理原始音频和图像块。集成思考模式（thinking mode），在回答前生成推理轨迹。通过关键设计选择提升了推理速度、内存与计算效率以及长上下文能力。在STEM、多模态和长上下文基准上表现显著提升，在人工评测任务中媲美更大的前沿开源模型。
Motivation: 旨在推动计算效率和推理能力，同时保持开源权重，缩小与更大专有模型的差距。
Method: 提出混合专家和稠密架构，统一的无编码器多模态架构，以及思考模式（生成推理轨迹）。
Result: 在STEM、多模态和长上下文基准上取得性能飞跃，在人类评分任务中匹敌更大的前沿开源模型。
Conclusion: Gemma 4通过多种架构创新和训练策略，在开放权重模型中树立了新标杆。

papers.title: Pretreatment MRI reveals a latent, molecular-subtype-independent structural phenotype that organizes treatment trajectories and recurrence risk
papers.abstract_en: Pathologic complete response and tumor shrinkage measure whether breast cancer responds to neoadjuvant therapy, but not whether that response was structurally favorable, persistent, or hidden beneath volume loss. We built an outcome-blind longitudinal DCE-MRI manifold from I-SPY2 trajectories to test whether pretreatment imaging carries a structural response phenotype missed by conventional descriptors. The dominant axis of response geometry was not recoverable from the full clinical and genomic stack -- age, receptor subtype, MammaPrint, PAM50, treatment arm, and tumor burden -- but became strongly recoverable once baseline structural entropy was added. A constrained representation mapping recovered the same axes as unconstrained decomposition, establishing the structure as intrinsic rather than a post-hoc interpretation. The phenotype persisted through therapy, and as treatment proceeded the volumetric signal faded while entropy stayed separated -- a crossover from burden to structural persistence. Among complete responders, structurally disordered tumors could shrink more early yet remain structurally disordered, a volumetric deception invisible to endpoint labels. External analyses in UCSF, I-SPY1, and Duke established recurrence relevance under representation-dependent boundaries, and a representation-family commensurability assessment showed why feature-name matching is insufficient: the same label can fail, transport, or entangle with extraction geometry. Pretreatment MRI therefore exposes a structural response phenotype that endpoint-based language leaves invisible -- including, among complete responders, a pretreatment imaging signal of structurally distinct response states that awaits prospective validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用I-SPY2的纵向DCE-MRI数据，发现预处理MRI中存在一种与分子亚型无关的结构表型，该表型能独立预测治疗反应轨迹和复发风险，且无法从常规临床和基因组特征中恢复。
Motivation: 现有病理完全缓解和肿瘤缩小指标不能反映反应的结构性质量（是否持久、是否隐藏在体积损失之下），因此需要发现预处理成像中的结构反应表型。
Method: 构建了一个不考虑治疗结局的纵向DCE-MRI流形，分析结构熵等特征，并通过约束表示映射验证其内在性。
Result: 该结构表型在治疗后持续存在，且体积信号逐渐消失而熵信号保持分离；在完全缓解者中，结构紊乱的肿瘤可早期缩小但结构仍紊乱；在多个外部数据集中验证了复发相关性。
Conclusion: 预处理MRI暴露了一个基于端点的语言无法看见的结构反应表型，在完全缓解者中存在结构上不同的反应状态，有待前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Risk Aversion in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Training AIs to be risk-averse in resources could offer a failsafe in the event that AIs turn out misaligned. Misaligned but risk-averse AIs would tend to prefer low-risk, low-reward strategies like cooperation over high-risk, high-reward strategies like rebellion, limiting the downsides of any misalignment. But we can only feasibly train AIs to be risk-averse on low-stakes gambles, and we will only be safe if their risk aversion generalizes to astronomically-high-stakes gambles. Will it? To shed light on this question, we introduce RiskAverseOOD: a benchmark for measuring how well risk aversion generalizes out of distribution. We then offer some initial results. Using a variety of methods to make Qwen3-8B choose risk-aversely when the stakes are low, we find that we can induce substantial risk aversion when the stakes are astronomically high. Our models' learned risk aversion generalizes at least partially across 98 orders of magnitude. From a baseline 2% rate of choosing a safe `Cooperate' option, we see rates around 70% (SFT and tie training), 52% (DPO), and 39% (activation steering). In another experiment, our fine-tuned reward model reliably scores risk-averse reasoning above risk-neutral or excessively risk-averse alternatives (99.6% pairwise accuracy). We replicate these effects at different scales (Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-14B) and across model families (Gemma-3-12B-IT and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct). Overall, we find that risk aversion learned at low stakes can generalize OOD to astronomically high stakes, though not yet consistently enough to serve as a reliable failsafe. Achieving that level of consistency is an open problem.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Agents in the Wild workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型的风险规避行为能否从低赌注泛化到极高赌注。作者构建了RiskAverseOOD基准，使用SFT、DPO、激活干预等方法训练Qwen3-8B在低赌注时选择安全选项，发现模型在高赌注下也能表现出部分风险规避，合作率从基线2%提升至70%（SFT）等。但一致性仍不足，无法作为可靠的故障安全机制。
Motivation: 训练AI在资源上风险规避可作为失配时的安全措施，但实际只能在低赌注下训练，需要验证风险规避能否泛化到天文级别的高赌注。
Method: 提出RiskAverseOOD基准，采用SFT、DPO、tie training、激活干预等方法让Qwen3-8B在低赌注时倾向风险规避，然后测试其在极高赌注下的选择。
Result: 低赌注下合作率基线2%，高风险下SFT和tie training达70%，DPO达52%，激活干预达39%。奖励模型在识别风险规避推理上正确率99.6%。效果在Qwen3-1.7B/14B、Gemma-3-12B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上复现。
Conclusion: 低赌注学习的风险规避可部分泛化到极高赌注（跨98个数量级），但一致性不足，尚未达到可靠故障安全的标准。

papers.title: CodeJeNN: A simple C++ neural network generator for physics applications
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning has shown speedups for numerical methods in physics applications, but integrating Python-based libraries into high-performance C++ solvers creates performance bottlenecks. We present CodeJeNN, which bridges this gap by auto-generating self-contained C++ code from trained Keras models for inference. This eliminates external dependencies through minimal inlined functions, allowing seamless integration into existing frameworks. We describe the Keras-to-C++ workflow, supported architectures, and limitations. CodeJeNN is demonstrated through inference benchmarks against Keras in eager and JIT modes and a CFD test case modeling viscosity in a hydrogen-air mixing layer, showing speedups without sacrificing accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CodeJeNN 是一个自动生成 C++ 推理代码的工具，从训练好的 Keras 模型生成无外部依赖的自包含代码，用于高性能物理模拟。通过最小化内联函数消除依赖，支持多种架构，并在 CFD 粘性氢气-空气混合层测试中展示加速效果。
Motivation: Python 机器学习库与高性能 C++ 求解器集成存在性能瓶颈，亟需一种轻量级推理方案。
Method: 从 Keras 模型自动生成自包含的 C++ 代码，仅使用最小化内联函数，无需外部依赖。
Result: 在 CFD 粘性氢气-空气混合层测试中，CodeJeNN 的推理速度较 Keras 的 eager 和 JIT 模式均有提升，且不牺牲精度。
Conclusion: CodeJeNN 提供了一种有效的 C++ 推理代码生成方法，方便集成到现有框架，但受限于支持的架构。

papers.title: Optimality-Informed Neural Networks for Lunar Landing Trajectory Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops an Optimality-Informed Neural Network (OINN) approach for the energy-optimal, free-final-time powered descent of a lunar lander from any initial position, velocity, and mass within a bounded operating envelope to a fixed landing site with zero terminal velocity. Building on a recent framework that jointly embeds Pontryagin's minimum principle and the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for general nonlinear optimal control, the proposed OINN approach specializes that idea to a lunar landing problem with free time of flight and fixed terminal state. Every boundary and transversality condition is hard-encoded into the network architecture by construction, the closed-form Pontryagin-optimal thrust magnitude and direction law is substituted directly rather than learned, and the remaining state, costate, and an auxiliary value-function output are trained against a physics-residual loss formed entirely from the necessary conditions of optimality, with no precomputed optimal trajectories required. A preliminary theoretical analysis is explored, establishing a stochastic-optimization stationarity guarantee for the offline training procedure, an explicit bound translating the achieved training residual into bounds on touchdown position, touchdown velocity, and flight-time error, and a fixed, input-independent onboard computational and memory cost suitable for real-time deployment. Numerical simulations evaluate the trained policy, with no retraining, against an independently solved indirect-method boundary-value problem at six representative initial states spanning the operating envelope and against eighty additional Monte Carlo simulation runs, demonstrating close agreement with the indirect-method solution and consistently small dynamics and transversality residuals throughout the envelope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一种最优性信息神经网络（OINN）方法，用于月球着陆器的能量最优、自由最终时间动力下降问题。该方法将庞特里亚金最小值原理和哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程嵌入网络架构，硬编码边界条件和横截条件，直接使用闭式最优推力规律，训练仅基于最优性必要条件的物理残差，无需预计算轨迹。理论分析提供训练平稳性保证和误差界，数值模拟表明与间接法解吻合良好。
Motivation: 传统月球着陆轨迹优化依赖数值求解边界值问题，计算成本高且难以实时应用，现有神经网络方法可能无法保证最优性或需大量预计算数据。
Method: 提出OINN，将庞特里亚金最小值原理和哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程联合嵌入神经网络，硬编码边界和横截条件，直接代入闭式最优推力规律，训练状态、协态和辅助价值函数输出，损失由最优性必要条件残差构成。
Result: 在六个代表性初始状态和八十次蒙特卡洛模拟中，OINN策略与间接法解高度一致，动力学和横截残差小，且训练后无需重新训练即可实时部署。
Conclusion: 该方法为月球着陆实时最优控制提供无监督学习框架，具有理论保证和固定计算成本，适合在线应用。

papers.title: Echoes of Unrest: A Multimodal NLP Framework for Early Warning of Fake News and Violence-Driven Mob Activity
papers.abstract_en: Rapid growth in social media has transformed global communication by enabling fast information exchange, but it has also accelerated the spread of misinformation. Fake news, manipulated content, and provocative narratives are increasingly linked to social unrest, political instability, and mob violence. Incidents in South Asia and elsewhere demonstrate how false information disseminated via platforms such as Facebook and WhatsApp can trigger real-world harm, often spreading faster than fact-checking efforts can respond. To address this challenge, this chapter presents a multilingual, multimodal Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework for early detection of misinformation and violence-prone dynamics. A fused dataset of 138,256 Bangla and English samples was created by combining multiple benchmark datasets. The framework integrates XLM-RoBERTa for multilingual text representation, CLIP for visual embedding, and a multi-head attention mechanism for multimodal fusion, enhanced with auxiliary features such as sarcasm and geospatial metadata. Experiments on a stratified 30% subset achieved 98% test accuracy with strong precision and recall. The outcomes show the efficacy of multimodal approaches in early misinformation detection and highlight the added value of geospatial signals for anticipating real-world escalation.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication as a book chapter (Taylor & Francis, 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个多语言、多模态的自然语言处理框架，用于早期检测假新闻和可能引发暴力的社会活动。该框架融合了文本（XLM-RoBERTa）、视觉（CLIP）和元数据（讽刺、地理空间）特征，在孟加拉语和英语混合数据集上达到98%的测试准确率。
Motivation: 社交媒体上的假新闻和煽动性内容加速了社会动荡和暴力事件，现有事实核查方法响应速度慢，需要自动早期检测框架。
Method: 框架结合XLM-RoBERTa进行多语言文本表示、CLIP进行视觉嵌入，并通过多头注意力机制实现多模态融合，同时集成讽刺检测和地理空间元数据作为辅助特征。
Result: 在138256条孟加拉语和英语样本的合并数据集上，使用30%分层测试集达到98%的测试准确率，精确率和召回率表现良好。
Conclusion: 研究表明多模态方法在早期假新闻检测中有效，地理空间信号有助于预测现实世界的恶化情况。

papers.title: SMOCS: A Streaming Framework for Simplified Deployment, Monitoring, and Optimization of ML Systems in Production
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning has demonstrated significant potential for real-time monitoring, optimization, and control of scientific facilities. However, deploying and maintaining ML models in operational environments remains a substantial engineering challenge. Each facility presents unique data protocols, non-standard formats, and infrastructure constraints, forcing teams to rebuild integration pipelines for every new application. We present SMOCS (Streaming Monitoring Optimization and Control System), a Kafka-based containerized framework that addresses this challenge through three contributions: 1) a layered abstraction over Apache Kafka that separates infrastructure from application logic, 2) a three-thread agent architecture that temporally decouples data ingestion, model training, and real-time inference enabling continuous online learning from live data streams, and 3) a configuration-driven deployment model that enables domain experts to operate ML pipelines without software engineering expertise. SMOCS is facility platform-agnostic, fault-isolated by design, and horizontally scalable through Docker containerization. The framework is publicly available as open-source software on the Jefferson Lab Github.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMOCS是一个基于Kafka的容器化流式框架，旨在简化机器学习系统在生产环境中的部署、监控和优化。它通过三层贡献实现：分层抽象分离基础设施与应用逻辑、三线程代理架构解耦数据摄取/模型训练/实时推理以支持连续在线学习、配置驱动部署让领域专家无需软件工程知识即可操作ML管道。该框架是设施平台无关的，具有故障隔离和水平可扩展性，已在Jefferson Lab作为开源软件发布。
Motivation: 生产环境中部署和维护ML模型面临重大工程挑战，每个科学设施都有独特数据协议、非标准格式和基础设施约束，迫使团队为每个新应用重建集成管道。
Method: 提出SMOCS框架，包含三部分：1) 基于Apache Kafka的分层抽象，将基础设施与应用程序逻辑分离；2) 三线程代理架构，时间上解耦数据摄取、模型训练和实时推理，实现从实时数据流中持续在线学习；3) 配置驱动部署模型，使领域专家无需软件工程专业知识即可操作ML管道。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据或定量结果，仅描述框架架构特性：设施平台无关性、故障隔离设计、通过Docker容器化实现水平可扩展性。
Conclusion: SMOCS作为开源软件在Jefferson Lab GitHub上公开可用，旨在降低ML系统在生产环境中的部署和维护门槛。

papers.title: Signal from Space: Detecting Schools and Towers to Bridge the Digital Divide
papers.abstract_en: Reliable internet access is essential for modern education, yet millions of school-aged children especially in developing regions remain offline due to unconnected schools. The Giga Initiative aims to connect every school to the internet, but doing so at scale requires efficient methods to map schools and assess surrounding connectivity infrastructure without relying on sparse or noisy third-party datasets. In this work, we propose a scalable, vision-only framework that uses high-resolution satellite imagery and transfer learning to address both tasks simultaneously. By adapting pre-trained object detection models to new geographical regions with minimal labeled data, we detect schools and cell towers directly from space. We then analyze the spatial relationship between detected schools and nearby towers as a proxy for connectivity availability. This purely imagery-driven pipeline enables large-scale infrastructure mapping, reduces dependency on auxiliary data, and supports data-driven prioritization of connectivity investments in underserved areas. Our approach is demonstrated on real satellite imagery from Lesotho, showing strong performance across this region.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个纯视觉框架，利用高分辨率卫星图像和迁移学习同时检测学校和通信塔，以评估互联网接入状况。该方法在莱索托的真实卫星图像上展示了良好性能，旨在支持大规模基础设施映射和数字鸿沟的填补。
Motivation: 全球数百万学龄儿童因学校未连接互联网而无法获得现代教育，而现有第三方数据集稀疏或有噪声，需要高效的方法来绘制学校及周边连接基础设施地图。
Method: 采用预训练目标检测模型，通过迁移学习适应新地理区域，仅需少量标注数据即可从卫星图像中检测学校和通信塔，然后分析空间关系作为连接可用性的代理。
Result: 在莱索托的真实卫星图像上，该框架显示出强大的性能，能够同时检测学校和通信塔。
Conclusion: 该纯图像驱动的管道能够实现大规模基础设施映射，减少对辅助数据的依赖，并支持数据驱动的连接投资优先级排序。

summary_sections.result: 在莱索托的真实卫星图像上，该框架显示出强大的性能，能够同时检测学校和通信塔。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该纯图像驱动的管道能够实现大规模基础设施映射，减少对辅助数据的依赖，并支持数据驱动的连接投资优先级排序。

papers.title: Weighted Conformal Prediction for Lab-to-Track Thermal Transfer in EV Motorsport Powertrains
papers.abstract_en: Predicting thermal volatility in high-performance EV powertrains is difficult as internal temperatures are rarely observable outside the lab, and models calibrated on lab drive cycles fail when deployed against real-world loads. We study this lab-to-track transfer problem using conformal prediction, offering distribution-free uncertainty bounds. We implement Ensemble Batch Prediction Intervals (EnbPI; Xu & Xie, 2021), a leave-one-out bootstrap-ensemble conformal method for autocorrelated time series, and calibrate it on real CALCE lithium-ion cycler data (A123 SP20 cells, FUDS profile). We evaluate it under a genuine, measured covariate shift: a second real CALCE test condition (US06 Highway Driving Schedule at 45°C). The unweighted EnbPI bound, achieving its nominal 95% coverage in-distribution (measured: 95.00%), degrades to 70.13% empirical coverage under this real shift. We introduce a weighted EnbPI procedure combining EnbPI's ensemble residuals with density-ratio weighting (Tibshirani et al., 2019), estimating the density ratio via a probabilistic domain classifier. This recovers coverage to 72.42%, a modest, honestly-reported improvement, not a complete fix. We additionally apply the calibrated model to real 2023 Formula 1 telemetry (Monza and Silverstone, driver VER) as an unsupervised out-of-distribution diagnostic. Because no internal thermal channel exists in public trackside telemetry, we report only unsupervised flag rates (65.6% at Monza, 58.0% at Silverstone, well above the 5% in-distribution base rate) and note inconsistent associations between flags and braking/DRS zones. We conclude that conformal domain adaptation is a promising but only partially solved tool for this problem, detailing exactly where it falls short.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 tables, github like for the codes and dataset:https://github.com/nearpot/Weighted-Conformal-Thermal-Transfer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究高性能电动汽车动力总成中热波动从实验室到真实赛道环境迁移的预测问题，使用加权共形预测（weighted conformal prediction）方法。在实验室数据上标称95%覆盖率的EnbPI方法在真实赛道数据下降至70.13%，引入密度比加权后恢复至72.42%，改进有限。论文还利用F1遥测数据作为无监督离群诊断，但无内部热通道数据，仅报告异常标志率。
Motivation: 实验室标定的热模型在真实赛道负载下失效，且内部温度在实际运行中难以观测，需要一种无需分布假设的不确定性量化方法。
Method: 基于EnbPI（集成批量预测区间）方法，结合密度比加权（Tibshirani et al., 2019），通过概率域分类器估计密度比，对自相关时间序列进行加权共形预测。
Result: 在CALCE电池数据上，未加权EnbPI在分布内达到95.00%覆盖，在真实US06工况下降至70.13%；加权后恢复至72.42%。F1遥测中异常标志率高达65.6%（Monza）和58.0%（Silverstone），远高于分布内5%。
Conclusion: 共形领域自适应是解决实验室-赛道热传递问题的有前景工具，但仅部分有效，论文详细指出了其不足之处。

papers.title: Provable Pruning for Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting via Coresets
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality real-time novel-view synthesis, but practical scenes often contain millions of Gaussians, making compression essential for deployment on limited hardware. Existing reduction methods are effective but mostly heuristic: they provide no multiplicative approximation guarantee for the rendered objective, and thus rely heavily on costly post-pruning finetuning to recover quality. We ask a basic question: can a 3DGS scene be provably replaced by a much smaller weighted subset (coreset) while preserving the objective of interest? We first show that, in the unrestricted setting, no non-trivial multiplicative 3DGS coreset exists. We then show that multiplicative guarantees are not impossible, but resolution-dependent. For a prescribed rendering resolution, such as representative views or grids of views/rays, we provide the first weighted coreset construction theorem for 3DGS. The construction samples Gaussians by sensitivity: provable importance scores measuring each Gaussian's role in the full-scene objective. Finally, under explicit validity and log-transmittance stability assumptions, we turn this objective guarantee into a rendering guarantee. Empirically, our method is strongest where deployment needs it most: aggressive compression with no or minimal recovery compute. In prune-only and very short finetuning regimes, it achieves state-of-the-art performance, showing that principled importance estimation can be both theoretically meaningful and practically useful. Open-source code is available at https://github.com/waseem-m/3dgs_provable_coresets.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 15 figures, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/waseem-m/3dgs_provable_coresets
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了3D高斯喷溅（3DGS）场景的可证明压缩问题。作者首先证明在无约束设置下不存在非平凡乘法coreset，但在给定渲染分辨率下，通过基于敏感度（重要性分数）的加权采样，可以构造具有乘法保证的coreset。在显式有效性和对数透射率稳定性假设下，该理论保证可转化为渲染质量保证。实验表明，在无微调或极短微调的高压缩场景下，该方法达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有3DGS压缩方法大多为启发式，缺乏对渲染目标的乘法近似保证，且依赖昂贵的后微调恢复质量。本文旨在解决能否用更小的加权子集（coreset）可证明地替换原始场景的问题。
Method: 提出基于敏感度的加权coreset构造定理。首先证明无约束下无平凡乘法coreset，然后针对固定渲染分辨率（如代表性视图或射线网格），通过计算每个高斯对全局目标的重要性分数进行加权采样，并给出理论保证。
Result: 在无微调或极短微调的高压缩场景下，该方法达到当前最优性能，表明基于原理的重要性估计既有理论意义又有实际效用。
Conclusion: 本文为3DGS压缩提供了首个可证明的加权coreset构造，理论保证与实验结果一致，特别适用于需要激进压缩且计算资源有限的部署场景。

papers.title: GRCD: Grounded Region Change Detection for Multi-Finding Chest X-Ray Pairs
papers.abstract_en: Radiologists routinely compare current and prior chest X-rays to track disease progression, producing follow-up reports that describe multiple findings, each localised to an anatomical region and annotated with a temporal change status. Existing automated methods either generate reports from a single image without modelling temporal context, or incorporate temporal information but do not ground their outputs spatially. The few approaches that combine temporal reasoning with spatial grounding are restricted to single-finding descriptions, leaving multi-finding reports with mixed change directions unaddressed. We present GRCD, a framework for grounded report generation from chest X-ray pairs in the multi-finding setting. We first construct a rigorously cleaned dataset of temporal chest X-ray pairs by identifying and correcting two systematic labelling errors in the source annotations. We then introduce a Region-Guided Change Token module that encodes per-region temporal change across anatomical structures and injects this signal into a language model through a dual-pathway strategy combining prepended spatial tokens with gated cross-attention. On a multi-finding test set, GRCD outperforms existing baselines on text generation and clinical accuracy metrics, with gains in change detection. Ablation studies confirm that the dual-pathway design outperforms either integration strategy in isolation on text and clinical metrics, and that region-level change encoding is necessary for multi-finding generation. Code is available at https://github.com/UTSA-VIRLab/GRCD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRCD框架，用于从成对胸部X光片中生成多发现、带空间定位的随访报告。通过构建清洗后的时间配对数据集，并设计区域引导变化标记模块，结合预挂空间令牌与门控交叉注意力的双路径策略，将区域级变化信息注入语言模型。在多发现测试集上，GRCD在文本生成和临床准确率指标上优于现有基线，消融实验验证了双路径设计和区域级变化编码的必要性。
Motivation: 现有自动化方法要么忽略时间上下文，要么缺乏空间定位，少数结合时间推理与空间定位的方法仅限于单发现描述，无法处理多发现混合变化方向的报告生成。
Method: 首先通过识别和修正源标注中的两类系统错误构建清洗后的时间胸部X光片对数据集；然后引入区域引导变化标记模块，编码每个解剖结构的区域级时间变化，并通过预挂空间令牌与门控交叉注意力的双路径策略将信号注入语言模型。
Result: 在多发现测试集上，GRDC在文本生成和临床准确率指标上优于现有基线，在变化检测方面有增益；消融实验表明双路径设计优于任一单独集成策略，且区域级变化编码对多发现生成是必要的。
Conclusion: GRCD框架有效解决了多发现胸片对报告的时空定位生成问题，但摘要未明确讨论局限性或适用范围。

papers.title: Diagnosing Aerial-View Object Detectors with Foundational Image Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large-scale image generative models enable photorealistic scene synthesis with controllable attributes. Beyond data augmentation, their potential as diagnostic tools for trained vision systems remains unexplored in the aerial and remote sensing domains. We introduce a synthetic diagnostic framework for aerial-view vehicle detection that combines text-guided generation, attribute-controlled editing, and automated attribute verification to construct a controllable synthetic testbed. This enables fine-grained evaluation of pretrained detectors under diverse scene types and environmental conditions that are difficult to isolate in real datasets. Across three detection architectures and three real aerial datasets, synthetic scene-wise performance trends closely match real-world weaknesses. Guided by these diagnostics, targeted supplementation with small real datasets from the identified weak categories yields improvements of up to 13% AP50 while requiring substantially fewer additional samples than non-targeted augmentation. Our results show that controlled synthetic probing can predict real-domain performance gaps and guide efficient data collection. The proposed diagnostic framework is modular and can incorporate alternative generative or vision-language models as capabilities evolve. Our code and datasets are available here: https://humansensinglab.github.io/AVODDiag/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于基础图像生成模型的航拍视图目标检测器诊断框架。该框架结合文本引导生成、属性控制编辑和自动属性验证，构建可控合成测试平台，用于细粒度评估预训练检测器在不同场景和环境条件下的表现。在三种检测架构和三个真实航拍数据集上，合成场景的性能趋势与真实弱点高度吻合。基于诊断结果，对识别出的薄弱类别进行有针对性的小规模真实数据补充，可在AP50上提升高达13%，且所需额外样本远少于非针对性增强。
Motivation: 现有航拍视图目标检测器在真实场景中的弱点难以隔离分析，而大规模图像生成模型的诊断潜力尚未在航拍遥感领域得到充分探索。
Method: 提出一种合成诊断框架，包括：(1) 使用文本引导生成模型合成具有可控属性的航拍图像；(2) 通过属性控制编辑和自动属性验证构建测试集；(3) 在合成测试集上评估预训练检测器，识别薄弱场景；(4) 基于诊断结果进行有针对性的真实数据补充。
Result: 在三个检测架构和三个真实数据集上，合成场景的性能趋势与真实世界弱点高度匹配。有针对性的数据补充在AP50上提升高达13%，且所需额外样本远少于非针对性增强。
Conclusion: 受控的合成探测可以预测真实域性能差距并指导高效数据收集。该诊断框架是模块化的，可随生成模型或视觉语言模型能力的提升而扩展。

papers.title: LiNO: Lifting based multiresolution neural operator
papers.abstract_en: Recently, neural operators have shown promising outcomes for learning solution operators of differential equations directly from data. This framework learns a functional mapping from the parameter field to the solution field, enabling the prediction of an entire class of solutions rather than a specific instance. However, existing operators often struggle to capture both global dynamics and fine-scale structure simultaneously. To design an effective operator capable of representing multiscale features, a hierarchical multiscale decomposition framework is required. In this study, we develop the Lifting Neural Operator (LiNO), a multiresolution operator built on the second-generation wavelet lifting scheme. LiNO learns a multiresolution decomposition directly from data by parameterizing the lifting transform. This lifting transformation is adaptive to the underlying solution function and exactly invertible by construction, enabling information-preserving multiscale operator learning. In the lifted multiresolution space, the operator evolves coarse and directional detail coefficients separately, resulting in scale-aware modeling of the underlying physics. We evaluate LiNO on several benchmarks, including Darcy flow, the Poisson equation, the Allen-Cahn equation, the compressible Navier-Stokes equation, and the Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system. Together, these benchmarks cover a wide range of physical behaviors, including multiscale phenomena, transport-dominated dynamics, and chaotic systems. LiNO demonstrates strong performance on these challenging benchmarks compared with state-of-the-art neural operators. These results suggest that adaptive multiresolution operators provide a promising direction for scientific machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于第二代小波提升方案的提升神经算子（LiNO），通过可逆提升变换实现数据驱动的多分辨率分解，分别处理粗尺度和方向细节系数，从而进行尺度感知的算子学习。在Darcy流、泊松方程、Allen-Cahn方程、可压缩Navier-Stokes方程和Gray-Scott反应扩散系统等多个基准上，LiNO相比现有神经算子展现出强性能，覆盖多尺度现象、输运主导动力学和混沌系统。
Motivation: 现有神经算子难以同时捕捉全局动力学和精细结构，需要能够表示多尺度特征的分层多尺度分解框架。
Method: 构建多分辨率算子LiNO，利用第二代小波提升方案，将提升变换参数化使其自适应于解函数且精确可逆，从而在提升多分辨率空间中分别演化粗尺度和方向细节系数。
Result: 在Darcy流、泊松方程、Allen-Cahn方程、可压缩Navier-Stokes方程和Gray-Scott反应扩散系统等基准上，LiNO与最先进神经算子相比表现出强性能。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出基于第二代小波提升方案的提升神经算子（LiNO），通过可逆提升变换实现数据驱动的多分辨率分解，分别处理粗尺度和方向细节系数，从而进行尺度感知的算子学习。在Darcy流、泊松方程、Allen-Cahn方程、可压缩Navier-Stokes方程和Gray-Scott反应扩散系统等多个基准上，LiNO相比现有神经算子展现出强性能，覆盖多尺度现象、输运主导动力学和混沌系统。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有神经算子难以同时捕捉全局动力学和精细结构，需要能够表示多尺度特征的分层多尺度分解框架。
summary_sections.method: 构建多分辨率算子LiNO，利用第二代小波提升方案，将提升变换参数化使其自适应于解函数且精确可逆，从而在提升多分辨率空间中分别演化粗尺度和方向细节系数。
summary_sections.result: 在Darcy流、泊松方程、Allen-Cahn方程、可压缩Navier-Stokes方程和Gray-Scott反应扩散系统等基准上，LiNO与最先进神经算子相比表现出强性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自适应多分辨率算子为科学机器学习提供了有前景的方向。

papers.title: Not All Refusals Are Equal: How Safety Alignment Fails Cybersecurity at Scale
papers.abstract_en: There is no doubt that safety alignment is an essential step in LLM training. However, conceptually it does not distinguish between various domains and the level of potential harm of a query, which creates significant complications in the fields like cyber security, where a model should not be constrained by its safety circuits to accomplish the goals of legitimate, authorized operations. In this work, we share our findings from a large scale abliteration experiment on 24 open-source LLMs and show that domain-specific abliteration is achievable with standard methodology on the example of a 1T-parameter Kimi K2. Building on recent work showing that refusal in LLMs occupies a multi-dimensional subspace within layers, we find that it is also distributed widely across layers, especially in trillion-parameter MoE architectures, and so we aim to capture the part of it that represents harmful concepts in the cybersecurity domain exclusively. We also investigate the correlation between models' features and the effect of domain-specific abliteration, identifying that the type of safety training and architecture are the most reliable predictors. Finally, we classify the models into 3 \emph{abliteration susceptibility} tiers and put forward a set of conjectures as to why a particular effect from this intervention might be observed in a given model.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 11 figures. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究安全对齐（safety alignment）在网络安全领域的过度限制问题，提出领域特定消融（domain-specific abliteration）方法。在24个开源LLM上进行大规模实验，包括万亿参数Kimi K2，发现拒绝行为（refusal）在多层分布，尤其在万亿参数MoE架构中。将模型分为3个消融易感性层级，并探讨相关预测因素。
Motivation: 安全对齐未区分领域和潜在危害程度，导致网络安全等场景中合法授权操作被不必要的限制，影响模型在专业领域的实用效果。
Method: 采用标准消融（abliteration）方法论，针对网络安全领域的特定有害概念，在24个开源LLM上实施大规模实验，并分析模型特征与消融效果的关联。
Result: 发现拒绝行为在模型的多个层间广泛分布，尤其在万亿参数MoE架构中；安全训练类型和架构是消融效果最可靠的预测因子；模型可分为三类消融易感性等级。
Conclusion: 提出领域特定消融可有效移除网络安全领域的拒绝行为，但效果因模型而异；需谨慎对待安全对齐的领域通用性限制。

papers.title: Global Pose Control for Generative View Synthesis in Normalized Object Coordinate Space
papers.abstract_en: Novel View Synthesis (NVS) enables the generation of unseen views of a scene from a single or multiple images, allowing users to freely explore an object from any viewpoint. Despite the recent impressive qualitative improvements of generative models for this task, existing methods struggle to provide global and intuitive control of target viewpoints because they either use input-relative camera poses or are limited to generating sparse global views. This lack of global pose control severely limits the number of downstream tasks potentially enabled by NVS. To address this limitation, we propose a novel approach for precise camera control in a customizable Normalized Object Coordinate Space (NOCS), requiring single or few unposed images. Our method operates solely on the absolute camera pose of the target view in NOCS, eliminating the need for a relative world frame or camera poses of the input images. Unlike previous methods that treat NVS as a standalone generation task, we formulate it as an image editing problem and build upon state-of-the-art editing models to leverage their superior generalization capability. Camera information is injected as dedicated camera tokens via an in-context multi-modal conditioning strategy. To alleviate the inherent ambiguity of NOCS, we incorporate text descriptions that explicitly define the object's canonical coordinate frame, which also enhances generalization to unseen object categories. Furthermore, we curate a high-quality dataset with consistently aligned orientations and corresponding NOCS text definitions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method robustly generates novel views with accurate and consistent orientations from arbitrary unposed images across diverse categories, achieving state-of-the-art image quality and fidelity.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page https://lizb6626.github.io/GlobalNVS/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在归一化物体坐标空间（NOCS）中进行全局姿态控制的新视角合成方法，利用单张或无位姿图像，通过将新视角合成视为图像编辑问题，并借助多模态条件注入相机信息，实现了精确且一致的视角生成。实验表明，该方法在多种物体类别上达到最先进的图像质量和保真度。
Motivation: 现有生成式新视角合成方法缺乏全局直观的目标视角控制，要么使用输入相对相机姿态，要么只能生成稀疏全局视图，限制了其下游应用。
Method: 方法在可定制的NOCS中仅使用目标视图的绝对相机姿态，无需输入图像的相对世界坐标系或相机姿态；将NVS视为图像编辑问题，基于预训练编辑模型，通过上下文多模态条件注入相机 token，并利用文本描述消除NOCS歧义。还构建了具有一致对齐方向和NOCS文本定义的高质量数据集。
Result: 实验表明，该方法能从任意未摆拍图像鲁棒地生成具有准确一致方向的新视图，在多个类别上达到了最先进的图像质量和保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法提供了全局、直观的相机控制，且仅需单张或少量未摆拍图像，通过去除对输入相机姿态的依赖和引入文本描述增强了泛化能力。

papers.title: RayTun3R: Online Camera Adaptation in 3D Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D foundation models, such as DUSt3R, MASt3R, VGGT, $π^3$, and Depth Anything 3, provide strong feed-forward depth and pose estimates on pinhole imagery, but degrade sharply under fisheye camera geometry. We show that this failure is partly caused by a pinhole camera bias in the positional encodings of pretrained 3D foundation models, and propose RayTun3R, a lightweight camera adaptation approach. It keeps the pretrained network fixed and adapts only lightweight components tied to token position and camera geometry. RayTun3R learns parameter-efficient residual corrections to absolute and rotary positional encodings, together with parameter-free tokenization and corrections to prediction-grid coordinates that remove residual pinhole assumptions. The resulting adapter contains only 10,752 trainable parameters and can be learned from a short temporal segment using geometric losses. Once adapted, RayTun3R transfers effectively to the remaining frames of the sequence without incurring additional runtime costs. Across diverse fisheye datasets with fields of view from $110^\circ$ to $200^\circ$, our adapter reduces rotation error by $2$-$12\times$ relative to the unadapted model, outperforms LoRA while using $\sim\!14\times$ fewer trainable parameters, improves pose over adaptation-free baselines while avoiding their multi-view inference cost, and remains competitive on depth accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现有3D基础模型（如DUSt3R、MASt3R等）在鱼眼相机几何下性能严重退化，原因是预训练位置编码存在针孔相机偏置。提出RayTun3R轻量级适配方法，仅调整位置编码和网格坐标的残差，参数量仅10,752，可通过短时序片段学习并迁移到剩余帧，在多个鱼眼数据集上旋转误差降低2-12倍，优于LoRA且参数量少14倍。
Motivation: 现有3D基础模型在针孔图像上表现出色，但在鱼眼相机几何下性能急剧下降，原因是预训练位置编码存在针孔相机偏置。
Method: 提出RayTun3R，保持预训练网络固定，仅适配与token位置和相机几何相关的轻量组件：学习绝对和旋转位置编码的参高效残差修正，以及无参数的分词和预测网格坐标修正以消除针孔假设。适配器仅10,752可训练参数，通过短时序段的几何损失学习。
Result: 在视场角110°-200°的多个鱼眼数据集上，旋转误差降低2-12倍；相比LoRA，参数量少约14倍且表现更优；无需多视图推理成本，深度精度保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 本文方法有效解决了鱼眼相机下的3D基础模型适应问题，且参数量极小，可在线适应。

papers.title: When Does Resolution Help a Frozen Backbone? Global Attention at Resolution Predicts Scalable Adaptation for Camouflaged and Marine Animal Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Adapting frozen vision foundation models to fine-grained segmentation now largely depends on backbone selection. Whether the backbone applies global attention to a high-resolution token set predicts whether a low-rank adapter turns resolution into accuracy. Isotropic ViTs attend globally over the full grid and keep improving with resolution; hierarchical backbones confine early attention to local windows and pool the grid before their global stages, plateauing at lower resolutions. A controlled six-backbone study establishes the pattern, and editing the backbone points to the cause: pooling keeps the benefit, removing global attention does not. The effect is specific to low-rank adaptation. Under one fixed pipeline, SALT (Side-stem, Attention-gated U-Net, Low-rank Tuning), one RGB-only pass on a strong isotropic backbone wins the best S-measure on the four data-matched camouflaged sets, and leads every marine and salient set. It reaches a new state of the art on both marine-animal benchmarks (MAS3K mIoU 0.878).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在冻结视觉基础模型（frozen vision foundation models）上适配细粒度分割时，骨干网络（backbone）选择的影响。发现各向同性ViT（isotropic ViTs）因为对完整高分辨率token网格进行全局注意力（global attention），其性能随分辨率持续提升；而层次化骨干（hierarchical backbones）在早期局部窗口注意力并池化后，性能在较低分辨率达到平台。通过控制实验和骨干编辑，证实全局注意力是关键因素，且效果限于低秩适配（low-rank adaptation）。在统一流程SALT下，使用各向同性骨干在伪装和海洋动物分割数据集上达到新最优，其中MAS3K的mIoU为0.878。
Motivation: 现有研究在适配冻结视觉基础模型进行细粒度分割时，主要关注骨干网络选择，但缺乏对分辨率如何影响性能的系统理解，特别是全局注意力在其中所起的作用。
Method: 进行六种骨干网络的受控对比研究，并通过编辑骨干网络（如去除全局注意力或保留池化）来隔离因果因素。在统一适配流程SALT（Side-stem, Attention-gated U-Net, Low-rank Tuning）下评估。
Result: 各向同性ViT随分辨率提升持续改善分割精度；层次化骨干在较低分辨率即达到性能平台。编辑实验表明，保留池化不影响趋势，但移除全局注意力会消除分辨率带来的收益。在伪装和海洋动物分割基准上，使用各向同性骨干的SALT达到新最优，MAS3K的mIoU为0.878。
Conclusion: 摘要强调全局注意力机制是冻结骨干网络通过低秩适配实现分辨率获益的关键，而池化操作并非主要限制。该发现为选择骨干网络和设计适配策略提供了指导。

papers.title: VLRC: Vision-Language Reprojection Consistency as a scalable signal for better feed-forward 3D pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D models are commonly trained using either expensive geometric supervision or self-supervised photometric objectives, both of which provide incomplete learning signals. We introduce Vision-Language Reprojection Consistency (VLRC), a scalable auxiliary objective that exploits frozen vision-language representations as semantic multi-view supervision. Given a predicted 3D reconstruction, VLRC reprojects dense vision-language features across views and enforces feature consistency between corresponding image locations, requiring no additional 3D annotations. The objective integrates seamlessly with both self-supervised monocular reconstruction and supervised-pretrained feed-forward 3D models during unlabeled adaptation. By aligning geometry with language-grounded features, VLRC not only improves depth and camera estimation but also enables more coherent multi-view semantic fusion for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding. Experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in 3D reconstruction accuracy and zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vision-Language Reprojection Consistency (VLRC)，一种可扩展的辅助目标，利用冻结的视觉-语言表示作为语义多视图监督，用于前馈 3D 模型训练。VLRC 通过将预测的 3D 重建的视觉-语言特征重新投影到多个视图并强制特征一致性，无需额外 3D 标注。实验表明，该目标提升了深度估计、相机估计以及零样本开放词汇 3D 语义分割的性能。
Motivation: 前馈 3D 模型通常依赖昂贵的几何监督或不完整的光度自监督目标，缺乏语义层次的监督信号。本文旨在利用免费可得的视觉-语言表示来提供语义多视图一致性监督，以改进 3D 预训练。
Method: VLRC 在给定预测 3D 重建后，从预训练的视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）提取密集特征，并将这些特征重新投影到多个视图，然后通过对比或回归损失强制同一 3D 点在跨视图中的特征一致性。该目标可无缝集成到现有自监督或监督式 3D 模型的微调中。
Result: 在室内和室外基准上，VLRC 一致提升了 3D 重建精度（深度和相机估计），并实现了零样本开放词汇 3D 语义分割的改进。
Conclusion: VLRC 提供了一种简单、可扩展的辅助信号，通过将几何任务与语言引导的语义特征对齐，有效改善了前馈 3D 模型的泛化能力和语义理解。

summary_sections.motivation: 前馈 3D 模型通常依赖昂贵的几何监督或不完整的光度自监督目标，缺乏语义层次的监督信号。本文旨在利用免费可得的视觉-语言表示来提供语义多视图一致性监督，以改进 3D 预训练。
summary_sections.method: VLRC 在给定预测 3D 重建后，从预训练的视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）提取密集特征，并将这些特征重新投影到多个视图，然后通过对比或回归损失强制同一 3D 点在跨视图中的特征一致性。该目标可无缝集成到现有自监督或监督式 3D 模型的微调中。
summary_sections.result: 在室内和室外基准上，VLRC 一致提升了 3D 重建精度（深度和相机估计），并实现了零样本开放词汇 3D 语义分割的改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: VLRC 提供了一种简单、可扩展的辅助信号，通过将几何任务与语言引导的语义特征对齐，有效改善了前馈 3D 模型的泛化能力和语义理解。

papers.title: LLMoxie: Exploring Agentic AI for Scientific Software Development
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we describe LLMoxie, an institutional AI platform whose three-tiered architecture supports multi-cloud and on-premise inference, a LiteLLM/MLflow control plane for authentication, budgeting, PII masking, and observability, and an application augmentation layer for AI coding agents. Layered on top, an open-source RSE-Plugins ecosystem encodes accumulated RSE knowledge as a Plugin-Agent-Skill hierarchy spanning scientific Python practice, domain-specific knowledge, a six-phase research-and-implement workflow, and project lifecycle management. Scientific software is judged less by raw code quality than by whether it can be cited, audited, reproduced, and extended. Off-the-shelf AI coding agents, optimized against commercial software benchmarks, are poorly calibrated for this setting: they ignore the conventions of the scientific Python libraries they invoke, mishandle sensitive or embargoed data, and leave decision trails that are difficult to reconstruct after the fact. We report on twenty months of practice at a university-based research software engineering (RSE) center, where RSEs embedded across astronomy, earth and climate science, agriculture, and health projects worked to close this gap. We characterize the recurring infrastructure, governance, and process challenges of adopting Agentic AI inside a multi-domain RSE center, describe the platform and plugin design, and distill operational lessons from real scientific software deployments. Together, the platform and plugins shift AI coding agents from generic code generators into domain-aware collaborators that respect community norms and produce auditable provenance of technical reasoning.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to ACM SIGKDD 2026 Workshop: Agentic AI for Scientific and Societal Advances (SciSoc Agents and LLMs). Describes an agentic AI platform for scientific software engineering with governed multi-cloud inference, structured multiagent workflows, and domain-aware coding support (cs.SE, cs.MA, cs.AI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 LLMoxie，一个面向科学软件开发的代理型AI平台，采用三阶段架构：多云和本地推理、LiteLLM/MLflow控制平面以及应用增强层。平台集成了开源RSE-Plugins生态系统，将研究软件工程知识编码为插件-代理-技能层次结构。作者报告了在多个科学领域的二十个月实践，总结了基础设施、治理和流程挑战，并提供了操作经验。目的是将通用AI编码代理转变为领域感知的协作工具，生成可审计的技术推理溯源。
Motivation: 现有的AI编码代理针对商业软件基准进行优化，不适用于科学软件开发，因为它们忽略科学Python库的约定，处理敏感或保密数据不当，且决策轨迹难以事后重建。因此，需要特定的平台和插件来适应多领域研究软件工程中心的需求。
Method: 提出LLMoxie平台，包括三层架构：多云/本地推理层、LiteLLM/MLflow控制平面（认证、预算、PII遮蔽、可观测性）、应用增强层（AI编码代理）。此外，开发了开源RSE-Plugins生态系统，包含插件-代理-技能层次结构，涵盖科学Python实践、领域知识、六阶段研究和实现工作流以及项目生命周期管理。
Result: 报告了在大学研究软件工程中心二十个月实践中的经验，涉及天文学、地球和气候科学、农业、健康等领域。总结了基础设施、治理和流程方面的挑战，并提供了实际科学软件部署中的操作经验。
Conclusion: 该平台和插件将AI编码代理从通用代码生成器转变为领域感知的协作工具，尊重社区规范并产生可审计的技术推理溯源。但论文主要关注平台设计和经验教训，而非具体性能度量。

papers.title: Aircraft Detection in Satellite Imagery using Deep Learning Object Detectors
authors: Mujahir Hussain Abbasi (Department of Information Technology Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology
S. Beghin (Bose School of Computational and Physical Sciences Kristu Jayanti
A. T. R. Krishna Priya (AB Technologies Nagercoil
P. Jamuna (Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering Nandha Engineering College
G. Anandhakumari (Department of Physics Erode Sengunthar Engineering College
S. Jaanaa Rubavathy (Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering Saveetha School of Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The object detection in satellite imagery has garnered considerable attention due to its extensive real-world applications and the inherent challenges it presents, including noise, fluctuating image quality, and intricate backgrounds. This paper proposed a framework for object detection that combines image enhancement and Deep Learning (DL) to make detection more accurate. First, a Gabor filter is used to process the input image to bring out important features and reduce noise. Then, normalization is applied to make sure that the data is evenly distributed so that the model works properly. After that, a model based on YOLOv11 is used to quickly learn and find object features. The proposed method achieves a mAP of 95%, precision of 97%, recall of 85%, and F1-score of 91%, which demonstrates the superior aircraft detection performance. These results show the framework accurately identify aircraft in satellite imagery and is suitable for real-time applications such as surveillance, air traffic monitoring and remote sensing analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合Gabor滤波图像增强和YOLOv11的卫星图像飞机检测框架，在测试集上达到95% mAP、97%精确率、85%召回率和91% F1分数，适用于实时监控和遥感分析。
Motivation: 卫星图像中的目标检测面临噪声、图像质量波动和复杂背景等挑战，需要更精确的检测方法。
Method: 先使用Gabor滤波器提取特征并降噪，再进行归一化，最后基于YOLOv11模型快速学习并检测目标。
Result: 该方法在实验中取得95% mAP、97%精确率、85%召回率和91% F1分数，显示出优越的飞机检测性能。
Conclusion: 该框架能准确识别卫星图像中的飞机，适用于监控、空中交通监测和遥感分析等实时应用。

papers.title: Property-Constrained 3D Porous Media Reconstruction from 2D Images via Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) framework for generating 3D porous media volumes with controlled porosity, trained exclusively on 2D thin section images. The key innovation lies in combining property-conditioned generation with 2D-to-3D reconstruction, eliminating the need for expensive 3D training data while maintaining control over petrophysical properties. The framework employs a hybrid architecture with a 3D generator and 2D discriminator, where multi-axis slice extraction enables learning 3D-consistent structures from 2D training data. Porosity labels are extracted using an Enhanced U-Net segmentation model. The methodology was demonstrated on two carbonate samples with different lithologies: dolomite-anhydrite and pure dolomite. Results show that the framework successfully generates realistic 3D volumes capturing lithological features such as anhydrite inclusions and fine crystalline textures. Porosity control achieved an $R^2$ of 0.93, with mean absolute errors of 0.019 and 0.010 for the heterogeneous and homogeneous samples, respectively.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）框架，仅从2D薄片图像生成具有可控孔隙度的3D多孔介质体积。该框架结合了属性条件生成与2D到3D重建，避免了昂贵的3D训练数据需求。在两种碳酸盐岩样本上验证，孔隙度控制达到R²=0.93，均绝对误差分别为0.019和0.010。
Motivation: 传统3D多孔介质重建需要大量3D训练数据或难以控制孔隙性质，本文旨在仅利用2D图像生成3D体积并实现孔隙度可控。
Method: 采用混合架构：3D生成器和2D判别器，通过多轴切片提取从2D数据学习3D一致结构；孔隙度标签由增强U-Net分割模型提取；条件GAN根据目标孔隙度生成3D体积。
Result: 在两种碳酸盐岩样本（异质白云石-硬石膏和纯白云石）上，生成体积逼真且捕获岩相特征；孔隙度控制准确，R²=0.93，异质和均质样本的MAE分别为0.019和0.010。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效从2D图像生成可控孔隙度的3D多孔介质，适用于岩石物理性质预测。

papers.title: An Automated Multimodal Glaucoma Detection Framework Using ViT and a Stacking-Based Ensemble
papers.abstract_en: Glaucoma is a progressive eye disease that can lead to irreversible vision loss if not detected at an early stage. Conventional diagnostic procedures are often time-consuming and rely heavily on expert interpretation, limiting their scalability for large-scale screening. In this study, glaucoma detection is investigated under two evaluation settings: sample-wise, where individual samples are analyzed independently, and patient-wise, where data from each patient are aggregated for final prediction. An automated multimodal framework is proposed that integrates fundus images with clinical data. Under the sample-wise setting, detection is performed using fundus images and clinical features individually, as well as through their multimodal combination. Under the patient-wise setting, predictions are obtained by aggregating multiple fundus image representations with corresponding clinical information for each patient. Deep visual features are extracted using a Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture and classified using classical machine-learning models, with a stacking-based ensemble of the three best-performing classifiers employed to optimize performance. Experiments conducted on the publicly available PAPILA dataset demonstrate strong diagnostic performance, achieving 97.47% accuracy and a 97.50% F1-score for sample-wise multimodal classification, and 98.97% accuracy and F1-score for subject-wise detection. The proposed framework is further deployed as an end-to-end web-based platform to support automated glaucoma screening and clinical decision support.

papers.title: S-EMBER: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Streaming Egocentric Memory Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: As wearable devices enable continuous first-person recording, AI assistants must reason across long time horizons to recall past experiences-a capability known as episodic memory. Current benchmarks often rely on offline evaluation with access to entire video files, failing to simulate the streaming reality of wearable intelligence. We introduce S-EMBER (Streaming Egocentric Memory Benchmark for Episodic Retrieval), a large-scale benchmark comprising 3,141 videos totaling 388 hours of organic activity captured via Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses. S-EMBER formalizes grounded streaming episodic retrieval, a paradigm shift from global offline search to causal, active recall triggered by visual events in a continuous stream. We provide 9,448 QA pairs requiring manual visual proof through precise temporal localization and supporting flexible response lengths to simulate natural human-AI interaction. Our extensive benchmarking of frontier models uncovers a localization paradox: while semantic reasoning improves with parameter scale, temporal grounding precision remains a stagnant architectural bottleneck that does not benefit from brute-force increases in model size, resolution, or frame density. S-EMBER establishes a hardware-authentic foundation for developing grounded, reliable episodic memory in the next generation of wearable AI agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 S-EMBER，一个大规模流式自我中心记忆检索基准，包含 3141 个视频（总计 388 小时）和 9448 个问答对，模拟可穿戴设备上的连续第一人称视角记忆检索。基准测试发现，模型语义推理能力随参数规模提升，但时间定位精度存在架构瓶颈，无法通过扩大模型、分辨率或帧密度改善。
Motivation: 现有基准通常依赖离线评估，无法模拟可穿戴设备实时流式处理的场景，缺乏对因果、主动回忆能力的评测。
Method: 构建基于 Ray-Ban Meta 智能眼镜录制的 388 小时视频数据集，定义流式自传体记忆检索任务，并提供需要精确时间定位的 QA 对。
Result: 对前沿模型的基准测试揭示了定位悖论：语义推理随参数规模提升，但时间定位精度停滞，不受模型大小、分辨率或帧密度增加的显著影响。
Conclusion: S-EMBER 为开发可穿戴 AI 代理的可靠情景记忆提供了硬件真实的基础，强调时间定位是当前架构的瓶颈。

papers.title: RES-DARE: Failure-Aware Expert Adaptation and Rollback-Safe Self-Repair for Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Intrusion detection systems are often trained under static benchmark conditions, although deployed network environments are affected by traffic drift, sensor noise, changing workloads, and evolving attack behaviour. Under such distribution shifts, static detectors may produce confident but incorrect predictions, leading to silent and unsafe failure modes. In this paper, RES-DARE (Recursive Evolving Specialists-Digital Adaptive Reasoning Engine) is proposed as a failure-aware continual intrusion detection framework with rollback-safe self-repair. Difficult, uncertain, and misclassified samples are treated as failure signals for expert specialisation rather than being discarded as noise. A supervised contrastive encoder, two-pass expert router, failure-buffer mechanism, HDBSCAN-based failure-region discovery, and trust-risk monitor are integrated to support adaptive IDS behaviour. AEHM-v2 is introduced as a rollback-safe repair mechanism, where candidate adaptations are provisionally activated and committed only when macro-F1 is preserved or improved while trust risk remains stable. Otherwise, the system is rolled back to its last validated state. RES-DARE is evaluated on CICIDS2017, UNSW-NB15, and TON\_IoT, achieving macro-F1 scores of 0.9850, 0.9736, and 0.9691, respectively. Under Gaussian feature corruption at strength 0.10, RES-DARE retains an Attack-F1 of 0.7920 on CICIDS2017 and achieves near-zero catastrophic forgetting with F = 0.0015. The results show that RES-DARE improves robustness, warning capability, and deployment safety under degraded conditions.
