papers.title: MARS: Margin and Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Reward modeling is central to alignment pipelines such as RLHF, RLAIF, and PPO-based policy optimization, yet its reliability is constrained by limited and heterogeneous human preference data that are expensive to collect at scale. While synthetic augmentation can expand preference supervision, existing methods often augment uniformly or at the representation level, without targeting examples where the reward model is uncertain or prone to mis-ranking. In this paper, we introduce MARS (Margin and Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Reward Modeling), an adaptive augmentation framework that prioritizes low-margin preference pairs and uses semantic distance as a second layer for refinement to enhance the contrast between the chosen and rejected responses. Across multiple preference datasets, reward-model backbones, downstream alignment settings, and benchmarks including RewardBench and AlpacaEval, MARS improves both reward-model quality and alignment performance over existing baselines. Our results show that reward-model augmentation is most effective when guided by both model margins and semantic structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MARS（Margin and Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Reward Modeling），一种自适应数据增强框架，旨在提升奖励模型的可靠性。MARS 优先选择低边距的偏好对，并利用语义距离作为第二层细化，增强 chosen 和 rejected 响应之间的对比。在多个偏好数据集、奖励模型骨干、下游对齐设置以及 RewardBench 和 AlpacaEval 等基准上，MARS 均显著提升了奖励模型质量和下游对齐性能。
Motivation: 奖励建模是 RLHF 等对齐流程的核心，但受限于有限且异构的人类偏好数据，现有增强方法往往均匀或仅在表征层面进行，未针对奖励模型不确定或易误排的样本。
Method: MARS 框架通过模型边际（margin）和语义距离（semantic distance）两个指标自适应地选择低边距偏好对进行数据增强，以最大化 chosen 和 rejected 响应之间的对比度。
Result: 在 RewardBench、AlpacaEval 等基准上，MARS 在多项指标上优于现有基线，表明同时利用模型边际和语义结构进行增强最有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，奖励模型数据增强只有在同时考虑模型不确定性和语义结构时才能获得最佳效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LGQ: Learnable Geometric Quantization for Image Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Recent collapse-free quantizers such as FSQ achieve stable training by replacing the learnable codebook with an engineered geometry: a fixed scalar grid whose structure is dictated by the codebook size K. We show this trade-off is unnecessary. We introduce Learnable Geometric Quantization (LGQ), which retains a learnable codebook of codes and performs soft-to-hard assignment via temperature annealing, regularized by two cheap terms: A diversity term scaled by codebook size that penalizes concentrated batch-average usage is the primary driver of collapse resistance, complemented by a peakedness term that sharpens each token's soft-assignment toward one-hot; together they prevent codebook collapse without EMA, reset heuristics, or codebook reparameterization. Under a fixed VQ-GAN backbone, we benchmark LGQ against RotVQ, FSQ, SimVQ, and IBQ on ImageNet 256x256 at K=16,384 and sweep LGQ over K={4096,..,65,536} without any per-K hyperparameter tuning. LGQ attains the best reconstruction FID at K = 16,384 while maintaining 100% codebook utilization, and continues to improve as the codebook grows to K = 65,536 with utilization unchanged. Training MaskGIT on the frozen tokenizers, LGQ further attains the best class-conditional generation among the compared quantizers, leading on reconstruction and generation alike. Code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/LGQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可学习几何量化（LGQ）方法，通过温度退火和两项正则项（多样性项和尖锐度项）避免码本崩溃，无需EMA或重置启发式。在ImageNet 256x256图像上，LGQ在K=16,384时达到最佳重建FID并保持100%码本利用率，在K=65,536时仍保持利用率；在MaskGIT生成任务中也优于对比量化器。
Motivation: 现有无崩溃量化器（如FSQ）用固定标量网格替代可学习码本，但这种结构化设计限制了灵活性。LGQ旨在保留可学习码本的同时避免码本崩溃。
Method: LGQ保留可学习码本，通过温度退火实现软到硬分配，并引入两项正则项：多样性项（根据码本大小缩放，惩罚批平均使用集中度）和尖锐度项（使每个token的软分配更接近独热）。
Result: 在VQ-GAN骨干下，LGQ在ImageNet 256x256上K=16,384时重建FID最佳，码本利用率100%；随码本增至K=65,536性能持续提升且利用率不变。训练MaskGIT后，LGQ在类条件生成中表现最优。
Conclusion: LGQ证明可学习码本与无崩溃训练可以兼得，方法简单且无需超参数调优。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpreadsheetArena: Decomposing Preference in LLM Generation of Spreadsheet Workbooks
papers.abstract_en: We consider the task of end-to-end spreadsheet generation, where language models produce spreadsheet artifacts to satisfy users' explicit and implicit constraints, specified in natural language. We introduce SpreadsheetArena, a platform for evaluating models' performance on the task via blind pairwise preference votes of LLM-generated spreadsheet workbooks. As with other complex, open-ended tasks, relevant evaluation criteria can vary greatly across use cases, often in ways that are difficult to formalize. Compared to general dialogue or text generation settings, spreadsheet generation presents unique challenges and opportunities: the task output structure is well-defined and multi-dimensional, and there are often complex interactivity and layout considerations. We observe that stylistic, structural, and functional features of preferred spreadsheets vary meaningfully across prompts. Expert evaluations of spreadsheets for finance prompts suggest that even highly ranked models do not reliably produce spreadsheets aligned with domain-specific best practices. We host a live arena and release a dataset of prompts, generated spreadsheets, and preference votes, which we hope will facilitate further study of tasks operating over spreadsheets as a challenging and interesting class of complex, open-ended tasks for LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了SpreadsheetArena，一个通过盲审偏好投票评估语言模型生成电子表格工作簿的平台。摘要指出，不同提示下，偏好电子表格的风格、结构和功能特征存在显著差异，且即使是排名高的模型也未能可靠地生成符合金融领域最佳实践的电子表格。该平台和数据集旨在促进电子表格生成这一复杂开放式任务的研究。
Motivation: 电子表格生成是一个复杂的开放式任务，评估标准因使用场景而异，难以形式化，缺乏有效的评估平台和数据集。
Method: 引入SpreadsheetArena平台，通过盲审成对偏好投票评估模型生成的电子表格，并收集提示、生成的工作簿和偏好投票作为数据集。
Result: 不同提示下偏好特征差异显著；专家评估显示高级模型未可靠遵循金融领域最佳实践。
Conclusion: 电子表格生成是一项具有挑战性的开放式任务，SpreadsheetArena平台和数据集为后续研究提供了基础。

papers.title: Tracing 3D Anatomy in 2D Strokes: A Multi-Stage Projection Driven Approach to Cervical Spine Fracture Identification
papers.abstract_en: Cervical spine fractures require rapid and accurate diagnosis, yet automatic CT interpretation remains challenging as subtle injuries must be assessed across large 3D volumes. We ask whether full 3D vertebra segmentation is necessary for automated fracture recognition, or whether vertebra masks approximated from 2D projections can preserve sufficient diagnostic context. We propose an end-to-end pipeline that localizes the cervical spine, estimates C1-C7 vertebra masks from optimized 2D projections, and uses the resulting vertebra-level volumes for downstream fracture classification. A YOLOv8 detector first localizes spine regions of interest from multi-view variance projections, achieving a 3D mean Intersection over Union of 94.45%. Multi-label vertebra segmentation is then performed with a DenseNet121-Unet on energy-based sagittal and coronal projections, attaining a mean Dice score of 87.86%. The predicted 2D masks are back-projected and fused into approximate 3D masks for each vertebra to extract volumes of interest from the original CT. These volumes are analyzed by an ensemble of 2.5D spatio-sequential CNN-Transformer models, yielding vertebra-level and patient-level F1 scores of 68.15 and 82.26, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 91.62 and 90.95, and area under the precision-recall curve of 75.60 and 92.00, respectively. The projection-derived volumes achieved fracture-recognition performance comparable to a full 3D-segmentation baseline, while shifting the vertebra segmentation stage into a lower-dimensional domain. Saliency-based explainability and interobserver variability analysis further examine interpretability and reliability. Overall, the results indicate that projection-based mask approximation is a viable proxy for full 3D vertebra segmentation in cervical fracture recognition.
papers.comment: Includes supplementary material. Under review at Medical Image Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端流水线，通过2D投影近似3D椎骨分割，用于颈椎骨折识别。系统使用YOLOv8检测器定位脊柱区域，DenseNet121-Unet在能量化投影上进行多标签分割，再将预测的2D掩膜反投影融合为3D掩膜，提取CT感兴趣区域。下游2.5D CNN-Transformer集成模型进行椎骨级和患者级骨折分类，性能与全3D分割基线相当。
Motivation: 颈椎骨折需快速准确诊断，但自动CT解释因需在大体积3D数据中评估细微损伤而具有挑战性。现有方法依赖完整3D椎骨分割，计算开销大。
Method: 提出多阶段流水线：1) YOLOv8从多视角方差投影定位脊柱；2) DenseNet121-Unet在能量化矢状面和冠状面投影上预测2D椎骨掩膜；3) 反投影并融合为3D掩膜提取感兴趣体积；4) 2.5D时空序列CNN-Transformer集成模型对提取的体积进行骨折分类。
Result: 在颈椎骨折数据集上，椎骨级和患者级F1分数分别为68.15和82.26，AUC-ROC为91.62和90.95，AUC-PR为75.60和92.00。投影派生体积的骨折识别性能与全3D分割基线相当，方法节省了计算维度。
Conclusion: 基于投影的掩膜近似是全3D椎骨分割在颈椎骨折识别中的可行替代方案，同时通过可解释性分析和观察者间变异性验证了其可靠性。

papers.title: JADAI: Jointly Amortizing Adaptive Design and Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract_en: We consider problems of parameter estimation where design variables can be actively optimized to maximize information gain. To this end, we introduce JADAI, a framework that jointly amortizes Bayesian adaptive design and inference by training a policy, a history network, and an inference network end-to-end. The networks minimize a generic loss that aggregates incremental reductions in posterior error along experimental sequences. Inference networks are instantiated with diffusion-based posterior estimators that can approximate high-dimensional and multimodal posteriors at every experimental step. Across standard adaptive design benchmarks, JADAI achieves superior or competitive performance.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JADAI框架，通过端到端训练策略网络、历史网络和推理网络，联合摊销贝叶斯自适应设计与推断。该框架使用基于扩散的后验估计器，可处理高维和多模态后验分布，并在标准自适应设计基准上取得优越或竞争性性能。
Motivation: 参数估计问题中，设计变量可主动优化以最大化信息增益，但现有方法在灵活性和扩展性上存在局限。JADAI旨在通过摊销方法实现高效的序列自适应设计。
Method: JADAI训练一个策略网络（决定下一步设计）、一个历史网络（编码实验历史）和一个推理网络（估计后验），三者联合优化一个聚合序列实验步骤中后验误差增量减少的通用损失函数。推理网络采用基于扩散的后验估计器以处理复杂后验。
Result: 在标准自适应设计基准上，JADAI取得了优越或竞争性的性能，表明其能有效提升信息获取效率。

papers.title: Closing Gaps in Emissions Monitoring with Climate TRACE
papers.abstract_en: Global greenhouse gas emissions estimates are essential for monitoring and mitigation planning. Existing emissions datasets provide critical foundations for understanding emissions patterns across sectors, geographies, and time scales. Through a structured assessment of recent emissions datasets, we identified opportunities to further increase the actionability of emissions data through more comprehensive source-level coverage, finer spatial and temporal resolution, and more frequent updates. Building on existing resources to address these opportunities, we present the Climate TRACE framework and resulting dataset, which is available on an open-access platform (climatetrace.org). The Climate TRACE framework synthesizes existing emissions data, prioritizing accuracy, coverage, and resolution, and fills remaining gaps using sector-specific estimation approaches. The resulting dataset is the first to provide global emissions estimates for individual sources (e.g., individual power plants) for most anthropogenic emitting sectors. The dataset spans January 1, 2021, to the present, with a two-month reporting lag and monthly updates. This dataset and open-access platform provides access to detailed emissions estimates for most subnational governments worldwide. By combining source-level spatial detail, monthly updates, and broad sectoral coverage, the dataset is designed to support analyses relevant to emissions monitoring and mitigation planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Climate TRACE 框架及对应的开放数据集，旨在填补现有全球温室气体排放估算在源级覆盖、时空分辨率和更新频率方面的不足。该数据集是首个为大多数人为排放部门提供单个源（如具体电厂）全球排放估算的数据集，覆盖 2021 年至今，每月更新，滞后约两个月。
Motivation: 现有排放数据集在源级覆盖、更细时空分辨率和更频繁更新方面仍有提升空间，限制其可操作性。
Method: 综合现有排放数据，优先保证准确性、覆盖率和分辨率，并利用部门特定估算方法填补数据空白，构建统一的开放平台。
Result: 首个提供全球单个源级排放估算的数据集，覆盖大多数人为排放部门，自 2021 年 1 月起以月频更新。
Conclusion: 该数据集通过源级空间细节、月度更新和广泛部门覆盖，旨在支持排放监测与减缓规划。

papers.title: Recursive Entropic Variational Inference for Nonlinear State-Space Models
papers.abstract_en: We present a class of algorithms for state estimation in nonlinear, non-Gaussian state-space models. Our approach is based on a variational Lagrangian formulation that casts Bayesian inference as a sequence of entropic trust-region updates subject to dynamic consistency constraints. This framework gives rise to a family of forward-backward algorithms whose structure is determined by the chosen factorization of the variational posterior. By focusing on Gauss--Markov approximations, we derive recursive schemes with favorable computational complexity. For general nonlinear, non-Gaussian models, we close the recursions using generalized statistical linear regression and Fourier--Hermite moment matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非线性、非高斯状态空间模型，提出一类基于变分拉格朗日公式的递归状态估计算法。该算法将贝叶斯推理转化为一系列熵信任区域更新，并受动态一致性约束，通过Gauss-Markov近似得到计算复杂度可接受的递归方案。对于一般非线性非高斯模型，使用广义统计线性回归和Fourier-Hermite矩匹配来闭合递归。
Motivation: 非线性非高斯状态空间模型的状态估计在工程和科学中广泛存在，但现有方法（如粒子滤波、扩展卡尔曼滤波）在计算效率或精度上存在局限，需要一种既能处理非线性非高斯性又保持计算可行性的框架。
Method: 提出变分拉格朗日框架，将贝叶斯推理视为熵信任区域更新序列，受动态一致性约束。通过选择变分后验的不同因子化结构，导出一族前向-后向算法。采用Gauss-Markov近似获得递归方案，并使用广义统计线性回归和Fourier-Hermite矩匹配处理一般非线性非高斯模型。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但指出该框架导出的算法具有有利的计算复杂度，并适用于一般非线性非高斯模型。
Conclusion: 本文提供了非线性状态空间模型状态估计的一类通用变分算法框架，通过熵正则化和动态约束实现了可扩展的递归推理。未来工作可探索更复杂的后验因子化或应用领域。

papers.title: BrainNormalizer: Anatomy-Informed Pseudo-Healthy Brain Reconstruction from Tumor MRI via Edge-Guided ControlNet
papers.abstract_en: Brain tumors induce complex structural deformations that obscure the patient' s original neuroanatomy, making it difficult to distinguish tumor-induced changes from inherent anatomical variability. Reconstructing a subject-specific pseudo-healthy brain can provide a critical reference for such analysis, but this task is inherently counterfactual, as paired pre-tumor scans and explicit healthy guidance are unavailable. We propose BrainNormalizer, a diffusion-based framework for subject-specific pseudo-healthy brain MRI reconstruction that enables anatomy-informed reconstruction without requiring paired data or explicit healthy references. The framework learns anatomical priors and edge-based structural conditioning through a two-stage training strategy consisting of inpainting-based diffusion fine-tuning and ControlNet-based edge conditioning. At inference, counterfactual pseudo-healthy reconstruction is achieved through a deliberate misalignment strategy, where tumorous inputs are paired with non-tumorous prompts and mirrored contralateral edge maps. This allows subject-specific anatomical guidance to be constructed from the patient's own anatomy, enabling anatomically consistent pseudo-healthy reconstruction that preserves individual structural characteristics. Experiments on the BraTS2020 dataset demonstrate that BrainNormalizer achieves improved distributional realism, symmetry-based structural consistency, and reduced false positive detection compared to existing methods. These results indicate that the proposed framework provides a principled approach for subject-specific counterfactual reconstruction and supports downstream analysis of tumor-induced deformation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainNormalizer，一种基于扩散模型的无配对伪健康脑MRI重建框架。通过两阶段训练（inpainting扩散微调和ControlNet边缘条件）以及推理时的有意错位策略（肿瘤输入与非肿瘤提示及镜像对侧边缘图配对），实现个体特异性解剖引导的伪健康重建。在BraTS2020数据集上，该方法在与现有方法的对比中取得了更好的分布真实性、基于对称性的结构一致性以及更低的假阳性检测率。
Motivation: 脑肿瘤引起复杂结构变形，混淆患者原始神经解剖结构，难以区分肿瘤导致的变化与固有解剖变异。由于缺乏配对健康扫描和显式健康参考，伪健康重建是一个反事实任务，需要无监督方法。
Method: 两阶段训练：先进行基于inpainting的扩散模型微调，学习解剖先验；然后训练ControlNet学习边缘结构条件。推理时，将肿瘤输入与非肿瘤提示以及镜像对侧边缘图配对，通过有意错位实现反事实重建，从而利用患者自身解剖提供个体特异性引导。
Result: 在BraTS2020数据集上，BrainNormalizer实现了更优的分布真实性、基于对称性的结构一致性，并降低了假阳性检测率。
Conclusion: 该方法为个体特异性反事实重建提供了原则性框架，可支持肿瘤所致形变的后续分析。

papers.title: SpatialThinker: Reinforcing Scene Graph-Grounded Spatial Reasoning via Dense Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in vision-language tasks, but continue to struggle with spatial reasoning. Existing spatial MLLMs rely on large-scale datasets, explicit 3D inputs, architecture-specific modifications, or sparse Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods that provide insufficient guidance for spatially-grounded reasoning. We introduce SpatialThinker. To our knowledge, it is the first MLLM unifying Scene Graph Generation (SGG) and visual reasoning in a single pass via online RL. The model simulates human-like spatial perception by constructing a mental scene graph of task-relevant objects and relations, and reasoning toward an answer via dense spatial rewards. Our contributions are threefold: (1) SGG-grounded reasoning: integrating SGG directly within the reasoning chain rather than as a disjoint preprocessing step; (2) STVQA-7K: a high-quality spatial VQA training dataset via a scalable synthesis pipeline; and (3) a dense spatial reward design that enforces structured grounding during RL and generalizes to improve broad visual perception. SpatialThinker-7B achieves 3.6$\times$ larger gains over SFT and $1.7\times$ better in- and out-of-distribution generalization than sparse RL. Trained on only 7K samples, SpatialThinker-7B matches GPT-5 and outperforms GPT-4o, while SpatialThinker-30B surpasses both GPT-5 and Claude 4 Sonnet on average across 14 spatial and real-world benchmarks, demonstrating that structured spatial grounding with reward-aligned reasoning enables robust spatial understanding with limited data.
papers.comment: Preprint. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 Workshops on SPACE in Vision, Language, and Embodied AI (SpaVLE) as Oral, Embodied World Models for Decision Making (EWM), Aligning Reinforcement Learning Experimentalists and Theorists (ARLET), and Scaling Environments for Agents (SEA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpatialThinker，首个通过在线强化学习统一场景图生成 (SGG) 与视觉推理的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM)。模型模拟人类空间感知，构建心理场景图并用密集空间奖励进行推理。在仅使用 7K 样本训练下，SpatialThinker-7B 匹配 GPT-5 并超越 GPT-4o；30B 版本超越 GPT-5 和 Claude 4 Sonnet，在 14 个空间与真实世界基准上取得平均最佳。

Method: 集成 SGG 到推理链中而非预处理步骤；提出 STVQA-7K 高质量空间 VQA 数据集；设计密集空间奖励，强化结构化接地并在强化学习中泛化到视觉感知。

Conclusion: 结构化空间接地与奖励对齐推理能够以有限数据实现稳健的空间理解。

papers.title: SilvaScenes: Tree Detection and Species Classification from Under-Canopy Images in Natural Forests
papers.abstract_en: Interest in forestry automation is growing alongside rapid advances in deep learning. In particular, tree detection and taxonomic classification are seen as core tasks required for automating field surveys and forestry equipment. These operations must often be performed in under-canopy settings, which pose challenging conditions for perception systems, including heavy occlusion, variable lighting, and dense vegetation. Despite this necessity, current work has yet to properly establish the feasibility of simultaneously executing tree detection and taxonomic classification in natural forests, as available datasets primarily focus on urban settings or on a limited number of species. To address this gap, we present SilvaScenes, a benchmark dataset for instance segmentation of tree species from under-canopy images in natural forests. Collected across five bioclimatic domains in Quebec, Canada, our dataset features 1421 trees from 28 species, with segmentation masks for pixel-precise tree trunk detection and fine-grained species annotations from forestry experts. We demonstrate the relevance and difficult nature of SilvaScenes by evaluating modern deep learning approaches, showing that while trunk segmentation is feasible, with a top mean average precision (mAP) of 69.9% and mean average recall (mAR) of 76.4%, species-aware segmentation remains a significant challenge with an mAP and an mAR of only 39.2% and 68.6%, respectively. Alongside additional experiments, we highlight key challenges, namely that species imbalance and tree occlusion figure among the most pressing issues for precise segmentation and identification. Meanwhile, higher image resolutions contribute to significant performance gains and will likely prove fundamental to these tasks moving forward. Our dataset, source code, and models will be made available at https://github.com/norlab-ulaval/SilvaScenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SilvaScenes 数据集，用于自然森林林下图像的树木检测和物种分类。该数据集包含来自加拿大魁北克五个生物气候区的 28 个物种共 1421 棵树的实例分割掩码。评估显示树干分割可行（mAP 69.9%，mAR 76.4%），但物种感知分割仍具挑战（mAP 39.2%，mAR 68.6%），物种不平衡和遮挡是主要难点。
Motivation: 当前工作尚未明确自然森林中同时进行树木检测和物种分类的可行性，现有数据集多聚焦城市环境或少数物种。
Method: 构建 SilvaScenes 基准数据集，收集林下图像并提供像素级树干分割掩码和精细物种标注，评估多种现代深度学习方法的性能。
Result: 树干分割最佳 mAP 69.9%，mAR 76.4%；物种感知分割最佳 mAP 39.2%，mAR 68.6%。高分辨率图像可显著提升性能，物种不平衡和遮挡是主要挑战。
Conclusion: 林下树木物种分类仍具挑战，高分辨率图像可能成为未来关键因素；数据集和代码将开源。

papers.title: Panorama: Fast-Track Nearest Neighbors
papers.abstract_en: Approximate Nearest-Neighbor Search (ANNS) pipelines for high-dimensional neural embeddings spend the bulk of their query time in candidate verification, making it the primary bottleneck in the search process. In this paper, we present PANORAMA, a state-of-the-art refinement technique that accelerates verification by exploiting the inherent spectral decay of these embeddings. Using PCA to compact signal energy, PANORAMA evaluates candidate distances incrementally, computing at each step a strict lower bound on the full-vector distance and dynamically pruning candidates the moment this bound exceeds the running k-th nearest neighbor distance. While PCA's concentration of variance facilitates pruning, it breaks the uniform-variance assumption required by Product Quantization (PQ); we resolve this with a variance-shaping step that redistributes energy across subvectors, rendering accretive refinement compatible with quantized indexes. Optimized for modern memory hierarchies via vectorized bulk-pruning and cache-conscious data layouts, PANORAMA has been upstreamed into the FAISS library across major index families (IVFPQ/Flat, HNSW, and Refine). PANORAMA achieves higher QPS at any target recall with a cost that provably scales inversely with dataset spectral decay, delivering end-to-end speedups of up to 28.9x and outperforming probabilistic methods across all recall bands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PANORAMA，一种利用PCA和增量距离计算的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）加速技术。它通过光谱衰减特性动态剪枝候选点，并在FAISS库中集成，在高维嵌入搜索中实现高达28.9倍的端到端加速。
Motivation: ANNS流水线中候选验证（candidate verification）成为查询时间的主要瓶颈，现有方法在召回率和速度之间折衷有限。
Method: 使用PCA压缩信号能量，逐步计算严格下界并动态剪枝；通过方差整形步骤使增量计算与量化索引（如PQ）兼容，并采用向量化批量剪枝和缓存友好的数据布局。
Result: 在FAISS的多个索引家族（IVFPQ/Flat、HNSW、Refine）中实现更高QPS，端到端加速比最高达28.9倍，且成本与数据集光谱衰减成反比，在所有召回率区间优于概率方法。
Conclusion: PANORAMA是一种即插即用的快速最近邻搜索细化技术，已上游到FAISS库，适用于高维神经嵌入。

papers.title: VLOD-TTA: Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Object Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language object detectors (VLODs) such as YOLO-World and Grounding DINO exhibit strong zero-shot generalization, but their performance degrades under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical way to adapt models during inference using only unlabeled target (test) data. However, while TTA has made substantial progress in vision-language classification, its application to VLODs remains largely unexplored. The only prior method relies on a mean-teacher framework that introduces significant latency and memory overhead. To this end, we introduce VLOD-TTA, a TTA method that leverages dense proposal overlap and image-conditioned prompts to adapt VLODs with low additional overhead. VLOD-TTA combines (i) an IoU-weighted entropy objective that emphasizes spatially coherent proposal clusters and mitigates confirmation bias from isolated boxes, and (ii) image-conditioned prompt selection that ranks prompts by image-level compatibility and aggregates the most informative prompt scores for detection. Our experiments across diverse distribution shifts, including artistic domains, adverse driving conditions, low-light imagery, and common corruptions, indicate that VLOD-TTA consistently outperforms standard TTA baselines and the prior state-of-the-art method using YOLO-World and Grounding DINO. Our code: https://github.com/imatif17/VLOD-TTA
papers.journal_ref: European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VLOD-TTA，一种针对视觉语言目标检测器（如YOLO-World、Grounding DINO）的测试时自适应方法。该方法通过IoU加权熵目标与图像条件提示选择，在分布偏移场景下提升检测性能，同时降低延迟和内存开销。实验在艺术域、恶劣驾驶条件、低光照和常见损坏等偏移下验证，优于现有TTA基线。
Motivation: 现有VLOD在分布偏移下性能下降，而TTA在视觉语言分类中已取得进展，但应用于检测器仍未被充分探索。现有方法基于均值教师框架，带来显著延迟和内存开销。
Method: 提出VLOD-TTA，结合（i）IoU加权熵目标，强调空间一致的候选框簇并减轻孤立框的确认偏差；（ii）图像条件提示选择，通过图像级兼容性排序并聚合最信息量的提示分数。
Result: 在艺术域、恶劣驾驶条件、低光照和常见损坏等多种分布偏移下，VLOD-TTA在YOLO-World和Grounding DINO上一致优于标准TTA基线和先前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，利用密集候选框重叠和图像条件提示可有效适应VLOD，且额外开销低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Margin RLHF via Preference over Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Margin-based optimization is fundamental to improving generalization and robustness in classification tasks. In the context of reward model learning from preferences within Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), existing methods typically rely on no margins, fixed margins, or margins that are simplistic functions of preference ratings. However, such formulations often fail to account for the varying strengths of different preferences or they rely on noisy margin information derived from preference ratings. Furthermore, many existing methods that use adaptive margins assume access to accurate preference scores, which can be difficult for humans to provide reliably. We propose leveraging preferences over preferences, that is, annotations indicating which of two preferences reflects a stronger distinction, to infer adaptive margins on a per-datapoint basis. Such preference-over-preference annotations are general and can be incorporated into both standard RLHF reward modeling objectives and direct alignment losses. As a concrete instantiation, we introduce DPO-PoP, an extension to Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) that incorporates adaptive margins from preference-over-preference supervision, enabling improved discriminative and generative performance. Additionally, we show a tradeoff between discriminative and generative performance and propose two sampling strategies for gathering preference-over-preference labels to navigate it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用“偏好之上的偏好”（preference over preferences）来推断自适应边际（adaptive margin），以改进RLHF中的奖励模型学习。具体扩展了DPO算法，引入DPO-PoP，在每数据点上根据偏好强度注释调整边际，从而提升判别和生成性能。实验还揭示了判别与生成性能之间的权衡，并提出了两种采样策略来获取偏好之上的偏好标签以应对该权衡。
Motivation: 现有RLHF方法中，边际通常固定或简单依赖偏好评分，忽略了不同偏好间的强度差异，且依赖人类难以准确提供的评分。
Method: 提出利用偏好之上的偏好（即指出两个偏好中哪一个代表更强区分）作为注释，据此为每个数据点推断自适应边际。将该方法整合到DPO中，得到DPO-PoP，并设计两种采样策略收集偏好之上的偏好标签。
Result: 摘要声称DPO-PoP在判别和生成性能上均优于基线。未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 偏好之上的偏好是一种通用注释形式，可用于标准RLHF奖励建模和直接对齐损失，但存在判别与生成性能的权衡，需通过特定采样策略来调节。

papers.title: ControlHair: Synergizing Physics Simulator and Video Diffusion for Controllable Dynamic Hair Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Hair simulation and rendering are challenging due to complex strand dynamics, diverse material properties, and intricate light-hair interactions. Recent video diffusion models can generate high-quality videos, but they lack fine-grained control over hair dynamics. We present ControlHair, a hybrid framework that integrates a physics simulator with conditional video diffusion to enable precise and controllable dynamic hair rendering. ControlHair adopts a three-stage pipeline: it first encodes physics conditions into per-frame geometry using a simulator, then extracts per-frame control signals, and finally feeds control signals into a video diffusion model to generate videos with desired hair dynamics. This cascaded design decouples physics reasoning from video generation, supports diverse physics, and makes training the video diffusion model easy. Trained on a curated 10K video dataset, ControlHair outperforms text- and pose-conditioned baselines, delivering precisely controlled hair dynamics. We also demonstrate three use cases of ControlHair, including dynamic hairstyle try-on, bullet-time effects, and cinemagraphic. Project page: https://linwk20.github.io/controlhair-web.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 21 pages. Project page: https://linwk20.github.io/controlhair-web
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ControlHair 是一个结合物理模拟器与条件视频扩散模型的混合框架，用于可控的动态头发渲染。它通过三阶段流水线：先用模拟器生成每帧几何，再提取控制信号，最后输入扩散模型生成视频。在10K视频数据集上训练，优于文本和姿态条件基线，支持动态发型试穿、子弹时间等应用。
Motivation: 头发模拟和渲染因复杂的动力学、材质和光交互而困难，现有视频扩散模型缺乏对头发动力学的精细控制。
Method: 提出三阶段混合框架：物理模拟器编码条件并生成每帧几何，提取每帧控制信号，输入条件视频扩散模型生成视频，从而解耦物理推理与视频生成。
Result: 在10K视频数据集上训练，ControlHair 在头发动力学控制精度上优于文本和姿态条件基线。
Conclusion: 该混合框架有效结合物理模拟与扩散模型，实现了精确可控的动态头发渲染，并展示了多种应用场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EyeMulator: Improving Code Language Models by Mimicking Human Visual Attention
papers.abstract_en: Code Language Models (CodeLLMs) learn token importance from data correlations, whereas human developers attend selectively to semantically salient code. We present EyeMulator, a model-agnostic method that injects human visual-attention priors into CodeLLM fine-tuning without architectural changes. EyeMulator distills eye-tracking data into semantic salience and gaze-transition priors, then uses them to reweight token-level training losses. Across six backbones, two data regimes, and three CodeXGLUE tasks, the reported configurations yield positive matched-metric deltas in all 36 model-task-setting cells. Effects are largest for structure-preserving completion and translation, while summarization shows smaller but positive METEOR deltas. Session-mode and component-ablation analyses further show that reading, writing, semantic, and transition-derived priors provide complementary signal. Human-attention artifacts are available at https://zenodo.org/records/17205682.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EyeMulator，一种模型无关的方法，通过将人类视觉注意力先验注入CodeLLM微调，无需改变架构。它从眼动数据中提取语义显著性(semantic salience)和注视转换(gaze-transition)先验，用于重新加权token级训练损失。在六个基座模型、两种数据设置和三个CodeXGLUE任务上，所有36个模型-任务-设置组合均获得正向指标增量，尤其在结构保持的补全和翻译任务上效果最大，摘要任务提升较小。人工注意力数据已公开。
Motivation: CodeLLM从数据相关性学习token重要性，而人类开发者会选择性关注语义上显著的代码。现有方法未利用人类视觉注意力模式。
Method: EyeMulator是一种模型无关方法，通过蒸馏眼动数据得到语义显著性和注视转换先验，然后用于重新加权token级训练损失。
Result: 在六个基座模型、两种数据设置和三个CodeXGLUE任务上，所有36个模型-任务-设置组合均获得正向指标增量，结构保持的补全和翻译任务效果最大，摘要任务上METEOR增量较小但也为正。
Conclusion: 人类视觉注意力先验可作为CodeLLM微调的有效补充信号，阅读、写作、语义和转换派生先验提供互补信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parity-Aware Byte-Pair Encoding: Improving Cross-lingual Fairness in Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Tokenization is the first -- and often least scrutinized -- step of most NLP pipelines. Standard algorithms for learning tokenizers rely on frequency-based objectives, which favor languages dominant in the training data and consequently leave lower-resource languages with tokenizations that are disproportionately longer, morphologically implausible, or even riddled with $<UNK>$ placeholders. This phenomenon ultimately amplifies computational and financial inequalities between users from different language backgrounds. To remedy this, we introduce Parity-aware Byte Pair Encoding (BPE), a variant of the widely-used BPE algorithm. At every merge step, Parity-aware BPE applies a fair-max rule that maximizes the compression gain of the currently worst-compressed language, trading a small amount of global compression for cross-lingual parity. We find empirically that Parity-aware BPE reduces tokenization inequality -- operationalized by the Gini coefficient of per-language token costs -- by up to 89% relative to Classical BPE. This comes with negligible impact on global compression rate and no evidence of systematic degradation in downstream LM performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Parity-aware BPE，一种改进的字节对编码算法，在每次合并时最大化当前压缩最差语言的压缩增益，以牺牲少量全局压缩换取跨语言公平性。实验表明，该方法能将基于基尼系数的标记化不平等降低高达89%，同时全局压缩率几乎不受影响，下游语言模型性能无系统退化。
Motivation: 标准 tokenizer 学习算法依赖频率目标，偏向训练数据中的主导语言，导致低资源语言的 tokenization 过长、形态不合理或充满 <UNK>，加剧不同语言用户之间的计算和经济不平等。
Method: 提出 Parity-aware BPE，在每次合并步骤应用公平最大化规则，优先改善当前压缩最差语言的压缩增益，从而在保持全局压缩的同时实现跨语言公平。
Result: 在多个语言上，Parity-aware BPE 将 tokenization 不平等（以基尼系数衡量）相对于经典 BPE 降低高达 89%，全局压缩率几乎无损失，下游 LM 性能没有系统退化证据。
Conclusion: 方法有效减少 tokenization 不平等，且对全局压缩和下游性能影响微小，可作为更公平 tokenizer 的实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topological data analysis using persistent discrete homology
papers.abstract_en: We propose persistent discrete homology as a tool for topological data analysis and discuss its advantages over the existing methods. In particular, we provide empirical evidence that persistent discrete homology is more noise-resistant than persistent homology of the Vietoris-Rips complex for data coming from non-metric settings.

papers.title: FuseMamba-VD: Dual Branch VideoMamba with Gated Class Token Fusion for Violence Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of surveillance cameras has increased the demand for automated violence detection. While CNNs and Transformers have shown success in extracting spatio-temporal features, they struggle with long-term dependencies and computational efficiency. We propose FuseMamba-VD: Dual Branch VideoMamba with Gated Class Token Fusion (GCTF), an efficient architecture combining a dual-branch design and a state-space model (SSM) backbone where one branch captures spatial features, while the other focuses on temporal dynamics. The model performs continuous fusion via a gating mechanism from the spatial branch into the temporal branch to enhance detection of violent activities even in challenging surveillance scenarios. We also present a new benchmark by merging RWF-2000, RLVS, SURV and VioPeru datasets in video violence detection, ensuring strict separation between training and testing sets. Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on this benchmark and also on DVD dataset which is a recently introduced dataset on video violence detection, offering an optimal balance between accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating the promise of SSMs for scalable, resource efficient video violence detection. The code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/damith92/FuseMamba-VD.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 22nd IEEE International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FuseMamba-VD，一种基于双分支 VideoMamba 和门控类别令牌融合（GCTF）的高效暴力检测架构。空间分支捕捉空间特征，时间分支聚焦时序动态，通过门控机制连续融合以增强复杂监控场景下的暴力活动检测。作者合并了 RWF-2000、RLVS、SURV 和 VioPeru 四个数据集形成新基准，并在该基准及 DVD 数据集上达到最优性能，同时保持计算效率。
Motivation: 现有 CNN 和 Transformer 在监控视频暴力检测中难以处理长程依赖且计算效率低，需要更高效的时空特征提取方法。
Method: 采用双分支 VideoMamba 架构（空间分支+时间分支），通过门控机制将空间特征连续注入时间分支进行融合，基于状态空间模型（SSM）实现高效时空建模。
Result: 在合并的基准数据集和 DVD 数据集上取得最优性能，并实现了准确率与计算效率的最佳平衡。
Conclusion: SSM 架构在可扩展、资源高效的视频暴力检测中具有潜力，代码和预训练模型已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Serious Games: Human-AI Interaction, Evolution, and Coevolution
papers.abstract_en: The serious games between humans and AI have only just begun. Evolutionary Game Theory (EGT) models the competitive and cooperative strategies of biological entities. EGT could help predict the potential evolutionary equilibrium of humans and AI. The objective of this work was to examine EGT models relevant to human-AI interaction, evolution, and co-evolution. Of thirteen EGT models considered, three were examined: the Hawk-Dove Game, Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma, and the War of Attrition. This selection was based on the widespread acceptance and clear relevance of these models to potential human-AI evolutionary dynamics and co-evolutionary trajectories. The Hawk-Dove Game predicts balanced mixed-strategy equilibria based on the costs of conflict. Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma suggests that repeated interaction may lead to cognitive co-evolution. The War of Attrition suggests that competition for resources may result in strategic co-evolution, asymmetric equilibria, and conventions on sharing resources. Each model was examined from the perspective of human and AI decision-making, from psychological and biological perspectives, and from an AI viewpoint. AI is being shaped by human input and is evolving in response to it. So too, neuroplasticity allows the human brain to evolve in response to stimuli. If humans and AI converge in future, what might be the result of human neuroplasticity combined with an ever-evolving AI? There are profound ethical and cognitive implications. EGT may provide a suitable framework to understand and predict human-AI interaction, evolution, and co-evolution. However, future research should extend beyond EGT and explore additional frameworks, empirical validation methods, and interdisciplinary perspectives. In the spirit of further exploration, an illustrative computational simulation is provided.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了进化博弈论（EGT）在人类与AI交互、进化及共同进化中的应用。作者从十三个EGT模型中选取了鹰鸽博弈、重复囚徒困境和消耗战三个模型，分析其在人类-AI决策中的适用性。文章从心理学、生物学和AI视角进行了论述，并指出神经可塑性与AI演化的结合可能带来深刻的伦理与认知影响。
Motivation: 人类与AI之间的严肃博弈刚刚开始，需要理论框架来理解和预测其进化均衡。进化博弈论能够模拟生物实体间的竞争与合作策略，可能为人类-AI交互的进化动态提供预测工具。
Method: 从十三个EGT模型中筛选出三个广泛接受且相关的模型（鹰鸽博弈、重复囚徒困境、消耗战），分别从人类决策、心理/生物视角和AI视角进行分析，并提供了一个说明性的计算模拟。
Result: 鹰鸽博弈预测基于冲突成本的混合策略均衡；重复囚徒困境表明重复互动可能导致认知共同进化；消耗战表明资源竞争可能导致战略共同进化和不对称均衡。
Conclusion: EGT为理解和预测人类-AI交互、进化及共同进化提供了合适框架，但未来研究需扩展到其他框架、实证验证方法和跨学科视角。

papers.title: FLASH: Flexible Learning of Adaptive Sampling from History in Temporal Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Aggregating temporal signals from historic interactions is a key step in future link prediction on dynamic graphs. However, incorporating long histories is resource-intensive. Hence, temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) often rely on historical neighbors sampling heuristics such as uniform sampling or recent neighbors selection. These heuristics are static and fail to adapt to the underlying graph structure. We introduce FLASH, a learnable and graph-adaptive neighborhood selection mechanism that generalizes existing heuristics. FLASH integrates seamlessly into TGNNs and is trained end-to-end using a self-supervised ranking loss. We provide theoretical evidence that commonly used heuristics hinder TGNNs performance, motivating our design. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistent and significant performance improvements for TGNNs equipped with FLASH.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FLASH，一种可学习且图自适应的邻居选择机制，用于时序图神经网络（TGNN）的历史邻居采样。该方法通过自监督排序损失端到端训练，替代传统静态启发式采样（如均匀采样或最近邻居选择）。理论分析表明常见启发式方法会限制TGNN性能，而FLASH在多个基准上取得一致且显著的改进。
Motivation: 现有TGNN在处理长历史交互时因计算开销而依赖静态采样启发式（如均匀或最新邻居采样），这些方法无法适应底层图结构，导致性能受限。
Method: 设计FLASH模块，采用可学习的评分函数和排序损失进行端到端训练，使TGNN能够根据图结构自适应选择历史邻居进行聚合。
Result: 在多个动态图链接预测基准上，集成FLASH的TGNN相比基线方法取得一致且显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: FLASH是一种即插即用的通用采样策略，可推广至不同TGNN架构，理论证明其优于常用启发式。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Evaluating LLM-Based Regression Test Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown tremendous promise in automated software engineering. In this paper, we investigate LLMs for just-in-time regression test generation for programs, like parsers, interpreters, or compilers, that take highly structured, human-readable inputs. When a bug fix or code change is committed, the repository (as part of CI/CD) runs an LLM for a few minutes to generate regression tests that exercise the changed code and potentially trigger bugs. We frame LLM-based regression test generation as a machine translation task that takes the developer-provided commit message, the code change, and the input format name (e.g., XML), and produces regression tests for the described change in that format. Testing 72 commits to Mujs, Libxml2, Poppler, JerryScript, Z3, PHP, JQ, and MicroPython, our feedback-directed, zero-shot prototype Cleverest performed well, even without the code change. In under 2 minutes on average, Cleverest found as many bugs as the state-of-the-art directed greybox fuzzer WAFLGo did in 24 hours, even though WAFLGo started with a commit-reaching seed corpus in most cases. Using the Cleverest-generated tests as a seed corpus in coverage-guided greybox fuzzing doubles the number of bugs found; we call this integration ClevFuzz. We also find that some commit messages are more expressive than others, thus we ask how it impacts Cleverest's effectiveness. Cleverest picks up on the change intention: e.g., given a commit message that a patch changes how floating point variables are treated in the Mujs JavaScript interpreter, Cleverest generates JavaScript programs that contain floating point variables. Minimally changing commit messages to reduce or increase their information substantially impacts effectiveness: adding 17 words on average (max. 43) to make ineffective commit messages more expressive significantly increased the number of bugs found.
papers.comment: 23 pages. Published in PACMSE Volume 3, Issue FSE. Artifact of Paper "Evaluating LLM-based Regression Test Generation": https://dl.acm.org/do/10.5281/zenodo.19616584
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了大语言模型（LLM）在回归测试生成中的表现，提出了一个将提交消息、代码变更和输入格式名称作为输入的机器翻译任务框架。原型系统Cleverest在不到2分钟的平均时间内，生成了与定向灰盒模糊测试工具WAFLGo在24小时内相当的bug数量。将Cleverest生成的测试作为种子语料库，可以加倍bug发现数量。研究发现提交消息的表达性显著影响测试效果。
Motivation: 现代软件工程中，回归测试生成对于确保代码变更后的正确性至关重要，但传统方法耗时且需要大量手动工作。LLM展示了自动化潜力，因此探索其用于即时回归测试生成。
Method: 将LLM-based回归测试生成建模为机器翻译任务，输入包括开发者提供的提交消息、代码变更和输入格式名称，输出是针对变更的回归测试。采用反馈驱动的零样本原型Cleverest，并在覆盖引导的灰盒模糊测试中集成ClevFuzz。
Result: 在72个提交上测试8个项目，Cleverest平均在2分钟内找到了与WAFLGo在24小时内一样多的bug。作为种子语料库时，ClevFuzz加倍了bug发现数量。提交消息的扩展（平均增加17个词）显著提高了有效性。
Conclusion: LLM可以高效生成回归测试，且提交消息的质量是关键因素。该方法适合持续集成/持续部署（CI/CD）流水线中的快速测试生成。

papers.title: Discrete distributions are learnable from metastable samples
papers.abstract_en: Physically motivated stochastic dynamics are widely used to sample from high-dimensional distributions. However, such samplers often get trapped in metastable states, approximately sampling from a distribution that differs significantly from the desired stationary state. We rigorously show that for multivariable discrete distributions, the true stationary model can nevertheless be recovered from these metastable samples. This relies on a fundamental observation: for distributions satisfying a strong metastability condition, their single-variable conditional probabilities are on average extremely close to those of the true stationary distribution. This remains true even when the two distributions are far apart under global metrics such as Kullback-Leibler divergence. Consequently, we can effectively learn the true model using a conditional-likelihood estimator even when the samples are drawn from a restricted state space. Extending these general results to Ising models, we prove rigorous parameter and structure learning guarantees. Finally, we demonstrate this phenomenon numerically on higher-alphabet spin glass models.
papers.comment: Updated version. Spin glass experiments added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多变量离散分布，证明即使在采样器陷入亚稳态（metastable states）时，仍能从亚稳态样本中学习到真实的稳态分布。关键观察是：满足强亚稳态条件的分布，其单变量条件概率平均意义上非常接近真实稳态分布，即使全局度量（如KL散度）下两者相距甚远。因此，可以使用条件似然估计器从受限状态空间中恢复真实模型。结果推广到Ising模型，提供了参数和结构学习的理论保证，并在高字母自旋玻璃模型上进行了数值验证。
Motivation: 随机动力学采样器常受困于亚稳态，样本分布偏离期望的稳态分布，导致模型学习困难。需要从这种有偏样本中恢复真实分布的方法。
Method: 提出利用条件似然估计器（conditional-likelihood estimator）学习真实模型。基于理论分析：强亚稳态条件下，亚稳态样本的单变量条件概率平均接近真实条件概率，从而绕过全局分布差异进行学习。
Result: 摘要声称对多变量离散分布有严格的理论保证；在Ising模型上得到参数和结构学习的可证明保证；数值实验在高字母自旋玻璃模型上验证了现象。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，即使在采样器受困于亚稳态时，也能通过学习条件概率有效恢复真实分布，具有理论上的严谨性和对Ising模型的推广。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作表明，即使在采样器受困于亚稳态时，也能通过学习条件概率有效恢复真实分布，具有理论上的严谨性和对Ising模型的推广。

papers.title: Improved Finite-Particle Convergence Rates for Stein Variational Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: We provide finite-particle convergence rates for the Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) algorithm in the Kernelized Stein Discrepancy ($\mathsf{KSD}$) and Wasserstein-2 metrics. Our key insight is that the time derivative of the relative entropy between the joint density of $N$ particle locations and the $N$-fold product target measure, starting from a regular initial distribution, splits into a dominant `negative part' proportional to $N$ times the expected $\mathsf{KSD}^2$ and a smaller `positive part'. This observation leads to $\mathsf{KSD}$ rates of order $1/\sqrt{N}$, in both continuous and discrete time, providing a near optimal (in the sense of matching the corresponding i.i.d. rates) double exponential improvement over the recent result by Shi and Mackey (2024). Under mild assumptions on the kernel and potential, these bounds also grow polynomially in the dimension $d$. By adding a bilinear component to the kernel, the above approach is used to further obtain Wasserstein-2 convergence in continuous time. For the case of `bilinear + Matérn' kernels, we derive Wasserstein-2 rates that exhibit a curse-of-dimensionality similar to the i.i.d. setting. We also obtain marginal convergence and long-time propagation of chaos results for the time-averaged particle laws.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文改进了 Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) 在核化 Stein 散度 (KSD) 和 Wasserstein-2 度量下的有限粒子收敛速率。关键洞察是粒子联合密度与目标乘积测度之间的相对熵的时间导数可以分解为主负部和较小正部，从而在连续和离散时间下得到 O(1/√N) 的 KSD 速率，相比 Shi 和 Mackey (2024) 有双指数改进，且在温和假设下对维度 d 多项式增长。通过向核添加双线性分量，还导出了连续时间下的 Wasserstein-2 收敛，对于双线性+Matérn 核，其 Wasserstein-2 速率表现出与 i.i.d. 设置相似的维数灾难。此外，得到了时间平均粒子律的边际收敛和长时间传播混沌结果。
Motivation: 现有 SVGD 的有限粒子收敛率不够紧，尤其是与 i.i.d. 样本的收敛率相比存在差距。
Method: 分析相对熵的时间导数，将其分解为与 N 倍期望 KSD² 成比例的主导负部和较小的正部，从而导出收敛率；并通过添加双线性核分量扩展到 Wasserstein-2 收敛。
Result: 在 KSD 度量下获得 O(1/√N) 的收敛率，接近最优 i.i.d. 率，且相比之前工作有双指数改进；在 Wasserstein-2 度量下得到连续时间收敛率，对 Matérn 核表现为维数灾难。
Conclusion: 该分析提供了 SVGD 在有限粒子情形下近乎最优的收敛率，并揭示了与 i.i.d. 采样相似的维度依赖特性，同时得到了边际收敛和长时间传播混沌的结果。

papers.title: Training Verifiably Robust Agents Using Set-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning policies parametrized by deep neural networks have achieved strong performance for continuous control, yet even small input perturbations may lead to unpredictable behavior. This sensitivity limits their use in safety-critical domains, where robustness guarantees are required. Our work addresses this gap between state-of-the-art adversarial training methods and formal verification to train verifiably robust agents. Previous works train networks with individual adversarial perturbations, making them only robust against the specific adversarial attacks used. In contrast, our approach propagates entire perturbed input sets, enclosing all possible adversarial attacks within a single network pass. We leverage this to explicitly penalize the size of the output set (minimizing closed-loop uncertainty) and thereby make the actor robust against all possible attacks. This is realized by the use of set-based policy gradients, where each output within the set has a different gradient, thereby balancing the accuracy and robustness of the network. Doing so, we achieve formal verifiability across different verification frameworks for up to 9 times larger input perturbations compared to standard reinforcement learning and improve certified worst-case performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于集合的强化学习方法，通过传播整个扰动输入集并显式惩罚输出集大小（最小化闭环不确定性），使得智能体对所有可能攻击鲁棒。该方法利用集合策略梯度，其中集合内每个输出具有不同梯度，从而平衡网络准确性与鲁棒性。实验表明，与标准强化学习相比，该方法在最多9倍大的输入扰动下实现形式可验证性，并提升了经认证的最坏情况性能。
Motivation: 深度神经网络参数化的强化学习策略在连续控制中表现出色，但即使是微小的输入扰动也可能导致不可预测的行为，限制了其在需要鲁棒性保证的安全关键领域的应用。现有对抗训练方法仅对特定对抗攻击鲁棒，缺乏正式保证。
Method: 提出基于集合的强化学习，在单次网络前向传播中传播整个扰动输入集（包含所有可能对抗攻击），通过集合策略梯度显式惩罚输出集大小以最小化闭环不确定性。每个输出具有不同梯度，从而平衡准确性与鲁棒性。
Result: 与标准强化学习相比，该方法在不同验证框架下实现形式可验证性，支持最多9倍大的输入扰动，并提升了经认证的最坏情况性能。
Conclusion: 该方法弥合了对抗训练与形式验证之间的差距，实现了可验证鲁棒的智能体，适用于安全关键场景。

papers.title: Double Fuzzy Probabilistic Interval Linguistic Term Set and a Dynamic Fuzzy Decision Making Model based on Markov Process with tts Application in Multiple Criteria Group Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: The probabilistic linguistic term has been proposed to deal with probability distributions in provided linguistic evaluations. However, because it has some fundamental defects, it is often difficult for decision-makers to get reasonable information of linguistic evaluations for group decision making. In addition, weight information plays a significant role in dynamic information fusion and decision making process. However, there are few research methods to determine the dynamic attribute weight with time. In this paper, I propose the concept of double fuzzy probability interval linguistic term set (DFPILTS). Firstly, fuzzy semantic integration, DFPILTS definition, its preference relationship, some basic algorithms and aggregation operators are defined. Then, a fuzzy linguistic Markov matrix with its network is developed. Then, a weight determination method based on distance measure and information entropy to reducing the inconsistency of DFPILPR and obtain collective priority vector based on group consensus is developed. Finally, an aggregation-based approach is developed, and an optimal investment case from a financial risk is used to illustrate the application of DFPILTS and decision method in multi-criteria decision making.
papers.comment: submitted to IEEE Transactions on Fuzzy Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对概率语言术语集在群决策中难以获得合理语言评估信息的问题，提出了双模糊概率区间语言术语集（DFPILTS）。定义了模糊语义集成、偏好关系、基本算法和聚合算子，构建了模糊语言马尔可夫矩阵与网络，并基于距离测度和信息熵开发了动态权重确定方法。通过金融风险投资案例验证了该方法在多准则群决策中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有概率语言术语集存在基本缺陷，决策者难以从群决策中获得合理的语言评估信息；同时，动态信息融合中的权重确定方法研究较少。
Method: 提出双模糊概率区间语言术语集（DFPILTS），包括模糊语义集成、定义、偏好关系、基本算法和聚合算子；构建模糊语言马尔可夫矩阵与网络；基于距离测度和信息熵开发权重确定方法以降低不一致性，并通过群共识获取集体优先向量。
Result: 通过一个金融风险投资案例展示了所提方法在多准则决策中的应用。
Conclusion: 所提方法能够有效处理群决策中的动态信息融合与权重确定问题。

papers.title: The agent creates, we validate: A Lightweight Framework for Agentic Artifact Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating structured artifacts with Large Language Models - e.g. database queries, threat framework mappings, entity schemas - is relatively straightforward; however, making them reliable enough for production deployments presents challenges. We present a lightweight framework based on a core principle: LLMs generate, we validate. This reframing shifts responsibility from generation quality to validation rigor. The framework rests on three key attributes: First, test driven generation: when tests fail, the LLM receives indicative error messages that expose why the output failed, enabling the LLM to understand its mistakes and refine subsequent attempts. Second, deterministic and LLM-based tests: deterministic tests catch heuristics that can be programmatically verified (schema, syntax, cross-reference), while LLM-based tests evaluate nuanced semantic and delicate features that resist programmatic inspection (intent alignment, logical consistency, domain correctness). Third, expert-distilled judges: LLM-based tests are calibrated to distill and replicate human expert decision distribution, transforming manual human quality gates into scalable, reusable evaluation proxies that reflect professional-grade validation standards. We demonstrate the framework on three artifact types in the security domain - KQL query generation, MITRE ATT\&CK mapping, and entity mapping - deployed in production at Microsoft Sentinel. We believe this framework can be applied beyond security to other artifact generation tasks, providing a path to reliable, high-quality outputs without sacrificing the efficiency gains of LLM generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个轻量级框架，核心原则是“LLM生成，我们验证”，用于生成可靠的结构化工件（如数据库查询、威胁框架映射、实体模式）。框架包括三个关键属性：测试驱动生成、确定性与LLM-based测试、专家提炼的评判器。在安全领域的KQL查询生成、MITRE ATT&CK映射和实体映射三种工件类型上演示，并已在Microsoft Sentinel生产环境部署。
Motivation: 使用LLM生成结构化工件相对容易，但使其达到生产部署所需的可靠性存在挑战。现有方法过度依赖生成质量，缺乏系统的验证机制。
Method: 框架基于三个属性：1）测试驱动生成：失败时向LLM提供指示性错误信息，帮助其理解错误并改进；2）确定性和基于LLM的测试：确定性测试捕获可编程验证的启发式规则，LLM-based测试评估语义和细微特征；3）专家提炼的评判器：将人类专家决策分布蒸馏到LLM-based测试中，建立可扩展的验证代理。
Result: 在安全领域的三种工件类型（KQL查询、MITRE ATT&CK映射、实体映射）上应用该框架，并已部署于Microsoft Sentinel生产环境。
Conclusion: 该框架可推广到安全领域之外的其他工件生成任务，在保持LLM生成效率的同时实现可靠、高质量的输出。

papers.title: Fusion: A Framework for Unified Sequential Token AdaptatIon in VisiOn TraNsformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers achieve strong image classification accuracy but process all image regions with nearly the same computation, even when many regions are redundant or uninformative. Recent adaptive inference methods reduce this cost by selectively compressing tokens or terminating inference early, but combining these mechanisms often causes unstable intermediate representations and accuracy degradation. We introduce Fusion, a unified adaptive inference framework that coordinates token merging, early exiting, and token pruning through a simple staged design: tokens are merged first, confidence is evaluated next, and pruning is applied only to samples that continue inference. This ordering allows the three mechanisms to operate cooperatively rather than competitively. Fusion further includes lightweight routing modules that adapt compression strength to each input and support inference-time adjustment of the accuracy--latency trade-off without retraining. On ImageNet-1k with DeiT-S, Fusion matches or surpasses state-of-the-art adaptive ViT methods at comparable compute budgets while reducing calibration error by up to $4\times$ and inference energy by $48\%$. Experiments across ImageNet-100, CIFAR-100, and ImageNette with multiple ViT backbones demonstrate consistent transferability without dataset-specific tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Fusion框架，统一协调视觉Transformer中的token合并、早期退出和token剪枝三种自适应推理机制，通过有序设计（先合并、再评估置信度、最后剪枝）避免冲突，并引入轻量路由模块实现每输入自适应压缩和推理时精度-延迟权衡调整。在ImageNet-1k上用DeiT-S达到或超过现有自适应方法，校准误差降低高达4倍，推理能耗降低48%。
Motivation: 现有视觉Transformer对所有图像区域几乎均等计算，冗余区域浪费资源。已有的自适应方法（token压缩、早期退出）组合使用时会导致中间表示不稳定和精度下降。
Method: 提出Fusion框架，采用分阶段设计：先合并相似token，再评估样本置信度，对需要继续推理的样本执行token剪枝。包含轻量路由模块动态调整压缩强度，支持推理时无重训练调整精度-延迟平衡。
Result: 在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-S在相似计算预算下匹配或超越现有自适应ViT方法，校准误差降低达4倍，推理能耗降低48%。在ImageNet-100、CIFAR-100、ImageNette上使用多种ViT骨干网络表现出一致迁移性。
Conclusion: Fusion通过协调多种自适应机制实现了更好的精度-效率权衡，且无需针对数据集微调。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: Fusion通过协调多种自适应机制实现了更好的精度-效率权衡，且无需针对数据集微调。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Industrial Ergonomics: mmWave-Based Automated REBA Scoring and Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Work-related Musculoskeletal Disorders (WMSDs) require continuous ergonomic assessments. While Rapid Entire Body Assessment (REBA) is a gold-standard observation tool, manual monitoring is labor-intensive, and vision-based automation leads to privacy concerns. This paper proposes a novel end-to-end multi-task learning framework for privacy-preserving ergonomic assessment using millimetre-wave (mmWave) radar. A spatio-temporal backbone reconstructs 3D human skeletons, which serves as the biomechanical foundation for a subsequent regression head to generate REBA risk scores. To overcome the sparsity of radar point clouds, we utilise a multi-objective loss function incorporating biomechanical limits and temporal smoothness constraints. Furthermore, we implement an oversampling strategy to address the imbalance of high-risk postures in existing datasets. Experimental results on MMFi dataset demonstrate that our framework achieves a Categorical Accuracy of 77.78% and real-time performance with an inference latency of 5.70 ms. Our method reaches a High-risk REBA MAE of 0.93, which significantly outperforms both direct regression and two-stage pipelines in high-risk scenarios, providing a robust solution for non-invasive industrial ergonomic assessment.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on Automation and Computing (ICAC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于毫米波雷达的端到端多任务学习框架，用于隐私保护的工业人体工学评估。该框架通过时空骨干网络重建3D人体骨骼，进而回归REBA风险评分，在MMFi数据集上达到77.78%的分类准确率和5.70ms推理延迟，高风险REBA MAE为0.93，优于直接回归和两阶段方法。
Motivation: 传统REBA人工评估劳动密集，基于视觉的自动化方法存在隐私问题，需要一种非侵入式且隐私保护的工业人体工学评估方案。
Method: 提出端到端多任务学习框架，使用毫米波雷达点云，通过时空骨干网络重建3D人体骨骼，再通过回归头生成REBA风险评分；采用多目标损失函数结合生物力学约束和时间平滑性，并过采样不平衡的高风险姿态。
Result: 在MMFi数据集上，分类准确率77.78%，推理延迟5.70ms，高风险REBA MAE为0.93，显著优于直接回归和两阶段基线。
Conclusion: 该框架为工业人体工学提供了非侵入式、实时且隐私保护的自动化REBA评估方案，尤其在高风险场景下表现稳健。

papers.title: Knowledge-Centric Information Systems
papers.abstract_en: For decades, data engineering has developed mature architectural principles for integrating, governing, validating, cataloging, and serving organizational data. The rise of large language models does not eliminate these concerns; it exposes a broader version of them. Organizational knowledge is becoming executable infrastructure: systems increasingly retrieve it, assemble it, reason over it, and act on it. This paper argues that enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) systems suggest a transition toward an architectural discipline for representing, maintaining, governing, and operationally delivering organizational knowledge. We refer to this discipline as \emph{knowledge architecture}. We offer a conceptual model and taxonomy showing how classical data-engineering guarantees must be redefined when the managed unit shifts from records to knowledge artifacts: extract, transform, and load (ETL) becomes knowledge ingestion, change-data capture (CDC) becomes knowledge change detection, lineage becomes provenance, catalogs become knowledge catalogs, materialized views become knowledge views, and medallion architectures become raw--curated--operational knowledge layers. Emerging formats such as large language model (LLM) Wiki and the Open Knowledge Format (OKF) are treated as early evidence of this transition, not as its endpoint. The central claim is that knowledge architecture becomes useful when organizational knowledge ceases to be a passive information resource and becomes an operational asset used by humans, agents, workflows, and models to execute work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识架构（knowledge architecture）作为一门新兴学科，用于在企业AI系统中表示、维护、治理和操作化交付组织知识。作者将传统数据工程概念（如ETL、CDC、血缘等）重新映射到知识领域（知识摄取、知识变更检测、来源等），并指出LLM Wiki和开放知识格式（OKF）是这一转变的早期证据。核心主张是，当组织知识从被动信息资源转变为被人类、智能体、工作流和模型用于执行工作的运营资产时，知识架构变得有用。
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型兴起，但组织仍面临集成、治理、验证和服务知识的挑战，传统数据工程原则需扩展以适应知识作为可执行基础设施的新范式。
Method: 提出概念模型和分类法，将数据工程中的ETL、CDC、血缘、目录、物化视图和勋章架构分别重新定义为知识摄入、知识变更检测、来源、知识目录、知识视图和原始-策管-运营知识层。
Conclusion: 知识架构成为必要，当组织知识从被动资源转变为运营资产；LLM Wiki和OKF等新兴格式是早期证据而非终点。

papers.title: Towards transferable lightweight neuromorphic computing through a model-free temporal-switch framework
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight neuromorphic computing offers a promising route to efficient AI, with particular benefits for resource-constrained edge deployments. However, its scalable deployment that can reliably transfer the expected performance has long been hindered by device-to-device variations, which necessitate costly and repeated re-training on new copies and undermine the practical advantages. To address this issue, we introduce a model-free temporal-switch (TS) framework to improve the direct transfer performance, without post-training calibration or adjustment. The TS framework provides a methodology to incorporate a broader spectrum of devices in the training process. In the validation using memristor-based reservoir computing, it enables high performance on unseen devices with a directly transferred readout. It achieves improved prediction in the representative Mackey--Glass benchmark, and the accuracy of 92.4% in spoken digit classification. Its efficacy is validated across different memristor families and RC configurations. Theoretical analysis not only reveals the general computational mechanism underlying its efficacy, but also underlines its potential applicability to other physical platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对轻量级神经形态计算中因器件差异导致的性能迁移困难，提出一种无需后训练校准的模型无关时间开关框架（temporal-switch framework）。在基于忆阻器的储层计算（reservoir computing）验证中，该框架在未见过器件上直接迁移的读出头表现优异，在Mackey-Glass基准预测和口语数字分类（准确率92.4%）上均取得改进，且跨不同忆阻器族和储层计算配置有效。理论分析揭示了其通用计算机制并指出对其他物理平台的潜在适用性。
Motivation: 轻量级神经形态计算在资源受限的边缘部署中具有优势，但器件间的差异导致需要昂贵的重复重新训练才能在新器件上保持性能，阻碍了可扩展部署。
Method: 提出模型无关的时间开关（TS）框架，在训练过程中纳入更广泛的器件特性，无需后训练校准或调整即可实现直接迁移性能提升。
Result: 在忆阻器储层计算实验中，TS框架使直接迁移到未用器件的读出头达到高性能：Mackey-Glass预测精度提升，口语数字分类准确率达92.4%，且在不同忆阻器族和RC配置上均保持有效性。
Conclusion: 理论分析表明TS框架的效能源于其通用计算机制，并强调该方法可推广至其他物理计算平台。

papers.title: Latent Visual Cache for Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video reasoning requires Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to remain grounded in dense evidence, yet existing systems largely adopt "read-once, generate-many" paradigm, in which visual grounding weakens during generation. This phenomenon has been widely observed and is known as Visual Anchoring Decay. To fill this gap, we introduce Latent Video Cache (Latent-VC), a recurrent latent visual cache inserted into the decoder to preserve compact visual memories throughout reasoning. The cache is trained with supervised contrastive cache alignment and vision-grounded GRPO with a latent grounding reward, while maintaining strict train-inference alignment through native decoder hidden states. Built on Qwen3.5-9B, Latent-VC consistently outperforms strong CoT and SFT+GRPO baselines across six video benchmarks, with especially clear gains on grounding-intensive and long-video tasks. In addition, it also achieves higher accuracy with substantially shorter responses, suggesting that latent visual caching improves video reasoning by preserving visual evidence rather than relying on longer textual chains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Visual Cache (Latent-VC)，一种在解码器中插入的循环潜在视觉缓存，用于在视频推理中保持紧凑的视觉记忆，解决视觉锚定衰减问题。该方法通过监督对比缓存对齐和基于视觉的GRPO训练，在六个视频基准上优于强基线，且响应更短。
Motivation: 现有大型多模态模型在视频推理中采用“一次读取，多次生成”范式，导致视觉锚定衰减（Visual Anchoring Decay），即生成过程中视觉基础减弱。
Method: 提出 Latent-VC，在解码器中插入循环潜在视觉缓存，通过监督对比缓存对齐和带潜在基础奖励的视觉接地GRPO进行训练，保持训练-推理对齐，基于Qwen3.5-9B。
Result: 在六个视频基准上一致优于强CoT和SFT+GRPO基线，在接地密集和长视频任务上尤其明显；同时以更短响应实现更高准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要认为潜在视觉缓存通过保留视觉证据而非依赖更长的文本链来改善视频推理。

papers.title: DynaWM: A Base-VLA-Guided World Foundation Model for Moving-Object Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Although vision-language-action (VLA) models have received widespread attention, many challenges remain in manipulating dynamic moving objects. In most existing approaches, end-to-end forward or inverse dynamics models, i.e., world models, are incorporated into high-performance base VLA architectures, which may degrade the performance of well-pretrained base VLA models due to inappropriate fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose DynaWM, a base-VLA-guided world foundation model that adapts to a wide variety of fine-tuned and coarse-tuned base-VLA checkpoints for moving-object manipulation. DynaWM uses a Mamba-3-based action encoder to encode the base action chunk produced by the base VLA into an action-conditioning representation, a V-JEPA 2.1 vision encoder to extract features from multi-view observation history, and a proprioceptive state encoder to encode robotic-arm proprioceptive states. These feature representations jointly condition a flow-matching DiT to regenerate motion-aware action trajectories for moving-object manipulation. For systematic evaluation, we construct the DynaGrasp-32 benchmark, covering six categories of moving-object manipulation tasks, including velocity variation, trajectory variation, and multi-object manipulation, as well as the DynaGrasp-1600 dataset, which consists of 32 scenarios, 1,600 demonstration trajectories, and approximately 1.53M images. For fine-tuned base-VLA checkpoints, DynaWM achieves percentage improvements of 7.19, 45.31, 1.88, and 10.94 over SmolVLA, X-VLA, π0, and π0.5, respectively. For coarse-tuned base-VLA checkpoints, performance increases by 35.13, 44.06, 35.69, and 26.13 percentage, respectively. Ablation experiments show that visual encoding enhances success by 27.50%, while reducing success by 45.44% if action conditioning is removed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynaWM，一种基于基座 VLA 引导的世界基础模型，用于动态物体操作。它采用 Mamba-3 动作编码器、V-JEPA 2.1 视觉编码器和本体感知状态编码器，通过流匹配 DiT 生成运动感知动作轨迹。在构建的 DynaGrasp-32 基准和 DynaGrasp-1600 数据集上，该模型在多种基座 VLA 检查点上取得了显著性能提升。
Motivation: 现有方法将世界模型集成到基座 VLA 中，可能因不当微调而降低预训练模型的性能，因此需要一种无需破坏基座 VLA 预训练权重的动态物体操作框架。
Method: DynaWM 使用 Mamba-3 动作编码器将基座 VLA 输出的动作块编码为动作条件表示，V-JEPA 2.1 视觉编码器提取多视图观测历史特征，本体感知状态编码器编码机器人臂状态。这些特征共同条件化一个流匹配 DiT 模型，以生成运动感知的动作轨迹。
Result: 在细调基座 VLA 检查点上，DynaWM 相对于 SmolVLA、X-VLA、π0 和 π0.5 分别提升 7.19、45.31、1.88 和 10.94 个百分点；在粗调检查点上分别提升 35.13、44.06、35.69 和 26.13 个百分点。消融实验显示视觉编码提升成功率达 27.50%，移除动作条件则降低 45.44%。
Conclusion: DynaWM 能够适应多种微调与粗调基座 VLA 检查点，有效改进动态物体操作任务的表现，且避免了直接微调基座 VLA 带来的性能下降。

papers.title: Scaling Weisfeiler-Leman Expressiveness Analysis to Massive Graphs with GPUs
papers.abstract_en: The stable coloring of the Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) test is a cornerstone of Graph Neural Networks because it provides an upper bound to the expressive power of message-passing architectures. Unfortunately, computing it presents two fundamental bottlenecks. First, classic algorithms are inherently sequential and cannot exploit modern massively parallel hardware. Second, these are \emph{global} algorithms, i.e., they require availability in memory of the full graph, severely limiting applicability to real-world instances. We leverage a linear-algebraic interpretation of 1-WL stable coloring and introduce two key contributions: (i)~a randomized refinement algorithm with tight probabilistic guarantees and (ii)~a correctness-preserving batching scheme that decomposes the graph into independently processable subgraphs while provably returning a stable coloring of the original graph. This approach maps directly to GPU-efficient primitives. In numerical experiments, our CUDA implementation delivers speedups up to two orders of magnitude over classical CPU-based partition refinement and, for the first time, successfully computes stable colorings on web-scale graphs with over 30 billion edges, where CPU baselines time out or fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于线性代数解释的1-WL稳定染色算法，通过随机细化算法和保持正确性的批处理方案，实现了在GPU上的高效并行计算。实验表明，CUDA实现在大规模图上比经典CPU算法快两个数量级，并首次成功计算了超过300亿条边的网络规模图的稳定染色。
Motivation: 经典1-WL稳定染色算法是序列化的，无法利用现代GPU并行硬件，且需要全图内存，限制了在大规模图上的应用。
Method: 利用1-WL稳定染色的线性代数解释，提出了一种具有严格概率保证的随机细化算法，以及一种保持正确性的批处理方案，将图分解为可独立处理的子图，并映射到GPU高效原语。
Result: CUDA实现相比经典CPU分区细化算法实现了高达两个数量级的加速，并首次成功计算了超过300亿条边的网络规模图的稳定染色。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了利用GPU规模化WL表达性分析的可行性，为大规模图神经网络的理论分析提供了工具。

papers.title: CV-DCLR: Causal-Visual Dynamic Label Refinement for Robust Zero-Shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Zero-Shot Learning (ZSL) facilitates knowledge transfer via shared semantic spaces. However, a critical bottleneck in this paradigm is Semantic Entanglement, where visual representations are inevitably conflated with visually similar semantic concepts, such as distinguishing the intrinsic traits of a Wolf from the shared features of a Husky. Existing global alignment methods often indiscriminately maximize correlations between visual and semantic modalities, leading models to overfit spurious similarities rather than capturing distinctive class identities. To address this fundamental limitation, we propose the Causal-Visual Dynamic Label Refinement (CV-DCLR) framework. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on superficial visual statistics, CV-DCLR recalibrates visual-semantic associations via a Dual-Stream Mutual Correction Mechanism. This includes a Visual Likelihood Stream to model observational patterns and a Causal Importance Stream that verifies the structural necessity of candidate prototypes through Counterfactual Intervention. Acting as a logical filter, our adaptive gating mechanism dynamically modulates feature responses to amplify genuine causal traits while suppressing visually plausible but structurally irrelevant distractors. Extensive experiments on the CUB, SUN, and AWA2 benchmarks under a rigorous Semantic Entanglement Injection protocol demonstrate that CV-DCLR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in high-ambiguity scenarios. Specifically, while existing models suffer catastrophic degradation under entanglement, our framework maintains robust performance, effectively disentangling true class identities from semantic confounders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉与语义模态的语义纠缠问题，提出因果-视觉动态标签精炼（CV-DCLR）框架。通过双流互校正机制（视觉似然流与因果重要性流）及自适应门控，放大因果特征并抑制视觉相似但无关的干扰。在CUB、SUN、AWA2基准上，高模糊场景下显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有全局对齐方法在视觉语义纠缠（如区分狼与哈士奇）时，易过拟合虚假相似性，无法捕捉独特类别身份，导致性能严重下降。
Method: 提出CV-DCLR框架，包含视觉似然流（建模观测模式）和因果重要性流（通过反事实干预验证候选原型的结构必要性），并由自适应门控机制动态调制特征响应，强化因果特征，抑制干扰。
Result: 在CUB、SUN、AWA2数据集上，经严格语义纠缠注入测试，CV-DCLR在高模糊场景下显著优于SOTA，现有模型因纠缠严重退化，而该方法保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 框架通过因果干预有效解耦真实类别身份与语义混淆因素，提升零样本学习的鲁棒性。

papers.title: AgentLTL: A Trace-Verification Framework for Measuring, Enforcing, and Training Procedural Compliance in Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents are usually evaluated by final-answer correctness or LLM judges. Neither captures how an answer was produced. In safety-critical settings, the procedure itself is part of correctness. In this paper, we introduce AgentLTL, a language derived from First-Order Linear Temporal Logic (FO-LTL) that expresses procedural rules over agent traces. It yields a deterministic, judge-free compliance score. In this framework, a single specification drives two usages. The first is harnessing: the constraints score completed traces, or gate tool calls by checking each prefix online, before execution. The second is finetuning: the score serves as a dense reward. On a benchmark spanning ordering, branching, iteration, and grounding, block-and-warn harnessing improves compliance on five of seven models. Finetuning with the same reward yields +38 and +17.5 percentage point gains in accuracy and compliance on held-out patterns, including unseen tool-name aliases. These findings are consistent with the model acquiring procedural structure rather than memorizing surface tool names and procedures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentLTL，一种基于一阶线性时态逻辑（FO-LTL）的语言，用于表达工具使用LLM代理轨迹的程序规则，并生成确定性的无裁判合规分数。该框架支持两种用法：一是约束（harnessing），对已完成轨迹评分或在线门控工具调用；二是微调（finetuning），将分数作为密集奖励。在包含排序、分支、迭代和接地等模式的基准上，约束方法提升了7个模型中的5个的合规性，而微调在保留模式（包括未见过的工具别名）上使准确率和合规性分别提高+38和+17.5个百分点。结果表明模型学到了程序结构而非记忆表面工具名称和程序。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理评估通常仅关注最终答案的正确性或使用LLM评判，忽略了答案的产生过程。在安全关键场景中，过程本身也是正确性的组成部分，因此需要一种能表达和验证程序合规性的方法。
Method: 提出AgentLTL语言，由一阶线性时态逻辑（FO-LTL）派生而来，可表达代理轨迹上的程序规则，并产生确定性的合规分数。该框架具有两种用法：约束（harnessing）——对已完成轨迹评分或在线检查每个前缀以在工具调用前进行门控；微调（finetuning）——将合规分数作为密集奖励信号用于模型微调。
Result: 在包含排序、分支、迭代和接地等模式的基准上，block-and-warn约束方法在7个模型中的5个上提升了合规性；使用相同奖励进行微调，在保留模式（包括未见过的工具别名）上准确率和合规性分别提高了+38和+17.5个百分点。
Conclusion: 结果表明，模型学到了程序结构而非记忆表面工具名称和程序。该框架提供了一种无需裁判的、可解释的过程合规性量化方法，可用于在线约束和训练信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating Agentic Harness Systems for Autonomous Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous computational pathology (ACP) converts high-level pathology analysis goals into executable, traceable and clinically bounded workflows. Realizing this capability requires adapting general agentic harness systems to pathology-specific tasks, tools, evidence standards and clinical claim boundaries. We contribute ACP-Bench, a framework that adapts existing harness systems from computational pathology support toward ACP workflow capability. ACP-Bench evaluates 41 pathology workflow tasks, including 24 biomarker, 7 morphology and 10 prognosis tasks spanning 6 body-system groups and 9 endpoint families. The benchmark evaluates 9 models and 3 harness groups (Claude Code, Codex and Open Code), yielding 369 complete trajectories. ACP-Bench evaluates each trajectory across workflow execution, diagnostic performance and clinical-boundary alignment, combining expert-adjudicated process audits, diagnostic assessment and pathologist-validated safety review. Across evaluated systems, workflow initiation, task interpretation and diagnostic reporting were more mature than tool-bound execution, result binding and reflective workflow revision, and formal end-to-end completion remained rare. ACP-Bench provides a reusable standard for auditing whether agentic systems can operationalize pathology workflows before claims of reliable clinical autonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACP-Bench，一个评估自主计算病理学（ACP）中代理工具系统的框架。该基准包含41个病理学工作流任务，涵盖生物标志物、形态学和预后等类别，评估了9个模型和3个工具组，共369条完整轨迹。评估发现工作流启动、任务解释和诊断报告较为成熟，但工具执行、结果绑定和反思性工作流修订仍不完善，端到端完成罕见。
Motivation: 现有代理工具系统缺乏针对病理学工作流的标准化评估方法，难以判断其是否具备可靠的临床自主性能力。
Method: 构建ACP-Bench框架，将通用代理工具系统适配到病理学特定任务，通过专家裁决的过程审计、诊断评估和病理学家验证的安全审查，对工作流执行、诊断性能和临床边界对齐进行多维度评估。
Result: 在41个任务上，工作流启动、任务解释和诊断报告表现较好，但工具执行、结果绑定和反思性工作流修订仍不成熟，完整的端到端完成案例很少。
Conclusion: ACP-Bench提供了在声称可靠的临床自主性之前，审计代理系统能否操作化病理学工作流的可复用标准。

papers.title: CIPHER: Causal Intervention Pathways for Healthcare Equity and Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for medical diagnosis frequently exhibit substantial performance disparities across sensitive subgroups (e.g., race, sex), even when average accuracy is high. While generative data augmentation offers a route to mitigate this, existing strategies are suboptimal; they typically address only one or two dependency channels between sensitive attributes and image features. We formalize the medical image formation process via a structural causal model, revealing that sensitive attributes actually influence image content through four distinct pathways-a structural complexity neglected by prior works. Based on this insight, we introduce CIPHER (Causal Intervention Pathways for Healthcare Equity and Robustness), a framework designed to systematically intervene on all four causal paths. To achieve this, CIPHER utilizes a diffusion backbone equipped with classifier-free guidance and null-text inversion. This technical design enables the faithful reconstruction of patient-specific anatomy while allowing for the precise, editable synthesis of counterfactuals required to break sensitive dependency chains. We tested CIPHER using chest X-ray and dermoscopy benchmarks across both standard and shifted data distributions. By employing a multi-pathway intervention strategy, our model reduced worst-group disparities by an average of 35.8% compared to disease-conditioned synthesis baselines, while also improving total diagnostic accuracy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CIPHER 框架，基于结构因果模型识别医学图像生成中敏感属性影响图像内容的四条因果路径，并通过扩散模型实现多路径干预，以提高诊断模型在不同亚组间的公平性和鲁棒性。在胸部X光和皮肤镜数据集上，该方法将最差亚组性能差距平均降低35.8%，同时提升总体诊断准确率。
Motivation: 现有医学诊断模型在敏感属性（如种族、性别）上常表现出显著性能差异，而生成式数据增强方法仅处理少数因果路径，未能全面干预敏感属性与图像特征之间的依赖关系。
Method: CIPHER 框架首先通过结构因果模型形式化医学图像形成过程，揭示敏感属性通过四条因果路径影响图像内容；然后利用带有无分类器引导和空文本反转的扩散模型，生成反事实图像以破坏敏感依赖链。
Result: 在标准分布和偏移分布下的胸部X光和皮肤镜基准上，CIPHER 相比疾病条件合成基线将最差亚组性能差距平均降低35.8%，并提升总体诊断准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多路径因果干预策略能有效提升医学诊断模型的公平性和鲁棒性，但未明确讨论计算成本或对其他模态的泛化性。

papers.title: An automated method of identifying incorrectly labelled images based on the sequences of loss functions of deep learning networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning is widely applied in medical image analysis, but up to 10% of manually labelled images may be incorrect, degrading model performance. This paper proposes an automated method to identify incorrectly labelled medical images by analyzing sequences of loss functions from deep learning classification networks over multiple training epochs. Identified images can be reviewed and relabelled by experts, improving dataset quality and model performance. Two experiments validate the method on a fundus image dataset for referable diabetic retinopathy screening. In the first, 6% (648) of 10,788 gold-standard labels were intentionally flipped. The method identified 75.31% (488) of the flipped samples, with only 4.85% (492) false positives among correctly labelled samples. In the second, reviewing and correcting the 980 identified samples (9.1% of the dataset) and retraining the model improved best accuracy on an independent test set from 95.93% (with 6% label noise) to 96.50% (with 1.5% noise), approaching the ideal 96.57% (with 0% noise). The results demonstrate the method's effectiveness in improving model performance through automated label quality control.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自动识别错误标记图像的方法，通过分析深度学习分类网络在多个训练轮次上的损失函数序列，识别可能标注错误的样本。在眼底图像数据集上验证，翻转6%标签后成功识别75.31%的错误样本，假阳性率仅4.85%；纠正后模型准确率从95.93%提升至96.50%，接近理想水平。
Motivation: 手动标记的医学图像错误率可达10%，会降低模型性能，需要自动化方法识别并纠正错误标签以提升数据集质量。
Method: 分析深度学习分类网络在多个训练轮次上的损失函数序列，根据损失值的变化模式识别可能错误的标注图像。

papers.title: Token-level Response-visual Attention Guidance for Multimodal LLMs Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: While knowledge distillation (KD) is widely adopted for training lightweight models by leveraging supervision from larger teacher models, relying solely on output token distributions has proven insufficient for compressing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Since output tokens are a byproduct of the model attending to visual inputs, prior works have explored explicitly distilling attention to provide a direct supervisory signal. While promising, the precise utility of which attention signals to distill remains under-explored. In this work, we challenge the conventional reliance on prompt-to-vision attention by revealing that downstream performance correlates strongly with response-to-vision attention similarity to the teacher, but negligibly with that of prompt-conditioned attention. Furthermore, we observe that attention distributions exhibit significant variance across individual tokens, indicating that a uniform distillation objective is suboptimal. To this end, we introduce Token-level Response-visual Attention Guidance (TRAG), a distillation objective that 1) shifts the focus to response-to-vision signals and 2) employs token-specific objectives by adaptively weighting the Kullback-Leibler divergence based on attention entropy, effectively guiding the student to mirror the teacher's precise visual focus. Extensive experimental results on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that TRAG significantly outperforms prior distillation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的知识蒸馏问题，提出Token-level Response-visual Attention Guidance (TRAG)方法。该方法将蒸馏目标从输出token分布转向响应-视觉注意力（response-to-vision attention），并基于每个token的注意力熵自适应加权KL散度，从而引导学生模型精确模仿教师模型的视觉焦点。实验表明，TRAG在多个基准上显著优于以往的蒸馏基线。
Motivation: 现有的知识蒸馏方法仅依赖输出token分布不足以压缩MLLM，而蒸馏注意力信号虽被探索，但哪些注意力信号更有效尚不明确。本文发现下游性能与响应-视觉注意力相似性强相关，而与提示-视觉注意力相似性无关，且注意力分布在单个token间差异大，统一蒸馏目标效果不佳。
Method: 提出TRAG蒸馏目标：1）聚焦于响应-视觉注意力信号；2）基于注意力熵对每个token自适应加权KL散度，实现token级特异性目标，引导学生精确匹配教师的视觉关注。
Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验结果表明，TRAG显著优于先前蒸馏基线。
Conclusion: 论文强调响应-视觉注意力比提示-视觉注意力更关键，且自适应token级加权策略有效提升了蒸馏效果。

papers.title: H-OPD: Confidence Aware Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher Multimodal On-policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as an effective post-training paradigm by providing supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, existing OPD methods for multimodal reasoning usually rely on a static teacher routing, assigning each sample to a single teacher based on modality or task type. This ignores that visual grounding and abstract reasoning may dominate different decoding steps, making a single teacher insufficient for the full trajectory. To this end, H-OPD is proposed as a confidence-aware heterogeneous multi-teacher OPD framework for multimodal reasoning. By verifying the complementarity of heterogeneous teachers in the same reasoning process, H-OPD replaces task or sample level teacher routing with token-level teacher arbitration along the shared student trajectory. H-OPD employs vision-to-language description transfer to enable text-only teachers to access key visual semantics, and uses a confidence-aware arbitration mechanism to dynamically combine vision-language teacher and text-only teachers at each token. Extensive evaluations over 11 widely-used reasoning benchmarks showcase the superior performance of our method.
papers.comment: Technical report(work-in-progress). Code will be available at \url{https://github.com/buptyqx/H-OPD}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 H-OPD，一种置信度感知的异构多教师在线蒸馏框架，用于多模态推理。它通过 token 级教师仲裁替代样本级路由，利用视觉到语言描述转换使文本教师获取视觉语义，并动态组合视觉语言教师和文本教师。在 11 个推理基准上表现优越。
Motivation: 现有在线蒸馏方法依赖静态教师路由，每个样本分配单一教师，忽略了视觉基础和抽象推理在不同解码步骤占主导，单一教师不足以指导完整轨迹。
Method: H-OPD 采用异构多教师框架，通过 token 级仲裁动态选择教师，引入视觉到语言描述转换使文本教师感知视觉信息，并使用置信度感知机制融合教师输出。
Result: 在 11 个广泛使用的推理基准上，H-OPD 取得了优越性能，表明其有效性。
Conclusion: H-OPD 通过 token 级教师仲裁和视觉-语言转换，有效提升了多模态推理的在线蒸馏效果。
