papers.title: CPR: Chained Perceptual Refinement for Coarse-to-Fine Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: High resolution medical images contain fine grained, spatially sparse cues that are critical for diagnosis, yet preserving full resolution incurs substantial computational and memory costs. Most deep models process images uniformly, leading to redundant computation or loss of diagnostic detail under downsampling. We propose Chained Perceptual Refinement, CPR, a coarse to fine framework that formulates medical image analysis as a sequential global to local decision process. Starting from a low resolution global view, CPR dynamically predicts the location and spatial extent of refinement regions, extracts high resolution evidence from the original image, and incrementally integrates it with global context. By keeping the backbone input size fixed while contracting the perceptual field, CPR preserves diagnostic fidelity with constant peak GPU memory. Extensive experiments on five medical imaging datasets and multiple backbone architectures demonstrate that CPR consistently outperforms both fixed resolution and multi scale state of the art baselines, achieving improvements of up to 2.27 percentage points over the second best method. It also achieves up to a 19.6 fold reduction in GFLOPs at matched accuracy, establishing a superior accuracy and efficiency trade off for high resolution medical image analysis. The code is available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出链式感知精化（CPR），一个用于医学图像分类的粗到细框架。CPR从低分辨率全局视图开始，动态预测精化区域，从原始图像提取高分辨率证据并逐步整合，在保持恒定峰值显存的同时提升诊断保真度。实验表明，在五个医学成像数据集上，CPR以更低的计算成本（最高19.6倍GFLOPs降低）取得了优于固定分辨率和多尺度基线的分类准确率（最高提升2.27个百分点）。
Motivation: 高分辨率医学图像中包含细微且稀疏的诊断线索，但全分辨率处理计算和内存成本高昂；传统下采样方法会丢失细节，而均匀处理方式导致冗余计算。
Method: 提出链式感知精化（CPR），一种粗到细框架：先以低分辨率全局视图输入，动态预测需要精化的区域位置和空间范围，再从原始图像提取高分辨率证据，逐步与全局上下文整合。骨干输入尺寸固定，通过收缩感知野来保持峰值GPU内存恒定。
Result: 在五个医学成像数据集上，CPR在多个骨干网络下一致超越固定分辨率和多尺度基线，最高提升准确率2.27个百分点；在匹配精度下，GFLOPs降低最多19.6倍。
Conclusion: CPR实现了高分辨率医学图像分析中准确性与效率的优越权衡，代码已开源。

papers.title: Homer: Understanding Long-form Videos with Hierarchical Memory and Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models excel on short clips but struggle on hour-long videos in an online setting, where frames are processed incrementally under limited memory. Existing online methods either retain compact visual representations that lack semantic structure, or build higher-level memory stores organized around temporal proximity rather than explicit causal links, leaving multi-hop narrative reasoning to be reconstructed by the LLM at every query. We bridge this gap with \textsc{Homer}, a Hierarchical Online Memory Exploration and Reasoning framework. \textsc{Homer}'s memory mirrors the multi-scale structure of long videos, ranging from raw perception, to recurring entities, to events connected by explicit temporal and causal relations. Its agentic reasoner then explores this memory the way humans do, locating the relevant scene, looking up details, and composing the answer through multi-round memory retrieval, with a harness that verifies and corrects each step. \textsc{Homer} outperforms the previous best agent method by $+5.5$, $+10.8$, and $+4.4$ points on M3-Bench-robot, M3-Bench-web, and Video-MME-Long, and consistently lifts three various LLM backbones, indicating a model-agnostic structural capability for grounded retrieval over long videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Homer，一种层次化在线记忆探索与推理框架，用于理解小时级长视频。Homer构建多尺度记忆结构，涵盖原始感知、重复实体和带有显式时间因果关联的事件，并通过代理推理器进行类似人类的多轮记忆检索，同时配备验证和修正机制。在M3-Bench-robot、M3-Bench-web和Video-MME-Long基准上，Homer分别超过此前最佳agent方法+5.5、+10.8和+4.4点，并在多种LLM骨干上持续提升，展示了模型无关的结构化长视频检索能力。
Motivation: 现有在线长视频方法要么保留紧致但缺乏语义结构的视觉表示，要么按时间邻近而非因果关联组织记忆，导致多跳叙事推理需每次由LLM重构，效率与准确性不足。
Method: Homer包含层次化记忆模块，模拟长视频的多尺度结构（原始感知、重复实体、时间因果事件），以及代理推理器，通过多轮检索定位相关场景、查阅细节并组合答案，并配有验证修正机制。
Result: 在M3-Bench-robot、M3-Bench-web和Video-MME-Long上分别比此前最佳agent方法提升+5.5、+10.8和+4.4个点，且在多种LLM骨干上均有效。
Conclusion: Homer的层次化记忆与代理推理能够实现基于grounded检索的长视频理解，且该方法具有模型无关性，可迁移至不同LLM。

papers.title: The Moving Target: A Longitudinal Audit of Trustworthiness Drift Across Twelve Checkpoints of Open-Source Chat LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Model cards quote trust-benchmark scores without recording when they were measured, and the same number is routinely carried across successive checkpoints of one release line as if the model behind it had not shifted. We test whether it has shifted by auditing four open-source release lines, Yi, Qwen, Mistral, and Gemma, at three successive generations each, on a fixed basket of trust benchmarks under multiple prompt templates. Mean absolute adjacent-generation drift lands well above an independence-based no-drift reference null, and the gap persists when we drop a benchmark, drop a release line, or switch to strict scoring. We therefore conclude that a trust score attached to a release line should not be carried forward to the next checkpoint without remeasurement; it should instead be reported as a checkpoint-bound, dated artefact, which we package as a longitudinal model card. Closed APIs, larger models, canonical benchmark protocols, and fixed month-cadence rules lie outside the audited scope and require their own evaluation.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 2 figures; accepted as a poster at the ICML 2026 TAIGA Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对四个开源聊天LLM系列（Yi、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma）的多个检查点进行纵向审计，发现相邻检查点之间的信任基准分数存在显著漂移，且该漂移在多种提示模板和严格评分下依然存在。作者据此提出，信任分数应作为检查点绑定、带日期的制品，而非跨检查点复用。
Motivation: 现有模型卡引用信任基准分数时未记录测量时间，且同一分数常被沿用至后续检查点，但模型本身已发生变化，导致分数可靠性存疑。
Method: 审计四个开源LLM系列（每个系列三个连续检查点），在固定信任基准集上使用多种提示模板测量分数漂移，并与无关漂移参考零进行比较。
Result: 平均绝对相邻生成漂移显著高于独立性假设下的无漂移参考零，且该结果在剔除单个基准、系列或改用严格评分后依然稳健。
Conclusion: 信任分数不应跨检查点携带，而应作为检查点绑定、带日期的制品报告，并建议采用纵向模型卡形式。

papers.title: Auditing the Audit: Five Failure Modes in Benchmark-Validity Audits
papers.abstract_en: Governance frameworks ask AI providers and auditors for documented evaluation evidence, and perturbation-based construct-validity audits are a common form of that evidence. We argue the audits are themselves fragile: their conclusions can be silently manufactured by implementation details that readers cannot see in the reported numbers. We name five classes of pipeline failure and demonstrate each in a self-audit over safety benchmarks and open-weight instruction-tuned models. Under a unified six-point due-diligence gate, every cell lands in a non-confirmatory bucket, and no cell reaches confirmatory. The evidence here is a single two-model, five-benchmark case study, and F1--F5 is an illustrative, deliberately non-exhaustive starting taxonomy -- not a comprehensive partition of audit failures. We position the gate as a withholding and disclosure protocol for assurance-grade evidence, supplementary to (not a replacement for) classical construct-validity evidence, and not as a route to benchmark-validity verdicts.

papers.title: Reliability-Aware CT-MRI Registration: A Quality Engineering Framework with Stability Analysis and Risk Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal CT-MRI registration is central to image-guided radiotherapy, surgical navigation, and diagnostic workflows, but most pipelines report only aggregate quality metrics without per-case reliability signals. We propose a reliability-aware framework that converts registration quality into Green/Yellow/Red risk categories using data-learned thresholds. CT images were registered to T1-weighted MRI using rigid and affine transformations on 90 paired slices from 18 patients across brain, abdominal, and neck anatomies. Reliability was assessed using Delta NMI, Delta SSIM, Dice overlap, registration stability, and inverse consistency error, combined into a single score R. Thresholds learned from training patients were applied unchanged to held-out test patients. Affine registration outperformed rigid registration on NMI and SSIM, yielding 44% Green classifications versus 33% for rigid. Reliability-filtered registrations improved the average alignment profile compared with unfiltered methods. Per-anatomy analysis showed substantial variation, with stronger reliability for abdominal registrations than brain registrations. Weight sensitivity analysis identified Dice overlap as the dominant reliability component. The proposed framework provides an interpretable quality-control layer for multimodal registration, while risk thresholds reflect statistical rather than clinical validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可靠性感知的CT-MRI多模态配准框架，将配准质量转换为绿/黄/红风险类别。基于18名患者的90对脑部、腹部和颈部切片，采用刚性/仿射变换，利用Delta NMI、Delta SSIM、Dice重叠等指标组合成综合可靠性评分R，并在测试集上验证。仿射配准效果优于刚性，但不同解剖部位差异显著。
Motivation: 现有配准方法仅报告整体质量指标，缺乏逐病例的可靠性信号，难以在临床中信任配准结果。
Method: 提出将配准质量分为三类的可靠性框架：基于训练数据学习阈值，将Delta NMI、Delta SSIM、Dice重叠、配准稳定性和逆一致性误差组合为单一可靠性评分R，应用于CT-MRI配准。
Result: 仿射配准在NMI和SSIM上优于刚性，产生44%绿色分类（刚性33%）；可靠性过滤后的配准改善了平均对齐；腹部配准可靠性高于脑部；Dice重叠是主导可靠性成分。
Conclusion: 该框架为多模态配准提供了可解释的质量控制层，但风险阈值基于统计而非临床验证。

papers.title: RotateAttention: RoPE-Aware Rotation and Range Rectification for INT4 Quantized Attention in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: In \textbf{DiT-based video generation models equipped with 3D Rotary Position Embeddings (3D RoPE)}, the attention mechanism remains a primary computational bottleneck due to its quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. While quantized \textbf{FlashAttention} offers a promising path toward hardware acceleration, existing low-bit quantization methods overlook two critical challenges in this setting: \textbf{1)} applying online rotation matrices -- a widely used technique for mitigating outliers in Queries ($Q$) and Keys ($K$) -- is difficult to reconcile with \textbf{RoPE}; and \textbf{2)} the non-negative attention matrix $P = \exp(QK - \max(QK))$ makes symmetric quantization waste half of the 4-bit dynamic range. In this work, we observe that the outlier distributions of $Q$ and $K$ are strongly affected by the dimensional partitioning of \textbf{3D RoPE}. Based on this finding, we propose \textbf{RotateAttention}, an efficient \textbf{mixed-precision INT4 FlashAttention} framework tailored for \textbf{DiT-based video generation models with 3D RoPE}, using selective \textbf{FP16 fallback} for accuracy-sensitive attention blocks and denoising steps. RotateAttention introduces two core techniques: \textbf{1) RoPE-aware Rotation}, which employs either mergeable rotation matrices that can be fused into RoPE or negligible-overhead matrices to mitigate RoPE-induced outliers in $Q$ and $K$; and \textbf{2) Range-optimized $P$ Quantization}, which uses fixed scales and zero-points to fully exploit the \textbf{INT4 numerical range} with minimal computational overhead. Experiments show that \textbf{RotateAttention} preserves video generation quality nearly identical to full-precision baselines while achieving up to 1.68$\times$ end-to-end speedup and 2.2$\times$ kernel-level acceleration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于DiT和3D RoPE的视频生成模型，提出RotateAttention——一种混合精度INT4 FlashAttention框架。通过RoPE-aware旋转（融合或低开销矩阵）和Range-optimized P量化（固定缩放和零点），解决了在线旋转矩阵与RoPE兼容性差、非负注意力矩阵对称量化浪费动态范围的问题。实验表明，该方法在保持几乎全精度生成质量的同时，实现端到端1.68倍、kernel级2.2倍加速。
Motivation: 现有低比特量化方法用于视频生成模型的FlashAttention时，忽略了两个关键挑战：在线旋转矩阵难以与RoPE融合，以及非负注意力矩阵使对称INT4量化浪费一半动态范围。
Method: 提出RotateAttention框架，包含两项核心技术：1) RoPE-aware Rotation，采用可合并到RoPE的旋转矩阵或低开销矩阵来抑制Q/K中的RoPE异常值；2) Range-optimized P Quantization，使用固定缩放和零点充分利用INT4数值范围，计算开销极低。
Result: 在DiT-based视频生成任务上，RotateAttention的生成质量几乎与全精度基线一致，端到端加速高达1.68倍，kernel级加速达2.2倍。
Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了3D RoPE下INT4量化注意力的异常值和量化范围浪费问题，为视频生成模型提供了高效的混合精度加速方案。

papers.title: Evaluating Intellectual Property Guardrails of Generative Image Models: A Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Generative image models are capable of producing images that bear a strong resemblance to, or replicate, recognizable intellectual property (IP). In this technical report, we present a benchmark and automated evaluation pipeline to test for evidence of IP guardrails in generative image models along with the propensity for these models to generate images with recognizable IP. The IP categories we tested include fictional characters, celebrity likeness, and commercial logos and do not encompass the full range of IP which may be implicated by image generation models. We evaluated fourteen widely used text-to-image models, including three self-hosted open weights models and eleven private models. While all of the private models were observed to refuse generations at some level due to IP guardrails, the frequency of generation refusals varied substantially among models. The refusal rates also varied considerably across the different IP categories tested. Commercial logos were refused least frequently and were successfully generated at the highest rate, on average. Though the rate varies, all models tested readily generated images containing recognizable IP as of March 2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该技术报告提出了一个基准和自动化评估流水线，用于测试生成图像模型中的知识产权防护栏（IP guardrails）以及生成可识别IP图像的趋势。测试了14个文本到图像模型（包括3个开源权重和11个私有模型），涵盖虚构角色、名人肖像和商业标志三类IP。发现所有私有模型都因IP防护栏而拒绝部分生成，但拒绝率在模型和IP类别间差异显著；商业标志被拒绝最少且生成成功率最高。截至2026年3月，所有模型仍可生成包含可识别IP的图像。
Motivation: 生成图像模型可能复制或生成与受保护知识产权高度相似的图像，现有防护措施的有效性缺乏系统评估。
Method: 构建包含三类IP（虚构角色、名人肖像、商业标志）的基准，并设计自动化评估流水线，测试14个主流文本到图像模型（自托管开源权重和私有模型）的生成拒绝率和成功生成率。
Result: 所有私有模型均有不同程度拒绝，但拒绝率差异大；商业标志拒绝率最低且生成成功率最高；即使有防护，所有模型仍能生成包含可识别IP的图像。
Conclusion: 当前生成图像模型的IP防护栏效果不均，商业标志保护最弱，模型仍存在生成侵权内容的风险。

papers.title: Classroom Behavior Monitoring with YOLO An Empirical Study in Higher Education Settings
papers.abstract_en: Classroom behavior monitoring plays a vital role in evaluating student engagement and improving teaching effectiveness. Traditional observation methods remain subjective and lack scalability. This study introduces a real-world dataset of classroom videos collected at the Banking Academy of Vietnam (BAV-Classroom dataset), annotated with nine distinctive behavioral categories. State-of-the-art Computer Vision models were evaluated and compared, with YOLOv11 achieving the best performance. Experimental results indicate that students' concentration often decreases notably during the final part of lectures, highlighting challenges in sustaining engagement. Our findings demonstrate the feasibility of applying computer vision for automated classroom monitoring, providing valuable insights for academic quality management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个真实课堂视频数据集（BAV-Classroom），标注了九种行为类别，并评估了多种计算机视觉模型。YOLOv11在课堂行为识别中表现最佳，实验发现学生注意力在课程后半段显著下降。研究证明了计算机视觉在自动课堂监控中的可行性，为学术质量管理提供参考。
Motivation: 传统课堂观察方法主观性强且难以规模化，亟需自动化的行为监控系统以提升教学评估的客观性和效率。
Method: 收集越南银行学院的课堂视频数据，标注九种行为类别，对比YOLOv11等SOTA计算机视觉模型的识别性能。
Result: YOLOv11在所有模型中准确率最高；学生注意力在课堂后半段显著下降，表明持续参与度不足。
Conclusion: 该研究验证了基于计算机视觉的课堂行为监控的可行性，为高校教学质量改进提供了数据驱动的工具。

papers.title: CORA: Per-Slice Coherent Orthogonal Rotation for SVD-based Low-Rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) commonly adapts pretrained weights through low-rank updates, and recent methods further exploit the singular value decomposition (SVD) of the base weight for initialization or subspace selection. However, these methods do not explicitly preserve the coupled geometry between the pretrained left and right singular bases. Motivated by recent minimum-perturbation theory, which shows that stable finetuning follows a coherent SVD rotation in which a single orthogonal $Q$ acts on both the left singular basis $U_0$ and the right singular basis $V_0$, we prove a per-slice analogue: each row slice of $W_0$ can be adapted by a shared orthogonal rotation $Q_i$ on its left basis $U_i$ and right basis $V_i$ together with a diagonal spectrum shift. We implement this form as CORA (Coherent Orthogonal Rotation Adaptation), which applies per-slice orthogonal rotations and a per-layer diagonal scale to the rank-$r$ SVD truncation of $W_0$. CORA uses $\tfrac{1}{2}m(r{-}1)$ trainable parameters per linear layer, about $4{\times}$ fewer than LoRA at the same rank. CORA outperforms LoRA, DoRA, PiSSA, and MiLoRA on commonsense reasoning and code generation while using about $8{\times}$ fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于SVD的低秩适应方法中缺乏对左右奇异基之间几何耦合的显式保持的问题，提出了CORA方法，对每个切片应用正交旋转和对角缩放。在常识推理和代码生成任务上，CORA使用比LoRA少4倍参数，但性能优于LoRA、DoRA等。
Motivation: 现有SVD初始化的PEFT方法没有显式保持预训练权重左右奇异基之间的耦合几何，而近期最小扰动理论表明稳定微调需要一致的SVD旋转。
Method: 提出CORA，对基础权重的秩-r SVD截断应用每个切片的正交旋转和每层对角缩放，每个线性层仅需½m(r-1)个可训练参数。
Result: 在常识推理和代码生成任务上，CORA使用比LoRA少约8倍参数（单个线性层约4倍），性能优于LoRA, DoRA, PiSSA, MiLoRA。
Conclusion: 摘要表明CORA实现了参数效率与性能的双重改进，但未明确讨论局限性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有SVD初始化的PEFT方法没有显式保持预训练权重左右奇异基之间的耦合几何，而近期最小扰动理论表明稳定微调需要一致的SVD旋转。
summary_sections.method: 提出CORA，对基础权重的秩-r SVD截断应用每个切片的正交旋转和每层对角缩放，每个线性层仅需½m(r-1)个可训练参数。
summary_sections.result: 在常识推理和代码生成任务上，CORA使用比LoRA少约8倍参数（单个线性层约4倍），性能优于LoRA, DoRA, PiSSA, MiLoRA。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明CORA实现了参数效率与性能的双重改进，但未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Criterion-Conditional In-Context Learning: Evaluating Criterion-Shift Adaptation in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models can perform new tasks without parameter updates through in-context learning (ICL), whose core mechanism is utilizing the support set for task induction. In the standard ICL setting, once the task is induced, its decision criterion remains fixed. However, in real-world applications, many tasks exhibit a stable high-level intent, while their decision criteria shift according to specific requirements. Thus, we introduce a new setting, denoted as Criterion-Conditional In-Context Learning (CC-ICL), where models must infer the latent criterion from context and adjust predictions accordingly under fixed task semantics. To evaluate this capability, we propose two complementary metrics, Criterion Invariance and Criterion Sensitivity, capturing the model's robustness and adaptability under criterion shifts. We further construct CC-Bench, a multi-domain benchmark that supports evaluation under the CC-ICL setting. By employing a dual-level data hierarchy, CC-Bench enables legitimate ground-truth variation conditioned on the active criterion even when the task remains fixed. Experiments on CC-Bench reveal that most models exhibit a rigid boundary bias, struggling to align their decisions with the latent criterion. We also find that even a simple multi-criterion training strategy can significantly reduce this bias, improving Criterion Sensitivity and enabling 7B-scale models to surpass proprietary models without degrading general multimodal performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的上下文学习设置——准则条件上下文学习（CC-ICL），要求视觉语言模型在固定任务语义下根据上下文推断潜在准则并调整预测。作者构建了多领域基准CC-Bench，并提出准则不变性和准则敏感性两个互补指标。实验表明，大多数模型存在刚性边界偏差，难以对齐准则；而简单的多准则训练策略能显著减少偏差，使7B规模模型超越专有模型，且不损害通用多模态性能。
Motivation: 标准上下文学习中任务准则固定，但现实应用中许多任务高层意图稳定而决策准则随需求变化。现有模型缺乏适应准则漂移的能力。
Method: 引入CC-ICL设置，通过双层级数据层次结构构建CC-Bench，使固定任务下真值随活跃准则变化；提出准则不变性和准则敏感性指标分别评估模型鲁棒性和适应性。
Result: 在CC-Bench上，大多数模型表现出刚性边界偏差，难以根据潜在准则调整预测。采用多准则训练策略后，7B模型在准则敏感性上显著提升，甚至超越专有模型，且通用多模态性能未下降。
Conclusion: 准则适应是视觉语言模型上下文学习中的关键挑战，多准则训练是一种有效的缓解方法。

papers.title: From Tensor Buffer to Distributed Memory Hierarchy: A Survey of KV Cache Management for LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache has become a first-order memory object in LLM serving rather than a temporary per-request tensor. This survey classifies more than thirty KV-management systems and frameworks using four axes: locality, lifetime, ownership, and substrate. The axes reveal five architectural archetypes -- local-paged, disaggregated-pipeline, shared-store, memory-pool, and hybrid-tier. Once workload and hardware are fixed, ownership accounts for much of the remaining design variance among distributed systems. The survey also audits current evaluations and identifies seven missing KV-specific measurements, linking them to open problems in fault tolerance, isolation, tiered eviction, speculative decoding, MoE serving, and shared-cache semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了超过三十种KV缓存管理系统和框架，使用四个轴（局部性、生命周期、所有权、底层媒体）进行分类，揭示五种架构原型：本地分页、分离流水线、共享存储、内存池和混合层级。摘要还审计了当前评估，指出七个缺失的KV特定测量，并与容错、隔离、分层驱逐、推测解码、MoE服务和共享缓存语义等开放问题相关联。
Motivation: KV缓存已成为LLM服务中的一级内存对象，但现有系统缺乏统一的分类和分析框架，导致设计选择分散。
Method: 使用四个轴（局部性、生命周期、所有权、底层媒体）对KV缓存管理进行分类，识别五种架构原型，并审计现有评估中的缺失。
Result: 发现所有权变量在固定工作负载和硬件后解释了分布式系统中大部分剩余设计差异；识别了七个缺失的KV特定测量指标。
Conclusion: 该调查为KV缓存管理提供了系统性分类，并指出了未来在容错、隔离、分层驱逐等方面的开放问题。

papers.title: Symmetry-Structured Neural Completion of Islamic Geometric Patterns from Sparse Control Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Islamic geometric patterns are governed by exact rotational symmetry and strict construction rules. This paper treats these rules as formal geometric knowledge and embeds them in a neural completion framework, rather than leaving them to be learned statistically from data. Given sparse control geometry and a target symmetry order, the system completes the pattern as a vector graph by predicting edges and refinements of bounded curves over a candidate lattice whose edges are organised into rotational orbits under the cyclic group. Symmetry is enforced either by constraining predictions within these orbits or by projecting them onto them during inference. The orbit-tied variant provides a constructive guarantee: for any input and any orbit-level selection rule, it produces exact N-fold symmetry, preserves anchor points, and keeps all refinements within prescribed bounds. These properties are verified numerically. The study focuses on rotational symmetry, and all quantitative results are obtained from procedurally generated graphs inspired by Islamic geometric design rather than from a historical corpus. On clean inputs, enforcing exact validity produces no measurable loss in fidelity. When control geometry is missing, an unstructured decoder loses fidelity and breaks symmetry; retraining on corrupted inputs recovers much of the fidelity but not exact validity. Symmetry-structured inference, by contrast, keeps violations at zero throughout. The results show that augmentation and symmetry structure address distinct failure modes: augmentation improves fidelity under corruption, while symmetry structure guarantees validity. The framework therefore provides a knowledge-constrained, guarantee-backed approach to neural completion for scalable vector ornaments whose validity depends on exact geometric structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于对称结构的神经网络补全方法，将伊斯兰几何图案的严格构造规则（旋转对称和边界曲线约束）嵌入框架中，而非从数据中统计学习。给定稀疏控制几何和目标对称阶，系统通过在候选格点上预测边和细化曲线完成图案，并利用循环群下的轨道约束强制精确对称性。轨道绑定变体提供构造性保证：对任意输入和轨道级选择规则，产生精确的N重对称、保持锚点并将细化限制在规定范围内。数值结果验证了这些性质。
Motivation: 现有神经网络方法无法保证输出图案满足伊斯兰几何的精确对称性和构造规则，论文旨在通过显式嵌入几何知识实现有保证的神经补全。
Method: 将候选格点图的边组织成循环群下的旋转轨道，通过两种方式强制对称：（1）在轨道内约束预测（orbit-tied），（2）在推理时投影到轨道上。系统基于稀疏控制几何和目标对称阶，预测边缘和细节曲线。
Result: 在干净输入上，强制精确有效性不引起可测的保真度损失。当控制几何缺失时，无结构解码器保真度下降且对称性被破坏；在损坏数据上重训练可恢复部分保真度但无法保证有效性。而对称结构推理始终保持零违规。
Conclusion: 数据增强和对称结构处理不同的失效模式：增强改善损坏下的保真度，对称结构保证有效性。该框架提供了知识约束、有保证的神经补全方法，适用于依赖精确几何结构的可缩放矢量装饰。

papers.title: Additive Causal Construction for Transferable and Reconfigurable Cross-System Learning in Multi-Source Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: In multi-source image fusion scenarios, heterogeneous inputs are typically driven by distinct generative mechanisms and can be viewed as a composition of multiple causal systems. However, cross-system discrepancy (CSD) and cross-system entanglement (CSE) commonly arise during the fusion process, often leading to significant performance degradation under out-of-distribution (OOD) predictions. To address the CSD and CSE issues, we propose the additive causal construction (ACC) framework, which characterizes information fusion at two levels: firstly, it establishes causal "anchors" shared among multiple systems through intervention consistency to enable causal graph transferability (CGT); and secondly, it formalizes the fusion process as causal construction and models the reliability of constructed paths through uncertainty quantification to ensure causal graph reconfigurability (CGR). Building upon this, we revisit the traditional causal representation learning (CRL) with ACC and propose ACC-CRL as a learnable instantiation of the framework. The method explores joint causal content representations across systems via content-mechanism decoupling, and performs response alignment under shared anchors to mitigate CSD. Furthermore, it incorporates structural uncertainty to adaptively regulate the fusion process, thereby suppressing unstable CSE. We conduct systematic experiments on synthetic data (ColorMNIST) and real-world multi-center medical imaging tasks (microvascular invasion (MVI) prediction). The results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves OOD generalization while maintaining in-distribution (ID) performance, validating the effectiveness and robustness of the ACC-CRL strategy based on mechanism alignment and uncertainty modeling in open environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多源图像融合中的跨系统差异（CSD）和跨系统纠缠（CSE）问题，提出加法因果构建（ACC）框架，通过干预一致性建立因果锚点实现图可迁移性，并通过不确定性量化建模融合路径可靠性实现图可重构性。基于此提出ACC-CRL作为可学习实例，在合成数据（ColorMNIST）和真实多中心医学影像任务（微血管侵犯预测）上验证了其在保持分布内性能的同时显著提升分布外泛化能力。
Motivation: 多源图像融合中异构输入由不同生成机制驱动，导致跨系统差异和纠缠，在分布外预测时性能严重下降。
Method: 提出ACC框架：通过干预一致性建立多系统共享的因果锚点（CGT），并用量化不确定性建模融合路径的可靠性（CGR）。实例化为ACC-CRL，通过内容-机制解耦学习联合因果内容表示，在共享锚点下进行响应对齐以缓解CSD，并引入结构不确定性自适应调整融合过程以抑制CSE。
Result: 在ColorMNIST合成数据和真实多中心医学成像任务（MVI预测）上，该方法显著提升了分布外泛化性能，同时保持分布内性能。
Conclusion: 基于机制对齐和不确定性建模的ACC-CRL策略在多源图像融合的开放环境中有效且鲁棒。

papers.title: Dual-Adaptive SAM3: Hierarchical Routing over Low-Rank Expert Layers for Parameter-Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: The Segment Anything Model with Concepts (SAM3) heralds a new paradigm for open-vocabulary segmentation through natural language interaction, offering significant potential for medical image analysis. However, effectively adapting such a powerful vision-language model to the diverse and nuanced domain of medical imaging remains a key challenge. Naive fine-tuning is parameter-inefficient, while standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) methods introduce prohibitive computational overhead, limiting their clinical applicability. To address this, we propose Dual-Adaptive SAM3 (DA-SAM3), a novel framework that achieves both high segmentation accuracy and extreme parameter efficiency via a dual-adaptive specialization mechanism. Our first adaptation is task-aware: a Dynamic Expert Router (DER) that sparsely activates the most relevant experts by jointly reasoning about the visual input and the textual concept prompt, mimicking a clinical consultation process. Our second adaptation is parameter-aware: a Decomposed Parameterized Experts (DPE) design that represents each expert as a shared frozen base (inherited from the pretrained SAM3) and a lightweight trainable low-rank delta, reducing MoE parameter overhead by over 80\%. Extensive experiments on multiple public medical segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that Dual-Adaptive SAM3 not only matches or exceeds the accuracy of fully fine-tuned SAM3 and standard MoE baselines, but also achieves a notable 5\% gain over current state-of-the-art methods, with interpretable results validating its effectiveness. The code is available at: https://github.com/Reconsider80/DA-SAM3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual-Adaptive SAM3 (DA-SAM3)，通过双自适应专业化机制将 SAM3 适配到医学图像分割，在保持高精度的同时实现极端参数效率。任务自适应采用动态专家路由器 (DER) 稀疏激活相关专家，参数自适应采用分解参数化专家 (DPE) 将每个专家表示为共享冻结基座和轻量可训练低秩增量，减少 MoE 参数开销超过 80%。实验表明 DA-SAM3 匹配或超越全微调 SAM3 及标准 MoE 基线，并在多个公开医学分割基准上比当前最先进方法提升 5%。
Motivation: 将强大的视觉语言模型 SAM3 适配到多样化且细微的医学图像领域仍是关键挑战；简单微调参数效率低，而标准 MoE 方法计算开销大，限制临床可用性。
Method: 提出 Dual-Adaptive SAM3，包含 Dynamic Expert Router (DER) 和 Decomposed Parameterized Experts (DPE)。DER 通过联合推理视觉输入和文本概念提示稀疏激活最相关的专家；DPE 将每个专家分解为共享冻结基座和轻量可训练低秩增量，降低 MoE 参数开销 80% 以上。
Result: 在多个公开医学分割基准上，DA-SAM3 匹配或超过全微调 SAM3 和标准 MoE 基线，并且相比当前最先进方法取得 5% 的提升，结果具有可解释性。
Conclusion: 双自适应机制实现了高分割准确度与极端参数效率的平衡，为医学图像分割提供了一种实用的参数高效微调范式。

summary_sections.motivation: 将强大的视觉语言模型 SAM3 适配到多样化且细微的医学图像领域仍是关键挑战；简单微调参数效率低，而标准 MoE 方法计算开销大，限制临床可用性。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Dual-Adaptive SAM3，包含 Dynamic Expert Router (DER) 和 Decomposed Parameterized Experts (DPE)。DER 通过联合推理视觉输入和文本概念提示稀疏激活最相关的专家；DPE 将每个专家分解为共享冻结基座和轻量可训练低秩增量，降低 MoE 参数开销 80% 以上。
summary_sections.result: 在多个公开医学分割基准上，DA-SAM3 匹配或超过全微调 SAM3 和标准 MoE 基线，并且相比当前最先进方法取得 5% 的提升，结果具有可解释性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 双自适应机制实现了高分割准确度与极端参数效率的平衡，为医学图像分割提供了一种实用的参数高效微调范式。

papers.title: DOSE-I: A Multimodal Biosignal Dataset of Procedural Sedation for Endoscopy -- Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: In this document, we describe characteristics and technical details of the multimodal biosignal dataset DOSE-I of procedural sedation for endoscopy published on zenodo. The DOSE-I dataset includes 78.5 hours of recording in 171 records ranging from 6.7 to 70.8 minutes (mean: 27.5, SD: 11.6) of 281 endoscopic procedures. 1129 (median: 6 per record) transitions of consciousness and 7328 (median: 39 per record) individual sedation depth labels were recorded. In addition to clinically annotated biosignals, the DOSE-I dataset provides detailed static data about the respective study subject and metadata about the respective recordings. To further support future research, we provide details about artifact detection and preprocessed pEEG features, too. C code used for this preprocessing is provided separately via Github.
papers.comment: Dataset can be accessed via zenodo DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18483292 For citation use the primary academic reference: Garbe J et al. Towards predicting sedation depth in endoscopy with large clinically annotated EEG data of continuous Propofol sedation. In: P. Andreevetal (Eds.): AIME2026, LNAI 16749, p.1-6, Springer, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-30813-9_58

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Last-Layer Adaptation of RETFound for Referable Diabetic Retinopathy Screening Under Dataset Shift
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a safety-centered empirical evaluation of uncertainty-aware last-layer adaptation for referable diabetic retinopathy screening using RETFound, a self-supervised vision-transformer retinal foundation model used here as a frozen feature encoder, and the public APTOS 2019 and DDR diabetic retinopathy fundus image datasets. We compare a cached-feature softmax head, post-hoc temperature scaling, variational Bayesian last-layer heads, a diagonal Laplace last-layer approximation, and an SNGP-style cached-feature head. On APTOS, uncertainty-aware operating points improved sensitivity and selective-referral behavior. The strongest APTOS selective-referral result deferred approximately 20 percent of cases and reduced accepted-case false negatives to zero while preserving high accepted-case specificity. However, threshold tuning also reduced false negatives at high false-positive cost, so false-negative reduction alone was not unique to Bayesian modeling. On DDR, native Bayesian heads qualitatively reproduced the APTOS direction but with weaker tradeoffs, while the APTOS-trained SNGP checkpoint transferred poorly and failed to provide useful external selective-referral behavior. These results highlight the value of safety-centered evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy: uncertainty-aware last-layer heads can improve internal safety-oriented operating points, but trustworthy retinal screening claims require explicit safety-coverage evaluation and second-dataset validation under shift.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 8 tables, 6 figures. Code available at https://github.com/kmardhani/uncertainty-aware-retfound
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对基于RETFound（自监督视觉Transformer基础模型）的不确定性感知最后一层适应方法进行安全中心的实证评估，用于可转诊糖尿病视网膜病变筛查。在APTOS和DDR数据集上比较了多种最后一层方法（softmax头、温度缩放、变分贝叶斯等），发现不确定性感知操作点能改善敏感性和选择性转诊行为，最佳结果推迟约20%病例并将接受病例假阴性降至零，但成本是高假阳性，且转移至DDR时效果较差。
Motivation: 现有视网膜病变筛查模型在数据集偏移下性能下降，缺乏安全导向的评估，本文旨在评估不确定性感知方法在内部和外部数据上的安全性能。
Method: 比较了六种最后一层适应方法：缓存特征softmax头、后验温度缩放、变分贝叶斯最后一层头、对角拉普拉斯最后一层近似、以及SNGP风格缓存特征头。
Result: 在APTOS上，不确定性感知操作点将敏感性和选择性转诊行为提升，最佳设定推迟约20%病例并将接受病例假阴性降至零（保持高特异性）；但在DDR上转移差，SNGP头无法提供有用的外部选择性转诊行为。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知最后一层头可改善内部安全操作点，但可靠筛查需要明确的安全-覆盖评估和第二数据集验证；假阴性减少并非贝叶斯建模独有。

papers.title: MAGE: View-guided Point Cloud Completion with Efficient Modality Alignment and Adaptive Geometry Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: View-based point cloud completion aims to recover a complete 3D shape from a partial point cloud, guided by a single-view image. However, existing approaches often suffer from limited performance due to weak modality alignment and limited self-geometry enhancement. To overcome these challenges, we propose a unified geometry-aware framework that integrates efficient modality alignment and adaptive geometry enhancement, mainly to address cross-modal geometric inconsistency of view-guided point cloud completion. Specifically, we propose a geometry-aware modality alignment by integrating a shared self-attention Transformer and cross-modality reconstruction supervision, which aims to bring features of the image and point cloud close to each other in a shared latent space describing the 3D object. To enhance the perception of global shape and local geometric details, we propose an adaptive geometry-aware self-attention module, which simultaneously considers local geometry-aware attention computation and the spatially-variant feature fusion. In addition, we apply a geometry-perceptive anchor refinement module to reorganize the anchor points (representing a local region of the shape) under appropriate supervision, further boosting the completion performance of our method. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance over existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/weizequan/MAGE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAGE框架，用于基于单视图图像引导的部分点云补全。通过共享自注意力Transformer的几何感知模态对齐、自适应几何感知自注意力模块以及几何感知锚点精炼模块，解决跨模态几何不一致和自几何增强不足的问题。在合成和真实数据集上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有基于视图的点云补全方法受限于模态对齐弱和自几何增强不足，导致性能有限。本文旨在解决跨模态几何不一致问题。
Method: 提出统一几何感知框架，包括：1）几何感知模态对齐，通过共享自注意力Transformer和跨模态重建监督，将图像和点云特征对齐到共享3D潜在空间；2）自适应几何感知自注意力模块，同时考虑局部几何感知注意力计算和空间变化特征融合；3）几何感知锚点精炼模块，在适当监督下重组锚点。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文提出的MAGE框架有效提升了视图引导的点云补全性能。代码将公开。

papers.title: CRODA-ST: Single-Target Cross-Receiver Open-Set Radio Fingerprint Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) provides a physical-layer credential for Internet of Things devices, but open-set decisions become fragile when a threshold calibrated on a source receiver is transferred to a target receiver. Receiver shift can lower the confidence of known transmitters and cause false rejection; closed-set alignment can have the opposite effect by pulling unseen target transmitters into known regions and increasing false acceptance. This letter presents CRODA-ST, a structure-first adaptation framework for singlesource single-target cross-receiver open-set RFFI. Its two components target the bottlenecks behind unreliable source-calibrated rejection: Discriminative Structure Anchoring (DSA) restores target-receiver known-class references from limited labeled target enrollment samples, and Rejection-Oriented Alignment (ROA) reduces receiver-sensitive confidence fluctuations around the anchored structure. On the WiSig ManyTx dataset, CRODA-ST reaches 0.9092 known-class accuracy, 0.9692 AUROC, and 0.9580 OSCR. Score-sweep analysis further reduces FPR90 to 0.0469.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRODA-ST，一种面向单源单目标跨接收器开放集无线电指纹识别的结构优先适配框架。通过判别结构锚定（DSA）和面向拒绝的对齐（ROA）两个组件，解决了接收器偏移导致的已知发射器误拒和未知发射器误纳问题。在 WiSig ManyTx 数据集上，已知类准确率0.9092，AUROC 0.9692，OSCR 0.9580，FPR90降至0.0469。
Motivation: 开放集无线电指纹识别中，在源接收器上校准的阈值迁移到目标接收器时会变得脆弱，导致已知发射器置信度降低（误拒）或未知发射器被拉入已知区域（误纳）。
Method: 提出结构优先适配框架 CRODA-ST，包含两个组件：判别结构锚定（DSA）利用少量带标签的目标注册样本恢复目标接收器上的已知类参考；面向拒绝的对齐（ROA）减少围绕锚定结构的接收器敏感置信度波动。
Result: 在 WiSig ManyTx 数据集上，CRODA-ST 达到已知类准确率0.9092，AUROC 0.9692，OSCR 0.9580，并通过得分扫描分析将 FPR90 降至0.0469。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架有效解决了跨接收器开放集 RFFI 中源校准阈值不可靠的问题。

papers.title: Coordinate Singularities Break Conformal Coverage for Gaze and Head Pose
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free reliability guarantees for vision systems, but these guarantees depend on how prediction errors are measured in the output space. Many vision tasks produce outputs on curved spaces (e.g. gaze directions on the sphere or 3D head rotations), yet intermediate prediction heads, residuals, uncertainty estimates, or conformal scores are often defined in flat coordinate charts such as yaw-pitch or Euler angles. We show that this scoring choice introduces systematic geometric distortion near coordinate singularities (large pitch angles on the sphere and poses approaching gimbal lock in 3D rotations). Across four datasets (ETH-XGaze, Gaze360, BIWI, AFLW2000-3D), slice-conditional coverage at a nominal 90% target drops by 30-50 percentage points in these regions, falling to 38.9% on ETH-XGaze and 42.0% on Gaze360 at gaze pitch above 70 degrees, and to 57.5% on BIWI and 55.2% on AFLW2000-3D at head pose pitch above 60 degrees near gimbal lock, despite marginal coverage remaining near 90%. We prove that this is structural. Scalar thresholding changes the size of chart-coordinate prediction sets but leaves their distorted axis ratios unchanged. To diagnose this hidden failure mode, we show that a simple geometric quantity, the Riemannian volume density, strongly correlates with where coverage collapse occurs. Finally, we show that coordinate-free geodesic scoring removes this distortion. It requires no retraining and adds negligible computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，在视线方向（球面）和3D头部旋转等弯曲输出空间中使用平坦坐标（如偏航-俯仰或欧拉角）进行共形预测评分会引入几何失真，导致靠近坐标奇异性（大俯仰角或万向锁）时覆盖条件性崩溃。在四个基准数据集上，标称90%的切片条件覆盖率下降30-50个百分点。Riemannian体积密度能有效诊断这一失效模式，而无需坐标变换的测地线评分可以消除失真。
Motivation: 现有共形预测方法在弯曲输出空间中通常采用平坦坐标定义评分，但这一选择在坐标奇异性附近引入系统性的几何失真，导致条件覆盖保证失效。
Method: 理论分析证明标量阈值化无法改变预测集的轴比失真；提出用Riemannian体积密度诊断覆盖崩溃区域；采用无坐标的测地线评分（geodesic scoring）替代平坦坐标评分，无需重新训练且计算开销可忽略。
Result: 在ETH-XGaze、Gaze360、BIWI、AFLW2000-3D上，标称90%的切片条件覆盖率在视线俯仰角>70°时降至38.9%和42.0%，在头部姿态俯仰角>60°（接近万向锁）时降至57.5%和55.2%；边际覆盖率仍保持近90%。
Conclusion: 坐标奇异性是共形预测在弯曲空间中的一个结构性失效模式，测地线评分可以有效修复，未来应避免在弯曲输出空间中使用平坦坐标评分。

papers.title: From Raw Segmentations to Simulation-Ready Cardiac Meshes: An Automated Framework for Anatomical Reconstruction and Virtual Cohort Generation
papers.abstract_en: Computational models of the human heart are widely used to study electromechanical and fluid-dynamical cardiac function and to support applications such as in silico clinical trials. However, most studies remain limited to single or patient-specific anatomies, restricting the inclusion of population-level variability required for uncertainty quantification. A key challenge is translating medical-image segmentations, which may contain artifacts, mesh defects or disjoint domains, into topologically coherent geometries suitable for multiphysics simulations. In this work, we present a semi-automatic pipeline that converts CT-based segmentations into simulation-ready cardiac meshes within a few minutes while preserving anatomical and topological consistency. Building on modern deep learning segmentation methods, the framework incorporates a template-based registration stage to regularize artifacts and enforce mesh-quality constraints. A Chamfer-distance morphing strategy deforms a high-quality template toward each segmented heart, matching individual chambers while preserving topology. The resulting meshes are watertight, isotopological, and endowed with consistent point-to-point correspondence. The pipeline is validated on 58 healthy cardiac CT scans, including all cardiac chambers and proximal vessel segments. The resulting meshes can be represented in a unified shape space, enabling the construction of a statistical shape model of the heart and major vessels. Principal Component Analysis shows that a low-dimensional latent space efficiently captures population variability, while Gaussian Mixture Modeling enables synthetic anatomy generation. Overall, the proposed framework (released open-source) provides a pathway from raw segmentations to simulation-ready cardiac geometries, enabling anatomically consistent virtual cohorts for large-scale in silico studies.

Result: 在58个健康心脏CT扫描上验证，生成的网格水密、同位拓扑、具有点对点对应；PCA显示低维潜空间有效捕捉群体变异性，GMM可实现合成解剖结构生成。
Conclusion: 该开源框架为从原始分割到模拟就绪心脏几何提供路径，支持大规模计算研究中解剖一致的虚拟队列构建。

papers.title: Attention Dynamics in Diffusion Models: A Visual Analytics Framework for Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based text-to-image models can synthesize complex and highly structured visual content, yet the emergence and evolution of semantic structure remain difficult to interpret. Many existing workflows rely on aggregated attention or scalar summaries that separate temporal change from image-space evidence. To address this gap, we present a visual analytics framework for exploring attention dynamics in diffusion models: the step-indexed evolution of token-level cross-attention maps, their temporal concentration, and their spatial relationships. Our approach enables structured analysis of attention behavior across generation steps by integrating quantitative measures with data-driven stage identification in an interactive workflow. Case studies on a structured 60-prompt Stable-Diffusion-class benchmark illustrate recurring, interpretable patterns within this setting and show how linked temporal and spatial views facilitate the observation and discussion of generative processes, supporting more effective human-AI collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于探索扩散模型注意力动态的可视分析框架，通过逐步索引的交叉注意力图、时间集中度和空间关系，结合定量指标和数据驱动阶段识别，支持生成过程的结构化分析。在包含60个提示词的Stable-Diffusion类基准案例研究中，展示了可重复的注意模式，并说明时空关联视图如何促进人机协作。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型解释方法多依赖聚合注意力或标量摘要，难以将时间变化与图像空间证据联系起来，阻碍了对语义结构涌现和演化的理解。
Method: 提出了一个交互式可视分析框架，集成逐步索引的token级交叉注意力图、时间集中度指标和空间关系，并结合数据驱动的阶段识别方法。
Result: 在60个提示词的Stable-Diffusion类基准上，案例研究展示了可重复的注意模式，并表明联合时空视图有助于观察和讨论生成过程。
Conclusion: 该框架支持对扩散模型注意力行为的结构化分析，促进更有效的人机协作，但未讨论计算开销或可扩展性。

papers.title: Entropy-Coded MS-VQ-VAE with Learned Priors for Ultra-Low Bitrate Video Compression
papers.abstract_en: Learned video codecs based on continuous latent representations struggle to operate reliably below 0.1 bits per pixel~(bpp): without a differentiable rate signal, Lagrangian optimisation cannot effectively trade reconstruction quality for bitrate at extreme compression ratios. We demonstrate that discrete latent representations sidestep this limitation entirely. In a vector-quantized~(VQ) codec, the codebook size~$K$ imposes a hard information ceiling of $\log_2 K$ bits per symbol; a learned autoregressive prior then exploits the non-uniform distribution of code usage -- which we show follows a power law -- to push actual bitrates well below this ceiling, without any rate-penalty tuning. Building on the MS-VQ-VAE architecture introduced in~\cite{kotthapalli2026msvqvae}, we sweep $K \in \{128, 256, 512, 1024\}$ under a uniform training protocol to trace four operating points on the rate-distortion~(RD) curve. We identify and resolve a critical training instability: gradient-based VQ collapses catastrophically at $K \leq 512$, whereas EMA-stabilised codebook updates with dead-code restart maintain full utilisation across all configurations. On 500 UCF101 test clips ($64\!\times\!64$, 32~frames), our models operate at 0.043-0.064~bpp -- 3.3-5$\times$ below H.264's practical floor and $5$-$7.6\times$ below H.265's floor at this resolution. Every MS-VQ-VAE configuration outperforms H.265 CRF\,36 on perceptual quality (LPIPS) despite using $5$-$7.6\times$ fewer bits. At $K{=}1024$, the model surpasses H.265 CRF\,36 on LPIPS by a margin of 0.072 absolute while using $5.1\times$ fewer bits. Codebook analysis confirms power-law index distributions and 70-85\% entropy efficiency, establishing the pipeline as a principled learned entropy coder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于熵编码的多尺度矢量量化变分自编码器（MS-VQ-VAE），用于超低比特率视频压缩（低于0.1 bpp）。通过离散潜在表示和自回归先验，绕过了连续表示中速率-失真优化的困难。在UCF101测试集上，模型在0.043-0.064 bpp下，感知质量（LPIPS）优于H.265 CRF 36，比特率降低5-7.6倍。证实了码本使用遵循幂律分布，并通过EMA稳定训练和死码重启解决训练不稳定性。
Motivation: 连续潜在表示的学习视频编码器在低于0.1 bpp时难以可靠工作，因为缺乏可微的率信号，无法有效平衡重建质量和比特率。离散潜在表示可以绕过这一限制。
Method: 在MS-VQ-VAE架构基础上，通过变化码本大小K（128,256,512,1024）在统一训练协议下获取四个率失真曲线上的操作点。采用EMA稳定码本更新和死码重启解决训练崩溃问题，并利用学习到的自回归先验利用码本使用的非均匀分布（幂律）降低实际比特率。
Result: 在UCF101 500个测试视频片段（64x64，32帧）上，模型运行在0.043-0.064 bpp，比H.264低3.3-5倍，比H.265低5-7.6倍。所有MS-VQ-VAE配置在感知质量（LPIPS）上均优于H.265 CRF 36，同时使用少5-7.6倍的比特。K=1024时，LPIPS绝对优势0.072，比特减少5.1倍。
Conclusion: 文章建立了基于离散潜在表示和熵编码的学得视频压缩流水线，码本分析确认了幂律分布和70-85%的熵效率，表明该方法是原理性的学得熵编码器。

papers.title: Double-Helix Active Geometry: LiDAR-Anchored Multi-View Depth with Selective Abstention
papers.abstract_en: Consumer depth sensors such as the LiDAR scanner on recent iPhones provide metric range, but their useful range is short and their returns are sparse. We present DH-Active, a lightweight, training-free geometry back-end that treats the sensor as a metric ruler rather than the sole source of depth. Near-field returns anchor the metric relative pose of two views through PnP; visually trackable samples without a valid depth return are then triangulated under that pose. A parallax/reprojection gate abstains wherever the geometry is ill-conditioned, leaving an explicit hole and a selective score instead of forcing an estimate. The measured core front end, including spiral sampling, sparse back-projection, and hole taxonomy but excluding preprocessing and multi-view recovery, runs at 1.11 ms median latency on CPU (OpenCV using 14 threads), about 38 times faster than a DINOv2-L visual branch on GPU in our timing setup. Across two iPhone captures and the public TUM RGB-D and ARKitScenes benchmarks, held-out depth is recovered at 1.4 to 6.7 percent median relative error. In a controlled ARKitScenes protocol that uses only returns within 2 m to set scale and an independent laser scan as ground truth, DH-Active achieves 64.2 percent scene-median coverage of evaluable far-field candidates at 13.4 percent scene-median relative error; direct triangulation from the device trajectory is not usable. We also report the alternatives that failed in our tests: single-frame defocus, classical focus-stack depth, defocus-LiDAR fusion, point-to-point ICP over a good visual-inertial track, and attention-to-holes resampling. A 1.26 B learned model remains more accurate after oracle scale alignment. The contribution here is narrower: metric sparse depth, explicit abstention, zero learned parameters, and near-millisecond CPU cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DH-Active，一种轻量级、免训练的几何后端方法，利用消费级 LiDAR 作为度量尺，通过 PnP 锚定多视图深度估计，并使用视差/重投影门控选择性地放弃条件不良的几何区域。该方法在多个基准上实现中值相对误差 1.4%-6.7%，CPU 延迟 1.11ms，无需学习参数。
Motivation: 消费级 LiDAR 深度传感器范围短且稀疏，现有方法难以在长距离上恢复准确深度，且多为黑盒模型，缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出 DH-Active，通过近场 LiDAR 返回进行 PnP 锚定多视图相对位姿，对无有效深度但可视觉跟踪的样本进行三角测量；设计视差/重投影门控，在几何条件不良时明确放弃估计，留下空洞和选择性分数。
Result: 在 iPhone 捕获、TUM RGB-D 和 ARKitScenes 基准上，恢复深度的中值相对误差为 1.4%-6.7%；在 ARKitScenes 协议下，远场候选覆盖率达 64.2%，中值相对误差 13.4%；CPU 中值延迟 1.11ms（14 线程），比 DINOv2-L GPU 分支快约 38 倍。
Conclusion: 本文贡献在于度量稀疏深度、显式放弃、零学习参数和近毫秒 CPU 成本，适用于现有方法（如单帧散焦、多帧 ICP、注意力重采样等）失败的场景。

papers.title: Inpainting U-Net for seamless pedestrian-level wind prediction across urban morphologies
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian-level wind prediction is essential for urban design and wind-comfort assessment, but high-fidelity simulations such as LES remain computationally expensive for rapid evaluation. This study develops a two-stage U-Net framework for efficient prediction of time-averaged pedestrian-level wind speed over realistic urban morphologies. The model is trained and evaluated using the UrbanTALES dataset, which contains realistic city configurations under different approaching wind directions. In the first stage, a baseline U-Net model (M1) predicts wind fields patch-by-patch from normalised building height and fetch information. This formulation allows application to urban domains of arbitrary size, but independent patch inference can introduce discontinuities at patch boundaries. To address this, a second U-Net model (M2) is introduced as an inpainting-based refinement model. M2 uses a larger contextual window containing the initial M1 prediction and local morphology to reduce discontinuities using neighbouring flow information. During full-field inference, M2 is applied iteratively using a Gauss-Seidel scheme until convergence. Results show that M1 captures the main spatial distribution of pedestrian-level wind speed and performs well in low- and moderate-velocity regions, although high-velocity peaks are less accurate. M2 substantially reduces patch-boundary artefacts and improves spatial coherence. Across unseen urban cases, the framework reproduces mean velocity and spatial variability reasonably well, while maximum velocities remain underestimated. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient and flexible surrogate model for high-resolution pedestrian-level wind prediction across realistic urban morphologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对城市行人级风速预测中高保真模拟计算成本高的问题，提出一个两阶段U-Net框架。第一阶段基线模型M1将城市按块预测风速场，第二阶段基于inpainting的细化模型M2利用邻域信息减少块边界伪影。在UrbanTALES数据集上测试表明，M1能捕捉主要空间分布但高估峰值不准确，M2显著改善空间连续性。整体框架为跨城市形态的高分辨率风速预测提供了高效灵活的代理模型。
Motivation: 高保真模拟如LES计算成本过高，难以快速评估城市设计中的行人级风舒适度，需要高效替代模型。
Method: 两阶段U-Net框架：第一阶段M1从归一化建筑高度和获取信息按块预测风场；第二阶段M2基于inpainting，以更大上下文窗口包含M1预测和局部形态，通过Gauss-Seidel迭代减少边界伪影。
Result: M1能捕捉风速空间分布，在低中速区域表现良好，但高速峰值不准确；M2大幅减少块边界伪影并提升空间一致性。在未见城市案例中，平均速度和空间变异性合理复现，但最大速度仍被低估。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了高效、灵活的高分辨率行人级风速预测代理模型，适用于不同城市形态，但最大风速预测有待改进。

papers.title: How many labels do you need? A decision framework for cross-habitat marine species recognition
papers.abstract_en: Automated image recognition is increasingly used to scale ecological monitoring beyond manual annotation, yet ecologists lack evidence-based guidance on how much labelling effort reliable deployment at new sites requires. We present a decision framework quantifying the trade-off between labelling effort and recognition accuracy when transferring vision systems across marine habitats. The benchmark spans five datasets, three oceans, and three taxonomic groups (fish, corals, invertebrates), from tropical reefs in the Great Barrier Reef and French Polynesia to a temperate Danish fjord. We evaluated four recognition models (DINOv2, CLIP, ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B4) under four adaptation strategies (linear probing, LoRA, Visual Prompt Tuning, full fine-tuning) across three protocols: within-habitat transfer across 20 reef sites (240 runs), cross-dataset geographic transfer along a difficulty gradient (40 runs), and few-shot adaptation curves with 0-100 labelled samples per class (648 runs). Frozen self-supervised foundation features (DINOv2 + linear classifier, 1,538 trainable parameters) generalised to unseen reef sites at least as well as fully fine-tuned convolutional baselines four orders of magnitude larger; they learned species-diagnostic, habitat-invariant representations, whereas baselines encoded habitat-specific shortcuts that fail at new sites. As few as 10-20 labelled images per species sufficed to deploy reliable recognition at a new site, cutting annotation effort by roughly an order of magnitude. Solution. Programmes expanding to new sites can deploy reliable recognition by pairing a frozen, open foundation model (DINOv2) with a simple linear classifier and annotating only 10-20 images per species - roughly 1-4 hours per site. The framework lets programmes budget labelling effort against expected accuracy across sites, ecosystems, and platforms.

papers.title: MLSYSIM: First-Principles Infrastructure Modeling for Machine Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: As machine learning shifts from laboratory curiosity to critical infrastructure, the systems that sustain it span an extraordinary range, from sub-milliwatt microcontrollers to multi-gigawatt datacenter fleets. Reasoning across this range is hard: empirical profiling requires the target hardware in hand, while cycle-accurate simulation costs hours per configuration, leaving no tool for rapid, full-stack architectural reasoning. We present MLSYSIM (Machine Learning Systems Infrastructure Modeling), a first-principles analytical framework that formalizes the "physics of systems" into a dimensionally-strict Python engine. MLSysim is built on a demand-supply abstraction that decouples computational demand from silicon supply and environmental context, and it enforces unit integrity at runtime so the silent conversion errors that plague ad-hoc modeling cannot occur. Every input is drawn from a typed, provenance-tracked registry, so no number enters an analysis without a documented source. On this engine we codify a taxonomy of 22 "Systems Walls" resolved by 28 composable models and solvers, enabling sub-second design-space exploration that identifies binding constraints and synthesizes ideal hardware specifications across the entire ML systems lifecycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MLSYSIM 是一个基于第一性原理的分析框架，用于对机器学习系统基础设施进行建模。它通过需求-供给抽象分离计算需求与硬件供应，并强制执行单元完整性以防止转换错误。框架包含22个系统壁垒和28个可组合模型，能在亚秒内探索设计空间并识别关键约束，覆盖ML系统全生命周期。
Motivation: 机器学习系统范围广泛（从微瓦微控制器到千兆瓦数据中心），但现有工具要么需要实际硬件进行经验分析，要么需要耗时数小时的周期精确模拟，缺乏快速全栈架构推理的工具。
Method: 提出MLSYSIM：一个基于Python的维度严格分析引擎，采用需求-供给抽象，运行时强制单元完整性，所有输入来自带类型和溯源追踪的注册表。在此基础上定义了22个系统壁垒和28个可组合模型与求解器。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但声称能够实现亚秒级设计空间探索，识别绑定约束并合成理想硬件规格。
Conclusion: MLSYSIM 提供了一个快速、可组合的架构推理工具，有助于理解ML系统从芯片到数据中心的基础设施瓶颈。

papers.title: Do Diabetic Foot Ulcer Segmentation Models Generalize? A Cross-Dataset Benchmark of CNN and Transformer Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models for diabetic foot ulcer (DFU) segmentation routinely report high accuracy, but they are almost always trained and tested on the same dataset, leaving their behaviour on data from a different clinical source largely unmeasured. We benchmark three representative segmentation architectures -- U-Net and DeepLabV3+ (convolutional) and SegFormer-B2 (Transformer) -- under an identical, leakage-screened protocol: training on the combined FUSeg/AZH wound data and evaluating, without fine-tuning, on two independent external datasets (DFUC2022 and Medetec). All models achieve strong in-domain performance (Dice 0.80--0.83) but degrade substantially across datasets. The degradation is, however, architecture-dependent: SegFormer-B2 generalizes best on both external sets (DFUC2022 Dice 0.557, Medetec Dice 0.786), outperforming both convolutional models, while the more complex DeepLabV3+ generalizes worse than the simpler U-Net. Per-image failure analysis on 2,160 images across both external test sets confirms that SegFormer-B2 produces the fewest catastrophic failures on DFUC2022 (31.1%), compared with U-Net (38.5%) and DeepLabV3+ (43.0%). The consistent ranking across two independent external sources, confirmed by Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (p < 0.001 on both datasets), indicates that architecture family, not model complexity, drives cross-hospital generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了 CNN 和 Transformer 架构（U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SegFormer-B2）在糖尿病足溃疡（DFU）分割中的跨数据集泛化能力。在相同协议下，所有模型在域内表现良好（Dice 0.80-0.83），但跨数据集时性能显著下降。SegFormer-B2 在两个外部数据集上泛化最佳（DFUC2022 Dice 0.557，Medetec Dice 0.786），且灾难性失败比例最低（31.1%），表明架构类型而非模型复杂度决定了跨医院泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 DFU 分割模型通常在同一数据集上训练和测试，缺乏对不同临床来源数据的泛化性评估，导致实际部署时性能未知。
Method: 采用泄露筛查后的统一协议：在 FUSeg/AZH 组合数据集上训练，不经微调直接在 DFUC2022 和 Medetec 两个独立外部数据集上评估三种架构（U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SegFormer-B2），并进行逐图像失败分析。
Result: SegFormer-B2 在两个外部数据集上 Dice 分别达 0.557 和 0.786，优于 U-Net 和 DeepLabV3+；其灾难性失败比例在 DFUC2022 上为 31.1%，低于 U-Net 的 38.5% 和 DeepLabV3+ 的 43.0%。Wilcoxon 符号秩检验证实排名一致性（p<0.001）。
Conclusion: 架构类型（Transformer 优于 CNN）是跨医院 DFU 分割泛化能力的关键，而非模型复杂度；未来应关注跨数据集泛化评估。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Monocular Depth Supervision for Sparse-View Neural Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view neural reconstruction is challenging in outdoor driving scenes, where cameras usually move along a narrow forward-facing trajectory and provide limited multi-view overlap. Although monocular depth estimators can provide dense geometric priors, their predictions are noisy, and not uniformly reliable across image regions. In this work, we study monocular depth supervision for sparse-view neural reconstruction. We use Depth Anything V2 as a dense monocular depth prior, align its predictions to metric depth using scale-shift fitting, and apply depth supervision selectively through photometric masks generated from an RGB-only baseline model. We evaluate this strategy on two representative scene representations: Mip-NeRF-360 and Splatfacto. On KITTISeq02 under an every2 sparse-view setting, masked monocular depth supervision gives only marginal rendering gains for Mip-NeRF-360 and does not improve metric geometry. In contrast, Splatfacto benefits more clearly, improving PSNR from 14.903 to 15.932 and reducing RMSE from 0.542 to 0.100. Additional KITTISeq05 experiments and matched-ratio mask ablations further show that the gains for Splatfacto come from selecting reliable low-error regions rather than simply reducing the number of depth-supervised pixels. Additional experiments on the Bicycle scene show that depth supervision can improve geometry while hurting RGB rendering quality when multi-view coverage is already strong. Overall, our results suggest that monocular depth priors are useful for under-constrained sparse-view reconstruction, but should be applied selectively and with moderate weighting.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. All authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对室外驾驶场景中稀疏视图神经重建的挑战，研究单目深度监督方法。使用Depth Anything V2作为密集深度先验，通过尺度-平移拟合对齐度量深度，并利用RGB-only基线模型生成的光度掩码选择性应用深度监督。在KITTISeq02和Seq05等数据集上评估了Mip-NeRF-360和Splatfacto两种表示，结果表明选择性深度监督对Splatfacto有显著提升（PSNR从14.903到15.932，RMSE从0.542到0.100），而对Mip-NeRF-360提升有限。
Motivation: 稀疏视图神经重建在室外驾驶场景中因相机运动受限、多视角重叠不足而困难；单目深度估计可提供密集几何先验，但其预测噪声大且在不同区域可靠性不一致。
Method: 采用Depth Anything V2作为单目深度先验，通过尺度-平移拟合将其对齐到度量深度；从RGB-only基线模型（无深度监督）生成光度掩码，仅对掩码区域施加深度监督，实现选择性深度监督。
Result: 在KITTISeq02的every2稀疏视图设置下，Splatfacto的PSNR从14.903提升至15.932，RMSE从0.542降至0.100；Mip-NeRF-360仅获得边际渲染增益。消融实验表明增益来自选择低误差区域而非单纯减少监督像素数。在Bicycle场景中，深度监督可改善几何但损害RGB渲染质量。
Conclusion: 单目深度先验对欠约束稀疏视图重建有用，但应选择性应用并适度加权，以避免对已有多视角覆盖的场景造成负面影响。

papers.title: Interpretable machine learning predicts Parkinson's disease severity using motion-corrected QSM MRI and multiband multiecho fMRI features
papers.abstract_en: Introduction: Objective neuroimaging biomarkers may improve Parkinson's disease motor assessment by capturing brain variation not directly observable from clinical examination. We used interpretable machine learning to predict current motor severity, measured by MDS-UPDRS Part III, from QSM and multiband multi-echo resting-state fMRI-derived ReHo features. Methods: Regional QSM and ReHo features were extracted from 28 participants, including 24 individuals with Parkinson's disease and 4 controls. Thirteen feature-set experiments evaluated imaging-only, clinical-only, imaging-plus-clinical, full, reduced, and multimodal inputs. Support vector regression, Elastic Net, Random Forest, and XGBoost models were trained using nested cross-validation. Performance was assessed using pooled held-out R^2, RMSE, MAE, Pearson correlation, permutation testing, and the proportion of participants predicted within +/-5 MDS-UPDRS Part III points. Results: Imaging-only models carried meaningful predictive signal, whereas the clinical-only model performed weakly. Full fMRI, full QSM, and clinical variables provided the strongest global fit, explaining 45.4% of variance in motor severity. Selected QSM plus clinical variables produced the most clinically close predictions, with 75.0% of participants predicted within +/-5 points and the lowest MAE among top-performing models. SHAP highlighted cerebellar, thalamic, striatal, insular, and motor cortical features. Conclusion: QSM and multiband multi-echo fMRI-derived ReHo capture distinct, interpretable dimensions of Parkinson's disease motor severity. These findings show that structural and functional imaging contribute differently depending on the clinical prediction goal.
papers.comment: 16 pages from main manuscript and 17 pages from supplementary information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用可解释机器学习，从运动校正的QSM MRI和多频段多回波静息态fMRI中提取特征，预测帕金森病运动严重程度（MDS-UPDRS Part III）。研究在28名参与者（24名患者，4名对照）上测试了多种特征组合和模型，发现影像学特征携带显著预测信号，而临床特征单独表现较弱。最佳模型（全fMRI、全QSM和临床变量）解释了45.4%的方差，其中选定的QSM加临床变量使75%参与者的预测误差在±5分内。SHAP解释突出了小脑、丘脑、纹状体、岛叶和运动皮层区域。
Motivation: 帕金森病的运动评估缺乏客观的神经影像生物标志物，临床观察无法捕捉大脑变异。本文旨在利用可解释机器学习从QSM和fMRI特征中预测运动严重程度。
Method: 从28名参与者（24名患者，4名对照）中提取区域QSM和ReHo特征，设计13组特征集实验（包括影像、临床、组合等）。使用支持向量回归、弹性网络、随机森林和XGBoost模型，通过嵌套交叉验证训练，评估指标包括R²、RMSE、MAE、Pearson相关、置换检验和±5分内的预测比例。
Result: 影像学模型携带有意义预测信号，临床模型表现弱。全fMRI、全QSM和临床变量获得最佳全局拟合，解释45.4%的方差。选定的QSM加临床变量产生最临床接近的预测，75%参与者预测误差在±5分内，且MAE最低。SHAP突出小脑、丘脑、纹状体、岛叶和运动皮层特征。
Conclusion: QSM和多频段多回波fMRI衍生的ReHo特征捕捉帕金森病运动严重程度的独立可解释维度，结构和功能成像根据临床预测目标贡献不同。

summary_sections.motivation: 帕金森病的运动评估缺乏客观的神经影像生物标志物，临床观察无法捕捉大脑变异。本文旨在利用可解释机器学习从QSM和fMRI特征中预测运动严重程度。
summary_sections.method: 从28名参与者（24名患者，4名对照）中提取区域QSM和ReHo特征，设计13组特征集实验（包括影像、临床、组合等）。使用支持向量回归、弹性网络、随机森林和XGBoost模型，通过嵌套交叉验证训练，评估指标包括R²、RMSE、MAE、Pearson相关、置换检验和±5分内的预测比例。
summary_sections.result: 影像学模型携带有意义预测信号，临床模型表现弱。全fMRI、全QSM和临床变量获得最佳全局拟合，解释45.4%的方差。选定的QSM加临床变量产生最临床接近的预测，75%参与者预测误差在±5分内，且MAE最低。SHAP突出小脑、丘脑、纹状体、岛叶和运动皮层特征。
summary_sections.conclusion: QSM和多频段多回波fMRI衍生的ReHo特征捕捉帕金森病运动严重程度的独立可解释维度，结构和功能成像根据临床预测目标贡献不同。

papers.title: DELTAVID: Enhancing Fine-Grained Spatiotemporal Perception with Cross-Video Differences
papers.abstract_en: Video multimodal large language models have made strong progress on open-ended video understanding, but they still lack precise local spatiotemporal perception. When two videos share almost the same global semantics and differ only in a short time span or a small region, current models often fail to find the change and provide reliable evidence. We propose DELTAVID, a verifiable proxy-task framework that enhances fine-grained spatiotemporal perception with cross-video differences. The key idea is to turn cross-video spot-the-difference into a trainable perception signal, where a model identifies local changes, judges temporal boundaries, and organizes spatial evidence by comparing similar videos. To make this signal scalable to train and reliable to evaluate, we further introduce DELTAVID-10K and DELTAVID-Bench, which convert controllable local differences in real videos into evidence-labeled training and test samples. Experiments show that DELTAVID substantially improves performance on cross-video difference understanding and transfers the learned local evidence ability to general video understanding benchmarks, including MMVU, MLVU, Video-MME, VideoHolmes, VideoMMMU, LVBench, TempCompass, and LongVideoBench. These results show that cross-video differences are not only an effective way to diagnose fine-grained perception failures, but also a scalable proxy supervision that moves Video MLLMs from coarse semantic understanding toward fine-grained spatiotemporal evidence reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DELTAVID 框架，通过跨视频差异（spot-the-difference）任务增强视频多模态大模型（Video MLLMs）的细粒度时空感知能力。构建了 DELTAVID-10K 训练集和 DELTAVID-Bench 基准，将局部变化识别转化为可训练的信号。实验表明，该方法不仅提升了跨视频差异理解性能，还向多个通用视频理解基准（如 MMVU、MLVU、Video-MME 等）迁移了局部证据推理能力。
Motivation: 现有视频多模态大模型在全局语义理解上表现良好，但在两段仅局部时空差异的视频上难以精准定位变化并提供可靠证据，缺乏细粒度时空感知能力。
Method: 提出 DELTAVID 框架：将跨视频差异任务转化为可验证的代理训练信号，模型需识别局部变化、判断时间边界并组织空间证据。同时构建 DELTAVID-10K（含证据标签的训练样本）和 DELTAVID-Bench（评估基准），基于真实视频的可控局部差异生成数据。
Result: 在跨视频差异理解任务上显著提升性能，并将学到的局部证据能力迁移至 MMVU、MLVU、Video-MME、VideoHolmes、VideoMMMU、LVBench、TempCompass、LongVideoBench 等通用视频理解基准。
Conclusion: 跨视频差异不仅是诊断细粒度感知失败的有效方式，也是可扩展的代理监督信号，推动 Video MLLMs 从粗粒度语义理解走向细粒度时空证据推理。

papers.title: Learning 3D Affordances for Blade Insertion in Cluttered Stowing
papers.abstract_en: Many manipulation tasks require reasoning about free-space affordances: discovering volumes where an extended rigid tool can safely navigate, complementary to surface contact affordances for grasping. Robotic stowing is a canonical instance, where a blade must sweep items aside inside cluttered fabric bins to create insertion space. Production stow systems generate millions of such episodes, but standard approaches with unimodal data infer affordances as SE(3) pose distributions, a geometric question asked in the wrong domain. VulcanVoxel keeps inference spatial: a masked autoencoder over 3D occupancy fields reconstructs blade occupancy conditioned on scene geometry, computing feasibility locally at each voxel and recovering multi-modal predictions from unimodal data. Blade affordances are spatial objects, subsets of 3D space defined by geometric feasibility. Pose parameters carry no structure for reasoning whether unobserved placements are feasible, and standard generative objectives including flow matching faithfully learn the unimodal distribution produced by execution policies and cannot recover geometric alternatives. Trained on 10,000 real warehouse stow episodes without human annotation, VulcanVoxel achieves top-5 coverage of 0.89 versus 0.71 for the best pose-based baseline, with a distilled student providing RGB-to-voxel inference in 30 ms. vs. 1.4 s. for voxel-to-voxel. We have released a dataset of real blade insertion cycles with RGB-D observations and pose trajectories at https://www.armbench.com/blade_insertion. html.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人杂乱收纳中的刀片插入问题，提出VulcanVoxel方法，通过掩码自编码器在3D占据场上重建刀片占据，以场景几何为条件，在每个体素局部计算可行性，从而从单峰数据恢复多模态预测。在10,000个真实仓库收纳场景上训练，无需人工标注，VulcanVoxel的top-5覆盖率达到0.89，优于基于姿态的最佳基线（0.71），且蒸馏学生模型实现RGB到体素的快速推理（30ms）。
Motivation: 现有方法将刀片插入的可供性视为SE(3)姿态分布，但姿态参数缺乏对未观察位置可行性的推理能力，且标准生成目标只能学习执行策略产生的单峰分布，无法恢复几何替代方案。
Method: 提出VulcanVoxel，使用掩码自编码器在3D占据场上重建刀片占据，以场景几何为条件，在每个体素局部计算可行性，从单峰数据恢复多模态预测。
Result: 在10,000个真实仓库收纳场景上训练，无需人工标注，VulcanVoxel的top-5覆盖率达到0.89，优于最佳姿态基线（0.71）；蒸馏学生模型实现RGB到体素推理30ms，而体素到体素推理需1.4s。
Conclusion: 刀片可供性是空间对象（3D空间的子集），通过几何可行性定义，VulcanVoxel证明了在杂乱收纳任务中利用空间推理而非姿态分布的有效性。

papers.title: Direct Time-of-Flight Measurement Accuracy Improvement With Perimeter-Gated SPADs
papers.abstract_en: Direct time of flight (dToF) measurements are susceptible to errors because of system-level and circuit-level timing jitters. In addition, device-level uncertainty stemming from the dark noise of single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) contributes to the aggregated error. We demonstrate that perimeter gating can help reduce the device-level detection inaccuracy for SPAD devices by reducing the dark noise probability. Specifically, in this work, we developed a general framework to accurately estimate the dToF jitters stemming from different source levels and analyzed a counter-based time to digital converter (TDC) circuit that are commonly used in such systems. We have also measured dToFs using a perimeter-gated SPAD (pg-SPAD) detector fabricated in a 0.35 $μ$m standard CMOS process. Experimental results show that pg-SPADs can improve measurement accuracy in both free-running and time-gated operations.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 7 figures, Accepted in MWSCAS 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对直接飞行时间（dToF）测量中的精度问题，提出使用周界门控（perimeter gating）技术降低SPAD暗噪声概率，从而减少器件级检测误差。作者开发了通用框架估计不同源的抖动，并分析了基于计数器的TDC电路。实验采用0.35μm CMOS工艺制造的pg-SPAD探测器，结果表明周界门控在自由运行和时间门控操作中均能提升测量精度。
Motivation: dToF测量受系统级和电路级时序抖动以及SPAD暗噪声导致的器件级不确定性影响，现有方法精度受限，需要降低器件级误差。
Method: 提出周界门控技术降低SPAD暗噪声概率；建立通用抖动估计框架；分析计数器式TDC电路；并使用0.35μm CMOS工艺的pg-SPAD进行实验验证。
Result: 实验结果显示，pg-SPAD在自由运行和时间门控操作中均能提升dToF测量精度。
Conclusion: 周界门控可有效抑制SPAD暗噪声，为dToF系统提供了一种改善测量精度的器件级方案。

papers.title: Transformer-based Multisensor Data Fusion of Ultrasonic Guided Wave and FBG-based Strain Measurements for Multitask Aerospace Structural Health Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Structural health monitoring (SHM) has emerged as an essential tool for ensuring the integrity and reliability of critical engineering structures, particularly in aerospace applications. Since each sensing technology has its limitations, the fusion of different modalities enables capturing a more complete picture of inhomogeneous materials, like composites. However, effective multisensor data fusion in SHM is often hindered by heterogeneous sensing modalities that operate at disparate sampling frequencies and acquisition intervals. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Transformer-based data fusion framework that integrates multisensor data streams from piezoelectric transducer (PZT) capturing ultrasonic guided wave signals and fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensors for strain measurements. By incorporating an attention-mechanism visualization, the proposed framework enables transparent, multitask learning for both health indicator (HI) prediction and damage localization. The framework was experimentally validated using aircraft composite structures subjected to compression-compression fatigue cyclic loading. For HI prediction, the framework consistently achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) below 0.1, representing a nearly 60% performance improvement over single-sensor approaches (PZT or FBG alone) and baseline deep learning models. For damage localization, the model demonstrated the highest accuracy, maintaining an MAE and RMSE below 0.0465 and 0.1571, respectively. These results demonstrate that the proposed Transformer-based data fusion framework significantly outperforms single-source models and state-of-the-art deep learning models in both HI prediction and damage localization accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的多传感器数据融合框架，集成PZT超声导波信号和FBG应变测量数据，用于航空复合材料结构健康监测的多任务学习（健康指标预测和损伤定位）。在压缩-压缩疲劳循环加载实验验证中，融合模型在健康指标预测任务上MAE和RMSE均低于0.1，相比单传感器方法提升近60%；损伤定位任务上MAE低于0.0465，RMSE低于0.1571。利用注意力机制实现可解释学习，显著优于基线模型。
Motivation: 单一传感技术存在局限性，而多传感器融合常因异质传感模态采样频率和采集间隔不同而受阻，难以有效集成。需要一种能处理异构数据流并实现多任务学习的融合框架。
Method: 提出基于Transformer的数据融合框架，利用注意力机制可视化实现透明多任务学习，同时处理PZT超声导波信号和FBG应变测量数据，进行健康指标预测和损伤定位的联合训练。
Result: 健康指标预测中，MAE和RMSE均低于0.1，比单传感器PZT或FBG单独使用以及基线深度学习模型性能提升约60%。损伤定位中，模型MAE低于0.0465，RMSE低于0.1571，达到最高精度。
Conclusion: 该Transformer多传感器融合框架在航空结构健康监测的多任务场景中显著优于单源模型和现有深度学习方法，证实了融合异构传感数据的有效性。

papers.title: Not Every Sync Is Safe: Calibrated DiLoCo Scheduling for Shared AI Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: DiLoCo-style training reduces communication by letting learner islands train locally before occasional outer synchronization, making it attractive for fragmented industrial AI fleets where training shares hardware with latency-sensitive serving. The question for such fleets is when an outer merge is worth its system cost, and whether choosing \emph{which} windows to defer matters at all. Existing scheduling studies evaluate workload-aware policies against fixed-period baselines, but most omit the control that isolates timing from budget: matched random deferral, which inherits the controller's synchronization budget but is not itself deployable. This omission is consequential: across controlled stress tests and real vLLM sidecar replays, matched random ties or beats every forecast-free policy we test, so gains reported against weaker baselines cannot be attributed to window choice. We fill this gap with Workload-Aware DiLoCo (WA-DiLoCo), a score-based controller that weighs learner progress against fleet pressure, and a calibration protocol that determines when matched random can be beaten, then demonstrate that it can. In the bursty regime where calibration exposes request-overlap structure, adding a one-step EWMA burst forecast to the online controller beats matched random in real vLLM sidecar replay, reducing SLO violations from 6.54\% to 5.09\% (8 of 10 seeds, $p=0.021$); offline Calibrated-WA, a non-deployable bound, shows the remaining headroom at 4.45\% versus 6.26\%. The deployable lesson remains the protocol: report real-sidecar effect-size transfer, a no-sync load match, and a matched-random envelope before claiming serving-SLO improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究DiLoCo风格分布式训练在共享AI基础设施上的同步调度问题，发现现有工作缺乏控制性基线（matched random deferral）导致收益评估不准确。作者提出Workload-Aware DiLoCo (WA-DiLoCo) 评分控制器和校准协议，在突发负载场景下结合EWMA预测，在真实vLLM sidecar重放中降低SLO违规率。
Motivation: 现有调度研究大多使用固定周期基线，但未控制时间选择与预算的独立性，导致报告的性能提升可能并非来自窗口选择本身。需要引入matched random基线并证明何时可以超越它。
Method: 提出WA-DiLoCo，一种基于评分的控制器，权衡学习者进度与集群压力；设计校准协议确定何时能击败matched random；在突发场景下增加一步EWMA突发预测增强在线控制器。
Result: 在真实vLLM sidecar重放中，EWMA在线控制器将SLO违规从6.54%降至5.09%（8/10种子，p=0.021）；离线校准版（Calibrated-WA）显示剩余提升空间：4.45%对比6.26%。
Conclusion: 强调部署时应报告真实sidecar效应量、无同步负载匹配以及matched random包络线，才能可靠声明服务SLO改进。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究DiLoCo风格分布式训练在共享AI基础设施上的同步调度问题，发现现有工作缺乏控制性基线（matched random deferral）导致收益评估不准确。作者提出Workload-Aware DiLoCo (WA-DiLoCo) 评分控制器和校准协议，在突发负载场景下结合EWMA预测，在真实vLLM sidecar重放中降低SLO违规率。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有调度研究大多使用固定周期基线，但未控制时间选择与预算的独立性，导致报告的性能提升可能并非来自窗口选择本身。需要引入matched random基线并证明何时可以超越它。
summary_sections.method: 提出WA-DiLoCo，一种基于评分的控制器，权衡学习者进度与集群压力；设计校准协议确定何时能击败matched random；在突发场景下增加一步EWMA突发预测增强在线控制器。

papers.title: iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose embodied agents must understand multimodal instructions, anticipate how their environment will evolve, and produce precise control actions over extended horizons. Existing approaches typically specialize in visual-language reasoning, video-based world modeling, or action generation, while cascaded pipelines that first synthesize future observations and then infer actions can introduce interface bottlenecks and compound prediction errors. We present iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni, a unified multimodal foundation model that jointly models vision(videos and images), language, and action within a single Omni framework. Its modality-specific visual-language, video-generation, and action-generation components communicate through shared multimodal self-attention. This design establishes brain-cerebellum collaboration: the vision-language modeland video generation model form a high-level brain for instruction understanding, task planning, progress tracking, and future visual-state prediction, whereas the action generation modelserves as a low-level cerebellum that directly converts planned subgoals and shared multimodal context into executable action chunks. To develop these capabilities, we combine action-annotated and action-free embodied videos from human demonstrations and robot interactions with embodied reasoning, embodied perception, and general-purpose image-text data to construct a comprehensive dataset. We further adopt a four-stage strategy that progressively trains the VLM, VGM, and AGM before jointly fine-tuning the complete model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni，一个统一的多模态基础模型，联合建模视觉（视频和图像）、语言和动作。通过共享多模态自注意力实现脑-小脑协作：视觉-语言模型和视频生成模型作为高级脑进行指令理解、任务规划、进度跟踪和未来视觉状态预测，动作生成模型作为低级小脑直接生成可执行动作。采用四阶段训练策略，逐步训练各组件再联合微调。
Motivation: 现有具身智能体通常分别处理视觉-语言推理、视频世界建模或动作生成，级联管道引入接口瓶颈和复合预测误差，需要统一模型以克服这些缺陷。
Method: 提出 Omni 框架，包含视觉-语言模型（VLM）、视频生成模型（VGM）和动作生成模型（AGM），通过共享多模态自注意力通信。采用四阶段训练：先分别训练 VLM、VGM、AGM，再联合微调整个模型。训练数据结合了动作标注和无标注的机器人演示、人类演示以及推理、感知和通用图文数据。
Result: 摘要声称该模型能够理解多模态指令、预测环境演化并产生精确控制动作，但未提供具体定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 该工作通过脑-小脑协作机制实现了多模态理解与动作生成的统一，避免了级联管道的缺点，为通用具身智能体提供了一个统一框架。

papers.title: Beyond Satisfaction: Learning Associations Between Content, Reviews, and Well-Being
papers.abstract_en: Digital platforms commonly optimize for satisfaction using signals such as ratings, likes, and sentiment, implicitly treating satisfaction as a proxy for user well-being. Psychological theory, however, characterizes well-being as a multidimensional construct that extends beyond satisfaction or short-term positivity. In this paper, we examine whether commonly used satisfaction signals capture expressions of well-being, and what types of content are associated with different well-being outcomes. Our study focuses on book consumption, a convenient domain wherein users engage substantially with fixed pieces of content and sometimes provide nuanced long-form feedback. Our results show that (a) rating scales and sentiment only loosely correlate with most facets of psychological well-being and (b) ratings and sentiment are more closely aligned with immediate and hedonic as opposed to enduring and eudaimonic expressions of well-being. Further, by linking reviews to book content, we find that themes related to values, and institutions like religion (Pearson r = 0.35) or human drives (r=.26) are associated with higher meaning and accomplishment respectively, while incivility (avg r = -.15) and past-focused language (avg r = -.12) are associated with lower well-being. These findings motivate richer outcome targets for content recommendation systems beyond satisfaction alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数字平台常用的满意度信号（如评分、点赞）是否能反映用户幸福感，以及内容类型与幸福感不同维度之间的关联。以书籍消费为例，发现评分和情感仅与幸福感微弱相关，更偏向即时享乐而非持久意义。通过将书评与书籍内容关联，识别出价值观、宗教等主题与更高意义感相关，不文明语言和过去导向语言则与较低幸福感相关。
Motivation: 数字平台通常将满意度视为用户幸福感的代理，但心理学认为幸福感是多维的，超越满意或短期积极情绪。本文旨在检验常用满意度信号是否真正捕捉到幸福感的表达，并探索不同内容类型与幸福感结果的关系。
Method: 以书籍消费为研究领域，分析用户评分、情感分析等满意度信号与心理学幸福感多维度指标的相关性，并通过自然语言处理将书评内容与书籍主题关联，计算主题与幸福感维度的相关性。
Result: (a) 评分和情感大多数情况下与心理幸福感各维度仅弱相关；(b) 评分和情感更接近即时享乐而非持久意义表达；价值观、宗教等主题与更高意义感相关（Pearson r = 0.35），不文明语言（平均 r = -0.15）和过去导向语言（平均 r = -0.12）与较低幸福感相关。
Conclusion: 研究结果建议内容推荐系统应考虑更丰富的结果目标，而不仅仅是满意度。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Domain-Invariant Feature Learning with Autoencoder-Driven Gaussian Clustering for Robust Non-line-of-Sight Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Jamming and spoofing pose significant threats to wireless and satellite navigation by disrupting radio-frequency (RF) signals and compromising availability and integrity. Robust RF interference direction finding through angle-of-arrival (AoA) estimation is therefore essential for detecting and localizing anomalous signals. Although data-driven methods perform well under line-of-sight (LoS) conditions, their performance degrades in practical environments due to non-line-of-sight (NLoS) multipath propagation. In this work, we propose a hybrid learning framework that incorporates physics-informed constraints into deep neural networks to improve the robustness of AoA estimation. A neural network is trained to estimate the azimuth and elevation of incoming signals received by a four-element antenna array, while a physics-informed loss enforces consistency between the predicted angles and inter-antenna phase differences under a plane-wave model. We further introduce a latent-space classifier to distinguish LoS from NLoS samples. Since inter-antenna phase differences under LoS propagation exhibit domain-invariant structure across environments, the physics-based loss is applied only to LoS samples, promoting physically consistent and domain-invariant representations without over-constraining the model in NLoS scenarios. In addition, domain-incremental learning (DIL) across NLoS environments with varying scatterer distributions improves cross-domain generalization. Evaluations on real-world datasets show that the proposed method reduces AoA estimation error by up to 6° in low-exemplar settings compared with DIL baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合学习框架，将物理信息约束融入深度神经网络，以提升非视距（NLoS）场景下到达角（AoA）估计的鲁棒性。方法包括：使用神经网络估计四元天线阵列接收信号的方位角和俯仰角，通过物理信息损失函数确保预测角度与天线间相位差在平面波模型下的一致性；引入潜在空间分类器区分视距（LoS）和NLoS样本，仅对LoS样本施加物理损失以促进域不变表示；采用域增量学习（DIL）在不同NLoS环境下提升跨域泛化。在真实数据集上，该方法在低样本设置下相比DIL基线降低了多达6°的AoA估计误差。
Motivation: 干扰和欺骗威胁无线和卫星导航系统，需要鲁棒的RF干扰测向。现有数据驱动方法在LoS条件下表现良好，但在NLoS多径传播下性能下降。
Method: 提出混合学习框架：1) 神经网络用于估计AoA；2) 物理信息损失强制平面波模型下预测角度与相位差的一致性；3) 潜在空间分类器区分LoS/NLoS，仅对LoS施加物理损失；4) 域增量学习提升跨域泛化。
Result: 在真实数据集上，低样本设置下AoA估计误差比DIL基线降低最多6°。
Conclusion: 物理信息约束和域增量学习可提升NLoS场景下的AoA估计鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0
